  | pos₀ b i u v => exact .pos₁ b i u v
  | pos₁ b i u v => exact .pos₂ b i u v
  | pos₂ b i u v => exact .pos₀ b i u v
  | neg₀ b i u v => exact .neg₁ b i u v
  | neg₁ b i u v => exact .neg₂ b i u v
  | neg₂ b i u v => exact .neg₀ b i u v

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.TriangleFace.mirror
statement:
theorem TriangleFace.mirror {a b c : d.OrientedEdge} (h : d.TriangleFace a b c) :
    d.TriangleFace (d.flipEdge a) (d.flipEdge c) (d.flipEdge b)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | pos₀ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.neg₀ (d := d) b i u v
  | pos₁ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.neg₂ (d := d) b i u v
  | pos₂ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.neg₁ (d := d) b i u v
  | neg₀ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.pos₀ (d := d) b i u v
  | neg₁ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.pos₂ (d := d) b i u v
  | neg₂ b i u v => simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.pos₁ (d := d) b i u v

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.rawMove_filled
statement:
theorem rawMove_filled {a c : d.RawPaths} {p q : a ⟶ c} (h : d.RawMove p q) :
    FilledBetween d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace (d.rawWord p) (d.rawWord q)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | backtrack h =>
    cases h with
    | step a c f =>
      change Fillable d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace
        (reverseWord d.flipEdge [d.orientedLabel f,d.orientedLabel (Quiver.reverse f)])
      rw [d.orientedLabel_reverse]
      simp only [reverseWord_cons,reverseWord_nil,List.nil_append,
        flipEdge_flipEdge,List.singleton_append]
      exact ⟨TriangleFilling.backtrack (d.flipEdge_flipEdge) (d.orientedLabel f)⟩
  | triangle b i u v =>
    change Nonempty (TriangleFilling d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace
      [d.orientedL b i u v, d.orientedX i u v, d.flipEdge (d.orientedR b i u v)])
    exact ⟨TriangleFilling.triangle d.flipEdge_flipEdge (fun _ _ _ => TriangleFace.rotate d)
      _ _ _ rfl rfl rfl (by simpa only [flipEdge_flipEdge] using TriangleFace.neg₀ (d := d) b i u v)⟩

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.rawHomotopic_filled
statement:
theorem rawHomotopic_filled {a c : d.RawPaths} {p q : a ⟶ c} (h : d.RawHomotopic p q) :
    FilledBetween d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace (d.rawWord p) (d.rawWord q)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel p q h =>
    cases h with
    | intro a c u p q v h =>
      rw [d.rawWord_comp,d.rawWord_comp,d.rawWord_comp,d.rawWord_comp]
      exact FilledBetween.whiskerLeft d.flipEdge_flipEdge (d.rawWord_typed u)
        ((d.rawWord_typed p).append (d.rawWord_typed v))
        ((d.rawWord_typed q).append (d.rawWord_typed v))
        (FilledBetween.whiskerRight d.flipEdge_flipEdge (d.rawWord_typed p)
          (d.rawWord_typed q) (d.rawWord_typed v) (d.rawMove_filled h))
  | refl p => exact FilledBetween.refl d.flipEdge_flipEdge (d.rawWord_typed p)
  | symm p q _ ih =>
    exact FilledBetween.symm d.flipEdge_flipEdge
      (fun _ _ _ => TriangleFace.mirror d) ih
  | trans p q s _ _ ih ih' =>
    exact FilledBetween.trans d.flipEdge_flipEdge d.edgeTarget_ne
      (d.rawWord_typed p) (d.rawWord_typed q) (d.rawWord_typed s) ih ih'

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.nullhomotopic_fillable
statement:
theorem nullhomotopic_fillable {a : d.RawPaths} {p : a ⟶ a} (h : d.RawHomotopic p (𝟙 a)) :
    Fillable d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace (d.rawWord p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [FilledBetween,rawWord_nil,reverseWord_nil,List.append_nil] using
    d.rawHomotopic_filled h

/
planar triangular filling. This lemma has no geometric hypothesis. -/

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.rectangle_fillable_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem rectangle_fillable_of_eq_one (i : I) (u u' v v' : Fin r)
    (h : d.x i u v * (d.x i u' v)⁻¹ * d.x i u' v' * (d.x i u v')⁻¹ = 1) :
    Fillable d.flipEdge d.edgeTarget d.TriangleFace
      [d.orientedX i u v, d.flipEdge (d.orientedX i u' v),
       d.orientedX i u' v', d.flipEdge (d.orientedX i u v')]
proof:
:= by
  exact d.nullhomotopic_fillable (d.rawRectangle_nullhomotopic_of_eq_one i u u' v v' h)

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.TriangleFace.colors
statement:
theorem TriangleFace.colors {a b c : d.OrientedEdge} (h : d.TriangleFace a b c) :
    d.edgeTarget a ≠ d.edgeTarget b ∧ d.edgeTarget b ≠ d.edgeTarget c ∧
    d.edgeTarget c ≠ d.edgeTarget a
proof:
:= by
  cases h <;> simp [orientedL,orientedX,orientedR,flipEdge,edgeTarget]

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.TriangleFace.typed
statement:
theorem TriangleFace.typed {a b c : d.OrientedEdge} (h : d.TriangleFace a b c) :
    d.edgeTarget (d.flipEdge b) = d.edgeTarget a ∧
    d.edgeTarget (d.flipEdge c) = d.edgeTarget b ∧
    d.edgeTarget (d.flipEdge a) = d.edgeTarget c
proof:
:= by
  cases h <;> simp [orientedL,orientedX,orientedR,flipEdge,edgeTarget]

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.TriangleFace.unique_aux
proof:
:= by
  cases h <;> cases h' <;>
    simp only [orientedL,orientedX,orientedR,flipEdge,Prod.mk.injEq,
      Sum.inl.injEq,Sum.inr.injEq,Sum.inl_ne_inr,Sum.inr_ne_inl,
      Bool.not_true,and_true,false_and] at ha hb ⊢
  all_goals
    first
    | have hbb := congrArg Sigma.fst ha; cases hbb
    | have hbb := congrArg Sigma.fst hb; cases hbb
  all_goals simp only [Sigma.mk.inj_iff,heq_eq_eq,Prod.mk.injEq,Subtype.val_inj,true_and] at ha hb ⊢
  case pos₀.pos₀ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases hb with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
    simp
  case pos₁.pos₁ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases ha with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
    simp
  case pos₂.pos₂ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases ha with ⟨rfl,hβ⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨rfl,hα⟩
    have hi := (d.block b).coordinates.injective
      (Prod.ext (add_right_cancel hα) (add_right_cancel hβ))
    subst i'
    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  case neg₀.neg₀ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases ha with ⟨rfl,hα⟩
    rcases hb with ⟨rfl,hβ⟩
    have hi := (d.block b).coordinates.injective
      (Prod.ext (add_right_cancel hα) (add_right_cancel hβ))
    subst i'
    exact ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
  case neg₁.neg₁ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases hb with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
    simp
  case neg₂.neg₂ b i u v u' v' i' =>
    rcases ha with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩
    simp

name: OAI.Release075.BlockPresentation.TriangleFace.unique
statement:
theorem TriangleFace.unique {a b c c' : d.OrientedEdge}
    (h : d.TriangleFace a b c) (h' : d.TriangleFace a b c') : c = c'
proof:
:=
  TriangleFace.unique_aux d h h' rfl rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.of_mul_stable
statement:
lemma of_mul_stable (f : Monoid.End U) (x : U) :
    of f x * stable f = stable f * of f (f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
  change QuotientGroup.mk' (relations f) (relation f x) = 1
  exact (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨x,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.stable_conjugate
statement:
lemma stable_conjugate (f : Monoid.End U) (x : U) :
    stable f * of f (f x) * (stable f)⁻¹ = of f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← of_mul_stable, mul_inv_cancel_right]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.inverse_conjugate
statement:
lemma inverse_conjugate (f : Monoid.End U) (x : U) :
    (stable f)⁻¹ * of f x * stable f = of f (f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, of_mul_stable, inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.lift_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_of (f : Monoid.End U) (φ : U →* V) (t : V)
    (h : ∀ x, φ x * t = t * φ (f x)) (x : U) :
    lift f φ t h (of f x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  change Coprod.lift φ (zpowersHom V t) (inl x) = _
  simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.lift_stable
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_stable (f : Monoid.End U) (φ : U →* V) (t : V)
    (h : ∀ x, φ x * t = t * φ (f x)) :
    lift f φ t h (stable f) = t
proof:
:= by
  change Coprod.lift φ (zpowersHom V t) (inr (ofAdd 1)) = _
  simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.cancel_right (QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relations f))).mp
  apply Coprod.hom_ext ho
  exact MonoidHom.ext_mint ht

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective (f : Monoid.End U) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (of f)
proof:
:= by
  let e : (⊤ : Subgroup U) ≃* f.range :=
    (Subgroup.topEquiv).trans (MonoidHom.ofInjective hf)
  let H := HNNExtension U ⊤ f.range e
  let j : U →* H := HNNExtension.of
  let s : H := HNNExtension.t
  have hs (x : U) : j x * s⁻¹ = s⁻¹ * j (f x) := by
    exact HNNExtension.of_mul_inv_t (⟨x,Subgroup.mem_top x⟩ : (⊤ : Subgroup U))
  let Φ : Torus f →* H := lift f j s⁻¹ hs
  intro x y hxy
  apply HNNExtension.of_injective (A := ⊤) (B := f.range) (φ := e)
  exact (lift_of f j s⁻¹ hs x).symm.trans
    ((congrArg Φ hxy).trans (lift_of f j s⁻¹ hs y))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.forward_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma forward_of (x : U) :
    forward a b (of (b.comp a) x) = of (a.comp b) (a x)
proof:
:=
  lift_of _ _ _ _ x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.forward_stable
statement:
@[simp] lemma forward_stable :
    forward a b (stable (b.comp a)) = stable (a.comp b)
proof: := lift_stable _ _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.backward_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma backward_of (p : P) :
    backward a b (of (a.comp b) p) =
      stable (b.comp a) * of (b.comp a) (b p) * (stable (b.comp a))⁻¹
proof:
:=
  lift_of _ _ _ _ p

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.backward_stable
statement:
@[simp] lemma backward_stable :
    backward a b (stable (a.comp b)) = stable (b.comp a)
proof: := lift_stable _ _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.backward_forward
statement: lemma backward_forward : (backward a b).comp (forward a b) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  · ext x
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, forward_of, backward_of, MonoidHom.id_apply]
    exact stable_conjugate (b.comp a) x
  · simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.forward_backward
statement: lemma forward_backward : (forward a b).comp (backward a b) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  · ext p
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, backward_of, map_mul, map_inv, forward_stable,
      forward_of, MonoidHom.id_apply]
    exact stable_conjugate (a.comp b) p
  · simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.relations_finitelyNormallyGenerated
statement:
lemma relations_finitelyNormallyGenerated [Group.FG U] (f : Monoid.End U) :
    (relations f).IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := (Group.FG.out : (⊤ : Subgroup U).FG)
  let N : Subgroup (Free U) := Subgroup.normalClosure (relation f '' (S : Set U))
  let Q := Free U ⧸ N
  let q : Free U →* Q := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  let t : Q := q letter
  let i : U →* Q := q.comp inl
  let j : U →* Q := (MulAut.conj t).toMonoidHom.comp (i.comp f)
  let E : Subgroup U :=
    { carrier := {x | i x = j x}
      one_mem' := by simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq,map_one]
      mul_mem' := by
        intro x y hx hy
        change i (x*y) = j (x*y)
        rw [map_mul,map_mul,hx,hy]
      inv_mem' := by
        intro x hx
        change i x⁻¹ = j x⁻¹
        rw [map_inv,map_inv,hx] }
  have hSsub : (S : Set U) ⊆ E := by
    intro x hx
    have hw : q (relation f x) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩)
    have he : i x * t = t * i (f x) := by
      apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
      exact hw
    change i x = t * i (f x) * t⁻¹
    rw [← he,mul_inv_cancel_right]
  have htop : (⊤ : Subgroup U) ≤ E := by
    rw [← hS]
    exact (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr hSsub
  have he (x : U) : i x = t * i (f x) * t⁻¹ := htop (Subgroup.mem_top x)
  refine ⟨relation f '' (S : Set U), S.finite_toSet.image _, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_mono
    rintro _ ⟨x,_,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x,rfl⟩
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨x,rfl⟩
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp
    change (i x * t) * (t * i (f x))⁻¹ = 1
    rw [mul_inv_eq_one]
    rw [he x,inv_mul_cancel_right]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.finitelyPresented_of_factorization
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_of_factorization {P : Type v} [Group P]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented P] (a : U →* P) (b : P →* U) :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (Torus (b.comp a))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.of_mul_stable_pow
statement:
lemma of_mul_stable_pow (f : Monoid.End U) (u : U) (n : ℕ) :
    of f u * stable f ^ n = stable f ^ n * of f ((f ^ n) u)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ih, mul_assoc, of_mul_stable, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]
    rw [pow_succ' f n]
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.inv_stable_pow_mul_of
statement:
lemma inv_stable_pow_mul_of (f : Monoid.End U) (u : U) (n : ℕ) :
    (stable f ^ n)⁻¹ * of f u = of f ((f ^ n) u) * (stable f ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_right_cancel (b := stable f ^ n)
  simp only [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel, mul_one]
  rw [of_mul_stable_pow, inv_mul_cancel_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.of_mem_normalForms
statement: lemma of_mem_normalForms (f : Monoid.End U) (u : U) : of f u ∈ normalForms f
proof:
:=
  ⟨0,0,u,by simp⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.stable_mem_normalForms
statement: lemma stable_mem_normalForms (f : Monoid.End U) : stable f ∈ normalForms f

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.normal_form
statement:
theorem normal_form (f : Monoid.End U) (x : Torus f) :
    ∃ (p q : ℕ) (u : U), x = stable f ^ p * of f u * (stable f ^ q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ normalForms f
  obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk'_surjective (relations f) x
  induction w using Coprod.induction_on with
  | inl u => exact of_mem_normalForms f u
  | inr z =>
    have hz : inr z = (letter (U := U)) ^ toAdd z := by
      rw [letter,← map_zpow]
      congr 1
      change z = ofAdd ((toAdd z) • (1 : ℤ))
      simp
    rw [hz,map_zpow]
    exact (normalForms f).zpow_mem (stable_mem_normalForms f) _
  | mul x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_mul]
    exact (normalForms f).mul_mem hx hy

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.height_of
statement: @[simp] lemma height_of (f : Monoid.End U) (u : U) : height f (of f u) = 1
proof:
:=
  lift_of f 1 (ofAdd 1) _ u

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.height_stable
statement: @[simp] lemma height_stable (f : Monoid.End U) : height f (stable f) = ofAdd 1
proof:
:=
  lift_stable f 1 (ofAdd 1) _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.coset_mul_of
statement:
lemma coset_mul_of (f : Monoid.End U) (x : Torus f) (u : U) :
    coset f (x * of f u) = coset f x
proof:
:=
  QuotientGroup.mk_mul_of_mem x ⟨u,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.next_coset
statement:
@[simp] lemma next_coset (f : Monoid.End U) (x : Torus f) :
    next f (coset f x) = coset f (x * stable f)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.next_iterate_coset
statement:
lemma next_iterate_coset (f : Monoid.End U) (k : ℕ) (x : Torus f) :
    (next f)^[k] (coset f x) = coset f (x * stable f ^ k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply',ih,next_coset,pow_succ,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.reaches_base_ray
statement:
lemma reaches_base_ray (f : Monoid.End U) (c : Coset f) :
    ∃ (p q : ℕ), (next f)^[q] c = (next f)^[p] (coset f 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective c
  obtain ⟨p,q,u,hx⟩ := normal_form f x
  refine ⟨p,q,?_⟩
  change (next f)^[q] (coset f x) = _
  rw [next_iterate_coset,next_iterate_coset,hx,mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel,mul_one,one_mul,coset_mul_of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.common_descendant
statement:
lemma common_descendant (f : Monoid.End U) (c d : Coset f) :
    ∃ (p q : ℕ), (next f)^[p] c = (next f)^[q] d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,hc⟩ := reaches_base_ray f c
  obtain ⟨r,s,hd⟩ := reaches_base_ray f d
  refine ⟨r+q,p+s,?_⟩
  rw [Function.iterate_add_apply,Function.iterate_add_apply,hc,hd,
    ← Function.iterate_add_apply,← Function.iterate_add_apply,Nat.add_comm r p]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.cosetHeight_coset
statement:
@[simp] lemma cosetHeight_coset (f : Monoid.End U) (x : Torus f) :
    cosetHeight f (coset f x) = toAdd (height f x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.height_next
statement:
lemma height_next (f : Monoid.End U) (c : Coset f) :
    cosetHeight f (next f c) = cosetHeight f c + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction c using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
  | H x =>
    change cosetHeight f (next f (coset f x)) = cosetHeight f (coset f x) + 1
    rw [next_coset,cosetHeight_coset,cosetHeight_coset,map_mul,height_stable]
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.coset_origin
statement:
@[simp] lemma coset_origin (f : Monoid.End U) (c : Coset f) :
    coset f (origin f c) = c
proof: := Quotient.out_eq' c

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.origin_next_mem
statement:
lemma origin_next_mem (f : Monoid.End U) (c : Coset f) :
    (origin f (next f c))⁻¹ * (origin f c * stable f) ∈ (of f).range
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientGroup.eq.mp
  change coset f (origin f (next f c)) = coset f (origin f c * stable f)
  rw [coset_origin,← next_coset,coset_origin]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.origin_next
statement:
lemma origin_next (f : Monoid.End U) (c : Coset f) :
    origin f (next f c) * of f (cosetOffset f c) = origin f c * stable f
proof:
:= by
  change origin f (next f c) * of f (Classical.choose (origin_next_mem f c)) = _
  rw [Classical.choose_spec (origin_next_mem f c),mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.smul_coset
statement: lemma smul_coset (g x : Torus f) : g • coset f x = coset f (g*x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.next_smul
statement: lemma next_smul (g : Torus f) (c : Coset f) : next f (g • c) = g • next f c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using QuotientGroup.induction_on with
  | H x => change coset f ((g*x)*stable f) = coset f (g*(x*stable f)); rw [mul_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.origin_action_mem
statement:
lemma origin_action_mem (g : Torus f) (c : Coset f) :
    (origin f (g • c))⁻¹ * (g * origin f c) ∈ (of f).range
proof:
:= by
  apply QuotientGroup.eq.mp
  change coset f (origin f (g • c)) = coset f (g * origin f c)
  rw [coset_origin,← smul_coset,coset_origin]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.origin_action
statement:
lemma origin_action (g : Torus f) (c : Coset f) :
    origin f (g • c) * of f (actionOffset f g c) = g * origin f c
proof:
:= by
  rw [actionOffset,Classical.choose_spec (origin_action_mem f g c),mul_inv_cancel_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.actionOffset_one
statement: lemma actionOffset_one (c : Coset f) : actionOffset f 1 c = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply of_injective f hf
  have h := origin_action f 1 c
  rw [one_smul,one_mul] at h
  exact (mul_left_cancel (h.trans (mul_one _).symm)).trans (map_one _).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.actionOffset_mul
statement:
lemma actionOffset_mul (g h : Torus f) (c : Coset f) :
    actionOffset f (g*h) c = actionOffset f g (h • c) * actionOffset f h c
proof:
:= by
  apply of_injective f hf
  apply mul_left_cancel (a := origin f ((g*h) • c))
  rw [map_mul,origin_action,mul_smul,←mul_assoc,origin_action]
  rw [mul_assoc,mul_assoc,origin_action]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.AscendingTorus.actionOffset_next
statement:
lemma actionOffset_next (g : Torus f) (c : Coset f) :
    actionOffset f g (next f c) * cosetOffset f c =
      cosetOffset f (g • c) * f (actionOffset f g c)
proof:
:= by
  apply of_injective f hf
  apply mul_left_cancel (a := origin f (next f (g • c)))
  calc
    origin f (next f (g • c)) * of f (actionOffset f g (next f c) * cosetOffset f c) =
        (origin f (g • next f c) * of f (actionOffset f g (next f c))) * of f (cosetOffset f c) := by rw [map_mul,←mul_assoc,next_smul]
    _ = g * (origin f (next f c) * of f (cosetOffset f c)) := by rw [origin_action,mul_assoc]
    _ = g * (origin f c * stable f) := by rw [origin_next]
    _ = (origin f (g • c) * of f (actionOffset f g c)) * stable f := by rw [origin_action,mul_assoc]
    _ = (origin f (g • c) * stable f) * of f (f (actionOffset f g c)) := by rw [mul_assoc,of_mul_stable,←mul_assoc]
    _ = (origin f (next f (g • c)) * of f (cosetOffset f (g • c))) * of f (f (actionOffset f g c)) := by rw [origin_next]
    _ = origin f (next f (g • c)) * of f (cosetOffset f (g • c) * f (actionOffset f g c)) := by rw [map_mul,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_boundary
statement: lemma continuous_boundary (n : ℕ) : Continuous (boundary n)
proof:
:=
  continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_interior
statement: lemma continuous_interior (n : ℕ) : Continuous (interior n)
proof:
:=
  continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.boundary_closedEmbedding
statement: lemma boundary_closedEmbedding (n : ℕ) : IsClosedEmbedding (boundary n)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_boundary n).isClosedEmbedding (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : Disk n => z.1) h))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.quotient_inl
statement: @[simp] lemma quotient_inl (x : X) : quotient a (Sum.inl x) = Sum.inl x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.quotient_interior
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotient_interior (i : ι) (x : OpenDisk n) :
    quotient a (Sum.inr ⟨i,interior n x⟩) = Sum.inr ⟨i,x⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact dite_eq_left x.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.quotient_boundary
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotient_boundary (i : ι) (x : Sphere n) :
    quotient a (Sum.inr ⟨i,boundary n x⟩) = Sum.inl (a i x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x.1 ∉ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1 := by
    simpa only [mem_ball,mem_sphere,x.2,lt_self_iff_false,not_false_eq_true] using
      (sphere_disjoint_ball.notMem_of_mem_left x.2)
  exact dite_eq_right hx

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.quotient_surjective
statement: lemma quotient_surjective : Function.Surjective (quotient a)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  cases z with
  | inl x => exact ⟨Sum.inl x,rfl⟩
  | inr p => exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨p.1,interior n p.2⟩,quotient_interior a p.1 p.2⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_quotient
statement: lemma continuous_quotient : Continuous (quotient a)
proof: := continuous_coinduced_rng

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_base
statement: lemma continuous_base : Continuous (base a)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_quotient a).comp continuous_inl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.cell_boundary
statement:
@[simp] lemma cell_boundary (i : ι) (x : Sphere n) :
    cell a i (boundary n x) = base a (a i x)
proof: := quotient_boundary a i x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.cell_interior
statement:
@[simp] lemma cell_interior (i : ι) (x : OpenDisk n) :
    cell a i (interior n x) = Sum.inr ⟨i,x⟩
proof: := quotient_interior a i x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_iff {Y : Type w} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : Space a → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ Continuous (f ∘ base a) ∧ ∀ i, Continuous (f ∘ cell a i)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous[TopologicalSpace.coinduced (quotient a) inferInstance,_] f ↔ _
  rw [continuous_coinduced_dom,continuous_sum_dom,continuous_sigma_iff]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.isClosed_iff
statement:
lemma isClosed_iff (S : Set (Space a)) :
    IsClosed S ↔ IsClosed (base a ⁻¹' S) ∧ ∀ i, IsClosed (cell a i ⁻¹' S)
proof:
:= by
  change @IsClosed _ (TopologicalSpace.coinduced (quotient a) inferInstance) S ↔ _
  rw [isClosed_coinduced,isClosed_sum_iff,isClosed_sigma_iff]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.cell_preimage_base_image
statement:
lemma cell_preimage_base_image (i : ι) (S : Set X) :
    cell a i ⁻¹' (base a '' S) = boundary n '' ((a i) ⁻¹' S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext d
  by_cases h : d.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
  · have hd : d = interior n ⟨d.1,h⟩ := rfl
    rw [hd]
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,cell_interior,base,Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x,_,hx⟩; cases hx
    · rintro ⟨x,_,hx⟩
      have heq := congrArg (fun d : Disk n => d.1) hx
      have hh : x.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1 := heq ▸ h
      exact False.elim ((sphere_disjoint_ball.notMem_of_mem_left x.2) hh)
  · let x : Sphere n := ⟨d.1,by
      have hd := d.2
      simp only [mem_closedBall,mem_ball,mem_sphere] at *
      exact le_antisymm hd (le_of_not_gt h)⟩
    have hd : d = boundary n x := rfl
    rw [hd]
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,cell_boundary,Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,hy,hyx⟩
      have heq : y = a i x := Sum.inl_injective hyx
      exact ⟨x,heq ▸ hy,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y,hy,hyx⟩
      have heq : y = x := Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun d : Disk n => d.1) hyx)
      subst y
      exact ⟨a i x,hy,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.base_isClosedMap
statement: lemma base_isClosedMap : IsClosedMap (base a)
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  rw [isClosed_iff]
  constructor
  · have heq : base a ⁻¹' (base a '' S) = S :=
      Set.preimage_image_eq S Sum.inl_injective
    exact heq.symm ▸ hS
  · intro i
    rw [cell_preimage_base_image]
    exact (boundary_closedEmbedding n).isClosedMap _ (hS.preimage (a i).continuous)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.base_closedEmbedding
statement: lemma base_closedEmbedding : IsClosedEmbedding (base a)
proof:
:=
  IsClosedEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isClosedMap
    (continuous_base a) Sum.inl_injective (base_isClosedMap a)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.lift_base
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_base {Y : Type w} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X,Y))
    (g : ι → C(Disk n,Y)) (h : ∀ i x, g i (boundary n x) = f (a i x)) (x : X) :
    lift a f g h (base a x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.lift_cell
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_cell {Y : Type w} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X,Y))
    (g : ι → C(Disk n,Y)) (h : ∀ i x, g i (boundary n x) = f (a i x))
    (i : ι) (d : Disk n) : lift a f g h (cell a i d) = g i d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hd : d.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
  · have heq : d = interior n ⟨d.1,hd⟩ := rfl
    rw [heq,cell_interior]
    rfl
  · let x : Sphere n := ⟨d.1,by
      have hm := d.2
      simp only [mem_closedBall,mem_ball,mem_sphere] at *
      exact le_antisymm hm (le_of_not_gt hd)⟩
    have heq : d = boundary n x := rfl
    rw [heq,cell_boundary,lift_base,h]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.lift_unique
statement:
lemma lift_unique {Y : Type w} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f g : C(Space a,Y))
    (hb : ∀ x, f (base a x) = g (base a x))
    (hc : ∀ i d, f (cell a i d) = g (cell a i d)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  obtain ⟨q,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective a z
  cases q with
  | inl x => exact hb x
  | inr p => exact hc p.1 p.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.interior_openEmbedding
statement: lemma interior_openEmbedding (n : ℕ) : IsOpenEmbedding (interior n)
proof:
:=
  .inclusion ball_subset_closedBall (isOpen_ball.preimage continuous_subtype_val)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.openCell_eq
statement: lemma openCell_eq (i : ι) : openCell a i = cell a i ∘ interior n
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  exact (cell_interior a i x).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.quotient_preimage_openCell_image
statement:
lemma quotient_preimage_openCell_image (i : ι) (S : Set (OpenDisk n)) :
    quotient a ⁻¹' (openCell a i '' S) =
      Sum.inr '' (Sigma.mk i '' (interior n '' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext q
  cases q with
  | inl x =>
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage,quotient_inl,Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,_,hy⟩; cases hy
    · rintro ⟨y,_,hy⟩; cases hy
  | inr p =>
    by_cases hp : p.2.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
    · have heq : p.2 = interior n ⟨p.2.1,hp⟩ := rfl
      change (∃ x ∈ S, openCell a i x = quotient a (Sum.inr ⟨p.1,p.2⟩)) ↔ _
      rw [heq,quotient_interior]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x,hx,he⟩
        have hh : (⟨i,x⟩ : Σ _ : ι, OpenDisk n) = ⟨p.1,⟨p.2.1,hp⟩⟩ := Sum.inr_injective he
        have hh' : (⟨i,interior n x⟩ : Σ _ : ι, Disk n) = ⟨p.1,p.2⟩ :=
          congrArg (fun p : Σ _ : ι, OpenDisk n => (⟨p.1,interior n p.2⟩ : Σ _ : ι, Disk n)) hh
        exact ⟨⟨i,interior n x⟩,⟨interior n x,⟨x,hx,rfl⟩,rfl⟩,congrArg Sum.inr hh'⟩
      · rintro ⟨y,⟨d,⟨x,hx,hxd⟩,hdy⟩,hy⟩
        subst d; subst y
        have hh := Sum.inr_injective hy
        have hi : i = p.1 := congrArg Sigma.fst hh
        subst i
        have hh' : interior n x = interior n ⟨p.2.1,hp⟩ := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hh).2
        have he : x = ⟨p.2.1,hp⟩ := (interior_openEmbedding n).injective hh'
        exact ⟨x,hx,by subst x; rfl⟩
    · let x : Sphere n := ⟨p.2.1,by
        have hm := p.2.2
        simp only [mem_closedBall,mem_ball,mem_sphere] at *
        exact le_antisymm hm (le_of_not_gt hp)⟩
      have heq : p.2 = boundary n x := rfl
      change (∃ y ∈ S, openCell a i y = quotient a (Sum.inr ⟨p.1,p.2⟩)) ↔ _
      rw [heq,quotient_boundary]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y,_,hy⟩; cases hy
      · rintro ⟨y,⟨d,⟨z,_,hzd⟩,hdy⟩,hy⟩
        subst d; subst y
        have hh := Sum.inr_injective hy
        have hi : i = p.1 := congrArg Sigma.fst hh
        subst i
        have hh' : interior n z = boundary n x := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hh).2
        have hh'' := congrArg (fun d : Disk n => d.1) hh'
        exact False.elim (hp (hh'' ▸ z.2))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.openCell_openEmbedding
statement: lemma openCell_openEmbedding (i : ι) : IsOpenEmbedding (openCell a i)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap
  · rw [openCell_eq]
    exact (cell a i).continuous.comp (continuous_interior n)
  · intro x y h
    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp (Sum.inr_injective h)).2
  · intro S hS
    change @IsOpen _ (TopologicalSpace.coinduced (quotient a) inferInstance) _
    rw [isOpen_coinduced,quotient_preimage_openCell_image]
    exact isOpenMap_inr _ (isOpenMap_sigmaMk _ ((interior_openEmbedding n).isOpenMap S hS))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.exists_real_extension
statement:
lemma exists_real_extension (f : C(X,ℝ)) :
    ∃ F : C(Space a,ℝ), ∀ x, F (base a x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hi (i : ι) : ∃ g : C(Disk n,ℝ), ∀ x, g (boundary n x) = f (a i x) := by
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := (f.comp (a i)).exists_extension' (boundary_closedEmbedding n)
    exact ⟨g,fun x => congrFun hg x⟩
  choose g hg using hi
  exact ⟨lift a f g hg,fun x => lift_base a f g hg x⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.RealSeparated.t2Space
statement:
lemma RealSeparated.t2Space {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (h : RealSeparated Y) :
    T2Space Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := h x y hxy
  exact separated_by_continuous f.continuous hf

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.realSeparated_of_tychonoff
statement:
lemma realSeparated_of_tychonoff {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [T1Space Y] [CompletelyRegularSpace Y] : RealSeparated Y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hfx,hfy⟩ := CompletelyRegularSpace.completely_regular x {y} isClosed_singleton
    (by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hxy)
  refine ⟨⟨fun q => (f q : ℝ),continuous_subtype_val.comp hf⟩,?_⟩
  change (f x : ℝ) ≠ (f y : ℝ)
  rw [hfx,hfy (Set.mem_singleton y)]
  norm_num

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.exists_interior_separator
statement:
lemma exists_interior_separator [T1Space X] (i : ι) (x : OpenDisk n) (z : Space a)
    (hxz : openCell a i x ≠ z) :
    ∃ F : C(Space a,ℝ), F (openCell a i x) = 1 ∧ F z = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K : Set (Disk n) := Set.range (boundary n) ∪ cell a i ⁻¹' {z}
  have hKc : IsClosed K := by

    have hz : IsClosed (cell a i ⁻¹' {z}) := by
      cases z with
      | inl y =>
        have heq : ({base a y} : Set (Space a)) = base a '' {y} :=
          Set.image_singleton.symm
        change IsClosed (cell a i ⁻¹' {base a y})
        rw [heq,cell_preimage_base_image]

        exact (boundary_closedEmbedding n).isClosedMap _
          (isClosed_singleton.preimage (a i).continuous)
      | inr p =>
        have heq : ({openCell a p.1 p.2} : Set (Space a)) = openCell a p.1 '' {p.2} :=
          Set.image_singleton.symm
        have hpre := quotient_preimage_openCell_image a p.1 ({p.2} : Set (OpenDisk n))
        have hclosed : IsClosed (quotient a ⁻¹' {Sum.inr p}) := by
          change IsClosed (quotient a ⁻¹' {openCell a p.1 p.2})
          rw [heq,hpre]
          exact isClosedMap_inr _ (isClosedMap_sigmaMk _
            ((isCompact_singleton.image (continuous_interior n)).isClosed))
        exact hclosed.preimage (continuous_inr.comp continuous_sigmaMk)
    exact (boundary_closedEmbedding n).isClosed_range.union hz
  have hxK : interior n x ∉ K := by
    rintro (hx | hx)
    · obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hx
      have heq := congrArg (fun d : Disk n => d.1) hs
      exact sphere_disjoint_ball.notMem_of_mem_left s.2 (heq ▸ x.2)
    · change cell a i (interior n x) = z at hx
      exact hxz ((cell_interior a i x).symm.trans hx)
  obtain ⟨f,hf0,hf1,_⟩ := exists_continuous_zero_one_of_isClosed hKc
    (isClosed_singleton (x := interior n x)) (Set.disjoint_singleton_right.mpr hxK)
  let g : ι → C(Disk n,ℝ) := fun j => if j = i then f else ContinuousMap.const _ 0
  have hgb (j : ι) (s : Sphere n) : g j (boundary n s) = (0 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [g]
    split_ifs with hji
    · exact hf0 (Set.mem_union_left _ (Set.mem_range_self s))
    · rfl
  let F : C(Space a,ℝ) := lift a (ContinuousMap.const _ 0) g hgb
  have hFcell (j : ι) (d : Disk n) : F (cell a j d) = g j d := lift_cell a _ _ _ j d
  refine ⟨F,?_,?_⟩
  · change F (Sum.inr ⟨i,x⟩) = 1
    rw [← cell_interior a i x,hFcell]
    simpa only [g,ite_eq_left rfl,Pi.one_apply] using hf1 (Set.mem_singleton _)
  · cases z with
    | inl y => exact lift_base a _ _ _ y
    | inr p =>
      rw [← cell_interior a p.1 p.2,hFcell]
      by_cases hpi : p.1 = i
      · have hm : interior n p.2 ∈ K := by
          right
          change cell a i (interior n p.2) = Sum.inr p
          rw [cell_interior]
          cases p with
          | mk j y => cases hpi; rfl
        simpa only [g,ite_eq_left hpi,Pi.zero_apply] using hf0 hm
      · simp only [g,ite_eq_right hpi,ContinuousMap.const_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.realSeparated
statement: lemma realSeparated (hX : RealSeparated X) : RealSeparated (Space a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : T2Space X := hX.t2Space
  intro x y hxy
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
    cases y with
    | inl y =>
      have hne : x ≠ y := fun heq => hxy (congrArg Sum.inl heq)
      obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := hX x y hne
      obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := exists_real_extension a f
      refine ⟨F,?_⟩
      change F (base a x) ≠ F (base a y)
      rwa [hF,hF]
    | inr p =>
      obtain ⟨F,hF1,hF0⟩ := exists_interior_separator a p.1 p.2 (Sum.inl x)
        (by exact fun h => hxy h.symm)
      refine ⟨F,?_⟩
      change F (Sum.inl x) ≠ F (openCell a p.1 p.2)
      rw [hF0,hF1]
      norm_num
  | inr p =>
    obtain ⟨F,hF1,hF0⟩ := exists_interior_separator a p.1 p.2 y hxy
    refine ⟨F,?_⟩
    change F (openCell a p.1 p.2) ≠ F y
    rw [hF1,hF0]
    norm_num

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.t2Space
statement: lemma t2Space (hX : RealSeparated X) : T2Space (Space a)
proof: := (realSeparated a hX).t2Space

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristic_disk
statement:
lemma characteristic_disk (i : ι) (d : Disk n) :
    characteristic a i d.1 = cell a i d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [characteristic,dite_eq_left d.2]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristic_open
statement:
lemma characteristic_open (i : ι) (x : OpenDisk n) :
    characteristic a i x.1 = openCell a i x
proof:
:= by
  exact (characteristic_disk a i (interior n x)).trans (cell_interior a i x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristic_bijOn
statement:
lemma characteristic_bijOn (i : ι) :
    Set.BijOn (characteristic a i) (ball 0 1) (Set.range (openCell a i))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,(characteristic_open a i ⟨x,hx⟩).symm⟩
  constructor
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxy' : openCell a i ⟨x,hx⟩ = openCell a i ⟨y,hy⟩ := by
      rwa [characteristic_open a i ⟨x,hx⟩,characteristic_open a i ⟨y,hy⟩] at hxy
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((openCell_openEmbedding a i).injective hxy')
  · rintro z ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x.1,x.2,characteristic_open a i x⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristicPE_continuousOn
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_continuousOn (i : ι) :
    ContinuousOn (characteristicPE a i) (closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  have heq : (closedBall (0:Fin n→ℝ) 1).domRestrict (characteristicPE a i) = cell a i := by
    funext x
    exact characteristic_disk a i x
  rw [heq]
  exact (cell a i).continuous

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristicPE_continuousOn_symm
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_continuousOn_symm (i : ι) :
    ContinuousOn (characteristicPE a i).symm (characteristicPE a i).target
proof:
:= by
  let e := characteristicPE a i
  have he : IsEmbedding (e.source.domRestrict e) := by
    have heq : e.source.domRestrict e = openCell a i := by
      funext x
      exact characteristic_open a i x
    rw [heq]
    exact (openCell_openEmbedding a i).isEmbedding
  let H : e.source ≃ₜ e.target := e.toEquiv.toHomeomorphOfIsInducing
    (he.isInducing.codRestrict (fun x => e.map_source x.2))
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  exact continuous_subtype_val.comp H.symm.continuous

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristicPE_image_ball
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_image_ball (i : ι) :
    characteristicPE a i '' ball 0 1 = Set.range (openCell a i)
proof:
:=
  (characteristic_bijOn a i).image_eq

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.characteristicPE_image_closedBall
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_image_closedBall (i : ι) :
    characteristicPE a i '' closedBall 0 1 = Set.range (cell a i)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,(characteristic_disk a i ⟨x,hx⟩).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x.1,x.2,characteristic_disk a i x⟩

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.conj_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem conj_mem_range_iff (g : G) :
    (t * of g * t⁻¹ : HNNExtension G A B φ) ∈ of.range ↔ g ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hg
    let w : NormalWord.ReducedWord G A B :=
      { head := 1
        toList := [(1,g),(-1,1)]
        chain := by simp [hg] }
    have hp : w.prod φ = t * of g * t⁻¹ := by
      simp [NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,w]
    have hn := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range φ w (hp ▸ h)
    simp [w] at hn
  · intro hg
    rw [← equiv_eq_conj (φ := φ) ⟨g,hg⟩]
    exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.commute_t_iff
statement:
theorem commute_t_iff (g : G) :
    Commute (t : HNNExtension G A A (MulEquiv.refl A)) (of g) ↔ g ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (conj_mem_range_iff (MulEquiv.refl A) g).mp
    rw [h.eq,mul_inv_cancel_right]
    exact ⟨g,rfl⟩
  · intro hg
    exact t_mul_of (φ := MulEquiv.refl A) ⟨g,hg⟩

name: OAI.Higman.benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds
statement:
theorem benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds : IsBenign A ↔
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (j : CentralExtension G A →* K), Function.Injective j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨K,_,_,i,hi,B,hB,hBi⟩
    exact ⟨CentralExtension K B,inferInstance,CentralExtension.finitelyPresented hB,
      CentralExtension.map i (le_of_eq hBi.symm),
      CentralExtension.map_injective i hi hBi⟩
  · rintro ⟨K,_,_,j,hj⟩
    obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := K)
    have : Group.FG K := Group.fg_of_surjective hp
    let i : G →* K := j.comp HNNExtension.of
    let t : K := j HNNExtension.t
    let k : G →* K × K := i.prod ((MulAut.conj t).toMonoidHom.comp i)
    let d : K →* K × K := (MonoidHom.id K).prod (MonoidHom.id K)
    have hd : d.range.FG := by
      rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
      obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := (Group.FG.out : (⊤ : Subgroup K).FG)
      refine (Subgroup.fg_iff _).mpr ⟨d '' (S : Set K),?_,S.finite_toSet.image d⟩
      rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure,hS]
    refine ⟨K × K,inferInstance,finitelyPresented_prod,k,?_,d.range,hd,?_⟩
    · intro x y he
      exact HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := MulEquiv.refl A)
        (hj (congrArg Prod.fst he))
    · ext g
      change (∃ z, d z = k g) ↔ g ∈ A
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
        have h₀ : z = i g := congrArg Prod.fst hz
        have h₁ : z = t * i g * t⁻¹ := congrArg Prod.snd hz
        have he : (HNNExtension.t : CentralExtension G A) * HNNExtension.of g *
            HNNExtension.t⁻¹ = HNNExtension.of g := by
          apply hj
          simpa only [i,t,MonoidHom.comp_apply,map_mul,map_inv] using h₁.symm.trans h₀
        apply (HNN.commute_t_iff g).mp
        change HNNExtension.t * HNNExtension.of g = HNNExtension.of g * HNNExtension.t
        calc
          HNNExtension.t * HNNExtension.of g =
              ((HNNExtension.t * HNNExtension.of g) * HNNExtension.t⁻¹) *
                (HNNExtension.t : CentralExtension G A) := (inv_mul_cancel_right _ _).symm
          _ = HNNExtension.of g * HNNExtension.t := congrArg (fun x : CentralExtension G A ↦
            x * HNNExtension.t) he
      · intro hg
        refine ⟨i g,?_⟩
        apply Prod.ext
        · rfl
        · change i g = t * i g * t⁻¹
          have he := HNNExtension.equiv_eq_conj (φ := MulEquiv.refl A) ⟨g,hg⟩
          simpa only [i,t,MonoidHom.comp_apply,map_mul,map_inv,MulEquiv.refl_apply] using
            congrArg j he

name: OAI.Higman.embeds_of_benign_kernel_fp
statement:
theorem embeds_of_benign_kernel_fp {D : Type v} [Group D]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (q : G →* D) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hben : IsBenign q.ker) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : D →* K), Function.Injective i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := G)
  let p' : FreeGroup (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) →* G := p.comp (FreeGroup.map ULift.down)
  have hp' : Function.Surjective p' := hp.comp
    (FreeGroup.map_surjective (fun a ↦ ⟨ULift.up a,rfl⟩))
  apply embeds_of_benign_kernel (q.comp p') (hq.comp hp')
  exact hben.comap p'

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawProjection_ker
statement:
theorem rawProjection_ker : (rawProjection A).ker =
    Subgroup.normalClosure (relation '' (A : Set G))
proof:
:= by
  let C := HNNExtension.con G A A (MulEquiv.refl A)
  let N := Subgroup.normalClosure (relation '' (A : Set G))
  let q := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  have hC : C ≤ Con.ker q := by
    apply Con.conGen_le.mpr
    rintro _ _ ⟨a,rfl,rfl⟩
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
    have hh : q (relation (a : G)) = 1 := (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (relation (a : G))).mpr
      (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure (show relation (a : G) ∈ relation '' (A : Set G) from
        ⟨a,a.2,rfl⟩))
    simpa only [relation,map_mul,map_inv,MulEquiv.refl_apply] using hh
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp
    apply (hC ?_).trans (map_one q)
    apply (Con.eq C).mp
    exact hx.trans (map_one C.mk').symm
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨g,hg,rfl⟩
    change rawProjection A (relation g) = 1
    change (HNNExtension.t * HNNExtension.of g) *
      (HNNExtension.of g * (HNNExtension.t : CentralExtension G A))⁻¹ = 1
    rw [HNNExtension.t_mul_of (φ := MulEquiv.refl A) ⟨g,hg⟩]
    exact mul_inv_cancel _

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawMap_surjective
statement:
theorem rawMap_surjective (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (Coprod.map f (MonoidHom.id (Multiplicative ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mp
  rw [Coprod.range_eq]
  have h₀ : ((Coprod.map f (MonoidHom.id (Multiplicative ℤ))).comp inl).range =
      (inl : H →* H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ).range := by
    change ((inl : H →* H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ).comp f).range = _
    rw [MonoidHom.range_comp,MonoidHom.range_eq_top.mpr hf,← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  rw [h₀]
  exact Coprod.range_inl_sup_range_inr

name: OAI.Higman.CentralExtension.rawProjection_ker_map
statement:
theorem rawProjection_ker_map (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (rawProjection A).ker.map (Coprod.map f (MonoidHom.id (Multiplicative ℤ))) =
      (rawProjection (A.map f)).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawProjection_ker,rawProjection_ker,
    Subgroup.map_normalClosure _ _ (rawMap_surjective f hf)]
  congr 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨g,hg,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f g,⟨g,hg,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simp [relation]
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨g,hg,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨relation g,⟨g,hg,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simp [relation]

name: OAI.Higman.IsBenign.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (hA : IsBenign A) (f : G →* H) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    IsBenign (A.map f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,_,_,j,hj⟩ := benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds.mp hA
  let π := CentralExtension.rawProjection A
  let F := Coprod.map f (MonoidHom.id (Multiplicative ℤ))
  let k : G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ →* K × (H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ) := (j.comp π).prod F
  let i : H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ →* K × (H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ) :=
    (1 : H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ →* K).prod (MonoidHom.id _)
  have hi : Function.Injective i := by
    intro x y he
    exact congrArg Prod.snd he
  have hk : k.range.FG := by
    obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ)
    have : Group.FG (G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ) := Group.fg_of_surjective hp
    obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := (Group.FG.out : (⊤ : Subgroup (G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ)).FG)
    refine (Subgroup.fg_iff _).mpr ⟨k '' (S : Set (G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ)),?_,
      S.finite_toSet.image k⟩
    rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure,hS,← MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  have hker : k.range.comap i = (CentralExtension.rawProjection (A.map f)).ker := by
    rw [← CentralExtension.rawProjection_ker_map A f hf]
    ext x
    change (∃ y, k y = i x) ↔ ∃ y, π y = 1 ∧ F y = x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,hy⟩
      refine ⟨y,?_,congrArg Prod.snd hy⟩
      apply hj
      exact (congrArg Prod.fst hy).trans (map_one j).symm
    · rintro ⟨y,hy,hxy⟩
      refine ⟨y,Prod.ext ?_ hxy⟩
      change j (π y) = 1
      rw [hy,map_one]
  have hben : IsBenign (CentralExtension.rawProjection (A.map f)).ker :=
    ⟨K × (H ∗ Multiplicative ℤ),inferInstance,finitelyPresented_prod,i,hi,k.range,hk,hker⟩
  apply benign_iff_centralExtension_embeds.mpr
  exact embeds_of_benign_kernel_fp (CentralExtension.rawProjection (A.map f))
    Con.mk'_surjective hben

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_of (g : G) : map φ ψ i hA hφ (HNNExtension.of g) =
    HNNExtension.of (i g)
proof: := by simp [map]

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_t
statement: @[simp] theorem map_t : map φ ψ i hA hφ HNNExtension.t = HNNExtension.t
proof: := by simp [map]

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.mapWord_prod
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapWord_prod (r : NormalWord.ReducedWord G A B) :
    (mapWord i hA hB r).prod ψ = map φ ψ i hA hφ (r.prod φ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,mapWord,map_list_prod,List.map_map,Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.mem_base_of_map_mem_base
statement:
theorem mem_base_of_map_mem_base (x : HNNExtension G A B φ)
    (hx : map φ ψ i hA hφ x ∈ (HNNExtension.of : K →* HNNExtension K C D ψ).range) :
    x ∈ (HNNExtension.of : G →* HNNExtension G A B φ).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := NormalWord.TransversalPair.nonempty G A B
  let r := NormalWord.equiv φ d x
  have hr : r.prod φ = x := (NormalWord.equiv φ d).symm_apply_apply x
  have hm : (mapWord i hA hB r.toReducedWord).prod ψ ∈ HNNExtension.of.range := by
    rw [mapWord_prod φ ψ i hA hB hφ]
    rw [hr]
    exact hx
  have hn := HNNExtension.ReducedWord.toList_eq_nil_of_mem_of_range ψ
    (mapWord i hA hB r.toReducedWord) hm
  have hnil : r.toList = [] := by simpa [mapWord] using hn
  refine ⟨r.head,?_⟩
  rw [← hr]
  simp [NormalWord.ReducedWord.prod,hnil]

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.map_injective
statement: theorem map_injective (hi : Function.Injective i) : Function.Injective (map φ ψ i hA hφ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (MonoidHom.ker_eq_bot_iff _).mp
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro x hx
  have hm : map φ ψ i hA hφ x ∈ HNNExtension.of.range := by
    change map φ ψ i hA hφ x = 1 at hx
    rw [hx]
    exact Subgroup.one_mem _
  obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := mem_base_of_map_mem_base φ ψ i hA hB hφ x hm
  change map φ ψ i hA hφ (HNNExtension.of g) = 1 at hx
  rw [map_of] at hx
  have hg : i g = 1 := HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := ψ) (hx.trans (map_one _).symm)
  have hg' : g = 1 := hi (hg.trans (map_one i).symm)
  rw [Subgroup.mem_bot,hg',map_one]

name: OAI.Higman.HNNTransport.range_comap_of
statement: theorem range_comap_of : (map φ ψ i hA hφ).range.comap HNNExtension.of = i.range
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx⟩
    have hm : map φ ψ i hA hφ x ∈ HNNExtension.of.range := ⟨k,hx.symm⟩
    obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := mem_base_of_map_mem_base φ ψ i hA hB hφ x hm
    refine ⟨g,?_⟩
    apply HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := ψ)
    simpa using hx
  · rintro ⟨g,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨HNNExtension.of g,map_of φ ψ i hA hφ g⟩

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.inclusion_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_of (s : S) :
    inclusion φ S hS (HNNExtension.of s) = HNNExtension.of (s : G)
proof:
:= by
  exact HNNTransport.map_of _ _ _ _ _ s

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.inclusion_t
statement: @[simp] theorem inclusion_t : inclusion φ S hS HNNExtension.t = HNNExtension.t
proof:
:= by
  exact HNNTransport.map_t _ _ _ _ _

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.range_comap_of
statement: theorem range_comap_of : (inclusion φ S hS).range.comap HNNExtension.of = S
proof:
:= by
  exact (HNNTransport.range_comap_of (restricted φ S hS) φ S.subtype rfl rfl
    (fun _ ↦ rfl)).trans (Subgroup.range_subtype S)

name: OAI.Higman.HNNSubgroup.closure_comap_of
statement:
theorem closure_comap_of :
    (Subgroup.closure (HNNExtension.of '' (S : Set G) ∪
      {(HNNExtension.t : HNNExtension G A B φ)})).comap HNNExtension.of = S
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hle : Subgroup.closure (HNNExtension.of '' (S : Set G) ∪
        {(HNNExtension.t : HNNExtension G A B φ)}) ≤ (inclusion φ S hS).range := by
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro _ (⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ | ht)
      · exact ⟨HNNExtension.of ⟨s,hs⟩,inclusion_of φ S hS ⟨s,hs⟩⟩
      · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ht
        exact ⟨HNNExtension.t,inclusion_t φ S hS⟩
    exact (Subgroup.comap_mono hle).trans_eq (range_comap_of φ S hS)
  · intro s hs
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.zeroEquiv_map
statement:
lemma zeroEquiv_map (m : ℕ) (g h : G) (i : ZeroOrbits.{u} m) (x : Fin m → ℝ) :
    RelCWComplex.map m (zeroEquiv m (g*h,i)) x = g • RelCWComplex.map m (zeroEquiv m (h,i)) x
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m => exact i.elim

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.discrete_dim
statement:
lemma discrete_dim {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X]
    (m : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell (univ : Set X) m) : m ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ m => exact i.elim

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.pointCover_quotient
statement:
lemma pointCover_quotient : IsQuotientCoveringMap (pointCover (G := G)) G where
  __
proof:
:= show IsQuotientMap (pointCover (G := G)) from
    (show IsOpenMap (pointCover (G := G)) from fun _ _ => isOpen_discrete _).isQuotientMap
      (by fun_prop) (fun _ => ⟨1,rfl⟩)
  __ := (inferInstance : ContinuousConstSMul G G)
  apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit := by
    intro x y
    constructor
    · intro _; exact ⟨x*y⁻¹,by simp [smul_eq_mul]⟩
    · intro _; rfl
  disjoint x := by
    refine ⟨{x},(isOpen_discrete _).mem_nhds (Set.mem_singleton x),?_⟩
    rintro g ⟨z,⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,h⟩
    simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy h
    rw [hy] at h
    exact mul_right_cancel (show g*x=1*x by simpa only [smul_eq_mul,one_mul] using h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.attaching_fill
statement: lemma attaching_fill : LowFillable (Space (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching hunif S))) (n+1)
proof:
:=
  (exists_finite_brown_attachment S.equiv S.equiv_map hunif n S.fill S.dimE S.sepE).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextInE_closed
statement: lemma nextInE_closed : IsClosedEmbedding (nextInE hunif S)
proof: := base_closedEmbedding _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextInB_closed
statement: lemma nextInB_closed : IsClosedEmbedding (nextInB hunif S)
proof: := base_closedEmbedding _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextInE_smul
statement: lemma nextInE_smul (g : G) (x : S.E) : nextInE hunif S (g • x) = g • nextInE hunif S x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.next_square
statement:
lemma next_square (x : S.E) :
    (nextStage hunif S).p (nextInE hunif S x) = nextInB hunif S (S.p x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellE_injective
statement: lemma nextCellE_injective (m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (nextCellE hunif S m)
proof:
:=
  layerOld_injective _ _ _ _ m

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellE_exhaustive
statement:
lemma nextCellE_exhaustive (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ n+1) (i : (nextStage hunif S).cwE.cell m) :
    ∃ j,nextCellE hunif S m j = i
proof: := layerOld_exhaustive _ _ _ _ m hm i

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellE_map
statement:
lemma nextCellE_map (m : ℕ) (i : S.cwE.cell m) (x : Fin m → ℝ) :
    nextInE hunif S (S.cwE.map m i x) = (nextStage hunif S).cwE.map m (nextCellE hunif S m i) x
proof:
:=
  (layerOld_map _ _ _ _ m i x).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellB_injective
statement: lemma nextCellB_injective (m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (nextCellB hunif S m)
proof: := Sum.inl_injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellB_exhaustive
statement:
lemma nextCellB_exhaustive (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ n+1) (i : (nextStage hunif S).cwB.cell m) :
    ∃ j,nextCellB hunif S m j = i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | inl i => exact ⟨i,rfl⟩
  | inr i => exact (hm i.down.1.down).elim

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextCellB_map
statement:
lemma nextCellB_map (m : ℕ) (i : S.cwB.cell m) (x : Fin m → ℝ) :
    nextInB hunif S (S.cwB.map m i x) = (nextStage hunif S).cwB.map m (nextCellB hunif S m i) x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextE_extendsReal
statement:
lemma nextE_extendsReal (f : C(S.E,ℝ)) : ∃ F : C((nextStage hunif S).E,ℝ),
    ∀ x,F (nextInE hunif S x) = f x
proof: := exists_real_extension _ f

statement:
lemma nextB_extendsReal (f : C(S.B,ℝ)) : ∃ F : C((nextStage hunif S).B,ℝ),
    ∀ x,F (nextInB hunif S x) = f x
proof: := exists_real_extension _ f

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.nextE_extendsSlice
statement:
lemma nextE_extendsSlice (U : Set S.E) (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hd : ∀ g : G, ((g • ·) '' U ∩ U).Nonempty → g = 1) :
    ∃ V : Set (nextStage hunif S).E, IsOpen V ∧ (nextInE hunif S) ⁻¹' V = U ∧
      ∀ g : G,((g • ·) '' V ∩ V).Nonempty → g = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨thickening _ U,thickening_isOpen _ hU,rfl,
    thickening_disjoint _ (equivariantFamily_smul (attaching hunif S)) hd⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.eMap_closed
statement: lemma eMap_closed : ∀ i j h,IsClosedEmbedding (eMap hunif i j h)
proof:
:=
  Sequential.map_closedEmbedding _ _ (fun n => nextInE_closed hunif (stages hunif n))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.bMap_closed
statement: lemma bMap_closed : ∀ i j h,IsClosedEmbedding (bMap hunif i j h)
proof:
:=
  Sequential.map_closedEmbedding _ _ (fun n => nextInB_closed hunif (stages hunif n))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.e_extendsReal
statement: lemma e_extendsReal : TopologicalTower.ExtendsReals (E hunif) (eMap hunif)
proof:
:= by
  intro n f
  obtain ⟨extension, hextension⟩ := nextE_extendsReal hunif (stages hunif n) f
  refine ⟨extension, ?_⟩
  intro point
  rw [eMap, Sequential.map_step]
  exact hextension point

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.b_extendsReal
statement: lemma b_extendsReal : TopologicalTower.ExtendsReals (B hunif) (bMap hunif)
proof:
:= by
  intro n f
  obtain ⟨extension, hextension⟩ := nextB_extendsReal hunif (stages hunif n) f
  refine ⟨extension, ?_⟩
  intro point
  rw [bMap, Sequential.map_step]
  exact hextension point

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.base_finite
statement: lemma base_finite (n : ℕ) : Finite ((baseCW hunif).cell n)
proof:
:=
  (stages hunif n).finiteB n

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.eventually_fills
statement: lemma eventually_fills : TopologicalTower.EventuallyFills (E hunif) (eMap hunif)
proof:
:= by
  intro n k a
  let j := max n k
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := (stages hunif j).fill n (le_max_left n k)
    ((eMap hunif k j (le_max_right n k)).comp a)
  exact ⟨j,le_max_right n k,F,hF⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.e_extendsSlices
statement: lemma e_extendsSlices : TopologicalTower.ExtendsSlices (G := G) (E hunif) (eMap hunif)
proof:
:= by
  intro n U
  obtain ⟨V,hV,hpre,hdis⟩ := nextE_extendsSlice hunif (stages hunif n) U.carrier U.isOpen U.disjoint
  refine ⟨⟨V,hV,hdis⟩,?_⟩
  rw [eMap, Sequential.map_step]
  exact hpre

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.p_compat
statement:
lemma p_compat (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (x : E hunif i) :
    pStage hunif j (eMap hunif i j h x) = bMap hunif i j h (pStage hunif i x)
proof:
:= by
  induction j,h using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp only [eMap,bMap,Sequential.map_self,ContinuousMap.id_apply]
  | succ j h ih =>
    simp only [eMap,bMap,Sequential.map_succ _ _ i j h,ContinuousMap.comp_apply]
    change pStage hunif (j+1) (eStep hunif j (eMap hunif i j h x)) = bStep hunif j (bMap hunif i j h (pStage hunif i x))
    exact (next_square hunif (stages hunif j) _).trans (congrArg (bStep hunif j) ih)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.pLimit_covering
statement: lemma pLimit_covering : IsQuotientCoveringMap (pLimit hunif) G
proof:
:=
  TopologicalTower.limitMap_isQuotientCovering _ _ _ _ (pStage hunif) (p_compat hunif)
    (eMap_closed hunif) (bMap_closed hunif) (fun n => (stages hunif n).covering) (e_extendsSlices hunif)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.geometric_of_uniform
statement: theorem geometric_of_uniform : HasTypeFInfinity G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Base hunif,inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,baseCW hunif,base_finite hunif,?_,?_⟩
  · let e : Total hunif := Classical.choice inferInstance
    refine ⟨pLimit hunif e,⟨?_⟩⟩
    exact ((pLimit_covering hunif).fundamentalGroupEquiv ⟨e,rfl⟩).trans (MulEquiv.inv' G).symm
  · exact ⟨Total hunif,inferInstance,inferInstance,pLimit hunif,
      (pLimit_covering hunif).surjective,(pLimit_covering hunif).isCoveringMap⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.sphere_one_cases
statement: lemma sphere_one_cases (x : Sphere 1) : x.1 0 = -1 ∨ x.1 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖x.1‖ = 1 := by simpa only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using x.2
  have hc : x.1 = fun _ => x.1 0 := funext (fun i => congrArg x.1 (Subsingleton.elim i 0))
  rw [hc,pi_norm_const,Real.norm_eq_abs] at hn
  exact ((abs_eq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)).mp hn).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.discrete_dimension
statement: lemma discrete_dimension (m : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell (Set.univ : Set G) m) : m < 1
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m => exact i.elim

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.graph_dimension
statement: lemma graph_dimension (m : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell (Set.univ : Set (Graph s)) m) : m < 2
proof:
:=
  layerCW_dimensions _ discrete_dimension m i

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.vertex_injective
statement: lemma vertex_injective : Function.Injective (vertex s)
proof: := Sum.inl_injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.cell_minus
statement:
lemma cell_minus (g : G) (i : S) :
    cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) (g,i) (boundary 1 minus) = vertex s g
proof:
:= by
  refine (cell_boundary (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) (g,i) minus).trans ?_
  change base _ (g * attaching s i minus) = vertex s g
  simp only [attaching,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,minus,ite_true,mul_one]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.cell_plus
statement:
lemma cell_plus (g : G) (i : S) :
    cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) (g,i) (boundary 1 plus) = vertex s (g*s i)
proof:
:= by
  refine (cell_boundary (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) (g,i) plus).trans ?_
  change base _ (g * attaching s i plus) = vertex s (g * s i)
  norm_num only [attaching,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,plus,ite_false]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.cell_joined
statement: lemma cell_joined (g : G) (i : S) : Joined (vertex s g) (vertex s (g*s i))
proof:
:= by
  have h : Joined (boundary 1 minus) (boundary 1 plus) := PathConnectedSpace.joined _ _
  have hh := h.map (cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) (g,i)).continuous
  simpa only [cell_minus,cell_plus] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.vertex_smul
statement: lemma vertex_smul (g h : G) : g • vertex s h = vertex s (g*h)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.vertices_joined
statement:
lemma vertices_joined (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range s) = ⊤) (g : G) :
    Joined (vertex s 1) (vertex s g)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup G :=
    { carrier := {g | Joined (vertex s 1) (vertex s g)}
      one_mem' := Joined.refl _
      mul_mem' := by
        intro g h hg hh
        have hh' := hh.map (continuous_const_smul g : Continuous (fun x : Graph s => g • x))
        rw [vertex_smul,vertex_smul,mul_one] at hh'
        exact hg.trans hh'
      inv_mem' := by
        intro g hg
        have hh := hg.symm.map (continuous_const_smul g⁻¹ : Continuous (fun x : Graph s => g⁻¹ • x))
        change Joined (vertex s 1) (vertex s g⁻¹)
        simpa only [vertex_smul,mul_one,inv_mul_cancel] using hh }
  have hK : Subgroup.closure (Set.range s) ≤ K := (Subgroup.closure_le K).2 (by
    rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
    change Joined (vertex s 1) (vertex s (s i))
    simpa only [one_mul] using cell_joined s 1 i)
  rw [hs] at hK
  exact hK (Subgroup.mem_top g)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.graph_pathConnected
statement: lemma graph_pathConnected (hs : Subgroup.closure (Set.range s) = ⊤) : PathConnectedSpace (Graph s)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ x : Graph s, Joined (vertex s 1) x := by
    intro x
    cases x with
    | inl g => exact vertices_joined s hs g
    | inr p =>
      have h : Joined (boundary 1 minus) (interior 1 p.2) := PathConnectedSpace.joined _ _
      have hh := h.map (cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) p.1).continuous
      rw [cell_interior] at hh
      have hp : cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s)) p.1 (boundary 1 minus) = vertex s p.1.1 :=
        cell_minus s p.1.1 p.1.2
      rw [hp] at hh
      exact (vertices_joined s hs p.1.1).trans hh
  exact ⟨inferInstance,fun x y => (hj x).symm.trans (hj y)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathSquares.turn
statement:
lemma turn (p : Path x a) (q : Path x b) (e : Path a b)
    (h : (p.trans e).Homotopic q) : e.Homotopic (p.symm.trans q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Path.Homotopic.refl_trans e).symm.trans
  apply ((Path.Homotopic.symm_trans p).symm.hcomp (Path.Homotopic.refl e)).trans
  exact (Path.Homotopic.trans_assoc p.symm p e).trans ((Path.Homotopic.refl p.symm).hcomp h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathSquares.spanContract_source
statement:
lemma spanContract_source (p : Path x a) (q : Path x b) (t : I) :
    spanContract p q (t,0) = p.symm t
proof:
:= by
  change (if (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 then p.extend ((1-(t:ℝ))*(1-2*0)) else q.extend ((1-(t:ℝ))*(2*0-1))) = _
  norm_num only [show (0:ℝ)≤1/2 by norm_num,ite_true,mul_zero,sub_zero,mul_one]
  rw [← Path.extend_symm_apply,Path.extend_extends' ]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathSquares.spanContract_target
statement:
lemma spanContract_target (p : Path x a) (q : Path x b) (t : I) :
    spanContract p q (t,1) = q.symm t
proof:
:= by
  change (if (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 then p.extend ((1-(t:ℝ))*(1-2*1)) else q.extend ((1-(t:ℝ))*(2*1-1))) = _
  norm_num only [mul_one,show (2:ℝ)-1=1 by norm_num,show ¬(1:ℝ)≤1/2 by norm_num,ite_false]
  rw [← Path.extend_symm_apply,Path.extend_extends' ]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathSquares.edgeSquare
statement:
theorem edgeSquare (p : Path x a) (q : Path x b) (e : Path a b)
    (h : (p.trans e).Homotopic q) :
    ∃ H : e.toContinuousMap.Homotopy (.const _ x),
      (∀ t, H (t,0) = pauseReverse p t) ∧ (∀ t, H (t,1) = pauseReverse q t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A⟩ := turn p q e h
  refine ⟨A.toHomotopy.trans (spanContract p q),?_,?_⟩
  · intro t
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with ht
    · change (t:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 at ht
      change A (_,0) = ((Path.refl a).trans p.symm) t
      rw [Path.trans_apply,dite_eq_left ht]
      exact A.source _
    · change ¬(t:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 at ht
      change spanContract p q (_,0) = ((Path.refl a).trans p.symm) t
      rw [Path.trans_apply,dite_eq_right ht,spanContract_source]
  · intro t
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with ht
    · change (t:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 at ht
      change A (_,1) = ((Path.refl b).trans q.symm) t
      rw [Path.trans_apply,dite_eq_left ht]
      exact A.target _
    · change ¬(t:ℝ) ≤ 1/2 at ht
      change spanContract p q (_,1) = ((Path.refl b).trans q.symm) t
      rw [Path.trans_apply,dite_eq_right ht,spanContract_target]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.continuous_edgeParam
statement: lemma continuous_edgeParam : Continuous edgeParam
proof: := by unfold edgeParam; fun_prop

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.continuous_edgeTime
statement: lemma continuous_edgeTime : Continuous edgeTime
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact (((continuous_apply 0).comp continuous_subtype_val).add continuous_const).div_const 2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeParam_time
statement: lemma edgeParam_time (d : Disk 1) : edgeParam (edgeTime d) = d
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst i
  dsimp [edgeParam,edgeTime]
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeTime_param
statement: lemma edgeTime_param (t : I) : edgeTime (edgeParam t) = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp [edgeTime,edgeParam]
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeParam_zero
statement: lemma edgeParam_zero : edgeParam 0 = boundary 1 minus
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  norm_num [edgeParam,minus,boundary]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeParam_one
statement: lemma edgeParam_one : edgeParam 1 = boundary 1 plus
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  norm_num [edgeParam,plus,boundary]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeTime_minus
statement: lemma edgeTime_minus : edgeTime (boundary 1 minus) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [←edgeParam_zero,edgeTime_param]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeTime_plus
statement: lemma edgeTime_plus : edgeTime (boundary 1 plus) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [←edgeParam_one,edgeTime_param]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.sphere_one_eq
statement: lemma sphere_one_eq (t : Sphere 1) : t = minus ∨ t = plus
proof:
:= by
  obtain h|h := sphere_one_cases t
  · left; apply Subtype.ext; funext i; have hi : i=0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _; subst i; exact h
  · right; apply Subtype.ext; funext i; have hi : i=0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _; subst i; exact h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeSquare_source
statement:
lemma edgeSquare_source (g : G) (i : S) (t : I) :
    edgeSquare s f y p hp g i (t,0) = PathSquares.pauseReverse (p g) t
proof:
:=
  (PathSquares.edgeSquare (p g) (p (g*s i)) ((edge s g i).map f.continuous) (hp g i)).choose_spec.1 t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgeSquare_target
statement:
lemma edgeSquare_target (g : G) (i : S) (t : I) :
    edgeSquare s f y p hp g i (t,1) = PathSquares.pauseReverse (p (g*s i)) t
proof:
:=
  (PathSquares.edgeSquare (p g) (p (g*s i)) ((edge s g i).map f.continuous) (hp g i)).choose_spec.2 t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edgePaths_boundary
statement:
lemma edgePaths_boundary (i : FreeIndex G S) (t : Sphere 1) :
    edgePaths s f y p hp i (boundary 1 t) =
      vertexPaths s f y p (equivariantFamily (G := G) (attaching s) i t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|rfl := sphere_one_eq t
  · apply ContinuousMap.ext; intro z
    change edgeSquare s f y p hp i.1 i.2 (z,edgeTime (boundary 1 minus)) = _
    rw [edgeTime_minus,edgeSquare_source]
    simp only [vertexPaths,equivariantFamily,attaching,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,minus,ite_true,smul_eq_mul,mul_one]
  · apply ContinuousMap.ext; intro z
    change edgeSquare s f y p hp i.1 i.2 (z,edgeTime (boundary 1 plus)) = _
    rw [edgeTime_plus,edgeSquare_target]
    norm_num [vertexPaths,equivariantFamily,attaching,plus]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.graphPaths_zero
statement: lemma graphPaths_zero (z : Graph s) : graphPaths s f y p hp z 0 = f z
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | inl g =>
    change PathSquares.pauseReverse (p g) 0 = _
    exact Path.source _
  | inr z =>
    change edgeSquare s f y p hp z.1.1 z.1.2 (0,edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)) = _
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
    change f (cell _ z.1 (edgeParam (edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)))) = f _
    rw [edgeParam_time,cell_interior]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.graphPaths_one
statement: lemma graphPaths_one (z : Graph s) : graphPaths s f y p hp z 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | inl g =>
    change PathSquares.pauseReverse (p g) 1 = y
    exact Path.target _
  | inr z =>
    change edgeSquare s f y p hp z.1.1 z.1.2 (1,edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)) = y
    exact ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.cylinderFill
statement:
theorem cylinderFill {n : ℕ} (a : C(Sphere n,C(unitInterval,Y))) (b : C(Disk n,Y × Y))
    (h : ∀ x, pathEndpoint (a x) = b (boundary n x))
    (F : C(Disk (n+1),Y)) (hF : ∀ x, F (boundary (n+1) x) = cylinderBoundaryMap a b h x) :
    ∃ e : C(Disk n,C(unitInterval,Y)),
      (∀ x, e (boundary n x) = a x) ∧ (∀ x, pathEndpoint (e x) = b x)
proof:
:= by
  let e : C(Disk n,C(unitInterval,Y)) :=
    (F.comp ⟨fun q : Disk n × unitInterval => diskCons q.1 q.2,continuous_diskCons⟩).curry
  refine ⟨e,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro t
    let s : Sphere (n+1) := ⟨_,cons_mem_sphere_of_boundary x t⟩
    have hs : s ∈ cylinderFace n none := by
      change (diskTail (diskCons (boundary n x) t)).1 ∈ sphere 0 1
      rw [diskTail_cons]
      exact x.2
    change F (diskCons (boundary n x) t) = a x t
    rw [show diskCons (boundary n x) t = boundary (n+1) s from rfl,hF,
      cylinderBoundaryMap_face a b h none ⟨s,hs⟩]
    change a (faceSphere ⟨s,hs⟩) (diskTime (diskCons (boundary n x) t)) = a x t
    rw [diskTime_cons]
    congr 1
  · intro x
    apply Prod.ext
    · let s : Sphere (n+1) := ⟨_,cons_zero_mem_sphere x⟩
      have hs : s ∈ cylinderFace n (some false) := by
        change (diskCons x 0).1 0 = -1
        norm_num [diskCons]
      change F (diskCons x 0) = (b x).1
      rw [show diskCons x 0 = boundary (n+1) s from rfl,hF,
        cylinderBoundaryMap_face a b h (some false) ⟨s,hs⟩]
      change (b (diskTail (diskCons x 0))).1 = (b x).1
      rw [diskTail_cons]
    · let s : Sphere (n+1) := ⟨_,cons_one_mem_sphere x⟩
      have hs : s ∈ cylinderFace n (some true) := by
        change (diskCons x 1).1 0 = 1
        norm_num [diskCons]
      change F (diskCons x 1) = (b x).2
      rw [show diskCons x 1 = boundary (n+1) s from rfl,hF,
        cylinderBoundaryMap_face a b h (some true) ⟨s,hs⟩]
      change (b (diskTail (diskCons x 1))).2 = (b x).2
      rw [diskTail_cons]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.LoopSphere.ends_sides
statement:
lemma ends_sides (p : Path x x) (z : Sphere 1) :
    pathEndpoint (sides (x := x) z) = ends p (boundary 1 z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|rfl := Cayley.sphere_one_eq z
  · change (x,x) = (p (Cayley.edgeTime (Attachment.boundary 1 Cayley.minus)),x)
    rw [Cayley.edgeTime_minus,p.source]
  · change (x,x) = (p (Cayley.edgeTime (Attachment.boundary 1 Cayley.plus)),x)
    rw [Cayley.edgeTime_plus,p.target]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.LoopSphere.homotopic_of_fill
statement:
theorem homotopic_of_fill (p : Path x x) (F : C(Disk 2,X))
    (hF : ∀ z, F (boundary 2 z) = map p z) : p.Homotopic (Path.refl x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e,he,hep⟩ := cylinderFill sides (ends p) (ends_sides p) F hF
  refine ⟨{
    toFun := fun z => e (Cayley.edgeParam z.2) z.1
    continuous_toFun := e.uncurry.continuous.comp
      ((Cayley.continuous_edgeParam.comp continuous_snd).prodMk continuous_fst)
    map_zero_left := ?_
    map_one_left := ?_
    prop' := ?_ }⟩
  · intro t
    have h := congrArg Prod.fst (hep (Cayley.edgeParam t))
    change e (Cayley.edgeParam t) 0 = p t
    change e (Cayley.edgeParam t) 0 = p (Cayley.edgeTime (Cayley.edgeParam t)) at h
    simpa only [Cayley.edgeTime_param] using h
  · intro t
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (hep (Cayley.edgeParam t))
  · intro t q hq
    obtain rfl|hq := hq
    · change e (Cayley.edgeParam 0) t = p 0
      rw [Cayley.edgeParam_zero,p.source]
      exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun (he Cayley.minus) t
    · obtain rfl := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hq
      change e (Cayley.edgeParam 1) t = p 1
      rw [Cayley.edgeParam_one,p.target]
      exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun (he Cayley.plus) t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.LoopSphere.natural
statement: lemma natural (p : Path x x) (f : C(X,Y)) : map (p.map f.continuous) = f.comp (map p)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext; intro z
  have hz : z ∈ ⋃ i, cylinderFace 1 i := by rw [cylinderFace_cover]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
  change cylinderBoundaryMap sides (ends (p.map f.continuous)) (ends_sides _) z =
    f (cylinderBoundaryMap sides (ends p) (ends_sides p) z)
  rw [cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ i ⟨z,hi⟩,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ i ⟨z,hi⟩]
  cases i with
  | none => rfl
  | some b => cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.LoopSphere.homotopic_map_of_fill
statement:
lemma homotopic_map_of_fill (p : Path x x) (f : C(X,Y)) (F : C(Disk 2,Y))
    (hF : ∀ z, F (boundary 2 z) = f (map p z)) :
    (p.map f.continuous).Homotopic (Path.refl (f x))
proof:
:= by
  apply homotopic_of_fill _ F
  intro z
  rw [natural]
  exact hF z

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.lipschitz_mul
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  simp only [ContinuousMap.mul_apply,NNReal.coe_add,NNReal.coe_mul,coe_nnnorm]
  calc
    dist (f x * g x) (f y * g y)
        = ‖f x * (g x-g y) + g y * (f x-f y)‖ := by
          rw [dist_eq_norm]; congr 1; ring
    _ ≤ ‖f x * (g x-g y)‖ + ‖g y * (f x-f y)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = ‖f x‖ * dist (g x) (g y) + ‖g y‖ * dist (f x) (f y) := by
      rw [norm_mul,norm_mul,dist_eq_norm,dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖f‖ * ((M:ℝ) * dist x y) + ‖g‖ * ((L:ℝ) * dist x y) := by
      gcongr
      · exact f.norm_coe_le_norm x
      · exact hg.dist_le_mul x y
      · exact g.norm_coe_le_norm y
      · exact hf.dist_le_mul x y
    _ = (‖f‖ * M + ‖g‖ * L) * dist x y := by ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.lipschitzAlgebra_separates
statement: lemma lipschitzAlgebra_separates : (lipschitzAlgebra (K := K)).SeparatesPoints
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  refine ⟨fun z => dist z y,⟨⟨fun z => dist z y,continuous_id.dist continuous_const⟩,
    ⟨1,LipschitzWith.dist_left y⟩,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  simpa using hxy

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.exists_lipschitz_approximation
statement:
lemma exists_lipschitz_approximation (f : C(K,ℝ)) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : C(K,ℝ), (∃ L, LipschitzWith L g) ∧ ∀ x, ‖g x-f x‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := ContinuousMap.exists_mem_subalgebra_near_continuous_of_separatesPoints
    lipschitzAlgebra lipschitzAlgebra_separates f f.continuous ε hε
  exact ⟨g,g.2,hg⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.exists_lipschitz_vector_approximation
statement:
lemma exists_lipschitz_vector_approximation {n : ℕ} (f : C(K,Fin n → ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : C(K,Fin n → ℝ), (∃ L, LipschitzWith L g) ∧ ∀ x, ‖g x-f x‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ g : C(K,ℝ), (∃ L, LipschitzWith L g) ∧
      ∀ x, ‖g x-f x i‖ < ε := fun i =>
    exists_lipschitz_approximation ⟨fun x => f x i,(continuous_apply i).comp f.continuous⟩ hε
  choose g hg he using hex
  choose L hL using hg
  let H : C(K,Fin n → ℝ) := ⟨fun x i => g i x,continuous_pi (fun i => (g i).continuous)⟩
  refine ⟨H,⟨Finset.univ.sup L,?_⟩,?_⟩
  · apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    rw [dist_pi_le_iff (mul_nonneg (NNReal.coe_nonneg _) dist_nonneg)]
    intro i
    exact (hL i).dist_le_mul x y |>.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Finset.le_sup (f := L) (Finset.mem_univ i)) dist_nonneg)
  · intro x
    exact (pi_norm_lt_iff hε).mpr (fun i => he i x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.exists_missing_point
statement:
lemma exists_missing_point {n : ℕ} {g : K → Fin n → ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0}
    (hg : LipschitzWith L g) (hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set K) < n)
    (c : Fin n → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ a ∈ Metric.ball c r, a ∉ Set.range g
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have hle : dimH (Metric.ball c r) ≤ dimH (Set.range g) := dimH_mono h
  rw [Real.dimH_ball_pi_fin _ hr] at hle
  exact (not_le_of_gt hdim) (hle.trans hg.dimH_range_le)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.exists_nonzero_approximation
statement:
lemma exists_nonzero_approximation {n : ℕ} (f : C(K,Fin n → ℝ))
    (hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set K) < n) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g : C(K,Fin n → ℝ), (∀ x, g x ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ x, ‖g x-f x‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h,⟨L,hL⟩,hh⟩ := exists_lipschitz_vector_approximation f (half_pos hε)
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ha'⟩ := exists_missing_point hL hdim 0 (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨h - ContinuousMap.const K a,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply ha'
    exact ⟨x,sub_eq_zero.mp hx⟩
  · intro x
    have ha : ‖a‖ < ε/2 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball,dist_zero_right] using ha
    change ‖(h x-a)-f x‖ < ε
    have hhx := hh x
    calc
      ‖(h x-a)-f x‖ = ‖(h x-f x)-a‖ := by congr 1; abel
      _ ≤ ‖h x-f x‖+‖a‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.cutoff_nonneg
statement: lemma cutoff_nonneg (δ r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ cutoff δ r
proof: := le_min (by norm_num) (le_max_left _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.cutoff_le_one
statement: lemma cutoff_le_one (δ r : ℝ) : cutoff δ r ≤ 1
proof: := min_le_left _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.cutoff_small
statement: lemma cutoff_small {δ r : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hr : r ≤ δ) : cutoff δ r = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply min_eq_left
  apply le_max_of_le_right
  have : r/δ ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hδ).mpr hr
  linarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.cutoff_large
statement: lemma cutoff_large {δ r : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hr : 2*δ ≤ r) : cutoff δ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : 2 ≤ r/δ := (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr hr
  simp only [cutoff,max_eq_left (by linarith : 2-r/δ ≤ 0),min_eq_right (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.continuous_cutoff
statement: lemma continuous_cutoff (δ : ℝ) : Continuous (cutoff δ)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.min (continuous_const.max (continuous_const.sub (continuous_id.div_const δ)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.exists_relative_nonzero_approximation
statement:
lemma exists_relative_nonzero_approximation {n : ℕ} (f : C(K,Fin n → ℝ))
    (hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set K) < n) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ g : C(K,Fin n → ℝ), (∀ x, g x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ x, 2*δ ≤ ‖f x‖ → g x = f x) ∧ ∀ x, ‖g x-f x‖ < δ/2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h,hne,hh⟩ := exists_nonzero_approximation f hdim (half_pos hδ)
  let g : C(K,Fin n → ℝ) := ⟨fun x => f x + cutoff δ ‖f x‖ • (h x-f x),
    f.continuous.add (((continuous_cutoff δ).comp f.continuous.norm).smul
      (h.continuous.sub f.continuous))⟩
  have hdist (x : K) : ‖g x-f x‖ < δ/2 := by
    change ‖(f x+cutoff δ ‖f x‖ • (h x-f x))-f x‖ < δ/2
    rw [add_sub_cancel_left,norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg (cutoff_nonneg _ _)]
    exact (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (cutoff_le_one _ _)).trans_lt (hh x)
  refine ⟨g,?_,?_,hdist⟩
  · intro x hx
    by_cases hnorm : ‖f x‖ ≤ δ
