    exact isClosed_eq continuous_subtype_val continuous_const

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.continuous_punctured
statement:
lemma continuous_punctured {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (F : punctured a → Y)
    (hb : Continuous (fun x : X => F ⟨base a x,base_mem_punctured a x⟩))
    (hc : ∀ i, Continuous (fun d : {d : Disk n // d.1 ≠ 0} =>
      F ⟨cell a i d.1,(cell_mem_punctured a i d.1).mpr d.2⟩)) : Continuous F
proof:
:= by
  let q := quotient a
  have hq : IsQuotientMap q := ⟨⟨rfl⟩,quotient_surjective a⟩
  have hp := hq.restrictPreimage_isOpen (punctured_open a)
  apply hp.continuous_iff.mpr
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  rintro ⟨z,hz⟩
  cases z with
  | inl x =>
    let e : X → q ⁻¹' punctured a := fun x => ⟨Sum.inl x,base_mem_punctured a x⟩
    have he : IsOpenEmbedding e := by
      have hi : IsOpenEmbedding (Sum.inl : X → X ⊕ (Σ _ : ι, Disk n)) := .inl
      exact ⟨hi.isEmbedding.codRestrict (q ⁻¹' punctured a) (fun x => base_mem_punctured a x),by
        have hr : Set.range e = Subtype.val ⁻¹' Set.range Sum.inl := by
          ext z
          simp only [mem_range,mem_preimage,e]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨x,rfl⟩; exact ⟨x,rfl⟩
          · rintro ⟨x,hx⟩; exact ⟨x,Subtype.ext hx⟩
        rw [hr]
        exact hi.isOpen_range.preimage continuous_subtype_val⟩
    exact (he.continuousAt_iff (g := F ∘ (punctured a).restrictPreimage q)).mp (hb.continuousAt (x := x))
  | inr p =>
    rcases p with ⟨i,d⟩
    have hd : d.1 ≠ 0 := (cell_mem_punctured a i d).mp hz
    let e : {d : Disk n // d.1 ≠ 0} → q ⁻¹' punctured a :=
      fun d => ⟨Sum.inr ⟨i,d.1⟩,(cell_mem_punctured a i d.1).mpr d.2⟩
    have he : IsOpenEmbedding e := by
      have hi : IsOpenEmbedding (fun d : Disk n => (Sum.inr ⟨i,d⟩ : X ⊕ (Σ _ : ι, Disk n))) :=
        IsOpenEmbedding.inr.comp IsOpenEmbedding.sigmaMk
      exact hi.restrict (fun d hd => (cell_mem_punctured a i d).mpr hd)
        (isClosed_eq continuous_subtype_val continuous_const).isOpen_compl
    have hc' : ContinuousAt ((F ∘ (punctured a).restrictPreimage q) ∘ e) ⟨d,hd⟩ := by
      change ContinuousAt (fun d : {d : Disk n // d.1 ≠ 0} =>
        F ⟨cell a i d.1,(cell_mem_punctured a i d.1).mpr d.2⟩) ⟨d,hd⟩
      exact (hc i).continuousAt
    have result := (he.continuousAt_iff (g := F ∘ (punctured a).restrictPreimage q)).mp hc'
    exact result

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.puncturedCell_boundary
statement:
lemma puncturedCell_boundary (i : ι) (x : Sphere n) :
    puncturedCell a i (puncturedBoundary x) = puncturedBase a (a i x)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (cell_boundary a i x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.puncturedLift_base
statement:
@[simp] lemma puncturedLift_base {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X,Y))
    (g : ι → C(PuncturedDisk n,Y))
    (h : ∀ i x, g i (puncturedBoundary x) = f (a i x)) (x : X) :
    puncturedLift a f g h (puncturedBase a x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.puncturedLift_cell
statement:
@[simp] lemma puncturedLift_cell {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X,Y))
    (g : ι → C(PuncturedDisk n,Y))
    (h : ∀ i x, g i (puncturedBoundary x) = f (a i x))
    (i : ι) (d : PuncturedDisk n) :
    puncturedLift a f g h (puncturedCell a i d) = g i d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hd : d.1.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
  · have heq : d.1 = interior n ⟨d.1.1,hd⟩ := rfl
    change puncturedLift a f g h ⟨cell a i d.1,_⟩ = _
    have hc : cell a i d.1 = Sum.inr ⟨i,⟨d.1.1,hd⟩⟩ := (congrArg (cell a i) heq).trans (cell_interior a i ⟨d.1.1,hd⟩)
    simp only [hc,puncturedLift,ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    exact congrArg (g i) (Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext rfl))
  · let x : Sphere n := ⟨d.1.1,by
      have hm := d.1.2
      simp only [mem_closedBall,mem_ball,mem_sphere] at *
      exact le_antisymm hm (le_of_not_gt hd)⟩
    have hd : d = puncturedBoundary x := rfl
    rw [hd,puncturedCell_boundary,puncturedLift_base,h]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.punctured_surjective
statement:
lemma punctured_surjective (z : punctured a) :
    (∃ x, z = puncturedBase a x) ∨ ∃ i d, z = puncturedCell a i d
proof:
:= by
  cases heq : z.1 with
  | inl x => exact Or.inl ⟨x,Subtype.ext heq⟩
  | inr p =>
    have hd : p.2.1 ≠ 0 := (cell_mem_punctured a p.1 (interior n p.2)).mp
      (by simpa only [cell_interior,← heq] using z.2)
    exact Or.inr ⟨p.1,⟨interior n p.2,hd⟩,Subtype.ext (heq.trans (cell_interior a p.1 p.2).symm)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialSphere_boundary
statement: @[simp] lemma radialSphere_boundary (x : Sphere n) : radialSphere (puncturedBoundary x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx : ‖x.1‖ = 1 := by simpa only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using x.2
  change ‖x.1‖⁻¹ • x.1 = x.1
  rw [hx,inv_one,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialDisk_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma radialDisk_zero (d : PuncturedDisk n) : radialDisk (0,d) = d.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [radialDisk]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialDisk_one
statement: @[simp] lemma radialDisk_one (d : PuncturedDisk n) : radialDisk (1,d) = boundary n (radialSphere d)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [radialDisk,boundary]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialDisk_boundary
statement:
@[simp] lemma radialDisk_boundary (t : unitInterval) (x : Sphere n) :
    radialDisk (t,puncturedBoundary x) = boundary n x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [radialDisk,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,radialSphere_boundary]
  change (1-(t:ℝ)) • x.1 + (t:ℝ) • x.1 = x.1
  rw [← add_smul,sub_add_cancel,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialRetraction_base
statement: @[simp] lemma radialRetraction_base (x : X) : radialRetraction a (puncturedBase a x) = x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialRetraction_cell
statement:
@[simp] lemma radialRetraction_cell (i : ι) (d : PuncturedDisk n) :
    radialRetraction a (puncturedCell a i d) = a i (radialSphere d)
proof:
:= by
  exact puncturedLift_cell _ _ _ _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialPaths_base
statement:
@[simp] lemma radialPaths_base (x : X) (t : unitInterval) :
    radialPaths a (puncturedBase a x) t = base a x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialPaths_cell
statement:
@[simp] lemma radialPaths_cell (i : ι) (d : PuncturedDisk n) (t : unitInterval) :
    radialPaths a (puncturedCell a i d) t = cell a i (radialDisk (t,d))
proof:
:= by
  unfold radialPaths
  rw [puncturedLift_cell]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.radialHomotopy_base
statement:
@[simp] lemma radialHomotopy_base (x : X) (t : unitInterval) :
    radialHomotopy a (t,puncturedBase a x) = base a x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.cell_eq_openCell_iff
statement:
lemma cell_eq_openCell_iff (i j : ι) (d : Disk n) (x : OpenDisk n) :
    cell a i d = openCell a j x ↔ i = j ∧ d.1 = x.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hd : d.1 ∈ ball (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
    · have hi : cell a i d = Sum.inr ⟨i,⟨d.1,hd⟩⟩ :=
        cell_interior a i ⟨d.1,hd⟩
      rw [hi] at h
      have hh : (⟨i,⟨d.1,hd⟩⟩ : Σ _ : ι, OpenDisk n) = ⟨j,x⟩ := Sum.inr_injective h
      exact ⟨congrArg Sigma.fst hh,congrArg (fun p : Σ _ : ι, OpenDisk n => p.2.1) hh⟩
    · let s : Sphere n := ⟨d.1,by
        have hm := d.2
        simp only [mem_sphere,mem_ball,mem_closedBall] at *
        exact le_antisymm hm (le_of_not_gt hd)⟩
      have hi : cell a i d = base a (a i s) := cell_boundary a i s
      rw [hi] at h
      cases h
  · rintro ⟨rfl,h⟩
    have hd : d = interior n x := Subtype.ext h
    rw [hd,cell_interior]
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.openCell_disjoint
statement:
lemma openCell_disjoint (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (openCell a i)) (Set.range (openCell a j))
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  rintro z ⟨x,rfl⟩ ⟨y,h⟩
  exact hij (congrArg Sigma.fst (Sum.inr_injective h)).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.openCell_selection_closed
statement:
lemma openCell_selection_closed {I : Type*} (c : I → ι) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (x : I → OpenDisk n) (S : Set (Space a))
    (hS : S ⊆ Set.range (fun i => openCell a (c i) (x i))) : IsClosed S
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClosed_iff]
  constructor
  · have h : base a ⁻¹' S = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hS hy
      cases hi
    rw [h]
    exact isClosed_empty
  · intro j
    suffices (cell a j ⁻¹' S).Subsingleton from this.finite.isClosed
    intro d hd e he
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hS hd
    obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hS he
    have hdi := (cell_eq_openCell_iff a j (c i) d (x i)).mp hi.symm
    have hek := (cell_eq_openCell_iff a j (c k) e (x k)).mp hk.symm
    have hik : i = k := hc (hdi.1.symm.trans hek.1)
    subst k
    exact Subtype.ext (hdi.2.trans hek.2.symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.compact_finitely_many_openCells
statement:
lemma compact_finitely_many_openCells {K : Set (Space a)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    {i : ι | (K ∩ Set.range (openCell a i)).Nonempty}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := {i : ι | (K ∩ Set.range (openCell a i)).Nonempty}
  have hchoice (i : I) : ∃ x : OpenDisk n, openCell a i.1 x ∈ K := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz,⟨x,hx⟩⟩ := i.2
    exact ⟨x,hx ▸ hz⟩
  choose x hx using hchoice
  let y : I → Space a := fun i => openCell a i.1 (x i)
  have hyinj : Function.Injective y := by
    intro i j h
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg Sigma.fst (Sum.inr_injective h)
  have hclosed : ∀ S ⊆ Set.range y, IsClosed S :=
    openCell_selection_closed a Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective x
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Set.range y) := hK.of_isClosed_subset
    (hclosed _ subset_rfl) (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hx)
  have hdisc : IsDiscrete (Set.range y) := by
    apply isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isClosed.mpr
    intro S hS
    exact ⟨S,hclosed S hS,Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hS⟩
  have hrange := hcompact.finite hdisc
  have : Finite I := (Set.finite_range_iff hyinj).mp hrange
  exact Set.toFinite I

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.patchFun_on
statement:
lemma patchFun_on (A : Set X) (f : C(X,Y)) (g : C(A,Y)) (x : A) :
    patchFun A f g x = g x
proof: := by simp only [patchFun,dite_eq_left x.2]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.patchFun_off
statement:
lemma patchFun_off (A : Set X) (f : C(X,Y)) (g : C(A,Y)) {x : X} (hx : x ∉ A) :
    patchFun A f g x = f x
proof: := by simp only [patchFun,dite_eq_right hx]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.continuous_patchFun
statement:
lemma continuous_patchFun {A : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (f : C(X,Y)) (g : C(A,Y))
    (hboundary : ∀ (x : A), (x:X) ∈ frontier A → g x = f x) :
    Continuous (patchFun A f g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hOn : ContinuousOn (patchFun A f g) A := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
    have heq : A.domRestrict (patchFun A f g) = g := funext (patchFun_on A f g)
    rw [heq]
    exact g.continuous
  have h := continuous_if (p := fun x => x ∈ A) (f := patchFun A f g) (g := f)
    (fun x hx => by
      have hxa : x ∈ A := hA.closure_eq ▸ hx.1
      exact (patchFun_on A f g ⟨x,hxa⟩).trans (hboundary ⟨x,hxa⟩ hx))
    (by simpa only [Set.ofPred_mem_eq,hA.closure_eq] using hOn) f.continuous.continuousOn
  convert h using 1
  ext x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hx]
  · simp only [ite_eq_right hx,patchFun_off A f g hx]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.patch_on
statement:
lemma patch_on {A : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (f : C(X,Y)) (g : C(A,Y))
    (hboundary : ∀ (x : A), (x:X) ∈ frontier A → g x = f x) (x : A) :
    patch hA f g hboundary x = g x
proof: := patchFun_on A f g x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.patch_off
statement:
lemma patch_off {A : Set X} (hA : IsClosed A) (f : C(X,Y)) (g : C(A,Y))
    (hboundary : ∀ (x : A), (x:X) ∈ frontier A → g x = f x) {x : X} (hx : x ∉ A) :
    patch hA f g hboundary x = f x
proof: := patchFun_off A f g hx

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.denominator_bounds
statement: lemma denominator_bounds (p : unitInterval × Disk n) : 1 ≤ denominator p ∧ denominator p ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ‖p.2.1‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using p.2.2
  have ht0 := p.1.2.1
  have ht1 := p.1.2.2
  constructor
  · exact (by linarith : 1 ≤ 2-(p.1:ℝ)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.denominator_pos
statement: lemma denominator_pos (p : unitInterval × Disk n) : 0 < denominator p
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (denominator_bounds p).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.factor_mul_denominator
statement: lemma factor_mul_denominator (p : unitInterval × Disk n) : factor p * denominator p = 2
proof:
:=
  div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (denominator_pos p))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.factor_bounds
statement: lemma factor_bounds (p : unitInterval × Disk n) : 1 ≤ factor p ∧ factor p ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd := denominator_bounds p
  constructor
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ (denominator_pos p)).mpr (by simpa using hd.2)
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ (denominator_pos p)).mpr (by linarith)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.factor_nonneg
statement: lemma factor_nonneg (p : unitInterval × Disk n) : 0 ≤ factor p
proof: := (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1).trans (factor_bounds p).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.retract_time_mem
statement:
lemma retract_time_mem (p : unitInterval × Disk n) :
    2 - factor p * (2-(p.1:ℝ)) ∈ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 2-(p.1:ℝ) ≤ denominator p := le_max_left _ _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (factor_nonneg p)
  have heq := factor_mul_denominator p
  have hf := (factor_bounds p).1
  have ht0 := p.1.2.1
  have ht1 := p.1.2.2
  have hge := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf (by linarith : 0 ≤ 2-(p.1:ℝ))
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.retract_disk_mem
statement:
lemma retract_disk_mem (p : unitInterval × Disk n) :
    factor p • p.2.1 ∈ closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (factor_nonneg p)]
  have hd : 2*‖p.2.1‖ ≤ denominator p := le_max_right _ _
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd (factor_nonneg p)
  have heq := factor_mul_denominator p
  nlinarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.retract_mem_rim
statement:
lemma retract_mem_rim (p : unitInterval × Disk n) :
    (⟨2-factor p*(2-(p.1:ℝ)),retract_time_mem p⟩ : unitInterval) = 0 ∨
      factor p • p.2.1 ∈ sphere (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (2*‖p.2.1‖) (2-(p.1:ℝ)) with h | h
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hd : denominator p = 2-(p.1:ℝ) := max_eq_left h
    have heq := factor_mul_denominator p
    rw [hd] at heq
    simpa only [Set.Icc.coe_zero,sub_eq_zero] using heq.symm
  · right
    simp only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (factor_nonneg p)]
    have hd : denominator p = 2*‖p.2.1‖ := max_eq_right h
    have heq := factor_mul_denominator p
    rw [hd] at heq
    nlinarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.continuous_denominator
statement: lemma continuous_denominator : Continuous (@denominator n)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).max
    (continuous_const.mul ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).norm))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.continuous_factor
statement: lemma continuous_factor : Continuous (@factor n)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.div continuous_denominator (fun p => ne_of_gt (denominator_pos p))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.retract_of_rim
statement: lemma retract_of_rim (p : Rim n) : (retract n p.1).1 = p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : denominator p.1 = 2 := by
    rcases p.2 with ht | hx
    · have hx' : ‖p.1.2.1‖ ≤ 1 := by simpa only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using p.1.2.2
      simp only [denominator,ht,Set.Icc.coe_zero,sub_zero]
      exact max_eq_left (by linarith)
    · have hx' : ‖p.1.2.1‖ = 1 := by simpa only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using hx
      simp only [denominator,hx',mul_one]
      exact max_eq_right (by linarith [p.1.1.2.1])
  have hf : factor p.1 = 1 := by simp [factor,hd]
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change 2-factor p.1*(2-(p.1.1:ℝ)) = (p.1.1:ℝ)
    rw [hf,one_mul]
    ring
  · apply Subtype.ext
    change factor p.1 • p.1.2.1 = p.1.2.1
    rw [hf,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.continuous_finite_closed_paste
statement:
lemma continuous_finite_closed_paste {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (S : ι → Set A) (f : ∀ i, C(S i,Y))
    (hcompat : ∀ i j x (hi : x ∈ S i) (hj : x ∈ S j), f i ⟨x,hi⟩ = f j ⟨x,hj⟩)
    (hcover : ⋃ i, S i = Set.univ) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (S i)) :
    Continuous (Set.liftCover S (fun i => f i) hcompat hcover)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_isClosed]
  intro D hD
  rw [Set.preimage_liftCover]
  exact isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun i => (hclosed i).isClosedMap_subtype_val _ (hD.preimage (f i).continuous)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.face_closed
statement: lemma face_closed (n : ℕ) (i : Bool) : IsClosed (face n i)
proof:
:= by
  cases i
  · exact isClosed_eq (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val) continuous_const
  · exact isClosed_sphere.preimage ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).comp continuous_subtype_val)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.face_cover
statement: lemma face_cover (n : ℕ) : ⋃ i, face n i = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro p
  rcases p.2 with h | h
  · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨false,h⟩
  · exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨true,h⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.faceValue_compatible
statement:
lemma faceValue_compatible (i j : Bool) (p : Rim n) (hi : p ∈ face n i) (hj : p ∈ face n j) :
    faceValue F H i ⟨p,hi⟩ = faceValue F H j ⟨p,hj⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hcross (h0 : p.1.1 = 0) (hs : p.1.2.1 ∈ sphere 0 1) :
      F p.1.2 = H (p.1.1,⟨p.1.2.1,hs⟩) := by
    rw [h0,h]
  cases i <;> cases j
  · rfl
  · exact hcross hi hj
  · exact (hcross hj hi).symm
  · rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.rimMap_face
statement: lemma rimMap_face (i : Bool) (p : face n i) : rimMap F H h p.1 = faceValue F H i p
proof:
:= by
  exact Set.liftCover_coe (S := face n) (f := fun i => faceValue F H i)
    (hf := faceValue_compatible F H h) (hS := face_cover n) p

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.extension_zero
statement: lemma extension_zero (x : Disk n) : extension F H h (0,x) = F x
proof:
:= by
  let p : Rim n := ⟨(0,x),Or.inl rfl⟩
  have heq : retract n (0,x) = p := Subtype.ext (retract_of_rim p)
  change rimMap F H h (retract n (0,x)) = F x
  rw [heq]
  exact rimMap_face F H h false ⟨p,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.extension_boundary
statement:
lemma extension_boundary (t : unitInterval) (x : Sphere n) :
    extension F H h (t,⟨x.1,sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩) = H (t,x)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Rim n := ⟨(t,⟨x.1,sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩),Or.inr x.2⟩
  have heq : retract n p.1 = p := Subtype.ext (retract_of_rim p)
  change rimMap F H h (retract n p.1) = H (t,x)
  rw [heq]
  exact rimMap_face F H h true ⟨p,x.2⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cylinder.homotopy_extension
statement:
theorem homotopy_extension : ∃ E : C(unitInterval × Disk n,Y),
    (∀ x, E (0,x) = F x) ∧ ∀ t (x : Sphere n),
      E (t,⟨x.1,sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩) = H (t,x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨extension F H h,extension_zero F H h,extension_boundary F H h⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.rim_contractible
statement: lemma rim_contractible (n : ℕ) : ContractibleSpace (Cylinder.Rim n)
proof:
:= by
  let : ContractibleSpace (Disk n) := (convex_closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1).contractibleSpace
    ⟨0,by simp⟩
  let : ContractibleSpace unitInterval := (convex_Icc (0:ℝ) 1).contractibleSpace ⟨0,by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨p,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (unitInterval × Disk n)
  let inc : C(Cylinder.Rim n,unitInterval × Disk n) := ⟨Subtype.val,continuous_subtype_val⟩
  let K := (ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl (Cylinder.retract n)).comp (H.compContinuousMap inc)
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
  refine ⟨Cylinder.retract n p,⟨?_⟩⟩
  have he : (Cylinder.retract n).comp ((ContinuousMap.id _).comp inc) = ContinuousMap.id _ := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro x
    exact Subtype.ext (Cylinder.retract_of_rim x)
  exact he ▸ K

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.rim_nullhomotopy
statement:
lemma rim_nullhomotopy [PathConnectedSpace Y] (f : C(Sphere (n+1),Y)) (y : Y) :
    Nonempty ((f.comp (rimSphere n)).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ y))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.edgeTrace_zero
statement: lemma edgeTrace_zero (s : Sphere n) : edgeTrace f y K (0,s) = (f.comp (top n)) (boundary n s)
proof:
:= by
  change K (0,rimSide n (s,1)) = _
  rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.topExtension_zero
statement: lemma topExtension_zero (x : Disk n) : topExtension f y K (0,x) = f (top n x)
proof:
:=
  Cylinder.extension_zero _ _ _ x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.topExtension_boundary
statement:
lemma topExtension_boundary (t : unitInterval) (s : Sphere n) :
    topExtension f y K (t,boundary n s) = K (t,rimSide n (s,1))
proof:
:=
  Cylinder.extension_boundary _ _ _ t s

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.normalizedTop_boundary
statement: lemma normalizedTop_boundary (s : Sphere n) : normalizedTop f y K (boundary n s) = y
proof:
:= by
  change topExtension f y K (1,boundary n s) = y
  rw [topExtension_boundary,ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one,ContinuousMap.const_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.spherePaths_compatible
statement:
lemma spherePaths_compatible (s : Sphere n) :
    pathEndpoint (sidePaths f y K s) =
      (bottomPaths f y K (boundary n s),topPaths f y K (boundary n s))
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro t
    exact (topExtension_boundary f y K t s).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.cons_tail_time
statement: lemma cons_tail_time (x : Disk (n+1)) : diskCons (diskTail x) (diskTime x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => rfl) i
  change 2*((x.1 0+1)/2)-1 = x.1 0
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.spherePaths_zero
statement: lemma spherePaths_zero (s : Sphere (n+1)) : spherePaths f y K s 0 = f s
proof:
:= by
  rcases sphere_split s with h | h | h
  · rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some false) ⟨s,h⟩]
    change K (0,rimBottom n (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s))) = f s
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
    change f (rimSphere n (rimBottom n (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)))) = f s
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    have ht : diskTime (boundary (n+1) s) = 0 := faceTime_eq_zero s h
    exact (congrArg (fun t => (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) t).1) ht).symm.trans
      (congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s)))
  · rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some true) ⟨s,h⟩]
    change topExtension f y K (0,diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) = f s
    rw [topExtension_zero]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    have ht : diskTime (boundary (n+1) s) = 1 := faceTime_eq_one s h
    exact (congrArg (fun t => (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) t).1) ht).symm.trans
      (congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s)))
  · rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ none ⟨s,h⟩]
    change K (0,rimSide n (faceSphere ⟨s,h⟩,faceTime none ⟨s,h⟩)) = f s
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
    change f (rimSphere n (rimSide n (faceSphere ⟨s,h⟩,faceTime none ⟨s,h⟩))) = f s
    apply congrArg f
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) (diskTime (boundary (n+1) s))).1 = s.1
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.normalizedSphere_rim
statement: lemma normalizedSphere_rim (x : Cylinder.Rim n) : normalizedSphere f y K (rimSphere n x) = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x.2 with hx | hx
  · have h : rimSphere n x ∈ cylinderFace n (some false) := by
      change (diskCons x.1.2 x.1.1).1 0 = -1
      simp only [hx,diskCons,Fin.cons_zero,Set.Icc.coe_zero,mul_zero,zero_sub]
    change spherePaths f y K (rimSphere n x) 1 = y
    rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some false) ⟨_,h⟩]
    exact K.apply_one _
  · have h : rimSphere n x ∈ cylinderFace n none := by
      change (diskTail (diskCons x.1.2 x.1.1)).1 ∈ sphere 0 1
      rw [diskTail_cons]; exact hx
    change spherePaths f y K (rimSphere n x) 1 = y
    rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ none ⟨_,h⟩]
    exact K.apply_one _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.normalizedSphere_top
statement: lemma normalizedSphere_top (x : Disk n) : normalizedSphere f y K (top n x) = normalizedTop f y K x
proof:
:= by
  have h : top n x ∈ cylinderFace n (some true) := by
    change (diskCons x 1).1 0 = 1
    norm_num [diskCons]
  change spherePaths f y K (top n x) 1 = _
  rw [spherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some true) ⟨_,h⟩]
  change topExtension f y K (1,diskTail (diskCons x 1)) = _
  rw [diskTail_cons]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DiskCube.from_to
statement: lemma from_to (n : ℕ) (x : Disk n) : fromCube n (toCube n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  change 2*((x.1 i+1)/2)-1 = x.1 i
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DiskCube.to_from
statement: lemma to_from (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → unitInterval) : toCube n (fromCube n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((2*(x i:ℝ)-1)+1)/2 = (x i:ℝ)
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DiskCube.from_boundary
statement:
lemma from_boundary (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → unitInterval) (hx : x ∈ Cube.boundary (Fin n)) :
    (fromCube n x).1 ∈ sphere 0 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i,hi | hi⟩ := hx
  all_goals
    simp only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right]
    apply le_antisymm
    · simpa only [mem_closedBall,dist_zero_right] using (fromCube n x).2
    · have h := norm_le_pi_norm (fromCube n x).1 i
      change ‖2*(x i:ℝ)-1‖ ≤ _ at h
      norm_num [hi] at h ⊢
      exact h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DiskCube.to_boundary
statement:
lemma to_boundary (n : ℕ) (x : Sphere n) :
    toCube n ⟨x.1,sphere_subset_closedBall x.2⟩ ∈ Cube.boundary (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ‖x.1‖ = 1 := by simpa only [mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using x.2
  have hi : ∃ i, 1 ≤ ‖x.1 i‖ := by
    by_contra! hh
    have := (pi_norm_lt_iff (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).mpr hh
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hi
  have heq : |x.1 i| = 1 := le_antisymm ((norm_le_pi_norm x.1 i).trans_eq hx) hi
  refine ⟨i,?_⟩
  rcases (abs_eq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1)).mp heq with h | h
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (x.1 i+1)/2 = 1
    rw [h]; norm_num
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (x.1 i+1)/2 = 0
    rw [h]; norm_num

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_one
statement: lemma diagramElement_one (e : D) : diagramElement (K := K) e (1 : V) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagramElement, map_one, TensorProduct.sub_tmul]
  rw [sub_add_cancel, Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_mul
statement:
lemma diagramElement_mul (e : D) (he : e * e = e) (v w : V) :
    diagramElement (K := K) e v * diagramElement (K := K) e w =
      diagramElement (K := K) e (v * w)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (1 - e) * e = 0 := by rw [sub_mul, one_mul, he, sub_self]
  have h₂ : e * (1 - e) = 0 := by rw [mul_sub, mul_one, he, sub_self]
  have h₃ : (1 - e) * (1 - e) = 1 - e := by
    rw [mul_sub, mul_one, h₁, sub_zero]
  simp only [diagramElement, add_mul, mul_add, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    h₁, h₂, h₃, he, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul, map_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_eq
statement:
lemma diagramElement_eq (e : D) (v : V) :
    diagramElement (K := K) e v =
      1 + e ⊗ₜ[K] (MonoidAlgebra.of K V v - 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagramElement, TensorProduct.sub_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
  rw [← Algebra.TensorProduct.one_def]
  abel

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_orthogonal_mul
statement:
lemma diagramElement_orthogonal_mul (e p : D) (hep : e * p = 0) (v w : V) :
    diagramElement (K := K) e v * diagramElement (K := K) p w =
      1 + e ⊗ₜ[K] (MonoidAlgebra.of K V v - 1) +
        p ⊗ₜ[K] (MonoidAlgebra.of K V w - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramElement_eq, diagramElement_eq]
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add, one_mul, mul_one, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul,
    hep, TensorProduct.zero_tmul, add_zero]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_commute
statement:
lemma diagramElement_commute (e p : D) (hep : e * p = 0) (hpe : p * e = 0)
    (v w : V) :
    Commute (diagramElement (K := K) e v) (diagramElement (K := K) p w)
proof:
:= by
  show _ * _ = _ * _
  rw [diagramElement_orthogonal_mul e p hep, diagramElement_orthogonal_mul p e hpe]
  abel

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramElement_add
statement:
lemma diagramElement_add (e p : D) (hep : e * p = 0) (v : V) :
    diagramElement (K := K) (e + p) v =
      diagramElement (K := K) e v * diagramElement (K := K) p v
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramElement_orthogonal_mul e p hep, diagramElement_eq,
    TensorProduct.add_tmul, add_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramHom_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma diagramHom_val (e : D) (he : e * e = e) (v : V) :
    (diagramHom (K := K) e he v : ModelAlgebra K D V) = diagramElement e v
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramHom_commute
statement:
lemma diagramHom_commute (e p : D) (he : e * e = e) (hp : p * p = p)
    (hep : e * p = 0) (hpe : p * e = 0) (v w : V) :
    Commute (diagramHom (K := K) e he v) (diagramHom (K := K) p hp w)
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact diagramElement_commute e p hep hpe v w

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramHom_add
statement:
lemma diagramHom_add (e p : D) (he : e * e = e) (hp : p * p = p)
    (hep : e * p = 0) (_hpe : p * e = 0)
    (hs : (e + p) * (e + p) = e + p) (v : V) :
    diagramHom (K := K) (e + p) hs v =
      diagramHom (K := K) e he v * diagramHom (K := K) p hp v
proof:
:= by
  apply Units.ext
  exact diagramElement_add e p hep v

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramHom_identity_val
statement:
@[simp]
lemma diagramHom_identity_val (v : V) :
    (diagramHom (K := K) (1 : D) (one_mul _) v : ModelAlgebra K D V) =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (MonoidAlgebra.of K V v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagramElement]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.diagramHom_identity_injective
statement:
lemma diagramHom_identity_injective [Nontrivial D] :
    Function.Injective (diagramHom (K := K) (1 : D) (one_mul _) :
      V →* (ModelAlgebra K D V)ˣ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  have h' := congrArg Units.val h
  simp only [diagramHom_identity_val] at h'
  have h'' := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_injective (RingHom.injective (algebraMap K D)) h'
  exact MonoidAlgebra.of_injective h''

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_of
statement:
@[simp]
lemma copy_of (i : I) (x : X) :
    copy r S T i (PresentedGroup.of x) = PresentedGroup.of (i, x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_same
statement: lemma copy_same (s : S) : copy r S T s.val.1 = copy r S T s.val.2
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro x
  apply PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem
  exact ⟨.inr (.inl (s, x)), rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_of_commute
statement:
lemma copy_of_commute (t : T) (x y : X) :
    Commute (copy r S T t.val.1 (.of x)) (copy r S T t.val.2.1 (.of y))
proof:
:= by
  change PresentedGroup.mk _ (_ * _) = PresentedGroup.mk _ (_ * _)
  apply PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem
  exact ⟨.inr (.inr (.inl (t, x, y))), rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_of_sum
statement:
lemma copy_of_sum (t : T) (x : X) :
    copy r S T t.val.2.2 (.of x) =
      copy r S T t.val.1 (.of x) * copy r S T t.val.2.1 (.of x)
proof:
:= by
  change PresentedGroup.mk _ _ = PresentedGroup.mk _ (_ * _)
  apply PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem
  exact ⟨.inr (.inr (.inr (t, x))), rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.commute_of_generators
statement:
lemma commute_of_generators {G : Type*} [Group G]
    (f g : PresentedGroup r →* G)
    (h : ∀ x y : X, Commute (f (.of x)) (g (.of y)))
    (u v : PresentedGroup r) : Commute (f u) (g v)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ (x : X) (v : PresentedGroup r) : Commute (f (.of x)) (g v) := by
    have hv := PresentedGroup.generated_by r
      ((Subgroup.centralizer {f (.of x)}).comap g)
      (fun y => Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mpr (h x y).eq.symm) v
    exact (Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hv).symm
  have hu := PresentedGroup.generated_by r
    ((Subgroup.centralizer {g v}).comap f)
    (fun x => Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mpr (h₁ x v).eq) u
  exact Subgroup.mem_centralizer_singleton_iff.mp hu

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_commute
statement:
lemma copy_commute (t : T) (u v : PresentedGroup r) :
    Commute (copy r S T t.val.1 u) (copy r S T t.val.2.1 v)
proof:
:=
  commute_of_generators _ _ (copy_of_commute r S T t) u v

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_sum
statement:
lemma copy_sum (t : T) (u : PresentedGroup r) :
    copy r S T t.val.2.2 u = copy r S T t.val.1 u * copy r S T t.val.2.1 u
proof:
:= by
  have h : copy r S T t.val.2.2 =
      commutingProduct (copy r S T t.val.1) (copy r S T t.val.2.1) (copy_commute t) := by
    apply PresentedGroup.ext
    exact copy_of_sum r S T t
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h u

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.model_satisfies_relations
statement:
lemma model_satisfies_relations : ∀ w ∈ relators r S T,
    FreeGroup.lift (fun ix : I × X => h ix.1 (.of ix.2)) w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : I) :
      (FreeGroup.lift (fun ix : I × X => h ix.1 (.of ix.2))).comp
        (FreeGroup.map fun x => (i, x)) = (h i).comp (PresentedGroup.mk r) := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro x
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, FreeGroup.map.of, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    rfl
  rintro _ ⟨idx, rfl⟩
  rcases idx with ⟨i, w⟩ | ⟨s, x⟩ | ⟨t, x, y⟩ | ⟨t, x⟩
  · change ((FreeGroup.lift _).comp (FreeGroup.map fun x => (i, x))) w.val = 1
    rw [hc]
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, PresentedGroup.one_of_mem w.property, map_one]
  · simp only [relationWord, map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    rw [hsame s, mul_inv_cancel]
  · simp only [relationWord, map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    exact mul_inv_eq_one.mpr (hcomm t (.of x) (.of y)).eq
  · simp only [relationWord, map_mul, map_inv, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
    exact mul_inv_eq_one.mpr (hsum t (.of x))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.modelMap_copy
statement:
@[simp]
lemma modelMap_copy (i : I) : (modelMap h hsame hcomm hsum).comp (copy r S T i) = h i
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro x
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, copy_of, modelMap, PresentedGroup.toGroup.of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteEnvelope.copy_injective_of_model
statement:
lemma copy_injective_of_model (i : I) (hi : Function.Injective (h i)) :
    Function.Injective (copy r S T i)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := modelMap_copy h hsame hcomm hsum i
  intro u v huv
  apply hi
  have hv := congrArg (modelMap h hsame hcomm hsum) huv
  simpa only [← MonoidHom.comp_apply, hc] using hv

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FiniteIdempotentSystem.isIdempotent
statement:
lemma isIdempotent (P : FiniteIdempotentSystem D) (e : P.carrier) :
    (e : D) * e = e
proof: := P.idempotent e.val e.property

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TwoEnvelope.family_common
statement:
lemma family_common (s : common P₂ P₃) :
    family (K₂ := K₂) (K₃ := K₃) P₂ P₃ V s.val.1 = family P₂ P₃ V s.val.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases s with ⟨s, hs⟩
  have hs' : s = (.inl P₂.identity, .inr P₃.identity) := hs
  subst s
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TwoEnvelope.family_commute
statement:
lemma family_commute (t : triples P₂ P₃) (u v : V) :
    Commute (family (K₂ := K₂) (K₃ := K₃) P₂ P₃ V t.val.1 u)
      (family P₂ P₃ V t.val.2.1 v)
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨⟨e, p, s⟩, ht⟩
  rcases e with e | e <;> rcases p with p | p <;> rcases s with s | s <;>
    simp only [triples, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ht
  · rcases ht with ⟨hep, hpe, _⟩
    exact (diagramHom_commute (K := K₂) e.val p.val (P₂.isIdempotent e)
      (P₂.isIdempotent p) hep hpe u v).map
      (diagramHom (K := K₃) (1 : D₃) (one_mul _))
  · rcases ht with ⟨hep, hpe, _⟩
    exact diagramHom_commute (K := K₃) e.val p.val (P₃.isIdempotent e)
      (P₃.isIdempotent p) hep hpe _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TwoEnvelope.family_sum
statement:
lemma family_sum (t : triples P₂ P₃) (u : V) :
    family (K₂ := K₂) (K₃ := K₃) P₂ P₃ V t.val.2.2 u =
      family P₂ P₃ V t.val.1 u * family P₂ P₃ V t.val.2.1 u
proof:
:= by
  rcases t with ⟨⟨e, p, s⟩, ht⟩
  rcases e with e | e <;> rcases p with p | p <;> rcases s with s | s <;>
    simp only [triples, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at ht
  · rcases ht with ⟨hep, _hpe, hs⟩
    change diagramHom (K := K₃) (1 : D₃) (one_mul _) (diagramHom s.val _ u) = _
    have heq : diagramHom (K := K₂) s.val (P₂.isIdempotent s) u =
        diagramHom e.val (P₂.isIdempotent e) u * diagramHom p.val (P₂.isIdempotent p) u := by
      apply Units.ext
      change diagramElement (K := K₂) s.val u = _
      rw [hs]
      exact diagramElement_add _ _ hep u
    rw [heq, map_mul]
    rfl
  · rcases ht with ⟨hep, _hpe, hs⟩
    apply Units.ext
    let w := diagramHom (K := K₂) (1 : D₂) (one_mul _) u
    change diagramElement (K := K₃) s.val w =
      diagramElement e.val w * diagramElement p.val w
    rw [hs]
    exact diagramElement_add _ _ hep _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TwoEnvelope.family_identity_injective
statement:
lemma family_identity_injective [Nontrivial D₂] [Nontrivial D₃] :
    Function.Injective (family (K₂ := K₂) (K₃ := K₃) P₂ P₃ V (.inl P₂.identity))
proof:
:=
  (diagramHom_identity_injective (K := K₃) (D := D₃)).comp
    (diagramHom_identity_injective (K := K₂) (D := D₂))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TwoEnvelope.finite_envelope
statement:
theorem finite_envelope [Nontrivial D₂] [Nontrivial D₃] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented V] :
    ∃ (W : Type) (_ : Group W), Group.IsFinitelyPresented W ∧
      ∃ k : Index P₂ P₃ → V →* W,
        k (.inl P₂.identity) = k (.inr P₃.identity) ∧
        Function.Injective (k (.inl P₂.identity)) ∧
        (∀ t : triples P₂ P₃, ∀ u v,
          Commute (k t.val.1 u) (k t.val.2.1 v)) ∧
        (∀ t : triples P₂ P₃, ∀ u,
          k t.val.2.2 u = k t.val.1 u * k t.val.2.1 u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, r, hr, ⟨e⟩⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.exists_mulEquiv_presentedGroup (G := V)
  let : Finite r := hr
  let k (i : Index P₂ P₃) :=
    (FiniteEnvelope.copy r (common P₂ P₃) (triples P₂ P₃) i).comp e.toMonoidHom
  refine ⟨FiniteEnvelope.Envelope r (common P₂ P₃) (triples P₂ P₃),
    inferInstance, inferInstance, k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hc := FiniteEnvelope.copy_same r (common P₂ P₃) (triples P₂ P₃)
      ⟨(.inl P₂.identity, .inr P₃.identity), rfl⟩
    exact congrArg (fun φ => φ.comp e.toMonoidHom) hc
  · have hi := FiniteEnvelope.copy_injective_of_model
      (family (K₂ := K₂) (K₃ := K₃) P₂ P₃ (PresentedGroup r))
      family_common family_commute family_sum (.inl P₂.identity) family_identity_injective
    exact hi.comp e.injective
  · intro t u v
    exact FiniteEnvelope.copy_commute t (e u) (e v)
  · intro t u
    exact FiniteEnvelope.copy_sum t (e u)

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.con_finitelyNormallyGenerated
statement:
theorem con_finitelyNormallyGenerated (hA : A.FG) :
    (HNNExtension.con G A B φ).subgroup.IsFinitelyNormallyGenerated
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Group.FG A := (Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg A).mpr hA
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := (Group.FG.out : (⊤ : Subgroup A).FG)
  let C := HNNExtension.con G A B φ
  let N : Subgroup (G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ) :=
    Subgroup.normalClosure (relation φ '' (S : Set A))
  let Q := (G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ) ⧸ N
  let q : G ∗ Multiplicative ℤ →* Q := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  let f : G →* Q := q.comp inl
  let t : Q := q (inr (ofAdd 1))
  let f₀ : A →* Q := (MulAut.conj t).toMonoidHom.comp (f.comp A.subtype)
  let f₁ : A →* Q := f.comp (B.subtype.comp φ.toMonoidHom)
  have hgen : (S : Set A) ⊆ f₀.eqLocus f₁ := by
    intro a ha
    have hr : q (relation φ a) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩)
    have he : t * f a = f (φ a) * t := mul_inv_eq_one.mp hr
    change t * f a * t⁻¹ = f (φ a)
    rw [he,mul_inv_cancel_right]
  have heq : f₀ = f₁ := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro a
    have hh : (⊤ : Subgroup A) ≤ f₀.eqLocus f₁ := by
      rw [← hS]
      exact (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr hgen
    exact hh (Subgroup.mem_top a)
  have hC : C ≤ Con.ker q := by
    apply Con.conGen_le.mpr
    rintro _ _ ⟨a,rfl,rfl⟩
    change t * f a = f (φ a) * t
    have he : t * f a * t⁻¹ = f (φ a) := DFunLike.congr_fun heq a
    rw [← he, inv_mul_cancel_right]
  refine ⟨relation φ '' (S : Set A), S.finite_toSet.image _, ?_⟩
  change N = C.subgroup
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
    rintro _ ⟨a,_,rfl⟩
    have hr : C (inr (ofAdd 1) * inl (a : G))
        (inl (φ a : G) * inr (ofAdd 1)) := ConGen.Rel.of _ _ ⟨a,rfl,rfl⟩
    change C (relation φ a) 1
    have hh := C.mul hr (C.refl (inl (φ a : G) * inr (ofAdd 1))⁻¹)
    simpa only [relation, mul_inv_cancel] using hh
  · intro x hx
    apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp
    exact (hC hx).trans (map_one q)

name: OAI.Higman.HNN.finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (hA : A.FG) :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (HNNExtension G A B φ)
proof:
:= by
  let C := HNNExtension.con G A B φ
  have hfp := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.quotient C.subgroup
    (con_finitelyNormallyGenerated φ hA)
  change Group.IsFinitelyPresented C.Quotient
  rw [← QuotientGroup.con_subgroup C]
  exact hfp

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.map_equiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_equiv (p : PartialIso G) (i : G →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (a : p.source) :
    ((p.map i hi).equiv (p.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi a) : K) = i (p.equiv a)
proof:
:= by
  change i (p.equiv ((p.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi).symm
    (p.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi a))) = i (p.equiv a)
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.invariant_map
statement:
theorem invariant_map (p : PartialIso G) (i : G →* K) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (R : Subgroup G) (S : Subgroup K) (he : S.comap i = R) (h : p.Invariant R) :
    (p.map i hi).Invariant S
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := (p.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi).surjective a
  rw [map_equiv]
  change (p.equiv b : G) ∈ S.comap i ↔ (b : G) ∈ S.comap i
  rw [he]
  exact h b

name: OAI.Higman.FiniteHNN.realization
statement:
theorem realization (ps : List (PartialIso G))
    (hfg : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.source.FG) (R : Subgroup G)
    (hinv : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Invariant R) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : G →* K), Function.Injective i ∧
      ∃ T : Set K, T.Finite ∧
        (Subgroup.closure (i '' (R : Set G) ∪ T)).comap i = R ∧
        ∀ p ∈ ps, ∃ t ∈ T, ∀ a : p.source,
          i (p.equiv a) = t * i a * t⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction ps with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨G,inferInstance,inferInstance,MonoidHom.id G,Function.injective_id,
      ∅,Set.finite_empty,?_,?_⟩
    · simp
    · simp
  | cons p ps ih =>
    obtain ⟨K,_,_,i,hi,T,hT,hR,hrel⟩ := ih
      (fun q hq ↦ hfg q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))
      (fun q hq ↦ hinv q (List.mem_cons_of_mem p hq))
    let q := p.map i hi
    let E := HNNExtension K q.source q.target q.equiv
    let j : K →* E := HNNExtension.of
    let i' := j.comp i
    let C := Subgroup.closure (i '' (R : Set G) ∪ T)
    let T' : Set E := j '' T ∪ {HNNExtension.t}
    have hqfg : q.source.FG := by
      obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := hfg p (List.mem_cons_self)
      refine (Subgroup.fg_iff _).mpr ⟨i '' (S : Set G),?_,S.finite_toSet.image i⟩
      rw [← MonoidHom.map_closure,hS]
      rfl
    have hCinv : q.Invariant C :=
      p.invariant_map i hi R C hR (hinv p (List.mem_cons_self))
    have hC : (Subgroup.closure (j '' (C : Set K) ∪ {HNNExtension.t})).comap j = C :=
      HNNSubgroup.closure_comap_of q.equiv C hCinv
    have hclosure : Subgroup.closure (i' '' (R : Set G) ∪ T') =
        Subgroup.closure (j '' (C : Set K) ∪ {HNNExtension.t}) := by
      conv_rhs => rw [Subgroup.closure_union,← MonoidHom.map_closure j (C : Set K),Subgroup.closure_eq]
      change Subgroup.closure (i' '' (R : Set G) ∪ T') =
        C.map j ⊔ Subgroup.closure {HNNExtension.t}
      rw [show C.map j = Subgroup.closure (j '' (i '' (R : Set G) ∪ T)) from
        MonoidHom.map_closure j _]
      rw [← Subgroup.closure_union]
      congr 1
      simp only [T',Set.image_union,Set.image_image,Set.union_assoc,i',MonoidHom.coe_comp]
      rfl
    refine ⟨E,inferInstance,HNN.finitelyPresented q.equiv hqfg,i',
      (HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := q.equiv)).comp hi,T',
      (hT.image j).union (Set.finite_singleton _),?_,?_⟩
    · rw [hclosure]
      change ((Subgroup.closure (j '' (C : Set K) ∪ {HNNExtension.t})).comap j).comap i = R
      rw [hC]
      exact hR
    · intro a ha
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp ha with rfl | ha
      · refine ⟨HNNExtension.t,Or.inr rfl,?_⟩
        intro b
        have he := HNNExtension.equiv_eq_conj (φ := q.equiv)
          (a.source.equivMapOfInjective i hi b)
        simpa only [q,PartialIso.map_equiv,i',j,MonoidHom.comp_apply,
          Subgroup.coe_equivMapOfInjective_apply] using he
      · obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := hrel a ha
        refine ⟨j t,Or.inl ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩,?_⟩
        intro b
        simpa only [i',MonoidHom.comp_apply,map_mul,map_inv] using congrArg j (he b)

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.invariant_sInf
statement:
theorem invariant_sInf (p : PartialIso G) (C : Set (Subgroup G))
    (hC : ∀ S ∈ C, p.Invariant S) : p.Invariant (sInf C)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_sInf]
  exact forall₂_congr fun S hS ↦ hC S hS a

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.subset
statement:
theorem subset (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) :
    S ⊆ subgroup ps S
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact Subgroup.mem_sInf.mpr (fun R hR ↦ hR.1 hx)

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.invariant
statement:
theorem invariant (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) (p : PartialIso G)
    (hp : p ∈ ps) : p.Invariant (subgroup ps S)
proof:
:=
  p.invariant_sInf _ (fun _ hR ↦ hR.2 p hp)

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.minimal
statement:
theorem minimal (ps : List (PartialIso G)) (S : Set G) (R : Subgroup G)
    (hS : S ⊆ R) (hR : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.Invariant R) : subgroup ps S ≤ R
proof:
:=
  sInf_le ⟨hS,hR⟩

name: OAI.Higman.Orbit.benign
statement:
theorem benign [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (ps : List (PartialIso G))
    (hfg : ∀ p ∈ ps, p.source.FG) (S : Set G) (hS : S.Finite) :
    IsBenign (subgroup ps S)
proof:
:= by
  let R := subgroup ps S
  obtain ⟨K,_,_,i,hi,T,hT,hR,hrel⟩ := FiniteHNN.realization ps hfg R
    (fun p hp ↦ invariant ps S p hp)
  let B := Subgroup.closure (i '' S ∪ T)
  have hB : B.FG := (Subgroup.fg_iff _).mpr ⟨i '' S ∪ T, rfl, (hS.image i).union hT⟩
  refine ⟨K,inferInstance,inferInstance,i,hi,B,hB,?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      B.comap i ≤ (Subgroup.closure (i '' (R : Set G) ∪ T)).comap i :=
        Subgroup.comap_mono (Subgroup.closure_mono
          (Set.union_subset_union_left _ (Set.image_mono (subset ps S))))
      _ = R := hR
  · apply minimal ps S (B.comap i)
    · intro x hx
      exact Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩)
    · intro p hp a
      obtain ⟨t,ht,he⟩ := hrel p hp
      have htB : t ∈ B := Subgroup.subset_closure (Or.inr ht)
      change i (p.equiv a) ∈ B ↔ i a ∈ B
      rw [he a]
      constructor
      · intro ha
        have hh := B.mul_mem (B.mul_mem (B.inv_mem htB) ha) htB
        simpa only [inv_mul_cancel_left,mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel,mul_one] using hh
      · intro ha
        exact B.mul_mem (B.mul_mem htB ha) (B.inv_mem htB)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.lipschitz_insertNth
statement:
lemma lipschitz_insertNth {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n+1)) (c : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ : Fin (n+1) => ℝ) i c : (Fin n → ℝ) → (Fin (n+1) → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one,one_mul]
  rw [dist_pi_le_iff dist_nonneg]
  intro j
  refine Fin.succAboveCases i ?_ (fun k => ?_) j
  · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_same,dist_self,dist_nonneg]
  · simp only [Fin.insertNth_apply_succAbove]
    exact dist_le_pi_dist x y k

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.sphere_subset_faces
statement:
lemma sphere_subset_faces (n : ℕ) :
    Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) 1 ⊆
      ⋃ i : Fin (n+1), ⋃ c ∈ ({1,-1}:Set ℝ), Set.range (Fin.insertNth (α := fun _ : Fin (n+1) => ℝ) i c : (Fin n → ℝ) → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxnorm : ‖x‖ = 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using hx
  have hi : ∃ i, 1 ≤ ‖x i‖ := by
    by_contra! hh
    have := (pi_norm_lt_iff (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).mpr hh
    linarith
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hi
  have heq : |x i| = 1 := le_antisymm ((norm_le_pi_norm x i).trans_eq hxnorm) hi
  have hc : x i ∈ ({1,-1}:Set ℝ) := by
    rcases abs_eq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤1) |>.mp heq with h | h <;> simp [h]
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x i,Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hc,?_⟩⟩⟩
  exact ⟨fun j => x (i.succAbove j),Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth _ _⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.dimH_cube_boundary_le
statement:
lemma dimH_cube_boundary_le (n : ℕ) :
    dimH (Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) 1) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  apply (dimH_mono (sphere_subset_faces n)).trans
  rw [dimH_iUnion]
  apply iSup_le
  intro i
  rw [dimH_bUnion (Set.toFinite ({1,-1}:Set ℝ)).countable]
  apply iSup_le
  intro c
  apply iSup_le
  intro _
  exact (lipschitz_insertNth i c).dimH_range_le.trans_eq (Real.dimH_univ_pi_fin n)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GeneralPosition.dimH_cube_boundary_subtype_le
statement:
lemma dimH_cube_boundary_subtype_le (n : ℕ) :
    dimH (Set.univ : Set (Metric.sphere (0 : Fin (n+1) → ℝ) 1)) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isometry_subtype_coe.dimH_image]
  simpa only [Subtype.range_coe_subtype,Set.image_univ,Set.ofPred_mem_eq] using dimH_cube_boundary_le n

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.sphere_filling_preserved
statement:
lemma sphere_filling_preserved {m : ℕ} (hm : m < n)
    (hX : ∀ f : C(Sphere (m+1),X), SphereTopology.Extends f)
    (f : C(Sphere (m+1),Space a)) : SphereTopology.Extends f
proof:
:= by
  let := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty m
  have hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set (Sphere (m+1))) < n :=
    (GeneralPosition.dimH_cube_boundary_subtype_le m).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hm)
  obtain ⟨g,H,_⟩ := exists_deformation_into_base a f hdim
  apply SphereTopology.extends_of_homotopy H
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := hX g
  refine ⟨(⟨base a,continuous_base a⟩ : C(X,Space a)).comp F,?_⟩
  ext x
  exact congrArg (base a) (ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.dimH_disk_subtype_le
statement: lemma dimH_disk_subtype_le (m : ℕ) : dimH (Set.univ : Set (Disk m)) ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isometry_subtype_coe.dimH_image]
  have hm := dimH_mono (Set.subset_univ (closedBall (0 : Fin m → ℝ) 1))
  simpa only [Set.image_univ,Subtype.range_coe_subtype,Set.ofPred_mem_eq,Real.dimH_univ_pi_fin] using hm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.filling_reflected
statement:
lemma filling_reflected {m : ℕ} (hm : m < n) (b : C(Sphere m,X))
    (hb : SphereTopology.Extends ((⟨base a,continuous_base a⟩ : C(X,Space a)).comp b)) :
    SphereTopology.Extends b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := hb
  have hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set (Disk m)) < n :=
    (dimH_disk_subtype_le m).trans_lt (by exact_mod_cast hm)
  obtain ⟨g,H,hstat⟩ := exists_deformation_into_base a F hdim
  refine ⟨g,?_⟩
  ext x
  apply (base_closedEmbedding a).injective
  have hb' : F (SphereTopology.boundary m x) = base a (b x) := ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x
  have hh := hstat 1 (SphereTopology.boundary m x) ⟨b x,hb'.symm⟩
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one,ContinuousMap.comp_apply,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,hb'] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.pathConnectedSpace
statement: lemma pathConnectedSpace : PathConnectedSpace (Space a)
proof:
:= by
  let x₀ : X := Classical.choice inferInstance
  let s₀ : Sphere n := Classical.choice inferInstance
  have hj : ∀ z : Space a, Joined (base a x₀) z := by
    intro z
    cases z with
    | inl x => exact (PathConnectedSpace.joined x₀ x).map (continuous_base a)
    | inr p =>
      have h : Joined (boundary n s₀) (interior n p.2) := PathConnectedSpace.joined _ _
      have hh := h.map (cell a p.1).continuous
      rw [cell_interior,cell_boundary] at hh
      exact ((PathConnectedSpace.joined x₀ (a p.1 s₀)).map (continuous_base a)).trans hh
  exact ⟨⟨base a x₀⟩,fun x y => (hj x).symm.trans (hj y)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationCover_pathConnected
statement: lemma presentationCover_pathConnected : PathConnectedSpace (PresentationCover s rels hrel)
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : Subgroup.closure (Set.range s) = ⊤ := by
    rw [←FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure,MonoidHom.range_eq_top]
    exact hs
  let := graph_pathConnected s hgen
  let := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty 1
  exact Attachment.pathConnectedSpace _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationCover_sphereFill
statement: lemma presentationCover_sphereFill (b : C(Sphere 2,PresentationCover s rels hrel)) : SphereTopology.Extends b
proof:
:= by
  let := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty 1
  have hdim : dimH (Set.univ : Set (Sphere 2)) < 2 :=
    (GeneralPosition.dimH_cube_boundary_subtype_le 1).trans_lt (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨g,H,_⟩ := exists_deformation_into_base _ b hdim
  apply SphereTopology.extends_of_homotopy H
  exact SphereTopology.extends_of_nullhomotopic
    (((presentationGraphNullhomotopy s rels hrel hs hker).compContinuousMap g).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationCover_simplyConnected
statement: lemma presentationCover_simplyConnected : SimplyConnectedSpace (PresentationCover s rels hrel)
proof:
:= by
  apply simply_connected_iff_loops_nullhomotopic.mpr
  refine ⟨presentationCover_pathConnected s rels hrel hs,?_⟩
  intro x p
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := presentationCover_sphereFill s rels hrel hs hker (LoopSphere.map p)
  apply LoopSphere.homotopic_of_fill p F
  intro z
  exact ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF z

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.orbit_mk_smul
statement: lemma orbit_mk_smul (g : G) (a : A) : (Quotient.mk'' (g • a) : Orbits (G := G) (A := A)) = Quotient.mk'' a
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.sound
  exact ⟨g,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.orbit_out_translate
statement: lemma orbit_out_translate (a : A) : ∃ g : G, a = g • (Quotient.mk'' a : Orbits (G := G)).out
proof:
:= by
  have h := Quotient.exact (Quotient.out_eq' (q := (Quotient.mk'' a : Orbits (G := G))))
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := h
  refine ⟨g⁻¹,?_⟩
  rw [←hg,inv_smul_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.orbitCoordinates_bijective
statement: lemma orbitCoordinates_bijective : Function.Bijective (fun p : G × Orbits (G := G) (A := A) => p.1 • p.2.out)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g,q⟩ ⟨h,r⟩ he
    have hqr : q = r := by
      have hh := congrArg (fun a : A => (Quotient.mk'' a : Orbits (G := G))) he
      simpa only [orbit_mk_smul,Quotient.out_eq'] using hh
    subst r
    change g • q.out = h • q.out at he
    have hh : (h⁻¹*g) • q.out = q.out := by rw [mul_smul,he,inv_smul_smul]
    have hh := hfree (h⁻¹*g) q.out hh
    have hgh : g = h := (inv_mul_eq_one.mp hh).symm
    exact Prod.ext hgh rfl
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := orbit_out_translate (G := G) a
    exact ⟨(g,Quotient.mk'' a),hg.symm⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.orbitCoordinates_apply
statement:
lemma orbitCoordinates_apply (g : G) (q : Orbits (G := G) (A := A)) :
    orbitCoordinates hfree (g,q) = g • q.out
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_apply
statement:
lemma actionChart_apply (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    actionChart σ n i x = i.1 • RelCWComplex.map n (σ n (1,i.2)) x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_image
statement:
lemma actionChart_image (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) (A : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    actionChart σ n i '' A = (fun x : X => i.1 • x) '' (RelCWComplex.map n (σ n (1,i.2)) '' A)
proof:
:=
  Set.image_comp (fun x : X => i.1 • x) (RelCWComplex.map n (σ n (1,i.2))) A

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_source
statement:
lemma actionChart_source (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) :
    (actionChart σ n i).source = ball 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [actionChart,PartialEquiv.trans_source,RelCWComplex.source_eq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_continuousOn
statement:
lemma actionChart_continuousOn (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) :
    ContinuousOn (actionChart σ n i) (closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_const_smul i.1).comp_continuousOn (RelCWComplex.continuousOn _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_continuousOn_symm
statement:
lemma actionChart_continuousOn_symm (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) :
    ContinuousOn (actionChart σ n i).symm (actionChart σ n i).target
proof:
:= by
  change ContinuousOn (fun y => (RelCWComplex.map n (σ n (1,i.2))).symm (i.1⁻¹ • y))
    (univ ∩ (fun y : X => i.1⁻¹ • y) ⁻¹' (RelCWComplex.map n (σ n (1,i.2))).target)
  exact (RelCWComplex.continuousOn_symm _ _).comp (continuous_const_smul _).continuousOn
    (fun _ h => h.2)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_open
statement:
lemma actionChart_open (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) :
    actionChart σ n i '' ball 0 1 = RelCWComplex.openCell n (σ n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actionChart_image]
  exact ho n i.1 i.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_closed
statement:
lemma actionChart_closed (n : ℕ) (i : G × ι n) :
    actionChart σ n i '' closedBall 0 1 = RelCWComplex.closedCell n (σ n i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actionChart_image]
  exact hc n i.1 i.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.closedCell_smul
statement:
lemma closedCell_smul (n : ℕ) (g h : G) (i : ι n) :
    (fun x : X => g • x) '' RelCWComplex.closedCell n (σ n (h,i)) =
      RelCWComplex.closedCell n (σ n (g*h,i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [←hc n h i,←Set.image_comp]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,mul_smul] using hc n (g*h) i

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.actionChart_smul
statement:
lemma actionChart_smul (n : ℕ) (g : G) (i : G × ι n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    actionChart σ n (g*i.1,i.2) x = g • actionChart σ n i x
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_smul _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.vertexTranslate_injective
statement: lemma vertexTranslate_injective (g : G) : Function.Injective (fun v : ℕ × G => (v.1,g*v.2))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i,a⟩ ⟨j,b⟩ h
  change (i,g*a) = (j,g*b) at h
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa only using congrArg (fun v : ℕ × G => v.1) h
  · exact mul_left_cancel (congrArg Prod.snd h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_card
statement: lemma translate_card (g : G) (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : (translate g s).card = s.card
proof:
:=
  Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (vertexTranslate_injective G g)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.cell_smul_val
statement:
lemma cell_smul_val (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) (c : StageCell G S n) :
    (g • c).1.1 = translate g c.1.1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.cellAction_free
statement:
lemma cellAction_free (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) (c : StageCell G S n)
    (h : g • c = c) : g = 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : translate g c.1.1 = c.1.1 := congrArg (fun c : StageCell G S n => c.1.1) h
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := c.1.2.1.1
  have ht : (v.1,g*v.2) ∈ c.1.1 := he ▸ Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩
  have heq := c.1.2.1.2 ht hv rfl
  have hg : g * v.2 = v.2 := congrArg Prod.snd heq
  exact mul_right_cancel (hg.trans (one_mul _).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.cellCoordinates_apply
statement:
lemma cellCoordinates_apply (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) (c : CellOrbits G S n) :
    cellCoordinates G S n (g,c) = g • c.out
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_smul_support
statement:
lemma stage_smul_support (S : Shapes G) (g : G) (x : Stage G S) :
    (g • x).1.support = translate g x.1.support
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapDomain_support_of_injective (vertexTranslate_injective G g) _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_openCell
statement:
lemma stage_openCell (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (c : StageCell G S n) :
    RelCWComplex.openCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n c = {x : Stage G S | x.1.support = c.1.1}
proof:
:=
  Simplicial.characteristicPE_open _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_closedCell
statement:
lemma stage_closedCell (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (c : StageCell G S n) :
    RelCWComplex.closedCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n c = {x : Stage G S | x.1.support ⊆ c.1.1}
proof:
:= by
  change Simplicial.characteristicPE _ c '' closedBall 0 1 = _
  rw [Simplicial.characteristicPE_closed,Simplicial.range_faceMap]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_openCell_smul
statement:
lemma stage_openCell_smul (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) (c : StageCell G S n) :
    (fun x : Stage G S => g • x) '' RelCWComplex.openCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n c = RelCWComplex.openCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n (g • c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stage_openCell,stage_openCell]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩
    change (g • y).1.support = (g • c).1.1
    rw [stage_smul_support,cell_smul_val,hy]
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨g⁻¹ • x,?_,smul_inv_smul _ _⟩
    change (g⁻¹ • x).1.support = c.1.1
    change x.1.support = translate g c.1.1 at hx
    rw [stage_smul_support,hx,translate_mul,inv_mul_cancel,translate_one]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_closedCell_smul
statement:
lemma stage_closedCell_smul (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) (c : StageCell G S n) :
    (fun x : Stage G S => g • x) '' RelCWComplex.closedCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n c = RelCWComplex.closedCell (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S))) n (g • c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stage_closedCell,stage_closedCell]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩
    change (g • y).1.support ⊆ (g • c).1.1
    rw [stage_smul_support,cell_smul_val]
    exact translate_mono _ hy
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨g⁻¹ • x,?_,smul_inv_smul _ _⟩
    change (g⁻¹ • x).1.support ⊆ c.1.1
    rw [stage_smul_support]
    have h := translate_mono g⁻¹ hx
    simpa only [cell_smul_val,translate_mul,inv_mul_cancel,translate_one] using h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edgeImage_edge_slice
statement:
lemma edgeImage_edge_slice [DecidableEq C] (c d : C) (S : Set (I × B)) :
    (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R d z.1 z.2) ⁻¹'
      ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S) =
      (if d = c then S else ∅) ∪
      ({0} ×ˢ ((L d) ⁻¹' ((vertex τ L R d) ⁻¹'
        ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S)))) ∪
      ({1} ×ˢ ((R d) ⁻¹' ((vertex τ L R (τ d)) ⁻¹'
        ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨t,x⟩
  constructor
  · intro hz
    by_cases h0 : t = 0
    · subst t
      change edge τ L R d 0 x ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S) at hz
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨rfl,by
        change vertex τ L R d (L d x) ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S)
        rw [edge_zero] at hz; exact hz⟩)
    · by_cases h1 : t = 1
      · subst t
        change edge τ L R d 1 x ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S) at hz
        exact Or.inr ⟨rfl,by
          change vertex τ L R (τ d) (R d x) ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S)
          rw [edge_one] at hz; exact hz⟩
      · let s : Inner := ⟨t.1,lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (fun h => h0 (Subtype.ext h.symm)),
          lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (fun h => h1 (Subtype.ext h))⟩
        have he : edge τ L R d t x = interior τ L R d s x := edge_inner τ L R d s x
        obtain ⟨z,hz,hze⟩ := hz
        have hm : z ∈ (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' {interior τ L R d s x} := hze.trans he
        rw [interior_preimage] at hm
        split_ifs at hm with hcd
        · change z = (t,x) at hm
          exact Or.inl (Or.inl (by rw [ite_eq_left hcd.symm]; exact hm ▸ hz))
        · exact False.elim hm
  · rintro ((hz|hz)|hz)
    · split_ifs at hz with hdc
      · subst d; exact ⟨(t,x),hz,rfl⟩
      · exact False.elim hz
    · rcases hz with ⟨h0,hx⟩
      change t = 0 at h0
      subst t
      change edge τ L R d 0 x ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S)
      rw [edge_zero]
      exact hx
    · rcases hz with ⟨h1,hx⟩
      change t = 1 at h1
      subst t
      change edge τ L R d 1 x ∈ ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S)
      rw [edge_one]
      exact hx

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_injective
statement:
lemma edge_injective (c : C) (hτ : τ c ≠ c) (hL : Function.Injective (L c))
    (hR : Function.Injective (R c)) : Function.Injective (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rintro ⟨t,x⟩ ⟨s,y⟩ he
  by_cases h0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    have he' : edge τ L R c s y = vertex τ L R c (L c x) := he.symm.trans (edge_zero τ L R c x)
    rcases (edge_eq_vertex τ L R c c s y (L c x)).mp he' with ⟨rfl,_,hy⟩|⟨_,ht,_⟩
    · exact Prod.ext rfl (hL hy).symm
    · exact False.elim (hτ ht)
  · by_cases h1 : t = 1
    · subst t
      have he' : edge τ L R c s y = vertex τ L R (τ c) (R c x) := he.symm.trans (edge_one τ L R c x)
      rcases (edge_eq_vertex τ L R c (τ c) s y (R c x)).mp he' with ⟨_,ht,_⟩|⟨rfl,_,hy⟩
      · exact False.elim (hτ ht.symm)
      · exact Prod.ext rfl (hR hy).symm
    · let r : Inner := ⟨t.1,lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (fun h => h0 (Subtype.ext h.symm)),
        lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (fun h => h1 (Subtype.ext h))⟩
      have ht : edge τ L R c t x = interior τ L R c r x := edge_inner τ L R c r x
      have hm : (s,y) ∈ (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' {interior τ L R c r x} := he.symm.trans ht
      rw [interior_preimage,ite_eq_left rfl] at hm
      exact (show (s,y) = (t,x) from hm).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_closedMap
statement:
lemma edge_closedMap (c : C) (hL : IsClosedMap (L c)) (hR : IsClosedMap (R c)) :
    IsClosedMap (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro S hS
  apply (isClosed_iff τ L R _).mpr
  refine ⟨fun d => edgeImage_vertex_closed τ L R c d S hS hL hR,fun d => ?_⟩
  rw [edgeImage_edge_slice]
  apply IsClosed.union
  · apply IsClosed.union
    · split_ifs; exact hS; exact isClosed_empty
    · exact isClosed_singleton.prod ((edgeImage_vertex_closed τ L R c d S hS hL hR).preimage (L d).continuous)
  · exact isClosed_singleton.prod ((edgeImage_vertex_closed τ L R c (τ d) S hS hL hR).preimage (R d).continuous)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_closedEmbedding
statement:
lemma edge_closedEmbedding (c : C) (hτ : τ c ≠ c) (hL : IsClosedEmbedding (L c))
    (hR : IsClosedEmbedding (R c)) : IsClosedEmbedding (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2)
proof:
:=
  IsClosedEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isClosedMap (edgeMap τ L R c).continuous
    (edge_injective τ L R c hτ hL.injective hR.injective)
    (edge_closedMap τ L R c hL.isClosedMap hR.isClosedMap)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro z
  change Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B) at z
  cases z with
  | inl z => exact hv z.1 z.2
  | inr z =>
    have hh := he z.1 (⟨z.2.1.1,z.2.1.2.1.le,z.2.1.2.2.le⟩,z.2.2)
    rw [edge_inner] at hh
    exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.transRefl_natural
statement:
lemma transRefl_natural {x y : Y} (p : Path x y) (z : I × I) :
    Path.Homotopy.transRefl p z = p (unpause z)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.continuous_transRefl
statement:
lemma continuous_transRefl {a b : J → Y} (p : ∀ j,Path (a j) (b j))
    (hp : Continuous (fun z : J × I => p z.1 z.2)) :
    Continuous (fun z : J × (I × I) => Path.Homotopy.transRefl (p z.1) z.2)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun z : J × (I × I) => p z.1 (unpause z.2))
  exact hp.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (unpause.continuous.comp continuous_snd))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edgePath_continuous
statement: lemma edgePath_continuous (c : C) : Continuous (fun z : B × I => edgePath τ L R c z.1 z.2)
proof:
:=
  (edgeMap τ L R c).continuous.comp continuous_swap

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.pausedEdge_continuous
statement: lemma pausedEdge_continuous (c : C) : Continuous (fun z : B × I => pausedEdge τ L R c z.1 z.2)
proof:
:=
  Path.trans_continuous_family (edgePath τ L R c) (edgePath_continuous τ L R c)
    (fun x => Path.refl (vertex τ L R (τ c) (R c x)))
    ((vertexMap τ L R (τ c)).continuous.comp ((R c).continuous.comp continuous_fst))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.pause_vertex
statement: lemma pause_vertex (c : C) (x : A) : pause τ L R (vertex τ L R c x) = vertex τ L R c x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.pause_edge
statement: lemma pause_edge (c : C) (z : I × B) : pause τ L R (edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) = pausedEdge τ L R c z.2 z.1
proof:
:=
  lift_edge τ L R _ _ _ _ c z

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.pauseEdgeHomotopy_continuous
statement:
lemma pauseEdgeHomotopy_continuous (c : C) :
    Continuous (fun z : I × (I × B) =>
      Path.Homotopy.transRefl (edgePath τ L R c z.2.2) (z.1,z.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun z : I × (I × B) =>
    edge τ L R c (PathFamilies.unpause (z.1,z.2.1)) z.2.2)
  exact (edgeMap τ L R c).continuous.comp
    ((PathFamilies.unpause.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.fst)).prodMk
      continuous_snd.snd)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.homogeneousMap_vertex
statement:
lemma homogeneousMap_vertex (c : C) (x : A) :
    homogeneousMap τ F ν K sig hsig a ha (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x) =
      vertex ν (fun _ => .id B) K (sig c) (a c x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.homogeneousMap_edge
statement:
lemma homogeneousMap_edge (c : C) (t : I) (x : A) :
    homogeneousMap τ F ν K sig hsig a ha (edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F c t x) =
      edge ν (fun _ => .id B) K (sig c) t (a c x)
proof: := lift_edge τ _ F _ _ _ _ c (t,x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.actionMap_vertex
statement:
lemma actionMap_vertex (g : G) (c : C) (x : A) :
    actionMap τ F hτ a ha g (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x) =
      vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (g • c) (a g c x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.actionMap_edge
statement:
lemma actionMap_edge (g : G) (c : C) (t : I) (x : A) :
    actionMap τ F hτ a ha g (edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F c t x) =
      edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F (g • c) t (a g c x)
proof:
:=
  homogeneousMap_edge τ F τ F _ _ _ _ c t x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.graphAction_continuous
statement:
lemma graphAction_continuous : @ContinuousConstSMul G (Space τ (fun _ => .id A) F) _
    (graphAction τ F hτ a ha a_one a_mul).toSMul

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_zero
statement: lemma edge_zero (c : C) (x : B) : edge τ L R c 0 x = vertex τ L R c (L c x)
proof: := by simp [edge]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_one
statement: lemma edge_one (c : C) (x : B) : edge τ L R c 1 x = vertex τ L R (τ c) (R c x)
proof: := by simp [edge]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_inner
statement:
lemma edge_inner (c : C) (s : Inner) (x : B) :
    edge τ L R c ⟨s.1,s.2.1.le,s.2.2.le⟩ x = interior τ L R c s x
proof:
:= by
  unfold edge
  split_ifs with h0 h1
  · exact False.elim (s.2.1.ne' (congrArg Subtype.val h0))
  · exact False.elim (s.2.2.ne (congrArg Subtype.val h1))
  · rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.continuous_quotient
statement: lemma continuous_quotient : Continuous (quotient τ L R)
proof: := continuous_coinduced_rng

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.continuous_vertex
statement: lemma continuous_vertex : Continuous (fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_quotient τ L R).comp continuous_inl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.continuous_edge
statement: lemma continuous_edge : Continuous (fun z : C × (I × B) => edge τ L R z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_quotient τ L R).comp continuous_inr

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.continuous_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_iff {Y : Type z} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : Space τ L R → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ (∀ c,Continuous (fun x => f (vertex τ L R c x))) ∧
      ∀ c,Continuous (fun z : I × B => f (edge τ L R c z.1 z.2))
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous[TopologicalSpace.coinduced (quotient τ L R) inferInstance,_] f ↔ _
  rw [continuous_coinduced_dom,continuous_sum_dom]
  exact and_congr continuous_prod_of_discrete_left continuous_prod_of_discrete_left

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.closed_of_slices
statement:
lemma closed_of_slices {D : Type*} [TopologicalSpace D] {S : Set (C × D)}
    (h : ∀ c,IsClosed ((fun x => (c,x)) ⁻¹' S)) : IsClosed S
proof:
:= by
  rw [←isOpen_compl_iff]
  apply isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.mpr
  intro z hz
  refine ⟨{z.1} ×ˢ ((fun x => (z.1,x)) ⁻¹' S)ᶜ,?_,
    (isOpen_discrete {z.1}).prod (h z.1).isOpen_compl,⟨rfl,hz⟩⟩
  intro p hp
  have he : p.1 = z.1 := hp.1
  simpa only [Set.mem_compl_iff,Set.mem_preimage,←he] using hp.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.isClosed_iff
statement:
lemma isClosed_iff (S : Set (Space τ L R)) :
    IsClosed S ↔ (∀ c,IsClosed ((vertex τ L R c) ⁻¹' S)) ∧
      ∀ c,IsClosed ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' S)
proof:
:= by
  change @IsClosed _ (TopologicalSpace.coinduced (quotient τ L R) inferInstance) S ↔ _
  rw [isClosed_coinduced,isClosed_sum_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv,he⟩
    exact ⟨fun c => hv.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id),
      fun c => he.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv,he⟩
    exact ⟨closed_of_slices hv,closed_of_slices he⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.liftFun_vertex
statement: lemma liftFun_vertex (c : C) (x : A) : liftFun τ L R v e (vertex τ L R c x) = v c x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.liftFun_edge
statement: lemma liftFun_edge (c : C) (t : I) (x : B) : liftFun τ L R v e (edge τ L R c t x) = e c (t,x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold edge
  split_ifs with h0 h1
  · subst t; exact (he0 c x).symm
  · subst t; exact (he1 c x).symm
  · rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.lift_vertex
statement: lemma lift_vertex (c : C) (x : A) : lift τ L R v e he0 he1 (vertex τ L R c x) = v c x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.lift_edge
statement: lemma lift_edge (c : C) (z : I × B) : lift τ L R v e he0 he1 (edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) = e c z
proof:
:=
  liftFun_edge τ L R v e he0 he1 c z.1 z.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_preimage_vertices
statement:
lemma edge_preimage_vertices (S : Set (C × A)) (c : C) :
    (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) ⁻¹'
      ((fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2) '' S) =
    ({0} ×ˢ ((fun x => (c,L c x)) ⁻¹' S)) ∪
      ({1} ×ˢ ((fun x => (τ c,R c x)) ⁻¹' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨t,x⟩
  change edge τ L R c t x ∈ ((fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2) '' S) ↔
    (t = 0 ∧ (c,L c x) ∈ S) ∨ (t = 1 ∧ (τ c,R c x) ∈ S)
  by_cases h0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    rw [edge_zero]
    simp only [true_and,zero_ne_one,false_and,or_false]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a,ha,he⟩
      have heq : a = (c,L c x) := Sum.inl.inj he
      exact heq ▸ ha
    · intro h; exact ⟨(c,L c x),h,rfl⟩
  · by_cases h1 : t = 1
    · subst t
      rw [edge_one]
      simp only [one_ne_zero,false_and,true_and,false_or]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a,ha,he⟩
        have heq : a = (τ c,R c x) := Sum.inl.inj he
        exact heq ▸ ha
      · intro h; exact ⟨(τ c,R c x),h,rfl⟩
    · have ht : ∃ z : Inner,t = ⟨z.1,z.2.1.le,z.2.2.le⟩ :=
        ⟨⟨t.1,lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (fun h => h0 (Subtype.ext h.symm)),
          lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (fun h => h1 (Subtype.ext h))⟩,rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨s,rfl⟩ := ht
      rw [edge_inner]
      simp only [h0,h1,false_and,or_self,iff_false]
      rintro ⟨a,_,he⟩
      change (Sum.inl a : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inr (c,(s,x)) at he
      cases he

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.base_closedEmbedding
statement: lemma base_closedEmbedding : IsClosedEmbedding (fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsClosedEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isClosedMap (continuous_vertex τ L R)
    Sum.inl_injective
  intro S hS
  apply (isClosed_iff τ L R _).mpr
  constructor
  · intro c
    have he : (vertex τ L R c) ⁻¹' ((fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2) '' S) =
        (fun x => (c,x)) ⁻¹' S := by
      ext x
      change (∃ a ∈ S, (Sum.inl a : Space τ L R) = Sum.inl (c,x)) ↔ (c,x) ∈ S
      simp only [Sum.inl.injEq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨a,ha,he⟩; cases he; exact ha
      · intro h; exact ⟨(c,x),h,rfl⟩
    rw [he]
    exact hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
  · intro c
    rw [edge_preimage_vertices]
    exact (isClosed_singleton.prod (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk (L c).continuous))).union
      (isClosed_singleton.prod (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk (R c).continuous)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.interior_preimage
statement:
lemma interior_preimage [DecidableEq C] (c d : C) (s : Inner) (x : B) :
    (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' {interior τ L R d s x} =
      (if c = d then {((⟨s.1,s.2.1.le,s.2.2.le⟩ : I),x)} else ∅ : Set (I × B))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext ⟨t,y⟩
  change edge τ L R c t y = interior τ L R d s x ↔ _
  have hright : (t,y) ∈ (if c = d then {((⟨s.1,s.2.1.le,s.2.2.le⟩ : I),x)} else ∅ : Set (I × B)) ↔
      c = d ∧ t.1 = s.1 ∧ y = x := by
    split_ifs with h
    · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff,Prod.mk.injEq,h,true_and]
      exact and_congr Subtype.ext_iff Iff.rfl
    · simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false,h,false_and]
  rw [hright]
  by_cases h0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    rw [edge_zero]
    constructor
    · intro h
      change (Sum.inl (c,L c y) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inr (d,(s,x)) at h
      cases h
    · rintro ⟨_,h,_⟩; exact False.elim (s.2.1.ne' h.symm)
  · by_cases h1 : t = 1
    · subst t
      rw [edge_one]
      constructor
      · intro h
        change (Sum.inl (τ c,R c y) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inr (d,(s,x)) at h
        cases h
      · rintro ⟨_,h,_⟩; exact False.elim (s.2.2.ne h.symm)
    · have ht : ∃ z : Inner,t = ⟨z.1,z.2.1.le,z.2.2.le⟩ :=
        ⟨⟨t.1,lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (fun h => h0 (Subtype.ext h.symm)),
          lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (fun h => h1 (Subtype.ext h))⟩,rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨s',rfl⟩ := ht
      rw [edge_inner]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have he : (c,(s',y)) = (d,(s,x)) := Sum.inr.inj h
        exact ⟨congrArg Prod.fst he,congrArg (fun z => z.2.1.1) he,
          congrArg (fun z => z.2.2) he⟩
      · rintro ⟨rfl,hs,rfl⟩
        have he : s' = s := Subtype.ext hs
        rw [he]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.selection_closed
statement:
lemma selection_closed {J : Type z} (c : J → C) (hc : Function.Injective c)
    (s : J → Inner) (x : J → B) (S : Set (Space τ L R))
    (hS : S ⊆ Set.range (fun j => interior τ L R (c j) (s j) (x j))) : IsClosed S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (isClosed_iff τ L R S).mpr
  constructor
  · intro d
    have he : (vertex τ L R d) ⁻¹' S = ∅ := by
      apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hS ha
      change (Sum.inr (c j,(s j,x j)) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inl (d,a) at hj
      cases hj
    rw [he]; exact isClosed_empty
  · intro d
    have hfinite : ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R d z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' S).Finite := by
      by_cases hex : ∃ j,c j = d
      · obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := hex
        apply (Set.finite_singleton (((⟨(s j).1,(s j).2.1.le,(s j).2.2.le⟩ : I),x j))).subset
        intro z hz
        obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hS hz
        have hmem : z ∈ (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R d z.1 z.2) ⁻¹'
            {interior τ L R (c i) (s i) (x i)} := hi.symm
        rw [interior_preimage] at hmem
        split_ifs at hmem with hdi
        · have hij : i = j := hc (hdi.symm.trans hj.symm)
          simpa only [hij] using hmem
