        · exact False.elim hmem
      · have he : (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R d z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' S = ∅ := by
          apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro z hz
          obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hS hz
          have hmem : z ∈ (fun z : I × B => edge τ L R d z.1 z.2) ⁻¹'
              {interior τ L R (c i) (s i) (x i)} := hi.symm
          rw [interior_preimage,ite_eq_right (fun h => hex ⟨i,h.symm⟩)] at hmem
          exact hmem
        rw [he]; exact Set.finite_empty
    exact hfinite.isClosed

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.compact_finitely_many_edges
statement:
theorem compact_finitely_many_edges {K : Set (Space τ L R)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    {c : C | ∃ (s : Inner) (x : B), interior τ L R c s x ∈ K}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let J := {c : C | ∃ (s : Inner) (x : B), interior τ L R c s x ∈ K}
  let s : J → Inner := fun j => j.2.choose
  let x : J → B := fun j => j.2.choose_spec.choose
  let y : J → Space τ L R := fun j => interior τ L R j.1 (s j) (x j)
  have hyK (j : J) : y j ∈ K := j.2.choose_spec.choose_spec
  have hinj : Function.Injective y := by
    intro i j hij
    apply Subtype.ext
    have he : (i.1,(s i,x i)) = (j.1,(s j,x j)) := Sum.inr.inj hij
    exact congrArg Prod.fst he
  have hall : ∀ S ⊆ Set.range y, IsClosed S :=
    selection_closed τ L R Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective s x
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Set.range y) :=
    hK.of_isClosed_subset (hall _ subset_rfl) (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr hyK)
  have hdiscrete : IsDiscrete (Set.range y) := by
    apply isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isClosed.mpr
    intro S hS
    exact ⟨S,hall S hS,Set.inter_eq_left.mpr hS⟩
  have hrange := hcompact.finite hdiscrete
  have : Finite J := (Set.finite_range_iff hinj).mp hrange
  exact Set.toFinite J

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.compact_finitely_many_vertices
statement:
theorem compact_finitely_many_vertices {K : Set (Space τ L R)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    {c : C | ∃ x : A,vertex τ L R c x ∈ K}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hc : IsCompact ((fun z : C × A => vertex τ L R z.1 z.2) ⁻¹' K) :=
    (base_closedEmbedding τ L R).isProperMap.isCompact_preimage hK
  have hf := (hc.image continuous_fst).finite_of_discrete
  convert hf using 1
  ext c
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx⟩; exact ⟨(c,x),hx,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨d,x⟩,hx,h⟩
    change d = c at h
    subst d; exact ⟨x,hx⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.vertex_eq_vertex
statement:
@[simp] lemma vertex_eq_vertex (c d : C) (x y : A) :
    vertex τ L R c x = vertex τ L R d y ↔ c = d ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  change (Sum.inl (c,x) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inl (d,y) ↔ _
  simp only [Sum.inl.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.vertex_ne_interior
statement:
@[simp] lemma vertex_ne_interior (c d : C) (x : A) (s : Inner) (y : B) :
    vertex τ L R c x ≠ interior τ L R d s y
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  change (Sum.inl (c,x) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inr (d,(s,y)) at h
  cases h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.interior_ne_vertex
statement:
@[simp] lemma interior_ne_vertex (c d : C) (s : Inner) (x : B) (y : A) :
    interior τ L R c s x ≠ vertex τ L R d y
proof:
:=
  (vertex_ne_interior τ L R d c y s x).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.interior_eq_interior
statement:
@[simp] lemma interior_eq_interior (c d : C) (s t : Inner) (x y : B) :
    interior τ L R c s x = interior τ L R d t y ↔ c = d ∧ s = t ∧ x = y
proof:
:= by
  change (Sum.inr (c,(s,x)) : Core (C := C) (A := A) (B := B)) = Sum.inr (d,(t,y)) ↔ _
  simp only [Sum.inr.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edge_eq_vertex
statement:
lemma edge_eq_vertex (c d : C) (t : I) (x : B) (y : A) :
    edge τ L R c t x = vertex τ L R d y ↔
    (t = 0 ∧ c = d ∧ L c x = y) ∨ (t = 1 ∧ τ c = d ∧ R c x = y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : t = 0
  · subst t
    rw [edge_zero,vertex_eq_vertex]
    simp only [true_and,zero_ne_one,false_and,or_false]
  · by_cases h1 : t = 1
    · subst t
      rw [edge_one,vertex_eq_vertex]
      simp only [true_and,one_ne_zero,false_and,false_or]
    · let s : Inner := ⟨t.1,lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (fun h => h0 (Subtype.ext h.symm)),
        lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (fun h => h1 (Subtype.ext h))⟩
      have he : edge τ L R c t x = interior τ L R c s x := edge_inner τ L R c s x
      rw [he]
      simp only [interior_ne_vertex,h0,h1,false_and,or_self]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edgeImage_vertex_slice
statement:
lemma edgeImage_vertex_slice [DecidableEq C] (c d : C) (S : Set (I × B)) :
    (vertex τ L R d) ⁻¹' ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S) =
      (if d = c then (L c) '' ((fun x : B => ((0:I),x)) ⁻¹' S) else ∅) ∪
      (if d = τ c then (R c) '' ((fun x : B => ((1:I),x)) ⁻¹' S) else ∅)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y
  change (∃ z ∈ S,edge τ L R c z.1 z.2 = vertex τ L R d y) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨t,x⟩,hx,he⟩
    rcases (edge_eq_vertex τ L R c d t x y).mp he with ⟨rfl,hcd,hx'⟩ | ⟨rfl,hcd,hx'⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by rw [ite_eq_left hcd.symm]; exact ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (by rw [ite_eq_left hcd.symm]; exact ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩)
  · intro h
    rcases h with h|h
    · split_ifs at h with hcd
      · obtain ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩ := h
        exact ⟨(0,x),hx,(edge_eq_vertex τ L R c d 0 x y).mpr (Or.inl ⟨rfl,hcd.symm,hx'⟩)⟩
      · exact False.elim h
    · split_ifs at h with hcd
      · obtain ⟨x,hx,hx'⟩ := h
        exact ⟨(1,x),hx,(edge_eq_vertex τ L R c d 1 x y).mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl,hcd.symm,hx'⟩)⟩
      · exact False.elim h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.edgeImage_vertex_closed
statement:
lemma edgeImage_vertex_closed (c d : C) (S : Set (I × B)) (hS : IsClosed S)
    (hL : IsClosedMap (L c)) (hR : IsClosedMap (R c)) :
    IsClosed ((vertex τ L R d) ⁻¹' ((fun z : I × B => edge τ L R c z.1 z.2) '' S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [edgeImage_vertex_slice]
  apply IsClosed.union
  · split_ifs
    · exact hL _ (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
    · exact isClosed_empty
  · split_ifs
    · exact hR _ (hS.preimage (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id))
    · exact isClosed_empty

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.push_ge
statement: lemma push_ge (a : Letter) (n : ℕ) : 8*n ≤ push a n
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨b,c,d⟩
  cases b <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [push,Nat.bit] <;> omega

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.code_pos
statement: lemma code_pos (w : List Letter) : 0 < code w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => decide
  | cons a w ih => have := push_ge a (code w); change 0 < push a (code w); omega

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.push_inj
statement: lemma push_inj {a b : Letter} {m n : ℕ} (h : push a m = push b n) : a = b ∧ m = n
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := congrArg Nat.bodd h
  have ht := congrArg Nat.div2 h
  simp only [push,Nat.bodd_bit,Nat.div2_bit] at h₁ ht
  have h₂ := congrArg Nat.bodd ht
  have hu := congrArg Nat.div2 ht
  simp only [Nat.bodd_bit,Nat.div2_bit] at h₂ hu
  have h₃ := congrArg Nat.bodd hu
  have hm := congrArg Nat.div2 hu
  simp only [Nat.bodd_bit,Nat.div2_bit] at h₃ hm
  exact ⟨Prod.ext h₁ (Prod.ext h₂ h₃),hm⟩

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.code_injective
statement: lemma code_injective : Function.Injective code
proof:
:= by
  intro v
  induction v with
  | nil =>
    intro w h
    cases w with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons a w =>
      have hp := code_pos w
      have hg := push_ge a (code w)
      change 1 = push a (code w) at h
      omega
  | cons a v ih =>
    intro w h
    cases w with
    | nil =>
      have hp := code_pos v
      have hg := push_ge a (code v)
      change push a (code v) = 1 at h
      omega
    | cons b w =>
      obtain ⟨rfl,he⟩ := push_inj h
      exact congrArg (List.cons a) (ih he)

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.trNat_bit
statement:
lemma trNat_bit (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    trNat (Nat.bit b n) = symbol b :: trNat n
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : (n : Num) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (fun m : Num ↦ (m : ℕ)) h
    simp only [Num.to_of_nat,Num.cast_zero] at this
    omega
  unfold trNat
  rw [← Num.ofNat'_eq,Num.ofNat'_bit,Num.ofNat'_eq]
  cases h : (n : Num) with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hcast h)
  | pos p => cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.trNat_code
statement: lemma trNat_code (w : List Letter) : trNat (code w) = spelling w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w ih =>
    have hp := code_pos w
    have hbit (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < Nat.bit b n := by
      cases b <;> simp [Nat.bit]; omega
    simp only [code,push,trNat_bit _ _ (hbit _ _ (hbit _ _ hp)),
      trNat_bit _ _ (hbit _ _ hp),trNat_bit _ _ hp,ih,spelling]

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.push_primrec
statement: lemma push_primrec : Primrec₂ push
proof:
:= by
  let digit : Letter → ℕ := fun a ↦ push a 0
  have h : Primrec (fun p : Letter × ℕ ↦ 8*p.2+digit p.1) :=
    Primrec.nat_add.comp (Primrec.nat_mul.comp (Primrec.const 8) Primrec.snd)
      ((Primrec.dom_finite digit).comp Primrec.fst)
  apply h.of_eq
  rintro ⟨⟨b,c,d⟩,n⟩
  cases b <;> cases c <;> cases d <;> simp [digit,push,Nat.bit] <;> omega

name: OAI.Higman.WordBinary.code_primrec
statement: lemma code_primrec : Primrec code
proof:
:= by
  have h := Primrec.list_foldr (α := List Letter) Primrec.id (Primrec.const 1)
    (push_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)).to₂
  apply h.of_eq
  intro w
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w ih => simpa only [id_eq,List.foldr_cons,code] using congrArg (push a) ih

name: OAI.Higman.RangeRecognizer.search_dom
statement: lemma search_dom (r : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) : (search r n).Dom ↔ n ∈ Set.range r
proof:
:= by
  exact (Nat.rfind_dom (p := fun k ↦ Part.some (decide (r k = n)))).trans
    (by simp [Set.mem_range])

name: OAI.Higman.RangeRecognizer.search_partrec
statement: lemma search_partrec (r : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : Computable r) : Partrec (search r)
proof:
:= by
  apply Partrec.rfind
  exact ((Primrec.eq.decide.to_comp).comp (hr.comp Computable.snd) Computable.fst).partrec.to₂

name: OAI.Higman.RangeRecognizer.exists_code
statement:
theorem exists_code (r : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : Computable r) :
    ∃ c : Code, ∀ n, (c.eval [n]).Dom ↔ n ∈ Set.range r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := Code.exists_code (Nat.Partrec'.part_iff₁.mpr (search_partrec r hr))
  refine ⟨c,fun n ↦ ?_⟩
  have he := hc ⟨[n],rfl⟩
  change c.eval [n] = _ at he
  rw [he]
  exact search_dom r n

name: OAI.Higman.RangeRecognizer.halt_iff_dom
statement:
lemma halt_iff_dom (c : Code) (v : List ℕ) :
    (∃ S x, TM2.Reaches tr (init c v) ⟨none,x,S⟩) ↔ (c.eval v).Dom
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S,x,h⟩
    have hm : (⟨none,x,S⟩ : Cfg') ∈ StateTransition.eval (TM2.step tr) (init c v) :=
      StateTransition.mem_eval.mpr ⟨h,rfl⟩
    rw [tr_eval] at hm
    obtain ⟨w,hw,_⟩ := (Part.mem_map_iff _).mp hm
    exact hw.1
  · intro h
    let w := (c.eval v).get h
    have hw : halt w ∈ StateTransition.eval (TM2.step tr) (init c v) := by
      rw [tr_eval]
      exact (Part.mem_map_iff _).mpr ⟨w,Part.get_mem h,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(halt w).stk,(halt w).var,(StateTransition.mem_eval.mp hw).1⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.store_push
statement:
lemma store_push (s : List Γ') (a : Γ') :
    update (store s) .main (a :: store s .main) = store (a::s)
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  cases k <;> simp [store]

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.initial_forget
statement:
lemma initial_forget (c : Code) (w : List Letter) :
    TM2StackCompiler.forget tr (support c) (store (encoded w),initialState c) =
      MicroTM2.translate tr (init c [code w])
proof:
:= by
  simp [TM2StackCompiler.forget,initialState,MicroTM2.translate,init,store,encoded,trNat_code]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.correct_seed
statement: lemma correct_seed (c : Code) (weight : Letter → G) : Correct c weight 1 (seed c)
proof:
:=
  ⟨[],rfl,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.correct_step
statement:
lemma correct_step (c : Code) (weight : Letter → G) (e : Edge c)
    (S T : K' → List Γ') (g : G) (hr : (prog c weight e).action.Rel S T)
    (hc : Correct c weight g (S,(prog c weight e).source)) :
    Correct c weight (g * (prog c weight e).weight) (T,(prog c weight e).target)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | first a =>
    obtain ⟨w,rfl,hg⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := hr
    cases ht
    exact ⟨w,store_push _ _,by simpa [prog] using hg⟩
  | second a =>
    obtain ⟨w,rfl,hg⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := hr
    cases ht
    exact ⟨w,store_push _ _,by simpa [prog] using hg⟩
  | third a =>
    obtain ⟨w,rfl,rfl⟩ := hc
    obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := hr
    cases ht
    refine ⟨a::w,?_,rfl⟩
    exact store_push _ _
  | enter =>
    obtain ⟨w,rfl,hg⟩ := hc
    cases hr
    refine ⟨w,by simpa [prog] using hg,?_⟩
    rw [initial_forget]
    exact .refl
  | machine e =>
    obtain ⟨w,hg,hh⟩ := hc
    refine ⟨w,by simpa [prog] using hg,hh.tail ?_⟩
    exact TM2StackCompiler.compile_sound tr (support c) (tr_supports c Cont'.halt).2 e S T hr
  | exit v =>
    obtain ⟨w,hg,hh⟩ := hc
    cases hr
    refine ⟨w,by simpa [prog] using hg,?_⟩
    apply (RangeRecognizer.halt_iff_dom c [code w]).mp
    exact ⟨S,v,(MicroTM2.reaches_halt_iff tr _ S v).mpr hh⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.run_correct
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | start => exact correct_seed c weight
  | step e S T hr h ih => exact correct_step c weight e S T _ hr ih

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.build_word
statement:
lemma build_word (c : Code) (weight : Letter → G) (w : List Letter) :
    ∃ s, Run (prog c weight) (seed c) s (store (encoded w),.ready) ∧
      HistoryMachine.value (fun e ↦ (prog c weight e).weight) s = HistoryMachine.value weight w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact ⟨[],Run.start,rfl⟩
  | cons a w ih =>
    obtain ⟨s,hs,hv⟩ := ih
    refine ⟨.third a :: .second a :: .first a :: s,?_,?_⟩
    · apply Run.step (prog := prog c weight) (Edge.third a) (store (symbol a.2.1 :: symbol a.2.2 :: encoded w)) _
      · exact ⟨_,rfl,(store_push _ _).symm⟩
      apply Run.step (prog := prog c weight) (Edge.second a) (store (symbol a.2.2 :: encoded w)) _
      · exact ⟨_,rfl,(store_push _ _).symm⟩
      apply Run.step (prog := prog c weight) (Edge.first a) (store (encoded w)) _
      · exact ⟨_,rfl,(store_push _ _).symm⟩
      exact hs
    · simpa only [HistoryMachine.value,prog,mul_one] using congrArg (fun g ↦ g * weight a) hv

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.enter_word
statement:
lemma enter_word (c : Code) (weight : Letter → G) (w : List Letter) :
    ∃ s, Run (prog c weight) (seed c) s (store (encoded w),.machine (initialState c)) ∧
      HistoryMachine.value (fun e ↦ (prog c weight e).weight) s = HistoryMachine.value weight w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hv⟩ := build_word c weight w
  exact ⟨.enter::s,Run.step (prog := prog c weight) Edge.enter _ _ rfl hs,by simpa only [HistoryMachine.value,prog,mul_one] using hv⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.run_machine
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | start => exact enter_word c weight w
  | step e S T hr h ih =>
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hv⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨.machine e::t,Run.step (prog := prog c weight) (Edge.machine e) S T hr ht,
      by simpa only [HistoryMachine.value,prog,mul_one] using hv⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.halt_word
statement:
lemma halt_word (c : Code) (weight : Letter → G) (w : List Letter) (h : (c.eval [code w]).Dom) :
    HistoryMachine.value weight w ∈ outputs (prog c weight) (seed c) .done
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,v,hm⟩ := (RangeRecognizer.halt_iff_dom c [code w]).mpr h
  have hh := (MicroTM2.reaches_halt_iff tr _ S v).mp hm
  rw [← initial_forget c w] at hh
  obtain ⟨s,d,hr,hd⟩ := TM2StackCompiler.reaches_complete (G := G) tr (support c)
    (tr_supports c Cont'.halt).2 hh
  have hq : d.2 = finalState c v := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun x ↦ x.2.1) hd
    · exact congrArg (fun x ↦ x.2.2) hd
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hv⟩ := run_machine c weight w hr
  have ht' : Run (prog c weight) (seed c) t (d.1,.machine (finalState c v)) := by
    simpa only [hq] using ht
  refine ⟨.exit v::t,d.1,Run.step (prog := prog c weight) (Edge.exit v) _ _ rfl ht',?_⟩
  simpa only [HistoryMachine.value,prog,mul_one] using hv.symm

name: OAI.Higman.RecognizingStack.outputs_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,S,hs,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hd⟩ := run_correct c weight hs
    exact ⟨w,hd,hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨w,hd,rfl⟩
    exact halt_word c weight w hd

name: OAI.Higman.benign_enumerated_words
statement:
theorem benign_enumerated_words (enumerate : ℕ → List Letter)
    (he : Computable enumerate) (weight : Letter → G) :
    IsBenign (Subgroup.closure (Set.range (fun n ↦ HistoryMachine.value weight (enumerate n))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := RangeRecognizer.exists_code (fun n ↦ code (enumerate n))
    (code_primrec.to_comp.comp he)
  have hh := StackProgram.benign_outputs (RecognizingStack.prog c weight)
    (RecognizingStack.seed c) RecognizingStack.State.done
  rw [RecognizingStack.outputs_eq] at hh
  have hs : {g | ∃ w, (c.eval [code w]).Dom ∧ g = HistoryMachine.value weight w} =
      Set.range (fun n ↦ HistoryMachine.value weight (enumerate n)) := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := (hc (code w)).mp hw
      exact ⟨n,congrArg (HistoryMachine.value weight) (code_injective hn)⟩
    · rintro ⟨n,rfl⟩
      exact ⟨enumerate n,(hc _).mpr ⟨n,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  rwa [hs] at hh

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.value_append
statement:
lemma value_append (weight : E → G) (v w : List E) :
    value weight (v ++ w) = value weight w * value weight v
proof:
:= by
  induction v with
  | nil => simp [value]
  | cons a v ih => simp only [List.cons_append,value,ih,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.encoded_value
statement: lemma encoded_value (w : Raw) : HistoryMachine.value weight (encodeWord w) = FreeGroup.mk w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a w ih =>
    simp only [encodeWord,List.reverse_cons,List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.map_nil,
      HistoryMachine.value_append,HistoryMachine.value,one_mul] at *
    rw [ih]
    rcases a with ⟨a,b⟩
    cases a <;> cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.encodeWord_primrec
statement: lemma encodeWord_primrec : Primrec encodeWord
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_reverse ((Primrec.dom_finite encodeLetter).comp Primrec.snd)

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.conjugator_primrec
statement: lemma conjugator_primrec : Primrec conjugator
proof:
:=
  Primrec.option_getD.comp Primrec.decode (Primrec.const [])

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.invRev_primrec
statement: lemma invRev_primrec : Primrec (@FreeGroup.invRev Alphabet)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FreeGroup.invRev
  apply Primrec.list_reverse.comp
  apply Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
  exact (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd).pair
    ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.enumerate_computable
statement: lemma enumerate_computable (r : ℕ → Raw) (hr : Computable r) : Computable (enumerate r)
proof:
:= by
  apply encodeWord_primrec.to_comp.comp
  have hc : Computable (fun n : ℕ ↦ conjugator n.unpair.1) :=
    conjugator_primrec.to_comp.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair).to_comp
  exact Primrec.list_append.to_comp.comp
    (Primrec.list_append.to_comp.comp hc (hr.comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair).to_comp))
    (invRev_primrec.to_comp.comp hc)

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.conjugator_encode
statement: lemma conjugator_encode (w : Raw) : conjugator (Encodable.encode w) = w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugator,Encodable.encodek,Option.getD_some]

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.mk_conjugated
statement:
lemma mk_conjugated (r : ℕ → Raw) (n : ℕ) :
    FreeGroup.mk (conjugated r n) = FreeGroup.mk (conjugator n.unpair.1) *
      FreeGroup.mk (r n.unpair.2) * (FreeGroup.mk (conjugator n.unpair.1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugated,← FreeGroup.mul_mk,← FreeGroup.inv_mk]

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.range_values
statement:
theorem range_values (r : ℕ → Raw) :
    Set.range (fun n ↦ HistoryMachine.value weight (enumerate r n)) =
      Group.conjugatesOfSet (Set.range (fun n ↦ FreeGroup.mk (r n)))
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n,rfl⟩
    change HistoryMachine.value weight (encodeWord (conjugated r n)) ∈ _
    rw [encoded_value,mk_conjugated]
    exact Group.mem_conjugatesOfSet_iff.mpr
      ⟨_,⟨n.unpair.2,rfl⟩,isConj_iff.mpr ⟨_,rfl⟩⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x,⟨k,rfl⟩,hx⟩ := Group.mem_conjugatesOfSet_iff.mp h
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := isConj_iff.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := Quot.exists_rep a
    refine ⟨Nat.pair (Encodable.encode w) k,?_⟩
    simp only [enumerate,encoded_value,mk_conjugated,Nat.unpair_pair,conjugator_encode]
    exact ha

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.benign_normalClosure
statement:
theorem benign_normalClosure (r : ℕ → Raw) (hr : Computable r) :
    IsBenign (Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range (fun n ↦ FreeGroup.mk (r n))))
proof:
:= by
  have h := benign_enumerated_words (enumerate r) (enumerate_computable r hr) weight
  rw [range_values] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.Higman.NormalWords.embeds_presentation
statement:
theorem embeds_presentation (r : ℕ → Raw) (hr : Computable r) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : PresentedGroup (Set.range (fun n ↦ FreeGroup.mk (r n))) →* K),
      Function.Injective i
proof:
:= by
  apply embeds_of_benign_kernel (PresentedGroup.mk _) (PresentedGroup.mk_surjective _)
  have he : (PresentedGroup.mk (Set.range (fun n ↦ FreeGroup.mk (r n)))).ker =
      Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range (fun n ↦ FreeGroup.mk (r n))) := by
    ext g
    exact PresentedGroup.mk_eq_one_iff
  rw [he]
  exact benign_normalClosure r hr

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.loopMap_homotopic
statement:
lemma loopMap_homotopic (f : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y) {p q : GenLoop N X x}
    (h : GenLoop.Homotopic p q) : GenLoop.Homotopic (loopMap f hf p) (loopMap f hf q)
proof:
:=
  h.comp_continuousMap f

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_mk (f : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y) (p : GenLoop N X x) :
    map f hf (Quotient.mk' p) = Quotient.mk' (loopMap f hf p)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.loopMap_const
statement:
lemma loopMap_const (f : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y) :
    loopMap (N := N) f hf GenLoop.const = GenLoop.const
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  exact hf

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.loopMap_transAt
statement:
lemma loopMap_transAt [DecidableEq N] (i : N) (f : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y)
    (p q : GenLoop N X x) :
    loopMap f hf (GenLoop.transAt i p q) = GenLoop.transAt i (loopMap f hf p) (loopMap f hf q)
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  change f (if (t i : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 then p _ else q _) =
    if (t i : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 then f (p _) else f (q _)
  split <;> rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) : map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.id X) rfl a = a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  exact congrArg Quotient.mk' (by ext t; rfl)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {Z : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Z] {z : Z}
    (f : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y) (g : C(Y,Z)) (hg : g y = z)
    (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
    map g hg (map f hf a) = map (g.comp f) (by change g (f x) = z; rw [hf,hg]) a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_const
statement:
lemma map_const [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
    map (ContinuousMap.const X y) rfl a = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.pair_homotopic
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨h⟩
  rcases k with ⟨k⟩
  refine ⟨{ toHomotopy := h.toHomotopy.prodMk k.toHomotopy,prop' := ?_ }⟩
  intro t a ha
  exact Prod.ext (h.eq_fst t ha) (k.eq_fst t ha)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.product_ext
statement:
lemma product_ext (a b : HomotopyGroup N (X × Y) (x,y))
    (h₁ : map ((ContinuousMap.fst : C(X × Y,X))) rfl a = map ((ContinuousMap.fst : C(X × Y,X))) rfl b)
    (h₂ : map ((ContinuousMap.snd : C(X × Y,Y))) rfl a = map ((ContinuousMap.snd : C(X × Y,Y))) rfl b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with | h q =>
  apply Quotient.sound
  have hh := pair_homotopic (Quotient.exact h₁) (Quotient.exact h₂)
  exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.diagonal_split
statement:
lemma diagonal_split [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
    map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a =
      (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x)) rfl a) *
      (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a)
proof:
:= by
  apply product_ext
  · change mapHom ((ContinuousMap.fst : C(X × X,X))) rfl _ = mapHom ((ContinuousMap.fst : C(X × X,X))) rfl _
    rw [map_mul]
    change map (y := x) ContinuousMap.fst rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a) =
      map (y := x) ContinuousMap.fst rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x)) rfl a) *
      map (y := x) ContinuousMap.fst rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a)
    calc
      _ = map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.id X) rfl a := map_comp _ _ _ _ a
      _ = map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.id X) rfl a *
          map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.const X x) rfl a :=
        (map_id a).trans (((congrArg₂ (fun left right : HomotopyGroup N X x => left * right)
          (map_id a) (map_const (y := x) a)).trans
          (mul_one a)).symm)
      _ = _ := congrArg₂ (fun left right : HomotopyGroup N X x => left * right)
        (map_comp (y := (x,x)) (z := x)
          ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x)) rfl
          ContinuousMap.fst rfl a).symm
        (map_comp (y := (x,x)) (z := x)
          ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl
          ContinuousMap.fst rfl a).symm
  · change mapHom ((ContinuousMap.snd : C(X × X,X))) rfl _ = mapHom ((ContinuousMap.snd : C(X × X,X))) rfl _
    rw [map_mul]
    change map (y := x) ContinuousMap.snd rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a) =
      map (y := x) ContinuousMap.snd rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x)) rfl a) *
      map (y := x) ContinuousMap.snd rfl
        (map (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl a)
    calc
      _ = map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.id X) rfl a := map_comp _ _ _ _ a
      _ = map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.const X x) rfl a *
          map (y := x) (ContinuousMap.id X) rfl a :=
        (map_id a).trans (((congrArg₂ (fun left right : HomotopyGroup N X x => left * right)
          (map_const (y := x) a) (map_id a)).trans
          (one_mul a)).symm)
      _ = _ := congrArg₂ (fun left right : HomotopyGroup N X x => left * right)
        (map_comp (y := (x,x)) (z := x)
          ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x)) rfl
          ContinuousMap.snd rfl a).symm
        (map_comp (y := (x,x)) (z := x)
          ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl
          ContinuousMap.snd rfl a).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.product_additivity
statement:
theorem product_additivity [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (F : C(X × X,Y))
    (hF : F (x,x) = y) (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
    map (F.comp ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X))) hF a =
      map (F.comp ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const X x))) hF a *
      map (F.comp ((ContinuousMap.const X x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X))) hF a
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_comp (y := (x,x)) ((ContinuousMap.id X).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id X)) rfl F hF a
  rw [← h,diagonal_split]
  change mapHom (N := N) F hF (_ * _) = _
  rw [map_mul]
  exact congrArg₂ (· * ·) (map_comp _ _ _ _ a) (map_comp _ _ _ _ a)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_eq_of_homotopy
statement:
lemma map_eq_of_homotopy (f g : C(X,Y)) (hf : f x = y) (hg : g x = y)
    (H : f.Homotopy g) (hH : ∀ t, H (t,x) = y) (a : HomotopyGroup N X x) :
    map f hf a = map g hg a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  apply Quotient.sound
  refine ⟨{ toHomotopy := H.compContinuousMap p.1,prop' := ?_ }⟩
  intro t z hz
  change H (t,p z) = f (p z)
  rw [GenLoop.boundary p z hz,hH,hf]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_mono
statement: lemma stage_mono {S T : Shapes G} (h : S ⊆ T) : stage G S ≤ stage G T
proof:
:=
  orbitSpan_mono (Finset.insert_subset_insert _ h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_point_face
statement: lemma stage_point_face (S : Shapes G) : {(0,1)} ∈ stage G S
proof:
:= by
  apply orbitSpan_contains (basedShapes G S)
  · exact ⟨Finset.singleton_nonempty _,by simpa only [Finset.coe_singleton] using Set.injOn_singleton Prod.fst (0,(1:G))⟩
  · exact ⟨{(0,1)},Finset.mem_insert_self _ _,Finset.Subset.refl _⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageIncl_point
statement: lemma stageIncl_point (S T : Shapes G) (h : S ⊆ T) : stageIncl G S T h (stagePoint G S) = stagePoint G T
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.smul_weight
statement: lemma smul_weight (g : G) (x : Space G) (v : ℕ × G) : (g • x).1 (v.1,g*v.2) = x.1 v
proof:
:= by
  change (x.1.mapDomain (fun w => (w.1,g*w.2))) (v.1,g*v.2) = x.1 v
  apply Finsupp.mapDomain_apply_of_injective (f := fun w : ℕ × G => (w.1,g*w.2))
  intro a b hab
  have hfst := congrArg (fun p : ℕ × G => p.1) hab
  have hsnd := congrArg (fun p : ℕ × G => p.2) hab
  exact Prod.ext hfst (mul_left_cancel hsnd)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.smul_weight_inv
statement: lemma smul_weight_inv (g : G) (x : Space G) (v : ℕ × G) : (g • x).1 v = x.1 (v.1,g⁻¹*v.2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_inv_cancel_left] using smul_weight g x (v.1,g⁻¹*v.2)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.exists_disjoint_nhds
statement:
lemma exists_disjoint_nhds (x : Space G) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, ∀ g : G, ((g • ·) '' U ∩ U).Nonempty → g = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := Simplicial.support_nonempty x.2.2.1
  let U : Set (Space G) := {y | 0 < y.1 v}
  have hx : x ∈ U := lt_of_le_of_ne (x.2.1 v) (Ne.symm (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hv))
  have hU : IsOpen U := isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_eval (complex G) v)
  refine ⟨U,hU.mem_nhds hx,?_⟩
  intro g hg
  obtain ⟨z,⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hgy⟩ := hg
  have h1 : v ∈ y.1.support := Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr (ne_of_gt hy)
  have h2 : (v.1,g⁻¹*v.2) ∈ y.1.support := by
    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    have hp : 0 < (g • y).1 v := hgy
    rw [smul_weight_inv] at hp
    exact ne_of_gt hp
  have he := congrArg Prod.snd (y.2.2.2.2 h1 h2 rfl)
  have hi : g⁻¹ = 1 := (mul_right_cancel (he.symm.trans (one_mul v.2).symm))
  exact inv_eq_one.mp hi

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.quotientCovering
statement:
lemma quotientCovering : IsQuotientCoveringMap
    (Quotient.mk (MulAction.orbitRel G (Space G))) G where
  __
proof:
:= isQuotientMap_quotient_mk'
  continuous_const_smul g := continuous_const_smul g
  apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit := Quotient.eq''
  disjoint := exists_disjoint_nhds

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageFull_embedding
statement: lemma stageFull_embedding (S : Shapes G) : IsClosedEmbedding (stageFull G S)
proof:
:=
  inclusion_closedEmbedding _ _ (fun _ h => orbitSpan_le _ h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_translate
statement:
lemma stage_translate (S : Shapes G) (g : G) (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    s.1.image (fun v => (v.1,g*v.2)) ∈ stage G S
proof: := orbitSpan_invariant _ g s.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageFull_smul
statement:
lemma stageFull_smul (S : Shapes G) (g : G) (x : Stage G S) :
    stageFull G S (g • x) = g • stageFull G S x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageIncl_smul
statement:
lemma stageIncl_smul (S T : Shapes G) (h : S ⊆ T) (g : G) (x : Stage G S) :
    stageIncl G S T h (g • x) = g • stageIncl G S T h x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.compact_controlled
statement:
lemma compact_controlled {K : Set (Space G)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ S : Shapes G, K ⊆ Set.range (stageFull G S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨V,hV⟩ := Simplicial.compact_bounded_vertices (complex G) hK
  refine ⟨V.powerset,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hm : x.1.support ∈ stage G V.powerset := by
    apply orbitSpan_contains (basedShapes G V.powerset) x.2.2.2
    exact ⟨x.1.support,Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (hV x hx)),Finset.Subset.refl _⟩
  exact ⟨⟨x.1,x.2.1,x.2.2.1,hm⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.compact_orbit_controlled
statement:
lemma compact_orbit_controlled {K : Set (Space G)} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ S : Shapes G, ∀ g : G, (g • ·) '' K ⊆ Set.range (stageFull G S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := compact_controlled G hK
  refine ⟨S,?_⟩
  intro g y hy
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := hS hx
  exact ⟨g • z,stageFull_smul G S g z⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.equivariant_controlled
statement:
lemma equivariant_controlled (hX : CompactFundamentalSet G (X := X))
    (f : C(X,Space G)) (hf : ∀ (g : G) x, f (g • x) = g • f x) :
    ∃ S : Shapes G, Set.range f ⊆ Set.range (stageFull G S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcov⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := compact_orbit_controlled G (hK.image f.continuous)
  refine ⟨S,?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g,y,hy,rfl⟩ := hcov x
  rw [hf]
  exact hS g ⟨f y,⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.factorStage_spec
statement:
lemma factorStage_spec (f : C(X,Space G)) (S : Shapes G)
    (hf : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range (stageFull G S)) (x : X) :
    stageFull G S (factorStage G f S hf x) = f x
proof: := (hf (Set.mem_range_self x)).choose_spec

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.factorStage_smul
statement:
lemma factorStage_smul (f : C(X,Space G)) (S : Shapes G)
    (hf : Set.range f ⊆ Set.range (stageFull G S))
    (he : ∀ (g : G) x, f (g • x) = g • f x) (g : G) (x : X) :
    factorStage G f S hf (g • x) = g • factorStage G f S hf x
proof:
:= by
  apply (stageFull_embedding G S).injective
  rw [factorStage_spec,stageFull_smul,factorStage_spec,he]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.carrier_finite
statement: lemma carrier_finite [Finite K] : (carrier K).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ((Set.finite_singleton (1 : algebra K)).union
    (Set.finite_range (fun x : Fin 3 × Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K => corner K x.1 x.2))).subset
  rintro E (rfl | ⟨a, M, _, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr ⟨(a,M), rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.one_mem
statement: lemma one_mem : (1 : algebra K) ∈ carrier K
proof: := Or.inl rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.corner_mem
statement:
lemma corner_mem (a : Fin 3) (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K)
    (hM : IsIdempotentElem M) : corner K a M ∈ carrier K
proof:
:=
  Or.inr ⟨a, M, hM, rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.carrier_idempotent
statement: lemma carrier_idempotent (E : algebra K) (hE : E ∈ carrier K) : IsIdempotentElem E
proof:
:= by
  rcases hE with rfl | ⟨a, M, hM, rfl⟩
  · exact IsIdempotentElem.one
  · change corner K a M * corner K a M = corner K a M
    rw [← map_mul, hM.eq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.sum_idempotent
proof:
:= by
  change (E + P) * (E + P) = E + P
  rw [add_mul, mul_add, mul_add, hE.eq, hP.eq, hEP, hPE]
  simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.diagonalUnit_eq_diagonal
statement:
lemma diagonalUnit_eq_diagonal (i : Fin 3) :
    (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit i : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) =
      Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j k
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;>
    simp [MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit, MatrixDiagram.basisVector,
      Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.diagonal, Pi.single_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.corner_diagonal
statement:
lemma corner_diagonal (a i : Fin 3) :
    corner K a (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit i) = projection K (words a i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalUnit_eq_diagonal]
  exact MatrixCorners.map_diagonal (K := K)
    (fun i => leftWord K (words a i)) (fun i => rightWord K (words a i))
    (word_orthogonality K a) i

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.projection_mem
statement: lemma projection_mem (a i : Fin 3) : projection K (words a i) ∈ carrier K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← corner_diagonal]
  exact corner_mem K a _ (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_idempotent i)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.projection_first_sum
statement:
lemma projection_first_sum :
    projection K (words 0 0) + projection K (words 0 1) + projection K (words 0 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change projection K [false,false] + projection K [false,true] + projection K [true] = 1
  have h := projection_split K [false]
  have h' := projection_split K []
  simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h h'
  rw [← h, ← h']
  simp [projection]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.projection_mul_zero
statement:
lemma projection_mul_zero (v w : List Bool)
    (h : rightWord K v * leftWord K w = 0) : projection K v * projection K w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [projection]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (rightWord K v), h, zero_mul, mul_zero]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.projection_orthogonal
statement:
lemma projection_orthogonal (a : Fin 3) {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    projection K (words a i) * projection K (words a j) = 0
proof:
:=
  projection_mul_zero K _ _ (by rw [word_orthogonality, ite_eq_right hij])

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.restrict_additive
statement:
lemma restrict_additive (z : algebra K → T) (hz : AdditiveOnDiagram K z) (a : Fin 3) :
    MatrixDiagram.OrthogonallyAdditive (fun M => z (corner K a M))
proof:
:= by
  intro E P hE hP hEP hPE
  have hsum := corner_mem K a (E + P) (sum_idempotent hE hP hEP hPE)
  rw [map_add] at hsum
  change z (corner K a (E + P)) = z (corner K a E) + z (corner K a P)
  rw [map_add]
  apply hz _ _ (corner_mem K a E hE) (corner_mem K a P hP) hsum
  · rw [← map_mul, hEP, map_zero]
  · rw [← map_mul, hPE, map_zero]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.projection_multiples
statement:
lemma projection_multiples (z : algebra K → T) (hz : AdditiveOnDiagram K z)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (a i j : Fin 3) :
    p • z (projection K (words a i)) = p • z (projection K (words a j))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [corner_diagonal] using
    MatrixDiagram.diagonal_equality (fun M => z (corner K a M))
      (restrict_additive K z hz a) p i j

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.first_projection_zero
statement:
lemma first_projection_zero (z : algebra K → T) (hz : AdditiveOnDiagram K z)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] : p • z (projection K [false,false]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := projection K [false,false]
  let B := projection K [false,true]
  let A₀ := projection K [false,false,false]
  let A₁ := projection K [false,false,true]
  have hA : A ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 0 0
  have hA₀ : A₀ ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 1 0
  have hA₁ : A₁ ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 2 0
  have hAB : p • z A = p • z B := projection_multiples K z hz p 0 0 1
  have hA₀B : p • z A₀ = p • z B := projection_multiples K z hz p 1 0 1
  have hA₁B : p • z A₁ = p • z B := projection_multiples K z hz p 2 0 1
  have hsplit : A = A₀ + A₁ := projection_split K [false,false]
  have horth₀₁ : A₀ * A₁ = 0 := by
    apply projection_mul_zero
    simp only [cancel_initial, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true]
  have horth₁₀ : A₁ * A₀ = 0 := by
    apply projection_mul_zero
    simp only [cancel_initial, Bool.true_eq_false, ite_false, ite_true]
  have hsum := hz A₀ A₁ hA₀ hA₁ (hsplit ▸ hA) horth₀₁ horth₁₀
  rw [← hsplit] at hsum
  have hq : p • z A = p • z A + p • z A := calc
    p • z A = p • z A₀ + p • z A₁ := by rw [hsum, nsmul_add]
    _ = _ := by rw [hA₀B, hA₁B, ← hAB]
  apply add_left_cancel (a := p • z A)
  exact hq.symm.trans (add_zero _).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.first_two_mem
statement: lemma first_two_mem : projection K (words 0 0) + projection K (words 0 1) ∈ carrier K
proof:
:= by
  have hd := corner_mem K 0
    ((MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit 0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) + MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit 1)
    (sum_idempotent (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_idempotent 0)
      (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_idempotent 1)
      (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_orthogonal (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1))
      (MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_orthogonal (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)))
  simpa only [map_add, corner_diagonal] using hd

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.identity_additive_decomposition
statement:
lemma identity_additive_decomposition (z : algebra K → T) (hz : AdditiveOnDiagram K z) :
    z 1 = z (projection K (words 0 0)) + z (projection K (words 0 1)) +
      z (projection K (words 0 2))
proof:
:= by
  let A := projection K (words 0 0)
  let B := projection K (words 0 1)
  let C := projection K (words 0 2)
  have hA : A ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 0 0
  have hB : B ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 0 1
  have hC : C ∈ carrier K := projection_mem K 0 2
  have hABorth : A * B = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
  have hBAorth : B * A = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)
  have hACorth : A * C = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2)
  have hBCorth : B * C = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2)
  have hCAorth : C * A = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)
  have hCBorth : C * B = 0 := projection_orthogonal K 0 (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
  have hABmem : A + B ∈ carrier K := first_two_mem K
  have hone : A + B + C = 1 := projection_first_sum K
  have hzAB := hz A B hA hB hABmem hABorth hBAorth
  have hzI := hz (A + B) C hABmem hC (hone.symm ▸ one_mem K)
    (by rw [add_mul, hACorth, hBCorth, add_zero])
    (by rw [mul_add, hCAorth, hCBorth, add_zero])
  rw [hone, hzAB] at hzI
  exact hzI

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.annihilates_identity
statement:
theorem annihilates_identity (z : algebra K → T) (hz : AdditiveOnDiagram K z)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] : p • z 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [identity_additive_decomposition K z hz, nsmul_add, nsmul_add,
    ← projection_multiples K z hz p 0 0 1, ← projection_multiples K z hz p 0 0 2]
  have h : p • z (projection K (words 0 0)) = 0 := first_projection_zero K z hz p
  rw [h, add_zero, add_zero]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.IdempotentSystems.annihilates_identity_subtype
statement:
theorem annihilates_identity_subtype (z : carrier K → T)
    (hz : ∀ E P : carrier K, ∀ hsum : E.val + P.val ∈ carrier K,
      E.val * P.val = 0 → P.val * E.val = 0 →
        z ⟨E.val + P.val, hsum⟩ = z E + z P)
    (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] : p • z ⟨1, one_mem K⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let z' : algebra K → T := fun E => if h : E ∈ carrier K then z ⟨E,h⟩ else 0
  have hz' : AdditiveOnDiagram K z' := by
    intro E P hE hP hsum hEP hPE
    simpa only [z', dite_eq_left hE, dite_eq_left hP, dite_eq_left hsum] using
      hz ⟨E,hE⟩ ⟨P,hP⟩ hsum hEP hPE
  simpa only [z', dite_eq_left (one_mem K)] using annihilates_identity K z' hz' p

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ConcreteEnvelopes.finite_envelope
statement:
theorem finite_envelope (V : Type) [Group V] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented V] :
    ∃ (W : Type) (_ : Group W), Group.IsFinitelyPresented W ∧
      ∃ k : Index → V →* W, IsDiagram k ∧
        Function.Injective (k (.inl P₂.identity))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hfp, k, hc, hi, hcomm, hsum⟩ :=
    TwoEnvelope.finite_envelope (ZMod 2) (ZMod 3) P₂ P₃ V
  exact ⟨W, hW, hfp, k, ⟨hc, hcomm, hsum⟩, hi⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ConcreteEnvelopes.self_maps
statement:
theorem self_maps (U : Type) [Group U] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented U]
    (hU : IsUniversal U) :
    ∃ k : Index → U →* U, IsDiagram k ∧
      Function.Injective (k (.inl P₂.identity))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hfp, k, hk, hi⟩ := finite_envelope U
  let := hW
  let := hfp
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := hU W
  refine ⟨fun E => κ.comp (k E), ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, hκ.comp hi⟩
  · rw [hk.common]
  · intro E u v
    exact (hk.commute E u v).map κ
  · intro E u
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, hk.sum E, map_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ConcreteEnvelopes.coprime_annihilation
statement:
theorem coprime_annihilation {T : Type*} [AddCommGroup T]
    (z : Index → T)
    (hc : z (.inl P₂.identity) = z (.inr P₃.identity))
    (hs : ∀ t : triples, z t.val.2.2 = z t.val.1 + z t.val.2.1) :
    z (.inl P₂.identity) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ : 2 • z (.inl P₂.identity) = 0 := by
    apply annihilates_identity_subtype (ZMod 2)
      (fun E => z (.inl E))
    intro E F hsum hEF hFE
    exact hs ⟨(.inl E, .inl F, .inl ⟨E.val + F.val, hsum⟩),
      ⟨hEF, hFE, rfl⟩⟩
  have h₃ : 3 • z (.inr P₃.identity) = 0 := by
    apply annihilates_identity_subtype (ZMod 3)
      (fun E => z (.inr E))
    intro E F hsum hEF hFE
    exact hs ⟨(.inr E, .inr F, .inr ⟨E.val + F.val, hsum⟩),
      ⟨hEF, hFE, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [← hc] at h₃
  have hx : (3 : ℕ) • z (.inl P₂.identity) = 2 • z (.inl P₂.identity) +
      z (.inl P₂.identity) := by exact succ_nsmul _ 2
  rw [hx, h₂, zero_add] at h₃
  exact h₃

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.universal_group_of_type_FInfinity
statement:
theorem universal_group_of_type_FInfinity :
    ∃ (H : Type u) (groupH : Group H),
      @HasTypeFInfinity H groupH ∧
      ∀ (G : Type u) [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G],
        ∃ φ : G →* H, Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,gU,fpU,i,hi⟩ := Higman.NormalWords.embeds_presentation
    RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerator RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerator_primrec.to_comp
  let : Group U := gU
  let : Group.IsFinitelyPresented U := fpU
  have hU : ConcreteEnvelopes.IsUniversal U := by
    intro V _ _
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := RecursiveUniversalThree.universal (G := V)
    exact ⟨i.comp j,hi.comp hj⟩
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hk_inj⟩ := ConcreteEnvelopes.self_maps U hU
  let : Fact (Function.Injective (k (.inl ConcreteEnvelopes.P₂.identity))) := ⟨hk_inj⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace U := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology U := ⟨rfl⟩
  let f := k (.inl ConcreteEnvelopes.P₂.identity)
  let H₀ := AscendingTorus.Torus f
  let : TopologicalSpace H₀ := ⊥
  let : DiscreteTopology H₀ := ⟨rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ULift.{u} H₀,inferInstance,?_,?_⟩
  · exact Brown.geometric_lifted_of_uniform
      (TorusGeometry.diagram_milnor_uniform_nullhomotopy k hk)
  · intro G _ _
    obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := RecursiveUniversalThree.universal (G := G)
    refine ⟨MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom.comp ((AscendingTorus.of f).comp (i.comp j)),?_⟩
    exact MulEquiv.ulift.symm.injective.comp ((AscendingTorus.of_injective f hk_inj).comp
      (hi.comp hj))

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem erase_of (S : Set X) (x : X) : erase S (FreeGroup.of x) =
    if x ∈ S then FreeGroup.of x else 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [erase]

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem erase_eq_self_iff (S : Set X) (g : FreeGroup X) : erase S g = g ↔ g ∈ span S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hle : (erase S).range ≤ span S := by
      rw [erase,FreeGroup.range_lift_eq_closure]
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro _ ⟨x,rfl⟩
      by_cases hx : x ∈ S
      · simp only [hx,ite_true]
        exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
      · simp only [hx,ite_false]
        exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    exact hle ⟨g,hg⟩
  · have hle : span S ≤ (erase S).eqLocus (MonoidHom.id _) := by
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro _ ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
      change erase S (FreeGroup.of x) = FreeGroup.of x
      simp [hx]
    exact fun hg ↦ hle hg

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.erase_comp
statement: theorem erase_comp (S T : Set X) : (erase S).comp (erase T) = erase (S ∩ T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro x
  by_cases hxS : x ∈ S <;> by_cases hxT : x ∈ T <;> simp [hxS,hxT]

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.span_inter
statement: theorem span_inter (S T : Set X) : span S ⊓ span T = span (S ∩ T)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro g hg
    apply (erase_eq_self_iff _ _).mp
    rw [← erase_comp]
    change erase S (erase T g) = g
    rw [(erase_eq_self_iff T g).mpr hg.2,(erase_eq_self_iff S g).mpr hg.1]
  · exact le_inf (Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left))
      (Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_right))

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.of_mem_span_iff
statement: theorem of_mem_span_iff (S : Set X) (x : X) : FreeGroup.of x ∈ span S ↔ x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hx
    have he := (erase_eq_self_iff S (FreeGroup.of x)).mpr h
    simp only [erase_of,hx,ite_false] at he
    exact FreeGroup.of_ne_one x he.symm
  · intro hx
    exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.FreeBasis.map_span_inf
statement:
theorem map_span_inf (d : FreeGroup X →* G) (r : G →* FreeGroup X)
    (hr : r.comp d = MonoidHom.id _) (U V : Set X) (A : Subgroup G)
    (hsupport : A.map r ≤ span U)
    (hletters : ∀ x ∈ U, d (FreeGroup.of x) ∈ A) :
    (span V).map d ⊓ A = (span (V ∩ U)).map d
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro g ⟨⟨w,hw,rfl⟩,hA⟩
    refine ⟨w,?_,rfl⟩
    rw [← span_inter]
    refine ⟨hw,?_⟩
    have hh := hsupport (Subgroup.mem_map.mpr ⟨d w,hA,rfl⟩)
    change w ∈ span U
    simpa only [← MonoidHom.comp_apply,hr,MonoidHom.id_apply] using hh
  · apply le_inf
    · exact Subgroup.map_mono (Subgroup.closure_mono (Set.image_mono Set.inter_subset_left))
    · rw [span,MonoidHom.map_closure]
      apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
      rintro _ ⟨_,⟨x,hx,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
      exact hletters x hx.2

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.eq_inclusion_of_right_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_inclusion_of_right_eq_one (x : Base G T Q) (hx : (test x).right = 1) :
    x = inclusion (test x).left
proof:
:= by
  apply (decomposition (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).injective
  change test x = test (inclusion (test x).left)
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply,test_comp]
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · rfl
  · exact hx

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.test_embedding
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_embedding (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (x : Base G D P) :
    test (embedding f o q w x) =
      SemidirectProduct.map (kernelMap f o q w) f (kernelMap_shift f o q w) (test x)
proof:
:= by
  change (test.comp inverse) _ = _
  rw [test_comp_inverse]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_inclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_inclusion (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (x : Kernel G D P) :
    embedding f o q w (inclusion x) = inclusion (kernelMap f o q w x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embedding,MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply (test : Base G D P →* _),test_comp]
  simp

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem kernel_intersection (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (R : Subgroup (Kernel G T Q)) :
    R.map inclusion ⊓ (embedding f o q w).range =
      (R ⊓ (kernelMap f o q w).range).map inclusion
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,⟨x,hx⟩⟩
    have hxright : (test x).right = 1 := by
      apply hf
      have he := congrArg (fun y : Base G T Q ↦ (test y).right) hx
      simp only [test_embedding,SemidirectProduct.map_right] at he
      rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply,test_comp] at he
      simpa only [SemidirectProduct.right_inl,map_one] using he
    have hx' := eq_inclusion_of_right_eq_one x hxright
    refine ⟨a,⟨ha,?_⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(test x).left,?_⟩
    apply inclusion_injective
    rw [← embedding_inclusion,← hx']
    exact hx
  · rintro _ ⟨a,⟨ha,⟨x,hx⟩⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨a,ha,rfl⟩,inclusion x,?_⟩
    rw [embedding_inclusion,hx]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_kernelMap
statement:
lemma projection_kernelMap (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) :
    (Coprod.snd : Kernel G T Q →* FreeGroup (T × Q)).comp (kernelMap f o q w) =
      (FreeGroup.map (index f o q)).comp (Coprod.snd : Kernel G D P →* _)
proof:
:= by
  apply Coprod.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    simp
  · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro x
    simp

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.range_projection_support
statement:
lemma range_projection_support (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) :
    (kernelMap f o q w).range.map Coprod.snd ≤ FreeBasis.span (Set.range (index f o q))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨_,⟨x,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  have he := DFunLike.congr_fun (projection_kernelMap f o q w) x
  change Coprod.snd (kernelMap f o q w x) ∈ FreeBasis.span (Set.range (index f o q))
  rw [show Coprod.snd (kernelMap f o q w x) = FreeGroup.map (index f o q) (Coprod.snd x) from he]
  have hm : FreeGroup.map (index f o q) (Coprod.snd x) ∈ (FreeGroup.map (index f o q)).range :=
    ⟨Coprod.snd x,rfl⟩
  simpa only [FreeGroup.range_map,FreeBasis.span] using hm

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_letter_mem_range
statement:
lemma decorated_letter_mem_range (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (x : T × Q) (hx : x ∈ Set.range (index f o q)) :
    DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v (FreeGroup.of x) ∈ (kernelMap f o q w).range
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨d,p⟩,rfl⟩ := hx
  refine ⟨inl (v (index f o q (d,p)) * (w p)⁻¹) * inr (FreeGroup.of (d,p)),?_⟩
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_kernel_intersection
statement:
theorem decorated_kernel_intersection (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    (FreeBasis.span V).map (DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v) ⊓ (kernelMap f o q w).range =
      (FreeBasis.span (V ∩ Set.range (index f o q))).map (DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v)
proof:
:=
  FreeBasis.map_span_inf (DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion v) Coprod.snd
    (DecoratedFreeBasis.projection_comp v) (Set.range (index f o q)) V _
    (range_projection_support f o q w) (decorated_letter_mem_range f o q w v)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decorated_intersection
statement:
theorem decorated_intersection (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    decoratedSubgroup v V ⊓ (embedding f o q w).range =
      decoratedSubgroup v (V ∩ Set.range (index f o q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [decoratedSubgroup,← Subgroup.map_map,kernel_intersection f hf o q w,
    decorated_kernel_intersection,Subgroup.map_map]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure
statement:
theorem decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    decoratedSubgroup v V =
      Subgroup.closure ((fun x : T × Q ↦ coefficient (v x) * marker x.1 x.2) '' V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decoratedSubgroup,FreeBasis.span,MonoidHom.map_closure,Set.image_image]
  congr 1

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_decorated
statement:
@[simp] lemma embedding_decorated (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (x : D × P) :
    embedding f o q w (coefficient (pullDecoration f o q w v x) * marker x.1 x.2) =
      coefficient (v (index f o q x)) * marker (index f o q x).1 (index f o q x).2
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul,embedding_coefficient,embedding_marker,← mul_assoc,← map_mul]
  simp [pullDecoration,index]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.map_decoratedSubgroup
statement:
lemma map_decoratedSubgroup (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (v : T × Q → G) (W : Set (D × P)) :
    (decoratedSubgroup (pullDecoration f o q w v) W).map (embedding f o q w) =
      decoratedSubgroup v (index f o q '' W)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure,MonoidHom.map_closure,decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure]
  simp only [Set.image_image,embedding_decorated]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.comap_decoratedSubgroup
statement:
theorem comap_decoratedSubgroup [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q))
    (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) :
    (decoratedSubgroup v V).comap (embedding f o q w) =
      decoratedSubgroup (pullDecoration f o q w v) (index f o q ⁻¹' V)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.map_injective (embedding_injective f hf o q w hi)
  rw [Subgroup.map_comap_eq,inf_comm,decorated_intersection f hf,
    map_decoratedSubgroup,Set.image_preimage_eq_inter_range]

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.ofEmbeddings_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofEmbeddings_apply (i j : H →* G) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (x : H) :
    ((ofEmbeddings i j hi hj).equiv (MonoidHom.ofInjective hi x) : G) = j x
proof:
:= by
  change j ((MonoidHom.ofInjective hi).symm ((MonoidHom.ofInjective hi) x)) = j x
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: OAI.Higman.PartialIso.ofEmbeddings_invariant_iff
statement:
lemma ofEmbeddings_invariant_iff (i j : H →* G) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hj : Function.Injective j) (R : Subgroup G) :
    (ofEmbeddings i j hi hj).Invariant R ↔ R.comap i = R.comap j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    simpa only [ofEmbeddings_apply,MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply,Subgroup.mem_comap] using
      (h (MonoidHom.ofInjective hi x)).symm
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨x,rfl⟩ := (MonoidHom.ofInjective hi).surjective a
    rw [ofEmbeddings_apply]
    change x ∈ R.comap j ↔ x ∈ R.comap i
    rw [h]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.input_index_injective
statement:
lemma input_index_injective : Function.Injective
    (index e.inputLinear (fun _ : Unit ↦ e.inputOffset) (fun _ ↦ e.inputState))
proof:
:=
  index_injective e.inputLinear e.input_injective _ _ (Function.injective_of_subsingleton _)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.output_index_injective
statement:
lemma output_index_injective : Function.Injective
    (index e.outputLinear (fun _ : Unit ↦ e.outputOffset) (fun _ ↦ e.outputState))
proof:
:=
  index_injective e.outputLinear e.output_injective _ _ (Function.injective_of_subsingleton _)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.inputMap_injective
statement: lemma inputMap_injective : Function.Injective e.inputMap
proof:
:=
  embedding_injective e.inputLinear e.input_injective _ _ _ e.input_index_injective

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.outputMap_injective
statement: lemma outputMap_injective : Function.Injective e.outputMap
proof:
:=
  embedding_injective e.outputLinear e.output_injective _ _ _ e.output_index_injective

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.inputMap_decorated
statement:
lemma inputMap_decorated (v : G) (d : e.Domain) :
    e.inputMap (coefficient v * marker d ()) =
      coefficient v * marker (e.input d).1 (e.input d).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [inputMap,input]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.outputMap_decorated
statement:
lemma outputMap_decorated (v : G) (d : e.Domain) :
    e.outputMap (coefficient v * marker d ()) =
      coefficient (v * e.weight) * marker (e.output d).1 (e.output d).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [outputMap,output,map_mul,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.decoratedSubgroup_congr
statement:
lemma decoratedSubgroup_congr {v w : T × Q → G} {V : Set (T × Q)}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ V, v x = w x) : decoratedSubgroup v V = decoratedSubgroup w V
proof:
:= by
  rw [decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure,decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure]
  congr 1
  apply Set.image_congr
  intro x hx
  rw [h x hx]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.invariant
statement:
theorem invariant (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q))
    (hV : ∀ d, e.input d ∈ V ↔ e.output d ∈ V)
    (hv : ∀ d, e.input d ∈ V → v (e.output d) = v (e.input d) * e.weight) :
    e.partialIso.Invariant (decoratedSubgroup v V)
proof:
:= by
  rw [partialIso,PartialIso.ofEmbeddings_invariant_iff]
  unfold inputMap outputMap
  rw [comap_decoratedSubgroup e.inputLinear e.input_injective _ _ _ e.input_index_injective,
    comap_decoratedSubgroup e.outputLinear e.output_injective _ _ _ e.output_index_injective]
  have he : index e.inputLinear (fun _ : Unit ↦ e.inputOffset) (fun _ ↦ e.inputState) ⁻¹' V =
      index e.outputLinear (fun _ : Unit ↦ e.outputOffset) (fun _ ↦ e.outputState) ⁻¹' V := by
    ext x
    exact hV x.1
  rw [← he]
  apply decoratedSubgroup_congr
  rintro ⟨d,p⟩ hd
  change v (e.input d) * (1 : G)⁻¹ = v (e.output d) * e.weight⁻¹
  change e.input d ∈ V at hd
  rw [hv d hd]
  simp

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.invariant_decorated_iff
statement:
lemma invariant_decorated_iff (R : Subgroup (Base G T Q)) (hR : e.partialIso.Invariant R)
    (a : G) (d : e.Domain) :
    coefficient (a * e.weight) * marker (e.output d).1 (e.output d).2 ∈ R ↔
      coefficient a * marker (e.input d).1 (e.input d).2 ∈ R
proof:
:= by
  have hh := hR (MonoidHom.ofInjective e.inputMap_injective (coefficient a * marker d ()))
  change ((PartialIso.ofEmbeddings e.inputMap e.outputMap _ _).equiv
    (MonoidHom.ofInjective e.inputMap_injective (coefficient a * marker d ())) :
    Base G T Q) ∈ R ↔ _ at hh
  simpa only [PartialIso.ofEmbeddings_apply,MonoidHom.ofInjective_apply,
    inputMap_decorated,outputMap_decorated] using hh

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.Edge.source_fg
statement:
lemma source_fg [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented e.Domain] :
    e.partialIso.source.FG
proof:
:= by
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × e.Domain) := finitelyPresented_prod
  obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := Base G e.Domain Unit)
  have : Group.FG (Base G e.Domain Unit) := Group.fg_of_surjective hp
  exact (Group.fg_iff_subgroup_fg e.inputMap.range).mp inferInstance

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.reach_iff
statement:
lemma reach_iff (es : List (Edge G T Q)) (seed : T × Q) (e : Edge G T Q) (he : e ∈ es)
    (d : e.Domain) : Reach es seed (e.input d) ↔ Reach es seed (e.output d)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Reach.forward e he d,Reach.backward e he d⟩

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.orbit_eq
statement:
theorem orbit_eq (es : List (Edge G T Q)) (seed : T × Q) (v : T × Q → G)
    (hv : ∀ e ∈ es, ∀ d, Reach es seed (e.input d) →
      v (e.output d) = v (e.input d) * e.weight) :
    Orbit.subgroup (es.map Edge.partialIso) {word v seed} =
      decoratedSubgroup v {c | Reach es seed c}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Orbit.minimal
    · rintro x (rfl : x = word v seed)
      rw [decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure]
      exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨seed,Reach.start,rfl⟩
    · intro p hp
      obtain ⟨e,he,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
      exact e.invariant v _ (reach_iff es seed e he) (hv e he)
  · rw [decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure]
    apply (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr
    rintro _ ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩
    change word v c ∈ Orbit.subgroup (es.map Edge.partialIso) {word v seed}
    induction hc with
    | start => exact Orbit.subset _ _ (Set.mem_singleton _)
    | forward e he d hr ih =>
      have hinv := Orbit.invariant (es.map Edge.partialIso) {word v seed} e.partialIso
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,he,rfl⟩)
      change coefficient (v (e.output d)) * marker (e.output d).1 (e.output d).2 ∈ _
      rw [hv e he d hr]
      exact (e.invariant_decorated_iff _ hinv (v (e.input d)) d).mpr ih
    | backward e he d hr ih =>
      have hinv := Orbit.invariant (es.map Edge.partialIso) {word v seed} e.partialIso
        (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,he,rfl⟩)
      apply (e.invariant_decorated_iff _ hinv (v (e.input d)) d).mp
      rw [← hv e he d (Reach.backward e he d hr)]
      exact ih

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerMachine.benign
statement:
theorem benign [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented T] [Finite Q]
    (es : List (Edge G T Q)) (hD : ∀ e ∈ es, Group.IsFinitelyPresented e.Domain)
    (seed : T × Q) (v : T × Q → G)
    (hv : ∀ e ∈ es, ∀ d, Reach es seed (e.input d) →
      v (e.output d) = v (e.input d) * e.weight) :
    IsBenign (decoratedSubgroup v {c | Reach es seed c})
proof:
:= by
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × T) := finitelyPresented_prod
  rw [← orbit_eq es seed v hv]
  apply Orbit.benign _ _ _ (Set.finite_singleton _)
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨e,he,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hp
  have := hD e he
  exact e.source_fg

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.shift_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem shift_inl (t : T) (g : G) : shift t (inl g : Kernel G T Q) = inl g
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.shift_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_inr_of (t s : T) (q : Q) :
    shift t (inr (FreeGroup.of (s,q)) : Kernel G T Q) = inr (FreeGroup.of (t*s,q))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem inclusion_inl (g : G) : inclusion (inl g : Kernel G T Q) = coefficient g
proof:
:= by
  simp [inclusion]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_inr_of (t : T) (q : Q) :
    inclusion (inr (FreeGroup.of (t,q)) : Kernel G T Q) = marker t q
proof:
:= by
  simp [inclusion]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.commute_coefficient_translation
statement:
lemma commute_coefficient_translation (g : G) (t : T) :
    Commute (coefficient g : Base G T Q) (translation t)
proof:
:=
  (MonoidHom.commute_inl_inr g t).map inl

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_commute
statement:
lemma test_commute (g : G) (t : T) :
    Commute (SemidirectProduct.inl (inl g) : ShiftGroup G T Q)
      (SemidirectProduct.inr t)
proof:
:= by
  apply SemidirectProduct.ext
  · change inl g * shifts (1 : T) 1 = 1 * shifts t (inl g)
    simp only [map_one, mul_one, one_mul]
    rfl
  · change (1 : T) * t = t * 1
    simp

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_coefficient (g : G) : test (coefficient g : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inl g)
proof: := by simp [test,coefficient]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_translation (t : T) : test (translation t : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inr t
proof: := by simp [test,translation]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_inr_of (q : Q) : test (inr (FreeGroup.of q) : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inr (FreeGroup.of (1,q)))
proof: := by simp [test]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_marker
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_marker (t : T) (q : Q) : test (marker t q : Base G T Q) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (inr (FreeGroup.of (t,q)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [marker,map_mul,map_inv,test_translation,test_inr_of]
  rw [← map_inv,← SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]
  change SemidirectProduct.inl (inr (FreeGroup.of (t * 1, q))) = _
  rw [mul_one]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_comp : (test (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp inclusion =
    SemidirectProduct.inl
proof:
:= by
  apply Coprod.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    simp
  · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    rintro ⟨t,q⟩
    simp

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_injective
statement: theorem inclusion_injective : Function.Injective (inclusion (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q))
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := test)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,test_comp]
  exact SemidirectProduct.inl_injective

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inclusion_shift
statement:
lemma inclusion_shift (t : T) :
    (inclusion (G := G) (Q := Q)).comp (shifts t).toMonoidHom =
      (MulAut.conj (translation t)).toMonoidHom.comp inclusion
proof:
:= by
  apply Coprod.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom,shifts,MonoidHom.coe_mk,
      OneHom.coe_mk,shift_inl,inclusion_inl,MulAut.conj_apply]
    rw [← (commute_coefficient_translation g t).eq,mul_inv_cancel_right]
  · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    rintro ⟨s,q⟩
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom,shifts,MonoidHom.coe_mk,
      OneHom.coe_mk,shift_inr_of,inclusion_inr_of,MulAut.conj_apply,marker,map_mul,map_inv]
    group

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_inl (x : Kernel G T Q) :
    inverse (SemidirectProduct.inl x) = inclusion x
proof: := by simp [inverse]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_inr (t : T) :
    inverse (SemidirectProduct.inr t : ShiftGroup G T Q) = translation t
proof: := by simp [inverse]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.inverse_comp_test
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_comp_test : (inverse (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp test =
    MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Coprod.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    rintro ⟨g,t⟩
    have he : (inl (g,t) : Base G T Q) = coefficient g * translation t := by
      rw [coefficient,translation,MonoidHom.comp_apply,MonoidHom.comp_apply,← map_mul]
      simp
    change inverse (test (inl (g,t))) = inl (g,t)
    rw [he]
    simp
  · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro q
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,MonoidHom.id_apply,test_inr_of,inverse_inl,
      inclusion_inr_of,marker,map_one,one_mul,inv_one,mul_one]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedMarker.test_comp_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem test_comp_inverse : (test (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).comp inverse =
    MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply SemidirectProduct.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro x
    simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,inverse_inl,MonoidHom.id_apply]
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun test_comp x
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro t
    simp

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_of (w : X → G) (x : X) :
    inclusion w (FreeGroup.of x) = inl (w x) * inr (FreeGroup.of x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [inclusion]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.projection_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem projection_comp (w : X → G) :
    (Coprod.snd : G ∗ FreeGroup X →* FreeGroup X).comp (inclusion w) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro x
  simp

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.inclusion_injective
statement: theorem inclusion_injective (w : X → G) : Function.Injective (inclusion w)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := (Coprod.snd : G ∗ FreeGroup X →* FreeGroup X))
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,projection_comp]
  exact Function.injective_id

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.twist_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem twist_inl (w : X → G) (g : G) : twist w (inl g) = inl g
proof:
:= by
  simp [twist]

name: OAI.Higman.DecoratedFreeBasis.twist_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem twist_inr_of (w : X → G) (x : X) : twist w (inr (FreeGroup.of x)) =
    inl (w x) * inr (FreeGroup.of x)
proof: := by simp [twist]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelMap_inl (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (g : G) :
    kernelMap f o q w (inl g) = inl g
proof: := by simp [kernelMap]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelMap_inr_of (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (x : D × P) :
    kernelMap f o q w (inr (FreeGroup.of x)) =
      inl (w x.2) * inr (FreeGroup.of (index f o q x))
proof: := by simp [kernelMap]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_shift
statement:
lemma kernelMap_shift (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (d : D) :
    (kernelMap f o q w).comp (shifts d).toMonoidHom =
      (shifts (f d)).toMonoidHom.comp (kernelMap f o q w)
proof:
:= by
  apply Coprod.hom_ext
  · apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    simp [shifts]
  · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    rintro ⟨e,p⟩
    simp [shifts,index,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_coefficient (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (g : G) : embedding f o q w (coefficient g) = coefficient g
proof:
:= by
  simp [embedding]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_translation
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_translation (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (d : D) : embedding f o q w (translation d) = translation (f d)
proof:
:= by
  simp [embedding]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_inr_of
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_inr_of (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (p : P) : embedding f o q w (inr (FreeGroup.of p)) = coefficient (w p) * marker (o p) (q p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [embedding,index]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_marker
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_marker (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G)
    (d : D) (p : P) : embedding f o q w (marker d p) =
      coefficient (w p) * marker (f d * o p) (q p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embedding,MonoidHom.comp_apply,test_marker,SemidirectProduct.map_inl,
    kernelMap_inr_of,inverse_inl,map_mul,inclusion_inl,inclusion_inr_of,index]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.kernelMap_injective
statement:
theorem kernelMap_injective [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (o : P → T) (q : P → Q)
    (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q)) :
    Function.Injective (kernelMap f o q w)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := Function.invFun (index f o q)
  have hr : Function.LeftInverse r (index f o q) := Function.leftInverse_invFun hi
  let k := Coprod.map (MonoidHom.id G) (FreeGroup.map (index f o q))
  have hk : Function.Injective k := by
    let l := Coprod.map (MonoidHom.id G) (FreeGroup.map r)
    have he : l.comp k = MonoidHom.id _ := by
      apply Coprod.hom_ext
      · apply MonoidHom.ext
        intro g
        simp [l,k]
      · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
        intro x
        simp [l,k,hr x]
    apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := l)
    rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,he]
    exact Function.injective_id
  have he : kernelMap f o q w = k.comp (DecoratedFreeBasis.twist (w ∘ Prod.snd)).toMonoidHom := by
    apply Coprod.hom_ext
    · apply MonoidHom.ext
      intro g
      simp [k]
    · apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
      intro x
      simp [k]
  rw [he]
  exact hk.comp (DecoratedFreeBasis.twist (w ∘ Prod.snd)).injective

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.embedding_injective
statement:
theorem embedding_injective [Nonempty P] (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (o : P → T) (q : P → Q) (w : P → G) (hi : Function.Injective (index f o q)) :
    Function.Injective (embedding f o q w)
proof:
:= by
  have hk := kernelMap_injective f o q w hi
  have hm : Function.Injective (SemidirectProduct.map (kernelMap f o q w) f
      (kernelMap_shift f o q w)) := by
    intro x y he
    apply SemidirectProduct.ext
    · exact hk (congrArg SemidirectProduct.left he)
    · exact hf (congrArg SemidirectProduct.right he)
  exact (decomposition (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Q)).symm.injective.comp
    (hm.comp (decomposition (G := G) (T := D) (Q := P)).injective)

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.index_injective
statement:
theorem index_injective (f : D →* T) (hf : Function.Injective f) (o : P → T)
    (q : P → Q) (hq : Function.Injective q) : Function.Injective (index f o q)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d,p⟩ ⟨e,r⟩ he
  obtain rfl : p = r := hq (congrArg Prod.snd he)
  have hd : f d * o p = f e * o p := congrArg Prod.fst he
  exact Prod.ext (hf (mul_right_cancel hd)) rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.rank_one_idempotent
statement:
lemma rank_one_idempotent (u l : Fin 3 → K) (h : l ⬝ᵥ u = 1) :
    IsIdempotentElem (vecMulVec u l)
proof:
:= by
  change vecMulVec u l * vecMulVec u l = vecMulVec u l
  rw [vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, h, one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.rank_one_mul_zero
statement:
lemma rank_one_mul_zero (u l v m : Fin 3 → K) (h : l ⬝ᵥ v = 0) :
    vecMulVec u l * vecMulVec v m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec, h, zero_smul, vecMulVec_zero]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.rank_one_difference
statement:
lemma rank_one_difference (z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T)
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) (u l v m : Fin 3 → K)
    (hlu : l ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hlv : l ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (hmu : m ⬝ᵥ u = 0) (hmv : m ⬝ᵥ v = 1) :
    z (vecMulVec (u + v) l) - z (vecMulVec u l) =
      z (vecMulVec v m) - z (vecMulVec v (m - l))
proof:
:= by
  have hmlv : (m - l) ⬝ᵥ v = 1 := by simp [sub_dotProduct, hmv, hlv]
  have hluv : l ⬝ᵥ (u + v) = 1 := by simp [dotProduct_add, hlu, hlv]
  have hmluv : (m - l) ⬝ᵥ (u + v) = 0 := by
    simp [sub_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, hmu, hmv, hlu, hlv]
  have h₁ := hz (vecMulVec u l) (vecMulVec v m)
    (rank_one_idempotent u l hlu) (rank_one_idempotent v m hmv)
    (rank_one_mul_zero u l v m hlv) (rank_one_mul_zero v m u l hmu)
  have h₂ := hz (vecMulVec (u + v) l) (vecMulVec v (m - l))
    (rank_one_idempotent (u + v) l hluv) (rank_one_idempotent v (m - l) hmlv)
    (rank_one_mul_zero (u + v) l v (m - l) hlv)
    (rank_one_mul_zero v (m - l) (u + v) l hmluv)
  have heq : vecMulVec u l + vecMulVec v m =
      vecMulVec (u + v) l + vecMulVec v (m - l) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.add_apply, vecMulVec_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  rw [heq, h₂] at h₁
  apply sub_eq_sub_iff_add_eq_add.mpr
  exact h₁.trans (add_comm _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.frame_identities
statement:
lemma frame_identities (s t : K) :
    row s ⬝ᵥ along s t = 1 ∧ row s ⬝ᵥ direction s = 0 ∧
    witness s t ⬝ᵥ along s t = 0 ∧ witness s t ⬝ᵥ direction s = 1 ∧
    row s ⬝ᵥ (anchor : Fin 3 → K) = 1 ∧
    witness s t ⬝ᵥ (anchor : Fin 3 → K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [row, along, witness, direction, anchor, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  constructor <;> ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.along_step
statement: lemma along_step (s t : K) : along s t + direction s = along s (t + 1)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [along, direction]
  ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.increment_independent
statement:
lemma increment_independent (z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T)
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) (s t : K) :
    z (vecMulVec (along s (t + 1)) (row s)) - z (vecMulVec (along s t) (row s)) =
      z (vecMulVec (along s 1) (row s)) - z (vecMulVec (along s 0) (row s))
proof:
:= by
  have hd (r : K) :
      z (vecMulVec (along s (r + 1)) (row s)) - z (vecMulVec (along s r) (row s)) =
        z (vecMulVec ((anchor : Fin 3 → K) + direction s) (row s)) -
          z (vecMulVec (anchor : Fin 3 → K) (row s)) := by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅, h₆⟩ := frame_identities s r
    rw [← along_step]
    exact (rank_one_difference z hz _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄).trans
      (rank_one_difference z hz _ _ _ _ h₅ h₂ h₆ h₄).symm
  exact (hd t).trans (by simpa using (hd 0).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.prime_multiple_step
statement:
theorem prime_multiple_step (z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T)
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (s : K) :
    p • z (vecMulVec (along s 1) (row s)) =
      p • z (vecMulVec (along s 0) (row s))
proof:
:= by
  let F (n : ℕ) := z (vecMulVec (along s (n : K)) (row s))
  let d := F 1 - F 0
  have hstep (n : ℕ) : F (n + 1) - F n = d := by
    simpa only [F, d, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero] using
      increment_independent z hz s (n : K)
  have hF (n : ℕ) : F n = F 0 + n • d := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have h := hstep n
      rw [ih, succ_nsmul] at *
      exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).trans (by abel)
  have hp : F p = F 0 := by simp only [F, CharP.cast_eq_zero, Nat.cast_zero]
  have hpd : p • d = 0 := by
    have h := (hF p).symm.trans hp
    simpa only [add_eq_left] using h
  have h := sub_eq_zero.mp (show p • F 1 - p • F 0 = 0 by
    simpa only [d, nsmul_sub] using hpd)
  simpa only [F, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero] using h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.OrthogonallyAdditive.transpose
statement:
lemma OrthogonallyAdditive.transpose {z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T}
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) : OrthogonallyAdditive (fun E => z E.transpose)
proof:
:= by
  intro E P hE hP hEP hPE
  have hEt : IsIdempotentElem E.transpose := by
    change E.transpose * E.transpose = E.transpose
    rw [← transpose_mul, hE]
  have hPt : IsIdempotentElem P.transpose := by
    change P.transpose * P.transpose = P.transpose
    rw [← transpose_mul, hP]
  have hEPt : E.transpose * P.transpose = 0 := by rw [← transpose_mul, hPE, transpose_zero]
  have hPEt : P.transpose * E.transpose = 0 := by rw [← transpose_mul, hEP, transpose_zero]
