  simpa only [transpose_add] using hz _ _ hEt hPt hEPt hPEt

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.OrthogonallyAdditive.comp
proof:
:= by
  intro E P hE hP hEP hPE
  have hEt : IsIdempotentElem (f E) := by
    change f E * f E = f E
    rw [← map_mul, hE]
  have hPt : IsIdempotentElem (f P) := by
    change f P * f P = f P
    rw [← map_mul, hP]
  have hEPt : f E * f P = 0 := by rw [← map_mul, hEP, map_zero]
  have hPEt : f P * f E = 0 := by rw [← map_mul, hPE, map_zero]
  simpa only [map_add] using hz _ _ hEt hPt hEPt hPEt

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.diagonal_zero_one
statement:
theorem diagonal_zero_one (z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T)
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] :
    p • z (diagonalUnit 0) = p • z (diagonalUnit 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := prime_multiple_step (fun E => z E.transpose) hz.transpose p 0
  have hmid := prime_multiple_step z hz p 1
  let q := (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv K (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)).toRingHom
  have hright := prime_multiple_step (fun E => z (q E).transpose)
    (hz.transpose.comp q) p 0
  have e0 : along (0 : K) 0 = basisVector 0 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [along, basisVector]
  have r0 : row (0 : K) = basisVector 0 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [row, basisVector]
  have e1 : along (1 : K) 1 = basisVector 1 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [along, basisVector]
  have m0 : along (1 : K) 0 = basisVector 0 := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [along, basisVector]
  have r1 : along (0 : K) 1 = row (1 : K) := by
    ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [along, row]
  have q0 : q (vecMulVec (along 0 0) (row 0)) = diagonalUnit 1 := by
    ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [q, Matrix.reindex, Matrix.submatrix, along, row,
        diagonalUnit, basisVector, Pi.single_apply, vecMulVec, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  have q1 : (q (vecMulVec (along 0 1) (row 0))).transpose =
      vecMulVec (basisVector 1) (row 1) := by
    ext i j; fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [q, Matrix.reindex, Matrix.submatrix, along, row,
        basisVector, Pi.single_apply, vecMulVec, Equiv.swap_apply_def]
  rw [transpose_vecMulVec, transpose_vecMulVec, e0, r0, r1] at hleft
  rw [e1, m0] at hmid
  rw [q0, q1, diagonalUnit, transpose_vecMulVec] at hright
  exact hleft.symm.trans (hmid.symm.trans hright)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.reindex_diagonalUnit
statement:
lemma reindex_diagonalUnit (e : Fin 3 ≃ Fin 3) (i : Fin 3) :
    reindexRingEquiv K e (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit (e i)
proof:
:= by
  have hb (x : Fin 3) : basisVector i (e.symm x) = (basisVector (e i) x : K) := by
    by_cases hx : x = e i
    · subst x; simp [basisVector]
    · have hx' : e.symm x ≠ i := fun h => hx (by simpa using congrArg e h)
      simp [basisVector, hx, hx']
  ext x y
  change basisVector i (e.symm x) * basisVector i (e.symm y) =
    (basisVector (e i) x : K) * basisVector (e i) y
  rw [hb, hb]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.diagonal_equality
statement:
theorem diagonal_equality (z : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K → T)
    (hz : OrthogonallyAdditive z) (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] (i j : Fin 3) :
    p • z (diagonalUnit i) = p • z (diagonalUnit j)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := diagonal_zero_one z hz p
  let e := Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2
  let q := (reindexRingEquiv K e).toRingHom
  have h02 := diagonal_zero_one (fun E => z (q E)) (hz.comp q) p
  have hq (i : Fin 3) : q (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit (e i) :=
    reindex_diagonalUnit e i
  simp only [hq] at h02
  have he0 : e 0 = 0 := by decide
  have he1 : e 1 = 2 := by decide
  rw [he0, he1] at h02
  have h0 (i : Fin 3) : p • z (diagonalUnit 0) = p • z (diagonalUnit i) := by
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · exact h01
    · exact h02
  exact (h0 i).symm.trans (h0 j)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_idempotent
statement:
lemma diagonalUnit_idempotent (i : Fin 3) :
    IsIdempotentElem (diagonalUnit i : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K)
proof:
:= by
  apply rank_one_idempotent
  simp [basisVector, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_orthogonal
statement:
lemma diagonalUnit_orthogonal {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (diagonalUnit i : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) * diagonalUnit j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply rank_one_mul_zero
  simp [basisVector, dotProduct, Pi.single_apply, Ne.symm hij]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixDiagram.diagonalUnit_sum
statement:
lemma diagonalUnit_sum :
    (diagonalUnit 0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) + diagonalUnit 1 + diagonalUnit 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [diagonalUnit, basisVector, vecMulVec]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.prefix_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma prefix_single (i : Bool) (s : Sequences) (a : K) :
    prefixOp K i (Finsupp.single s a) = Finsupp.single (Stream'.cons i s) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [prefixOp]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.delete_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma delete_single (i : Bool) (s : Sequences) (a : K) :
    delete K i (Finsupp.single s a) = if s.head = i then Finsupp.single s.tail a else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : s.head = i <;> simp [delete, h]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.delete_prefix
statement:
lemma delete_prefix (i j : Bool) :
    delete K i * prefixOp K j = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, prefix_single, delete_single,
    Stream'.head_cons, Stream'.tail_cons]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp
  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.prefix_partition
statement: lemma prefix_partition : prefixOp K false * delete K false + prefixOp K true * delete K true = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, Module.End.mul_apply, delete_single]
  cases h : s.head <;> simp
  all_goals rw [← h, Stream'.cons_head_tail]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.right_left
statement: lemma right_left (i j : Bool) : right K i * left K j = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [Subalgebra.coe_mul, left, right, Subalgebra.coe_one, Subalgebra.coe_zero,
    apply_ite] using delete_prefix K i j

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.partition
statement: lemma partition : left K false * right K false + left K true * right K true = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact prefix_partition K

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.leftWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma leftWord_nil : leftWord K [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.rightWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma rightWord_nil : rightWord K [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.cancel_initial
statement:
lemma cancel_initial (b c : Bool) (v w : List Bool) :
    rightWord K (b :: v) * leftWord K (c :: w) =
      if b = c then rightWord K v * leftWord K w else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rightWord, leftWord]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (right K b), right_left]
  by_cases h : b = c <;> simp [h]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.word_cancel
statement: @[simp] lemma word_cancel (w : List Bool) : rightWord K w * leftWord K w = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp
  | cons b w ih => rw [cancel_initial, ite_eq_left rfl, ih]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.word_orthogonality
statement:
lemma word_orthogonality (a i j : Fin 3) :
    rightWord K (words a i) * leftWord K (words a j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [words, cancel_initial]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.projection_idempotent
statement: lemma projection_idempotent (w : List Bool) : IsIdempotentElem (projection K w)
proof:
:= by
  change (leftWord K w * rightWord K w) * (leftWord K w * rightWord K w) = _
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (rightWord K w), word_cancel, one_mul]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PrefixAlgebra.projection_split
statement:
lemma projection_split (w : List Bool) :
    projection K w = projection K (w ++ [false]) + projection K (w ++ [true])
proof:
:= by
  have hl (w v : List Bool) : leftWord K (w ++ v) = leftWord K w * leftWord K v := by
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [leftWord]
    | cons b w ih => simp only [List.cons_append, leftWord, ih, mul_assoc]
  have hr (w v : List Bool) : rightWord K (w ++ v) = rightWord K v * rightWord K w := by
    induction w with
    | nil => simp [rightWord]
    | cons b w ih => simp only [List.cons_append, rightWord, ih, mul_assoc]
  simp only [projection, hl, hr, leftWord, rightWord, mul_one, one_mul]
  calc
    _ = leftWord K w * (left K false * right K false + left K true * right K true) * rightWord K w := by
      rw [partition, mul_one]
    _ = _ := by noncomm_ring

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.unit_mul
statement:
lemma unit_mul (i j k m : ι) :
    unit L R i j * unit L R k m = if j = k then unit L R i m else 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [unit]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (R j), h]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.weighted_unit_mul
statement:
lemma weighted_unit_mul (a b : K) (i j k m : ι) :
    (a • unit L R i j) * (b • unit L R k m) =
      if j = k then (a * b) • unit L R i m else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_mul_smul, unit_mul L R h]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.matrixMap_mul
statement:
lemma matrixMap_mul (A B : Matrix ι ι K) :
    matrixMap L R (A * B) = matrixMap L R A * matrixMap L R B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hr : matrixMap L R A * matrixMap L R B =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ m, (A i j * B j m) • unit L R i m := by
    simp only [matrixMap, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, weighted_unit_mul L R h]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, ∑ m, (A i j * B j m) • unit L R i m := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hr]
  simp only [matrixMap, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_smul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.map_diagonal
statement:
lemma map_diagonal (i : ι) :
    hom L R h (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : K))) = L i * R i
proof:
:= by
  change matrixMap L R _ = _
  simp [matrixMap, Matrix.diagonal, Pi.single_apply, unit]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.map_one
statement: lemma map_one : hom L R h (1 : Matrix ι ι K) = ∑ i, L i * R i
proof:
:= by
  change matrixMap L R _ = _
  simp [matrixMap, Matrix.one_apply, unit]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.MatrixCorners.extract
statement:
lemma extract (A : Matrix ι ι K) (i j : ι) :
    R i * hom L R h A * L j = algebraMap K D (A i j)
proof:
:= by
  change R i * matrixMap L R A * L j = _
  have hextract (a : K) (k l : ι) :
      R i * (a • unit L R k l) * L j =
        if i = k then if l = j then algebraMap K D a else 0 else 0 := by
    rw [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
    dsimp only [unit]
    rw [← mul_assoc (R i), h]
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · rw [ite_eq_left hik, one_mul, h]
      by_cases hlj : l = j <;> simp [hlj, hik, Algebra.smul_def]
    · simp [hik]
  simp only [matrixMap, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, hextract]
  simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.mem_complex
statement:
lemma mem_complex (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : s ∈ complex G ↔
    s.Nonempty ∧ Set.InjOn Prod.fst (s : Set (ℕ × G))
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_le
statement: lemma bounded_le (N : ℕ) : bounded G N ≤ complex G
proof: := fun _ hs => hs.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_mono
statement: lemma bounded_mono {N M : ℕ} (h : N ≤ M) : bounded G N ≤ bounded G M
proof:
:=
  fun _ hs => ⟨hs.1,fun v hv => lt_of_lt_of_le (hs.2 v hv) h⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.map_face
statement:
lemma map_face (φ : G → H) (ρ : ℕ → ℕ) (hρ : Function.Injective ρ)
    (s : Face (complex G)) : s.1.image (fun v => (ρ v.1,φ v.2)) ∈ complex H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨s.2.1.image _,?_⟩
  rintro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
  obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
  exact congrArg (fun v : ℕ × G => (ρ v.1,φ v.2)) (s.2.2 hx hy (hρ hab))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {J : Type*} (φ : G → H) (ψ : H → J)
    (ρ τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hρ : Function.Injective ρ) (hτ : Function.Injective τ) (x : Space G) :
    map ψ τ hτ (map φ ρ hρ x) = map (ψ ∘ φ) (τ ∘ ρ) (hτ.comp hρ) x

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (x : Space G) : map id id Function.injective_id x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_id

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_union_apex
statement:
lemma bounded_union_apex (N : ℕ) (g : G) (s : Face (bounded G N)) :
    s.1 ∪ {(N,g)} ∈ complex G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨s.2.1.1.mono Finset.subset_union_left,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx <;> rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
  · exact s.2.1.2 hx hy hxy
  · have hyy := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy
    subst y
    exact False.elim ((Nat.ne_of_lt (s.2.2 x hx)) hxy)
  · have hxx := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx
    subst x
    exact False.elim ((Nat.ne_of_lt (s.2.2 y hy)) hxy.symm)
  · exact (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).trans (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_id_face
statement: lemma bounded_id_face (N : ℕ) (s : Face (bounded G N)) : s.1.image id ∈ complex G
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Finset.image_id] using s.2.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_const_face
statement:
lemma bounded_const_face (N : ℕ) (g : G) (s : Face (bounded G N)) :
    s.1.image (fun _ => (N,g)) ∈ complex G
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.image_const s.2.1.1]
  exact ⟨Finset.singleton_nonempty _,by simpa only [Finset.coe_singleton] using Set.injOn_singleton Prod.fst (N,g)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_contiguous
statement:
lemma bounded_contiguous (N : ℕ) (g : G) (s : Face (bounded G N)) :
    s.1.image id ∪ s.1.image (fun _ => (N,g)) ∈ complex G
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.image_id,Finset.image_const s.2.1.1]
  exact bounded_union_apex N g s

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.bounded_map_id
statement:
lemma bounded_map_id (N : ℕ) (x : Simplicial.Space (bounded G N)) :
    Simplicial.map (bounded G N) (complex G) id (bounded_id_face N) x =
      Simplicial.inclusion (bounded G N) (complex G) (fun _ h => bounded_le G N h) x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_id

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.map_const_vertex
statement:
lemma map_const_vertex (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (ℕ × G)) (v : ℕ × G)
    (hf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image (fun _ => v) ∈ complex G) (x : Simplicial.Space K) :
    Simplicial.map K (complex G) (fun _ => v) hf x = vertex v
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change x.1.mapDomain (fun _ => v) = Finsupp.single v 1
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain,← Finsupp.single_sum]
  exact congrArg (Finsupp.single v) x.2.2.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.faceDisk_open
statement:
lemma faceDisk_open {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1.1) :
    (faceDisk K s x).1 ∈ ball 0 1 ↔ (faceMap K s.1 x).1.support = s.1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_eq_iff]
  exact (SimplexDisk.simplexDisk_open n _).trans (SimplexDisk.reindex_positive _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.diskMap_injective
statement: lemma diskMap_injective {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) : Function.Injective (diskMap K s)
proof:
:=
  (faceMap_injective K s.1).comp (faceDisk K s).symm.injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.diskMap_range
statement: lemma diskMap_range {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) : Set.range (diskMap K s) = Set.range (faceMap K s.1)
proof:
:=
  (faceDisk K s).symm.surjective.range_comp (faceMap K s.1)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristic_disk
statement:
lemma characteristic_disk {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) (x : closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1) :
    characteristic K s x.1 = diskMap K s x
proof: := by simp only [characteristic,dite_eq_left x.2]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristic_bijOn
statement:
lemma characteristic_bijOn {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    Set.BijOn (characteristic K s) (ball 0 1) {x | x.1.support = s.1.1}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    let d : closedBall (0 : Fin n → ℝ) 1 := ⟨x,ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩
    rw [show characteristic K s x = diskMap K s d from characteristic_disk K s d]
    exact (faceDisk_open K s ((faceDisk K s).symm d)).mp (by simpa using hx)
  constructor
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have hxy' : diskMap K s ⟨x,ball_subset_closedBall hx⟩ = diskMap K s ⟨y,ball_subset_closedBall hy⟩ := by
      simpa only [← characteristic_disk] using hxy
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (diskMap_injective K s hxy')
  · intro x hx
    let z := coordinates K s.1.1 x (by rw [hx])
    let d := faceDisk K s z
    have hd : d.1 ∈ ball 0 1 := (faceDisk_open K s z).mpr (by rwa [faceMap_coordinates])
    exact ⟨d.1,hd,(characteristic_disk K s d).trans (by
      change faceMap K s.1 ((faceDisk K s).symm (faceDisk K s z)) = x
      rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
      exact faceMap_coordinates K s.1 x _)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristicPE_open
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_open {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    characteristicPE K s '' ball 0 1 = {x | x.1.support = s.1.1}
proof:
:=
  (characteristic_bijOn K s).image_eq

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristicPE_closed
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_closed {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    characteristicPE K s '' closedBall 0 1 = Set.range (faceMap K s.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diskMap_range]
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z,hz,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨z,hz⟩,(characteristic_disk K s ⟨z,hz⟩).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨z,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨z.1,z.2,characteristic_disk K s z⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristicPE_continuous
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_continuous {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    ContinuousOn (characteristicPE K s) (closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  have he : (closedBall (0:Fin n→ℝ) 1).domRestrict (characteristicPE K s) = diskMap K s := by
    funext x
    exact characteristic_disk K s x
  rw [he]
  exact (diskMap K s).continuous

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristicPE_continuous_symm
statement:
lemma characteristicPE_continuous_symm {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    ContinuousOn (characteristicPE K s).symm (characteristicPE K s).target
proof:
:= by
  let e := characteristicPE K s
  have he : IsEmbedding (e.source.domRestrict e) := by
    let inc : ball (0:Fin n→ℝ) 1 → closedBall (0:Fin n→ℝ) 1 := fun x => ⟨x.1,ball_subset_closedBall x.2⟩
    have hi : IsEmbedding inc := IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.codRestrict _ (fun x => ball_subset_closedBall x.2)
    have heq : e.source.domRestrict e = (diskMap K s) ∘ inc := by
      funext x
      exact characteristic_disk K s (inc x)
    rw [heq]
    exact ((diskMap K s).continuous.isClosedEmbedding (diskMap_injective K s)).isEmbedding.comp hi
  let H : e.source ≃ₜ e.target := e.toEquiv.toHomeomorphOfIsInducing
    (he.isInducing.codRestrict (fun x => e.map_source x.2))
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  exact continuous_subtype_val.comp H.symm.continuous

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.support_lt_of_sphere
statement:
lemma support_lt_of_sphere {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ sphere 0 1) :
    (characteristicPE K s x).1.support.card < s.1.1.card
proof:
:= by
  have hd := characteristic_disk K s ⟨x,sphere_subset_closedBall hx⟩
  have hs : (characteristicPE K s x).1.support ⊆ s.1.1 := by
    rw [show characteristicPE K s x = diskMap K s ⟨x,sphere_subset_closedBall hx⟩ from hd]
    exact weight_support_subset _ _
  apply Finset.card_lt_card
  refine Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hs,?_⟩
  intro he
  have ho : x ∈ ball (0:Fin n→ℝ) 1 := by
    have hh := (faceDisk_open K s ((faceDisk K s).symm ⟨x,sphere_subset_closedBall hx⟩)).mpr (by
      change (characteristic K s x).1.support = s.1.1 at he
      rwa [hd] at he)
    simpa only [Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply] using hh
  exact sphere_disjoint_ball.notMem_of_mem_left hx ho

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.subcells_finite
statement: lemma subcells_finite (s : Face K) (n : ℕ) : Set.Finite {c : Cell K n | c.1.1 ⊆ s.1}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun c : Cell K n => c.1.1) := Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective
  have hfin := (s.1.powerset.finite_toSet).preimage hinj.injOn
  convert hfin using 1
  ext c
  simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,mem_preimage,Finset.mem_coe,Finset.mem_powerset]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.characteristic_boundary
statement:
lemma characteristic_boundary {n : ℕ} (s : Cell K n) :
    MapsTo (characteristicPE K s) (sphere 0 1)
      (⋃ (m < n) (j ∈ subcells K s.1 m), characteristicPE K j '' closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let y := characteristicPE K s x
  let t : Face K := ⟨y.1.support,y.2.2.2⟩
  let m := y.1.support.card-1
  let c : Cell K m := cellOfFace K t
  have hpos : 0 < y.1.support.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr (support_nonempty y.2.2.1)
  have hlt : y.1.support.card < s.1.1.card := support_lt_of_sphere K s x hx
  have hmn : m < n := by dsimp [m]; rw [s.2] at hlt; omega
  have hcs : c ∈ subcells K s.1 m := by
    rw [subcells,Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
    change y.1.support ⊆ s.1.1
    rw [show y = diskMap K s ⟨x,sphere_subset_closedBall hx⟩ from characteristic_disk K s ⟨x,sphere_subset_closedBall hx⟩]
    exact weight_support_subset _ _
  refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨m,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hmn,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨c,mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hcs,?_⟩⟩⟩⟩
  rw [characteristicPE_closed,range_faceMap]
  exact Finset.Subset.refl _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.compactMap_bounded
statement:
lemma compactMap_bounded {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CompactSpace A] (f : C(A,Space G)) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∃ F : C(A,Simplicial.Space (bounded G N)), (boundedInclusion N).comp F = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := Simplicial.compact_bounded_vertices (complex G) (isCompact_range f.continuous)
  let N := S.sup Prod.fst + 1
  have hN (a : A) (v : ℕ × G) (hv : v ∈ (f a).1.support) : v.1 < N := by
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Finset.le_sup (f := Prod.fst) (hS (f a) (mem_range_self a) hv))
  let F : A → Simplicial.Space (bounded G N) := fun a =>
    ⟨(f a).1,(f a).2.1,(f a).2.2.1,(f a).2.2.2,hN a⟩
  have hc : Continuous F :=
    (Simplicial.inclusion_closedEmbedding (bounded G N) (complex G)
      (fun _ h => bounded_le G N h)).isEmbedding.continuous_iff.mpr f.continuous
  exact ⟨N,⟨F,hc⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.compactMap_nullhomotopic
statement:
lemma compactMap_nullhomotopic {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CompactSpace A]
    (g : G) (f : C(A,Space G)) : ∃ y, Nonempty (f.Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,F,hF⟩ := compactMap_bounded f
  exact ⟨vertex (N,g),⟨((boundedContraction N g).compContinuousMap F).cast hF rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.sphereFillable
statement: lemma sphereFillable (g : G) : Cellular.SphereFillable (Space G)
proof:
:= by
  intro n f
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨ContinuousMap.const _ (vertex (0,g)),?_⟩
    intro x
    have hx : False := by
      have he := x.2
      simp only [Metric.mem_sphere,Subsingleton.elim x.1 0,dist_self] at he
      exact zero_ne_one he
    exact hx.elim
  | succ n =>
    let := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty n
    obtain ⟨y,⟨H⟩⟩ := compactMap_nullhomotopic g f
    obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := SphereTopology.extends_of_nullhomotopic H.symm
    exact ⟨F,fun x => ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.contractible
statement: lemma contractible [Nonempty G] : ContractibleSpace (Space G)
proof:
:= by
  let g : G := Classical.choice ‹Nonempty G›
  let : Nonempty (Space G) := ⟨vertex (0,g)⟩
  exact Cellular.contractible_of_sphereFillable (sphereFillable g)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_one
statement: lemma translate_one (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : translate 1 s = s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [translate,one_mul,Prod.mk.eta,Finset.image_id']

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_mul
statement: lemma translate_mul (g h : G) (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) : translate g (translate h s) = translate (g*h) s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [translate,Finset.image_image,Function.comp_def,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_mono
statement: lemma translate_mono (g : G) {s t : Finset (ℕ × G)} (h : s ⊆ t) : translate g s ⊆ translate g t
proof:
:=
  Finset.image_subset_image h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_valid
statement: lemma translate_valid (g : G) {s : Finset (ℕ × G)} (hs : s ∈ complex G) : translate g s ∈ complex G
proof:
:=
  map_face (g * ·) id Function.injective_id ⟨s,hs⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_le
statement: lemma orbitSpan_le (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) : orbitSpan S ≤ complex G
proof: := fun _ h => h.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_mono
statement: lemma orbitSpan_mono {S T : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))} (h : S ⊆ T) : orbitSpan S ≤ orbitSpan T
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨g,s,hs,hts⟩ := ht.2
  exact ⟨ht.1,g,s,h hs,hts⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_contains
statement:
lemma orbitSpan_contains (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) {t : Finset (ℕ × G)}
    (ht : t ∈ complex G) (h : ∃ s ∈ S, t ⊆ s) : t ∈ orbitSpan S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hts⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ht,1,s,hs,by rwa [translate_one]⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_invariant
statement:
lemma orbitSpan_invariant (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) (g : G)
    {t : Finset (ℕ × G)} (ht : t ∈ orbitSpan S) : translate g t ∈ orbitSpan S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h,s,hs,hts⟩ := ht.2
  exact ⟨translate_valid g ht.1,g*h,s,hs,by rw [←translate_mul]; exact translate_mono g hts⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_bounded
statement:
lemma orbitSpan_bounded (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) :
    orbitSpan S ≤ bounded G ((S.biUnion id).sup Prod.fst + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  refine ⟨ht.1,?_⟩
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨g,s,hs,hts⟩ := ht.2
  obtain ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hts hv)
  have hh : w.1 ≤ (S.biUnion id).sup Prod.fst := Finset.le_sup (f := Prod.fst) (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s,hs,hw⟩)
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.controlled_orbitSpan
statement: lemma controlled_orbitSpan (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) : Controlled (orbitSpan S)
proof: := ⟨S,le_rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.controlled_bounded
statement:
lemma controlled_bounded {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (ℕ × G)} (hK : Controlled K) :
    ∃ N, K ≤ bounded G N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := hK
  exact ⟨_,hS.trans (orbitSpan_bounded S)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbitSpan_finite_representatives
statement:
lemma orbitSpan_finite_representatives (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G)), ∀ t ∈ orbitSpan S, ∃ s ∈ T, ∃ g : G, t = translate g s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨S.biUnion Finset.powerset,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  obtain ⟨g,s,hs,hts⟩ := ht.2
  have hh : translate g⁻¹ t ⊆ s := by
    have hh := translate_mono g⁻¹ hts
    simpa only [translate_mul,inv_mul_cancel,translate_one] using hh
  refine ⟨translate g⁻¹ t,Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s,hs,Finset.mem_powerset.mpr hh⟩,g,?_⟩
  rw [translate_mul,mul_inv_cancel,translate_one]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.faceImage_translate
statement:
lemma faceImage_translate (φ : G →* H) (α : ℕ → ℕ) (a : G) (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) :
    faceImage φ α (translate a s) = translate (φ a) (faceImage φ α s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [faceImage,translate,Finset.image_image,vertexMap,Function.comp_def,map_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.faceImage_valid
statement:
lemma faceImage_valid (φ : G →* H) (α : ℕ → ℕ) (hα : Function.Injective α)
    {s : Finset (ℕ × G)} (hs : s ∈ complex G) : faceImage φ α s ∈ complex H
proof:
:=
  map_face φ α hα ⟨s,hs⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.faceImage_controlled
statement:
lemma faceImage_controlled (φ : G →* H) (α : ℕ → ℕ) (hα : Function.Injective α)
    (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    faceImage φ α s.1 ∈ orbitSpan (imageShapes φ α S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,t,ht,hst⟩ := s.2.2
  refine ⟨faceImage_valid φ α hα s.2.1,φ a,faceImage φ α t,
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  rw [← faceImage_translate]
  exact Finset.image_subset_image hst

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.unionFace_valid
statement:
lemma unionFace_valid (φ : G →* H) (α β : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    {s : Finset (ℕ × G)} (hs : s ∈ complex G)
    (hc : ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, α v.1 = β w.1 → v.1 = w.1) :
    faceImage φ α s ∪ faceImage φ β s ∈ complex H
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(faceImage_valid φ α hα hs).1.mono Finset.subset_union_left,?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy hxy
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx <;> rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
  · exact (faceImage_valid φ α hα hs).2 hx hy hxy
  · obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    have hvw : v = w := hs.2 hv hw (hc v hv w hw hxy)
    subst w
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hxy
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    have hvw : w = v := hs.2 hw hv (hc w hw v hv hxy.symm)
    subst w
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact hxy
    · rfl
  · exact (faceImage_valid φ β hβ hs).2 hx hy hxy

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.translate_union
statement: lemma translate_union (a : H) (s t : Finset (ℕ × H)) : translate a (s ∪ t) = translate a s ∪ translate a t
proof:
:=
  Finset.image_union _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.unionFace_controlled
statement:
lemma unionFace_controlled (φ : G →* H) (α β : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hα : Function.Injective α) (hβ : Function.Injective β)
    (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) (s : Face (orbitSpan S))
    (hc : ∀ v ∈ s.1, ∀ w ∈ s.1, α v.1 = β w.1 → v.1 = w.1) :
    faceImage φ α s.1 ∪ faceImage φ β s.1 ∈ orbitSpan (unionShapes φ α β S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,t,ht,hst⟩ := s.2.2
  refine ⟨unionFace_valid φ α β hα hβ s.2.1 hc,φ a,faceImage φ α t ∪ faceImage φ β t,
    Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  rw [translate_union,←faceImage_translate,←faceImage_translate]
  exact Finset.union_subset_union (Finset.image_subset_image hst) (Finset.image_subset_image hst)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.fresh_zero
statement: lemma fresh_zero (N : ℕ) : fresh N 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [fresh]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.fresh_injective
statement: lemma fresh_injective (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (fresh N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  unfold fresh at h
  split_ifs at h with hi hj hj
  · exact hi.trans hj.symm
  · exfalso; omega
  · exfalso; omega
  · omega

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.fresh_cross
statement:
lemma fresh_cross (N : ℕ) (α : ℕ → ℕ) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hzero : α 0 = 0)
    {i j : ℕ} (hi : α i < N) (h : α i = fresh N j) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    apply hα
    simpa only [fresh_zero,hzero] using h
  · have hh : N ≤ fresh N j := by simp only [fresh,ite_eq_right hj]; exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
    omega

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.orbit_below_bound
statement:
lemma orbit_below_bound (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) (α : ℕ → ℕ)
    (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) {v : ℕ × G} (hv : v ∈ s.1) : α v.1 < shapeBound S α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,t,ht,hst⟩ := s.2.2
  obtain ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp (hst hv)
  have hh : α w.1 ≤ (S.biUnion id).sup (fun v => α v.1) :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : ℕ × G => α v.1) (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t,ht,hw⟩)
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerLeftValid
statement:
lemma relayerLeftValid (φ : G →* H) (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G)))
    (α β : ℕ → ℕ) (hα : Function.Injective α) (hα0 : α 0 = 0) (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    faceImage φ α s.1 ∪ faceImage φ (relayerFresh S α β) s.1 ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply orbitSpan_mono Finset.subset_union_left
  apply unionFace_controlled φ α (relayerFresh S α β) hα (fresh_injective _) S s
  intro v hv w _ h
  exact fresh_cross _ α hα hα0 ((orbit_below_bound S α s hv).trans_le (le_max_left _ _)) h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerRightValid
statement:
lemma relayerRightValid (φ : G →* H) (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G)))
    (α β : ℕ → ℕ) (hβ : Function.Injective β) (hβ0 : β 0 = 0) (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    faceImage φ β s.1 ∪ faceImage φ (relayerFresh S α β) s.1 ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)
proof:
:= by
  apply orbitSpan_mono Finset.subset_union_right
  apply unionFace_controlled φ β (relayerFresh S α β) hβ (fresh_injective _) S s
  intro v hv w _ h
  exact fresh_cross _ β hβ hβ0 ((orbit_below_bound S β s hv).trans_le (le_max_right _ _)) h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerLeftMapValid
statement:
lemma relayerLeftMapValid (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    s.1.image (vertexMap φ α) ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)
proof:
:=
  (orbitSpan _).isRelLowerSet_faces.mem_of_le (relayerLeftValid φ S α β hα hα0 s)
    Finset.subset_union_left (s.2.1.1.image _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerRightMapValid
statement:
lemma relayerRightMapValid (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    s.1.image (vertexMap φ β) ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)
proof:
:=
  (orbitSpan _).isRelLowerSet_faces.mem_of_le (relayerRightValid φ S α β hβ hβ0 s)
    Finset.subset_union_left (s.2.1.1.image _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerFreshMapValid
statement:
lemma relayerFreshMapValid (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) :
    s.1.image (vertexMap φ (relayerFresh S α β)) ∈ orbitSpan (relayerTarget φ S α β)
proof:
:=
  (orbitSpan _).isRelLowerSet_faces.mem_of_le (relayerLeftValid φ S α β hα hα0 s)
    Finset.subset_union_right (s.2.1.1.image _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerLeftPure
statement:
lemma relayerLeftPure (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G) (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) :
    relayerLeftMap φ S α β hα hα0 x = relayerFreshMap φ S α β hα hα0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change x.1.mapDomain (vertexMap φ α) = x.1.mapDomain (vertexMap φ (relayerFresh S α β))
  rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  congr 1
  exact Prod.ext (hα0.trans (fresh_zero (max (shapeBound S α) (shapeBound S β))).symm) rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerRightPure
statement:
lemma relayerRightPure (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G) (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) :
    relayerRightMap φ S α β hβ hβ0 x = relayerFreshMap φ S α β hα hα0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change x.1.mapDomain (vertexMap φ β) = x.1.mapDomain (vertexMap φ (relayerFresh S α β))
  rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  congr 1
  exact Prod.ext (hβ0.trans (fresh_zero (max (shapeBound S α) (shapeBound S β))).symm) rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerLeftHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma relayerLeftHomotopy_fixed (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G)
    (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) (t : I) :
    relayerLeftHomotopy φ S α β hα hα0 (t,x) = relayerLeftMap φ S α β hα hα0 x
proof:
:=
  straightHomotopy_fixed _ _ _ _ _ _ (relayerLeftValid φ S α β hα hα0) x
    (relayerLeftPure φ S α β hα hα0 x g hx) t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerRightHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma relayerRightHomotopy_fixed (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G)
    (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) (t : I) :
    relayerRightHomotopy φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 (t,x) = relayerRightMap φ S α β hβ hβ0 x
proof:
:=
  straightHomotopy_fixed _ _ _ _ _ _ (relayerRightValid φ S α β hβ hβ0) x
    (relayerRightPure φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 x g hx) t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerHomotopy_fixed
statement:
theorem relayerHomotopy_fixed (x : Simplicial.Space (orbitSpan S)) (g : G)
    (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single (0,g) 1) (t : I) :
    relayerHomotopy φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 (t,x) = relayerLeftMap φ S α β hα hα0 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [relayerHomotopy,ContinuousMap.Homotopy.trans_apply]
  split
  · exact relayerLeftHomotopy_fixed φ S α β hα hα0 x g hx _
  · rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.symm_apply]
    exact (relayerRightHomotopy_fixed φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 x g hx _).trans
      ((relayerRightPure φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 x g hx).trans
        (relayerLeftPure φ S α β hα hα0 x g hx).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.restrict_le
statement: lemma restrict_le (S : Finset V) : restrict K S ≤ K
proof: := fun _ h => h.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.compactMap_finiteRestriction
statement:
lemma compactMap_finiteRestriction {A : Type v} [TopologicalSpace A] [CompactSpace A] (f : C(A,Space K)) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, ∃ F : C(A,Space (restrict K S)), (restrictInclusion K S).comp F = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS⟩ := compact_bounded_vertices K (isCompact_range f.continuous)
  let F : A → Space (restrict K S) := fun a =>
    ⟨(f a).1,(f a).2.1,(f a).2.2.1,(f a).2.2.2,hS (f a) (mem_range_self a)⟩
  have hc : Continuous F := (inclusion_closedEmbedding (restrict K S) K
    (fun _ h => restrict_le K S h)).isEmbedding.continuous_iff.mpr f.continuous
  exact ⟨S,⟨F,hc⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.value_eq_of_le
statement:
lemma value_eq_of_le (S T : Shapes G) (h : S ⊆ T) (f : StageValues G N A S) :
    value G N A S f = value G N A T ((stageHom G N S T h).comp f)
proof: := DirectLimit.eq_of_le ⟨S,f⟩ T h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.value_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma value_eq_one_iff (S : Shapes G) (f : StageValues G N A S) :
    value G N A S f = 1 ↔ ∃ T, ∃ h : S ⊆ T, (stageHom G N S T h).comp f = 1
proof:
:=
  DirectLimit.exists_eq_one (f := valueHom G N A) ⟨S,f⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.value_mul
statement:
lemma value_mul (S : Shapes G) (f g : StageValues G N A S) :
    value G N A S (f*g) = value G N A S f * value G N A S g
proof:
:=
  (DirectLimit.mul_def (f := valueHom G N A) S f g).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageMap_point
statement: lemma stageMap_point (hα : α 0 = 0) : stageMap φ α S T hv (stagePoint G S) = stagePoint H T
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (Finsupp.single (0,(1:G)) (1:ℝ)).mapDomain (vertexMap φ α) = Finsupp.single (0,1) 1
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  congr 1
  exact Prod.ext hα φ.map_one

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageMapValue_congrTarget
statement:
lemma stageMapValue_congrTarget (U : Shapes H)
    (hu : ∀ s : Face (stage G S), faceImage φ α s.1 ∈ stage H U) :
    stageMapValue N φ α S T hv hα = stageMapValue N φ α S U hu hα
proof:
:= by
  apply Quotient.sound
  refine ⟨T ∪ U,Finset.subset_union_left,Finset.subset_union_right,?_⟩
  apply MonoidHom.ext
  intro a
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h p =>
  apply congrArg Quotient.mk'
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext z
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stageMapValue_eq_of_homotopy
statement:
lemma stageMapValue_eq_of_homotopy (ψ : G →* H) (β : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hw : ∀ s : Face (stage G S), faceImage ψ β s.1 ∈ stage H T) (hβ : β 0 = 0)
    (F : (stageMap φ α S T hv).Homotopy (stageMap ψ β S T hw))
    (hF : ∀ t, F (t,stagePoint G S) = stagePoint H T) :
    stageMapValue N φ α S T hv hα = stageMapValue N ψ β S T hw hβ
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg (value H N _ T)
  ext a
  exact HomotopyFunctor.map_eq_of_homotopy _ _ _ _ F hF a

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.image_stage_valid
statement:
lemma image_stage_valid (hαi : Function.Injective α) (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage φ α s.1 ∈ stage H (imageShapes φ α (basedShapes G S))
proof:
:=
  orbitSpan_mono (Finset.subset_insert _ _) (faceImage_controlled φ α hαi (basedShapes G S) s)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.mapValue_eq
statement:
lemma mapValue_eq (hαi : Function.Injective α) :
    mapValue N φ α S hα hαi = stageMapValue N φ α S T hv hα
proof:
:=
  stageMapValue_congrTarget N φ α S _ _ hα T hv

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerStageLeftValid
statement:
lemma relayerStageLeftValid (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage φ α s.1 ∈ stage H (relayerTarget φ (basedShapes G S) α β)
proof:
:=
  orbitSpan_mono (Finset.subset_insert _ _) (relayerLeftMapValid φ (basedShapes G S) α β hα hα0 s)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerStageRightValid
statement:
lemma relayerStageRightValid (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage φ β s.1 ∈ stage H (relayerTarget φ (basedShapes G S) α β)
proof:
:=
  orbitSpan_mono (Finset.subset_insert _ _) (relayerRightMapValid φ (basedShapes G S) α β hβ hβ0 s)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.relayerStageHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma relayerStageHomotopy_fixed (t : I) :
    relayerStageHomotopy φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 (t,stagePoint G S) =
      stagePoint H (relayerTarget φ (basedShapes G S) α β)
proof:
:= by
  change relayerToStage φ S α β (relayerHomotopy φ (basedShapes G S) α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 (t,stagePoint G S)) = _
  rw [relayerHomotopy_fixed φ (basedShapes G S) α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0 (stagePoint G S) 1 rfl]
  exact stageMap_point φ α S _ (relayerStageLeftValid φ S α β hα hα0) hα0

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.mapValue_relayer
statement: lemma mapValue_relayer : mapValue N φ α S hα0 hα = mapValue N φ β S hβ0 hβ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapValue_eq N φ α S _ (relayerStageLeftValid φ S α β hα hα0) hα0 hα,
    mapValue_eq N φ β S _ (relayerStageRightValid φ S α β hβ hβ0) hβ0 hβ]
  exact stageMapValue_eq_of_homotopy N φ α S _ _ hα0 φ β _ hβ0
    (relayerStageHomotopy φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0) (relayerStageHomotopy_fixed φ S α β hα hβ hα0 hβ0)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.loop_finite_restriction
statement:
lemma loop_finite_restriction (p : GenLoop N (Space K) x) :
    ∃ S : Finset V, ∃ y : Space (restrict K S),
      ∃ hy : restrictInclusion K S y = x,
      ∃ q : GenLoop N (Space (restrict K S)) y,
        HomotopyFunctor.loopMap (restrictInclusion K S) hy q = p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,F,hF⟩ := compactMap_finiteRestriction K p.1
  let z : N → unitInterval := fun _ => 0
  have hz : z ∈ Cube.boundary N := ⟨Classical.arbitrary N,Or.inl rfl⟩
  have hy : restrictInclusion K S (F z) = x :=
    (ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF z).trans (GenLoop.boundary p z hz)
  let q : GenLoop N (Space (restrict K S)) (F z) := ⟨F,by
    intro t ht
    apply inclusion_injective (restrict K S) K (fun _ h => restrict_le K S h)
    exact (ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF t).trans ((GenLoop.boundary p t ht).trans hy.symm)⟩
  refine ⟨S,F z,hy,q,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hF

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_apply
statement: lemma tensor_apply (x : V →₀ ℝ) (y : W →₀ ℝ) (p : V × W) : tensor x y p = x p.1*y p.2
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_support
statement:
lemma tensor_support (x : V →₀ ℝ) (y : W →₀ ℝ) :
    (tensor x y).support = x.support ×ˢ y.support
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [Finsupp.mem_support_iff,tensor_apply,Finset.mem_product,mul_ne_zero_iff]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_sum
statement:
lemma tensor_sum (x : V →₀ ℝ) (y : W →₀ ℝ) :
    (tensor x y).sum (fun _ r => r) = x.sum (fun _ r => r)*y.sum (fun _ r => r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.sum,tensor_support,Finset.sum_product]
  simp only [tensor_apply,Finsupp.sum,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pairMap_support
statement:
lemma pairMap_support (x : Space K) (y : Space L) :
    (pairMap K L M p hp x y).1.support ⊆ (x.1.support ×ˢ y.1.support).image p
proof:
:= by
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_support.trans (by rw [tensor_support])

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_pairMap_faces
statement:
lemma continuous_pairMap_faces (s : Face K) (t : Face L) :
    Continuous (fun q : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 × SimplexDisk.Simplex t.1 =>
      pairMap K L M p hp (faceMap K s q.1) (faceMap L t q.2))
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_of_support_subset M _ ⟨(s.1 ×ˢ t.1).image p,hp s t⟩
  · intro q
    exact (pairMap_support K L M p hp _ _).trans
      (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.product_subset_product (weight_support_subset _ _) (weight_support_subset _ _)))
  · intro b
    have he : (fun q : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 × SimplexDisk.Simplex t.1 =>
        (pairMap K L M p hp (faceMap K s q.1) (faceMap L t q.2)).1 b) =
        fun q => ∑ a : s.1, ∑ c : t.1, if p (a.1,c.1) = b then q.1.1 a * q.2.1 c else 0 := by
      funext q
      change ((tensor (weight s.1 q.1) (weight t.1 q.2)).mapDomain p) b = _
      rw [push_apply p _ (s.1 ×ˢ t.1) (by rw [tensor_support]; exact Finset.product_subset_product (weight_support_subset _ _) (weight_support_subset _ _)),Finset.sum_product]
      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      rw [← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro c _
      simp only [tensor_apply,weight_apply]
    rw [he]
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro a _
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro c _
    split_ifs
    · exact (((continuous_apply a).comp continuous_subtype_val).comp continuous_fst).mul
        (((continuous_apply c).comp continuous_subtype_val).comp continuous_snd)
    · exact continuous_const

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_prod_faces_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_prod_faces_iff [Finite (Face K)] {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (f : Space K × Space L → Y) : Continuous f ↔
    ∀ s : Face K, ∀ t : Face L, Continuous (fun q : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 × SimplexDisk.Simplex t.1 =>
      f (faceMap K s q.1,faceMap L t q.2))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf s t
    exact hf.comp (((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_fst).prodMk ((continuous_faceMap L t).comp continuous_snd))
  · intro hf
    rw [continuous_prod_iff]
    intro t
    have hc : Continuous (fun q : SimplexDisk.Simplex t.1 × Space K => f (q.2,faceMap L t q.1)) := by
      rw [continuous_prod_iff]
      intro s
      exact (hf s t).comp continuous_swap
    exact hc.comp continuous_swap

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_pairMap
statement: lemma continuous_pairMap [Finite (Face K)] : Continuous (fun q : Space K × Space L => pairMap K L M p hp q.1 q.2)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_prod_faces_iff K L _).mpr (continuous_pairMap_faces K L M p hp)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_carrierBlend
statement: lemma continuous_carrierBlend : Continuous (fun p : I × Space K => carrierBlend K L f g c hf hg p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_prod_iff]
  intro s
  apply continuous_of_support_subset L _ (c s)
  · intro p
    exact (blend_support _ _ p.1).trans (Finset.union_subset
      (hf s _ (weight_support_subset _ _)) (hg s _ (weight_support_subset _ _)))
  · intro b
    change Continuous (fun p : I × SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 =>
      (1-(p.1:ℝ)) * (f (faceMap K s p.2)).1 b + (p.1:ℝ) * (g (faceMap K s p.2)).1 b)
    exact ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      ((continuous_eval L b).comp (f.continuous.comp ((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_snd)))).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).mul
        ((continuous_eval L b).comp (g.continuous.comp ((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_snd))))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.carrierHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma carrierHomotopy_fixed (x : Space K) (h : f x = g x) (t : I) :
    carrierHomotopy K L f g c hf hg (t,x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (1-(t:ℝ)) • (f x).1 + (t:ℝ) • (g x).1 = (f x).1
  rw [←h,←add_smul,sub_add_cancel,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_single
statement:
lemma tensor_single (v : V) (w : W) (a b : ℝ) :
    tensor (Finsupp.single v a) (Finsupp.single w b) = Finsupp.single (v,w) (a*b)
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp only [tensor_apply,Finsupp.single_apply]
  by_cases hv : v = p.1 <;> by_cases hw : w = p.2
  · have h : (v,w) = p := Prod.ext hv hw
    simp only [ite_eq_left hv,ite_eq_left hw,ite_eq_left h]
  · have h : (v,w) ≠ p := fun h => hw (congrArg Prod.snd h)
    simp only [ite_eq_left hv,ite_eq_right hw,ite_eq_right h,mul_zero]
  · have h : (v,w) ≠ p := fun h => hv (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    simp only [ite_eq_right hv,ite_eq_left hw,ite_eq_right h,zero_mul]
  · have h : (v,w) ≠ p := fun h => hv (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    simp only [ite_eq_right hv,ite_eq_right hw,ite_eq_right h,zero_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.diagonal_face
statement: lemma diagonal_face (s : Face K) : s.1.image (fun v => p (v,v)) ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  apply L.isRelLowerSet_faces.mem_of_le (hp s s) _ ((K.isRelLowerSet_faces s.2).1.image _)
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(v,v),Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv,hv⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.productDiagonal_carried
statement:
lemma productDiagonal_carried (s : Face K) (x : Space K) (hx : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) :
    (productDiagonal K L p hp x).1.support ⊆ (diagonalCarrier K L p hp s).1
proof:
:=
  (pairMap_support K K L p hp x x).trans (Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.product_subset_product hx hx))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.vertexDiagonal_carried
statement:
lemma vertexDiagonal_carried (s : Face K) (x : Space K) (hx : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) :
    (vertexDiagonal K L p hp x).1.support ⊆ (diagonalCarrier K L p hp s).1
proof:
:= by
  apply (map_support K L (fun v => p (v,v)) (diagonal_face K L p hp) x).trans
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨v,hv,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(v,v),Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hx hv,hx hv⟩,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pairMap_pure
statement:
lemma pairMap_pure {M : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (q : V × V → W)
    (hq : ∀ s : Face K, ∀ t : Face M, (s.1 ×ˢ t.1).image q ∈ L)
    (x : Space K) (y : Space M) (v w : V)
    (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single v 1) (hy : y.1 = Finsupp.single w 1) :
    (pairMap K M L q hq x y).1 = Finsupp.single (q (v,w)) 1
proof:
:= by
  change (tensor x.1 y.1).mapDomain q = _
  rw [hx,hy,tensor_single,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,one_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.diagonalHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma diagonalHomotopy_fixed (x : Space K) (v : V) (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single v 1) (t : I) :
    diagonalHomotopy K L p hp (t,x) = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x
proof:
:= by
  have h : productDiagonal K L p hp x = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [show (productDiagonal K L p hp x).1 = Finsupp.single (p (v,v)) 1 from
      pairMap_pure K L p hp x x v v hx hx]
    change Finsupp.single (p (v,v)) 1 = x.1.mapDomain (fun v => p (v,v))
    rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  exact (carrierHomotopy_fixed K L _ _ _ _ _ x h t).trans h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_single_right_push
statement:
lemma tensor_single_right_push (x : V →₀ ℝ) (w : W) (p : V × W → U) :
    (tensor x (Finsupp.single w 1)).mapDomain p = x.mapDomain (fun v => p (v,w))
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [push_apply p _ (x.support ×ˢ {w}) (by
    rw [tensor_support]
    exact Finset.product_subset_product (Finset.Subset.refl _) Finsupp.support_single_subset)]
  rw [push_apply (fun v => p (v,w)) x x.support (Finset.Subset.refl _),Finset.sum_product]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  simp only [Finset.sum_singleton,tensor_apply,Finsupp.single_eq_same,mul_one]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.tensor_single_left_push
statement:
lemma tensor_single_left_push (v : V) (y : W →₀ ℝ) (p : V × W → U) :
    (tensor (Finsupp.single v 1) y).mapDomain p = y.mapDomain (fun w => p (v,w))
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [push_apply p _ ({v} ×ˢ y.support) (by
    rw [tensor_support]
    exact Finset.product_subset_product Finsupp.support_single_subset (Finset.Subset.refl _))]
  rw [push_apply (fun w => p (v,w)) y y.support (Finset.Subset.refl _),Finset.sum_product,Finset.sum_singleton]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro w _
  simp only [tensor_apply,Finsupp.single_eq_same,one_mul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.trans_cast
statement:
lemma trans_cast {x' y' z' : X} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y z) (hx : x' = x) (hy : y' = y) (hz : z' = z) :
    (p.cast hx hy).trans (q.cast hy hz) = (p.trans q).cast hx hz
proof:
:= by
  subst x'; subst y'; subst z'; simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.map_trans
statement:
lemma map_trans {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y z) (f : C(X,Y)) :
    (p.trans q).map f = (p.map f).trans (q.map f)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk p =>
  induction q using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk q =>
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (p.map_trans q f.continuous)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.map_refl
statement:
lemma map_refl {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (x : X) (f : C(X,Y)) :
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x).map f = Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.map_symm
statement:
lemma map_symm {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) (f : C(X,Y)) :
    p.symm.map f = (p.map f).symm
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk p =>
  exact congrArg Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (p.map_symm f.continuous)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.refl
statement: lemma refl (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) : Equal p p
proof: := ⟨rfl,rfl,HEq.rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.ofEq
statement: lemma ofEq {p q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y} (h : p = q) : Equal p q
proof: := ⟨rfl,rfl,heq_of_eq h⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.symm
statement:
lemma symm {x' y' : X} {p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y}
    {q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x' y'} (h : Equal p q) : Equal q p
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.source.symm,h.target.symm,h.path.symm⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.trans
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.source.trans k.source,h.target.trans k.target,h.path.trans k.path⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.map
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hx,hy,hp⟩
  subst x'; subst y'
  cases eq_of_heq hp
  exact .refl _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.Equal.comp
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp with ⟨hx,hy,hp⟩
  rcases hq with ⟨_,hz,hq⟩
  subst x'; subst y'; subst z'
  cases eq_of_heq hp; cases eq_of_heq hq
  exact .refl _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.cast_equal
statement:
lemma cast_equal {x' y' : X} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) (hx : x' = x) (hy : y' = y) :
    Equal (p.cast hx hy) p
proof: := ⟨hx,hy,Path.Homotopic.Quotient.cast_heq hx hy⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.Q.refl_equal
statement:
lemma refl_equal {x y : X} (h : x = y) :
    Equal (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x) (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl y)
proof:
:= by
  subst y
  exact .refl _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.map_one_equal
statement:
lemma map_one_equal {x y : X} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) :
    Q.Equal (p.map (smulMap (1 : G))) p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨one_smul G x,one_smul G y,?_⟩
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk p =>
  exact Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext (fun t => one_smul G (p t))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.map_mul_equal
statement:
lemma map_mul_equal {x y : X} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) (g h : G) :
    Q.Equal ((p.map (smulMap h)).map (smulMap g)) (p.map (smulMap (g*h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(mul_smul g h x).symm,(mul_smul g h y).symm,?_⟩
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk p =>
  exact Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext (fun t => (mul_smul g h (p t)).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {a b : Extension G x₀} (hg : a.1 = b.1) (hp : HEq a.2 b.2) : a = b
proof:
:=
  Sigma.ext hg hp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mul_path_equal
statement:
lemma mul_path_equal (a b : Extension G x₀) :
    Q.Equal (a*b).2 (a.2.trans (b.2.map (smulMap a.1)))
proof:
:=
  Q.cast_equal _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.one_path_equal
statement: lemma one_path_equal : Q.Equal (1 : Extension G x₀).2 (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x₀)
proof:
:= by
  change Q.Equal ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x₀).cast rfl (one_smul G x₀)) _
  exact Q.cast_equal _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mul_assoc
statement: lemma mul_assoc (a b c : Extension G x₀) : a*b*c = a*(b*c)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext (_root_.mul_assoc _ _ _)
  apply Q.Equal.path
  apply Q.Equal.trans (mul_path_equal (a*b) c)
  apply Q.Equal.trans (Q.Equal.comp (mul_path_equal a b) (map_mul_equal c.2 a.1 b.1).symm)
  apply Q.Equal.trans (Q.Equal.ofEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc _ _ _))
  apply Q.Equal.trans ?_ (mul_path_equal a (b*c)).symm
  apply Q.Equal.comp (Q.Equal.refl _)
  apply Q.Equal.trans ?_ ((mul_path_equal b c).map (smulMap a.1)).symm
  exact Q.Equal.ofEq (Q.map_trans _ _ _).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.one_mul
statement: lemma one_mul (a : Extension G x₀) : 1*a = a
proof:
:= by
  apply ext (_root_.one_mul _)
  apply Q.Equal.path
  exact (mul_path_equal 1 a).trans
    ((Q.Equal.comp one_path_equal (map_one_equal a.2)).trans
      (Q.Equal.ofEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans a.2)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mul_one
statement: lemma mul_one (a : Extension G x₀) : a*1 = a
proof:
:= by
  apply ext (_root_.mul_one _)
  apply Q.Equal.path
  apply Q.Equal.trans (mul_path_equal a 1)
  apply Q.Equal.trans (Q.Equal.comp (Q.Equal.refl _) (one_path_equal.map (smulMap a.1)))
  rw [Q.map_refl]
  exact Q.Equal.ofEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl a.2)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.inv_mul_cancel
statement: lemma inv_mul_cancel (a : Extension G x₀) : a⁻¹*a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext (_root_.inv_mul_cancel _)
  apply Q.Equal.path
  apply Q.Equal.trans (mul_path_equal a⁻¹ a)
  have hi : Q.Equal (a⁻¹).2 (a.2.map (smulMap a.1⁻¹)).symm := Q.cast_equal _ _ _
  exact (Q.Equal.comp hi (Q.Equal.refl _)).trans
    ((Q.Equal.ofEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans _)).trans
      ((Q.refl_equal (inv_smul_smul a.1 x₀)).trans one_path_equal.symm))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.natural_smul_equal
statement:
lemma natural_smul_equal {x y : X} (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y) (g : G) :
    Q.Equal ((p.map (smulMap g)).map f) ((p.map f).map (smulMap g))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hf g x,hf g y,?_⟩
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk p =>
  exact Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext (fun t => hf g (p t))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mapFun_equal
statement:
lemma mapFun_equal (a : Extension G x₀) :
    Q.Equal (mapFun f hf x₀ a).2 (a.2.map f)
proof: := Q.cast_equal _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mapFun_one
statement: lemma mapFun_one : mapFun f hf x₀ 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext rfl
  apply Q.Equal.path
  apply (mapFun_equal f hf x₀ 1).trans
  apply (one_path_equal.map f).trans
  rw [Q.map_refl]
  exact one_path_equal.symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.mapFun_mul
statement: lemma mapFun_mul (a b : Extension G x₀) : mapFun f hf x₀ (a*b) = mapFun f hf x₀ a * mapFun f hf x₀ b
proof:
:= by
  apply ext (a := mapFun f hf x₀ (a*b)) (b := mapFun f hf x₀ a * mapFun f hf x₀ b) (by rfl)
  apply Q.Equal.path
  apply (mapFun_equal f hf x₀ (a*b)).trans
  apply ((mul_path_equal a b).map f).trans
  apply (Q.Equal.ofEq (Q.map_trans _ _ _)).trans
  apply Q.Equal.trans ?_ (mul_path_equal (mapFun f hf x₀ a) (mapFun f hf x₀ b)).symm
  exact Q.Equal.comp (mapFun_equal f hf x₀ a).symm
    ((natural_smul_equal f hf b.2 a.1).trans
      ((mapFun_equal f hf x₀ b).map (smulMap a.1)).symm)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathExtension.projection_map
statement: lemma projection_map : projection.comp (map f hf x₀) = projection
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.smul_vertex
statement: lemma smul_vertex (g h : G) : g • vertex s h = vertex s (g*h)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.projection_wordLift
statement: lemma projection_wordLift : PathExtension.projection.comp (wordLift s) = FreeGroup.lift s
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,wordLift,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.wordLift_fst
statement: lemma wordLift_fst (w : FreeGroup S) : (wordLift s w).1 = FreeGroup.lift s w
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (projection_wordLift s) w

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.relatorLoop_eq
statement:
lemma relatorLoop_eq (r : rels) : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (relatorLoop s rels hrel r) =
    relatorClass s rels hrel r
proof:
:=
  (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective (relatorClass s rels hrel r)).choose_spec

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.relatorLoop_equal
statement:
lemma relatorLoop_equal (r : rels) :
    PathExtension.Q.Equal (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (relatorLoop s rels hrel r))
      (wordLift s r.1).2
proof:
:=
  (PathExtension.Q.Equal.ofEq (relatorLoop_eq s rels hrel r)).trans (PathExtension.Q.cast_equal _ _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationBase_smul
statement:
lemma presentationBase_smul (g : G) (x : Graph s) :
    presentationBase s rels hrel (g • x) = g • presentationBase s rels hrel x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.mapped_relator_homotopic
statement:
lemma mapped_relator_homotopic (r : rels) :
    ((relatorLoop s rels hrel r).map (presentationBase s rels hrel).continuous).Homotopic
      (Path.refl (presentationBase s rels hrel (vertex s 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply LoopSphere.homotopic_map_of_fill _ _ (cell _ ((1:G),r))
  intro z
  change cell (equivariantFamily (G := G) (relatorAttaching s rels hrel)) ((1:G),r)
    (Attachment.boundary 2 z) = _
  refine (cell_boundary (equivariantFamily (G := G) (relatorAttaching s rels hrel))
    (1,r) z).trans ?_
  change base _ ((1 : G) • relatorAttaching s rels hrel r z) = _
  rw [one_smul]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.coverWordLift_relator
statement: lemma coverWordLift_relator (r : rels) : coverWordLift s rels hrel r.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply PathExtension.ext (a := coverWordLift s rels hrel r.1) (b := 1)
    ((wordLift_fst s r.1).trans (hrel r.1 r.2))
  apply PathExtension.Q.Equal.path
  apply (PathExtension.mapFun_equal (presentationBase s rels hrel)
    (presentationBase_smul s rels hrel) (vertex s 1) (wordLift s r.1)).trans
  apply ((relatorLoop_equal s rels hrel r).map (presentationBase s rels hrel)).symm.trans
  apply (PathExtension.Q.Equal.ofEq (Quotient.sound (mapped_relator_homotopic s rels hrel r))).trans
  exact PathExtension.one_path_equal.symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.coverWordLift_ker
statement:
lemma coverWordLift_ker (hker : (FreeGroup.lift s).ker = Subgroup.normalClosure rels) :
    (FreeGroup.lift s).ker ≤ (coverWordLift s rels hrel).ker
proof:
:= by
  rw [hker]
  apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
  intro r hr
  exact coverWordLift_relator s rels hrel ⟨r,hr⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationSection_lift
statement:
lemma presentationSection_lift (hs : Function.Surjective (FreeGroup.lift s))
    (hker : (FreeGroup.lift s).ker = Subgroup.normalClosure rels) (w : FreeGroup S) :
    presentationSection s rels hrel hs hker (FreeGroup.lift s w) = coverWordLift s rels hrel w
proof:
:=
  MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply ..

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationSection_fst
statement:
lemma presentationSection_fst (hs : Function.Surjective (FreeGroup.lift s))
    (hker : (FreeGroup.lift s).ker = Subgroup.normalClosure rels) (g : G) :
    (presentationSection s rels hrel hs hker g).1 = g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := hs g
  rw [presentationSection_lift]
  exact wordLift_fst s w

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.vertex_action
statement: lemma vertex_action (g : G) : f (vertex s g) = g • f (vertex s 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf,smul_vertex,_root_.mul_one]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.pathGenerator_equal
statement: lemma pathGenerator_equal (i : S) : Q.Equal (pathGenerator s i).2 (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (edge s 1 i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [smul_vertex]; simp only [_root_.one_mul,_root_.mul_one]; rfl
  · exact Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext (fun _ => rfl)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.edge_smul_equal
statement:
lemma edge_smul_equal (g : G) (i : S) :
    Q.Equal (((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (edge s 1 i)).map f).map (smulMap g))
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk ((edge s g i).map f.continuous))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(vertex_action s f hf g).symm,?_,?_⟩
  · change g • f (vertex s (1*s i)) = f (vertex s (g*s i))
    rw [←hf,smul_vertex,_root_.one_mul]
  · apply Path.Homotopic.hpath_hext
    intro t
    change g • f (cell _ ((1:G),i) (edgeParam t)) = f (cell _ (g,i) (edgeParam t))
    refine (hf g _).symm.trans (congrArg f ?_)
    refine (smul_cell _ (equivariantFamily_smul (attaching s)) g (1,i) _).trans ?_
    exact congrArg (fun first : G => cell _ (first,i) (edgeParam t)) (_root_.mul_one g)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.coherentPath_equal
statement: lemma coherentPath_equal (g : G) : Q.Equal (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (coherentPath s f hf τ hτ g)) (τ g).2
proof:
:=
  (Q.Equal.ofEq (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective (coherentClass s f hf τ hτ g)).choose_spec).trans
    (Q.cast_equal _ _ _)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.coherentPath_edge
statement:
lemma coherentPath_edge (g : G) (i : S) :
    ((coherentPath s f hf τ hτ g).trans ((edge s g i).map f.continuous)).Homotopic
      (coherentPath s f hf τ hτ (g*s i))
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.Homotopic.Quotient.exact
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (coherentPath s f hf τ hτ g)).trans
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk ((edge s g i).map f.continuous)) = _
  apply eq_of_heq
  apply Q.Equal.path
  have he : Q.Equal ((τ (s i)).2.map (smulMap (τ g).1))
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk ((edge s g i).map f.continuous)) := by
    apply ((hgen i).map (smulMap (τ g).1)).trans
    rw [hτ]
    exact edge_smul_equal s f hf g i
  apply (Q.Equal.comp (coherentPath_equal s f hf τ hτ g) he.symm).trans
  apply (mul_path_equal (τ g) (τ (s i))).symm.trans
  have hm : Q.Equal (τ g * τ (s i)).2 (τ (g*s i)).2 := by
    rw [←τ.map_mul]
    exact .refl _
  exact hm.trans (coherentPath_equal s f hf τ hτ (g*s i)).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cayley.presentationSection_generator
statement:
lemma presentationSection_generator (i : S) :
    Q.Equal (presentationSection s rels hrel hs hker (s i)).2
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk ((edge s 1 i).map (presentationBase s rels hrel).continuous))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : presentationSection s rels hrel hs hker (s i) =
      PathExtension.map (presentationBase s rels hrel) (presentationBase_smul s rels hrel) (vertex s 1)
        (pathGenerator s i) := by
    simpa only [FreeGroup.lift_apply_of,coverWordLift,MonoidHom.comp_apply,wordLift]
      using presentationSection_lift s rels hrel hs hker (FreeGroup.of i)
  rw [hh]
  exact (PathExtension.mapFun_equal (presentationBase s rels hrel) (presentationBase_smul s rels hrel) (vertex s 1) (pathGenerator s i)).trans
    ((pathGenerator_equal s i).map (presentationBase s rels hrel))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.exists_equivariant_extension
statement:
lemma exists_equivariant_extension (f : C(X,Y))
    (hf : ∀ (g : G) x, f (g • x) = g • f x) (hY : Cellular.SphereFillable Y) :
    ∃ F : C(Space (equivariantFamily (G := G) a),Y),
      (∀ x, F (base _ x) = f x) ∧ (∀ (g : G) x, F (g • x) = g • F x)
proof:
:= by
  choose e he using fun i => hY n (f.comp (a i))
  let b : FreeIndex G ι → C(Disk n,Y) := fun i =>
    ⟨fun d => i.1 • e i.2 d,(continuous_const_smul i.1).comp (e i.2).continuous⟩
  have hb (i : FreeIndex G ι) (x : Sphere n) :
      b i (boundary n x) = f (equivariantFamily a i x) := by
    change i.1 • e i.2 (Cellular.boundary n x) = f (i.1 • a i.2 x)
    rw [he,hf]
    rfl
  refine ⟨lift _ f b hb,fun _ => rfl,?_⟩
  intro g x
  cases x with
  | inl x => exact hf g x
  | inr p => exact (mul_smul g p.1.1 (e p.1.2 (interior n p.2)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Attachment.compactFundamentalSet
statement:
lemma compactFundamentalSet [Finite ι] (hX : Milnor.CompactFundamentalSet G (X := X)) :
    Milnor.CompactFundamentalSet G (X := Space (equivariantFamily (G := G) a))
proof:
:= by
  let b := equivariantFamily (G := G) a
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcov⟩ := hX
  let L : Set (Space b) := (base b '' K) ∪ ⋃ i : ι, Set.range (cell b ((1:G),i))
  refine ⟨L,(hK.image (continuous_base b)).union (isCompact_iUnion (fun i =>
    isCompact_range (cell b ((1:G),i)).continuous)),?_⟩
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl x =>
    obtain ⟨g,y,hy,rfl⟩ := hcov x
    exact ⟨g,base b y,Or.inl ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  | inr p =>
    refine ⟨p.1.1,cell b ((1:G),p.1.2) (interior n p.2),?_,?_⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p.1.2,Set.mem_range_self _⟩)
    · refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun point : Space b => p.1.1 • point)
        (cell_interior b (1,p.1.2) p.2)).symm
      exact congrArg (fun first : G => openCell b (first,p.1.2) p.2)
        (mul_one p.1.1).symm

name: OAI.Higman.commute_of_free_generators
statement:
lemma commute_of_free_generators {ι : Type u} {κ : Type v}
    {G : Type w} {H : Type x} {K : Type*} [Group G] [Group H] [Group K]
    (p : FreeGroup ι →* G) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (q : FreeGroup κ →* H) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (f : G →* K) (g : H →* K)
    (hc : ∀ i j, Commute (f (p (FreeGroup.of i))) (g (q (FreeGroup.of j)))) :
    ∀ a b, Commute (f a) (g b)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := hp a
  obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := hq b
  have hgen (i : ι) (b : FreeGroup κ) :
      Commute (f (p (FreeGroup.of i))) (g (q b)) := by
    induction b using FreeGroup.induction_on with
    | one => simp
    | of j => exact hc i j
    | inv_of b hb => simpa only [map_inv] using hb.inv_right
    | mul b c hb hc => simpa only [map_mul] using hb.mul_right hc
  induction a using FreeGroup.induction_on with
  | one => simp
  | of i => exact hgen i b
  | inv_of a ha => simpa only [map_inv] using ha.inv_left
  | mul a c ha hc => simpa only [map_mul] using ha.mul_left hc

name: OAI.Higman.finitelyPresented_prod
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_prod {G : Type u} {H : Type v} [Group G] [Group H]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented H] :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × H)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := G)
  obtain ⟨m,q,hq,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := H)
  let relation : Fin n × Fin m → G ∗ H := fun ij ↦
    (inl (p (FreeGroup.of ij.1)) * inr (q (FreeGroup.of ij.2))) *
      (inr (q (FreeGroup.of ij.2)) * inl (p (FreeGroup.of ij.1)))⁻¹
  let N := Subgroup.normalClosure (Set.range relation)
  let Q := (G ∗ H) ⧸ N
  let proj : G ∗ H →* Q := QuotientGroup.mk' N
  let f : G →* Q := proj.comp inl
  let g : H →* Q := proj.comp inr
  have hcomm : ∀ a b, Commute (f a) (g b) := by
    apply commute_of_free_generators p hp q hq
    intro i j
    have h : proj (relation (i,j)) = 1 :=
      (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨(i,j),rfl⟩)
    exact mul_inv_eq_one.mp (by simpa only [f,g,MonoidHom.comp_apply,relation,map_mul,map_inv] using h)
  let π : G ∗ H →* G × H := Coprod.lift (MonoidHom.inl G H) (MonoidHom.inr G H)
  let s : G × H →* Q := MonoidHom.noncommCoprod f g hcomm
  have hs : s.comp π = proj := by
    apply Coprod.hom_ext <;> ext z <;> simp [s,π,f,g]
  have hker : π.ker = N := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro z hz
      apply (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mp
      change proj z = 1
      rw [← hs]
      change s (π z) = 1
      rw [show π z = 1 from hz,map_one]
    · apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
      rintro z ⟨⟨i,j⟩,rfl⟩
      change π (relation (i,j)) = 1
      simp [π,relation]
  apply Group.IsFinitelyPresented.of_surjective π
  · rintro ⟨a,b⟩
    exact ⟨inl a * inr b,by simp [π]⟩
  · exact ⟨Set.range relation,Set.finite_range _,hker.symm⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented [Finite ι] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented K]
    (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (Container α β)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.relation_zero
statement:
lemma relation_zero (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι ⊕ ι) :
    proj α β (relation α β j) = 1
proof:
:=
  (QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff _).mpr (Subgroup.subset_normalClosure ⟨j,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.generator_zero
statement:
lemma generator_zero (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (α (FreeGroup.of j)) =
      kMap α β (α (FreeGroup.of j)) * stable α β
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
  simpa only [proj,relation,map_mul,map_inv,kMap,stable,MonoidHom.comp_apply] using
    relation_zero α β (.inl j)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.generator_one
statement:
lemma generator_one (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (j : ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (β (FreeGroup.of j)) =
      kMap α β (β (FreeGroup.of j)) * fMap α β (FreeGroup.of j) * stable α β
proof:
:= by
  apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
  simpa only [proj,relation,map_mul,map_inv,kMap,fMap,stable,MonoidHom.comp_apply] using
    relation_zero α β (.inr j)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.conjugate_zero
statement:
lemma conjugate_zero (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (α w) * (stable α β)⁻¹ = kMap α β (α w)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (MulAut.conj (stable α β)).toMonoidHom.comp ((kMap α β).comp α) =
      (kMap α β).comp α := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro j
    change stable α β * kMap α β (α (FreeGroup.of j)) * (stable α β)⁻¹ = _
    rw [generator_zero,mul_inv_cancel_right]
    rfl
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hh w

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.pair_eq
statement:
lemma pair_eq (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (k : K) (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    proj α β (Coprod.inl (k,w)) = kMap α β k * fMap α β w
proof:
:= by
  change proj α β (Coprod.inl (k,w)) =
    proj α β (Coprod.inl (k,1)) * proj α β (Coprod.inl (1,w))
  rw [← map_mul,← map_mul]
  simp

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.conjugate_one
statement:
lemma conjugate_one (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    stable α β * kMap α β (β w) * (stable α β)⁻¹ =
      kMap α β (β w) * fMap α β w
proof:
:= by
  let p : FreeGroup ι →* Container α β :=
    ((proj α β).comp Coprod.inl).comp (β.prod (MonoidHom.id _))
  have hh : (MulAut.conj (stable α β)).toMonoidHom.comp ((kMap α β).comp β) = p := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro j
    change stable α β * kMap α β (β (FreeGroup.of j)) * (stable α β)⁻¹ =
      proj α β (Coprod.inl (β (FreeGroup.of j),FreeGroup.of j))
    rw [generator_one,mul_inv_cancel_right,pair_eq]
  have h := DFunLike.congr_fun hh w
  change stable α β * kMap α β (β w) * (stable α β)⁻¹ =
    proj α β (Coprod.inl (β w,w)) at h
  rwa [pair_eq] at h

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.kills_relation
statement:
lemma kills_relation (α β : FreeGroup ι →* K) (w : FreeGroup ι) (hw : α w = β w) :
    fMap α β w = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := conjugate_zero α β w
  rw [hw,conjugate_one] at h0
  exact mul_left_cancel (h0.trans (mul_one _).symm)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.left_injective
statement: lemma left_injective : Function.Injective (left i (G := G))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  exact hi (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.right_injective
statement: lemma right_injective : Function.Injective (right i r)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  exact hi (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.associated_left
statement:
lemma associated_left (a : A) : associated i hi r ⟨left i a,⟨a,rfl⟩⟩ =
    ⟨right i r a,⟨a,rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  change (MonoidHom.ofInjective (right_injective i hi r))
    ((MonoidHom.ofInjective (left_injective i hi)).symm
      ((MonoidHom.ofInjective (left_injective i hi)) a)) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.model_relation
statement:
lemma model_relation (a : A) :
    (HNNExtension.t : Model i hi r) * HNNExtension.of (i a,1) =
      HNNExtension.of (i a,r a) * HNNExtension.t
proof:
:= by
  have h := HNNExtension.t_mul_of (φ := associated i hi r) ⟨left i a,⟨a,rfl⟩⟩
  rw [associated_left] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.evaluate_rawK
statement:
@[simp] lemma evaluate_rawK (k : K) :
    evaluate i hi r q (rawK k) = HNNExtension.of (k,1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluate,rawK]

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.evaluate_rawF
statement:
@[simp] lemma evaluate_rawF (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    evaluate i hi r q (rawF w) = HNNExtension.of (1,q w)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluate,rawF]

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.evaluate_rawT
statement:
@[simp] lemma evaluate_rawT :
    evaluate i hi r q rawT = HNNExtension.t
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluate,rawT]

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.evaluate_relation
statement:
lemma evaluate_relation (j : ι ⊕ ι) :
    evaluate i hi r q (relation (i.comp p₀) (i.comp p₁) j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | inl j =>
    simp only [relation,map_mul,map_inv,evaluate_rawK,evaluate_rawT]
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mpr
    simpa only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,h₀] using model_relation i hi r (p₀ (FreeGroup.of j))
  | inr j =>
    simp only [relation,map_mul,map_inv,evaluate_rawK,evaluate_rawF,evaluate_rawT]
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mpr
    rw [← map_mul]
    simpa only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,Prod.mk_mul_mk,mul_one,one_mul,h₁] using
      model_relation i hi r (p₁ (FreeGroup.of j))

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.detect_fMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma detect_fMap (w : FreeGroup ι) :
    detect i hi r q p₀ p₁ h₀ h₁ (fMap (i.comp p₀) (i.comp p₁) w) =
      HNNExtension.of (1,q w)
proof:
:= by
  change evaluate i hi r q (rawF w) = _
  exact evaluate_rawF i hi r q w

name: OAI.Higman.RopeTrick.embeds_quotient
statement:
theorem embeds_quotient [Finite ι] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented K]
    (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hident : ∀ w ∈ q.ker, i (p₀ w) = i (p₁ w)) :
    ∃ (Q : Type (max u w)) (_ : Group Q) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented Q),
      ∃ j : G →* Q, Function.Injective j
proof:
:= by
  let α := i.comp p₀
  let β := i.comp p₁
  have hk : q.ker ≤ (fMap α β).ker := by
    intro w hw
    exact kills_relation α β w (hident w hw)
  let j : G →* Container α β := q.liftOfSurjective hq ⟨fMap α β,hk⟩
  have hj (w : FreeGroup ι) : j (q w) = fMap α β w := by
    exact MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp_apply _ _ _ _ _
  let d := detect i hi r q p₀ p₁ h₀ h₁
  have hd (g : G) : d (j g) = HNNExtension.of (1,g) := by
    obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := hq g
    rw [hj]
    exact detect_fMap i hi r q p₀ p₁ h₀ h₁ w
  refine ⟨Container α β,inferInstance,finitelyPresented α β,j,?_⟩
  intro g h he
  have hh := congrArg d he
  rw [hd,hd] at hh
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := associated i hi r) hh)

name: OAI.Higman.Double.firstIn_eq_secondIn
statement:
lemma firstIn_eq_secondIn {A : Subgroup G} {g : G} (hg : g ∈ A) :
    firstIn A g = secondIn A g
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact HNNExtension.equiv_eq_conj (φ := MulEquiv.refl A) ⟨g,hg⟩

name: OAI.Higman.embeds_of_benign_kernel
statement:
theorem embeds_of_benign_kernel {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    {D : Type v} [Group D] (q : FreeGroup ι →* D) (hq : Function.Surjective q)
    (hben : IsBenign q.ker) :
    ∃ (K : Type u) (_ : Group K) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented K)
      (i : D →* K), Function.Injective i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,_,_,i,hi,B,hB,hBi⟩ := hben
  let E := CentralExtension K B
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented E := CentralExtension.finitelyPresented hB
  let j := CentralExtension.map i (le_of_eq hBi.symm)
  have hj : Function.Injective j := CentralExtension.map_injective i hi hBi
  let A := Double.subgroup q.ker
  let jA : A →* E := j.comp A.subtype
  have hjA : Function.Injective jA := hj.comp Subtype.val_injective
  let r := Double.read q (le_refl q.ker)
  exact RopeTrick.embeds_quotient jA hjA r q
    (Double.firstIn q.ker) (Double.secondIn q.ker)
    (Double.read_first q (le_refl q.ker))
    (Double.read_second q (le_refl q.ker)) hq
    (fun w hw ↦ congrArg jA (Double.firstIn_eq_secondIn hw))

name: OAI.Higman.IsBenign.of_fg
statement: theorem of_fg [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] (hA : A.FG) : IsBenign A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨G,inferInstance,inferInstance,MonoidHom.id G,Function.injective_id,A,hA,?_⟩
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.IsBenign.inf
statement: theorem inf (hA : IsBenign A) (hB : IsBenign B) : IsBenign (A ⊓ B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K,_,_,i,hi,L,hL,hLi⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨K',_,_,j,_,L',hL',hLj⟩ := hB
