  refine ⟨K × K',inferInstance,finitelyPresented_prod,i.prod j,?_,L.prod L',
    hL.prod hL',?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    exact hi (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  · ext x
    change i x ∈ L ∧ j x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ A ∧ x ∈ B
    change x ∈ L.comap i ∧ x ∈ L'.comap j ↔ _
    rw [hLi,hLj]

name: OAI.Higman.IsBenign.comap
statement:
theorem comap {D : Type u} [Group D] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented D]
    (hA : IsBenign A) (f : D →* G) : IsBenign (A.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,p,hp,_⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := D)
  have : Group.FG D := Group.fg_of_surjective hp
  obtain ⟨K,_,_,i,_,L,hL,hLi⟩ := hA
  refine ⟨D × K,inferInstance,finitelyPresented_prod,
    (MonoidHom.id D).prod (i.comp f),?_,(⊤ : Subgroup D).prod L,
    Group.FG.out.prod hL,?_⟩
  · intro x y h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  · ext x
    change (x ∈ (⊤ : Subgroup D) ∧ i (f x) ∈ L) ↔ f x ∈ A
    simpa only [Subgroup.mem_top,true_and,Subgroup.mem_comap] using
      (show f x ∈ L.comap i ↔ f x ∈ A by rw [hLi])

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.sumCLM_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma sumCLM_apply (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : sumCLM n x = ∑ i, x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [sumCLM]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.truncated_closed
statement: lemma truncated_closed (n : ℕ) : IsClosed (Truncated n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Truncated n = (⋂ i, {x | (0:ℝ) ≤ x i}) ∩ {x | ∑ i, x i ≤ 1} := by
    ext x; simp [Truncated]
  rw [h]
  exact (isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i)).inter
    (isClosed_le (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_apply i) continuous_const)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.positive_open
statement: lemma positive_open (n : ℕ) : IsOpen (Positive n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Positive n = (⋂ i, {x | (0:ℝ) < x i}) ∩ {x | ∑ i, x i < 1} := by
    ext x; simp [Positive]
  rw [h]
  exact (isOpen_iInter_of_finite fun i => isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_apply i)).inter
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_finsetSum _ fun i _ => continuous_apply i) continuous_const)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.interior_truncated
statement: lemma interior_truncated (n : ℕ) : interior (Truncated n) = Positive n
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    have hc : ∀ i, 0 < x i := by
      intro i
      have hh := interior_mono (show Truncated n ⊆ (Function.eval i) ⁻¹' Ici (0:ℝ) from fun _ h => h.1 i) hx
      rw [← (isOpenMap_eval i).preimage_interior_eq_interior_preimage (continuous_apply i),interior_Ici] at hh
      exact hh
    refine ⟨hc,?_⟩
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      have hs : Function.Surjective (sumCLM (n+1)) := by
        intro r
        refine ⟨Pi.single 0 r,?_⟩
        simp
      have hh := interior_mono (show Truncated (n+1) ⊆ (sumCLM (n+1)) ⁻¹' Iic (1:ℝ) from fun _ h => by simpa using h.2) hx
      rw [← ((sumCLM (n+1)).isOpenMap hs).preimage_interior_eq_interior_preimage (sumCLM (n+1)).continuous,interior_Iic] at hh
      simpa only [mem_preimage,mem_Iio,sumCLM_apply] using hh
  · apply (positive_open n).subset_interior_iff.mpr
    exact fun _ h => ⟨fun i => (h.1 i).le,h.2.le⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.truncated_convex
statement: lemma truncated_convex (n : ℕ) : Convex ℝ (Truncated n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Truncated n = (⋂ i, ((LinearMap.proj i : (Fin n → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) ⁻¹' Ici 0)) ∩
      (sumCLM n) ⁻¹' Iic 1 := by ext x; simp [Truncated]
  rw [h]
  exact (convex_iInter fun i => (convex_Ici (0:ℝ)).linear_preimage (LinearMap.proj i)).inter
    ((convex_Iic (1:ℝ)).linear_preimage (sumCLM n).toLinearMap)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.truncated_bounded
statement: lemma truncated_bounded (n : ℕ) : Bornology.IsBounded (Truncated n)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isBounded_Icc (a := (0 : Fin n → ℝ)) (b := 1)).subset
  intro x hx
  refine ⟨hx.1,fun i => ?_⟩
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => hx.1 j) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans hx.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.positive_nonempty
statement: lemma positive_nonempty (n : ℕ) : (Positive n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 1 / (n+1 : ℝ),fun _ => by positivity,?_⟩
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hn : (0:ℝ) < n+1 := by positivity
  rw [mul_one_div,div_lt_one hn]
  linarith

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.ambient_positive
statement: lemma ambient_positive (n : ℕ) : ambient n '' Positive n = ball 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ambient,interior_truncated] using
    (Classical.choose_spec (exists_homeomorph_image_interior_closure_frontier_eq_unitBall
      (truncated_convex n) (by rw [interior_truncated]; exact positive_nonempty n) (truncated_bounded n))).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.ambient_truncated
statement: lemma ambient_truncated (n : ℕ) : ambient n '' Truncated n = closedBall 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ambient,(truncated_closed n).closure_eq] using
    (Classical.choose_spec (exists_homeomorph_image_interior_closure_frontier_eq_unitBall
      (truncated_convex n) (by rw [interior_truncated]; exact positive_nonempty n) (truncated_bounded n))).2.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.simplexTruncated_positive
statement:
lemma simplexTruncated_positive (n : ℕ) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex (Fin (n+1))) :
    (simplexTruncated n x).1 ∈ Positive n ↔ ∀ i, 0 < x.1 i
proof:
:= by
  have h := x.2.2
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc,hs⟩ i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => hc j) i
    change ∑ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ < 1 at hs
    linarith
  · intro hc
    refine ⟨fun j => hc _,?_⟩
    change ∑ i : Fin n, x.1 i.succ < 1
    linarith [hc 0]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.simplexDisk_open
statement:
lemma simplexDisk_open (n : ℕ) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex (Fin (n+1))) :
    (simplexDisk n x).1 ∈ ball 0 1 ↔ ∀ i, 0 < x.1 i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← simplexTruncated_positive]
  change ambient n (simplexTruncated n x).1 ∈ ball 0 1 ↔ _
  rw [← ambient_positive]
  exact (ambient n).injective.mem_set_image

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.simplexDisk_boundary
statement:
lemma simplexDisk_boundary (n : ℕ) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex (Fin (n+1))) :
    (simplexDisk n x).1 ∈ sphere 0 1 ↔ ∃ i, x.1 i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (simplexDisk n x).2
  rw [mem_sphere,mem_closedBall] at *
  have ho := simplexDisk_open n x
  simp only [mem_ball] at ho
  constructor
  · intro he
    have hn : ¬ ∀ i, 0 < x.1 i := by rw [←ho,he]; exact lt_irrefl _
    push Not at hn
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := hn
    exact ⟨i,le_antisymm hi (x.2.1 i)⟩
  · rintro ⟨i,hi⟩
    apply le_antisymm h
    by_contra hn
    have hp := ho.mp (lt_of_not_ge hn)
    linarith [hp i]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SimplexDisk.reindex_positive
statement:
lemma reindex_positive {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (e : A ≃ B) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex A) :
    (∀ b, 0 < (reindex e x).1 b) ↔ ∀ a, 0 < x.1 a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    change ∀ b, 0 < x.1 (e.symm b) at h
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply] using h (e a)
  · intro h b
    change 0 < x.1 (e.symm b)
    exact h _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.support_nonempty
statement: lemma support_nonempty {w : V →₀ ℝ} (h : w.sum (fun _ r => r) = 1) : w.support.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  have hz : w = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.support_eq_empty.mp
    exact Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn
  simp [hz] at h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.face_nonempty
statement: lemma face_nonempty (s : Face K) : s.1.Nonempty
proof: := (K.isRelLowerSet_faces s.2).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.weight_apply
statement:
lemma weight_apply (s : Finset V) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s) (v : s) :
    weight s x v = x.1 v
proof:
:= by
  exact Finsupp.embDomain_apply_self _ _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.weight_apply_not
statement:
lemma weight_apply_not (s : Finset V) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s) {v : V} (hv : v ∉ s) :
    weight s x v = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.embDomain_of_notMem_range
  rintro ⟨w,hw⟩
  exact hv (hw ▸ w.2)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.weight_nonneg
statement: lemma weight_nonneg (s : Finset V) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s) (v : V) : 0 ≤ weight s x v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v ∈ s
  · exact (weight_apply s x ⟨v,hv⟩) ▸ x.2.1 ⟨v,hv⟩
  · rw [weight_apply_not _ _ hv]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.weight_sum
statement: lemma weight_sum (s : Finset V) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s) : (weight s x).sum (fun _ r => r) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight,Finsupp.sum_embDomain,Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (fun _ => rfl)]
  exact x.2.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.weight_support_subset
statement: lemma weight_support_subset (s : Finset V) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s) : (weight s x).support ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v hv
  by_contra hn
  exact Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hv (weight_apply_not _ _ hn)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_iff {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : Space K → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ s : Face K, Continuous (f ∘ faceMap K s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_coinduced_dom]
  exact continuous_sigma_iff

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_faceMap
statement: lemma continuous_faceMap (s : Face K) : Continuous (faceMap K s)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_coinduced_rng : Continuous (quotient K)).comp (continuous_sigmaMk (i := s))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_eval
statement: lemma continuous_eval (v : V) : Continuous (fun x : Space K => x.1 v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [continuous_iff]
  intro s
  by_cases hv : v ∈ s.1
  · have he : (fun x : Space K => x.1 v) ∘ faceMap K s = (fun x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 => x.1 ⟨v,hv⟩) := by
      funext x
      exact weight_apply s.1 x ⟨v,hv⟩
    rw [he]
    exact (continuous_apply (⟨v,hv⟩ : s.1)).comp continuous_subtype_val
  · have he : (fun x : Space K => x.1 v) ∘ faceMap K s = (fun _ => (0:ℝ)) := by
      funext x
      exact weight_apply_not _ _ hv
    rw [he]
    exact continuous_const

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.faceMap_injective
statement: lemma faceMap_injective (s : Face K) : Function.Injective (faceMap K s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext v
  have hh := congrArg (fun p : Space K => p.1 v) h
  exact (weight_apply _ _ _).symm.trans (hh.trans (weight_apply _ _ _))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.faceMap_closedEmbedding
statement: lemma faceMap_closedEmbedding (s : Face K) : IsClosedEmbedding (faceMap K s)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_faceMap K s).isClosedEmbedding (faceMap_injective K s)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.faceMap_coordinates
statement:
lemma faceMap_coordinates (s : Face K) (x : Space K) (h : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) :
    faceMap K s (coordinates K s.1 x h) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ s.1
  · exact weight_apply _ _ ⟨v,hv⟩
  · change weight s.1 _ v = x.1 v
    rw [weight_apply_not _ _ hv,Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp (fun hh => hv (h hh))]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.range_faceMap
statement: lemma range_faceMap (s : Face K) : Set.range (faceMap K s) = {x | x.1.support ⊆ s.1}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact weight_support_subset _ _
  · intro h
    exact ⟨coordinates K s.1 x h,faceMap_coordinates K s x h⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.quotient_surjective
statement: lemma quotient_surjective : Function.Surjective (quotient K)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  exact ⟨⟨⟨x.1.support,x.2.2.2⟩,coordinates K x.1.support x (subset_refl _)⟩,
    faceMap_coordinates K ⟨x.1.support,x.2.2.2⟩ x (subset_refl _)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.isClosed_iff
statement:
lemma isClosed_iff (A : Set (Space K)) :
    IsClosed A ↔ ∀ s : Face K, IsClosed ((faceMap K s) ⁻¹' A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClosed_coinduced]
  exact isClosed_sigma_iff

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.support_eq_iff
statement:
lemma support_eq_iff (s : Face K) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1) :
    (faceMap K s x).1.support = s.1 ↔ ∀ v, 0 < x.1 v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro he v
    have hn : weight s.1 x v ≠ 0 := by
      apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp
      change v.1 ∈ (faceMap K s x).1.support
      rw [he]
      exact v.2
    rw [weight_apply] at hn
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (x.2.1 v) (Ne.symm hn)
  · intro hp
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm (weight_support_subset _ _)
    intro v hv
    apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr
    rw [weight_apply _ _ ⟨v,hv⟩]
    exact ne_of_gt (hp ⟨v,hv⟩)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_of_support_subset
statement:
lemma continuous_of_support_subset [TopologicalSpace T] (f : T → Space K) (s : Face K)
    (hs : ∀ x, (f x).1.support ⊆ s.1) (hc : ∀ v, Continuous fun x => (f x).1 v) : Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  let c : T → SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 := fun x => coordinates K s.1 (f x) (hs x)
  have hcc : Continuous c := (continuous_pi fun v : s.1 => hc v.1).subtype_mk _
  have he : f = (faceMap K s) ∘ c := by
    funext x
    exact (faceMap_coordinates K s (f x) (hs x)).symm
  rw [he]
  exact (continuous_faceMap K s).comp hcc

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.push_apply
statement:
lemma push_apply (f : V → W) (w : V →₀ ℝ) (s : Finset V) (hs : w.support ⊆ s) (b : W) :
    (w.mapDomain f) b = ∑ a ∈ s, if f a = b then w a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain,Finsupp.sum_apply]
  rw [w.sum_of_support_subset hs]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    simp only [Finsupp.single_apply]
  · intro a _
    simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.push_nonneg
statement:
lemma push_nonneg (f : V → W) (w : V →₀ ℝ) (hw : ∀ v, 0 ≤ w v) (b : W) :
    0 ≤ (w.mapDomain f) b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [push_apply f w w.support (Finset.Subset.refl _) b]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => by split; exact hw a; exact le_rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.push_sum
statement:
lemma push_sum (f : V → W) (w : V →₀ ℝ) :
    (w.mapDomain f).sum (fun _ r => r) = w.sum (fun _ r => r)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.map_support
statement:
lemma map_support (f : V → W) (hf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image f ∈ L) (x : Space K) :
    (map K L f hf x).1.support ⊆ x.1.support.image f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_support

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_map
statement: lemma continuous_map (f : V → W) (hf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image f ∈ L) : Continuous (map K L f hf)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [continuous_iff]
  intro s
  apply continuous_of_support_subset L _ ⟨s.1.image f,hf s⟩
  · intro x
    exact (map_support K L f hf _).trans (Finset.image_subset_image (weight_support_subset _ _))
  · intro b
    have he : (fun x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 => ((map K L f hf ∘ faceMap K s) x).1 b) =
        fun x => ∑ a : s.1, if f a.1 = b then x.1 a else 0 := by
      funext x
      change (Finsupp.mapDomain f (weight s.1 x)) b = _
      rw [push_apply f _ s.1 (weight_support_subset _ _) b,← Finset.sum_coe_sort]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      rw [weight_apply]
    rw [he]
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro a _
    split_ifs
    · exact (continuous_apply a).comp continuous_subtype_val
    · exact continuous_const

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (hf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image id ∈ K) (x : Space K) : map K K id hf x = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_id

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {U : Type*} (M : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex U)
    (f : V → W) (hf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image f ∈ L)
    (g : W → U) (hg : ∀ s : Face L, s.1.image g ∈ M)
    (hgf : ∀ s : Face K, s.1.image (g ∘ f) ∈ M) (x : Space K) :
    map L M g hg (map K L f hf x) = map K M (g ∘ f) hgf x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_comp.symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.quotient_quotientMap
statement: lemma quotient_quotientMap : IsQuotientMap (quotient K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨rfl⟩,quotient_surjective K⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_prod_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_prod_iff [TopologicalSpace T] [LocallyCompactSpace T]
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : T × Space K → Y) :
    Continuous f ↔ ∀ s : Face K, Continuous (fun p : T × SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 => f (p.1,faceMap K s p.2))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf s
    exact hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_snd))
  · intro hf
    apply (quotient_quotientMap K).continuous_lift_prod_right
    rw [continuous_def]
    intro O hO
    have hp : (fun p : T × (Σ s : Face K, SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1) => f (p.1,quotient K p.2)) ⁻¹' O =
      ⋃ s : Face K, (fun p : T × SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 => (p.1,⟨s,p.2⟩)) ''
        ((fun p : T × SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 => f (p.1,faceMap K s p.2)) ⁻¹' O) := by
      ext p
      simp only [mem_preimage,mem_iUnion,mem_image]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨p.2.1,⟨p.1,p.2.2⟩,h,rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨s,p,h,rfl⟩
        exact h
    rw [hp]
    apply isOpen_iUnion
    intro s
    exact (IsOpenMap.id.prodMap isOpenMap_sigmaMk) _ ((hf s).isOpen_preimage O hO)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.mass_apply
statement: lemma mass_apply (w : V →₀ ℝ) : mass w = w.sum (fun _ r => r)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.blend_support
statement:
lemma blend_support (x y : V →₀ ℝ) (t : I) :
    ((1-(t:ℝ)) • x + (t:ℝ) • y).support ⊆ x.support ∪ y.support
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.support_add.trans (Finset.union_subset_union Finsupp.support_smul Finsupp.support_smul)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.blend_zero
statement:
lemma blend_zero (s : Face K) (x y : Space K) (hx : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) (hy : y.1.support ⊆ s.1) :
    blend K s x y hx hy 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [blend]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.blend_one
statement:
lemma blend_one (s : Face K) (x y : Space K) (hx : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) (hy : y.1.support ⊆ s.1) :
    blend K s x y hx hy 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [blend]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.blend_self
statement:
lemma blend_self (s : Face K) (x : Space K) (hx : x.1.support ⊆ s.1) (t : I) :
    blend K s x x hx hx t = x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (1-(t:ℝ)) • x.1 + (t:ℝ) • x.1 = x.1
  rw [← add_smul,sub_add_cancel,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_straight
statement: lemma continuous_straight : Continuous (fun p : I × Space K => straight K L f g hf hg hfg p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_prod_iff]
  intro s
  apply continuous_of_support_subset L _ ⟨s.1.image f ∪ s.1.image g,hfg s⟩
  · intro p
    exact (blend_support _ _ p.1).trans (Finset.union_subset_union
      ((map_support K L f hf _).trans (Finset.image_subset_image (weight_support_subset _ _)))
      ((map_support K L g hg _).trans (Finset.image_subset_image (weight_support_subset _ _))))
  · intro b
    change Continuous (fun p : I × SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1 =>
      (1-(p.1:ℝ)) * (map K L f hf (faceMap K s p.2)).1 b +
        (p.1:ℝ) * (map K L g hg (faceMap K s p.2)).1 b)
    exact ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      ((continuous_eval L b).comp ((continuous_map K L f hf).comp ((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_snd)))).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).mul
        ((continuous_eval L b).comp ((continuous_map K L g hg).comp ((continuous_faceMap K s).comp continuous_snd))))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.straightHomotopy_fixed
statement:
lemma straightHomotopy_fixed (x : Space K) (h : map K L f hf x = map K L g hg x) (t : I) :
    straightHomotopy K L f g hf hg hfg (t,x) = map K L f hf x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (1-(t:ℝ)) • (map K L f hf x).1 + (t:ℝ) • (map K L g hg x).1 = (map K L f hf x).1
  rw [←h,←add_smul,sub_add_cancel,one_smul]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.inclusion_injective
statement: lemma inclusion_injective : Function.Injective (inclusion K L hKL)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : Space L => z.1) h)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.inclusion_faceMap
statement:
lemma inclusion_faceMap (s : Face K) (x : SimplexDisk.Simplex s.1) :
    inclusion K L hKL (faceMap K s x) = faceMap L ⟨s.1,hKL _ s.2⟩ x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.continuous_inclusion
statement: lemma continuous_inclusion : Continuous (inclusion K L hKL)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff]
  intro s
  exact continuous_faceMap L ⟨s.1,hKL _ s.2⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.inclusion_isClosedMap
statement: lemma inclusion_isClosedMap : IsClosedMap (inclusion K L hKL)
proof:
:= by
  intro A hA
  rw [isClosed_iff]
  intro s
  let T : Set (Face K) := {t | t.1 ⊆ s.1}
  have hT : T.Finite := by
    have hf := s.1.powerset.finite_toSet.preimage (Subtype.val_injective : Function.Injective (Subtype.val : Face K → Finset V)).injOn
    convert hf using 1
    ext t
    simp only [T,mem_ofPred_eq,mem_preimage,Finset.mem_coe,Finset.mem_powerset]
  have hc : IsClosed (⋃ t ∈ T, inclusion K L hKL '' (A ∩ Set.range (faceMap K t))) := by
    apply hT.isClosed_biUnion
    intro t _
    exact (((isCompact_range (continuous_faceMap K t)).inter_left hA).image
      (continuous_inclusion K L hKL)).isClosed
  have he : inclusion K L hKL '' A ∩ Set.range (faceMap L s) =
      ⋃ t ∈ T, inclusion K L hKL '' (A ∩ Set.range (faceMap K t)) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_inter_iff,mem_image,mem_iUnion]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,hs⟩
      rw [range_faceMap] at hs
      let t : Face K := ⟨y.1.support,y.2.2.2⟩
      refine ⟨t,hs,y,⟨hy,?_⟩,rfl⟩
      rw [range_faceMap]
      exact Finset.Subset.refl _
    · rintro ⟨t,ht,y,⟨hy,hyt⟩,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,?_⟩
      rw [range_faceMap] at hyt ⊢
      exact hyt.trans (show t.1 ⊆ s.1 from ht)
  rw [←he] at hc
  have hp := hc.preimage (continuous_faceMap L s)
  simpa only [preimage_inter,preimage_range,inter_univ] using hp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.inclusion_closedEmbedding
statement: lemma inclusion_closedEmbedding : IsClosedEmbedding (inclusion K L hKL)
proof:
:=
  .of_continuous_injective_isClosedMap (continuous_inclusion K L hKL)
    (inclusion_injective K L hKL) (inclusion_isClosedMap K L hKL)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.pairFace_valid
statement:
lemma pairFace_valid (β : G → H → J) {s : Finset (ℕ × G)} {t : Finset (ℕ × H)}
    (hs : s ∈ complex G) (ht : t ∈ complex H) : pairFace β s t ∈ complex J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(hs.1.product ht.1).image _,?_⟩
  intro a ha b hb hab
  obtain ⟨⟨x,y⟩,hxy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
  obtain ⟨⟨x',y'⟩,hxy',rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
  have hh := Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp hab
  have hx : x = x' := hs.2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hxy).1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hxy').1 hh.1
  have hy : y = y' := ht.2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hxy).2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hxy').2 hh.2
  subst x'; subst y'; rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.pairFace_mono
statement:
lemma pairFace_mono (β : G → H → J) {s s' : Finset (ℕ × G)} {t t' : Finset (ℕ × H)}
    (hs : s ⊆ s') (ht : t ⊆ t') : pairFace β s t ⊆ pairFace β s' t'
proof:
:=
  Finset.image_subset_image (Finset.product_subset_product hs ht)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.pair_translate_vertex
statement:
lemma pair_translate_vertex (a g : G) (b h : H) :
    φ (a*g)*ψ (b*h) = (φ a*ψ b)*(φ g*ψ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [φ.map_mul,ψ.map_mul]
  calc
    (φ a*φ g)*(ψ b*ψ h) = φ a*(φ g*ψ b)*ψ h := by simp only [mul_assoc]
    _ = φ a*(ψ b*φ g)*ψ h := by
      have hh := hc g b
      change φ g * ψ b = ψ b * φ g at hh
      rw [hh]
    _ = (φ a*ψ b)*(φ g*ψ h) := by simp only [mul_assoc]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.pairFace_translate
statement:
lemma pairFace_translate (a : G) (b : H) (s : Finset (ℕ × G)) (t : Finset (ℕ × H)) :
    pairFace (fun g h => φ g*ψ h) (translate a s) (translate b t) =
      translate (φ a*ψ b) (pairFace (fun g h => φ g*ψ h) s t)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [pairFace,translate,Finset.mem_image,Finset.mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x,y⟩,⟨⟨v,hv,rfl⟩,⟨w,hw,rfl⟩⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨pairVertex (fun g h => φ g*ψ h) (v,w),⟨⟨v,w⟩,⟨hv,hw⟩,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact (pair_translate_vertex φ ψ hc a v.2 b w.2).symm
  · rintro ⟨z,⟨⟨v,w⟩,⟨hv,hw⟩,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨(v.1,a*v.2),(w.1,b*w.2)⟩,⟨⟨v,hv,rfl⟩,⟨w,hw,rfl⟩⟩,?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact pair_translate_vertex φ ψ hc a v.2 b w.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.pairFace_controlled
statement:
lemma pairFace_controlled (S : Finset (Finset (ℕ × G))) (T : Finset (Finset (ℕ × H)))
    (s : Face (orbitSpan S)) (t : Face (orbitSpan T)) :
    pairFace (fun g h => φ g*ψ h) s.1 t.1 ∈ orbitSpan (productShapes φ ψ S T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,s',hs',hss⟩ := s.2.2
  obtain ⟨b,t',ht',htt⟩ := t.2.2
  refine ⟨pairFace_valid _ s.2.1 t.2.1,φ a*ψ b,pairFace (fun g h => φ g*ψ h) s' t',?_,?_⟩
  · exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(s',t'),Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hs',ht'⟩,rfl⟩
  · rw [←pairFace_translate φ ψ hc]
    exact pairFace_mono _ hss htt

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.HomotopyFunctor.map_congr_maps
proof:
:= by
  subst g
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.anchorFace
statement: lemma anchorFace : ({v} : Finset V) ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  have hh := x.2.2.2
  rwa [hx,Finsupp.support_single _ one_ne_zero] at hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.leftAxisFace
statement: lemma leftAxisFace (s : Face K) : s.1.image (fun a => p (a,v)) ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  have hh := hp s ⟨{v},anchorFace K x v hx⟩
  simpa only [Finset.product_singleton,Finset.map_eq_image,Finset.image_image,
    Function.comp_def,Function.Embedding.sectL_apply] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.rightAxisFace
statement: lemma rightAxisFace (s : Face K) : s.1.image (fun a => p (v,a)) ∈ L
proof:
:= by

  simpa only [Finset.singleton_product,Finset.map_eq_image,Finset.image_image,
    Function.comp_def,Function.Embedding.sectR_apply] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.leftAxis_point
statement: lemma leftAxis_point : leftAxis K L p hp x v hx x = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x
proof:
:= by

  rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.rightAxis_point
statement: lemma rightAxis_point : rightAxis K L p hp x v hx x = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change x.1.mapDomain _ = x.1.mapDomain _
  rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pairLeft_eq
statement:
lemma pairLeft_eq : (pairMapC K K L p hp).comp ((ContinuousMap.id _).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const _ x)) =
    leftAxis K L p hp x v hx
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (tensor z.1 x.1).mapDomain p = z.1.mapDomain _
  rw [hx,tensor_single_right_push]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pairRight_eq
statement:
lemma pairRight_eq : (pairMapC K K L p hp).comp ((ContinuousMap.const _ x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id _)) =
    rightAxis K L p hp x v hx
proof:
:= by

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.productDiagonal_point
statement: lemma productDiagonal_point : productDiagonal K L p hp x = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [show (productDiagonal K L p hp x).1 = Finsupp.single (p (v,v)) 1 from pairMap_pure K L p hp x x v v hx hx]
  change Finsupp.single _ 1 = x.1.mapDomain _
  rw [hx,Finsupp.mapDomain_single]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.finite_pair_additivity
statement:
lemma finite_pair_additivity (a : HomotopyGroup N (Space K) x) :
    HomotopyFunctor.map (vertexDiagonal K L p hp) rfl a =
      HomotopyFunctor.map (leftAxis K L p hp x v hx) (leftAxis_point K L p hp x v hx) a *
      HomotopyFunctor.map (rightAxis K L p hp x v hx) (rightAxis_point K L p hp x v hx) a
proof:
:= by
  have hh := HomotopyFunctor.product_additivity (pairMapC K K L p hp)
    (productDiagonal_point K L p hp x v hx) a
  have hD := HomotopyFunctor.map_eq_of_homotopy (productDiagonal K L p hp) (vertexDiagonal K L p hp)
    (productDiagonal_point K L p hp x v hx) rfl (diagonalHomotopy K L p hp)
    (diagonalHomotopy_fixed K L p hp x v hx) a
  simp only [ContinuousMap.id_apply] at hh
  have hL := HomotopyFunctor.map_congr_maps ((pairMapC K K L p hp).comp ((ContinuousMap.id _).prodMk (ContinuousMap.const _ x))) _ (productDiagonal_point K L p hp x v hx) (leftAxis_point K L p hp x v hx)
    (pairLeft_eq K L p hp x v hx) a
  have hR := HomotopyFunctor.map_congr_maps ((pairMapC K K L p hp).comp ((ContinuousMap.const _ x).prodMk (ContinuousMap.id _))) _ (productDiagonal_point K L p hp x v hx) (rightAxis_point K L p hp x v hx)
    (pairRight_eq K L p hp x v hx) a
  exact hD.symm.trans (hh.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) hL hR))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.finite_pair_additivity_to
statement:
lemma finite_pair_additivity_to [Finite (Face K)] (z : Space L)
    (hz : vertexDiagonal K L p hp x = z) (a : HomotopyGroup N (Space K) x) :
    HomotopyFunctor.map (vertexDiagonal K L p hp) hz a =
      HomotopyFunctor.map (leftAxis K L p hp x v hx) ((leftAxis_point K L p hp x v hx).trans hz) a *
      HomotopyFunctor.map (rightAxis K L p hp x v hx) ((rightAxis_point K L p hp x v hx).trans hz) a
proof:
:= by
  subst z
  exact finite_pair_additivity K L p hp x v hx a

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pair_additivity
statement:
lemma pair_additivity (a : HomotopyGroup N (Space K) x) :
    HomotopyFunctor.map (vertexDiagonal K L p hp) rfl a =
      HomotopyFunctor.map (leftAxis K L p hp x v hx) (leftAxis_point K L p hp x v hx) a *
      HomotopyFunctor.map (rightAxis K L p hp x v hx) (rightAxis_point K L p hp x v hx) a
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with | h q =>
  obtain ⟨R,y,hy,r,hr⟩ := loop_finite_restriction K q
  have hyr : y.1 = Finsupp.single v 1 := (congrArg (fun z : Space K => z.1) hy).trans hx
  let hpR : ∀ s t : Face (restrict K R), (s.1 ×ˢ t.1).image p ∈ L :=
    fun s t => hp ⟨s.1,s.2.1⟩ ⟨t.1,t.2.1⟩
  have hz : vertexDiagonal (restrict K R) L p hpR y = vertexDiagonal K L p hp x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact congrArg (Finsupp.mapDomain (fun v => p (v,v))) (congrArg (fun z : Space K => z.1) hy)
  have hh := finite_pair_additivity_to (restrict K R) L p hpR y v hyr _ hz (Quotient.mk' r)
  subst q
  exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Simplicial.pair_additivity_to
statement:
lemma pair_additivity_to (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W)
    (p : V × V → W) (hp : ∀ s t : Face K, (s.1 ×ˢ t.1).image p ∈ L)
    (x : Space K) (v : V) (hx : x.1 = Finsupp.single v 1) {N : Type w} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N]
    (z : Space L) (hz : vertexDiagonal K L p hp x = z) (a : HomotopyGroup N (Space K) x) :
    HomotopyFunctor.map (vertexDiagonal K L p hp) hz a =
      HomotopyFunctor.map (leftAxis K L p hp x v hx) ((leftAxis_point K L p hp x v hx).trans hz) a *
      HomotopyFunctor.map (rightAxis K L p hp x v hx) ((rightAxis_point K L p hp x v hx).trans hz) a
proof:
:= by
  subst z
  exact pair_additivity K L p hp x v hx a

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addValid
statement: lemma addValid (s t : Face (stage G S)) : (s.1 ×ˢ t.1).image (addVertex φ ψ) ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
proof:
:=
  orbitSpan_mono (Finset.subset_insert _ _) (pairFace_controlled φ ψ hc _ _ s t)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.diagLayer_injective
statement: lemma diagLayer_injective : Function.Injective diagLayer
proof: := fun _ _ h => (Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp h).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.leftLayer_injective
statement: lemma leftLayer_injective : Function.Injective leftLayer
proof: := fun _ _ h => (Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp h).1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.rightLayer_injective
statement: lemma rightLayer_injective : Function.Injective rightLayer
proof: := fun _ _ h => (Nat.pair_eq_pair.mp h).2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addDiagValid
statement:
lemma addDiagValid (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer s.1 ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
proof:
:=
  diagonal_face _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) s

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addLeftValid
statement:
lemma addLeftValid (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage φ leftLayer s.1 ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := leftAxisFace _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl s
  change (s.1.image (fun a => (Nat.pair a.1 0,φ a.2))) ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
  simpa only [addVertex,pairVertex,map_one,mul_one] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addRightValid
statement:
lemma addRightValid (s : Face (stage G S)) :
    faceImage ψ rightLayer s.1 ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := rightAxisFace _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl s
  change (s.1.image (fun a => (Nat.pair 0 a.1,ψ a.2))) ∈ stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)
  simpa only [addVertex,pairVertex,map_one,one_mul] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addLeftMap
statement:
lemma addLeftMap : leftAxis _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl =
    stageMap φ leftLayer S _ (addLeftValid φ ψ hc S)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  change z.1.mapDomain _ = z.1.mapDomain _
  congr 1
  funext v
  exact Prod.ext rfl (by exact (congrArg (φ v.2 * ·) ψ.map_one).trans (mul_one _))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addRightMap
statement:
lemma addRightMap : rightAxis _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl =
    stageMap ψ rightLayer S _ (addRightValid φ ψ hc S)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  change z.1.mapDomain _ = z.1.mapDomain _
  congr 1
  funext v
  exact Prod.ext rfl (by exact (congrArg (· * ψ v.2) φ.map_one).trans (one_mul _))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.addHom
statement:
lemma addHom : stageMapHom N (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer S _ (addDiagValid φ ψ hc S) rfl =
    stageMapHom N φ leftLayer S _ (addLeftValid φ ψ hc S) rfl *
      stageMapHom N ψ rightLayer S _ (addRightValid φ ψ hc S) rfl
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  have hh := pair_additivity_to (stage G S) (stage H (addTarget φ ψ S)) (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S)
    (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl (stagePoint H (addTarget φ ψ S))
    (stageMap_point (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer S _ (addDiagValid φ ψ hc S) rfl) a
  have hL := HomotopyFunctor.map_congr_maps _ _
    ((leftAxis_point _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl).trans (stageMap_point (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer S _ (addDiagValid φ ψ hc S) rfl))
    (stageMap_point φ leftLayer S _ (addLeftValid φ ψ hc S) rfl) (addLeftMap φ ψ hc S) a
  have hR := HomotopyFunctor.map_congr_maps _ _
    ((rightAxis_point _ _ (addVertex φ ψ) (addValid φ ψ hc S) (stagePoint G S) (0,1) rfl).trans (stageMap_point (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer S _ (addDiagValid φ ψ hc S) rfl))
    (stageMap_point ψ rightLayer S _ (addRightValid φ ψ hc S) rfl) (addRightMap φ ψ hc S) a
  exact hh.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) hL hR)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.mapValue_product
statement:
theorem mapValue_product :
    mapValue N (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) id S rfl Function.injective_id =
      mapValue N φ id S rfl Function.injective_id * mapValue N ψ id S rfl Function.injective_id
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapValue_relayer N (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) S id diagLayer Function.injective_id diagLayer_injective rfl rfl,
    mapValue_relayer N φ S id leftLayer Function.injective_id leftLayer_injective rfl rfl,
    mapValue_relayer N ψ S id rightLayer Function.injective_id rightLayer_injective rfl rfl,
    mapValue_eq N (commutingProduct φ ψ hc) diagLayer S _ (addDiagValid φ ψ hc S) rfl diagLayer_injective,
    mapValue_eq N φ leftLayer S _ (addLeftValid φ ψ hc S) rfl leftLayer_injective,
    mapValue_eq N ψ rightLayer S _ (addRightValid φ ψ hc S) rfl rightLayer_injective]
  change value H N _ _ _ = value H N _ _ _ * value H N _ _ _
  rw [←value_mul,addHom N φ ψ hc S]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.bottom_repr
statement:
lemma bottom_repr (s : Sphere (n+1)) (h : s.1 0 = -1) :
    rimSphere n (rimBottom n (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s))) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) 0).1 = s.1
  exact (congrArg (fun t => (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) t).1)
    (faceTime_eq_zero s h)).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.top_repr
statement:
lemma top_repr (s : Sphere (n+1)) (h : s.1 0 = 1) :
    top n (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) 1).1 = s.1
  exact (congrArg (fun t => (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) t).1)
    (faceTime_eq_one s h)).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.side_repr
statement:
lemma side_repr (s : Sphere (n+1)) (h : (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)).1 ∈ sphere 0 1) :
    rimSphere n (rimSide n (faceSphere ⟨s,h⟩,faceTime none ⟨s,h⟩)) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (diskCons (diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) (diskTime (boundary (n+1) s))).1 = s.1
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (cons_tail_time (boundary (n+1) s))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.nullSphere_zero
statement: lemma nullSphere_zero (s : Sphere (n+1)) : nullSpherePaths g y H hb s 0 = F s
proof:
:= by
  rcases sphere_split s with h | h | h
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some false) ⟨s,h⟩]
    change y = F s
    rw [← bottom_repr s h,hr]
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some true) ⟨s,h⟩]
    change H (0,diskTail (boundary (n+1) s)) = F s
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero,← ht,top_repr s h]
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ none ⟨s,h⟩]
    change y = F s
    rw [← side_repr s h,hr]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.nullSphere_one
statement: lemma nullSphere_one (s : Sphere (n+1)) : nullSpherePaths g y H hb s 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases sphere_split s with h | h | h
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some false) ⟨s,h⟩]; rfl
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ (some true) ⟨s,h⟩]
    exact H.apply_one _
  · rw [nullSpherePaths,cylinderBoundaryMap_face _ _ _ none ⟨s,h⟩]; rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.killsSpheres_of_null_cubes
statement:
theorem killsSpheres_of_null_cubes [PathConnectedSpace Y] (y : Y) (q : C(Y,Z))
    (hq : ∀ p : GenLoop (Fin n) Y y,
      Nonempty ((q.comp p.1).HomotopyRel (ContinuousMap.const _ (q y)) (Cube.boundary (Fin n)))) :
    KillsSpheres q (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨K⟩ := rim_nullhomotopy f y
  let g := normalizedTop f y K
  let p := basedDiskLoop g y (normalizedTop_boundary f y K)
  obtain ⟨L⟩ := hq p
  let H : (q.comp g).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ (q y)) :=
    { toFun := fun v => L (v.1,DiskCube.toCube n v.2)
      continuous_toFun := L.continuous.comp
        (continuous_fst.prodMk ((DiskCube.toCube n).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
      map_zero_left := by
        intro x
        change L (0,DiskCube.toCube n x) = _
        rw [L.apply_zero]
        change q (g (DiskCube.fromCube n (DiskCube.toCube n x))) = q (g x)
        rw [DiskCube.from_to]
      map_one_left := by intro x; exact L.apply_one _ }
  have hb : ∀ t s, H (t,boundary n s) = q y := by
    intro t s
    exact L.eq_snd t (DiskCube.to_boundary n s)
  let J := nullSphere ((q.comp (normalizedSphere f y K))) (q.comp g) (q y)
    (fun x => congrArg q (normalizedSphere_rim f y K x))
    (fun x => congrArg q (normalizedSphere_top f y K x)) H hb
  let N := (ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl q).comp (normalizeHomotopy f y K)
  let : Nonempty (SphereTopology.Sphere (n+1)) := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty n
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := SphereTopology.extends_of_nullhomotopic (N.trans J).symm
  exact ⟨F,fun x => ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.killsSpheres_of_homotopy_zero
statement:
lemma killsSpheres_of_homotopy_zero [Nonempty (Fin n)] [PathConnectedSpace Y]
    (y : Y) (q : C(Y,Z))
    (hq : ∀ a : HomotopyGroup (Fin n) Y y, HomotopyFunctor.map q rfl a = 1) :
    Cellular.KillsSpheres q (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  apply killsSpheres_of_null_cubes y q
  intro p
  have hh := hq (Quotient.mk' p)
  change Quotient.mk' (HomotopyFunctor.loopMap q rfl p) = Quotient.mk' GenLoop.const at hh
  exact Quotient.exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.rim_nullhomotopy_of_joined
statement:
lemma rim_nullhomotopy_of_joined (r : C(X,Y)) (y : Y)
    (hy : ∀ x, Joined (r x) y) (f : C(Sphere (n+1),X)) :
    Nonempty (((r.comp f).comp (rimSphere n)).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ y))
proof:
:= by
  let := rim_contractible n
  obtain ⟨p,⟨H⟩⟩ := id_nullhomotopic (Cylinder.Rim n)
  let F := (r.comp f).comp (rimSphere n)
  let K := (ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl F).comp H
  let q : Path (F p) y := (hy (f (rimSphere n p))).somePath
  let L : (ContinuousMap.const (Cylinder.Rim n) (F p)).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ y) :=
    { toFun := fun z => q z.1
      continuous_toFun := q.continuous.comp continuous_fst
      map_zero_left := fun _ => q.source
      map_one_left := fun _ => q.target }
  exact ⟨K.trans L⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.fills_of_rim_nullhomotopy
statement:
lemma fills_of_rim_nullhomotopy (y : Y) (q : C(Y,Z))
    (hq : ∀ p : GenLoop (Fin n) Y y,
      Nonempty ((q.comp p.1).HomotopyRel (ContinuousMap.const _ (q y)) (Cube.boundary (Fin n))))
    (f : C(Sphere (n+1),Y))
    (K : (f.comp (rimSphere n)).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ y)) :
    ∃ F : C(Disk (n+1),Z), ∀ x, F (boundary (n+1) x) = q (f x)
proof:
:= by
  let g := normalizedTop f y K
  let p := basedDiskLoop g y (normalizedTop_boundary f y K)
  obtain ⟨L⟩ := hq p
  let H : (q.comp g).Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ (q y)) :=
    { toFun := fun v => L (v.1,DiskCube.toCube n v.2)
      continuous_toFun := L.continuous.comp
        (continuous_fst.prodMk ((DiskCube.toCube n).continuous.comp continuous_snd))
      map_zero_left := by
        intro x
        change L (0,DiskCube.toCube n x) = _
        rw [L.apply_zero]
        change q (g (DiskCube.fromCube n (DiskCube.toCube n x))) = q (g x)
        rw [DiskCube.from_to]
      map_one_left := by intro x; exact L.apply_one _ }
  have hb : ∀ t s, H (t,boundary n s) = q y := by
    intro t s
    exact L.eq_snd t (DiskCube.to_boundary n s)
  let J := nullSphere (q.comp (normalizedSphere f y K)) (q.comp g) (q y)
    (fun x => congrArg q (normalizedSphere_rim f y K x))
    (fun x => congrArg q (normalizedSphere_top f y K x)) H hb
  let N := (ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl q).comp (normalizeHomotopy f y K)
  let : Nonempty (SphereTopology.Sphere (n+1)) := SphereTopology.sphere_nonempty n
  obtain ⟨F,hF⟩ := SphereTopology.extends_of_nullhomotopic (N.trans J).symm
  exact ⟨F,fun x => ContinuousMap.congr_fun hF x⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.SphereCube.killsSpheres_of_connected_image
statement:
lemma killsSpheres_of_connected_image [Nonempty (Fin n)] (r : C(X,Y)) (y : Y)
    (hy : ∀ x, Joined (r x) y) (q : C(Y,Z)) (z : Z) (hbase : q y = z)
    (hq : ∀ a : HomotopyGroup (Fin n) Y y, HomotopyFunctor.map q hbase a = 1) :
    KillsSpheres (q.comp r) (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  subst z
  intro f
  obtain ⟨K⟩ := rim_nullhomotopy_of_joined r y hy f
  apply fills_of_rim_nullhomotopy y q (fun p => ?_) (r.comp f) K
  have hh := hq (Quotient.mk' p)
  change Quotient.mk' (HomotopyFunctor.loopMap q rfl p) = Quotient.mk' GenLoop.const at hh
  exact Quotient.exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.KillsSpheres.post
statement:
lemma KillsSpheres.post {q : C(X,Y)} {n : ℕ} (hq : KillsSpheres q n) (r : C(Y,Z)) :
    KillsSpheres (r.comp q) n
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := hq a
  exact ⟨r.comp d,fun x => congrArg r (hd x)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Cellular.joined_of_killsSpheres_one
statement:
lemma joined_of_killsSpheres_one (q : C(X,Y)) (hq : KillsSpheres q 1) (x y : X) :
    Joined (q x) (q y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a : C(Sphere 1,X) := ⟨fun s => if s = Cayley.minus then x else y,continuous_of_discreteTopology⟩
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := hq a
  have hm : a Cayley.minus = x := ite_eq_left rfl
  have hp : a Cayley.plus = y := by
    apply ite_eq_right
    intro h
    have := congrArg (fun z : Sphere 1 => z.1 0) h
    norm_num [Cayley.plus,Cayley.minus] at this
  have hh := (PathConnectedSpace.joined (boundary 1 Cayley.minus) (boundary 1 Cayley.plus)).map d.continuous
  rw [hd,hd,hm,hp] at hh
  exact hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.uniform_low_fp
statement:
lemma uniform_low_fp (S : Shapes G) :
    ∃ (T : Shapes G) (hST : S ⊆ T), ∀ n : ℕ, n = 1 ∨ n = 2 →
      KillsSpheres (stageIncl G S T hST) n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m,q,hq,R,hR,hker⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.out (G := G)
  let s : Fin m → G := fun i => q (FreeGroup.of i)
  have hs : FreeGroup.lift s = q := by
    apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
    intro i
    exact FreeGroup.lift_apply_of
  have hrel : ∀ r ∈ R, FreeGroup.lift s r = 1 := by
    intro r hr
    rw [hs]
    exact show r ∈ q.ker from hker.symm ▸ Subgroup.subset_normalClosure hr
  apply uniform_low_connectivity s R hrel hR
  · rwa [hs]
  · rw [hs]; exact hker.symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.uniform_diagram_sphere_ghost
statement:
lemma uniform_diagram_sphere_ghost (k : Index → G →* G) (hk : IsDiagram k)
    (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (T : Shapes G) (q : C(Stage G S,Stage G T)),
      Represents (k (.inl P₂.identity)) q ∧ KillsSpheres q n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := k (.inl P₂.identity)
  obtain ⟨R,hSR,hR⟩ := uniform_low_fp S
  let e := stageIncl G S R hSR
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · let T := imageShapes f id (basedShapes G R)
    let a := stageMap f id R T (image_stage_valid f id R Function.injective_id)
    refine ⟨T,a.comp e,fun _ => rfl,?_⟩
    intro b
    let : Nonempty (Stage G T) := ⟨stagePoint G T⟩
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := SphereTopology.fill_zero (a.comp (e.comp b))
    exact ⟨d,hd⟩
  obtain hn | hn := (lt_or_ge n 3)
  · let T := imageShapes f id (basedShapes G R)
    let a := stageMap f id R T (image_stage_valid f id R Function.injective_id)
    refine ⟨T,a.comp e,fun _ => rfl,?_⟩
    exact (hR n (by omega)).post a
  · let m := n-1
    have hm : n = m+1 := by omega
    have hm2 : 2 ≤ m := by omega
    let : Nonempty (Fin m) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp (by omega)
    let : Nontrivial (Fin m) := Fin.nontrivial_iff_two_le.mpr hm2
    obtain ⟨T,hT,hzero⟩ := diagram_uniform_homotopy_killing (Fin m) k hk R
    let a := (stageIncl G _ T hT).comp
      (stageMap f id R _ (image_stage_valid f id R Function.injective_id))
    have ha : a (stagePoint G R) = stagePoint G T := by
      change stageIncl G _ T hT (stageMap f id R _ _ (stagePoint G R)) = _
      rw [stageMap_point f id R _ _ rfl]
      rfl
    have hz : ∀ z : HomotopyGroup (Fin m) (Stage G R) (stagePoint G R),
        HomotopyFunctor.map a ha z = 1 := by
      intro z
      have hz := DFunLike.congr_fun hzero z
      change HomotopyFunctor.map (stageIncl G _ T hT) rfl
        (HomotopyFunctor.map (stageMap f id R _ _) (stageMap_point f id R _ _ rfl) z) = 1 at hz
      rw [HomotopyFunctor.map_comp] at hz
      exact hz
    refine ⟨T,a.comp e,fun _ => rfl,?_⟩
    rw [hm]
    apply SphereCube.killsSpheres_of_connected_image e (stagePoint G R) ?_ a (stagePoint G T) ha hz
    intro x
    exact joined_of_killsSpheres_one e (hR 1 (Or.inl rfl)) x (stagePoint G S)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.stage_bounded_dimension
statement:
lemma stage_bounded_dimension (S : Shapes G) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, Skeleton (univ : Set (Stage G S)) d = univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := (basedShapes G S).sup Finset.card
  refine ⟨d,Set.eq_univ_of_forall (fun x => ?_)⟩
  have hx : x ∈ (univ : Set (Stage G S)) := Set.mem_univ _
  rw [←CWComplex.iUnion_openCell_eq_complex (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S)))] at hx
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hx
  obtain ⟨n,i,hi⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨g,s,hs,his⟩ := i.1.2.2
  have hn : n < d := by
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card his
    rw [translate_card] at hcard
    rw [i.2] at hcard
    have hd := Finset.le_sup (f := Finset.card) hs
    omega
  exact CWComplex.skeletonLT_mono (C := (univ : Set (Stage G S)))
    (m := (n : ℕ∞)+1) (n := (d : ℕ∞)) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn)
    (CWComplex.closedCell_subset_skeletonLT n i (CWComplex.openCell_subset_closedCell n i hi))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.Represents.comp
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [show (r.comp q) x = r (q x) from rfl,hr,hq,←Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.Represents.id
statement: lemma Represents.id (S : Shapes G) : Represents (MonoidHom.id G) (ContinuousMap.id (Stage G S))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change x.1 = x.1.mapDomain _root_.id
  exact (Finsupp.mapDomain_id).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.ghostMap_represents
statement:
lemma ghostMap_represents (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) :
    Represents (k (.inl P₂.identity)) (ghostMap k hk S n)
proof:
:=
  (uniform_diagram_sphere_ghost k hk (ghostShapes k hk S n) (n+1)).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.ghostMap_kills
statement: lemma ghostMap_kills (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) : KillsSpheres (ghostMap k hk S n) (n+1)
proof:
:=
  (uniform_diagram_sphere_ghost k hk (ghostShapes k hk S n) (n+1)).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.ghostComposite_represents
statement:
lemma ghostComposite_represents (S : Shapes G) (n : ℕ) :
    Represents (iterateHom (k (.inl P₂.identity)) n)
      (towerComposite (fun i => Stage G (ghostShapes k hk S i)) (ghostMap k hk S)
        (ContinuousMap.id (Stage G S)) n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Represents.id S
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (ghostMap_represents k hk S n).comp ih

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.diagram_uniform_stage_nullhomotopy
statement:
theorem diagram_uniform_stage_nullhomotopy (S : Shapes G) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (T : Shapes G) (q : C(Stage G S,Stage G T)) (z : Stage G T),
      Represents (iterateHom (k (.inl P₂.identity)) d) q ∧
      Nonempty (q.Homotopy (ContinuousMap.const _ z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := stage_bounded_dimension S
  let Y : ℕ → Type := fun i => Stage G (ghostShapes k hk S i)
  let q := ghostMap k hk S
  let a := towerComposite Y q (ContinuousMap.id (Stage G S)) d
  let b := towerComposite Y q (ContinuousMap.const (Stage G S) (stagePoint G S)) d
  have hb : ∀ x,b x = a (stagePoint G S) := by
    intro x
    change towerComposite Y q (ContinuousMap.const (Stage G S) (stagePoint G S)) d x =
      towerComposite Y q (ContinuousMap.id (Stage G S)) d (stagePoint G S)
    clear hd a b
    induction d with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ d ih => exact congrArg (q d) ih
  refine ⟨d,ghostShapes k hk S d,a,a (stagePoint G S),ghostComposite_represents k hk S d,?_⟩
  have H := towerHomotopy Y q (ContinuousMap.id (Stage G S))
    (ContinuousMap.const (Stage G S) (stagePoint G S)) (ghostMap_kills k hk S) d hd
  exact ⟨H.cast rfl (ContinuousMap.ext hb)⟩

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.code_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem code_nil (b : ℤ) (d : E → ℤ) : code b d [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.code_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem code_cons (b : ℤ) (d : E → ℤ) (e : E) (s : List E) :
    code b d (e :: s) = b * code b d s + d e
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.push_mod
statement: lemma push_mod (e : E) (z : ℤ) : (b * z + d e) % b = d e
proof:
:= by
  rw [Int.add_emod,Int.mul_emod_right,zero_add,Int.emod_emod,
    Int.emod_eq_of_lt (by have := (hd e).1; omega) (hd e).2]

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.push_ne_empty
statement: lemma push_ne_empty (e : E) (z : ℤ) : b * z + d e ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun x : ℤ ↦ x % b) h
  rw [push_mod b d hd,Int.emod_eq_of_lt (by omega) (by omega)] at he
  have := (hd e).1
  omega

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.push_injective
statement:
lemma push_injective (hdinj : Function.Injective d) {e f : E} {z w : ℤ}
    (h : b * z + d e = b * w + d f) : e = f ∧ z = w
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun x : ℤ ↦ x % b) h
  rw [push_mod b d hd,push_mod b d hd] at he
  have hef := hdinj he
  subst f
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  have hm : b * z = b * w := by omega
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by omega : b ≠ 0) hm

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.decode_push
statement:
theorem decode_push (hdinj : Function.Injective d) (e : E) (z : ℤ) (s : List E) :
    b * z + d e = code b d s ↔ ∃ t, s = e :: t ∧ z = code b d t
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | nil => simp [push_ne_empty b d hb hd e z]
  | cons f t =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨hef,hzt⟩ := push_injective b d hb hd hdinj h
      subst f
      exact ⟨t,rfl,hzt⟩
    · rintro ⟨u,hu,hz⟩
      cases hu
      simp [hz]

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.code_injective
statement: theorem code_injective (hdinj : Function.Injective d) : Function.Injective (code b d)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  induction s with
  | nil =>
    intro t h
    cases t with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons e t => exact False.elim (push_ne_empty b d hb hd e (code b d t) h.symm)
  | cons e s ih =>
    intro t h
    obtain ⟨u,rfl,hu⟩ := (decode_push b d hb hd hdinj e (code b d s) t).mp h
    exact congrArg (List.cons e) (ih hu)

name: OAI.Higman.IntegerStack.code_pos
statement: theorem code_pos (s : List E) : 0 < code b d s
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => simp
  | cons e s ih =>
    have hm : 0 < b * code b d s := mul_pos (by omega) ih
    have hh := (hd e).1
    rw [code_cons]
    omega

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.run_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem run_nil (c : C) : Run input output initial [] c ↔ c = initial
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact Run.start

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.run_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem run_cons (e : E) (s : List E) (c : C) :
    Run input output initial (e :: s) c ↔
      ∃ z : D e, c = output e z ∧ Run input output initial s (input e z)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | step e z h => exact ⟨z,rfl,h⟩
  · rintro ⟨z,rfl,h⟩
    exact Run.step e z h

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.reach_start
statement: lemma reach_start : Reach input output initial b digit initial 1
proof: := ⟨[],Run.start,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.reach_step_iff
statement:
theorem reach_step_iff (hout : ∀ e, Function.Injective (output e)) (e : E) (z : D e)
    (h : ℤ) :
    Reach input output initial b digit (output e z) (b * h + digit e) ↔
      Reach input output initial b digit (input e z) h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,he⟩
    obtain ⟨t,rfl,ht⟩ := (IntegerStack.decode_push b digit hb hd hinj e h s).mp he
    obtain ⟨y,hy,hr⟩ := (run_cons input output initial e t (output e z)).mp hs
    have hzy : z = y := hout e hy
    subst y
    exact ⟨t,hr,ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e :: s,Run.step e z hs,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.decoration_code
statement:
@[simp] theorem decoration_code (weight : E → G) (s : List E) :
    decoration b digit weight (IntegerStack.code b digit s) = value weight s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold decoration
  split_ifs with h
  · have he : h.choose = s :=
      IntegerStack.code_injective b digit hb hd hinj h.choose_spec.symm
    rw [he]
  · exact False.elim (h ⟨s,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.Higman.HistoryMachine.decoration_step
statement:
lemma decoration_step (weight : E → G) (e : E) (z : D e) (h : ℤ)
    (hr : Reach input output initial b digit (input e z) h) :
    decoration b digit weight (b * h + digit e) = decoration b digit weight h * weight e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,_,rfl⟩ := hr
  rw [← IntegerStack.code_cons,decoration_code b digit hb hd hinj,
    decoration_code b digit hb hd hinj]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.scale_injective
statement: lemma scale_injective (b : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (scale b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  change x.toAdd = y.toAdd
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hb (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h)

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.forget_augment
statement: @[simp] lemma forget_augment (c : T × Q) (h : ℤ) : forget (augment c h) = c
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.history_augment
statement: @[simp] lemma history_augment (c : T × Q) (h : ℤ) : history (augment c h) = h
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.augment_forget
statement: @[simp] lemma augment_forget (c : (T × Counter) × Q) : augment (forget c) (history c) = c
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.edge_input
statement:
@[simp] lemma edge_input (e : Edge G T Q) (b digit : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (d : e.Domain) (h : Counter) :
    (edge e b digit hb).input (d,h) = augment (e.input d) h.toAdd
proof:
:= by
  change ((e.inputLinear d, h) * (e.inputOffset, 1), e.inputState) = _
  simp only [Prod.mul_def, mul_one]
  rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.edge_output
statement:
@[simp] lemma edge_output (e : Edge G T Q) (b digit : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (d : e.Domain) (h : Counter) :
    (edge e b digit hb).output (d,h) =
      augment (e.output d) (b * h.toAdd + digit)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.mem_edgeList
statement: lemma mem_edgeList (e : E) : edge (edges e) b (digit e) (by omega) ∈ edgeList edges b digit hb
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨e,Finset.mem_toList.mpr (Finset.mem_univ _),rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.of_mem_edgeList
statement:
lemma of_mem_edgeList (a : Edge G (T × Counter) Q) (ha : a ∈ edgeList edges b digit hb) :
    ∃ e, a = edge (edges e) b (digit e) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e,_,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  exact ⟨e,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.forward_start
statement: lemma forward_start : Forward edges b digit seed (augment seed 1)
proof:
:=
  HistoryMachine.reach_start _ _ _ _ _

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.output_injective
statement: lemma output_injective (e : Edge G T Q) : Function.Injective e.output
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  exact e.output_injective (mul_right_cancel (congrArg Prod.fst h))

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.forward_edge
statement:
lemma forward_edge (e : E) (d : (edges e).Domain) (h : ℤ) :
    Forward edges b digit seed (augment ((edges e).output d) (b*h + digit e)) ↔
      Forward edges b digit seed (augment ((edges e).input d) h)
proof:
:=
  HistoryMachine.reach_step_iff _ _ _ b digit hb hd hinj
    (fun e ↦ output_injective (edges e)) e d h

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.reach_implies_forward
statement:
lemma reach_implies_forward (c : (T × Counter) × Q)
    (hc : MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1) c) :
    Forward edges b digit seed c
proof:
:= by
  induction hc with
  | start => exact forward_start edges b digit seed
  | forward a ha d _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨e,rfl⟩ := of_mem_edgeList edges b digit hb a ha
    obtain ⟨d,h⟩ := d
    change Counter at h
    simpa only [edge_output] using
      (forward_edge edges b digit hb seed hd hinj e d h.toAdd).mpr
        (by simpa only [edge_input] using ih)
  | backward a ha d _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨e,rfl⟩ := of_mem_edgeList edges b digit hb a ha
    obtain ⟨d,h⟩ := d
    change Counter at h
    simpa only [edge_input] using
      (forward_edge edges b digit hb seed hd hinj e d h.toAdd).mp
        (by simpa only [edge_output] using ih)

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.run_implies_reach
statement:
lemma run_implies_reach {s : List E} {c : T × Q}
    (hc : HistoryMachine.Run (fun e ↦ (edges e).input) (fun e ↦ (edges e).output) seed s c) :
    MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1)
      (augment c (IntegerStack.code b digit s))
proof:
:= by
  induction hc with
  | start => exact MarkerMachine.Reach.start
  | @step s e d hr ih =>
    have hh := MarkerMachine.Reach.forward (seed := augment seed 1)
      (edge (edges e) b (digit e) (by omega)) (mem_edgeList edges b digit hb e)
      (d,Multiplicative.ofAdd (IntegerStack.code b digit s))
    rw [edge_input,edge_output] at hh
    exact hh ih

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.forward_implies_reach
statement:
lemma forward_implies_reach (c : (T × Counter) × Q) (hc : Forward edges b digit seed c) :
    MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hh⟩ := hc
  have hr := run_implies_reach edges b digit hb seed hs
  rw [← hh,augment_forget] at hr
  exact hr

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.reach_iff_forward
statement:
theorem reach_iff_forward (c : (T × Counter) × Q) :
    MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1) c ↔
      Forward edges b digit seed c
proof:
:=
  ⟨reach_implies_forward edges b digit hb seed hd hinj c,
    forward_implies_reach edges b digit hb seed c⟩

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.decoration_edge
statement:
lemma decoration_edge (a : Edge G (T × Counter) Q) (ha : a ∈ edgeList edges b digit hb)
    (d : a.Domain) (hr : MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1) (a.input d)) :
    decoration edges b digit (a.output d) = decoration edges b digit (a.input d) * a.weight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e,rfl⟩ := of_mem_edgeList edges b digit hb a ha
  obtain ⟨d,h⟩ := d
  have hf := reach_implies_forward edges b digit hb seed hd hinj _ hr
  rw [edge_input] at hf ⊢
  rw [edge_output]
  exact HistoryMachine.decoration_step (fun e ↦ (edges e).input) (fun e ↦ (edges e).output)
    seed b digit hb hd hinj
    (fun e ↦ (edges e).weight) e d h.toAdd hf

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.benign_forward
statement:
theorem benign_forward [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented T] [Finite Q]
    (hD : ∀ e, Group.IsFinitelyPresented (edges e).Domain) :
    IsBenign (decoratedSubgroup (decoration edges b digit) {c | Forward edges b digit seed c})
proof:
:= by
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (T × Counter) := finitelyPresented_prod
  have he : {c | MarkerMachine.Reach (edgeList edges b digit hb) (augment seed 1) c} =
      {c | Forward edges b digit seed c} := by
    ext c
    exact reach_iff_forward edges b digit hb seed hd hinj c
  rw [← he]
  apply MarkerMachine.benign _ _ _ _ (decoration_edge edges b digit hb seed hd hinj)
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨e,rfl⟩ := of_mem_edgeList edges b digit hb a ha
  have := hD e
  exact finitelyPresented_prod

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] lemma projection_coefficient (g : G) :
    coefficientProjection (coefficient g : Base G T Q) = g
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientProjection,coefficient]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_translation
statement:
@[simp] lemma projection_translation (t : T) :
    coefficientProjection (translation t : Base G T Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientProjection,translation]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_marker
statement:
@[simp] lemma projection_marker (t : T) (q : Q) :
    coefficientProjection (marker t q : Base G T Q) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientProjection,marker,translation]

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.projection_surjective
statement: lemma projection_surjective : Function.Surjective (coefficientProjection : Base G T Q →* G)
proof:
:=
  fun g ↦ ⟨coefficient g,projection_coefficient g⟩

name: OAI.Higman.MarkerEmbedding.benign_output
statement:
theorem benign_output [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented T]
    (v : T × Q → G) (V : Set (T × Q)) (hR : IsBenign (decoratedSubgroup v V)) (q : Q) :
    IsBenign (Subgroup.closure (v '' {c | c ∈ V ∧ c.2 = q}))
proof:
:= by
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × T) := finitelyPresented_prod
  let f : Base G T Unit →* Base G T Q := embedding (MonoidHom.id T) (fun _ ↦ 1)
    (fun _ ↦ q) (fun _ ↦ 1)
  have hi : Function.Injective (index (MonoidHom.id T) (fun _ : Unit ↦ 1) (fun _ ↦ q)) :=
    index_injective _ Function.injective_id _ _ (Function.injective_of_subsingleton _)
  have hB := (hR.comap f).map_surjective
    (coefficientProjection : Base G T Unit →* G)
      (projection_surjective (G := G) (T := T) (Q := Unit))
  dsimp only [f] at hB
  rw [comap_decoratedSubgroup _ Function.injective_id _ _ _ hi,
    decoratedSubgroup_eq_closure,MonoidHom.map_closure] at hB
  have he : (coefficientProjection : Base G T Unit →* G) ''
      ((fun x : T × Unit ↦ coefficient
        (pullDecoration (MonoidHom.id T) (fun _ ↦ 1) (fun _ ↦ q) (fun _ ↦ 1) v x) *
          marker x.1 x.2) ''
        (index (MonoidHom.id T) (fun _ : Unit ↦ 1) (fun _ ↦ q) ⁻¹' V)) =
      v '' {c | c ∈ V ∧ c.2 = q} := by
    rw [Set.image_image]
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨t,p⟩,ht,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(t,q),⟨?_,rfl⟩,?_⟩
      · simpa [index] using ht
      · simp [pullDecoration,index]
    · rintro ⟨⟨t,r⟩,⟨hc,hq⟩,rfl⟩
      change r = q at hq
      subst r
      refine ⟨(t,()),?_,?_⟩
      · simpa [index] using hc
      · simp [pullDecoration,index]
  rw [he] at hB
  exact hB

name: OAI.Higman.RecordedMachine.benign_accepted
statement:
theorem benign_accepted (hD : ∀ e, Group.IsFinitelyPresented (edges e).Domain) :
    IsBenign (Subgroup.closure (acceptedOutputs edges seed halt))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : ℤ := Fintype.card E + 2
  let digit : E → ℤ := fun e ↦ ((Fintype.equivFin E e).val : ℤ) + 2
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; omega
  have hd : ∀ e, 2 ≤ digit e ∧ digit e < b := by
    intro e
    have hh := (Fintype.equivFin E e).isLt
    dsimp [digit,b]
    constructor <;> omega
  have hi : Function.Injective digit := by
    intro e f h
    apply (Fintype.equivFin E).injective
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [digit] at h
    omega
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (T × Counter) := finitelyPresented_prod
  have hp := MarkerEmbedding.benign_output (decoration edges b digit)
    {c | Forward edges b digit seed c}
    (benign_forward edges b digit hb seed hd hi hD) halt
  have he : decoration edges b digit ''
      {c | c ∈ {c | Forward edges b digit seed c} ∧ c.2 = halt} =
      acceptedOutputs edges seed halt := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c,⟨⟨s,hs,hh⟩,hc⟩,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨s,forget c,hs,hc,?_⟩
      dsimp [decoration]
      rw [hh,HistoryMachine.decoration_code b digit hb hd hi]
    · rintro ⟨s,c,hs,hc,rfl⟩
      refine ⟨augment c (IntegerStack.code b digit s),⟨?_,hc⟩,?_⟩
      · exact ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩
      · exact HistoryMachine.decoration_code b digit hb hd hi _ s
  rwa [he] at hp

name: OAI.Higman.finitelyPresented_pi
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_pi (I : Type u) [Finite I] (G : Type v) [Group G]
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (I → G)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finite.induction_empty_option _ _ _ I
  · intro A B e ih
    have := ih
    exact Group.IsFinitelyPresented.equiv (MulEquiv.arrowCongr e (MulEquiv.refl G))
  · infer_instance
  · intro A _ ih
    have := ih
    have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (G × (A → G)) := finitelyPresented_prod
    let e : (Option A → G) ≃* G × (A → G) :=
      { Equiv.piOptionEquivProd with map_mul' := fun _ _ ↦ rfl }
    exact Group.IsFinitelyPresented.equiv e.symm

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.scale_injective
statement: lemma scale_injective (b : ℤ) (hb : b ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (scale b)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Multiplicative.toAdd.injective
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hb (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h)

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.encode_injective
statement: lemma encode_injective : Function.Injective (encode b digit)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ IntegerStack.code_injective b digit hb hd hi (congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h)

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.local_sound
statement:
theorem local_sound (p q : Q) (w : G) (o : Op Γ)
    (x : (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).Domain) (s : List Γ)
    (h : (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputLinear x *
      (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputOffset = encode b digit s) :
    ∃ t, (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputLinear x *
      (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputOffset = encode b digit t ∧ o.Rel s t
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | push a =>
    change x * 1 = encode b digit s at h
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    subst x
    exact ⟨a::s,rfl,rfl⟩
  | pop a =>
    change Counter at x
    have hh : b*x.toAdd + digit a = IntegerStack.code b digit s :=
      congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h
    obtain ⟨t,rfl,ht⟩ := (IntegerStack.decode_push b digit hb hd hi a x.toAdd s).mp hh
    refine ⟨t,?_,rfl⟩
    change x * 1 = encode b digit t
    rw [mul_one]
    exact Multiplicative.toAdd.injective ht
  | peek a =>
    change Counter at x
    have hh : b*x.toAdd + digit a = IntegerStack.code b digit s :=
      congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd h
    obtain ⟨t,ht,_⟩ := (IntegerStack.decode_push b digit hb hd hi a x.toAdd s).mp hh
    exact ⟨s,h,rfl,t,ht⟩
  | empty =>
    have hh : encode b digit [] = encode b digit s := by
      change (1 : Counter) * encode b digit [] = encode b digit s at h
      simpa only [one_mul] using h
    have hs : s = [] := (encode_injective b digit hb hd hi hh).symm
    exact ⟨[],rfl,hs,rfl⟩
  | idle => exact ⟨s,h,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.local_complete
statement:
theorem local_complete (p q : Q) (w : G) (o : Op Γ) (s t : List Γ) (h : o.Rel s t) :
    ∃ x : (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).Domain,
      (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputLinear x *
        (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputOffset = encode b digit s ∧
      (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputLinear x *
        (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputOffset = encode b digit t
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | push a => exact ⟨encode b digit s, mul_one _, by cases h; rfl⟩
  | pop a => exact ⟨encode b digit t, by cases h; rfl, mul_one _⟩
  | peek a =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,r,rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨encode b digit r,rfl,rfl⟩
  | empty =>
    obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := h
    exact ⟨PUnit.unit,rfl,rfl⟩
  | idle => exact ⟨encode b digit s,mul_one _,by cases h; exact mul_one _⟩

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.insertLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma insertLinear_apply {A : Type} [Group A] (k : K) (f : A →* Counter)
    (x : A × Rest k) (j : K) : insertLinear k f x j =
      if h : j = k then f x.1 else x.2 ⟨j,h⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.insertLinear_injective
statement:
lemma insertLinear_injective {A : Type} [Group A] (k : K) (f : A →* Counter)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) : Function.Injective (insertLinear k f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply hf
    simpa [insertLinear] using congrFun h k
  · funext j
    simpa [insertLinear,j.property] using congrFun h j.val

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.liftEdge_finitelyPresented
statement:
lemma liftEdge_finitelyPresented [Finite K] (k : K) (e : Edge G Counter Q)
    [Group.IsFinitelyPresented e.Domain] : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (liftEdge k e).Domain
proof:
:= by
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (Rest k) := finitelyPresented_pi _ _
  exact finitelyPresented_prod

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.action_finitelyPresented
statement:
lemma action_finitelyPresented [Finite K] (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ) :
    Group.IsFinitelyPresented (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).Domain
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o => exact liftEdge_finitelyPresented _ _
  | idle => exact finitelyPresented_pi _ _

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.action_sound
statement:
theorem action_sound (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ)
    (x : (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).Domain) (S : K → List Γ)
    (h : (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).inputLinear x *
      (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).inputOffset = encodeStores b digit S) :
    ∃ T, (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).outputLinear x *
      (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).outputOffset = encodeStores b digit T ∧ a.Rel S T
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o =>
    change (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).Domain × Rest k at x
    have input_eq (j : K) :
        (if hj : j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputLinear x.1
          else x.2 ⟨j,hj⟩) *
        (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputOffset else 1) =
          encode b digit (S j) := congrFun h j
    have hk : (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputLinear x.1 *
        (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputOffset = encode b digit (S k) := by
      simpa using input_eq k
    obtain ⟨t,ht,hr⟩ := local_sound b digit hb hd hi p q w o x.1 (S k) hk
    refine ⟨Function.update S k t,?_,t,hr,rfl⟩
    funext j
    change (if hj : j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputLinear x.1
        else x.2 ⟨j,hj⟩) *
      (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputOffset else 1) =
        encode b digit (Function.update S k t j)
    by_cases hj : j = k
    · subst j
      simpa using ht
    · simpa [hj] using input_eq j
  | idle => exact ⟨S,h,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.action_complete
statement:
theorem action_complete (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ) (S T : K → List Γ) (h : a.Rel S T) :
    ∃ x : (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).Domain,
      (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).inputLinear x *
        (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).inputOffset = encodeStores b digit S ∧
      (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).outputLinear x *
        (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).outputOffset = encodeStores b digit T
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o =>
    obtain ⟨t,hr,rfl⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨x,hs,ht⟩ := local_complete b digit hb p q w o (S k) t hr
    refine ⟨(x,fun j ↦ encode b digit (S j.val)),?_,?_⟩
    · funext j
      change (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputLinear x
          else encode b digit (S j)) *
        (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).inputOffset else 1) =
          encode b digit (S j)
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        simpa using hs
      · simp [hj]
    · funext j
      change (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputLinear x
          else encode b digit (S j)) *
        (if j = k then (localEdge b digit (by omega) p q w o).outputOffset else 1) =
          encode b digit (Function.update S k t j)
      by_cases hj : j = k
      · subst j
        simpa using ht
      · simp [hj]
  | idle => exact ⟨encodeStores b digit S,mul_one _,by cases h; exact mul_one _⟩

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.actionEdge_inputState
statement:
@[simp] lemma actionEdge_inputState (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ) :
    (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).inputState = p
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o => cases o <;> rfl
  | idle => rfl

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.actionEdge_outputState
statement:
@[simp] lemma actionEdge_outputState (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ) :
    (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).outputState = q
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o => cases o <;> rfl
  | idle => rfl

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.actionEdge_weight
statement:
@[simp] lemma actionEdge_weight (p q : Q) (w : G) (a : Action K Γ) :
    (actionEdge b digit hb p q w a).weight = w
proof:
:= by
  cases a with
  | onStack k o => cases o <;> rfl
  | idle => rfl

name: OAI.Higman.AffineStack.encodeStores_injective
statement: lemma encodeStores_injective : Function.Injective (encodeStores (K := K) b digit)
proof:
:= by
  intro S T h
  funext k
  exact encode_injective b digit hb hd hi (congrFun h k)

name: OAI.Higman.StackProgram.run_sound
statement:
theorem run_sound {s : List E} {c : Stores K × Q}
    (h : HistoryMachine.Run (fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).input)
      (fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).output) (encodeStores b digit seed.1,seed.2) s c) :
    ∃ S, encodeStores b digit S = c.1 ∧ Run prog seed s (S,c.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | start => exact ⟨seed.1,rfl,Run.start⟩
  | @step s e x h ih =>
    obtain ⟨S,hS,hR⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨T,hT,hr⟩ := action_sound b digit hb hd hi (prog e).source (prog e).target
      (prog e).weight (prog e).action x S hS.symm
    refine ⟨T,hT.symm,?_⟩
    simp only [Edge.input,Instruction.edge,actionEdge_inputState] at hR
    simpa only [Edge.output,Instruction.edge,actionEdge_outputState] using Run.step e S T hr hR

name: OAI.Higman.StackProgram.run_complete
statement:
theorem run_complete {s : List E} {c : (K → List Γ) × Q} (h : Run prog seed s c) :
    HistoryMachine.Run (fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).input)
      (fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).output) (encodeStores b digit seed.1,seed.2)
      s (encodeStores b digit c.1,c.2)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | start => exact HistoryMachine.Run.start
  | @step s e S T hr h ih =>
    obtain ⟨x,hS,hT⟩ := action_complete b digit hb (prog e).source (prog e).target
      (prog e).weight (prog e).action S T hr
    have hin : ((prog e).edge b digit hb).input x = (encodeStores b digit S,(prog e).source) := by
      apply Prod.ext hS
      exact actionEdge_inputState _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    have hout : ((prog e).edge b digit hb).output x = (encodeStores b digit T,(prog e).target) := by
      apply Prod.ext hT
      exact actionEdge_outputState _ _ _ _ _ _ _
    rw [← hout]
    apply HistoryMachine.Run.step (input := fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).input)
      (output := fun e ↦ ((prog e).edge b digit hb).output) e x
    rwa [hin]

name: OAI.Higman.StackProgram.benign_outputs
statement: theorem benign_outputs : IsBenign (Subgroup.closure (outputs prog seed halt))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : ℤ := Fintype.card Γ + 2
  let digit : Γ → ℤ := fun a ↦ ((Fintype.equivFin Γ a).val : ℤ) + 2
  have hb : 2 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; omega
  have hd : ∀ a, 2 ≤ digit a ∧ digit a < b := by
    intro a
    have hh := (Fintype.equivFin Γ a).isLt
    dsimp [digit,b]
    constructor <;> omega
  have hi : Function.Injective digit := by
    intro a c h
    apply (Fintype.equivFin Γ).injective
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [digit] at h
    omega
  have : Group.IsFinitelyPresented (Stores K) := finitelyPresented_pi _ _
  have hp := RecordedMachine.benign_accepted (fun e ↦ (prog e).edge b digit hb)
    (encodeStores b digit seed.1,seed.2) halt
    (fun e ↦ action_finitelyPresented b digit hb (prog e).source (prog e).target
      (prog e).weight (prog e).action)
  have he : RecordedMachine.acceptedOutputs (fun e ↦ (prog e).edge b digit hb)
      (encodeStores b digit seed.1,seed.2) halt = outputs prog seed halt := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s,c,hs,hc,hg⟩
      obtain ⟨S,_,hR⟩ := run_sound prog seed b digit hb hd hi hs
      refine ⟨s,S,?_,?_⟩
      · rwa [hc] at hR
      · simpa only [Instruction.edge,actionEdge_weight] using hg
    · rintro ⟨s,S,hs,hg⟩
      refine ⟨s,(encodeStores b digit S,halt),run_complete prog seed b digit hb hs,rfl,?_⟩
      simpa only [Instruction.edge,actionEdge_weight] using hg
  rwa [he] at hp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.of_compat
statement:
lemma of_compat (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (x : X i) :
    of X f j (f i j h x) = of X f i x
proof: := DirectLimit.mk_apply i j x h

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.continuous_iff
statement:
lemma continuous_iff {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] (g : Space X f → Y) :
    Continuous g ↔ ∀ n, Continuous (g ∘ of X f n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_coinduced_dom,continuous_sigma_iff]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.continuous_of
statement: lemma continuous_of (n : ℕ) : Continuous (of X f n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous (fun x : Σ n, X n => of X f x.1 x.2) := continuous_coinduced_rng
  exact h.comp continuous_sigmaMk

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.isClosed_iff
statement:
lemma isClosed_iff (A : Set (Space X f)) :
    IsClosed A ↔ ∀ n, IsClosed (of X f n ⁻¹' A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isClosed_coinduced]
  exact isClosed_sigma_iff

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.of_injective
statement: lemma of_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (of X f n)
proof:
:=
  DirectLimit.mk_injective f (fun i j h => (hf i j h).injective) n

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.preimage_of_image_le
statement:
lemma preimage_of_image_le (i j : ℕ) (h : i ≤ j) (A : Set (X i)) :
    of X f j ⁻¹' (of X f i '' A) = f i j h '' A
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,hxy⟩
    refine ⟨x,hx,?_⟩
    apply of_injective X f hf j
    exact (of_compat X f i j h x).trans hxy
  · rintro ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x,hx,(of_compat X f i j h x).symm⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TopologicalTower.preimage_of_image_ge
statement:
