  change (p.trans q).extend _ = (p.trans q).extend _
  rw [add_comm (t:ℝ) (s:ℝ)]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.diagonalSquare_zero_right
statement:
lemma diagonalSquare_zero_right (p : Path x y) (q : Path y z) (t : I) :
    diagonalSquare p q (t,0) = p t
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalSquare_symm,diagonalSquare_zero_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.diagonalSquare_one_right
statement:
lemma diagonalSquare_one_right (p : Path x y) (q : Path y z) (t : I) :
    diagonalSquare p q (t,1) = q t
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalSquare_symm,diagonalSquare_one_left]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.diagonalSquare_continuous
statement:
lemma diagonalSquare_continuous {a b c : X → Y}
    (p : ∀ x,Path (a x) (b x)) (q : ∀ x,Path (b x) (c x))
    (hp : Continuous (fun z : X × I => p z.1 z.2))
    (hq : Continuous (fun z : X × I => q z.1 z.2)) :
    Continuous (fun z : X × (I × I) => diagonalSquare (p z.1) (q z.1) z.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Path.continuous_uncurry_extend_of_continuous_family
    (fun x => (p x).trans (q x)) (Path.trans_continuous_family p hp q hq)).comp
      (continuous_fst.prodMk (by fun_prop))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.PathFamilies.diagonalSquare_continuous_params
statement:
lemma diagonalSquare_continuous_params {a b c : X → Y}
    (p : ∀ x,Path (a x) (b x)) (q : ∀ x,Path (b x) (c x))
    (hp : Continuous (fun z : X × I => p z.1 z.2))
    (hq : Continuous (fun z : X × I => q z.1 z.2)) :
    Continuous (fun z : I × (I × X) => diagonalSquare (p z.2.2) (q z.2.2) (z.1,z.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : I × (I × X) => (z.2.2,(z.1,z.2.1))) :=
    continuous_snd.snd.prodMk (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd.fst)
  exact (diagonalSquare_continuous p q hp hq).comp hc

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.shift_vertex
statement:
lemma shift_vertex (c : C) (x : A) :
    shift τ F (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x) = vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) (F c x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.shift_edge
statement:
lemma shift_edge (c : C) (t : I) (x : A) :
    shift τ F (edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F c t x) = edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) t (F c x)
proof:
:=
  lift_edge τ _ F _ _ _ _ c (t,x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.shiftEdge_continuous
statement:
lemma shiftEdge_continuous (c : C) :
    Continuous (fun z : I × (I × A) =>
      PathFamilies.diagonalSquare (edgePath τ (fun _ => .id A) F c z.2.2)
        (edgePath τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) (F c z.2.2)) (z.1,z.2.1))
proof:
:= by
  let p : ∀ x : A, Path (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x)
      (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) (F c x)) := edgePath τ (fun _ => .id A) F c
  let q : ∀ x : A, Path (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) (F c x))
      (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ (τ c)) (F (τ c) (F c x))) :=
    fun x => edgePath τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c) (F c x)
  have hp : Continuous (fun z : A × I => p z.1 z.2) :=
    (edgeMap τ (fun _ => .id A) F c).continuous.comp continuous_swap
  have hq : Continuous (fun z : A × I => q z.1 z.2) :=
    (edgeMap τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ c)).continuous.comp
      (continuous_snd.prodMk ((F c).continuous.comp continuous_fst))
  exact PathFamilies.diagonalSquare_continuous_params p q hp hq

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.forward_natural
statement:
lemma forward_natural (n : ℕ) (c : C) (x : A) :
    forward τ F n (τ c) (F c x) = F (τ^[n] c) (forward τ F n c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change F (τ^[n] (τ c)) (forward τ F n (τ c) (F c x)) =
      F (τ^[n+1] c) (F (τ^[n] c) (forward τ F n c x))
    rw [ih,Function.iterate_succ_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.shiftIterate_vertex
statement:
lemma shiftIterate_vertex (n : ℕ) (c : C) (x : A) :
    shiftIterate τ F n (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x) =
      vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ^[n] c) (forward τ F n c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change shift τ F (shiftIterate τ F n (vertex τ (fun _ => .id A) F c x)) = _
    rw [ih,shift_vertex,Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.shiftIterate_edge
statement:
lemma shiftIterate_edge (n : ℕ) (c : C) (t : I) (x : A) :
    shiftIterate τ F n (edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F c t x) =
      edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F (τ^[n] c) t (forward τ F n c x)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    change shift τ F (shiftIterate τ F n (edge τ (fun _ => .id A) F c t x)) = _
    rw [ih,shift_edge,Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Milnor.iterateHom_comm
statement: lemma iterateHom_comm (f : G →* G) (n : ℕ) (g : G) : iterateHom f n (f g) = f (iterateHom f n g)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => exact congrArg f ih

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TorusGeometry.forward_eq
statement:
lemma forward_eq (n : ℕ) (c : Coset f) (x : Milnor.Space U) :
    GraphBundle.forward (next f) (transition f) n c x =
      forwardOffset f n c • Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id x
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    change x = 1 • Milnor.map (id : U → U) id Function.injective_id x
    rw [one_smul,Milnor.map_id]
  | succ n ih =>
    change transition f ((next f)^[n] c) (GraphBundle.forward (next f) (transition f) n c x) = _
    rw [ih,transition_apply]
    refine (congrArg (cosetOffset f ((next f)^[n] c) • ·)
      (Milnor.map_smul f (forwardOffset f n c) _)).trans ?_
    rw [←mul_smul]
    change (cosetOffset f ((next f)^[n] c) * f (forwardOffset f n c)) •
      Milnor.map f id Function.injective_id (Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id x) = _
    rw [Milnor.map_comp]
    rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TorusGeometry.forward_naturality
statement:
lemma forward_naturality (n : ℕ) (c : Coset f) (x : Milnor.Space U) :
    transition f ((next f)^[n] c)
      (forwardOffset f n c • Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id x) =
      forwardOffset f n (next f c) • Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id (transition f c x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←forward_eq,←forward_eq]
  exact (GraphBundle.forward_natural (next f) (transition f) n c x).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TorusGeometry.stage_shift_vertex
statement:
lemma stage_shift_vertex (S : Shapes U) (n : ℕ) (c : Coset f) (x : Milnor.Stage U (vertexShapes f S)) :
    GraphBundle.shiftIterate (next f) (transition f) n
      (stageFull f S (GraphBundle.vertex _ _ _ c x)) =
    vertex f ((next f)^[n] c)
      (forwardOffset f n c • Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id (Milnor.stageFull U _ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageFull_vertex]
  exact (GraphBundle.shiftIterate_vertex _ _ n c _).trans (congrArg (vertex f _) (forward_eq f n c _))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.TorusGeometry.stage_shift_edge
statement:
lemma stage_shift_edge (S : Shapes U) (n : ℕ) (c : Coset f) (t : I) (x : Milnor.Stage U S) :
    GraphBundle.shiftIterate (next f) (transition f) n
      (stageFull f S (GraphBundle.edge _ _ _ c t x)) =
    GraphBundle.edge _ _ _ ((next f)^[n] c) t
      (forwardOffset f n c • Milnor.map (iterateHom f n) id Function.injective_id (Milnor.stageFull U _ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageFull_edge,GraphBundle.shiftIterate_edge,forward_eq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.discrete_dimension
statement: lemma discrete_dimension (m : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell (Set.univ : Set C) m) : m < 1
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m => exact i.elim

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.graph_dimension
statement: lemma graph_dimension [Nonempty C] (m : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell (Set.univ : Set (Graph τ)) m) : m < 2
proof:
:=
  layerCW_dimensions _ discrete_dimension m i

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.cell_minus
statement: lemma cell_minus (c : C) : cell (attaching τ) c (boundary 1 Cayley.minus) = vertex τ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell_boundary]; simp only [attaching,Cayley.minus,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,ite_true]; rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.cell_plus
statement: lemma cell_plus (c : C) : cell (attaching τ) c (boundary 1 Cayley.plus) = vertex τ (τ c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cell_boundary]; norm_num [attaching,Cayley.plus,vertex]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.edgeSquare_source
statement: lemma edgeSquare_source (c : C) (t : I) : edgeSquare τ f y p hp c (t,0) = PathSquares.pauseReverse (p c) t
proof:
:=
  (PathSquares.edgeSquare (p c) (p (τ c)) ((edge τ c).map f.continuous) (hp c)).choose_spec.1 t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.edgeSquare_target
statement: lemma edgeSquare_target (c : C) (t : I) : edgeSquare τ f y p hp c (t,1) = PathSquares.pauseReverse (p (τ c)) t
proof:
:=
  (PathSquares.edgeSquare (p c) (p (τ c)) ((edge τ c).map f.continuous) (hp c)).choose_spec.2 t

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.edgePaths_boundary
statement:
lemma edgePaths_boundary (c : C) (t : Sphere 1) :
    edgePaths τ f y p hp c (boundary 1 t) = vertexPaths τ f y p (attaching τ c t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|rfl := Cayley.sphere_one_eq t
  · apply ContinuousMap.ext; intro z
    change edgeSquare τ f y p hp c (z,Cayley.edgeTime (boundary 1 Cayley.minus)) = _
    rw [Cayley.edgeTime_minus,edgeSquare_source]
    simp only [vertexPaths,attaching,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,Cayley.minus,ite_true]
  · apply ContinuousMap.ext; intro z
    change edgeSquare τ f y p hp c (z,Cayley.edgeTime (boundary 1 Cayley.plus)) = _
    rw [Cayley.edgeTime_plus,edgeSquare_target]
    norm_num [vertexPaths,attaching,Cayley.plus]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.graphPaths_zero
statement: lemma graphPaths_zero (z : Graph τ) : graphPaths τ f y p hp z 0 = f z
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | inl c => exact Path.source _
  | inr z =>
    change edgeSquare τ f y p hp z.1 (0,Cayley.edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)) = _
    rw [ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_zero]
    change f (cell _ z.1 (Cayley.edgeParam (Cayley.edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)))) = f _
    rw [Cayley.edgeParam_time,cell_interior]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.graphPaths_one
statement: lemma graphPaths_one (z : Graph τ) : graphPaths τ f y p hp z 1 = y
proof:
:= by
  cases z with
  | inl c => exact Path.target _
  | inr z =>
    change edgeSquare τ f y p hp z.1 (1,Cayley.edgeTime (interior 1 z.2)) = y
    exact ContinuousMap.Homotopy.apply_one _ _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.height_iterate
statement: lemma height_iterate (c : C) (n : ℕ) : h (τ^[n] c) = h c + n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply',hτ,ih]; push_cast; omega

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.rayProduct_add
statement:
lemma rayProduct_add (c : C) (n k : ℕ) :
    rayProduct τ w c (n+k) = rayProduct τ w c n * rayProduct τ w (τ^[n] c) k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [rayProduct]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [Nat.add_succ,rayProduct,ih,rayProduct,mul_assoc]
    congr 2
    rw [Function.iterate_add_apply]
    exact congrArg w ((Function.Commute.iterate_iterate (Function.Commute.refl τ) n k).eq c)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.rayProduct_first
statement:
lemma rayProduct_first (c : C) (n : ℕ) :
    rayProduct τ w c (n+1) = w c * rayProduct τ w (τ c) n
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm 1 n,rayProduct,Function.iterate_zero,Function.id_def,one_mul,
    Function.iterate_one] using rayProduct_add τ w c 1 n

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.route_independent
statement:
lemma route_independent (c d : C) (p q p' q' : ℕ)
    (he : τ^[p] c = τ^[q] d) (he' : τ^[p'] c = τ^[q'] d) :
    rayProduct τ w c p * (rayProduct τ w d q)⁻¹ =
      rayProduct τ w c p' * (rayProduct τ w d q')⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (p:ℤ) + q' = (p':ℤ) + q := by
    have ha := congrArg h he
    have hb := congrArg h he'
    rw [height_iterate τ h hτ,height_iterate τ h hτ] at ha hb
    omega
  have hlen' : p + q' = p' + q := by omega
  have enlarge (a b : C) (i j k : ℕ) (hab : τ^[i] a = τ^[j] b) :
      rayProduct τ w a i * (rayProduct τ w b j)⁻¹ =
      rayProduct τ w a (i+k) * (rayProduct τ w b (j+k))⁻¹ := by
    rw [rayProduct_add,rayProduct_add,hab,mul_inv_rev]
    group
  rw [enlarge c d p q q' he,enlarge c d p' q' q he',hlen',Nat.add_comm q' q]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.potential_route
statement:
lemma potential_route (c : C) (p q : ℕ) (he : τ^[p] root = τ^[q] c) :
    potential τ w hc root c = rayProduct τ w root p * (rayProduct τ w c q)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact route_independent τ h hτ w root c _ _ p q (hc root c).choose_spec.choose_spec he

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedTree.potential_edge
statement: lemma potential_edge (c : C) : potential τ w hc root c * w c = potential τ w hc root (τ c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,he⟩ := hc root (τ c)
  have he' : τ^[p] root = τ^[q+1] c := by simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply] using he
  rw [potential_route τ h hτ w hc root c p (q+1) he',
    potential_route τ h hτ w hc root (τ c) p q he,rayProduct_first]
  group

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.ray_joined
statement: lemma ray_joined (c : C) (n : ℕ) : Joined (vertex τ c) (vertex τ (τ^[n] c))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Joined.refl _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    exact ih.trans ⟨edge τ (τ^[n] c)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.vertex_joined
statement: lemma vertex_joined (c : C) : Joined (vertex τ root) (vertex τ c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,he⟩ := hc root c
  have hd : Joined (vertex τ c) (vertex τ (τ^[p] root)) := by
    rw [he]; exact ray_joined τ c q
  exact (ray_joined τ root p).trans hd.symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.treeClass_edge
statement:
lemma treeClass_edge (c : C) : (treeClass τ hc root c).trans (edgeClass τ c) =
    treeClass τ hc root (τ c)
proof:
:= by
  have he := DirectedTree.potential_edge τ h hτ (edgeWeight τ hc root) hc root c
  have he' := congrArg MulOpposite.unop he
  simp only [MulOpposite.unop_mul,FundamentalGroup.mul_def,edgeWeight,MulOpposite.unop_op] at he'
  have hh := congrArg (fun (k : FundamentalGroup (Graph τ) (vertex τ root)) =>
    k.trans (initialClass τ hc root (τ c))) he'
  simpa only [treeClass,Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl] using hh

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.treePath_edge
statement:
lemma treePath_edge (c : C) : ((treePath τ hc root c).trans (edge τ c)).Homotopic
    (treePath τ hc root (τ c))
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.Homotopic.Quotient.exact
  change (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (treePath τ hc root c)).trans (edgeClass τ c) = _
  unfold treePath
  rw [(Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective (treeClass τ hc root c)).choose_spec,
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_surjective (treeClass τ hc root (τ c))).choose_spec]
  exact treeClass_edge τ h hτ hc root c

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.DirectedGraph.tree_contractible
statement: lemma tree_contractible : ContractibleSpace (Graph τ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (contractible_iff_id_nullhomotopic _).mpr
  refine ⟨vertex τ root,⟨graphNullhomotopy τ (.id _) (vertex τ root)
    (treePath τ hc root) ?_⟩⟩
  intro c
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.coe_id,Path.map_id] using treePath_edge τ h hτ hc root c

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.treeProjection_vertex
statement:
lemma treeProjection_vertex (c : C) (x : A) :
    treeProjection τ L R (vertex τ L R c x) = DirectedGraph.vertex τ c
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.treeProjection_edge
statement:
lemma treeProjection_edge (c : C) (t : I) (x : B) :
    treeProjection τ L R (edge τ L R c t x) = DirectedGraph.edge τ c t
proof:
:=
  lift_edge τ L R _ _ _ _ c (t,x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.pathMap_boundary
statement:
lemma pathMap_boundary (y : C → Y) (p : ∀ c,Path (y c) (y (τ c))) (c : C)
    (x : Attachment.Sphere 1) :
    p c (Cayley.edgeTime (Attachment.boundary 1 x)) = y (DirectedGraph.attaching τ c x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl|rfl := Cayley.sphere_one_eq x
  · rw [Cayley.edgeTime_minus,Path.source]
    simp only [DirectedGraph.attaching,Cayley.minus,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,ite_true]
  · rw [Cayley.edgeTime_plus,Path.target]
    norm_num [DirectedGraph.attaching,Cayley.plus]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.treePathMap_vertex
statement:
lemma treePathMap_vertex (y : C → Y) (p : ∀ c,Path (y c) (y (τ c))) (c : C) :
    treePathMap τ y p (DirectedGraph.vertex τ c) = y c
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.treePathMap_edge
statement:
lemma treePathMap_edge (y : C → Y) (p : ∀ c,Path (y c) (y (τ c))) (c : C) (t : I) :
    treePathMap τ y p (DirectedGraph.edge τ c t) = p c t
proof:
:= by
  change Attachment.lift _ _ _ _ (Attachment.cell _ c (Cayley.edgeParam t)) = _
  rw [Attachment.lift_cell]
  change p c (Cayley.edgeTime (Cayley.edgeParam t)) = p c t
  rw [Cayley.edgeTime_param]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.nullhomotopic_of_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma nullhomotopic_of_fiber_constant (h : C → ℤ) (hτ : ∀ c,h (τ c) = h c+1)
    (hc : ∀ c d,∃ m n : ℕ,τ^[m] c = τ^[n] d) (root : C)
    (f : C(Space τ L R,Y)) (y : C → Y) (p : ∀ c,Path (y c) (y (τ c)))
    (hv : ∀ c x,f (vertex τ L R c x) = y c)
    (he : ∀ c t x,f (edge τ L R c t x) = p c t) : f.Nullhomotopic
proof:
:= by
  have := DirectedGraph.tree_contractible τ h hτ hc root
  have hf : f = (treePathMap τ y p).comp (treeProjection τ L R) := by
    apply hom_ext τ L R
    · intro c x
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.comp_apply,treeProjection_vertex,treePathMap_vertex] using hv c x
    · intro c z
      simpa only [ContinuousMap.comp_apply,treeProjection_edge,treePathMap_edge] using he c z.1 z.2
  rw [hf]
  have hn := (id_nullhomotopic (DirectedGraph.Graph τ)).comp_right (treePathMap τ y p)
  exact hn.comp_left (treeProjection τ L R)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.connectorPath_continuous
statement:
lemma connectorPath_continuous (c : C) : Continuous (fun p : (I × B) × I =>
    connectorPath τ L R f y V b H Q qleft qright c p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun p : (I × B) × I => Q c p.1.2 p.1.1 p.2)
  exact (Q c).uncurry.uncurry.continuous.comp
    ((continuous_fst.snd.prodMk continuous_fst.fst).prodMk continuous_snd)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.gluedPath_continuous
statement:
lemma gluedPath_continuous (c : C) : Continuous (fun p : (I × B) × I =>
    gluedPath τ L R f y V a b e H Q qleft qright c p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact Path.trans_continuous_family (fun z : I × B => e c (H c z))
    ((he c).comp (((H c).continuous.comp continuous_fst).prodMk continuous_snd))
    (connectorPath τ L R f y V b H Q qleft qright c)
    (connectorPath_continuous τ L R f y V b H Q qleft qright c)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.gluedPath_zero
statement:
lemma gluedPath_zero (c : C) (x : B) (s : I) :
    gluedPath τ L R f y V a b e H Q qleft qright c (0,x) s =
      f (pause τ L R (edge τ L R c s x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [pause_edge τ L R c (s,x)]
  change ((e c (H c (0,x))).trans (connectorPath τ L R f y V b H Q qleft qright c (0,x))) s =
    f ((edgePath τ L R c x).trans (Path.refl _) s)
  rw [Path.trans_apply,Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with hs
  · exact e0 c x _
  · exact q0 c x _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.collapsed_edge
statement:
lemma collapsed_edge (c : C) (s : I) (x : B) :
    collapsed τ L R y p (edge τ L R c s x) = p c s
proof:
:=
  lift_edge τ L R _ _ _ _ c (s,x)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.GraphBundle.nullhomotopic_of_coherent_contraction
statement:
theorem nullhomotopic_of_coherent_contraction
    (height : C → ℤ) (hτ : ∀ c,height (τ c) = height c+1)
    (hc : ∀ c d,∃ m n : ℕ,τ^[m] c = τ^[n] d) (root : C) : f.Nullhomotopic
proof:
:= by
  have hn := nullhomotopic_of_fiber_constant τ L R height hτ hc root
    (collapsed τ L R y p) y p (fun _ _ => rfl) (collapsed_edge τ L R y p)
  obtain ⟨z,⟨K⟩⟩ := hn
  refine ⟨z,⟨?_⟩⟩
  have J := coherentHomotopy τ L R f y V a b e he H Q hleft qleft qright e0 q0 p e1
  have P := (ContinuousMap.Homotopy.refl f).comp (pauseHomotopy τ L R)
  exact P.symm.trans (J.trans K)

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.reaches_stepAux
statement:
theorem reaches_stepAux (q : Stmt K Γ Λ σ) (v : σ) (S : K → List Γ) :
    StateTransition.Reaches (step M) (S,some q,v) (translate M (TM2.stepAux q v S))
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing v S with
  | push k f r ih =>
    exact ReflTransGen.head rfl (ih v (update S k (f v :: S k)))
  | peek k f r ih => exact ReflTransGen.head rfl (ih (f v (S k).head?) S)
  | pop k f r ih =>
    exact ReflTransGen.head rfl (ih (f v (S k).head?) (update S k (S k).tail))
  | load f r ih => exact ReflTransGen.head rfl (ih (f v) S)
  | branch f r t ihr iht =>
    cases h : f v
    · simp only [TM2.stepAux,h,Bool.cond_false]
      exact ReflTransGen.head
        (show (S,some t,v) ∈ step M (S,some (.branch f r t),v) by simp [step,h]) (iht v S)
    · simp only [TM2.stepAux,h,Bool.cond_true]
      exact ReflTransGen.head
        (show (S,some r,v) ∈ step M (S,some (.branch f r t),v) by simp [step,h]) (ihr v S)
  | goto f => exact ReflTransGen.single rfl
  | halt => exact ReflTransGen.single rfl

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.translate_step
statement:
theorem translate_step {c d : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K ↦ Γ) Λ σ} (h : d ∈ TM2.step M c) :
    StateTransition.Reaches (step M) (translate M c) (translate M d)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨_ | l,v,S⟩
  · simp [TM2.step] at h
  · have hh : d = TM2.stepAux (M l) v S := by simpa [TM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact reaches_stepAux M (M l) v S

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.translate_reaches
statement:
theorem translate_reaches {c d : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K ↦ Γ) Λ σ}
    (h : TM2.Reaches M c d) : StateTransition.Reaches (step M) (translate M c) (translate M d)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail h hd ih => exact ih.trans (translate_step M hd)

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.project_step
statement:
theorem project_step {c d : Cfg K Γ Λ σ} (h : d ∈ step M c) :
    TM2.Reaches M (project c) (project d)
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨S,_ | q,v⟩
  · simp [step] at h
  · cases q with
    | push k f r =>
      have hd : d = (update S k (f v :: S k),some r,v) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | peek k f r =>
      have hd : d = (S,some r,f v (S k).head?) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | pop k f r =>
      have hd : d = (update S k (S k).tail,some r,f v (S k).head?) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | load f r =>
      have hd : d = (S,some r,f v) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | branch f r t =>
      have hd : d = (S,some (if f v then r else t),v) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      cases h : f v <;> simp [project,TM2.stepAux,h,TM2.Reaches] <;> exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | goto f =>
      have hd : d = (S,some (M (f v)),v) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.single rfl
    | halt =>
      have hd : d = (S,none,v) := by simpa [step] using h.symm
      subst d
      exact ReflTransGen.refl

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.project_reaches
statement:
theorem project_reaches {c d : Cfg K Γ Λ σ} (h : StateTransition.Reaches (step M) c d) :
    TM2.Reaches M (project c) (project d)
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail h hd ih => exact ih.trans (project_step M hd)

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.reaches_project_translate
statement:
theorem reaches_project_translate (c : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K ↦ Γ) Λ σ) :
    TM2.Reaches M c (project (translate M c))
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨_ | l,v,S⟩
  · exact ReflTransGen.refl
  · exact ReflTransGen.single rfl

name: OAI.Higman.MicroTM2.reaches_halt_iff
statement:
theorem reaches_halt_iff (c : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : K ↦ Γ) Λ σ) (S : K → List Γ) (v : σ) :
    TM2.Reaches M c ⟨none,v,S⟩ ↔
      StateTransition.Reaches (step M) (translate M c) (S,none,v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact translate_reaches M
  · intro h
    exact (reaches_project_translate M c).trans (project_reaches M h)

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.readOp_rel
statement:
lemma readOp_rel (pop : Bool) (a : Option Γ) (s t : List Γ) :
    (readOp pop a).Rel s t ↔ a = s.head? ∧ t = (if pop then s.tail else s)
proof:
:= by
  cases pop <;> cases a <;> cases s <;> simp [readOp,Op.Rel] <;> aesop

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.readAction_rel
statement:
lemma readAction_rel (pop : Bool) (a : Option Γ) (k : K) (S T : K → List Γ) :
    (Action.onStack k (readOp pop a)).Rel S T ↔
      a = (S k).head? ∧ T = (if pop then update S k (S k).tail else S)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Action.Rel,readOp_rel]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,⟨h,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨h,?_⟩
    cases pop <;> simp
  · rintro ⟨h,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨if pop then (S k).tail else S k,⟨h,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    cases pop <;> simp

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.raw_sound
statement:
lemma raw_sound (q : Stmt K Γ Λ σ) (v : σ) (a : Option Γ) (S T : K → List Γ)
    (h : (rawAction q v a).Rel S T) :
    (T,rawTarget M q v a) ∈ MicroTM2.step M (S,some q,v)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | push k f r =>
    obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := h
    cases ht
    rfl
  | peek k f r =>
    obtain ⟨ha,rfl⟩ := (readAction_rel false a k S T).mp h
    simp [rawTarget,MicroTM2.step,ha]
  | pop k f r =>
    obtain ⟨ha,rfl⟩ := (readAction_rel true a k S T).mp h
    simp [rawTarget,MicroTM2.step,ha]
  | load f r | branch f r t | goto f | halt =>
    cases h
    rfl

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.raw_complete
statement:
lemma raw_complete (q : Stmt K Γ Λ σ) (v : σ) (S : K → List Γ) (d : Cfg K Γ Λ σ)
    (h : d ∈ MicroTM2.step M (S,some q,v)) :
    ∃ a, (rawAction q v a).Rel S d.1 ∧ d.2 = rawTarget M q v a
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | push k f r =>
    have hd : d = (update S k (f v :: S k),some r,v) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨none,⟨f v :: S k,rfl,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  | peek k f r =>
    have hd : d = (S,some r,f v (S k).head?) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨(S k).head?,(readAction_rel false _ k S S).mpr ⟨rfl,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  | pop k f r =>
    have hd : d = (update S k (S k).tail,some r,f v (S k).head?) := by
      simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨(S k).head?,(readAction_rel true _ k S _).mpr ⟨rfl,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
  | load f r =>
    have hd : d = (S,some r,f v) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨none,rfl,rfl⟩
  | branch f r t =>
    have hd : d = (S,some (if f v then r else t),v) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨none,rfl,rfl⟩
  | goto f =>
    have hd : d = (S,some (M (f v)),v) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨none,rfl,rfl⟩
  | halt =>
    have hd : d = (S,none,v) := by simpa [MicroTM2.step] using h.symm
    subst d
    exact ⟨none,rfl,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.target_mem
statement:
lemma target_mem (q : Stmt K Γ Λ σ) (hq : some q ∈ TM2.stmts M L) (v : σ) (a : Option Γ) :
    (rawTarget M q v a).1 ∈ TM2.stmts M L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : TM2.SupportsStmt L q := by
    obtain ⟨l,hl,hh⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (Finset.some_mem_insertNone.mp hq)
    exact TM2.stmts₁_supportsStmt_mono hh (hL l hl)
  cases q with
  | push k f r | peek k f r | pop k f r | load f r =>
    exact TM2.stmts_trans (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self]) hq
  | branch f r t =>
    dsimp [rawTarget]
    split_ifs
    · exact TM2.stmts_trans (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self]) hq
    · exact TM2.stmts_trans (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self]) hq
  | goto f =>
    apply Finset.some_mem_insertNone.mpr
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨f v,hs v,TM2.stmts₁_self⟩
  | halt => exact Finset.none_mem_insertNone

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.compile_sound
statement:
lemma compile_sound (e : Edge M L) (S T : K → List Γ)
    (h : (compile (G := G) M L hL e).action.Rel S T) :
    forget M L (T,(compile (G := G) M L hL e).target) ∈
      MicroTM2.step M (forget M L (S,(compile (G := G) M L hL e).source))
proof:
:=
  raw_sound M e.1.val e.2.1 e.2.2 S T h

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.compile_complete
statement:
lemma compile_complete (c : (K → List Γ) × State M L) (d : Cfg K Γ Λ σ)
    (h : d ∈ MicroTM2.step M (forget M L c)) :
    ∃ e : Edge M L, c.2 = (compile (G := G) M L hL e).source ∧
      (compile (G := G) M L hL e).action.Rel c.1 d.1 ∧
      forget M L (d.1,(compile (G := G) M L hL e).target) = d
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨S,⟨_ | q,hq⟩,v⟩
  · simp [forget,MicroTM2.step] at h
  · obtain ⟨a,ha,hd⟩ := raw_complete M q v S d h
    refine ⟨(⟨q,hq⟩,v,a),rfl,ha,?_⟩
    change (d.1,rawTarget M q v a) = d
    rw [← hd]

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.run_sound
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | start => exact ReflTransGen.refl
  | step e S T hr h ih => exact ih.tail (compile_sound M L hL e S T hr)

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.reaches_complete
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨[],seed,Run.start,rfl⟩
  | @tail d f hr hd ih =>
    obtain ⟨s,c,hc,rfl⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨e,he,ha,hf⟩ := compile_complete (G := G) M L hL c f hd
    refine ⟨e::s,(f.1,(compile (G := G) M L hL e).target),?_,hf⟩
    apply Run.step e c.1 f.1 ha
    simpa only [← he] using hc

name: OAI.Higman.TM2StackCompiler.weights_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma weights_one (s : List (Edge M L)) :
    HistoryMachine.value (fun e ↦ (compile (G := G) M L hL e).weight) s = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e s ih => simpa only [HistoryMachine.value,compile,mul_one] using ih

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniversalGroup.countable_universal
statement:
theorem countable_universal {G : Type*} [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] :
    ∃ φ : G →* CountableUniversal, Function.Injective φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,s,hs,⟨e⟩⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.exists_mulEquiv_presentedGroup (G := G)
  let p : PresentationCode := ⟨n,hs.toFinset⟩
  have heq : (p.2 : Set (FreeGroup (Fin p.1))) = s := hs.coe_toFinset
  let a : G ≃* Presented p := e.trans (QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq
    (congrArg Subgroup.normalClosure heq.symm))
  exact ⟨(Monoid.CoprodI.of (i := p)).comp a.toMonoidHom,
    (Monoid.CoprodI.of_injective p).comp a.injective⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.shift_of
statement: @[simp] lemma shift_of (n k : ℤ) : shift n (FreeGroup.of k) = FreeGroup.of (n+k)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.test_a
statement: @[simp] lemma test_a : test a = SemidirectProduct.inr (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [test,a]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.test_p
statement: @[simp] lemma test_p : test p = SemidirectProduct.inl (FreeGroup.of 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [test,p]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.test_word
statement:
lemma test_word (i : ℕ) : test (word i) =
    SemidirectProduct.inl (FreeGroup.of (i : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [word,map_mul,map_pow,map_inv,test_a,test_p]
  rw [← map_pow,← map_inv,← SemidirectProduct.inl_aut]
  congr 1
  change shift ((Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ)) ^ i).toAdd (FreeGroup.of 0) = _
  simp

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.test_comp
statement:
lemma test_comp : test.comp inclusion =
    (SemidirectProduct.inl : FreeGroup ℤ →* ShiftGroup).comp (FreeGroup.map Int.ofNat)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simpa only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, inclusion, FreeGroup.lift_apply_of, FreeGroup.map.of]
    using (test_word i).trans (congrArg SemidirectProduct.inl
      (congrArg FreeGroup.of (show (i : ℤ) = Int.ofNat i from rfl)))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.FreeConjugates.inclusion_injective
statement: lemma inclusion_injective : Function.Injective inclusion
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := test)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,test_comp]
  exact SemidirectProduct.inl_injective.comp (FreeGroup.map_injective Int.ofNat_injective)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.left_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma left_of (i : ℕ) : left (C := C) (FreeGroup.of i) =
    Coprod.inr (FreeConjugates.word i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [left,MonoidHom.comp_apply,FreeConjugates.inclusion,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.right_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma right_of (i : ℕ) : right c (FreeGroup.of i) =
    Coprod.inl (c i) * Coprod.inr (FreeConjugates.word i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [right,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.left_injective
statement: lemma left_injective : Function.Injective (left (C := C))
proof:
:=
  Coprod.inr_injective.comp FreeConjugates.inclusion_injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.projection_right
statement: lemma projection_right : (projection (C := C)).comp (right c) = FreeConjugates.inclusion
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp [projection,right,FreeConjugates.inclusion]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.right_injective
statement: lemma right_injective : Function.Injective (right c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := projection)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,projection_right]
  exact FreeConjugates.inclusion_injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.embed_injective
statement: lemma embed_injective : Function.Injective (embed c)
proof:
:=
  (HNNExtension.of_injective (φ := associated c)).comp Coprod.inl_injective

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.associated_left
statement:
lemma associated_left (g : FreeGroup ℕ) : associated c ⟨left g,⟨g,rfl⟩⟩ =
    ⟨right c g,⟨g,rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  change (MonoidHom.ofInjective (right_injective c))
    ((MonoidHom.ofInjective (left_injective (C := C))).symm
      ((MonoidHom.ofInjective (left_injective (C := C))) g)) = _
  rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.generator_formula
statement:
lemma generator_formula (i : ℕ) : embed c (c i) =
    t c * (a c ^ i * p c * (a c ^ i)⁻¹) * (t c)⁻¹ *
      (a c ^ i * p c * (a c ^ i)⁻¹)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := HNNExtension.equiv_eq_conj (φ := associated c)
    (⟨left (FreeGroup.of i),⟨FreeGroup.of i,rfl⟩⟩ : (left (C := C)).range)
  rw [associated_left] at h
  change HNNExtension.of (right c (FreeGroup.of i)) = _ at h
  simp only [right_of,left_of,map_mul] at h
  have hw : (HNNExtension.of (Coprod.inr (FreeConjugates.word i)) : Overgroup c) =
      a c ^ i * p c * (a c ^ i)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [FreeConjugates.word,map_mul,map_inv,map_pow,a,p]
  rw [hw] at h
  change embed c (c i) * _ = t c * _ * (t c)⁻¹ at h
  rw [← h]
  group

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.closure_three_of_generates
statement:
lemma closure_three_of_generates (hc : Subgroup.closure (Set.range c) = ⊤) :
    Subgroup.closure ({a c,p c,t c} : Set (Overgroup c)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let S := Subgroup.closure ({a c,p c,t c} : Set (Overgroup c))
  have ha : a c ∈ S := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hp : p c ∈ S := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have ht : t c ∈ S := Subgroup.subset_closure (by simp)
  have hgen : Set.range c ⊆ S.comap (embed c) := by
    rintro _ ⟨i,rfl⟩
    change embed c (c i) ∈ S
    rw [generator_formula]
    have hv := S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem ha i) hp) (S.inv_mem (S.pow_mem ha i))
    exact S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem ht hv) (S.inv_mem ht)) (S.inv_mem hv)
  have htop : ⊤ ≤ S.comap (embed c) := by
    rw [← hc]
    exact (Subgroup.closure_le _).mpr hgen
  have hcS (g : C) : embed c g ∈ S := htop (Subgroup.mem_top g)
  have hfS (g : FreeConjugates.Two) :
      (HNNExtension.of (Coprod.inr g) : Overgroup c) ∈ S := by
    induction g using FreeGroup.induction_on with
    | one => simp
    | of b => cases b <;> assumption
    | inv_of g hg => simpa only [map_inv] using S.inv_mem hg
    | mul g h hg hh => simpa only [map_mul] using S.mul_mem hg hh
  apply top_unique
  intro g hg
  clear hg
  change g ∈ S
  induction g using HNNExtension.induction_on with
  | of g =>
    induction g using Coprod.induction_on with
    | inl g => exact hcS g
    | inr g => exact hfS g
    | mul g h hg hh => simpa only [map_mul] using S.mul_mem hg hh
  | t => exact ht
  | mul g h hg hh => exact S.mul_mem hg hh
  | inv g hg => exact S.inv_mem hg

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.closure_three
statement:
lemma closure_three (hc : Function.Surjective c) :
    Subgroup.closure ({a c,p c,t c} : Set (Overgroup c)) = ⊤
proof:
:=
  closure_three_of_generates c (by rw [Set.range_eq_univ.mpr hc,Subgroup.closure_univ])

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.finitely_generated
statement: lemma finitely_generated (hc : Function.Surjective c) : Group.FG (Overgroup c)
proof:
:=
  Group.fg_iff.mpr ⟨{a c,p c,t c},closure_three c hc,by simp⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.CountableOvergroup.countable_embeds_three_generated
statement:
theorem countable_embeds_three_generated [Countable C] :
    ∃ (V : Type u) (_ : Group V) (_ : Group.FG V),
      ∃ e : C →* V, Function.Injective e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := exists_surjective_nat C
  exact ⟨Overgroup c,inferInstance,finitely_generated c hc,embed c,embed_injective c⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ThreePresentation.lift_substitute
statement:
lemma lift_substitute : (FreeGroup.lift (generator rels)).comp substitute =
    (CountableOvergroup.embed (PresentedGroup.of (rels := rels))).comp
      (PresentedGroup.mk rels)
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,substitute,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of,
    map_mul,map_inv,conjugate,map_pow,A,P,T,generator]
  exact (CountableOvergroup.generator_formula _ i).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ThreePresentation.substituted_relation
statement:
lemma substituted_relation (r : Words) (hr : r ∈ substitute '' rels) :
    FreeGroup.lift (generator rels) r = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,rfl⟩ := hr
  change ((FreeGroup.lift (generator rels)).comp substitute) r = 1
  rw [lift_substitute,MonoidHom.comp_apply,PresentedGroup.one_of_mem hr,map_one]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ThreePresentation.fromC_of
statement:
lemma fromC_of (i : ℕ) : fromC rels (PresentedGroup.of i) =
    (PresentedGroup.mk (substitute '' rels))
      (T * conjugate i * T⁻¹ * (conjugate i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  change (PresentedGroup.mk _) (substitute (FreeGroup.of i)) = _
  rw [substitute,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ThreePresentation.toV_comp_fromC
statement:
lemma toV_comp_fromC : (toV rels).comp (fromC rels) =
    CountableOvergroup.embed (PresentedGroup.of (rels := rels))
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro i
  rw [MonoidHom.comp_apply,fromC_of]
  change (FreeGroup.lift (generator rels))
    (T * conjugate i * T⁻¹ * (conjugate i)⁻¹) = _
  simp only [map_mul,map_inv,conjugate,map_pow,T,A,P,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of,generator]
  exact (CountableOvergroup.generator_formula _ i).symm

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.ThreePresentation.fromC_injective
statement: theorem fromC_injective : Function.Injective (fromC rels)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := toV rels)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,toV_comp_fromC]
  exact CountableOvergroup.embed_injective _

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.rawAt_encode
statement: lemma rawAt_encode (P : Code) (j : ℕ) : rawAt (Encodable.encode P) j = P.getD j []
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawAt]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.coloured_relation
statement:
lemma coloured_relation (P : Code) (w : Word) (hw : w ∈ P) :
    FreeGroup.map (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode P)) (FreeGroup.mk w) ∈ allRelations
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem?.mp hw
  refine ⟨Nat.pair (Encodable.encode P) j,?_⟩
  simp only [relator,Nat.unpair_pair,rawAt_encode,List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,hj,
    Option.getD_some,colour,FreeGroup.map.mk]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.eval_colour
statement:
lemma eval_colour (P : Code) (m : ℕ) :
    (FreeGroup.lift (project P)).comp (FreeGroup.map (Nat.pair m)) =
      if m = Encodable.encode P then PresentedGroup.mk (relations P) else 1
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro i
  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply,FreeGroup.map.of,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of,project,
    Nat.unpair_pair]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.raw_relation
statement:
lemma raw_relation (P : Code) (j : ℕ) :
    PresentedGroup.mk (relations P) (FreeGroup.mk (P.getD j [])) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]
  cases hj : P[j]? with
  | none => change (PresentedGroup.mk (relations P)) 1 = 1; exact map_one _
  | some w =>
    simp only [Option.getD_some]
    exact PresentedGroup.one_of_mem ⟨w,List.mem_of_getElem? hj,rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.project_relator
statement:
lemma project_relator (P : Code) (k : ℕ) :
    FreeGroup.lift (project P) (FreeGroup.mk (relator k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change FreeGroup.lift (project P)
    (FreeGroup.mk ((rawAt k.unpair.1 k.unpair.2).map
      (fun x => (Nat.pair k.unpair.1 x.1,x.2)))) = 1
  rw [← FreeGroup.map.mk]
  rw [← MonoidHom.comp_apply]
  rw [eval_colour]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h,rawAt_encode]
    exact raw_relation P _
  · rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.retract_embed
statement: lemma retract_embed (P : Code) : (retract P).comp (embed P) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro i
  change FreeGroup.lift (project P) (FreeGroup.map (Nat.pair (Encodable.encode P))
    (FreeGroup.of i)) = PresentedGroup.of i
  simp [project]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.embed_injective
statement: lemma embed_injective (P : Code) : Function.Injective (embed P)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := retract P)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,retract_embed]
  exact Function.injective_id

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.renameValues_comp
statement:
lemma renameValues_comp {α β : Type*} (i : α ↪ β) (s : Set (FreeGroup α)) :
    (FreeGroup.lift (renameValues i s)).comp (FreeGroup.map i) = PresentedGroup.mk s
proof:
:= by
  apply FreeGroup.ext_hom
  intro a
  simp [renameValues,i.injective.extend_apply,PresentedGroup.of]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.renameRetract_comp
statement:
lemma renameRetract_comp {α β : Type*} (i : α ↪ β) (s : Set (FreeGroup α)) :
    (renameRetract i s).comp (rename i s) = MonoidHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply PresentedGroup.ext
  intro a
  change FreeGroup.lift (renameValues i s) (FreeGroup.map i (FreeGroup.of a)) =
    PresentedGroup.of a
  simp [renameValues,i.injective.extend_apply]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.rename_injective
statement:
lemma rename_injective {α β : Type*} (i : α ↪ β) (s : Set (FreeGroup α)) :
    Function.Injective (rename i s)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Injective.of_comp (f := renameRetract i s)
  rw [← MonoidHom.coe_comp,renameRetract_comp]
  exact Function.injective_id

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.code_exists
statement: lemma code_exists (s : Set (FreeGroup ℕ)) (hs : s.Finite) : ∃ P : Code, relations P = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨hs.toFinset.toList.map FreeGroup.toWord,?_⟩
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w,hw,rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨q,hq,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hw
    rw [FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
    exact hs.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_toList.mp hq)
  · intro hr
    refine ⟨r.toWord,?_,FreeGroup.mk_toWord⟩
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨r,Finset.mem_toList.mpr (hs.mem_toFinset.mpr hr),rfl⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.universal
statement:
theorem universal {G : Type*} [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] :
    ∃ h : G →* Universal, Function.Injective h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,s,hs,⟨e⟩⟩ := Group.IsFinitelyPresented.exists_mulEquiv_presentedGroup (G := G)
  let i : Fin n ↪ ℕ := ⟨Fin.val,Fin.val_injective⟩
  obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := code_exists (FreeGroup.map i '' s) (hs.image _)
  let eP : PresentedGroup (FreeGroup.map i '' s) ≃* PresentedGroup (relations P) :=
    QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq (congrArg Subgroup.normalClosure hP.symm)
  exact ⟨(embed P).comp (eP.toMonoidHom.comp ((rename i s).comp e.toMonoidHom)),
    (embed_injective P).comp (eP.injective.comp ((rename_injective i s).comp e.injective))⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.rawAt_primrec
statement: lemma rawAt_primrec : Primrec₂ rawAt
proof:
:= by
  unfold rawAt
  exact (Primrec.list_getD []).comp
    (Primrec.option_getD.comp (Primrec.decode.comp Primrec.fst) (Primrec.const [])) Primrec.snd

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.colour_primrec
statement: lemma colour_primrec : Primrec₂ colour
proof:
:= by
  unfold Primrec₂ colour
  apply Primrec.list_map Primrec.snd
  exact (Primrec₂.natPair.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.fst)
    (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd)).pair (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversal.relator_primrec
statement: theorem relator_primrec : Primrec relator
proof:
:= by
  unfold relator
  exact colour_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair)
    (rawAt_primrec.comp (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.unpair) (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.unpair))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.mk_positive
statement: lemma mk_positive (i : ℕ) : FreeGroup.mk (positive i) = A ^ i
proof:
:= by
  induction i with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    simp only [positive,List.replicate_succ]
    change A * FreeGroup.mk (positive i) = A ^ (i+1)
    rw [ih,pow_succ']

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.mk_v
statement: lemma mk_v (i : ℕ) : FreeGroup.mk (v i) = conjugate i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [v,← FreeGroup.mul_mk,← FreeGroup.inv_mk,mk_positive,conjugate]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.mk_replacement
statement:
lemma mk_replacement (i : ℕ) : FreeGroup.mk (replacement i) =
    substitute (FreeGroup.of i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [replacement,← FreeGroup.mul_mk,← FreeGroup.inv_mk,mk_v,
    substitute,FreeGroup.lift_apply_of]
  rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.mk_substituteRaw
statement:
lemma mk_substituteRaw (w : RecursiveUniversal.Word) : FreeGroup.mk (substituteRaw w) =
    substitute (FreeGroup.mk w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | nil => exact (map_one substitute).symm
  | cons x w ih =>
    rcases x with ⟨i,b⟩
    cases b with
    | false =>
      change FreeGroup.mk (FreeGroup.invRev (replacement i) ++ substituteRaw w) =
        substitute ((FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ * FreeGroup.mk w)
      rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk,← FreeGroup.inv_mk,mk_replacement,map_mul,map_inv,ih]
    | true =>
      change FreeGroup.mk (replacement i ++ substituteRaw w) =
        substitute (FreeGroup.of i * FreeGroup.mk w)
      rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk,mk_replacement,map_mul,ih]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerated_relations
statement:
lemma enumerated_relations : Set.range (fun k => FreeGroup.mk (enumerator k)) =
    substitute '' RecursiveUniversal.allRelations
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨FreeGroup.mk (RecursiveUniversal.relator k),⟨k,rfl⟩,(mk_substituteRaw _).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_,⟨k,rfl⟩,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k,mk_substituteRaw _⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.invRev_primrec
statement: lemma invRev_primrec : Primrec (@FreeGroup.invRev Alphabet)
proof:
:= by
  unfold FreeGroup.invRev
  apply Primrec.list_reverse.comp
  apply Primrec.list_map Primrec.id
  exact (Primrec.fst.comp Primrec.snd).pair
    ((Primrec.dom_bool Bool.not).comp (Primrec.snd.comp Primrec.snd))

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.positive_primrec
statement: lemma positive_primrec : Primrec positive
proof:
:= by
  have h : Primrec (fun i : ℕ => (List.range i).map (fun _ => ((Sum.inl false,true) : Alphabet × Bool))) :=
    Primrec.list_map Primrec.list_range (Primrec₂.const _)
  apply h.of_eq
  intro i
  simp only [List.map_const',List.length_range,positive]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.v_primrec
statement: lemma v_primrec : Primrec v
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_append.comp
    (Primrec.list_append.comp positive_primrec (Primrec.const _))
    (invRev_primrec.comp positive_primrec)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.replacement_primrec
statement: lemma replacement_primrec : Primrec replacement
proof:
:=
  Primrec.list_append.comp
    (Primrec.list_append.comp (Primrec.list_append.comp (Primrec.const _) v_primrec) (Primrec.const _))
    (invRev_primrec.comp v_primrec)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.substituteRaw_primrec
statement: lemma substituteRaw_primrec : Primrec substituteRaw
proof:
:= by
  have h : Primrec (fun x : ℕ × Bool =>
      if x.2 then replacement x.1 else FreeGroup.invRev (replacement x.1)) := by
    apply (Primrec.cond Primrec.snd (replacement_primrec.comp Primrec.fst)
      (invRev_primrec.comp (replacement_primrec.comp Primrec.fst))).of_eq
    intro x
    cases x.2 <;> rfl
  exact Primrec.list_flatMap Primrec.id (h.comp Primrec.snd)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerator_primrec
statement: theorem enumerator_primrec : Primrec enumerator
proof:
:=
  substituteRaw_primrec.comp RecursiveUniversal.relator_primrec

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.RecursiveUniversalThree.universal
statement:
theorem universal {G : Type*} [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G] :
    ∃ h : G →* Universal, Function.Injective h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := RecursiveUniversal.universal (G := G)
  let q := QuotientGroup.quotientMulEquivOfEq
    (congrArg Subgroup.normalClosure enumerated_relations.symm)
  exact ⟨q.toMonoidHom.comp ((ThreePresentation.fromC _).comp e),
    q.injective.comp ((ThreePresentation.fromC_injective _).comp he)⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.exists_universal_finitely_presented
statement:
theorem exists_universal_finitely_presented :
    ∃ (U : Type) (_ : Group U) (_ : Group.IsFinitelyPresented U),
      ∀ (G : Type z) [Group G] [Group.IsFinitelyPresented G],
        ∃ i : G →* U, Function.Injective i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U,gU,fpU,i,hi⟩ := Higman.NormalWords.embeds_presentation
    RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerator RecursiveUniversalThree.enumerator_primrec.to_comp
  refine ⟨U,gU,fpU,?_⟩
  intro G _ _
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := RecursiveUniversalThree.universal (G := G)
  exact ⟨i.comp j,hi.comp hj⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.transportedMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma transportedMap_apply (n : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell C n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    transportedMap hf n i x = f (RelCWComplex.map n i x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.transportedMap_source
statement:
lemma transportedMap_source (n : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell C n) :
    (transportedMap hf n i).source = ball 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transportedMap,PartialEquiv.trans_source,
    IsEmbedding.toPartialHomeomorph_source,Set.preimage_univ,Set.inter_univ,
    RelCWComplex.source_eq]

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.transportedMap_image
statement:
lemma transportedMap_image (n : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell C n) (S : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transportedMap hf n i '' S = f '' (RelCWComplex.map n i '' S)
proof:
:=
  Set.image_comp f (RelCWComplex.map n i) S

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.transportedMap_continuousOn
statement:
lemma transportedMap_continuousOn (n : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell C n) :
    ContinuousOn (transportedMap hf n i) (closedBall 0 1)
proof:
:=
  hf.continuous.comp_continuousOn (RelCWComplex.continuousOn n i)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.transportedMap_continuousOn_symm
statement:
lemma transportedMap_continuousOn_symm (n : ℕ) (i : RelCWComplex.cell C n) :
    ContinuousOn (transportedMap hf n i).symm (transportedMap hf n i).target
proof:
:= by
  let e := hf.isEmbedding.toPartialHomeomorph f
  change ContinuousOn (fun y => (RelCWComplex.map n i).symm (e.symm y))
    (e.target ∩ e.symm ⁻¹' (RelCWComplex.map n i).target)
  exact (RelCWComplex.continuousOn_symm n i).comp
    (e.continuousOn_symm.mono Set.inter_subset_left) (fun _ h => h.2)

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.UniverseTransport.liftedCover_quotient
statement:
lemma liftedCover_quotient : IsQuotientCoveringMap (liftedCover.{u,v} (p := p)) G where
  __
proof:
:= (Homeomorph.ulift.symm.isQuotientMap.comp hp.toIsQuotientMap).comp
    Homeomorph.ulift.isQuotientMap
  continuous_const_smul g := by
    change Continuous (fun e : ULift.{v} E => ULift.up (g • e.down))
    exact continuous_uliftUp.comp ((hp.continuous_const_smul g).comp continuous_uliftDown)
  apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit := by
    intro e₁ e₂
    change ULift.up (p e₁.down) = ULift.up (p e₂.down) ↔ e₁ ∈ MulAction.orbit G e₂
    rw [ULift.up_inj,hp.apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
      exact ⟨g,ULift.down_injective hg⟩
    · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
      exact ⟨g,congrArg ULift.down hg⟩
  disjoint e := by
    obtain ⟨U,hU,hd⟩ := hp.disjoint e.down
    refine ⟨ULift.down ⁻¹' U,continuous_uliftDown.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hU,?_⟩
    rintro g ⟨z,⟨y,hy,hyz⟩,hz⟩
    exact hd g ⟨z.down,⟨y.down,hy,congrArg ULift.down hyz⟩,hz⟩

name: OAI.UniversalFInfinity.Brown.geometric_lifted_of_uniform
statement: theorem geometric_lifted_of_uniform : HasTypeFInfinity (ULift.{z} G)
proof:
:= by
  let : T2Space (ULift.{z} (Base hunif)) := Homeomorph.ulift.symm.t2Space
  let : ContractibleSpace (ULift.{z} (Total hunif)) := Homeomorph.ulift.contractibleSpace
  let q : ULift.{z} (Total hunif) → ULift.{z} (Base hunif) :=
    liftedCover (p := pLimit hunif)
  have hq : IsQuotientCoveringMap q G := liftedCover_quotient (pLimit_covering hunif)
  let : ConnectedSpace (ULift.{z} (Base hunif)) := hq.surjective.connectedSpace hq.continuous
  let cw : CWComplex (univ : Set (ULift.{z} (Base hunif))) := liftCW
  refine ⟨ULift.{z} (Base hunif),inferInstance,inferInstance,inferInstance,cw,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro n
    change Finite (ULift.{z} ((baseCW hunif).cell n))
    have := base_finite hunif n
    infer_instance
  · let e : ULift.{z} (Total hunif) := Classical.choice inferInstance
    exact ⟨q e,⟨(hq.fundamentalGroupEquiv ⟨e,rfl⟩).trans
      ((MulEquiv.inv' G).symm.trans MulEquiv.ulift.symm)⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨ULift.{z} (Total hunif),inferInstance,inferInstance,q,hq.surjective,hq.isCoveringMap⟩

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_blockDiagonal
statement:
theorem entropy_blockDiagonal (A : μ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hA : ∀ m, (A m).IsHermitian) :
    entropy (Matrix.blockDiagonal A)=∑ m, entropy (A m)
proof:
:= by
  let U := blockUnitary (fun m ↦ (hA m).eigenvectorUnitary)
  let d : ι × μ → ℝ := fun im ↦ (hA im.2).eigenvalues im.1
  have he : Matrix.blockDiagonal A=Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U (Matrix.diagonal (fun im ↦ (d im:ℂ))) := by
    rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
    change Matrix.blockDiagonal A=Matrix.blockDiagonal _*Matrix.diagonal _*(Matrix.blockDiagonal _)ᴴ
    dsimp only [d]
    rw [← Matrix.blockDiagonal_diagonal (fun m i ↦ ((hA m).eigenvalues i:ℂ)),Matrix.blockDiagonal_conjTranspose,
      ← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul,← Matrix.blockDiagonal_mul]
    congr 1; funext m
    exact (hA m).spectral_theorem
  have hh : (Matrix.diagonal (fun im ↦ (d im:ℂ))).IsHermitian := by
    apply Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr
    intro im; exact Complex.conj_ofReal _
  rw [he,entropy_unitary_conj U hh,entropy_diagonal,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _
  exact (entropy_eq_sum (hA m)).symm

name: OAI.GAD.blockProjection_isProjection
statement: theorem blockProjection_isProjection (m : μ) : IsProjection (blockProjection (ι := ι) m)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply Matrix.isHermitian_diagonal_iff.mpr
    intro im; split_ifs <;> simp
  · rw [blockProjection,Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    congr 1; funext im; split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.GAD.blockProjection_mul
statement:
theorem blockProjection_mul (m : μ) (X : Matrix (ι × μ) κ ℂ) (ia : ι × μ) (j : κ) :
    (blockProjection (ι := ι) m*X) ia j=if ia.2=m then X ia j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [blockProjection,Matrix.diagonal_mul]

name: OAI.GAD.blockInjection_mul
statement:
theorem blockInjection_mul (m : μ) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ia : ι × μ) (j : κ) :
    (blockInjection (ι := ι) m*X) ia j=if ia.2=m then X ia.1 j else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [blockInjection,Matrix.mul_apply,ite_mul]

name: OAI.GAD.blockInjection_isometry
statement:
theorem blockInjection_isometry (m : μ) :
    (blockInjection (ι := ι) m)ᴴ*blockInjection (ι := ι) m=1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,blockInjection]
  simp [Matrix.one_apply,eq_comm]

name: OAI.GAD.blockProjection_range
statement:
theorem blockProjection_range {m : μ} {X : Matrix (ι × μ) κ ℂ}
    (hX : blockProjection (ι := ι) m*X=X) : blockInjection (ι := ι) m*(show Matrix ι κ ℂ from fun i j ↦ X (i,m) j)=X
proof:
:= by
  ext ia j
  have h := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (ι × μ) κ ℂ ↦ A ia j) hX
  rw [blockProjection_mul] at h
  rw [blockInjection_mul]
  split_ifs with hm
  · cases ia with | mk i a => change a=m at hm; subst a; rfl
  · simpa only [ite_eq_right hm] using h

name: OAI.GAD.mass_isometry
statement:
theorem mass_isometry {ρ : Type u_6} [Fintype ρ] (W : Matrix ρ ι ℂ)
    (hW : Wᴴ*W=1) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : mass (W*X)=mass X
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [mass,gram]
  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  have h : Xᴴ*Wᴴ*(W*X)=Xᴴ*X := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc _ W,Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ, hW,Matrix.mul_one]
  rw [h,Matrix.trace_mul_comm]

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_gram_isometry
statement:
theorem entropy_gram_isometry {ρ : Type u_7} [Fintype ρ] [DecidableEq ρ] [DecidableEq κ]
    (W : Matrix ρ ι ℂ) (hW : Wᴴ*W=1) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    entropy (gram (W*X))=entropy (gram X)
proof:
:= by
  change entropy ((W*X)*(W*X)ᴴ)=entropy (X*Xᴴ)
  rw [entropy_mul_conjTranspose,entropy_mul_conjTranspose X,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc _ W,Matrix.mul_assoc Xᴴ,hW,Matrix.mul_one]

name: OAI.GAD.block_factor_entropy
statement:
theorem block_factor_entropy [DecidableEq κ] (m : μ) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    entropy (gram (blockInjection (ι := ι) m*X))=entropy (gram X)
proof:
:=
  entropy_gram_isometry _ (blockInjection_isometry m) X

name: OAI.GAD.gram_blockInjection
statement:
theorem gram_blockInjection (m : μ) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ia jb : ι × μ) :
    gram (blockInjection (ι := ι) m*X) ia jb=
      if ia.2=m ∧ jb.2=m then gram X ia.1 jb.1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ k, (blockInjection (ι := ι) m*X) ia k*star ((blockInjection (ι := ι) m*X) jb k)) = _
  simp only [blockInjection_mul]
  by_cases hi : ia.2=m <;> by_cases hj : jb.2=m <;>
    simp [hi,hj,gram,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]

name: OAI.GAD.trace_product_nonneg
statement:
theorem trace_product_nonneg {A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ (A*B).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  let L := spectralFactor hB
  have hL : L*Lᴴ=B := spectralFactor_gram hB
  have h := (hA.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same L).trace_nonneg
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle] at h
  rw [hL] at h
  simpa only [Matrix.trace_mul_comm B A] using (Complex.nonneg_iff.mp h).1

name: OAI.GAD.trace_product_mono
statement:
theorem trace_product_mono {P A B : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef)
    (hAB : (B-A).PosSemidef) : (P*A).trace.re ≤ (P*B).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_product_nonneg hP hAB
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.trace_sub,Complex.sub_re,sub_nonneg] using h

name: OAI.GAD.IsState.le_one
statement: theorem IsState.le_one {A : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : IsState A) : (1-A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  let U := hA.1.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let l := hA.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  have hl : ∀ i, l i ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [← spectral_weights_sum hA]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hA.1.eigenvalues_nonneg j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hd : (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ ((1-l i:ℝ):ℂ))).PosSemidef := by
    apply Matrix.PosSemidef.diagonal
    intro i
    change (0:ℂ) ≤ ((1-l i:ℝ):ℂ)
    exact_mod_cast sub_nonneg.mpr (hl i)
  have he : 1-A=U.val*Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ ((1-l i:ℝ):ℂ))*U.valᴴ := by
    have hs := hA.1.isHermitian.spectral_theorem
    rw [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply] at hs
    have hd' : Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ ((1-l i:ℝ):ℂ))=1-Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ (l i:ℂ)) := by
      ext i j
      by_cases h : i=j <;> simp [h]
    rw [hd',Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_one]
    have hu : U.val*U.valᴴ=1 := by
      change U.val*star U.val=1
      exact Unitary.mul_star_self_of_mem U.prop
    rw [hu]
    exact congrArg (fun M ↦ 1-M) hs
  rw [he]
  exact hd.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same _

name: OAI.GAD.state_measurement_prob_le_trace
statement:
theorem state_measurement_prob_le_trace {A D : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hA : IsState A)
    (hD : D.PosSemidef) : (D*A).trace.re ≤ D.trace.re
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_one] using trace_product_mono hD hA.le_one

name: OAI.GAD.phase_rate_achievable
statement:
theorem phase_rate_achievable (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrχ : r < objective γ ν p) :
    Achievable γ ν (r/Real.log 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨q,U,hq,hs,hphase,hent⟩ := phase_spectral γ ν hγ hν hp
  let δ := (objective γ ν p-r)/4
  let K := 9*logVariance (meanPhaseWeights γ ν p)+8*logVariance q
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hb : 0 < objective γ ν p-2*δ-r := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hex (n : ℕ) : ∃ C : Code n, 0 < n →
      C.messages=codingMessages r n ∧ averageError γ ν C ≤
        K/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)+4*(codingMessages r n:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(objective γ ν p-2*δ)) := by
    by_cases hn : 0 < n
    · obtain ⟨C,hC,he⟩ := exists_phase_code γ ν hγ hν hp q U hq hs hphase hent hδ hn
        (codingMessages r n) (codingMessages_pos r n)
      exact ⟨C,fun _ ↦ ⟨hC,he⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨trivialCode n,fun hn' ↦ (hn hn').elim⟩
  choose C hC using hex
  refine ⟨C,?_,?_⟩
  · apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n ↦ averageError_nonneg γ ν hγ hν (C n)))
    · filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
      have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
      exact ((hC n hn0).2).trans (add_le_add le_rfl
        (coding_cross_bound hr (objective γ ν p-2*δ) n))
    · exact coding_error_tendsto K δ hb
  · intro ε hε
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop 1] with n hn
    have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
    rw [(hC n hn0).1]
    exact (sub_le_self _ hε.le).trans (codingMessages_rate r hn0)

name: OAI.GAD.code_success_dim_bound
statement:
theorem code_success_dim_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (C : Code n) :
    (∑ m, (C.decoding m*channel γ ν n (C.encoding m)).trace.re) ≤ (2:ℝ)^n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ m, (C.decoding m).trace.re := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ ↦
      state_measurement_prob_le_trace (channel_state γ ν hγ hν n (C.encoding_state m)) (C.decoding_pos m))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Complex.re_sum,← Matrix.trace_sum,C.decoding_sum,Matrix.trace_one]
      rw [basis_card,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      rw [← Complex.ofReal_ofNat,← Complex.ofReal_pow,Complex.ofReal_re]

name: OAI.GAD.code_messages_bound
statement:
theorem code_messages_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (C : Code n)
    (he : averageError γ ν C ≤ 1/2) : (C.messages:ℝ) ≤ 2*(2:ℝ)^n
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < (C.messages:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast C.messages_pos
  have hs := code_success_dim_bound γ ν hγ hν C
  dsimp [averageError] at he
  have ht : (1/2:ℝ)*(C.messages:ℝ) ≤ ∑ m, (C.decoding m*channel γ ν n (C.encoding m)).trace.re := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hM).mp
    linarith
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.code_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem code_entropy_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (C : Code n) {p : ℝ} (hp : Maximizes γ ν p)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Real.log (C.messages:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)*objective γ ν p+
      2*factorError ε (2*averageError γ ν C) (2^n*C.messages)
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin C.messages) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp C.messages_pos
  have h := cq_decoding_entropy_bound (fun m ↦ channel γ ν n (C.encoding m)) C.decoding
    (fun m ↦ channel_state γ ν hγ hν n (C.encoding_state m)) C.decoding_pos C.decoding_sum hε
  have hw (m : Fin C.messages) : uniformWeight (Fin C.messages) m=(C.messages:ℝ)⁻¹ := by
    simp only [uniformWeight,Fintype.card_fin]
  have he : 1-∑ m, uniformWeight (Fin C.messages) m*(C.decoding m*channel γ ν n (C.encoding m)).trace.re =
      averageError γ ν C := by
    simp only [hw,← Finset.mul_sum,averageError,div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [he,Fintype.card_prod,basis_card,Fintype.card_fin] at h
  have hu := ensemble_nats_upper γ ν hγ hν (codeEnsemble C) hp
  change entropy (∑ a, (((C.messages:ℝ)⁻¹:ℝ):ℂ) • channel γ ν n (C.encoding a)) -
    (∑ a, (C.messages:ℝ)⁻¹*entropy (channel γ ν n (C.encoding a))) ≤ (n:ℝ)*objective γ ν p at hu
  simp only [Complex.coe_smul] at hu
  simp only [hw] at h
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.code_log_dimension_bound
statement:
theorem code_log_dimension_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (C : Code n)
    (he : averageError γ ν C ≤ 1/2) :
    Real.log (2^n*C.messages:ℕ) ≤ 3*(n:ℝ)*Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < (C.messages:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast C.messages_pos
  have hpow : 0 < (2:ℝ)^n := by positivity
  have hb := code_messages_bound γ ν hγ hν C he
  have hl := Real.log_le_log hM hb
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 0) hpow.ne',Real.log_pow] at hl
  rw [Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat,Real.log_mul hpow.ne' hM.ne',Real.log_pow]
  have hn' : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hlog : 0 ≤ Real.log 2 := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GAD.code_log_rate_bound
statement:
theorem code_log_rate_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (C : Code n) {p : ℝ} (hp : Maximizes γ ν p)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (he : averageError γ ν C ≤ 1/2)
    (heε : averageError γ ν C ≤ 2*ε^2) :
    Real.log (C.messages:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)*objective γ ν p+
      12*ε*(n:ℝ)*Real.log 2+(2+4*ε)*Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := code_entropy_bound γ ν hγ hν C hp hε
  have hd : 0 < 2^n*C.messages := Nat.mul_pos (pow_pos (by norm_num) n) C.messages_pos
  have hb := factorError_mono hε hd (show 2*averageError γ ν C ≤ 4*ε^2 by nlinarith)
  have hlog := code_log_dimension_bound γ ν hγ hν hn C he
  have ht : factorError ε (4*ε^2) (2^n*C.messages)=
      2*ε*Real.log (2^n*C.messages:ℕ)+(1+2*ε)*Real.log 2 := by
    dsimp [factorError]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [ht] at hb
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlog (show 0 ≤ 2*ε by positivity)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GAD.achievable_upper
statement:
theorem achievable_upper (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p R : ℝ} (hp : Maximizes γ ν p)
    (hR : Achievable γ ν R) : R ≤ objective γ ν p/Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,herr,hrate⟩ := hR
  by_contra! hbad
  let χ := objective γ ν p/Real.log 2
  let ε := (R-χ)/28
  have hε : 0 < ε := by dsimp [ε,χ]; linarith
  have hl : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have he1 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, averageError γ ν (C n) < 1/2 :=
    herr.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2))
  have he2 : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop, averageError γ ν (C n) < 2*ε^2 :=
    herr.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2*ε^2))
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((2+4*ε)/ε)
  obtain ⟨n,hnR,hn1,hn2,hn⟩ := ((hrate ε hε).and (he1.and
    (he2.and (eventually_ge_atTop (max N 1))))).exists
  have hn0 : 0 < n := by omega
  have hnR0 : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn0
  have hNn : (N:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (le_trans (le_max_left N 1) hn)
  have hsmall : 2+4*ε ≤ ε*(n:ℝ) := by
    have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ hε).mp hN
    nlinarith
  have hupper := code_log_rate_bound γ ν hγ hν hn0 (C n) hp hε hn1.le hn2.le
  have hlower := (le_div_iff₀ hl).mp ((le_div_iff₀ hnR0).mp hnR)
  have hχ : χ*Real.log 2=objective γ ν p := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hl.ne'
  have hχn : (n:ℝ)*objective γ ν p=χ*(n:ℝ)*Real.log 2 := by rw [← hχ]; ring
  rw [hχn] at hupper
  have hsmall' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hl.le
  have hf : (R-χ-14*ε)*((n:ℝ)*Real.log 2) ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hg : 0 < R-χ-14*ε := by dsimp [ε]; change χ < R at hbad; linarith
  exact (not_le_of_gt (mul_pos hg (mul_pos hnR0 hl))) hf

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_zero (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 0 = !![(Real.sqrt (1 - ν) : ℂ), 0; 0, (Real.sqrt (1 - ν) * Real.sqrt (1 - γ) : ℂ)]
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [kraus]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_one
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_one (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 1 = !![0, (Real.sqrt (γ * (1 - ν)) : ℂ); 0, 0]
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [kraus]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_two
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_two (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 2 = !![(Real.sqrt ν * Real.sqrt (1 - γ) : ℂ), 0; 0, (Real.sqrt ν : ℂ)]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kraus, show (2 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 by decide, show (2 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 by decide, ite_false, ite_true]

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_three
statement: @[simp] theorem kraus_three (γ ν : ℝ) : kraus γ ν 3 = !![0, 0; (Real.sqrt (γ * ν) : ℂ), 0]
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kraus, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 0 by decide, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 1 by decide, show (3 : Fin 4) ≠ 2 by decide, ite_false]

name: OAI.GAD.sum_fin_cons
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (Fin.consEquiv (fun _ : Fin (n+1) ↦ α)).sum_comp f]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rfl

name: OAI.GAD.local_channel
statement:
theorem local_channel (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    applyKraus (kraus γ ν) P =
      !![((1-γ*ν:ℝ):ℂ)*P 0 0+((γ*(1-ν):ℝ):ℂ)*P 1 1,
         (Real.sqrt (1-γ):ℂ)*P 0 1;
         (Real.sqrt (1-γ):ℂ)*P 1 0,
         ((γ*ν:ℝ):ℂ)*P 0 0+((1-γ*(1-ν):ℝ):ℂ)*P 1 1]
proof:
:= by
  have hγ0 : 0 ≤ 1-γ := sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2
  have hν0 : 0 ≤ 1-ν := sub_nonneg.mpr hν.2
  have hs (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (Real.sqrt x : ℂ)^2 = (x:ℂ) := by
    norm_cast; exact Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have hsν := hs ν hν.1
  have hsγν := hs (ν*γ) (mul_nonneg hν.1 hγ.1)
  have hsγν' := hs (-(ν*γ)+γ) (by nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν0])
  simp only [applyKraus, Fin.sum_univ_four, kraus_zero, kraus_one, kraus_two, kraus_three]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
    ring_nf <;>
    simp only [hsν, hsγν, hsγν', hs (1-ν) hν0, hs (1-γ) hγ0] <;>
    push_cast <;> ring

name: OAI.GAD.kraus_complete
statement:
theorem kraus_complete (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ∑ r, (kraus γ ν r).conjTranspose * kraus γ ν r = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hγ0 : 0 ≤ 1-γ := sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2
  have hν0 : 0 ≤ 1-ν := sub_nonneg.mpr hν.2
  have hs (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (Real.sqrt x : ℂ)^2 = (x:ℂ) := by
    norm_cast; exact Real.sq_sqrt hx
  have hsν := hs ν hν.1
  have hsγν := hs (ν*γ) (mul_nonneg hν.1 hγ.1)
  have hsγν' := hs (-(ν*γ)+γ) (by nlinarith only [mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν0])
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four, kraus_zero, kraus_one, kraus_two, kraus_three]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;>
    ring_nf <;>
    simp only [hsν, hsγν, hsγν', hs (1-ν) hν0, hs (1-γ) hγ0] <;>
    push_cast <;> ring

name: OAI.GAD.tensorKraus_complete
statement:
theorem tensorKraus_complete (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ r, (tensorKraus γ ν n r).conjTranspose * tensorKraus γ ν n r = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, tensorKraus,
    star_prod]
  simp only [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have hinner (r : Fin n → Fin 4) :
      (∑ b : Basis n, ∏ k, star (kraus γ ν (r k) (b k) (i k)) * kraus γ ν (r k) (b k) (j k)) =
      ∏ k, ∑ b : Fin 2, star (kraus γ ν (r k) b (i k)) * kraus γ ν (r k) b (j k) :=
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k b ↦ star (kraus γ ν (r k) b (i k)) * kraus γ ν (r k) b (j k))).symm
  simp only [hinner]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun k r ↦ ∑ b : Fin 2,
    star (kraus γ ν r b (i k)) * kraus γ ν r b (j k))]
  have hc (k : Fin n) :
      (∑ r : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 2, star (kraus γ ν r b (i k)) * kraus γ ν r b (j k)) =
      if i k = j k then 1 else 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ ↦ A (i k) (j k))
      (kraus_complete γ ν hγ hν)
    simpa only [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
      Matrix.one_apply] using h
  simp_rw [hc]
  simp [Fintype.prod_ite_zero, funext_iff, Matrix.one_apply]

name: OAI.GAD.applyKraus_posSemidef
statement:
theorem applyKraus_posSemidef {ι : Type u_7} {κ : Type u_8} {ρ : Type u_9} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ)
    {P : Matrix κ κ ℂ} (hP : P.PosSemidef) : (applyKraus L P).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ ↦ Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr
    (hP.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (L r)))

name: OAI.GAD.applyKraus_trace
statement:
theorem applyKraus_trace {ι : Type u_10} {κ : Type u_11} {ρ : Type u_12} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    [DecidableEq κ] (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ)
    (hL : ∑ r, (L r).conjTranspose * L r = 1) (P : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    (applyKraus L P).trace = P.trace
proof:
:= by
  simp only [applyKraus, Matrix.trace_sum]
  calc
    _ = ∑ r, ((L r).conjTranspose * L r * P).trace := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      exact Matrix.trace_mul_cycle _ _ _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Matrix.trace_sum, ← Matrix.sum_mul, hL, Matrix.one_mul]

name: OAI.GAD.channel_trace
statement:
theorem channel_trace (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) (P : QMatrix n) :
    (channel γ ν n P).trace = P.trace
proof:
:=
  applyKraus_trace _ (tensorKraus_complete γ ν hγ hν n) P

name: OAI.GAD.channel_posSemidef
statement:
theorem channel_posSemidef (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {P : QMatrix n} (hP : P.PosSemidef) :
    (channel γ ν n P).PosSemidef
proof: := applyKraus_posSemidef _ hP

name: OAI.GAD.mul_pure_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem mul_pure_mul_conjTranspose {ι : Type u_13} {κ : Type u_14} [Fintype κ]
    (L : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) : L * pure ψ * L.conjTranspose = pure (L *ᵥ ψ)
proof:
:= by
  change L * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ (star ψ) * L.conjTranspose =
    Matrix.vecMulVec (L *ᵥ ψ) (star (L *ᵥ ψ))
  rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, ← Matrix.star_mulVec]

name: OAI.GAD.columns_mul_conjTranspose
statement:
theorem columns_mul_conjTranspose {ι : Type u_18} {κ : Type u_19} {ρ : Type u_20} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ φ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ * (columns L φ).conjTranspose =
      ∑ r, L r * Matrix.vecMulVec ψ (star φ) * (L r).conjTranspose
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, ← Matrix.star_mulVec]
  ext i j
  simp [columns, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply]

name: OAI.GAD.columns_pure
statement:
theorem columns_pure {ι : Type u_21} {κ : Type u_22} {ρ : Type u_23} [Fintype κ] [Fintype ρ]
    (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ * (columns L ψ).conjTranspose = applyKraus L (pure ψ)
proof:
:=
  columns_mul_conjTranspose L ψ ψ

name: OAI.GAD.averageError_nonneg
statement:
theorem averageError_nonneg (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (C : Code n) :
    0 ≤ averageError γ ν C
proof:
:= by
  have hM : 0 < (C.messages:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast C.messages_pos
  have hDs (m : Fin C.messages) : (1-C.decoding m).PosSemidef := by
    rw [← C.decoding_sum]
    have hle : C.decoding m ≤ ∑ j, C.decoding j := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun j _ ↦ Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mpr (C.decoding_pos j)) (Finset.mem_univ m)
    exact Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
  have hprob (m : Fin C.messages) : (C.decoding m*channel γ ν n (C.encoding m)).trace.re ≤ 1 := by
    have hA := channel_state γ ν hγ hν n (C.encoding_state m)
    have h := trace_product_mono hA.1 (hDs m)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ (C.decoding m),hA.2,Complex.one_re] using h
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun m _ ↦ hprob m)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hs
  dsimp [averageError]
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr ((div_le_one hM).mpr hs)

name: OAI.GAD.trivialCode_error
statement:
theorem trivialCode_error (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) : averageError γ ν (trivialCode n)=0
proof:
:= by
  have h := channel_state γ ν hγ hν n (phaseState_state (n := n) (p := 0) (by norm_num) (fun _ ↦ 0))
  dsimp only [averageError,trivialCode]
  simp only [Matrix.one_mul,Fin.sum_univ_one,Nat.cast_one,div_one]
  rw [h.2,Complex.one_re,sub_self]

name: OAI.GAD.zero_achievable
statement:
theorem zero_achievable (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) : Achievable γ ν 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨trivialCode,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [trivialCode_error γ ν hγ hν] using
      (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ ↦ (0:ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0))
  · intro ε hε
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro n
    simp only [trivialCode,Nat.cast_one,Real.log_one,zero_div,zero_sub]
    linarith

name: OAI.GAD.codingMessages_pos
statement: theorem codingMessages_pos (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : 0 < codingMessages r n
proof:
:=
  Nat.ceil_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos _)

name: OAI.GAD.codingMessages_bound
statement:
theorem codingMessages_bound {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    (codingMessages r n:ℝ) ≤ 2*Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (Real.exp_pos ((n:ℝ)*r)).le
  have h2 : 1 ≤ Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*r) := Real.one_le_exp_iff.mpr (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hr)
  dsimp only [codingMessages]
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.codingMessages_rate
statement:
theorem codingMessages_rate (r : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    r/Real.log 2 ≤ Real.log (codingMessages r n:ℝ)/Real.log 2/(n:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (n:ℝ)*r ≤ Real.log (codingMessages r n:ℝ) := by
    have hh := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos ((n:ℝ)*r)) (Nat.le_ceil (Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*r)))
    simpa only [Real.log_exp,codingMessages] using hh
  have hn' : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hl : 0 < Real.log 2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h hl.le) hn'.le
  have he : (n:ℝ)*r/Real.log 2/(n:ℝ)=r/Real.log 2 := by
    field_simp
  rw [he] at hh
  exact hh

name: OAI.GAD.coding_cross_bound
statement:
theorem coding_cross_bound {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    4*(codingMessages r n:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*a) ≤
      8*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(a-r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (codingMessages_bound hr n) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 4)) (Real.exp_pos (-(n:ℝ)*a)).le
  apply h.trans_eq
  rw [show 4*(2*Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*r))*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*a)=
    8*(Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*r)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*a)) by ring,← Real.exp_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.coding_error_tendsto
statement:
theorem coding_error_tendsto (K δ : ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ K/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)+8*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*b)) atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ K/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h := (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat K).div_const (δ^2)
    simpa only [div_div,zero_div] using h
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 8*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*b)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have he := tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (Real.exp_pos (-b)).le
      (Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (neg_neg_of_pos hb))
    have h := he.const_mul (8:ℝ)
    simpa only [mul_zero,← Real.exp_nat_mul,mul_neg,neg_mul] using h
  simpa only [zero_add] using h1.add h2

name: OAI.GAD.concaveOn_binEntropy
statement: theorem concaveOn_binEntropy : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) Real.binEntropy
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Icc _ _, ?_⟩
  intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
  have h₀ := Real.concaveOn_negMulLog.2 hp.1 hq.1 ha hb hab
  have h₁ := Real.concaveOn_negMulLog.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr hp.2) (sub_nonneg.mpr hq.2) ha hb hab
  have heq : 1-(a*p+b*q)=a*(1-p)+b*(1-q) := by nlinarith only [hab]
