  have he : deriv wootters =ᶠ[𝓝 s] woottersSlope := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with x hx
    exact deriv_wootters hx
  exact he.deriv_eq.trans (hasDerivAt_woottersSlope hs).deriv

name: OAI.GAD.convexOn_wootters
statement: theorem convexOn_wootters : ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) wootters
proof:
:= by
  apply convexOn_of_deriv2_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _) continuous_wootters.continuousOn
  · intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    exact (hasDerivAt_wootters hs).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    have he : deriv wootters =ᶠ[𝓝 s] woottersSlope := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hs] with x hx
      exact deriv_wootters hx
    exact ((hasDerivAt_woottersSlope hs).differentiableAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq he).differentiableWithinAt
  · intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    rw [deriv2_wootters hs]
    have ht := radius_pos_lt_one hs
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (sub_nonneg.2 (logRatio_lower ht.1.le ht.2)))
      (pow_nonneg ht.1.le _)

name: OAI.GAD.monotoneOn_wootters
statement: theorem monotoneOn_wootters : MonotoneOn wootters (Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  apply monotoneOn_of_hasDerivWithinAt_nonneg (convex_Icc _ _)
    continuous_wootters.continuousOn
  · intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    exact (hasDerivAt_wootters hs).hasDerivWithinAt
  · intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    have ht := radius_pos_lt_one hs
    unfold woottersSlope
    exact mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hs.1.le) ht.1.le)
      (le_trans (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ht.1.le) (logRatio_lower ht.1.le ht.2))

name: OAI.GAD.v_nonneg
statement:
theorem v_nonneg {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (p : ℝ) : 0 ≤ v γ ν p
proof:
:= by
  unfold v
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν.1) (sub_nonneg.2 hν.2))
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hγ.2)) (sq_nonneg _))

name: OAI.GAD.v_population_form
statement:
theorem v_population_form (γ ν p : ℝ) :
    v γ ν p = ((1 - γ) * p + γ * ν) * (1 - ((1 - γ) * p + γ * ν)) -
      (1 - γ) * p * (1 - p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold v
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.v_le_quarter
statement:
theorem v_le_quarter {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (_hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    v γ ν p ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [v_population_form]
  have hsub : 0 ≤ (1 - γ) * p * (1 - p) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hγ.2) hp.1) (sub_nonneg.2 hp.2)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (((1 - γ) * p + γ * ν) - 1 / 2)]

name: OAI.GAD.sqrt_v_mem
statement:
theorem sqrt_v_mem {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Real.sqrt (v γ ν p) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Real.sqrt_nonneg _, (Real.sqrt_le_left (by norm_num)).2 ?_⟩
  convert v_le_quarter hγ hν hp using 1
  norm_num

name: OAI.GAD.convexOn_sqrt_v
statement:
theorem convexOn_sqrt_v {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun p ↦ Real.sqrt (v γ ν p))
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℝ → ℂ := fun p ↦ ⟨Real.sqrt (γ * ν * (1 - ν)),
    Real.sqrt (γ * (1 - γ)) * (p - ν)⟩
  have hA : 0 ≤ γ * ν * (1 - ν) :=
    mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν.1) (sub_nonneg.2 hν.2)
  have hB : 0 ≤ γ * (1 - γ) := mul_nonneg hγ.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hγ.2)
  have hz (p : ℝ) : ‖z p‖ = Real.sqrt (v γ ν p) := by
    rw [Complex.norm_def]
    congr 1
    dsimp [z]
    calc
      _ = Real.sqrt (γ * ν * (1 - ν)) ^ 2 +
          Real.sqrt (γ * (1 - γ)) ^ 2 * (p - ν) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = v γ ν p := by rw [Real.sq_sqrt hA, Real.sq_sqrt hB]; rfl
  refine ⟨convex_Icc _ _, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  change Real.sqrt (v γ ν (a * x + b * y)) ≤
    a * Real.sqrt (v γ ν x) + b * Real.sqrt (v γ ν y)
  rw [← hz, ← hz, ← hz]
  have he : z (a * x + b * y) = a • z x + b • z y := by
    have hb' : b = 1 - a := by linarith
    rw [hb']
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [z] <;> ring
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖a • z x‖ + ‖b • z y‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = _ := by rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg ha, abs_of_nonneg hb]

name: OAI.GAD.wootters_sqrt
statement: theorem wootters_sqrt {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) : wootters (Real.sqrt u) = g u
proof:
:= by
  unfold wootters
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hu]

name: OAI.GAD.convexOn_output_entropy
statement:
theorem convexOn_output_entropy {γ ν : ℝ} (hγ : γ ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (fun p ↦ g (v γ ν p))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_Icc _ _, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy a b ha hb hab
  have hxy := (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) hx hy ha hb hab
  have hx' := sqrt_v_mem hγ hν hx
  have hy' := sqrt_v_mem hγ hν hy
  have hxy' := sqrt_v_mem hγ hν hxy
  have hc := (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) hx' hy' ha hb hab
  have hm := monotoneOn_wootters hxy' hc ((convexOn_sqrt_v hγ hν).2 hx hy ha hb hab)
  have hh := hm.trans (convexOn_wootters.2 hx' hy' ha hb hab)
  simpa only [wootters_sqrt (v_nonneg hγ hν _)] using hh

name: OAI.GAD.continuous_objective
statement: theorem continuous_objective (γ ν : ℝ) : Continuous (objective γ ν)
proof:
:= by
  unfold objective v
  exact (Real.binEntropy_continuous.comp (by fun_prop)).sub
    (continuous_g.comp (by fun_prop))

/

name: OAI.GAD.exists_maximizer
statement:
theorem exists_maximizer (γ ν : ℝ) :
    ∃ p ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ q ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, objective γ ν q ≤ objective γ ν p
proof:
:= by
  exact isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn (by norm_num) (continuous_objective γ ν).continuousOn

name: OAI.GAD.pure_output_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem pure_output_entropy_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) (ψ : Basis n → ℂ)
    (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) :
    ∑ j, g (v γ ν (population ψ j)) ≤ entropy (channel γ ν n (pure ψ))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa using entropy_nonneg (channel_state γ ν hγ hν 0 (pure_state hψ))
  | succ n ih =>
      let x := vecMass (branch ψ 0)
      let y := vecMass (branch ψ 1)
      let ψ₀ := normalize (branch ψ 0)
      let ψ₁ := normalize (branch ψ 1)
      have hx : 0 ≤ x := vecMass_nonneg _
      have hy : 0 ≤ y := vecMass_nonneg _
      have hxy : x+y=1 := (vecMass_branches ψ).symm.trans hψ
      have h₀ := ih ψ₀ (normalize_mass _)
      have h₁ := ih ψ₁ (normalize_mass _)
      have hpop (j : Fin n) : population ψ j.succ = x*population ψ₀ j+y*population ψ₁ j := by
        rw [population_succ,population_normalize (branch ψ 0),population_normalize (branch ψ 1)]
      have hj (j : Fin n) : g (v γ ν (population ψ j.succ)) ≤
          x*g (v γ ν (population ψ₀ j))+y*g (v γ ν (population ψ₁ j)) := by
        rw [hpop]
        exact (convexOn_output_entropy hγ hν).2
          (population_mem (normalize_mass _) j) (population_mem (normalize_mass _) j) hx hy hxy
      calc
        ∑ j, g (v γ ν (population ψ j)) =
            g (v γ ν (population ψ 0))+∑ j : Fin n, g (v γ ν (population ψ j.succ)) :=
          Fin.sum_univ_succ _
        _ ≤ g (v γ ν (population ψ 0))+
            ∑ j : Fin n, (x*g (v γ ν (population ψ₀ j))+y*g (v γ ν (population ψ₁ j))) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hj j))
        _ = g (v γ ν (population ψ 0))+
            (x*(∑ j, g (v γ ν (population ψ₀ j)))+y*(∑ j, g (v γ ν (population ψ₁ j)))) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ ≤ g (v γ ν (population ψ 0))+
            (x*entropy (channel γ ν n (pure ψ₀))+y*entropy (channel γ ν n (pure ψ₁))) :=
          add_le_add le_rfl (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₀ hx)
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h₁ hy))
        _ ≤ entropy (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ)) := by
          have h := output_entropy_recursion γ ν hγ hν ψ hψ
          dsimp [x,y,ψ₀,ψ₁]
          linarith

name: OAI.GAD.mixed_output_entropy_bound
statement:
theorem mixed_output_entropy_bound (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) {P : QMatrix n} (hP : IsState P) :
    ∑ j, g (v γ ν (matrixPopulation P j)) ≤ entropy (channel γ ν n P)
proof:
:= by
  let w := hP.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let ψ := fun a i ↦ hP.1.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary i a
  have hw (a) : 0 ≤ w a := hP.1.eigenvalues_nonneg a
  have hs : ∑ a, w a = 1 := spectral_weights_sum hP
  have hv (a) : vecMass (ψ a) = 1 := spectral_vectors_mass hP.1.isHermitian a
  have hdecomp : P = ∑ a, w a • pure (ψ a) := spectral_pure_decomposition hP.1.isHermitian
  have hchan : channel γ ν n P = ∑ a, w a • channel γ ν n (pure (ψ a)) := by
    rw [hdecomp,channel_mixture]
  have hpop (j) : matrixPopulation P j = ∑ a, w a * population (ψ a) j := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp]
    rw [matrixPopulation_mixture]
    simp only [matrixPopulation_pure]
  have hj (j) : g (v γ ν (matrixPopulation P j)) ≤ ∑ a, w a*g (v γ ν (population (ψ a) j)) := by
    rw [hpop]
    exact (convexOn_output_entropy hγ hν).map_sum_le (fun a _ ↦ hw a) hs
      (fun a _ ↦ population_mem (hv a) j)
  calc
    ∑ j, g (v γ ν (matrixPopulation P j)) ≤
        ∑ j, ∑ a, w a*g (v γ ν (population (ψ a) j)) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ hj j)
    _ = ∑ a, w a * ∑ j, g (v γ ν (population (ψ a) j)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]; simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ a, w a * entropy (channel γ ν n (pure (ψ a))) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ ↦ mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pure_output_entropy_bound γ ν hγ hν n (ψ a) (hv a)) (hw a))
    _ ≤ entropy (channel γ ν n P) := by
      rw [hchan]
      exact concaveOn_entropy.le_map_sum (fun a _ ↦ hw a) hs
        (fun a _ ↦ channel_posSemidef γ ν n (pure_posSemidef (ψ a)))

name: OAI.GAD.coordinatePerm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePerm_apply {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_2} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : Fin n → α) (k : Fin n) : coordinatePerm e i k = i (e.symm k)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GAD.coordinatePerm_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinatePerm_symm_apply {n : ℕ} {α : Type u_3} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (i : Fin n → α) (k : Fin n) : (coordinatePerm e).symm i k = i (e k)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GAD.tensorKraus_reindex
statement:
theorem tensorKraus_reindex (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (r : Fin n → Fin 4) :
    Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) (tensorKraus γ ν n r) =
      tensorKraus γ ν n (coordinatePerm e r)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change (∏ k, kraus γ ν (r k) (i (e k)) (j (e k))) =
    ∏ k, kraus γ ν (r (e.symm k)) (i k) (j k)
  simpa using Equiv.prod_comp e (fun k ↦ kraus γ ν (r (e.symm k)) (i k) (j k))

name: OAI.GAD.channel_reindex
statement:
theorem channel_reindex (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (P : QMatrix n) :
    Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) (channel γ ν n P) =
      channel γ ν n (Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) P)
proof:
:= by
  let φ := reindexStarAlgEquiv (coordinatePerm e : Basis n ≃ Basis n)
  have hL (r : Fin n → Fin 4) : φ (tensorKraus γ ν n r) =
      tensorKraus γ ν n (coordinatePerm e r) := tensorKraus_reindex γ ν n e r
  change φ (∑ r, tensorKraus γ ν n r * P * star (tensorKraus γ ν n r)) = _
  simp only [map_sum,map_mul,map_star,hL]
  exact (coordinatePerm e : (Fin n → Fin 4) ≃ _).sum_comp
    (fun r ↦ tensorKraus γ ν n r * φ P * star (tensorKraus γ ν n r))

name: OAI.GAD.matrixPopulation_reindex
statement:
theorem matrixPopulation_reindex {n : ℕ} (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (P : QMatrix n) (j : Fin n) :
    matrixPopulation (Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) P) j =
      matrixPopulation P (e.symm j)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (coordinatePerm e).symm
  intro i
  simp [Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply]

name: OAI.GAD.population_channel_pure_zero
statement:
theorem population_channel_pure_zero (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    matrixPopulation (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ)) 0 =
      (1-γ)*population ψ 0+γ*ν*vecMass ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hentry (i : Basis n) :
      (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ) (Fin.cons 1 i) (Fin.cons 1 i)).re =
        (γ*ν)*(gram (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 0)) i i).re+
          (1-γ*(1-ν))*(gram (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 1)) i i).re := by
    rw [channel_first_site_entry]
    rw [local_channel γ ν hγ hν (fun a d ↦
      (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ a) *
        (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ d)).conjTranspose) i i)]
    simp [gram]
  have hmass (b : Fin 2) : (∑ i, (gram (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ b)) i i).re) =
      vecMass (branch ψ b) := by
    simpa only [mass,Matrix.trace,Matrix.diag,Complex.re_sum] using
      mass_channel_columns γ ν hγ hν n (branch ψ b)
  unfold matrixPopulation
  rw [sum_fin_cons]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two,Fin.cons_zero,show (0:Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide,ite_false,
    Finset.sum_const_zero,zero_add,ite_true,hentry,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,hmass,
    population_zero,vecMass_branches]
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.population_channel_zero
statement:
theorem population_channel_zero (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} {P : QMatrix (n+1)} (hP : IsState P) :
    matrixPopulation (channel γ ν (n+1) P) 0 = (1-γ)*matrixPopulation P 0+γ*ν
proof:
:= by
  let w := hP.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let ψ := fun a i ↦ hP.1.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary i a
  have hs : ∑ a, w a = 1 := spectral_weights_sum hP
  have hv (a) : vecMass (ψ a) = 1 := spectral_vectors_mass hP.1.isHermitian a
  have hdecomp : P = ∑ a, w a • pure (ψ a) := spectral_pure_decomposition hP.1.isHermitian
  conv_lhs => rw [hdecomp]
  rw [channel_mixture,matrixPopulation_mixture]
  simp only [population_channel_pure_zero γ ν hγ hν,hv,mul_one]
  conv_rhs => rw [hdecomp]
  rw [matrixPopulation_mixture]
  simp only [matrixPopulation_pure,mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hs,one_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.channel_population
statement:
theorem channel_population (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} {P : QMatrix n} (hP : IsState P) (j : Fin n) :
    matrixPopulation (channel γ ν n P) j = (1-γ)*matrixPopulation P j+γ*ν
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 j
  | succ n =>
      let e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n+1)) := Equiv.swap 0 j
      let Q := Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) P
      have hQ : IsState Q := ⟨hP.1.submatrix _, (trace_reindex _ P).trans hP.2⟩
      have h := population_channel_zero γ ν hγ hν hQ
      change matrixPopulation (channel γ ν (n+1) (Matrix.reindex _ _ P)) 0 = _ at h
      rw [← channel_reindex, matrixPopulation_reindex] at h
      change matrixPopulation (channel γ ν (n+1) P) (e.symm 0) =
        (1-γ)*matrixPopulation (Matrix.reindex (coordinatePerm e) (coordinatePerm e) P) 0+γ*ν at h
      rw [matrixPopulation_reindex] at h
      simpa [e] using h

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_conjugate
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_conjugate (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    phaseOutput γ ν p s=Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ (signUnitary s) (phaseOutput γ ν p 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput_formula γ ν hγ hν hp s,phaseOutput_formula γ ν hγ hν hp 0]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases s <;>
    simp [Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,signUnitary,Matrix.mul_apply,Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.star_apply]

name: OAI.GAD.spectralMatrix_conjugate
statement:
theorem spectralMatrix_conjugate {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (q : ι → ℝ) :
    Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U (spectralMatrix V q)=spectralMatrix (U*V) q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [spectralMatrix,Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply,Submonoid.coe_mul,star_mul,
    Matrix.mul_assoc]

/

name: OAI.GAD.phase_spectral
statement:
theorem phase_spectral (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ (q : Fin 2 → ℝ) (U : Fin 2 → Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) ∧ (∑ i, q i=1) ∧
      (∀ s, phaseOutput γ ν p s=spectralMatrix (U s) q) ∧
      classicalEntropy q=g (v γ ν p)
proof:
:= by
  let hA := phaseOutput_state γ ν hγ hν hp 0
  let q := hA.1.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  let V := hA.1.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hV : phaseOutput γ ν p 0=spectralMatrix V q := hA.1.isHermitian.spectral_theorem
  refine ⟨q,fun s ↦ signUnitary s*V,?_,spectral_weights_sum hA,?_,?_⟩
  · exact hA.1.eigenvalues_nonneg
  · intro s
    rw [phaseOutput_conjugate γ ν hγ hν hp s,hV,spectralMatrix_conjugate]
  · rw [← phaseOutput_entropy γ ν hγ hν hp 0,hV,spectralMatrix_entropy]
    rfl

name: OAI.GAD.meanPhaseWeights_nonneg
statement:
theorem meanPhaseWeights_nonneg (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (b : Fin 2) :
    0 ≤ meanPhaseWeights γ ν p b
proof:
:= by
  have he : 0 ≤ (1-γ)*p+γ*ν := add_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2) hp.1)
    (mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν.1)
  have hu : (1-γ)*p+γ*ν ≤ 1 := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp.2 (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hν.2 hγ.1
    nlinarith
  dsimp [meanPhaseWeights]
  split_ifs
  · linarith
  · exact he

name: OAI.GAD.meanPhaseWeights_sum
statement: theorem meanPhaseWeights_sum (γ ν p : ℝ) : ∑ b, meanPhaseWeights γ ν p b=1
proof:
:= by
  simp [meanPhaseWeights,Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: OAI.GAD.meanPhaseWeights_entropy
statement:
theorem meanPhaseWeights_entropy (γ ν p : ℝ) :
    classicalEntropy (meanPhaseWeights γ ν p)=Real.binEntropy ((1-γ)*p+γ*ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp [classicalEntropy,meanPhaseWeights,Fin.sum_univ_two,
    Real.binEntropy_eq_negMulLog_add_negMulLog_one_sub,add_comm]

name: OAI.GAD.phase_mean_spectral
statement:
theorem phase_mean_spectral (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 0+(1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 1=
      spectralMatrix 1 (meanPhaseWeights γ ν p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput_average γ ν hγ hν hp]
  simp [spectralMatrix,meanPhaseWeights]

name: OAI.GAD.exists_phase_code
statement:
theorem exists_phase_code (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (q : Fin 2 → ℝ) (U : Fin 2 → Matrix.unitaryGroup (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hq : ∀ i, 0 ≤ q i) (hs : ∑ i, q i=1)
    (hphase : ∀ s, phaseOutput γ ν p s=spectralMatrix (U s) q)
    (hent : classicalEntropy q=g (v γ ν p))
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (M : ℕ) (hM : 0 < M) :
    ∃ C : Code n, C.messages=M ∧ averageError γ ν C ≤
      (9*logVariance (meanPhaseWeights γ ν p)+8*logVariance q)/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)+
        4*(M:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(objective γ ν p-2*δ))
proof:
:= by
  let qb := meanPhaseWeights γ ν p
  let w : Basis n → ℝ := fun _ ↦ ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹
  let A : Basis n → QMatrix n := fun s ↦ channel γ ν n (phaseState p s)
  let P := typicalProjection n (fun _ ↦ 1) qb δ
  let Q := fun s : Basis n ↦ typicalProjection n (fun k ↦ U (s k)) q δ
  have hmean : (∑ s, w s • A s)=tensorMatrix n (fun _ ↦ spectralMatrix 1 qb) := by
    simp only [w,A,phaseState_output]
    rw [tensorMatrix_average]
    simp only [phase_mean_spectral γ ν hγ hν hp,qb]
  have hA (s : Basis n) : A s=tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ spectralMatrix (U (s k)) q) := by
    simp only [A,phaseState_output,hphase]
  have hP := typicalProjection_properties n (fun _ ↦ 1) qb
    (meanPhaseWeights_nonneg γ ν hγ hν hp) (meanPhaseWeights_sum γ ν p) hδ hn
  have hQ (s : Basis n) := typicalProjection_properties n (fun k ↦ U (s k)) q hq hs hδ hn
  have hw : ∀ s, 0 ≤ w s := fun _ ↦ by dsimp [w]; positivity
  have hw1 : ∑ s, w s=1 := phase_weights_sum n
  have hga : (∑ s, w s*(1-(P*A s).trace.re)) ≤ logVariance qb/((n:ℝ)*δ^2) := by
    have he : (∑ s, w s*(1-(P*A s).trace.re))=
        1-(P*(∑ s, w s • A s)).trace.re := by
      simp only [mul_sub,mul_one,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hw1,Matrix.mul_sum,Matrix.mul_smul,
        Matrix.trace_sum,Matrix.trace_smul,Complex.re_sum,Complex.real_smul,Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_re,Complex.ofReal_im,zero_mul,sub_zero]
    rw [he,hmean]
    exact hP.2.2.1
  have hcb : (∑ s, w s*(1-(Q s*A s).trace.re)) ≤ logVariance q/((n:ℝ)*δ^2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ s, w s*(logVariance q/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro s _
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hw s)
        rw [hA]
        exact (hQ s).2.2.1
      _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hw1,one_mul]
  have hcp : (Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(classicalEntropy qb-δ)) • P-
      P*(∑ s, w s • A s)*P).PosSemidef := by
    rw [hmean]
    exact hP.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨x,D,hD,hDs,he⟩ := exists_packed_measurement w hw hw1 A Q
    (fun s ↦ channel_state γ ν hγ hν n (phaseState_state hp s))
    (fun s ↦ (hQ s).1) P hP.1 (Real.exp_pos _).le (Real.exp_pos _).le
    hga hcb (fun s ↦ (hQ s).2.1) hcp M hM
  let C : Code n := {
    messages := M
    messages_pos := hM
    encoding := fun m ↦ phaseState p (x m)
    encoding_state := fun m ↦ phaseState_state hp (x m)
    decoding := D
    decoding_pos := hD
    decoding_sum := hDs }
  refine ⟨C,rfl,?_⟩
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(classicalEntropy qb-δ))*
      Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*(classicalEntropy q+δ))=
        Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(objective γ ν p-2*δ)) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add,hent,meanPhaseWeights_entropy]
    congr 1
    dsimp [objective]
    ring
  have hbound : 9*(logVariance qb/((n:ℝ)*δ^2))+8*(logVariance q/((n:ℝ)*δ^2))+
      4*(M:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(classicalEntropy qb-δ))*Real.exp ((n:ℝ)*(classicalEntropy q+δ))=
      (9*logVariance qb+8*logVariance q)/((n:ℝ)*δ^2)+
        4*(M:ℝ)*Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*(objective γ ν p-2*δ)) := by
    rw [mul_assoc (4*(M:ℝ)),hexp]
    ring
  rw [hbound] at he
  simpa only [averageError,C,A,Complex.re_sum] using he

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_split
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_split {n : ℕ} (A : Fin (n+1) → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (tensorSplit n) (tensorSplit n) (tensorMatrix (n+1) A) =
      A 0 ⊗ₖ tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ A k.succ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply,tensorSplit,tensorMatrix,
    Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_trace
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_trace (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (tensorMatrix n A).trace = ∏ k, (A k).trace
proof:
:= by
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k i ↦ A k i i)).symm

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_zero
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_zero (A : Fin 0 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    tensorMatrix 0 A = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [tensorMatrix,Matrix.one_apply,Subsingleton.elim i j]

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_posSemidef
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_posSemidef (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ k, (A k).PosSemidef) : (tensorMatrix n A).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [tensorMatrix_zero]; exact Matrix.PosSemidef.one
  | succ n ih =>
      have h := (hA 0).kronecker (ih (fun k ↦ A k.succ) (fun k ↦ hA k.succ))
      rw [← tensorMatrix_split A] at h
      have h' := h.submatrix (tensorSplit n)
      simpa only [Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_submatrix,Equiv.symm_comp_self,
        Matrix.submatrix_id_id] using h'

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_state
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_state (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ k, IsState (A k)) : IsState (tensorMatrix n A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨tensorMatrix_posSemidef n A (fun k ↦ (hA k).1), ?_⟩
  rw [tensorMatrix_trace]
  simp only [(hA _).2,Finset.prod_const_one]

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_entropy
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_entropy (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ k, IsState (A k)) : entropy (tensorMatrix n A) = ∑ k, entropy (A k)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [tensorMatrix_zero]
      have hdiag : (1 : QMatrix 0) = Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Basis 0 ↦ (1:ℂ)) := by simp
      rw [hdiag]
      change entropy (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Basis 0 ↦ ((1:ℝ):ℂ))) = _
      rw [entropy_diagonal]
      simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [← entropy_reindex (tensorSplit n) (tensorMatrix_state (n+1) A hA).1.isHermitian,
        tensorMatrix_split,entropy_kronecker_state (hA 0)
          (tensorMatrix_state n _ (fun k ↦ hA k.succ)),ih _ (fun k ↦ hA k.succ),Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: OAI.GAD.channel_tensorMatrix
statement:
theorem channel_tensorMatrix (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    channel γ ν n (tensorMatrix n A) =
      tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ applyKraus (kraus γ ν) (A k))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [channel,applyKraus,tensorMatrix,Matrix.mul_apply,Matrix.sum_apply,Matrix.conjTranspose_apply]
  change (∑ r : Fin n → Fin 4, ∑ v : Basis n,
      (∑ u : Basis n, (∏ k, kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) (u k)) * (∏ k, A k (u k) (v k))) *
        star (∏ k, kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) (v k))) =
    ∏ k, ∑ r : Fin 4, ∑ v : Fin 2,
      (∑ u : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r (i k) u * A k u v) * star (kraus γ ν r (j k) v)
  simp only [star_prod,Finset.sum_mul,← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have hinner (r : Fin n → Fin 4) (v : Basis n) :
      (∑ u : Basis n, ∏ k, (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) (u k) * A k (u k) (v k)) *
        star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) (v k))) =
      ∏ k, ∑ u : Fin 2, (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) u * A k u (v k)) *
        star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) (v k)) :=
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k u ↦ (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) u * A k u (v k)) *
      star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) (v k)))).symm
  simp only [hinner]
  have hmid (r : Fin n → Fin 4) :
      (∑ v : Basis n, ∏ k, ∑ u : Fin 2,
        (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) u * A k u (v k)) * star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) (v k))) =
      ∏ k, ∑ v : Fin 2, ∑ u : Fin 2,
        (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) u * A k u v) * star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) v) :=
    (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k v ↦ ∑ u : Fin 2,
      (kraus γ ν (r k) (i k) u * A k u v) * star (kraus γ ν (r k) (j k) v))).symm
  simp only [hmid]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k r ↦ ∑ v : Fin 2, ∑ u : Fin 2,
    (kraus γ ν r (i k) u * A k u v) * star (kraus γ ν r (j k) v))).symm

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_sum
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_sum {n : ℕ} (B : Fin n → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (∑ s : Basis n, tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ B k (s k))) =
      tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ ∑ s, B k s)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.sum_apply,tensorMatrix]
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun k s ↦ B k s (i k) (j k))).symm

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_smul {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → ℝ) (A : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ c k • A k) = (∏ k, c k) • tensorMatrix n A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [tensorMatrix,Complex.real_smul,Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: OAI.GAD.tensorMatrix_average
statement:
theorem tensorMatrix_average {n : ℕ} (B : Fin n → Fin 2 → Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    (∑ s : Basis n, ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹ • tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ B k (s k))) =
      tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ (1/2:ℝ) • B k 0+(1/2:ℝ) • B k 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.smul_sum,tensorMatrix_sum]
  have hm : (fun k ↦ (1/2:ℝ) • B k 0+(1/2:ℝ) • B k 1) =
      (fun k ↦ (1/2:ℝ) • (∑ s, B k s)) := by
    funext k
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two,smul_add]
  rw [hm,tensorMatrix_smul]
  simp [Finset.prod_const,one_div]

name: OAI.GAD.phaseState_tensor
statement:
theorem phaseState_tensor {n : ℕ} (p : ℝ) (s : Basis n) :
    phaseState p s = tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ pure (phaseSignal p (s k)))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [phaseState,phaseProduct,pure,tensorMatrix,star_prod,Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: OAI.GAD.phaseState_state
statement:
theorem phaseState_state {n : ℕ} {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Basis n) :
    IsState (phaseState p s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseState_tensor]
  exact tensorMatrix_state n _ (fun k ↦ pure_state (phaseSignal_mass hp (s k)))

name: OAI.GAD.phaseState_output
statement:
theorem phaseState_output {n : ℕ} (γ ν p : ℝ) (s : Basis n) :
    channel γ ν n (phaseState p s) = tensorMatrix n (fun k ↦ phaseOutput γ ν p (s k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseState_tensor,channel_tensorMatrix]
  rfl

name: OAI.GAD.phaseState_entropy
statement:
theorem phaseState_entropy {n : ℕ} (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Basis n) :
    entropy (channel γ ν n (phaseState p s)) = (n:ℝ)*g (v γ ν p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseState_output,tensorMatrix_entropy n _ (fun k ↦ phaseOutput_state γ ν hγ hν hp (s k))]
  simp only [phaseOutput_entropy γ ν hγ hν hp,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.GAD.phaseState_average_entropy
statement:
theorem phaseState_average_entropy (n : ℕ) (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    entropy (∑ s : Basis n, (((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹ : ℂ) • channel γ ν n (phaseState p s)) =
      (n:ℝ)*Real.binEntropy ((1-γ)*p+γ*ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Complex.ofReal_pow,← Complex.ofReal_inv,Complex.coe_smul,phaseState_output]
  rw [tensorMatrix_average]
  have hs : IsState ((1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 0+(1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 1) := by
    have h := state_mixture (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ (1/2:ℝ)) (phaseOutput γ ν p)
      (by intro a; norm_num) (by norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_two])
      (fun s ↦ phaseOutput_state γ ν hγ hν hp s)
    simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_two] using h
  rw [tensorMatrix_entropy n _ (fun _ ↦ hs)]
  simp only [phaseOutput_average_entropy γ ν hγ hν hp,Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.GAD.basis_card
statement: theorem basis_card (n : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Basis n) = 2^n
proof:
:= by
  simp [Basis]

name: OAI.GAD.phase_weights_sum
statement: theorem phase_weights_sum (n : ℕ) : (∑ _s : Basis n, ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,basis_card,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.cast_pow,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero n (by norm_num))

name: OAI.GAD.phaseValue_formula
statement:
theorem phaseValue_formula (n : ℕ) (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    phaseValue γ ν p n = (n:ℝ)/Real.log 2*objective γ ν p
proof:
:= by
  unfold phaseValue
  rw [phaseState_average_entropy n γ ν hγ hν hp]
  simp only [phaseState_entropy γ ν hγ hν hp,← Finset.sum_mul,phase_weights_sum,one_mul]
  unfold objective
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.phaseEnsemble_value
statement:
theorem phaseEnsemble_value (n : ℕ) (γ ν p : ℝ) (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    ensembleValue γ ν (phaseEnsemble n p hp) = phaseValue γ ν p n
proof:
:= by
  unfold ensembleValue phaseEnsemble phaseValue
  simp only [← Complex.ofReal_inv,← Complex.ofReal_pow]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp (Fintype.equivFin (Basis n)).symm
    (fun s ↦ Complex.ofReal ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹ • channel γ ν n (phaseState p s)),
    Equiv.sum_comp (Fintype.equivFin (Basis n)).symm
    (fun s ↦ ((2:ℝ)^n)⁻¹ * entropy (channel γ ν n (phaseState p s)))]

name: OAI.GAD.entropy_qubit
statement:
theorem entropy_qubit {P : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ} (hP : P.IsHermitian)
    (htr : P.trace=1) : entropy P = g P.det.re
proof:
:= by
  let a := hP.eigenvalues 0
  let b := hP.eigenvalues 1
  have hab : a+b=1 := by
    have h := congrArg Complex.re (hP.trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues.symm.trans htr)
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_two,a,b] using h
  have hd : P.det.re=a*b := by
    rw [hP.det_eq_prod_eigenvalues,Fin.prod_univ_two]
    simp [a,b]
  have he : entropy P=Real.negMulLog a+Real.negMulLog b := by
    rw [entropy_eq_sum hP,Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hdisc : 1-4*P.det.re=(a-b)^2 := by rw [hd]; nlinarith only [hab]
  rw [he,g,hdisc,Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  by_cases h : b ≤ a
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h)]
    have ht : (1+(a-b))/2=a := by linarith
    rw [ht,Real.binEntropy_eq_negMulLog_add_negMulLog_one_sub]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    linarith
  · rw [abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr (lt_of_not_ge h))]
    have ht : (1+ -(a-b))/2=b := by linarith
    rw [ht,Real.binEntropy_eq_negMulLog_add_negMulLog_one_sub]
    have ht' : 1-b=a := by linarith
    rw [ht']; ring

name: OAI.GAD.phaseSignal_mass
statement:
theorem phaseSignal_mass {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    vecMass (phaseSignal p s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vecMass,Fin.sum_univ_two,phaseSignal,ite_true,show (1:Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide,ite_false]
  split_ifs <;> simp [Complex.normSq_ofReal,Real.mul_self_sqrt hp.1,
    Real.mul_self_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hp.2)]

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_state
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_state (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    IsState (phaseOutput γ ν p s)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨applyKraus_posSemidef _ (pure_posSemidef _), ?_⟩
  exact (applyKraus_trace _ (kraus_complete γ ν hγ hν) _).trans (pure_state (phaseSignal_mass hp s)).2

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_formula
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_formula (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    phaseOutput γ ν p s =
      !![((1-((1-γ)*p+γ*ν) : ℝ):ℂ),
          ((if s=0 then 1 else -1 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt (1-p)*Real.sqrt p : ℂ);
         ((if s=0 then 1 else -1 : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt (1-p)*Real.sqrt p : ℂ),
          (((1-γ)*p+γ*ν : ℝ):ℂ)]
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput,local_channel γ ν hγ hν]
  have hsp : (Real.sqrt p : ℂ)^2=(p:ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt hp.1
  have hs1p : (Real.sqrt (1-p) : ℂ)^2=(1-p:ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hp.2)
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases s <;>
    simp [pure,phaseSignal,Matrix.of_apply,Complex.ofReal_mul,Complex.ofReal_sub] <;>
    ring_nf <;> simp only [hsp,hs1p] <;> ring

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_det
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_det (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    (phaseOutput γ ν p s).det.re=v γ ν p
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput_formula γ ν hγ hν hp s,Matrix.det_fin_two]
  have hγ' := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2)
  have hp' := Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr hp.2)
  have hp'' := Real.sq_sqrt hp.1
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply,Matrix.cons_val_zero,Matrix.cons_val_one,Matrix.cons_val_fin_one,
    ← Complex.ofReal_mul,← Complex.ofReal_sub,Complex.ofReal_re]
  split_ifs <;> dsimp only [v] <;>
    ring_nf <;> rw [hγ', hp', hp''] <;> ring

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_entropy
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_entropy (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (s : Fin 2) :
    entropy (phaseOutput γ ν p s)=g (v γ ν p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [entropy_qubit (phaseOutput_state γ ν hγ hν hp s).1.isHermitian
    (phaseOutput_state γ ν hγ hν hp s).2,phaseOutput_det γ ν hγ hν hp s]

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_average
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_average (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    (1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 0+(1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 1 =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun b : Fin 2 ↦ ((if b=0 then 1-((1-γ)*p+γ*ν) else (1-γ)*p+γ*ν : ℝ):ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput_formula γ ν hγ hν hp 0,phaseOutput_formula γ ν hγ hν hp 1]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [Complex.real_smul] <;> ring

name: OAI.GAD.phaseOutput_average_entropy
statement:
theorem phaseOutput_average_entropy (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) :
    entropy ((1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 0+(1/2:ℝ) • phaseOutput γ ν p 1) =
      Real.binEntropy ((1-γ)*p+γ*ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [phaseOutput_average γ ν hγ hν hp,entropy_diagonal]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two,Real.binEntropy_eq_negMulLog_add_negMulLog_one_sub,add_comm]

name: OAI.GAD.inv_unitary_conj
statement:
theorem inv_unitary_conj (U : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))⁻¹ =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A⁻¹ * (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⁻¹ = (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :=
    Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv (Unitary.coe_mul_star_self U)
  have hs : (star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)⁻¹ = (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :=
    Matrix.inv_eq_right_inv (by simpa only [Unitary.coe_star] using Unitary.coe_star_mul_self U)
  rw [Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, hu, hs, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_unitary
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_unitary (U V : Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ) (Z D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    blockLogDet ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*Z*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ))
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*D*(star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ))
      ((V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*E*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) = blockLogDet Z D E
proof:
:= by
  have he : (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*D*(star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) +
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*Z*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) *
      (((V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*E*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ))⁻¹) *
      ((U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*Z*(star V : Matrix ι ι ℂ))ᴴ =
      (U : Matrix ι ι ℂ)*(D+Z*E⁻¹*Zᴴ)*(star U : Matrix ι ι ℂ) := by
    rw [inv_unitary_conj]
    simp only [← Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, star_mul, star_star]
    have hv : star (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = 1 := Unitary.coe_star_mul_self V
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc (star (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) (V : Matrix ι ι ℂ),
      hv, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  unfold blockLogDet
  rw [he]
  change Real.log ‖(Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U (D+Z*E⁻¹*Zᴴ)).det‖ -
    Real.log ‖(Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ _ U D).det‖ = _
  rw [det_unitary_conj, det_unitary_conj]

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_empty
statement: theorem partialPinch_empty (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) : partialPinch ∅ A = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j; simp [partialPinch]

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_univ
statement:
theorem partialPinch_univ (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    partialPinch Finset.univ A = Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ A i i)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [partialPinch, Matrix.diagonal, h]

name: OAI.GAD.flipSign_conj_apply
statement:
theorem flipSign_conj_apply (k i j : ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    ((flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * A * (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ)) i j =
      (if i = k then (-1 : ℂ) else 1) * A i j * (if j = k then (-1 : ℂ) else 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = k <;> by_cases hj : j = k <;>
    simp [flipSign, Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul, hi, hj]

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_insert
statement:
theorem partialPinch_insert (s : Finset ι) (k : ι) (A : Matrix ι ι ℂ) :
    partialPinch (insert k s) A = (1/2 : ℝ) • partialPinch s A +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • ((flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * partialPinch s A *
        (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, flipSign_conj_apply, partialPinch,
    Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    by_cases hi : i = k <;> simp [hi, Complex.real_smul] <;> ring
  · by_cases hi : i = k <;> by_cases hj : j = k <;>
      by_cases his : i ∈ s <;> by_cases hjs : j ∈ s <;>
      simp_all [Complex.real_smul]; ring

name: OAI.GAD.flipSign_diagonal
statement:
theorem flipSign_diagonal (k : ι) (z : ι → ℂ) :
    (flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal z *
      (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ) = Matrix.diagonal z
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [flipSign_conj_apply]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; by_cases hi : i = k <;> simp [hi]
  · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ h]

name: OAI.GAD.partialPinch_posDef
statement:
theorem partialPinch_posDef {D : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hD : D.PosDef) (s : Finset ι) :
    (partialPinch s D).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa only [partialPinch_empty] using hD
  | @insert k s _ ih =>
    rw [partialPinch_insert]
    exact posDef_segment ih (ih.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
      (Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := flipSign k))))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_partialPinch_le
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_partialPinch_le (z : ι → ℂ) {D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hE : E.PosDef) (s : Finset ι) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) (partialPinch s D) (partialPinch s E) ≤
      blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) D E
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [partialPinch_empty, le_refl]
  | @insert k s _ ih =>
    have hDp := partialPinch_posDef hD s
    have hEp := partialPinch_posDef hE s
    have hDc := hDp.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
      (Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := flipSign k)))
    have hEc := hEp.mul_mul_conjTranspose_same
      (Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff_isUnit.mpr (Unitary.isUnit_coe (U := flipSign k)))
    have hh := (convexOn_blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z)).2
      (x := (partialPinch s D, partialPinch s E))
      (y := ((flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * partialPinch s D * (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ),
        (flipSign k : Matrix ι ι ℂ) * partialPinch s E * (star (flipSign k) : Matrix ι ι ℂ)))
      ⟨hDp,hEp⟩ ⟨hDc,hEc⟩
      (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 by norm_num) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2 by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have he := blockLogDet_unitary (flipSign k) (flipSign k) (Matrix.diagonal z)
      (partialPinch s D) (partialPinch s E)
    rw [flipSign_diagonal] at he
    simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at hh
    rw [← partialPinch_insert, ← partialPinch_insert, he] at hh
    linarith

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_diagonal_le (z : ι → ℂ) {D E : Matrix ι ι ℂ}
    (hD : D.PosDef) (hE : E.PosDef) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ D i i))
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun i ↦ E i i)) ≤ blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal z) D E
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [partialPinch_univ] using blockLogDet_partialPinch_le z hD hE Finset.univ

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_nonneg
statement: theorem vecMass_nonneg (ψ : ι → ℂ) : 0 ≤ vecMass ψ
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ Complex.normSq_nonneg (ψ i))

name: OAI.GAD.pure_posSemidef
statement: theorem pure_posSemidef (ψ : ι → ℂ) : (pure ψ).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.posSemidef_vecMulVec_self_star ψ

name: OAI.GAD.pure_trace
statement: theorem pure_trace (ψ : ι → ℂ) : (pure ψ).trace = (vecMass ψ : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, pure, vecMass, Complex.mul_conj]

name: OAI.GAD.pure_state
statement: theorem pure_state [DecidableEq ι] {ψ : ι → ℂ} (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) : IsState (pure ψ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨pure_posSemidef ψ, by rw [pure_trace,hψ]; rfl⟩

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_eq_zero
statement: theorem vecMass_eq_zero {ψ : ι → ℂ} : vecMass ψ = 0 ↔ ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext i
    apply Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ Complex.normSq_nonneg (ψ i))).mp h i
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  · rintro rfl
    simp [vecMass]

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_unitVec
statement: @[simp] theorem vecMass_unitVec [Inhabited ι] : vecMass (unitVec (ι := ι)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [vecMass, unitVec]

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_smul
statement:
theorem vecMass_smul (z : ℂ) (ψ : ι → ℂ) :
    vecMass (z • ψ) = Complex.normSq z * vecMass ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp [vecMass, Complex.normSq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.GAD.sqrt_mass_normalize
statement:
theorem sqrt_mass_normalize [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) :
    (Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) : ℂ) • normalize ψ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : vecMass ψ = 0
  · have hz := vecMass_eq_zero.mp h
    simp [normalize,hz,vecMass]
  · have hs : (Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
      exact_mod_cast (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne (vecMass_nonneg ψ) (Ne.symm h)))
    simp [normalize,h,smul_smul,hs]

name: OAI.GAD.normalize_mass
statement: theorem normalize_mass [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) : vecMass (normalize ψ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : vecMass ψ = 0
  · simp [normalize,h]
  · have hs : Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ)*Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) = vecMass ψ := Real.mul_self_sqrt (vecMass_nonneg ψ)
    simp only [normalize, ite_eq_right h, vecMass_smul, map_inv₀, Complex.normSq_ofReal, hs]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ h

name: OAI.GAD.normSq_normalize
statement:
theorem normSq_normalize [Inhabited ι] (ψ : ι → ℂ) (i : ι) :
    Complex.normSq (ψ i) = vecMass ψ * Complex.normSq (normalize ψ i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Complex.normSq (ψ i) = Complex.normSq (((Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) : ℂ) • normalize ψ) i) :=
      congrArg (fun f : ι → ℂ ↦ Complex.normSq (f i)) (sqrt_mass_normalize ψ).symm
    _ = _ := by simp [Complex.normSq_mul, Real.mul_self_sqrt (vecMass_nonneg ψ)]

name: OAI.GAD.population_nonneg
statement:
theorem population_nonneg {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    0 ≤ population ψ j
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _
  · rfl

name: OAI.GAD.population_le_mass
statement:
theorem population_le_mass {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j ≤ vecMass ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact Complex.normSq_nonneg _

name: OAI.GAD.population_mem
statement:
theorem population_mem {n : ℕ} {ψ : Basis n → ℂ} (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨population_nonneg ψ j, hψ ▸ population_le_mass ψ j⟩

name: OAI.GAD.vecMass_branches
statement:
theorem vecMass_branches {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    vecMass ψ = vecMass (branch ψ 0) + vecMass (branch ψ 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold vecMass
  rw [sum_fin_cons]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two,branch]

name: OAI.GAD.population_zero
statement:
theorem population_zero {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    population ψ 0 = vecMass (branch ψ 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold population
  rw [sum_fin_cons]
  simp [vecMass,branch]

name: OAI.GAD.population_succ
statement:
theorem population_succ {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j.succ = population (branch ψ 0) j + population (branch ψ 1) j
proof:
:= by
  unfold population
  rw [sum_fin_cons]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two,branch]

name: OAI.GAD.population_normalize
statement:
theorem population_normalize {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (j : Fin n) :
    population ψ j = vecMass ψ * population (normalize ψ) j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [population,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs with h
  · exact normSq_normalize ψ i
  · exact (mul_zero _).symm

name: OAI.GAD.basisSplit_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem basisSplit_inl {n : ℕ} (i : Basis n) : basisSplit n (Sum.inl i) = Fin.cons 0 i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GAD.basisSplit_inr
statement: @[simp] theorem basisSplit_inr {n : ℕ} (i : Basis n) : basisSplit n (Sum.inr i) = Fin.cons 1 i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GAD.channel_pure_apply
statement:
theorem channel_pure_apply (γ ν : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) (i j : Basis n) :
    channel γ ν n (pure ψ) i j =
      ∑ r, (tensorKraus γ ν n r *ᵥ ψ) i * star ((tensorKraus γ ν n r *ᵥ ψ) j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [channel,mul_pure_mul_conjTranspose,Matrix.sum_apply,pure]

name: OAI.GAD.tensorKraus_mulVec_cons
statement:
theorem tensorKraus_mulVec_cons (γ ν : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (r : Fin 4) (R : Fin n → Fin 4)
    (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) (b : Fin 2) (i : Basis n) :
    (tensorKraus γ ν (n+1) (Fin.cons r R) *ᵥ ψ) (Fin.cons b i) =
      ∑ a : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r b a * (tensorKraus γ ν n R *ᵥ branch ψ a) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec,dotProduct]
  rw [sum_fin_cons]
  simp only [tensorKraus,Fin.prod_univ_succ,Fin.cons_zero,Fin.cons_succ]
  simp only [branch,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.GAD.channel_first_site_entry
statement:
theorem channel_first_site_entry (γ ν : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ)
    (b c : Fin 2) (i j : Basis n) :
    channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ) (Fin.cons b i) (Fin.cons c j) =
      applyKraus (kraus γ ν)
        (fun a d ↦ (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ a) *
          (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ d)).conjTranspose) i j) b c
proof:
:= by
  rw [channel_pure_apply,sum_fin_cons]
  simp only [tensorKraus_mulVec_cons]
  let u (R : Fin n → Fin 4) (a : Fin 2) (k : Basis n) :=
    (tensorKraus γ ν n R *ᵥ branch ψ a) k
  change (∑ r : Fin 4, ∑ R : Fin n → Fin 4,
      (∑ a : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r b a * u R a i) *
        star (∑ d : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r c d * u R d j)) =
    ∑ r : Fin 4, ∑ d : Fin 2,
      (∑ a : Fin 2, kraus γ ν r b a * (∑ R : Fin n → Fin 4, u R a i * star (u R d j))) *
        star (kraus γ ν r c d)
  simp only [star_sum,star_mul,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro r _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro R _
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.channel_branch_blocks
statement:
theorem channel_branch_blocks (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ) :
    Matrix.reindex (basisSplit n).symm (basisSplit n).symm (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ)) =
      thermal (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 0))
        (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ 1))
        (1-γ*ν) (γ*(1-ν)) (γ*ν) (1-γ*(1-ν)) (Real.sqrt (1-γ))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp only [Matrix.reindex_apply,Matrix.submatrix_apply,Equiv.symm_symm,basisSplit_inl,basisSplit_inr,
      channel_first_site_entry]
  all_goals
    rw [local_channel γ ν hγ hν (fun a d ↦
      (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ a) *
        (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (branch ψ d)).conjTranspose) i j)]
    simp [thermal,gram]

name: OAI.GAD.columns_smul
statement:
theorem columns_smul (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) (z : ℂ) :
    columns L (z • ψ) = z • columns L ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext i r
  simp [columns, Matrix.mulVec_smul]

name: OAI.GAD.columns_normalize
statement:
theorem columns_normalize [Inhabited κ] (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    columns L ψ = Real.sqrt (vecMass ψ) • columns L (normalize ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.coe_smul, ← columns_smul, sqrt_mass_normalize]

name: OAI.GAD.gram_columns
statement:
theorem gram_columns (L : ρ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (ψ : κ → ℂ) :
    gram (columns L ψ) = applyKraus L (pure ψ)
proof: := columns_pure L ψ

name: OAI.GAD.mass_channel_columns
statement:
theorem mass_channel_columns (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) (ψ : Basis n → ℂ) :
    mass (columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) ψ) = vecMass ψ
proof:
:= by
  unfold mass
  rw [gram_columns]
  change (channel γ ν n (pure ψ)).trace.re = _
  rw [channel_trace γ ν hγ hν, pure_trace,Complex.ofReal_re]

name: OAI.GAD.thermal_sqrt_smul
statement:
theorem thermal_sqrt_smul (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (a b c d K : ℝ)
    {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    thermal (Real.sqrt x • X) (Real.sqrt y • Y) a b c d K =
      thermal X Y (a*x) (b*y) (c*x) (d*y) (K*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [thermal,gram_sqrt_smul hx,gram_sqrt_smul hy,smul_smul,
    Matrix.conjTranspose_smul, star_trivial,Matrix.smul_mul,Matrix.mul_smul]
  congr 1
  · congr 1; ring
  · congr 1; ring

name: OAI.GAD.channel_state
statement:
theorem channel_state (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (n : ℕ) {P : QMatrix n} (hP : IsState P) :
    IsState (channel γ ν n P)
proof:
:=
  ⟨channel_posSemidef _ _ _ hP.1, (channel_trace γ ν hγ hν n P).trans hP.2⟩

name: OAI.GAD.output_entropy_recursion
statement:
theorem output_entropy_recursion (γ ν : ℝ) (hγ : γ ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hν : ν ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) {n : ℕ} (ψ : Basis (n+1) → ℂ)
    (hψ : vecMass ψ = 1) :
    vecMass (branch ψ 0) * entropy (channel γ ν n (pure (normalize (branch ψ 0)))) +
      vecMass (branch ψ 1) * entropy (channel γ ν n (pure (normalize (branch ψ 1)))) +
      g (v γ ν (population ψ 0)) ≤ entropy (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ))
proof:
:= by
  let x := vecMass (branch ψ 0)
  let y := vecMass (branch ψ 1)
  let X := columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (normalize (branch ψ 0))
  let Y := columns (tensorKraus γ ν n) (normalize (branch ψ 1))
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := vecMass_nonneg _
  have hy : 0 ≤ y := vecMass_nonneg _
  have hxy : x+y=1 := (vecMass_branches ψ).symm.trans hψ
  have hxy' : x=1-y := by linarith
  have hX : mass X = 1 := (mass_channel_columns γ ν hγ hν n _).trans (normalize_mass _)
  have hY : mass Y = 1 := (mass_channel_columns γ ν hγ hν n _).trans (normalize_mass _)
  have h1ν : 0 ≤ 1-ν := sub_nonneg.mpr hν.2
  have h1γ : 0 ≤ 1-γ := sub_nonneg.mpr hγ.2
  have h1γν : 0 ≤ 1-γ*ν := by nlinarith [hγ.2, mul_nonneg hγ.1 h1ν]
  have h1γν' : 0 ≤ 1-γ*(1-ν) := by nlinarith [hγ.2, mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν.1]
  have hKsq : (Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y)^2 = (1-γ)*x*y := by
    rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,Real.sq_sqrt h1γ,Real.sq_sqrt hx,Real.sq_sqrt hy]
  have hh := thermal_entropy X Y hX hY
    (mul_nonneg h1γν hx) (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.1 h1ν) hy)
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hγ.1 hν.1) hx) (mul_nonneg h1γν' hy)
    (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _))
    (show (1-γ*ν)*x+γ*(1-ν)*y+γ*ν*x+(1-γ*(1-ν))*y=1 by nlinarith only [hxy])
    (show ((1-γ*ν)*x)*((1-γ*(1-ν))*y)-(γ*(1-ν)*y)*(γ*ν*x)=
      (Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y)^2 by rw [hKsq]; ring)
  have hcolx : (1-γ*ν)*x+γ*ν*x=x := by ring
  have hcoly : γ*(1-ν)*y+(1-γ*(1-ν))*y=y := by ring
  have hu : ((1-γ*ν)*x+γ*(1-ν)*y)*(γ*ν*x+(1-γ*(1-ν))*y)-
      (Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y)^2 = v γ ν y := by
    rw [hKsq,hxy']; unfold v; ring
  have heq : Matrix.reindex (basisSplit n).symm (basisSplit n).symm
      (channel γ ν (n+1) (pure ψ)) =
        thermal X Y ((1-γ*ν)*x) (γ*(1-ν)*y) (γ*ν*x) ((1-γ*(1-ν))*y)
          (Real.sqrt (1-γ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.sqrt y) := by
    rw [channel_branch_blocks γ ν hγ hν,columns_normalize _ (branch ψ 0),
      columns_normalize _ (branch ψ 1),thermal_sqrt_smul _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hx hy]
  have hent := entropy_reindex (basisSplit n).symm
    (channel_posSemidef γ ν (n+1) (pure_posSemidef ψ)).isHermitian
  rw [heq] at hent
  have hbound := hh.2.2
  rw [hcolx,hcoly,hu,hent] at hbound
  simpa only [x,y,X,Y,gram_columns,population_zero,channel,applyKraus] using hbound

name: OAI.GAD.blockLambda_properties
statement:
theorem blockLambda_properties {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    0 ≤ blockLambdaPlus x y z ∧ 0 ≤ blockLambdaMinus x y z ∧
    blockLambdaPlus x y z + blockLambdaMinus x y z = x + y + z ∧
    blockLambdaPlus x y z * blockLambdaMinus x y z = y*z
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 ≤ (x+y+z)^2 - 4*y*z := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (y-z), mul_nonneg hx (by linarith : 0 ≤ y+z)]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hd
  have hsr := Real.sqrt_nonneg ((x+y+z)^2-4*y*z)
  have hle : Real.sqrt ((x+y+z)^2-4*y*z) ≤ x+y+z := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hy hz]
  dsimp [blockLambdaPlus, blockLambdaMinus]
  refine ⟨by positivity, by linarith, by ring, ?_⟩
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_nonneg
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_nonneg {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (i : Fin 5) : 0 ≤ deficitSpectrum x y z i
proof:
:= by
  have h := blockLambda_properties hx hy hz
  fin_cases i <;> simp [deficitSpectrum] <;> tauto

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_trace
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_trace {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * deficitSpectrum x y z i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (blockLambda_properties hx hy hz).2.2.1
  simp [deficitSpectrum, deficitSigns, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_entropy
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_entropy (x y z : ℝ) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * Real.negMulLog (deficitSpectrum x y z i) = scalarDeficit x y z
proof:
:= by
  simp [deficitSpectrum, deficitSigns, scalarDeficit, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.deficitSpectrum_log
statement:
theorem deficitSpectrum_log {x y z t : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (ht : 0 < t) :
    ∑ i, deficitSigns i * Real.log (1 + deficitSpectrum x y z i / t) = deficitLog x y z t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlp, hlm, hsum, hprod⟩ := blockLambda_properties hx hy hz
  have hn (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) : 1 + a/t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  have hty : t+y ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have htz : t+z ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hid : (1 + blockLambdaPlus x y z/t) * (1 + blockLambdaMinus x y z/t) =
      (1+y/t)*(1+z/t)*(1+t*x/((t+y)*(t+z))) := by
    field_simp
    nlinarith [hsum, hprod]
  have hlast : 1+t*x/((t+y)*(t+z)) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
  simp only [deficitSigns, deficitSpectrum, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_succ, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, one_mul, neg_one_mul]
  have hh := congrArg Real.log hid
  rw [Real.log_mul (hn _ hlp) (hn _ hlm),
    Real.log_mul (mul_ne_zero (hn _ hy) (hn _ hz)) hlast,
    Real.log_mul (hn _ hy) (hn _ hz)] at hh
  dsimp [deficitLog]
  linarith

/

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le {α : Type u_1} [Fintype α]
    (c x y z : α → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i, 0 ≤ y i) (hz : ∀ i, 0 ≤ z i)
    (hlog : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∑ i, c i * deficitLog (x i) (y i) (z i) t ≤ 0) :
    ∑ i, c i * scalarDeficit (x i) (y i) (z i) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := entropy_sum_le_of_log_sum_le
    (fun i : α × Fin 5 ↦ c i.1 * deficitSigns i.2)
    (fun i ↦ deficitSpectrum (x i.1) (y i.1) (z i.1) i.2)
    (fun i ↦ deficitSpectrum_nonneg (hx i.1) (hy i.1) (hz i.1) i.2) ?_ ?_
  · simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      deficitSpectrum_entropy] using h
  · simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      deficitSpectrum_trace (hx _) (hy _) (hz _), mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · intro t ht
    simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      deficitSpectrum_log (hx _) (hy _) (hz _) ht] using hlog t ht

/

name: OAI.GAD.blockLogDet_scalar
statement:
theorem blockLogDet_scalar {q d e : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e) :
    blockLogDet (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (Real.sqrt q : ℂ)))
      (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (d : ℂ))) (Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (e : ℂ))) =
      Real.log (1 + q/(d*e))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Real.sqrt q : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt q : ℂ) = (q : ℂ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Real.mul_self_sqrt hq
  have ht : 0 < d + q/e := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hd (div_nonneg hq he.le)
  have heq : d + q/e = d*(1+q/(d*e)) := by field_simp
  have hinv : Ring.inverse (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ (e : ℂ)) = fun _ ↦ (e : ℂ)⁻¹ := by
    let u : (Fin 1 → ℂ)ˣ := ⟨fun _ ↦ (e : ℂ), fun _ ↦ (e : ℂ)⁻¹,
      by ext; simp [he.ne'], by ext; simp [he.ne']⟩
    exact Ring.inverse_unit u
  simp only [blockLogDet, Matrix.inv_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose,
    Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, Matrix.det_fin_one, Matrix.add_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq, hinv, Pi.star_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.conj_ofReal]
  have hc : (d : ℂ) + (Real.sqrt q : ℂ) * (e : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt q : ℂ) =
      ((d+q/e : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    push_cast
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    calc
      _ = (d : ℂ) + ((Real.sqrt q : ℂ)*(Real.sqrt q : ℂ)) * (e : ℂ)⁻¹ := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hs]
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ht, abs_of_pos hd]
  rw [heq, Real.log_mul hd.ne' (ne_of_gt (by positivity : 0 < 1+q/(d*e)))]
  ring

name: OAI.GAD.convexOn_log_one_add_div_mul
proof:
:= by
  let Z : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (Real.sqrt q : ℂ))
  let diag (d : ℝ) : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ := Matrix.diagonal (fun _ ↦ (d : ℂ))
  have hp {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) : (diag d).PosDef := by
    apply Matrix.PosDef.diagonal
    intro i
    exact_mod_cast hd
  have hl (a b d e : ℝ) : a • diag d + b • diag e = diag (a*d+b*e) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i; fin_cases j
    simp [diag]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
    exact ⟨convex_Ioi (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ) hp.1 hq.1 ha hb hab, convex_Ioi (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ) hp.2 hq.2 ha hb hab⟩
  intro p hp' v hv a b ha hb hab
  have h := (convexOn_blockLogDet Z).2 (x := (diag p.1,diag p.2)) (y := (diag v.1,diag v.2))
    ⟨hp hp'.1, hp hp'.2⟩ ⟨hp hv.1, hp hv.2⟩ ha hb hab
  have hd : 0 < a*p.1+b*v.1 := convex_Ioi (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ) hp'.1 hv.1 ha hb hab
  have he : 0 < a*p.2+b*v.2 := convex_Ioi (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : ℝ) hp'.2 hv.2 ha hb hab
  change blockLogDet Z (a • diag p.1+b • diag v.1) (a • diag p.2+b • diag v.2) ≤ _ at h
  rw [hl, hl] at h
  simpa only [Z, diag, blockLogDet_scalar hq hp'.1 hp'.2,
    blockLogDet_scalar hq hv.1 hv.2, blockLogDet_scalar hq hd he,
    Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] using h

name: OAI.GAD.concaveOn_deficitLog_one
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq a b ha hb _
    exact ⟨add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.1) (mul_nonneg hb hq.1),
       add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.2) (mul_nonneg hb hq.2)⟩
  intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
  have h := (convexOn_log_one_add_div_mul ht.le).2
    (x := (t+p.1,t+p.2)) (y := (t+q.1,t+q.2))
    ⟨by simpa using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg ht hp.1,
     by simpa using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg ht hp.2⟩
    ⟨by simpa using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg ht hq.1,
     by simpa using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg ht hq.2⟩ ha hb hab
  have he (u v : ℝ) : a*(t+u)+b*(t+v) = t+(a*u+b*v) := by nlinarith [hab]
  simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul,
    he, deficitLog, mul_one] at h ⊢
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ ↦ v * Real.log (1+1/t)) hab]

name: OAI.GAD.concaveOn_scalarDeficit_one
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p hp q hq a b ha hb _
    exact ⟨add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.1) (mul_nonneg hb hq.1),
       add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.2) (mul_nonneg hb hq.2)⟩
  intro p hp q hq a b ha hb hab
  have hy : ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ (![p.1,q.1,a*p.1+b*q.1] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i := by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    · exact hp.1
    · exact hq.1
    · exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.1) (mul_nonneg hb hq.1)
  have hz : ∀ i : Fin 3, 0 ≤ (![p.2,q.2,a*p.2+b*q.2] : Fin 3 → ℝ) i := by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp
    · exact hp.2
    · exact hq.2
    · exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg ha hp.2) (mul_nonneg hb hq.2)
  have h := scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le ![a,b,-1] (fun _ : Fin 3 ↦ 1)
    ![p.1,q.1,a*p.1+b*q.1] ![p.2,q.2,a*p.2+b*q.2] (by intro i; positivity) hy hz
    (by
      intro t ht
      have h := (concaveOn_deficitLog_one ht).2 hp hq ha hb hab
      simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, neg_one_mul, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
        Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
      linarith)
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ,
    Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, neg_one_mul, Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add,
    Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.deficitLog_mono
statement:
theorem deficitLog_mono {x y z y' z' t : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hyy : y ≤ y') (hzz : z ≤ z') (ht : 0 < t) :
    deficitLog x y z t ≤ deficitLog x y' z' t
proof:
:= by
  have hden : (t+y)*(t+z) ≤ (t+y')*(t+z') :=
    mul_le_mul (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hdiv := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (mul_nonneg ht.le hx)
    (by positivity : 0 < (t+y)*(t+z)) hden
  have hlog := Real.strictMonoOn_log.monotoneOn
    (show 1+t*x/((t+y')*(t+z')) ∈ Ioi 0 by change (0 : ℝ) < _; have : 0 ≤ y' := hy.trans hyy; have : 0 ≤ z' := hz.trans hzz; positivity)
    (show 1+t*x/((t+y)*(t+z)) ∈ Ioi 0 by change (0 : ℝ) < _; positivity)
    (add_le_add_right hdiv 1)
  dsimp only [deficitLog]
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_mono
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_mono {x y z y' z' : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hyy : y ≤ y') (hzz : z ≤ z') : scalarDeficit x y z ≤ scalarDeficit x y' z'
proof:
:= by
  have h := scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le ![1,-1] (fun _ : Fin 2 ↦ x)
    ![y,y'] ![z,z'] (fun _ ↦ hx)
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp; exact hy; exact hy.trans hyy)
    (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp; exact hz; exact hz.trans hzz)
    (by
      intro t ht
      have h := deficitLog_mono hx hy hz hyy hzz ht
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ] using sub_nonpos.mpr h)
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, sub_nonpos] using h

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_zero
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_zero {y z : ℝ} (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit 0 y z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h (c : ℝ) : c * scalarDeficit 0 y z ≤ 0 := by
    have h := scalarDeficit_weighted_le_of_log_le (fun _ : Fin 1 ↦ c) (fun _ ↦ 0)
      (fun _ ↦ y) (fun _ ↦ z) (fun _ ↦ le_rfl) (fun _ ↦ hy) (fun _ ↦ hz)
      (by intro t ht; simp [deficitLog])
    simpa using h
  have hp := h 1
  have hm := h (-1)
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_homogeneous
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_homogeneous {a x y z : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit (a*x) (a*y) (a*z) = a * scalarDeficit x y z
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Real.sqrt ((a*x+a*y+a*z)^2-4*(a*y)*(a*z)) =
      a * Real.sqrt ((x+y+z)^2-4*y*z) := by
    rw [show (a*x+a*y+a*z)^2-4*(a*y)*(a*z) = a^2*((x+y+z)^2-4*y*z) by ring,
      Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg a), Real.sqrt_sq ha]
  have hp : blockLambdaPlus (a*x) (a*y) (a*z) = a * blockLambdaPlus x y z := by
    dsimp [blockLambdaPlus]; rw [hs]; ring
  have hm : blockLambdaMinus (a*x) (a*y) (a*z) = a * blockLambdaMinus x y z := by
    dsimp [blockLambdaMinus]; rw [hs]; ring
  have hsum := (blockLambda_properties hx hy hz).2.2.1
  simp only [scalarDeficit, hp, hm, Real.negMulLog_mul]
  nlinarith [congrArg (fun v : ℝ ↦ v * Real.negMulLog a) hsum]

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_perspective
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_perspective {x y z : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z) :
    scalarDeficit x y z = x * scalarDeficit 1 (y/x) (z/x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := scalarDeficit_homogeneous hx.le (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
    (div_nonneg hy hx.le) (div_nonneg hz hx.le)
  simpa [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hx.ne'] using h

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_superadd
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_superadd {x y z x' y' z' : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hz : 0 ≤ z)
    (hx' : 0 ≤ x') (hy' : 0 ≤ y') (hz' : 0 ≤ z') :
    scalarDeficit x y z + scalarDeficit x' y' z' ≤
      scalarDeficit (x+x') (y+y') (z+z')
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : x = 0
  · subst x
    rw [scalarDeficit_zero hy hz, zero_add, zero_add]
    exact scalarDeficit_mono hx' hy' hz' (by linarith) (by linarith)
  by_cases h0' : x' = 0
  · subst x'
    rw [scalarDeficit_zero hy' hz', add_zero, add_zero]
    exact scalarDeficit_mono hx hy hz (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hxp : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne hx (Ne.symm h0)
  have hxp' : 0 < x' := lt_of_le_of_ne hx' (Ne.symm h0')
  have hs : 0 < x+x' := add_pos hxp hxp'
  have h := concaveOn_scalarDeficit_one.2
    (x := (y/x,z/x)) (y := (y'/x',z'/x'))
    ⟨div_nonneg hy hx, div_nonneg hz hx⟩ ⟨div_nonneg hy' hx', div_nonneg hz' hx'⟩
    (div_nonneg hx hs.le) (div_nonneg hx' hs.le)
    (show x/(x+x') + x'/(x+x') = 1 by field_simp)
  simp only [Prod.fst_add, Prod.snd_add, Prod.smul_fst, Prod.smul_snd, smul_eq_mul] at h
  have he (a b : ℝ) : x/(x+x')*(a/x) + x'/(x+x')*(b/x') = (a+b)/(x+x') := by
    field_simp
  rw [he, he] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hs.le
  rw [scalarDeficit_perspective hxp hy hz,
    scalarDeficit_perspective hxp' hy' hz',
    scalarDeficit_perspective hs (add_nonneg hy hy') (add_nonneg hz hz')]
  convert hm using 1; first | rfl | field_simp

name: OAI.GAD.scalarDeficit_sum_le
statement:
theorem scalarDeficit_sum_le {ι : Type u_2} (s : Finset ι) (x y z : ι → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ x i) (hy : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ y i) (hz : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ z i) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, scalarDeficit (x i) (y i) (z i) ≤
      scalarDeficit (∑ i ∈ s, x i) (∑ i ∈ s, y i) (∑ i ∈ s, z i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [scalarDeficit_zero (le_refl 0) (le_refl 0)]
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_insert hi]
    have hxs := fun j hj ↦ hx j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    have hys := fun j hj ↦ hy j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    have hzs := fun j hj ↦ hz j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)
    calc
      _ ≤ scalarDeficit (x i) (y i) (z i) + scalarDeficit (∑ j ∈ s, x j) (∑ j ∈ s, y j) (∑ j ∈ s, z j) := add_le_add le_rfl (ih hxs hys hzs)
      _ ≤ _ := scalarDeficit_superadd (hx i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
        (hy i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s)) (hz i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg hxs) (Finset.sum_nonneg hys) (Finset.sum_nonneg hzs)

name: OAI.GAD.finiteProjectors_projection
statement:
theorem finiteProjectors_projection {M : ℕ} (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) (k : ℕ) : IsProjection (finiteProjectors Q k)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [finiteProjectors]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hQ _
  · exact ⟨Matrix.isHermitian_zero, Matrix.zero_mul _⟩

name: OAI.GAD.finiteProjectors_apply
statement:
theorem finiteProjectors_apply {M : ℕ} (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (m : Fin M) :
    finiteProjectors Q m=Q m
proof: := by simp [finiteProjectors,m.isLt]

name: OAI.GAD.sequentialMeasurement_pos
statement:
theorem sequentialMeasurement_pos {M : ℕ} (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) (m : Fin M) : (sequentialMeasurement P Q m).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  (hQ m).posSemidef.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same _

name: OAI.GAD.sequentialMeasurement_sum
statement:
theorem sequentialMeasurement_sum {M : ℕ} (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : IsProjection P)
    (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) :
    (∑ m, sequentialMeasurement P Q m)=
      P-P*(rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M)ᴴ*rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M*P
proof:
:= by
  let R := rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q)
  have he : (∑ m, sequentialMeasurement P Q m)=
      P*(∑ m : Fin M, (R m)ᴴ*finiteProjectors Q m*R m)*P := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_sum,Matrix.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro m _
    rw [finiteProjectors_apply,sequentialMeasurement,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hP.1.eq]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc,R]
  rw [he,Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k ↦ (R k)ᴴ*finiteProjectors Q k*R k) M]
  have ht := rejectProduct_sum (finiteProjectors Q) (finiteProjectors_projection Q hQ) M
  dsimp only [R]
  rw [ht,Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.mul_one,hP.2]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: OAI.GAD.sequentialMeasurement_remainder
statement:
theorem sequentialMeasurement_remainder {M : ℕ} (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : IsProjection P)
    (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) :
    (1-∑ m, sequentialMeasurement P Q m).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  rw [sequentialMeasurement_sum P hP Q hQ]
  have he : 1-(P-P*(rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M)ᴴ*rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M*P)=
      (1-P)+(rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M*P)ᴴ*(rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) M*P) := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hP.1.eq]
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    abel
  rw [he]
  exact hP.complement.posSemidef.add (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self _)

name: OAI.GAD.complete_submeasurement
statement:
theorem complete_submeasurement {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (D : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hD : ∀ m, (D m).PosSemidef) (hR : (1-∑ m, D m).PosSemidef) :
    ∃ E : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ, (∀ m, (E m).PosSemidef) ∧ (∑ m, E m=1) ∧
      (∀ m, (E m-D m).PosSemidef)
proof:
:= by
  let m0 : Fin M := ⟨0,hM⟩
  let R := 1-∑ m, D m
  let E := fun m ↦ D m+if m=m0 then R else 0
  refine ⟨E,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro m
    dsimp [E]
    split_ifs
    · exact (hD m).add hR
    · simpa only [add_zero] using hD m
  · dsimp [E]
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,ite_true]
    dsimp [R]
    abel
  · intro m
    dsimp [E]
    split_ifs
    · convert hR using 1; dsimp [R]; abel
    · simp only [add_zero,sub_self]; exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

name: OAI.GAD.sequentialMeasurement_success
statement:
theorem sequentialMeasurement_success {M : ℕ} (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (Q : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) (F : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (m : Fin M) :
    (sequentialMeasurement P Q m*gram F).trace.re=
      mass (Q m*rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m*P*F)
proof:
:= by
  have he : Q m*rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m*P*F=
      Q m*((rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m*P)*F) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [he,← projection_inner (hQ m),frobVector_inner]
  have ht := Matrix.trace_mul_cycle
    ((rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m*P)ᴴ*Q m*(rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m*P)) F Fᴴ
  simpa only [sequentialMeasurement,gram,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,Matrix.mul_assoc] using congrArg Complex.re ht

/

name: OAI.GAD.sequential_decoder_bound
statement:
theorem sequential_decoder_bound {M : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : IsProjection P)
    (Q A : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hQ : ∀ m, IsProjection (Q m)) (hA : ∀ m, IsState (A m)) :
    ∃ D : Fin M → Matrix ι ι ℂ, (∀ m, (D m).PosSemidef) ∧ (∑ m, D m=1) ∧
      ∀ m, 1-(D m*A m).trace.re ≤
        9*(1-(P*A m).trace.re)+8*(1-(Q m*A m).trace.re)+
          4*∑ j : Fin M, if j=m then 0 else (Q j*(P*A m*P)).trace.re
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D,hD,hDs,hDb⟩ := complete_submeasurement hM (sequentialMeasurement P Q)
    (sequentialMeasurement_pos P Q hQ) (sequentialMeasurement_remainder P hP Q hQ)
  refine ⟨D,hD,hDs,fun m ↦ ?_⟩
  let F := spectralFactor (hA m).1
  have hF : gram F=A m := spectralFactor_gram (hA m).1
  have hmF : mass F=1 := by dsimp [mass]; rw [hF,(hA m).2]; rfl
  have hb := sequential_projector_success (finiteProjectors Q) (finiteProjectors_projection Q hQ) (P*F) m
  rw [finiteProjectors_apply] at hb
  have hself := projected_self_failure (P := P) (hQ m) F
  have hfailP := projection_mass_decomposition hP F
  have hfailQ := projection_mass_decomposition (hQ m) F
  rw [projection_gram_mass hP F,hF] at hfailP
  rw [projection_gram_mass (hQ m) F,hF] at hfailQ
  have hcross : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m:ℕ), mass (finiteProjectors Q j*(P*F))) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin M, if j=m then 0 else (Q j*(P*A m*P)).trace.re := by
    have hgp : gram (P*F)=P*A m*P := by
      dsimp only [gram]
      rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,hP.1.eq,← Matrix.mul_assoc,Matrix.mul_assoc P F Fᴴ]
      change P*gram F*P=P*A m*P
      rw [hF]
    calc
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m:ℕ), if j=(m:ℕ) then 0 else mass (finiteProjectors Q j*(P*F)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [ite_eq_right (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega)]
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range M, if j=(m:ℕ) then 0 else mass (finiteProjectors Q j*(P*F)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono m.isLt.le)
        intro j _ _
        split_ifs
        · exact le_rfl
        · exact mass_nonneg _
      _ = _ := by
        rw [← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j ↦ if j=(m:ℕ) then 0 else mass (finiteProjectors Q j*(P*F))) M]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        by_cases hj : j=m
        · subst j; simp
        · have hjv : (j:ℕ) ≠ (m:ℕ) := by intro h; exact hj (Fin.ext h)
          rw [ite_eq_right hjv,ite_eq_right hj,finiteProjectors_apply,projection_gram_mass (hQ j),hgp]

  have hsucc := sequentialMeasurement_success P Q hQ F m
  rw [hF] at hsucc
  have hmono := trace_product_mono (hA m).1 (hDb m)
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm (A m) (sequentialMeasurement P Q m),Matrix.trace_mul_comm (A m) (D m)] at hmono
  rw [hsucc] at hmono
  have hpm : mass (P*F)=(P*A m).trace.re := by rw [projection_gram_mass hP,hF]
  rw [hmF] at hfailP hfailQ
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Q m*rejectProduct (finiteProjectors Q) m) P F] at hb
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.projectionAction_frob
statement:
theorem projectionAction_frob (P : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (X : Matrix ι κ ℂ) :
    projectionAction P (frobVector X)=frobVector (P*X)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GAD.projectionAction_orthogonal
statement:
theorem projectionAction_orthogonal {P : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hP : IsProjection P)
    (v w : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × κ)) :
    ⟪projectionAction P v,w-projectionAction P w⟫_ℝ=0
proof:
:= by
  exact projection_orthogonal hP (fun i k ↦ v (i,k)) (fun i k ↦ w (i,k))

name: OAI.GAD.matrix_sequential_union_bound
statement:
theorem matrix_sequential_union_bound (P : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hP : ∀ i, IsProjection (P i))
    (X : ℕ → Matrix ι κ ℂ) (hX : ∀ i, X (i+1)=P i*X i) (n : ℕ) :
    mass (X 0)-mass (X n) ≤ 4*∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, mass (X 0-P i*X 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sequential_union_bound (fun i ↦ projectionAction (P i))
    (fun i ↦ projectionAction_orthogonal (hP i)) (fun i ↦ frobVector (X i))
    (fun i ↦ by rw [hX]; rfl) n
  simpa only [projectionAction_frob,← frobVector_sub,frobVector_norm] using h

name: OAI.GAD.rejectProduct_loss
statement:
theorem rejectProduct_loss (Q : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hQ : ∀ k, IsProjection (Q k)) (k : ℕ) :
    (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ*rejectProduct Q k-
      (rejectProduct Q (k+1))ᴴ*rejectProduct Q (k+1)=
      (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ*Q k*rejectProduct Q k
proof:
:= by
  rw [rejectProduct,Matrix.conjTranspose_mul,(hQ k).complement.1.eq]
  have he : (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ*(1-Q k)*((1-Q k)*rejectProduct Q k)=
      (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ*(1-Q k)*rejectProduct Q k := by
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc _ (1-Q k),Matrix.mul_assoc (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ,
      (hQ k).complement.2]
  rw [he,Matrix.mul_sub,Matrix.mul_one,Matrix.sub_mul]
  abel

name: OAI.GAD.rejectProduct_sum
statement:
theorem rejectProduct_sum (Q : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ) (hQ : ∀ k, IsProjection (Q k)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (rejectProduct Q k)ᴴ*Q k*rejectProduct Q k)=
      1-(rejectProduct Q n)ᴴ*rejectProduct Q n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← rejectProduct_loss Q hQ]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_sub']
  simp [rejectProduct]

name: OAI.GAD.sequential_projector_success
statement:
theorem sequential_projector_success (Q : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ)
    (hQ : ∀ k, IsProjection (Q k)) (Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) (m : ℕ) :
    mass Y-mass (Q m*rejectProduct Q m*Y) ≤
      4*(mass (Y-Q m*Y)+∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, mass (Q j*Y))
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Matrix ι ι ℂ := fun k ↦ if k=m then Q m else 1-Q k
  have hp (k : ℕ) : IsProjection (P k) := by
    dsimp [P]; split_ifs
    · exact hQ m
    · exact (hQ k).complement

  let Z : ℕ → Matrix ι κ ℂ := fun k ↦ Nat.rec Y (fun j A ↦ P j*A) k
  have hz (k : ℕ) : Z (k+1)=P k*Z k := rfl
  have hZ (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) : Z k=rejectProduct Q k*Y := by
    induction k with
    | zero => simp [Z,rejectProduct]
    | succ k ih =>
      rw [hz,ih (by omega)]
      have hkm : k ≠ m := by omega
      simp only [P,ite_eq_right hkm,rejectProduct,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have hZend : Z (m+1)=Q m*rejectProduct Q m*Y := by
    rw [hz,hZ m le_rfl]; simp only [P,ite_eq_left rfl,Matrix.mul_assoc]
  have h := matrix_sequential_union_bound P hp Z hz (m+1)
  have hZ0 : Z 0=Y := rfl
  rw [hZ0,hZend,Finset.sum_range_succ] at h
  have hs : (∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, mass (Y-P j*Y))=∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, mass (Q j*Y) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    have hjm : j ≠ m := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega
    simp only [P,ite_eq_right hjm,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.one_mul,sub_sub_cancel]
  rw [hs] at h
  simpa only [P,ite_eq_left rfl,add_comm] using h

name: OAI.GAD.mass_triangle_sq
statement: theorem mass_triangle_sq (X Y : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : mass (X+Y) ≤ 2*mass X+2*mass Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_sq_real (frobVector X) (frobVector Y)
  rw [mass_add,← frobVector_norm X,← frobVector_norm Y]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖frobVector X-frobVector Y‖]

name: OAI.GAD.projected_self_failure
statement:
theorem projected_self_failure {P Q : Matrix ι ι ℂ} (hQ : IsProjection Q)
    (F : Matrix ι κ ℂ) : mass (P*F-Q*(P*F)) ≤ 2*mass (F-Q*F)+2*mass (F-P*F)
proof:
:= by
  have he : P*F-Q*(P*F)=(F-Q*F)+(-(1-Q)*(F-P*F)) := by
    simp only [Matrix.neg_mul,Matrix.sub_mul,Matrix.one_mul,Matrix.mul_sub]
    abel
  rw [he]
  have hb := mass_triangle_sq (F-Q*F) (-(1-Q)*(F-P*F))
  have hn : mass (-(1-Q)*(F-P*F))=mass ((1-Q)*(F-P*F)) := by
    rw [Matrix.neg_mul,← neg_one_smul ℝ ((1-Q)*(F-P*F)),mass_real_smul]
    norm_num
  rw [hn] at hb
  have hc := projection_mass_le hQ.complement (F-P*F)
  linarith

name: OAI.GAD.sequential_union_bound
statement:
