name: OAI.CriticalSK.independent_product_submartingale
statement:
lemma independent_product_submartingale {Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ}
    (hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Y i)) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ)
    (hint : ∀ n, Integrable (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω) μ)
    (hi : ∀ i, Integrable (Y i) μ) (hpos : ∀ i ω, 0 ≤ Y i ω)
    (hmean : ∀ i, 1 ≤ ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) :
    Submartingale (fun n ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω)
      (Filtration.natural Y hY) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hadp : StronglyAdapted (Filtration.natural Y hY)
      (fun n ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω) := by
    intro n
    have hh : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        StronglyMeasurable[Filtration.natural Y hY n] (Y i) := by
      intro i hi
      exact (Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural hY i).mono
        ((Filtration.natural Y hY).mono (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))
    convert Finset.stronglyMeasurable_prod (Finset.range (n + 1)) hh using 1
    ext ω
    simp only [Finset.prod_apply]
  apply submartingale_nat hadp hint
  intro n
  have hid : (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1 + 1), Y i ω) =
      (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω) * Y (n + 1) := by
    funext ω
    simp [Finset.prod_range_succ]
  rw [hid]
  have hcond := condExp_mul_of_stronglyMeasurable_left (hadp n)
    (hid ▸ hint (n + 1)) (hi (n + 1))
  have hindcond := hind.condExp_natural_ae_eq_of_lt hY (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  filter_upwards [hcond, hindcond] with ω hc he
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [he]
  exact le_mul_of_one_le_right
    (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hpos i ω)) (hmean (n + 1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.exp_partial_sum_submartingale
statement:
lemma exp_partial_sum_submartingale {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (t : ℝ) :
    ∃ (F : Filtration ℕ ‹MeasurableSpace Ω›),
      Submartingale (fun n ω => Real.exp (t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω)) F μ
proof:
:= by
  let Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun i ω => Real.exp (t * X i ω)
  have hY : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (Y i) := fun i =>
    Real.continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable ((hX i).const_mul t)
  have hYi : ∀ i, Integrable (Y i) μ := fun i => (hmgf i).integrable_exp_mul t
  have hindY : iIndepFun Y μ := hind.comp (fun _ x => Real.exp (t * x))
    (fun _ => Real.measurable_exp.comp (measurable_const.mul measurable_id))
  have heq (n : ℕ) : (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω) =
      (fun ω => Real.exp (t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω)) := by
    funext ω
    simp only [Y, Finset.mul_sum, Real.exp_sum]
  have hint (n : ℕ) : Integrable (fun ω => ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Y i ω) μ := by
    rw [heq]
    exact (HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hind (fun i _ => hmgf i)).integrable_exp_mul t
  have hm (i : ℕ) : 1 ≤ ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ := by
    have h := integral_mono (((hmgf i).integrable.const_mul t).add (integrable_const 1))
      (hYi i) (fun ω => Real.add_one_le_exp (t * X i ω))
    change (∫ ω, t * X i ω + 1 ∂μ) ≤ ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ at h
    rw [integral_add ((hmgf i).integrable.const_mul t) (integrable_const 1),
      integral_const_mul, hmean i] at h
    simpa using h
  refine ⟨Filtration.natural Y hY, ?_⟩
  have h := independent_product_submartingale hY hindY hint hYi
    (fun i ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le) hm
  convert h using 1
  funext n
  exact (heq n).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_maximal_exponential
statement:
lemma partial_sum_maximal_exponential {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0)
    (m : ℕ) {a t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-t * a + (m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hs⟩ := exp_partial_sum_submartingale hX hind hmgf hmean t
  let f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ := fun k ω => Real.exp (t * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω)
  let A : Set Ω := {ω | Real.exp (t * a) ≤
    (Finset.range (m + 1)).sup' Finset.nonempty_range_add_one (fun k => f k ω)}
  have hmax := maximal_ineq (f := f) hs (fun k ω => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
    (ε := ⟨Real.exp (t * a), (Real.exp_pos _).le⟩) m
  have hr := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hmax
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∫ ω in A, f m ω ∂μ := integral_nonneg (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  have hr' : Real.exp (t * a) * μ.real A ≤ ∫ ω in A, f m ω ∂μ := by
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul] at hr
    change Real.exp (t * a) * μ.real A ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω in A, f m ω ∂μ)).toReal at hr
    rwa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hn] at hr
  have hsubset : {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ⊆ A := by
    rintro ω ⟨k, hk, hka⟩
    exact (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hka ht)).trans
      (Finset.le_sup' (fun k => f k ω) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk)))
  have htotal : (∫ ω, f m ω ∂μ) ≤
      Real.exp ((m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    have h := (HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hind
      (s := Finset.range (m + 1)) (fun i _ => hmgf i)).mgf_le t
    simpa [f, mgf] using h
  have hbound : Real.exp (t * a) *
      μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ≤
      Real.exp ((m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) := by
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (measureReal_mono hsubset) (Real.exp_pos _).le).trans
      (hr'.trans ((setIntegral_le_integral (hs.integrable m)
        (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => (Real.exp_pos _).le))).trans htotal))
  calc
    _ ≤ Real.exp ((m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * t ^ 2 / 2) / Real.exp (t * a) :=
      (le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)).mpr (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hbound)
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.exp_sub]; congr 1; ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_maximal_tail
statement:
lemma partial_sum_maximal_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω} ≤
      Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc' : 0 < (c : ℝ) := hc
  have hp : 0 < (m + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have h := partial_sum_maximal_exponential hX hind hmgf hmean m
    (a := a) (t := a / ((m + 1) * (c : ℝ))) (by positivity)
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partial_sum_abs_maximal_tail
statement:
lemma partial_sum_abs_maximal_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := partial_sum_maximal_tail hX hind hmgf hmean hc m ha
  have hn := partial_sum_maximal_tail (X := fun i ω => -X i ω)
    (fun i => (hX i).neg) (hind.comp (fun _ x => -x) (fun _ => measurable_neg))
    (fun i => (hmgf i).neg) (fun i => by rw [integral_neg, hmean, neg_zero]) hc m ha
  let A : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω}
  let B : Set Ω := {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), -X i ω}
  have hs : {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X i ω|} ⊆ A ∪ B := by
    rintro ω ⟨k, hk, hka⟩
    rcases le_abs.mp hka with h | h
    · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hk, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨k, hk, by simpa only [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] using h⟩
  have h := (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) hs).trans (measureReal_union_le A B)
  change μ.real _ ≤ μ.real A + μ.real B at h
  change μ.real A ≤ _ at hp
  change μ.real B ≤ _ at hn
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_tail
statement:
lemma block_prefix_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (start m : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, a ≤ |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (start + i) ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-a ^ 2 / (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  exact partial_sum_abs_maximal_tail (fun i => hX (start + i))
    (hind.precomp (fun i j h => Nat.add_left_cancel h))
    (fun i => hmgf (start + i)) (fun i => hmean (start + i)) hc m ha

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockThreshold_sq
statement:
lemma blockThreshold_sq (c : ℝ≥0) (m j r : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    blockThreshold c m j r h ^ 2 =
      2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * (h ^ 2 + (j + r : ℕ) * Real.log 16)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_dyadic_tail
statement:
lemma block_prefix_dyadic_tail {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (start m j r : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    μ.real {ω | ∃ k ≤ m, blockThreshold c m j r h ≤
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (start + i) ω|} ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := block_prefix_tail hX hind hmgf hmean hc start m
    (a := blockThreshold c m j r h) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  rw [blockThreshold_sq] at ht
  have hc' : (c : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
  have hm : (m + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have he : -(2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ) * (h ^ 2 + (j + r : ℕ) * Real.log 16)) /
      (2 * (m + 1) * (c : ℝ)) = -h ^ 2 + (j + r : ℕ) * (-Real.log 16) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [he, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul, Real.exp_neg (Real.log 16), Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 16)] at ht
  simpa only [one_div, mul_assoc] using ht

name: OAI.CriticalSK.geometric_half_sum_le_two
statement:
lemma geometric_half_sum_le_two (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range N, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).sum_le_tsum
    (Finset.range N) (fun _ _ => by positivity)
  rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)] at h
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finite_scale_shell_union_bound
statement:
lemma finite_scale_shell_union_bound (A : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Set Ω)
    (B : ℕ → ℕ → Finset ℕ) (J R : ℕ) {C h : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hcard : ∀ j r, ((B j r).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (8 : ℝ) ^ (j + r))
    (hprob : ∀ j r b, b ∈ B j r → μ.real (A j r b) ≤
      2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)) :
    μ.real (⋃ j ∈ Finset.range J, ⋃ r ∈ Finset.range R, ⋃ b ∈ B j r, A j r b) ≤
      8 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hbr (j r : ℕ) : μ.real (⋃ b ∈ B j r, A j r b) ≤
      2 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ b ∈ B j r, μ.real (A j r b) := measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ B j r, 2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b hb => hprob j r b hb)
      _ = (B j r).card * (2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)) := by simp
      _ ≤ (C * (8 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)) *
          (2 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcard j r) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        have he : (8 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) := by
          rw [← mul_pow]
          norm_num
        calc
          _ = 2 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * ((8 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)) := by ring
          _ = _ := by rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, μ.real (⋃ r ∈ Finset.range R, ⋃ b ∈ B j r, A j r b) :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, μ.real (⋃ b ∈ B j r, A j r b) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun _ _ => measureReal_biUnion_finset_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, ∑ r ∈ Finset.range R,
        2 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (j + r) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Finset.sum_le_sum fun r _ => hbr j r
    _ = 2 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) *
        (∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j) *
        (∑ r ∈ Finset.range R, (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ r) := by
      simp_rw [pow_add, ← mul_assoc, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ 2 * C * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) * 2 * 2 := by
      gcongr
      · exact geometric_half_sum_le_two J
      · exact geometric_half_sum_le_two R
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockShell_card
statement:
lemma blockShell_card (j r : ℕ) :
    ((blockShell j r).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ (j + r)
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => simp [blockShell]
  | succ r =>
    have hpow : (2 : ℕ) ^ (r + 1) ≤ 8 ^ (r + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by decide) _
    have he : 2 ^ (r + 2) * 8 ^ j - 2 ^ (r + 1) * 8 ^ j = 2 ^ (r + 1) * 8 ^ j := by
      rw [show r + 2 = (r + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
      have hid : 2 ^ (r + 1) * 2 * 8 ^ j = 2 * (2 ^ (r + 1) * 8 ^ j) := by ring
      rw [hid]
      omega
    rw [blockShell, Nat.card_Ico, he]
    push_cast
    rw [pow_add (8 : ℝ) j (r + 1)]
    have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ (r + 1) ≤ 8 ^ (r + 1) := by exact_mod_cast hpow
    calc
      _ ≤ 8 ^ (r + 1) * (8 : ℝ) ^ j := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (by positivity)
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (8 : ℝ) ^ j * 8 ^ (r + 1) by positivity]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockShell_covers
statement:
lemma blockShell_covers (j b : ℕ) :
    ∃ r ≤ b, b ∈ blockShell j r
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b < 2 * 8 ^ j
  · exact ⟨0, Nat.zero_le _, by simpa [blockShell]⟩
  · have h8 : 0 < (8 : ℕ) ^ j := by positivity
    have hq : 2 ≤ b / 8 ^ j := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le h8).mpr (Nat.le_of_not_gt hb)
    let r := Nat.log 2 (b / 8 ^ j)
    have hr : 0 < r := Nat.log_pos (by decide) hq
    have hlo : 2 ^ r * 8 ^ j ≤ b :=
      (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le h8).mp (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (by omega : b / 8 ^ j ≠ 0))
    have hhi : b < 2 ^ (r + 1) * 8 ^ j :=
      (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul h8).mp (Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by decide) _)
    refine ⟨r, (Nat.log_le_self _ _).trans (Nat.div_le_self _ _), ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨r', heq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
    rw [heq] at hlo hhi ⊢
    simpa [blockShell, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using And.intro hlo hhi

name: OAI.CriticalSK.blockShell_lower
statement:
lemma blockShell_lower (j r b : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (hb : b ∈ blockShell j r) :
    2 ^ r * 8 ^ j ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hr)
  exact (Finset.mem_Ico.mp hb).1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.multiscaleBad_measurable
statement:
lemma multiscaleBad_measurable (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i))
    (c : ℝ≥0) (d : ℕ → ℕ) (J N : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (multiscaleBad X c d J N h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold multiscaleBad
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro j
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro _
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro r
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro _
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro b
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro _
  simp only [Set.ofPred_exists, Set.ofPred_and]
  apply MeasurableSet.iUnion
  intro k
  exact (MeasurableSet.const _).inter
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const (Finset.measurable_sum _ (fun i _ => hX _)).abs)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.multiscaleBad_probability
statement:
lemma multiscaleBad_probability {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0}
    (hX : ∀ i, StronglyMeasurable (X i)) (hind : iIndepFun X μ)
    (hmgf : ∀ i, HasSubgaussianMGF (X i) c μ)
    (hmean : ∀ i, ∫ ω, X i ω ∂μ = 0) (hc : 0 < c)
    (d : ℕ → ℕ) (J N : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    μ.real (multiscaleBad X c d J N h) ≤ 16 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [multiscaleBad, show (8 : ℝ) * 2 = 16 by norm_num] using
    finite_scale_shell_union_bound
      (fun j r b => {ω | ∃ k ≤ d j, blockThreshold c (d j) j r h ≤
        |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (b * (d j + 1) + i) ω|})
      blockShell J (N + 1) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)
      blockShell_card (fun j r b _ => block_prefix_dyadic_tail hX hind hmgf hmean hc _ _ _ _ _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.good_multiscale_prefix
statement:
lemma good_multiscale_prefix {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} {d : ℕ → ℕ}
    {J N : ℕ} {h : ℝ} {ω : Ω} (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c d J N h)
    {j b : ℕ} (hj : j < J) (hb : b ≤ N) :
    ∃ r ≤ b, b ∈ blockShell j r ∧ ∀ k ≤ d j,
      |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (b * (d j + 1) + i) ω| ≤
        blockThreshold c (d j) j r h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hbr⟩ := blockShell_covers j b
  refine ⟨r, hr, hbr, fun k hk => le_of_lt ?_⟩
  by_contra! hbad
  apply hω
  simp only [multiscaleBad, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mpr hj, r, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), b, hbr, k, hk, hbad⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.good_multiscale_prefix_all
statement:
lemma good_multiscale_prefix_all {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} {d : ℕ → ℕ}
    {J N : ℕ} {h : ℝ} {ω : Ω} (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c d J N h)
    {j r b : ℕ} (hj : j < J) (hr : r ≤ N) (hb : b ∈ blockShell j r) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ d j) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (b * (d j + 1) + i) ω| ≤ blockThreshold c (d j) j r h
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_lt
  by_contra! hbad
  apply hω
  simp only [multiscaleBad, Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_range.mpr hj, r, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), b, hb, k, hk, hbad⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_summation_by_parts
statement:
lemma block_summation_by_parts (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i * w i =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ξ i) * w m +
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ξ j) * (w i - w (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_zero_sum_bound
statement:
lemma block_zero_sum_bound (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {B : ℝ}
    (htotal : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i = 0)
    (hpref : ∀ k ≤ m, |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i| ≤ B) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i * w i| ≤
      B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, |w (i + 1) - w i|
proof:
:= by
  rw [block_summation_by_parts, htotal, zero_mul, zero_add,
    Finset.sum_range_succ, htotal, zero_mul, add_zero]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m,
        |(∑ j ∈ Finset.range (i + 1), ξ j) * (w i - w (i + 1))| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, B * |w (i + 1) - w i| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      rw [abs_mul, abs_sub_comm (w i)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hpref i (Nat.le_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)))
        (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := (Finset.mul_sum ..).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_prefix_weight_bound
statement:
lemma block_prefix_weight_bound (ξ w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hpref : ∀ k ≤ m, |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i| ≤ B) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i * w i| ≤
      B / (m + 1) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), |w i|) +
        2 * B * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, |w (i + 1) - w i|
proof:
:= by
  let avg : ℝ := (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i) / (m + 1)
  have hm : 0 < (m + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have havg : |avg| ≤ B / (m + 1) := by
    dsimp [avg]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hm]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hpref m le_rfl) hm.le
  have hc (k : ℕ) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, (ξ i - avg)) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range k, ξ i) - k * avg := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hz : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (ξ i - avg) = 0 := by
    rw [hc]
    dsimp [avg]
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have hp (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) : |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (ξ i - avg)| ≤ 2 * B := by
    rw [hc]
    have hk' : (k + 1 : ℝ) ≤ m + 1 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_succ hk
    have hpart : |(k + 1 : ℝ) * avg| ≤ B := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k + 1)]
      calc
        _ ≤ (k + 1) * (B / (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left havg (by positivity)
        _ ≤ (m + 1) * (B / (m + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hk' (by positivity)
        _ = B := by field_simp
    have ha := abs_sub (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ξ i) ((k + 1 : ℝ) * avg)
    push_cast
    exact ha.trans (by linarith [hpref k hk])
  have hs := block_zero_sum_bound (fun i => ξ i - avg) w m hz hp
  have hid : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ξ i * w i) =
      avg * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), w i) +
        (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (ξ i - avg) * w i) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    ring
  rw [hid]
  refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add ?_ hs)
  rw [abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul havg (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_apply
statement:
lemma alignIsometry_apply (e v x : E) :
    alignIsometry e v x = x -
      (2 * (inner ℝ (v - ‖v‖ • e) x / ‖v - ‖v‖ • e‖ ^ 2)) • (v - ‖v‖ • e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [alignIsometry, Submodule.reflection_orthogonal_apply,
    Submodule.reflection_singleton_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq, neg_sub, two_smul]
  rw [two_mul, add_smul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_align
statement:
lemma alignIsometry_align (e v : E) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) :
    alignIsometry e v v = ‖v‖ • e
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.reflection_sub
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), he, mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alignIsometry_measurable
statement:
lemma alignIsometry_measurable (e : E) :
    Measurable (fun p : E × E => alignIsometry e p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [alignIsometry_apply]
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.random_isometry_gaussian_preserving
statement:
lemma random_isometry_gaussian_preserving {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ] (U : Ω → E ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] E)
    (hU : Measurable (fun p : Ω × E => U p.1 p.2)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : Ω × E => (p.1, U p.1 p.2))
      (μ.prod (stdGaussian E)) (μ.prod (stdGaussian E))
proof:
:= by
  exact (MeasurePreserving.id μ).skew_product (g := fun ω x => U ω x)
    (μc := stdGaussian E) (μd := stdGaussian E) hU
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => stdGaussian_map (U ω)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.exposed_gaussian_alignment
statement:
lemma exposed_gaussian_alignment (e : E) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : E × E => (p.1, alignIsometry e p.1 p.2))
      ((stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian E)) ((stdGaussian E).prod (stdGaussian E))
proof:
:=
  random_isometry_gaussian_preserving _ _ (alignIsometry_measurable e)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_inner_stdGaussian
statement:
lemma covariance_inner_stdGaussian (v w : E) :
    cov[fun x => inner ℝ v x, fun x => inner ℝ w x; stdGaussian E] = inner ℝ v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← covarianceBilin_apply_eq_cov IsGaussian.memLp_two_id,
    covarianceBilin_stdGaussian]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.inner_stdGaussian_law
statement:
lemma inner_stdGaussian_law (v : E) :
    (stdGaussian E).map (fun x => inner ℝ v x) =
      gaussianReal 0 (‖v‖ ^ 2).toNNReal
proof:
:= by
  have hG : HasGaussianLaw (fun x : E => inner ℝ v x) (stdGaussian E) :=
    IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id.map_fun (innerSL ℝ v)
  rw [hG.map_eq_gaussianReal]
  congr 1
  · exact integral_strongDual_stdGaussian (innerSL ℝ v)
  · rw [← covariance_self (by fun_prop), covariance_inner_stdGaussian, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_orthogonal_independent
statement:
lemma gaussian_orthogonal_independent {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ] (v : κ → E)
    (hv : Pairwise (fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j) = 0)) :
    iIndepFun (fun i x => inner ℝ (v i) x) (stdGaussian E)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : HasGaussianLaw (fun x : E => fun i => inner ℝ (v i) x) (stdGaussian E) :=
    IsGaussian.hasGaussianLaw_id.map_fun (ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun i => innerSL ℝ (v i)))
  apply hG.iIndepFun_of_covariance_eq_zero
  intro i j hij
  rw [covariance_inner_stdGaussian]
  exact hv hij

name: OAI.CriticalSK.transposeGaussianMatrix_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma transposeGaussianMatrix_apply (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (i j : ι) :
    transposeGaussianMatrix A i j = A j i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rowIsometry_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rowIsometry_apply (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (i : ι) : rowIsometry U A i = U (A i)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_preserves
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_preserves (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (stdGaussian (GaussianMatrix ι)).map (conjugateGaussianMatrix U) =
      stdGaussian (GaussianMatrix ι)
proof:
:=
  stdGaussian_map _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum
statement:
lemma euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (i : ι) :
    U v i = ∑ j, v j * U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ j) i
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ).sum_repr v, map_sum]
  simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (i j : ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U A i j =
      ∑ k, ∑ l, U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ k) i * A k l *
        U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ l) j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugateGaussianMatrix, LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply,
    transposeGaussianMatrix_apply, rowIsometry_apply]
  rw [euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  simp only [transposeGaussianMatrix_apply, rowIsometry_apply]
  rw [euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U (transposeGaussianMatrix A) =
      transposeGaussianMatrix (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply, transposeGaussianMatrix_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l _
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous
statement:
lemma symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous (s : ℝ) :
    Continuous (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix (ι := ι) s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold symmetrizeGaussianMatrix
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugate_symmetrize
statement:
lemma conjugate_symmetrize (s : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix U (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s A) =
      symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [symmetrizeGaussianMatrix, map_smul, map_add,
    conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeLaw_conjugate
statement:
lemma goeLaw_conjugate (s : ℝ)
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    (goeLaw ι s).map (conjugateGaussianMatrix U) = goeLaw ι s
proof:
:= by
  unfold goeLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, conjugate_symmetrize]
  calc
    _ = ((stdGaussian (GaussianMatrix ι)).map (conjugateGaussianMatrix U)).map
        (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s) :=
      (Measure.map_map (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable
        (conjugateGaussianMatrix U).continuous.measurable).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [conjugateGaussianMatrix_preserves]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_measurable
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_measurable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (U : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (hU : Measurable (fun p : Ω × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => U p.1 p.2)) :
    Measurable (fun p : Ω × GaussianMatrix ι => conjugateGaussianMatrix (U p.1) p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (k i : ι) : Measurable (fun ω => U ω (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ k) i) :=
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => x i)).comp
      (hU.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const))
  change Measurable (fun p : Ω × GaussianMatrix ι => WithLp.toLp 2
    (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => conjugateGaussianMatrix (U p.1) p.2 i j)))
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro j
  simp only [conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply]
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro k _
  apply Finset.measurable_sum
  intro l _
  exact ((hc k i).comp measurable_fst |>.mul
    ((by fun_prop : Measurable (fun A : GaussianMatrix ι => A k l)).comp measurable_snd)).mul
      ((hc l j).comp measurable_fst)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.random_goe_conjugation_preserving
statement:
lemma random_goe_conjugation_preserving {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ] (s : ℝ)
    (U : Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (hU : Measurable (fun p : Ω × EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => U p.1 p.2)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : Ω × GaussianMatrix ι =>
      (p.1, conjugateGaussianMatrix (U p.1) p.2))
      (μ.prod (goeLaw ι s)) (μ.prod (goeLaw ι s))
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (goeLaw ι s) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
      (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable.aemeasurable).2 inferInstance
  exact (MeasurePreserving.id μ).skew_product
    (g := fun ω A => conjugateGaussianMatrix (U ω) A)
    (conjugateGaussianMatrix_measurable U hU)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => goeLaw_conjugate s (U ω)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrixUnit_inner
statement:
@[simp] lemma matrixUnit_inner (i j : ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    inner ℝ (matrixUnit i j) A = A i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [matrixUnit, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  · intro k _ hki
    simp [matrixUnit, hki]
  · simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrixUnit_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma matrixUnit_apply [DecidableEq ι] (i j k l : ι) :
    matrixUnit i j k l = if k = i ∧ l = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [matrixUnit]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeEntryVector_inner
statement:
lemma goeEntryVector_inner (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    inner ℝ (goeEntryVector s i j) A = symmetrizeGaussianMatrix s A i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [goeEntryVector, symmetrizeGaussianMatrix, inner_smul_left, inner_add_left]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entry_variance
statement:
lemma goe_entry_variance [DecidableEq ι] (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    ‖goeEntryVector s i j‖ ^ 2 = if i = j then 4 * s ^ 2 else 2 * s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [goeEntryVector, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    inner_add_left, inner_add_right, matrixUnit_inner, matrixUnit_apply]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp only [and_self, ite_true]
    ring
  · have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij
    simp only [hij, hji, and_self, ite_true, ite_false]
    ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entry_law
statement:
lemma goe_entry_law [DecidableEq ι] (s : ℝ) (i j : ι) :
    (goeLaw ι s).map (fun A => A i j) =
      gaussianReal 0 (if i = j then (4 * s ^ 2).toNNReal else (2 * s ^ 2).toNNReal)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold goeLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, ← goeEntryVector_inner]
  rw [inner_stdGaussian_law, goe_entry_variance]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeEntryVector_orthogonal
statement:
lemma goeEntryVector_orthogonal (s : ℝ) :
    Pairwise (fun p q : UpperEntry ι =>
      inner ℝ (goeEntryVector s p.1.1 p.1.2) (goeEntryVector s q.1.1 q.1.2) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hij⟩ ⟨⟨k, l⟩, hkl⟩ hpq
  have h1 : ¬(i = k ∧ j = l) := by
    rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact hpq rfl
  have h2 : ¬(i = l ∧ j = k) := by
    intro hs
    have he : i = j := le_antisymm hij (by simpa only [hs.1, hs.2] using hkl)
    apply hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext (he.trans hs.2) (he.symm.trans hs.1)
  simp only [goeEntryVector, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    inner_add_left, inner_add_right, matrixUnit_inner, matrixUnit_apply]
  simp only [h1, h2, ite_false, add_zero, mul_zero,
    show ¬(j = k ∧ i = l) from fun h => h2 ⟨h.2, h.1⟩,
    show ¬(j = l ∧ i = k) from fun h => h1 ⟨h.2, h.1⟩]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_entries_independent
statement:
lemma goe_entries_independent (s : ℝ) :
    iIndepFun (fun p : UpperEntry ι => fun A : GaussianMatrix ι => A p.1.1 p.1.2)
      (goeLaw ι s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gaussian_orthogonal_independent
    (fun p : UpperEntry ι => goeEntryVector s p.1.1 p.1.2) (goeEntryVector_orthogonal s)
  simp only [goeEntryVector_inner] at h
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (goeLaw ι s) :=
    (Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map_iff
      (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable.aemeasurable).2 inferInstance
  apply (iIndepFun_iff_map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun _ => by fun_prop)).2
  unfold goeLaw
  rw [Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable]
  have hh := h.map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun _ => by fun_prop)
  simp only [Function.comp_def] at *
  rw [hh]
  congr 1
  ext p : 1
  exact (Measure.map_map (g := fun A : GaussianMatrix ι => A p.1.1 p.1.2) (by fun_prop)
    (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperRead_measurable
statement: lemma upperRead_measurable : Measurable (upperRead (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro p
  fun_prop [upperRead]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperWrite_measurable
statement: lemma upperWrite_measurable : Measurable (upperWrite (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro j
  dsimp [upperWrite]
  split_ifs <;> fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperWrite_upperRead
statement:
lemma upperWrite_upperRead (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    upperWrite (upperRead A) = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  dsimp [upperWrite, upperRead]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · exact hA j i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperRead_upperWrite
statement:
@[simp] lemma upperRead_upperWrite (a : UpperEntry ι → ℝ) :
    upperRead (upperWrite a) = a
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  exact dite_eq_left p.2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_symmetric_ae
statement: lemma goe_symmetric_ae (s : ℝ) : ∀ᵐ A ∂goeLaw ι s, ∀ i j, A i j = A j i
proof:
:= by
  rw [goeLaw]
  apply (ae_map_iff (symmetrizeGaussianMatrix_continuous s).measurable.aemeasurable (by measurability)).2
  filter_upwards [] with A i j
  simp only [symmetrizeGaussianMatrix, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.add_apply,
    transposeGaussianMatrix_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_upper_law
statement:
lemma goe_upper_law (s : ℝ) :
    (goeLaw ι s).map upperRead = Measure.pi (fun p : UpperEntry ι =>
      gaussianReal 0 (if p.1.1 = p.1.2 then (4 * s^2).toNNReal else (2 * s^2).toNNReal))
proof:
:= by
  unfold upperRead
  rw [(goe_entries_independent (ι := ι) s).map_fun_eq_pi_map (fun _ => by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  funext p
  exact goe_entry_law s p.1.1 p.1.2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeLaw_eq_upper_product
statement:
lemma goeLaw_eq_upper_product (s : ℝ) :
    goeLaw ι s = (Measure.pi (fun p : UpperEntry ι =>
      gaussianReal 0 (if p.1.1 = p.1.2 then (4 * s^2).toNNReal else (2 * s^2).toNNReal))).map
        upperWrite
proof:
:= by
  rw [← goe_upper_law, Measure.map_map upperWrite_measurable upperRead_measurable]
  have heq : (upperWrite ∘ upperRead : GaussianMatrix ι → GaussianMatrix ι) =ᵐ[goeLaw ι s] id := by
    filter_upwards [goe_symmetric_ae (ι := ι) s] with A hA
    exact upperWrite_upperRead A hA
  rw [Measure.map_congr heq, Measure.map_id]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperSplit_diag
statement: @[simp] lemma upperSplit_diag (n : ℕ) : upperSplit n (Sum.inl ()) = ⟨(0, 0), le_rfl⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperSplit_column
statement:
@[simp] lemma upperSplit_column (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    upperSplit n (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) = ⟨(0, i.succ), Fin.zero_le _⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.upperSplit_tail
statement:
@[simp] lemma upperSplit_tail (n : ℕ) (p : UpperEntry (Fin n)) :
    upperSplit n (Sum.inr (Sum.inr p)) =
      ⟨(p.1.1.succ, p.1.2.succ), Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr p.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.splitUpper_preserving
statement:
lemma splitUpper_preserving (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (splitUpper n) (Measure.pi (goeUpperMarginal (ι := Fin (n + 1)) s))
      ((gaussianReal 0 (4 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
        ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
          (Measure.pi (goeUpperMarginal (ι := Fin n) s))))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := goeUpperMarginal (ι := Fin (n + 1)) s
  have h1 := (measurePreserving_piCongrLeft μ (upperSplit n)).symm
  have h2 := measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi (fun i => μ (upperSplit n i))
  have h3 := (measurePreserving_piUnique (fun u : Unit => μ (upperSplit n (Sum.inl u)))).prod
    (measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi (fun i => μ (upperSplit n (Sum.inr i))))
  have h := h3.comp (h2.comp h1)
  convert h using 1
  · rfl
  · dsimp [μ, goeUpperMarginal]
    simp only [Fin.succ_inj, (Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero _)), ite_false]
    rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_zero
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma extendTailIsometry_succ {n : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (i : Fin n) :
    extendTailIsometry U x i.succ = U (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun j => x j.succ)) i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_basis_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma extendTailIsometry_basis_zero {n : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    extendTailIsometry U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ 0) =
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ i =>
    simp only [extendTailIsometry_succ, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
    have h : (WithLp.toLp 2 fun j : Fin n => (EuclideanSpace.single 0 (1 : ℝ)) j.succ) = 0 := by
      ext j; simp
    rw [h, map_zero]
    simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_basis_succ
statement:
lemma extendTailIsometry_basis_succ {n : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (k : Fin n) :
    extendTailIsometry U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ k.succ) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cases 0 (U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin n) ℝ k)))
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i =>
    simp only [extendTailIsometry_succ, Fin.cases_succ]
    apply congrArg (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) => U w i)
    ext j
    simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma borderMatrix_zero_zero {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (B : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) : borderMatrix a v B 0 0 = a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma borderMatrix_zero_succ {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (B : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : borderMatrix a v B 0 i.succ = v i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_succ_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma borderMatrix_succ_zero {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (B : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) : borderMatrix a v B i.succ 0 = v i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma borderMatrix_succ_succ {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (B : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) (i j : Fin n) : borderMatrix a v B i.succ j.succ = B i j
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_border
statement:
lemma extendTailIsometry_border {n : ℕ}
    (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (a : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (B : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix (extendTailIsometry U) (borderMatrix a v B) =
      borderMatrix a (U v) (conjugateGaussianMatrix U B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i j
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> cases j using Fin.cases
  all_goals simp only [conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  all_goals simp only [extendTailIsometry_basis_zero, extendTailIsometry_basis_succ]
  all_goals simp only [Fin.cases_zero, Fin.cases_succ,
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  all_goals simp only [PiLp.single_apply, Fin.succ_ne_zero,
    ite_true, ite_false, borderMatrix_zero_zero, borderMatrix_zero_succ,
    borderMatrix_succ_zero, borderMatrix_succ_succ, zero_mul, mul_zero,
    one_mul, mul_one, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  · simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using (euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum U v _).symm
  · rw [euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, mul_comm]
  · simpa only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply] using (conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply U B _ _).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrixTail_measurable
statement: lemma matrixTail_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (matrixTail (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro j
  fun_prop [matrixTail]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeBlocks_measurable
statement: lemma goeBlocks_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (goeBlocks (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  exact (by fun_prop : Measurable fun A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)) => A 0 0).prodMk
    ((Measurable.of_eval (fun _ => by fun_prop)).prodMk (matrixTail_measurable n))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_blocks
statement:
lemma borderMatrix_blocks {n : ℕ} (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    borderMatrix (goeBlocks A).1 (WithLp.toLp 2 (goeBlocks A).2.1) (goeBlocks A).2.2 = A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> cases j using Fin.cases
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact hA _ _
  · rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goeBlocks_preserving
statement:
lemma goeBlocks_preserving (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (goeBlocks (n := n)) (goeLaw (Fin (n + 1)) s)
      ((gaussianReal 0 (4 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
        ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
          (goeLaw (Fin n) s)))
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi (goeUpperMarginal (ι := Fin (n+1)) s)
  have hw : MeasurePreserving (upperWrite (ι := Fin n))
      (Measure.pi (goeUpperMarginal s)) (goeLaw (Fin n) s) :=
    ⟨upperWrite_measurable, (goeLaw_eq_upper_product s).symm⟩
  have hr : MeasurePreserving (upperRead (ι := Fin (n+1))) (goeLaw (Fin (n+1)) s) μ :=
    ⟨upperRead_measurable, goe_upper_law s⟩
  have hp := (MeasurePreserving.id (gaussianReal 0 (4 * s^2).toNNReal)).prod
    ((MeasurePreserving.id (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal)).prod hw)
  have h := hp.comp ((splitUpper_preserving n s).comp hr)
  refine ⟨goeBlocks_measurable n, ?_⟩
  rw [← h.map_eq]
  apply Measure.map_congr
  filter_upwards [goe_symmetric_ae (ι := Fin (n+1)) s] with A hA
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, Prod.map_apply, id_eq, splitUpper, upperRead, goeBlocks]
  refine Prod.ext rfl (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
  change matrixTail A = upperWrite (upperRead (matrixTail A))
  exact (upperWrite_upperRead _ (fun i j => hA i.succ j.succ)).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.aligned_goeBlock_preserving
statement:
lemma aligned_goeBlock_preserving (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ)
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × GaussianMatrix (Fin n) =>
      (p.1, conjugateGaussianMatrix (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1)) p.2))
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal).prod (goeLaw (Fin n) s))
      ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal).prod (goeLaw (Fin n) s))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : (Fin n → ℝ) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
      alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 p.1) p.2) := by
    simp_rw [alignIsometry_apply]
    fun_prop
  exact random_goe_conjugation_preserving
    (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal) s
    (fun v : Fin n → ℝ => alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 v)) hm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.exposed_column_tail_law
statement:
lemma exposed_column_tail_law (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)) =>
      (A 0 0, (fun i => A 0 i.succ,
        conjugateGaussianMatrix (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ)))
          (matrixTail A))))
      (goeLaw (Fin (n+1)) s)
      ((gaussianReal 0 (4 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
        ((Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2 * s^2).toNNReal).prod
          (goeLaw (Fin n) s)))
proof:
:=
  ((MeasurePreserving.id _).prod (aligned_goeBlock_preserving n s e)).comp (goeBlocks_preserving n s)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.goe_step_conjugate
statement:
lemma goe_step_conjugate {n : ℕ} (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (he : ‖e‖ = 1)
    (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1))) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix
      (extendTailIsometry (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ)))) A =
      borderMatrix (A 0 0) (‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ • e)
        (conjugateGaussianMatrix (alignIsometry e (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => A 0 i.succ)))
          (matrixTail A))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => arg 2; rw [← borderMatrix_blocks A hA]
  rw [extendTailIsometry_border]
  dsimp only [goeBlocks]
  rw [alignIsometry_align _ _ he]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrixOfGaussian_injective
statement: lemma matrixOfGaussian_injective : Function.Injective (matrixOfGaussian (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  ext i j
  exact congrFun (congrFun h i) j

name: OAI.CriticalSK.orthoMatrix_trans
statement:
lemma orthoMatrix_trans (U V : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    orthoMatrix (U.trans V) = orthoMatrix V * orthoMatrix U
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change V (U (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ j)) i = _
  rw [euclidean_isometry_apply_eq_sum]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, orthoMatrix]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intros
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.matrixOfGaussian_conjugate
statement:
lemma matrixOfGaussian_conjugate (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    matrixOfGaussian (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A) =
      orthoMatrix U * matrixOfGaussian A * (orthoMatrix U).transpose
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [matrixOfGaussian, conjugateGaussianMatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, orthoMatrix, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugateGaussianMatrix_trans
statement:
lemma conjugateGaussianMatrix_trans (U V : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix (U.trans V) A =
      conjugateGaussianMatrix V (conjugateGaussianMatrix U A)
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixOfGaussian_injective
  simp only [matrixOfGaussian_conjugate, orthoMatrix_trans, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.conjugate_symmetric
statement:
lemma conjugate_symmetric (U : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (A : GaussianMatrix ι) (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    ∀ i j, conjugateGaussianMatrix U A i j = conjugateGaussianMatrix U A j i
proof:
:= by
  have hT : transposeGaussianMatrix A = A := by ext i j; exact hA j i
  have h := conjugateGaussianMatrix_transpose U A
  rw [hT] at h
  intro i j
  exact congrArg (fun B : GaussianMatrix ι => B i j) h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.firstAxis_succ
statement: lemma firstAxis_succ (n : ℕ) : firstAxis (n+1) = EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n+1)) ℝ 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> simp [firstAxis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.firstAxis_norm_succ
statement: lemma firstAxis_norm_succ (n : ℕ) : ‖firstAxis (n+1)‖ = 1
proof:
:= by

  exact (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n+1)) ℝ).orthonormal.norm_eq_one 0

name: OAI.CriticalSK.align_firstAxis
statement:
lemma align_firstAxis (n : ℕ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    alignIsometry (firstAxis n) v v = ‖v‖ • firstAxis n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ n => exact alignIsometry_align _ _ (firstAxis_norm_succ n)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.extendTailIsometry_firstAxis
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstAxis_succ]
  exact extendTailIsometry_basis_zero U

name: OAI.CriticalSK.reducedTail_symmetric
statement:
lemma reducedTail_symmetric {n : ℕ} (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)))
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) : ∀ i j, reducedTail A i j = reducedTail A j i
proof:
:=
  conjugate_symmetric _ _ (fun i j => hA i.succ j.succ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.firstColumn_measurable
statement: @[fun_prop] lemma firstColumn_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (firstColumn (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i

name: OAI.CriticalSK.reducedTail_measurable
statement: lemma reducedTail_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (reducedTail (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (exposed_column_tail_law n 1 (firstAxis n)).measurable
  have ht : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ((Fin n → ℝ) × GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) => p.2.2) :=
    measurable_snd.comp measurable_snd
  exact ht.comp hm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.first_step_conjugate
statement:
lemma first_step_conjugate {n : ℕ} (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)))
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    conjugateGaussianMatrix (extendTailIsometry (alignIsometry (firstAxis n) (firstColumn A))) A =
      borderMatrix (A 0 0) (‖firstColumn A‖ • firstAxis n) (reducedTail A)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => arg 2; rw [← borderMatrix_blocks A hA]
  rw [extendTailIsometry_border]
  dsimp only [goeBlocks]
  change borderMatrix (A 0 0) (alignIsometry (firstAxis n) (firstColumn A) (firstColumn A))
    (reducedTail A) = _
  rw [align_firstAxis]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triIsometry_firstAxis
statement:
lemma triIsometry_firstAxis (n : ℕ) (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) :
    triIsometry n A (firstAxis n) = firstAxis n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n => simp only [triIsometry, LinearIsometryEquiv.trans_apply, extendTailIsometry_firstAxis]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triReduce_conjugate
statement:
lemma triReduce_conjugate (n : ℕ) (A : GaussianMatrix (Fin n))
    (hA : ∀ i j, A i j = A j i) :
    triReduce n A = conjugateGaussianMatrix (triIsometry n A) A
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [triIsometry, conjugateGaussianMatrix_trans, first_step_conjugate A hA,
      extendTailIsometry_border]
    simp only [map_smul, triIsometry_firstAxis]
    rw [← ih _ (reducedTail_symmetric A hA)]
    rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.borderMatrix_measurable
statement:
lemma borderMatrix_measurable (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) =>
      borderMatrix p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).comp
  apply Measurable.of_eval
  intro j
  change Measurable (fun p : ℝ × (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × GaussianMatrix (Fin n)) =>
    borderMatrix p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 i j)
  cases i using Fin.cases <;> cases j using Fin.cases
  all_goals simp only [borderMatrix_zero_zero, borderMatrix_zero_succ,
    borderMatrix_succ_zero, borderMatrix_succ_succ]
  all_goals fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triReduce_measurable
statement: lemma triReduce_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (triReduce n)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact measurable_id
  | succ n ih =>
    exact (borderMatrix_measurable n).comp
      ((by fun_prop : Measurable fun A : GaussianMatrix (Fin (n+1)) => A 0 0).prodMk
        (((firstColumn_measurable n).norm.smul measurable_const).prodMk
          (ih.comp (reducedTail_measurable n))))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.assembleTri_measurable
statement: lemma assembleTri_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (assembleTri n)
proof:
:=
  (borderMatrix_measurable n).comp
    (measurable_fst.prodMk ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_snd |>.smul measurable_const).prodMk
      (measurable_snd.comp measurable_snd)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.columnNorm_preserving
statement:
lemma columnNorm_preserving (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (fun v : Fin n → ℝ => ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖)
      (Measure.pi fun _ : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (2*s^2).toNNReal) (columnNormLaw n s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(WithLp.measurable_toLp _ _).norm, rfl⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triReduce_preserving
statement:
lemma triReduce_preserving (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (triReduce n) (goeLaw (Fin n) s) (triMatrixLaw n s)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact MeasurePreserving.id _
  | succ n ih =>
    have hp := (MeasurePreserving.id (gaussianReal 0 (4*s^2).toNNReal)).prod
      ((columnNorm_preserving n s).prod ih)
    have ha : MeasurePreserving (assembleTri n)
        ((gaussianReal 0 (4*s^2).toNNReal).prod ((columnNormLaw n s).prod (triMatrixLaw n s)))
        (triMatrixLaw (n+1) s) := ⟨assembleTri_measurable n, rfl⟩
    exact ha.comp (hp.comp (exposed_column_tail_law n s (firstAxis n)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_density
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_density (t x : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x * Real.exp (t * x ^ 2) =
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 - t) * x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianPDFReal, NNReal.coe_one, mul_one, sub_zero]
  rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 2
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_integral
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_integral (t : ℝ) (ht : t < 1 / 2) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (t * x ^ 2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1) =
      (Real.sqrt (1 - 2 * t))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, gaussian_square_density]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_gaussian]
  have ha : 0 < 1 / 2 - t := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < 1 - 2 * t := by linarith
  apply (mul_left_inj' (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hb)).mp
  rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr hb)]
  have he : Real.sqrt (Real.pi / (1 / 2 - t)) * Real.sqrt (1 - 2 * t) =
      Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
    rw [← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity), show Real.pi / (1 / 2 - t) * (1 - 2 * t) =
      2 * Real.pi by field_simp]
  calc
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (Real.pi / (1 / 2 - t)) *
        Real.sqrt (1 - 2 * t) = (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by
          rw [mul_assoc, he]
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_integrable
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_integrable (t : ℝ) (ht : t < 1 / 2) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x ^ 2)) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply mgf_pos_iff.mp
  change 0 < ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (t * x ^ 2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1
  rw [gaussian_square_integral t ht]
  exact inv_pos.mpr (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianLinear_continuous
statement: lemma gaussianLinear_continuous (a : ι → ℝ) : Continuous (gaussianLinear a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianLinear
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_exp_integrable
statement:
lemma gaussian_exp_integrable (v : ℝ≥0) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z => Real.exp (gaussianLinear a z)) (gaussianScalarPi v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianLinear,Real.exp_sum]
  exact Integrable.fintype_prod (fun i => integrable_exp_mul_gaussianReal (a i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_exp_integral
statement:
lemma gaussian_exp_integral (v : ℝ≥0) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ z, Real.exp (gaussianLinear a z) ∂gaussianScalarPi v) = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*(∑ i, a i^2)/2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianLinear,Real.exp_sum,gaussianScalarPi]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod (μ := fun _ => gaussianReal 0 v) (fun i (z : ℝ) => Real.exp (a i*z))]
  have he (i : ι) : (∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (a i*z) ∂gaussianReal 0 v) = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*(a i)^2/2) := by
    have hh := mgf_gaussianReal (p := gaussianReal 0 v) (X := id) (μ := 0) (v := v) (by simp) (a i)
    simpa only [mgf,zero_mul,zero_add,id_eq] using hh
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← Real.exp_sum]
  congr 1
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_div]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianLinear_neg
statement: lemma gaussianLinear_neg (a z : ι → ℝ) : gaussianLinear (-a) z = -gaussianLinear a z
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussianLinear]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianLinear_add
statement: lemma gaussianLinear_add (a b z : ι → ℝ) : gaussianLinear (a+b) z = gaussianLinear a z+gaussianLinear b z
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussianLinear,add_mul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianLinear_sub
statement: lemma gaussianLinear_sub (a b z : ι → ℝ) : gaussianLinear (a-b) z = gaussianLinear a z-gaussianLinear b z
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaussianLinear,sub_mul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cosh_integrable
statement:
lemma gaussian_cosh_integrable (v : ℝ≥0) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z => Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)) (gaussianScalarPi v)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Real.cosh_eq,← gaussianLinear_neg]
  exact ((gaussian_exp_integrable v a).add (gaussian_exp_integrable v (-a))).div_const 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cosh_integral
statement:
lemma gaussian_cosh_integral (v : ℝ≥0) (a : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ z, Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z) ∂gaussianScalarPi v) = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*(∑ i, a i^2)/2)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Real.cosh_eq,← gaussianLinear_neg]
  rw [integral_div,integral_add (gaussian_exp_integrable v a) (gaussian_exp_integrable v (-a)),gaussian_exp_integral,gaussian_exp_integral]
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply,neg_sq]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cosh_mul_cosh_identity
statement: lemma cosh_mul_cosh_identity (a b : ℝ) : Real.cosh a*Real.cosh b = (Real.cosh (a+b)+Real.cosh (a-b))/2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.cosh_add,Real.cosh_sub]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cosh_product_integrable
statement:
lemma gaussian_cosh_product_integrable (v : ℝ≥0) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun z => Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear b z)) (gaussianScalarPi v)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cosh_mul_cosh_identity,← gaussianLinear_add,← gaussianLinear_sub]
  exact ((gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a+b)).add (gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a-b))).div_const 2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cosh_product_integral
statement:
lemma gaussian_cosh_product_integral (v : ℝ≥0) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ z, Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear b z) ∂gaussianScalarPi v) =
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*((∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2))/2)*Real.cosh ((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a i*b i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cosh_mul_cosh_identity,← gaussianLinear_add,← gaussianLinear_sub]
  rw [integral_div,integral_add (gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a+b)) (gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a-b)),gaussian_cosh_integral,gaussian_cosh_integral]
  have hp : (∑ i, (a+b) i^2) = (∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2)+2*∑ i, a i*b i := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _; ring
  have hm : (∑ i, (a-b) i^2) = (∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2)-2*∑ i, a i*b i := by
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply,Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _; ring
  rw [hp,hm,Real.cosh_eq]
  rw [show (v:ℝ)*((∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2)+2*∑ i, a i*b i)/2 =
    (v:ℝ)*((∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2))/2+(v:ℝ)*∑ i, a i*b i by ring,
    show (v:ℝ)*((∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2)-2*∑ i, a i*b i)/2 =
    (v:ℝ)*((∑ i, a i^2)+(∑ i, b i^2))/2+(-((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a i*b i)) by ring,
    Real.exp_add,Real.exp_add]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cosh_pow_exp_bound
statement:
lemma cosh_pow_exp_bound (z : ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    Real.cosh z^m ≤ Real.exp ((m:ℝ)*z)+Real.exp (-((m:ℝ)*z))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Real.cosh z ≤ Real.exp |z| := by
    rw [Real.cosh_eq]
    have hp := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_abs_self z)
    have hm := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (neg_le_abs z)
    linarith
  have hh := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.cosh_pos z).le hc m
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul] at hh
  exact hh.trans (by
    by_cases hz : 0 ≤ z
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hz]
      linarith [Real.exp_pos (-((m:ℝ)*z))]
    · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hz),mul_neg]
      linarith [Real.exp_pos ((m:ℝ)*z)])

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cosh_pow_bound
statement:
lemma gaussian_cosh_pow_bound (v : ℝ≥0) (a : ι → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) ∧
    (∫ z, Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)^m ∂gaussianScalarPi v) ≤
      2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2*(v:ℝ)*(∑ i, a i^2)/2)
proof:
:= by
  let b : ι → ℝ := fun i => (m:ℝ)*a i
  have he (z : ι → ℝ) : gaussianLinear b z = (m:ℝ)*gaussianLinear a z := by
    simp only [gaussianLinear,b,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]
  have hib := (gaussian_exp_integrable v b).add (gaussian_exp_integrable v (-b))
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => Real.cosh (gaussianLinear a z)^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) := by
    apply hib.mono' (((Real.continuous_cosh.comp (gaussianLinear_continuous a)).pow m).aestronglyMeasurable)
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Function.comp_apply]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Real.cosh_pos _).le _),gaussianLinear_neg,he]
      exact cosh_pow_exp_bound _ _)
  refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ z, Real.exp (gaussianLinear b z)+Real.exp (gaussianLinear (-b) z) ∂gaussianScalarPi v :=
      integral_mono hi hib (fun z => by rw [gaussianLinear_neg,he]; exact cosh_pow_exp_bound _ _)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_add (gaussian_exp_integrable v b) (gaussian_exp_integrable v (-b)),gaussian_exp_integral,gaussian_exp_integral]
      simp only [Pi.neg_apply,neg_sq,b,mul_pow,← Finset.mul_sum]
      ring_nf

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cosh_sub_one_quadratic
statement: lemma cosh_sub_one_quadratic {z : ℝ} (hz : |z| ≤ 1) : Real.cosh z-1 ≤ (Real.exp 1-1)*z^2
proof:
:= by
  have hz2 : z^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_abs z,abs_nonneg z]
  have hc := (convexOn_exp.2 (show (0:ℝ) ∈ univ from trivial) (show (1:ℝ) ∈ univ from trivial)
    (show 0 ≤ 1-z^2 by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg z) (by ring))
  simp only [smul_eq_mul,mul_zero,mul_one,zero_add,Real.exp_zero] at hc
  have he := (Real.cosh_le_exp_half_sq z).trans (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg z] : z^2/2 ≤ z^2))
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_continuous
statement: lemma coshMixture_continuous (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) : Continuous (coshMixture p a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshMixture
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact continuous_const.mul (Real.continuous_cosh.comp (gaussianLinear_continuous _))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_nonneg
statement: lemma coshMixture_nonneg {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ coshMixture p a z
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (hp x) (Real.cosh_pos _).le)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_integrable
statement:
lemma coshMixture_integrable (v : ℝ≥0) (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (coshMixture p a) (gaussianScalarPi v)
proof:
:=
  integrable_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => (gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a x)).const_mul (p x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_integral
statement:
lemma coshMixture_integral (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1)
    (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s) :
    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z ∂gaussianScalarPi v) = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold coshMixture
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => (gaussian_cosh_integrable v (a x)).const_mul (p x))]
  simp_rw [integral_const_mul,gaussian_cosh_integral,hs]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hpsum,one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound
statement:
lemma coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun z => coshMixture p a z^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) ∧
    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z^m ∂gaussianScalarPi v) ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2*(v:ℝ)*s/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hib : Integrable (fun z => ∑ x, p x*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a x) z)^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) :=
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => ((gaussian_cosh_pow_bound v (a x) m).1.const_mul _))
  have hbound (z : ι → ℝ) : coshMixture p a z^m ≤ ∑ x, p x*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a x) z)^m :=
    Real.pow_arith_mean_le_arith_mean_pow _ _ _ (fun x _ => hp x) hpsum (fun _ _ => (Real.cosh_pos _).le) m
  have hi : Integrable (fun z => coshMixture p a z^m) (gaussianScalarPi v) := by
    apply hib.mono' ((coshMixture_continuous p a).pow m).aestronglyMeasurable
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by simp only [Pi.pow_apply]; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (coshMixture_nonneg hp a z) _)]; exact hbound z)
  refine ⟨hi,?_⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ z, ∑ x, p x*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a x) z)^m ∂gaussianScalarPi v := integral_mono hi hib hbound
    _ = ∑ x, p x*(∫ z, Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a x) z)^m ∂gaussianScalarPi v) := by
      rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => ((gaussian_cosh_pow_bound v (a x) m).1.const_mul _))]
      simp only [integral_const_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ x, p x*(2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2*(v:ℝ)*s/2)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro x _
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hp x)
      simpa only [hs] using (gaussian_cosh_pow_bound v (a x) m).2
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,hpsum,one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_square
statement:
lemma coshMixture_square (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) (z : ι → ℝ) :
    coshMixture p a z^2 = ∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*(Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a x) z)*Real.cosh (gaussianLinear (a y) z))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coshMixture,pow_two,Finset.sum_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_square_integral
statement:
lemma coshMixture_square_integral (v : ℝ≥0) (p : κ → ℝ) (a : κ → ι → ℝ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s) :
    (∫ z, coshMixture p a z^2 ∂gaussianScalarPi v) =
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*(∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*Real.cosh ((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [coshMixture_square]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun y _ => (gaussian_cosh_product_integrable v (a x) (a y)).const_mul (p x*p y)))]
  simp_rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun y _ => (gaussian_cosh_product_integrable v _ (a y)).const_mul _),integral_const_mul,gaussian_cosh_product_integral,hs]
  rw [show (v:ℝ)*(s+s)/2 = (v:ℝ)*s by ring]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.coshMixture_centered_integrable_bound
statement:
lemma coshMixture_centered_integrable_bound (v : ℝ≥0) {p : κ → ℝ} (hp : ∀ x, 0 ≤ p x)
    (hpsum : ∑ x, p x = 1) (a : κ → ι → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : ∀ x, ∑ i, a x i^2 = s)
    (hc : ∀ x y, |(v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i| ≤ 1) :
    Integrable (fun z => (coshMixture p a z-Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2))^2) (gaussianScalarPi v) ∧
    (∫ z, (coshMixture p a z-Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2))^2 ∂gaussianScalarPi v) ≤
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*(Real.exp 1-1)*(∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i)^2)
proof:
:= by
  let m := Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s/2)
  have hi := (coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound v hp hpsum a hs 2).1
  have hmi := coshMixture_integrable v p a
  have he (z : ι → ℝ) : (coshMixture p a z-m)^2 = coshMixture p a z^2-2*m*coshMixture p a z+m^2 := by ring
  have hiz : Integrable (fun z => (coshMixture p a z-m)^2) (gaussianScalarPi v) := by
    simp_rw [he]
    exact (hi.sub (hmi.const_mul _)).add (integrable_const _)
  refine ⟨hiz,?_⟩
  have hm2 : m^2 = Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s) := by dsimp only [m]; rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
  have hsum : (∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y) = 1 := by simp only [← Finset.mul_sum,hpsum,mul_one]
  have hid : (∫ z, (coshMixture p a z-m)^2 ∂gaussianScalarPi v) =
      Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*(∑ x, ∑ y, p x*p y*(Real.cosh ((v:ℝ)*∑ i, a x i*a y i)-1)) := by
    simp_rw [he]
    rw [integral_add (f := fun z => coshMixture p a z^2-2*m*coshMixture p a z) (g := fun _ => m^2) (hi.sub (hmi.const_mul _)) (integrable_const _),integral_sub (f := fun z => coshMixture p a z^2) (g := fun z => 2*m*coshMixture p a z) hi (hmi.const_mul _),integral_const_mul,
      coshMixture_integral v hpsum a hs,coshMixture_square_integral v p a hs,integral_const,probReal_univ,one_smul]
    change Real.exp ((v:ℝ)*s)*_-2*m*m+m^2 = _
    simp only [mul_sub,mul_one,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,hsum]
    nlinarith
  rw [hid]
  rw [mul_assoc]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (Real.exp_pos _).le
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro x _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro y _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cosh_sub_one_quadratic (hc x y)) (mul_nonneg (hp x) (hp y))]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.partition_pos
statement: lemma partition_pos : 0 < partition W
proof:
:= by
  unfold partition
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_pos
statement: lemma gibbs_pos (x : Spin n) : 0 < gibbs W x
proof:
:=
  div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (partition_pos W)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_nonneg
statement: lemma gibbs_nonneg (x : Spin n) : 0 ≤ gibbs W x
proof: := (gibbs_pos W x).le

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_sum
statement: lemma gibbs_sum : ∑ x : Spin n, gibbs W x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold gibbs
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (ne_of_gt (partition_pos W))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_le_one
statement: lemma gibbs_le_one (x : Spin n) : gibbs W x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gibbs_sum W]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => gibbs_nonneg W y) (Finset.mem_univ x)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinFlipEquiv_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma spinFlipEquiv_apply (x : Spin n) : spinFlipEquiv x = spinFlip x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinFlip_spinFlip
statement: @[simp] lemma spinFlip_spinFlip (x : Spin n) : spinFlip (spinFlip x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [spinFlip]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_not
statement: @[simp] lemma spinValue_not (b : Bool) : spinValue (!b) = -spinValue b
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> norm_num [spinValue]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hamiltonian_spinFlip
statement:
@[simp] lemma hamiltonian_spinFlip (x : Spin n) :
    hamiltonian W (spinFlip x) = hamiltonian W x
proof:
:= by
  unfold hamiltonian
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  simp [spinFlip]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gibbs_spinFlip
statement: @[simp] lemma gibbs_spinFlip (x : Spin n) : gibbs W (spinFlip x) = gibbs W x
proof:
:= by
  simp [gibbs]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_odd_eq_zero
statement:
lemma mean_odd_eq_zero (f : Spin n → ℝ) (hf : ∀ x, f (spinFlip x) = -f x) :
    mean W f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : mean W f = -mean W f := by
    calc
      mean W f = ∑ x, gibbs W (spinFlip x) * f (spinFlip x) :=
        (Equiv.sum_comp spinFlipEquiv (fun x => gibbs W x * f x)).symm
      _ = -mean W f := by simp [hf, mean, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_spin
statement: @[simp] lemma mean_spin (i : Fin n) : mean W (fun x => spinValue (x i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply mean_odd_eq_zero
  intro x
  simp [spinFlip]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearObservable_spinFlip
statement:
@[simp] lemma linearObservable_spinFlip (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable a (spinFlip x) = -linearObservable a x
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearObservable, spinFlip, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_linearObservable
statement:
@[simp] lemma mean_linearObservable (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (linearObservable a) = 0
proof:
:=
  mean_odd_eq_zero W _ (linearObservable_spinFlip a)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_eq
statement:
lemma covariance_eq (i j : Fin n) :
    covariance W i j = mean W (fun x => spinValue (x i) * spinValue (x j))
proof:
:= by
  simp [covariance]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.covariance_diag
statement: @[simp] lemma covariance_diag (i : Fin n) : covariance W i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [covariance_eq]
  simpa [mean, ← sq] using gibbs_sum W

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_refl
statement: lemma sameExcept_refl (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : sameExcept i x x
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_symm
statement:
lemma sameExcept_symm {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    sameExcept i y x
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  exact (h j hj).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_trans
statement:
lemma sameExcept_trans {i : Fin n} {x y z : Spin n}
    (hxy : sameExcept i x y) (hyz : sameExcept i y z) : sameExcept i x z
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  exact (hyz j hj).trans (hxy j hj)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sameExcept_classes
statement:
lemma sameExcept_classes {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y)
    (z : Spin n) : sameExcept i x z ↔ sameExcept i y z
proof:
:=
  ⟨sameExcept_trans (sameExcept_symm h), sameExcept_trans h⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fiberMass_pos
statement: lemma fiberMass_pos (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : 0 < fiberMass W i x
proof:
:= by
  have h : gibbs W x ≤ fiberMass W i x := by
    unfold fiberMass
    have hh := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun z => if sameExcept i x z then gibbs W z else 0)
      (fun z _ => by split_ifs; exact gibbs_nonneg W z; exact le_rfl) (Finset.mem_univ x)
    simpa only [sameExcept_refl, ite_true] using hh
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (gibbs_pos W x) h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fiberMass_eq
statement:
lemma fiberMass_eq {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    fiberMass W i x = fiberMass W i y
proof:
:= by
  unfold fiberMass
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  simp only [sameExcept_classes h z]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_nonneg
statement: lemma siteKernel_nonneg (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) : 0 ≤ siteKernel W i x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold siteKernel
  split_ifs
  · exact (div_pos (gibbs_pos W y) (fiberMass_pos W i x)).le
  · exact le_rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_sum
statement: lemma siteKernel_sum (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ y, siteKernel W i x y) = fiberMass W i x / fiberMass W i x := by
      unfold siteKernel fiberMass
      rw [Finset.sum_div]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      split_ifs <;> simp
    _ = 1 := div_self (ne_of_gt (fiberMass_pos W i x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_reversible
statement:
lemma siteKernel_reversible (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    gibbs W x * siteKernel W i x y = gibbs W y * siteKernel W i y x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : sameExcept i x y
  · have h' := sameExcept_symm h
    change gibbs W x * (if sameExcept i x y then gibbs W y / fiberMass W i x else 0) =
      gibbs W y * (if sameExcept i y x then gibbs W x / fiberMass W i y else 0)
    simp only [h, h', ite_true, fiberMass_eq W h]
    ring
  · have h' : ¬sameExcept i y x := fun hh => h (sameExcept_symm hh)
    simp [siteKernel, h, h']

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_stationary
statement:
lemma siteKernel_stationary (i : Fin n) (y : Spin n) :
    ∑ x, gibbs W x * siteKernel W i x y = gibbs W y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [siteKernel_reversible W i]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, siteKernel_sum, mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_same_row
statement:
lemma siteKernel_same_row {i : Fin n} {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    siteKernel W i x = siteKernel W i y
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  change (if sameExcept i x z then gibbs W z / fiberMass W i x else 0) =
    (if sameExcept i y z then gibbs W z / fiberMass W i y else 0)
  simp only [sameExcept_classes h z, fiberMass_eq W h]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteKernel_projection
statement: lemma siteKernel_projection (i : Fin n) : siteKernel W i * siteKernel W i = siteKernel W i
proof:
:= by
  ext x z
  change (∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * siteKernel W i y z) = siteKernel W i x z
  calc
    (∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * siteKernel W i y z) =
        ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * siteKernel W i x z := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases h : sameExcept i x y
      · rw [siteKernel_same_row W h]
      · simp [siteKernel, h]
    _ = siteKernel W i x z := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, siteKernel_sum, one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_nonneg
statement: lemma mean_nonneg {f : Spin n → ℝ} (hf : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) : 0 ≤ mean W f
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => mul_nonneg (gibbs_nonneg W x) (hf x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_mono
statement: lemma mean_mono {f g : Spin n → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) : mean W f ≤ mean W g
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h x) (gibbs_nonneg W x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_const
statement: @[simp] lemma mean_const (c : ℝ) : mean W (fun _ => c) = c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, ← Finset.sum_mul, gibbs_sum, one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_add
statement:
lemma mean_add (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x + g x) = mean W f + mean W g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_sub
statement:
lemma mean_sub (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x - g x) = mean W f - mean W g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_neg
statement: lemma mean_neg (f : Spin n → ℝ) : mean W (fun x => -f x) = -mean W f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_mul_const
statement:
lemma mean_mul_const (f : Spin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * c) = mean W f * c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, ← mul_assoc, Finset.sum_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_const_mul
statement:
lemma mean_const_mul (f : Spin n → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => c * f x) = c * mean W f
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [mul_comm c] using mean_mul_const W f c

name: OAI.CriticalSK.mean_sum
statement:
lemma mean_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, mean W (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_eq
statement:
lemma siteAverage_eq (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    siteAverage W i f x = ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * f y
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_add
statement:
lemma siteAverage_add (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (fun x => f x + g x) =
      fun x => siteAverage W i f x + siteAverage W i g x
proof:
:=
  Matrix.mulVec_add _ _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_sub
statement:
lemma siteAverage_sub (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (fun x => f x - g x) =
      fun x => siteAverage W i f x - siteAverage W i g x
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp only [siteAverage_eq, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_idempotent
statement:
lemma siteAverage_idempotent (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ) :
    siteAverage W i (siteAverage W i f) = siteAverage W i f
proof:
:= by
  unfold siteAverage
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, siteKernel_projection]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma siteAverage_fiber_constant (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ)
    {x y : Spin n} (h : sameExcept i x y) :
    siteAverage W i f x = siteAverage W i f y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [siteAverage_eq, siteKernel_same_row W h]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_of_fiber_constant
statement:
lemma siteAverage_of_fiber_constant (i : Fin n) (f : Spin n → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x y, sameExcept i x y → f y = f x) : siteAverage W i f = f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  calc
    siteAverage W i f x = ∑ y, siteKernel W i x y * f x := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y _
      by_cases h : sameExcept i x y
      · rw [hf x y h]
      · simp [siteKernel, h]
    _ = f x := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, siteKernel_sum, one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.siteAverage_selfadjoint
statement:
lemma siteAverage_selfadjoint (i : Fin n) (f g : Spin n → ℝ) :
    mean W (fun x => f x * siteAverage W i g x) =
      mean W (fun x => siteAverage W i f x * g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, siteAverage_eq, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  calc
    gibbs W y * (f y * (siteKernel W i y x * g x)) =
      (gibbs W y * siteKernel W i y x) * (f y * g x) := by ring
    _ = (gibbs W x * siteKernel W i x y) * (f y * g x) := by
      rw [siteKernel_reversible]
