  have h2 := edgeCoeff_lower n (i-1) (by omega)
  have h3 : (i-1+1 : ℕ) = i := by omega
  have h4 : ((i-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = i := by exact_mod_cast h3
  have h5 : (i : ℝ)/(n+1) ≤ (i+1 : ℝ)/(n+1) := by gcongr; linarith
  rw [h4] at h2
  rw [mul_div_assoc]
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_energy
statement:
lemma edgeTent_energy {m b n : ℕ} (_hfit : b+4*m ≤ n) :
    pathEnergy n (edgeTent m b) ≤ 4*m + (2*(b+4*m+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m b i ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathEnergy_expansion]
  apply add_le_add
  · calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (edgeTent m b (i+1)-edgeTent m b i)^2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (edgeCoeff_le_one n i (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega))
      _ ≤ 4*m := edgeTent_gradient m b n
  · rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i; rw [edgeTent_zero_left (by omega)]; simp
    · simp only [ite_eq_right hi0]
      by_cases hit : b+4*m ≤ i
      · rw [edgeTent_zero_right hit]; simp
      · apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg _)
        apply (edge_potential_upper (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega) hi0).trans
        gcongr
        exact_mod_cast (show i ≤ b+4*m by omega)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_mul_zero
statement:
lemma edgeTent_mul_zero {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m b i * edgeTent m d i = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i ≤ d
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_left h, mul_zero]
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_right (by omega), zero_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_adj_mul_zero
statement:
lemma edgeTent_adj_mul_zero {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m b i * edgeTent m d (i+1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i+1 ≤ d
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_left h, mul_zero]
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_right (by omega), zero_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_adj_mul_zero'
statement:
lemma edgeTent_adj_mul_zero' {m b d i : ℕ} (hgap : b+4*m ≤ d) :
    edgeTent m d i * edgeTent m b (i+1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i ≤ d
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_left h, zero_mul]
  · rw [edgeTent_zero_right (m := m) (b := b) (i := i+1) (by omega), mul_zero]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.separated_tents
statement:
lemma separated_tents {m k l i : ℕ} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    edgeTent m (4*m*k) i * edgeTent m (4*m*l) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkl with h | h
  · apply edgeTent_mul_zero
    nlinarith
  · rw [mul_comm]
    apply edgeTent_mul_zero
    nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.separated_tents_adj
statement:
lemma separated_tents_adj {m k l i : ℕ} (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    edgeTent m (4*m*k) i * edgeTent m (4*m*l) (i+1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkl with h | h
  · apply edgeTent_adj_mul_zero
    nlinarith
  · apply edgeTent_adj_mul_zero'
    nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sum_mul_diagonal
statement:
lemma sum_mul_diagonal {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (u v c : ι → ℝ)
    (huv : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → u i * v j = 0) :
    (∑ i, c i * u i) * (∑ i, c i * v i) = ∑ i, c i ^ 2 * u i * v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · ring
  · intro j _ hji
    calc
      _ = (c i * c j) * (u i * v j) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [huv i j hji.symm, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_sq
statement:
lemma tentCombination_sq {r : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    tentCombination m c i ^ 2 = ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sq, tentCombination, sum_mul_diagonal]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intros
    ring
  · intro k l hkl
    exact separated_tents (fun h => hkl (Fin.ext h))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_adj
statement:
lemma tentCombination_adj {r : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    tentCombination m c i * tentCombination m c (i+1) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i * edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) (i+1)
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_mul_diagonal _ _ _ (fun k l hkl => separated_tents_adj (fun h => hkl (Fin.ext h)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_mass
statement:
lemma tentCombination_mass {r : ℕ} (m n : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tentCombination_sq, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_energy
statement:
lemma tentCombination_energy {r : ℕ} (m n : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n (tentCombination m c) =
      ∑ k, c k ^ 2 * pathEnergy n (edgeTent m (4*m*k.val))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathEnergy, tentCombination_sq, tentCombination_adj,
    mul_assoc, mul_sub, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.range (n+1)), Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.range n)]
  congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro k _
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intros
    ring
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intros
    ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeTent_rayleigh
statement:
lemma edgeTent_rayleigh {m b n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : b+4*m ≤ n) :
    pathEnergy n (edgeTent m b) ≤
      (4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(b+4*m+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m b i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hmass := edgeTent_mass (m := m) (b := b) (n := n) (by omega)
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmass (show 0 ≤ 4/(m : ℝ)^2 by positivity)
  have he : 4/(m : ℝ)^2 * (m : ℝ)^3 = 4*m := by field_simp
  rw [he] at h
  have henergy := edgeTent_energy hfit
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_rayleigh
statement:
lemma tentCombination_rayleigh {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    pathEnergy n (tentCombination m c) ≤
      (4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) *
        ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [tentCombination_mass, tentCombination_energy, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro k _
  have hk : 4*m*k.val+4*m ≤ 4*m*r := by nlinarith [k.isLt]
  have h := edgeTent_rayleigh hm (hk.trans hfit)
  have h' : 4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*k.val+4*m+1 : ℝ)/(n+1) ≤
      4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1) := by
    gcongr
    exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith [k.isLt] : 4*m*k.val+4*m ≤ 4*m*r)
  push_cast at h
  have hmass : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), edgeTent m (4*m*k.val) i ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hbound := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h' hmass)
  have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound (sq_nonneg (c k))
  convert hscaled using 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentCombination_probe
statement:
lemma tentCombination_probe {m r : ℕ} (c : Fin r → ℝ) (k : Fin r) :
    tentCombination m c (4*m*k.val+m) = c k * m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [tentCombination, Finset.sum_eq_single k]
  · rw [edgeTent_plateau (by omega) (by omega)]
  · intro l _ hlk
    by_cases hm : m = 0
    · subst m
      simp [edgeTent]
    have h := separated_tents (m := m) (i := 4*m*k.val+m)
      (show l.val ≠ k.val from fun h => hlk (Fin.ext h))
    rw [edgeTent_plateau (m := m) (b := 4*m*k.val) (i := 4*m*k.val+m) (by omega) (by omega)] at h
    have hz : edgeTent m (4*m*l.val) (4*m*k.val+m) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right (by exact_mod_cast hm)
    rw [hz, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_injective
statement:
lemma tentMap_injective {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n) :
    Function.Injective (tentMap m n r)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  funext k
  have hidx : 4*m*k.val+m < n+1 := by nlinarith [k.isLt]
  have he := congrArg (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)) =>
    u ⟨4*m*k.val+m, hidx⟩) h
  change tentCombination m c (4*m*k.val+m) = tentCombination m d (4*m*k.val+m) at he
  rw [tentCombination_probe, tentCombination_probe] at he
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)) he

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_rank
statement:
lemma tentMap_rank {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n) :
    finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range (tentMap m n r)) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (LinearEquiv.ofInjective _ (tentMap_injective hm hfit))]
  simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.tentMap_mass
statement:
lemma tentMap_mass (m n r : ℕ) (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n+1), tentCombination m c i ^ 2) = ‖tentMap m n r c‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [tentMap, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, PiLp.toLp_apply,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  exact (Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range _ _).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.eigenvalue_lower_of_subspace
statement:
lemma eigenvalue_lower_of_subspace {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
    {T : E →ₗ[ℝ] E} (hT : T.IsSymmetric) {n : ℕ} (hn : finrank ℝ E = n)
    (S : Submodule ℝ E) (i : Fin n) {a : ℝ}
    (hdim : i.val < finrank ℝ S)
    (hquad : ∀ x : E, x ∈ S → ‖x‖ = 1 → a ≤ inner ℝ x (T x)) :
    a ≤ hT.eigenvalues hn i
proof:
:= by
  let b := hT.eigenvectorBasis hn
  let U := basisSpan b (Finset.Ici i)
  have hnot : ¬ Disjoint S U := by
    intro hd
    have h := Submodule.finrank_add_finrank_le_of_disjoint hd
    rw [show U = basisSpan b (Finset.Ici i) from rfl, basisSpan_finrank,
      Fin.card_Ici, hn] at h
    omega
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def] at hnot
  push Not at hnot
  obtain ⟨x, hxS, hxU, hx⟩ := hnot
  let y := ‖x‖⁻¹ • x
  have hy : ‖y‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx)
  have hlow := hquad y (S.smul_mem _ hxS) hy
  have hupp := basisQuadratic_le b (hT.eigenvalues hn) (Finset.Ici i)
    (U.smul_mem ‖x‖⁻¹ hxU) hy (fun j hj => hT.eigenvalues_antitone hn (Finset.mem_Ici.mp hj))
  rw [eigenbasisQuadratic_eq] at hupp
  exact hlow.trans hupp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma scaledHermite_zero (a : ℝ) : scaledHermite a 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_succ
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    scaledHermite a (k + 1) = X * scaledHermite a k - C a * derivative (scaledHermite a k)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.derivative_scaledHermite_succ
statement:
lemma derivative_scaledHermite_succ (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative (scaledHermite a (k + 1)) = C (k + 1 : ℝ) * scaledHermite a k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [scaledHermite]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [scaledHermite_succ a (k + 1), derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X,
      one_mul, ih, derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add]
    rw [derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add]
    rw [scaledHermite_succ a k]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, map_add, map_one]
    ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_three_term
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_three_term (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    scaledHermite a (k + 2) = X * scaledHermite a (k + 1) -
      C (a * (k + 1)) * scaledHermite a k
proof:
:= by
  rw [show k + 2 = (k + 1) + 1 by omega, scaledHermite_succ,
    derivative_scaledHermite_succ, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_differential
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_differential (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    C a * derivative (derivative (scaledHermite a k)) -
      X * derivative (scaledHermite a k) + C (k : ℝ) * scaledHermite a k = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := derivative_scaledHermite_succ a k
  rw [scaledHermite_succ, derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_X,
    one_mul, derivative_mul, derivative_C, zero_mul, zero_add] at h
  simp only [map_add, map_one] at h
  linear_combination -h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_degree_gap
statement:
lemma scaledHermite_degree_gap (a : ℝ) (p : Polynomial ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    (C a * derivative p).degree < (X * p).degree
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · simp only [ha, map_zero, zero_mul, degree_zero]
    exact degree_ne_bot.mpr (mul_ne_zero X_ne_zero hp) |>.bot_lt
  · rw [degree_C_mul ha, mul_comm X p]
    exact degree_derivative_le.trans_lt (degree_lt_degree_mul_X hp)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_monic
statement: lemma scaledHermite_monic (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (scaledHermite a k).Monic
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [scaledHermite_succ]
    exact (monic_X.mul ih).sub_of_left (scaledHermite_degree_gap a _ ih.ne_zero)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaledHermite_degree
statement: lemma scaledHermite_degree (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (scaledHermite a k).degree = k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [scaledHermite_succ, degree_sub_eq_left_of_degree_lt
      (scaledHermite_degree_gap a _ (scaledHermite_monic a k).ne_zero), mul_comm X _,
      degree_mul_X, ih]
    norm_cast

name: OAI.CriticalSK.det_tridiagonal_step
statement:
lemma det_tridiagonal_step {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 2)) (Fin (k + 2)) R)
    (hrow : ∀ j : Fin k, A 0 j.succ.succ = 0)
    (hcol : ∀ i : Fin k, A i.succ.succ 0 = 0) :
    A.det = A 0 0 * (A.submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ).det -
      A 0 1 * A 1 0 * (A.submatrix (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ) (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ)).det
proof:
:= by
  have hminor : (A.submatrix Fin.succ (1 : Fin (k + 2)).succAbove).det =
      A 1 0 * (A.submatrix (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ) (Fin.succ ∘ Fin.succ)).det := by
    rw [det_succ_column_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul,
      Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.one_succAbove_zero, hcol, mul_zero, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, submatrix_submatrix, Fin.succAbove_zero]
    congr 2
  rw [det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Fin.succAbove_zero, Fin.val_succ,
    Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, hminor, hrow, mul_zero, zero_mul,
    Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero, Fin.val_one, pow_one, neg_one_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_diagonal
statement: lemma jacobi_diagonal (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : jacobi a k i i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [jacobi]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_symmetric
statement: lemma jacobi_symmetric (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : (jacobi a k).IsSymm
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  dsimp [jacobi, Matrix.transpose]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₃ <;> first | rfl | omega

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_tail
statement:
lemma jacobi_tail (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a (k + 1)).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ = jacobi a k
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.submatrix_apply, jacobi, Fin.val_succ, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  split_ifs <;> congr 1 <;> ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_row_zero
statement: lemma jacobi_row_zero (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (j : Fin k) : jacobi a (k + 2) 0 j.succ.succ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [jacobi]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_col_zero
statement: lemma jacobi_col_zero (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) : jacobi a (k + 2) i.succ.succ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [jacobi]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_first_super
statement:
lemma jacobi_first_super (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    jacobi a (k + 2) 0 1 = Real.sqrt (a * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [jacobi]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_first_sub
statement:
lemma jacobi_first_sub (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    jacobi a (k + 2) 1 0 = Real.sqrt (a * (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [jacobi]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.charmatrix_jacobi_tail
statement:
lemma charmatrix_jacobi_tail (a : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((jacobi a (k + 1)).charmatrix).submatrix Fin.succ Fin.succ =
      (jacobi a k).charmatrix
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    simp [jacobi_diagonal]
  · simp [hij, charmatrix_apply_ne, ← jacobi_tail a k]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly_step
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly_step {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a (k + 2)).charpoly = X * (jacobi a (k + 1)).charpoly -
      C (a * (k + 1)) * (jacobi a k).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  have hr (j : Fin k) : (jacobi a (k + 2)).charmatrix 0 j.succ.succ = 0 := by
    rw [charmatrix_apply_ne _ _ _ (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]; omega), jacobi_row_zero]
    simp
  have hc (i : Fin k) : (jacobi a (k + 2)).charmatrix i.succ.succ 0 = 0 := by
    rw [charmatrix_apply_ne _ _ _ (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]; omega), jacobi_col_zero]
    simp
  unfold Matrix.charpoly
  rw [det_tridiagonal_step k _ hr hc, charmatrix_apply_eq, jacobi_diagonal,
    map_zero, sub_zero, charmatrix_jacobi_tail,
    charmatrix_apply_ne _ _ _ (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one]; omega : (0 : Fin (k + 2)) ≠ 1),
    charmatrix_apply_ne _ _ _ (by simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one]; omega : (1 : Fin (k + 2)) ≠ 0),
    jacobi_first_super, jacobi_first_sub, neg_mul_neg, ← map_mul,
    ← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
  congr 2
  rw [← submatrix_submatrix, charmatrix_jacobi_tail, charmatrix_jacobi_tail]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (k : ℕ) :
    (jacobi a k).charpoly = scaledHermite a k
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp
  | one =>
    have hz : jacobi a 1 = 0 := by ext i j; fin_cases i; fin_cases j; simp [jacobi]
    simp [hz, scaledHermite]
  | more k h0 h1 => rw [jacobi_charpoly_step ha, h0, h1, scaledHermite_three_term]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finset_sum_indicator_le_one
statement:
lemma finset_sum_indicator_le_one {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (p : ι → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] (hp : ∀ i j, p i → p j → i = j) :
    (∑ i, if p i then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ i, p i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
    have heq : ∀ j, p j ↔ j = i := fun j => ⟨fun hj => hp j i hj hi, fun h => h ▸ hi⟩
    simp_rw [heq]
    simp
  · simp [not_exists.mp hex]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_row_norm_bound
statement:
lemma jacobi_row_norm_bound (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n i j‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt)
  have hentry (k : Fin n) : Real.sqrt ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n : ℝ) - 1 - k.val)) ≤ 1 := by
    apply Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr
    have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k.val := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    apply (inv_mul_le_iff₀ hn).mpr
    linarith
  have hpoint (j : Fin n) : ‖jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n i j‖ ≤
      (if i.val + 1 = j.val then 1 else 0) + (if j.val + 1 = i.val then 1 else 0) := by
    unfold jacobi
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _),
      norm_zero] <;> linarith [hentry i, hentry j]
  have h₁ := finset_sum_indicator_le_one (fun j : Fin n => i.val + 1 = j.val)
    (fun j k hj hk => Fin.ext (by omega))
  have h₂ := finset_sum_indicator_le_one (fun j : Fin n => j.val + 1 = i.val)
    (fun j k hj hk => Fin.ext (by omega))
  have hb := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_ : j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))) => hpoint j)
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hb
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_hermitian
statement: lemma jacobi_hermitian (a : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : (jacobi a n).IsHermitian
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isHermitian_iff_isSymm.mpr (jacobi_symmetric a n)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_eigenvalue_bound
statement:
lemma jacobi_eigenvalue_bound (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    |(jacobi_hermitian (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).eigenvalues i| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  let hA := jacobi_hermitian (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n
  have he : Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n))
      (hA.eigenvalues i) := by
    apply Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector
    refine ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr (hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i), ?_⟩
    intro h
    apply hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero i
    ext j
    exact congrFun h j
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := eigenvalue_mem_ball he
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, jacobi_diagonal, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hj
  exact hj.trans ((Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)).trans
    (jacobi_row_norm_bound n j))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircle_discriminant_pos
statement: lemma semicircle_discriminant_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < s * (4 + s)
proof: := by positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_pos
statement: lemma semicircleResolvent_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < semicircleResolvent s
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s * (4 + s))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs).le
  unfold semicircleResolvent
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_le_one
statement: lemma semicircleResolvent_le_one {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : semicircleResolvent s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s * (4 + s))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ s * (4 + s) by positivity)
  unfold semicircleResolvent
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_deficit
statement:
lemma semicircleResolvent_deficit {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    1 - semicircleResolvent s ≤ Real.sqrt s
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s * (4 + s))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ s * (4 + s) by positivity)
  have hb := Real.sqrt_nonneg s
  have hb2 := Real.sq_sqrt hs
  unfold semicircleResolvent
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hs hb]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircleResolvent_difference
statement:
lemma semicircleResolvent_difference {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    semicircleResolvent (s / 2) - semicircleResolvent s ≤ Real.sqrt s
proof:
:= by
  have := semicircleResolvent_le_one (show 0 ≤ s / 2 by positivity)
  have := semicircleResolvent_deficit hs
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.semicircle_discriminant_lower
statement:
lemma semicircle_discriminant_lower {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    2 * Real.sqrt s ≤ Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s * (4 + s))
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ s * (4 + s) by positivity)
  have hb := Real.sqrt_nonneg s
  have hb2 := Real.sq_sqrt hs
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_pos
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < empiricalResolvent e s
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalResolvent
  apply mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos))
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => inv_pos.mpr (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (he i))) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolventSquare_pos
statement: lemma empiricalResolventSquare_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : 0 < empiricalResolventSquare e s
proof:
:= by
  unfold empiricalResolventSquare
  apply mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos))
  exact Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => sq_pos_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr
    (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (he i)))) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_le_inv
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_le_inv {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s ≤ s⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ _i : ι, s⁻¹ := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      exact (inv_le_inv₀ (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (he i)) hs).mpr (le_add_of_nonneg_right (he i))
    _ = s⁻¹ := by simp [hn.ne']

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_continuousOn
statement: lemma empiricalResolvent_continuousOn : ContinuousOn (empiricalResolvent e) (Set.Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousOn.const_mul
  apply continuousOn_finsetSum
  intro i _
  apply ContinuousOn.inv₀ (continuousOn_id.add continuousOn_const)
  intro s hs
  exact ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (he i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_hasDerivAt {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    HasDerivAt (empiricalResolvent e) (-empiricalResolventSquare e s) s
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : ι) : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (u + e i)⁻¹) (-(s + e i)⁻¹ ^ 2) s := by
    convert! ((hasDerivAt_id s).add_const (e i)).inv (ne_of_gt
      (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (he i))) using 1
    simp only [neg_div, one_div, inv_pow, id_eq]
  convert! (HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => h i)).const_mul
    (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ using 1
  simp only [empiricalResolventSquare, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, mul_neg]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_square_difference
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_square_difference {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤ 2 / s *
      (empiricalResolvent e (s / 2) - empiricalResolvent e s)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hpoint (i : ι) : (s + e i)⁻¹ ^ 2 ≤ 2 / s * ((s / 2 + e i)⁻¹ - (s + e i)⁻¹) := by
    have hi : 0 < s + e i := by linarith [he i]
    have hi2 : 0 < s / 2 + e i := by linarith [he i]
    have hval : 2 / s * ((s / 2 + e i)⁻¹ - (s + e i)⁻¹) =
        ((s / 2 + e i) * (s + e i))⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_sub_inv hi2.ne' hi.ne',
          show s + e i - (s / 2 + e i) = s / 2 by ring, ← mul_div_assoc,
          show 2 / s * (s / 2) = 1 by field_simp, one_div]
    rw [hval, inv_pow]
    apply (inv_le_inv₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hi) (mul_pos hi2 hi)).mpr
    nlinarith
  unfold empiricalResolventSquare empiricalResolvent
  calc
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ i, 2 / s * ((s / 2 + e i)⁻¹ - (s + e i)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hpoint i)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
    _ = _ := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_lt_midpoint
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_lt_midpoint
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s < (2 + s) / 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hbad
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (2 + u) / 2 - empiricalResolvent e u
  have hfs : f s ≤ 0 := by dsimp [f]; linarith
  have hft : 0 ≤ f (s + 2) := by
    have hb := empiricalResolvent_le_inv e he (show 0 < s + 2 by linarith)
    have hinv : (s + 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ (by linarith)).mpr (by linarith)
    dsimp [f]
    linarith
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc s (s + 2)) := by
    apply ContinuousOn.sub
    · exact (continuous_const.add continuous_id).continuousOn.div_const 2
    · exact (empiricalResolvent_continuousOn e he).mono (fun u hu => lt_of_lt_of_le hs hu.1)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hzero⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (show s ≤ s + 2 by linarith) hc ⟨hfs, hft⟩
  have hu0 : 0 < u := lt_of_lt_of_le hs hu.1
  have hid := hR u hu0
  have ht : 0 < empiricalResolventSquare e u / Fintype.card ι :=
    div_pos (empiricalResolventSquare_pos e he hu0) hn
  dsimp [f] at hzero
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : empiricalResolvent e s < semicircleResolvent s
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hmid := empiricalResolvent_lt_midpoint e he hR hs
  have hid := hR s hs
  have ht : 0 < empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι :=
    div_pos (empiricalResolventSquare_pos e he hs) hn
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs).le
  have hpos := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s * (4 + s))
  unfold semicircleResolvent
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_root_difference
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_root_difference
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ≤
        empiricalResolventSquare e s /
          ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle e he hR hs).le
  refine ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr hd, ?_⟩
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s)) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs)
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs).le
  have hid := hR s hs
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hn hpos)).mpr
  have hid' := (eq_div_iff hn.ne').mp hid
  unfold semicircleResolvent at *
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((2 + s - Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) / 2 - empiricalResolvent e s)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolventSquare_bound
statement:
lemma empiricalResolventSquare_bound
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 4 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) :
    empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt s
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hsp := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  have hdisc := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs)
  have hd := empiricalResolvent_root_difference e he hR hs
  have hhalf := (empiricalResolvent_lt_semicircle e he hR (show 0 < s / 2 by positivity)).le
  have hdiff := semicircleResolvent_difference hs.le
  have hb := empiricalResolvent_square_difference e he hs
  have hT := (empiricalResolventSquare_pos e he hs).le
  have hd' : 2 * (semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s) ≤
      s * empiricalResolventSquare e s / 2 := by
    have hden : 0 < (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s)) := mul_pos hn hdisc
    have hmul := (le_div_iff₀ hden).mp hd.2
    have hscl : 4 ≤ s * ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) := by nlinarith
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscl hd.1
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmul hs.le
    nlinarith
  have hb' : s * empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤
      2 * (empiricalResolvent e (s / 2) - empiricalResolvent e s) := by
    have := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb hs.le)
    field_simp at this
    nlinarith
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hsp).mpr
  have hmain : s * empiricalResolventSquare e s ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt s := by linarith
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmain hsp.le
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_error_bound
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_error_bound
    (hR : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      (empiricalResolvent e s) ^ 2 - (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent e s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare e s / Fintype.card ι)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 4 ≤ (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s))) :
    0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent e s ≤ 2 / ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hsp := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  have hdisc := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (semicircle_discriminant_pos hs)
  have hd := empiricalResolvent_root_difference e he hR hs
  refine ⟨hd.1, ?_⟩
  have hT := empiricalResolventSquare_bound e he hR hs hscale
  have hlow := semicircle_discriminant_lower hs.le
  have hd' := (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hn hdisc)).mp hd.2
  have hT' := (le_div_iff₀ hsp).mp hT
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd' hsp.le
  have hlow' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (mul_nonneg hd.1 hn.le)
  have hlow'' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlow' hsp.le
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hn hs)).mpr
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.empiricalResolvent_counting
statement:
lemma empiricalResolvent_counting {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤
      4 * (Fintype.card ι : ℝ) * s ^ 2 * empiricalResolventSquare e s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card ι := Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos
  have hpoint (i : ι) (hi : e i ≤ s) : 1 ≤ 4 * s ^ 2 * (s + e i)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
    have hsi : 0 < s + e i := by linarith [he i]
    rw [inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, le_div_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hsi)]
    nlinarith [he i]
  calc
    _ = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i ≤ s), (1 : ℝ) := by simp
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i ≤ s), 4 * s ^ 2 * (s + e i)⁻¹ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hpoint i (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2)
    _ ≤ ∑ i : ι, 4 * s ^ 2 * (s + e i)⁻¹ ^ 2 :=
      Finset.sum_le_univ_sum_of_nonneg (fun _ => by positivity)
    _ = _ := by
      unfold empiricalResolventSquare
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
      field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobiGaps_nonneg
statement: lemma jacobiGaps_nonneg (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) : 0 ≤ jacobiGaps n i
proof:
:= by
  have := (abs_le.mp (jacobi_eigenvalue_bound n i)).2
  exact sub_nonneg.mpr this

name: OAI.CriticalSK.hermitian_charpoly_derivative_ratio
statement:
lemma hermitian_charpoly_derivative_ratio {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) {z : ℝ} (hz : A.charpoly.eval z ≠ 0) :
    A.charpoly.derivative.eval z / A.charpoly.eval z = ∑ i, (z - hA.eigenvalues i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.splits_charpoly.eval_derivative_div_eval_of_ne_zero hz,
    hA.roots_charpoly_eq_eigenvalues, Multiset.map_map]
  simp [one_div]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_charpoly_nonzero
statement:
lemma jacobi_charpoly_nonzero {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.eval (2 + s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(jacobi_hermitian (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly_eq, eval_prod]
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro i _
  simp only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]
  have := jacobiGaps_nonneg n i
  dsimp [jacobiGaps] at this
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_logarithmic_ratio
statement:
lemma jacobi_logarithmic_ratio {n : ℕ} {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.derivative.eval (2 + s) /
      (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly.eval (2 + s) =
        (n : ℝ) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp [empiricalResolvent]
  · rw [hermitian_charpoly_derivative_ratio _ (jacobi_hermitian (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n)
      (jacobi_charpoly_nonzero hs)]
    simp only [empiricalResolvent, Fintype.card_fin, ← mul_assoc,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ (show (n : ℝ) ≠ 0 from Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn), one_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    congr 1
    simp [jacobiGaps]
    ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_riccati
statement:
lemma jacobi_riccati {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s) ^ 2 -
      (2 + s) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s + 1 =
        empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s / n
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < n := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  let p := (jacobi (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n).charpoly
  have hp : p.eval (2 + s) ≠ 0 := jacobi_charpoly_nonzero hs
  have hpd : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => p.eval (2 + u)) (p.derivative.eval (2 + s)) s := by
    convert! (p.hasDerivAt (2 + s)).comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add 2) using 1
    simp only [mul_one]
  have hpdd : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => p.derivative.eval (2 + u))
      (p.derivative.derivative.eval (2 + s)) s := by
    convert! (p.derivative.hasDerivAt (2 + s)).comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add 2) using 1
    simp only [mul_one]
  have hratio : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      (p.derivative.eval (2 + u) / p.eval (2 + u)))
      ((n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((p.derivative.derivative.eval (2 + s) * p.eval (2 + s) -
        p.derivative.eval (2 + s) * p.derivative.eval (2 + s)) / p.eval (2 + s)^2)) s := by
    convert! (hpdd.div hpd hp).const_mul (n : ℝ)⁻¹ using 1
  have hlocal : (fun u : ℝ => (n : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      (p.derivative.eval (2 + u) / p.eval (2 + u))) =ᶠ[𝓝 s]
        empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) := by
    filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hs] with u hu
    rw [jacobi_logarithmic_ratio hu, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hnR.ne', one_mul]
  have hder := (hratio.congr_of_eventuallyEq hlocal.symm).unique
    (empiricalResolvent_hasDerivAt (jacobiGaps n) (jacobiGaps_nonneg n) hs)
  have hode := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (2 + s)) (scaledHermite_differential (n : ℝ)⁻¹ n)
  rw [← jacobi_charpoly (inv_nonneg.mpr hnR.le) n] at hode
  rw [eval_zero] at hode
  change (C (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * p.derivative.derivative - X * p.derivative + C (n : ℝ) * p).eval (2 + s) = 0 at hode
  simp only [eval_add, eval_sub, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X] at hode
  have hv := jacobi_logarithmic_ratio (n := n) hs
  change p.derivative.eval (2 + s) / p.eval (2 + s) =
    (n : ℝ) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s at hv
  change (n : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((p.derivative.derivative.eval (2 + s) * p.eval (2 + s) -
        p.derivative.eval (2 + s) * p.derivative.eval (2 + s)) / p.eval (2 + s)^2) =
      -empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s at hder
  field_simp [hnR.ne', hp] at hode hv hder ⊢
  rw [hv] at hode hder
  have hh : (n : ℝ) * p.eval (2 + s) ^ 2 *
      ((n : ℝ) * (empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s *
        (empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s - (2 + s)) + 1) -
        empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s) = 0 := by
    linear_combination p.eval (2 + s) * hode - hder
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left
    (mul_ne_zero hnR.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 hp)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_resolvent_estimates
statement:
lemma jacobi_resolvent_estimates {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s) :
    empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt s ∧
      0 ≤ semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s ∧
      semicircleResolvent s - empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) s ≤ 2 / (n * s)
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  have hR : ∀ u : ℝ, 0 < u →
      (empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) u) ^ 2 -
        (2 + u) * empiricalResolvent (jacobiGaps n) u + 1 =
          empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) u / Fintype.card (Fin n) := by
    intro u hu
    simpa using (jacobi_riccati hn hu)
  have hscale' : 4 ≤ (Fintype.card (Fin n) : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt (s * (4 + s)) := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (semicircle_discriminant_lower hs.le)
      (show 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s by positivity)
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨empiricalResolventSquare_bound _ (jacobiGaps_nonneg n) hR hs hscale',
    by simpa using empiricalResolvent_error_bound _ (jacobiGaps_nonneg n) hR hs hscale'⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_gap_counting
statement:
lemma jacobi_gap_counting {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s)
    (hscale : 2 ≤ (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun i => jacobiGaps n i ≤ s)).card : ℝ) ≤
      16 * (n : ℝ) * s * Real.sqrt s
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero n := ⟨hn.ne'⟩
  have hc := empiricalResolvent_counting _ (jacobiGaps_nonneg n) hs
  have ht := (jacobi_resolvent_estimates hn hs hscale).1
  have hsp := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs
  have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le
  calc
    _ ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) * s ^ 2 * empiricalResolventSquare (jacobiGaps n) s := by simpa using hc
    _ ≤ 4 * (n : ℝ) * s ^ 2 * (4 / Real.sqrt s) := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by field_simp; nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_symmetric
statement: lemma pathOperator_symmetric (n : ℕ) : (pathOperator n).IsSymmetric
proof:
:=
  Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr (jacobi_hermitian _ _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.jacobi_edgeCoeff
statement:
lemma jacobi_edgeCoeff (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin (n+1)) :
    jacobi (n+1 : ℝ)⁻¹ (n+1) i j =
      (if i.val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n i.val else 0) +
      (if j.val+1=i.val then edgeCoeff n j.val else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hs (k : Fin (n+1)) :
      Real.sqrt ((n+1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ((n+1 : ℝ)-1-k.val)) = edgeCoeff n k.val := by
    unfold edgeCoeff
    congr 1
    field_simp
    ring
  simp only [jacobi, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, hs]
  split_ifs with h h' h' <;> try rfl
  · omega
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.directed_neighbor_sum
statement:
lemma directed_neighbor_sum (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (n+1), ∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (if i.val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n i.val else 0) * u i.val * u j.val) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hl : (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (if (Fin.last n).val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n (Fin.last n).val else 0) *
        u (Fin.last n).val * u j.val) = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j _
    rw [ite_eq_right (by have := j.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_last]; omega), zero_mul, zero_mul]
  rw [hl, add_zero, ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i.succ]
  · simp
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [ite_eq_right (fun h => hj (Fin.ext (by simpa using h.symm))), zero_mul, zero_mul]
  · simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_inner
statement:
lemma pathOperator_inner (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => u i.val))
      (pathOperator n (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => u i.val))) =
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pathOperator, Matrix.toLpLin_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct,
    Pi.star_apply, star_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec,
    jacobi_edgeCoeff, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hlo : (∑ i : Fin (n+1), (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (if i.val+1=j.val then edgeCoeff n i.val else 0) * u j.val) * u i.val) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1) := by
    convert directed_neighbor_sum n u using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intros
    ring
  have hhi : (∑ i : Fin (n+1), (∑ j : Fin (n+1),
      (if j.val+1=i.val then edgeCoeff n j.val else 0) * u j.val) * u i.val) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i+1) := by
    simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    exact directed_neighbor_sum n u
  rw [hlo, hhi]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_tent_rayleigh
statement:
lemma pathOperator_tent_rayleigh {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (c : Fin r → ℝ) :
    (2-(4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1))) * ‖tentMap m n r c‖^2 ≤
      inner ℝ (tentMap m n r c) (pathOperator n (tentMap m n r c))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tentCombination_rayleigh hm hfit c
  rw [pathEnergy, tentMap_mass] at h
  change _ ≤ inner ℝ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => tentCombination m c i.val))
    (pathOperator n (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (n+1) => tentCombination m c i.val)))
  rw [pathOperator_inner]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pathOperator_eigenvalue_lower
statement:
lemma pathOperator_eigenvalue_lower {m n r : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hfit : 4*m*r ≤ n)
    (i : Fin (n+1)) (hi : i.val < r) :
    2-(4/(m : ℝ)^2 + 2*(4*m*r+1 : ℝ)/(n+1)) ≤
      (pathOperator_symmetric n).eigenvalues (by simp) i
proof:
:= by
  apply eigenvalue_lower_of_subspace (pathOperator_symmetric n) (by simp)
    (LinearMap.range (tentMap m n r)) i
  · rw [tentMap_rank hm hfit]
    exact hi
  · rintro x ⟨c, rfl⟩ hx
    have h := pathOperator_tent_rayleigh hm hfit c
    simpa only [hx, one_pow, mul_one] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_three_eighth_sub_le
statement:
lemma rpow_three_eighth_sub_le {s x y : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hsx : s ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    y ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) - x ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤
      (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) * (y - x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : 0 < x := hs.trans_le hsx
  have hd (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Icc x y) :
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun z : ℝ => z ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ))
        ((3 / 8 : ℝ) * z ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ)) (Set.Icc x y) z := by
    have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := (3 / 8 : ℝ))
      (Or.inl (ne_of_gt (hx.trans_le hz.1)))).hasDerivWithinAt (s := Set.Icc x y)
    norm_num at h ⊢
    exact h
  have hb (z : ℝ) (hz : z ∈ Set.Ico x y) :
      ‖(3 / 8 : ℝ) * z ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ)‖ ≤ (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ z := (hx.trans_le hz.1).le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (3 / 8 : ℝ) * z ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ))]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hs (hsx.trans hz.1) (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
  have h := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' hd hb y ⟨hxy, le_rfl⟩
  exact (le_abs_self _).trans h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_three_eighth_mono
statement:
lemma rpow_three_eighth_mono {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    x ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)
proof: := Real.rpow_le_rpow hx hxy (by norm_num)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_mono {A B C s : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s) :
    MonotoneOn (edgeError A B C s) (Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y _hy hxy
  change 0 ≤ x at hx
  dsimp [edgeError]
  gcongr

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_increment
statement:
lemma edgeError_increment {A B C s x y : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) :
    edgeError A B C s y - edgeError A B C s x ≤
      (A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C) * (y - x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (rpow_three_eighth_sub_le hs
    (show s ≤ x + s by linarith) (show x + s ≤ y + s by linarith)) hA
  dsimp [edgeError]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_gap_comparison_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_gap_comparison_mono {A B C s : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsmall : A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C ≤ 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun e => e + edgeError A B C s e) (Set.Ici 0) ∧
    MonotoneOn (fun e => e - edgeError A B C s e) (Set.Ici 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have := edgeError_mono (B := B) hA hC hs hx hy hxy
    linarith
  · intro x hx y _hy hxy
    have h := edgeError_increment (B := B) (C := C) hA hs hx hxy
    have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall (sub_nonneg.mpr hxy)
    linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_eigenvalue_comparison_mono
statement:
lemma edgeError_eigenvalue_comparison_mono {A B C s : ℝ}
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hsmall : A * (3 / 8 : ℝ) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + C ≤ 1) :
    MonotoneOn (fun v => v + edgeError A B C s (2 - v)) (Set.Iic 2) ∧
    MonotoneOn (fun v => v - edgeError A B C s (2 - v)) (Set.Iic 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := edgeError_gap_comparison_mono (B := B) hA hC hs hsmall
  constructor
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have h := hm (show 0 ≤ 2 - y by exact sub_nonneg.mpr hy)
      (show 0 ≤ 2 - x by exact sub_nonneg.mpr hx) (by linarith : 2 - y ≤ 2 - x)
    linarith
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have h := hp (show 0 ≤ 2 - y by exact sub_nonneg.mpr hy)
      (show 0 ≤ 2 - x by exact sub_nonneg.mpr hx) (by linarith : 2 - y ≤ 2 - x)
    linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeError_relative
statement:
lemma edgeError_relative {A B C s t e : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hs : 0 < s) (hst : s ≤ t) (he : 0 ≤ e) :
    edgeError A B C s e ≤ (A * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) + B / s + C) * (t + e)
proof:
:= by
  have hes : 0 < e + s := by linarith
  have ht : 0 < t + e := by linarith
  have hp : (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) = (e + s) * (e + s) ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    nth_rw 2 [← Real.rpow_one (e + s)]
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hes]
    norm_num
  have hp' : (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) * (t + e) := by
    rw [hp]
    calc
      _ ≤ (e + s) * s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hs (by linarith) (by norm_num)) hes.le
      _ ≤ _ := by
        have : 0 ≤ s ^ (-5 / 8 : ℝ) := by positivity
        nlinarith
  have hb : B ≤ (B / s) * (t + e) := by
    have : B / s * s = B := div_mul_cancel₀ B hs.ne'
    have : 0 ≤ B / s := div_nonneg hB hs.le
    nlinarith [div_mul_cancel₀ B hs.ne']
  have hc : C * e ≤ C * (t + e) := by nlinarith [hs.trans_le hst]
  dsimp [edgeError]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp' hA]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.third_power_square
statement: lemma third_power_square {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) : (x^(1/3:ℝ))^2 = x^(2/3:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx]
  norm_num

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fifth_third_power
statement: lemma fifth_third_power {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) : x^(5/3:ℝ) = x*x^(2/3:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (5/3:ℝ) = 1+2/3 by ring,Real.rpow_add hx,Real.rpow_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)^(a-ε)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hε).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  simp only [Function.comp_def]
  rw [← Real.rpow_sub (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero
statement:
lemma ceil_rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (⌈(n:ℝ)^(a-ε)⌉₊:ℝ)/(n:ℝ)^a) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have he := (rpow_ratio_tendsto_zero (a := a) hε).add
    (((tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop ha).comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop))
  rw [zero_add] at he
  apply squeeze_zero' (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => by positivity)) _ he
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with n hn
  have hc := (Nat.ceil_lt_add_one (show 0 ≤ (n:ℝ)^(a-ε) by positivity)).le
  have hp : 0 < (n:ℝ)^a := Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn) a
  calc
    _ ≤ ((n:ℝ)^(a-ε)+1)/(n:ℝ)^a := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc hp.le
    _ = _ := by simp only [Function.comp_def]; rw [add_div,one_div,Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.abs_spinValue
statement: @[simp] lemma abs_spinValue (b : Bool) : |spinValue b| = 1
proof: := by cases b <;> norm_num [spinValue]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlapCoord_abs_le_one
statement: lemma cavityOverlapCoord_abs_le_one (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) : |cavityOverlapCoord i x y| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  rw [cavityOverlapCoord,abs_div,abs_of_pos hn,div_le_one hn]
  calc
    |∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, spinValue (x j)*spinValue (y j)| ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, |spinValue (x j)*spinValue (y j)| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = (n:ℝ)-1 := by
      simp only [abs_mul,abs_spinValue,mul_one,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
      rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i),Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_sub (by have := i.isLt; omega),Nat.cast_one]
    _ ≤ (n:ℝ) := by linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityNormalization_join
statement:
lemma cavityNormalization_join (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) :
    cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i =
      coshMixture (gibbs ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v))) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val) u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cavityNormalization,delete_cavityJoin,mean,coshMixture,localField_cavityJoin,gaussianLinear]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlap_join
statement:
lemma cavityOverlap_join (i : Fin n) (u : Incident i → ℝ) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) :
    cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i =
      ∑ x, ∑ y, gibbs ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)) x*gibbs ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)) y*cavityOverlapCoord i x y^2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cavityOverlap,delete_cavityJoin,mean,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_variance_bound
statement: lemma incident_variance_bound (i : Fin n) : (n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < (n:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt
  calc
    _ ≤ (n:ℝ)⁻¹*(n:ℝ) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (inv_nonneg.mpr hn.le)
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hn.ne'

name: OAI.CriticalSK.incident_scaled_product
statement:
lemma incident_scaled_product (i : Fin n) (x y : Spin n) :
    (n:ℝ)⁻¹*(∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val*incidentCoeff i y e.val) = cavityOverlapCoord i x y
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (n:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt))
  rw [incident_coeff_product,← mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel₀ hn,one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_conditional_mean
statement:
lemma cavity_conditional_mean (i : Fin n) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u => cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i) (incidentLaw i) ∧
    (∫ u, cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ∂incidentLaw i) = Real.exp ((n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1)/2)
proof:
:= by
  change Integrable (fun u => cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i) (gaussianScalarPi (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹) ∧ _
  simp_rw [cavityNormalization_join]
  refine ⟨coshMixture_integrable (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹ (gibbs ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v))) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val), ?_⟩
  change (∫ u, coshMixture (gibbs ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v))) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val) u ∂gaussianScalarPi (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹) = _

  simpa only [NNReal.coe_inv,NNReal.coe_natCast] using coshMixture_integral (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹ (gibbs_sum _) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val) (incident_coeff_square i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_conditional_pow
statement:
lemma cavity_conditional_pow (i : Fin n) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) (m : ℕ) :
    Integrable (fun u => cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i^m) (incidentLaw i) ∧
    (∫ u, cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i^m ∂incidentLaw i) ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := coshMixture_pow_integrable_bound (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹ (gibbs_nonneg ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v))) (gibbs_sum _) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val) (incident_coeff_square i) m
  simp only [NNReal.coe_inv,NNReal.coe_natCast] at hh
  simp_rw [cavityNormalization_join]
  refine ⟨hh.1,hh.2.trans ?_⟩
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (by norm_num)
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (incident_variance_bound i) (sq_nonneg (m:ℝ))]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_conditional_variance
statement:
lemma cavity_conditional_variance (i : Fin n) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u => (cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i-Real.exp ((n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1)/2))^2) (incidentLaw i) ∧
    (∫ u, (cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i-Real.exp ((n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1)/2))^2 ∂incidentLaw i) ≤
      Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)) i
proof:
:= by
  have hc (x y : Spin n) : |((n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹:ℝ)*(∑ e : Incident i, incidentCoeff i x e.val*incidentCoeff i y e.val)| ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_inv,NNReal.coe_natCast,incident_scaled_product] using cavityOverlapCoord_abs_le_one i x y
  have hh := coshMixture_centered_integrable_bound (n:ℝ≥0)⁻¹ (gibbs_nonneg ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v))) (gibbs_sum _) (fun (x : Spin n) (e : Incident i) => incidentCoeff i x e.val) (incident_coeff_square i) hc
  simp only [NNReal.coe_inv,NNReal.coe_natCast,incident_scaled_product] at hh
  simp_rw [← cavityNormalization_join] at hh
  rw [← cavityOverlap_join i 0 v] at hh
  refine ⟨hh.1,hh.2.trans ?_⟩
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (incident_variance_bound i)) (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp 1])) (cavityOverlap_nonneg _ i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.deleteDisorder_continuous
statement: lemma deleteDisorder_continuous (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => deleteDisorder W i)
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro e
  by_cases he : e.val.1=i ∨ e.val.2=i
  · simp only [deleteDisorder,ite_eq_left he]; exact continuous_const
  · simp only [deleteDisorder,ite_eq_right he]; exact continuous_apply e

name: OAI.CriticalSK.localField_continuous
statement: lemma localField_continuous (i : Fin n) (x : Spin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => localField W i x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold localField
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityNormalization_continuous
statement: lemma cavityNormalization_continuous (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => cavityNormalization W i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cavityNormalization mean
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact ((gibbs_continuous x).comp (deleteDisorder_continuous i)).mul (Real.continuous_cosh.comp (localField_continuous i x))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityOverlap_continuous
statement: lemma cavityOverlap_continuous (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => cavityOverlap W i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cavityOverlap mean
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  apply ((gibbs_continuous x).comp (deleteDisorder_continuous i)).mul
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro y _
  exact ((gibbs_continuous y).comp (deleteDisorder_continuous i)).mul continuous_const

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_event_identity
statement:
lemma cavity_event_identity (i : Fin n) {E : Set (Disorder n)} (hE : MeasurableSet E) :
    (disorderLaw n).real E = ∫ v, (incidentLaw i).real {u | (cavitySplit i).symm (u,v) ∈ E} ∂nonincidentLaw i
proof:
:=
  preserving_product_event_real _ _ _ _ (cavitySplit_preserving i).symm hE

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_conditional_tail
statement:
lemma cavity_conditional_tail (i : Fin n) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (m : ℕ) :
    (incidentLaw i).real {u | b ≤ cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i} ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi,hh⟩ := cavity_conditional_pow i v m
  have ht := integral_dominates_event (E := {u | b ≤ cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i})
    (hi.div_const (b^m)) (fun u => div_nonneg (pow_nonneg (by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i]) _) (pow_nonneg hb.le _))
    (fun u hu => by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hb _)).mpr
      rw [one_mul]
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hb.le hu _)
  rw [integral_div] at ht
  exact ht.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hh (pow_nonneg hb.le _))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_tail
statement:
lemma cavity_tail (i : Fin n) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (m : ℕ) :
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} ≤ 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m
proof:
:= by
  rw [cavity_event_identity i (measurableSet_le measurable_const (cavityNormalization_continuous i).measurable)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _v, 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m ∂nonincidentLaw i :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg)) (integrable_const _) (ae_of_all _ (fun v => cavity_conditional_tail i v hb m))
    _ = _ := by simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.all_cavity_tail
statement:
lemma all_cavity_tail {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (m : ℕ) :
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | ∃ i, b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} ≤ (n:ℝ)*(2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m)
proof:
:= by
  have he : {W : Disorder n | ∃ i, b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} = ⋃ i : Fin n, {W | b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} := by ext W; simp
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, (disorderLaw n).real {W | b ≤ cavityNormalization W i} := measureReal_iUnion_fintype_le _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, 2*Real.exp ((m:ℝ)^2/2)/b^m := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => cavity_tail i hb m)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_conditional_clipped
statement:
lemma cavity_conditional_clipped (i : Fin n) (v : Nonincident i → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (incidentLaw i).real {u | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ∧ cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ≤ r} ≤
      Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r
proof:
:= by
  have he (u : Incident i → ℝ) : cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i = cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)) i := by
    rw [cavityOverlap_join,cavityOverlap_join]
  by_cases hR : cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (0,v)) i ≤ r
  · obtain ⟨hi,hh⟩ := cavity_conditional_variance i v
    have hm : Real.exp ((n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1)/2) ≤ Real.exp 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith [incident_variance_bound i])
    have ht := integral_dominates_event (E := {u | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ∧ cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ≤ r}) hi (fun _ => sq_nonneg _) (fun u hu => by
      have hz := hu.1
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i-Real.exp ((n:ℝ)⁻¹*((n:ℝ)-1)/2)-1)])
    exact ht.trans (hh.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp 1]))))
  · have hset : {u | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ∧ cavityOverlap ((cavitySplit i).symm (u,v)) i ≤ r} = ∅ := by
      ext u
      simp only [mem_ofPred_eq,he,mem_empty_iff_false,iff_false,not_and]
      exact fun _ => hR
    rw [hset,measureReal_empty]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp 1])) hr

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityClipped_measurable
statement: lemma cavityClipped_measurable (i : Fin n) (r : ℝ) : MeasurableSet {W : Disorder n | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i ∧ cavityOverlap W i ≤ r}
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (cavityNormalization_continuous i).measurable).inter (measurableSet_le (cavityOverlap_continuous i).measurable measurable_const)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_clipped
statement:
lemma cavity_clipped (i : Fin n) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i ∧ cavityOverlap W i ≤ r} ≤ Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r
proof:
:= by
  rw [cavity_event_identity i (cavityClipped_measurable i r)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ _v, Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r ∂nonincidentLaw i :=
      integral_mono_of_nonneg (ae_of_all _ (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg)) (integrable_const _) (ae_of_all _ (fun v => cavity_conditional_clipped i v hr))
    _ = _ := by simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityClippedCount_nonneg
statement: lemma cavityClippedCount_nonneg (W : Disorder n) (r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ cavityClippedCount W r
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityClippedCount_integrable
statement: lemma cavityClippedCount_integrable (r : ℝ) : Integrable (fun W : Disorder n => cavityClippedCount W r) (disorderLaw n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cavityClippedCount
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  refine ((integrable_const (μ := disorderLaw n) (1:ℝ)).indicator (cavityClipped_measurable i r)).congr (ae_of_all _ ?_)
  intro W
  by_cases hW : Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i ∧ cavityOverlap W i ≤ r <;> simp [hW]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityClippedCount_expectation
statement:
lemma cavityClippedCount_expectation {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (∫ W, cavityClippedCount W r ∂disorderLaw n) ≤ (n:ℝ)*(Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cavityClippedCount
  rw [integral_finsetSum]
  · calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin n, (disorderLaw n).real {W | Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i ∧ cavityOverlap W i ≤ r} := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        simpa only [Set.indicator, mem_ofPred_eq, Pi.one_apply] using integral_indicator_one (μ := disorderLaw n) (cavityClipped_measurable i r)
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin n, Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => cavity_clipped i hr)
      _ = _ := by simp
  · intro i _
    refine ((integrable_const (μ := disorderLaw n) (1:ℝ)).indicator (cavityClipped_measurable i r)).congr (ae_of_all _ ?_)
    intro W
    by_cases hW : Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i ∧ cavityOverlap W i ≤ r <;> simp [hW]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavityClippedCount_tail
statement:
lemma cavityClippedCount_tail {r b : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (disorderLaw n).real {W | b ≤ cavityClippedCount W r} ≤ (n:ℝ)*(Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*r)/b
proof:
:= by
  have ht := integral_dominates_event (μ := disorderLaw n) (E := {W | b ≤ cavityClippedCount W r}) ((cavityClippedCount_integrable r).div_const b)
    (fun W => div_nonneg (cavityClippedCount_nonneg W r) hb.le) (fun W hW => (le_div_iff₀ hb).mpr (by simpa using hW))
  rw [integral_div] at ht
  exact ht.trans (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (cavityClippedCount_expectation hr) hb.le)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_nonneg
statement: lemma variance_linear_nonneg (a : Fin n → ℝ) : 0 ≤ variance W (linearObservable a)
proof: := mean_nonneg _ (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_norm_bound
statement: lemma variance_linear_norm_bound (a : Fin n → ℝ) : variance W (linearObservable a) ≤ covarianceNorm W*(∑ i, a i^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := variance_linear_le_norm W (WithLp.toLp 2 a)
  rwa [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq] at hh

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound
statement:
lemma linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) {B : ℝ} (_hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B) :
    (∑ i ∈ A, a i^2) ≤ B^2*dirichlet W (linearObservable a)
proof:
:= by
  have ht (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∈ A) : a i^2 ≤ B^2*(alphaSite W i*a i^2) := by
    have hZ := cavityNormalization_ge_one W i
    have hα := alphaSite_pos W i
    have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith : 0 ≤ cavityNormalization W i) (hz i hi) 2
    have hh := alphaSite_normalization W i
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq hα.le
    have hn : 1 ≤ B^2*alphaSite W i := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (sq_nonneg (a i))]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ A, B^2*(alphaSite W i*a i^2) := Finset.sum_le_sum ht
    _ = B^2*(∑ i ∈ A, alphaSite W i*a i^2) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ ≤ B^2*(∑ i : Fin n, alphaSite W i*a i^2) := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg B)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ A) (fun i _ _ => mul_nonneg (alphaSite_pos W i).le (sq_nonneg _))
    _ = _ := by rw [dirichlet_linear_eq]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.restrictCoeff_sum_sq
statement:
lemma restrictCoeff_sum_sq (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, restrictCoeff A a i^2) = ∑ i ∈ A, a i^2
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictCoeff,ite_pow,Finset.sum_ite_mem]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.restrictCoeff_linear
statement:
lemma restrictCoeff_linear (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable (restrictCoeff A a) x = ∑ i ∈ A, a i*spinValue (x i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [linearObservable,restrictCoeff,ite_mul,Finset.sum_ite_mem]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.restrictCoeff_linear_sq
statement:
lemma restrictCoeff_linear_sq (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : Spin n) :
    linearObservable (restrictCoeff A a) x^2 ≤ (A.card:ℝ)*(∑ i ∈ A, a i^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [restrictCoeff_linear]
  have hh := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq A a (fun i => spinValue (x i))
  simp only [spinValue_sq,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one] at hh
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_split_bound
statement:
lemma variance_linear_split_bound (A : Finset (Fin n)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) {B K : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hzG : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B)
    (hzB : ∀ i ∈ Aᶜ, cavityNormalization W i ≤ K) :
    variance W (linearObservable a) ≤
      (2*B^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(Aᶜ.card:ℝ)*K^2)*dirichlet W (linearObservable a)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit (x : Spin n) : linearObservable a x = linearObservable (restrictCoeff A a) x+linearObservable (restrictCoeff Aᶜ a) x := by
    rw [restrictCoeff_linear,restrictCoeff_linear,Finset.sum_add_sum_compl]
    rfl
  have hv : variance W (linearObservable a) ≤ 2*variance W (linearObservable (restrictCoeff A a))+2*variance W (linearObservable (restrictCoeff Aᶜ a)) := by
    simp only [variance,mean_linearObservable,sub_zero]
    rw [← mean_const_mul,← mean_const_mul,← mean_add]
    apply mean_mono
    intro x
    rw [hsplit]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (linearObservable (restrictCoeff A a) x-linearObservable (restrictCoeff Aᶜ a) x)]
  have hG := variance_linear_norm_bound W (restrictCoeff A a)
  rw [restrictCoeff_sum_sq] at hG
  have hGB := linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound W A a hB hzG
  have hBC := linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound W Aᶜ a hK hzB
  have hVB : variance W (linearObservable (restrictCoeff Aᶜ a)) ≤ (Aᶜ.card:ℝ)*(∑ i ∈ Aᶜ, a i^2) := by
    rw [variance,mean_linearObservable]
    simp only [sub_zero]
    exact (mean_mono W (restrictCoeff_linear_sq Aᶜ a)).trans_eq (mean_const _ _)
  have hN : 0 ≤ covarianceNorm W := norm_nonneg _
  have hC : 0 ≤ (Aᶜ.card:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hGB hN,mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hBC hC]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_global_bound
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_global_bound (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤
      covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2
proof:
:= by
  let B := ∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one W i]
  have hZ (i : Fin n) (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) : cavityNormalization W i ≤ B :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one W j]) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hd := linear_dirichlet_coeff_bound W Finset.univ a hB hZ
  have hV := variance_linear_norm_bound W a
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (dirichlet_linear_pos W ha)).mpr
  have hN : 0 ≤ covarianceNorm W := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd hN]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratios_bdd
statement: lemma linear_ratios_bdd : BddAbove {r : ℝ | ∃ a : Fin n → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ r = variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a)}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2,?_⟩
  rintro r ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
  exact linear_ratio_global_bound W a ha

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratios_nonempty
statement: lemma linear_ratios_nonempty (hn : 0 < n) : Set.Nonempty {r : ℝ | ∃ a : Fin n → ℝ, a ≠ 0 ∧ r = variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a)}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨_,(fun _ => 1),?_,rfl⟩
  intro hh
  have he := congrFun hh ⟨0,hn⟩
  norm_num at he

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_le
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_le (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) ≤ linearRayleigh W
proof:
:=
  le_csSup (linear_ratios_bdd W) ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_split_bound
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_split_bound (hn : 0 < n) (A : Finset (Fin n)) {B K : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hzG : ∀ i ∈ A, cavityNormalization W i ≤ B)
    (hzB : ∀ i ∈ Aᶜ, cavityNormalization W i ≤ K) :
    linearRayleigh W ≤ 2*B^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(Aᶜ.card:ℝ)*K^2
proof:
:= by
  apply csSup_le (linear_ratios_nonempty W hn)
  rintro r ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (dirichlet_linear_pos W ha)).mpr (variance_linear_split_bound W A a hB hK hzG hzB)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_smallBall
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_smallBall (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ∑ i, a i^2 = 1) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    b^2*(1-linearSmallBall W a b) ≤ linearRayleigh W
proof:
:= by
  have hane : a ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp only [hh,Pi.zero_apply,zero_pow (by norm_num : (2:ℕ) ≠ 0),Finset.sum_const_zero] at ha; norm_num at ha
  have hd := dirichlet_linear_le W a
  rw [ha] at hd
  have hdp := dirichlet_linear_pos W hane
  have hV := variance_linear_nonneg W a
  have hr : variance W (linearObservable a) ≤ variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a) :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hdp).mpr (by nlinarith)
  exact (variance_linear_smallBall W a hb).trans (hr.trans (linear_ratio_le W a hane))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.variance_linear_continuous
statement: lemma variance_linear_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => variance W (linearObservable a))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [variance,mean_linearObservable]
  simp only [sub_zero,mean]
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact (gibbs_continuous x).mul continuous_const

name: OAI.CriticalSK.alphaSite_continuous
statement: lemma alphaSite_continuous (i : Fin n) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => alphaSite W i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold alphaSite mean
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact (gibbs_continuous x).mul (((Real.continuous_cosh.comp (localField_continuous i x)).inv₀ (fun _ => (Real.cosh_pos _).ne')).pow 2)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dirichlet_linear_continuous
statement: lemma dirichlet_linear_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) : Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => dirichlet W (linearObservable a))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dirichlet_linear_eq]
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  exact (alphaSite_continuous i).mul continuous_const

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linear_ratio_continuous
statement:
lemma linear_ratio_continuous (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Continuous (fun W : Disorder n => variance W (linearObservable a)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a))
proof:
:=
  (variance_linear_continuous a).div (dirichlet_linear_continuous a) (fun W => (dirichlet_linear_pos W ha).ne')

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_eq_iSup
statement:
lemma linearRayleigh_eq_iSup (W : Disorder n) : linearRayleigh W =
    ⨆ a : {a : Fin n → ℝ // a ≠ 0}, variance W (linearObservable a.val)/dirichlet W (linearObservable a.val)
proof:
:= by
  change sSup _ = sSup _
  congr 1
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a,ha⟩,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a.val,a.property,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.linearRayleigh_measurable
statement: lemma linearRayleigh_measurable (n : ℕ) : Measurable (linearRayleigh (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : LowerSemicontinuous (linearRayleigh (n := n)) := by
    change LowerSemicontinuous (fun W : Disorder n => linearRayleigh W)
    simp_rw [linearRayleigh_eq_iSup]
    apply lowerSemicontinuous_ciSup
    · intro W
      refine ⟨covarianceNorm W*(∑ i : Fin n, cavityNormalization W i)^2,?_⟩
      rintro r ⟨a,rfl⟩
      exact linear_ratio_global_bound W a.val a.property
    · intro a
      exact (linear_ratio_continuous a.val a.property).lowerSemicontinuous
  exact hh.measurable

name: OAI.CriticalSK.shift_rpow_neg_tendsto
statement: lemma shift_rpow_neg_tendsto {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n+4:ℝ)^(-p)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (tendsto_rpow_neg_atTop hp).comp ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_max_rate_identity
statement:
lemma cavity_max_rate_identity {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x*(2*Real.exp 20000/(x^(1/100:ℝ))^200) = (2*Real.exp 20000)*x^(-1:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx.le]
  norm_num
  rw [Real.rpow_neg_one]
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_count_rate_identity
statement:
lemma cavity_count_rate_identity {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    x*(Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1)*x^(-1/2:ℝ))/x^(3/5:ℝ) = (Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1))*x^(-1/10:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1))*(x^((1:ℝ))*x^(-1/2:ℝ)/x^(3/5:ℝ)) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]; ring
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hx,← Real.rpow_sub hx]; congr 2; norm_num

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_overlap_rate_identity
proof:
:= by
  have he : x⁻¹^2 = x^(-2:ℝ) := by rw [Real.rpow_neg hx.le,Real.rpow_two,inv_pow]
  rw [he,← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx.le]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
  calc
    _ = 2*((x^(1/100*2:ℝ)*x^(-3/5:ℝ)/x^(-1/2:ℝ))+(x^(1/100*2:ℝ)*x^(-2:ℝ)/x^(-1/2:ℝ))) := by ring_nf
    _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hx,← Real.rpow_sub hx,← Real.rpow_add hx,← Real.rpow_sub hx]; congr 2 <;> norm_num

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_overlap_rate_eventually
statement:
lemma cavity_overlap_rate_eventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
    2*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2*((n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ)+(n+4:ℝ)⁻¹^2) ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := ((shift_rpow_neg_tendsto (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2/25)).add (shift_rpow_neg_tendsto (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<37/25))).const_mul 2
  simp only [mul_zero,add_zero] at hh
  filter_upwards [hh.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))] with n hn
  apply (div_le_one (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))).mp
  rw [cavity_overlap_rate_identity (by positivity)]
  simpa only [neg_div] using hn.le

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_error_rate_identity
statement:
lemma rayleigh_error_rate_identity {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    (x^(3/5:ℝ)*(x^(1/100:ℝ))^2)/x^(2/3:ℝ) = x^(-7/150:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hx.le,← Real.rpow_add hx,← Real.rpow_sub hx]
  norm_num

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_error_rate_eventually
statement:
lemma rayleigh_error_rate_eventually : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in atTop,
    (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2 ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [(shift_rpow_neg_tendsto (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<7/150)).eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1))] with n hn
  apply (div_le_one (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ))).mp
  rw [rayleigh_error_rate_identity (by positivity)]
  simpa only [neg_div] using hn.le

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_max_tail_zero
statement:
lemma cavity_max_tail_zero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
    {W | ∃ i, (n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ) ≤ cavityNormalization W i}) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg)
    (g := fun n : ℕ => (2*Real.exp 20000)*(n+4:ℝ)^(-1:ℝ))
  · intro n
    have hh := all_cavity_tail (n := n+4) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ)) 200
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
    rwa [cavity_max_rate_identity (by positivity)] at hh
  · simpa using (shift_rpow_neg_tendsto (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1)).const_mul (2*Real.exp 20000)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_count_tail_zero
statement:
lemma cavity_count_tail_zero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
    {W | (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ) ≤ cavityClippedCount W ((n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))}) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply squeeze_zero (fun _ => measureReal_nonneg)
    (g := fun n : ℕ => (Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1))*(n+4:ℝ)^(-1/10:ℝ))
  · intro n
    have hh := cavityClippedCount_tail (n := n+4) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤(n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ))
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
    simp only [← neg_div] at hh
    rwa [cavity_count_rate_identity (by positivity)] at hh
  · simpa only [mul_zero,neg_div] using (shift_rpow_neg_tendsto (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/10)).const_mul (Real.exp 1*(Real.exp 1-1))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cavity_overlap_tail_zero
statement:
lemma cavity_overlap_tail_zero : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (disorderLaw (n+4)).real
    {W | (n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ) ≤ gibbsOverlap W}) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_order.mpr
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    exact Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ha.trans_le measureReal_nonneg)
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨C,_hC,hp⟩ := natural_GibbsOverlap_tight ha
    have ht : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n+4:ℝ)^(1/15:ℝ)) atTop atTop := by
      have hh := (tendsto_rpow_atTop (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1/15)).comp ((tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 4))
      simpa only [Function.comp_def,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
    filter_upwards [hp,tendsto_atTop.mp ht C] with n hn hCn
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt (measureReal_mono ?_) hn
    intro W hW
    change C/(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ) ≤ gibbsOverlap W
    change (n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ) ≤ gibbsOverlap W at hW
    apply le_trans _ hW
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ))).mpr
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<n+4)]
    norm_num
    exact hCn

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rayleigh_cavity_good_bound
statement:
lemma rayleigh_cavity_good_bound (n : ℕ) (W : Disorder (n+4))
    (hrate : 2*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2*((n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ)+(n+4:ℝ)⁻¹^2) ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ))
    (herr : (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)*((n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))^2 ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ))
    (hZ : ∀ i, cavityNormalization W i < (n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))
    (hQ : gibbsOverlap W < (n+4:ℝ)^(-3/5:ℝ))
    (hC : cavityClippedCount W ((n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)) < (n+4:ℝ)^(3/5:ℝ)) :
    linearRayleigh W ≤ 2*(Real.exp 1+1)^2*covarianceNorm W+2*(n+4:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hR (i : Fin (n+4)) : cavityOverlap W i ≤ (n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ) := by
    have hh := cavityOverlap_compare W i
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
    refine hh.trans (le_trans ?_ hrate)
    apply mul_le_mul
    · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith [cavityNormalization_ge_one W i]) (hZ i).le 2) (by norm_num)
    · exact add_le_add hQ.le le_rfl
    · exact add_nonneg (gibbsOverlap_nonneg W) (sq_nonneg _)
    · positivity
  let A : Finset (Fin (n+4)) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => cavityNormalization W i ≤ Real.exp 1+1)
  have hcard : (Aᶜ.card:ℝ) = cavityClippedCount W ((n+4:ℝ)^(-1/2:ℝ)) := by
    rw [cavityClippedCount]
    have he (i : Fin (n+4)) : i ∈ Aᶜ ↔ Real.exp 1+1 < cavityNormalization W i := by simp [A]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin (n+4), if i ∈ Aᶜ then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by rw [← Finset.sum_filter]; simp only [Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter,Finset.univ_inter,Finset.sum_const,nsmul_eq_mul,mul_one]
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        simp only [he,hR i,and_true]
  have hb := linearRayleigh_split_bound W (by omega : 0<n+4) A
    (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤Real.exp 1+1) (by positivity : (0:ℝ)≤(n+4:ℝ)^(1/100:ℝ))
