       ∂orthogonalHaar ι) = spherePartition lam a r
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ U, Real.exp (a / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • (orthogonalSphere U u).val))
        ∂orthogonalHaar ι := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with U
      rw [(orthogonalIsometry U).map_smul]
      rfl
    _ = _ := orthogonal_first_moment _ (sphere_energy_continuous lam a r) u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.orthogonal_radial_partition
statement:
lemma orthogonal_radial_partition (lam : ι → ℝ) (a : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) (hx : ‖x‖ = r) :
    (∫ U, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U x)) ∂orthogonalHaar ι) =
      spherePartition lam a r
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ‖r⁻¹ • x‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le), hx, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr.ne']
  let u : unitSphere ι := ⟨r⁻¹ • x, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr hu⟩
  have he : r • u.val = x := by
    change r • (r⁻¹ • x) = x
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hr.ne', one_smul]
  calc
    _ = ∫ U, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (r • u.val)))
        ∂orthogonalHaar ι := by simp only [he]
    _ = _ := orthogonal_scaled_partition lam a r u

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeVector_norm
statement: lemma cubeVector_norm {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) : ‖cubeVector x‖ = Real.sqrt n
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _), EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  change ∑ i : Fin n, spinValue (x i)^2 = (n : ℝ)
  simp only [spinValue_sq, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul,
    mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rotatedCubePartition_first_moment
statement:
lemma rotatedCubePartition_first_moment {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∫ U, rotatedCubePartition lam a U ∂orthogonalHaar (Fin n)) =
      spherePartition lam a (Real.sqrt n)
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨⟨0, hn⟩⟩
  unfold rotatedCubePartition
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_finsetSum]
  · simp_rw [orthogonal_radial_partition lam a (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn))
      _ (cubeVector_norm _)]
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero (α := Spin n)), one_mul]
  · intro x _
    apply orthogonalHaar_integrable
    exact (continuous_const.mul ((diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp
      (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous (cubeVector x)))).rexp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.overlapPair_gram
statement:
lemma overlapPair_gram {u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r q : ℝ}
    (hu : ‖u‖ = r) (hv : ‖v‖ = r) (horth : inner ℝ u v = 0) (hq : |q| ≤ 1) :
    ‖overlapPlus u v q‖ = r ∧ ‖overlapMinus u v q‖ = r ∧
      inner ℝ (overlapPlus u v q) (overlapMinus u v q) = q * r^2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (1+q)/2 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hq).1]
  have hm : 0 ≤ (1-q)/2 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hq).2]
  have hpu := Real.sq_sqrt hp
  have hmu := Real.sq_sqrt hm
  have horth' : inner ℝ v u = 0 := by rw [real_inner_comm, horth]
  have huu : inner ℝ u u = r^2 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]
  have hvv : inner ℝ v v = r^2 := by rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hv]
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := hu ▸ norm_nonneg u
  have hplus : ‖overlapPlus u v q‖^2 = r^2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [overlapPlus, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, horth, horth', huu, hvv]
    nlinarith
  have hminus : ‖overlapMinus u v q‖^2 = r^2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [overlapMinus, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, horth, horth', huu, hvv]
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨(sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr).mp hplus,
    (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hr).mp hminus, ?_⟩
  simp only [overlapPlus, overlapMinus, inner_add_left, inner_sub_right,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, horth, horth', huu, hvv]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalEnergy_overlap
statement:
lemma diagonalEnergy_overlap (lam : ι → ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) {q : ℝ}
    (hq : |q| ≤ 1) :
    diagonalEnergy lam (overlapPlus u v q) + diagonalEnergy lam (overlapMinus u v q) =
      (1+q)*diagonalEnergy lam u + (1-q)*diagonalEnergy lam v
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 ≤ (1+q)/2 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hq).1]
  have hm : 0 ≤ (1-q)/2 := by linarith [(abs_le.mp hq).2]
  have hpu := Real.sq_sqrt hp
  have hmu := Real.sq_sqrt hm
  unfold diagonalEnergy
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [overlapPlus, overlapMinus, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    _ = 2 * lam i * (Real.sqrt ((1+q)/2))^2 * (u i)^2 +
        2 * lam i * (Real.sqrt ((1-q)/2))^2 * (v i)^2 := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hpu, hmu]; ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pair_energy_orbit
statement:
lemma pair_energy_orbit (lam : ι → ℝ) {x y u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r q : ℝ}
    (hx : ‖x‖ = r) (hy : ‖y‖ = r) (hu : ‖u‖ = r) (hv : ‖v‖ = r)
    (horth : inner ℝ u v = 0) (hq : |q| ≤ 1) (hxy : inner ℝ x y = q*r^2) :
    (∫ U, Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U x) +
        diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U y))/2) ∂orthogonalHaar ι) =
      pairMoment lam u v q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hplus,hminus,hgram⟩ := overlapPair_gram hu hv horth hq
  rw [orthogonal_pair_integral_eq
    (fun a b => Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam a + diagonalEnergy lam b)/2))
    (hx.trans hplus.symm) (hy.trans hminus.symm) (hxy.trans hgram.symm)]
  unfold pairMoment pairIntegrand
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with U
  have hplus' : orthogonalIsometry U (overlapPlus u v q) =
      overlapPlus (orthogonalIsometry U u) (orthogonalIsometry U v) q := by
    simp only [overlapPlus, map_add, map_smul]
  have hminus' : orthogonalIsometry U (overlapMinus u v q) =
      overlapMinus (orthogonalIsometry U u) (orthogonalIsometry U v) q := by
    simp only [overlapMinus, map_sub, map_smul]
  rw [hplus', hminus', diagonalEnergy_overlap lam _ _ hq]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.pairMoment_continuous
statement:
lemma pairMoment_continuous (lam : ι → ℝ) (u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    Continuous (pairMoment lam u v)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ =>
      diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry p.2 u)) :=
    ((diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous u)).comp
      continuous_snd
  have hv : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ =>
      diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry p.2 v)) :=
    ((diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous v)).comp
      continuous_snd
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ =>
      pairIntegrand lam u v p.1 p.2) :=
    ((((continuous_const.add continuous_fst).mul hu).add
      ((continuous_const.sub continuous_fst).mul hv)).div_const 2).rexp
  have hi := continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := orthogonalHaar ι)
    (f := fun q U => pairIntegrand lam u v q U) hc (s := Set.univ) isCompact_univ
  change Continuous (fun q : ℝ => ∫ U, pairIntegrand lam u v q U ∂orthogonalHaar ι)
  simpa only [setIntegral_univ] using hi

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereUniform_rotation_preserving
statement:
lemma sphereUniform_rotation_preserving (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ) :
    MeasurePreserving (orthogonalSphere U) (sphereUniform (ι := ι)) sphereUniform
proof:
:=
  (sphereMap_preserving (orthogonalIsometry U)).smul_measure _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.orthogonalSphere_injective
statement:
lemma orthogonalSphere_injective (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ) :
    Function.Injective (orthogonalSphere U)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (orthogonalIsometry U).injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.orthogonalSphere_fixed_continuous
statement:
lemma orthogonalSphere_fixed_continuous (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ) :
    Continuous (orthogonalSphere U)
proof: := sphereMap_continuous (orthogonalIsometry U)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePair_rotation_integral
statement:
lemma spherePair_rotation_integral (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ)
    (f : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ p, f (orthogonalSphere U p.1, orthogonalSphere U p.2)
      ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)) = ∫ p, f p ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (sphereUniform_rotation_preserving U).prod (sphereUniform_rotation_preserving U)
  have hc : Continuous (Prod.map (orthogonalSphere U) (orthogonalSphere U)) :=
    (orthogonalSphere_fixed_continuous U).prodMap (orthogonalSphere_fixed_continuous U)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (Prod.map (orthogonalSphere U) (orthogonalSphere U)) := by
    intro a b h
    exact Prod.ext (orthogonalSphere_injective U (congrArg Prod.fst h))
      (orthogonalSphere_injective U (congrArg Prod.snd h))
  exact hp.integral_comp (hc.measurableEmbedding hinj) f

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuous_pair_first
statement:
lemma continuous_pair_first {A B C D : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    [TopologicalSpace C] [TopologicalSpace D] {f : A × B → D} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun z : A × (B × C) => f (z.1, z.2.1))
proof:
:=
  hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.continuous_pair_second
statement:
lemma continuous_pair_second {A B C D : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A] [TopologicalSpace B]
    [TopologicalSpace C] [TopologicalSpace D] {f : A × C → D} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun z : A × (B × C) => f (z.1, z.2.2))
proof:
:=
  hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePair_first_continuous
statement:
lemma spherePair_first_continuous :
    Continuous (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ × (unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) =>
      orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.1)
proof:
:=
  continuous_pair_first (orthogonalSphere_continuous (ι := ι))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePair_second_continuous
statement:
lemma spherePair_second_continuous :
    Continuous (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ × (unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) =>
      orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.2)
proof:
:=
  continuous_pair_second (orthogonalSphere_continuous (ι := ι))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePair_action_continuous
statement:
lemma spherePair_action_continuous :
    Continuous (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ × (unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) =>
      (orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.1, orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.2))
proof:
:=
  (spherePair_first_continuous (ι := ι)).prodMk (spherePair_second_continuous (ι := ι))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePair_haar_average
statement:
lemma spherePair_haar_average (f : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    (∫ p, ∫ U, f (orthogonalSphere U p.1, orthogonalSphere U p.2) ∂orthogonalHaar ι
      ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)) = ∫ p, f p ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ × (unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) =>
      f (orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.1, orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.2)) :=
    hf.comp spherePair_action_continuous
  have hi : Integrable (fun z : Matrix.orthogonalGroup ι ℝ × (unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) =>
      f (orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.1, orthogonalSphere z.1 z.2.2))
      ((orthogonalHaar ι).prod (sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)) := by
    simpa only [integrableOn_univ] using hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ
  rw [← integral_integral_swap hi]
  simp only [spherePair_rotation_integral, integral_const, probReal_univ, one_smul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_inner_abs_le_one
statement: lemma sphere_inner_abs_le_one (x y : unitSphere ι) : |inner ℝ x.val y.val| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_real_inner_le_norm x.val y.val
  simpa only [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp x.property, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp y.property,
    one_mul] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePairEnergy_factor
statement:
lemma spherePairEnergy_factor (lam : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) :
    spherePairEnergy lam r p =
      Real.exp (1 / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • p.1.val)) *
      Real.exp (1 / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • p.2.val))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_add]
  unfold spherePairEnergy
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePairEnergy_continuous
statement: lemma spherePairEnergy_continuous (lam : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) : Continuous (spherePairEnergy lam r)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := sphere_energy_continuous lam 1 r
  have he : spherePairEnergy lam r = fun p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι =>
      Real.exp (1 / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • p.1.val)) *
      Real.exp (1 / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • p.2.val)) := funext (spherePairEnergy_factor lam r)
  rw [he]
  exact (hf.comp continuous_fst).mul (hf.comp continuous_snd)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePairEnergy_integral
statement:
lemma spherePairEnergy_integral (lam : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    (∫ p, spherePairEnergy lam r p ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)) =
      (spherePartition lam 1 r)^2
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [spherePairEnergy_factor]
  let f : unitSphere ι → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (1 / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
  change (∫ p, f p.1 * f p.2 ∂((sphereUniform (ι := ι)).prod sphereUniform)) = _
  rw [integral_prod_mul f f, sphereUniform_integral]
  exact (pow_two _).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spectrum_pair_second_moment
statement:
lemma spectrum_pair_second_moment (lam : ι → ℝ) {u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι} {r : ℝ}
    (hu : ‖u‖ = r) (hv : ‖v‖ = r) (horth : inner ℝ u v = 0) :
    (∫ p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι, pairMoment lam u v (inner ℝ p.1.val p.2.val)
      ∂(sphereUniform.prod sphereUniform)) = (spherePartition lam 1 r)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := hu ▸ norm_nonneg u
  have hnorm (x : unitSphere ι) : ‖r • x.val‖ = r := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp x.property, mul_one]
  have he (p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι) :
      pairMoment lam u v (inner ℝ p.1.val p.2.val) =
        ∫ U, spherePairEnergy lam r (orthogonalSphere U p.1, orthogonalSphere U p.2)
          ∂orthogonalHaar ι := by
    have hxy : inner ℝ (r • p.1.val) (r • p.2.val) = inner ℝ p.1.val p.2.val * r^2 := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
      ring
    rw [← pair_energy_orbit lam (hnorm p.1) (hnorm p.2) hu hv horth
      (sphere_inner_abs_le_one p.1 p.2) hxy]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with U
    simp only [spherePairEnergy, orthogonalSphere, sphereMap, map_smul]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [spherePair_haar_average _ (spherePairEnergy_continuous lam r), spherePairEnergy_integral]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereOverlap_second_moment
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : unitSphere ι × unitSphere ι => inner ℝ p.1.val p.2.val) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).inner (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
  rw [sphereOverlapLaw, integral_map hc.measurable.aemeasurable
    (pairMoment_continuous lam u v).aestronglyMeasurable]
  exact spectrum_pair_second_moment lam hu hv horth

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_beq
statement: lemma spinValue_beq (a b : Bool) : spinValue (a == b) = spinValue a * spinValue b
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> norm_num [spinValue]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinProduct_involution
statement: lemma spinProduct_involution {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) : Function.Involutive (spinProduct x)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  funext i
  change (x i == (x i == y i)) = y i
  cases x i <;> cases y i <;> rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_signMean
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_signMean {n : ℕ} (x y : Spin n) :
    cubeOverlap x y = signMean (spinProduct x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cubeOverlap signMean cubeVector
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_toLp_toLp]
  simp only [star_trivial, dotProduct, spinProduct, spinValue_beq, mul_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_abs_le_one
statement: lemma cubeOverlap_abs_le_one {n : ℕ} (x y : Spin n) : |cubeOverlap x y| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · simp [cubeOverlap]
  have h := abs_real_inner_le_norm (cubeVector x) (cubeVector y)
  rw [cubeVector_norm, cubeVector_norm, ← sq, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)] at h
  unfold cubeOverlap
  rw [abs_div, show |(n : ℝ)| = n from abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n)]
  exact (div_le_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)).mpr h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_gram
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_gram {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x y : Spin n) :
    inner ℝ (cubeVector x) (cubeVector y) = cubeOverlap x y * (Real.sqrt n)^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  exact (div_mul_cancel₀ _ (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne')).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_sum
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_sum {n : ℕ} (x : Spin n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y)) = ∑ y : Spin n, f (signMean y)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cubeOverlap_signMean]
  exact (spinProductEquiv x).sum_comp (fun y => f (signMean y))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_average
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_average {n : ℕ} (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ x : Spin n, ∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y) =
      (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ y : Spin n, f (signMean y)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cubeOverlap_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hn : (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.signMean_finset
statement:
lemma signMean_finset {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Spin n) :
    signMean x = -1 + 2 * ((spinFinsetEquiv n x).card : ℝ) / n
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∑ i : Fin n, spinValue (x i)) =
      2 * ((spinFinsetEquiv n x).card : ℝ) - n := by
    have hv (i : Fin n) : spinValue (x i) = (if x i = true then 2 else 0) - 1 := by
      cases x i <;> norm_num [spinValue]
    simp_rw [hv, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp [spinFinsetEquiv, Finset.sum_ite, mul_comm]
  rw [signMean, he]
  field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hn.ne']
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.finset_card_sum
statement:
lemma finset_card_sum (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ s : Finset (Fin n), f s.card) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * f k
proof:
:= by
  have hm (s : Finset (Fin n)) (_ : s ∈ Finset.univ) : s.card ∈ Finset.range (n+1) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (by simpa using s.card_le_univ)
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to' hm f]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.univ_filter_card_eq, Finset.card_powersetCard,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cubeOverlap_binomial_sum
statement:
lemma cubeOverlap_binomial_sum {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ x : Spin n, ∑ y : Spin n, f (cubeOverlap x y) =
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
        (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * f (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeOverlap_average]
  simp_rw [signMean_finset hn]
  rw [(spinFinsetEquiv n).sum_comp (fun s => f (-1 + 2 * (s.card : ℝ) / n)),
    finset_card_sum n (fun k => f (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n))]
  congr 1
  simp [Spin, inv_pow]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rotatedCubePartition_continuous
statement:
lemma rotatedCubePartition_continuous {n : ℕ} (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    Continuous (rotatedCubePartition lam a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.const_mul
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro x _
  exact (continuous_const.mul ((diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp
    (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous (cubeVector x)))).rexp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rotatedCubePartition_square
statement:
lemma rotatedCubePartition_square {n : ℕ} (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    (U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) :
    rotatedCubePartition lam 1 U ^ 2 =
      (Fintype.card (Spin n) : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ 2 * ∑ x : Spin n, ∑ y : Spin n,
      Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector x)) +
        diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector y)))/2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rotatedCubePartition
  rw [mul_pow, pow_two (∑ _, _), Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp_rw [← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cube_pair_energy_continuous
statement:
lemma cube_pair_energy_continuous {n : ℕ} (lam : Fin n → ℝ) (x y : Spin n) :
    Continuous (fun U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector x)) +
        diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector y)))/2))
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous (cubeVector x))
  have hy := (diagonalEnergy_continuous lam).comp (orthogonalIsometry_fixed_continuous (cubeVector y))
  exact ((hx.add hy).div_const 2).rexp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.rotatedCubePartition_second_moment
statement:
lemma rotatedCubePartition_second_moment {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (lam : Fin n → ℝ)
    {u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hu : ‖u‖ = Real.sqrt n) (hv : ‖v‖ = Real.sqrt n)
    (horth : inner ℝ u v = 0) :
    (∫ U, rotatedCubePartition lam 1 U ^ 2 ∂orthogonalHaar (Fin n)) =
      (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ n * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1),
      (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) * pairMoment lam u v (-1 + 2 * (k : ℝ) / n)
proof:
:= by
  have hi (x y : Spin n) := orthogonalHaar_integrable (cube_pair_energy_continuous lam x y)
  simp_rw [rotatedCubePartition_square]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun x _ => integrable_finsetSum _ (fun y _ => hi x y))]
  have hinner (x : Spin n) : (∫ U, ∑ y : Spin n,
      Real.exp ((diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector x)) +
        diagonalEnergy lam (orthogonalIsometry U (cubeVector y)))/2) ∂orthogonalHaar (Fin n)) =
      ∑ y : Spin n, pairMoment lam u v (cubeOverlap x y) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun y _ => hi x y)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y _
    exact pair_energy_orbit lam (cubeVector_norm x) (cubeVector_norm y) hu hv horth
      (cubeOverlap_abs_le_one x y) (cubeOverlap_gram hn x y)
  simp_rw [hinner]
  exact cubeOverlap_binomial_sum hn _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_polar
statement:
lemma integral_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (f : E → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      f (p.2.val • p.1.val) ∂μ.toSphere.prod (volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : ({(0)}ᶜ : Set E), f x.val ∂(μ.comap (↑)) := by
      rw [integral_subtype_comap (measurableSet_singleton _).compl f,
        restrict_compl_singleton]
    _ = _ := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply, homeomorphUnitSphereProd_symm_apply_coe] using
        μ.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd.integral_comp
          (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding _) (fun p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ) =>
            f ((homeomorphUnitSphereProd E).symm p).val)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radial_map_preserving
statement:
lemma radial_map_preserving (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] :
    MeasurePreserving (fun p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ) => p.2.val • p.1.val)
      (μ.toSphere.prod (volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : MeasurePreserving (Subtype.val : ({(0)}ᶜ : Set E) → E)
      (μ.comap Subtype.val) μ := by
    simpa only [restrict_compl_singleton] using
      (measurePreserving_subtype_coe (μa := μ) (measurableSet_singleton (0 : E)).compl)
  exact hs.comp (MeasurePreserving.symm (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E).toMeasurableEquiv
    μ.measurePreserving_homeomorphUnitSphereProd)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_polar
statement:
lemma lintegral_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫⁻ p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      f (p.2.val • p.1.val) ∂μ.toSphere.prod (volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))
proof:
:=
  ((radial_map_preserving μ).lintegral_comp hf).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialGaussian_finite
statement: lemma radialGaussian_finite (n : ℕ) : radialGaussian n < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.lintegral_lt_top
  have h := integrableOn_rpow_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0) (Nat.cast_nonneg (n-1)))
  simp only [Real.rpow_natCast, neg_one_mul] at h
  change Integrable _ (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) at h
  exact h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialGaussian_pos
statement: lemma radialGaussian_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < radialGaussian n
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialGaussian, setLIntegral_pos_iff (by fun_prop)]
  have he : Function.support (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (r^(n-1) * Real.exp (-r^2))) ∩
      Ioi 0 = Ioi 0 := by
    apply inter_eq_right.mpr
    intro r hr
    exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.mpr (mul_pos (pow_pos hr _) (Real.exp_pos _))).ne'
  rw [he, Real.volume_Ioi]
  exact ENNReal.zero_lt_top

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_scale_pos
statement:
lemma lintegral_scale_pos {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ x, f x) = ∫⁻ t : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal a * f (a*t)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (fun t : ℝ => a*t) '' Set.univ = Set.univ :=
    Set.image_univ_of_surjective (fun x => ⟨x/a, mul_div_cancel₀ x ha.ne'⟩)
  have h := lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul (s := Set.univ) (f' := fun _ => a) MeasurableSet.univ
    (fun t _ => by convert! ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a).hasDerivWithinAt (s := Set.univ) using 1; simp only [mul_one])
    (mul_right_injective₀ ha.ne').injOn f
  simpa only [hi, setLIntegral_univ, abs_of_pos ha] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_scale_pos_Ioi
statement:
lemma lintegral_scale_pos_Ioi {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ x in Ioi 0, f x) = ∫⁻ t in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal a * f (a*t)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (fun t : ℝ => a*t) '' Ioi 0 = Ioi 0 := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      exact mul_pos ha ht
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x/a, div_pos hx ha, mul_div_cancel₀ x ha.ne'⟩
  have h := lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (f' := fun _ => a) measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun t _ => by convert! ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul a).hasDerivWithinAt (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) using 1; simp only [mul_one])
    (mul_right_injective₀ ha.ne').injOn f
  simpa only [hi, abs_of_pos ha] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialGaussian_scaled
statement:
lemma radialGaussian_scaled (k : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^k * Real.exp (-(c*r)^2))) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (c⁻¹^(k+1)) * radialGaussian (k+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_scale_pos_Ioi (inv_pos.mpr hc)]
  have he (r : ℝ) :
      ENNReal.ofReal c⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal ((c⁻¹*r)^k * Real.exp (-(c*(c⁻¹*r))^2)) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (c⁻¹^(k+1)) * ENNReal.ofReal (r^k * Real.exp (-r^2)) := by
    rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ hc.ne', mul_pow, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le),
      ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le) _)]
    congr 1
    rw [pow_succ]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialGaussian_polar
statement:
lemma radialGaussian_polar (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {g : E → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hg : Measurable g) (hhom : ∀ (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∀ x : E, g (r • x) = g x) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * g x ∂μ) =
      (∫⁻ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, g u.val ∂μ.toSphere) * radialGaussian (Module.finrank ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_polar μ (by fun_prop)]
  have he (p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖p.2.val • p.1.val‖^2)) * g (p.2.val • p.1.val) =
      g p.1.val * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-p.2.val^2)) := by
    rw [hhom _ p.2.property, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg p.2.property.le,
      mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp p.1.property, mul_one, mul_comm]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [lintegral_prod_mul (f := fun u : sphere (0 : E) 1 => g u.val)
    (g := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-r.val^2))) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  congr 1
  rw [volumeIoiPow, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul
    (f := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal (r.val^(Module.finrank ℝ E-1)))
    (g := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-r.val^2))) _ (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal (r.val^(Module.finrank ℝ E-1) * Real.exp (-r.val^2))
        ∂volume.comap Subtype.val := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro r
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg r.property.le _)).symm
    _ = _ := lintegral_subtype_comap (μ := volume) (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) measurableSet_Ioi
      (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (r^(Module.finrank ℝ E-1) * Real.exp (-r^2)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.volumeIoiPow_lintegral
statement:
lemma volumeIoiPow_lintegral (k : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), f r.val ∂volumeIoiPow k) =
      ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^k) * f r
proof:
:= by
  rw [volumeIoiPow, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _
    (f := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => ENNReal.ofReal (r.val^k))
    (g := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => f r.val) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  exact lintegral_subtype_comap (μ := volume) (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)) measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun r : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (r^k) * f r)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.lintegral_radial_norm
statement:
lemma lintegral_radial_norm (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞}
    (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x, f ‖x‖ ∂μ) = μ.toSphere Set.univ *
      ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(Module.finrank ℝ E-1)) * f r
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_polar μ (f := fun x => f ‖x‖) (by fun_prop)]
  have he (p : sphere (0 : E) 1 × Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
      f ‖p.2.val • p.1.val‖ = (1 : ℝ≥0∞) * f p.2.val := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg p.2.property.le,
      mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp p.1.property, mul_one, one_mul]
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [lintegral_prod_mul (f := fun _ : sphere (0 : E) 1 => (1 : ℝ≥0∞))
    (g := fun r : Ioi (0 : ℝ) => f r.val) (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop),
    lintegral_const, one_mul, volumeIoiPow_lintegral _ hf]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_den_pos
statement: lemma sphereRatio_den_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < 1+t^2
proof: := by positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_sq
statement: lemma sphereRatio_sq (t : ℝ) : sphereRatio t ^ 2 = t^2/(1+t^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereRatio, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (sphereRatio_den_pos t).le]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.one_sub_sphereRatio_sq
statement: lemma one_sub_sphereRatio_sq (t : ℝ) : 1-sphereRatio t ^ 2 = 1/(1+t^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereRatio_sq]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_mem
statement: lemma sphereRatio_mem (t : ℝ) : sphereRatio t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < 1-sphereRatio t^2 := by rw [one_sub_sphereRatio_sq]; positivity
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sphereRatio t + 1), sq_nonneg (sphereRatio t - 1)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_den_pos
statement:
lemma sphereRatioInv_den_pos {q : ℝ} (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    0 < 1-q^2
proof: := by nlinarith [hq.1, hq.2]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.one_add_sphereRatioInv_sq
statement:
lemma one_add_sphereRatioInv_sq {q : ℝ} (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    1+sphereRatioInv q ^ 2 = 1/(1-q^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereRatioInv, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq).le]
  field_simp [(sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq).ne']
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_left_inverse
statement: lemma sphereRatio_left_inverse (t : ℝ) : sphereRatioInv (sphereRatio t) = t
proof:
:= by
  unfold sphereRatioInv
  rw [one_sub_sphereRatio_sq, Real.sqrt_div (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_one]
  unfold sphereRatio
  simpa only [div_one] using
    div_div_div_cancel_right₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (sphereRatio_den_pos t)) t 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_right_inverse
statement:
lemma sphereRatio_right_inverse {q : ℝ} (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    sphereRatio (sphereRatioInv q) = q
proof:
:= by
  unfold sphereRatio
  rw [one_add_sphereRatioInv_sq hq, Real.sqrt_div (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_one]
  unfold sphereRatioInv
  simpa only [div_one] using
    div_div_div_cancel_right₀ (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq)) q 1

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_injective
statement: lemma sphereRatio_injective : Function.Injective sphereRatio
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective sphereRatio_left_inverse

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_injOn
statement: lemma sphereRatioInv_injOn : Set.InjOn sphereRatioInv (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq r hr he
  have := congrArg sphereRatio he
  simpa only [sphereRatio_right_inverse hq, sphereRatio_right_inverse hr] using this

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_image
statement: lemma sphereRatioInv_image : sphereRatioInv '' Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1 = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
  intro t
  exact ⟨sphereRatio t, sphereRatio_mem t, sphereRatio_left_inverse t⟩

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_hasDerivAt
statement:
lemma sphereRatioInv_hasDerivAt {q : ℝ} (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivAt sphereRatioInv (1/(Real.sqrt (1-q^2))^3) q
proof:
:= by
  have hder := (hasDerivAt_id q).div
    (((hasDerivAt_const q 1).sub ((hasDerivAt_id q).pow 2)).sqrt
      (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq).ne')
    (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq))
  convert! hder using 1
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq).le
  have hn := (Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq))
  dsimp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq]
  norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.reduceSub, pow_one, one_mul, mul_one, zero_sub]
  field_simp [hn]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_continuousOn
statement: lemma sphereRatioInv_continuousOn : ContinuousOn sphereRatioInv (Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hq => (sphereRatioInv_hasDerivAt hq).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatioInv_jacobian_shape
statement:
lemma sphereRatioInv_jacobian_shape {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {q : ℝ}
    (hq : q ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) :
    |1/(Real.sqrt (1-q^2))^3| * (Real.sqrt (1+sphereRatioInv q^2))⁻¹ ^ n =
      sphereOverlapShape n q
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (1-q^2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (sphereRatioInv_den_pos hq)
  rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity), one_add_sphereRatioInv_sq hq,
    Real.sqrt_div (by norm_num), Real.sqrt_one]
  simp only [one_div, inv_inv]
  rw [mul_comm, ← div_eq_mul_inv]
  exact (pow_sub₀ _ hs.ne' hn).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereRatio_integral
statement:
lemma sphereRatio_integral {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∫⁻ t : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹ ^ n) * f (sphereRatio t)) =
      ∫⁻ q in Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (sphereOverlapShape n q) * f q
proof:
:= by
  have h := lintegral_image_eq_lintegral_abs_deriv_mul measurableSet_Ioo
    (fun q hq => (sphereRatioInv_hasDerivAt hq).hasDerivWithinAt) sphereRatioInv_injOn
    (fun t => ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹ ^ n) * f (sphereRatio t))
  rw [sphereRatioInv_image, setLIntegral_univ] at h
  rw [h]
  apply setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo
  intro q hq
  dsimp only
  rw [sphereRatio_right_inverse hq, ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (abs_nonneg _),
    sphereRatioInv_jacobian_shape hn hq]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinderKernel_measurable
statement:
lemma cylinderKernel_measurable {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    Measurable (Function.uncurry (cylinderKernel f))
proof:
:= by
  unfold cylinderKernel Function.uncurry
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaled_ratio
statement:
lemma scaled_ratio {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (t : ℝ) :
    r*t / Real.sqrt ((r*t)^2+r^2) = sphereRatio t
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (r*t)^2+r^2 = r^2*(1+t^2) by ring,
    Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg r), Real.sqrt_sq hr.le]
  exact mul_div_mul_left t _ hr.ne'

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinderKernel_scaled
statement:
lemma cylinderKernel_scaled {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (t : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) :
    cylinderKernel f (r*t) r =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cylinderKernel
  rw [scaled_ratio hr]
  congr 3
  simp only [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (sphereRatio_den_pos t).le]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinder_scalar_scale
statement:
lemma cylinder_scalar_scale {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫⁻ s : ℝ, cylinderKernel f s r) =
      ENNReal.ofReal r * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_scale_pos hr]
  simp_rw [cylinderKernel_scaled hr]
  exact lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top

name: OAI.CriticalSK.cylinder_radius_integral
statement:
lemma cylinder_radius_integral (k : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^k) * ∫⁻ s : ℝ, cylinderKernel f s r) =
      radialGaussian (k+2) * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹^(k+2)) * f (sphereRatio t)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ∫⁻ t : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(k+1)) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)) := by
      apply setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro r hr
      dsimp only
      rw [cylinder_scalar_scale hr, ← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hr.le _),
        ← pow_succ, ← lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
    _ = ∫⁻ t : ℝ, ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(k+1)) *
        (ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2)) * f (sphereRatio t)) := by
      apply lintegral_lintegral_swap
      unfold sphereRatio
      fun_prop
    _ = ∫⁻ t : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹^(k+2)) *
        radialGaussian (k+2) * f (sphereRatio t) := by
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro t
      calc
        _ = (∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(k+1) * Real.exp (-(Real.sqrt (1+t^2)*r)^2))) *
            f (sphereRatio t) := by
          rw [← lintegral_mul_const _ (by fun_prop)]
          apply setLIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
          intro r hr
          dsimp only
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hr.le _), mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [radialGaussian_scaled _ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (sphereRatio_den_pos t))]
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm _ (radialGaussian (k+2))]
      exact lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (radialGaussian_finite _).ne

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_preserving
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_preserving (n : ℕ) :
    MeasurePreserving (euclidSplit n) volume (volume.prod volume)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n+1) => (volume : Measure ℝ)) 0).comp
    (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp (Fin (n+1)))
  have ht := (MeasurePreserving.id (volume : Measure ℝ)).prod
    (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin n))
  exact ht.comp hs

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_norm_sq
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_norm_sq (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1))) :
    ‖x‖^2 = (euclidSplit n x).1^2 + ‖(euclidSplit n x).2‖^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_succ, EuclideanSpace.norm_sq_eq]
  simp only [euclidSplit, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_norm
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_norm (n : ℕ) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1))) :
    ‖x‖ = Real.sqrt ((euclidSplit n x).1^2 + ‖(euclidSplit n x).2‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← euclidSplit_norm_sq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclidSplit_integral
statement:
lemma euclidSplit_integral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    ∫⁻ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2))) *
        f (p.1 / Real.sqrt (p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2)) ∂volume.prod volume
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) =>
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-(p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2))) *
        f (p.1 / Real.sqrt (p.1^2 + ‖p.2‖^2))) := by fun_prop
  rw [← (euclidSplit_preserving n).lintegral_comp hm]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro x
  rw [← euclidSplit_norm_sq, Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_cylinder_volume
statement:
lemma gaussian_cylinder_volume (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
      radialGaussian (n+3) * ∫⁻ t : ℝ,
        ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (1+t^2))⁻¹^(n+3)) * f (sphereRatio t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [euclidSplit_integral (n+2) hf]
  change (∫⁻ p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)), cylinderKernel f p.1 ‖p.2‖
    ∂volume.prod volume) = _
  rw [lintegral_prod _ (by unfold cylinderKernel; fun_prop)]
  have ht (s : ℝ) : (∫⁻ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)), cylinderKernel f s ‖y‖) =
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
        ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(n+1)) * cylinderKernel f s r := by
    simpa only [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin, show n+2-1=n+1 by omega] using
      (lintegral_radial_norm (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2))))
        (f := fun r => cylinderKernel f s r) (by unfold cylinderKernel; fun_prop))
  simp_rw [ht]
  rw [lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (measure_ne_top _ _)]
  calc
    _ = (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
        ∫⁻ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, ENNReal.ofReal (r^(n+1)) * ∫⁻ s : ℝ, cylinderKernel f s r := by
      congr 1
      rw [lintegral_lintegral_swap (by unfold cylinderKernel Function.uncurry; fun_prop)]
      apply lintegral_congr
      intro r
      exact lintegral_const_mul' _ _ ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    _ = _ := by rw [cylinder_radius_integral _ hf, ← mul_assoc]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_coordinate_polar
statement:
lemma gaussian_coordinate_polar (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)),
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-‖x‖^2)) * f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) =
    (∫⁻ u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1,
      f (u.val 0) ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)))).toSphere) *
        radialGaussian (n+3)
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)) => f (x 0 / ‖x‖)) := by fun_prop
  have hhom (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) :
      f ((r • x) 0 / ‖r • x‖) = f (x 0 / ‖x‖) := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hr.le]
    change f (r * x 0 / (r * ‖x‖)) = _
    rw [mul_div_mul_left _ _ hr.ne']
  have h := radialGaussian_polar volume hm hhom
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace, Fintype.card_fin,
    mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp (Subtype.property _), div_one] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphere_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1,
      f (u.val 0) ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)))).toSphere) =
    (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ *
      ∫⁻ q in Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (sphereOverlapShape (n+3) q) * f q
proof:
:= by
  apply (ENNReal.mul_left_inj (radialGaussian_pos (n+3)).ne' (radialGaussian_finite (n+3)).ne).mp
  rw [← gaussian_coordinate_polar n hf, gaussian_cylinder_volume n hf,
    sphereRatio_integral (by omega : 3 ≤ n+3)]
  ac_rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.overlapShapeMeasure_lintegral
statement:
lemma overlapShapeMeasure_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ q, f q ∂overlapShapeMeasure n) =
      ∫⁻ q in Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (sphereOverlapShape n q) * f q
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapShapeMeasure, lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul _ (by unfold sphereOverlapShape; fun_prop) hf]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.overlapShapeMeasure_univ
statement:
lemma overlapShapeMeasure_univ (n : ℕ) :
    overlapShapeMeasure n Set.univ = ∫⁻ q in Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ENNReal.ofReal (sphereOverlapShape n q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lintegral_one, overlapShapeMeasure_lintegral n measurable_const]
  simp only [mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereUniform_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphereUniform_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ u : unitSphere (Fin (n+3)), f (u.val 0) ∂sphereUniform) =
      ∫⁻ q, f q ∂normalizedOverlapShape (n+3)
proof:
:= by
  let A := (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)))).toSphere Set.univ
  have hA0 : A ≠ 0 := (measure_univ_pos.mpr (Measure.toSphere_ne_zero _)).ne'
  have hAt : A ≠ ⊤ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have hfull : (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)))).toSphere Set.univ =
      A * overlapShapeMeasure (n+3) Set.univ := by
    have h := sphere_coordinate_lintegral n (f := fun _ => 1) measurable_const
    simpa only [lintegral_one, mul_one, overlapShapeMeasure_univ, A] using h
  rw [sphereUniform, lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, sphere_coordinate_lintegral n hf,
    hfull, ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inl hA0) (Or.inl hAt), normalizedOverlapShape,
    lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, overlapShapeMeasure_lintegral _ hf]
  change (A⁻¹ * (overlapShapeMeasure (n+3) Set.univ)⁻¹) * (A * _) = _
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm _ A, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel_left hA0 hAt]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphere_inner_coordinate_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphere_inner_coordinate_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f)
    (u : unitSphere (Fin (n+1))) :
    (∫⁻ v : unitSphere (Fin (n+1)), f (inner ℝ u.val v.val) ∂sphereUniform) =
      ∫⁻ v : unitSphere (Fin (n+1)), f (v.val 0) ∂sphereUniform
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := orthogonalSphere_transitive (firstUnit n) u
  have hm : Measurable (fun v : unitSphere (Fin (n+1)) => f (inner ℝ u.val v.val)) := by fun_prop
  rw [← (sphereUniform_rotation_preserving U).lintegral_comp hm]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro v
  congr 1
  rw [← hU]
  change inner ℝ (orthogonalIsometry U (firstUnit n).val) (orthogonalIsometry U v.val) = _
  rw [(orthogonalIsometry U).inner_map_map]
  simp only [firstUnit, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, map_one, one_mul]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereOverlapLaw_lintegral
statement:
lemma sphereOverlapLaw_lintegral (n : ℕ) {f : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : Measurable f) :
    (∫⁻ q, f q ∂sphereOverlapLaw (Fin (n+3))) =
      ∫⁻ q, f q ∂normalizedOverlapShape (n+3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereOverlapLaw, lintegral_map hf (by fun_prop),
    lintegral_prod _ (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [sphere_inner_coordinate_lintegral (n+2) hf]
  rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one, sphereUniform_coordinate_lintegral n hf]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereOverlapLaw_density
statement:
lemma sphereOverlapLaw_density (n : ℕ) :
    sphereOverlapLaw (Fin (n+3)) = normalizedOverlapShape (n+3)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext_of_lintegral
  exact fun _ hf => sphereOverlapLaw_lintegral n hf

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPDF_nonneg
statement: lemma gaussianPiPDF_nonneg (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ gaussianPiPDF v x
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg _ _ _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPDF_integrable
statement: lemma gaussianPiPDF_integrable (v : ι → ℝ≥0) : Integrable (gaussianPiPDF v)
proof:
:=
  Integrable.fintype_prod (fun i => integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 (v i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPi_density
statement:
lemma gaussianPi_density (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) :
    Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)) =
      volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPiPDF v x))
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.pi_eq
  intro s hs
  rw [withDensity_apply _ (MeasurableSet.univ_pi hs),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (gaussianPiPDF_integrable v).integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (gaussianPiPDF_nonneg v))]
  change ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, gaussianPiPDF v x
      ∂(Measure.pi (fun _ : ι => (volume : Measure ℝ))).restrict (Set.univ.pi s)) = _
  rw [Measure.restrict_pi_pi]
  simp only [gaussianPiPDF]
  rw [integral_fintype_prod_eq_prod]
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_prod_of_nonneg]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero _ (hv i), withDensity_apply _ (hs i)]
    exact ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal
      (integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 (v i)).integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 (v i)))
  · intro i _
    exact integral_nonneg (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 (v i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPDF_continuous
statement: lemma gaussianPiPDF_continuous (v : ι → ℝ≥0) : Continuous (gaussianPiPDF v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianPiPDF gaussianPDFReal
  fun_prop

name: OAI.CriticalSK.map_density_of_preserving
statement:
lemma map_density_of_preserving {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} {T : X → Y} (hT : MeasurePreserving T μ ν)
    (w : Y → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w) :
    (μ.withDensity (fun x => w (T x))).map T = ν.withDensity w
proof:
:= by
  ext A hA
  rw [Measure.map_apply hT.measurable hA, withDensity_apply _ (hT.measurable hA),
    withDensity_apply _ hA]
  exact hT.setLIntegral_comp_preimage hA hw

name: OAI.CriticalSK.density_toLp
statement:
lemma density_toLp (w : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ≥0∞) (hw : Measurable w) :
    ((volume : Measure (ι → ℝ)).withDensity w).map (WithLp.toLp 2 : (ι → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) = volume.withDensity
      (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => w (WithLp.ofLp x))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => w (WithLp.ofLp x)) :=
    hw.comp (WithLp.measurable_ofLp 2 _)
  simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_toLp] using
    map_density_of_preserving (PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp ι)
      (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => w (WithLp.ofLp x)) hm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_density
statement:
lemma diagonalGaussian_density (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) :
    diagonalGaussian v = volume.withDensity
      (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPiPDF v (WithLp.ofLp x)))
proof:
:= by
  change (Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))).map (WithLp.toLp 2 : (ι → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) = _
  rw [gaussianPi_density v hv]
  exact density_toLp _ (gaussianPiPDF_continuous v).measurable.ennreal_ofReal

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous
statement:
lemma euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    Continuous (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x)
proof:
:=
  (gaussianPiPDF_continuous v).comp (PiLp.continuous_ofLp 2 _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.euclideanGaussianPDF_integrable
statement:
lemma euclideanGaussianPDF_integrable (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    Integrable (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x)
proof:
:= by
  exact (PiLp.volume_preserving_ofLp ι).integrable_comp
    (gaussianPiPDF_integrable v).aestronglyMeasurable |>.mpr (gaussianPiPDF_integrable v)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_polar_iterated
statement:
lemma integral_polar_iterated (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r : Ioi (0 : ℝ), ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1,
      f (r.val • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere ∂volumeIoiPow (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_polar μ f]
  exact integral_prod_symm _
    ((radial_map_preserving μ).integrable_comp hf.aestronglyMeasurable |>.mpr hf)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.angular_integral_continuous
statement:
lemma angular_integral_continuous (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]
    [ProperSpace E] {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    Continuous (fun r : ℝ => ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere.restrict A)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun r : ℝ => fun u : sphere (0 : E) 1 =>
      f (r • u.val))) := hf.comp (continuous_fst.smul (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd))
  simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using
    (continuous_parametric_integral_of_continuous (μ := μ.toSphere.restrict A) h
      (isCompact_univ : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1))))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.integral_polar_real
statement:
lemma integral_polar_real (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) *
      ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_polar_iterated μ hf, Measure.volumeIoiPow,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by fun_prop)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  rw [integral_subtype_comap measurableSet_Ioi
    (fun r : ℝ => (ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1))).toReal •
      ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere)]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
  intro r hr
  dsimp only
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (pow_nonneg hr.le _)]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_measurable
statement: lemma normShell_measurable (a b : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (normShell (E := E) a b)
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_norm).inter
    (measurableSet_le measurable_norm measurable_const)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_radial
statement:
lemma normShell_radial (a b : ℝ) (r : Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (u : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    r.val • u.val ∈ normShell a b ↔ r.val ∈ Ioc a b
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ‖u.val‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.property
  simp only [normShell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos r.property.out,
    hu, mul_one, Set.mem_Ioc]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_integral
statement:
lemma normShell_integral (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (∫ x in normShell a b, f x ∂μ) = ∫ r in Ioc a b,
      r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) * ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_indicator (normShell_measurable a b),
    integral_polar_real μ (hf.indicator (normShell_measurable a b))]
  calc
    _ = ∫ r in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (Ioc a b).indicator
        (fun r => r ^ (Module.finrank ℝ E - 1) *
          ∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere) r := by
      apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
      intro r hr
      have hh (u : sphere (0 : E) 1) := normShell_radial a b ⟨r, hr⟩ u
      by_cases hab : r ∈ Ioc a b
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hab]
        congr 1
        apply integral_congr_ae
        exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => Set.indicator_of_mem ((hh u).mpr hab) f)
      · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hab]
        have hz : (∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1,
            (normShell a b).indicator f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere) = 0 := by
          apply integral_eq_zero_of_ae
          exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => Set.indicator_of_notMem
            (fun h => hab ((hh u).mp h)) f)
        rw [hz, mul_zero]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [setIntegral_indicator measurableSet_Ioc]
      have hsub : Ioc a b ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) := fun _ h => lt_of_le_of_lt ha h.1
      rw [Set.inter_eq_right.mpr hsub]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_continuous
statement:
lemma radialDensity_continuous (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) : Continuous (radialDensity μ f)
proof:
:= by
  have h := angular_integral_continuous μ hf Set.univ
  simp only [Measure.restrict_univ] at h
  exact (continuous_id.pow _).mul h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density
statement:
lemma normShell_density (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell a b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∫ r in Ioc a b, radialDensity μ f r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [withDensity_apply _ (normShell_measurable a b),
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hf.integrableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfn),
    normShell_integral μ hf ha]
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density_real
statement:
lemma normShell_density_real (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] {f : E → ℝ}
    (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell a b)).toReal =
      ∫ r in Ioc a b, radialDensity μ f r
proof:
:= by
  rw [normShell_density μ hf hfn ha, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal]
  apply setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioc
  intro r hr
  exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (le_trans ha hr.1.le) _) (integral_nonneg (fun u => hfn _))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_density_limit
statement:
lemma normShell_density_limit (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfc : Continuous f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ =>
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (normShell r (r+δ))).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (radialDensity μ f r))
proof:
:= by
  have hq := radialDensity_continuous μ hfc
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => ∫ t in r..b, radialDensity μ f t)
      (radialDensity μ f r) r :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (IntervalIntegrable.refl)
      hq.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hq.continuousAt
  apply hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  rw [normShell_density_real μ hf hfn hr.le,
    intervalIntegral.integral_same, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul,
    intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by linarith [hδ.out] : r ≤ r+δ)]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareNormShell_measurable
statement: lemma squareNormShell_measurable (s δ : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (squareNormShell (E := E) s δ)
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_lt measurable_const (measurable_norm.pow_const 2)).inter
    (measurableSet_le (measurable_norm.pow_const 2) measurable_const)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareNormShell_eq
statement:
lemma squareNormShell_eq {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    squareNormShell (E := E) s δ = normShell (Real.sqrt s) (Real.sqrt (s+δ))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h1 := Real.sq_sqrt hs
  have h2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ s+δ)
  have h3 := Real.sqrt_nonneg s
  have h4 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (s+δ)
  have h5 := norm_nonneg x
  change (s < ‖x‖^2 ∧ ‖x‖^2 ≤ s+δ) ↔ (Real.sqrt s < ‖x‖ ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (s+δ))
  constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> nlinarith [h.1, h.2]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareNormShell_density_limit
statement:
lemma squareNormShell_density_limit (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfc : Continuous f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ =>
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (squareNormShell s δ)).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (radialDensity μ f (Real.sqrt s) / (2 * Real.sqrt s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hq := radialDensity_continuous μ hfc
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ r in Real.sqrt s..t, radialDensity μ f r)
      (radialDensity μ f (Real.sqrt s)) (Real.sqrt s) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right IntervalIntegrable.refl
      hq.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hq.continuousAt
  have hd' := hd.comp s (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt hs.ne')
  have hh := hd'.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one_div] at hh
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.out
  rw [squareNormShell_eq hs.le hδ0.le,
    normShell_density_real μ hf hfn (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), intervalIntegral.integral_same,
    sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith))]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.splitPair_preserving
statement:
lemma splitPair_preserving (n : ℕ) (μ : Fin (n+2) → Measure ℝ) [∀ i, SigmaFinite (μ i)] :
    MeasurePreserving (splitPair n) (Measure.pi μ)
      (((μ 0).prod (μ 1)).prod (Measure.pi (fun i => μ i.succ.succ)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove μ 0
  have h2 := (MeasurePreserving.id (μ 0)).prod
    (measurePreserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun i : Fin (n+1) => μ i.succ) 0)
  have h3 := (measurePreserving_prodAssoc (μ 0) (μ 1)
    (Measure.pi fun i : Fin n => μ i.succ.succ)).symm
  exact h3.comp (h2.comp h1)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.splitPair_square_sum
statement:
lemma splitPair_square_sum (n : ℕ) (x : Fin (n+2) → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, x i^2) = x 0^2 + x 1^2 + ∑ i : Fin n, x i.succ.succ^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareDisk_measurable
statement: lemma squareDisk_measurable (s : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (squareDisk s)
proof:
:= by
  exact measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareAnnulus_measurable
statement: lemma squareAnnulus_measurable (s δ : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (squareAnnulus s δ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (measurableSet_lt measurable_const
    (show Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) by fun_prop)).inter
    (measurableSet_le (show Measurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) by fun_prop) measurable_const)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareDisk_complex
statement:
lemma squareDisk_complex {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd ⁻¹' squareDisk s =
      Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) (Real.sqrt s)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, squareDisk, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    Complex.measurableEquivRealProd_apply, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  rw [show z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2 = ‖z‖ ^ 2 by rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]; ring]
  exact (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) hs).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.volume_squareDisk
statement:
lemma volume_squareDisk {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    volume (squareDisk s) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Complex.volume_preserving_equiv_real_prod.measure_preimage
    (squareDisk_measurable s).nullMeasurableSet, squareDisk_complex hs, Complex.volume_closedBall,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_pow (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), Real.sq_sqrt hs]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, NNReal.coe_real_pi, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hs, mul_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareAnnulus_sdiff
statement:
lemma squareAnnulus_sdiff (s δ : ℝ) :
    squareAnnulus s δ = squareDisk (s+δ) \ squareDisk s
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp [squareAnnulus, squareDisk, and_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.volume_squareAnnulus
statement:
lemma volume_squareAnnulus {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    volume (squareAnnulus s δ) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [squareAnnulus_sdiff, measure_sdiff (by
    intro p hp
    change p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ s at hp
    change p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 ≤ s+δ
    linarith) (squareDisk_measurable s).nullMeasurableSet (by
      rw [volume_squareDisk hs]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)]
  rw [volume_squareDisk (by linarith), volume_squareDisk hs,
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_sub _ (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg
statement: lemma gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg (a b : ℝ≥0) : 0 ≤ gaussianPairPrefactor a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianPairPrefactor
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_density
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_density (a b : ℝ≥0) (x y : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 a x * gaussianPDFReal 0 b y =
      gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*a) + y^2/(2*b)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianPDFReal, sub_zero, gaussianPairPrefactor, mul_inv, neg_div]
  rw [show (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*a))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*a))) *
      ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*b))⁻¹ * Real.exp (-(y^2/(2*b)))) =
      ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*a))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*b))⁻¹) *
      (Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*a))) * Real.exp (-(y^2/(2*b)))) by ring,
    ← Real.exp_add, ← neg_add]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_density_upper
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_density_upper (a b : ℝ≥0) (x y : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 a x * gaussianPDFReal 0 b y ≤ gaussianPairPrefactor a b
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPair_density]
  have h : Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*a) + y^2/(2*b))) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity))
  simpa only [mul_one] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg a b)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_density_lower
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_density_lower {a b : ℝ≥0} {m R x y : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hma : m ≤ a) (hmb : m ≤ b) (hR : x^2+y^2 ≤ R) :
    gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-R/(2*m)) ≤
      gaussianPDFReal 0 a x * gaussianPDFReal 0 b y
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPair_density]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg a b)
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  have hxa : x^2/(2*a) ≤ x^2/(2*m) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg x) (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hyb : y^2/(2*b) ≤ y^2/(2*m) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg y) (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have hsum : x^2/(2*a) + y^2/(2*b) ≤ R/(2*m) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ x^2/(2*m) + y^2/(2*m) := add_le_add hxa hyb
      _ = (x^2+y^2)/(2*m) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hR (by positivity)
  rw [neg_div]
  exact neg_le_neg hsum

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_apply
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_apply {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (s : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)) s =
      ∫⁻ p in s, ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPDFReal 0 a p.1 * gaussianPDFReal 0 b p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero _ ha, gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero _ hb,
    prod_withDensity (measurable_gaussianPDF _ _) (measurable_gaussianPDF _ _),
    withDensity_apply' _ s]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro p
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (gaussianPDFReal_nonneg _ _ _)).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_annulus_upper
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_annulus_upper {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    {s δ : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)) (squareAnnulus s δ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPair_apply ha hb]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _p in squareAnnulus s δ, ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPairPrefactor a b) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro p
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (gaussianPair_density_upper a b p.1 p.2)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, volume_squareAnnulus hs hδ,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg _ _), mul_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_annulus_lower
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_annulus_lower {a b : ℝ≥0} {m s δ : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hma : m ≤ a) (hmb : m ≤ b) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-(s+δ)/(2*m))) ≤
      ((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)) (squareAnnulus s δ)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp only [h, NNReal.coe_zero] at hma; linarith
  have hb : b ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp only [h, NNReal.coe_zero] at hmb; linarith
  rw [gaussianPair_apply ha hb]
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ _p in squareAnnulus s δ,
        ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-(s+δ)/(2*m))) := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, volume_squareAnnulus hs hδ,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (mul_nonneg (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg _ _)
          (Real.exp_pos _).le)]
      congr 1
      ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      apply (ae_restrict_iff' (squareAnnulus_measurable s δ)).mpr
      exact ae_of_all _ (fun p hp => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        (gaussianPair_density_lower hm hma hmb hp.2))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.volume_squareAnnulus_le
statement:
lemma volume_squareAnnulus_le {s δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    volume (squareAnnulus s δ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : 0 ≤ s
  · exact le_of_eq (volume_squareAnnulus hs hδ)
  · have hsn : s < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hs
    by_cases ht : 0 ≤ s+δ
    · have hsub : squareAnnulus s δ ⊆ squareDisk (s+δ) := fun _ h => h.2
      calc
        _ ≤ volume (squareDisk (s+δ)) := measure_mono hsub
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi*(s+δ)) := volume_squareDisk ht
        _ ≤ _ := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) Real.pi_pos.le)
    · have hset : squareAnnulus s δ = ∅ := by
        apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro p hp
        have hh := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg p.1) (sq_nonneg p.2)
        exact ht (le_trans hh hp.2)
      rw [hset, measure_empty]
      exact bot_le

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_annulus_upper_all
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_annulus_upper_all {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)) (squareAnnulus s δ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPair_apply ha hb]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _p in squareAnnulus s δ, ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPairPrefactor a b) := by
      exact lintegral_mono (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (gaussianPair_density_upper a b p.1 p.2))
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (gaussianPairPrefactor a b) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ) := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (volume_squareAnnulus_le hδ) bot_le
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg _ _), mul_comm]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sumSquareShell_measurable
statement:
lemma sumSquareShell_measurable {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable Z) (s δ : ℝ) :
    MeasurableSet (sumSquareShell Z s δ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Measurable (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × Ω => p.1.1^2 + p.1.2^2 + Z p.2) := by fun_prop
  exact (measurableSet_lt measurable_const h).inter (measurableSet_le h measurable_const)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sumSquareShell_apply
statement:
lemma sumSquareShell_apply (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) (ν : Measure Ω) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable Z) (s δ : ℝ) :
    (μ.prod ν) (sumSquareShell Z s δ) = ∫⁻ ω, μ (squareAnnulus (s-Z ω) δ) ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm (sumSquareShell_measurable hZ s δ)]
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro ω
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, sumSquareShell, squareAnnulus, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_bulk_upper
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_bulk_upper {ν : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable Z) {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)).prod ν) (sumSquareShell Z s δ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumSquareShell_apply _ _ hZ]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _ : Ω, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b) ∂ν :=
      lintegral_mono (fun ω => gaussianPair_annulus_upper_all ha hb (s-Z ω) hδ)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_bulk_lower
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_bulk_lower {ν : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable Z) {a b : ℝ≥0} {m s R δ : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hma : m ≤ a) (hmb : m ≤ b) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-(R+δ)/(2*m))) *
      ν {ω | s-R ≤ Z ω ∧ Z ω ≤ s} ≤
      (((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)).prod ν) (sumSquareShell Z s δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sumSquareShell_apply _ _ hZ]
  let A := {ω | s-R ≤ Z ω ∧ Z ω ≤ s}
  have hA : MeasurableSet A :=
    (measurableSet_le measurable_const hZ).inter (measurableSet_le hZ measurable_const)
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ _ω in A, ENNReal.ofReal
        (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b * Real.exp (-(R+δ)/(2*m))) ∂ν := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ ω in A, ((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b))
        (squareAnnulus (s-Z ω) δ) ∂ν := by
      apply lintegral_mono_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hA] with ω hω
      apply le_trans _ (gaussianPair_annulus_lower hm hma hmb (sub_nonneg.mpr hω.2) hδ)
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hδ) (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg _ _))
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity : 0 < 2*m)).mpr
      linarith [hω.1]
    _ ≤ _ := setLIntegral_le_lintegral _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.fourth_power_le_exp
statement: lemma fourth_power_le_exp (x : ℝ) : x ^ 4 ≤ 32 * Real.exp (x^2/4)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (x^2/4) (by positivity) 2
  norm_num at h
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_fourth_integrable
statement: lemma gaussian_fourth_integrable : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x^4) (gaussianReal 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply ((gaussian_square_integrable (1/4) (by norm_num)).const_mul 32).mono' (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ x^4)]
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using fourth_power_le_exp x

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_fourth_bound
statement: lemma gaussian_fourth_bound : (∫ x : ℝ, x ^ 4 ∂gaussianReal 0 1) ≤ 64
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, 32 * Real.exp ((1/4) * x^2) ∂gaussianReal 0 1 :=
      integral_mono gaussian_fourth_integrable
        ((gaussian_square_integrable (1/4) (by norm_num)).const_mul 32)
        (fun x => by simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_comm] using fourth_power_le_exp x)
    _ = 32 * (Real.sqrt (1/2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, gaussian_square_integral _ (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ 64 := by
      have hs : (1/2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (1/2) := by
        apply Real.le_sqrt (by norm_num) (by norm_num) |>.mpr
        norm_num
      have hh : (Real.sqrt (1/2))⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
        calc
          _ ≤ (1/2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := (inv_le_inv₀ (by positivity) (by norm_num)).mpr hs
          _ = 2 := by norm_num
      linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_as_scaled
statement:
lemma gaussian_as_scaled (v : ℝ≥0) : gaussianReal 0 v =
    (gaussianReal 0 1).map (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt v * x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianReal_map_const_mul]
  congr 1
  · simp
  · apply NNReal.coe_injective
    simp [Real.sq_sqrt v.coe_nonneg]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_fourth_integrable_var
statement:
lemma gaussian_fourth_integrable_var (v : ℝ≥0) :
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x^4) (gaussianReal 0 v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussian_as_scaled]
  apply (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)).mpr
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_pow] using gaussian_fourth_integrable.const_mul ((Real.sqrt v)^4)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_fourth_bound_var
statement:
lemma gaussian_fourth_bound_var (v : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, x^4 ∂gaussianReal 0 v) ≤ 64 * (v:ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussian_as_scaled, integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [mul_pow]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (v:ℝ))^4 = (v:ℝ)^2 := by
    rw [show (4:ℕ)=2*2 by rfl, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt v.coe_nonneg]
  rw [hs]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left gaussian_fourth_bound (sq_nonneg (v:ℝ))).trans_eq (mul_comm _ _)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_memLp
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_memLp (v : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (fun x : ℝ => x^2) 2 (gaussianReal 0 v)
proof:
:= by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (by fun_prop)).mpr
  simpa only [← pow_mul] using gaussian_fourth_integrable_var v

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_mean
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_mean (v : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ x : ℝ, x^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 v) = v
proof:
:= by
  have h := variance_eq_sub (μ := gaussianReal 0 v) (X := id) (memLp_id_gaussianReal 2)
  simpa only [variance_id_gaussianReal, id_eq, Pi.pow_apply, integral_id_gaussianReal,
    zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), sub_zero] using h.symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_variance
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_variance (v : ℝ≥0) :
    Var[(fun x : ℝ => x^2); gaussianReal 0 v] ≤ 64 * (v:ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  rw [variance_eq_sub (gaussian_square_memLp v), gaussian_square_mean]
  have h : (∫ x : ℝ, (x^2)^2 ∂gaussianReal 0 v) ≤ 64 * (v:ℝ)^2 := by
    simpa only [← pow_mul] using gaussian_fourth_bound_var v
  simpa only [Pi.pow_apply] using (sub_le_self _ (sq_nonneg (v:ℝ))).trans h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_memLp
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_memLp (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (piSquareSum (ι := ι)) 2 (Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)))
proof:
:= by
  exact memLp_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (gaussian_square_memLp (v i)).comp_measurePreserving
    (measurePreserving_eval _ i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_mean
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_mean (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ x, piSquareSum x ∂Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))) = ∑ i, (v i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold piSquareSum
  rw [integral_finsetSum Finset.univ (f := fun (i : ι) (x : ι → ℝ) => x i ^ 2)
    (fun i _ => integrable_comp_eval (μ := fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)) (i := i)
      ((gaussian_square_memLp (v i)).integrable (by norm_num)))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [integral_comp_eval (μ := fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)) (i := i) (f := fun x : ℝ => x^2) (by fun_prop)]
  exact gaussian_square_mean (v i)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_variance
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_variance (v : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    Var[piSquareSum (ι := ι); Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))] ≤
      64 * ∑ i, (v i : ℝ)^2
proof:
:= by
  have he : piSquareSum (ι := ι) = ∑ i, (fun x : ι → ℝ => x i^2) := by
    funext x
    simp only [piSquareSum, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [he, variance_sum_pi (X := fun (_ : ι) (x : ℝ) => x^2)
    (fun i => gaussian_square_memLp (v i)), Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => gaussian_square_variance (v i))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_tail
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_tail (v : ι → ℝ≥0) {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))) {x | d ≤ |piSquareSum x - ∑ i, (v i : ℝ)|} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (64 * (∑ i, (v i : ℝ)^2) / d^2)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq (piSquareSum_memLp v) hd
  rw [piSquareSum_mean] at ht
  refine ht.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_)
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (piSquareSum_variance v) (sq_nonneg d)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.piSquareSum_bulk_mass
statement:
lemma piSquareSum_bulk_mass (v : ι → ℝ≥0) {s d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d)
    (hmean : (∑ i, (v i : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i, (v i : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :
    (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ (Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i)))
      {x | s-2*d ≤ piSquareSum x ∧ piSquareSum x ≤ s}
proof:
:= by
  let μ := Measure.pi (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))
  let A := {x : ι → ℝ | s-2*d ≤ piSquareSum x ∧ piSquareSum x ≤ s}
  have hA : MeasurableSet A := by
    have hS : Measurable (piSquareSum (ι := ι)) := by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop
    exact (measurableSet_le measurable_const hS).inter (measurableSet_le hS measurable_const)
  have hsub : Aᶜ ⊆ {x : ι → ℝ | d ≤ |piSquareSum x - ∑ i, (v i : ℝ)|} := by
    intro x hx
    change ¬ (s-2*d ≤ piSquareSum x ∧ piSquareSum x ≤ s) at hx
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hmean, le_abs]
    push Not at hx
    by_cases hh : s-2*d ≤ piSquareSum x
    · left; linarith [hx hh]
    · right; linarith
  have ht : μ Aᶜ ≤ (1/2:ℝ≥0∞) := by
    apply (measure_mono hsub).trans ((piSquareSum_tail v hd).trans _)
    rw [show (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (1/2) by rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (by norm_num)]; norm_num]
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hd)).mpr
    linarith
  have hsum : μ A + μ Aᶜ = 1 := by
    rw [measure_add_measure_compl hA, measure_univ]
  have hfin : μ A ≠ ∞ := measure_ne_top _ _
  have hreal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hsum
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add hfin (measure_ne_top _ _), ENNReal.toReal_one] at hreal
  have ht' := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ∞) ht
  norm_num at ht'
  apply (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal (by norm_num) hfin).mp
  norm_num
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_shell_split
statement:
lemma diagonalGaussian_shell_split (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) (s δ : ℝ) :
    diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ) =
      (((gaussianReal 0 (v 0)).prod (gaussianReal 0 (v 1))).prod
        (Measure.pi fun i : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (v i.succ.succ)))
      (sumSquareShell piSquareSum s δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalGaussian, Measure.map_apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _)
    (squareNormShell_measurable s δ)]
  rw [← (splitPair_preserving n (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))).measure_preimage
    (sumSquareShell_measurable (by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop) s δ).nullMeasurableSet]
  congr 1
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_preimage, squareNormShell, sumSquareShell, Set.mem_ofPred_eq,
    EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, splitPair, piSquareSum]
  rw [splitPair_square_sum]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_shell_upper
statement:
