lemma diagonalGaussian_shell_upper (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0)
    (h0 : v 0 ≠ 0) (h1 : v 1 ≠ 0) (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalGaussian_shell_split]
  exact gaussianPair_bulk_upper (by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop) h0 h1 s hδ

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_shell_lower
statement:
lemma diagonalGaussian_shell_lower (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) {m s d δ : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hm0 : m ≤ v 0) (hm1 : m ≤ v 1) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hmean : (∑ i : Fin n, (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i : Fin n, (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
      Real.exp (-(2*d+δ)/(2*m)) / 2) ≤ diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalGaussian_shell_split]
  have hl := gaussianPair_bulk_lower
    (ν := Measure.pi fun i : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (v i.succ.succ))
    (Z := piSquareSum) (by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop) (s := s) (R := 2*d)
    hm hm0 hm1 hδ
  have hp := piSquareSum_bulk_mass (fun i : Fin n => v i.succ.succ) hd hmean hvar
  apply le_trans _ hl
  calc
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
      Real.exp (-(2*d+δ)/(2*m))) * (1/2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat, div_eq_mul_inv]
        congr 1
        norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp bot_le

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalSquareDensity_limit
statement:
lemma diagonalSquareDensity_limit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ)).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (diagonalSquareDensity v s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalGaussian_density v hv]
  exact squareNormShell_density_limit volume (euclideanGaussianPDF_integrable v)
    (euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous v) (fun x => gaussianPiPDF_nonneg v x) hs

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalSquareDensity_upper
statement:
lemma diagonalSquareDensity_upper (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    diagonalSquareDensity v s ≤ Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_tendsto (diagonalSquareDensity_limit v hv hs)
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.out
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)
    (diagonalGaussian_shell_upper v (hv 0) (hv 1) s hδ0.le)
  have hp := gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg (v 0) (v 1)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)] at h
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hδ0).mpr
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalSquareDensity_lower
statement:
lemma diagonalSquareDensity_lower (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    {m s d : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m) (hm0 : m ≤ v 0) (hm1 : m ≤ v 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hmean : (∑ i : Fin n, (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i : Fin n, (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :
    Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) * Real.exp (-d/m) / 2 ≤
      diagonalSquareDensity v s
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun δ : ℝ => Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
      Real.exp (-(2*d+δ)/(2*m)) / 2) := by fun_prop
  have ht := (hc.continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto.mono_left
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  have ht' : Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
      Real.exp (-(2*d+δ)/(2*m)) / 2) (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0))
      (𝓝 (Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) * Real.exp (-d/m) / 2)) := by
    have he : -(2*d+(0:ℝ))/(2*m) = -d/m := by ring
    simpa only [he] using ht
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto ht' (diagonalSquareDensity_limit v hv hs)
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.out
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top _ _)
    (diagonalGaussian_shell_lower v hm hm0 hm1 hδ0.le hd hmean hvar)
  have hp := gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg (v 0) (v 1)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)] at h
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ0).mpr
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialEval_embedding
statement: lemma radialEval_embedding : MeasurableEmbedding (radialEval (E := E))
proof:
:= by
  exact (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe (measurableSet_singleton (0 : E)).compl).comp
    (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding (homeomorphUnitSphereProd E).symm)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialCone_measurable
statement:
lemma radialCone_measurable {A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    MeasurableSet (radialCone A)
proof: := radialEval_embedding.measurableSet_image' (hA.prod .univ)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialCone_mem
statement:
lemma radialCone_mem (A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) (r : Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (u : sphere (0 : E) 1) :
    r.val • u.val ∈ radialCone A ↔ u ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have h := radialEval_embedding.injective.mem_set_image (s := A ×ˢ Set.univ) (a := (u,r))
  simpa only [radialCone, radialEval, Set.mem_prod, Set.mem_univ, and_true] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.angular_indicator_integral
statement:
lemma angular_indicator_integral (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] (f : E → ℝ)
    {A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    (∫ u : sphere (0 : E) 1, (radialCone A).indicator f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere) =
      ∫ u in A, f (r • u.val) ∂μ.toSphere
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_indicator hA]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards with u
  have hh := radialCone_mem A ⟨r, hr⟩ u
  by_cases hu : u ∈ A
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hu, Set.indicator_of_mem (hh.mpr hu)]
  · simp only [Set.indicator_of_notMem hu, Set.indicator_of_notMem (fun h => hu (hh.mp h))]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensityOn_continuous
statement:
lemma radialDensityOn_continuous (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)) :
    Continuous (radialDensityOn μ f A)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_id.pow _).mul (angular_integral_continuous μ hf A)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.normShell_cone_density_real
proof:
:= by
  have hind : (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal ((radialCone A).indicator f x)) =
      (radialCone A).indicator (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) := by
    funext x
    by_cases h : x ∈ radialCone A <;> simp [h]
  have hw := normShell_density_real μ (hf.indicator (radialCone_measurable hA))
    (fun x => Set.indicator_nonneg (fun x _ => hfn x) x) (b := b) ha
  rw [hind, withDensity_indicator (radialCone_measurable hA),
    ← restrict_withDensity (radialCone_measurable hA),
    Measure.restrict_apply (normShell_measurable a b)] at hw
  rw [hw]
  apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioc
  intro r hr
  simp only [radialDensity, radialDensityOn,
    angular_indicator_integral μ f hA (lt_of_le_of_lt ha hr.1)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.squareNormShell_cone_density_limit
statement:
lemma squareNormShell_cone_density_limit (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure] [ProperSpace E]
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Integrable f μ) (hfc : Continuous f) (hfn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x)
    {A : Set (sphere (0 : E) 1)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ =>
      (μ.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (f x)) (squareNormShell s δ ∩ radialCone A)).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (radialDensityOn μ f A (Real.sqrt s) / (2 * Real.sqrt s)))
proof:
:= by
  have hq := radialDensityOn_continuous μ hfc A
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => ∫ r in Real.sqrt s..t, radialDensityOn μ f A r)
      (radialDensityOn μ f A (Real.sqrt s)) (Real.sqrt s) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right IntervalIntegrable.refl
      hq.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter hq.continuousAt
  have hd' := hd.comp s (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt hs.ne')
  have hh := hd'.tendsto_slope_zero_right
  simp only [Function.comp_def, mul_one_div] at hh
  apply hh.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.out
  rw [squareNormShell_eq hs.le hδ0.le,
    normShell_cone_density_real μ hf hfn hA (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), intervalIntegral.integral_same,
    sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith))]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPair_bulk_restricted_upper
statement:
lemma gaussianPair_bulk_restricted_upper {ν : Measure Ω} [SFinite ν]
    {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable Z) {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    {B : Set Ω} (hB : MeasurableSet B) (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (((gaussianReal 0 a).prod (gaussianReal 0 b)).prod ν)
      (sumSquareShell Z s δ ∩ Prod.snd ⁻¹' B) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor a b) * ν B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.prod_apply_symm ((sumSquareShell_measurable hZ s δ).inter
    (hB.preimage measurable_snd)), ← Measure.restrict_apply_univ (μ := ν) (s := B),
    ← lintegral_const, ← lintegral_indicator hB]
  apply lintegral_mono
  intro ω
  by_cases hω : ω ∈ B
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hω]
    convert gaussianPair_annulus_upper_all ha hb (s-Z ω) hδ using 2
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, sumSquareShell, squareAnnulus,
      Set.mem_ofPred_eq, hω, and_true]
    constructor <;> intro h <;> constructor <;> linarith [h.1, h.2]
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hω]
    suffices he : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p, ω)) ⁻¹' (sumSquareShell Z s δ ∩ Prod.snd ⁻¹' B) = ∅ by
      dsimp only
      rw [he, measure_empty]
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro p hp
    exact hω hp.2

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_density_upper
statement:
lemma gaussian_density_upper (v : ℝ≥0) (x : ℝ) :
    gaussianPDFReal 0 v x ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * v))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianPDFReal
  rw [sub_zero]
  have h : Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*v))) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity))
  simpa only [neg_div, mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity :
    0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_smallBall_upper
statement:
lemma gaussian_smallBall_upper {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0) (T : ℝ) :
    gaussianReal 0 v {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ T} ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2*T*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have he : {x : ℝ | |x| ≤ T} = Set.Icc (-T) T := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_Icc, abs_le]
  rw [he, gaussianReal_of_var_ne_zero _ hv, withDensity_apply _ measurableSet_Icc]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _x in Set.Icc (-T) T, ENNReal.ofReal ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹) := by
      exact lintegral_mono (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (gaussian_density_upper v x))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [lintegral_const, Measure.restrict_apply_univ, Real.volume_Icc,
        ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
      congr 1
      ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_shell_restricted_upper
statement:
lemma diagonalGaussian_shell_restricted_upper (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0)
    (h0 : v 0 ≠ 0) (h1 : v 1 ≠ 0) {B : Set (Fin n → ℝ)} (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ ∩
      {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)) | (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ.succ) ∈ B}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1)) *
        (Measure.pi fun i : Fin n => gaussianReal 0 (v i.succ.succ)) B
proof:
:= by
  have hB' : MeasurableSet {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2)) |
      (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ.succ) ∈ B} := hB.preimage (by fun_prop)
  rw [diagonalGaussian, Measure.map_apply (WithLp.measurable_toLp 2 _)
    ((squareNormShell_measurable s δ).inter hB')]
  have he : (WithLp.toLp 2 : (Fin (n+2) → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+2))) ⁻¹'
      (squareNormShell s δ ∩ {x | (fun i : Fin n => x i.succ.succ) ∈ B}) =
      splitPair n ⁻¹' (sumSquareShell piSquareSum s δ ∩ Prod.snd ⁻¹' B) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_inter_iff, squareNormShell, sumSquareShell,
      Set.mem_ofPred_eq, EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq, splitPair, piSquareSum]
    rw [splitPair_square_sum]
  rw [he, (splitPair_preserving n (fun i => gaussianReal 0 (v i))).measure_preimage
    ((sumSquareShell_measurable (by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop) s δ).inter
      (hB.preimage measurable_snd)).nullMeasurableSet]
  exact gaussianPair_bulk_restricted_upper (by unfold piSquareSum; fun_prop) h0 h1 hB s hδ

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialCone_coordinate_bound
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨⟨u,r⟩, ⟨hu,_⟩, rfl⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < r.val := r.property
  have hu' : |u.val i| ≤ b := hu
  have huN : ‖u.val‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.property
  have hn' : r.val^2 ≤ K := by
    simpa only [radialEval, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr0, huN, mul_one] using hn
  have hK : 0 ≤ K := (sq_nonneg r.val).trans hn'
  have hr : r.val ≤ Real.sqrt K := (Real.le_sqrt hr0.le hK).mpr hn'
  change |(r.val • u.val) i| ≤ _
  simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hr0]
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hu' hr0.le).trans (by nlinarith)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalGaussian_shell_cone_upper
statement:
lemma diagonalGaussian_shell_cone_upper (v : Fin (n+3) → ℝ≥0)
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) {s δ b : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ ∩
      radialCone {u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1 |
        |u.val (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ| ≤ b}) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
        (2*(b*Real.sqrt (s+δ))*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹))
proof:
:= by
  let B := {x : Fin (n+1) → ℝ | |x 0| ≤ b * Real.sqrt (s+δ)}
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := by
    exact measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have hsub : squareNormShell s δ ∩
      radialCone {u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1 |
        |u.val (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ| ≤ b} ⊆
      squareNormShell s δ ∩
        {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3)) | (fun i : Fin (n+1) => x i.succ.succ) ∈ B} := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hx.1, radialCone_coordinate_bound hb hx.2 hx.1.2⟩
  apply (measure_mono hsub).trans
  apply (diagonalGaussian_shell_restricted_upper v (hv 0) (hv 1) hB s hδ).trans
  have he : (Measure.pi fun i : Fin (n+1) => gaussianReal 0 (v i.succ.succ)) B =
      gaussianReal 0 (v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ) {y : ℝ | |y| ≤ b*Real.sqrt (s+δ)} := by
    exact (measurePreserving_eval (fun i : Fin (n+1) => gaussianReal 0 (v i.succ.succ)) 0).measure_preimage
      (measurableSet_le (measurable_id.abs) measurable_const).nullMeasurableSet
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.pi * δ * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1)) *
        ENNReal.ofReal (2*(b*Real.sqrt (s+δ))*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (gaussian_smallBall_upper (hv _) _) bot_le
    _ = _ := (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg Real.pi_pos.le hδ) (gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg _ _))).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalSquareDensityOn_limit
statement:
lemma diagonalSquareDensityOn_limit {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    {A : Set (sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) 1)} (hA : MeasurableSet A)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    Tendsto (fun δ : ℝ => (diagonalGaussian v (squareNormShell s δ ∩ radialCone A)).toReal / δ)
      (nhdsWithin 0 (Ioi 0)) (𝓝 (diagonalSquareDensityOn v A s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalGaussian_density v hv]
  exact squareNormShell_cone_density_limit volume (euclideanGaussianPDF_integrable v)
    (euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous v) (fun x => gaussianPiPDF_nonneg v x) hA hs

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalSquareDensityOn_smallBall
statement:
lemma diagonalSquareDensityOn_smallBall (v : Fin (n+3) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    {s b : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    diagonalSquareDensityOn v
      {u : sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+3))) 1 |
        |u.val (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ| ≤ b} s ≤
      Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
        (2*(b*Real.sqrt s)*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun δ : ℝ => Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
      (2*(b*Real.sqrt (s+δ))*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹)) := by fun_prop
  have ht := (hc.continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto.mono_left
    (nhdsWithin_le_nhds (s := Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
  simp only [add_zero] at ht
  apply le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
    (diagonalSquareDensityOn_limit v hv (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const) hs) ht
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with δ hδ
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ := hδ.out
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    (diagonalGaussian_shell_cone_upper v hv (s := s) hδ0.le hb)
  have hp := gaussianPairPrefactor_nonneg (v 0) (v 1)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)] at h
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hδ0).mpr
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereAverage_one
statement: lemma sphereAverage_one : sphereAverage (fun _ : unitSphere ι => (1:ℝ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold sphereAverage sphereArea
  simp only [integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  exact div_self (ne_of_gt (sphereArea_pos (ι := ι)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPDF_exp
statement:
lemma gaussianPiPDF_exp (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    gaussianPiPDF v x = gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-∑ i, x i ^ 2 / (2*v i))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussianPiPDF, gaussianPDFReal, sub_zero, Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
    gaussianPiPrefactor, ← Real.exp_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_div]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPrefactor_pos
statement:
lemma gaussianPiPrefactor_pos {v : ι → ℝ≥0} (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) :
    0 < gaussianPiPrefactor v
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  have hvi : 0 < (v i : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hv i))
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.unitSphere_sum_sq
statement: lemma unitSphere_sum_sq (u : unitSphere ι) : ∑ i, u.val i ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖u.val‖ = 1 := mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp u.property
  simpa only [hn, one_pow] using (EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq u.val).symm

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereGaussianPDF
statement:
lemma sphereGaussianPDF {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (r : ℝ) (u : unitSphere ι) :
    gaussianPiPDF v (WithLp.ofLp (r • u.val)) = gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-z*r^2/2) *
      Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianPiPDF_exp, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 2
  have hsum : ∑ i, (r • u.val) i ^ 2 / (2 * v i) =
      z*r^2/2 - a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val) := by
    simp only [diagonalEnergy, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, (z*r^2/2 * u.val i^2 - a/2 * (lam i*(r*u.val i)^2)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv, hq i]
        ring
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, unitSphere_sum_sq, mul_one,
          ← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hsum]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_spherePartition
statement:
lemma radialDensity_spherePartition {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (r : ℝ) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x) r =
      r ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-z*r^2/2) *
      sphereArea (ι := ι) * spherePartition lam a r
proof:
:= by
  unfold radialDensity spherePartition sphereAverage
  simp only [finrank_euclideanSpace]
  simp_rw [sphereGaussianPDF hq]
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  have ha := ne_of_gt (sphereArea_pos (ι := ι))
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePartition_zero
statement: lemma spherePartition_zero (lam : ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) : spherePartition lam 0 r = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [spherePartition, zero_div, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero] using sphereAverage_one (ι := ι)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherePartition_pos
statement: lemma spherePartition_pos (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) : 0 < spherePartition lam a r
proof:
:= by
  apply div_pos _ sphereArea_pos
  have hc : Continuous (fun u : unitSphere ι => Real.exp (a/2*diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))) := by
    unfold diagonalEnergy
    fun_prop
  have hi : Integrable (fun u : unitSphere ι => Real.exp (a/2*diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val)))
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere := by
    simpa only [integrableOn_univ] using hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ
  let _ : NeZero (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere := ⟨Measure.toSphere_ne_zero _⟩
  exact integral_exp_pos hi

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_standard
statement:
lemma radialDensity_standard (r : ℝ) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF (fun _ => 1) x) r =
      r ^ (Fintype.card ι - 1) * gaussianPiPrefactor (fun _ : ι => 1) * Real.exp (-r^2/2) *
      sphereArea (ι := ι)
proof:
:= by
  have h := radialDensity_spherePartition (lam := fun _ : ι => (0:ℝ))
    (v := fun _ => 1) (z := 1) (a := 0) (by norm_num) r
  simpa only [spherePartition_zero, mul_one, neg_mul, one_mul] using h

name: OAI.CriticalSK.radialDensity_standard_pos
statement:
lemma radialDensity_standard_pos {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    0 < radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF (fun _ => 1) x) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialDensity_standard]
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos (pow_pos hr _) (gaussianPiPrefactor_pos (by simp)))
    (Real.exp_pos _)) sphereArea_pos

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spherical_radial_ratio
statement:
lemma spherical_radial_ratio {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a r : ℝ}
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (hr : 0 < r) :
    radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF v x) r /
      radialDensity volume (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => gaussianPiPDF (fun _ => 1) x) r =
      gaussianPiPrefactor v / gaussianPiPrefactor (fun _ : ι => 1) *
        Real.exp (-(z-1)*r^2/2) * spherePartition lam a r
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialDensity_spherePartition hq, radialDensity_standard]
  have hE : Real.exp (-(z-1)*r^2/2) = Real.exp (-z*r^2/2) / Real.exp (-r^2/2) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_sub]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hE]
  have h1 := ne_of_gt (gaussianPiPrefactor_pos (v := fun _ : ι => 1) (by simp))
  have h2 := ne_of_gt (sphereArea_pos (ι := ι))
  have h3 := ne_of_gt (pow_pos hr (Fintype.card ι - 1))
  have h4 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos (-r^2/2))
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereWeight_integrable
statement:
lemma sphereWeight_integrable (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u : unitSphere ι => Real.exp (a / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val)))
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun u : unitSphere ι => Real.exp (a / 2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))) := by
    unfold diagonalEnergy; fun_prop
  simpa only [integrableOn_univ] using hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereWeight_integral_pos
statement:
lemma sphereWeight_integral_pos (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) :
    0 < ∫ u : unitSphere ι, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
      ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere
proof:
:= by
  have h := spherePartition_pos lam a r
  exact (div_pos_iff.mp h).elim (fun h => h.1)
    (fun h => False.elim (not_lt_of_ge (sphereArea_pos (ι := ι)).le h.2))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_apply_real
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_apply_real (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) {A : Set (unitSphere ι)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (sphereTilted lam a r A).toReal =
      (∫ u in A, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, Real.exp (a/2 * diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, withDensity_apply _ hA,
    ← ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal (sphereWeight_integrable lam a r).integrableOn
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun u => (Real.exp_pos _).le)),
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_inv,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sphereWeight_integral_pos lam a r).le,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (integral_nonneg (fun u => (Real.exp_pos _).le))]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_density_ratio
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_density_ratio {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a s : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z - a * lam i) (hs : 0 < s)
    {A : Set (unitSphere ι)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s) A).toReal =
      diagonalSquareDensityOn v A s / diagonalSquareDensity v s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted_apply_real lam a _ hA]
  unfold diagonalSquareDensityOn diagonalSquareDensity radialDensityOn radialDensity
  simp_rw [sphereGaussianPDF hq]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  have h1 := ne_of_gt (gaussianPiPrefactor_pos hv)
  have h2 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos (-z*(Real.sqrt s)^2/2))
  have h3 := ne_of_gt (pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs) (Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) - 1))
  have h4 := ne_of_gt (sphereWeight_integral_pos lam a (Real.sqrt s))
  have h5 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs)
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPairPrefactor_pos
statement:
lemma gaussianPairPrefactor_pos {a b : ℝ≥0} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    0 < gaussianPairPrefactor a b
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : 0 < (a:ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha)
  have hb' : 0 < (b:ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb)
  unfold gaussianPairPrefactor
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_smallBall
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_smallBall (lam : Fin (n+3) → ℝ) (a z : ℝ)
    (v : Fin (n+3) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i)
    {s m d b : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m) (hm0 : m ≤ v 0) (hm1 : m ≤ v 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hmean : (∑ i : Fin (n+1), (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128 * (∑ i : Fin (n+1), (v i.succ.succ : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2) :
    (sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s)
      {u : unitSphere (Fin (n+3)) | |u.val (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ| ≤ b}).toReal ≤
      4 * (b * Real.sqrt s) * (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹ *
        Real.exp (d/m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted_density_ratio hv hq hs (measurableSet_le (by fun_prop) measurable_const)]
  have hl := diagonalSquareDensity_lower v hv hs hm hm0 hm1 hd hmean hvar
  have hu := diagonalSquareDensityOn_smallBall v hv hs hb
  have hP := mul_pos Real.pi_pos (gaussianPairPrefactor_pos (hv 0) (hv 1))
  have hp : 0 < diagonalSquareDensity v s :=
    (div_pos (mul_pos hP (Real.exp_pos _)) (by norm_num)).trans_le hl
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have hC : 0 ≤ 4 * (b*Real.sqrt s) *
      (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹ * Real.exp (d/m) := by positivity
  apply hu.trans
  apply le_trans _ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl hC)
  have he : Real.exp (d/m) * Real.exp (-d/m) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show d/m + -d/m = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
  apply le_of_eq
  symm
  calc
    _ = (Real.pi * gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1) *
        (2*(b*Real.sqrt s)*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v (0 : Fin (n+1)).succ.succ))⁻¹)) *
        (Real.exp (d/m) * Real.exp (-d/m)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he, mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussian_square_pdf_le_double
statement:
lemma gaussian_square_pdf_le_double {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0) (x : ℝ) :
    x^2 * gaussianPDFReal 0 v x ≤ 8 * (v:ℝ) * gaussianPDFReal 0 (2*v) x
proof:
:= by
  have hvp : 0 < (v:ℝ) := NNReal.coe_pos.mpr (pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hv)
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v) := by positivity
  have hs2 : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(2*v:ℝ≥0)) := by positivity
  have hsle : Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(2*v:ℝ≥0)) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · push_cast
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*Real.pi*(v:ℝ))]
  have hpre : (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹ ≤
      2 * (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(2*v:ℝ≥0)))⁻¹ := by
    have hd : 1 / Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v) ≤ 2 / Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(2*v:ℝ≥0)) :=
      (div_le_div_iff₀ hs hs2).mpr (by simpa only [one_mul] using hsle)
    simpa only [one_div, div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] using hd
  let t : ℝ := x^2/(4*v)
  have ht : t ≤ Real.exp t := (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1)).trans
    (Real.add_one_le_exp t)
  have ht' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ht (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-2*t)))
  have hmul : Real.exp t * Real.exp (-2*t) = Real.exp (-t) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
  rw [hmul] at ht'
  have he : x^2 * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*v))) ≤ 4*v * Real.exp (-(x^2/(4*v))) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht' (show 0 ≤ 4*(v:ℝ) by positivity)
    have ha : -2*t = -(x^2/(2*v)) := by dsimp [t]; field_simp; ring
    have hb : 4*(v:ℝ)*t = x^2 := by dsimp [t]; field_simp
    rw [ha, ← mul_assoc, hb] at hh
    exact hh
  unfold gaussianPDFReal
  simp only [sub_zero, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_ofNat]
  have he' : x^2 * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*v))) ≤
      4*v * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*(2*v)))) := by convert he using 2; congr 2; ring
  calc
    _ = (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹ * (x^2 * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*v)))) := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*v))⁻¹ * (4*v * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*(2*v))))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he' (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (2*(Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi*(2*v)))⁻¹) *
        (4*v * Real.exp (-(x^2/(2*(2*v))))) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpre (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring_nf

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianPiPDF_square_le_double
statement:
lemma gaussianPiPDF_square_le_double (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) (hv : v i ≠ 0) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    x i ^ 2 * gaussianPiPDF v x ≤
      8*(v i:ℝ) * gaussianPiPDF (Function.update v i (2*v i)) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianPiPDF
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ
    (fun j => gaussianPDFReal 0 (Function.update v i (2*v i) j) (x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)]
  rw [Function.update_self]
  have he : (∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i,
      gaussianPDFReal 0 (Function.update v i (2*v i) j) (x j)) =
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, gaussianPDFReal 0 (v j) (x j) := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
  rw [he, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (gaussian_square_pdf_le_double hv (x i))
    (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun j _ => gaussianPDFReal_nonneg 0 (v j) (x j)))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_integral
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_integral (lam : ι → ℝ) (a r : ℝ) (F : unitSphere ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ u, F u ∂sphereTilted lam a r) =
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, Real.exp (a/2*diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val)) * F u
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, Real.exp (a/2*diagonalEnergy lam (r • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted, integral_smul_measure,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by unfold diagonalEnergy; fun_prop)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (sphereWeight_integral_pos lam a r).le,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Real.exp_pos _).le, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_gaussian_integral
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_gaussian_integral {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i : ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i)
    (r : ℝ) (F : unitSphere ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ u, F u ∂sphereTilted lam a r) =
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, gaussianPiPDF v (r • u.val) * F u
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) /
      (∫ u : unitSphere ι, gaussianPiPDF v (r • u.val)
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted_integral]
  simp_rw [← WithLp.ofLp_smul, sphereGaussianPDF hq, mul_assoc (gaussianPiPrefactor v * Real.exp (-z*r^2/2)),
    integral_const_mul]
  have h1 := ne_of_gt (gaussianPiPrefactor_pos hv)
  have h2 := ne_of_gt (Real.exp_pos (-z*r^2/2))
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.angular_continuous_integrable
statement:
lemma angular_continuous_integrable {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (r : ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun u : unitSphere ι => f (r • u.val))
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun u : unitSphere ι => f (r • u.val)) := hf.comp (by fun_prop)
  simpa only [integrableOn_univ] using hc.continuousOn.integrableOn_compact isCompact_univ

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_coordinate_sq
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_coordinate_sq {lam : ι → ℝ} {v : ι → ℝ≥0} {z a s : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0) (hq : ∀ i, (v i:ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i) (hs : 0 < s) (i : ι) :
    (∫ u : unitSphere ι, ((Real.sqrt s • u.val) i)^2 ∂sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s)) =
      gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity v i s / diagonalSquareDensity v s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted_gaussian_integral hv hq]
  unfold gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity diagonalSquareDensity radialDensity
  simp_rw [mul_comm (gaussianPiPDF v _)]
  have h1 := ne_of_gt (pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs) (Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) - 1))
  have h2 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hs)
  field_simp
  rfl

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_le_double
statement:
lemma gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_le_double [DecidableEq ι] (v : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι)
    (hv : v i ≠ 0) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity v i s ≤
      8*(v i:ℝ)*diagonalSquareDensity (Function.update v i (2*v i)) s
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (∫ u : unitSphere ι,
      ((Real.sqrt s • u.val) i)^2 * gaussianPiPDF v (WithLp.ofLp (Real.sqrt s • u.val))
      ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) ≤
      8*(v i:ℝ) * (∫ u : unitSphere ι,
        gaussianPiPDF (Function.update v i (2*v i)) (WithLp.ofLp (Real.sqrt s • u.val))
        ∂(volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)).toSphere) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_mono
      (angular_continuous_integrable ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι => x i^2)).mul
        (euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous v)) _)
      ((angular_continuous_integrable (euclideanGaussianPDF_continuous _) _).const_mul _)
    intro u
    exact gaussianPiPDF_square_le_double v i hv _
  have hh := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (show 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt s)^(Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)-1) by positivity))
    (show 0 ≤ 2*Real.sqrt s by positivity)
  unfold gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity diagonalSquareDensity radialDensity
  convert hh using 1
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_upper
statement:
lemma gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_upper (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin (n+2)) (h0 : i ≠ 0) (h1 : i ≠ 1) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity v i s ≤
      8*(v i:ℝ)*Real.pi*gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1)
proof:
:= by
  let v' := Function.update v i (2*v i)
  have hv' : ∀ j, v' j ≠ 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j=i
    · subst j
      simpa only [v', Function.update_self] using mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2:ℝ≥0) ≠ 0) (hv i)
    · simpa only [v', Function.update_of_ne hj] using hv j
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (diagonalSquareDensity_upper v' hv' hs)
    (show 0 ≤ 8*(v i:ℝ) by positivity)
  have he0 : v' 0 = v 0 := Function.update_of_ne h0.symm _ _
  have he1 : v' 1 = v 1 := Function.update_of_ne h1.symm _ _
  rw [he0, he1] at hh
  exact (gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_le_double v i (hv i) hs).trans
    (hh.trans_eq (by ring))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.sphereTilted_coordinate_sq_upper
statement:
lemma sphereTilted_coordinate_sq_upper (lam : Fin (n+2) → ℝ) (a z : ℝ)
    (v : Fin (n+2) → ℝ≥0) (hv : ∀ i, v i ≠ 0)
    (hq : ∀ i, (v i:ℝ)⁻¹ = z-a*lam i)
    {s m d : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : 0 < m) (hm0 : m ≤ v 0) (hm1 : m ≤ v 1)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hmean : (∑ j : Fin n, (v j.succ.succ : ℝ)) = s-d)
    (hvar : 128*(∑ j : Fin n, (v j.succ.succ : ℝ)^2) ≤ d^2)
    (i : Fin (n+2)) (h0 : i ≠ 0) (h1 : i ≠ 1) :
    (∫ u : unitSphere (Fin (n+2)), ((Real.sqrt s • u.val) i)^2
      ∂sphereTilted lam a (Real.sqrt s)) ≤ 16*(v i:ℝ)*Real.exp (d/m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereTilted_coordinate_sq hv hq hs]
  have hl := diagonalSquareDensity_lower v hv hs hm hm0 hm1 hd hmean hvar
  have hp : 0 < diagonalSquareDensity v s :=
    (div_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos Real.pi_pos (gaussianPairPrefactor_pos (hv 0) (hv 1)))
      (Real.exp_pos _)) (by norm_num)).trans_le hl
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hp).mpr
  apply (gaussianSquareCoordinateDensity_upper v hv i h0 h1 hs).trans
  apply le_trans _ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (show 0 ≤ 16*(v i:ℝ)*Real.exp (d/m) by positivity))
  have he : Real.exp (d/m) * Real.exp (-d/m) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add, show d/m + -d/m = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
  apply le_of_eq
  symm
  calc
    _ = (8*(v i:ℝ)*Real.pi*gaussianPairPrefactor (v 0) (v 1)) *
        (Real.exp (d/m) * Real.exp (-d/m)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he, mul_one]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.spinValue_sq
statement: @[simp] lemma spinValue_sq (b : Bool) : spinValue b ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> norm_num [spinValue]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaleLength_pos
statement: lemma scaleLength_pos (J j : ℕ) : 0 < scaleLength J j
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleLength
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaleRoot_pos
statement: lemma scaleRoot_pos (J j : ℕ) : 0 < scaleRoot J j
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleRoot
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaleEnergy_pos
statement: lemma scaleEnergy_pos (J j : ℕ) : 0 < scaleEnergy J j
proof: := sq_pos_of_pos (scaleRoot_pos J j)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_length_root_eq_one
statement:
lemma scale_length_root_eq_one {J j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J) :
    (scaleLength J j : ℝ) * scaleRoot J j = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleLength scaleRoot
  push_cast
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hj, div_self (by positivity)]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_last
statement: lemma scale_last (J : ℕ) : scaleRoot J (J + 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleRoot
  rw [pow_succ]
  field_simp

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_length_root
statement:
lemma scale_length_root {J j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J + 1) :
    1 ≤ (scaleLength J j : ℝ) * scaleRoot J j ∧
    (scaleLength J j : ℝ) * scaleRoot J j ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : j ≤ J
  · rw [scale_length_root_eq_one h]
    norm_num
  · have : j = J + 1 := by omega
    subst j
    simp [scaleLength, scale_last]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scaleEnergy_step
statement: lemma scaleEnergy_step (J j : ℕ) : scaleEnergy J (j + 1) = 4 * scaleEnergy J j
proof:
:= by
  unfold scaleEnergy scaleRoot
  rw [pow_succ]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.energy_first_scale
statement:
lemma energy_first_scale (J : ℕ) {e : ℝ} (hen : 0 ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 4) :
    ∃ j ≤ J + 1, e ≤ scaleEnergy J j ∧
      scaleEnergy J j ≤ 4 * (e + scaleEnergy J 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he0 : e ≤ scaleEnergy J 0
  · exact ⟨0, by omega, he0, by nlinarith [scaleEnergy_pos J 0]⟩
  · have hex : ∃ j, e ≤ scaleEnergy J j := ⟨J + 1, by norm_num [scaleEnergy, scale_last]; exact he⟩
    let j := Nat.find hex
    have hj : j ≤ J + 1 := Nat.find_min' hex (by norm_num [scaleEnergy, scale_last]; exact he)
    have hj0 : 0 < j := by
      by_contra! h
      have : j = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h
      exact he0 (this ▸ Nat.find_spec hex)
    have hprev : scaleEnergy J (j - 1) < e := lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min hex (by omega))
    refine ⟨j, hj, Nat.find_spec hex, ?_⟩
    have heq : j - 1 + 1 = j := by omega
    rw [← heq, scaleEnergy_step]
    nlinarith [scaleEnergy_pos J 0]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_shell_geometry
statement:
lemma scale_shell_geometry {N J j : ℕ} (hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ 3)
    (hj : j ≤ J + 1) :
    (N : ℝ) * scaleEnergy J j ≤ (8 : ℝ)^j * scaleLength J j
proof:
:= by
  have hscale := (scale_length_root hj).1
  have hp : (8 : ℝ)^j = ((2 : ℝ)^j)^3 := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm j 3, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hm : 0 < (2 : ℝ)^J := by positivity
  have ht : 0 < (2 : ℝ)^j := by positivity
  unfold scaleRoot at hscale
  rw [← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ hm] at hscale
  unfold scaleEnergy scaleRoot
  rw [div_pow, ← mul_div_assoc, div_le_iff₀ (sq_pos_of_pos hm), hp]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (sq_nonneg ((2 : ℝ)^j))
  have hmul2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hscale
    (by positivity : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ)^j)^2 * ((2 : ℝ)^J)^2)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.dyadic_cube_scale
statement:
lemma dyadic_cube_scale (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) :
    (N : ℝ) ≤ ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 N)) ^ 3 ∧
    ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 N)) ^ 3 ≤ 8 * N
proof:
:= by
  have he : ((2 : ℝ)^Nat.clog 8 N) ^ 3 = (8 : ℝ)^Nat.clog 8 N := by
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm (Nat.clog 8 N) 3, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [he]
  constructor
  · exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 8) N
  · by_cases hn : N = 1
    · subst N
      norm_num [Nat.clog_one_right]
    · have hn' : 1 < N := by omega
      have hi := Nat.pow_pred_clog_lt_self (by decide : 1 < 8) hn'
      have hj := Nat.clog_pos (by decide : 1 < 8) hn'
      have hid : Nat.clog 8 N = (Nat.clog 8 N).pred + 1 := by
        simpa only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using (Nat.succ_pred_eq_of_pos hj).symm
      rw [hid, pow_succ]
      have hi' : (8 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 N).pred < N := by exact_mod_cast hi
      linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.natural_le_exponential_quarter
statement:
lemma natural_le_exponential_quarter (j : ℕ) :
    (j + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 8 * ((2 : ℝ)^j) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 := by
    have := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)
    norm_num at this ⊢
    exact this
  rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos (by positivity), Real.log_pow]
  have he := Real.add_one_le_exp ((j : ℝ) * Real.log 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ))
  have hj : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.block_scale_factor
statement:
lemma block_scale_factor {d t e : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) (ht : 0 < t)
    (hdt : 1 ≤ d * t) (hdt2 : d * t ≤ 2) (he : 0 ≤ e) (het : e ≤ t^2) :
    Real.sqrt d * (1 / d + 13 * Real.sqrt e) ≤ 27 * Real.sqrt t
proof:
:= by
  have hsd := Real.sq_sqrt hd.le
  have hst := Real.sq_sqrt ht.le
  have hse := Real.sq_sqrt he
  have hsd0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hd
  have hst0 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr ht
  have hsmall : Real.sqrt d / d ≤ Real.sqrt t := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hd).mpr
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdt hd.le
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
    rw [hsd, mul_pow, hst]
    nlinarith
  have hlarge : Real.sqrt d * Real.sqrt e ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt t := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left het hd.le
    have hm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdt2 ht.le
    apply (sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)).mp
    rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, hsd, hse, hst]
    nlinarith
  calc
    _ = Real.sqrt d / d + 13 * (Real.sqrt d * Real.sqrt e) := by ring
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt t + 13 * (2 * Real.sqrt t) := by linarith
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_block_factor
statement:
lemma scale_block_factor {J j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J + 1) {e : ℝ}
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (het : e ≤ scaleEnergy J j) :
    Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j) * (1 / scaleLength J j + 13 * Real.sqrt e) ≤
      27 * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j)
proof:
:=
  block_scale_factor (by exact_mod_cast scaleLength_pos J j) (scaleRoot_pos J j)
    (scale_length_root hj).1 (scale_length_root hj).2 he het

name: OAI.CriticalSK.scale_weight_absorption
statement:
lemma scale_weight_absorption (J j : ℕ) {e s h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hes : 0 ≤ e + s)
    (hscale : scaleEnergy J j ≤ 4 * (e + s)) :
    (h + j + 1) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j) ≤
      16 * (h + 1) * ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := by positivity
  have ht := scaleRoot_pos J j
  have hm : (0 : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ)^J := by positivity
  have hlin : h + j + 1 ≤ (h + 1) * (j + 1) := by nlinarith
  have hcoef := natural_le_exponential_quarter j
  have hfactor : ((2 : ℝ)^j) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j) =
      ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (scaleEnergy J j) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    have htdef : (2 : ℝ)^j = (2 : ℝ)^J * scaleRoot J j := by
      unfold scaleRoot
      field_simp
    rw [htdef, Real.mul_rpow hm.le ht.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    unfold scaleEnergy
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (scaleRoot J j) 2, ← Real.rpow_mul ht.le,
      mul_assoc, ← Real.rpow_add ht]
    norm_num
  have hfour : (4 : ℝ) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
    have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4)
      (by norm_num : (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
    simpa only [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, show Real.sqrt 4 = 2 by norm_num] using hp
  have henergy : (scaleEnergy J j) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (4 * (e + s)) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow (scaleEnergy_pos J j).le hscale (by norm_num)
      _ = (4 : ℝ) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ) := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) hes
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfour (Real.rpow_nonneg hes _)
  calc
    _ ≤ ((h + 1) * (j + 1)) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlin (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ ((h + 1) * (8 * ((2 : ℝ)^j) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ))) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j) := by
      gcongr
    _ = 8 * (h + 1) * (((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (scaleEnergy J j) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [← hfactor]
      ring
    _ ≤ 8 * (h + 1) * (((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (2 * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ))) := by
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.good_scale_prefix
statement:
lemma good_scale_prefix {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} {J N : ℕ} {h : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength J j - 1) (J + 2) N h)
    {j r b k : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ J + 1) (hr : r < N) (hb : b ∈ blockShell j r)
    (hk : k < scaleLength J j) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), X (b * scaleLength J j + i) ω| ≤
      (Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j)) * (h + j + r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := scaleLength_pos J j
  have he : scaleLength J j - 1 + 1 = scaleLength J j := by omega
  have hp := good_multiscale_prefix_all hω (j := j) (r := r) (b := b)
    (by omega) (by omega) hb (k := k) (by omega)
  simpa only [he] using hp.trans (blockThreshold_length_bound c (scaleLength J j) j r hd hh)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.selected_scale_form_bound
statement:
lemma selected_scale_form_bound {J j : ℕ} {e s h c a : ℝ}
    (hj : j ≤ J + 1) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hh : 0 ≤ h) (_hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (heσ : e ≤ scaleEnergy J j) (hσ : scaleEnergy J j ≤ 4 * (e + s))
    (ha : a ≤ 32 * (Real.sqrt (32 * c) * Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j)) *
      (h + j + 1) * (1 / scaleLength J j + 13 * Real.sqrt e)) :
    a ≤ 13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) * (h + 1) * ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
      (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ≤ 32 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) * (h + j + 1) *
        (Real.sqrt (scaleLength J j) * (1 / scaleLength J j + 13 * Real.sqrt e)) := by
      convert ha using 1
      ring
    _ ≤ 32 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) * (h + j + 1) * (27 * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (scale_block_factor hj he heσ) (by positivity)
    _ = 864 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) * ((h + j + 1) * Real.sqrt (scaleRoot J j)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 864 * Real.sqrt (32 * c) *
        (16 * (h + 1) * ((2 : ℝ)^J) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (e + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (scale_weight_absorption J j hh (add_nonneg he hs) hσ) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.centered_square_form_good
statement:
lemma centered_square_form_good {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j - 1)
      (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1) + 2) (n + 1) h)
    (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i^2) = 1) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω * u i^2| ≤
      13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * (h + 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 (n + 1))) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (pathEnergy n u + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he0 := pathEnergy_nonneg n u
  have he4 : pathEnergy n u ≤ 4 := by simpa only [hnorm, mul_one] using pathEnergy_le_four_mass n u
  obtain ⟨j, hj, heσ, hσ⟩ := energy_first_scale (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) he0 he4
  have hsize := scale_shell_geometry (dyadic_cube_scale (n + 1) (by omega)).1 hj
  have hscale := square_multiscale_prefix (fun i => X i ω) n j
    (scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j) (scaleLength_pos _ _) u hu hnorm
    (scaleEnergy_pos _ _) hh (by positivity) heσ (by exact_mod_cast hsize)
    (fun r hr b _ hb k hk => good_scale_prefix hh hω hj hr hb hk)
  exact selected_scale_form_bound hj he0 ((scaleEnergy_pos _ _).le.trans hs) hh c.prop
    heσ (hσ.trans (by linarith)) hscale

name: OAI.CriticalSK.centered_product_form_good
statement:
lemma centered_product_form_good {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {c : ℝ≥0} (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : Ω}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ multiscaleBad X c (fun j => scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j - 1)
      (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1) + 2) (n + 1) h)
    (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i^2) = 1) :
    |∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), X i ω * (u i * u (i + 1))| ≤
      13824 * Real.sqrt (32 * (c : ℝ)) * (h + 1) *
        ((2 : ℝ)^(Nat.clog 8 (n + 1))) ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (pathEnergy n u + s) ^ (3 / 8 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he0 := pathEnergy_nonneg n u
  have he4 : pathEnergy n u ≤ 4 := by simpa only [hnorm, mul_one] using pathEnergy_le_four_mass n u
  obtain ⟨j, hj, heσ, hσ⟩ := energy_first_scale (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) he0 he4
  have hsize := scale_shell_geometry (dyadic_cube_scale (n + 1) (by omega)).1 hj
  have hscale := product_multiscale_prefix (fun i => X i ω) n j
    (scaleLength (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) j) (scaleLength_pos _ _) u hu hnorm
    (scaleEnergy_pos _ _) hh (by positivity) heσ (by exact_mod_cast hsize)
    (fun r hr b _ hb k hk => good_scale_prefix hh hω hj hr hb hk)
  exact selected_scale_form_bound hj he0 ((scaleEnergy_pos _ _).le.trans hs) hh c.prop
    heσ (hσ.trans (by linarith)) hscale

name: OAI.CriticalSK.edgeCoeff_sqrt_div
statement:
lemma edgeCoeff_sqrt_div (n i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ n) :
    edgeCoeff n i = Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeCoeff, ← Real.sqrt_div (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hi]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.chi_scaled_bias_bound
statement:
lemma chi_scaled_bias_bound (n i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) :
    (Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) - ∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) /
      Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤
      4 / (n + 1) + (4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hN : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hsN : 0 < Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hN
  have hm : 0 < n - i := by omega
  have hsm : 0 < Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm)
  have hb := (chi_mean_bias (n - i) hm).2
  have hb2 := chi_bias_le_two (n - i) hm
  by_cases hearly : 2 * (i + 1 : ℝ) ≤ n + 1
  · have hdiff : (n + 1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ (n - i : ℕ) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
      linarith
    have hroot : Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) := by
      have hsqN := Real.sq_sqrt hN.le
      have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n - i : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      have hsqD := Real.sq_sqrt hd0
      nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (n + 1 : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg (n - i : ℕ)]
    have hbound : (Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) - ∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) /
        Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 / (n + 1) := by
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hsN).mpr
      have hprod : 2 / Real.sqrt (n - i : ℕ) ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hsm hsN).mpr
        linarith
      have hid : 4 / (n + 1 : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) = 4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt hN.le
        field_simp
        nlinarith
      rw [hid]
      exact hb.trans hprod
    exact hbound.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity))
  · have hlate : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ (i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hN).mpr
      push Not at hearly
      linarith
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb2 hsN.le
      _ ≤ (4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1)) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlate (show 0 ≤ 4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) by positivity)
        calc
          2 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) = (4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) * (1 / 2) := by ring
          _ ≤ _ := this
      _ ≤ _ := le_add_of_nonneg_left (by positivity)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_neighbor_sum
statement:
lemma weighted_neighbor_sum (n : ℕ) (u w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ w (i + 1)) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w i * (u i ^ 2 + u (i + 1) ^ 2)) ≤
      2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w i * u i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w i * u i ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w i * u i ^ 2 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (hw0 _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have hb : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w i * u (i + 1) ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w i * u i ^ 2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w (i + 1) * u (i + 1) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hw i) (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg (hw0 _) (sq_nonneg _))
  simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.weighted_edge_form
statement:
lemma weighted_edge_form (n : ℕ) (u a : ℕ → ℝ) {B C : ℝ}
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (ha : ∀ i < n, |a i| ≤ B + C * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1))) :
    2 * |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i * u i * u (i + 1)| ≤
      2 * B * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) + 4 * C * pathEnergy n u
proof:
:= by
  let w (i : ℕ) : ℝ := B + C * ((i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1))
  have hw0 : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i := by intro i; dsimp [w]; positivity
  have hw : ∀ i, w i ≤ w (i + 1) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [w]
    gcongr
    norm_num
  have habs : 2 * |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i * u i * u (i + 1)| ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, w i * (u i ^ 2 + u (i + 1) ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, |a i * u i * u (i + 1)| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (by norm_num)
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, |a i| * (2 * |u i * u (i + 1)|) := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        simp only [abs_mul]
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        apply mul_le_mul (ha i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)) ?_ (by positivity) (hw0 i)
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|u i| - |u (i + 1)|), sq_abs (u i), sq_abs (u (i + 1)),
          show |u i * u (i + 1)| = |u i| * |u (i + 1)| from abs_mul _ _]
  have hid : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), w i * u i ^ 2) =
      B * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) +
        C * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (i + 1 : ℝ) / (n + 1) * u i ^ 2) := by
    simp only [w, add_mul, mul_assoc, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hvari := pathEnergy_weighted_mass n u
  have hn := habs.trans (weighted_neighbor_sum n u w hw0 hw)
  rw [hid] at hn
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hvari hC]

name: OAI.CriticalSK.chi_mean_form_bias
statement:
lemma chi_mean_form_bias (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    2 * |∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1)| ≤
      8 / (n + 1) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) +
        16 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) * pathEnergy n u
proof:
:= by
  have hb := weighted_edge_form n u
    (fun i => (∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ) -
      edgeCoeff n i)
    (B := 4 / (n + 1)) (C := 4 / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) (by positivity) (by positivity) ?_
  · convert hb using 1
    ring
  intro i hi
  rw [edgeCoeff_sqrt_div n i (by omega), ← sub_div]
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), abs_sub_comm,
    abs_of_nonneg (chi_mean_bias (n - i) (by omega)).1]
  exact chi_scaled_bias_bound n i hi

name: OAI.CriticalSK.entryVariance_pos
statement: lemma entryVariance_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < entryVariance n
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < 2 * (48 * Real.exp 1 + 4) / (n + 1 : ℝ)
  positivity

name: OAI.CriticalSK.subGaussian_enlarge
statement:
lemma subGaussian_enlarge {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ}
    {c d : ℝ≥0} (h : HasSubgaussianMGF X c μ) (hcd : c ≤ d) : HasSubgaussianMGF X d μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h.integrable_exp_mul, fun t => (h.mgf_le t).trans ?_⟩
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  gcongr

name: OAI.CriticalSK.diagonalRows_common_subGaussian
statement:
lemma diagonalRows_common_subGaussian (n i : ℕ) :
    HasSubgaussianMGF (fun ω : ℕ → ℝ => ω i) (entryVariance n) (diagonalLaw n)
proof:
:= by
  apply subGaussian_enlarge (diagonalRows_subGaussian n i)
  change 2 / (n + 1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (48 * Real.exp 1 + 4) / (n + 1)
  gcongr
  have := Real.exp_pos (1 : ℝ)
  linarith

name: OAI.CriticalSK.entryBad_measurable
statement:
lemma entryBad_measurable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (n : ℕ) (X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, Measurable (X i)) (h : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (entryBad n X h)
proof:
:=
  multiscaleBad_measurable X hX _ _ _ _ _

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triBad_measurable
statement: lemma triBad_measurable (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (triBad n h)
proof:
:=
  ((entryBad_measurable n _ (fun i => measurable_pi_apply i) h).preimage measurable_fst).union
    ((entryBad_measurable n _ (scaledChiRow_measurable n) h).preimage measurable_snd)

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triBad_probability
statement:
lemma triBad_probability (n : ℕ) (h : ℝ) :
    (triLaw n).real (triBad n h) ≤ 32 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (diagonalLaw n).real (entryBad n (fun i (ω : ℕ → ℝ) => ω i) h) ≤
      16 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) :=
    multiscaleBad_probability (fun i => (measurable_pi_apply i).stronglyMeasurable)
      (diagonalRows_independent n) (diagonalRows_common_subGaussian n) (diagonalRows_mean n)
      (entryVariance_pos n) _ _ _ _
  have hb : (chiRowLaw n).real (entryBad n (scaledChiRow n) h) ≤
      16 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) :=
    multiscaleBad_probability (fun i => (scaledChiRow_measurable n i).stronglyMeasurable)
      (scaledChiRows_independent n) (scaledChiRow_subGaussian n) (scaledChiRow_mean n)
      (entryVariance_pos n) _ _ _ _
  have hU := measureReal_union_le (μ := triLaw n)
    (Prod.fst ⁻¹' entryBad n (fun i (ω : ℕ → ℝ) => ω i) h)
    (Prod.snd ⁻¹' entryBad n (scaledChiRow n) h)
  have heA : Prod.fst ⁻¹' entryBad n (fun i (ω : ℕ → ℝ) => ω i) h =
      (entryBad n (fun i (ω : ℕ → ℝ) => ω i) h) ×ˢ (Set.univ : Set (ChiRows n)) := by ext; simp
  have heB : Prod.snd ⁻¹' entryBad n (scaledChiRow n) h =
      (Set.univ : Set (ℕ → ℝ)) ×ˢ (entryBad n (scaledChiRow n) h) := by ext; simp
  simpa only [triBad, heA, heB, triLaw, measureReal_prod_prod, probReal_univ, mul_one, one_mul]
    using hU.trans (by simpa only [heA, heB, triLaw, measureReal_prod_prod, probReal_univ,
      mul_one, one_mul] using (show _ + _ ≤ 32 * Real.exp (-h ^ 2) by linarith [ha, hb]))

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triForm_decomposition
statement:
lemma triForm_decomposition (n : ℕ) (ω : TriSample n) (u : ℕ → ℝ) :
    triForm n ω u - (2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) - pathEnergy n u) =
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ω.1 i * u i ^ 2) +
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))) +
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold triForm pathEnergy
  have he : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (chi (chiRowDim n i) (ω.2 i) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) * u i * u (i + 1)) =
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, edgeCoeff n i * u i * u (i + 1)) +
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))) +
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1)) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hd : chiRowDim n i = n - i := by unfold chiRowDim; have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega
    have hmean : (∫ y, chi (chiRowDim n i) y ∂standardGaussianProduct (chiRowDim n i)) =
        (∫ y, chi (n - i) y ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) := by rw [hd]
    simp only [scaledChiRow, centeredChiRow]
    rw [hmean]
    ring
  rw [he]
  ring

name: OAI.CriticalSK.triForm_good
statement:
lemma triForm_good (n : ℕ) {h s : ℝ} {ω : TriSample n}
    (hh : 0 ≤ h) (hs : scaleEnergy (Nat.clog 8 (n + 1)) 0 ≤ s)
    (hω : ω ∉ triBad n h) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (hu : ∀ i, n + 1 ≤ i → u i = 0)
    (hnorm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), u i ^ 2) = 1) :
    |triForm n ω u - (2 - pathEnergy n u)| ≤ formError n h s (pathEnergy n u)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ω.1 ∉ entryBad n (fun i (a : ℕ → ℝ) => a i) h := by
    intro ha
    exact hω (Or.inl ha)
  have hB : ω.2 ∉ entryBad n (scaledChiRow n) h := by
    intro hb
    exact hω (Or.inr hb)
  have ha := centered_square_form_good n hh hs hA u hu hnorm
  have hb := centered_product_form_good n hh hs hB u hu hnorm
  have hbias := chi_mean_form_bias n u
  rw [hnorm, mul_one] at hbias
  have heB : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1)) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, hu (n + 1) (by omega)]
    ring
  rw [heB] at hb
  have he := triForm_decomposition n ω u
  rw [hnorm, mul_one] at he
  rw [he]
  have habs := abs_add_le
    ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ω.1 i * u i ^ 2) +
    2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))))
    (2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (((∫ x, chi (n - i) x ∂standardGaussianProduct (n - i)) / Real.sqrt (n + 1 : ℝ)) -
        edgeCoeff n i) * u i * u (i + 1)))
  have habs2 := abs_add_le
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ω.1 i * u i ^ 2)
    (2 * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, scaledChiRow n i ω.2 * (u i * u (i + 1))))
  simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)] at habs habs2
  dsimp only [formError]
  linarith

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.component_le
statement:
theorem component_le (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) (i : ι) :
    S.component μ i ≤ μ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    S.component μ i ≤ ∑ j, S.component μ j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => Measure.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ = μ := hμ.symm

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.affine_preimage_closedBall
statement:
theorem affine_preimage_closedBall (S : System ι) (i : ι) (x r : ℝ) :
    S.affine i ⁻¹' closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r) = closedBall x r
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [mem_preimage,mem_closedBall,Real.dist_eq]
  have he : S.affine i y-S.affine i x = S.ratio i*(y-x) := by simp only [affine]; ring
  rw [he,abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (S.ratio_pos i)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.System.component_ball
statement:
theorem component_ball (S : System ι) (μ : Measure ℝ) (i : ι) (x r : ℝ) :
    S.component μ i (closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (S.weight i) * μ (closedBall x r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [component,Measure.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,Measure.map_apply
    (S.affine_continuous i).measurable isClosed_closedBall.measurableSet,
    S.affine_preimage_closedBall]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.massReal_pos
statement:
theorem massReal_pos (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {x r : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ μ.support) (hr : 0 < r) : 0 < μ.real (closedBall x r)
proof:
:= by
  exact ENNReal.toReal_pos (ne_of_gt ((Measure.mem_support_iff_forall x).mp hx _
    (closedBall_mem_nhds x hr))) (measure_ne_top μ _)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.information_component
statement:
theorem information_component {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] (S : System ι)
    (μ : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (hμ : S.SelfSimilar μ) (i : ι)
    {x r : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ μ.support) (hr : 0 < r) :
    information μ (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r) =
      information μ x r - Real.log (S.weight i) -
        logRatio μ (S.component μ i) (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r)
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := massReal_pos μ hx hr
  have hcomp : (S.component μ i).real (closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r)) =
      S.weight i * μ.real (closedBall x r) := by
    simp only [Measure.real,S.component_ball,ENNReal.toReal_mul,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (S.weight_nonneg i)]
  have hcp : 0 < (S.component μ i).real (closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r)) := by
    rw [hcomp]; exact mul_pos (S.weight_pos i) hbase
  have htop : 0 < μ.real (closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r)) := by
    exact hcp.trans_le (ENNReal.toReal_mono (measure_ne_top μ _)
      (S.component_le μ hμ i _))
  have hl : logRatio μ (S.component μ i) (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r) =
      Real.log (μ.real (closedBall (S.affine i x) (|S.ratio i| *r))) -
        Real.log (S.weight i) - Real.log (μ.real (closedBall x r)) := by
    unfold logRatio
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_div]
    change Real.log (μ.real _ / (S.component μ i).real _) = _
    rw [Real.log_div htop.ne' hcp.ne']
    rw [hcomp,Real.log_mul (S.weight_pos i).ne' hbase.ne']
    ring
  rw [hl]
  unfold information
  ring

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.slope_ne_zero
statement: theorem slope_ne_zero (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι) (n : ℕ) : slope S ω n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
  intro j _
  exact abs_pos.mp (S.ratio_pos (ω j))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.abs_slope_pos
statement: theorem abs_slope_pos (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι) (n : ℕ) : 0 < |slope S ω n|
proof:
:=
  abs_pos.mpr (slope_ne_zero S ω n)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.abs_slope_lt_one
statement:
theorem abs_slope_lt_one (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι) {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    |slope S ω n| < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,T,hc,hc1,_,hr,_⟩ := S.exists_uniform_bounds
  exact (abs_slope_le S ω hc.le hr n).trans_lt (pow_lt_one₀ hc.le hc1 hn.ne')

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.slope_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem slope_tendsto_zero (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι) :
    Tendsto (fun n => |slope S ω n|) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,T,hc,hc1,_,hr,_⟩ := S.exists_uniform_bounds
  exact squeeze_zero (fun n => abs_nonneg _) (abs_slope_le S ω hc.le hr)
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hc.le hc1)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.clippedCorr_measurable
statement: theorem clippedCorr_measurable (S : System ι) (n : ℕ) : Measurable (clippedCorr S n)
proof:
:=
  measurable_const.max ((envelope_measurable S).min (corr_measurable S n))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.clippedLimit_measurable
statement: theorem clippedLimit_measurable (S : System ι) : Measurable (clippedLimit S)
proof:
:=
  measurable_const.max ((envelope_measurable S).min (corrLimit_measurable S))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.clip_bound
statement: theorem clip_bound {E x : ℝ} (hE : 0 ≤ E) : |max 0 (min E x)| ≤ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_max_left _ _)]
  exact max_le hE (min_le_left _ _)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.clippedCorr_bound
statement:
theorem clippedCorr_bound (S : System ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ι) :
    |clippedCorr S n ω| ≤ envelope S ω
proof: := clip_bound (envelope_nonneg S ω)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.clippedLimit_bound
statement:
theorem clippedLimit_bound (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι) :
    |clippedLimit S ω| ≤ envelope S ω
proof: := clip_bound (envelope_nonneg S ω)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.ae_clipped_limit
statement:
theorem ae_clipped_limit (S : System ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S,
    Tendsto (fun n => clippedCorr S n ω) atTop (𝓝 (clippedLimit S ω))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [ae_corr_limit S] with ω hω
  exact tendsto_const_nhds.max (tendsto_const_nhds.min hω)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.ae_corr_triangle
statement:
theorem ae_corr_triangle (S : System ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S,
    Tendsto (fun n => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, corr S (n-j) (shift^[j] ω)) / (n : ℝ))
      atTop (𝓝 (∫ ω, clippedLimit S ω ∂addressMeasure S))
proof:
:= by
  have hT : Ergodic shift (addressMeasure S) := shift_ergodic (symbolMeasure S)
  have ht := ae_tendsto_triangle hT (clippedCorr_measurable S) (clippedLimit_measurable S)
    (envelope_measurable S) (clippedCorr_bound S) (clippedLimit_bound S)
    (envelope_integrable S) (ae_clipped_limit S)
  have ha : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S, ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      0 ≤ corr S n (shift^[j] ω) ∧ corr S n (shift^[j] ω) ≤ envelope S (shift^[j] ω) := by
    apply ae_all_iff.mpr
    intro j
    exact ((show MeasurePreserving shift (addressMeasure S) (addressMeasure S) from
      shift_preserving (symbolMeasure S)).iterate j).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae (ae_corr_bounds S)
  filter_upwards [ht,ha] with ω hω hbound
  convert hω using 1
  funext n
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have hjn : 0 < n-j := by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega
  obtain ⟨h0,h1⟩ := hbound j (n-j) hjn
  simp only [clippedCorr,min_eq_right h1,max_eq_right h0]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.prefixInfo_succ
statement:
theorem prefixInfo_succ (S : System ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ι)
    (hω : point S (shift ω) ∈ (law S).support) :
    prefixInfo S (n+1) ω = prefixInfo S n (shift ω) + weightObs S ω - corr S (n+1) ω
proof:
:= by
  have he := BallRatios.information_component S (law S) (law_selfSimilar S) (ω 0)
    hω (abs_slope_pos S (shift ω) n)
  have hs : |slope S ω (n+1)| = |S.ratio (ω 0)| * |slope S (shift ω) n| := by
    rw [slope_shift,abs_mul]
  unfold prefixInfo weightObs corr
  rw [point_shift S ω,hs]
  exact he

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.triangle_succ
statement:
theorem triangle_succ (S : System ι) (n : ℕ) (ω : ℕ → ι) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n+1), corr S (n+1-j) (shift^[j] ω)) =
      corr S (n+1) ω + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, corr S (n-j) (shift^[j] (shift ω))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_add_right,Function.iterate_succ_apply,Function.iterate_zero_apply,
    Nat.sub_zero]
  ring

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.prefixInfo_telescope
statement:
theorem prefixInfo_telescope (S : System ι) (ω : ℕ → ι)
    (hω : ∀ j : ℕ, point S (shift^[j] ω) ∈ (law S).support) (n : ℕ) :
    prefixInfo S n ω = birkhoffSum shift (weightObs S) n ω -
      (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, corr S (n-j) (shift^[j] ω)) +
      BallRatios.information (law S) (point S (shift^[n] ω)) 1
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing ω with
  | zero => simp [prefixInfo,slope_zero,birkhoffSum]
  | succ n ih =>
    have htail : ∀ j : ℕ, point S (shift^[j] (shift ω)) ∈ (law S).support := by
      intro j
      simpa only [Function.iterate_succ_apply] using hω (j+1)
    rw [prefixInfo_succ S n ω (by simpa using hω 1),ih (shift ω) htail,
      triangle_succ,birkhoffSum_succ_apply']
    simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
    ring

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.head_integrable
statement:
theorem head_integrable (S : System ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun ω : ℕ → ι => f (ω 0)) (addressMeasure S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Integrable.of_bound ((measurable_of_finite f).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0)).aestronglyMeasurable
    (∑ i, |f i|)
  exact ae_of_all _ fun ω => by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => abs_nonneg (f i)) (Finset.mem_univ (ω 0))

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.head_integral
statement:
theorem head_integral (S : System ι) (f : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, f (ω 0) ∂addressMeasure S) = ∑ i, S.weight i * f i
proof:
:= by
  have he : (addressMeasure S).map (fun ω => ω 0) = symbolMeasure S :=
    Measure.infinitePi_map_eval _ _
  have hm := measurable_of_finite f
  rw [← integral_map (measurable_pi_apply 0).aemeasurable hm.aestronglyMeasurable,he]
  unfold symbolMeasure
  rw [integral_finsetSum_measure (fun i _ =>
    (show Integrable f (Measure.dirac i) from Integrable.of_finite).smul_measure (by simp))]
  simp only [integral_smul_measure,integral_dirac,smul_eq_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (S.weight_nonneg _)]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.ae_point_support
statement:
theorem ae_point_support (S : System ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S,
    ∀ j : ℕ, point S (shift^[j] ω) ∈ (law S).support
proof:
:= by
  apply ae_all_iff.mpr
  intro j
  have ha : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S, point S ω ∈ (law S).support :=
    ae_of_ae_map (point_measurable S).aemeasurable (law S).support_mem_ae
  exact ((show MeasurePreserving shift (addressMeasure S) (addressMeasure S) from
      shift_preserving (symbolMeasure S)).iterate j).quasiMeasurePreserving.ae ha

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.law_support_compact
statement: theorem law_support_compact (S : System ι) : IsCompact (law S).support
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B,_,hB⟩ := S.selfSimilar_compact (law S) (law_selfSimilar S)
  exact isCompact_Icc.of_isClosed_subset (law S).isClosed_support
    (Measure.support_subset_of_isClosed isClosed_Icc hB)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.Coding.ae_prefixInfo_limit
statement:
theorem ae_prefixInfo_limit (S : System ι) : ∀ᵐ ω ∂addressMeasure S,
    Tendsto (fun n => prefixInfo S n ω / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 (infoRate S))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hCb⟩ := BallRatios.information_one_bound (law S) (law_support_compact S)
  have hT : Ergodic shift (addressMeasure S) := shift_ergodic (symbolMeasure S)
  have hb := ae_tendsto_average hT
    ((measurable_of_finite (fun i => -Real.log (S.weight i))).comp (measurable_pi_apply 0))
    (head_integrable S (fun i => -Real.log (S.weight i)))
  filter_upwards [hb,ae_corr_triangle S,ae_point_support S] with ω hweight hcorr hsupp
  have hend : Tendsto (fun n => BallRatios.information (law S)
      (point S (shift^[n] ω)) 1 / (n : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    apply squeeze_zero
      (fun n => div_nonneg (BallRatios.information_nonneg _ _ _) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))
      (fun n => div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hCb _ (hsupp n)) (Nat.cast_nonneg n))
    exact tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
  have hh := (hweight.sub hcorr).add hend
  convert hh using 1
  · funext n
    rw [prefixInfo_telescope S ω hsupp,add_div,sub_div]
    rfl
  · simp only [infoRate,weightObs,add_zero,Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.exists_small_ratio_bound
statement:
theorem exists_small_ratio_bound : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞)
    (E : Set ℝ),
    (∀ x ∈ E, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 ∧ ν (closedBall x r) ≤ t*μ (closedBall x r)) →
    ν E ≤ N*t*μ univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨N,τ,hτ,hN⟩ := HasBesicovitchCovering.no_satelliteConfig (α := ℝ)
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro μ ν t E hE
  choose r hr hr1 hrat using fun x : E => hE x.val x.property
  let q : Besicovitch.BallPackage E ℝ :=
    { c := Subtype.val, r := r, rpos := hr, r_bound := 1, r_le := hr1 }
  obtain ⟨s,hd,hcover⟩ := Besicovitch.exist_disjoint_covering_families hτ hN q
  have hcnt : ∀ i, (s i).Countable := by
    intro i
    apply (hd i).countable_of_nonempty_interior
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨x.val, ball_subset_interior_closedBall (mem_ball_self (hr x))⟩
  have hb : ∀ i, ν (⋃ x ∈ s i, ball (q.c x) (q.r x)) ≤ t*μ univ := by
    intro i
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑' x : s i, ν (closedBall (q.c x.val) (q.r x.val)) := by
        apply le_trans (measure_biUnion_le ν (hcnt i) _)
        exact ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => measure_mono ball_subset_closedBall
      _ ≤ ∑' x : s i, t*μ (closedBall (q.c x.val) (q.r x.val)) :=
        ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => hrat x.val
      _ = t * μ (⋃ x ∈ s i, closedBall (q.c x) (q.r x)) := by
        rw [ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, measure_biUnion (hcnt i) (hd i)
          (fun _ _ => measurableSet_closedBall)]
      _ ≤ t*μ univ := mul_le_mul' le_rfl (measure_mono (subset_univ _))
  calc
    ν E ≤ ν (⋃ i, ⋃ x ∈ s i, ball (q.c x) (q.r x)) := by
      apply measure_mono
      intro x hx
      exact hcover ⟨⟨x,hx⟩,rfl⟩
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin N, ν (⋃ x ∈ s i, ball (q.c x) (q.r x)) :=
      measure_iUnion_fintype_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin N, t*μ univ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => hb i
    _ = N*t*μ univ := by simp [mul_assoc]

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.measurable_ball_mass
statement:
theorem measurable_ball_mass (μ : Measure ℝ) [SFinite μ] (r : ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun x : ℝ => μ (closedBall x r))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ | dist p.2 p.1 ≤ r} :=
    measurableSet_le (measurable_snd.dist measurable_fst) measurable_const
  exact measurable_measure_prodMk_left hs

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.maximal_measurable
statement:
theorem maximal_measurable (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] :
    Measurable (maximal μ ν)
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.iSup
  intro q
  exact (measurable_ball_mass μ _).div (measurable_ball_mass ν _)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.maximal_tail
statement:
theorem maximal_tail {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞) (E : Set ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ E, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 ∧ ν (closedBall x r) ≤ t*μ (closedBall x r)) →
      ν E ≤ N*t*μ univ)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (a : ℝ≥0∞) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hat : a ≠ ⊤) :
    ν {x | a < maximal μ ν x} ≤ N * a⁻¹ * μ univ
proof:
:= by
  apply hN
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ : ∃ q : Radius, a < μ (closedBall x (q.val : ℝ)) /
      ν (closedBall x (q.val : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, maximal, lt_iSup_iff] using hx
  refine ⟨q.val,q.property.1,q.property.2,?_⟩
  have hh := (ENNReal.lt_div_iff_mul_lt (Or.inr hat)
    (Or.inl (measure_ne_top ν _))).mp hq
  have := (ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le (Or.inl ha) (Or.inl hat)).mpr
    (show ν (closedBall x (q.val : ℝ)) * a ≤ μ (closedBall x (q.val : ℝ)) by
      simpa only [mul_comm] using hh.le)
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm] using this

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.maximal_finite_ae
statement:
theorem maximal_finite_ae (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂ν, maximal μ ν x ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N,hN⟩ := exists_small_ratio_bound
  apply ae_iff.mpr
  simp only [not_not]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * μ univ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh := ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul ENNReal.tendsto_nat_nhds_top.inv
      (Or.inr (show (N : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ ⊤ by simp))
    have hf := ENNReal.Tendsto.mul_const hh (Or.inr (measure_ne_top μ univ))
    simpa using hf
  apply ge_of_tendsto hlim
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop (0 : ℕ)] with n hn
  calc
    ν {x | maximal μ ν x = ⊤} ≤ ν {x | (n : ℝ≥0∞) < maximal μ ν x} := by
      apply measure_mono
      intro x (hx : maximal μ ν x = ⊤)
      change (n : ℝ≥0∞) < maximal μ ν x
      rw [hx]
      exact ENNReal.natCast_lt_top n
    _ ≤ _ := maximal_tail hN μ ν n (by exact_mod_cast hn.ne') (by simp)

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.logEnvelope_nonneg
statement: theorem logEnvelope_nonneg (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ logEnvelope μ ν x
proof:
:=
  le_max_left _ _

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.logEnvelope_measurable
statement:
theorem logEnvelope_measurable (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [SFinite μ] [SFinite ν] :
    Measurable (logEnvelope μ ν)
proof:
:=
  measurable_const.max (maximal_measurable μ ν).ennreal_toReal.log

name: OAI.EntropyRateDimension.BallRatios.logEnvelope_tail
statement:
theorem logEnvelope_tail {N : ℕ}
    (hN : ∀ (μ ν : Measure ℝ) (t : ℝ≥0∞) (E : Set ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ E, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 ∧ ν (closedBall x r) ≤ t*μ (closedBall x r)) →
      ν E ≤ N*t*μ univ)
    (μ ν : Measure ℝ) [IsFiniteMeasure ν] {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ν {x | t < logEnvelope μ ν x} ≤
      (N : ℝ≥0∞)*μ univ*ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (-t))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ν {x | ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp t) < maximal μ ν x} := by
      apply measure_mono
      intro x hx
      have hh : t < Real.log (maximal μ ν x).toReal :=
        (lt_max_iff.mp hx).resolve_left (not_lt_of_ge ht)
      have hp : 0 < (maximal μ ν x).toReal := by
        apply lt_of_le_of_ne ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
        intro he
        simp [← he] at hh
        linarith
      have he := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hp).mp hh
      exact ((ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff hp).mpr he).trans_le ENNReal.ofReal_toReal_le
