name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceInner_runs
statement:
lemma reduceInner_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (a : Bool)
    (d : Data) (xs bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceInner
   (st (reduceControl p r a) none
     {d with mat := r.tail.entries.map some ++ none::xs,back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (reduceControl p r a) none
     {d with mat := xs,back := ((reducedRow p r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (4*(n+1)+10)
proof:
:= by
 cases p with
 | none =>
   let c := reduceControl none r a
   have hm := moveRow_runs Reg.mat Reg.back (by decide) (fun (_ : Local) a => a)
     (none,c) none ({d with piv := [],pivBack := []}).tapes r.tail.entries xs bs
   have hm' : Runs (moveRow Reg.mat Reg.back (fun (_ : Local) a => a))
     (st c none {d with mat := r.tail.entries.map some ++ none::xs,back := bs,piv := [],pivBack := []})
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := (r.tail.entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := [],pivBack := []})
     (2*(n+1)+5) := by simpa [st] using hm
   have hc := Runs.cond_true (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.2.2.pivot == 0)
     (b := zipRow Reg.mat Reg.back Reg.piv Reg.pivBack (fun (c : Control) x y => x-c.factor*y))
     (by simp [st,state,c,reduceControl,pivotHead]) hm'
   have hr := moveRev_runs Reg.pivBack Reg.piv (by decide) (fun (_ : Local) a => a)
     (none,c) none ({d with mat := xs,back := (r.tail.entries.map some).reverse ++ bs}).tapes [] []
   have hr' : Runs (moveRev Reg.pivBack Reg.piv (fun (_ : Local) a => a))
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := (r.tail.entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := [],pivBack := []})
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := (r.tail.entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := [],pivBack := []}) 3 := by
     simpa [st,Function.comp_def] using hr
   exact (hc.seq hr').mono (by omega)
 | some p =>
   let c := reduceControl (some p) r a
   have hm := zipRow_runs Reg.mat Reg.back Reg.piv Reg.pivBack
     (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
     (fun (c : Control) x y => x-c.factor*y) c none d.tapes r.tail.entries p.tail.entries
     (by simp) xs bs []
   have hm' : Runs (zipRow Reg.mat Reg.back Reg.piv Reg.pivBack (fun (c : Control) x y => x-c.factor*y))
     (st c none {d with mat := r.tail.entries.map some ++ none::xs,back := bs,piv := p.tail.entries.map some,pivBack := []})
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := ((p.reduce r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := [],pivBack := (p.tail.entries.map some).reverse}) (2*(n+1)+5) := by
     simpa [st,c,reduceControl,pivotHead,entries_reduce] using hm
   have hc := Runs.cond_false (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.2.2.pivot == 0)
     (a := moveRow Reg.mat Reg.back (fun (_ : Local) a => a))
     (by simpa [st,state,c,reduceControl,pivotHead] using hp p (by simp)) hm'
   have hr := moveRev_runs Reg.pivBack Reg.piv (by decide) (fun (_ : Local) a => a)
     (none,c) none ({d with mat := xs,back := ((p.reduce r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs}).tapes
     (p.tail.entries.map some).reverse []
   have hr' : Runs (moveRev Reg.pivBack Reg.piv (fun (_ : Local) a => a))
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := ((p.reduce r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := [],pivBack := (p.tail.entries.map some).reverse})
     (st c none {d with mat := xs,back := ((p.reduce r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := p.tail.entries.map some,pivBack := []}) (2*(n+1)+3) := by
     simpa [st,Function.comp_def] using hr
   convert hc.seq hr' using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceBody_runs
statement:
lemma reduceBody_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (r : SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)) (rs) (a : Bool)
    (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data) (bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceBody
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) buf
     {d with mat := payload (r::rs),back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := (payload [reducedRow p r]).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (4*(n+1)+14)
proof:
:= by
 have ho : Runs (.atom (.pop .mat (fun (c : Option Letter × Local) a =>
       (none,(none,{c.2.2 with factor := (a.bind id).getD 0/c.2.2.pivot}))) .done))
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) buf
       {d with mat := payload (r::rs),back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
     (st (reduceControl p r a) none
       {d with mat := r.tail.entries.map some ++ none::payload rs,back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes,payload_cons,entries_head_tail,ctrl,reduceControl]
 have hi := reduceInner_runs p hp r a d (payload rs) bs
 have hf : Runs (.atom (.push .back (fun _ : Option Letter × Local => none)
       (.peek .mat (fun (c : Option Letter × Local) a => (a,(none,{c.2.2 with factor := 0}))) .done)))
     (st (reduceControl p r a) none
       {d with mat := payload rs,back := ((reducedRow p r).entries.map some).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head?
       {d with mat := payload rs,back := (payload [reducedRow p r]).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes,payload,SerialGaussian.Row.entries,ctrl,reduceControl,List.reverse_append]
 convert ho.seq (hi.seq hf) using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.payload_append
statement:
lemma payload_append {n} (xs ys : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 payload (xs++ys) = payload xs ++ payload ys
proof: := by simp [payload]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceLoop_runs
statement:
lemma reduceLoop_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (a : Bool) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) (bs : List Letter) :
 Runs reduceLoop
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) none
     {d with mat := [],back := (payload (rs.map (reducedRow p))).reverse ++ bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   ((4*(n+1)+15)*rs.length+1)
proof:
:= by
 induction rs generalizing bs with
 | nil => simpa [payload,reduceLoop] using
     (Runs.loop_false (b := reduceBody) (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.1.isSome)
       (s := st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) none {d with mat := [],back := bs,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []}) rfl)
 | cons r rs ih =>
   have hb := reduceBody_runs p hp r rs a (payload (r::rs)).head? d bs
   have ht := ih ((payload [reducedRow p r]).reverse ++ bs)
   have h := Runs.loop_true (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.1.isSome)
     (by simp [st,state,payload_head]) hb ht
   convert h using 1 <;>
     simp [reduceLoop,payload,List.map_cons,List.reverse_append,List.append_assoc] ; ring

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.reduceMatrix_runs
statement:
lemma reduceMatrix_runs {n} (p : Option (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1)))
    (hp : ∀ q ∈ p, q.head ≠ 0) (a : Bool) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs reduceMatrix
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) buf
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) none
     {d with mat := [],back := (payload (rs.map (reducedRow p))).reverse,piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
   ((4*(n+1)+15)*rs.length+3)
proof:
:= by
 have hpeek : Runs (peek Reg.mat)
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []})
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) a) (payload rs).head? {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],piv := pivotTail p,pivBack := []}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes]
 have h := hpeek.seq (reduceLoop_runs p hp a d rs [])
 have h' := h.mono (show 1+(1+((4*(n+1)+15)*rs.length+1)) ≤ (4*(n+1)+15)*rs.length+3 by omega)
 simpa only [List.append_nil,reduceMatrix] using h'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.nextRows_length
statement:
@[simp] lemma nextRows_length {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 (nextRows rs).length = rs.length
proof: := by simp [nextRows]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.pivot_nonzero
statement:
lemma pivot_nonzero {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 ∀ q ∈ pivot rs, q.head ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
 intro q hq
 have h := List.find?_some hq
 simpa [pivot,← Row.head_decode] using h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solve_next
statement:
lemma solve_next {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 solve rs = solve (nextRows rs)
proof:
:= by
 cases hp : pivot rs <;> simp only [solve,nextRows,hp] <;> rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminate_runs
statement:
lemma eliminate_runs {n} (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) :
 Runs eliminate
   (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 c.answer) none
     {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []})
   (100*(rs.length+1)*(n+3))
proof:
:= by
 let d' : Data := {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := []}
 let p := pivot rs
 have hf := findPivot_runs c buf d rs
 have hr := reduceMatrix_runs p (pivot_nonzero rs) c.answer none d' rs
 have hm := moveRev_runs Reg.back Reg.mat (by decide) (fun (_ : Local) a => a)
   (none,ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none ({d' with piv := pivotTail p}).tapes
   (payload (nextRows rs)).reverse []
 have hm' : Runs (moveRev Reg.back Reg.mat (fun (_ : Local) a => a))
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none {d' with mat := [],back := (payload (nextRows rs)).reverse,piv := pivotTail p})
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none {d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs),piv := pivotTail p})
     (2*(payload (nextRows rs)).length+3) := by simpa [st,d',Function.comp_def] using hm
 have hc := clear_runs (σ := Local) Reg.piv (none,ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none
   ({d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs)}).tapes (pivotTail p)
 have hc' : Runs (clear Reg.piv)
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none {d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs),piv := pivotTail p})
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none {d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs)})
     (2*(pivotTail p).length+3) := by simpa [st,d'] using hc
 have hl : Runs (.atom (.load (fun c : Option Letter × Local =>
       (none,(none,ctrl 0 c.2.2.answer))) .done))
     (st (ctrl (pivotHead p) c.answer) none {d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs)})
     (st (ctrl 0 c.answer) none {d' with mat := payload (nextRows rs)}) 1 := Runs.atom_of _ _ _ rfl
 have h := hf.seq (hr.seq (hm'.seq (hc'.seq hl)))
 apply h.mono
 rw [payload_length,nextRows_length]
 have ht := pivotTail_length p
 nlinarith

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.normal_length
statement:
@[simp] lemma normal_length {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 (normal rs).length = rs.length
proof:
:= by
 induction n with
 | zero => rfl
 | succ n ih => simpa [normal] using ih (nextRows rs)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solve_normal
statement: lemma solve_normal {n} (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) : solve (normal rs) = solve rs
proof:
:= by
 induction n with
 | zero => rfl
 | succ n ih => rw [normal,ih,← solve_next]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminationBody_runs
statement:
lemma eliminationBody_runs {n} (a : Bool) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data)
    (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row (n+1))) (ws : List Letter) :
 Runs eliminationBody
   (st (ctrl 0 a) buf {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := none::ws})
   (st (ctrl 0 a) ws.head?
     {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := ws})
   (100*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)+2)
proof:
:= by
 have he := eliminate_runs (ctrl 0 a) buf {d with width := none::ws} rs
 have hp : Runs (.atom (.pop .width (fun c : Option Letter × Local => fun _ => c)
       (.peek .width (fun (c : Option Letter × Local) a => (a,c.2)) .done)))
     (st (ctrl 0 a) none {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := none::ws})
     (st (ctrl 0 a) ws.head? {d with mat := payload (nextRows rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := ws}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes]
 convert he.seq hp using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.eliminationLoop_runs
statement:
lemma eliminationLoop_runs {n} (a : Bool) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 Runs eliminationLoop
   (st (ctrl 0 a) (List.replicate n (none : Letter)).head?
     {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := List.replicate n none})
   (st (ctrl 0 a) none
     {d with mat := payload (normal rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := []})
   (200*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)
proof:
:= by
 induction n with
 | zero =>
   apply (Runs.loop_false rfl).mono
   norm_num
   omega
 | succ n ih =>
   have hb := eliminationBody_runs a (List.replicate (n+1) (none : Letter)).head? d rs
     (List.replicate n none)
   have ht := ih (nextRows rs)
   have h := Runs.loop_true (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.1.isSome)
     (by simp [st,state,List.replicate_succ]) hb ht
   have h' : Runs eliminationLoop
       (st (ctrl 0 a) (List.replicate (n+1) (none : Letter)).head?
         {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := List.replicate (n+1) none})
       (st (ctrl 0 a) none
         {d with mat := payload (normal rs),back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := []})
       (1+(100*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)+2+200*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)) := by
     simpa only [eliminationLoop,List.replicate_succ,normal,nextRows_length] using h
   exact h'.mono (by nlinarith)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.payload_zero_cons
statement:
lemma payload_zero_cons (r : SerialGaussian.Row 0) (rs) :
 payload (r::rs) = some r.rhs :: none :: payload rs
proof:
:= by
 have hc : r.coeff = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero r.length_eq
 simp [payload, hc]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.zeroLoop_runs
statement:
lemma zeroLoop_runs (a : Bool) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row 0)) :
 Runs zeroLoop (st (ctrl 0 a) (payload rs).head? {d with mat := payload rs})
   (st (ctrl 0 (a && solve rs)) none {d with mat := []}) (2*rs.length+1)
proof:
:= by
 induction rs generalizing a with
 | nil => simpa [zeroLoop,solve,payload,ctrl] using
     (Runs.loop_false (b := zeroBody) (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.1.isSome)
       (s := st (ctrl 0 a) none {d with mat := []}) rfl)
 | cons r rs ih =>
   have hb : Runs zeroBody (st (ctrl 0 a) (payload (r::rs)).head? {d with mat := payload (r::rs)})
       (st (ctrl 0 (a && (r.rhs == 0))) (payload rs).head? {d with mat := payload rs}) 1 := by
     apply Runs.atom_of
     simp [Action.run,st,state,ctrl,Data.tapes,payload_zero_cons]
   have h := Runs.loop_true (f := fun c : Option Letter × Local => c.1.isSome)
     (by simp [st,state,payload_zero_cons]) hb (ih (a && (r.rhs == 0)))
   convert h using 1 <;> simp [zeroLoop,solve,Bool.and_assoc] ; omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.checkZero_runs
statement:
lemma checkZero_runs (c : Control) (buf : Option Letter) (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row 0)) :
 Runs checkZero (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,output := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)}) (2*rs.length+5)
proof:
:= by
 have hi : Runs (.atom (.load (fun _ : Option Letter × Local => (none,(none,ctrl 0 true)))
       (.peek .mat (fun (c : Option Letter × Local) a => (a,c.2)) .done)))
     (st c buf {d with mat := payload rs,output := []})
     (st (ctrl 0 true) (payload rs).head? {d with mat := payload rs,output := []}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes]
 have hz := zeroLoop_runs true {d with output := []} rs
 have ho : Runs (.atom (.push .output (fun c : Option Letter × Local =>
       some (if c.2.2.answer then 1 else 0)) .done))
     (st (ctrl 0 (true && solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],output := []})
     (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   simp [Action.run,st,state,Data.tapes,ctrl,boolCode]
 convert hi.seq (hz.seq ho) using 1 <;> first | rfl | omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.GaussMachine.solver_runs
statement:
lemma solver_runs {n} (d : Data) (rs : List (SerialGaussian.Row n)) :
 Runs solver
   (st (ctrl 0 true) none {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := List.replicate n none,output := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)})
   (300*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2)
proof:
:= by
 have hp : Runs (peek .width)
     (st (ctrl 0 true) none {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := List.replicate n none,output := []})
     (st (ctrl 0 true) (List.replicate n (none : Letter)).head?
       {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := List.replicate n none,output := []}) 1 := by
   apply Runs.atom_of
   rfl
 have he := eliminationLoop_runs true {d with output := []} rs
 have hz := checkZero_runs (ctrl 0 true) none
     {d with back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [],width := []}
     (normal rs)
 have h := hp.seq (he.seq hz)
 have h' : Runs solver
   (st (ctrl 0 true) none {d with mat := payload rs,back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := List.replicate n none,output := []})
   (st (ctrl 0 (solve rs)) none {d with mat := [],back := [],scan := [],piv := [],pivBack := [], width := [],output := boolCode (solve rs)})
   (1+(1+(1+(200*(rs.length+1)*(n+3)^2+(2*rs.length+5))))) := by
   simpa only [solver,solve_normal,normal_length] using h
 exact h'.mono (by
   have hs : 1 ≤ (n+3)^2 := Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr (pow_pos (by omega) 2)
   have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (rs.length+1) hs
   nlinarith)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.satisfies_cons
statement:
lemma satisfies_cons {n} (r : Row (n+1)) (x : Scalar) (v : Fin n → Scalar) :
    r.satisfies (Fin.cons x v) ↔
      r.coeff 0*x + (∑ i, r.coeff i.succ * v i) = r.rhs
proof:
:= by
  simp [satisfies,Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.tail_iff
statement:
lemma tail_iff {n} (r : Row (n+1)) (h : r.coeff 0 = 0) (x : Scalar) (v : Fin n → Scalar) :
    r.satisfies (Fin.cons x v) ↔ r.tail.satisfies v
proof:
:= by
  rw [satisfies_cons,h]
  simp [satisfies,tail]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.pivot_solution
statement:
lemma pivot_solution {n} (p : Row (n+1)) (hp : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0) (v : Fin n → Scalar) :
    p.satisfies (Fin.cons ((p.rhs - ∑ i, p.coeff i.succ * v i)/p.coeff 0) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [satisfies_cons]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.reduce_iff
statement:
lemma reduce_iff {n} (p r : Row (n+1)) (hp : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0)
    (x : Scalar) (v : Fin n → Scalar) (hpx : p.satisfies (Fin.cons x v)) :
    r.satisfies (Fin.cons x v) ↔ (p.reduce r).satisfies v
proof:
:= by
  rw [satisfies_cons] at hpx ⊢
  simp only [satisfies,reduce,sub_mul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    mul_assoc,← Finset.mul_sum]
  have h : (r.coeff 0 / p.coeff 0)*p.coeff 0 = r.coeff 0 := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp
  have heq : r.coeff 0*x + ∑ i, r.coeff i.succ*v i - r.rhs =
      (∑ i, r.coeff i.succ*v i) - (r.coeff 0/p.coeff 0)*(∑ i, p.coeff i.succ*v i) -
        (r.rhs-(r.coeff 0/p.coeff 0)*p.rhs) := by
    rw [← hpx]
    linear_combination -(x*h)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.symm.trans (iff_of_eq (congrArg (fun z => z = 0) heq))).trans sub_eq_zero

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.pivot_some
statement:
lemma pivot_some {n} {rows : List (Row (n+1))} {p : Row (n+1)} (h : pivot rows = some p) :
    p ∈ rows ∧ p.coeff 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h, by simpa using List.find?_some h⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.pivot_none
statement:
lemma pivot_none {n} {rows : List (Row (n+1))} (h : pivot rows = none) :
    ∀ r ∈ rows, r.coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pivot,List.find?_eq_none] using h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.solvable_tail
statement:
lemma solvable_tail {n} {rows : List (Row (n+1))} (h : pivot rows = none) :
    Solvable rows ↔ Solvable (rows.map Row.tail)
proof:
:= by
  have hz := pivot_none h
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => v i.succ,?_⟩
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
    have hv' : Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i => v i.succ) = v := by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> rfl
    exact (Row.tail_iff s (hz s hs) (v 0) _).mp (hv' ▸ hv s hs)
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    refine ⟨Fin.cons 0 v,?_⟩
    intro r hr
    exact (Row.tail_iff r (hz r hr) 0 v).mpr (hv _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hr))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.solvable_reduce
statement:
lemma solvable_reduce {n} {rows : List (Row (n+1))} {p : Row (n+1)}
    (h : pivot rows = some p) : Solvable rows ↔ Solvable (rows.map (Row.reduce p))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hpm,hp⟩ := pivot_some h
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    have hv' : Fin.cons (v 0) (fun i => v i.succ) = v := by ext i; cases i using Fin.cases <;> rfl
    refine ⟨fun i => v i.succ,?_⟩
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨s,hs,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hr
    exact (Row.reduce_iff p s hp (v 0) _ (hv' ▸ hv p hpm)).mp (hv' ▸ hv s hs)
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    let x := (p.rhs - ∑ i, p.coeff i.succ * v i)/p.coeff 0
    refine ⟨Fin.cons x v,?_⟩
    intro r hr
    exact (Row.reduce_iff p r hp x v (Row.pivot_solution p hp v)).mpr
      (hv _ (List.mem_map_of_mem hr))

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.solve_correct
statement: theorem solve_correct {n} (rows : List (Row n)) : solve rows = true ↔ Solvable rows
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    simp only [solve,List.all_eq_true,beq_iff_eq]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨Fin.elim0,fun r hr => by simpa [Row.satisfies] using (h r hr).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩ r hr
      simpa [Row.satisfies] using (hv r hr).symm
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hp : pivot rows with
    | none => simpa only [solve,hp] using (ih (rows.map Row.tail)).trans (solvable_tail hp).symm
    | some p => simpa only [solve,hp] using (ih (rows.map (Row.reduce p))).trans (solvable_reduce hp).symm

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.dense_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma dense_eq {n} (r : Row n) : r.dense = r
proof:
:= by
  cases r
  simp only [dense]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact Vector.get_ofFn _ i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.Row.reduceDense_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma reduceDense_eq {n} (p r : Row (n+1)) : p.reduceDense r = p.reduce r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [reduceDense,reduce]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact Vector.get_ofFn _ i

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.metered_answer
statement: @[simp] theorem metered_answer {n} (rows : List (Row n)) : (metered rows).1 = solve rows
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hp : pivot rows with
    | none => simp [metered,solve,hp,ih]
    | some p =>
      have he : p.reduceDense = p.reduce := funext (fun r => Row.reduceDense_eq p r)
      simp [metered,solve,hp,ih,he]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.metered_bound
statement:
theorem metered_bound {n} (rows : List (Row n)) :
    (metered rows).2 ≤ 12*(rows.length+1)*(n+1)^2
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [metered]; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have hpoly : 12*(rows.length+1)*(n+1)^2+(8*n+12)*rows.length+2 ≤
        12*(rows.length+1)*(n+1+1)^2 := by nlinarith
    cases hp : pivot rows with
    | none =>
      have hi := ih (rows.map (fun (r : Row (n+1)) => r.tail.dense))
      simp only [List.length_map] at hi
      simp only [metered,hp]
      omega
    | some p =>
      have hi := ih (rows.map (Row.reduceDense p))
      simp only [List.length_map] at hi
      simp only [metered,hp]
      omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Gaussian.metered_correct
statement:
theorem metered_correct {n} (rows : List (Row n)) :
    (metered rows).1 = true ↔ Solvable rows
proof: := by rw [metered_answer,solve_correct]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.sum_subtype
statement:
lemma sum_subtype {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : A → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (f : A → Scalar) : (∑ a, if p a then f a else 0) = ∑ a : {a // p a}, f a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  exact Finset.sum_subtype _ (by simp) f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.coefficient_eq
statement:
lemma coefficient_eq (S : Data N) (y : S.Edge) (a : S.Config) :
    coefficient S y a = S.coefficient y a
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficient Input.coefficient
  rw [← sum_subtype (fun x => S.rel .Ed x x = true) (fun x => if S.rel .I a x then ∑ δ : Scalar, if S.rel (.Z δ) y x then δ else 0 else 0)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  by_cases h : S.rel .Ed x x = true <;> by_cases h' : S.rel .I a x = true <;> simp [h,h']

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.incident_eq
statement:
lemma incident_eq (S : Data N) (t : S.Config) (y : S.Edge) :
    incident S t y = true ↔ S.incident t y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [incident,List.any_eq_true,Bool.and_eq_true,List.mem_finRange,true_and,
    Input.incident]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,⟨ha,hva⟩,x,⟨hx,hix⟩,hby⟩
    exact ⟨⟨a,ha⟩,hva,⟨x,hx⟩,hix,hby⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,hva,x,hix,hby⟩
    exact ⟨a,⟨a.property,hva⟩,x,⟨x.property,hix⟩,hby⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.row_zero
statement:
lemma row_zero (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :
    (⟨fun _ => 0,0⟩ : Gaussian.Row (N+N)).satisfies v
proof: := by simp [Gaussian.Row.satisfies]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.normalization_satisfies
statement:
lemma normalization_satisfies (S : Data N) (t : Fin N) (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :
    (normalizationRow S t).satisfies v ↔
      S.rel .Cf t t = true →
        (∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a else 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : S.rel .Cf t t = true
  · simp only [normalizationRow,ht,ite_true,Gaussian.Row.satisfies,Fin.sum_univ_add,
      Fin.addCases_left,Fin.addCases_right,zero_mul,Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero,
      true_implies]
    have heq : (∑ a : Fin N, (if S.rel .Cf a a && S.rel .VB t a then (1:Scalar) else 0) * left v a) =
        ∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a else 0 := by
      rw [← sum_subtype (fun a => S.rel .Cf a a = true) (fun a => if S.rel .VB t a then left v a else 0)]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      by_cases ha : S.rel .Cf a a = true <;> by_cases hv : S.rel .VB t a = true <;> simp [ha,hv]
    exact (congrArg (fun z => z = 1) heq).to_iff
  · simp [normalizationRow,ht,Gaussian.Row.satisfies]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.consistency_satisfies
statement:
lemma consistency_satisfies (S : Data N) (t y : Fin N) (v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar) :
    (consistencyRow S t y).satisfies v ↔
      ∀ (ht : S.rel .Cf t t = true) (hy : S.rel .Ed y y = true),
        S.incident ⟨t,ht⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩ →
        right v y = ∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a*S.coefficient ⟨y,hy⟩ a else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : S.rel .Cf t t = true
  · by_cases hy : S.rel .Ed y y = true
    · have hi := incident_eq S ⟨t,ht⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩
      by_cases hin : incident S t y = true
      · simp only [consistencyRow,ht,hy,hin,Bool.true_and,ite_true,
          Gaussian.Row.satisfies,Fin.sum_univ_add,Fin.addCases_left,Fin.addCases_right]
        have hr : (∑ z : Fin N, (if z = y then (1:Scalar) else 0)*right v z) = right v y := by
          simp
        have hl : (∑ a : Fin N, (if S.rel .Cf a a && S.rel .VB t a then -coefficient S y a else 0)*left v a) =
            -(∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then left v a*S.coefficient ⟨y,hy⟩ a else 0) := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
          trans ∑ a : S.Config, (if S.rel .VB t a then -coefficient S y a else 0)*left v a
          · rw [← sum_subtype (fun a => S.rel .Cf a a = true) (fun a => (if S.rel .VB t a then -coefficient S y a else 0)*left v a)]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro a _
            by_cases ha : S.rel .Cf a a = true <;> by_cases hv : S.rel .VB t a = true <;> simp [ha,hv]
          · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro a _
            rw [coefficient_eq S ⟨y,hy⟩ a]
            by_cases hv : S.rel .VB t a = true <;> simp [hv,mul_comm]
        change (_ + _ = 0) ↔ _
        rw [show (∑ i : Fin N, (if i = y then (1:Scalar) else 0) * v (Fin.natAdd N i)) = right v y from hr]
        rw [show (∑ i : Fin N, (if S.rel .Cf i i && S.rel .VB t i then -coefficient S y i else 0) * v (Fin.castAdd N i)) = _ from hl]
        constructor
        · intro h _ _ _
          linear_combination h
        · intro h
          have hh := h True.intro True.intro (hi.mp hin)
          linear_combination hh
      · have hni : ¬ S.incident ⟨t,ht⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩ := fun h => hin (hi.mpr h)
        simp only [consistencyRow,ht,hy,Bool.true_and,hin,true_implies,hni,false_implies,iff_true]
        exact row_zero v
    · simp [consistencyRow,hy,Gaussian.Row.satisfies]
  · simp [consistencyRow,ht,Gaussian.Row.satisfies]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.norm_mem
statement: lemma norm_mem (S : Data N) (t : Fin N) : normalizationRow S t ∈ rows S
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_append_left
  exact List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_finRange t)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.consistency_mem
statement: lemma consistency_mem (S : Data N) (t y : Fin N) : consistencyRow S t y ∈ rows S
proof:
:= by
  apply List.mem_append_right
  exact List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨t,List.mem_finRange t,List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_finRange y)⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.rows_solvable_iff
statement: theorem rows_solvable_iff (S : Data N) : Gaussian.Solvable (rows S) ↔ S.query
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    refine ⟨fun a => left v a,fun y => right v y,?_,?_⟩
    · intro t
      exact (normalization_satisfies S t v).mp (hv _ (norm_mem S t)) t.property
    · intro t y hinc
      exact (consistency_satisfies S t y v).mp (hv _ (consistency_mem S t y)) t.property y.property hinc
  · rintro ⟨lam,mu,hnorm,hcons⟩
    let l : Fin N → Scalar := fun a => if ha : S.rel .Cf a a = true then lam ⟨a,ha⟩ else 0
    let r : Fin N → Scalar := fun y => if hy : S.rel .Ed y y = true then mu ⟨y,hy⟩ else 0
    let v : Fin (N+N) → Scalar := Fin.addCases l r
    have hl (a : S.Config) : left v a = lam a := by simp [left,v,l,a.property]
    have hr (y : S.Edge) : right v y = mu y := by
      simp only [right,v,Fin.addCases_right]
      simp only [r,dite_eq_left y.property]
    refine ⟨v,?_⟩
    intro row hrow
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hrow with hrow | hrow
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hrow
      apply (normalization_satisfies S t v).mpr
      intro ht
      simpa only [hl] using hnorm ⟨t,ht⟩
    · obtain ⟨t,ht,hrow⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp hrow
      obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hrow
      apply (consistency_satisfies S t y v).mpr
      intro ht hy hi
      rw [show right v y = mu ⟨y,hy⟩ from hr ⟨y,hy⟩]
      simpa only [hl] using hcons ⟨t,ht⟩ ⟨y,hy⟩ hi

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.decideQuery_correct
statement: theorem decideQuery_correct (S : Data N) : decideQuery S = true ↔ S.query
proof:
:= by
  simp only [decideQuery,Gaussian.metered_answer,Gaussian.solve_correct]
  have he : (rows S).map Gaussian.Row.dense = rows S := by
    have hf : Gaussian.Row.dense (n := N+N) = id := funext Gaussian.Row.dense_eq
    rw [hf,List.map_id]
  rw [he,rows_solvable_iff]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.rows_length
statement: theorem rows_length (S : Data N) : (rows S).length = N+N*N
proof:
:= by
  simp [rows,List.length_flatMap]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.elimination_operations
statement:
theorem elimination_operations (S : Data N) :
    (Gaussian.metered ((rows S).map Gaussian.Row.dense)).2 ≤ 96*(N+1)^4
proof:
:= by
  have h := Gaussian.metered_bound ((rows S).map Gaussian.Row.dense)
  simp only [List.length_map,rows_length] at h
  have hr : N+N*N+1 ≤ 2*(N+1)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hc : N+N+1 ≤ 2*(N+1) := by omega
  calc
    _ ≤ 12*(N+N*N+1)*(N+N+1)^2 := h
    _ ≤ 12*(2*(N+1)^2)*(2*(N+1))^2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 12 hr) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hc 2)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.Row.decode_encode
statement: @[simp] theorem Row.decode_encode {n} (r : Gaussian.Row n) : (Row.encode r).decode = r
proof:
:= by
  cases r
  simp only [Row.encode,Row.decode,List.getElem_ofFn]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.Row.head_decode
statement: @[simp] theorem Row.head_decode {n} (r : Row (n+1)) : r.head = r.decode.coeff 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with ⟨l,h,b⟩
  cases l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a l => rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.Row.decode_tail
statement: @[simp] theorem Row.decode_tail {n} (r : Row (n+1)) : r.tail.decode = r.decode.tail
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg₂ Gaussian.Row.mk
  · funext i
    simp [Row.decode,Row.tail]
  · rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.Row.decode_reduce
statement:
@[simp] theorem Row.decode_reduce {n} (p r : Row (n+1)) :
    (p.reduce r).decode = p.decode.reduce r.decode
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg₂ Gaussian.Row.mk
  · funext i
    simp [Row.decode,Row.reduce,List.getElem_zipWith,Row.head_decode]
  · simp [Row.decode,Row.reduce,Row.head_decode]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.pivot_decode
statement:
@[simp] theorem pivot_decode {n} (rows : List (Row (n+1))) :
    Gaussian.pivot (rows.map Row.decode) = (pivot rows).map Row.decode
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Gaussian.pivot,pivot,List.find?_map]
  congr 2
  funext r
  simp []

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.solve_decode
statement:
theorem solve_decode {n} (rows : List (Row n)) :
    solve rows = Gaussian.solve (rows.map Row.decode)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [solve,Gaussian.solve,Row.decode,Function.comp_def]
  | succ n ih =>
    cases hp : pivot rows with
    | none => simp [solve,Gaussian.solve,pivot_decode,hp,ih,List.map_map,Function.comp_def]
    | some p => simp [solve,Gaussian.solve,pivot_decode,hp,ih,List.map_map,Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.payload_length
statement:
theorem payload_length {n} (rows : List (Row n)) :
    (payload rows).length = rows.length*(n+2)
proof:
:= by
  induction rows with
  | nil => simp [payload]
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [payload,List.flatMap_cons,List.length_append,List.length_map,
      r.length_eq,List.length_cons,List.length_nil] at *
    rw [Nat.add_mul]
    omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.queryRows_correct
statement:
theorem queryRows_correct {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
    solve (queryRows S) = true ↔ S.query
proof:
:= by
  rw [solve_decode]
  have hd : Gaussian.Row.dense (n := N+N) = id := funext Gaussian.Row.dense_eq
  simpa [queryRows,List.map_map,Function.comp_def,OrderedQuery.decideQuery,
    Gaussian.metered_answer,hd] using OrderedQuery.decideQuery_correct S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.query_payload_size
statement:
theorem query_payload_size {N} (S : OrderedQuery.Data N) :
    (payload (queryRows S)).length ≤ 2*(N+1)^3
proof:
:= by
  rw [payload_length]
  simp only [queryRows,List.length_map,OrderedQuery.rows_length]
  have he : (N+N*N)*(N+N+2) = 2*N*(N+1)^2 := by ring
  rw [he]
  calc
    2*N*(N+1)^2 ≤ 2*(N+1)*(N+1)^2 := by gcongr; omega
    _ = 2*(N+1)^3 := by ring

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.reduce_payload_size
statement:
theorem reduce_payload_size {n} (p : Row (n+1)) (rows : List (Row (n+1))) :
    (payload (rows.map (Row.reduce p))).length ≤ (payload rows).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [payload_length,List.length_map]
  gcongr
  omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.SerialGaussian.tail_payload_size
statement:
theorem tail_payload_size {n} (rows : List (Row (n+1))) :
    (payload (rows.map Row.tail)).length ≤ (payload rows).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [payload_length,List.length_map]
  gcongr
  omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.indexSymbol_symbolIndex
statement: @[simp] theorem indexSymbol_symbolIndex (r : Symbol) : indexSymbol (symbolIndex r) = r
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | Ed => decide
  | Cf => decide
  | EB => decide
  | VB => decide
  | I => decide
  | Z δ => fin_cases δ <;> decide

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.symbolIndex_indexSymbol
statement: @[simp] theorem symbolIndex_indexSymbol (i : Fin 8) : symbolIndex (indexSymbol i) = i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.cellValue_index
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellValue_index (S : Data N) (r : Symbol) (a b : Fin N) :
    cellValue S (cellIndex r a b) = S.rel r a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [cellValue,cellIndex]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.tableDecode_tableBits
statement: @[simp] theorem tableDecode_tableBits (S : Data N) : tableDecode N (tableBits S) = S
proof:
:= by
  cases S with
  | mk rel =>
    apply congrArg Input.mk
    funext r a b
    simp [tableBits,cellValue_index]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.tableBits_length
statement: @[simp] theorem tableBits_length (S : Data N) : (tableBits S).length = 8*(N*N)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tableBits]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.encode_size
statement: @[simp] theorem encode_size (S : OrderedInput) : (encode S).count none = S.1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encode,List.count_append,List.count_replicate,List.count_cons]
  have h : List.count none ((tableBits S.2).map some) = 0 :=
    List.count_eq_zero_of_not_mem (by simp)
  simp [h]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.decode_encode
statement: @[simp] theorem decode_encode (S : OrderedInput) : decode (encode S) = S
proof:
:= by
  rcases S with ⟨N,S⟩
  have htail : (encode ⟨N,S⟩).drop (N+1) = (tableBits S).map some := by
    simp [encode,List.drop_append]
  unfold decode
  rw [encode_size]
  change (⟨N,tableDecode N _⟩ : OrderedInput) = ⟨N,S⟩
  apply congrArg (Sigma.mk N)
  rw [htail,List.map_map]
  change tableDecode N ((tableBits S).map id) = S
  rw [List.map_id]
  exact tableDecode_tableBits S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.encode_injective
statement: theorem encode_injective : Function.Injective encode
proof:
:= by
  intro S T h
  simpa only [decode_encode] using congrArg decode h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.encode_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem encode_length (S : OrderedInput) :
    (encode S).length = S.1+1+8*(S.1*S.1)
proof: := by simp [encode]; omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.OrderedQuery.answer_correct
statement: theorem answer_correct (S : OrderedInput) : answer S = true ↔ S.2.query
proof:
:=
  decideQuery_correct S.2

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_single
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_single {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (l : ι → Scalar) (e : ι) (z : Scalar) : pairing l (Pi.single e z) = l e * z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ j, l j * (Pi.single e z : ι → Scalar) j) = _
  simp only [Pi.single_apply, mul_ite, mul_zero]
  simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_boundary
statement:
theorem pairing_boundary (φ : Vertex n → Scalar) (z : Edge n → Scalar) :
    pairing φ (boundary z) = pairing (gradient φ) z
proof:
:= by
  have hb : boundary z = ∑ e : Edge n, z e •
      ((Pi.single (head e) (1 : Scalar) : Vertex n → Scalar) - Pi.single (tail e) 1) := rfl
  rw [hb]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, map_sub, pairing_single, mul_one, smul_eq_mul]
  change (∑ e, z e * (φ (head e) - φ (tail e))) =
    ∑ e, (φ (head e) - φ (tail e)) * z e
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  ring

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_gradient_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_gradient_flow (φ : Vertex n → Scalar) (k : FlowSpace n) :
    pairing (gradient φ) k.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pairing_boundary, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp k.property, map_zero]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.pairing_sub
statement:
theorem pairing_sub {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (l r z : ι → Scalar) :
    pairing (l-r) z = pairing l z - pairing r z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairing, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Pi.sub_apply,
    sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_representative
statement:
theorem exists_representative (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar) :
    ∃ l : Edge n → Scalar, ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend lambda
  let l : Edge n → Scalar := fun e => g (Pi.single e 1)
  have hrep (z : Edge n → Scalar) : g z = pairing l z := by
    have hz : (∑ e : Edge n, z e • Pi.single e (1 : Scalar)) = z := by
      classical
      ext e
      simp [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.single_apply]
    calc
      g z = g (∑ e : Edge n, z e • Pi.single e (1 : Scalar)) := congrArg g hz.symm
      _ = ∑ e, z e * l e := by simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]; rfl
      _ = pairing l z := by
        change (∑ e, z e * l e) = ∑ e, l e * z e
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro e _
        ring
  refine ⟨l, fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [← hrep]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hg k

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_representative
statement:
theorem curl_representative (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar) (l : Edge n → Scalar)
    (hl : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k) (f : Face n) :
    curl l f = lambda (flowCycle f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hl]
  simp only [curl, pairing, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, flowCycle, mul_comm]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.curl_count_le_codim
statement:
theorem curl_count_le_codim (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n))
    (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S).dualAnnihilator)
    (l : Edge n → Scalar) (hl : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing l k.val = lambda k) :
    (nonzeroSet (curl l)).card ≤ faceCodim S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hiso : ∀ a ∈ Support.H.projected flowCycle S,
      ∀ b ∈ Support.H.projected flowCycle S, Support.diagonalForm (curl l) a b = 0 := by
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [Support.diagonalForm_apply, curl_representative lambda l hl]
    exact Support.H.stabilizer_isotropic flowCycle S lambda
      ((Submodule.mem_dualAnnihilator lambda).mp hlambda) ha hb
  have h := Support.nonzero_blocks_le_codim (curl l)
    (Support.H.projected flowCycle S) hiso
  simpa only [nonzeroSet, faceCodim, Fintype.card_subtype] using h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sparse_annihilator
statement:
theorem sparse_annihilator (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n))
    (lambda : FlowSpace n →ₗ[Scalar] Scalar)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S).dualAnnihilator) :
    ∃ r : Edge n → Scalar,
      (∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing r k.val = lambda k) ∧
      (nonzeroSet r).card ≤ (n+1) * faceCodim S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := exists_representative lambda
  obtain ⟨φ,hφ⟩ := sparse_cochain l
  refine ⟨l - gradient φ, ?_, hφ.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (curl_count_le_codim S lambda hlambda l hl))⟩
  intro k
  rw [pairing_sub, pairing_gradient_flow, sub_zero, hl]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.subgroup_support_edges
statement:
theorem subgroup_support_edges (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n)) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Edge n),
      T.card ≤ (n+1) * faceCodim S * flowCodim S ∧
      ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
        Support.H.central flowCycle k ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S).dualAnnihilator
  have : Module.Free Scalar W := Module.Free.of_divisionRing Scalar W
  let b := Module.finBasis Scalar W
  have hd : Module.finrank Scalar W = flowCodim S := by
    have h := Subspace.finrank_add_finrank_dualAnnihilator_eq
      (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S)
    change Module.finrank Scalar (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S) +
      Module.finrank Scalar W = Module.finrank Scalar (FlowSpace n) at h
    unfold flowCodim
    omega
  have hr : ∀ i : Fin (Module.finrank Scalar W), ∃ r : Edge n → Scalar,
      (∀ k : FlowSpace n, pairing r k.val = (b i).val k) ∧
      (nonzeroSet r).card ≤ (n+1) * faceCodim S := by
    intro i
    exact sparse_annihilator S (b i).val (b i).property
  choose r hr hbnd using hr
  let T := Finset.univ.biUnion (fun i => nonzeroSet (r i))
  refine ⟨T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      T.card ≤ ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank Scalar W), (nonzeroSet (r i)).card :=
        Finset.card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ _ : Fin (Module.finrank Scalar W), (n+1) * faceCodim S :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hbnd i)
      _ = (n+1) * faceCodim S * flowCodim S := by simp [hd, Nat.mul_comm]
  · intro k hk
    apply (Support.H.mem_centralPart flowCycle S k).mp
    apply (Subspace.forall_mem_dualAnnihilator_apply_eq_zero_iff
      (Support.H.centralPart flowCycle S) k).mp
    have hbi (i : Fin (Module.finrank Scalar W)) : (b i).val k = 0 := by
      rw [← hr i k]
      change (∑ e, r i e * k.val e) = 0
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro e _
      by_cases he : r i e = 0
      · simp [he]
      · have hmem : e ∈ T := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
          ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, (mem_nonzeroSet _ _).mpr he⟩
        simp [hk e hmem]
    intro lambda hlambda
    let w : W := ⟨lambda, hlambda⟩
    have heq := congrArg (fun w : W => w.val k) (b.sum_repr w)
    simp only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hbi, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero] at heq
    exact heq.symm

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.box_subgroup_index
statement:
theorem box_subgroup_index (S : Subgroup (BoxGroup n)) :
    S.index = 3 ^ (faceCodim S + flowCodim S)
proof:
:=
  Support.H.subgroup_index flowCycle S

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.orbit_card_eq_power
statement:
theorem orbit_card_eq_power {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X] (x : X) :
    Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (BoxGroup n) x) =
      3 ^ (faceCodim (MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x) +
        flowCodim (MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (MulAction.orbitEquivQuotientStabilizer (BoxGroup n) x)]
  exact box_subgroup_index (MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.small_orbit_support_edges
statement:
theorem small_orbit_support_edges {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X]
    (x : X) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (q : ℝ) (_hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (horbit : (Nat.card (MulAction.orbit (BoxGroup n) x) : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ q) :
    ∃ T : Finset (Edge n),
      (T.card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (n+1 : ℝ) * (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 ∧
      ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
        Support.H.central flowCycle k • x = x
proof:
:= by
  let S := MulAction.stabilizer (BoxGroup n) x
  obtain ⟨T,hcard,hfix⟩ := subgroup_support_edges S
  have heq := orbit_card_eq_power (n := n) x
  have horbit' : (3 : ℝ) ^ (faceCodim S + flowCodim S) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ q := by
    rw [heq, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] at horbit
    exact horbit
  have hlog := Real.logb_le_logb_of_le (b := 3) (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 3)
    (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 3 ^ (faceCodim S + flowCodim S)) horbit'
  rw [Real.logb_pow, Real.logb_self_eq_one (by norm_num), mul_one,
    Real.logb_rpow_eq_mul_logb_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hN), Nat.cast_add] at hlog
  have ha : 0 ≤ (faceCodim S : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hd : 0 ≤ (flowCodim S : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hab : (faceCodim S : ℝ) * flowCodim S ≤ (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((faceCodim S : ℝ) - flowCodim S)]
  have hc : (T.card : ℝ) ≤ (n+1 : ℝ) * faceCodim S * flowCodim S := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  refine ⟨T, ?_, fun k hk => hfix k hk⟩
  calc
    (T.card : ℝ) ≤ (n+1 : ℝ) * faceCodim S * flowCodim S := hc
    _ ≤ (n+1 : ℝ) * (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 := by
      rw [mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hab (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 2 * (n+1 : ℝ) * (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 := by
      have hpos : 0 ≤ (n+1 : ℝ) * (q * Real.logb 3 N)^2 := by positivity
      nlinarith

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_subtype_zero
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_zero {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [AddCommMonoid M]
    (p : ι → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (f : ι → M) (h : ∀ i, ¬ p i → f i = 0) :
    (∑ i : {x // p x}, f i.val) = ∑ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (∑ i : {x // ¬ p x}, f i.val) = 0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => h i.val i.property)
  simpa only [hz,add_zero] using Fintype.sum_subtype_add_sum_subtype p f

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.restrictGroup_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictGroup_face (g : BoxGroup n) (e : Edge n) (f : EdgeFaces e) :
    (restrictGroup e g).face f = g.face f.val
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.restrictGroup_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem restrictGroup_flow (g : BoxGroup n) (e : Edge n) :
    (restrictGroup e g).flow = g.flow.val e
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.boundary_eval
statement:
theorem boundary_eval (z : Edge n → Scalar) (v : Vertex n) :
    boundary z v = ∑ e, epsilon v e * z e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [boundary, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro e _
  simp [epsilon, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm, mul_comm]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_eq_zero
statement:
theorem epsilon_eq_zero (v : Vertex n) (e : Edge n) (h : ¬ incident v e) :
    epsilon v e = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [incident, not_or] at h
  simp [epsilon,h.1,h.2]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_incident
statement:
theorem sum_incident (z : Edge n → Scalar) (v : Vertex n) :
    (∑ e : IncidentEdges v, epsilon v e.val * z e.val) = boundary z v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [boundary_eval]
  exact sum_subtype_zero (incident v) (fun e => epsilon v e * z e)
    (fun e he => by rw [epsilon_eq_zero v e he,zero_mul])

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.compatible_iff_extend
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_extend {v : Vertex n} (s : LocalStates v) :
    Compatible s ↔ ∃ u : Face n → Plane,
      ∀ (e : IncidentEdges v) (f : EdgeFaces e.val), (s e).face f = u f.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    let u (f : Face n) : Plane := if hh : ∃ e : IncidentEdges v, cycle f e.val ≠ 0
      then (s hh.choose).face ⟨f,hh.choose_spec⟩ else 0
    refine ⟨u,?_⟩
    intro e f
    have hh : ∃ e : IncidentEdges v, cycle f.val e.val ≠ 0 := ⟨e,f.property⟩
    simp only [u,dite_eq_left hh]
    exact h e hh.choose f.val f.property hh.choose_spec
  · rintro ⟨u,h⟩ e e' f hf hf'
    rw [h e ⟨f,hf⟩, h e' ⟨f,hf'⟩]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.Configuration.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem Configuration.ext {b : Vertex n → Scalar} {v : Vertex n}
    {s t : Configuration b v} (h : ∀ e, s.state e = t.state e) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  cases s; cases t
  congr
  exact funext h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.actState_compatible
statement:
theorem actState_compatible {v : Vertex n} (g : BoxGroup n) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : Compatible (actState g s)
proof:
:= by
  intro e e' f hf hf'
  simp only [actState, Support.H.mul_face, Pi.add_apply, restrictGroup_face]
  rw [hs e e' f hf hf']

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.actState_divergence
statement:
theorem actState_divergence {v : Vertex n} (g : BoxGroup n) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : divergence (actState g s) = divergence s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := (compatible_iff_extend s).mp hs
  have hc (e : IncidentEdges v) : Support.correction (localCycle e.val)
      (restrictGroup e.val g).face (s e).face =
        (Support.correction flowCycle g.face u).val e.val := by
    have heq : (s e).face = fun f : EdgeFaces e.val => u f.val := funext (hu e)
    rw [heq]
    simp only [Support.correction, Submodule.coe_smul, Submodule.coe_sum,
      Pi.smul_apply, Finset.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul, flowCycle, localCycle,
      restrictGroup_face]
    congr 1
    exact sum_subtype_zero (fun f : Face n => cycle f e.val ≠ 0)
      (fun f => omega (g.face f) (u f) * cycle f e.val)
      (fun f hf => by push Not at hf; simp only [hf,mul_zero])
  simp only [divergence, actState, Support.H.mul_flow, restrictGroup_flow,
    mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp_rw [hc]
  rw [sum_incident, sum_incident]
  have hg := congrFun g.flow.property v
  have hb := congrFun (Support.correction flowCycle g.face u).property v
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hg hb
  simp [hg,hb]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.edgeEquiv_val
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.configEquiv_val
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.coefficient_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficient_eq (y : S.Edge) (a : S.Config) :
    T.coefficient (e.edgeEquiv y) (e.configEquiv a) = S.coefficient y a
proof:
:= by
  unfold coefficient
  symm
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv e.edgeEquiv
  intro x
  simp [edgeEquiv, configEquiv, e.rel_eq]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.incident_eq
proof:
:= by
  unfold incident
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, x, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨e.configEquiv.symm a, ?_, e.edgeEquiv.symm x, ?_, ?_⟩
    all_goals
      have heqa : e.toEquiv (e.configEquiv.symm a).val = a.val :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (e.configEquiv.apply_symm_apply a)
      have heqx : e.toEquiv (e.edgeEquiv.symm x).val = x.val :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (e.edgeEquiv.apply_symm_apply x)
      first
      | simpa only [configEquiv_val, edgeEquiv_val, ← heqa, ← heqx, e.rel_eq] using ha
      | simpa only [configEquiv_val, edgeEquiv_val, ← heqa, ← heqx, e.rel_eq] using hx
      | simpa only [configEquiv_val, edgeEquiv_val, ← heqa, ← heqx, e.rel_eq] using hy
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, x, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨e.configEquiv a, ?_, e.edgeEquiv x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [configEquiv_val, e.rel_eq] using ha
    · simpa only [configEquiv_val, edgeEquiv_val, e.rel_eq] using hx
    · simpa only [edgeEquiv_val, e.rel_eq] using hy

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.Iso.query_map
statement: theorem query_map : S.query → T.query
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨lambda, mu, hn, hc⟩
  refine ⟨lambda ∘ e.configEquiv.symm, mu ∘ e.edgeEquiv.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := e.configEquiv.surjective t
    calc
      (∑ a : T.Config, if T.rel .VB (e.configEquiv t) a then
        (lambda ∘ e.configEquiv.symm) a else 0) =
          ∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then lambda a else 0 := by
            symm
            apply Fintype.sum_equiv e.configEquiv
            intro a
            simp [configEquiv, e.rel_eq]
      _ = 1 := hn t
  · intro t y ht
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := e.configEquiv.surjective t
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := e.edgeEquiv.surjective y
    have hi : S.incident t y := (e.incident_eq t y).mp ht
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    calc
      mu y = ∑ a : S.Config, if S.rel .VB t a then lambda a * S.coefficient y a
        else 0 := hc t y hi
      _ = ∑ a : T.Config, if T.rel .VB (e.configEquiv t) a then
          (lambda ∘ e.configEquiv.symm) a * T.coefficient (e.edgeEquiv y) a else 0 := by
        apply Fintype.sum_equiv e.configEquiv
        intro a
        simp [configEquiv_val, e.rel_eq]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Input.query_invariant
statement:
theorem query_invariant {S : Input A} {T : Input B} (e : S.Iso T) :
    S.query ↔ T.query
proof: := ⟨e.query_map, e.symm.query_map⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomRelation.map
statement:
theorem AtomRelation.map (g : BoxGroup n) {r : Symbol} {x y : Atom b}
    (h : AtomRelation b r x y) : AtomRelation b r (g • x) (g • y)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | ed e s => exact .ed e _
  | cf v s => exact .cf v _
  | eb e s t => exact .eb e _ _
  | vb v s t => exact .vb v _ _
  | inc v s e => exact .inc v (g • s) e
  | z e s t δ h =>
    apply AtomRelation.z
    simpa only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left] using h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomRelation.map_iff
statement:
theorem AtomRelation.map_iff (g : BoxGroup n) (r : Symbol) (x y : Atom b) :
    AtomRelation b r (g • x) (g • y) ↔ AtomRelation b r x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa only [inv_smul_smul] using h.map g⁻¹
  · exact fun h => h.map g

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.central_fix_zeroEdgeAtom_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_fix_zeroEdgeAtom_iff (k : FlowSpace n) (e : Edge n) :
    Support.H.central flowCycle k • zeroEdgeAtom b e = zeroEdgeAtom b e ↔ k.val e = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (Sum.inl ⟨e,restrictGroup e (Support.H.central flowCycle k) * 1⟩ : Atom b) =
    (Sum.inl ⟨e,(1 : LocalGroup e)⟩ : Atom b) ↔ _
  simp only [mul_one, Sum.inl.injEq, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact congrArg Support.H.flow h
  · intro h
    apply Support.H.ext
    · rfl
    · exact h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.central_smul_atom
statement:
@[simp] theorem central_smul_atom (k : CentralGroup n) (x : Atom b) :
    k • x = Support.H.central flowCycle k.toAdd • x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.edge_support_tuple
statement:
theorem edge_support_tuple {X : Type*} [MulAction (BoxGroup n) X]
    (T : Finset (Edge n)) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ k : FlowSpace n, (∀ e ∈ T, k.val e = 0) →
      Support.H.central flowCycle k • x = x) :
    ∃ alpha : Fin T.card → Atom b, ∀ k : CentralGroup n,
      (∀ i, k • alpha i = alpha i) → centralHom k • x = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let alpha (i : Fin T.card) : Atom b := zeroEdgeAtom b ((T.equivFin).symm i).val
  refine ⟨alpha,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  apply hx k.toAdd
  intro e he
  let i : Fin T.card := T.equivFin ⟨e,he⟩
  have hi : ((T.equivFin).symm i).val = e := by simp [i]
  have hfix := hk i
  change Support.H.central flowCycle k.toAdd •
      zeroEdgeAtom b ((T.equivFin).symm i).val = _ at hfix
  rw [central_fix_zeroEdgeAtom_iff] at hfix
  simpa only [hi] using hfix

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.head_ne_tail
statement: theorem head_ne_tail (e : Edge n) : head e ≠ tail e
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨i,j,k⟩ | (⟨i,j,k⟩ | ⟨i,j,k⟩)
  all_goals simp only [head,tail]
  · intro h
    have hu := congrArg (fun v : Vertex n => v.1.val) h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc] at hu
    omega
  · intro h
    have hu := congrArg (fun v : Vertex n => v.2.1.val) h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc] at hu
    omega
  · intro h
    have hu := congrArg (fun v : Vertex n => v.2.2.val) h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ,Fin.val_castSucc] at hu
    omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_boundary
statement: theorem sum_boundary (z : Edge n → Scalar) : ∑ v, boundary z v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [boundary, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Finset.sum_apply,
    Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro e _
  simp [mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.head_injective_on_axis
statement:
theorem head_injective_on_axis {e e' : Edge n}
    (ha : edgeAxis e = edgeAxis e') (hh : head e = head e') : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨i,j,k⟩ | (⟨i,j,k⟩ | ⟨i,j,k⟩)
  all_goals rcases e' with ⟨i',j',k'⟩ | (⟨i',j',k'⟩ | ⟨i',j',k'⟩)
  all_goals simp_all [edgeAxis,head]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.tail_injective_on_axis
statement:
theorem tail_injective_on_axis {e e' : Edge n}
    (ha : edgeAxis e = edgeAxis e') (hh : tail e = tail e') : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨i,j,k⟩ | (⟨i,j,k⟩ | ⟨i,j,k⟩)
  all_goals rcases e' with ⟨i',j',k'⟩ | (⟨i',j',k'⟩ | ⟨i',j',k'⟩)
  all_goals simp_all [edgeAxis,tail]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_head_or_tail
statement:
theorem exists_head_or_tail (hn : 1 ≤ n) (v : Vertex n) :
    ∃ e : Edge n, head e = v ∨ tail e = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨i,j,k⟩
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · refine ⟨ex ⟨0,by omega⟩ j k, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simp only [ex,tail,Prod.mk.injEq, and_true]
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hi.symm
  · refine ⟨ex ⟨i.val-1,by omega⟩ j k, Or.inl ?_⟩
    simp only [ex,head,Prod.mk.injEq,and_true]
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_succ]
    omega

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.degree_le_six
statement:
theorem degree_le_six (v : Vertex n) :
    Fintype.card {e : Edge n // head e = v ∨ tail e = v} ≤ 6
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : {e : Edge n // head e = v ∨ tail e = v} → Fin 3 × Bool :=
    fun e => (edgeAxis e.val, decide (head e.val = v))
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro e e' heq
    have ha : edgeAxis e.val = edgeAxis e'.val := congrArg Prod.fst heq
    have hb : decide (head e.val = v) = decide (head e'.val = v) := congrArg Prod.snd heq
    apply Subtype.ext
    by_cases he : head e.val = v
    · have he' : head e'.val = v := by simpa only [he,decide_true,true_eq_decide_iff] using hb
      exact head_injective_on_axis ha (he.trans he'.symm)
    · have he' : head e'.val ≠ v := by simpa only [he,decide_false,false_eq_decide_iff] using hb
      exact tail_injective_on_axis ha
        ((e.property.resolve_left he).trans (e'.property.resolve_left he').symm)
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  simpa using h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.atomInput_rel_true
statement:
@[simp] theorem atomInput_rel_true (r : Symbol) (x y : Atom b) :
    (atomInput b).rel r x y = true ↔ AtomRelation b r x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [atomInput]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_queryEdge
statement:
theorem exists_queryEdge (y : (atomInput b).Edge) :
    ∃ (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e), y = queryEdge e g
proof:
:= by
  rcases y with ⟨y,hy⟩
  have h := (atomInput_rel_true .Ed y y).mp hy
  cases h with
  | ed e g => exact ⟨e,g,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.exists_queryConfig
statement:
theorem exists_queryConfig (a : (atomInput b).Config) :
    ∃ (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v), a = queryConfig v s
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a,ha⟩
  have h := (atomInput_rel_true .Cf a a).mp ha
  cases h with
  | cf v s => exact ⟨v,s,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.queryEdge_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem queryEdge_eq {e e' : Edge n} {g : LocalGroup e} {g' : LocalGroup e'} :
    queryEdge (b := b) e g = queryEdge e' g' ↔ (⟨e,g⟩ : Σ e, LocalGroup e) = ⟨e',g'⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [queryEdge,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.queryConfig_eq
proof:
:= by
  simp [queryConfig,Subtype.ext_iff]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_vb
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_vb (v w : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (t : Configuration b w) :
    (atomInput b).rel .VB (queryConfig v s) (queryConfig w t) = true ↔ v = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomInput_rel_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact .vb v s t

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_eb
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_eb (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) :
    (atomInput b).rel .EB (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) = true ↔ e = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomInput_rel_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact .eb e g h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_inc
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_inc (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (e : Edge n)
    (g : LocalGroup e) :
    (atomInput b).rel .I (queryConfig v s) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) = true ↔
      ∃ h : incident v e, s.state ⟨e,h⟩ = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomInput_rel_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | inc v s e => exact ⟨e.property,rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h,rfl⟩
    exact .inc v s ⟨e,h⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_z_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem rel_z_same (e : Edge n) (g h : LocalGroup e) (d : Scalar) :
    (atomInput b).rel (.Z d) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) e h) = true ↔ (g⁻¹*h).flow = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomInput_rel_true]
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | z e g h d hd => exact hd
  · intro hd
    exact .z e g h d hd

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.rel_z_edge
statement:
theorem rel_z_edge (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) (d : Scalar)
    (hz : (atomInput b).rel (.Z d) (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) = true) : e = f
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomInput_rel_true] at hz
  cases hz
  rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_head
statement: @[simp] theorem epsilon_head (e : Edge n) : epsilon (head e) e = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [epsilon,Ne.symm (head_ne_tail e)]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_tail
statement: @[simp] theorem epsilon_tail (e : Edge n) : epsilon (tail e) e = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp [epsilon,head_ne_tail e]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.epsilon_sq
statement: theorem epsilon_sq (v : Vertex n) (e : IncidentEdges v) : epsilon v e.val ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases e with ⟨e,he⟩
  rcases he with h | h
  · subst v; simp
  · subst v; simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_queryEdges
statement:
theorem sum_queryEdges {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (atomInput b).Edge → M) :
    (∑ y, f y) = ∑ e, ∑ g, f (queryEdge e g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (queryEdgeEquiv (b := b)).sum_comp f,Fintype.sum_sigma]
  rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_queryConfigs
statement:
theorem sum_queryConfigs {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : (atomInput b).Config → M) :
    (∑ a, f a) = ∑ v, ∑ t, f (queryConfig v t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (queryConfigEquiv (b := b)).sum_comp f,Fintype.sum_sigma]
  rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.zsum_same
statement:
theorem zsum_same (e : Edge n) (g h : LocalGroup e) :
    (∑ d : Scalar, if (atomInput b).rel (.Z d)
      (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) e h) then d else 0) = (g⁻¹*h).flow
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rel_z_same]
  simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.zsum_ne
statement:
theorem zsum_ne (e f : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (h : LocalGroup f) (hne : e ≠ f) :
    (∑ d : Scalar, if (atomInput b).rel (.Z d)
      (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) then d else 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro d _
  have hh : ¬(atomInput b).rel (.Z d)
      (queryEdge (b := b) e g) (queryEdge (b := b) f h) = true := fun hd =>
    hne (rel_z_edge e f g h d hd)
  simp [hh]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.coefficient_incident
statement:
theorem coefficient_incident (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)
    (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) (he : incident v e) :
    (atomInput b).coefficient (queryEdge e g) (queryConfig v s) =
      (g⁻¹ * s.state ⟨e,he⟩).flow
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold Input.coefficient
  rw [sum_queryEdges,Finset.sum_eq_single e]
  · simp only [zsum_same,rel_inc]
    have hiff : ∀ h : LocalGroup e,
        (∃ he : incident v e, s.state ⟨e,he⟩ = h) ↔ s.state ⟨e,he⟩ = h := by
      intro h
      exact ⟨fun ⟨_,hh⟩ => hh,fun hh => ⟨he,hh⟩⟩
    simp only [hiff]
    simp
  · intro f _ hfe
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro h _
    simp only [zsum_ne e f g h hfe.symm,ite_self]
  · simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_incident_iff
statement:
theorem query_incident_iff (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v)
    (e : Edge n) (g : LocalGroup e) :
    (atomInput b).incident (queryConfig v s) (queryEdge e g) ↔ incident v e
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,hvb,x,hI,hEB⟩
    obtain ⟨w,t,rfl⟩ := exists_queryConfig a
    obtain ⟨f,h,rfl⟩ := exists_queryEdge x
    have hw : v = w := (rel_vb v w s t).mp hvb
    have hf : e = f := (rel_eb e f g h).mp hEB
    subst w; subst f
    exact ((rel_inc v t e h).mp hI).choose
  · intro he
    refine ⟨queryConfig v s,?_,queryEdge e (s.state ⟨e,he⟩),?_,?_⟩
    · exact (rel_vb _ _ _ _).mpr rfl
    · exact (rel_inc _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨he,rfl⟩
    · exact (rel_eb _ _ _ _).mpr rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.sum_block
statement:
theorem sum_block (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) (f : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar) :
    (∑ a : (atomInput b).Config, if (atomInput b).rel .VB (queryConfig v s) a then f a else 0) =
      ∑ t : Configuration b v, f (queryConfig v t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sum_queryConfigs]
  simp only [rel_vb]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single v]
  · simp
  · intro w _ hw
    simp [Ne.symm hw]
  · simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.block_normalized
statement:
theorem block_normalized (hn : 1 ≤ n) (lambda : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar)
    (hl : (atomInput b).normalized lambda) (v : Vertex n) :
    (∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := hl (queryConfig v (someConfiguration hn b v))
  rw [sum_block] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.flow_query_eq
statement:
theorem flow_query_eq (hn : 1 ≤ n) (lambda : (atomInput b).Config → Scalar)
    (mu : (atomInput b).Edge → Scalar) (h : (atomInput b).consistent lambda mu)
    (v : Vertex n) (e : IncidentEdges v) :
    mu (queryEdge e.val 1) = ∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t) * (t.state e).flow
proof:
:= by
  have hh := h (queryConfig v (someConfiguration hn b v)) (queryEdge e.val 1)
    ((query_incident_iff _ _ _ _).mpr e.property)
  rw [sum_block] at hh
  simpa only [coefficient_incident v _ e.val 1 e.property,inv_one,one_mul] using hh

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_implies_total_charge_zero
statement:
theorem query_implies_total_charge_zero (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hq : (atomInput b).query) :
    (∑ v, b v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨lambda,mu,hl,hm⟩ := hq
  let z : Edge n → Scalar := fun e => mu (queryEdge e 1)
  have hz : boundary z = b := by
    funext v
    rw [← sum_incident]
    change (∑ e : IncidentEdges v, epsilon v e.val * mu (queryEdge e.val 1)) = b v
    simp_rw [flow_query_eq hn lambda mu hm,Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ t : Configuration b v, ∑ e : IncidentEdges v,
        epsilon v e.val * (lambda (queryConfig v t) * (t.state e).flow)) =
        ∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t) * divergence t.state := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro t _
          simp only [divergence,Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro e _
          ring
      _ = ∑ t : Configuration b v, lambda (queryConfig v t) * b v := by
          simp only [Configuration.charge]
      _ = b v := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul,block_normalized hn lambda hl,one_mul]
  rw [← hz]
  exact sum_boundary z

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.query_zero_charge
statement: theorem query_zero_charge : (atomInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)).query
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨zeroWeight,zeroMu,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a
    obtain ⟨v,t,rfl⟩ := exists_queryConfig a
    rw [sum_block]
    simp [zeroWeight,queryConfig]
  · intro a y hi
    obtain ⟨v,t,rfl⟩ := exists_queryConfig a
    obtain ⟨e,g,rfl⟩ := exists_queryEdge y
    have he : incident v e := (query_incident_iff v t e g).mp hi
    rw [sum_block]
    change -g.flow = ∑ t' : Configuration (0 : Vertex n → Scalar) v,
      (if t' = zeroConfiguration v then 1 else 0) *
        (atomInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)).coefficient (queryEdge e g) (queryConfig v t')
    simp only [ite_mul,one_mul,zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (zeroConfiguration v)]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ,ite_true,coefficient_incident v _ e g he,
      zeroConfiguration, mul_one,Support.H.inv_flow]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.opposite_answers
statement:
theorem opposite_answers (hn : 1 ≤ n) (vstar : Vertex n) :
    (atomInput (0 : Vertex n → Scalar)).query ∧
      ¬ (atomInput (Pi.single vstar (1 : Scalar))).query
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨query_zero_charge,?_⟩
  intro h
  have hh := query_implies_total_charge_zero hn h
  simp at hh

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_face (e : Edge n) (z : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    (shiftLocal e z s).face = s.face
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftLocal,Support.H.mul_face,Support.H.central]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_flow (e : Edge n) (z : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    (shiftLocal e z s).flow = z+s.flow
proof:
:= by
  simp [shiftLocal,Support.H.mul_flow,Support.H.central,Support.correction]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftLocal_zero (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e) : shiftLocal e 0 s = s
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftLocal_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLocal_add (e : Edge n) (z w : Scalar) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    shiftLocal e z (shiftLocal e w s) = shiftLocal e (z+w) s
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [add_assoc]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftStates_compatible
statement:
theorem shiftStates_compatible {v : Vertex n} (t : Edge n → Scalar) (s : LocalStates v)
    (hs : Compatible s) : Compatible (shiftStates t s)
proof:
:= by
  intro e e' f hf hf'
  simpa only [shiftStates,shiftLocal_face] using hs e e' f hf hf'

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.shiftStates_divergence
statement:
theorem shiftStates_divergence {v : Vertex n} (t : Edge n → Scalar) (s : LocalStates v) :
    divergence (shiftStates t s) = boundary t v + divergence s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [divergence,shiftStates,shiftLocal_flow,mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib,sum_incident]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.Configuration.shift_state
statement:
@[simp] theorem Configuration.shift_state {v : Vertex n} (s : Configuration b v)
    (t : Edge n → Scalar) (h : boundary t v = b' v - b v) (e : IncidentEdges v) :
    (s.shift t h).state e = shiftLocal e.val (t e.val) (s.state e)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.symm
statement:
theorem AtomShift.symm {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) : AtomShift (-t) y x
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | edge e s => simpa using (AtomShift.edge (b := b') (b' := b) (t := -t) e (shiftLocal e (t e) s))
  | config v s h =>
    have hh : boundary (-t) v = b v - b' v := by simp only [map_neg,Pi.neg_apply,h]; abel
    have he : (s.shift t h).shift (-t) hh = s := by apply Configuration.ext; intro e; simp
    simpa only [he] using (AtomShift.config (t := -t) v (s.shift t h) hh)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.functional
statement:
theorem AtomShift.functional {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x : Atom b} {y z : Atom b'}
    (hy : AtomShift t x y) (hz : AtomShift t x z) : y = z
proof:
:= by
  cases hy <;> cases hz <;> rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.equal_iff
statement:
theorem AtomShift.equal_iff {t : Edge n → Scalar} {x x' : Atom b} {y y' : Atom b'}
    (h : AtomShift t x y) (h' : AtomShift t x' y') : x = x' ↔ y = y'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he; subst x'; exact h.functional h'
  · intro he; subst y'; exact h.symm.functional h'.symm

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.relation
proof:
:= by
  cases hr with
  | ed e s => cases h; cases h'; exact .ed _ _
  | cf v s => cases h; cases h'; exact .cf _ _
  | eb e s a => cases h; cases h'; exact .eb _ _ _
  | vb v s a => cases h; cases h'; exact .vb _ _ _
  | inc v s e => cases h; cases h'; exact .inc _ _ e
  | z e s a δ hz =>
    cases h; cases h'
    apply AtomRelation.z
    simpa only [shiftLocal,mul_inv_rev,mul_assoc,inv_mul_cancel_left] using hz

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.AtomShift.relation_iff
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hr => h.relation h' hr,fun hr => h.symm.relation h'.symm hr⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.blockShiftEquiv_edge
statement:
theorem blockShiftEquiv_edge (te : Edge n → Edge n → Scalar) (tv : Vertex n → Edge n → Scalar)
    (hv : ∀ v, boundary (tv v) v = b' v - b v) (e : Edge n) (s : LocalGroup e) :
    blockShiftEquiv te tv hv (.inl ⟨e,s⟩) = .inl ⟨e,shiftLocal e (te e e) s⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Grid.blockShiftEquiv_config
statement:
theorem blockShiftEquiv_config (te : Edge n → Edge n → Scalar) (tv : Vertex n → Edge n → Scalar)
    (hv : ∀ v, boundary (tv v) v = b' v - b v) (v : Vertex n) (s : Configuration b v) :
    blockShiftEquiv te tv hv (.inr ⟨v,s⟩) = .inr ⟨v,s.shift (tv v) (hv v)⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mk_out
statement: @[simp] theorem mk_out (x : HF A) : mk (Quotient.out x) = x
proof: := Quotient.out_eq x

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.isSet_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem isSet_mk (l : Lists A) : isSet (mk l) = l.1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.isSet_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem isSet_atom (a : A) : isSet (atom a) = false
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.elements_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem elements_mk (l : Lists A) : elements (mk l) = rawElements l
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.elements_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem elements_atom (a : A) : elements (atom a) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change rawElements (Lists.atom a) = ∅
  simp [rawElements, Lists.toList]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.not_mem_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem not_mem_atom (x : HF A) (a : A) : ¬ x ∈ atom a
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ x ∈ elements (atom a)
  simp

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.atom_injective
statement: theorem atom_injective : Function.Injective (atom : A → HF A)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have h' := Lists.equiv_atom.mp (mk_eq_mk.mp h)
  cases h'
  rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.isSet_ofFinset
statement: @[simp] theorem isSet_ofFinset (s : Finset (HF A)) : isSet (ofFinset s) = true
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.elements_ofFinset
statement: @[simp] theorem elements_ofFinset (s : Finset (HF A)) : elements (ofFinset s) = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  simp only [ofFinset, elements_mk, rawElements, Lists.to_ofList, Finset.mem_image,
    List.mem_toFinset]
  simp only [List.mem_map, Finset.mem_toList]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩,h⟩
    rw [mk_out] at h
    exact h ▸ hy
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨Quotient.out x, ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩, mk_out x⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_ofFinset
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_ofFinset (x : HF A) (s : Finset (HF A)) : x ∈ ofFinset s ↔ x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ elements (ofFinset s) ↔ x ∈ s
  rw [elements_ofFinset]

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.ext_sets
statement:
theorem ext_sets {x y : HF A} (hx : isSet x = true) (hy : isSet y = true)
    (h : ∀ z, z ∈ x ↔ z ∈ y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | _ l =>
    induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | _ r =>
      rcases l with ⟨(_ | _), l⟩ <;> (try cases hx)
      rcases r with ⟨(_ | _), r⟩ <;> (try cases hy)
      apply mk_eq_mk.mpr
      apply Lists.Equiv.antisymm
      · apply Lists'.subset_def.mpr
        intro a ha
        apply (mem_mk a (Lists.of' r)).mp
        apply (h (mk a)).mp
        exact (mem_mk a (Lists.of' l)).mpr ⟨a,ha,Lists.Equiv.refl a⟩
      · apply Lists'.subset_def.mpr
        intro a ha
        apply (mem_mk a (Lists.of' l)).mp
        apply (h (mk a)).mpr
        exact (mem_mk a (Lists.of' r)).mpr ⟨a,ha,Lists.Equiv.refl a⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.ofFinset_elements
statement: theorem ofFinset_elements {x : HF A} (hx : isSet x = true) : ofFinset (elements x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_sets (isSet_ofFinset _) hx
  intro z
  rw [mem_ofFinset]
  rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.atom_or_set
statement: theorem atom_or_set (x : HF A) : (∃ a, x = atom a) ∨ x = ofFinset (elements x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | _ l =>
    rcases l with ⟨(_ | _), l⟩
    · cases l with
      | atom a => exact Or.inl ⟨a,rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr (ofFinset_elements rfl).symm

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rank_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_mk (l : Lists A) : rank (mk l) = rawRank l
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rank_atom
statement: @[simp] theorem rank_atom (a : A) : rank (atom a) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.mem_wellFounded
statement: theorem mem_wellFounded : WellFounded (fun x y : HF A => x ∈ y)
proof:
:=
  (measure rank).wf.mono (fun _ _ h => rank_lt_of_mem h)

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.toList_rawMap'
statement:
theorem toList_rawMap' (f : A → B) {b : Bool} (l : Lists' A b) :
    (rawMap' f l).toList = l.toList.map (rawMap f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | atom => rfl
  | nil => rfl
  | cons' a l iha ihl => simp only [rawMap', Lists'.toList, ihl]; rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.rawMap_congr
statement:
theorem rawMap_congr (f : A → B) {l r : Lists A} (h : Lists.Equiv l r) :
    Lists.Equiv (rawMap f l) (rawMap f r)
proof:
:= by
  induction h using Lists.Equiv.rec
      (motive_2 := fun l r _ => Lists'.Subset (rawMap' f l) (rawMap' f r)) with
  | refl => exact Lists.Equiv.refl _
  | antisymm hl hr ihl ihr => exact Lists.Equiv.antisymm ihl ihr
  | nil => exact Lists'.Subset.nil
  | @cons a a' l r heq hmem hsub iheq ihsub =>
    apply Lists'.Subset.cons iheq _ ihsub
    rw [toList_rawMap']
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨a',hmem,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.map_mk
statement: @[simp] theorem map_mk (f : A → B) (l : Lists A) : map f (mk l) = mk (rawMap f l)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CPTSeparation.Hereditary.map_atom
