  induction J using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [residueWeight]
  | @insert j J hj ih =>
    rw [Finset.biUnion_insert,Finset.sum_insert hj]
    exact (residueWeight_union_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (le_refl _) ih)

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.separated_factor_cost
statement:
lemma separated_factor_cost (J : Finset ℕ) {K j : ℕ} (hK : 0<K)
    (hsep : ∀ a∈J, ∀ b∈J, a<b → a+K≤b)
    (hcap : ∀ a∈J, a+K≤j) :
    residueWeight (J.biUnion (fun a => (dyadicSieve a).availableFactors))≤
      (4*Real.log 4/((2:ℝ)^K-1))*(2:ℝ)^j
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a (_ : a∈J) => dyadicSieve_available_weight a)
  rw [←Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (separated_power_sum J hK hsep hcap)
    (show 0≤4*Real.log 4 by positivity)
  have ht := (residueWeight_biUnion_le J (fun a => (dyadicSieve a).availableFactors)).trans (hsum.trans hh)
  calc
    _ ≤ 4*Real.log 4*((2:ℝ)^j/(2^K-1)) := ht
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.log_two_lower
statement: lemma log_two_lower : (1/2:ℝ)≤Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Real.one_sub_inv_le_log_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)
  norm_num at hh
  exact hh

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.narrow_bins_card
statement:
lemma narrow_bins_card {X : ℝ} (hX : 2≤X) (J : Finset ℕ)
    (hJ : ∀ j∈J, (j:ℝ)*Real.log 2≤21/20*X) :
    (J.card:ℝ)≤3*X
proof:
:= by
  have hj : ∀ j∈J, (j:ℝ)≤21/10*X := by
    intro j hj
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left log_two_lower (Nat.cast_nonneg j)
    linarith only [hh,hJ j hj]
  have hs : J⊆Finset.range (⌊21/10*X⌋₊+1) := by
    intro j hj'
    apply Finset.mem_range.mpr
    exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le ((Nat.le_floor_iff (by positivity)).mpr (hj j hj'))
  have hc : (J.card:ℝ)≤(⌊21/10*X⌋₊:ℝ)+1 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_le_card hs).trans_eq (Finset.card_range _)
  have hf := Nat.floor_le (show 0≤21/10*X by linarith only [hX])
  linarith only [hc,hf,hX]

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.topBlock_separated
proof:
:= by
  apply topBlock_bound ha.le
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgap (show 0≤(2:ℝ)^i by positivity)
  rw [←mul_assoc,←pow_add] at hh
  have hp : (2:ℝ)^(i+K)≤(2:ℝ)^j := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hij
  have hp' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hp (topCoefficient_pos ha).le
  have hg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hh.trans hp') topParameter_pos.le
  nlinarith only [hg]

name: OAI.GaussianMoat.eventually_window_top
statement:
theorem eventually_window_top {D a δ : ℝ} {K : ℕ}
    (hD : 1≤D) (ha : 0<a) (haδ : 2*a≤δ)
    (hgap : a≤(2:ℝ)^K*topCoefficient a) :
    ∀ᶠ X : ℝ in atTop, ∀ (J : Finset ℕ) (initial : List ℕ),
      (∀ i∈J, ∀ j∈J, i<j → i+K≤j) →
      (∀ j∈J, X≤j*Real.log 2 ∧ j*Real.log 2≤21/20*X ∧
        δ*(2:ℝ)^j/Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(j+1))≤(PrimeLogMass.dyadicBatch j).card) →
      ∀ j∈J, Nonempty (EntropyBand (dyadicSieve j) D (initial++topBlocks a J)
        0 (bandSize (dyadicSieve j) topParameter (a*(2:ℝ)^j) topIterations) (1/10000)) ∧
        topCoefficient a*(2:ℝ)^j/(4*Real.log ((2:ℝ)^j))≤
          (bandSize (dyadicSieve j) topParameter (a*(2:ℝ)^j) topIterations:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : 0<δ := by linarith only [ha,haδ]
  have htop := eventually_top_band hD ha haδ
  have hlen := eventually_poly_le_exp (100:ℝ)
    (a := topParameter*topCoefficient a) (mul_pos topParameter_pos (topCoefficient_pos ha)) 1
  obtain ⟨x0,h0⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (htop.and hlen)
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (max x0 2)] with X hX
  intro J initial hsep hJ j hj
  have hX2 : 2≤X := (le_max_right _ _).trans hX
  have hX0 : x0≤X := (le_max_left _ _).trans hX
  have hlog := (hJ j hj).1
  have hlog' := (hJ j hj).2.1
  obtain ⟨hband,hlen⟩ := h0 (j*Real.log 2) (hX0.trans hlog)
  have hn : (dyadicSieve j).primes.Nonempty := by
    apply Finset.card_pos.mp
    have hlogp : 0<Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(j+1)) := by
      rw [Real.log_pow]
      positivity
    have hh := (hJ j hj).2.2
    have hp : 0<δ*(2:ℝ)^j/Real.log ((2:ℝ)^(j+1)) := div_pos (by positivity) hlogp
    have hc : (0:ℝ)<(PrimeLogMass.dyadicBatch j).card := hp.trans_le hh
    exact_mod_cast hc
  obtain ⟨pre,post,he,hpl,hpm⟩ := topBlocks_split (a := a) hj
  have hT : Real.exp (j*Real.log 2)=(2:ℝ)^j := by rw [Real.exp_nat_mul,Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
  have hcard := narrow_bins_card hX2 J (fun i hi => (hJ i hi).2.1)
  have hlen' : (post.length+2:ℝ)≤Real.exp (topParameter*topCoefficient a*(2:ℝ)^j) := by
    have hp : (post.length:ℝ)≤(J.card:ℝ)*topIterations := by exact_mod_cast hpl
    simp only [pow_one,hT] at hlen
    have he := Real.add_one_le_exp (topParameter*topCoefficient a*(2:ℝ)^j)
    norm_num only [topIterations,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hp
    nlinarith only [hp,hcard,hlen,he,hlog,hX2]
  have hprime : ∀ p∈(dyadicSieve j).primes, Real.exp (j*Real.log 2)≤(p:ℝ) ∧
      (p:ℝ)≤2*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [hT]
    have hh := (PrimeLogMass.mem_dyadicBatch j p).mp hp
    constructor
    · exact_mod_cast hh.1
    · have hh' : p≤2^(j+1) := hh.2.1.le
      rw [pow_succ] at hh'
      exact_mod_cast (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hh' : p≤2*2^j)
  have hdense : δ*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2)/Real.log (2*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2))≤
      (dyadicSieve j).primes.card := by
    change δ*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2)/Real.log (2*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2))≤
      (PrimeLogMass.dyadicBatch j).card
    simpa only [hT,pow_succ,mul_comm] using (hJ j hj).2.2
  have hpst : ∀ n∈post, (n:ℝ)≤Real.exp (topParameter*topCoefficient a*Real.exp (j*Real.log 2)) := by
    intro n hnp
    obtain ⟨i,hi,hij,hni⟩ := hpm n hnp
    rw [hT]
    exact topBlock_separated ha hgap (hsep i hi j hj hij) n hni
  obtain ⟨hb,hbsize⟩ := hband (dyadicSieve j) (initial++pre) post hn hprime hdense hpst
    (by simpa only [hT] using hlen')
  refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [hT,he,topBlock,List.append_assoc] using hb
  · simpa only [hT,Real.log_pow] using hbsize

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.split
statement: lemma split (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ x%2 ≤ y%2 ∧ Bits (x/2) (y/2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨by simpa using h 0, ?_⟩
    intro i
    simpa [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, pow_succ', mul_comm] using h (i+1)
  · rintro ⟨h,h'⟩ (_|i)
    · simpa using h
    · simpa [Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, pow_succ', mul_comm] using h' i

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.zero_right
statement: lemma zero_right (x : ℕ) : Bits x 0 ↔ x=0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · induction x using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h x ih =>
      intro hx
      by_cases h : x=0
      · exact h
      have he := (split x 0).mp hx
      have hh := ih (x/2) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega)) (by simpa using he.2)
      simp only [Nat.zero_mod] at he
      omega
  · rintro rfl; intro i; simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.choose_odd_iff
statement: lemma choose_odd_iff (x y : ℕ) : y.choose x % 2=1 ↔ Bits x y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing x with
  | h y ih =>
    by_cases hy : y=0
    · subst y
      rw [zero_right]
      cases x <;> simp
    have hl := Choose.choose_modEq_choose_mod_mul_choose_div_nat (n:=y) (k:=x) (p:=2)
    change y.choose x%2 = (y%2).choose (x%2)*(y/2).choose (x/2)%2 at hl
    rw [hl,Nat.mul_mod,split, ← ih (y/2) (Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by omega))]
    have hx := Nat.mod_lt x (by omega : 0<2)
    have hy' := Nat.mod_lt y (by omega : 0<2)
    have hz := Nat.mod_lt ((y/2).choose (x/2)) (by omega : 0<2)
    interval_cases hxm : x%2 <;> interval_cases hym : y%2 <;> simp_all

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.le
statement: lemma le {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : x≤y
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (choose_odd_iff x y).mpr h
  by_contra hl
  rw [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)] at hh
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.ofDigits_digit
statement:
lemma ofDigits_digit {B : ℕ} (hB : 0<B) (l : List ℕ) (hl : ∀ a∈l, a<B) (i : ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits B l/B^i%B=l[i]?.getD 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.ofDigits_div_pow_eq_ofDigits_drop i hB l hl]
  have hd : ∀ a∈l.drop i,a<B := fun a ha => hl a (List.mem_of_mem_drop ha)
  have he : l[i]?=(l.drop i)[0]? := by simp
  rw [he]
  generalize l.drop i = v at *
  cases v with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a v =>
    simp only [Nat.ofDigits_cons, Nat.add_mul_mod_self_left, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.getD_some]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hd a List.mem_cons_self)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.ofDigits_map_range
statement:
lemma ofDigits_map_range (B n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    Nat.ofDigits B ((List.range n).map f) = ∑ i∈Finset.range n, f i*B^i
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ,List.map_append,Nat.ofDigits_append]
    simp [ih,Finset.sum_range_succ, mul_comm]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.choose_digit
statement:
lemma choose_digit {x y B : ℕ} (hxy : x≤y) (hB : 2^y<B) :
    (B+1)^y/B^x%B=y.choose x
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0<B := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity : 0<2^y) (Nat.le_of_lt hB)
  have hl : ∀ a∈(List.range (y+1)).map (Nat.choose y),a<B := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i,hi,rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.choose_le_two_pow y i) hB
  have he : (B+1)^y=Nat.ofDigits B ((List.range (y+1)).map (Nat.choose y)) := by
    rw [ofDigits_map_range,add_pow]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [mul_comm]
  rw [he,ofDigits_digit hpos _ hl]
  simp [show x<y+1 by omega]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.extract_unique
statement:
lemma extract_unique {B H N s d r : ℕ} (h : N=s*B*H+d*H+r) (hd : d<B) (hr : r<H) :
    r=N%H ∧ d=N/H%B ∧ s=N/H/B
proof:
:= by
  have hH : 0<H := by omega
  have hB : 0<B := by omega
  have he : N=(s*B+d)*H+r := by nlinarith only [h]
  have hq : N/H=s*B+d := by rw [he, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hH, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr, zero_add]
  have hm : N%H=r := by rw [he,Nat.add_mod]; simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr]
  rw [hq]
  constructor
  · exact hm.symm
  constructor
  · simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hd]
  · rw [Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ hB,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hd,zero_add]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.sound
statement: lemma sound {x y : ℕ} {w : Fin 7 → ℕ} (hw : System x y w) : Bits x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hw with ⟨hxy,hB,hH,hN,he,hd,hr,ht⟩
  have hh := (extract_unique he hd hr).2.1
  have hpow : 2^y<2^(y+1) := by simp [pow_succ]
  rw [hN,hH,hB,choose_digit hxy hpow] at hh
  apply (choose_odd_iff x y).mp
  rw [← hh,ht]
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.unique
statement: lemma unique {x y : ℕ} {w v : Fin 7 → ℕ} (hw : System x y w) (hv : System x y v) : w=v
proof:
:= by
  rcases hw with ⟨_,hB,hH,hN,he,hd,hr,ht⟩
  rcases hv with ⟨_,hB',hH',hN',he',hd',hr',ht'⟩
  have h0 : w 0=v 0 := hB.trans hB'.symm
  have h1 : w 1=v 1 := by rw [hH,hH',h0]
  have h2 : w 2=v 2 := by rw [hN,hN',h0]
  have hh := extract_unique he hd hr
  have hh' := extract_unique he' hd' hr'
  rw [h0,h1,h2] at hh
  have h3 := hh.2.2.trans hh'.2.2.symm
  have h4 := hh.2.1.trans hh'.2.1.symm
  have h5 := hh.1.trans hh'.1.symm
  have h6 : w 6=v 6 := by omega
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.complete
statement: lemma complete {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : ∃ w, System x y w
proof:
:= by
  let B:=2^(y+1)
  let H:=B^x
  let N:=(B+1)^y
  let d:=N/H%B
  have hB : 0<B := by positivity
  have hH : 0<H := by positivity
  have hpow : 2^y<B := by dsimp [B]; simp [pow_succ]
  have hd : d=y.choose x := choose_digit (le h) hpow
  have ho : d%2=1 := by rw [hd]; exact (choose_odd_iff x y).mpr h
  refine ⟨![B,H,N,N/H/B,d,N%H,d/2],le h,rfl,rfl,rfl,?_,Nat.mod_lt _ hB,Nat.mod_lt _ hH,?_⟩
  · change N=N/H/B*B*H+(N/H%B)*H+N%H
    have hq := Nat.mod_add_div (N/H) B
    have hn := Nat.mod_add_div N H
    nlinarith only [hq,hn]
  · change d=2*(d/2)+1
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.vector
statement:
lemma vector {α ι : Type} [Finite ι] {f : ι → (α → ℕ) → ℕ}
    (h : ∀ i, ScalarSF (f i)) : MapSF (fun z i => f i z)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((MapSF.proj (fun i => (i,()))).comp (MapSF.all h)).congr (by intros; rfl)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.powerRel
statement:
lemma powerRel (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) (hh : ScalarSF h) :
    SF (fun z => 2≤f z ∧ h z=f z^g z)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : MapSF (fun z => ![f z,g z,h z]) := MapSF.vector (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption)
  exact hv.pullback PowerCompilation.power

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.system_sf
statement: lemma system_sf : SF (fun z : Fin 2⊕Fin 7 → ℕ => System (z (.inl 0)) (z (.inl 1)) (z ∘ Sum.inr))
proof:
:= by
  let α:=Fin 2⊕Fin 7
  let a (i : α) : ScalarSF (fun z : α → ℕ => z i) := ScalarSF.proj i
  let x:=a (.inl 0); let y:=a (.inl 1)
  let B:=a (.inr 0); let H:=a (.inr 1); let N:=a (.inr 2)
  let s:=a (.inr 3); let d:=a (.inr 4); let r:=a (.inr 5); let t:=a (.inr 6)
  let k (j : ℕ) : ScalarSF (fun _ : α → ℕ => j) := ScalarSF.const j
  have h := (x.le y).and (((k 2).powerRel (y.add (k 1)) B).and
    ((B.powerRel x H).and (((B.add (k 1)).powerRel y N).and
      ((N.eq ((((s.mul B).mul H).add (d.mul H)).add r)).and
        ((d.lt B).and ((r.lt H).and (d.eq (((k 2).mul t).add (k 1)))))))))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxy,⟨_,hB⟩,⟨_,hH⟩,⟨_,hN⟩,he⟩
    exact ⟨hxy,hB,hH,hN,he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxy,hB,hH,hN,he⟩
    have hb : 2≤z (.inr 0) := by
      change 2≤(z ∘ Sum.inr) 0
      rw [hB,pow_succ]
      have := Nat.two_pow_pos (z (.inl 1))
      omega
    exact ⟨hxy,⟨by omega,hB⟩,⟨hb,hH⟩,⟨by omega,hN⟩,he⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Binary.bits
statement: theorem bits : SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => Bits (z 0) (z 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h := system_sf.ex (by intro z w w' hw hw'; exact unique hw hw')
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  exact ⟨fun ⟨w,hw⟩ => sound hw,complete⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_pack
statement:
lemma bits_pack {B w k : ℕ} (hB : B=2^w) (hw : 0 < w) (f g : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : ∀t < k,f t < B) (hg : ∀t < k,g t < B) (hfg : ∀t < k,Bits (f t) (g t)) :
    Bits (pack B k f) (pack B k g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hB,bits_blocks hw]
  intro t
  by_cases ht : t < k
  · simpa only [←hB,digit_pack (by rw [hB]; positivity) hf,
      digit_pack (by rw [hB]; positivity) hg,ite_eq_left ht] using hfg t ht
  · simp only [←hB,digit_pack (by rw [hB]; positivity) hf,
      digit_pack (by rw [hB]; positivity) hg,ite_eq_right ht]
    exact bits_refl 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.exists_scale
statement: lemma exists_scale {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) : ∃ w b : ℕ, 0 < w ∧ 0 < b ∧ 2^w=4*b ∧ 2*L < 2^w ∧ b ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w,hl,hu⟩:=unique_scale hL
  have hw : 2 ≤ w := by
    by_contra hn
    have hw : w=0 ∨ w=1 := by omega
    rcases hw with hw|hw <;> simp [hw] at hl <;> omega
  refine ⟨w,2^(w-2),by omega,pow_pos (by omega) _,?_,hl.1,?_⟩
  · have hh : w=(w-2)+2 := by omega
    nth_rw 1 [hh]
    rw [pow_add]
    norm_num
    omega
  · have hh : 2^w=4*2^(w-2) := by
      have he : w=(w-2)+2 := by omega
      nth_rw 1 [he]
      rw [pow_add]
      norm_num
      omega
    rw [hh] at hl
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.stateAt_le
statement: lemma stateAt_le (c : Cfg Q J) (q : Q) : stateAt c q ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold stateAt; split_ifs <;> omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.zeroAt_le
statement: lemma zeroAt_le (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (q : Q) : zeroAt M c q ≤ stateAt c q
proof:
:= by
  unfold zeroAt stateAt
  split <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.decAt_le
statement: lemma decAt_le (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (q : Q) : decAt M c q ≤ stateAt c q
proof:
:= by
  unfold decAt stateAt
  split <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.arcAt_inactive
statement: lemma arcAt_inactive (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (q : Q) (b : Bool) (hq : q≠c.state) : arcAt M c q b=0
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> cases b <;> simp [arcAt,stateAt,zeroAt,decAt,hi,hq]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.arcAt_halt
statement: lemma arcAt_halt (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (hc : c.state=M.halt) (q : Q) (b : Bool) : arcAt M c q b=0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q=c.state
  · have hi : M.instr q=.halt := (M.halt_iff q).mpr (hq.trans hc)
    cases b <;> simp [arcAt,hi]
  · exact arcAt_inactive M c q b hq

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.testAt_partition
statement:
lemma testAt_partition (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (q : Q) (j : J) (p0 pd : Q)
    (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) : zeroAt M c q+decAt M c q=stateAt c q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [zeroAt,decAt,hi,stateAt]
  by_cases hq : q=c.state <;> by_cases hz : c.value j=0 <;> simp [hq,hz]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.incomingAt_active
statement:
lemma incomingAt_active (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (p : Q) :
    incomingAt M c p=∑b : Bool,if dest M c.state b=some p then arcAt M c c.state b else 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single c.state
  · intro q hq hqc
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    simp [arcAt_inactive M c q b hqc]
  · simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.incAt_active
statement:
lemma incAt_active (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (j : J) :
    incAt M c j=match M.instr c.state with | .inc i _=>if i=j then 1 else 0 | _=>0
proof:
:= by
  unfold incAt
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c.state]
  · simp [stateAt]
  · intro q hq hqc
    cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [stateAt,hqc]
  · simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.subAt_active
statement:
lemma subAt_active (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (j : J) :
    subAt M c j=match M.instr c.state with | .test i _ _=>if i=j ∧ c.value i≠0 then 1 else 0 | _=>0
proof:
:= by
  unfold subAt
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single c.state]
  · cases hi : M.instr c.state <;> simp [decAt,hi,ite_and]
  · intro q hq hqc
    cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [decAt,hi,hqc]
  · simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.incAt_le
statement: lemma incAt_le (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (j : J) : incAt M c j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [incAt_active]
  split <;> (try split_ifs) <;> omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.subAt_le
statement: lemma subAt_le (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (j : J) : subAt M c j ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [subAt_active]
  split <;> (try split_ifs) <;> omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.incomingAt_next
statement:
lemma incomingAt_next (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (hc : c.state≠M.halt) (p : Q) :
    incomingAt M c p=stateAt (next M c) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [incomingAt_active]
  cases hi : M.instr c.state with
  | halt => exact False.elim (hc ((M.halt_iff _).mp hi))
  | inc j q => simp [dest,arcAt,hi,stateAt,next,eq_comm]
  | test j p0 pd =>
    by_cases hz : c.value j=0 <;> simp [dest,arcAt,hi,stateAt,next,zeroAt,decAt,hz,eq_comm]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.counterAt_next
statement:
lemma counterAt_next (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (j : J) :
    (next M c).value j+subAt M c j=c.value j+incAt M c j
proof:
:= by
  rw [incAt_active,subAt_active]
  cases hi : M.instr c.state with
  | halt => simp [next,hi]
  | inc i p =>
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · subst i; simp [next,hi]
    · simp [next,hi,hij,Ne.symm hij,Function.update_of_ne]
  | test i p0 pd =>
    by_cases hz : c.value i=0
    · simp [next,hi,hz]
    · by_cases hij : i=j
      · subst i; simp [next,hi,hz]; omega
      · simp [next,hi,hz,hij,Ne.symm hij,Function.update_of_ne]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.incAt_halt
statement: lemma incAt_halt (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (hc : c.state=M.halt) (j : J) : incAt M c j=0
proof:
:= by
  rw [incAt_active,(M.halt_iff _).mpr hc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.subAt_halt
statement: lemma subAt_halt (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) (hc : c.state=M.halt) (j : J) : subAt M c j=0
proof:
:= by
  rw [subAt_active,(M.halt_iff _).mpr hc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_ite_const
statement:
lemma pack_ite_const (B k : ℕ) (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (f g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>if p then f t else g t)=if p then pack B k f else pack B k g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p <;> simp [hp]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_arc
statement:
lemma trace_arc (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (q : Q) (a : Bool) :
    arc M (trace M d B w b T) q a=pack B (T+1) (fun t=>arcAt M (run M d t) q a)
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> cases a <;> simp [arc,arcAt,hi,trace,pack_const_zero]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_incoming
statement:
lemma trace_incoming (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (q : Q) :
    incoming M (trace M d B w b T) q=pack B (T+1) (fun t=>incomingAt M (run M d t) q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [incoming,incomingAt,pack_sum,pack_ite_const,pack_const_zero,trace_arc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_inc
statement:
lemma trace_inc (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (j : J) :
    increments M (trace M d B w b T) j=pack B (T+1) (fun t=>incAt M (run M d t) j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [increments,incAt,pack_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [trace,pack_const_zero,pack_ite_const]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_sub
statement:
lemma trace_sub (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (j : J) :
    decrements M (trace M d B w b T) j=pack B (T+1) (fun t=>subAt M (run M d t) j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [decrements,subAt,pack_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [trace,pack_const_zero,pack_ite_const]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_transition
statement:
lemma trace_transition (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (hT : HaltsAt M d T) (q : Q) :
    (trace M d B w b T).state q=(if q=M.start then 1 else 0)+B*incoming M (trace M d B w b T) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_incoming]
  have hlast : incomingAt M (run M d T) q=0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    simp [arcAt_halt M _ hT.1]
  rw [pack_last hlast]
  change pack B (T+1) (fun t=>stateAt (run M d t) q)=_
  rw [pack_cons]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg (B*·)
  apply pack_congr
  intro t ht
  rw [incomingAt_next M _ (hT.2 t ht),run_succ]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_update
statement:
lemma trace_update (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) (hT : HaltsAt M d T) (j : J) :
    (trace M d B w b T).counter (some j)+B*decrements M (trace M d B w b T) j=
      d j+B*((trace M d B w b T).rem (some j)+increments M (trace M d B w b T) j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_inc,trace_sub]
  have hi := pack_last (B:=B) (T:=T) (f:=fun t=>incAt M (run M d t) j)
    (incAt_halt M _ hT.1 j)
  have hs := pack_last (B:=B) (T:=T) (f:=fun t=>subAt M (run M d t) j)
    (subAt_halt M _ hT.1 j)
  rw [hi,hs]
  exact update_identity _ _ _ rfl (fun t _=>by simpa only [valueAt,run_succ] using counterAt_next M (run M d t) j)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.valueAt_bound
statement:
lemma valueAt_bound (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (j : Option J) (t T : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) :
    valueAt M d j t ≤ baseC Q d+T
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | none => dsimp [valueAt]; omega
  | some j =>
    have hi : d j ≤ ∑i,d i := Finset.single_le_sum (fun _ _=>Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hh := value_bound M d t j
    dsimp [valueAt,baseC]
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_of_le_one
statement: lemma bits_of_le_one {x y : ℕ} (hxy : x ≤ y) (hy : y ≤ 1) : Bits x y
proof:
:= by
  interval_cases y
  · have hx : x=0 := by omega
    simpa [hx] using bits_refl 0
  · exact (bits_one x).mpr hxy

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_clock
statement:
lemma trace_clock (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ) :
    (trace M d B w b T).counter none+B*(trace M d B w b T).last=
      baseC Q d+B*((trace M d B w b T).rem none+(trace M d B w b T).mask)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := update_identity (B:=B) (T:=T) (d:=baseC Q d)
    (fun t=>baseC Q d+t) (fun _=>1) (fun _=>0) (by omega) (by intros; omega)
  rw [pack_const_zero,mul_zero,add_zero] at hh
  change pack B (T+1) (fun t=>baseC Q d+t)+B*B^T=
    baseC Q d+B*(pack B T (fun t=>baseC Q d+t)+ones B (T+1))
  rw [hh,ones,pack_succ]
  ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.trace_system
statement:
lemma trace_system (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (B w b T : ℕ)
    (hT : HaltsAt M d T) (hB : B=2^w) (hw : 0 < w) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbase : B=4*b) (hlarge : 2*(baseC Q d+T) < B) (hsmall : b ≤ baseC Q d+T) :
    System M d (trace M d B w b T)
proof:
:= by
  have hBpos : 0 < B := by omega
  have hBone : 1 < B := by omega
  have hhalf : 2*b=2^(w-1) := by
    have hh : 2^w=2^(w-1)*2 := by
      nth_rw 1 [show w=(w-1)+1 by omega]
      rw [pow_succ]
    omega
  have hv (j : Option J) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : valueAt M d j t < 2*b := by
    have := valueAt_bound M d j t T ht
    omega
  have hvl (j : Option J) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : valueAt M d j t < B := by
    have := hv j t ht
    omega
  have hs (t : ℕ) (q : Q) : stateAt (run M d t) q < B :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (stateAt_le _ _) hBone
  refine ⟨hB,hbase,by dsimp [trace]; omega,by simp [trace],rfl,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · dsimp [trace]; rw [pow_succ,mul_comm]
  · exact geometric hBone (T+1)
  · intro q
    exact bits_pack hB hw _ _ (fun t _=>hs t q) (fun _ _=>hBone)
      (fun t _=>(bits_one _).mpr (stateAt_le _ _))
  · change (∑q,pack B (T+1) (fun t=>stateAt (run M d t) q))=ones B (T+1)
    rw [←pack_sum]
    apply pack_congr
    intro t ht
    simp [stateAt]
  · intro q
    cases hi : M.instr q with
    | halt => simp [trace,zeroAt,decAt,hi,pack_const_zero]
    | inc j p => simp [trace,zeroAt,decAt,hi,pack_const_zero]
    | test j p0 pd =>
      have hz (t : ℕ) : zeroAt M (run M d t) q ≤ 1 := le_trans (zeroAt_le _ _ _) (stateAt_le _ _)
      have hn (t : ℕ) : decAt M (run M d t) q ≤ 1 := le_trans (decAt_le _ _ _) (stateAt_le _ _)
      change Packed.Bits _ _ ∧ Packed.Bits _ _ ∧ _ ∧ _
      refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
      · exact bits_pack hB hw _ _ (fun t _=>lt_of_le_of_lt (hz t) hBone) (fun t _=>hs t q)
          (fun t _=>bits_of_le_one (zeroAt_le _ _ _) (stateAt_le _ _))
      · exact bits_pack hB hw _ _ (fun t _=>lt_of_le_of_lt (hn t) hBone) (fun t _=>hs t q)
          (fun t _=>bits_of_le_one (decAt_le _ _ _) (stateAt_le _ _))
      · change pack B (T+1) _+pack B (T+1) _=pack B (T+1) _
        rw [←pack_add]
        apply pack_congr
        intro t ht
        exact testAt_partition _ _ _ _ _ _ hi
      · change pack B (T+1) _+(match M.instr q with | .test _ _ _=>_ | _=>0)=ones B (T+1)
        rw [hi,←pack_add]
        apply pack_congr
        intro t ht
        exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (hz t)
  · exact trace_transition M d B w b T hT
  · intro j
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_⟩
    · change Packed.Bits (pack B (T+1) (valueAt M d j)) ((2*b-1)*ones B (T+1))
      rw [ones_mul]
      apply bits_pack hB hw _ _ (fun t ht=>hvl j t (by omega)) (by intros; omega)
      intro t ht
      rw [hhalf]
      exact (bits_full _ _).mpr (by rw [←hhalf]; exact hv j t (by omega))
    · change pack B (T+1) _=valueAt M d j T*B^T+pack B T _
      rw [pack_succ,add_comm]
    · exact pack_lt hBpos (fun t ht=>hvl j t (by omega))
  · exact trace_update M d B w b T hT
  · intro q
    cases hi : M.instr q with
    | halt => trivial
    | inc j p => trivial
    | test j p0 pd =>
      change Packed.Bits (pack B (T+1) (valueAt M d (some j))) ((B-1)*_)
      simp only [trace,hi]
      rw [←pack_mul]
      apply bits_pack hB hw _ _ (fun t ht=>hvl (some j) t (by omega))
      · intro t ht
        have hh : zeroAt M (run M d t) q ≤ 1 := le_trans (zeroAt_le _ _ _) (stateAt_le _ _)
        interval_cases hz : zeroAt M (run M d t) q <;> simp <;> omega
      · intro t ht
        by_cases hz : zeroAt M (run M d t) q=0
        · simp only [hz,Nat.sub_zero,mul_one]
          rw [hB]
          exact (bits_full _ _).mpr (by rw [←hB]; exact hvl (some j) t (by omega))
        · have hj : (run M d t).value j=0 := by
            simp only [zeroAt,hi] at hz
            split_ifs at hz with hc
            · exact hc.2
            · contradiction
          simp only [valueAt,hj]
          exact bits_zero_left _
  · exact trace_clock M d B w b T
  · exact hsmall
  · exact hlarge

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.system_complete
statement:
theorem system_complete (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (h : Halts M d) :
    ∃v,System M d v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T,hT⟩ := h
  have hc : 0 < baseC Q d+T := by dsimp [baseC]; omega
  obtain ⟨w,b,hw,hb,hB,hlarge,hsmall⟩ := exists_scale hc
  exact ⟨trace M d (2^w) w b T,trace_system M d _ _ _ _ hT rfl hw hb hB hlarge hsmall⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.finset_sum
statement:
lemma finset_sum (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → (α → ℕ) → ℕ) (h : ∀i∈s,ScalarSF (f i)) :
    ScalarSF (fun z => ∑i∈s,f i z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using const (α:=α) 0
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
    have hh := (h i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).add (ih (fun j hj=>h j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))
    simpa only [Finset.sum_insert hi] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.sum
statement:
lemma sum [Fintype ι] (f : ι → (α → ℕ) → ℕ) (h : ∀i,ScalarSF (f i)) :
    ScalarSF (fun z => ∑i,f i z)
proof: := finset_sum Finset.univ f (fun i _=>h i)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.bits
statement: lemma bits (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : SF (fun z=>Binary.Bits (f z) (g z))
proof:
:= by
  have hv : MapSF (fun z=>![f z,g z]) := MapSF.vector (by intro i; fin_cases i <;> assumption)
  exact hv.pullback Binary.bits

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.decode_encode
statement: @[simp] lemma decode_encode {Q J : Type} (v : Witness Q J) : decode (encode v)=v
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.encode_decode
statement: @[simp] lemma encode_decode {Q J : Type} (v : Var Q J → ℕ) : encode (decode v)=v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; cases i <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.decode_injective
statement: lemma decode_injective {Q J : Type} : Function.Injective (@decode Q J)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  simpa using congrArg encode h

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.field_sf
statement: lemma field_sf (i : Var Q J) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ => z (.inr i))
proof: := ScalarSF.proj _

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.input_sf
statement: lemma input_sf (j : J) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ => inp z j)
proof: := ScalarSF.proj _

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.baseC_sf
statement: lemma baseC_sf : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ => baseC Q (inp z))
proof:
:=
  (ScalarSF.const (1+Fintype.card Q)).add (ScalarSF.sum _ input_sf)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.arc_sf
statement: lemma arc_sf (q : Q) (b : Bool) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>arc M (wit z) q b)
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> cases b <;> simp only [arc,hi] <;>
    first | exact field_sf _ | exact ScalarSF.const 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.incoming_sf
statement: lemma incoming_sf (p : Q) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>incoming M (wit z) p)
proof:
:= by
  apply ScalarSF.sum
  intro q
  apply ScalarSF.sum
  intro b
  by_cases h : dest M q b=some p
  · simpa only [ite_eq_left h] using arc_sf M q b
  · simpa only [ite_eq_right h] using (ScalarSF.const (α:=Input Q J) 0)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.increments_sf
statement: lemma increments_sf (j : J) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>increments M (wit z) j)
proof:
:= by
  apply ScalarSF.sum
  intro q
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => exact ScalarSF.const 0
  | inc i p =>
    by_cases h : i=j
    · simpa only [ite_eq_left h,wit,decode,Function.comp_apply] using field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.state q)
    · simpa only [ite_eq_right h] using (ScalarSF.const (α:=Input Q J) 0)
  | test i p0 pd => exact ScalarSF.const 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.decrements_sf
statement: lemma decrements_sf (j : J) : ScalarSF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>decrements M (wit z) j)
proof:
:= by
  apply ScalarSF.sum
  intro q
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => exact ScalarSF.const 0
  | inc i p => exact ScalarSF.const 0
  | test i p0 pd =>
    by_cases h : i=j
    · simpa only [ite_eq_left h,wit,decode,Function.comp_apply] using field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.decBranch q)
    · simpa only [ite_eq_right h] using (ScalarSF.const (α:=Input Q J) 0)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.branch_sf
statement:
lemma branch_sf : SF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>∀q,match M.instr q with
    | .test _ _ _ => Bits ((wit z).zeroBranch q) ((wit z).state q) ∧
      Bits ((wit z).decBranch q) ((wit z).state q) ∧
      (wit z).zeroBranch q+(wit z).decBranch q=(wit z).state q ∧
      (wit z).zeroBranch q+(wit z).complement q=(wit z).mask
    | _ => (wit z).zeroBranch q=0 ∧ (wit z).decBranch q=0 ∧ (wit z).complement q=0)
proof:
:= by
  apply SF.all
  intro q
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt =>
    exact ((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.zeroBranch q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)).and
      (((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.decBranch q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)).and ((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.complement q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)))
  | inc i p =>
    exact ((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.zeroBranch q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)).and
      (((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.decBranch q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)).and ((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.complement q)).eq (ScalarSF.const 0)))
  | test i p0 pd =>
    exact ((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.zeroBranch q)).bits (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.state q))).and
      (((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.decBranch q)).bits (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.state q))).and
      ((((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.zeroBranch q)).add (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.decBranch q))).eq (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.state q))).and
      (((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.zeroBranch q)).add (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.complement q))).eq (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) .mask))))

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.zero_test_sf
statement:
lemma zero_test_sf : SF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>∀q,match M.instr q with
    | .test j _ _=>Bits ((wit z).counter (some j)) (((wit z).B-1)*(wit z).complement q)
    | _=>True)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : SF (fun _ : Input Q J → ℕ=>True) :=
    (SF.eq (Poly.const 0) (Poly.const 0)).congr (by simp)
  apply SF.all
  intro q
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => exact ht
  | inc i p => exact ht
  | test j p0 pd =>
    exact (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.counter (some j))).bits
      (((field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) .B).sub (ScalarSF.const 1)).mul (field_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J) (.complement q)))

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.system_sf
statement: lemma system_sf : SF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>System M (inp z) (wit z))
proof:
:= by
  let a (i : Var Q J) := field_sf i
  let c (k : ℕ) := ScalarSF.const (α:=Input Q J) k
  have hp : SF (fun z : Input Q J → ℕ=>(wit z).B=2^(wit z).w) :=
    ((c 2).powerRel (a .w) (a .B)).congr (by intro z; simp only [le_refl,true_and]; rfl)
  have hb := (a .B).eq ((c 4).mul (a .b))
  have hbound := ((c 2).mul (baseC_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J))).lt (a .B)
  have hk := (c 0).lt (a .k)
  have hfull := (a .B).powerRel (a .k) (a .H)
  have hlast := ((a .B).mul (a .last)).eq (a .H)
  have hmask := (((a .B).sub (c 1)).mul (a .mask)).eq ((a .H).sub (c 1))
  have hstate := SF.all (fun q=> (a (.state q)).bits (a .mask))
  have hpart := (ScalarSF.sum _ (fun q=>a (.state q))).eq (a .mask)
  have htrans := SF.all (fun q=> (a (.state q)).eq
    ((c (if q=M.start then 1 else 0)).add ((a .B).mul (incoming_sf M q))))
  have hcounter := SF.all (fun j : Option J=>
    ((a (.counter j)).bits ((((c 2).mul (a .b)).sub (c 1)).mul (a .mask))).and
    (((a (.counter j)).eq (((a (.final j)).mul (a .last)).add (a (.rem j)))).and
      ((a (.rem j)).lt (a .last))))
  have hupdate := SF.all (fun j=> ((a (.counter (some j))).add ((a .B).mul (decrements_sf M j))).eq
    ((input_sf j).add ((a .B).mul ((a (.rem (some j))).add (increments_sf M j)))))
  have hclock := ((a (.counter none)).add ((a .B).mul (a .last))).eq
    ((baseC_sf (Q:=Q) (J:=J)).add ((a .B).mul ((a (.rem none)).add (a .mask))))
  have hlower := (a .b).le (a (.final none))
  have hupper := ((c 2).mul (a (.final none))).lt (a .B)
  have hh := hp.and (hb.and (hbound.and (hk.and (hfull.and (hlast.and (hmask.and
    (hstate.and (hpart.and ((branch_sf M).and (htrans.and (hcounter.and (hupdate.and
    ((zero_test_sf M).and (hclock.and (hlower.and hupper)))))))))))))))
  refine hh.congr ?_
  intro z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp,hb,hbound,hk,⟨_,hfull⟩,hlast,hmask,hstate,hpart,hbranch,htrans,hcounter,hupdate,hzero,hclock,hlower,hupper⟩
    exact ⟨hp,hb,hbound,hk,hfull,hlast,hmask,hstate,hpart,hbranch,htrans,hcounter,hupdate,hzero,hclock,hlower,hupper⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.power,h.base,h.bound,h.length,⟨show 2≤(wit z).B from le_trans (by omega) h.Bfour,h.full⟩,h.last,h.mask,
      h.state_bits,h.partition,h.branch,h.transition,h.counter,h.update,h.zero_test,h.clock,h.scale_lower,h.scale_upper⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.CounterCompilation.halts_sf
statement: lemma halts_sf : SF (fun d : J → ℕ=>Counter.Halts M d)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (system_sf M).ex (fun d v u hv hu=>decode_injective (system_unique hv hu))
  refine hh.congr ?_
  intro d
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    exact ⟨_,hv.haltsAt⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨v,hv⟩:=system_complete M d h
    refine ⟨encode v,?_⟩
    simpa only [inp,wit,Function.comp_def,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,decode_encode] using hv

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.run_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma run_zero (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) : run M d 0=⟨M.start,d⟩
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.run_succ
statement: lemma run_succ (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (t : ℕ) : run M d (t+1)=next M (run M d t)
proof:
:=
  Function.iterate_succ_apply' _ _ _

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.haltsAt_unique
statement:
lemma haltsAt_unique {M : Machine Q J} {d : J → ℕ} {T U : ℕ}
    (hT : HaltsAt M d T) (hU : HaltsAt M d U) : T=U
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy T U with h|h|h
  · exact False.elim (hU.2 T h hT.1)
  · exact h
  · exact False.elim (hT.2 U h hU.1)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.value_bound
statement: lemma value_bound (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (t : ℕ) (j : J) : (run M d t).value j ≤ d j+t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [run_succ,next]
    split
    · omega
    · rename_i k p hk
      dsimp
      by_cases h : j=k
      · subst j; simp; omega
      · simp [Function.update_of_ne h]; omega
    · rename_i k p0 pd hk
      split
      · change (run M d t).value j ≤ d j+(t+1)
        omega
      · dsimp
        by_cases h : j=k
        · subst j; simp; omega
        · simp [Function.update_of_ne h]; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.Cpos
statement: lemma Cpos : 0 < baseC Q d
proof: := by simp [baseC]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.Bpos
statement: lemma Bpos : 0 < v.B
proof: := by have := h.bound; have := (System.Cpos (Q:=Q) (d:=d)); omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.Bfour
statement: lemma Bfour : 4 ≤ v.B
proof: := by have := h.base; have := h.Bpos; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.Bgt
statement: lemma Bgt : 1 < v.B
proof: := by have := h.Bfour; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.bpos
statement: lemma bpos : 0 < v.b
proof: := by have := h.base; have := h.Bpos; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.width
statement: lemma width : 0 < v.w
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hh
  have hw : v.w=0 := by omega
  have := h.power
  rw [hw,pow_zero] at this
  have := h.Bfour
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.states_bound
statement: lemma states_bound : 2*Fintype.card Q < v.B
proof:
:= by
  have := h.bound
  dsimp [baseC] at this
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.initial_bound
statement: lemma initial_bound (j : J) : d j < 2*v.b
proof:
:= by
  have hh : d j ≤ ∑i,d i := Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _=>Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  have hb := h.bound
  have hbase := h.base
  dsimp [baseC] at hb
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.clock_bound
statement: lemma clock_bound : baseC Q d < 2*v.b
proof: := by have := h.bound; have := h.base; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.last_eq
statement: lemma last_eq : v.last=v.B^(v.k-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have he := h.last
  rw [h.full,hk,pow_succ'] at he
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left h.Bpos he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.mask_eq
statement: lemma mask_eq : v.mask=ones v.B v.k
proof:
:= by
  have he := h.mask
  rw [h.full,←geometric h.Bgt v.k] at he
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (by have := h.Bgt; omega) he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.state_info
statement: lemma state_info (q : Q) : v.state q < v.B^v.k ∧ ∀t < v.k,digit v.B (v.state q) t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh := h.state_bits q
  change Packed.Bits (v.state q) v.mask at hh
  rw [h.mask_eq,h.power] at hh
  rw [h.power]
  exact (bits_ones h.width).mp hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.counter_info
statement: lemma counter_info (j : Option J) : v.counter j < v.B^v.k ∧ ∀t < v.k,digit v.B (v.counter j) t < 2*v.b
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (h.counter j).1
  change Packed.Bits (v.counter j) ((2*v.b-1)*v.mask) at hh
  rw [h.mask_eq,h.power] at hh
  have hfcap : 2*v.b-1 < 2^v.w := by have := h.base; rw [←h.power]; have := h.bpos; omega
  have hc := (bits_mask h.width hfcap).mp hh
  rw [←h.power] at hc
  refine ⟨hc.1,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have := bits_le (hc.2 t ht)
  have := h.bpos
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.rem_eq
statement: lemma rem_eq (j : Option J) : v.rem j=pack v.B (v.k-1) (digit v.B (v.counter j))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have he := (h.counter j).2.1
  rw [h.last_eq] at he
  have hr := (h.counter j).2.2
  rw [h.last_eq] at hr
  exact (division_last h.Bpos (by rw [←hk]; exact (h.counter_info j).1) he hr).2

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.final_eq
statement: lemma final_eq (j : Option J) : v.final j=digit v.B (v.counter j) (v.k-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have he := (h.counter j).2.1
  rw [h.last_eq] at he
  have hr := (h.counter j).2.2
  rw [h.last_eq] at hr
  exact (division_last h.Bpos (by rw [←hk]; exact (h.counter_info j).1) he hr).1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.state_partition
statement: lemma state_partition (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) : (∑q,digit v.B (v.state q) t)=1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀u < v.k,(∑q,digit v.B (v.state q) u) < v.B := by
    intro u hu
    have hh : (∑q,digit v.B (v.state q) u) ≤ Fintype.card Q := by
      calc _  ≤ ∑q : Q,1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q _=>(h.state_info q).2 u hu)
           _ =_ := by simp
    have := h.states_bound
    omega
  have he := digit_sum h.Bpos v.state (fun q=>(h.state_info q).1) hc t
  rw [h.partition,h.mask_eq] at he
  change digit v.B (pack v.B v.k (fun _=>1)) t=_ at he
  rw [digit_pack h.Bpos (fun _ _=>h.Bgt),ite_eq_left ht] at he
  simpa only [ite_eq_left ht] using he.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_none
statement: lemma arc_none (q : Q) (b : Bool) (he : dest M q b=none) : arc M v q b=0
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> cases b <;> simp_all [dest,arc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.incoming_sum
statement: lemma incoming_sum : (∑p,incoming M v p)=∑q,∑b : Bool,arc M v q b
proof:
:= by
  unfold incoming
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  cases he : dest M q b with
  | none => simp [System.arc_none (M:=M) (v:=v) q b he]
  | some p => simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.outgoing
statement: lemma outgoing (q : Q) : v.state q=(if q=M.halt then v.state q else 0)+∑b : Bool,arc M v q b
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => have hq := (M.halt_iff q).mp hi; simp [hq,arc,(M.halt_iff M.halt).mpr rfl]
  | inc j p =>
    have hq : q≠M.halt := by intro hh; have := (M.halt_iff q).mpr hh; rw [hi] at this; contradiction
    simp [hq,arc,hi]
  | test j p0 pd =>
    have hq : q≠M.halt := by intro hh; have := (M.halt_iff q).mpr hh; rw [hi] at this; contradiction
    have hb := h.branch q
    rw [hi] at hb
    simpa [hq,arc,hi,add_comm] using hb.2.2.1.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.outgoing_sum
statement: lemma outgoing_sum : v.mask=v.state M.halt+∑q,∑b : Bool,arc M v q b
proof:
:= by
  rw [←h.partition]
  calc
    _ = ∑q,((if q=M.halt then v.state q else 0)+∑b : Bool,arc M v q b) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _=>h.outgoing q)
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.transition_sum
statement: lemma transition_sum : v.mask=1+v.B*(∑q,∑b : Bool,arc M v q b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←h.partition]
  calc
    _ = ∑q,((if q=M.start then 1 else 0)+v.B*incoming M v q) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun q _=>h.transition q)
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,←Finset.mul_sum,(System.incoming_sum (M:=M) (v:=v))]; simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.halt_mask
statement: lemma halt_mask : v.state M.halt=v.last
proof:
:= by
  have h₁:=h.outgoing_sum
  have h₂:=h.transition_sum
  have h₃:=h.mask
  have h₄:=h.last
  have h₅ : 0 < v.H := by rw [h.full]; exact pow_pos h.Bpos _
  have h₆ : (v.B-1)*v.mask+v.mask=v.B*v.mask := by
    have hh : v.B-1+1=v.B := Nat.sub_add_cancel h.Bgt.le
    nlinarith
  have h₇ := congrArg (fun n=>v.B*n) h₁
  have h₈ : v.H-1+1=v.H := Nat.sub_add_cancel h₅
  have he : v.B*v.state M.halt=v.B*v.last := by nlinarith only [h₂,h₃,h₄,h₆,h₇,h₈]
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left h.Bpos he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_bits
statement: lemma arc_bits (q : Q) (b : Bool) : Packed.Bits (arc M v q b) v.mask
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => cases b <;> simp [arc,hi,bits_zero_left]
  | inc j p => cases b <;> simp [arc,hi,bits_zero_left]; exact h.state_bits q
  | test j p0 pd =>
    have hb:=h.branch q
    rw [hi] at hb
    cases b
    · simpa only [arc,hi] using bits_trans hb.1 (h.state_bits q)
    · simpa only [arc,hi] using bits_trans hb.2.1 (h.state_bits q)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_info
statement: lemma arc_info (q : Q) (b : Bool) : arc M v q b < v.B^v.k ∧ ∀t < v.k,digit v.B (arc M v q b) t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh:=h.arc_bits q b
  rw [h.mask_eq,h.power] at hh
  rw [h.power]
  exact (bits_ones h.width).mp hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arcs_sum_eq
statement: lemma arcs_sum_eq : (∑q,∑b : Bool,arc M v q b)=ones v.B (v.k-1)
proof:
:= by
  have he:=h.outgoing_sum
  rw [h.mask_eq,h.halt_mask,h.last_eq] at he
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have hp : ones v.B v.k=ones v.B (v.k-1)+v.B^(v.k-1) := by
    nth_rw 1 [hk]
    simp only [ones,pack_succ,one_mul]
  rw [hp] at he
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_digit_cap
statement: lemma arc_digit_cap (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) : (∑q,∑b : Bool,digit v.B (arc M v q b) t) < v.B
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (∑q,∑b : Bool,digit v.B (arc M v q b) t) ≤ 2*Fintype.card Q := by
    calc _ ≤ ∑q : Q,∑b : Bool,1 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun q _=>Finset.sum_le_sum (fun b _=>(h.arc_info q b).2 t ht))
         _ = _ := by simp; omega
  exact hc.trans_lt h.states_bound

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_digit_sum
statement:
lemma arc_digit_sum (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    (∑q,∑b : Bool,digit v.B (arc M v q b) t)=if t < v.k-1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀u < v.k,(∑a : Q×Bool,digit v.B (arc M v a.1 a.2) u) < v.B := by
    intro u hu
    simpa only [Fintype.sum_prod_type] using h.arc_digit_cap u hu
  have he:=digit_sum h.Bpos (fun a : Q×Bool=>arc M v a.1 a.2) (fun a=>(h.arc_info a.1 a.2).1) hc t
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,ite_eq_left ht,h.arcs_sum_eq] at he
  rw [ones,digit_pack h.Bpos (fun _ _=>h.Bgt)] at he
  exact he.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.selected_digit
statement:
lemma selected_digit (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) t=∑q,∑b : Bool,if P q b then digit v.B (arc M v q b) t else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx (a : Q×Bool) : (if P a.1 a.2 then arc M v a.1 a.2 else 0) < v.B^v.k := by
    split_ifs
    · exact (h.arc_info a.1 a.2).1
    · exact pow_pos h.Bpos _
  have hc : ∀u < v.k,(∑a : Q×Bool,digit v.B (if P a.1 a.2 then arc M v a.1 a.2 else 0) u) < v.B := by
    intro u hu
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ (h.arc_digit_cap u hu)
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro q hq
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b hb
    split_ifs <;> simp [digit_zero]
  have he:=digit_sum h.Bpos (fun a : Q×Bool=>if P a.1 a.2 then arc M v a.1 a.2 else 0) hx hc t
  simpa only [selected,Fintype.sum_prod_type,ite_eq_left ht,apply_ite (digit v.B) _,ite_apply,digit_zero] using he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.selected_bound
statement: lemma selected_bound (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] : selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P < v.B^v.k
proof:
:= by
  have hl : selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P ≤ ∑q,∑b : Bool,arc M v q b := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro q hq
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro b hb
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hb : ones v.B (v.k-1) ≤ ones v.B v.k := by
    have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
    conv_rhs => rw [hk,ones,pack_succ]
    exact Nat.le_add_right _ _
  exact hl.trans_lt ((h.arcs_sum_eq ▸ hb).trans_lt (pack_lt h.Bpos (fun _ _=>h.Bgt)))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.selected_le_one
statement:
lemma selected_le_one (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) t ≤ if t < v.k-1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.selected_digit P t ht,←h.arc_digit_sum t ht]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro q hq
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro b hb
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_init
statement:
lemma digit_init {B a x : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (ha : a < B) :
    digit B (a+B*x) 0=a ∧ ∀t,digit B (a+B*x) (t+1)=digit B x t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [digit,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt ha]
  · intro t
    rw [digit,pow_succ',←Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hB,
      Nat.div_eq_of_lt ha,zero_add]
    rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_add
statement:
lemma digit_add {B k x y : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hx : x < B^k) (hy : y < B^k)
    (hc : ∀t < k,digit B x t+digit B y t < B) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < k) :
    digit B (x+y) t=digit B x t+digit B y t
proof:
:= by
  have he : x+y=pack B k (fun t=>digit B x t+digit B y t) := by
    rw [pack_add,pack_digits hB hx,pack_digits hB hy]
  rw [he,digit_pack hB hc,ite_eq_left ht]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.selected_pack
statement:
lemma selected_pack (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] :
    selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P=pack v.B (v.k-1) (digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := pack_digits h.Bpos (h.selected_bound P)
  have hz : digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) (v.k-1)=0 := by
    have hh:=h.selected_le_one P (v.k-1) (by have:=h.length; omega)
    simpa using hh
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  nth_rw 1 [hk] at hp
  rw [pack_last hz] at hp
  exact hp.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.incoming_selected
statement: lemma incoming_selected (p : Q) : incoming M v p=selected (M:=M) (v:=v) (fun q b=>dest M q b=some p)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.inc_selected
statement:
lemma inc_selected (j : J) : increments M v j=selected (M:=M) (v:=v)
    (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .inc i _ => i=j ∧ b=false | _=>False)
proof:
:= by
  unfold increments selected
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [hi,arc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.dec_selected
statement:
lemma dec_selected (j : J) : decrements M v j=selected (M:=M) (v:=v)
    (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .test i _ _ => i=j ∧ b=true | _=>False)
proof:
:= by
  unfold decrements selected
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  cases hi : M.instr q <;> simp [hi,arc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.counter_update
statement:
lemma counter_update (j : J) :
    digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) 0=d j ∧ ∀t < v.k-1,
    digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) (t+1)+digit v.B (decrements M v j) t=
      digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t+digit v.B (increments M v j) t
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have ha : ∀t < v.k-1,digit v.B (increments M v j) t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [(System.inc_selected (M:=M) (v:=v))]
    have hh:=h.selected_le_one (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .inc i _=>i=j ∧ b=false | _=>False) t (by omega)
    simpa [ht] using hh
  have hf : ∀t < v.k-1,digit v.B (decrements M v j) t ≤ 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [(System.dec_selected (M:=M) (v:=v))]
    have hh:=h.selected_le_one (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .test i _ _=>i=j ∧ b=true | _=>False) t (by omega)
    simpa [ht] using hh
  apply update_coefficients (B:=v.B) (T:=v.k-1) (m:=2*v.b) (by have:=h.base; omega) (h.initial_bound j) _ _ _
    (by intro t ht; exact (h.counter_info (some j)).2 t (by omega)) ha hf
  have he:=h.update j
  rw [h.rem_eq] at he
  have hac := h.selected_pack (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .inc i _=>i=j ∧ b=false | _=>False)
  have hfc := h.selected_pack (fun q b=>match M.instr q with | .test i _ _=>i=j ∧ b=true | _=>False)
  rw [←(System.inc_selected (M:=M) (v:=v))] at hac
  rw [←(System.dec_selected (M:=M) (v:=v))] at hfc
  rw [←hk,pack_digits h.Bpos (h.counter_info (some j)).1,←hac,←hfc]
  exact he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.state_initial
statement: lemma state_initial (q : Q) : digit v.B (v.state q) 0=if q=M.start then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.transition q]
  apply (digit_init h.Bpos _).1
  split_ifs <;> have := h.Bgt <;> omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.state_step
statement: lemma state_step (q : Q) (t : ℕ) : digit v.B (v.state q) (t+1)=digit v.B (incoming M v q) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.transition q]
  apply (digit_init h.Bpos _).2
  split_ifs <;> have := h.Bgt <;> omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.clock_update
statement:
lemma clock_update : digit v.B (v.counter none) 0=baseC Q d ∧ ∀t < v.k-1,
    digit v.B (v.counter none) (t+1)=digit v.B (v.counter none) t+1
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=v.k-1+1 := by have := h.length; omega
  have hmask : v.mask=v.last+ones v.B (v.k-1) := by
    rw [h.mask_eq,h.last_eq]
    nth_rw 1 [hk]
    rw [ones,pack_succ]
    simp only [one_mul]
    exact Nat.add_comm _ _
  have he : v.counter none=baseC Q d+v.B*(v.rem none+ones v.B (v.k-1)) := by
    have hh:=h.clock
    rw [hmask] at hh
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hh := update_coefficients (B:=v.B) (T:=v.k-1) (m:=2*v.b) (d:=baseC Q d)
    (by have:=h.base; omega) h.clock_bound (digit v.B (v.counter none)) (fun _=>1) (fun _=>0)
    (by intro t ht; exact (h.counter_info none).2 t (by omega)) (by intros; omega) (by intros; omega)
  simp only [pack_const_zero,mul_zero,add_zero] at hh
  apply hh
  rw [←hk,pack_digits h.Bpos (h.counter_info none).1,←h.rem_eq]
  exact he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.clock_digits
statement: lemma clock_digits (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) : digit v.B (v.counter none) t=baseC Q d+t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simpa using h.clock_update.1
  | succ t ih => rw [h.clock_update.2 t (by omega),ih (by omega)]; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.clock_final
statement: lemma clock_final : v.final none=baseC Q d+(v.k-1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.final_eq,h.clock_digits _ (by have:=h.length; omega)]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_power
statement: lemma digit_power {B T t : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B) (ht : t < T+1) : digit B (B^T) t=if t=T then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : B^T=pack B (T+1) (fun u=>if u=T then 1 else 0) := by simp [pack]
  have hc : ∀u < T+1,(if u=T then 1 else 0) < B := by intro u hu; split_ifs <;> omega
  rw [he,digit_pack (by omega) hc,ite_eq_left ht]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_state_bits
statement: lemma arc_state_bits (q : Q) (b : Bool) : Packed.Bits (arc M v q b) (v.state q)
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : M.instr q with
  | halt => cases b <;> simp [arc,hi,bits_zero_left]
  | inc j p => cases b <;> simp [arc,hi,bits_zero_left,bits_refl]
  | test j p0 pd =>
    have hb:=h.branch q
    rw [hi] at hb
    cases b
    · simpa only [arc,hi,Bits,Packed.Bits] using hb.1
    · simpa only [arc,hi,Bits,Packed.Bits] using hb.2.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.arc_digit_le
statement: lemma arc_digit_le (q : Q) (b : Bool) (t : ℕ) : digit v.B (arc M v q b) t ≤ digit v.B (v.state q) t
proof:
:= by
  have hh:=h.arc_state_bits q b
  rw [h.power] at *
  exact bits_le ((bits_blocks h.width _ _).mp hh t)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.selected_at_state
statement:
lemma selected_at_state (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0) :
    digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) t=∑b : Bool,if P q b then digit v.B (arc M v q b) t else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.selected_digit P t ht]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_single q
  · intro p hp hpq
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro b hb
    have hzero : digit v.B (arc M v p b) t=0 := by have hh:=h.arc_digit_le p b t; rw [hs p,ite_eq_right hpq] at hh; omega
    simp [hzero]
  · simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.halt_digit
statement: lemma halt_digit (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) : digit v.B (v.state M.halt) t=if t=v.k-1 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.halt_mask,h.last_eq]
  apply digit_power h.Bgt
  have := h.length
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.test_partition
statement:
lemma test_partition (q : Q) (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t+digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t=digit v.B (v.state q) t
proof:
:= by
  have hz:=h.arc_info q false
  have hn:=h.arc_info q true
  simp only [arc,hi] at hz hn
  have hb:=h.branch q
  rw [hi] at hb
  rw [←hb.2.2.1]
  symm
  apply digit_add h.Bpos hz.1 hn.1 _ t ht
  intro u hu
  have := hz.2 u hu
  have := hn.2 u hu
  have := h.Bfour
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.complement_pack
statement:
lemma complement_pack (q : Q) (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) :
    v.complement q=pack v.B v.k (fun t=>1-digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t)
proof:
:= by
  have hz:=h.arc_info q false
  simp only [arc,hi] at hz
  have hb:=h.branch q
  rw [hi] at hb
  have he : pack v.B v.k (digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q))+pack v.B v.k (fun t=>1-digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t)=ones v.B v.k := by
    rw [←pack_add]
    apply pack_congr
    intro t ht
    exact Nat.add_sub_of_le (hz.2 t ht)
  rw [pack_digits h.Bpos hz.1,←h.mask_eq] at he
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.zero_branch_forces
statement:
lemma zero_branch_forces (q : Q) (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (hz : digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t=1) : digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t=0
proof:
:= by
  have hb:=h.zero_test q
  rw [hi] at hb
  change Packed.Bits _ _ at hb
  rw [h.complement_pack q j p0 pd hi,←pack_mul] at hb
  have hc : ∀u < v.k,(v.B-1)*(1-digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) u) < v.B := by
    intro u hu
    have hh : 1-digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) u ≤ 1 := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have := h.Bpos
    nlinarith only [hh,this,Nat.sub_le v.B 1,Nat.sub_lt this (by omega : 0 < 1)]
  have hb' : Packed.Bits (digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t)
      (digit v.B (pack v.B v.k (fun u=>(v.B-1)*(1-digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) u))) t) := by
    rw [h.power] at hb ⊢
    exact (bits_blocks h.width _ _).mp hb t
  rw [digit_pack h.Bpos hc,ite_eq_left ht,hz,Nat.sub_self,mul_zero] at hb'
  exact (bits_zero_right _).mp hb'

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.select_inc
statement:
lemma select_inc (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0)
    (j : J) (p : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.inc j p) :
    digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) t=if P q false then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.selected_at_state P t ht q hs]
  simp [arc,hi,hs q,digit_zero]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.select_test
statement:
lemma select_test (P : Q → Bool → Prop) [DecidableRel P] (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0)
    (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) :
    digit v.B (selected (M:=M) (v:=v) P) t=
      (if P q true then digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t else 0)+
      (if P q false then digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.selected_at_state P t ht q hs]
  simp [arc,hi]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.inc_values
statement:
lemma inc_values (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0)
    (j : J) (p : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.inc j p) :
    (∀z,digit v.B (incoming M v z) t=if z=p then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀i,digit v.B (increments M v i) t=if i=j then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀i,digit v.B (decrements M v i) t=0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro z
    rw [(System.incoming_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_inc _ t ht q hs j p hi]
    simp [dest,hi,eq_comm]
  constructor
  · intro i
    rw [(System.inc_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_inc _ t ht q hs j p hi]
    simp [hi,eq_comm]
  · intro i
    rw [(System.dec_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_inc _ t ht q hs j p hi]
    simp [hi]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.test_values
statement:
lemma test_values (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0)
    (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) :
    (∀z,digit v.B (incoming M v z) t=
      (if z=pd then digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t else 0)+
      (if z=p0 then digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t else 0)) ∧
    (∀i,digit v.B (increments M v i) t=0) ∧
    (∀i,digit v.B (decrements M v i) t=if i=j then digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t else 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro z
    rw [(System.incoming_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_test _ t ht q hs j p0 pd hi]
    simp [dest,hi,eq_comm]
  constructor
  · intro i
    rw [(System.inc_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_test _ t ht q hs j p0 pd hi]
    simp [hi]
  · intro i
    rw [(System.dec_selected (M:=M) (v:=v)),h.select_test _ t ht q hs j p0 pd hi]
    simp [hi,eq_comm]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.test_choice
statement:
lemma test_choice (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k-1) (q : Q)
    (hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0)
    (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd) :
    digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t=(if digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t=0 then 1 else 0) ∧
    digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t=(if digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t=0 then 0 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  have ht' : t < v.k := by omega
  have hp:=h.test_partition q j p0 pd hi t ht'
  rw [hs q,ite_eq_left rfl] at hp
  have hv:=h.test_values t ht' q hs j p0 pd hi
  have hu:=(h.counter_update j).2 t ht
  rw [hv.2.1 j,hv.2.2 j,ite_eq_left rfl,add_zero] at hu
  by_cases hz : digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t=0
  · simp only [ite_eq_left hz]
    omega
  · have hn : digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t≠1 := by
      intro hh
      exact hz (h.zero_branch_forces q j p0 pd hi t ht' hh)
    simp only [ite_eq_right hz]
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.decode
statement:
lemma decode (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    (∀q,digit v.B (v.state q) t=if q=(run M d t).state then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∀j,digit v.B (v.counter (some j)) t=(run M d t).value j)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ⟨h.state_initial,fun j=>(h.counter_update j).1⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    have ht' : t < v.k-1 := by omega
    have ht0 : t < v.k := by omega
    rcases ih ht0 with ⟨hs,hr⟩
    have hnh : (run M d t).state≠M.halt := by
      intro hh
      have hd:=h.halt_digit t ht0
      rw [hh] at hs
      rw [hs M.halt,ite_eq_left rfl,ite_eq_right (by omega)] at hd
      omega
    cases hi : M.instr (run M d t).state with
    | halt => exact False.elim (hnh ((M.halt_iff _).mp hi))
    | inc j p =>
      have hv:=h.inc_values t ht0 _ hs j p hi
      have hn : run M d (t+1)=⟨p,Function.update (run M d t).value j ((run M d t).value j+1)⟩ := by
        rw [run_succ,next,hi]
      rw [hn]
      constructor
      · intro q; exact (h.state_step q t).trans (hv.1 q)
      · intro i
        have hu:=(h.counter_update i).2 t ht'
        rw [hv.2.1 i,hv.2.2 i,hr i,add_zero] at hu
        by_cases hij : i=j
        · subst i; simpa using hu
        · simpa [hij,Function.update_of_ne hij] using hu
    | test j p0 pd =>
      have hv:=h.test_values t ht0 _ hs j p0 pd hi
      have hc:=h.test_choice t ht' _ hs j p0 pd hi
      rw [hr j] at hc
      by_cases hz : (run M d t).value j=0
      · simp only [ite_eq_left hz] at hc
        have hn : run M d (t+1)=⟨p0,(run M d t).value⟩ := by rw [run_succ]; simp [next,hi,hz]
        rw [hn]
        constructor
        · intro q
          rw [h.state_step,hv.1,hc.1,hc.2]
          simp
        · intro i
          have hu:=(h.counter_update i).2 t ht'
          rw [hv.2.1 i,hv.2.2 i,hc.2,hr i] at hu
          simpa using hu
      · simp only [ite_eq_right hz] at hc
        have hn : run M d (t+1)=⟨pd,Function.update (run M d t).value j ((run M d t).value j-1)⟩ := by
          rw [run_succ]; simp [next,hi,hz]
        rw [hn]
        constructor
        · intro q
          rw [h.state_step,hv.1,hc.1,hc.2]
          simp
        · intro i
          have hu:=(h.counter_update i).2 t ht'
          rw [hv.2.1 i,hv.2.2 i,hc.2,hr i,add_zero] at hu
          by_cases hij : i=j
          · subst i
            simp only [ite_true] at hu
            change _=(Function.update (run M d t).value j ((run M d t).value j-1)) j
            simp only [Function.update_self]
            omega
          · simpa [hij,Function.update_of_ne hij] using hu

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.haltsAt
statement: lemma haltsAt : HaltsAt M d (v.k-1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have ht : v.k-1 < v.k := by have:=h.length; omega
    have hs:=(h.decode _ ht).1 M.halt
    rw [h.halt_digit _ ht,ite_eq_left rfl] at hs
    by_contra hh
    rw [ite_eq_right (Ne.symm hh)] at hs
    omega
  · intro t ht hh
    have ht' : t < v.k := by omega
    have hs:=(h.decode t ht').1 M.halt
    rw [h.halt_digit t ht',hh,ite_eq_left rfl,ite_eq_right (by omega)] at hs
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.System.branch_digits
statement:
lemma branch_digits (q : Q) (j : J) (p0 pd : Q) (hi : M.instr q=.test j p0 pd)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < v.k) :
    digit v.B (v.zeroBranch q) t=(if q=(run M d t).state ∧ (run M d t).value j=0 then 1 else 0) ∧
    digit v.B (v.decBranch q) t=(if q=(run M d t).state ∧ (run M d t).value j≠0 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q=(run M d t).state
  · have hnh : q≠M.halt := by intro hh; have := (M.halt_iff q).mpr hh; rw [hi] at this; contradiction
    have hlt : t < v.k-1 := by
      have hh:=h.haltsAt.1
      by_contra hn
      have he : t=v.k-1 := by omega
      rw [he,hh] at hq
      exact hnh hq
    have hs : ∀p,digit v.B (v.state p) t=if p=q then 1 else 0 := by
      intro p; rw [(h.decode t ht).1 p,hq]
    have hh:=h.test_choice t hlt q hs j p0 pd hi
    rw [(h.decode t ht).2 j] at hh
    by_cases hz : (run M d t).value j=0 <;> simpa [hq,hz] using hh
  · have hz:=h.arc_digit_le q false t
    have hn:=h.arc_digit_le q true t
    simp only [arc,hi] at hz hn
    rw [(h.decode t ht).1 q,ite_eq_right hq] at hz hn
    simp only [hq,false_and,ite_false]
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.system_unique
statement: lemma system_unique {v u : Witness Q J} (hv : System M d v) (hu : System M d u) : v=u
proof:
:= by
  have hk : v.k=u.k := by
    have hh:=haltsAt_unique hv.haltsAt hu.haltsAt
    have := hv.length
    have := hu.length
    omega
  have hf : v.final none=u.final none := by rw [hv.clock_final,hu.clock_final,hk]
  have hw : v.w=u.w := by
    have hp : 0 < v.final none := by rw [hv.clock_final]; have:=(System.Cpos (Q:=Q) (d:=d)); omega
    obtain ⟨w,hw,huniq⟩:=unique_scale hp
    apply (huniq v.w _).trans (huniq u.w _).symm
    · have h₁:=hv.scale_lower; have h₂:=hv.scale_upper; have h₃:=hv.base
      rw [←hv.power]; omega
    · have h₁:=hu.scale_lower; have h₂:=hu.scale_upper; have h₃:=hu.base
      rw [←hu.power]; rw [hf]; omega
  have hB : v.B=u.B := by rw [hv.power,hu.power,hw]
  have hb : v.b=u.b := by have := hv.base; have := hu.base; omega
  have hH : v.H=u.H := by rw [hv.full,hu.full,hB,hk]
  have hl : v.last=u.last := by rw [hv.last_eq,hu.last_eq,hB,hk]
  have hm : v.mask=u.mask := by rw [hv.mask_eq,hu.mask_eq,hB,hk]
  have hs : v.state=u.state := by
    funext q
    apply digits_ext hv.Bpos (hv.state_info q).1 (by rw [hB,hk]; exact (hu.state_info q).1)
    intro t ht
    rw [(hv.decode t ht).1 q,hB,(hu.decode t (by omega)).1 q]
  have hc : v.counter=u.counter := by
    funext j
    apply digits_ext hv.Bpos (hv.counter_info j).1 (by rw [hB,hk]; exact (hu.counter_info j).1)
    intro t ht
    cases j with
    | none => rw [hv.clock_digits t ht,hB,hu.clock_digits t (by omega)]
    | some j => rw [(hv.decode t ht).2 j,hB,(hu.decode t (by omega)).2 j]
  have hz : v.zeroBranch=u.zeroBranch ∧ v.decBranch=u.decBranch ∧ v.complement=u.complement := by
    suffices ∀q,v.zeroBranch q=u.zeroBranch q ∧ v.decBranch q=u.decBranch q ∧ v.complement q=u.complement q from
      ⟨funext (fun q=>(this q).1),funext (fun q=>(this q).2.1),funext (fun q=>(this q).2.2)⟩
    intro q
    have hbv:=hv.branch q
    have hbu:=hu.branch q
    cases hi : M.instr q with
    | halt => rw [hi] at hbv hbu; omega
    | inc j p => rw [hi] at hbv hbu; omega
    | test j p0 pd =>
      rw [hi] at hbv hbu
      have hve:=hv.arc_info q false
      have hue:=hu.arc_info q false
      have hvn:=hv.arc_info q true
      have hun:=hu.arc_info q true
      simp only [arc,hi] at hve hue hvn hun
      have hze : v.zeroBranch q=u.zeroBranch q := by
        apply digits_ext hv.Bpos hve.1 (by rw [hB,hk]; exact hue.1)
        intro t ht
        rw [(hv.branch_digits q j p0 pd hi t ht).1,hB,(hu.branch_digits q j p0 pd hi t (by omega)).1]
      have hne : v.decBranch q=u.decBranch q := by
        apply digits_ext hv.Bpos hvn.1 (by rw [hB,hk]; exact hun.1)
        intro t ht
        rw [(hv.branch_digits q j p0 pd hi t ht).2,hB,(hu.branch_digits q j p0 pd hi t (by omega)).2]
      exact ⟨hze,hne,by omega⟩
  have hfinal : v.final=u.final := by
    funext j
    rw [hv.final_eq,hu.final_eq,hB,hk,hc]
  have hrem : v.rem=u.rem := by
    funext j
    rw [hv.rem_eq,hu.rem_eq,hB,hk,hc]
  rcases hz with ⟨hz,hn,hcpl⟩
  cases v
  cases u
  simp_all only

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.equation
statement: lemma equation {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) : y^2 = x^3-25*x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff, E, sub_eq_add_neg] using h.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.negY
statement: @[simp] lemma negY (x y : ℚ) : E.negY x y = -y
proof: := by simp []

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.adjusted_triple
statement:
lemma adjusted_triple {b m v x z r : ℚ} (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hp : x*z+x*r+z*r = b-2*m*v) (hv : x*z*r=v^2) :
    IsSquare (adjusted b x * adjusted b z * adjusted b r)
proof:
:= by
  have hz (x z r : ℚ) (hp : x*z+x*r+z*r = b-2*m*v) (hv : x*z*r=v^2)
      (hx : x=0) : IsSquare (adjusted b x * adjusted b z * adjusted b r) := by
    subst x
    have hv0 : v=0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v]
    rw [hv0] at hp
    have he : z*r=b := by nlinarith
    have hzn : z ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at he; exact hb he.symm
    have hrn : r ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at he; exact hb he.symm
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    simp [adjusted, hzn, hrn, mul_assoc, he]
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · exact hz x z r hp hv hx
  by_cases hzz : z=0
  · have hh := hz z x r (by nlinarith [hp]) (by nlinarith [hv]) hzz
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hh
  by_cases hr : r=0
  · have hh := hz r z x (by nlinarith [hp]) (by nlinarith [hv]) hr
    simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hh
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  simpa [adjusted, hx, hzz, hr, pow_two] using hv

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.distinct_pair
statement:
lemma distinct_pair {x z y w m : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ z)
    (h₁ : y^2=x^3-25*x) (h₂ : w^2=z^3-25*z)
    (hm : m*(x-z)=y-w) :
    x*z+(m^2-x-z)*(x+z) = -25-2*m*(y-m*x)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (x-z)*(x*z+(m^2-x-z)*(x+z)-(-25-2*m*(y-m*x)))=0 := by
    linear_combination h₁-h₂+(y+w-m*(x-z))*hm
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.shifted_line
statement:
lemma shifted_line {x z y m e : ℚ} (he : e^3-25*e=0)
    (h₁ : y^2=x^3-25*x)
    (hp : x*z+(m^2-x-z)*(x+z) = -25-2*m*(y-m*x)) :
    let r
proof:
:= m^2-x-z
    let v := y-m*(x-e)
    (x-e)*(z-e)+(x-e)*(r-e)+(z-e)*(r-e) =
      (3*e^2-25)-2*m*v ∧
    (x-e)*(z-e)*(r-e)=v^2 := by
  dsimp
  constructor
  · linear_combination hp
  · linear_combination -h₁ + (x-e)*hp - he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alphaVal_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma alphaVal_zero (e : ℚ) : alphaVal e 0 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alphaVal_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma alphaVal_some (e : ℚ) {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) :
    alphaVal e (.some x y h) = adjusted (3*e^2-25) (x-e)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alphaVal_ne_zero
statement:
lemma alphaVal_ne_zero (e : ℚ) (hb : 3*e^2-25 ≠ 0) (P : E.Point) :
    alphaVal e P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => exact one_ne_zero
  | some x y h => simp only [alphaVal, adjusted]; split_ifs <;> assumption

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alphaVal_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma alphaVal_neg (e : ℚ) (P : E.Point) : alphaVal e (-P) = alphaVal e P
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => simp only [← zero_def, _root_.neg_zero]
  | some x y h => rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alphaVal_add_square
statement:
lemma alphaVal_add_square (e : ℚ) (he : e^3-25*e=0) (hb : 3*e^2-25 ≠ 0)
    (P Q : E.Point) : IsSquare (alphaVal e P * alphaVal e Q * alphaVal e (P+Q))
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => simpa only [← zero_def, zero_add, alphaVal_zero, one_mul] using
      (IsSquare.mul_self (alphaVal e Q))
  | some x y h =>
    cases Q with
    | zero => simpa only [← zero_def, add_zero, alphaVal_zero, mul_one] using
        (IsSquare.mul_self (alphaVal e (some x y h)))
    | some z w h' =>
      by_cases hneg : (some x y h : E.Point) = -(some z w h')
      · rw [hneg, neg_add_cancel, alphaVal_neg, alphaVal_zero, mul_one]
        exact IsSquare.mul_self _
      have hxneg : ¬(x=z ∧ y=E.negY z w) := by
        rintro ⟨rfl, hy⟩
        apply hneg
        simp only [neg_some, hy]
      by_cases hx : x=z
      · subst z
        have hyw : y=w := by
          have hh : y=w ∨ y=-w := by
            have heq := equation h
            have heq' := equation h'
            exact (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp (heq.trans heq'.symm)
          exact hh.resolve_right (fun hy => hxneg ⟨rfl, by simpa only [negY] using hy⟩)
        subst w
        have hy : y ≠ E.negY x y := fun hy => hxneg ⟨rfl,hy⟩
        have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          exact hy (by simp [hz])
        have hm : (E.slope x x y y)*(2*y)=3*x^2-25 := by
          rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy]
          simp [ WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY]
          field_simp
          ring
        have hp : x*x+((E.slope x x y y)^2-x-x)*(x+x) =
            -25-2*(E.slope x x y y)*(y-(E.slope x x y y)*x) := by
          linear_combination hm
        have hc := shifted_line he (equation h) hp
        dsimp at hc
        rw [add_self_of_Y_ne hy, alphaVal_some, alphaVal_some]
        change IsSquare (adjusted (3*e^2-25) (x-e) * adjusted (3*e^2-25) (x-e) *
          adjusted (3*e^2-25) (E.addX x x (E.slope x x y y)-e))
        simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, E] using adjusted_triple hb hc.1 hc.2
      · have hm : E.slope x z y w * (x-z)=y-w := by
          rw [slope_of_X_ne hx]
          exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx)
        have hp := distinct_pair hx (equation h) (equation h') hm
        have hc := shifted_line he (equation h) hp
        dsimp at hc
        rw [add_of_X_ne hx, alphaVal_some, alphaVal_some, alphaVal_some]
        simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, E] using adjusted_triple hb hc.1 hc.2

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma classOf_zero : classOf 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [classOf]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_one
statement: @[simp] lemma classOf_one : classOf 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [classOf]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_mul
statement:
lemma classOf_mul {x y : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    classOf (x*y)=classOf x * classOf y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [classOf, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right hy, dite_eq_right (mul_ne_zero hx hy)]
  rw [Units.mk0_mul]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_eq_one_iff
statement: lemma classOf_eq_one_iff {x : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ 0) : classOf x = 1 ↔ IsSquare x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [classOf, dite_eq_right hx, QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff, MonoidHom.mem_range,
    powMonoidHom_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨r,hr⟩
    refine ⟨(r:ℚ), ?_⟩
    have hh := congrArg (fun a : ℚˣ => (a:ℚ)) hr
    simpa [pow_two] using hh.symm
  · rintro ⟨r,hr⟩
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hr; exact hx hr
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 r hr0, ?_⟩
    apply Units.ext
    simpa [pow_two] using hr.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_square
statement: lemma classOf_square (x : ℚ) : classOf (x*x)=1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · simp [hx]
  · exact (classOf_eq_one_iff (mul_ne_zero hx hx)).mpr (IsSquare.mul_self _)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_self_mul
statement: lemma classOf_self_mul (x : ℚ) : classOf x * classOf x = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · simp [hx]
  · rw [← classOf_mul hx hx, classOf_square]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.squareClass_self_mul
statement: lemma squareClass_self_mul (c : SquareClass) : c*c=1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u,rfl⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_surjective c
  have hu : (u:ℚ) ≠ 0 := u.ne_zero
  have he : classOf (u:ℚ) = QuotientGroup.mk u := by
    simp only [classOf, dite_eq_right hu]
    congr 1
    ext
    rfl
  rw [← he]
  exact classOf_self_mul _

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.squareClass_inv
statement: lemma squareClass_inv (c : SquareClass) : c⁻¹=c
proof:
:= by
  exact inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_left (squareClass_self_mul c)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_inv
statement: lemma classOf_inv (x : ℚ) : classOf x⁻¹ = (classOf x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · simp [hx]
  · simp only [classOf, dite_eq_right hx, dite_eq_right (inv_ne_zero hx)]
    have he : Units.mk0 x⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hx) = (Units.mk0 x hx)⁻¹ := by ext; rfl
    rw [he]
    rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_div
statement:
lemma classOf_div {x y : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    classOf (x/y)=classOf x * classOf y
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, classOf_mul hx (inv_ne_zero hy), classOf_inv, squareClass_inv]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_pow
statement: lemma classOf_pow (x : ℚ) (n : ℕ) : classOf (x^n)=(classOf x)^n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x=0
  · subst x
    cases n <;> simp
  · induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n hn => rw [pow_succ, classOf_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hx) hx, hn, pow_succ]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.half_algebra
statement:
lemma half_algebra {x r s t : ℚ} (hr : r^2=x) (hs : s^2=x-5) (ht : t^2=x+5) :
    let X
proof:
:= x+r*s+r*t+s*t
    let Y := -(r+s)*(r+t)*(s+t)
    Y ≠ 0 ∧ Y^2 = X^3-25*X ∧ (-(r+s+t))*(2*Y)=3*X^2-25 ∧
    (-(r+s+t))^2-2*X=x := by
  dsimp
  have hA : r+s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : r = -s := by linarith
    rw [he] at hr
    nlinarith
  have hB : r+t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : r = -t := by linarith
    rw [he] at hr
    nlinarith
  have hC : s+t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he : s = -t := by linarith
    rw [he] at hs
    nlinarith
  have h₁ : (r+s)*(r+t)=x+r*s+r*t+s*t := by nlinarith
  have h₂ : (r+s)*(s+t)=x+r*s+r*t+s*t-5 := by nlinarith
  have h₃ : (r+t)*(s+t)=x+r*s+r*t+s*t+5 := by nlinarith
  refine ⟨mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr hA) hB) hC, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      (-(r+s)*(r+t)*(s+t))^2 =
          ((r+s)*(r+t))*((r+s)*(s+t))*((r+t)*(s+t)) := by ring
      _ = (x+r*s+r*t+s*t)^3-25*(x+r*s+r*t+s*t) := by rw [h₁,h₂,h₃]; ring
  · have hid : (r+s)*(r+t)*((r+s)*(s+t)) + (r+s)*(r+t)*((r+t)*(s+t)) +
        (r+s)*(s+t)*((r+t)*(s+t)) =
        (-(r+s+t))*(2*(-(r+s)*(r+t)*(s+t))) := by ring
    rw [h₁,h₂,h₃] at hid
    nlinarith only [hid]
  · nlinarith only [hr,hs,ht]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.exists_half_of_squares
statement:
lemma exists_half_of_squares {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y)
    (h₀ : IsSquare x) (hp : IsSquare (x-5)) (hn : IsSquare (x+5)) :
    ∃ Q : E.Point, (2:ℕ) • Q = some x y h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := h₀
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := hn
  have hr' : r^2=x := by simpa only [pow_two] using hr.symm
  have hs' : s^2=x-5 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hs.symm
  have ht' : t^2=x+5 := by simpa only [pow_two] using ht.symm
  let X := x+r*s+r*t+s*t
  let Y := -(r+s)*(r+t)*(s+t)
  obtain ⟨hY,heq,htan,hdup⟩ := half_algebra hr' hs' ht'
  change Y ≠ 0 at hY
  change Y^2=X^3-25*X at heq
  change (-(r+s+t))*(2*Y)=3*X^2-25 at htan
  change (-(r+s+t))^2-2*X=x at hdup
  have hQ : E.Nonsingular X Y := E.equation_iff_nonsingular.mp (by
    simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff, E, sub_eq_add_neg] using heq)
