  have hYn : Y ≠ E.negY X Y := by rw [negY]; intro hh; apply hY; linarith
  have hm : E.slope X X Y Y = -(r+s+t) := by
    rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hYn]
    simp only [ WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY]
    convert (div_eq_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2:ℚ) ≠ 0) hY)).mpr htan.symm using 1; ring
  have hx : E.addX X X (E.slope X X Y Y)=x := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, hm]
    simp only []
    linarith only [hdup]
  have hsame : ((2:ℕ) • (some X Y hQ : E.Point)).xRep = (some x y h).xRep := by
    rw [two_smul, add_self_of_Y_ne hYn]
    simp only [xRep_some, hx]
  rcases eq_or_eq_neg_of_xRep_eq_xRep hsame with hp | hp
  · exact ⟨some X Y hQ,hp⟩
  · refine ⟨-(some X Y hQ), ?_⟩
    simpa only [two_smul, neg_add, neg_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg hp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.not_isSquare_prime
statement: lemma not_isSquare_prime (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : ¬IsSquare (p:ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r,hr⟩
  have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  have hv := congrArg (padicValRat p) hr
  rw [← pow_two, padicValRat.pow, padicValRat.self hp.one_lt] at hv
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.kummer_halves
statement: lemma kummer_halves (P : E.Point) : kummer ((2:ℕ) • P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_nsmul]
  rw [two_smul]
  apply Prod.ext <;> change (classOf _)*(classOf _)=1 <;> exact classOf_self_mul _

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.kummer_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem kummer_eq_zero_iff (P : E.Point) : kummer P = 0 ↔ ∃ Q : E.Point, (2:ℕ) • Q=P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have h₀ := congrArg Prod.fst hp
    have h₅ := congrArg Prod.snd hp
    cases P with
    | zero => exact ⟨0,by simp only [← zero_def, two_smul, zero_add]⟩
    | some x y h =>
      change classOf (adjusted (3*0^2-25) (x-0))=1 at h₀
      change classOf (adjusted (3*5^2-25) (x-5))=1 at h₅
      norm_num only [sub_zero] at h₀ h₅
      have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
        intro hx
        rw [hx] at h₀
        have hh := (classOf_eq_one_iff (by norm_num : (-25:ℚ) ≠ 0)).mp (by simpa [adjusted] using h₀)
        exact (by norm_num : ¬ (0:ℚ) ≤ -25) hh.nonneg
      have hs₀ : IsSquare x := (classOf_eq_one_iff hx).mp (by simpa [adjusted,hx] using h₀)
      have hx5 : x-5 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hh
        have he : x=5 := by linarith
        rw [he] at hs₀
        exact not_isSquare_prime 5 (by norm_num) hs₀
      have hs₅ : IsSquare (x-5) := (classOf_eq_one_iff hx5).mp (by simpa [adjusted,hx5] using h₅)
      apply exists_half_of_squares h hs₀ hs₅
      obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hs₀
      obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hs₅
      have hrr : r ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hr; exact hx hr
      have hss : s ≠ 0 := by intro hh; simp [hh] at hs; exact hx5 hs
      refine ⟨y/(r*s), ?_⟩
      have he := equation h
      have he' : (r*s)^2*(x+5)=y^2 := by
        calc
          (r*s)^2*(x+5) = x*(x-5)*(x+5) := by rw [mul_pow, pow_two, pow_two, ←hr, ←hs]
          _ = y^2 := by nlinarith only [he]
      field_simp
      nlinarith only [he']
  · rintro ⟨Q,rfl⟩
    exact kummer_halves Q

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.gcd_numerator_divides
statement:
lemma gcd_numerator_divides (a b : ℤ) (h : IsCoprime a b) :
    gcd ((a^2+25*b^2)^2) (4*a*b*(a^2-25*b^2)) ∣ (6250000:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let N := (a^2+25*b^2)^2
  have ht : IsCoprime (a^2+25*b^2) b := by
    have hh := (h.pow_left (m:=2)).add_mul_right_left (25*b)
    simpa only [pow_two,mul_assoc] using hh
  have hs : IsCoprime (a^2-25*b^2) b := by
    have hh := (h.pow_left (m:=2)).add_mul_right_left (-25*b)
    simpa only [pow_two,mul_assoc,neg_mul,sub_eq_add_neg] using hh
  have h4 : gcd N 4 ∣ (4:ℤ) := gcd_dvd_right _ _
  have ha : gcd N a ∣ (625:ℤ) := by
    have hcop : IsCoprime (gcd N a) (b^4) :=
      (h.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_right N a)).pow_right
    apply hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    have hh := dvd_sub (gcd_dvd_left N a)
      (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_right N a) (a^3+50*a*b^2))
    convert hh using 1; dsimp [N]; ring
  have hb : gcd N b ∣ (1:ℤ) :=
    ((ht.pow_left (m:=2)).isUnit_of_dvd' (gcd_dvd_left N b) (gcd_dvd_right N b)).dvd
  have hc : gcd N (a^2-25*b^2) ∣ (2500:ℤ) := by
    have hcop : IsCoprime (gcd N (a^2-25*b^2)) (b^4) :=
      (hs.of_isCoprime_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_right N _)).pow_right
    apply hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
    have hh := dvd_sub (gcd_dvd_left N (a^2-25*b^2))
      (dvd_mul_of_dvd_left (gcd_dvd_right N (a^2-25*b^2)) (a^2+75*b^2))
    convert hh using 1; dsimp [N]; ring
  have hh := gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd N (4*a*b) (a^2-25*b^2)
  have h₁ := gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd N (4*a) b
  have h₂ := gcd_mul_dvd_mul_gcd N 4 a
  exact hh.trans ((mul_dvd_mul
    (h₁.trans (mul_dvd_mul (h₂.trans (mul_dvd_mul h4 ha)) hb)) hc) |>.trans (by norm_num))

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.common_divisor_bound
statement:
lemma common_divisor_bound (a b c : ℤ) (h : IsCoprime a b)
    (hN : c ∣ (a^2+25*b^2)^2) (hD : c ∣ 4*a*b*(a^2-25*b^2)) : c ∣ (6250000:ℤ)
proof:
:=
  (dvd_gcd hN hD).trans (gcd_numerator_divides a b h)

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.dupX_fraction
statement:
lemma dupX_fraction (x : ℚ) : dupX x =
    (((x.num:ℤ)^2+25*(x.den:ℤ)^2)^2 : ℤ) / (4*x.num*x.den*(x.num^2-25*(x.den:ℤ)^2) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : (x.den:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast x.den_ne_zero
  conv_lhs => rw [←x.num_div_den]
  unfold dupX
  push_cast
  field_simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.height_dup_lower
statement:
lemma height_dup_lower (x : ℚ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hs : x^2-25 ≠ 0) :
    height x ^ 4 ≤ 6250000 * height (dupX x)
proof:
:= by
  let a := x.num
  let b : ℤ := x.den
  let N := (a^2+25*b^2)^2
  let D := 4*a*b*(a^2-25*b^2)
  have hb : (x.den:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast x.den_ne_zero
  have ha : a ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hx
  have hsn : a^2-25*b^2 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hh
    apply hs
    rw [←x.num_div_den]
    dsimp [a,b] at hh
    have hh' : (x.num:ℚ)^2-25*(x.den:ℚ)^2=0 := by exact_mod_cast hh
    field_simp
    nlinarith only [hh']
  have hD : D ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha)
    (by dsimp [b]; exact_mod_cast x.den_ne_zero)) hsn
  have hf : dupX x = Rat.divInt N D := by
    rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div]
    exact dupX_fraction x
  obtain ⟨c,hNc,hDc⟩ := Rat.num_den_mk hD hf
  have hc : c ∣ (6250000:ℤ) := common_divisor_bound a b c x.isCoprime_num_den
    ⟨_,hNc⟩ ⟨_,hDc⟩
  have hc' : c.natAbs ≤ 6250000 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) (Int.natAbs_dvd_natAbs.mpr hc)
  have hN : N.natAbs ≤ 6250000 * height (dupX x) := by
    rw [hNc,Int.natAbs_mul]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul hc' (le_max_left _ _)
  apply le_trans _ hN
  have hN' : (N.natAbs:ℤ)=N := Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
  have ha' : (a.natAbs:ℤ)^2=a^2 := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs,sq_abs]
  apply Int.ofNat_le.mp
  rw [hN']
  push_cast
  unfold height
  rcases le_total x.num.natAbs x.den with hl|hl
  · rw [max_eq_right hl]
    change (b^4:ℤ) ≤ (a^2+25*b^2)^2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a^2),sq_nonneg (b^2),mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (sq_nonneg b)]
  · rw [max_eq_left hl]
    change (a.natAbs:ℤ)^4 ≤ (a^2+25*b^2)^2
    rw [show (a.natAbs:ℤ)^4=((a.natAbs:ℤ)^2)^2 by ring,ha']
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b^2),mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg a) (sq_nonneg b)]

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.denominator_square
statement: lemma denominator_square {x y : ℚ} (he : y^2=x^3-25*x) : IsSquare x.den
proof:
:= by
  let a := x.num
  let b : ℤ := x.den
  have hb : 0 < b := by dsimp [b]; exact_mod_cast x.den_pos
  have hbq : (x.den:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast x.den_ne_zero
  have hcop : IsCoprime (a^3-25*a*b^2) (b^3) := by
    apply IsCoprime.pow_right
    have hh := (x.isCoprime_num_den.pow_left (m:=3)).add_mul_right_left (-25*a*b)
    have hn : a^3-25*a*b^2=x.num^3+(-25*a*b)*(x.den:ℤ) := by dsimp [a,b]; ring
    rw [hn]
    exact hh
  have hf : y^2=((a^3-25*a*b^2:ℤ):ℚ)/(b^3:ℤ) := by
    rw [he]
    conv_lhs => rw [←x.num_div_den]
    dsimp [a,b]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  have hd := Rat.den_div_eq_of_coprime (pow_pos hb 3) (Int.isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime.mp hcop)
  rw [←hf,Rat.den_pow] at hd
  dsimp [b] at hd
  have hd' : (y.den:ℚ)^2=(x.den:ℚ)^3 := by exact_mod_cast hd
  apply Rat.isSquare_natCast_iff.mp
  refine ⟨(y.den:ℚ)/x.den,?_⟩
  field_simp
  nlinarith only [hd']

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.bounded_points
statement:
lemma bounded_points (i : Fin 19) (j : Fin 20) (k : Fin 13) :
    let x : ℚ
proof:
:= (20*(i.val:ℤ)+(j.val:ℤ)-184) / ((k.val+1:ℕ):ℚ)^2
    IsSquare (x^3-25*x) → x=0 ∨ x=5 ∨ x= -5 ∨ x= -4 ∨ x=45 ∨ x=25/4 ∨ x= -5/9 := by
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases i <;> revert j <;> decide +kernel

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.small_points
statement:
lemma small_points {x y : ℚ} (he : y^2=x^3-25*x) (hH : height x < 185) :
    x=0 ∨ x=5 ∨ x= -5 ∨ x= -4 ∨ x=45 ∨ x=25/4 ∨ x= -5/9
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := denominator_square he
  have hnum : x.num.natAbs < 185 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hH
  have hden : x.den < 185 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hH
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by have := x.den_pos; rw [hk] at this; nlinarith
  have hklt : k < 14 := by rw [hk] at hden; nlinarith
  let a := (x.num+184).toNat
  have ha : (a:ℤ)=x.num+184 := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (by
    have hh' : -(184:ℤ) ≤ x.num := by
      have : (x.num.natAbs:ℤ) ≤ 184 := by exact_mod_cast (show x.num.natAbs ≤ 184 by omega)
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs] at this
      exact (abs_le.mp this).1
    omega)
  have halt : a < 369 := by
    have hh' : x.num ≤ 184 := by
      have : (x.num.natAbs:ℤ) ≤ 184 := by exact_mod_cast (show x.num.natAbs ≤ 184 by omega)
      rw [Int.natCast_natAbs] at this
      exact (abs_le.mp this).2
    omega
  have harr : 20*(a/20)+a%20=a := by omega
  have hv : (20*(a/20:ℕ)+(a%20:ℕ)-184:ℚ) / ((k-1+1:ℕ):ℚ)^2 = x := by
    rw [show k-1+1=k by omega]
    have hh : (20*(a/20:ℕ)+(a%20:ℕ)-184:ℚ) = (x.num:ℚ) := by
      have haQ : (a:ℚ)=(x.num:ℚ)+184 := by exact_mod_cast ha
      have hrQ : 20*(a/20:ℕ)+(a%20:ℕ)=(a:ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast harr
      linarith
    calc
      _=(x.num:ℚ)/x.den := by rw [hh,hk]; push_cast; ring
      _=x := x.num_div_den
  have h := bounded_points ⟨a/20,by omega⟩ ⟨a%20,by omega⟩ ⟨k-1,by omega⟩
  dsimp only at h
  simp only [Int.cast_natCast] at h
  rw [hv] at h
  exact h ⟨y,by nlinarith only [he]⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.height_dup_strict
statement:
lemma height_dup_strict {x y : ℚ} (he : y^2=x^3-25*x) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    height x < height (dupX x)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at he; simp at he; exact hy he
  have hs : x^2-25 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hh : y^2=0 := by linear_combination he+x*h
    exact hy (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hh)
  by_cases hH : height x < 185
  · rcases small_points he hH with h|h|h|h|h|h|h
    · exact False.elim (hx h)
    · subst x; norm_num at hs
    · subst x; norm_num at hs
    · subst x; decide +kernel
    · subst x; decide +kernel
    · subst x; decide +kernel
    · subst x; decide +kernel
  · have hH' : 185 ≤ height x := by omega
    have hc : 6250000 < height x ^ 3 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hH' 3)
    have hhp : 0 < height x := by omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc hhp
    have hmul' : 6250000*height x < height x^4 := by simpa [pow_succ] using hmul
    have hl := height_dup_lower x hx hs
    nlinarith only [hmul',hl]

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.height_dup_gt_five
statement:
lemma height_dup_gt_five {x y : ℚ} (he : y^2=x^3-25*x) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    5 < height (dupX x)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hH : 5 ≤ height x
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt hH (height_dup_strict he hy)
  · rcases small_points he (by omega) with h|h|h|h|h|h|h
    all_goals subst x
    · norm_num at he; exact False.elim (hy he)
    · norm_num at he; exact False.elim (hy he)
    · norm_num at he; exact False.elim (hy he)
    · decide +kernel
    · norm_num [height] at hH
    · norm_num [height] at hH
    · norm_num [height] at hH

name: OAI.SingleFold.DuplicationBound.height_y_zero
statement: lemma height_y_zero {x y : ℚ} (he : y^2=x^3-25*x) (hy : y = 0) : height x ≤ 5
proof:
:= by
  have h : x*(x-5)*(x+5)=0 := by rw [hy] at he; linear_combination -he
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h|h
  · rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h|h
    · subst x; decide
    · have : x=5 := by linarith
      subst x; decide
  · have : x= -5 := by linarith
    subst x; decide

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.equation_iff
statement: lemma equation_iff (x y : ℚ) : E.Nonsingular x y ↔ y^2=x^3-25*x
proof:
:= by
  rw [←E.equation_iff_nonsingular]
  simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff,E,sub_eq_add_neg]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.encode_valid
statement: lemma encode_valid (P : E.Point) : (encode P).Valid
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => exact ⟨RationalCode.encode_valid _,RationalCode.encode_valid _,Or.inl ⟨rfl,RationalCode.encode_value _,RationalCode.encode_value _⟩⟩
  | some x y hp =>
    refine ⟨RationalCode.encode_valid _,RationalCode.encode_valid _,Or.inr ⟨rfl,?_⟩⟩
    simpa [encode,RationalCode.encode_value] using (equation_iff _ _).mp hp

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.Code.encode_toPoint
statement: lemma Code.encode_toPoint (c : Code) (hc : c.Valid) : encode (c.toPoint hc)=c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : c.flag=1
  · have hxy := (hc.2.2.resolve_right (by rintro ⟨h,_⟩; omega)).2
    have hx : RationalCode.encode 0=c.x := RationalCode.unique (RationalCode.encode_valid _) hc.1 ((RationalCode.encode_value _).trans hxy.1.symm)
    have hy : RationalCode.encode 0=c.y := RationalCode.unique (RationalCode.encode_valid _) hc.2.1 ((RationalCode.encode_value _).trans hxy.2.symm)
    simp only [Code.toPoint,dite_eq_left hf,encode,hx]
    cases c; simp_all
  · have hf0 := (hc.2.2.resolve_left (by tauto)).1
    simp only [Code.toPoint,dite_eq_right hf,encode,←RationalCode.eq_encode hc.1,←RationalCode.eq_encode hc.2.1]
    cases c; simp_all

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.encode_toPoint
statement: lemma encode_toPoint (P : E.Point) : (encode P).toPoint (encode_valid P)=P
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => simp [Code.toPoint,encode,←zero_def]
  | some x y h => simp [Code.toPoint,encode,RationalCode.encode_value]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.Code.unique
statement: lemma Code.unique {c d : Code} (hc : c.Valid) (hd : d.Valid) (he : c.toPoint hc=d.toPoint hd) : c=d
proof:
:= by
  rw [←c.encode_toPoint hc,←d.encode_toPoint hd,he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.from_tuple
statement: lemma from_tuple (c : Code) : fromTuple (tuple c)=c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fromTuple,tuple,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,ite_true,show (1:Fin 2)≠0 by decide,ite_false]
  change Code.mk c.flag (code (RationalCompiler.tuple c.x)) (code (RationalCompiler.tuple c.y))=c
  rw [code_tuple,code_tuple]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.tuple_from
statement: lemma tuple_from (z : Var → ℕ) : tuple (fromTuple z)=z
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases i with i|⟨i,j⟩
  · rfl
  · fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.code_valid_semi
statement: lemma code_valid_semi : Semi (fun z => (fromTuple z).Valid)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 2 × Fin 6 → Var := Sum.inr
  let G : (Var → ℕ) → Prop := fun z => Valid (z ∘ f)
  have hg : Semi G := valid_semi.reindex f
  have eqc (p q : Expr (Fin 2)) := Expr.eq_under hg f (fun _ h => h) p q
  let x : Expr (Fin 2) := .var 0
  let y : Expr (Fin 2) := .var 1
  have ho := (Semi.eq (Poly.proj (.inl () : Var)) 1).and ((eqc x 0).and (eqc y 0))
  have ha := (Semi.eq (Poly.proj (.inl () : Var)) 0).and (eqc (y^2) (x^3-25*x))
  refine (ho.or ha).congr ?_
  intro z
  have hG : G z ↔ (fromTuple z).x.Valid ∧ (fromTuple z).y.Valid := by
    change (∀ i : Fin 2, (code (fun j => z (Sum.inr (i,j)))).Valid) ↔ _
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨h 0,h 1⟩
    · intro h i; fin_cases i; exact h.1; exact h.2
  simp only [Expr.eval_pow,Expr.eval_sub,Expr.eval_mul,Expr.eval_zero,
    Expr.eval_var,Poly.proj_apply,Poly.one_apply,Poly.zero_apply,x,y] at *
  change (((z (.inl ()):ℤ)=1 ∧ (G z ∧ (fromTuple z).x.value=0) ∧ G z ∧ (fromTuple z).y.value=0) ∨
    (z (.inl ()):ℤ)=0 ∧ G z ∧ (fromTuple z).y.value^2=(fromTuple z).x.value^3-25*(fromTuple z).x.value) ↔ _
  rw [hG]
  have h1 : (z (.inl ()):ℤ)=1 ↔ z (.inl ())=1 := by omega
  have h0 : (z (.inl ()):ℤ)=0 ↔ z (.inl ())=0 := by omega
  rw [h1,h0]
  dsimp only [Code.Valid,fromTuple]
  tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.line_iff
statement:
lemma line_iff {d n x₁ x₂ y₁ x₃ y₃ : ℚ} (hd : d≠0) :
    Line d n x₁ x₂ y₁ x₃ y₃ ↔
      x₃=(n/d)^2-x₁-x₂ ∧ y₃=n/d*(x₁-x₃)-y₁
proof:
:= by
  unfold Line
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩
    constructor
    · field_simp
      nlinarith only [hx]
    · field_simp
      nlinarith only [hy]
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩
    field_simp at hx hy
    constructor <;> nlinarith only [hx,hy]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.E_addX
statement: @[simp] lemma E_addX (x₁ x₂ l : ℚ) : E.addX x₁ x₂ l=l^2-x₁-x₂
proof: := by simp [E]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.E_addY
statement: @[simp] lemma E_addY (x₁ x₂ y₁ l : ℚ) : E.addY x₁ x₂ y₁ l=l*(x₁-(l^2-x₁-x₂))-y₁
proof: := by simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addY,WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negAddY,WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY,E]; ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.E_negY
statement: @[simp] lemma E_negY (x y : ℚ) : E.negY x y= -y
proof: := by simp [E]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.line_chord
statement:
lemma line_chord {x₁ x₂ y₁ y₂ x₃ y₃ : ℚ}
    (h₁ : E.Nonsingular x₁ y₁) (h₂ : E.Nonsingular x₂ y₂) (h₃ : E.Nonsingular x₃ y₃)
    (hx : x₁≠x₂) :
    Line (x₁-x₂) (y₁-y₂) x₁ x₂ y₁ x₃ y₃ ↔ some x₁ y₁ h₁+some x₂ y₂ h₂=some x₃ y₃ h₃
proof:
:= by
  rw [line_iff (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx),add_of_X_ne hx,some.injEq,slope_of_X_ne hx,E_addX,E_addY]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩; exact ⟨hx.symm,by rw [←hx]; exact hy.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩; exact ⟨hx.symm,by rw [hx] at hy; exact hy.symm⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.line_tangent
proof:
:= by
  have hyn : y≠E.negY x y := by rw [E_negY]; intro he; apply hy; linarith
  have hs : E.slope x x y y=(3*x^2-25)/(2*y) := by
    rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hyn,E_negY]
    simp only [E]
    congr 1 <;> ring
  rw [line_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hy),add_self_of_Y_ne hyn,some.injEq,hs,E_addX,E_addY]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩; exact ⟨hx.symm,by rw [←hx]; exact hy.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx,hy⟩; exact ⟨hx.symm,by rw [hx] at hy; exact hy.symm⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.encode_injective
statement: lemma encode_injective : Function.Injective encode
proof:
:= by
  intro p q he
  have he' : (⟨encode p,encode_valid p⟩ : {c : Code // c.Valid})=⟨encode q,encode_valid q⟩ := Subtype.ext he
  have hh := congrArg (fun c : {c : Code // c.Valid} => c.1.toPoint c.2) he'
  simpa only [encode_toPoint] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.addEq_encode
statement: lemma addEq_encode (P Q R : E.Point) : AddEq (encode P) (encode Q) (encode R) ↔ P+Q=R
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero =>
    simp only [AddEq,encode,one_ne_zero,false_and,true_and,or_false]
    change (encode R=encode Q) ↔ (0:E.Point)+Q=R
    simp only [zero_add,encode_injective.eq_iff,eq_comm]
  | some x₁ y₁ h₁ =>
    cases Q with
    | zero =>
      simp only [AddEq,encode,zero_ne_one,false_and,true_and,false_or,one_ne_zero]
      change (encode R=encode (some x₁ y₁ h₁)) ∨ False ↔ some x₁ y₁ h₁+(0:E.Point)=R
      simp only [or_false,add_zero,encode_injective.eq_iff,eq_comm]
    | some x₂ y₂ h₂ =>
      have hv := (equation_iff _ _).mp h₁
      have hw := (equation_iff _ _).mp h₂
      by_cases hx : x₁=x₂
      · subst x₂
        by_cases hy : y₁+y₂=0
        · have he : y₁=E.negY x₁ y₂ := by rw [E_negY]; linarith
          rw [add_of_Y_eq rfl he]
          cases R <;> simp [AddEq,encode,RationalCode.encode_value,hy,←zero_def]
        · have hy' : y₁=y₂ := by
            rcases (sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg).mp (hv.trans hw.symm) with hh|hh
            · exact hh
            · exact False.elim (hy (by linarith))
          subst y₂
          have hyn : y₁≠0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hy
          cases R with
          | zero =>
            have hn : y₁≠E.negY x₁ y₁ := by rw [E_negY]; intro he; apply hyn; linarith
            rw [add_self_of_Y_ne hn]
            simp [AddEq,encode,RationalCode.encode_value,hy,←zero_def]
          | some x₃ y₃ h₃ =>
            simpa [AddEq,encode,RationalCode.encode_value,hy] using line_tangent h₁ h₃ hyn
      · cases R with
        | zero =>
          rw [add_of_X_ne hx]
          simp [AddEq,encode,RationalCode.encode_value,hx,←zero_def]
        | some x₃ y₃ h₃ =>
          simpa [AddEq,encode,RationalCode.encode_value,hx] using line_chord h₁ h₂ h₃ hx

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.addEq_spec
statement:
lemma addEq_spec (a b c : Code) (ha : a.Valid) (hb : b.Valid) (hc : c.Valid) :
    AddEq a b c ↔ a.toPoint ha+b.toPoint hb=c.toPoint hc
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Code.encode_toPoint] using addEq_encode (a.toPoint ha) (b.toPoint hb) (c.toPoint hc)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.addition_existsUnique
statement:
lemma addition_existsUnique (a b : Code) (ha : a.Valid) (hb : b.Valid) :
    ∃! c : Code, c.Valid ∧ AddEq a b c
proof:
:= by
  let P := a.toPoint ha+b.toPoint hb
  have hc := encode_valid P
  have hh : AddEq a b (encode P) := (addEq_spec _ _ _ ha hb hc).mpr (encode_toPoint P).symm
  refine ⟨encode P,⟨hc,hh⟩,?_⟩
  rintro c ⟨hv,he⟩
  apply Code.unique hv hc
  rw [encode_toPoint P]
  exact ((addEq_spec _ _ _ ha hb hv).mp he).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.allValid_semi
statement: lemma allValid_semi : Semi (@AllValid ι)
proof:
:=
  Semi.all (fun i => code_valid_semi.reindex (fun k => (i,k)))

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.flag_semi
statement: lemma flag_semi (i : ι) (n : ℕ) : Semi (fun z => (At z i).flag=n)
proof:
:=
  (Semi.eq (Poly.proj (i,Sum.inl ())) (Poly.const n)).congr (by intro z; change (z (i,Sum.inl ()):ℤ)=(n:ℤ) ↔ _; exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.codeEq_semi
statement: lemma codeEq_semi (i j : ι) : Semi (fun z => At z i=At z j)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Semi (fun z : ι×Var → ℕ => ∀ k, z (i,k)=z (j,k)) :=
    Semi.all (fun k => (Semi.eq (Poly.proj (i,k)) (Poly.proj (j,k))).congr (by intro z; change (z (i,k):ℤ)=(z (j,k):ℤ) ↔ _; exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro he; exact congrArg fromTuple (funext he)
  · intro he k
    have hh := congrArg tuple he
    simp only [At,tuple_from] at hh
    exact congrFun hh k

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.allValid_rational
statement: lemma allValid_rational (z) (hz : AllValid z) : Valid (z ∘ @ratMap ι)
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨i,v⟩
  fin_cases v
  · exact (hz i).1
  · exact (hz i).2.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.exprEq_semi
statement: lemma exprEq_semi (p q : Expr (ι×Fin 2)) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ p.eval (values z)=q.eval (values z))
proof:
:=
  Expr.eq_under allValid_semi ratMap allValid_rational p q

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.exprNe_semi
statement: lemma exprNe_semi (p q : Expr (ι×Fin 2)) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ p.eval (values z)≠q.eval (values z))
proof:
:=
  (allValid_semi.and (exprEq_semi p q).not).congr (by intro z; tauto)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.line_semi
statement:
lemma line_semi (d n x₁ x₂ y₁ x₃ y₃ : Expr (ι×Fin 2)) :
    Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ Line (d.eval (values z)) (n.eval (values z))
      (x₁.eval (values z)) (x₂.eval (values z)) (y₁.eval (values z)) (x₃.eval (values z)) (y₃.eval (values z)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((exprEq_semi (d^2*(x₃+x₁+x₂)) (n^2)).and (exprEq_semi (d*(y₃+y₁)) (n*(x₁-x₃)))).congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [Expr.eval_pow,Expr.eval_mul,Expr.eval_add,Expr.eval_sub,Line]
  tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.chord_semi
statement:
lemma chord_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧
    Line ((At z i).x.value-(At z j).x.value) ((At z i).y.value-(At z j).y.value)
      (At z i).x.value (At z j).x.value (At z i).y.value (At z k).x.value (At z k).y.value)
proof:
:= by
  refine (line_semi (xe i-xe j) (ye i-ye j) (xe i) (xe j) (ye i) (xe k) (ye k)).congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [Expr.eval_sub,xe,ye,Expr.eval_var]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.tangent_semi
statement:
lemma tangent_semi (i k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧
    Line (2*(At z i).y.value) (3*(At z i).x.value^2-25)
      (At z i).x.value (At z i).x.value (At z i).y.value (At z k).x.value (At z k).y.value)
proof:
:= by
  refine (line_semi (2*ye i) (3*(xe i)^2-25) (xe i) (xe i) (ye i) (xe k) (ye k)).congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [Expr.eval_pow,Expr.eval_sub,Expr.eval_mul,xe,ye,Expr.eval_var]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.xeq_semi
statement: lemma xeq_semi (i j : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).x.value=(At z j).x.value)
proof: := exprEq_semi (xe i) (xe j)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.xne_semi
statement: lemma xne_semi (i j : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).x.value≠(At z j).x.value)
proof: := exprNe_semi (xe i) (xe j)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.yneg_semi
statement: lemma yneg_semi (i j : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).y.value+(At z j).y.value=0)
proof: := exprEq_semi (ye i+ye j) 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.ynneg_semi
statement: lemma ynneg_semi (i j : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).y.value+(At z j).y.value≠0)
proof: := exprNe_semi (ye i+ye j) 0

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add1_semi
statement: lemma add1_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => (At z i).flag=1 ∧ At z k=At z j)
proof:
:=
  (flag_semi i 1).and (codeEq_semi k j)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add2_semi
statement: lemma add2_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => (At z i).flag=0 ∧ (At z j).flag=1 ∧ At z k=At z i)
proof:
:=
  (flag_semi i 0).and ((flag_semi j 1).and (codeEq_semi k i))

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add3_semi
statement:
lemma add3_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).flag=0 ∧ (At z j).flag=0 ∧
    (At z i).x.value=(At z j).x.value ∧ (At z i).y.value+(At z j).y.value=0 ∧ (At z k).flag=1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((flag_semi i 0).and ((flag_semi j 0).and ((xeq_semi i j).and ((yneg_semi i j).and (flag_semi k 1))))).congr ?_
  intro z; tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add4_semi
statement:
lemma add4_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).flag=0 ∧ (At z j).flag=0 ∧
    (At z i).x.value≠(At z j).x.value ∧ (At z k).flag=0 ∧
    Line ((At z i).x.value-(At z j).x.value) ((At z i).y.value-(At z j).y.value)
      (At z i).x.value (At z j).x.value (At z i).y.value (At z k).x.value (At z k).y.value)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((flag_semi i 0).and ((flag_semi j 0).and ((xne_semi i j).and ((flag_semi k 0).and (chord_semi i j k))))).congr ?_
  intro z; tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add5_semi
statement:
lemma add5_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ (At z i).flag=0 ∧ (At z j).flag=0 ∧
    (At z i).x.value=(At z j).x.value ∧ (At z i).y.value+(At z j).y.value≠0 ∧ (At z k).flag=0 ∧
    Line (2*(At z i).y.value) (3*(At z i).x.value^2-25)
      (At z i).x.value (At z i).x.value (At z i).y.value (At z k).x.value (At z k).y.value)
proof:
:= by
  refine ((flag_semi i 0).and ((flag_semi j 0).and ((xeq_semi i j).and ((ynneg_semi i j).and ((flag_semi k 0).and (tangent_semi i k)))))).congr ?_
  intro z; tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.addEq_semi
statement: lemma addEq_semi (i j k : ι) : Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ AddEq (At z i) (At z j) (At z k))
proof:
:= by
  refine (allValid_semi.and ((add1_semi i j k).or ((add2_semi i j k).or ((add3_semi i j k).or ((add4_semi i j k).or (add5_semi i j k)))))).congr ?_
  intro z
  unfold AddEq
  tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.fromTuple_injective
statement: lemma fromTuple_injective : Function.Injective fromTuple
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hh := congrArg tuple h
  simpa only [tuple_from] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_valid
statement: lemma mulRel_valid {n a b} (h : MulRel n a b) : a.Valid ∧ b.Valid
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨encode_valid _,encode_valid _⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_unique
statement: lemma mulRel_unique {n a b c} (hb : MulRel n a b) (hc : MulRel n a c) : b=c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩ := hb
  obtain ⟨Q,hq,rfl⟩ := hc
  exact congrArg (fun P => encode (n • P)) (encode_injective hq)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_exists
statement: lemma mulRel_exists (n : ℕ) (a : Code) (ha : a.Valid) : ∃! b, MulRel n a b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨encode (n • a.toPoint ha),⟨a.toPoint ha,(a.encode_toPoint ha).symm,rfl⟩,?_⟩
  intro b hb
  exact mulRel_unique hb ⟨a.toPoint ha,(a.encode_toPoint ha).symm,rfl⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_zero
statement: lemma mulRel_zero (a b : Code) : MulRel 0 a b ↔ a.Valid ∧ b=encode 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P,rfl,hb⟩; exact ⟨encode_valid _,by simpa using hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha,rfl⟩; exact ⟨a.toPoint ha,(a.encode_toPoint ha).symm,by simp⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_succ
statement:
lemma mulRel_succ (n : ℕ) (a b : Code) : MulRel (n+1) a b ↔
    ∃ c, MulRel n a c ∧ c.Valid ∧ a.Valid ∧ b.Valid ∧ AddEq c a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨encode (n • P),⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩,encode_valid _,encode_valid _,encode_valid _,?_⟩
    apply (addEq_encode _ _ _).mpr
    exact (add_nsmul P n 1).symm.trans (by simp)
  · rintro ⟨c,⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩,_,_,hb,he⟩
    refine ⟨P,rfl,?_⟩
    have hh := (addEq_spec _ _ _ (encode_valid _) (encode_valid _) hb).mp he
    rw [encode_toPoint,encode_toPoint] at hh
    have hh' : b.toPoint hb=(n+1) • P := by rw [←hh,add_nsmul,one_nsmul]
    exact (b.encode_toPoint hb).symm.trans (congrArg encode hh')

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.valid_sf
statement: lemma valid_sf (f : Var → α) : SF (fun z => (fromTuple (z ∘ f)).Valid)
proof: := code_valid_semi.1.reindex f

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.const_sf
statement: lemma const_sf (f : Var → α) (c : Code) : SF (fun z => fromTuple (z ∘ f)=c)
proof:
:= by
  have h : SF (fun z : α → ℕ => ∀ v, z (f v)=tuple c v) :=
    SF.all (fun v => (SF.eq (Poly.proj (f v)) (Poly.const (tuple c v))).congr (by intro z; change (z (f v):ℤ)=(tuple c v:ℤ) ↔ _; exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hh; have he : z ∘ f=tuple c := funext hh; rw [he,from_tuple]
  · intro hh v; simpa only [tuple_from,Function.comp_apply] using congrFun (congrArg tuple hh) v

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.add_general_sf
statement:
lemma add_general_sf (f g h : Var → α) : SF (fun z =>
    (fromTuple (z ∘ f)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ g)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ h)).Valid ∧
    AddEq (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (fromTuple (z ∘ g)) (fromTuple (z ∘ h)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((addEq_semi (ι:=Fin 3) 0 1 2).1.reindex (tripleMap f g h)).congr ?_
  intro z
  have hh : AllValid (z ∘ tripleMap f g h) ↔
      (fromTuple (z ∘ f)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ g)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ h)).Valid := by
    constructor
    · intro hh; exact ⟨hh 0,hh 1,hh 2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h₀,h₁,h₂⟩ i
      fin_cases i
      exact h₀
      exact h₁
      exact h₂
  change (AllValid (z ∘ tripleMap f g h) ∧ _) ↔ _
  rw [hh]
  tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.mulRel_sf
statement:
lemma mulRel_sf (n : ℕ) : ∀ {α : Type} (f g : Var → α),
    SF (fun z => MulRel n (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (fromTuple (z ∘ g)))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro α f g
    exact ((valid_sf f).and (const_sf g (encode 0))).congr (fun _ => (mulRel_zero _ _).symm)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro α f g
    let f' : Var → α⊕Var := Sum.inl ∘ f
    let g' : Var → α⊕Var := Sum.inl ∘ g
    have h := (ih f' Sum.inr).and (add_general_sf Sum.inr f' g')
    have hu : ∀ x y y',
        (MulRel n (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ f')) (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
          (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ Sum.inr)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ f')).Valid ∧
          (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ g')).Valid ∧ AddEq (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ Sum.inr))
            (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ f')) (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y ∘ g'))) →
        (MulRel n (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ f')) (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ Sum.inr)) ∧
          (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ Sum.inr)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ f')).Valid ∧
          (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ g')).Valid ∧ AddEq (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ Sum.inr))
            (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ f')) (fromTuple (Sum.elim x y' ∘ g'))) → y=y' := by
      intro x y y' hy hy'
      exact fromTuple_injective (mulRel_unique hy.1 hy'.1)
    refine (h.ex hu).congr ?_
    intro z
    change (∃ y : Var → ℕ, MulRel n (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (fromTuple y) ∧
      (fromTuple y).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ f)).Valid ∧ (fromTuple (z ∘ g)).Valid ∧
      AddEq (fromTuple y) (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (fromTuple (z ∘ g))) ↔ _
    rw [mulRel_succ]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y,hy⟩; exact ⟨fromTuple y,hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨c,hc⟩; exact ⟨tuple c,by simpa only [from_tuple] using hc⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.max_eq
statement: theorem max_eq (p q r : Poly α) : Semi (fun z => max (p z) (q z)=r z)
proof:
:= by
  refine (((Semi.le p q).and (Semi.eq q r)).or ((Semi.lt q p).and (Semi.eq p r))).congr ?_
  intro z
  by_cases h : p z≤q z
  · simp only [h,max_eq_right h,true_and,not_lt_of_ge h,false_and,or_false]
  · have h' := lt_of_not_ge h
    simp only [h,max_eq_left h'.le,false_and,h',true_and,false_or]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.height_pos
statement: lemma height_pos {a : Code} (ha : a.Valid) : 0<a.height
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (RationalCode.den_pos ha.1) (le_max_right _ _)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.height_semi
statement:
lemma height_semi {α : Type} (f : Var → α) (v : α) :
    Semi (fun z => (fromTuple (z ∘ f)).height=z v)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Poly α := Poly.proj (f (.inr (0,0)))+Poly.proj (f (.inr (0,1)))
  let q : Poly α := Poly.proj (f (.inr (0,2)))
  refine (Semi.max_eq p q (Poly.proj v)).congr ?_
  intro z
  change max ((z (f (.inr (0,0))):ℤ)+z (f (.inr (0,1)))) (z (f (.inr (0,2))):ℤ)=(z v:ℤ) ↔ _
  dsimp only [Code.height,fromTuple,RationalCompiler.code,Function.comp_apply]
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.wRel_semantics
statement:
lemma wRel_semantics (m : ℕ) (a : Code) (v : ℕ) :
    WRel m a v ↔ ∃ P, a=encode P ∧ (encode (m • P)).height=v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,⟨P,ha,rfl⟩,hv⟩; exact ⟨P,ha,hv⟩
  · rintro ⟨P,rfl,hv⟩; exact ⟨encode (m • P),⟨P,rfl,rfl⟩,hv⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.wRel_unique
statement: lemma wRel_unique {m a v w} (hv : WRel m a v) (hw : WRel m a w) : v=w
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨c,hc,rfl⟩ := hw
  rw [mulRel_unique hb hc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.wRel_exists
statement: lemma wRel_exists (m : ℕ) (a : Code) (ha : a.Valid) : ∃! v, WRel m a v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b,hb,_⟩ := mulRel_exists m a ha
  exact ⟨b.height,⟨b,hb,rfl⟩,fun w hw => wRel_unique hw ⟨b,hb,rfl⟩⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.wRel_sf
statement:
lemma wRel_sf {α : Type} (m : ℕ) (f : Var → α) (v : α) :
    SF (fun z => WRel m (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (z v))
proof:
:= by
  let f' : Var → α⊕Var := Sum.inl ∘ f
  have h := (mulRel_sf m f' Sum.inr).and (height_semi Sum.inr (Sum.inl v)).1
  refine (h.ex (fun z x y hx hy => fromTuple_injective (mulRel_unique hx.1 hy.1))).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∃ b : Var → ℕ, MulRel m (fromTuple (z ∘ f)) (fromTuple b) ∧ (fromTuple b).height=z v) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨b,hb⟩; exact ⟨fromTuple b,hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨b,hb⟩; exact ⟨tuple b,by simpa only [from_tuple] using hb⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.rational_height
statement:
lemma rational_height (r : ℚ) :
    max ((RationalCode.encode r).p+(RationalCode.encode r).n) (RationalCode.encode r).d=
      max r.num.natAbs r.den
proof:
:= by
  have hv := RationalCode.encode_valid r
  have hc := RationalCode.canonical hv
  have hp := RationalCode.positive_num hv
  have hn := RationalCode.negative_num hv
  rw [RationalCode.encode_value] at hc hp hn
  rw [←hp,←hn,hc.2,Int.toNat_add_toNat_neg_eq_natAbs]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.Hx_pos
statement: lemma Hx_pos (Q : E.Point) : 0<Hx Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => exact Nat.zero_lt_one
  | some x y h => exact lt_of_lt_of_le x.den_pos (le_max_right _ _)

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.log_Hx
statement: lemma log_Hx (Q : E.Point) : Real.log (Hx Q:ℝ)=CurveHeight.naiveHeight Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => simp only [Hx,Nat.cast_one,Real.log_one,←zero_def,CurveHeight.naiveHeight_zero]
  | some x y h => exact (CurveHeight.naiveHeight_some h).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.Hx_neg
statement: lemma Hx_neg (Q : E.Point) : Hx (-Q)=Hx Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | some x y h => rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_add
statement: lemma point_add (n m : ℤ) (t s : T) : point f (n+m) (t+s)=point f n t+point f m s
proof:
:= by
  apply f.injective
  simp [point]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_zero
statement: lemma point_zero : point f 0 0=0
proof:
:= by
  apply f.injective
  simp [point]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_int
statement: lemma point_int (n : ℤ) : point f n 0=n • P f
proof:
:= by
  apply f.injective
  simp [point,P]
  funext i; simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_split
statement: lemma point_split (n : ℤ) (t : T) : point f n t=n • P f+point f 0 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [←point_int,←point_add,add_zero,zero_add]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_nsmul
statement: lemma point_nsmul (n : ℤ) (t : T) (m : ℕ) : m • point f n t=point f (m*n) (m • t)
proof:
:= by
  apply f.injective
  simp [point]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_torsion
statement: lemma point_torsion [Finite T] (t : T) : IsOfFinAddOrder (point f 0 t)
proof:
:= by
  have h := isOfFinAddOrder_of_finite t
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hnt⟩ := h.exists_nsmul_eq_zero
  refine isOfFinAddOrder_iff_nsmul_eq_zero.mpr ⟨n,hn,?_⟩
  rw [point_nsmul,hnt,mul_zero,point_zero]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.double_torsion
statement: lemma double_torsion [Finite T] (t : T) : (2:ℕ) • point f 0 t=0
proof:
:=
  (Torsion.torsion_iff _).mp (point_torsion f t)

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.P_nontorsion
statement: lemma P_nontorsion : ¬IsOfFinAddOrder (P f)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨n,hn,hne⟩ := h.exists_nsmul_eq_zero
  have hh := congrArg (fun Q => (f Q).1 0) hne
  simp [P,point] at hh
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.normal_form
statement: lemma normal_form (Q : E.Point) : Q=point f (index f Q) (f Q).2
proof:
:= by
  apply f.injective
  simp only [point,AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply,index]
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext i
    exact congrArg (fun j => (f Q).1 j) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  · rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.W_pos
statement: lemma W_pos (m : ℕ) (Q : E.Point) : 0<W m Q
proof: := Hx_pos _

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.sequence_zero
statement: lemma sequence_zero (m : ℕ) : sequence f m 0=1
proof:
:= by
  unfold sequence W
  rw [zero_nsmul,nsmul_zero]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.W_neg
statement: lemma W_neg (m : ℕ) (Q : E.Point) : W m (-Q)=W m Q
proof:
:= by
  change Hx (m • (-Q))=Hx (m • Q)
  rw [show m • (-Q)= -(m • Q) from (nsmulAddMonoidHom (α:=E.Point) m).map_neg Q,Hx_neg]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.W_point
statement: lemma W_point [Finite T] (m : ℕ) (hm : Even m) (n : ℤ) (t : T) : W m (point f n t)=W m (n • P f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := hm
  have ht : m • point f 0 t=0 := by
    rw [hd,show d+d=2*d by omega,mul_comm,mul_smul,double_torsion,nsmul_zero]
  rw [point_split,W,nsmul_add,ht,add_zero]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.W_index
statement: lemma W_index [Finite T] (m : ℕ) (hm : Even m) (Q : E.Point) : W m Q=sequence f m (index f Q).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  calc
    W m Q = W m ((index f Q) • P f) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [normal_form f Q]
      exact W_point f m hm _ _
    _ = sequence f m (index f Q).natAbs := by
      by_cases h : 0 ≤ index f Q
      · have hn : ((index f Q).natAbs:ℤ)=index f Q := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs,abs_of_nonneg h]
        rw [sequence,←natCast_zsmul,hn]
      · have hn : index f Q= -((index f Q).natAbs:ℤ) := by rw [Int.natCast_natAbs,abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h),neg_neg]
        conv_lhs => rw [hn,neg_smul,W_neg,natCast_zsmul]
        rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.sequence_approx
statement:
lemma sequence_approx (m : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ Q : E.Point, |CurveHeight.naiveHeight Q-2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight Q|≤c) (j : ℕ) :
    |Real.log (sequence f m j:ℝ)-(2*(m:ℝ)^2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f))*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c
proof:
:= by
  have hh := hc (m • (j • P f))
  rw [CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_nsmul,CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_nsmul] at hh
  rw [sequence,W,log_Hx]
  convert hh using 1
  congr 1
  ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.xcoord_neg
statement: lemma xcoord_neg (Q : E.Point) : xcoord (-Q)=xcoord Q
proof: := by cases Q <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.ycoord_neg
statement: lemma ycoord_neg (Q : E.Point) : ycoord (-Q)= -ycoord Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => rfl
  | some x y h => change E.negY x y= -y; simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.xy_unique
statement:
lemma xy_unique {Q R : E.Point} (hQ : Q≠0) (hR : R≠0)
    (hx : xcoord Q=xcoord R) (hyQ : 0≤ycoord Q) (hyR : 0≤ycoord R) : Q=R
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hQ rfl)
  | some x y h =>
    cases R with
    | zero => exact False.elim (hR rfl)
    | some z w h' =>
      change x=z at hx
      subst z
      have he := CurveHeight.E_equation h
      have he' := CurveHeight.E_equation h'
      have hy : y=w := by
        change 0≤y at hyQ
        change 0≤w at hyR
        nlinarith
      subst w
      rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.index_point
statement: lemma index_point (n : ℤ) (t : T) : index f (point f n t)=n
proof: := by simp [index,point]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.index_zero
statement: lemma index_zero : index f 0=0
proof: := by simp [index]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.index_add
statement: lemma index_add (Q R : E.Point) : index f (Q+R)=index f Q+index f R
proof: := by simp [index]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.index_neg
statement: lemma index_neg (Q : E.Point) : index f (-Q)= -index f Q
proof: := by simp [index]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.point_ne_zero
statement: lemma point_ne_zero {n : ℤ} (hn : n≠0) (t : T) : point f n t≠0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (index f) h
  rw [index_point,index_zero] at hh
  exact hn hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.representative_max
statement:
lemma representative_max {m : ℕ} {Q R : E.Point} (hQ : Representative f m Q)
    (hidx : (index f R).natAbs=(index f Q).natAbs) : xcoord R≤xcoord Q
proof:
:= by
  have hidx' : index f R=index f Q ∨ index f R= -index f Q := by
    exact Int.natAbs_eq_natAbs_iff.mp hidx
  rcases hidx' with h|h
  · let t := (f R).2-(f Q).2
    have he : R=Q+point f 0 t := by
      apply f.injective
      simp only [map_add,point,AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      apply Prod.ext
      · funext i
        change (f R).1 i=(f Q).1 i+0
        simpa only [add_zero,index,show i=(0:Fin 1) from Subsingleton.elim _ _] using h
      · simp [t]
    rw [he]
    exact (hQ.2.2.2 t).2
  · let t := -(f R).2-(f Q).2
    have he : -R=Q+point f 0 t := by
      apply f.injective
      simp only [map_add,map_neg,point,AddEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      apply Prod.ext
      · funext i
        change -(f R).1 i=(f Q).1 i+0
        have hi : i=(0:Fin 1) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simp only [hi,add_zero]
        change -(index f R)=index f Q
        rw [h,neg_neg]
      · simp [t]
    rw [←xcoord_neg R,he]
    exact (hQ.2.2.2 t).2

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.representative_unique
proof:
:=
  xy_unique hQ.1 hR.1 (le_antisymm (representative_max f hR hidx) (representative_max f hQ hidx.symm)) hQ.2.1 hR.2.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.representative_exists
statement:
lemma representative_exists [Finite T] (m : ℕ) (hm : Even m)
    (hstrict : StrictMono (sequence f m)) (j : ℕ) (hj : 1≤j) :
    ∃! Q : E.Point, Representative f m Q ∧ (index f Q).natAbs=j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := Finite.exists_max (fun t : T => xcoord (point f j t))
  let A := point f j t
  have hj0 : (j:ℤ)≠0 := by omega
  have hA : A≠0 := point_ne_zero f hj0 t
  have hiA : (index f A).natAbs=j := by simp [A,index_point]
  have hWA : 1<W m A := by
    rw [W_index f m hm,hiA,←sequence_zero f m]
    exact hstrict (by omega)
  have htA (s : T) : A+point f 0 s≠0 ∧ xcoord (A+point f 0 s)≤xcoord A := by
    change point f j t+point f 0 s≠0 ∧ _
    rw [←point_add,add_zero]
    exact ⟨point_ne_zero f hj0 _,ht _⟩
  have hex : ∃ Q, Representative f m Q ∧ (index f Q).natAbs=j := by
    by_cases hy : 0≤ycoord A
    · exact ⟨A,⟨hA,hy,hWA,htA⟩,hiA⟩
    · refine ⟨-A,⟨neg_ne_zero.mpr hA,?_,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩
      · rw [ycoord_neg]; linarith
      · rw [W_neg]; exact hWA
      · intro s
        have he : -A+point f 0 s= -(A+point f 0 (-s)) := by
          have hn : point f 0 (-s)= -point f 0 s := by
            apply f.injective; simp [point]; rfl
          rw [hn]; abel
        rw [he,xcoord_neg,xcoord_neg]
        exact ⟨neg_ne_zero.mpr (htA (-s)).1,(htA (-s)).2⟩
      · rw [index_neg,Int.natAbs_neg,hiA]
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨Q,hQ,?_⟩
  intro R hR
  exact representative_unique f hR.1 hQ.1 (hR.2.trans hQ.2.symm)

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.height_constants
statement:
theorem height_constants : ∃ (c : ℝ) (κ m : ℕ),
    0 < c ∧ 0 < κ ∧ 0 < m ∧ Even m ∧
    (∀ Q : E.Point, |CurveHeight.naiveHeight Q-2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight Q|≤c) ∧
    2*c < 2*(m:ℝ)^2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f) ∧
    6*c < Real.log κ ∧ Real.log κ < 2*(2*(m:ℝ)^2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f))-6*c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,herr⟩ := CurveHeight.uniform_height
  have hp := CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_pos (P_nontorsion f)
  obtain ⟨κ,hκ⟩ := exists_nat_gt (Real.exp (6*c))
  have hκpos : 0<κ := by exact_mod_cast lt_trans (Real.exp_pos _) hκ
  have hlog : 6*c<Real.log κ := by
    rw [←Real.log_exp (6*c)]
    exact Real.log_lt_log (Real.exp_pos _) hκ
  let B := max (2*c) ((Real.log κ+6*c)/2)
  obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max (B/CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f)+1) 1)
  have hd1 : (1:ℝ)<d := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hd
  have hdn1 : 1<d := by exact_mod_cast hd1
  have hdB : B/CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f)+1<(d:ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hd
  have hB : B<(d:ℝ)*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f) := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hp).mp
    linarith
  have hBd : B<8*(d:ℝ)^2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f) := by
    have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (show (d:ℝ)<8*(d:ℝ)^2 by nlinarith) hp
    exact hB.trans hmul
  refine ⟨c,κ,2*d,hc,hκpos,by omega,even_two_mul d,herr,?_,hlog,?_⟩
  · have hb := le_max_left (2*c) ((Real.log κ+6*c)/2)
    dsimp [B] at hBd
    push_cast
    nlinarith
  · have hb := le_max_right (2*c) ((Real.log κ+6*c)/2)
    dsimp [B] at hBd
    push_cast
    nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.neighbor_index
statement: lemma neighbor_index (n : ℤ) : max (n+1).natAbs (n-1).natAbs=n.natAbs+1
proof:
:= by
  apply Int.natCast_inj.mp
  simp only [Nat.cast_max,Int.natCast_natAbs,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
  rcases le_total 0 n with hn|hn
  · rw [abs_of_nonneg hn,abs_of_nonneg (by omega : 0≤n+1),max_eq_left (by
      rw [abs_le]; omega)]
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos hn,abs_of_nonpos (by omega : n-1≤0),max_eq_right (by
      rw [abs_le]; omega)]
    ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.index_P
statement: lemma index_P : index f (P f)=1
proof: := by rw [P,index_point]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.neighbor_max
statement:
lemma neighbor_max [Finite T] (m : ℕ) (hm : Even m) (hs : StrictMono (sequence f m)) (Q : E.Point) :
    max (W m (Q+P f)) (W m (Q-P f))=sequence f m ((index f Q).natAbs+1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [W_index f m hm,W_index f m hm,←hs.monotone.map_max]
  have hi : index f (Q-P f)=index f Q-1 := by
    change (f (Q-P f)).1 0= _
    simp only [map_sub,Prod.fst_sub,Pi.sub_apply]
    change index f Q-index f (P f)= _
    rw [index_P]
  rw [hi,index_add,index_P,neighbor_index]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.double_index
statement: lemma double_index (Q : E.Point) : (index f ((2:ℕ) • Q)).natAbs=2*(index f Q).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  rw [two_nsmul,index_add,←two_mul,Int.natAbs_mul]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.representative_index_pos
statement:
lemma representative_index_pos [Finite T] {m : ℕ} (hm : Even m) {Q : E.Point}
    (hQ : Representative f m Q) : 1 ≤ (index f Q).natAbs
proof:
:= by
  have hw := hQ.2.2.1
  rw [W_index f m hm] at hw
  by_contra hn
  have hi : (index f Q).natAbs=0 := by omega
  rw [hi,sequence_zero] at hw
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.sequence_one
statement: lemma sequence_one (m : ℕ) : sequence f m 1=W m (P f)
proof: := by simp only [sequence,one_nsmul]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.bracket_iff
statement:
lemma bracket_iff [Finite T] {m : ℕ} (hm : Even m) (hs : StrictMono (sequence f m))
    (u : ℕ) (Q : E.Point) : Bracket f m u Q ↔
      sequence f m (index f Q).natAbs ≤ u+sequence f m 1 ∧
        u+sequence f m 1 < sequence f m ((index f Q).natAbs+1)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Bracket]
  rw [W_index f m hm Q,←sequence_one,neighbor_max f m hm hs]

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.window_iff
statement:
lemma window_iff [Finite T] {m κ : ℕ} {a c : ℝ} (hm : Even m) (hs : StrictMono (sequence f m))
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (h₁ : 6*c < Real.log κ) (h₂ : Real.log κ < 2*a-6*c)
    (ha : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → |Real.log (sequence f m j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2| ≤ c)
    {Q R : E.Point} (hQ : Representative f m Q) (hR : Representative f m R) :
    Window f m κ Q R ↔ (index f R).natAbs=(index f Q).natAbs^2
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [Window]
  rw [W_index f m hm (2 • Q),W_index f m hm R,W_index f m hm Q,
    ←sequence_one,neighbor_max f m hm hs,double_index]
  exact HeightWindow.square_window (fun j => W_pos _ _) ha hc hκ h₁ h₂
    (representative_index_pos f hm hQ) (representative_index_pos f hm hR)

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.growth_pair_existsUnique
statement:
lemma growth_pair_existsUnique [Finite T] {m κ : ℕ} {a c : ℝ}
    (hm : Even m) (hs : StrictMono (sequence f m))
    (hu : ∀ U, ∃ j, U < sequence f m j) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ)
    (h₁ : 6*c < Real.log κ) (h₂ : Real.log κ < 2*a-6*c)
    (ha : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → |Real.log (sequence f m j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2| ≤ c) (u : ℕ) :
    ∃! A, GrowthPair f m κ u A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k,hk,hku⟩ := GrowthEstimate.bracket_unique hs hu u
  obtain ⟨Q,⟨hQ,hiQ⟩,_⟩ := representative_exists f m hm hs k hk.1
  obtain ⟨R,⟨hR,hiR⟩,_⟩ := representative_exists f m hm hs (k^2) (by nlinarith [hk.1])
  have hbQ : Bracket f m u Q := (bracket_iff f hm hs u Q).mpr (by simpa only [hiQ] using hk.2)
  have hwQR : Window f m κ Q R := (window_iff f hm hs hc hκ h₁ h₂ ha hQ hR).mpr (by rw [hiQ,hiR])
  refine ⟨(Q,R),⟨hQ,hbQ,hR,hwQR⟩,?_⟩
  rintro ⟨Q',R'⟩ ⟨hQ',hbQ',hR',hwQR'⟩
  have hiQ' : (index f Q').natAbs=k := hku _ ⟨representative_index_pos f hm hQ',
    (bracket_iff f hm hs u Q').mp hbQ'⟩
  have hQQ : Q'=Q := representative_unique f hQ' hQ (hiQ'.trans hiQ.symm)
  have hiR' := (window_iff f hm hs hc hκ h₁ h₂ ha hQ' hR').mp hwQR'
  have hRR : R'=R := representative_unique f hR' hR (by rw [hiR',hiQ',hiR])
  exact Prod.ext hQQ hRR

name: OAI.SingleFold.EllipticModel.growth_model
statement:
theorem growth_model [Finite T] : ∃ (m κ : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (u₀ : ℕ),
    0 < m ∧ Even m ∧ 0 < κ ∧ 0 < δ ∧ 4 ≤ u₀ ∧
    (∀ u, ∃! A : E.Point × E.Point, GrowthPair f m κ u A) ∧
    (∀ u v, (∃ A, GrowthPair f m κ u A ∧ W m A.2=v) ↔ v=g u) ∧
    (∀ u, u₀ ≤ u → δ*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 < Real.log (g u:ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (g u:ℝ) < (u:ℝ)*Real.log (u:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨c,κ,m,hc,hκ,hm,heven,herr,hlarge,hlog,hlog'⟩ := height_constants f
  let a : ℝ := 2*(m:ℝ)^2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P f)
  have hp := CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_pos (P_nontorsion f)
  have ha : 0 < a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have happ : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → |Real.log (sequence f m j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2| ≤ c :=
    fun j _ => sequence_approx f m c herr j
  have hs : StrictMono (sequence f m) := GrowthEstimate.sequence_strict
    (fun j => W_pos _ _) (sequence_zero f m) hc.le hlarge happ
  have hunb := GrowthEstimate.sequence_unbounded (fun j => W_pos m (j • P f)) ha happ
  have hpair (u) := growth_pair_existsUnique f heven hs hunb hc.le hκ hlog hlog' happ u
  let A (u : ℕ) : E.Point × E.Point := Classical.choose (hpair u)
  have hA (u) : GrowthPair f m κ u (A u) := (Classical.choose_spec (hpair u)).1
  let g (u) := W m (A u).2
  obtain ⟨u₀,hu₀,hu⟩ := GrowthEstimate.eventual_output (fun j => W_pos m (j • P f)) ha hc.le happ
  refine ⟨m,κ,g,1/(128*a),u₀,hm,heven,hκ,by positivity,hu₀,hpair,?_,?_⟩
  · intro u v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B,hB,hv⟩
      have hBA : B=A u := (Classical.choose_spec (hpair u)).2 B hB
      subst B
      exact hv.symm
    · rintro rfl; exact ⟨A u,hA u,rfl⟩
  · intro u huu
    have hQ := (hA u).1
    have hR := (hA u).2.2.1
    have hb := (bracket_iff f heven hs u (A u).1).mp (hA u).2.1
    have hi := (window_iff f heven hs hc.le hκ hlog hlog' happ hQ hR).mp (hA u).2.2.2
    have hg : g u=sequence f m ((index f (A u).1).natAbs^2) := by
      dsimp [g]; rw [W_index f m heven,hi]
    rw [hg]
    exact hu u huu _ (representative_index_pos f heven hQ) hb

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.encoded_height
statement: lemma encoded_height (Q : E.Point) : (encode Q).height=EllipticModel.Hx Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q with
  | zero => change max ((RationalCode.encode 0).p+(RationalCode.encode 0).n) (RationalCode.encode 0).d=1
            rw [rational_height]; norm_num
  | some x y h => exact rational_height x

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.encoded_x
statement: lemma encoded_x (Q : E.Point) : (encode Q).x.value=EllipticModel.xcoord Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q <;> exact RationalCode.encode_value _

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.encoded_y
statement: lemma encoded_y (Q : E.Point) : (encode Q).y.value=EllipticModel.ycoord Q
proof:
:= by
  cases Q <;> exact RationalCode.encode_value _

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.height_sf
statement:
lemma height_sf {α : Type} {Q : (α → ℕ) → E.Point} (hQ : PointSF Q) (m : ℕ) :
    ScalarSF (fun z => EllipticModel.W m (Q z))
proof:
:= by
  refine MapSF.congr (PointSF.height m hQ) ?_
  intro z; funext j; exact encoded_height _

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.representative_sf
statement:
lemma representative_sf (m : ℕ) (hQ : PointSF Q) :
    SF (fun z => EllipticModel.Representative f m (Q z))
proof:
:= by
  have hy := hQ.ynonneg.congr (fun z => by rw [encoded_y])
  have hw := (ScalarSF.const 1).lt (height_sf hQ m)
  have ht := SF.all (fun t : T =>
    let hadd := hQ.add (PointSF.const (EllipticModel.point f 0 t))
    hadd.nonzero.and (hadd.xle hQ))
  refine (hQ.nonzero.and (hy.and (hw.and ht))).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (Q z ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ EllipticModel.ycoord (Q z) ∧ 1 < EllipticModel.W m (Q z) ∧
    ∀ t : T, Q z + EllipticModel.point f 0 t ≠ 0 ∧
      (encode (Q z + EllipticModel.point f 0 t)).x.value ≤ (encode (Q z)).x.value) ↔ _
  simp only [EllipticModel.Representative, encoded_x]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.bracket_sf
statement:
lemma bracket_sf (m : ℕ) {u : (α → ℕ) → ℕ} (hu : ScalarSF u) (hQ : PointSF Q) :
    SF (fun z => EllipticModel.Bracket f m (u z) (Q z))
proof:
:= by
  have hw := height_sf hQ m
  have hplus := height_sf (hQ.add (PointSF.const (EllipticModel.P f))) m
  have hminus := height_sf (hQ.add (PointSF.const (-EllipticModel.P f))) m
  have hb := hu.add (ScalarSF.const (EllipticModel.W m (EllipticModel.P f)))
  have hn := hplus.max hminus
  refine ((hw.le hb).and (hb.lt hn)).congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg,EllipticModel.Bracket]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.window_sf
statement:
lemma window_sf (m κ : ℕ) (hQ : PointSF Q) (hR : PointSF R) :
    SF (fun z => EllipticModel.Window f m κ (Q z) (R z))
proof:
:= by
  have hL := ((height_sf (hQ.smul 2) m).mul (height_sf hR m)).mul
    (ScalarSF.const (EllipticModel.W m (EllipticModel.P f)))
  have hmax := (height_sf (hR.add (PointSF.const (EllipticModel.P f))) m).max
    (height_sf (hR.add (PointSF.const (-EllipticModel.P f))) m)
  have hD := ((height_sf hQ m).pow 2).mul hmax
  refine ((hL.le ((ScalarSF.const κ).mul hD)).and (hD.le ((ScalarSF.const κ).mul hL))).congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [sub_eq_add_neg,EllipticModel.Window]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.pair_sf
statement:
lemma pair_sf (m κ : ℕ) {u : (α → ℕ) → ℕ} (hu : ScalarSF u) (hQ : PointSF Q) (hR : PointSF R) :
    SF (fun z => EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ (u z) (Q z,R z))
proof:
:=
  (representative_sf f m hQ).and ((bracket_sf f m hu hQ).and
    ((representative_sf f m hR).and (window_sf f m κ hQ hR)))

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.decode_injective_valid
statement:
lemma decode_injective_valid {a b : Code} (ha : a.Valid) (hb : b.Valid)
    (he : a.decode=b.decode) : a=b
proof:
:= by
  apply Code.unique ha hb
  simpa only [Code.decode,dite_eq_left ha,dite_eq_left hb] using he

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.graph_sf
statement:
lemma graph_sf (m κ : ℕ) (hunique : ∀ u, ∃! A, EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ u A) :
    SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => ∃ A, EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ (z 0) A ∧ EllipticModel.W m A.2=z 1)
proof:
:= by
  let α := Fin 2⊕(Fin 2×Var)
  let q : Var → α := fun k => .inr (0,k)
  let r : Var → α := fun k => .inr (1,k)
  let Q (z : α → ℕ) := (fromTuple (z ∘ q)).decode
  let R (z : α → ℕ) := (fromTuple (z ∘ r)).decode
  have hQ : PointSF Q := PointSF.var q
  have hR : PointSF R := PointSF.var r
  have hv := allValid_semi.reindex (Sum.inr : Fin 2×Var → α)
  have hp := pair_sf f m κ (ScalarSF.proj (.inl 0)) hQ hR
  have hw := (height_sf hR m).eq (ScalarSF.proj (.inl 1))
  have h := hv.1.and (hp.and hw)
  have hdec (z : Fin 2 → ℕ) (w : Fin 2×Var → ℕ) :
      (Q (Sum.elim z w),R (Sum.elim z w))=((At w 0).decode,(At w 1).decode) := rfl
  have hu : ∀ (z : Fin 2 → ℕ) (w w' : Fin 2×Var → ℕ),
      (AllValid w ∧ EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ (z 0) ((At w 0).decode,(At w 1).decode) ∧
        EllipticModel.W m (At w 1).decode=z 1) →
      (AllValid w' ∧ EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ (z 0) ((At w' 0).decode,(At w' 1).decode) ∧
        EllipticModel.W m (At w' 1).decode=z 1) → w=w' := by
    intro z w w' hw hw'
    have he := (hunique (z 0)).unique hw.2.1 hw'.2.1
    have hcode (i : Fin 2) : At w i=At w' i := by
      apply decode_injective_valid (hw.1 i) (hw'.1 i)
      fin_cases i
      · exact congrArg Prod.fst he
      · exact congrArg Prod.snd he
    funext ⟨i,j⟩
    exact congrFun (fromTuple_injective (hcode i)) j
  refine (h.ex hu).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∃ w : Fin 2×Var → ℕ, AllValid w ∧
    EllipticModel.GrowthPair f m κ (z 0) ((At w 0).decode,(At w 1).decode) ∧
    EllipticModel.W m (At w 1).decode=z 1) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w,_,hp,hw⟩; exact ⟨_,hp,hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨P,S⟩,hp,hw⟩
    let w : Fin 2×Var → ℕ := fun v => tuple (encode (if v.1=0 then P else S)) v.2
    have hc (i : Fin 2) : At w i=encode (if i=0 then P else S) := from_tuple _
    have hd0 : (At w 0).decode=P := by rw [hc]; exact decode_encode P
    have hd1 : (At w 1).decode=S := by rw [hc]; exact decode_encode S
    refine ⟨w,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · intro i; rw [hc]; exact encode_valid _
    · simpa only [hd0,hd1] using hp
    · simpa only [hd1] using hw

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthCompilation.growth
statement:
theorem growth : ∃ (g : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (u₀ : ℕ), 0 < δ ∧ 4 ≤ u₀ ∧
    SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => z 1=g (z 0)) ∧
    (∀ u, u₀ ≤ u → δ*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 < Real.log (g u:ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (g u:ℝ) < (u:ℝ)*Real.log (u:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T,hT,hfin,⟨f⟩⟩ := CurveRank.rank_one
  let := hT
  let := hfin
  obtain ⟨m,κ,g,δ,u₀,_,_,_,hδ,hu₀,hunique,hgraph,hest⟩ := EllipticModel.growth_model f
  exact ⟨g,δ,u₀,hδ,hu₀,(graph_sf f m κ hunique).congr (fun z => hgraph (z 0) (z 1)),hest⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.symPoly_homogeneous
statement: lemma symPoly_homogeneous (i : Fin 3) : (symPoly (K := K) i).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [symPoly, isHomogeneous_X, IsHomogeneous.add]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.symCoeff_homogeneous
statement:
lemma symCoeff_homogeneous (ij : (Fin 2 × Fin 2) × Fin 3) :
    (symCoeff (K := K) ij).IsHomogeneous 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases ij with ⟨⟨i,j⟩,k⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases k <;>
    simp [symCoeff, isHomogeneous_X, isHomogeneous_zero, IsHomogeneous.neg]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.symCoeff_condition
statement:
lemma symCoeff_condition (u v : Fin 2 → K) (k : Fin 2 × Fin 2) :
    ∑ j : Fin 3, (symCoeff (k,j)).eval (fun ij => u ij.1 * v ij.2) *
      (symPoly j).eval (fun ij => u ij.1 * v ij.2) = (u k.1 * v k.2) ^ (1 + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases k with ⟨i,j⟩
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [symCoeff, symPoly, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.symmetric_height_bound
statement:
theorem symmetric_height_bound [AdmissibleAbsValues K] :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ u v : Fin 2 → K, u ≠ 0 → v ≠ 0 →
      |logHeight ![u 0 * v 0, u 0 * v 1 + u 1 * v 0, u 1 * v 1] -
        (logHeight u + logHeight v)| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₁,h₁⟩ := logHeight_eval_le' (symPoly_homogeneous (K := K))
  obtain ⟨C₂,h₂⟩ := logHeight_eval_ge' (N := 1) (symCoeff_homogeneous (K := K))
  refine ⟨max C₁ (-C₂), ?_⟩
  intro u v hu hv
  have hlo := h₂ symPoly (symCoeff_condition u v)
  have hhi := h₁ (fun ij => u ij.1 * v ij.2)
  have hev : (fun j => (symPoly (K := K) j).eval (fun ij => u ij.1 * v ij.2)) =
      ![u 0 * v 0, u 0 * v 1 + u 1 * v 0, u 1 * v 1] := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [symPoly]
  rw [hev, logHeight_fun_mul_eq hu hv] at hlo hhi
  simp only [Nat.cast_one, one_mul] at hlo hhi
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor
  · have := le_max_right C₁ (-C₂)
    linarith
  · have := le_max_left C₁ (-C₂)
    linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.E_equation
statement: lemma E_equation {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) : y ^ 2 = x ^ 3 - 25*x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff, E, sub_eq_add_neg] using h.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.E_negY
statement: @[simp] lemma E_negY (x y : ℚ) : E.negY x y = -y
proof: := by simp []

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.E_addSub_eval
statement:
lemma E_addSub_eval (s t u : ℚ) :
    (fun j => (WeierstrassCurve.addSubMap E j).eval ![s,t,u]) =
      ![(s+25*u)^2, 2*t*(s-25*u), t^2-4*s*u]
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [WeierstrassCurve.addSubMap, WeierstrassCurve.b₂, WeierstrassCurve.b₄,
      WeierstrassCurve.b₆, WeierstrassCurve.b₈] <;> ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.difference_coordinates
statement:
lemma difference_coordinates {x z y w : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ z)
    (h₁ : y^2 = x^3 - 25*x) (h₂ : w^2 = z^3 - 25*z) :
    let A
proof:
:= ((y-w)/(x-z))^2-x-z
    let B := ((y+w)/(x-z))^2-x-z
    (x-z)^2 * (A+B) = 2*(x+z)*(x*z-25) ∧
    (x-z)^2 * (A*B) = (x*z+25)^2 := by
  dsimp
  have hd : x-z ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx
  constructor
  · field_simp
    linear_combination 2*h₁ + 2*h₂
  · field_simp
    linear_combination
      (y^2 + (x^3-25*x) - 2*w^2 - 2*(x+z)*(x-z)^2)*h₁ +
      (-2*(x^3-25*x) + w^2 + (z^3-25*z) - 2*(x+z)*(x-z)^2)*h₂

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.addSub_diagonal
statement:
lemma addSub_diagonal (P : E.Point) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (fun j => (WeierstrassCurve.addSubMap E j).eval (P.sym2x P)) =
        c • (P+P).sym2x 0
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero =>
    refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
    simp only [← zero_def, zero_add, sym2x_zero_zero, E_addSub_eval, one_smul]
    norm_num
  | some x y h =>
    have he := E_equation h
    rw [sym2x_some_some, E_addSub_eval]
    by_cases hy : y = 0
    · have hadd : (some x y h + some x y h : E.Point) = 0 :=
        add_self_of_Y_eq (by simp [hy])
      rw [hadd, sym2x_zero_zero]
      refine ⟨(x*x+25)^2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have : 0 < x*x+25 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
        positivity
      · ext i
        fin_cases i
        · simp
        · change 2*(x+x)*(x*x-25*1) = (x*x+25)^2*0
          rw [hy] at he
          linear_combination -4*he
        · change (x+x)^2-4*(x*x)*1 = (x*x+25)^2*0
          ring
    · have hy' : y ≠ E.negY x y := by rw [E_negY]; intro hz; apply hy; linarith
      have hs : E.slope x x y y = (3*x^2-25)/(2*y) := by
        rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy']
        simp []
        congr 1 <;> ring
      have hcoord : (4*y^2) * (((3*x^2-25)/(2*y))^2-x-x) = (x*x+25)^2 := by
        field_simp
        linear_combination -32*x*he
      rw [add_self_of_Y_ne hy', sym2x_some_zero]
      refine ⟨4*y^2, by positivity, ?_⟩
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · change (x*x+25*1)^2 = (4*y^2)*
          (E.addX x x (E.slope x x y y))
        rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, hs]
        simpa [E] using hcoord.symm
      · change 2*(x+x)*(x*x-25*1) = (4*y^2)*1
        linear_combination -4*he
      · change (x+x)^2-4*(x*x)*1 = (4*y^2)*0
        ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.addSub_distinct
statement:
lemma addSub_distinct {x z y w : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) (h' : E.Nonsingular z w)
    (hx : x ≠ z) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (fun j => (WeierstrassCurve.addSubMap E j).eval
        ((some x y h).sym2x (some z w h'))) =
      c • ((some x y h + some z w h').sym2x (some x y h - some z w h'))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := difference_coordinates hx (E_equation h) (E_equation h')
  dsimp at hc
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_some, add_of_X_ne hx, add_of_X_ne hx, sym2x_some_some,
    sym2x_some_some, E_addSub_eval]
  refine ⟨(x-z)^2, pow_ne_zero _ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx), ?_⟩
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · change (x*z+25*1)^2 = (x-z)^2 *
      (E.addX x z (E.slope x z y w) * E.addX x z (E.slope x z y (E.negY z w)))
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX,
      slope_of_X_ne hx, slope_of_X_ne hx, E_negY]
    simpa [E] using hc.2.symm
  · change 2*(x+z)*(x*z-25*1) = (x-z)^2 *
      (E.addX x z (E.slope x z y w) + E.addX x z (E.slope x z y (E.negY z w)))
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX,
      slope_of_X_ne hx, slope_of_X_ne hx, E_negY]
    simpa [E] using hc.1.symm
  · change (x+z)^2-4*(x*z)*1 = (x-z)^2*1
    ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.addSub_projective
statement:
theorem addSub_projective (P Q : E.Point) :
    ∃ c : ℚ, c ≠ 0 ∧
      (fun j => (WeierstrassCurve.addSubMap E j).eval (P.sym2x Q)) =
        c • (P+Q).sym2x (P-Q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : P.xRep = Q.xRep
  · rcases xRep_eq_xRep_iff.mp hx with heq | heq
    · subst P
      simpa only [sub_self] using addSub_diagonal Q
    · subst P
      obtain ⟨c,hc,he⟩ := addSub_diagonal Q
      refine ⟨c,hc,?_⟩
      rw [sym2x_neg_left, neg_add_cancel]
      have hsub : -Q-Q = -(Q+Q) := by abel
      rw [hsub, sym2x_neg_right, sym2x_comm (0 : E.Point) (Q+Q)]
      exact he
  · cases P with
    | zero =>
      cases Q with
      | zero => exact (hx rfl).elim
      | some x y h =>
        refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
        simp only [← zero_def, zero_add, zero_sub, sym2x_neg_right,
          sym2x_zero_some, sym2x_some_some, E_addSub_eval, one_smul]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring
    | some x y h =>
      cases Q with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨1, one_ne_zero, ?_⟩
        simp only [← zero_def, add_zero, sub_zero, sym2x_some_zero,
          sym2x_some_some, E_addSub_eval, one_smul]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp <;> ring
      | some z w h' =>
        apply addSub_distinct h h'
        intro hsame
        apply hx
        simp [hsame]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.approximate_parallelogram
statement:
theorem approximate_parallelogram :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ P Q : E.Point,
      |naiveHeight (P+Q) + naiveHeight (P-Q) -
        2*(naiveHeight P+naiveHeight Q)| ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C₁,h₁⟩ := symmetric_height_bound (K := ℚ)
  obtain ⟨C₂,h₂⟩ := E.abs_logHeight_addSubMap_sub_two_mul_logHeight_le
  refine ⟨3*C₁+C₂, ?_⟩
  intro P Q
  have hPQ := h₁ P.xRep Q.xRep P.xRep_ne_zero Q.xRep_ne_zero
  have hpm := h₁ (P+Q).xRep (P-Q).xRep (P+Q).xRep_ne_zero (P-Q).xRep_ne_zero
  change |Height.logHeight (P.sym2x Q) - (naiveHeight P + naiveHeight Q)| ≤ C₁ at hPQ
  change |Height.logHeight ((P+Q).sym2x (P-Q)) -
    (naiveHeight (P+Q)+naiveHeight (P-Q))| ≤ C₁ at hpm
  obtain ⟨c,hc,he⟩ := addSub_projective P Q
  have hmap := h₂ (P.sym2x Q)
  rw [he, Height.logHeight_smul_eq_logHeight _ hc] at hmap
  rcases abs_le.mp hPQ with ⟨hl₁,hu₁⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hpm with ⟨hl₂,hu₂⟩
  rcases abs_le.mp hmap with ⟨hl₃,hu₃⟩
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.HeightDescent.finitely_generated
statement:
theorem finitely_generated (h : A → ℝ) [Northcott h]
    (hn : ∀ P, 0 ≤ h P)
    (hp : ∀ P Q, h (P+Q)+h (P-Q)=2*h P+2*h Q)
    (hd : ∀ P, h ((2:ℕ) • P)=4*h P)
    (F : Finset A) (hF : ∀ P, ∃ R ∈ F, ∃ Q, P=R+(2:ℕ) • Q) : AddGroup.FG A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩ := (F.finite_toSet.image h).bddAbove
  let S : Set A := {P | h P ≤ B}
  have hS : S.Finite := Northcott.finite_le B
  have hR : ∀ R ∈ F, R ∈ AddSubgroup.closure S := by
    intro R hR
    apply AddSubgroup.subset_closure
    exact hB ⟨R,hR,rfl⟩
  have htop : AddSubgroup.closure S = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro P _
    by_contra hh
    obtain ⟨P,hP,hmin⟩ := Northcott.exists_min_image h {P | P ∉ AddSubgroup.closure S} ⟨P,hh⟩
    have hPl : B < h P := by
      by_contra hle
      exact hP (AddSubgroup.subset_closure (le_of_not_gt hle))
    obtain ⟨R,hRF,Q,hPQ⟩ := hF P
    have hRB : h R ≤ B := hB ⟨R,hRF,rfl⟩
    have he : P-R=(2:ℕ) • Q := by rw [hPQ]; abel
    have hdQ : 4*h Q ≤ 2*h P+2*h R := by
      have hpara := hp P R
      rw [he,hd] at hpara
      linarith [hn (P+R)]
    have hsmall : h Q < h P := by linarith
    have hQ : Q ∈ AddSubgroup.closure S := by
      by_contra hQ
      have := hmin Q hQ
      linarith
    apply hP
    rw [hPQ]
    exact (AddSubgroup.closure S).add_mem (hR R hRF)
      ((AddSubgroup.closure S).nsmul_mem hQ 2)
  exact ⟨hS.toFinset, by simpa only [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using htop⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.canonical_parallelogram
statement:
lemma canonical_parallelogram (P Q : E.Point) :
    CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P+Q) + CurveHeight.canonicalHeight (P-Q) =
      2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight P + 2*CurveHeight.canonicalHeight Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := CurveHeight.approximate_parallelogram
  have hh := QuadraticLimit.limit_parallelogram CurveHeight.naiveHeight C
    CurveHeight.naiveHeight_zero hC P Q
  unfold CurveHeight.canonicalHeight
  convert congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (1/2:ℝ)*x) hh using 1 <;> ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.representatives_card
statement: lemma representatives_card : representatives.card ≤ 8
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu := Finset.card_union_le ({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point)
    (({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point).image (· + G))
  have hi := Finset.card_image_le (s := ({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point)) (f := (· + G))
  have hc : ({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point).card ≤ 4 := by
    exact (Finset.card_insert_le ..).trans (by
      have h1 := Finset.card_insert_le T0 ({T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point)
      have h2 := Finset.card_insert_le T5 ({T0+T5} : Finset E.Point)
      simp only [Finset.card_singleton] at h2
      omega)
  unfold representatives
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.representatives_cover
statement: lemma representatives_cover (P : E.Point) : ∃ R ∈ representatives, ∃ Q, P=R+(2:ℕ) • Q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨S,b,Q,hS,hP⟩ := mod_two_cover P
  have hmem : S ∈ ({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point) := by simpa using hS
  refine ⟨S+(if b then G else 0),?_,Q,hP⟩
  cases b
  · simpa only [representatives,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,add_zero] using Finset.mem_union_left
      (({0,T0,T5,T0+T5} : Finset E.Point).image (· + G)) hmem
  · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨S,hmem,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.congr
statement: lemma congr {f g : (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} (hf : MapSF f) (hfg : ∀ z, f z=g z) : MapSF g
proof:
:=
  SF.congr hf (by intro z; rw [hfg])

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.proj
statement: lemma proj (i : β → α) [Finite β] : MapSF (fun z => z ∘ i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SF.all (fun j : β => SF.eq (Poly.proj (Sum.inr j : α⊕β)) (Poly.proj (Sum.inl (i j))))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∀ j, (z (Sum.inr j):ℤ)=z (Sum.inl (i j))) ↔ _
  simp only [Int.natCast_inj]
  exact ⟨fun h => funext h,fun h j => congrFun h j⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.const
statement: lemma const (b : β → ℕ) [Finite β] : MapSF (fun _ : α → ℕ => b)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SF.all (fun j : β => SF.eq (Poly.proj (Sum.inr j : α⊕β)) (Poly.const (b j)))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∀ j, (z (Sum.inr j):ℤ)=(b j:ℤ)) ↔ _
  simp only [Int.natCast_inj]
  exact ⟨fun h => funext h,fun h j => congrFun h j⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.reindex
statement:
lemma reindex {f : (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} (hf : MapSF f) (i : α → γ) :
    MapSF (fun z => f (z ∘ i))
proof:
:= by
  exact (SF.reindex hf (Sum.map i id)).congr (by intro z; rfl)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.comp
statement:
lemma comp {f : (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} {g : (β → ℕ) → (γ → ℕ)} [Finite β]
    (hg : MapSF g) (hf : MapSF f) : MapSF (fun z => g (f z))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (SF.reindex hf (Sum.elim (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) Sum.inr)).and
    (SF.reindex hg (Sum.elim Sum.inr (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr)))
  have hu : ∀ (z : α⊕γ → ℕ) (x y : β → ℕ),
      (x=f (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr=g x) →
      (y=f (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr=g y) → x=y := by
    intro z x y hx hy; exact hx.1.trans hy.1.symm
  refine (h.ex hu).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∃ x, x=f (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr=g x) ↔ _
  simp only [exists_eq_left]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.pair
statement:
lemma pair {f : (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} {g : (α → ℕ) → (γ → ℕ)}
    (hf : MapSF f) (hg : MapSF g) : MapSF (fun z => Sum.elim (f z) (g z))
proof:
:= by
  have h := (SF.reindex hf (Sum.map id Sum.inl)).and (SF.reindex hg (Sum.map id Sum.inr))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (z ∘ Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inl=f (z ∘ Sum.inl) ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inr=g (z ∘ Sum.inl)) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂⟩; funext j; cases j with
    | inl j => exact congrFun h₁ j
    | inr j => exact congrFun h₂ j
  · intro h
    exact ⟨congrArg (fun z => z ∘ Sum.inl) h,congrArg (fun z => z ∘ Sum.inr) h⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.all
statement:
lemma all [Finite δ] {f : δ → (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} (hf : ∀ d, MapSF (f d)) :
    MapSF (fun z (v : δ×β) => f v.1 z v.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SF.all (fun d => SF.reindex (hf d) (Sum.map id (fun j => (d,j))))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hh; funext ⟨d,j⟩; exact congrFun (hh d) j
  · intro hh d; funext j; exact congrFun hh (d,j)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.MapSF.pullback
statement:
lemma pullback {f : (α → ℕ) → (β → ℕ)} [Finite β] (hf : MapSF f)
    {R : (β → ℕ) → Prop} (hR : SF R) : SF (fun z => R (f z))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf.and (hR.reindex Sum.inr)
  refine (h.ex (fun z x y hx hy => hx.1.trans hy.1.symm)).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (∃ x, x=f z ∧ R x) ↔ _
  simp only [exists_eq_left]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.decode_encode
statement: lemma decode_encode (P : E.Point) : (encode P).decode=P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Code.decode,dite_eq_left (encode_valid P),encode_toPoint]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.normalized_graph
statement: lemma normalized_graph : MapSF (fun z : Var → ℕ => tuple (encode (fromTuple z).decode))
proof:
:= by
  let v := code_valid_semi.reindex (Sum.inl : Var → Var⊕Var)
  have ht : SF (fun z : Var⊕Var → ℕ => z ∘ Sum.inr=z ∘ Sum.inl) := MapSF.proj id
  have hz : SF (fun z : Var⊕Var → ℕ => z ∘ Sum.inr=tuple (encode 0)) := MapSF.const _
  have h := (v.1.and ht).or (v.2.and hz) (by intro z; tauto)
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (((fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inl)).Valid ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr=z ∘ Sum.inl) ∨
    ¬(fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inl)).Valid ∧ z ∘ Sum.inr=tuple (encode 0)) ↔ _
  by_cases hv : (fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inl)).Valid
  · simp only [hv,true_and,not_true,false_and,or_false]
    rw [Code.decode,dite_eq_left hv,Code.encode_toPoint,tuple_from]
  · simp only [hv,false_and,not_false_eq_true,true_and,false_or]
    rw [Code.decode,dite_eq_right hv]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.const
statement: lemma const (P : E.Point) : PointSF (fun _ : α → ℕ => P)
proof: := MapSF.const _

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.var
statement: lemma var (i : Var → α) : PointSF (fun z => (fromTuple (z ∘ i)).decode)
proof:
:=
  MapSF.reindex normalized_graph i

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.reindex
statement: lemma reindex (hf : PointSF f) (i : α → β) : PointSF (fun z => f (z ∘ i))
proof:
:=
  MapSF.reindex hf i

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.add
statement: lemma add (hf : PointSF f) (hg : PointSF g) : PointSF (fun z => f z+g z)
proof:
:= by
  have hf' := MapSF.reindex hf (Sum.inl : α → α⊕Var)
  have hg' := MapSF.reindex hg (Sum.inl : α → α⊕Var)
  have hframe := MapSF.pair (MapSF.pair hf' hg') (MapSF.proj (Sum.inr : Var → α⊕Var))
  have h := hframe.pullback (add_general_sf (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inl) (Sum.inl ∘ Sum.inr) Sum.inr)
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  simp only [Function.comp_def,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,from_tuple] at h ⊢
  change ((encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl))).Valid ∧ (encode (g (z ∘ Sum.inl))).Valid ∧
    (fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inr)).Valid ∧ AddEq (encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl))) (encode (g (z ∘ Sum.inl)))
      (fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inr))) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_,_,hv,he⟩
    have hh := (addEq_spec _ _ _ (encode_valid _) (encode_valid _) hv).mp he
    rw [encode_toPoint,encode_toPoint] at hh
    have hc : fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inr)=encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl)+g (z ∘ Sum.inl)) := by
      rw [hh,Code.encode_toPoint]
    exact fromTuple_injective (hc.trans (from_tuple _).symm)
  · intro he
    have hc := congrArg fromTuple he
    rw [from_tuple] at hc
    change fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inr)=encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl)+g (z ∘ Sum.inl)) at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact ⟨encode_valid _,encode_valid _,encode_valid _,(addEq_encode _ _ _).mpr rfl⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.smul
statement: lemma smul (n : ℕ) (hf : PointSF f) : PointSF (fun z => n • f z)
proof:
:= by
  have hframe := MapSF.pair (MapSF.reindex hf (Sum.inl : α → α⊕Var))
    (MapSF.proj (Sum.inr : Var → α⊕Var))
  refine (hframe.pullback (mulRel_sf n Sum.inl Sum.inr)).congr ?_
  intro z
  change MulRel n (fromTuple (tuple (encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl))))) (fromTuple (z ∘ Sum.inr)) ↔ _
  rw [from_tuple]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P,hP,hout⟩
    have hp := encode_injective hP
    subst P
    exact fromTuple_injective (hout.trans (from_tuple _).symm)
  · intro he
    refine ⟨f (z ∘ Sum.inl),rfl,?_⟩
    have hh := congrArg fromTuple he
    simpa only [from_tuple] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.height
statement:
lemma height (m : ℕ) (hf : PointSF f) :
    MapSF (fun z (_ : Unit) => (encode (m • f z)).height)
proof:
:= by
  have hframe := MapSF.pair (MapSF.reindex hf (Sum.inl : α → α⊕Unit))
    (MapSF.proj (Sum.inr : Unit → α⊕Unit))
  refine (hframe.pullback (wRel_sf m Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))).congr ?_
  intro z
  change WRel m (fromTuple (tuple (encode (f (z ∘ Sum.inl))))) (z (Sum.inr ())) ↔ _
  rw [from_tuple,wRel_semantics]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨P,hP,hv⟩
    have hp := encode_injective hP
    subst P
    funext j; cases j; exact hv.symm
  · intro he
    exact ⟨f (z ∘ Sum.inl),rfl,(congrFun he ()).symm⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.const
statement: lemma const (n : ℕ) : ScalarSF (fun _ : α → ℕ => n)
proof: := MapSF.const _

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.proj
statement: lemma proj (i : α) : ScalarSF (fun z => z i)
proof: := MapSF.proj (fun _ => i)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.poly
statement: lemma poly {f : (α → ℕ) → ℕ} (p : Poly α) (hp : ∀ z, p z=(f z:ℤ)) : ScalarSF f
proof:
:= by
  have h := SF.eq (Poly.proj (Sum.inr () : α⊕Unit)) (p.map Sum.inl)
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (z (Sum.inr ()):ℤ)=p (z ∘ Sum.inl) ↔ _
  rw [hp,Int.natCast_inj]
  exact ⟨fun hh => funext (fun j => by cases j; exact hh),fun hh => congrFun hh ()⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.add
statement: lemma add (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : ScalarSF (fun z => f z+g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ScalarSF (fun z : Unit⊕Unit → ℕ => z (.inl ())+z (.inr ())) :=
    poly (Poly.proj (.inl ())+Poly.proj (.inr ())) (by intro z; simp)
  exact MapSF.comp h (MapSF.pair hf hg)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.mul
