statement: lemma mul (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : ScalarSF (fun z => f z*g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ScalarSF (fun z : Unit⊕Unit → ℕ => z (.inl ())*z (.inr ())) :=
    poly (Poly.proj (.inl ())*Poly.proj (.inr ())) (by intro z; simp)
  exact MapSF.comp h (MapSF.pair hf hg)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.pow
statement: lemma pow (hf : ScalarSF f) (n : ℕ) : ScalarSF (fun z => f z^n)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ScalarSF (fun z : Unit → ℕ => z ()^n) :=
    poly (Poly.proj ()^n) (by
      intro z
      induction n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ,Poly.mul_apply,ih,Poly.proj_apply,Nat.cast_pow,←pow_succ,Nat.cast_pow])
  exact MapSF.comp h hf

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.max
statement: lemma max (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : ScalarSF (fun z => max (f z) (g z))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ScalarSF (fun z : Unit⊕Unit → ℕ => Max.max (z (.inl ())) (z (.inr ()))) := by
    refine (Semi.max_eq (Poly.proj (.inl (.inl ()))) (Poly.proj (.inl (.inr ())))
      (Poly.proj (.inr ()))).1.congr ?_
    intro z
    change Max.max (z (.inl (.inl ())):ℤ) (z (.inl (.inr ())) : ℤ)=(z (.inr ()):ℤ) ↔ _
    rw [←Nat.cast_max,Int.natCast_inj]
    exact ⟨fun hh => funext (fun j => by cases j; exact hh.symm),fun hh => (congrFun hh ()).symm⟩
  exact MapSF.comp h (MapSF.pair hf hg)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.le
statement: lemma le (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : SF (fun z => f z≤g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (MapSF.pair hf hg).pullback (SF.le (Poly.proj (.inl ())) (Poly.proj (.inr ())))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (f z:ℤ)≤(g z:ℤ) ↔ _
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.lt
statement: lemma lt (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : SF (fun z => f z<g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (MapSF.pair hf hg).pullback (SF.lt (Poly.proj (.inl ())) (Poly.proj (.inr ())))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (f z:ℤ)<(g z:ℤ) ↔ _
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.eq
statement: lemma eq (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : SF (fun z => f z=g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (MapSF.pair hf hg).pullback (SF.eq (Poly.proj (.inl ())) (Poly.proj (.inr ())))
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change (f z:ℤ)=(g z:ℤ) ↔ _
  exact_mod_cast Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.exprLe_semi
statement:
lemma exprLe_semi {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (p q : Expr (ι×Fin 2)) :
    Semi (fun z => AllValid z ∧ p.eval (values z)≤q.eval (values z))
proof:
:=
  Expr.le_under allValid_semi ratMap allValid_rational p q

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.nonzero
statement: lemma nonzero (hf : PointSF f) : SF (fun z => f z≠0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hf.pullback ((Semi.eq (Poly.proj (Sum.inl () : Var)) 0).1)
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  change ((encode (f z)).flag:ℤ)=0 ↔ _
  cases f z <;> simp [encode,←WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Point.zero_def]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.xle
statement:
lemma xle (hf : PointSF f) (hg : PointSF g) :
    SF (fun z => (encode (f z)).x.value≤(encode (g z)).x.value)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := MapSF.all (f:=fun i : Fin 2 => if i=0 then (fun z => tuple (encode (f z))) else (fun z => tuple (encode (g z))))
    (fun i => by fin_cases i; exact hf; exact hg)
  have he := (exprLe_semi (xe (0:Fin 2)) (xe 1)).1
  refine (hh.pullback he).congr ?_
  intro z
  let frame : Fin 2×Var → ℕ := fun v => (if v.1=0 then (fun z => tuple (encode (f z))) else (fun z => tuple (encode (g z)))) z v.2
  change (AllValid frame ∧ (At frame 0).x.value≤(At frame 1).x.value) ↔ _
  have h₀ : At frame 0=encode (f z) := from_tuple _
  have h₁ : At frame 1=encode (g z) := from_tuple _
  have hv : AllValid frame := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    · change (At frame 0).Valid
      rw [h₀]; exact encode_valid _
    · change (At frame 1).Valid
      rw [h₁]; exact encode_valid _
  rw [h₀,h₁]
  simp only [hv,true_and]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PointCompiler.PointSF.ynonneg
statement: lemma ynonneg (hf : PointSF f) : SF (fun z => 0≤(encode (f z)).y.value)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := MapSF.all (fun _ : Unit => hf)
  refine (hh.pullback (exprLe_semi (ι:=Unit) 0 (ye ()) ).1).congr ?_
  intro z
  change (AllValid (fun v : Unit×Var => tuple (encode (f z)) v.2) ∧ 0≤(encode (f z)).y.value) ↔ _
  have hv : AllValid (fun v : Unit×Var => tuple (encode (f z)) v.2) := by
    intro i; exact (by simpa only [At,from_tuple] using encode_valid (f z))
  simp only [hv,true_and]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.sequence_strict
statement:
lemma sequence_strict (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (hzero : W 0=1) (hc : 0≤c) (ha : 2*c<a)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c) : StrictMono W
proof:
:= by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro n
  have hp (j : ℕ) : (0:ℝ)<W j := by exact_mod_cast hW j
  apply_mod_cast (Real.log_lt_log_iff (hp n) (hp (n+1))).mp (show Real.log (W n:ℝ)<Real.log (W (n+1):ℝ) from ?_)
  have ha' : 0<a := by linarith
  rcases n with _|n
  · have hh := (abs_le.mp (happrox 1 (by omega))).1
    simpa only [hzero,Nat.cast_one,Real.log_one,one_pow,mul_one] using (show (0:ℝ)<Real.log (W 1:ℝ) by
      norm_num at hh
      linarith)
  · have hh := abs_le.mp (happrox (n+1) (by omega))
    have hh' := abs_le.mp (happrox (n+1+1) (by omega))
    push_cast at hh hh'
    nlinarith [show (0:ℝ)≤n by positivity]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.sequence_unbounded
statement:
lemma sequence_unbounded (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c) (U : ℕ) : ∃ j, U<W j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt (max ((U+c+1)/a+1) 1)
  have hn1 : 1<n := by exact_mod_cast lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hn
  have hn' : (U+c+1)/a+1 < (n:ℝ) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hn
  have hh := (abs_le.mp (happrox n (by omega))).1
  have hlog := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hW n : (0:ℝ)<W n)
  have hn2 : (1:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hdiv : (U:ℝ)+c+1 < (n-1:ℝ)*a := (div_lt_iff₀ ha).mp (show ((U:ℝ)+c+1)/a < (n:ℝ)-1 by linarith)
  have hn3 : (n-1:ℝ)*a < a*(n:ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show (n:ℝ)-1 < (n:ℝ)^2 by nlinarith) ha]
  have hu : (U:ℝ)<W n := by linarith
  exact ⟨n,by exact_mod_cast hu⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.bracket_unique
statement:
lemma bracket_unique (hW : StrictMono W) (hunb : ∀ U, ∃ j, U<W j) (u : ℕ) :
    ∃! k : ℕ, 1≤k ∧ W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1)
proof:
:= by
  let j := Nat.find (hunb (u+W 1))
  have hj : u+W 1<W j := Nat.find_spec (hunb (u+W 1))
  have hj2 : 2≤j := by
    by_contra hn
    have hj1 : j≤1 := by omega
    have hh := hW.monotone hj1
    omega
  have hprev : W (j-1)≤u+W 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have : j≤j-1 := Nat.find_min' (hunb (u+W 1)) (m:=j-1) (by omega)
    omega
  refine ⟨j-1,⟨by omega,hprev,by simpa only [show j-1+1=j by omega] using hj⟩,?_⟩
  rintro k ⟨_,hk,hk'⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra hn
    have hjk : j≤k := by omega
    have hh := hW.monotone hjk
    omega
  · by_contra hn
    have hkj : k+1≤j-1 := by omega
    have hh := hW.monotone hkj
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.bracket_log
statement:
lemma bracket_log {u k : ℕ} (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c)
    (hk : 1≤k) (hb : W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1)) :
      a*(k:ℝ)^2-c ≤ Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ) ∧
      Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ) < 4*a*(k:ℝ)^2+c
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0:ℝ)<W k := by exact_mod_cast hW k
  have hU : (0:ℝ)<(u+W 1:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u+W 1 by have := hW 1; omega)
  have hlo : Real.log (W k:ℝ)≤Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ) := Real.log_le_log hp (by exact_mod_cast hb.1)
  have hhi : Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)<Real.log (W (k+1):ℝ) := Real.log_lt_log hU (by exact_mod_cast hb.2)
  have ha₁ := abs_le.mp (happrox k hk)
  have ha₂ := abs_le.mp (happrox (k+1) (by omega))
  have hk' : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  constructor
  · linarith
  · have : ((k:ℝ)+1)^2≤4*(k:ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith
    push_cast at ha₂
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this ha.le]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.output_upper
statement:
lemma output_upper {u k : ℕ} (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a) (_hc : 0≤c)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c)
    (hk : 1≤k) (hb : W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1)) :
      Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ) ≤ ((Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)+c)^2)/a+c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hlo,_⟩ := bracket_log hW ha happrox hk hb
  have hg := (abs_le.mp (happrox (k^2) (by nlinarith))).2
  have hlog : 0≤Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ) := Real.log_natCast_nonneg _
  have hh : a*(k:ℝ)^2≤Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)+c := by linarith
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity : 0≤a*(k:ℝ)^2) hh 2
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hg ha.le
  suffices Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ)-c ≤ (Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)+c)^2/a by linarith
  apply (le_div_iff₀ ha).mpr
  push_cast at hmul
  nlinarith only [hmul,hsq]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.output_lower
statement:
lemma output_lower {u k : ℕ} (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a) (hc : 0≤c)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c)
    (hk : 1≤k) (hb : W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1))
    (hu : 0<u) (hlarge : 9*c<Real.log (u:ℝ)) :
      (1/(128*a))*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 < Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlog := Real.log_natCast_nonneg u
  have huU : Real.log (u:ℝ) ≤ Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast hu) (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.le_add_right u (W 1)))
  have hh := (bracket_log hW ha happrox hk hb).2
  have hu' : Real.log (u:ℝ) < 4*a*(k:ℝ)^2+c := lt_of_le_of_lt huU hh
  have hh' : 2*c<a*(k:ℝ)^2 := by linarith
  have hk' : (1:ℝ)≤k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hk2 : (1:ℝ)≤(k:ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hk4 : (k:ℝ)^2≤((k:ℝ)^2)^2 := by nlinarith
  have hl : Real.log (u:ℝ) < 8*a*(k:ℝ)^2 := by linarith
  have hsq := pow_lt_pow_left₀ hl hlog (by norm_num : (2:ℕ)≠0)
  have hg := (abs_le.mp (happrox (k^2) (by nlinarith))).1
  push_cast at hg
  have hc' : c<a*((k:ℝ)^2)^2/2 := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hk4 ha.le]
  have h128 : 0<128*a := by positivity
  have hcq : (Real.log (u:ℝ))^2/(128*a) < a*((k:ℝ)^2)^2/2 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ h128).mpr
    nlinarith only [hsq]
  rw [one_div_mul_eq_div]
  linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.output_upper_log
statement:
lemma output_upper_log {u k : ℕ} (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a) (hc : 0≤c)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c)
    (hk : 1≤k) (hb : W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1))
    (hu : 2≤u) (hWu : W 1≤u) (hcL : c≤Real.log (u:ℝ)) (hL : 1≤Real.log (u:ℝ)) :
      Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ) ≤ (9/a+1)*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u by omega)
  have huU : Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)≤Real.log (2*(u:ℝ)) :=
    Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u+W 1 by omega)) (by push_cast; exact_mod_cast (show u+W 1≤2*u by omega))
  have htwo : Real.log 2≤Real.log (u:ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (by exact_mod_cast hu)
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hp.ne'] at huU
  have hh : Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)+c ≤ 3*Real.log (u:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith [Real.log_natCast_nonneg (u+W 1)] : 0≤Real.log (u+W 1:ℕ)+c) hh 2
  have hh' := output_upper hW ha hc happrox hk hb
  have hl2 : c≤(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 := by nlinarith
  have hdiv := (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right ha).mpr hsq
  nlinarith only [hh',hdiv,hl2,show (3*Real.log (u:ℝ))^2/a=9/a*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 by ring]

name: OAI.SingleFold.GrowthEstimate.eventual_output
statement:
theorem eventual_output (hW : ∀ j, 0<W j) (ha : 0<a) (hc : 0≤c)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1≤j → |Real.log (W j:ℝ)-a*(j:ℝ)^2|≤c) :
    ∃ u₀ : ℕ, 4≤u₀ ∧ ∀ u≥u₀, ∀ k, 1≤k →
      W k≤u+W 1 ∧ u+W 1<W (k+1) →
      (1/(128*a))*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 < Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ) ∧
      Real.log (W (k^2):ℝ) < (u:ℝ)*Real.log (u:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let B : ℝ := 9/a+1
  have hB : 0<B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  have hε : 0<1/(2*B) := by positivity
  have hsmall := Real.isLittleO_log_id_atTop.bound hε
  have hsmallN := (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R:=ℝ)).eventually hsmall
  have hlog := (Real.tendsto_log_atTop.comp (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R:=ℝ))).eventually_gt_atTop (max (9*c) 1)
  have he : ∀ᶠ u : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      4≤u ∧ W 1≤u ∧ 9*c<Real.log (u:ℝ) ∧ 1<Real.log (u:ℝ) ∧
      B*Real.log (u:ℝ)<u := by
    filter_upwards [hsmallN,hlog,Filter.eventually_ge_atTop 4,Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (W 1)] with u hs hl hu hw
    have hl0 : 0≤Real.log (u:ℝ) := Real.log_natCast_nonneg u
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hl0,abs_of_nonneg (show (0:ℝ)≤(u:ℝ) by positivity),id_eq] at hs
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hB.le
    have hb : B*(1/(2*B)*(u:ℝ))=(u:ℝ)/2 := by field_simp
    rw [hb] at hm
    refine ⟨hu,hw,lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hl,lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hl,?_⟩
    have hu' : (0:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u by omega)
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u₀,hu₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp he
  refine ⟨max 4 u₀,le_max_left _ _,?_⟩
  intro u hu k hk hb
  obtain ⟨hu4,hw,hl,hL,hsmall⟩ := hu₀ u ((le_max_right _ _).trans hu)
  refine ⟨output_lower hW ha hc happrox hk hb (by omega) hl,?_⟩
  have he := output_upper_log hW ha hc happrox hk hb (by omega) hw (by linarith) hL.le
  have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall (by linarith : 0<Real.log (u:ℝ))
  dsimp [B] at hh
  nlinarith only [he,hh]

name: OAI.SingleFold.HeightWindow.index_separation
statement:
lemma index_separation {k r : ℕ} (h : r ≠ k ^ 2) :
    1 ≤ |(k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h with hlt | hgt
  · have : (r : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) ^ 2 := by exact_mod_cast hlt
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    linarith
  · have : (k : ℝ) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hgt
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
    linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.HeightWindow.separated_window
statement:
lemma separated_window {a c K e : ℝ} {k r : ℕ}
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hK : 6 * c < K) (ha : K < 2 * a - 6 * c)
    (he : |e| ≤ 6 * c) :
    |2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ)) + e| ≤ K ↔ r = k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith
  constructor
  · intro hwin
    by_contra hne
    have hsep := index_separation hne
    have htri := abs_add_le ((2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ))) + e) (-e)
    have hb : |2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ))| ≤ K + 6 * c := by
      calc
        |2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ))| =
            |(2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ)) + e) + -e| := by congr 1; ring
        _ ≤ |2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ)) + e| + |-e| := htri
        _ ≤ K + 6 * c := by rw [abs_neg]; linarith
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (show 0 < 2 * a by positivity)] at hb
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    subst r
    simp only [Nat.cast_pow, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_add]
    exact he.trans hK.le

name: OAI.SingleFold.HeightWindow.multiplicative_window
statement:
lemma multiplicative_window {L D K : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L) (hD : 0 < D) (hK : 0 < K) :
    (L ≤ K * D ∧ D ≤ K * L) ↔ |Real.log L - Real.log D| ≤ Real.log K
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    have h₁' := Real.log_le_log hL h₁
    have h₂' := Real.log_le_log hD h₂
    rw [Real.log_mul hK.ne' hD.ne'] at h₁'
    rw [Real.log_mul hK.ne' hL.ne'] at h₂'
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    · apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hL (mul_pos hK hD)).mp
      rw [Real.log_mul hK.ne' hD.ne']
      linarith
    · apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hD (mul_pos hK hL)).mp
      rw [Real.log_mul hK.ne' hL.ne']
      linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.HeightWindow.square_window
statement:
theorem square_window {W : ℕ → ℕ} {a c : ℝ} {κ k r : ℕ}
    (hW : ∀ j, 0 < W j)
    (happrox : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → |Real.log (W j : ℝ) - a * (j : ℝ) ^ 2| ≤ c)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hκ : 0 < κ) (h₁ : 6 * c < Real.log κ)
    (h₂ : Real.log κ < 2 * a - 6 * c) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (W (2 * k) * W r * W 1 ≤ κ * (W k ^ 2 * W (r + 1)) ∧
      W k ^ 2 * W (r + 1) ≤ κ * (W (2 * k) * W r * W 1)) ↔ r = k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have pos (j : ℕ) : (0 : ℝ) < W j := by exact_mod_cast hW j
  let L : ℝ := (W (2 * k) : ℝ) * W r * W 1
  let D : ℝ := (W k : ℝ) ^ 2 * W (r + 1)
  have hL : 0 < L := mul_pos (mul_pos (pos _) (pos _)) (pos _)
  have hD : 0 < D := mul_pos (pow_pos (pos _) _) (pos _)
  have prod_iff :
      (W (2 * k) * W r * W 1 ≤ κ * (W k ^ 2 * W (r + 1)) ∧
        W k ^ 2 * W (r + 1) ≤ κ * (W (2 * k) * W r * W 1)) ↔
      (L ≤ (κ : ℝ) * D ∧ D ≤ (κ : ℝ) * L) := by
    dsimp [L, D]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨h, h'⟩
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast h, by exact_mod_cast h'⟩
    · exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast h, by exact_mod_cast h'⟩
  rw [prod_iff, multiplicative_window hL hD (by exact_mod_cast hκ)]
  let err (j : ℕ) := Real.log (W j : ℝ) - a * (j : ℝ) ^ 2
  have herr (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) : -c ≤ err j ∧ err j ≤ c :=
    abs_le.mp (happrox j hj)
  have herr2k := herr (2 * k) (by omega)
  have herrr := herr r hr
  have herr1 := herr 1 (by omega)
  have herrk := herr k hk
  have herrr1 := herr (r + 1) (by omega)
  let e := err (2 * k) + err r + err 1 - 2 * err k - err (r + 1)
  have he : |e| ≤ 6 * c := by
    apply abs_le.mpr
    dsimp [e]
    constructor <;> linarith [herr2k.1, herr2k.2, herrr.1, herrr.2,
      herr1.1, herr1.2, herrk.1, herrk.2, herrr1.1, herrr1.2]
  have formula : Real.log L - Real.log D =
      2 * a * ((k : ℝ) ^ 2 - (r : ℝ)) + e := by
    dsimp [L, D, e, err]
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (pos _) (pos _)).ne' (pos _).ne',
      Real.log_mul (pos _).ne' (pos _).ne',
      Real.log_mul (pow_pos (pos _) _).ne' (pos _).ne', Real.log_pow]
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [formula]
  exact separated_window hc h₁ h₂ he

name: OAI.SingleFold.LocalFive.mod_five_anisotropic
statement:
lemma mod_five_anisotropic (c : ℤ) (hc : c=2 ∨ c= -2) (a b : ℤ) (h : (5:ℤ) ∣ a^2-c*b^2) :
    (5:ℤ) ∣ a ∧ (5:ℤ) ∣ b
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (a:ZMod 5)^2-(c:ZMod 5)*(b:ZMod 5)^2=0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (a^2-c*b^2) 5).mpr h
  have hz : (a:ZMod 5)=0 ∧ (b:ZMod 5)=0 := by
    rcases hc with rfl | rfl
    · exact (by decide : ∀ a b : ZMod 5, a^2-2*b^2=0 → a=0 ∧ b=0) _ _ (by simpa using hh)
    · exact (by decide : ∀ a b : ZMod 5, a^2-(-2)*b^2=0 → a=0 ∧ b=0) _ _ (by simpa using hh)
  exact ⟨(ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd a 5).mp hz.1,
    (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd b 5).mp hz.2⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.LocalFive.five_dvd_of_sq
statement: lemma five_dvd_of_sq {a : ℤ} (h : (5:ℤ) ∣ a^2) : (5:ℤ) ∣ a
proof:
:=
  (show Prime (5:ℤ) by norm_num).dvd_of_dvd_pow h

name: OAI.SingleFold.LocalFive.no_norm_five_int
statement: lemma no_norm_five_int (c : ℤ) (hc : c=2 ∨ c= -2) (N : ℕ) : ∀ R S : ℤ, R^2-c*S^2=5*(N:ℤ)^2 → N=0
proof:
:= by
  induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h N ih =>
    intro R S he
    by_cases hN : N=0
    · exact hN
    obtain ⟨hr,hs⟩ := mod_five_anisotropic c hc R S ⟨(N:ℤ)^2, he⟩
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hr
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := hs
    have hd : (5:ℤ) ∣ (N:ℤ)^2 := ⟨r^2-c*s^2, by rw [hr,hs] at he; nlinarith only [he]⟩
    have hd' : 5 ∣ N := by exact_mod_cast five_dvd_of_sq hd
    obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := hd'
    have hnl : n < N := by omega
    have he' : r^2-c*s^2=5*(n:ℤ)^2 := by
      rw [hr,hs,hn] at he
      push_cast at he
      nlinarith only [he]
    have hn0 := ih n hnl r s he'
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.LocalFive.no_norm_five
statement: lemma no_norm_five (c : ℤ) (hc : c=2 ∨ c= -2) (r s : ℚ) : r^2-(c:ℚ)*s^2 ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let N := r.den*s.den
  let R : ℤ := r.num*s.den
  let S : ℤ := s.num*r.den
  have he : R^2-c*S^2=5*(N:ℤ)^2 := by
    have h' : (R:ℚ)^2-(c:ℚ)*(S:ℚ)^2=5*(N:ℚ)^2 := by
      dsimp [R,S,N]
      push_cast
      have hr := r.num_div_den
      have hs := s.num_div_den
      rw [←hr,←hs] at h
      field_simp at h
      nlinarith only [h]
    exact_mod_cast h'
  have hz := no_norm_five_int c hc N R S he
  exact (Nat.mul_ne_zero r.den_ne_zero s.den_ne_zero) hz

name: OAI.SingleFold.LocalFive.no_norm_ten
statement: lemma no_norm_ten (r s : ℚ) : r^2-10*s^2 ≠ 5
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by intro hh; rw [hh] at h; nlinarith [sq_nonneg s]
  have h' : (5/r)^2-(-2:ℤ)*(5*s/r)^2=5 := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    nlinarith only [h]
  exact no_norm_five (-2) (Or.inr rfl) (5/r) (5*s/r) h'

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alpha_five_when_zero
statement:
lemma alpha_five_when_zero (P : E.Point) (h0 : classOf (alphaVal 0 P)=1) :
    classOf (alphaVal 5 P)=1 ∨ classOf (alphaVal 5 P)=classOf 5
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => exact Or.inl (by simp [←zero_def])
  | some x y h =>
    have hsq := (classOf_eq_one_iff (alphaVal_ne_zero 0 (by norm_num) (some x y h))).mp h0
    by_cases hx : x=0
    · have hs : IsSquare (-25:ℚ) := by
        simp only [alphaVal,adjusted,hx,sub_self] at hsq
        convert hsq using 1; norm_num
      obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hs
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
    have hs : IsSquare x := by simpa [alphaVal,adjusted,hx] using hsq
    obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := hs
    have hxp : 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]) (Ne.symm hx)
    have hx5 : x ≠ 5 := by
      intro he
      exact not_isSquare_prime 5 (by norm_num) (by change IsSquare (5:ℚ); rw [←he]; exact ⟨r,hr⟩)
    have hx5p : 5 < x := by
      have he := equation h
      by_contra hn
      have hl : x < 5 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hn) hx5
      have hm : x*(5-x)*(x+5)>0 := mul_pos (mul_pos hxp (sub_pos.mpr hl)) (by linarith)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
    obtain ⟨d,s,hd,hs0,he⟩ := supported_five (some x y h)
    have ha : alphaVal 5 (some x y h)=x-5 := by simp [alphaVal,adjusted,sub_ne_zero.mpr hx5]
    rw [ha] at he ⊢
    have hdpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro hh; subst d; norm_num at hd)
    have hnneg : ¬ x-5= -((d:ℚ)*s^2) := by
      have hdq : 0 ≤ (d:ℚ) := Nat.cast_nonneg d
      have hnon := mul_nonneg hdq (sq_nonneg s)
      intro hh
      linarith
    have he := he.resolve_right hnneg
    have hdle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num : 0 < 10) hd
    interval_cases d <;> norm_num at hd
    · left
      rw [he]
      simpa using classOf_mul_sq (d:=1) (by norm_num) hs0
    · exfalso
      apply LocalFive.no_norm_five 2 (Or.inl rfl) r s
      norm_num at he ⊢
      nlinarith only [hr,he]
    · right
      rw [he]
      exact classOf_mul_sq (by norm_num) hs0
    · exfalso
      apply LocalFive.no_norm_ten r s
      norm_num at he
      nlinarith only [hr,he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.a0_T0
statement: lemma a0_T0 : a0 T0 = Additive.ofMul (classOf (-1))
proof:
:= by
  change classOf _ = _
  have hh := classOf_mul_sq (d := -1) (r := 5) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  norm_num [T0,alphaVal,adjusted] at *
  exact hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.a0_T5
statement: lemma a0_T5 : a0 T5 = Additive.ofMul (classOf 5)
proof:
:= by
  change classOf (alphaVal 0 T5) = classOf 5
  norm_num [T5,alphaVal,adjusted]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.a0_G
statement: lemma a0_G : a0 G = 0
proof:
:= by
  change classOf _ = 1
  have hh := classOf_mul_sq (d := 1) (r := 5/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  norm_num [G,alphaVal,adjusted] at *
  exact hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.a5_G
statement: lemma a5_G : a5 G = Additive.ofMul (classOf 5)
proof:
:= by
  change classOf _ = _
  have hh := classOf_mul_sq (d := 5) (r := 1/2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  norm_num [G,alphaVal,adjusted] at *
  exact hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.normalize_a0
statement:
lemma normalize_a0 (P : E.Point) : ∃ S : E.Point,
    (S=0 ∨ S=T0 ∨ S=T5 ∨ S=T0+T5) ∧ a0 (P-S)=0
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | h | h | h := alpha_zero_classes P
  · refine ⟨0,Or.inl rfl,?_⟩
    change classOf (alphaVal 0 (P-0))=1
    simpa only [sub_zero,classOf_one] using h
  · refine ⟨T0,Or.inr (Or.inl rfl),?_⟩
    rw [map_sub,a0_T0]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
  · refine ⟨T5,Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)),?_⟩
    rw [map_sub,a0_T5]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h
  · refine ⟨T0+T5,Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)),?_⟩
    rw [map_sub,map_add,a0_T0,a0_T5]
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    change classOf (alphaVal 0 P)=classOf (-1)*classOf 5
    rw [←classOf_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
    exact h

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.mod_two_cover
statement:
theorem mod_two_cover (P : E.Point) : ∃ S : E.Point, ∃ b : Bool, ∃ Q : E.Point,
    (S=0 ∨ S=T0 ∨ S=T5 ∨ S=T0+T5) ∧ P = (S + if b then G else 0) + (2:ℕ) • Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S,hS,h0⟩ := normalize_a0 P
  have h5 := alpha_five_when_zero (P-S) h0
  rcases h5 with h5 | h5
  · have hk : kummer (P-S)=0 := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · exact h0
      · exact h5
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := (kummer_eq_zero_iff _).mp hk
    refine ⟨S,false,Q,hS,?_⟩
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, add_zero]
    rw [hQ]
    abel
  · have hk : kummer (P-S-G)=0 := by
      apply Prod.ext
      · change a0 (P-S-G)=0
        rw [map_sub,h0,a0_G,sub_self]
      · change a5 (P-S-G)=0
        rw [map_sub,a5_G]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h5
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ⟩ := (kummer_eq_zero_iff _).mp hk
    refine ⟨S,true,Q,hS,?_⟩
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    rw [hQ]
    abel

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.inc_reg
statement:
lemma inc_reg (M : Q → Instr Q J) (start : Q) (s t : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ) (j : J)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.inc (.inl j) t) :
    Counter.step (compile M start) (cfg s v a)=some (cfg t (Function.update v j (v j+1)) a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Counter.step,compile,cfg,hi,Counter.next,Sum.elim_inl]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  funext i
  cases i <;> simp [Function.update_apply]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.inc_scratch
statement:
lemma inc_scratch (M : Q → Instr Q J) (start : Q) (s t : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.inc scratch t) :
    Counter.step (compile M start) (cfg s v a)=some (cfg t v (a+1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Counter.step,compile,cfg,hi,Counter.next,scratch,Sum.elim_inr,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  funext i
  rcases i with j|b
  · simp
  · cases b <;> simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.test_reg
statement:
lemma test_reg (M : Q → Instr Q J) (start : Q) (s t u : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ) (j : J)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.test (.inl j) t u) :
    Counter.step (compile M start) (cfg s v a)=
      some (if v j=0 then cfg t v a else cfg u (Function.update v j (v j-1)) a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Counter.step,compile,cfg,hi,Counter.next,Sum.elim_inl]
  by_cases h : v j=0
  · simp [h]
  · simp only [h, ite_false]; congr 1; congr 1; funext i; cases i <;> simp [Function.update_apply]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.test_scratch
statement:
lemma test_scratch (M : Q → Instr Q J) (start : Q) (s t u : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.test scratch t u) :
    Counter.step (compile M start) (cfg s v a)=
      some (if a=0 then cfg t v a else cfg u v (a-1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Counter.step,compile,cfg,hi,Counter.next,scratch,Sum.elim_inr,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · congr 1; congr 1; funext i
    rcases i with j|b
    · simp
    · cases b <;> simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.goto
statement:
lemma goto (M : Q → Instr Q J) (start : Q) (s t : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=go t) :
    Counter.step (compile M start) (cfg s v a)=some (cfg t v a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Counter.step,compile,cfg,hi,go,Counter.next,zeroReg]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.prepend
statement:
lemma prepend {c d e : Counter.Cfg (State Q) (Reg J)}
    (ht : Reaches₁ F d e) (h : F c=some d) : Reaches₁ F c e
proof:
:=
  TransGen.head (r:=fun c d=>d∈F c) h ht

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.inc_at
statement:
lemma inc_at (s t : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a n : ℕ) (j : J)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.inc (.inl j) t) :
    F (cfg s (Function.update v j n) a)=some (cfg t (Function.update v j (n+1)) a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using inc_reg M start s t (Function.update v j n) a j hi

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.test_at_zero
statement:
lemma test_at_zero (s t u : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ) (j : J)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.test (.inl j) t u) :
    F (cfg s (Function.update v j 0) a)=some (cfg t (Function.update v j 0) a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using test_reg M start s t u (Function.update v j 0) a j hi

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.test_at_succ
statement:
lemma test_at_succ (s t u : State Q) (v : J → ℕ) (a n : ℕ) (j : J)
    (hi : compileInstr M s=.test (.inl j) t u) :
    F (cfg s (Function.update v j (n+1)) a)=some (cfg u (Function.update v j n) a)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using test_reg M start s t u (Function.update v j (n+1)) a j hi

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.grow_loop
statement:
lemma grow_loop (q : Q) (i : Fin 5) (v : J → ℕ) (a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.grow q i) v a) (cfg (.main q) v (a+(5-i.val)))
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.reverseInduction generalizing a with
  | last =>
    exact TransGen.single (by simpa using inc_scratch M start (.grow q 4) (.main q) v a rfl)
  | cast i ih =>
    have hi : i.val < 4 := i.isLt
    have hs : succ5 i.castSucc=i.succ := by ext; simp [succ5]; omega
    have hh : compileInstr M (.grow q i.castSucc)=.inc scratch (.grow q i.succ) := by
      simp only [compileInstr,Fin.val_castSucc]
      rw [ite_eq_right (by omega),hs]
    have he := inc_scratch M start (.grow q i.castSucc) (.grow q i.succ) v a hh
    have ht := prepend M start (ih (a+1)) he
    convert ht using 1 ; congr 1 ; simp only [Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_succ] ; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.multiply_loop
statement:
lemma multiply_loop (q : Q) (j : J) (e : Fin 5) (p : Q) (hm : M q=.muladd j e p)
    (v : J → ℕ) (n a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.main q) (Function.update v j n) a)
      (cfg (.copy q 0) (Function.update v j 0) (a+5*n))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing a with
  | zero =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa using test_at_zero M start (.main q) (.copy q 0) (.grow q 0) v a j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 := test_at_succ M start (.main q) (.copy q 0) (.grow q 0) v a n j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
    have h2 := grow_loop M start q 0 (Function.update v j n) a
    have h3 := prepend M start (h2.trans (ih (a+5))) h1
    convert h3 using 1 ; congr 1 ; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.copy_loop
statement:
lemma copy_loop (q : Q) (j : J) (r : Fin 5)
    (hm : (∃e p,M q=.muladd j e p) ∨ (∃b p,M q=.div j b p))
    (v : J → ℕ) (n a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.copy q r) (Function.update v j n) a)
      (cfg (finish M q r) (Function.update v j (n+a)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing n with
  | zero =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa using test_scratch M start (.copy q r) (finish M q r) (.copyInc q r) (Function.update v j n) 0 rfl
  | succ a ih =>
    have h1 := test_scratch M start (.copy q r) (finish M q r) (.copyInc q r) (Function.update v j n) (a+1) rfl
    simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, Nat.one_ne_zero, and_false, ite_false, Nat.add_sub_cancel] at h1
    have hh : compileInstr M (.copyInc q r)=.inc (.inl j) (.copy q r) := by
      rcases hm with ⟨e,p,h⟩|⟨b,p,h⟩ <;> simp [compileInstr,h]
    have h2 := inc_at M start (.copyInc q r) (.copy q r) v a n j hh
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using prepend M start (prepend M start (ih (n+1)) h2) h1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.add_loop
statement:
lemma add_loop (q : Q) (j : J) (e : Fin 5) (p : Q) (hm : M q=.muladd j e p)
    (i : Fin 5) (hi : i.val ≤ e.val) (v : J → ℕ) (n a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.add q i) (Function.update v j n) a)
      (cfg (.main p) (Function.update v j (n+(e.val-i.val))) a)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.reverseInduction generalizing n with
  | last =>
    have hh : e.val=4 := by have := e.isLt; simp only [Fin.val_last] at hi; omega
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa [hh] using goto M start (.add q 4) (.main p) (Function.update v j n) a (by simp [compileInstr,hm,hh])
  | cast i ih =>
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc] at hi
    by_cases he : i.val=e.val
    · apply TransGen.single
      simpa [he] using goto M start (.add q i.castSucc) (.main p) (Function.update v j n) a (by simp [compileInstr,hm,he])
    · have hs : succ5 i.castSucc=i.succ := by ext; simp [succ5]; have := i.isLt; omega
      have h1 := inc_at M start (.add q i.castSucc) (.add q i.succ) v a n j (by
        simp only [compileInstr,hm,Fin.val_castSucc]; rw [ite_eq_left (by omega),hs])
      have h2 := prepend M start (ih (by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega) (n+1)) h1
      have har : n+(e.val-i.val)=(n+1)+(e.val-(i.val+1)) := by omega
      simpa only [Fin.val_castSucc,Fin.val_succ,har] using h2

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.radix_pos
statement: lemma radix_pos (b : Bool) : 0 < radix b
proof: := by cases b <;> decide

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.radix_le
statement: lemma radix_le (b : Bool) : radix b ≤ 5
proof: := by cases b <;> decide

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.mod5_val
statement: @[simp] lemma mod5_val (b : Bool) (n : ℕ) : (mod5 b n).val=n%radix b
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.mod5_self
statement: lemma mod5_self (b : Bool) (r : Fin 5) (hr : r.val<radix b) : mod5 b r.val=r
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.quotient_loop
statement:
lemma quotient_loop (q : Q) (j : J) (b : Bool) (p : Fin 5 → Q) (hm : M q=.div j b p)
    (v : J → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (r : Fin 5) (hr : r.val<radix b) (a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.quotient q r) (Function.update v j n) a)
      (cfg (.copy q (mod5 b (n+r.val))) (Function.update v j 0) (a+(n+r.val)/radix b))
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing r a with
  | zero =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa [mod5_self b r hr, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr] using test_at_zero M start (.quotient q r) (.copy q r)
      (if r.val+1=radix b then .carry q else .quotient q (succ5 r)) v a j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1 := test_at_succ M start (.quotient q r) (.copy q r)
      (if r.val+1=radix b then .carry q else .quotient q (succ5 r)) v a n j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
    by_cases he : r.val+1=radix b
    · simp only [he,ite_eq_left] at h1
      have h2 := inc_scratch M start (.carry q) (.quotient q 0) (Function.update v j n) a rfl
      have h3 := prepend M start (prepend M start (ih 0 (radix_pos b) (a+1)) h2) h1
      have har : n+1+r.val=n+radix b := by omega
      simpa [har,mod5,radix_pos b,Nat.add_div_right, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using h3
    · have hs : (succ5 r).val=r.val+1 := by
        apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
        have := radix_le b
        omega
      simp only [he,ite_false] at h1
      have h3 := prepend M start (ih (succ5 r) (by rw [hs]; omega) a) h1
      simpa only [hs, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using h3

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.simulate
statement:
lemma simulate (q : Q) (v : J → ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (cfg (.main q) v 0) (encode (next M q v))
proof:
:= by
  cases hm : M q with
  | halt =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa [next,hm,encode] using goto M start (.main q) .halt v 0 (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
  | goto p =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa [next,hm,encode] using goto M start (.main q) (.main p) v 0 (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
  | inc j p =>
    apply TransGen.single
    simpa [next,hm,encode] using inc_reg M start (.main q) (.main p) v 0 j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
  | test j pz pp =>
    have h1 := test_reg M start (.main q) (.main pz) (.restore q) v 0 j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
    by_cases hz : v j=0
    · apply TransGen.single
      simpa [next,hm,encode,hz] using h1
    · simp only [hz,ite_false] at h1
      have h2 := inc_at M start (.restore q) (.main pp) v 0 (v j-1) j (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
      have har : v j-1+1=v j := by omega
      have ht : Reaches₁ F (cfg (.restore q) (Function.update v j (v j-1)) 0) (cfg (.main pp) v 0) :=
        TransGen.single (by simpa [har] using h2)
      simpa [next,hm,encode,hz] using prepend M start ht h1
  | muladd j e p =>
    have h1 := multiply_loop M start q j e p hm v (v j) 0
    have h2 := copy_loop M start q j 0 (Or.inl ⟨e,p,hm⟩) v 0 (5*v j)
    have h3 := add_loop M start q j e p hm 0 (Nat.zero_le _) v (5*v j) 0
    simp only [Nat.zero_add] at h1
    simp only [finish,hm,Nat.zero_add] at h2
    simp only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.sub_zero] at h3
    have ht := (h1.trans h2).trans h3
    simpa [next,hm,encode,Reaches₁] using ht
  | div j b p =>
    have h1 := goto M start (.main q) (.quotient q 0) v 0 (by simp [compileInstr,hm])
    have h2 := quotient_loop M start q j b p hm v (v j) 0 (radix_pos b) 0
    have h3 := copy_loop M start q j (mod5 b (v j)) (Or.inr ⟨b,p,hm⟩) v 0 (v j/radix b)
    simp only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.add_zero,Nat.zero_add,Function.update_eq_self] at h2
    simp only [finish,hm,Nat.zero_add] at h3
    simpa [next,hm,encode,mod5] using prepend M start (h2.trans h3) h1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.respects
statement: lemma respects : Respects (step M) F (fun c d=>encode c=d)
proof:
:= by
  apply fun_respects.mpr
  intro c
  rcases c with ⟨label,v⟩
  cases label with
  | none => simp [step,encode,FRespects,Counter.step,compile,compileInstr,cfg]
  | some q => exact simulate M start q v

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.eval_dom
statement:
lemma eval_dom (c : Cfg Q J) :
    (eval F (encode c)).Dom ↔ (eval (step M) c).Dom
proof:
:=
  tr_eval_dom (respects M start) rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.step_eq_none
statement: lemma step_eq_none (M : Machine Q J) (c : Cfg Q J) : step M c=none ↔ c.state=M.halt
proof:
:= by
  rw [←M.halt_iff c.state]
  cases h : M.instr c.state <;> simp [step,h]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.reaches_iterate
statement:
lemma reaches_iterate (M : Machine Q J) {c e : Cfg Q J} (h : Reaches (step M) c e) :
    ∃t,(next M)^[t] c=e
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0,rfl⟩
  | @tail d e h hd ih =>
    rcases ih with ⟨t,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t+1,?_⟩
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    change step M ((next M)^[t] c)=some e at hd
    unfold step at hd
    split at hd
    · contradiction
    · exact Option.some.inj hd

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.reaches_run
statement:
lemma reaches_run (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) (t : ℕ) :
    Reaches (step M) ⟨M.start,d⟩ (run M d t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ t ih =>
    rw [run_succ]
    cases h : M.instr (run M d t).state with
    | halt => simpa only [next,h] using ih
    | inc j p => exact ih.tail (by simp [step,h])
    | test j pz pd => exact ih.tail (by simp [step,h])

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.halts_iff_exists
statement: lemma halts_iff_exists (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) : Halts M d ↔ ∃t,(run M d t).state=M.halt
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,_⟩; exact ⟨t,ht⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨Nat.find h,Nat.find_spec h,fun t ht=>Nat.find_min h ht⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Counter.eval_dom_iff_halts
statement:
lemma eval_dom_iff_halts (M : Machine Q J) (d : J → ℕ) :
    (eval (step M) ⟨M.start,d⟩).Dom ↔ Halts M d
proof:
:= by
  rw [halts_iff_exists]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hr,hh⟩ := mem_eval.mp (Part.get_mem h)
    obtain ⟨t,ht⟩ := reaches_iterate M hr
    refine ⟨t,?_⟩
    have := (step_eq_none M _).mp hh
    simpa only [run,ht] using this
  · rintro ⟨t,ht⟩
    have h := mem_eval.mpr ⟨reaches_run M d t,(step_eq_none M _).mpr ht⟩
    exact Part.dom_iff_mem.mpr ⟨_,h⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.recursively_enumerable_sf
statement: theorem recursively_enumerable_sf {n : ℕ} {p : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : REPred p) : SF p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hD,M,hM⟩:=TM2Macro.exists_counter hp
  let := hQ
  let := hD
  have hc := CounterCompilation.halts_sf M
  have hi : MapSF (TM2Macro.counterInput (n:=n)) := by
    apply MapSF.vector
    intro j
    cases hs : TM2Macro.inputSlot j with
    | none => simpa only [TM2Macro.counterInput,hs,Option.elim_none] using (ScalarSF.const (α:=Fin n) 0)
    | some i => simpa only [TM2Macro.counterInput,hs,Option.elim_some] using ScalarSF.proj i
  exact (hi.pullback hc).congr (fun a=>(hM a).symm)

name: OAI.SingleFold.main
statement: theorem main : MainStatement
proof:
:= by
  intro n _ S hS
  obtain ⟨r⟩:=recursively_enumerable_sf hS
  obtain ⟨m,hm,P,hP,hU⟩:=export_polynomial r
  exact ⟨m,hm,P,fun a=>⟨hP a,hU a⟩⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_testBit
statement: lemma bits_testBit (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ ∀ i, x.testBit i=true → y.testBit i=true
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Bits,Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq,decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h i hi
    have := h i
    have := Nat.mod_lt (y/2^i) (by omega : 0 < 2)
    omega
  · intro h i
    have hx := Nat.mod_lt (x/2^i) (by omega : 0 < 2)
    have hy := Nat.mod_lt (y/2^i) (by omega : 0 < 2)
    by_cases hh : x/2^i%2=1
    · have := h i hh; omega
    · omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.testBit_digit
statement:
lemma testBit_digit (w x t j : ℕ) :
    (digit (2^w) x t).testBit j=(decide (j < w) && x.testBit (w*t+j))
proof:
:= by
  unfold digit
  rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow,←pow_mul]
  congr 1
  simp only [Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq,Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,←pow_add]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_blocks
statement:
lemma bits_blocks {w : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (x y : ℕ) :
    Bits x y ↔ ∀t, Bits (digit (2^w) x t) (digit (2^w) y t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bits_testBit,testBit_digit,Bool.and_eq_true,decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h t j hj
    exact ⟨hj.1,h _ hj.2⟩
  · intro h i hi
    have hh := h (i/w) (i%w) ⟨Nat.mod_lt i hw, by simpa [Nat.div_add_mod] using hi⟩
    simpa [Nat.div_add_mod] using hh.2

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_lt
statement: lemma digit_lt {B : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (x t : ℕ) : digit B x t < B
proof: := Nat.mod_lt _ hB

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_zero
statement: lemma digit_zero (B t : ℕ) : digit B 0 t=0
proof: := by simp [digit]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_of_lt
statement: lemma digit_of_lt {B x : ℕ} (hx : x < B) : digit B x 0=x
proof: := by simp [digit,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hx]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_high
statement: lemma digit_high {B x t : ℕ} (hx : x < B^t) : digit B x t=0
proof: := by simp [digit,Nat.div_eq_of_lt hx]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_succ
statement: lemma pack_succ (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B (k+1) f=pack B k f+f k*B^k
proof:
:= by
  simp [pack,Finset.sum_range_succ]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_cons
statement: lemma pack_cons (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B (k+1) f=f 0+B*pack B k (fun t=>f (t+1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pack,Finset.sum_range_succ',pow_zero,mul_one,Finset.mul_sum,pow_succ]
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intros; ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_zero
statement: lemma pack_zero (B : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : pack B 0 f=0
proof: := by simp [pack]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_add
statement:
lemma pack_add (B k : ℕ) (f g : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>f t+g t)=pack B k f+pack B k g
proof: := by simp [pack,add_mul,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_mul
statement:
lemma pack_mul (B k c : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>c*f t)=c*pack B k f
proof: := by simp [pack,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_lt
statement: lemma pack_lt {B k : ℕ} (_hB : 0 < B) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : ∀ t < k,f t < B) : pack B k f < B^k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [pack]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pack_succ,pow_succ]
    have hi := ih (fun t ht=>hf t (by omega))
    have hh := hf k (by omega)
    nlinarith only [hi,hh,pow_pos _hB k]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_pack
statement:
lemma digit_pack {B k : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : ∀ t < k,f t < B) (i : ℕ) :
    digit B (pack B k f) i=if i < k then f i else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing f i with
  | zero => simp [pack_zero,digit_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pack_cons]
    cases i with
    | zero => simp [digit,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (hf 0 (by omega))]
    | succ i =>
      rw [digit,pow_succ',←Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul,Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ hB,
        Nat.div_eq_of_lt (hf 0 (by omega)),zero_add]
      simpa only [digit, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right] using ih (fun t ht=>hf (t+1) (by omega)) i

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_digits
statement: lemma pack_digits {B k x : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hx : x < B^k) : pack B k (digit B x)=x
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing x with
  | zero =>
    have : x=0 := by simpa using hx
    simp [this,pack_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pack_cons]
    have he : (fun t=>digit B x (t+1))=digit B (x/B) := by
      funext t
      simp [digit,pow_succ',Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
    rw [he,ih]
    · simp [digit,Nat.mod_add_div]
    · rw [pow_succ'] at hx
      exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hB).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hx)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digits_ext
statement:
lemma digits_ext {B k x y : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hx : x < B^k) (hy : y < B^k)
    (h : ∀t < k,digit B x t=digit B y t) : x=y
proof:
:= by
  rw [←pack_digits hB hx,←pack_digits hB hy]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  rw [h t (Finset.mem_range.mp ht)]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_and
statement: lemma bits_and (x y : ℕ) : Bits x y ↔ x&&&y=x
proof:
:= by
  rw [bits_testBit]
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
    intro i
    rw [Nat.testBit_and]
    cases hx : x.testBit i  <;> simp [hx,h i]
  · intro h i hi
    have hh := congrArg (fun n=>Nat.testBit n i) h
    simpa [Nat.testBit_and,hi] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_le
statement: lemma bits_le {x y : ℕ} (h : Bits x y) : x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [←(bits_and x y).mp h]
  exact Nat.and_le_right

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_refl
statement: lemma bits_refl (x : ℕ) : Bits x x
proof: := fun _=>le_rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_zero_left
statement: lemma bits_zero_left (x : ℕ) : Bits 0 x
proof: := by intro i; simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_zero_right
statement: lemma bits_zero_right (x : ℕ) : Bits x 0 ↔ x=0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun h=>Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (bits_le h),fun h=>h ▸ bits_refl 0⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_one
statement: lemma bits_one (x : ℕ) : Bits x 1 ↔ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact bits_le
  · intro h
    interval_cases x
    · exact bits_zero_left 1
    · exact bits_refl 1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_full
statement: lemma bits_full (x h : ℕ) : Bits x (2^h-1) ↔ x < 2^h
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hh
    have := bits_le hh
    have := Nat.two_pow_pos h
    omega
  · intro hh
    rw [bits_and]
    exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_of_lt_two_pow hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.ones_mul
statement: lemma ones_mul (B k c : ℕ) : c*ones B k=pack B k (fun _=>c)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ones] using (pack_mul B k c (fun _=>1)).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.geometric
statement: lemma geometric {B : ℕ} (hB : 1 < B) (k : ℕ) : (B-1)*ones B k=B^k-1
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp [ones,pack_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
    change (B-1)*pack B (k+1) (fun _=>1)=B^(k+1)-1
    rw [pack_succ,mul_add,one_mul,pow_succ]
    change (B-1)*ones B k+(B-1)*B^k=B^k*B-1
    rw [ih]
    have hp := pow_pos (by omega : 0 < B) k
    nlinarith only [hp, hB, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ B), Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1 ≤ B^k), Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ B^k*B by exact Nat.mul_pos hp (by omega))]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_mask
statement:
lemma bits_mask {w k c x : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) (hc : c < 2^w) :
    Bits x (c*ones (2^w) k) ↔ x < (2^w)^k ∧ ∀t < k, Bits (digit (2^w) x t) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ones_mul]
  have hpos := Nat.two_pow_pos w
  have hlt := pack_lt hpos (fun _ _=>hc : ∀t < k,c < 2^w)
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (bits_le h) hlt,?_⟩
    intro t ht
    have hh := (bits_blocks hw x _).mp h t
    rwa [digit_pack hpos (fun _ _=>hc),ite_eq_left ht] at hh
  · rintro ⟨hx,h⟩
    apply (bits_blocks hw x _).mpr
    intro t
    rw [digit_pack hpos (fun _ _=>hc)]
    split_ifs with ht
    · exact h t ht
    · rw [bits_zero_right]
      apply digit_high
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le hx (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hpos (by omega))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_ones
statement:
lemma bits_ones {w k x : ℕ} (hw : 0 < w) :
    Bits x (ones (2^w) k) ↔ x < (2^w)^k ∧ ∀t < k,digit (2^w) x t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [bits_one] using bits_mask (x:=x) (k:=k) hw (Nat.one_lt_two_pow (by omega : w≠0))

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_sum
statement:
lemma pack_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (B k : ℕ) (f : ι → ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B k (fun t=>∑i,f i t)=∑i,pack B k (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pack, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.digit_sum
statement:
lemma digit_sum {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] {B k : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (x : ι → ℕ)
    (hx : ∀i,x i < B^k) (hc : ∀t < k,∑i,digit B (x i) t < B) (t : ℕ) :
    digit B (∑i,x i) t=if t < k then ∑i,digit B (x i) t else 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (∑i,x i)=pack B k (fun t=>∑i,digit B (x i) t) := by
    rw [pack_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact (pack_digits hB (hx i)).symm
  rw [he,digit_pack hB hc]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  have hh := congrArg (fun x=>digit B x t) he
  simpa [digit_pack hB hf,digit_pack hB hg,ht] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.unique_scale
statement: lemma unique_scale {L : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) : ∃! w : ℕ, 2*L < 2^w ∧ 2^w ≤ 4*L
proof:
:= by
  let w:=Nat.log 2 (2*L)+1
  have hl : 2*L < 2^w := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (by omega) (2*L)
  have hu : 2^w ≤ 4*L := by
    have h := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 (x:=2*L) (by omega)
    dsimp [w]; rw [pow_succ]; omega
  refine ⟨w,⟨hl,hu⟩,?_⟩
  intro v ⟨hv,hv'⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra hh
    have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < 2) (show w+1 ≤ v by omega)
    rw [pow_succ] at hpow
    omega
  · by_contra hh
    have hpow := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < 2) (show v+1 ≤ w by omega)
    rw [pow_succ] at hpow
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.bits_trans
statement: lemma bits_trans {x y z : ℕ} (hxy : Bits x y) (hyz : Bits y z) : Bits x z
proof:
:=
  fun i=>(hxy i).trans (hyz i)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_congr
statement: lemma pack_congr {B k : ℕ} {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (h : ∀t < k,f t=g t) : pack B k f=pack B k g
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  rw [h t (Finset.mem_range.mp ht)]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_const_zero
statement: lemma pack_const_zero (B k : ℕ) : pack B k (fun _=>0)=0
proof: := by simp [pack]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_shift
statement:
lemma pack_shift (B k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B (k+1) (fun t=>if t=0 then 0 else f (t-1))=B*pack B k f
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_cons]
  simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_init
statement:
lemma pack_init (B k a : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    pack B (k+1) (fun t=>if t=0 then a else f (t-1))=a+B*pack B k f
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_cons]
  simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.pack_last
statement: lemma pack_last {B T : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : f T=0) : pack B (T+1) f=pack B T f
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_succ,hf,zero_mul,add_zero]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.division_last
statement:
lemma division_last {B T R ρ η : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hR : R < B^(T+1))
    (he : R=ρ*B^T+η) (hη : η < B^T) :
    ρ=digit B R T ∧ η=pack B T (digit B R)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := pack_digits hB hR
  rw [pack_succ] at hp
  have hl : pack B T (digit B R) < B^T := pack_lt hB (fun t _=>digit_lt hB R t)
  have hq : R/B^T=ρ := by rw [he,Nat.add_comm,Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (pow_pos hB T),Nat.div_eq_of_lt hη,zero_add]
  have hq' : R/B^T=digit B R T := by nth_rw 1 [←hp]; rw [Nat.add_mul_div_right _ _ (pow_pos hB T),Nat.div_eq_of_lt hl,zero_add]
  have hr : ρ=digit B R T := hq.symm.trans hq'
  exact ⟨hr,by rw [hr] at he; omega⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.update_coefficients
statement:
lemma update_coefficients {B T m d : ℕ} (hB : 2*m ≤ B) (hd : d < m)
    (r a f : ℕ → ℕ) (hr : ∀t < T+1,r t < m) (ha : ∀t < T,a t ≤ 1) (hf : ∀t < T,f t ≤ 1)
    (he : pack B (T+1) r+B*pack B T f=d+B*(pack B T r+pack B T a)) :
    r 0=d ∧ ∀t < T,r (t+1)+f t=r t+a t
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < B := by omega
  let l := fun t=>r t+(if t=0 then 0 else f (t-1))
  let u := fun t=>if t=0 then d else r (t-1)+a (t-1)
  have he' : pack B (T+1) l=pack B (T+1) u := by
    dsimp [l,u]
    rw [pack_add,pack_shift]
    rw [pack_init B T d (fun u=>r u+a u),pack_add]
    exact he
  have hl : ∀t < T+1,l t < B := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [l]
    split_ifs with ht0
    · have := hr t ht; omega
    · have hh := hr t ht
      have hh' := hf (t-1) (by omega)
      omega
  have hu : ∀t < T+1,u t < B := by
    intro t ht
    dsimp [u]
    split_ifs with ht0
    · omega
    · have hh := hr (t-1) (by omega)
      have hh' := ha (t-1) (by omega)
      omega
  have hh := pack_injective hpos hl hu he'
  refine ⟨by simpa [l,u] using hh 0 (by omega),?_⟩
  intro t ht
  simpa [l,u] using hh (t+1) (by omega)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Packed.update_identity
statement:
lemma update_identity {B T d : ℕ} (r a f : ℕ → ℕ) (h0 : r 0=d)
    (hstep : ∀t < T,r (t+1)+f t=r t+a t) :
    pack B (T+1) r+B*pack B T f=d+B*(pack B T r+pack B T a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [←pack_shift B T f,←pack_add,←pack_add,←pack_init B T d (fun t=>r t+a t)]
  apply pack_congr
  intro t ht
  by_cases he : t=0
  · simp [he,h0]
  · have hh := hstep (t-1) (by omega)
    simpa [he,show t-1+1=t by omega] using hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.y_positive
statement: lemma y_positive {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) : 0 < Pell.yn ha n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le hn (Pell.yn_ge_n ha n)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.step_bounds
statement:
lemma step_bounds (n : ℕ) :
    (2*a-1)*Pell.yn ha (n+1) ≤ Pell.yn ha (n+2) ∧
    Pell.yn ha (n+2) ≤ (2*a)*Pell.yn ha (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := Pell.yn_succ_succ ha n
  have hm := (Pell.strictMono_y ha).monotone (Nat.le_succ n)
  have ha' : 2*a-1+1=2*a := by omega
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.power_bounds
statement:
lemma power_bounds (n : ℕ) :
    (2*a-1)^n ≤ Pell.yn ha (n+1) ∧ Pell.yn ha (n+1) ≤ (2*a)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    obtain ⟨hl,hu⟩ := step_bounds ha n
    constructor
    · calc
        (2*a-1)^(n+1)=(2*a-1)*(2*a-1)^n := pow_succ' _ _
        _ ≤ (2*a-1)*Pell.yn ha (n+1) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hn.1
        _ ≤ Pell.yn ha (n+2) := hl
    · calc
        Pell.yn ha (n+2) ≤ (2*a)*Pell.yn ha (n+1) := hu
        _ ≤ (2*a)*(2*a)^n := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hn.2
        _ = (2*a)^(n+1) := (pow_succ' _ _).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.rate_bounds
statement: lemma rate_bounds (n : ℕ) : 2*(a:ℝ)-1 ≤ rate ha n ∧ rate ha n ≤ 2*a
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (0:ℝ) < Pell.yn ha (n+1) := by exact_mod_cast y_positive ha (by omega : 0<n+1)
  simp only [rate]
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hp,div_le_iff₀ hp]
  have hb := step_bounds ha n
  have ha' : 1 ≤ 2*a := by omega
  constructor
  · have hc : ((2*a-1:ℕ):ℝ)=2*(a:ℝ)-1 := by rw [Nat.cast_sub ha']; push_cast; rfl
    rw [←hc]; exact_mod_cast hb.1
  · exact_mod_cast hb.2

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.rate_pos
statement: lemma rate_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < rate ha n
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (rate_bounds ha n).1
  have ha' : (1:ℝ)<a := by exact_mod_cast ha
  linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.rate_zero
statement: lemma rate_zero : rate ha 0 = 2*a
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Pell.yn_succ_succ ha 0
  norm_num only [Pell.yn_zero,Pell.yn_one,add_zero,mul_one] at hh
  simp only [rate,zero_add,Pell.yn_one,hh,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_one,div_one]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.rate_succ
statement: lemma rate_succ (n : ℕ) : rate ha (n+1)=2*a-1/rate ha n
proof:
:= by
  have hr := Pell.yn_succ_succ ha (n+1)
  have hr' : (Pell.yn ha (n+3):ℝ)+Pell.yn ha (n+1)=2*a*Pell.yn ha (n+2) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hp : (Pell.yn ha (n+1):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (y_positive ha (by omega : 0<n+1)).ne'
  have hp' : (Pell.yn ha (n+2):ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (y_positive ha (by omega : 0<n+2)).ne'
  simp only [rate]
  have hn : n+1+2=n+3 := by omega
  rw [hn]
  rw [one_div_div]
  apply (div_eq_iff hp').mpr
  rw [sub_mul,div_mul_cancel₀ _ hp']
  linarith only [hr']

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.ratio_rate
statement:
lemma ratio_rate {b u : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hu : 1 < u) (n : ℕ) :
    (b:ℝ)*rate hu n ≤ rate (show 1 < b*u by nlinarith) n
proof:
:= by
  have hbu : 1 < b*u := by nlinarith
  have hb' : (1:ℝ)<b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [rate_zero,Nat.cast_mul]; ring_nf; rfl
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [rate_succ,rate_succ]
    have hp := rate_pos hu n
    have hp' := rate_pos hbu n
    have hh : 1/rate hbu n ≤ (b:ℝ)/rate hu n := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hp' hp]
      nlinarith
    simp only [Nat.cast_mul,div_eq_mul_inv,one_mul] at hh ⊢
    nlinarith only [hh]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellPower.ratio_bounds
statement:
lemma ratio_bounds {b u : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) (hu : 1 < u) (n : ℕ) :
    (b:ℝ)^n ≤ (Pell.yn (show 1 < b*u by nlinarith) (n+1):ℝ)/Pell.yn hu (n+1) ∧
    (Pell.yn (show 1 < b*u by nlinarith) (n+1):ℝ)/Pell.yn hu (n+1) ≤
      (b:ℝ)^n*(1+1/(2*u-1))^n
proof:
:= by
  have hbu : 1 < b*u := by nlinarith
  have hu' : (1:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hb' : (1:ℝ)<b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hd : 0 < 2*(u:ℝ)-1 := by linarith
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n hn =>
    have hp : (0:ℝ)<Pell.yn hu (n+1) := by exact_mod_cast y_positive hu (by omega : 0<n+1)
    have hp' : (0:ℝ)<Pell.yn hbu (n+1) := by exact_mod_cast y_positive hbu (by omega : 0<n+1)
    have hrp := rate_pos hu n
    have hrp' := rate_pos hbu n
    have he : (Pell.yn hbu (n+2):ℝ)/Pell.yn hu (n+2) =
        (rate hbu n/rate hu n)*((Pell.yn hbu (n+1):ℝ)/Pell.yn hu (n+1)) := by
      simp only [rate]
      field_simp
    have hl : (b:ℝ) ≤ rate hbu n/rate hu n := (le_div_iff₀ hrp).mpr (ratio_rate hb hu n)
    have hh : rate hbu n/rate hu n ≤ (b:ℝ)*(1+1/(2*u-1)) := by
      have hstep := (rate_bounds hbu n).2
      have hstep' := (rate_bounds hu n).1
      calc
        _ ≤ (2*(b*u:ℕ):ℝ)/(2*u-1) := div_le_div₀ (by positivity) hstep hd hstep'
        _ = (b:ℝ)*(1+1/(2*u-1)) := by push_cast; field_simp; ring
    rw [he,pow_succ',pow_succ']
    constructor
    · exact mul_le_mul hl hn.1 (by positivity) (by positivity)
    · calc
        _ ≤ ((b:ℝ)*(1+1/(2*u-1)))*((b:ℝ)^n*(1+1/(2*u-1))^n) :=
          mul_le_mul hh hn.2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellAnalytics.reciprocal_binomial
statement:
lemma reciprocal_binomial (z : ℝ) (hz : 0≤z) (n : ℕ) :
    (1+z)^n*(1-(n:ℝ)*z)≤1
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    push_cast
    rw [pow_succ]
    have hh : 0≤(1+z)^n*((n:ℝ)+1)*z^2 := by positivity
    nlinarith only [ih,hh]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellAnalytics.binomial_error
statement:
lemma binomial_error (z : ℝ) (hz : 0≤z) (n : ℕ) (hn : (n:ℝ)*z<1) :
    (1+z)^n-1≤(n:ℝ)*z/(1-(n:ℝ)*z)
proof:
:= by
  apply (le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)).mpr
  nlinarith only [reciprocal_binomial z hz n]

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellAnalytics.index_cutoff_real
statement: lemma index_cutoff_real : ∀ u : ℕ, 4≤u → (u:ℝ)<(2-1/(u:ℝ))^(u-1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · norm_num
  · intro u hu ih
    have hp : (0:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u by omega)
    have hu' : (4:ℝ)≤u := by exact_mod_cast hu
    have hr : 0<2-1/(u:ℝ) := by
      have : 1/(u:ℝ)≤1 := (div_le_one hp).mpr (by linarith)
      linarith
    have hr' : 2-1/(u:ℝ)≤2-1/((u:ℝ)+1) := by
      have := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hp (show (u:ℝ)≤u+1 by linarith)
      linarith
    have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hr.le hr' u
    have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ih hr
    have he : (u-1)+1=u := by omega
    rw [←pow_succ,he] at hh
    have he' : (u:ℝ)*(2-1/(u:ℝ))=2*u-1 := by field_simp
    rw [he'] at hh
    push_cast
    linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellAnalytics.index_cutoff
statement: lemma index_cutoff (u : ℕ) (hu : 4≤u) : u^u<(2*u-1)^(u-1)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := index_cutoff_real u hu
  have hp : (0:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<u by omega)
  have he : (2-1/(u:ℝ))=((2*u:ℕ)-1:ℕ)/(u:ℝ) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1≤2*u)]
    push_cast
    field_simp
  rw [he,div_pow] at hh
  have hh' := (lt_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hp (u-1))).mp hh
  have he' : (u-1)+1=u := by omega
  rw [←pow_succ',he'] at hh'
  exact_mod_cast hh'

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellAnalytics.quotient_error
statement:
lemma quotient_error {b n c u : ℕ} (hu : (c+1)*(n+1)+4≤u)
    (hc : b^n≤c) {F H : ℝ} (_hH : 0<H)
    (hlo : (b:ℝ)^n≤F/H)
    (hhi : F/H≤(b:ℝ)^n*(1+1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))^n) :
    0≤F/H-(b:ℝ)^n ∧ F/H-(b:ℝ)^n<1
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : ((c:ℝ)+1)*((n:ℝ)+1)+4≤u := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hc' : (b:ℝ)^n≤c := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hn : (0:ℝ)≤n := by positivity
  have hcn : (0:ℝ)≤c := by positivity
  have hd : 0<2*(u:ℝ)-1 := by nlinarith
  have hdn : 0<2*(u:ℝ)-1-n := by nlinarith
  have hz : 0≤1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1) := by positivity
  have hnz : (n:ℝ)*(1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))<1 := by
    rw [mul_one_div,div_lt_one hd]
    linarith
  have he := binomial_error _ hz n hnz
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (show 0≤(b:ℝ)^n by positivity)
  have heq : (b:ℝ)^n*((n:ℝ)*(1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))/(1-(n:ℝ)*(1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))))=
      (b:ℝ)^n*n/(2*(u:ℝ)-1-n) := by
    field_simp
  rw [heq] at hh
  have hb : F/H-(b:ℝ)^n≤(b:ℝ)^n*n/(2*(u:ℝ)-1-n) := by nlinarith only [hh,hhi]
  have hbc : (b:ℝ)^n*n/(2*(u:ℝ)-1-n)≤(c:ℝ)*n/(2*(u:ℝ)-1-n) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc' hn) hdn.le
  have hcq : (c:ℝ)*n/(2*(u:ℝ)-1-n)<1 := by
    rw [div_lt_one hdn]
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨sub_nonneg.mpr hlo,lt_of_le_of_lt (hb.trans hbc) hcq⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellSystem.index_pinned
statement:
lemma index_pinned {a u n i q : ℕ} (hu : 4≤u) (ha : u≤a) (hn : n+1<u-1)
    (hcut : Pell.yn (show 1<a by omega) i<u^u)
    (hres : Pell.yn (show 1<a by omega) i=n+1+(a-1)*q) : i=n+1
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : 1<a := by omega
  have hi : i<u := by
    by_contra h
    have hui : u ≤ i := by omega
    have hpow : (2*u-1)^(u-1)≤(2*a-1)^(u-1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _
    have hb := (PellPower.power_bounds ha' (u-1)).1
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega : 1≤u)] at hb
    have hmono := (Pell.strictMono_y ha').monotone hui
    have hcut' := PellAnalytics.index_cutoff u hu
    omega
  have hn' : n+1<a-1 := by omega
  have hmod : i ≡ n+1 [MOD a-1] := by
    have h := (Pell.yn_modEq_a_sub_one ha' i).symm
    rw [hres] at h
    exact h.trans (by unfold Nat.ModEq; simp)
  have his : i<a-1 := by
    by_contra h
    have he : i=a-1 := by omega
    rw [he] at hmod
    have hh : (n+1)%(a-1)=0 := by simpa only [Nat.ModEq,Nat.mod_self] using hmod.symm
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn'] at hh
    omega
  exact hmod.eq_of_lt_of_lt his hn'

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellSystem.pell_pinned
statement:
lemma pell_pinned {a u n X F q : ℕ} (hu : 4≤u) (ha : u≤a) (hn : n+1<u-1)
    (hpell : X^2=1+(a^2-1)*F^2) (hcut : F<u^u) (hres : F=n+1+(a-1)*q) :
    X=Pell.xn (show 1<a by omega) (n+1) ∧ F=Pell.yn (show 1<a by omega) (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  have ha' : 1<a := by omega
  have he : X*X-(a*a-1)*F*F=1 := by
    have hp : X*X=1+(a*a-1)*F*F := by simpa only [pow_two, Nat.mul_assoc] using hpell
    omega
  obtain ⟨i,rfl,rfl⟩ := Pell.eq_pell ha' he
  have hi := index_pinned hu ha hn hcut hres
  subst i
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellSystem.quotient_sound
statement:
lemma quotient_sound {b u n c r : ℕ} (hb : 2≤b) (hu : (c+1)*(n+1)+4≤u)
    (hdiv : Pell.yn (show 1<b*u by nlinarith) (n+1)=c*Pell.yn (show 1<u by nlinarith) (n+1)+r)
    (hr : r<Pell.yn (show 1<u by nlinarith) (n+1)) : c=b^n
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : 1<b := by omega
  have hu' : 1<u := by nlinarith
  have hbu : 1<b*u := by nlinarith
  let F := Pell.yn hbu (n+1)
  let H := Pell.yn hu' (n+1)
  have hH : 0<H := PellPower.y_positive hu' (by omega)
  have hH' : (0:ℝ)<H := by exact_mod_cast hH
  have hbds := PellPower.ratio_bounds hb' hu' n
  change (b:ℝ)^n≤(F:ℝ)/H ∧ (F:ℝ)/H≤(b:ℝ)^n*(1+1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))^n at hbds
  have hlow : b^n*H≤F := by
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hH').mp hbds.1
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hhigh : F<(c+1)*H := by change F=c*H+r at hdiv; change r<H at hr; nlinarith
  have hbc : b^n≤c := by
    by_contra h
    have hc : c+1≤b^n := by omega
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right H hc
    omega
  have herr := PellAnalytics.quotient_error hu hbc hH' hbds.1 hbds.2
  have hclow : (c:ℝ)≤(F:ℝ)/H := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hH').mpr
    have hh : c*H≤F := by change F=c*H+r at hdiv; omega
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hlt : (c:ℝ)<(b:ℝ)^n+1 := by linarith [herr.2]
  have hcle : c<b^n+1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.PellSystem.residue_exists
statement:
lemma residue_exists {a : ℕ} (ha : 1<a) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! q : ℕ, Pell.yn ha (n+1)=n+1+(a-1)*q
proof:
:= by
  have hge := Pell.yn_ge_n ha (n+1)
  obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := (Pell.yn_modEq_a_sub_one ha (n+1)).symm.dvd'
  refine ⟨q,by omega,?_⟩
  intro q' hq'
  have hai : 0<a-1 := by omega
  have he : (a-1)*q'=(a-1)*q := by omega
  exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hai he

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.elim_comp_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma elim_comp_map {α β γ δ ε : Type} (x : γ → ε) (w : δ → ε)
    (f : α → γ) (g : β → δ) :
    Sum.elim x w ∘ Sum.map f g = Sum.elim (x ∘ f) (w ∘ g)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; cases i <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.elim_comp_assoc
statement:
@[simp] lemma elim_comp_assoc {α β γ δ : Type} (x : α → δ) (w : β ⊕ γ → δ) :
    Sum.elim x w ∘ (Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ) =
      Sum.elim (Sum.elim x (w ∘ Sum.inl)) (w ∘ Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  funext i; rcases i with (i|i)|i <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Representation.zeros_eq
statement: lemma zeros_eq {β : Type} [Finite β] (w : β → ℕ) : zeros β w = 0 ↔ w=0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite β
  rw [zeros,Poly.sumsq_eq_zero,List.forall_map_iff]
  simp only [List.forall_iff_forall_mem,Finset.mem_toList,Finset.mem_univ,
    true_implies,Function.comp_apply,Poly.proj_apply,Int.natCast_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨fun h => funext h,fun h i => congrFun h i⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.poly_to_mv
statement:
theorem poly_to_mv {α : Type} (p : Poly α) :
    ∃ q : MvPolynomial α ℤ, ∀ x, q.eval (fun i => (x i : ℤ)) = p x
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Poly.induction with
  | H1 i => exact ⟨MvPolynomial.X i,by simp⟩
  | H2 n => exact ⟨MvPolynomial.C n,by simp⟩
  | H3 f g hf hg =>
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p-q,by intro x; simp [hp,hq]⟩
  | H4 f g hf hg =>
    obtain ⟨p,hp⟩ := hf
    obtain ⟨q,hq⟩ := hg
    exact ⟨p*q,by intro x; simp [hp,hq]⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.export_polynomial
statement:
theorem export_polynomial {α : Type} {R : (α → ℕ) → Prop} (r : Representation R) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m ∧ ∃ p : MvPolynomial (α ⊕ Fin m) ℤ,
      (∀ x, R x ↔ ∃ w : Fin m → ℕ, p.eval (Sum.elim (fun i => (x i:ℤ)) (fun j => (w j:ℤ)))=0) ∧
      (∀ (x : α → ℕ) (w w' : Fin m → ℕ), p.eval (Sum.elim (fun i => (x i:ℤ)) (fun j => (w j:ℤ)))=0 →
        p.eval (Sum.elim (fun i => (x i:ℤ)) (fun j => (w' j:ℤ)))=0 → w=w')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p : Poly (α ⊕ (r.vars ⊕ Unit)) := r.poly.map (Sum.map id Sum.inl)
  let q : Poly (α ⊕ (r.vars ⊕ Unit)) := Poly.proj (Sum.inr (Sum.inr ()))
  let := Fintype.ofFinite (r.vars ⊕ Unit)
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (r.vars ⊕ Unit)
  let f := (p*p+q*q).map (Sum.map id e)
  obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := poly_to_mv f
  have ev (x : α → ℕ) (w : Fin (Fintype.card (r.vars ⊕ Unit)) → ℕ) :
      P.eval (Sum.elim (fun i => (x i:ℤ)) (fun j => (w j:ℤ)))=0 ↔
        r.poly (Sum.elim x (fun i => w (e (Sum.inl i))))=0 ∧ w (e (Sum.inr ()))=0 := by
    have he := hP (Sum.elim x w)
    have hc : (fun i : α ⊕ Fin (Fintype.card (r.vars ⊕ Unit)) => ((Sum.elim x w) i:ℤ)) =
        Sum.elim (fun i => (x i:ℤ)) (fun j => (w j:ℤ)) := by funext i; cases i <;> rfl
    rw [hc] at he
    rw [he]
    simp only [f,p,q,Poly.map_apply,Poly.add_apply,Poly.mul_apply,Poly.proj_apply,elim_comp_map,Function.comp_id]
    change r.poly (Sum.elim x (fun i => w (e (Sum.inl i)))) *
      r.poly (Sum.elim x (fun i => w (e (Sum.inl i)))) +
      (w (e (Sum.inr ())):ℤ) * (w (e (Sum.inr ())):ℤ)=0 ↔ _
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h₁ : r.poly (Sum.elim x (fun i => w (e (Sum.inl i))))=0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w (e (Sum.inr ())):ℤ)]
      exact ⟨h₁,by rw [h₁] at h; norm_num at h; exact h⟩
    · rintro ⟨h₁,h₂⟩; simp [h₁,h₂]
  refine ⟨Fintype.card (r.vars ⊕ Unit),by exact Fintype.card_pos, P,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := r.complete x hx
      refine ⟨Sum.elim w (fun _ => 0) ∘ e.symm,(ev _ _).mpr ?_⟩
      simpa using And.intro hw (show (0:ℕ)=0 from rfl)
    · rintro ⟨w,hw⟩
      exact r.sound _ _ ((ev _ _).mp hw).1
  · intro x w w' hw hw'
    obtain ⟨hr,hz⟩ := (ev _ _).mp hw
    obtain ⟨hr',hz'⟩ := (ev _ _).mp hw'
    have hh := r.unique _ _ _ hr hr'
    funext i
    obtain ⟨j,rfl⟩ := e.surjective i
    rcases j with j|⟨⟩
    · exact congrFun hh j
    · exact hz.trans hz'.symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerEstimate.choose_ell
statement: lemma choose_ell {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) : ∃ ell : ℕ, 1 ≤ ell ∧ 3 < δ*(ell:ℝ)*Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (2:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨ell,hell⟩ := exists_nat_gt (3/(δ*Real.log 2))
  refine ⟨ell,?_,?_⟩
  · have : (0:ℝ) < ell := lt_trans (div_pos (by norm_num) (mul_pos hδ hlog)) hell
    have hp : 0<ell := by exact_mod_cast this
    omega
  · have hh := (div_lt_iff₀ (mul_pos hδ hlog)).mp hell
    nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerEstimate.input_bounds
statement:
lemma input_bounds {ell u₀ b n c : ℕ} (hell : 1≤ell) (h₀ : 4≤u₀) :
    u₀ ≤ input ell u₀ b n c ∧ (c+1)*(n+1)+4 ≤ input ell u₀ b n c ∧
    b < input ell u₀ b n c ∧ n+1 < input ell u₀ b n c-1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : c+1≤(c+1)^ell := Nat.le_pow hell
  have h1 : 1≤(c+1)^ell*(n+1) := by
    have : 0<(c+1)^ell*(n+1) := by positivity
    omega
  have hn : n+1≤(c+1)^ell*(n+1) := by nlinarith
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n+1) hp
  dsimp [input]
  constructor; omega
  constructor; nlinarith
  constructor
  · nlinarith
  · have hnn : n+1+4≤(c+1)^ell*(n+1)*(b+1)+u₀ := by nlinarith
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerEstimate.growth_nat
statement:
lemma growth_nat {g : ℕ → ℕ} {δ : ℝ} {u : ℕ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hu : 4≤u)
    (hg : δ*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 < Real.log (g u:ℝ) ∧ Real.log (g u:ℝ)<(u:ℝ)*Real.log (u:ℝ)) :
    0<g u ∧ g u<u^u
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : (1:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 1<u by omega)
  have hlog : 0<Real.log (u:ℝ) := Real.log_pos hu'
  have hglog : 0<Real.log (g u:ℝ) := lt_trans (mul_pos hδ (sq_pos_of_pos hlog)) hg.1
  have hgp : 0<g u := by
    by_contra h
    have he : g u=0 := by omega
    simp [he] at hglog
  refine ⟨hgp,?_⟩
  have hup : (0:ℝ)<(u:ℝ)^u := pow_pos (by linarith) _
  have hlg : Real.log (g u:ℝ)<Real.log ((u:ℝ)^u) := by simpa only [Real.log_pow] using hg.2
  have hh := (Real.log_lt_log_iff (by exact_mod_cast hgp) hup).mp hlg
  exact_mod_cast hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerEstimate.cutoff
statement:
lemma cutoff {δ : ℝ} {ell u₀ b n : ℕ} (hδ : 0<δ) (hell : 1≤ell)
    (hell' : 3<δ*(ell:ℝ)*Real.log 2) (h₀ : 4≤u₀) (hb : 2≤b) :
    let u
proof:
:= input ell u₀ b n (b^n)
    Real.log (((2*(b*u))^n:ℕ):ℝ) < δ*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2 := by
  dsimp only
  let u := input ell u₀ b n (b^n)
  have hbounds := input_bounds (c:=b^n) (b:=b) (n:=n) hell h₀
  have hu : 4≤u := h₀.trans hbounds.1
  have hbu : b<u := hbounds.2.2.1
  have hb' : (2:ℝ)≤b := by exact_mod_cast hb
  have hu' : (2:ℝ)<u := by exact_mod_cast (show 2<u by omega)
  have hbp : (0:ℝ)<b := by linarith
  have hup : (0:ℝ)<u := by linarith
  have hlog : 0<Real.log (u:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
  have hl2 : 0<Real.log (2:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hlb : Real.log (2:ℝ)≤Real.log (b:ℝ) := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hb'
  have hpu : (b^n)^ell≤u := by
    have hp : (b^n)^ell≤(b^n+1)^ell := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _
    dsimp [u,input]
    have hpn : (b^n+1)^ell≤(b^n+1)^ell*(n+1) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
    exact hp.trans (hpn.trans ((Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega : 0<b+1)).trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _)))
  have hlogu : (ell:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)*Real.log (b:ℝ)≤Real.log (u:ℝ) := by
    have hp : (0:ℝ)<((b:ℝ)^n)^ell := pow_pos (pow_pos hbp _) _
    have hh : ((b:ℝ)^n)^ell≤(u:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hpu
    have hh' := Real.log_le_log hp hh
    simpa only [Real.log_pow,mul_assoc] using hh'
  have hnu : (ell:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)*Real.log 2≤Real.log (u:ℝ) := by
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlb (by positivity : 0≤(ell:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))).trans hlogu
  have htriple : Real.log (2*(b:ℝ)*u) ≤ 3*Real.log (u:ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_mul (mul_pos (by norm_num) hbp).ne' hup.ne', Real.log_mul (by norm_num) hbp.ne']
    have hh1 := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2) hu'.le
    have hh2 := Real.log_le_log hbp (show (b:ℝ)≤u by exact_mod_cast hbu.le)
    linarith
  have hsmall : 3*(n:ℝ) < δ*Real.log (u:ℝ) := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnu hδ.le
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · subst n; simpa using mul_pos hδ hlog
    · have hn' : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      have ht := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hell' hn'
      nlinarith
  have hl : Real.log (((2*(b*u))^n:ℕ):ℝ)=(n:ℝ)*Real.log (2*(b:ℝ)*u) := by
    push_cast; rw [Real.log_pow]; congr 2; ring
  rw [hl]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htriple (Nat.cast_nonneg n : (0:ℝ)≤n)
  have hh' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hsmall hlog
  nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.pell_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hh : a^2-1+1=a^2 := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by nlinarith)
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.coords_eq
statement:
lemma coords_eq {a : ℕ} (ha : 1<a) (n : ℕ) :
    (Pell.xn ha n)^2+(Pell.yn ha n)^2=1+a^2*(Pell.yn ha n)^2
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Pell.pell_eq ha n
  change Pell.xn ha n*Pell.xn ha n-(a*a-1)*Pell.yn ha n*Pell.yn ha n=1 at hh
  have hh' : Pell.xn ha n*Pell.xn ha n=1+(a*a-1)*Pell.yn ha n*Pell.yn ha n := by omega
  apply (pell_eq ha).mpr
  simpa only [pow_two,Nat.mul_assoc] using hh'

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.pinned
statement:
lemma pinned {b n c : ℕ} {w : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) :
    w 2=px (b*w 0) (n+1) ∧ w 3=py (b*w 0) (n+1) ∧
    w 4=px (w 0) (n+1) ∧ w 5=py (w 0) (n+1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hw with ⟨hb,hu,hv,hX,hY,hF,hFv,hH,hHv,hq,hq',hdiv,hr⟩
  have hbds := input_bounds (c:=c) (n:=n) (b:=b) hell h₀
  rw [←hu] at hbds
  have hu4 : 4≤w 0 := h₀.trans hbds.1
  have hgu := growth_nat hδ hu4 (hg _ hbds.1)
  have hla : w 0≤b*w 0 := by nlinarith
  have hba : 1<b*w 0 := by nlinarith
  have hua : 1<w 0 := by omega
  have ha := PellSystem.pell_pinned hu4 hla hbds.2.2.2 ((pell_eq hba).mp hX) (by omega) hq
  have hh := PellSystem.pell_pinned hu4 (le_refl (w 0)) hbds.2.2.2 ((pell_eq hua).mp hY) (by omega) hq'
  simpa only [px,py,dite_eq_left hba,dite_eq_left hua] using And.intro ha.1 (And.intro ha.2 hh)

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.sound
statement: lemma sound {b n c : ℕ} {w : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) : 2≤b ∧ c=b^n
proof:
:= by
  have hp := pinned hδ hell h₀ hg hw
  have hbds := input_bounds (c:=c) (n:=n) (b:=b) hell h₀
  rcases hw with ⟨hb,hu,hv,hX,hY,hF,hFv,hH,hHv,hq,hq',hdiv,hr⟩
  rw [←hu] at hbds
  rw [hp.2.1,hp.2.2.2] at hdiv
  rw [hp.2.2.2] at hr
  have hua : 1<w 0 := by omega
  have hba : 1<b*w 0 := by nlinarith
  simp only [py,dite_eq_left hua,dite_eq_left hba] at hdiv hr
  exact ⟨hb,PellSystem.quotient_sound hb hbds.2.1 hdiv hr⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.unique
statement: lemma unique {b n c : ℕ} {w w' : Fin 9 → ℕ} (hw : System g ell u₀ b n c w) (hw' : System g ell u₀ b n c w') : w=w'
proof:
:= by
  have hp := pinned hδ hell h₀ hg hw
  have hp' := pinned hδ hell h₀ hg hw'
  rcases hw with ⟨hb,hu,hv,hX,hY,hF,hFv,hH,hHv,hq,hq',hdiv,hr⟩
  rcases hw' with ⟨_,hu',hv',hX',hY',hF',hFv',hH',hHv',hqq,hqq',hdiv',hr'⟩
  have h0 : w 0=w' 0 := hu.trans hu'.symm
  have h1 : w 1=w' 1 := by rw [hv,hv',h0]
  have h2 : w 2=w' 2 := by rw [hp.1,hp'.1,h0]
  have h3 : w 3=w' 3 := by rw [hp.2.1,hp'.2.1,h0]
  have h4 : w 4=w' 4 := by rw [hp.2.2.1,hp'.2.2.1,h0]
  have h5 : w 5=w' 5 := by rw [hp.2.2.2,hp'.2.2.2,h0]
  have hu4 : 4≤w' 0 := by rw [hu']; exact h₀.trans (input_bounds (c:=c) (n:=n) (b:=b) hell h₀).1
  have h6 : w 6=w' 6 := by
    rw [h0,h3] at hq
    have hh : 2≤b*w' 0 := by nlinarith only [hb,hu4]
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (show 0<b*w' 0-1 by omega)
    omega
  have h7 : w 7=w' 7 := by
    rw [h0,h5] at hq'
    apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (show 0<w' 0-1 by omega)
    omega
  have h8 : w 8=w' 8 := by rw [h3,h5] at hdiv; omega
  funext j; fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerSystem.complete
statement:
lemma complete (hell' : 3<δ*(ell:ℝ)*Real.log 2) {b n : ℕ} (hb : 2≤b) :
    ∃ w, System g ell u₀ b n (b^n) w
proof:
:= by
  let c := b^n
  let u := input ell u₀ b n c
  have hbds := input_bounds (c:=c) (n:=n) (b:=b) hell h₀
  have hu4 : 4≤u := h₀.trans hbds.1
  have hua : 1<u := by omega
  have hba : 1<b*u := by nlinarith
  let F := Pell.yn hba (n+1)
  let H := Pell.yn hua (n+1)
  have hF : 0<F := PellPower.y_positive hba (by omega)
  have hH : 0<H := PellPower.y_positive hua (by omega)
  have hH' : (0:ℝ)<H := by exact_mod_cast hH
  have hrati := PellPower.ratio_bounds (show 1<b by omega) hua n
  change (b:ℝ)^n≤(F:ℝ)/H ∧ (F:ℝ)/H≤(b:ℝ)^n*(1+1/(2*(u:ℝ)-1))^n at hrati
  have herr := PellAnalytics.quotient_error (c:=c) hbds.2.1 (le_refl c) hH' hrati.1 hrati.2
  have hle : c*H≤F := by
    have hh := (le_div_iff₀ hH').mp hrati.1
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hc : (c:ℝ)=(b:ℝ)^n := by simp only [c,Nat.cast_pow]
  have hlt : F<(c+1)*H := by
    have hh : (F:ℝ)/H < (c:ℝ)+1 := by linarith [herr.2]
    have hh' := (div_lt_iff₀ hH').mp hh
    exact_mod_cast hh'
  let r := F-c*H
  have hr : r<H := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hh : F<c*H+H := by nlinarith only [hlt]
    omega
  have hd : F=c*H+r := by dsimp [r]; omega
  obtain ⟨q,hq,_⟩ := PellSystem.residue_exists hba n
  obtain ⟨q',hq',_⟩ := PellSystem.residue_exists hua n
  have hgrowth := hg u hbds.1
  have hgp := (growth_nat hδ hu4 hgrowth).1
  have hcut := PowerEstimate.cutoff (n:=n) hδ hell hell' h₀ hb
  change Real.log (((2*(b*u))^n:ℕ):ℝ)<_ at hcut
  have hbig : (2*(b*u))^n<g u := by
    have hh := lt_trans hcut hgrowth.1
    have hp : (0:ℝ)<((2*(b*u))^n:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0<(2*(b*u))^n by positivity)
    exact_mod_cast (Real.log_lt_log_iff hp (by exact_mod_cast hgp)).mp hh
  have hFv : F<g u := lt_of_le_of_lt (PellPower.power_bounds hba n).2 hbig
  have hHv : H<g u := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt (PellPower.power_bounds hua n).2
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by nlinarith only [hb] : 2*u≤2*(b*u)) n) hbig
  refine ⟨![u,g u,Pell.xn hba (n+1),F,Pell.xn hua (n+1),H,q,q',r],?_⟩
  change 2≤b ∧ u=input ell u₀ b n (b^n) ∧ g u=g u ∧
    (Pell.xn hba (n+1))^2+F^2=1+(b*u)^2*F^2 ∧
    (Pell.xn hua (n+1))^2+H^2=1+u^2*H^2 ∧
    0<F ∧ F<g u ∧ 0<H ∧ H<g u ∧ F=n+1+(b*u-1)*q ∧ H=n+1+(u-1)*q' ∧ F=(b^n)*H+r ∧ r<H
  exact ⟨hb,rfl,rfl,coords_eq hba _,coords_eq hua _,hF,hFv,hH,hHv,hq,hq',hd,hr⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.reindex
statement: lemma reindex (hf : ScalarSF f) {β : Type} (i : α → β) : ScalarSF (fun z => f (z ∘ i))
proof:
:=
  MapSF.reindex hf i

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.ScalarSF.sub
statement: lemma sub (hf : ScalarSF f) (hg : ScalarSF g) : ScalarSF (fun z => f z-g z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ((proj (Sum.inr ())).add (hg.reindex Sum.inl)).eq
    ((hf.reindex Sum.inl).max (hg.reindex Sum.inl))
  refine SF.congr h ?_
  intro z

  constructor
  · intro hh
    funext j; cases j
    change z (.inr ())=f (z ∘ Sum.inl)-g (z ∘ Sum.inl)
    omega
  · intro hh
    have he := congrFun hh ()
    change z (.inr ())=f (z ∘ Sum.inl)-g (z ∘ Sum.inl) at he
    omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerCompilation.system_sf
statement:
lemma system_sf (g : ℕ → ℕ) (ell u₀ : ℕ)
    (hg : SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => z 1=g (z 0))) :
    SF (fun z : Fin 3⊕Fin 9 → ℕ => PowerSystem.System g ell u₀ (z (.inl 0)) (z (.inl 1)) (z (.inl 2)) (z ∘ Sum.inr))

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerCompilation.power_of_growth
statement:
lemma power_of_growth (g : ℕ → ℕ) (δ : ℝ) (u₀ : ℕ) (hδ : 0<δ) (h₀ : 4≤u₀)
    (hgraph : SF (fun z : Fin 2 → ℕ => z 1=g (z 0)))
    (hg : ∀ u, u₀≤u → δ*(Real.log (u:ℝ))^2<Real.log (g u:ℝ) ∧ Real.log (g u:ℝ)<(u:ℝ)*Real.log (u:ℝ)) :
    SF (fun z : Fin 3 → ℕ => 2≤z 0 ∧ z 2=z 0^z 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ell,hell,hell'⟩ := PowerEstimate.choose_ell hδ
  have h := (system_sf g ell u₀ hgraph).ex (by
    intro z w w' hw hw'
    exact PowerSystem.unique hδ hell h₀ hg hw hw')
  refine h.congr ?_
  intro z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w,hw⟩
    exact PowerSystem.sound hδ hell h₀ hg hw
  · rintro ⟨hb,hc⟩
    obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := PowerSystem.complete hδ hell h₀ hg hell' (n:=z 1) hb
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    change PowerSystem.System g ell u₀ (z 0) (z 1) (z 2) w
    rw [hc]
    exact hw

name: OAI.SingleFold.PowerCompilation.power
statement: theorem power : SF (fun z : Fin 3 → ℕ => 2≤z 0 ∧ z 2=z 0^z 1)
proof:
:= by
