  obtain ⟨g,δ,u₀,hδ,h₀,hgraph,hg⟩ := GrowthCompilation.growth
  exact power_of_growth g δ u₀ hδ h₀ hgraph hg

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.step_bound
statement:
lemma step_bound (P : A) (n : ℕ) :
    dist (sequence h P n) (sequence h P (n+1)) ≤ (C/4)*(1/4:ℝ)^n
proof:
:= by
  have hb := hpara ((2^n) • P) ((2^n) • P)
  rw [sub_self, hzero, add_zero] at hb
  have hd : (2^(n+1)) • P = (2^n) • P + (2^n) • P := by
    rw [pow_succ, mul_comm, mul_nsmul, two_nsmul, nsmul_add]
  rw [Real.dist_eq, sequence, sequence, hd, pow_succ]
  have he : (1/4:ℝ)^n * h ((2^n) • P) -
      ((1/4:ℝ)^n * (1/4)) * h ((2^n) • P + (2^n) • P) =
      -((1/4:ℝ)^n / 4) *
        (h ((2^n) • P + (2^n) • P) - 2*(h ((2^n) • P)+h ((2^n) • P))) := by ring
  rw [he, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  calc
    (1/4:ℝ)^n / 4 * |h ((2^n) • P + (2^n) • P) -
        2*(h ((2^n) • P)+h ((2^n) • P))| ≤ (1/4:ℝ)^n / 4 * C :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.sequence_cauchy
statement: lemma sequence_cauchy (P : A) : CauchySeq (sequence h P)
proof:
:=
  cauchySeq_of_le_geometric (1/4:ℝ) (C/4) (by norm_num) (step_bound h C hzero hpara P)

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.tendsto_sequence
statement: lemma tendsto_sequence (P : A) : Tendsto (sequence h P) atTop (𝓝 (limit h P))
proof:
:=
  (sequence_cauchy h C hzero hpara P).tendsto_limUnder

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.error_bound
statement: lemma error_bound (P : A) : |h P - limit h P| ≤ C/3
proof:
:= by
  have hh := dist_le_of_le_geometric_of_tendsto₀ (1/4:ℝ) (C/4) (by norm_num)
    (step_bound h C hzero hpara P) (tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara P)
  norm_num [sequence, Real.dist_eq] at hh
  linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_zero
statement: lemma limit_zero : limit h (0:A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_nhds_unique (tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara 0)
  convert (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0:ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)) using 1
  ext n
  simp [sequence, hzero]

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_nonneg
statement: lemma limit_nonneg (hnonneg : ∀ P, 0 ≤ h P) (P : A) : 0 ≤ limit h P
proof:
:= by
  exact ge_of_tendsto (tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara P)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun n => mul_nonneg (by positivity) (hnonneg _))

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_parallelogram
statement:
lemma limit_parallelogram (P Q : A) :
    limit h (P+Q)+limit h (P-Q) = 2*(limit h P+limit h Q)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => sequence h (P+Q) n + sequence h (P-Q) n -
    2*(sequence h P n + sequence h Q n)
  have hf : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 (limit h (P+Q)+limit h (P-Q)-
      2*(limit h P+limit h Q))) :=
    ((tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara (P+Q)).add
      (tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara (P-Q))).sub
      (tendsto_const_nhds.mul ((tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara P).add
        (tendsto_sequence h C hzero hpara Q)))
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : |f n| ≤ C*(1/4:ℝ)^n := by
    have hp := hpara ((2^n) • P) ((2^n) • Q)
    have he : f n = (1/4:ℝ)^n * (h ((2^n) • P + (2^n) • Q) +
        h ((2^n) • P - (2^n) • Q) - 2*(h ((2^n) • P)+h ((2^n) • Q))) := by
      dsimp [f, sequence]
      rw [nsmul_add, nsmul_sub]
      ring
    rw [he, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), mul_comm C]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity)
  have hz : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => C*(1/4:ℝ)^n) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/4)
      (by norm_num : (1/4:ℝ) < 1)).const_mul C
  have hf0 : Tendsto f atTop (𝓝 0) := squeeze_zero_norm (fun n => hbound n) hz
  have := tendsto_nhds_unique hf hf0
  linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_nsmul
statement: lemma limit_nsmul (P : A) (n : ℕ) : limit h (n • P) = (n:ℝ)^2 * limit h P
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.twoStepInduction with
  | zero => simp [limit_zero h C hzero hpara]
  | one => simp
  | more n hn hn1 =>
    have hp := limit_parallelogram h C hzero hpara ((n+1) • P) P
    have ha : (n+1) • P + P = (n+2) • P := by simp [add_nsmul]; abel
    have hs : (n+1) • P - P = n • P := by simp [add_nsmul]
    rw [ha, hs, hn, hn1] at hp
    push_cast at hp ⊢
    nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_neg
statement: lemma limit_neg (P : A) : limit h (-P) = limit h P
proof:
:= by
  have hp := limit_parallelogram h C hzero hpara 0 P
  simp only [zero_add, zero_sub, limit_zero h C hzero hpara, zero_add] at hp
  linarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.QuadraticLimit.limit_zsmul
statement: lemma limit_zsmul (P : A) (n : ℤ) : limit h (n • P) = (n:ℝ)^2 * limit h P
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | ofNat n => simpa using limit_nsmul h C hzero hpara P n
  | negSucc n =>
    rw [Int.negSucc_eq, neg_smul, limit_neg h C hzero hpara]
    rw [← Nat.cast_add_one, natCast_zsmul]
    rw [limit_nsmul h C hzero hpara]
    push_cast
    ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.naiveHeight_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma naiveHeight_zero : naiveHeight (0:E.Point) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [naiveHeight, xRep_zero, Height.logHeight_swap, ← Height.logHeight₁_eq_logHeight]
  simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.naiveHeight_nonneg
statement: lemma naiveHeight_nonneg (P : E.Point) : 0 ≤ naiveHeight P
proof: := Height.logHeight_nonneg _

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.naiveHeight_some
statement:
lemma naiveHeight_some {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) :
    naiveHeight (some x y h) = Real.log (max x.num.natAbs x.den : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [naiveHeight, xRep_some, ← Height.logHeight₁_eq_logHeight, Rat.logHeight₁_eq_log_max]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.finite_x_fiber
statement: lemma finite_x_fiber (x : ℚ) : {P : E.Point | P.xRep = ![x,1]}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : {P : E.Point | P.xRep = ![x,1]}.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨P,hP⟩ := hn
    apply (Set.finite_singleton P |>.union (Set.finite_singleton (-P))).subset
    intro Q hQ
    have he := xRep_eq_xRep_iff.mp (hQ.trans hP.symm)
    simpa [or_comm] using he
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn]
    exact Set.finite_empty

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_limit
statement:
lemma canonicalHeight_limit (P : E.Point) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1/2:ℝ) * (1/4:ℝ)^n * naiveHeight ((2^n) • P))
      atTop (𝓝 (canonicalHeight P))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := approximate_parallelogram
  simpa [canonicalHeight, QuadraticLimit.sequence, mul_assoc] using
    (QuadraticLimit.tendsto_sequence naiveHeight C naiveHeight_zero hC P).const_mul (1/2:ℝ)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_nonneg
statement: lemma canonicalHeight_nonneg (P : E.Point) : 0 ≤ canonicalHeight P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := approximate_parallelogram
  exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num)
    (QuadraticLimit.limit_nonneg naiveHeight C naiveHeight_zero hC naiveHeight_nonneg P)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma canonicalHeight_zero : canonicalHeight (0:E.Point) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := approximate_parallelogram
  simp [canonicalHeight, QuadraticLimit.limit_zero naiveHeight C naiveHeight_zero hC]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_zsmul
statement:
lemma canonicalHeight_zsmul (P : E.Point) (n : ℤ) :
    canonicalHeight (n • P) = (n:ℝ)^2 * canonicalHeight P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := approximate_parallelogram
  unfold canonicalHeight
  rw [QuadraticLimit.limit_zsmul naiveHeight C naiveHeight_zero hC]
  ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_nsmul
statement:
lemma canonicalHeight_nsmul (P : E.Point) (n : ℕ) :
    canonicalHeight (n • P) = (n:ℝ)^2 * canonicalHeight P
proof:
:= by
  simpa using canonicalHeight_zsmul P (n:ℤ)

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.uniform_height
statement:
theorem uniform_height : ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ P : E.Point,
    |naiveHeight P - 2*canonicalHeight P| ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := approximate_parallelogram
  refine ⟨|C|/3+1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro P
  have hh := QuadraticLimit.error_bound naiveHeight C naiveHeight_zero hC P
  have he : 2*canonicalHeight P = QuadraticLimit.limit naiveHeight P := by
    unfold canonicalHeight
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact hh.trans (by linarith [le_abs_self C])

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveHeight.canonicalHeight_pos
statement:
theorem canonicalHeight_pos {P : E.Point} (hP : ¬IsOfFinAddOrder P) :
    0 < canonicalHeight P
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hz : canonicalHeight P = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hn) (canonicalHeight_nonneg P)
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hbound⟩ := uniform_height
  have hm (n : ℕ) : naiveHeight (n • P) ≤ c := by
    have hh := hbound (n • P)
    rw [canonicalHeight_nsmul, hz, mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] at hh
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans hh
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => n • P) :=
    (injective_nsmul_iff_not_isOfFinAddOrder).mpr hP
  exact (Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem hi hm) (Northcott.finite_le c)

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.mem_doubleRange
statement: lemma mem_doubleRange (x : A) : x ∈ doubleRange A ↔ ∃ y, (2:ℕ) • y=x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.mem_doubleKernel
statement: lemma mem_doubleKernel (x : A) : x ∈ doubleKernel A ↔ (2:ℕ) • x=0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.index_le_of_cover
statement:
lemma index_le_of_cover (F : Finset A) (hF : ∀ P, ∃ R ∈ F, ∃ Q, P=R+(2:ℕ) • Q) :
    (doubleRange A).index ≤ F.card
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Function.Surjective (fun R : F => (QuotientAddGroup.mk R.val : A ⧸ doubleRange A)) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨P,rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective x
    obtain ⟨R,hR,Q,hQ⟩ := hF P
    refine ⟨⟨R,hR⟩,?_⟩
    apply QuotientAddGroup.eq.mpr
    change -R+P ∈ doubleRange A
    refine ⟨Q,?_⟩
    simp only [nsmulAddMonoidHom_apply]
    rw [hQ]
    abel
  simpa [AddSubgroup.index, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ hs

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.doubleRange_prod
statement:
lemma doubleRange_prod (B : Type v) [AddCommGroup B] :
    doubleRange (A×B)=(doubleRange A).prod (doubleRange B)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨y.1,rfl⟩,⟨y.2,rfl⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨a,ha⟩,⟨b,hb⟩⟩
    exact ⟨(a,b),Prod.ext ha hb⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.doubleRange_pi
statement:
lemma doubleRange_pi (ι : Type v) :
    doubleRange (ι → A)=AddSubgroup.pi Set.univ (fun _ => doubleRange A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    intro i _
    exact ⟨y i,rfl⟩
  · intro h
    have hh : ∀ i, ∃ y, (2:ℕ) • y=x i := fun i => h i (Set.mem_univ i)
    choose y hy using hh
    exact ⟨y,funext hy⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.doubleRange_int
statement: lemma doubleRange_int : doubleRange ℤ = AddSubgroup.zmultiples (2:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Int.range_nsmulAddMonoidHom 2

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.free_index
statement: lemma free_index (n : ℕ) : (doubleRange (Fin n → ℤ)).index = 2^n
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubleRange_pi,AddSubgroup.index_pi]
  simp [doubleRange_int,Int.index_zmultiples]

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.finite_index_eq_kernel
statement: lemma finite_index_eq_kernel [Finite A] : (doubleRange A).index = Nat.card (doubleKernel A)
proof:
:=
  AddSubgroup.index_range

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.doubleRange_map
statement:
lemma doubleRange_map {B : Type v} [AddCommGroup B] (f : A ≃+ B) :
    (doubleRange A).map f.toAddMonoidHom=doubleRange B
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y,⟨z,hz⟩,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨f z,?_⟩
    change (2:ℕ) • f z=f y
    rw [←map_nsmul,f.injective.eq_iff]
    exact hz
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(2:ℕ) • f.symm y,⟨f.symm y,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.doubleRange_index_equiv
statement:
lemma doubleRange_index_equiv {B : Type v} [AddCommGroup B] (f : A ≃+ B) :
    (doubleRange A).index=(doubleRange B).index
proof:
:= by
  rw [←doubleRange_map f]
  exact (AddSubgroup.index_map_equiv _ f).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.index_rank_formula
statement:
lemma index_rank_formula {T : Type w} [AddCommGroup T] [Finite T] (n : ℕ)
    (f : A ≃+ (Fin n → ℤ)×T) :
    (doubleRange A).index = 2^n * Nat.card (doubleKernel A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubleRange_index_equiv f,doubleRange_prod,AddSubgroup.index_prod,free_index,
    finite_index_eq_kernel]
  congr 1
  exact (Nat.card_congr ((doubleKernel_equiv f).trans
    (doubleKernel_free_prod_equiv (Fin n) T))).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.AbstractRank.exists_rank_le_one
statement:
theorem exists_rank_le_one [AddGroup.FG A]
    (hindex : (doubleRange A).index ≤ 8) (hker : 4 ≤ Nat.card (doubleKernel A)) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (T : Type) (_ : AddCommGroup T) (_ : Finite T),
      n ≤ 1 ∧ Nonempty (A ≃+ (Fin n → ℤ) × T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨n,ι,hi,p,hp,e,⟨f⟩⟩ := AddCommGroup.equiv_free_prod_directSum_zmod A
  let T := DirectSum ι (fun i => ZMod (p i ^ e i))
  have hp0 : ∀ i, NeZero (p i ^ e i) := fun i => ⟨pow_ne_zero _ (hp i).ne_zero⟩
  let : Finite T := Finite.of_equiv (∀ i, ZMod (p i ^ e i)) DFinsupp.equivFunOnFintype.symm
  let g : A ≃+ (Fin n → ℤ)×T := f.trans
    ((Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite ℤ ℤ (Fin n)).toAddEquiv.prodCongr (AddEquiv.refl T))
  have heq := index_rank_formula n g
  have hpow : 2^n ≤ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hn : n ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have hh : 2^2 ≤ 2^n := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) (by omega)
    norm_num at hh
    omega
  exact ⟨n,T,inferInstance,inferInstance,hn,⟨g⟩⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.double_torsion
statement:
lemma double_torsion (P : E.Point) (hP : P=0 ∨ P=T0 ∨ P=T5 ∨ P=Tm5) :
    (2:ℕ) • P=0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hP with rfl|rfl|rfl|rfl
  · simp
  all_goals
    rw [two_smul]
    simp only [T0,T5,Tm5]
    apply add_self_of_Y_eq
    norm_num [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY]

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.four_le_doubleKernel
statement: lemma four_le_doubleKernel : 4 ≤ Nat.card (AbstractRank.doubleKernel E.Point)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 4 → AbstractRank.doubleKernel E.Point := fun i =>
    ⟨![0,T0,T5,Tm5] i,by
      apply double_torsion
      fin_cases i <;> simp⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i j h
    have hh := congrArg (fun x : AbstractRank.doubleKernel E.Point => x.val) h
    change ![0,T0,T5,Tm5] i = ![0,T0,T5,Tm5] j at hh
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp_all [T0,T5,Tm5]
    all_goals norm_num at hh
  simpa using Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hf

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.rank_at_most_one
statement:
theorem rank_at_most_one :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (T : Type) (_ : AddCommGroup T) (_ : Finite T),
      n ≤ 1 ∧ Nonempty (E.Point ≃+ (Fin n → ℤ) × T)
proof:
:= by
  apply AbstractRank.exists_rank_le_one
  · exact (AbstractRank.index_le_of_cover E.Point representatives representatives_cover).trans
      representatives_card
  · exact four_le_doubleKernel

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.equation
statement: lemma equation {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) : y^2=x^3-25*x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff,sub_eq_add_neg] using h.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.val_add_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply padicValRat.add_eq_min _ hx hy hval
  intro h
  apply hval
  have he : x = -y := by linarith
  simp [he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.val_25
statement: lemma val_25 : padicValRat 2 25=0
proof:
:= by
  change padicValRat 2 (25:ℕ)=0
  rw [padicValRat.of_nat,padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd (by decide)]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.val_4
statement: lemma val_4 : padicValRat 2 4=2
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (4:ℚ)=2^2 by norm_num,padicValRat.pow]
  have hh : padicValRat 2 2=1 := padicValRat.self (by norm_num : 1 < (2:ℕ))
  simp [hh]

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.val_sq_add
statement:
lemma val_sq_add {x : ℚ} (hx : padicValRat 2 x < 0) :
    padicValRat 2 (x^2+25)=2*padicValRat 2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hxn : x ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hx
  have hh := val_add_eq (p:=2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hxn) (by norm_num : (25:ℚ) ≠ 0)
    (by rw [padicValRat.pow,val_25]; norm_num; omega)
  rw [padicValRat.pow,val_25,min_eq_left] at hh
  · simpa using hh
  · norm_num; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.val_sq_sub
statement:
lemma val_sq_sub {x : ℚ} (hx : padicValRat 2 x < 0) :
    padicValRat 2 (x^2-25)=2*padicValRat 2 x
proof:
:= by
  have hxn : x ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hx
  have hh := val_add_eq (p:=2) (pow_ne_zero 2 hxn) (by norm_num : (-25:ℚ) ≠ 0)
    (by rw [padicValRat.pow,padicValRat.neg,val_25]; norm_num; omega)
  rw [padicValRat.pow,padicValRat.neg,val_25,min_eq_left] at hh
  · simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hh
  · norm_num; omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.duplication
statement:
lemma duplication {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h' : E.Nonsingular ((x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2)) (E.addY x x y (E.slope x x y y)),
      (2:ℕ) • some x y h = some ((x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2)) (E.addY x x y (E.slope x x y y)) h'
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y ≠ E.negY x y := by simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY] using (show y ≠ -y by intro hh; apply hy; linarith)
  have hs : E.slope x x y y = (3*x^2-25)/(2*y) := by
    rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy']
    simp
    congr 1 <;> ring
  have hx' : E.addX x x (E.slope x x y y) = (x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2) := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX,hs]
    dsimp
    field_simp
    have he := equation h
    linear_combination -32*x*he
  rw [two_smul,add_self_of_Y_ne hy']
  have he := E.nonsingular_add h h (by simpa using hy')
  rw [hx'] at he
  exact ⟨he,by simp only [hx']⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.double_val
statement:
lemma double_val {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) (hx : padicValRat 2 x < 0) :
    ∃ (x' y' : ℚ) (h' : E.Nonsingular x' y'),
      (2:ℕ) • some x y h = some x' y' h' ∧
      padicValRat 2 x'=padicValRat 2 x-2
proof:
:= by
  have hxn : x ≠ 0 := by intro he; simp [he] at hx
  have hs := val_sq_sub hx
  have hsn : x^2-25 ≠ 0 := by intro he; rw [he,padicValRat.zero] at hs; omega
  have he : y^2=x*(x^2-25) := by nlinarith only [equation h]
  have hyn : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro he'
    apply mul_ne_zero hxn hsn
    rw [←he,he']
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨h',hh⟩ := duplication h hyn
  refine ⟨_,_,h',hh,?_⟩
  have hp : x^2+25 ≠ 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]
  rw [padicValRat.div (pow_ne_zero 2 hp) (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hyn)),
    padicValRat.pow,padicValRat.mul (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 2 hyn),val_4,
    he,padicValRat.mul hxn hsn,val_sq_add hx,hs]
  ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.vx_double
statement: lemma vx_double (P : E.Point) (h : vx P < 0) : vx ((2:ℕ) • P)=vx P-2
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => simp [vx] at h
  | some x y hp =>
    obtain ⟨x',y',h',hh,hv⟩ := double_val hp h
    rw [hh]
    exact hv

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.vx_G
statement: lemma vx_G : vx G = -2
proof:
:= by
  change padicValRat 2 (25/4)= -2
  rw [padicValRat.div (by norm_num) (by norm_num),val_25,val_4]
  norm_num

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.vx_dyadic
statement: lemma vx_dyadic (n : ℕ) : vx ((2^n:ℕ) • G)= -2-2*(n:ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using vx_G
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [pow_succ',mul_smul,vx_double _ (by rw [hn]; omega),hn]
    push_cast
    ring

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.dyadic_injective
statement: lemma dyadic_injective : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => (2^n:ℕ) • G)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m h
  have hh := congrArg vx h
  rw [vx_dyadic,vx_dyadic] at hh
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.ValuationRank.G_nontorsion
statement: lemma G_nontorsion : ¬IsOfFinAddOrder G
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hf : (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => (2^n:ℕ) • G)).Finite :=
    h.finite_multiples.subset (by rintro _ ⟨n,rfl⟩; exact ⟨2^n,rfl⟩)
  exact (Set.infinite_range_of_injective dyadic_injective) hf

name: OAI.SingleFold.CurveRank.rank_one
statement:
theorem rank_one : ∃ (T : Type) (_ : AddCommGroup T) (_ : Finite T),
    Nonempty (E.Point ≃+ (Fin 1 → ℤ) × T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n,T,hT,hfin,hn,⟨f⟩⟩ := rank_at_most_one
  rcases (show n=0 ∨ n=1 by omega) with rfl|rfl
  · let : Finite E.Point := Finite.of_equiv ((Fin 0 → ℤ)×T) f.symm.toEquiv
    exact False.elim (ValuationRank.G_nontorsion (isOfFinAddOrder_of_finite _))
  · exact ⟨T,hT,hfin,⟨f⟩⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.den_pos
statement: lemma den_pos {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) : 0 < z.d
proof:
:= by
  have := h.2.1
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.inverse_lt
statement: lemma inverse_lt {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) : z.t < z.d
proof:
:= by
  have := h.2.1
  omega

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.inverse_mod
statement:
lemma inverse_mod {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) :
    (z.p + z.n) * z.t ≡ 1 [MOD z.d]
proof:
:= by
  change ((z.p + z.n) * z.t) % z.d = 1 % z.d
  have hm := congrArg (fun a : ℕ => a % z.d) h.2.2
  simpa [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mul_mod] using hm

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.reduced
statement: lemma reduced {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) : (z.p + z.n).Coprime z.d
proof:
:=
  Nat.coprime_of_mul_modEq_one z.t (inverse_mod h)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.abs_num
statement:
lemma abs_num {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) :
    ((z.p : ℤ) - z.n).natAbs = z.p + z.n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h.1 with hp | hn
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [hn]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.canonical
statement:
lemma canonical {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) :
    z.value.num = (z.p : ℤ) - z.n ∧ z.value.den = z.d
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ((z.p : ℤ) - z.n).natAbs.Coprime z.d := by
    rw [abs_num h]
    exact reduced h
  let r := Rat.mk' ((z.p : ℤ) - z.n) z.d (den_pos h).ne' hr
  have hv : z.value = r := by
    simpa only [r, Rat.mk', value, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast] using Rat.num_div_den r
  rw [hv]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.positive_num
statement: lemma positive_num {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) : z.value.num.toNat = z.p
proof:
:= by
  rw [(canonical h).1]
  rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h.1 with hp | hn
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [hn]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.negative_num
statement: lemma negative_num {z : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) : (-z.value.num).toNat = z.n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(canonical h).1]
  rcases Nat.mul_eq_zero.mp h.1 with hp | hn
  · simp [hp]
  · simp [hn]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.unique
statement:
theorem unique {z z' : RationalCode} (h : z.Valid) (h' : z'.Valid)
    (heq : z.value = z'.value) : z = z'
proof:
:= by
  have hp : z.p = z'.p := by rw [← positive_num h, ← positive_num h', heq]
  have hn : z.n = z'.n := by rw [← negative_num h, ← negative_num h', heq]
  have hd : z.d = z'.d := by rw [← (canonical h).2, ← (canonical h').2, heq]
  have hm : (z.p + z.n) * z.t ≡ (z.p + z.n) * z'.t [MOD z.d] := by
    have hi' := inverse_mod h'
    rw [← hp, ← hn, ← hd] at hi'
    exact (inverse_mod h).trans hi'.symm
  have ht : z.t = z'.t := by
    apply (hm.cancel_left_of_coprime (reduced h).symm).eq_of_lt_of_lt (inverse_lt h)
    rw [hd]
    exact inverse_lt h'
  have hs : z.s = z'.s := by
    have hd₁ := h.2.1
    have hd₂ := h'.2.1
    omega
  have hq : z.q = z'.q := by
    have he₁ := h.2.2
    have he₂ := h'.2.2
    rw [← hp, ← hn, ← hd, ← ht] at he₂
    have hx : z.q * z.d = z'.q * z.d := by omega
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_right (den_pos h) hx
  exact RationalCode.ext hp hn hd ht hs hq

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.inverse_exists
statement:
lemma inverse_exists {a d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hcop : a.Coprime d) :
    ∃ t s q : ℕ, d = 1 + t + s ∧ a * t + d = 1 + q * d
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd1 : d = 1
  · subst d
    exact ⟨0, 0, 0, by omega, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hinv⟩ := Nat.exists_mul_mod_eq_one_of_coprime hcop (by omega)
    refine ⟨t, d - 1 - t, (a * t) / d + 1, by omega, ?_⟩
    have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div (a * t) d
    rw [hinv] at hdiv
    nlinarith

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.existsUnique
statement: theorem existsUnique (r : ℚ) : ∃! z : RationalCode, z.Valid ∧ z.value = r
proof:
:= by
  let p := r.num.toNat
  let n := (-r.num).toNat
  have hpn : p * n = 0 := by
    rcases le_total 0 r.num with hn | hn
    · have : n = 0 := Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr hn)
      simp [this]
    · have : p = 0 := Int.toNat_eq_zero.mpr hn
      simp [this]
  have habs : p + n = r.num.natAbs := Int.toNat_add_toNat_neg_eq_natAbs _
  obtain ⟨t, s, q, hd, hi⟩ := inverse_exists r.den_pos (habs ▸ r.reduced)
  let z : RationalCode := ⟨p, n, r.den, t, s, q⟩
  have hz : z.Valid := ⟨hpn, hd, hi⟩
  have hv : z.value = r := by
    have hn := Int.toNat_sub_toNat_neg r.num
    have hn' : (p : ℚ) - n = (r.num : ℚ) := by exact_mod_cast hn
    dsimp [value, z]
    rw [hn']
    exact r.num_div_den
  refine ⟨z, ⟨hz, hv⟩, ?_⟩
  intro z' hz'
  exact unique hz'.1 hz (hz'.2.trans hv.symm)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.congr
statement: theorem congr (h : SF R) (he : ∀ x, R x ↔ S x) : SF S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := h
  exact ⟨r.congr he⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.and
statement: theorem and (hR : SF R) (hS : SF S) : SF (fun x => R x ∧ S x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hR; obtain ⟨s⟩ := hS
  exact ⟨r.and s⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.or
statement: theorem or (hR : SF R) (hS : SF S) (hd : ∀ x, ¬(R x ∧ S x)) : SF (fun x => R x ∨ S x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hR; obtain ⟨s⟩ := hS
  exact ⟨r.or s hd⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.reindex
statement: theorem reindex (hR : SF R) (f : α → β) : SF (fun x => R (x ∘ f))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hR; exact ⟨r.reindex f⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.all
statement: theorem all [Finite β] {R : β → (α → ℕ) → Prop} (hr : ∀ i, SF (R i)) : SF (fun x => ∀ i, R i x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Representation.all R (fun i => Classical.choice (hr i))⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.eq
statement: theorem eq (p q : Poly α) : SF (fun x => p x=q x)
proof: := ⟨Representation.eq p q⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.le
statement: theorem le (p q : Poly α) : SF (fun x => p x≤q x)
proof: := ⟨Representation.le p q⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.lt
statement: theorem lt (p q : Poly α) : SF (fun x => p x<q x)
proof: := ⟨Representation.lt p q⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.SF.ex
statement:
theorem ex {R : (α ⊕ β → ℕ) → Prop} [Finite β] (hr : SF R)
    (hu : ∀ x y y', R (Sum.elim x y) → R (Sum.elim x y') → y=y') :
    SF (fun x => ∃ y, R (Sum.elim x y))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r⟩ := hr; exact ⟨r.ex hu⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.const_value
statement: lemma const_value (r : ℚ) (z : α → ℕ) : (const r).value z=r
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [value,const,Poly.const_apply,Int.cast_natCast] using r.num_div_den

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.add_value
statement:
lemma add_value (p q : FractionPoly α) (z : α → ℕ) (hp : 0<p.den z) (hq : 0<q.den z) :
    (p.add q).value z=p.value z+q.value z
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : (p.den z:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  have hq' : (q.den z:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  simp only [value,add,Poly.add_apply,Poly.mul_apply,Int.cast_add,Int.cast_mul]
  simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_add_div (p.num z : ℚ) (q.num z : ℚ) hp' hq').symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.mul_value
statement:
lemma mul_value (p q : FractionPoly α) (z : α → ℕ) :
    (p.mul q).value z=p.value z*q.value z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [value,mul,Poly.mul_apply,Int.cast_mul,div_mul_div_comm]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.neg_value
statement: lemma neg_value (p : FractionPoly α) (z : α → ℕ) : (p.neg).value z= -p.value z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [value,neg,Poly.neg_apply,Int.cast_neg,neg_div]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.eq_iff
statement:
lemma eq_iff (p q : FractionPoly α) (z : α → ℕ) (hp : 0<p.den z) (hq : 0<q.den z) :
    p.value z=q.value z ↔ (p.num*q.den) z=(q.num*p.den) z
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : (p.den z:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hp.ne'
  have hq' : (q.den z:ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq.ne'
  rw [value,value,div_eq_div_iff hp' hq']
  simp only [Poly.mul_apply]
  exact_mod_cast (Iff.rfl : (p.num z:ℚ)*q.den z=q.num z*p.den z ↔ (p.num z:ℚ)*q.den z=q.num z*p.den z)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.le_iff
statement:
lemma le_iff (p q : FractionPoly α) (z : α → ℕ) (hp : 0<p.den z) (hq : 0<q.den z) :
    p.value z≤q.value z ↔ (p.num*q.den) z≤(q.num*p.den) z
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : (0:ℚ)<p.den z := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hq' : (0:ℚ)<q.den z := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [value,value,div_le_div_iff₀ hp' hq']
  simp only [Poly.mul_apply]
  exact_mod_cast (Iff.rfl : (p.num z:ℚ)*q.den z≤q.num z*p.den z ↔ (p.num z:ℚ)*q.den z≤q.num z*p.den z)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.guarded_eq
statement:
lemma guarded_eq {D : (α → ℕ) → Prop} (hD : SF D) (p q : FractionPoly α)
    (hp : ∀ z, D z → 0<p.den z) (hq : ∀ z, D z → 0<q.den z) :
    SF (fun z => D z ∧ p.value z=q.value z)
proof:
:=
  (hD.and (SF.eq (p.num*q.den) (q.num*p.den))).congr (fun z => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hd,he⟩; exact ⟨hd,(p.eq_iff q z (hp z hd) (hq z hd)).mpr he⟩
    · rintro ⟨hd,he⟩; exact ⟨hd,(p.eq_iff q z (hp z hd) (hq z hd)).mp he⟩)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.FractionPoly.guarded_le
statement:
lemma guarded_le {D : (α → ℕ) → Prop} (hD : SF D) (p q : FractionPoly α)
    (hp : ∀ z, D z → 0<p.den z) (hq : ∀ z, D z → 0<q.den z) :
    SF (fun z => D z ∧ p.value z≤q.value z)
proof:
:=
  (hD.and (SF.le (p.num*q.den) (q.num*p.den))).congr (fun z => by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hd,he⟩; exact ⟨hd,(p.le_iff q z (hp z hd) (hq z hd)).mpr he⟩
    · rintro ⟨hd,he⟩; exact ⟨hd,(p.le_iff q z (hp z hd) (hq z hd)).mp he⟩)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.code_tuple
statement: @[simp] lemma code_tuple (z : RationalCode) : code (tuple z)=z
proof: := by cases z; rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.tuple_code
statement: @[simp] lemma tuple_code (z : Fin 6 → ℕ) : tuple (code z)=z

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.input_value
statement: lemma input_value {α : Type} (i : α) (z : α × Fin 6 → ℕ) : (input i).value z=value z i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FractionPoly.value,input,Poly.sub_apply,Poly.proj_apply,Int.cast_sub,
    Int.cast_natCast,value,RationalCode.value,code]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.input_pos
statement: lemma input_pos {α : Type} (i : α) (z : α × Fin 6 → ℕ) (hz : Valid z) : 0<(input i).den z
proof:
:= by
  change (0:ℤ) < (z (i,2):ℤ)
  have h := RationalCode.den_pos (hz i)
  change 0 < z (i,2) at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.valid_single_fold
statement: lemma valid_single_fold {α : Type} [Finite α] : SF (@Valid α)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.compile_spec
statement:
lemma compile_spec (p : Expr α) (z : α × Fin 6 → ℕ) (hz : Valid z) :
    0<p.compile.den z ∧ p.compile.value z=p.eval (value z)
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | var i => exact ⟨input_pos i z hz,input_value i z⟩
  | const q => exact ⟨by change (0:ℤ)<(q.den:ℤ); exact_mod_cast q.den_pos,FractionPoly.const_value q z⟩
  | add p q hp hq =>
    exact ⟨mul_pos hp.1 hq.1,by simpa only [compile,eval,hp.2,hq.2] using FractionPoly.add_value p.compile q.compile z hp.1 hq.1⟩
  | mul p q hp hq =>
    exact ⟨mul_pos hp.1 hq.1,by simpa only [compile,eval,hp.2,hq.2] using FractionPoly.mul_value p.compile q.compile z⟩
  | neg p hp => exact ⟨hp.1,by simpa only [compile,eval,hp.2] using FractionPoly.neg_value p.compile z⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eq_single_fold
statement:
lemma eq_single_fold [Finite α] (p q : Expr α) :
    SF (fun z => Valid z ∧ p.eval (value z)=q.eval (value z))
proof:
:= by
  have hp (z) (hz : Valid z) := (p.compile_spec z hz).1
  have hq (z) (hz : Valid z) := (q.compile_spec z hz).1
  refine (FractionPoly.guarded_eq valid_single_fold p.compile q.compile hp hq).congr ?_
  intro z
  exact and_congr_right (fun hz => by rw [(p.compile_spec z hz).2,(q.compile_spec z hz).2])

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.le_single_fold
statement:
lemma le_single_fold [Finite α] (p q : Expr α) :
    SF (fun z => Valid z ∧ p.eval (value z)≤q.eval (value z))
proof:
:= by
  have hp (z) (hz : Valid z) := (p.compile_spec z hz).1
  have hq (z) (hz : Valid z) := (q.compile_spec z hz).1
  refine (FractionPoly.guarded_le valid_single_fold p.compile q.compile hp hq).congr ?_
  intro z
  exact and_congr_right (fun hz => by rw [(p.compile_spec z hz).2,(q.compile_spec z hz).2])

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.congr
statement: theorem congr (h : Semi R) (he : ∀ x, R x ↔ S x) : Semi S
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.1.congr he,h.2.congr (fun x => not_congr (he x))⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.not
statement: theorem not (h : Semi R) : Semi (fun x => ¬R x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.2,h.1.congr (fun _ => (not_not).symm)⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.and
statement: theorem and (hR : Semi R) (hS : Semi S) : Semi (fun x => R x ∧ S x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hR.1.and hS.1,?_⟩
  refine (hR.2.or (hR.1.and hS.2) (by intro x h; exact h.1 h.2.1)).congr ?_
  intro x; tauto

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.or
statement: theorem or (hR : Semi R) (hS : Semi S) : Semi (fun x => R x ∨ S x)
proof:
:=
  ((hR.not.and hS.not).not).congr (by intro x; tauto)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.reindex
statement: theorem reindex (hR : Semi R) (f : α → β) : Semi (fun x => R (x ∘ f))
proof:
:=
  ⟨hR.1.reindex f,hR.2.reindex f⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.eq
statement: theorem eq (p q : Poly α) : Semi (fun x => p x=q x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SF.eq p q,((SF.lt p q).or (SF.lt q p) (by intro x h; exact lt_asymm h.1 h.2)).congr ?_⟩
  intro x; constructor
  · intro h; rcases h with h|h; exact h.ne; exact h.ne'
  · exact lt_or_gt_of_ne

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.le
statement: theorem le (p q : Poly α) : Semi (fun x => p x≤q x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨SF.le p q,(SF.lt q p).congr (fun _ => not_le.symm)⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.lt
statement: theorem lt (p q : Poly α) : Semi (fun x => p x<q x)
proof:
:=
  ⟨SF.lt p q,(SF.le q p).congr (fun _ => not_lt.symm)⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Compiler.Semi.all
statement:
theorem all [Finite β] {P : β → (α → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : ∀ i, Semi (P i)) :
    Semi (fun x => ∀ i, P i x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := Fintype.ofFinite β
  suffices ∀ s : Finset β, Semi (fun x => ∀ i∈s, P i x) by
    exact (this Finset.univ).congr (by simp)
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact (Semi.eq (0:Poly α) 0).congr (by simp)
  | @insert i s hi hs => exact ((hp i).and hs).congr (by simp)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.valid_semi
statement: lemma valid_semi {α : Type} [Finite α] : Semi (@Valid α)

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_add
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_add (p q : Expr α) (x) : (p+q).eval x=p.eval x+q.eval x

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_mul
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_mul (p q : Expr α) (x) : (p*q).eval x=p.eval x*q.eval x

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_neg

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_sub

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_nat

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_ofNat
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_ofNat (n : ℕ) [n.AtLeastTwo] (x : α → ℚ) : (OfNat.ofNat n : Expr α).eval x=n

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_zero (x : α → ℚ) : (0:Expr α).eval x=0

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_one
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_one (x : α → ℚ) : (1:Expr α).eval x=1

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eval_pow
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_pow (p : Expr α) (n : ℕ) (x) : (p^n).eval x=(p.eval x)^n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => change (1:ℚ)=_; simp
  | succ n ih => change (p*(p^n)).eval x=_; rw [eval_mul,ih,pow_succ']

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.eq_under
statement:
lemma eq_under {G : (β → ℕ) → Prop} (hG : Semi G) (f : α×Fin 6 → β)
    (hv : ∀ z, G z → Valid (z ∘ f)) (p q : Expr α) :
    Semi (fun z => G z ∧ p.eval (value (z ∘ f))=q.eval (value (z ∘ f)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (hG.and (Semi.eq ((p.compile.num*q.compile.den).map f) ((q.compile.num*p.compile.den).map f))).congr ?_
  intro z
  apply and_congr_right
  intro hz
  have hp := p.compile_spec (z ∘ f) (hv z hz)
  have hq := q.compile_spec (z ∘ f) (hv z hz)
  change (p.compile.num*q.compile.den) (z ∘ f)=(q.compile.num*p.compile.den) (z ∘ f) ↔ _
  rw [←FractionPoly.eq_iff _ _ _ hp.1 hq.1,hp.2,hq.2]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCompiler.Expr.le_under
statement:
lemma le_under {G : (β → ℕ) → Prop} (hG : Semi G) (f : α×Fin 6 → β)
    (hv : ∀ z, G z → Valid (z ∘ f)) (p q : Expr α) :
    Semi (fun z => G z ∧ p.eval (value (z ∘ f))≤q.eval (value (z ∘ f)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (hG.and (Semi.le ((p.compile.num*q.compile.den).map f) ((q.compile.num*p.compile.den).map f))).congr ?_
  intro z
  apply and_congr_right
  intro hz
  have hp := p.compile_spec (z ∘ f) (hv z hz)
  have hq := q.compile_spec (z ∘ f) (hv z hz)
  change (p.compile.num*q.compile.den) (z ∘ f)≤(q.compile.num*p.compile.den) (z ∘ f) ↔ _
  rw [←FractionPoly.le_iff _ _ _ hp.1 hq.1,hp.2,hq.2]

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.encode_valid

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.encode_value

name: OAI.SingleFold.RationalCode.eq_encode
statement: lemma eq_encode {z : RationalCode} (hz : z.Valid) : z=encode z.value
proof:
:=
  unique hz (encode_valid _) (encode_value _).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.forget_good
statement: lemma forget_good (A : Finset (Stmt Λ)) (q : BLabel n {q // q∈A}) : Good A (forget A q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q <;> simp only [forget,Good]
  all_goals exact Subtype.property _

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.forget_surj
statement:
lemma forget_surj (A : Finset (Stmt Λ)) (q : {q : Label n Λ // Good A q}) :
    ∃ b : BLabel n {q // q∈A}, forget A b=q.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨q,hq⟩
  cases q with
  | code q v => exact ⟨.code ⟨q,hq⟩ v,rfl⟩
  | restore k d q v => exact ⟨.restore k d ⟨q,hq⟩ v,rfl⟩
  | start i => exact ⟨.start i,rfl⟩
  | divide i => exact ⟨.divide i,rfl⟩
  | bit i => exact ⟨.bit i,rfl⟩
  | pushBit i d => exact ⟨.pushBit i d,rfl⟩
  | reverse i => exact ⟨.reverse i,rfl⟩
  | pushRev i d => exact ⟨.pushRev i d,rfl⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.program_within
statement:
lemma program_within (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (initial : Λ) (A : Finset (Stmt Λ))
    (hinit : M initial∈A) (hsub : ∀ q∈A,TM2.stmts₁ q⊆A)
    (hgoto : ∀ f, (TM2.Stmt.goto f : Stmt Λ)∈A → ∀ v,M (f v)∈A) :
    ∀ q : Label n Λ,Good A q → (program M initial q).Within (Good A)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  cases q with
  | code q v =>
    change q∈A at hq
    have hs := hsub q hq
    cases q with
    | push k f q => exact hs (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self])
    | peek k f q => intro d; exact hs (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self])
    | pop k f q => intro d; exact hs (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self])
    | load f q => exact hs (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self])
    | branch f q r =>
      change (if f v then q else r)∈A
      split <;> exact hs (by simp [TM2.stmts₁,TM2.stmts₁_self])
    | goto f => exact hgoto f hq v
    | halt => trivial
  | restore k d q v => dsimp only [program]; split <;> exact hq
  | start i => simp only [program]; split <;> simp_all [Macro.Instr.Within,Good]
  | divide i => exact ⟨trivial,trivial⟩
  | bit i => intro d; trivial
  | pushBit i d => trivial
  | reverse i => intro d; change Good A (if d.val=0 then _ else _); split <;> trivial
  | pushRev i d => trivial

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.statements_self
statement: lemma statements_self (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (S : Finset Λ) {l : Λ} (hl : l∈S) : M l∈statements M S
proof:
:=
  Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨l,hl,TM2.stmts₁_self⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.statements_sub
statement:
lemma statements_sub (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (S : Finset Λ) (q : Stmt Λ) (hq : q∈statements M S) :
    TM2.stmts₁ q⊆statements M S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hq⟩:=Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hq
  intro r hr
  exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨l,hl,TM2.stmts₁_trans hq hr⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.statements_goto
statement:
lemma statements_goto (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (S : Finset Λ) (hS : ∀ l∈S,TM2.SupportsStmt S (M l))
    (f : Store → Λ) (hf : (TM2.Stmt.goto f : Stmt Λ)∈statements M S) (v : Store) :
    M (f v)∈statements M S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l,hl,hf⟩:=Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hf
  exact statements_self M S (TM2.stmts₁_supportsStmt_mono hf (hS l hl) v)

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.counterInput_eq
statement: lemma counterInput_eq (a : Fin n → ℕ) : counterInput a=Sum.elim (initValues [] [] a) (fun b=>if b then 0 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases j with (k|i)|b
  · cases k <;> rfl
  · rfl
  · cases b <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.counter_halts
statement:
lemma counter_halts (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (initial : Λ) (S : Finset Λ)
    (hini : initial∈S) (hS : ∀ l∈S,TM2.SupportsStmt S (M l)) (a : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Counter.Halts (counterProgram M initial S) (counterInput a) ↔
      (eval (TM2.step M) ⟨some initial,none,K'.elim (trList (List.ofFn a)) [] [] []⟩).Dom
proof:
:= by
  let c : Macro.Cfg (FiniteState n M S) (Reg n) := ⟨some (finStart M S),initValues [] [] a⟩
  have hstep := program_within M initial (statements M S) (statements_self M S hini)
    (statements_sub M S) (statements_goto M S hS) (n:=n)
  have henc : Macro.encode c=⟨(counterProgram M initial S).start,counterInput a⟩ := by
    rw [counterInput_eq]
    rfl
  have hfin := Macro.restrict_eval_dom (program M initial) (Good (statements M S)) (finStart M S) hstep c
  have htrace := reaches_eval (initialize_reaches M initial a).to_reflTransGen
  have hsim := eval_dom M initial ⟨some initial,none,K'.elim (trList (List.ofFn a)) [] [] []⟩ (fun _ : Fin n=>0)
  calc
    Counter.Halts (counterProgram M initial S) (counterInput a) ↔
        (eval (Counter.step (counterProgram M initial S)) (Macro.encode c)).Dom := by
          rw [henc]; exact (Counter.eval_dom_iff_halts _ _).symm
    _ ↔ (eval (Macro.step (finProgram M initial S)) c).Dom := Macro.eval_dom _ _ c
    _ ↔ (eval (Macro.step (program M initial)) (initCfg (.start (Fin.last n)) [] [] a)).Dom := hfin
    _ ↔ (eval (Macro.step (program M initial))
      (codeCfg (M initial) none (K'.elim (trList (List.ofFn a)) [] [] []) (fun _=>0))).Dom := by rw [htrace]
    _ ↔ _ := hsim

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.exists_code
statement:
lemma exists_code {p : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : REPred p) :
    ∃ c : ToPartrec.Code,∀a,(ToPartrec.Code.eval c (List.ofFn a)).Dom ↔ p a
proof:
:= by
  let f (v : List.Vector ℕ n) : Part ℕ :=
    (Part.assert (p v.get) (fun _=>Part.some ())).map (fun _=>0)
  have hf : Partrec f := (hp.comp Primrec.vector_get'.to_comp).map (Computable.const 0).to₂
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩:=ToPartrec.Code.exists_code (Nat.Partrec'.of_part hf)
  refine ⟨c,fun a=>?_⟩
  rw [←List.Vector.toList_ofFn a]
  change (ToPartrec.Code.eval c (List.Vector.ofFn a).val).Dom ↔p a
  rw [hc]
  have hg : (List.Vector.ofFn a).get=a := funext (List.Vector.get_ofFn a)
  change (∃ _ : p (List.Vector.ofFn a).get, True) ↔p a
  rw [hg]
  simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.exists_counter
statement:
theorem exists_counter {p : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop} (hp : REPred p) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (M : Counter.Machine Q (Macro.Reg (Reg n))),
      ∀a, p a ↔ Counter.Halts M (counterInput a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩:=exists_code hp
  let initial := trNormal c Cont'.halt
  let S := codeSupp c Cont'.halt
  have hS := tr_supports c Cont'.halt
  refine ⟨Macro.State (FiniteState n tr S),inferInstance,inferInstance,counterProgram tr initial S,fun a=>?_⟩
  rw [counter_halts tr initial S hS.1 hS.2]
  change p a ↔ (eval (TM2.step tr) (init c (List.ofFn a))).Dom
  rw [PartrecToTM2.tr_eval]
  exact (hc a).symm

name: OAI.SingleFold.SquareSupport.squarefree_decomposition
statement:
lemma squarefree_decomposition {x : ℚ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (r : ℚ), 0 < d ∧ r ≠ 0 ∧ Squarefree d ∧ |x| = d*r^2
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < x.num.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (Rat.num_ne_zero.mpr hx)
  obtain ⟨d,k,hd,hk,he,hf⟩ := Nat.sq_mul_squarefree_of_pos (Nat.mul_pos hn x.den_pos)
  refine ⟨d,(k:ℚ)/x.den,hd,div_ne_zero (by exact_mod_cast hk.ne') (by exact_mod_cast x.den_ne_zero),hf,?_⟩
  have he' : (k:ℚ)^2*d=x.num.natAbs*x.den := by exact_mod_cast he
  rw [Rat.abs_def, Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  have habs : |(x.num:ℚ)| = (x.num.natAbs:ℚ) := by simp
  rw [habs]
  nlinarith only [he']

name: OAI.SingleFold.SquareSupport.val_add_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply padicValRat.add_eq_min _ hx hy hval
  intro h
  apply hval
  have he : x = -y := by linarith
  simp [he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.SquareSupport.even_val_triple
statement:
lemma even_val_triple {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {x y a b : ℚ}
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxa : x+a ≠ 0) (hxb : x+b ≠ 0)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (hva : padicValRat p a = 0) (hvb : padicValRat p b = 0)
    (he : y^2=x*(x+a)*(x+b)) : Even (padicValRat p x)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := congrArg (padicValRat p) he
  rw [padicValRat.pow, padicValRat.mul (mul_ne_zero hx hxa) hxb,
    padicValRat.mul hx hxa] at hv
  by_cases hz : padicValRat p x=0
  · simp [hz]
  have h₁ := val_add_eq (p := p) hx ha (by simpa [hva] using hz)
  have h₂ := val_add_eq (p := p) hx hb (by simpa [hvb] using hz)
  rw [hva] at h₁
  rw [hvb] at h₂
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hl | hl
  · rw [min_eq_left hl.le] at h₁ h₂
    rw [h₁,h₂] at hv
    refine ⟨padicValRat p y - padicValRat p x, ?_⟩
    omega
  · rw [min_eq_right hl.le] at h₁ h₂
    rw [h₁,h₂] at hv
    exact ⟨padicValRat p y, by omega⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.SquareSupport.squarefree_support
statement:
lemma squarefree_support {x r : ℚ} {d D : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hf : Squarefree d) (he : |x| = d*r^2) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬p ∣ D → Even (padicValRat p x)) : d ∣ D
proof:
:= by
  apply (Nat.factorization_le_iff_dvd hd.ne' hD).mp
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.Prime
  · by_cases hpd : p ∣ d
    · have hdd := Nat.factorization_eq_one_of_squarefree hf hp hpd
      have hpd' : p ∣ D := by
        by_contra hpD
        have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
        have hxval := congrArg (padicValRat p) he
        have habs : padicValRat p |x| = padicValRat p x := by
          rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hs | hs
          · rw [abs_of_nonneg hs]
          · rw [abs_of_neg hs, padicValRat.neg]
        rw [habs, padicValRat.mul (by exact_mod_cast hd.ne') (pow_ne_zero _ hr),
          padicValRat.of_nat, padicValRat.pow, ← Nat.factorization_def d hp, hdd] at hxval
        obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := hv p hp hpD
        omega
      rw [hdd]
      exact (hp.dvd_iff_one_le_factorization hD).mp hpd'
    · simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hpd]
  · simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_prime d hp]

name: OAI.SingleFold.SquareSupport.supported_decomposition
statement:
lemma supported_decomposition {x : ℚ} {D : ℕ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hv : ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → ¬p ∣ D → Even (padicValRat p x)) :
    ∃ (d : ℕ) (r : ℚ), d ∣ D ∧ r ≠ 0 ∧ (x=d*r^2 ∨ x=-(d*r^2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d,r,hd,hr,hf,he⟩ := squarefree_decomposition hx
  refine ⟨d,r,squarefree_support hd hr hf he hD hv,hr,?_⟩
  rcases le_or_gt 0 x with hs | hs
  · exact Or.inl (by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hs] using he)
  · exact Or.inr (by rw [abs_of_neg hs] at he; linarith)

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.supported_zero
statement:
lemma supported_zero (P : E.Point) : ∃ (d : ℕ) (r : ℚ), d ∣ 5 ∧ r ≠ 0 ∧
    (alphaVal 0 P=d*r^2 ∨ alphaVal 0 P=-(d*r^2))
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => exact ⟨1,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inl (by norm_num [alphaVal])⟩
  | some x y h =>
    by_cases hx : x=0
    · exact ⟨1,5,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inr (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hx])⟩
    by_cases hx5 : x=5
    · exact ⟨5,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inl (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hx5])⟩
    by_cases hxm5 : x= -5
    · exact ⟨5,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inr (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hxm5])⟩
    simp only [alphaVal_some, sub_zero, adjusted, ite_eq_right hx]
    apply supported_decomposition hx (by norm_num)
    intro p hp hp5
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    have hv : padicValRat p (5:ℚ)=0 := by
      rw [show (5:ℚ)=(5:ℕ) from rfl, padicValRat.of_nat, padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hp5]
      rfl
    apply even_val_triple (a := -5) (b := 5) hx (by simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using sub_ne_zero.mpr hx5)
      (by intro hh; apply hxm5; linarith) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simpa using hv) hv
    have he := equation h
    nlinarith only [he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.supported_five
statement:
lemma supported_five (P : E.Point) : ∃ (d : ℕ) (r : ℚ), d ∣ 10 ∧ r ≠ 0 ∧
    (alphaVal 5 P=d*r^2 ∨ alphaVal 5 P=-(d*r^2))
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => exact ⟨1,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inl (by norm_num [alphaVal])⟩
  | some x y h =>
    by_cases hx : x=0
    · exact ⟨5,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inr (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hx])⟩
    by_cases hx5 : x=5
    · exact ⟨2,5,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inl (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hx5])⟩
    by_cases hxm5 : x= -5
    · exact ⟨10,1,by norm_num,by norm_num,Or.inr (by norm_num [alphaVal,adjusted,hxm5])⟩
    have hx5' : x-5 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hx5
    simp only [alphaVal_some, adjusted, ite_eq_right hx5']
    apply supported_decomposition hx5' (by norm_num)
    intro p hp hp10
    have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
    have hv (k : ℕ) (hk : k ∣ 10) : padicValRat p (k:ℚ)=0 := by
      rw [padicValRat.of_nat, padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd (fun hh => hp10 (hh.trans hk))]
      rfl
    apply even_val_triple (a := 5) (b := 10) hx5' (by simpa using hx)
      (by intro hh; apply hxm5; linarith) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (hv 5 (by norm_num)) (hv 10 (by norm_num))
    have he := equation h
    nlinarith only [he]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.classOf_mul_sq
statement:
lemma classOf_mul_sq {d r : ℚ} (hd : d ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    classOf (d*r^2)=classOf d
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two, classOf_mul hd (mul_ne_zero hr hr), classOf_square, mul_one]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Descent.alpha_zero_classes
statement:
lemma alpha_zero_classes (P : E.Point) :
    classOf (alphaVal 0 P) = classOf 1 ∨ classOf (alphaVal 0 P) = classOf (-1) ∨
    classOf (alphaVal 0 P) = classOf 5 ∨ classOf (alphaVal 0 P) = classOf (-5)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d,r,hd,hr,he | he⟩ := supported_zero P
  all_goals rcases (Nat.dvd_prime (by norm_num : Nat.Prime 5)).mp hd with rfl | rfl
  · left; rw [he]; exact classOf_mul_sq (by norm_num) hr
  · right; right; left; rw [he]; exact classOf_mul_sq (by norm_num) hr
  · right; left; rw [he, ← neg_mul]; exact classOf_mul_sq (by norm_num) hr
  · right; right; right; rw [he, ← neg_mul]; exact classOf_mul_sq (by norm_num) hr

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.equation
statement: lemma equation {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) : y^2=x^3-25*x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff,sub_eq_add_neg] using h.1

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.duplication
statement:
lemma duplication {x y : ℚ} (h : E.Nonsingular x y) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ h' : E.Nonsingular ((x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2)) (E.addY x x y (E.slope x x y y)),
      (2:ℕ) • some x y h = some ((x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2)) (E.addY x x y (E.slope x x y y)) h'
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y ≠ E.negY x y := by simpa [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY] using (show y ≠ -y by intro hh; apply hy; linarith)
  have hs : E.slope x x y y = (3*x^2-25)/(2*y) := by
    rw [slope_of_Y_ne rfl hy']
    simp
    congr 1 <;> ring
  have hx' : E.addX x x (E.slope x x y y) = (x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2) := by
    rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.addX,hs]
    dsimp
    field_simp
    have he := equation h
    linear_combination -32*x*he
  rw [two_smul,add_self_of_Y_ne hy']
  have he := E.nonsingular_add h h (by simpa using hy')
  rw [hx'] at he
  exact ⟨he,by simp only [hx']⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.double_nondegenerate
statement:
lemma double_nondegenerate (P : E.Point) (h : Nondegenerate P) :
    Nondegenerate ((2:ℕ) • P) ∧ H P < H ((2:ℕ) • P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,y,hp,hy,rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨h',hh⟩ := duplication hp hy
  have he := equation hp
  have hx : (x^2+25)^2/(4*y^2) = dupX x := by
    dsimp [dupX]
    congr 1
    linear_combination 4*he
  rw [hh]
  have hu : E.addY x x y (E.slope x x y y) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hb := height_y_zero (equation h') hz
    rw [hx] at hb
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hb) (height_dup_gt_five he hy)
  exact ⟨⟨_,_,h',hu,rfl⟩,by simpa only [H,hx] using height_dup_strict he hy⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.nondegenerate_nontorsion
statement: lemma nondegenerate_nontorsion (P : E.Point) (h : Nondegenerate P) : ¬IsOfFinAddOrder P
proof:
:= by
  have hd (n : ℕ) : Nondegenerate ((2^n:ℕ) • P) := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simpa using h
    | succ n hn => simpa [pow_succ',mul_smul] using (double_nondegenerate _ hn).1
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun n : ℕ => H ((2^n:ℕ) • P)) := by
    apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro n
    simpa only [pow_succ',mul_smul] using (double_nondegenerate _ (hd n)).2
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun n : ℕ => (2^n:ℕ) • P) := by
    intro n m he
    exact hmono.injective (congrArg H he)
  intro ht
  have hf : (Set.range (fun n : ℕ => (2^n:ℕ) • P)).Finite :=
    ht.finite_multiples.subset (by rintro _ ⟨n,rfl⟩; exact ⟨2^n,rfl⟩)
  exact (Set.infinite_range_of_injective hi) hf

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.torsion_doubled
statement: theorem torsion_doubled (P : E.Point) (h : IsOfFinAddOrder P) : (2:ℕ) • P = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases P with
  | zero => simp only [←zero_def,nsmul_zero]
  | some x y hp =>
    have hy : y=0 := by
      by_contra hn
      exact nondegenerate_nontorsion _ ⟨x,y,hp,hn,rfl⟩ h
    rw [two_smul,add_self_of_Y_eq (by simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.negY,hy])]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Torsion.torsion_iff
statement: theorem torsion_iff (P : E.Point) : IsOfFinAddOrder P ↔ (2:ℕ) • P = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨torsion_doubled P,fun h => ?_⟩
  exact isOfFinAddOrder_iff_nsmul_eq_zero.mpr ⟨2,by norm_num,h⟩

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.symbol_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma symbol_zero : symbol 0=none
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.symbol_digit
statement: @[simp] lemma symbol_digit (s : Symbol) : symbol (digit s)=some s
proof: := by cases s <;> rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.digit_pos
statement: lemma digit_pos (s : Symbol) : 0 < (digit s).val
proof: := by cases s <;> decide

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma pack_nil : pack []=0
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma pack_cons (s : Symbol) (l : List Symbol) : pack (s::l)=5*pack l+(digit s).val
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_div
statement: lemma pack_div (l : List Symbol) : pack l/5=pack l.tail
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s l => simp [Nat.mul_add_div, Nat.div_eq_of_lt (digit s).isLt]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_mod
statement: lemma pack_mod (l : List Symbol) : mod5 false (pack l)=l.head?.elim 0 digit
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s l => apply Fin.ext; simp [mod5,Macro.radix, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (digit s).isLt]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_symbol
statement: lemma pack_symbol (l : List Symbol) : symbol (mod5 false (pack l))=l.head?
proof:
:= by
  rw [pack_mod]; cases l <;> simp

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.pack_restore
statement:
lemma pack_restore (l : List Symbol) :
    (if (mod5 false (pack l)).val=0 then pack l/5 else 5*(pack l/5)+(mod5 false (pack l)).val)=pack l
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s l => cases s <;> simp [pack,mod5,Macro.radix,digit,Nat.mul_add_div]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.values_inl
statement: @[simp] lemma values_inl (S : Stack → List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (k : Stack) : values S x (.inl k)=pack (S k)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.values_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma values_inr (S : Stack → List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) : values S x (.inr i)=x i
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.values_update
statement:
lemma values_update (S : Stack → List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (k : Stack) (l : List Symbol) :
    values (Function.update S k l) x=Function.update (values S x) (.inl k) (pack l)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases i with j|j
  · by_cases h : j=k <;> simp [values,Function.update_apply,h]
  · simp [values,Function.update_apply]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.stepAux_reaches
statement:
lemma stepAux_reaches (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (initial : Λ) (q : Stmt Λ) (v : Store)
    (S : Stack → List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ (Macro.step (program M initial)) (codeCfg q v S x) (encode M (TM2.stepAux q v S) x)
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing v S with
  | halt => exact TransGen.single rfl
  | goto f => exact TransGen.single rfl
  | load f q ih => exact (ih (f v) S).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c) rfl
  | branch f q r ihq ihr =>
    cases h : f v
    · simpa only [Reaches₁,TM2.stepAux,h,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,Bool.cond_false] using
        (ihr v S).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c) (show Macro.step (program M initial) (codeCfg (.branch f q r) v S x)=some (codeCfg r v S x) by simp [Macro.step,Macro.next,program,codeCfg,h])
    · simpa only [Reaches₁,TM2.stepAux,h,ite_true,Bool.cond_true] using
        (ihq v S).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c) (show Macro.step (program M initial) (codeCfg (.branch f q r) v S x)=some (codeCfg q v S x) by simp [Macro.step,Macro.next,program,codeCfg,h])
  | push k f q ih =>
    apply (ih v (Function.update S k (f v::S k))).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c)
    change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.code q v)) (Function.update (values S x) (.inl k) (5*pack (S k)+(digit (f v)).val))) = some _
    rw [codeCfg,values_update,pack_cons]
  | pop k f q ih =>
    apply (ih (f v (S k).head?) (Function.update S k (S k).tail)).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c)
    change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.code q (f v (symbol (mod5 false (pack (S k))))))) (Function.update (values S x) (.inl k) (pack (S k)/5))) = some _
    rw [pack_symbol,pack_div,codeCfg,values_update]
  | peek k f q ih =>
    let d := mod5 false (pack (S k))
    let w := f v (S k).head?
    let V := Function.update (values S x) (.inl k) (pack (S k)/5)
    have h1 : Macro.step (program M initial) (codeCfg (.peek k f q) v S x)=
        some ⟨some (.restore k d q w),V⟩ := by
      change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.restore k d q (f v (symbol (mod5 false (pack (S k))))))) V)=some _
      rw [pack_symbol]
    have h2 : Macro.step (program M initial) ⟨some (.restore k d q w),V⟩=some (codeCfg q w S x) := by
      have hp : (if d.val=0 then pack (S k)/5 else 5*(pack (S k)/5)+d.val)=pack (S k) := pack_restore (S k)
      by_cases hd : d.val=0
      · rw [ite_eq_left hd] at hp
        have hv : V=values S x := by
          dsimp [V]; rw [hp]
          exact Function.update_eq_self _ _
        change some (Macro.next (program M initial) (.restore k d q w) V)=some _
        simp only [Macro.next,program,hd,ite_eq_left]
        rw [hv]; rfl
      · rw [ite_eq_right hd] at hp
        change some (Macro.next (program M initial) (.restore k d q w) V)=some _
        simp only [Macro.next,program,hd,ite_false]
        have hV : V (.inl k)=pack (S k)/5 := Function.update_self _ _ _
        rw [hV]
        dsimp only [V]
        rw [Function.update_idem,hp]
        change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.code q w)) (Function.update (values S x) (.inl k) (values S x (.inl k))))=some _
        rw [Function.update_eq_self]; rfl

    exact ((ih w S).head (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c) h2).head
      (r:=fun c d=>d∈Macro.step (program M initial) c) h1

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.respects
statement:
lemma respects (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (initial : Λ) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Respects (TM2.step M) (Macro.step (program M initial)) (fun c d=>encode M c x=d)
proof:
:= by
  apply fun_respects.mpr
  rintro ⟨l,v,S⟩
  cases l with
  | none => rfl
  | some l => exact stepAux_reaches M initial (M l) v S x

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.eval_dom
statement:
lemma eval_dom (M : Λ → Stmt Λ) (initial : Λ) (c : TM2.Cfg (fun _ : Stack=>Symbol) Λ Store) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    (eval (Macro.step (program M initial)) (encode M c x)).Dom ↔ (eval (TM2.step M) c).Dom
proof:
:=
  tr_eval_dom (respects M initial x) rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.trNat_posNum
statement: lemma trNat_posNum (p : PosNum) : trNat (p:ℕ)=trPosNum p
proof:
:= by
  simp [trNat,trNum]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.trNat_div
statement: lemma trNat_div (a : ℕ) (ha : a≠0) : trNat a=(if a%2=0 then Γ'.bit0 else Γ'.bit1)::trNat (a/2)
proof:
:= by
  have H (m : Num) (hm : (m:ℕ)≠0) : trNat (m:ℕ)=(if (m:ℕ)%2=0 then Γ'.bit0 else Γ'.bit1)::trNat ((m:ℕ)/2) := by
    cases m with
    | zero => exact (hm rfl).elim
    | pos p =>
      change trNat (p:ℕ)=_
      rw [trNat_posNum]
      cases p with
      | one => simp [trPosNum]
      | bit0 p =>
        have he : ((p:ℕ)+(p:ℕ))%2=0 := by omega
        have hd : ((p:ℕ)+(p:ℕ))/2=(p:ℕ) := by omega
        simp only [Num.cast_pos,PosNum.cast_bit0,he,ite_true,hd,trPosNum,trNat_posNum]
      | bit1 p =>
        have he : ((p:ℕ)+(p:ℕ)+1)%2≠0 := by omega
        have hd : ((p:ℕ)+(p:ℕ)+1)/2=(p:ℕ) := by omega
        simp only [Num.cast_pos,PosNum.cast_bit1,he,ite_false,hd,trPosNum,trNat_posNum]
  simpa only [Num.to_of_nat] using H (a:Num) (by simpa only [Num.to_of_nat] using ha)

lemma initValues_update_main (L R L' : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Function.update (initValues L R x) (.inl .main) (pack L')=initValues L' R x

:= by
  funext j
  rcases j with k|i
  · cases k <;> simp [initValues,values,K'.elim]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.initValues_update_rev

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.initValues_update_input
statement:
lemma initValues_update_input (L R : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (i : Fin n) (a : ℕ) :
    Function.update (initValues L R x) (.inr i) a=initValues L R (Function.update x i a)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rcases j with k|j <;> simp [initValues,values,Function.update_apply]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.prepend
statement: lemma prepend {c d e : Macro.Cfg (Label n Λ) (Reg n)} (ht : Reaches₁ F d e) (h : F c=some d) : Reaches₁ F c e
proof:
:=
  TransGen.head (r:=fun c d=>d∈F c) h ht

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.reverse_loop
statement:
lemma reverse_loop (i : Fin n) (L R : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (initCfg (.reverse i) L R x) (initCfg (.start i.castSucc) (R.reverse++L) [] x)
proof:
:= by
  induction R generalizing L with
  | nil =>
    apply TransGen.single
    have hv : Function.update (initValues L [] x) (.inl .rev) 0=initValues L [] x :=
      initValues_update_rev L [] [] x
    simp [Macro.step,initCfg,Macro.next,program,Macro.radix,hv]
  | cons s R ih =>
    have h1 : F (initCfg (.reverse i) L (s::R) x)=some (initCfg (.pushRev i (digit s)) L R x) := by
      change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (if (mod5 false (pack (s::R))).val=0 then .start i.castSucc else .pushRev i (mod5 false (pack (s::R))))) (Function.update (initValues L (s::R) x) (.inl .rev) (pack (s::R)/5)))=some _
      rw [show mod5 false (pack (s::R))=digit s from pack_mod _,
        show pack (s::R)/5=pack R from pack_div _, initValues_update_rev,
        ite_eq_right (Nat.ne_of_gt (digit_pos s))]
      rfl
    have h2 : F (initCfg (.pushRev i (digit s)) L R x)=some (initCfg (.reverse i) (s::L) R x) := by
      change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.reverse i)) (Function.update (initValues L R x) (.inl .main) (pack (s::L))))=some _
      rw [initValues_update_main]; rfl
    simpa only [List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using prepend M initial (prepend M initial (ih (s::L)) h2) h1

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.divide_loop
statement:
lemma divide_loop (i : Fin n) (L R : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) (a : ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (initCfg (.divide i) L R (Function.update x i a))
      (initCfg (.reverse i) L ((trNat a).reverse++R) (Function.update x i 0))
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing R with
  | h a ih =>
    have hx : Function.update x i a i=a := Function.update_self _ _ _
    by_cases ha : a=0
    · subst a
      apply TransGen.single
      change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (if Function.update x i 0 i=0 then .reverse i else .bit i)) (initValues L R (Function.update x i 0)))=some _
      rw [Function.update_self,ite_eq_left rfl]
      simp only [trNat_zero,List.reverse_nil,List.nil_append,initCfg]
    · let s : Symbol := if a%2=0 then .bit0 else .bit1
      have h1 : F (initCfg (.divide i) L R (Function.update x i a))=some (initCfg (.bit i) L R (Function.update x i a)) := by
        change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (if Function.update x i a i=0 then .reverse i else .bit i)) (initValues L R (Function.update x i a)))=some _
        rw [hx,ite_eq_right ha]; rfl
      have h2 : F (initCfg (.bit i) L R (Function.update x i a))=some (initCfg (.pushBit i (mod5 true a)) L R (Function.update x i (a/2))) := by
        change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.pushBit i (mod5 true (Function.update x i a i)))) (Function.update (initValues L R (Function.update x i a)) (.inr i) (Function.update x i a i/2)))=some _
        rw [hx,initValues_update_input,Function.update_idem]; rfl
      have h3 : F (initCfg (.pushBit i (mod5 true a)) L R (Function.update x i (a/2)))=some (initCfg (.divide i) L (s::R) (Function.update x i (a/2))) := by
        change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.divide i)) (Function.update (initValues L R (Function.update x i (a/2))) (.inl .rev) (pack (s::R))))=some _
        rw [initValues_update_rev]; rfl
      have ht := prepend M initial (prepend M initial (prepend M initial (ih (a/2) (Nat.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ha) (by omega)) (s::R)) h3) h2) h1
      simpa only [trNat_div a ha,List.reverse_cons,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append] using ht

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.one_input
statement:
lemma one_input (i : Fin n) (L : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (initCfg (.start i.succ) L [] x)
      (initCfg (.start i.castSucc) (trNat (x i)++Γ'.cons::L) [] (Function.update x i 0))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : F (initCfg (.start i.succ) L [] x)=some (initCfg (.divide i) (Γ'.cons::L) [] x) := by
    simp only [Macro.step,initCfg,Macro.next,program,Option.map_some,Fin.val_succ,
      Nat.add_eq_zero_iff,Nat.one_ne_zero,and_false,dite_false,Nat.add_sub_cancel,initValues_main]
    change some (Macro.Cfg.mk (Q:=Label n Λ) (some (.divide i)) (Function.update (initValues L [] x) (.inl .main) (pack (Γ'.cons::L))))=some _
    rw [initValues_update_main]
  have h2 := divide_loop M initial i (Γ'.cons::L) [] x (x i)
  simp only [Function.update_eq_self,List.append_nil] at h2
  have h3 := reverse_loop M initial i (Γ'.cons::L) (trNat (x i)).reverse (Function.update x i 0)
  simp only [List.reverse_reverse] at h3
  exact prepend M initial (h2.trans h3) h1

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.prefix_succ
statement:
lemma prefix_succ (x : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k+1≤n) :
    inputPrefix x (k+1) hk=inputPrefix x k (by omega)++[x ⟨k,by omega⟩]
proof:
:= by
  unfold inputPrefix
  rw [List.ofFn_succ',List.concat_eq_append]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.prefix_update
statement:
lemma prefix_update (x : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k<n) :
    inputPrefix (Function.update x ⟨k,hk⟩ 0) k (by omega)=inputPrefix x k (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  exact Function.update_of_ne (by intro he; have hh:=congrArg Fin.val he; exact Nat.ne_of_lt j.isLt hh) _ _

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.clearPrefix_update
statement:
lemma clearPrefix_update (x : Fin n → ℕ) (k : ℕ) (hk : k<n) :
    clearPrefix (Function.update x ⟨k,hk⟩ 0) k=clearPrefix x (k+1)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j.val<k
  · simp [clearPrefix,h,show j.val<k+1 by omega]
  · by_cases he : j.val=k
    · have hej : j=⟨k,hk⟩ := Fin.ext he
      simp [clearPrefix,hej]
    · have hej : j≠⟨k,hk⟩ := fun hh=>he (congrArg Fin.val hh)
      simp [clearPrefix,h,show ¬j.val<k+1 by omega,Function.update_of_ne hej]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.trList_append
statement: lemma trList_append (L R : List ℕ) : trList (L++R)=trList L++trList R
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a L ih => simp only [List.cons_append,trList,ih,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append]

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.init_loop
statement:
lemma init_loop (k : ℕ) (hk : k≤n) (L : List Symbol) (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Reaches F (initCfg (.start ⟨k,by omega⟩) L [] x)
      (initCfg (.start 0) (trList (inputPrefix x k hk)++L) [] (clearPrefix x k))
proof:
:= by
  induction k generalizing L x with
  | zero =>
    have hc : clearPrefix x 0=x := by funext j; simp [clearPrefix]
    rw [hc]
    exact ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ k ih =>
    have ht := (one_input M initial (⟨k,by omega⟩:Fin n) L x).to_reflTransGen
    have hs := ih (by omega) (trNat (x ⟨k,by omega⟩)++Γ'.cons::L) (Function.update x ⟨k,by omega⟩ 0)
    rw [prefix_update,clearPrefix_update] at hs
    have hh := ht.trans hs
    change ReflTransGen (fun c d=>d∈F c) _ _
    simp only [prefix_succ,trList_append,trList,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append,List.nil_append]
    exact hh

name: OAI.SingleFold.TM2Macro.initialize_reaches
statement:
lemma initialize_reaches (x : Fin n → ℕ) :
    Reaches₁ F (initCfg (.start (Fin.last n)) [] [] x)
      (codeCfg (M initial) none (K'.elim (trList (List.ofFn x)) [] [] []) (fun _=>0))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := init_loop M initial n le_rfl [] x
  have hp : inputPrefix x n le_rfl=List.ofFn x := rfl
  have hc : clearPrefix x n=(fun _=>0) := by funext j; simp [clearPrefix,j.isLt]
  rw [hp,hc,List.append_nil] at ht
  apply TransGen.tail' ht
  change some (Macro.next (program M initial) (.start 0) _)=some _
  simp only [Macro.next,program,Fin.val_zero]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.retract_val
statement: lemma retract_val (p : Q → Prop) (q₀ : {q // p q}) (q : Q) (hq : p q) : (retract p q₀ q).val=q
proof:
:= by
  simp [retract,hq]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.instr_retract
statement:
lemma instr_retract (p : Q → Prop) (q₀ : {q // p q}) (i : Instr Q J) (hi : i.Within p) :
    Instr.map Subtype.val (Instr.map (retract p q₀) i)=i
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> simp_all [Instr.map,Instr.Within,retract,Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.cfg_next_map
statement:
lemma cfg_next_map (f : Q → Q') (M : Q → Instr Q J) (q : Q) (v : J → ℕ) :
    Cfg.map f (next M q v)=next (fun _=>Instr.map f (M q)) (f q) v
proof:
:= by
  cases h : M q <;> simp only [next,h,Instr.map,Cfg.map]
  case test j p r => split <;> rfl
  all_goals rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.restrict_next
statement:
lemma restrict_next (M : Q → Instr Q J) (p : Q → Prop) (q₀ : {q // p q})
    (hM : ∀ q,p q → (M q).Within p) (q : {q // p q}) (v : J → ℕ) :
    Cfg.map Subtype.val (next (restrict M p q₀) q v)=next M q.val v
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfg_next_map]
  have he : Instr.map Subtype.val (restrict M p q₀ q)=M q.val := instr_retract p q₀ _ (hM q q.property)
  rw [he]
  rfl

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.restrict_respects
statement:
lemma restrict_respects (M : Q → Instr Q J) (p : Q → Prop) (q₀ : {q // p q})
    (hM : ∀ q,p q → (M q).Within p) :
    Respects (step (restrict M p q₀)) (step M) (fun c d=>Cfg.map Subtype.val c=d)
proof:
:= by
  apply fun_respects.mpr
  rintro ⟨l,v⟩
  cases l with
  | none => rfl
  | some q =>
    apply TransGen.single
    change some (next M q.val v)=some (Cfg.map Subtype.val (next (restrict M p q₀) q v))
    rw [restrict_next M p q₀ hM]

name: OAI.SingleFold.Macro.restrict_eval_dom
statement:
lemma restrict_eval_dom (M : Q → Instr Q J) (p : Q → Prop) (q₀ : {q // p q})
    (hM : ∀ q,p q → (M q).Within p) (c : Cfg {q // p q} J) :
    (eval (step (restrict M p q₀)) c).Dom ↔ (eval (step M) (Cfg.map Subtype.val c)).Dom
proof:
:=
  (tr_eval_dom (restrict_respects M p q₀ hM) rfl).symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.retainedMap_fixed
statement:
lemma retainedMap_fixed (g : Equiv.Perm (Boxes (hookPart μ p))) :
    H.placementAction (H.retainedMap μ p e g) (H.removedPlacement μ p e)=H.removedPlacement μ p e
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  change H.stabilizerFreeEquiv (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv.symm
    (e.symm.permCongrHom (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g)))
    (e.symm (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm i))))=_
  rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp [leftPerm,removedPlacement]
  rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.retainedInto_bijective
statement: lemma retainedInto_bijective : Function.Bijective (H.retainedInto μ p e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro g g' hh
    have heq := congrArg (fun t => e.permCongrHom (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv t.val)) hh
    change e.permCongrHom (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv.symm
      (e.symm.permCongrHom (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g))))=
      e.permCongrHom (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv.symm
      (e.symm.permCongrHom (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g')))) at heq
    simp only [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at heq
    have hleft : leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g=leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g' := by simpa using heq
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro x
    have hx := congrArg (fun t : Equiv.Perm (Boxes μ) => (boxesSplit μ p).symm (t (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inl x)))) hleft
    simpa [leftPerm] using hx
  · intro g
    have hfix : ∀ z : Boxes (removedPart μ p),
        e.permCongrHom (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv g.val) (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr z))=boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr z) := by
      intro z
      have hh := congrArg (fun u : H.Placement (k := Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p))) => e (u ((Fintype.equivFin _) z))) g.property
      change e ((H.stabilizerFreeEquiv g.val) (e.symm (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm ((Fintype.equivFin _) z))))))=e (e.symm (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr ((Fintype.equivFin _).symm ((Fintype.equivFin _) z))))) at hh
      change e ((H.stabilizerFreeEquiv g.val) (e.symm (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inr z))))=_
      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply,Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hh
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := leftPerm_range_of_fix_right (boxesSplit μ p)
      (e.permCongrHom (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv g.val)) hfix
    refine ⟨a,?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply H.stabilizerFreeEquiv.injective
    change H.stabilizerFreeEquiv (H.stabilizerFreeEquiv.symm
      (e.symm.permCongrHom (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) a)))=H.stabilizerFreeEquiv g.val
    rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply,ha]
    apply Equiv.ext
    intro y
    simp

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.asRepresentation_pullback
statement:
lemma asRepresentation_pullback (ρ : UnitaryIrrep Γ) (e : Λ ≃* Γ) :
    (ρ.pullback e).asRepresentation=ρ.asRepresentation.comp e.toMonoidHom
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.UnitaryIrrep.dimension_eq_finrank
statement:

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.retained_restrict

lemma retained_restrict (τ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer) :
    (matrixRepresentation (τ.matrix.comp (H.placementChart (H.removedPlacement μ p e)).stabilizer.subtype)).comp
        (H.retainedEquiv μ p e).toMonoidHom=

/- Source06:eq22 and genuine retained-hook Hom multiplicity simultaneously,
on the literal placement stabilizer used by the conditional induced cycle. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.exists_retained_irrep
statement:
theorem exists_retained_irrep (τ : UnitaryIrrep H.stabilizer)
    (hτ : hasShape μ (Equiv.refl _) (τ.pullback (H.boxesChart μ e)).asRepresentation) :
    ∃ ρ : UnitaryIrrep (H.placementChart (H.removedPlacement μ p e)).stabilizer,
      hasShape (hookPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _)
        (ρ.asRepresentation.comp (H.retainedEquiv μ p e).toMonoidHom) ∧
      Module.finrank ℂ (shapeSubrep (removedPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _)).toSubmodule ≤
        Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
          (matrixRepresentation (τ.matrix.comp (H.placementChart (H.removedPlacement μ p e)).stabilizer.subtype))) ∧
      τ.dimension ≤ (Fintype.card (Boxes μ))^(Fintype.card (Boxes (removedPart μ p)))*ρ.dimension
proof:
:= by
  let τB := (τ.pullback (H.boxesChart μ e)).asRepresentation
  let δ := (shapeSubrep (removedPart μ p) (Equiv.refl _)).toRepresentation
  obtain ⟨S,hSi,hSh,hm⟩ := hook_removed_multiplicity μ p τB hτ δ (shapeSubrep_hasShape _ _)
  let : S.toRepresentation.IsIrreducible := hSi
  obtain ⟨σ,⟨eS⟩⟩ := UnitaryRealization.exists_unitary S.toRepresentation
  have hSdim : Module.finrank ℂ S.toSubmodule=σ.dimension := by
    have hh := eS.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    simpa using hh
  have hS : S ≠ ⊥ := by
    intro hh
    rw [hh] at hSdim
    have hz : Module.finrank ℂ (⊥ : Submodule ℂ (Fin τ.dimension → ℂ))=0 := by simp
    have he : σ.dimension=0 := hSdim.symm.trans hz
    exact σ.positive.ne' he
  let ρ := σ.pullback (H.retainedEquiv μ p e).symm
  have hρ : ρ.asRepresentation.comp (H.retainedEquiv μ p e).toMonoidHom=σ.asRepresentation := by
    apply MonoidHom.ext
    intro g
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro v
    change σ.asRepresentation ((H.retainedEquiv μ p e).symm (H.retainedEquiv μ p e g)) v=σ.asRepresentation g v
    rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  refine ⟨ρ,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [hρ]
    exact hasShape_equiv _ _ _ _ eS hSh
  · have hsource := (Representation.IntertwiningMap.sourceEquiv eS
        (τB.comp (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p)))).finrank_eq
    have hreparam := (Representation.IntertwiningMap.reparamEquiv ρ.asRepresentation
      (matrixRepresentation (τ.matrix.comp (H.placementChart (H.removedPlacement μ p e)).stabilizer.subtype))
        (H.retainedEquiv μ p e)).finrank_eq
    rw [hρ,H.retained_restrict μ p e τ] at hreparam
    exact hm.trans_eq (hsource.trans hreparam.symm)
  · have hh := hook_dimension_upper μ p τB S hS
    rw [hSdim] at hh
    change Module.finrank ℂ (Fin τ.dimension → ℂ) ≤ _ at hh
    rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
    exact hh

lemma retainedSite_ne_removed (a : Boxes (hookPart μ p))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.retainedMap_site
statement:
lemma retainedMap_site (g : Equiv.Perm (Boxes (hookPart μ p))) (a : Boxes (hookPart μ p)) :

proof:

    (e.symm.permCongrHom (leftPerm (boxesSplit μ p) g))) (e.symm (boxesSplit μ p (Sum.inl a)))=_
