    H.freeColumn y ⟨H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω) x.val,
      (H.columnResidual_label hf ω x.val).trans x.property⟩=
    (H.columnHoles y).stabilizerFreeEquiv
      ((H.columnHoles y).residualWithReference ((H.refPair hf).2 y) (ω y)) (H.freeColumn y x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (splitSlots A B ((H.columnResidual hf ω).val x.val.val)).2=_
  rw [H.columnResidual_split]
  change (B.sweep ((H.refPair hf).2 (H.columnLabel x.val)).val)⁻¹
    (B.sweep (ω (H.columnLabel x.val)).val (splitSlots A B x.val.val).2)=_
  rw [x.property]
  rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowResidual_index
statement:
lemma rowResidual_index (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.RowChoices) (x : H.JunctionFree) :
    H.rowIndex (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.rowResidual hf ω) x)=H.rowIndex x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (Fintype.equivFin B.Slot) (H.rowResidual_label hf ω x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnResidual_index
statement:
lemma columnResidual_index (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.ColumnChoices) (x : H.JunctionFree) :
    H.columnIndex (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω) x)=H.columnIndex x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (Fintype.equivFin A.Slot) (H.columnResidual_label hf ω x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem row_restrict_eq (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.RowChoices) (i : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot)) :
    restrict H.rowIndex (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.rowResidual hf ω)) (H.rowResidual_index hf ω) i=
      H.rowChildEquiv hf i ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).residualWithReference
        ((H.refPair hf).1 (H.rowSite i)) (ω (H.rowSite i)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro j
  apply (H.rowLocalChart i).injective
  have hh := H.rowResidual_fiber hf ω (H.rowSite i)
    ⟨(cards H.rowIndex i j).val,(Fintype.equivFin B.Slot).eq_symm_apply.mpr (cards H.rowIndex i j).property⟩
  change H.rowLocalChart i (restrict H.rowIndex _ _ i j)=
    H.rowLocalChart i ((H.rowLocalChart i).symm
      ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).outputStabilizerEquiv ((H.refPair hf).1 (H.rowSite i))
        ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).residualWithReference ((H.refPair hf).1 (H.rowSite i)) (ω (H.rowSite i)))
        (H.rowLocalChart i j)))
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  change (splitSlots A B (cards H.rowIndex i (restrict H.rowIndex _ _ i j)).val.val).1=_
  rw [restrict_apply]
  exact he

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_restrict_eq
statement:
theorem column_restrict_eq (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.ColumnChoices) (i : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot)) :
    restrict H.columnIndex (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω)) (H.columnResidual_index hf ω) i=
      H.columnChildEquiv i ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).residualWithReference
        ((H.refPair hf).2 (H.columnSite i)) (ω (H.columnSite i)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro j
  apply (H.columnLocalChart i).injective
  have hh := H.columnResidual_fiber hf ω (H.columnSite i)
    ⟨(cards H.columnIndex i j).val,(Fintype.equivFin A.Slot).eq_symm_apply.mpr (cards H.columnIndex i j).property⟩
  change H.columnLocalChart i (restrict H.columnIndex _ _ i j)=
    H.columnLocalChart i ((H.columnLocalChart i).symm
      ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).stabilizerFreeEquiv
        ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).residualWithReference ((H.refPair hf).2 (H.columnSite i)) (ω (H.columnSite i)))
        (H.columnLocalChart i j)))
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val hh
  change (splitSlots A B (cards H.columnIndex i (restrict H.columnIndex _ _ i j)).val.val).2=_
  rw [restrict_apply]
  exact he

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowResidual_as_fibers
statement:
lemma rowResidual_as_fibers (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.RowChoices) :
    H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.rowResidual hf ω)=action H.rowIndex (fun i =>
      H.rowChildEquiv hf i ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).residualWithReference
        ((H.refPair hf).1 (H.rowSite i)) (ω (H.rowSite i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← action_restrict H.rowIndex _ (H.rowResidual_index hf ω)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact H.row_restrict_eq hf ω i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnResidual_as_fibers
statement:
lemma columnResidual_as_fibers (hf : H.Feasible) (ω : H.ColumnChoices) :
    H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω)=action H.columnIndex (fun i =>
      H.columnChildEquiv i ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).residualWithReference
        ((H.refPair hf).2 (H.columnSite i)) (ω (H.columnSite i))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← action_restrict H.columnIndex _ (H.columnResidual_index hf ω)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact H.column_restrict_eq hf ω i

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowAverage_eq_ambient
statement:
theorem rowAverage_eq_ambient (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) :
    H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)=
      ambientAverage (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) (total H.rowIndex)
        (regroup H.rowIndex e) (H.rowLocalWeight z) (H.rowLocalPerm hf)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rowAverage ambientAverage averageMatrix
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv H.rowChoiceFinEquiv
  intro ω
  congr 1
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_prod]
    exact ((Fintype.equivFin B.Slot).symm.prod_comp
      (fun y => ((A.choiceWeight z (ω y).val/(H.rowHoles y).probability z : ℝ) : ℂ))).symm
  · change matrix (Equiv.permCongr e.symm (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.rowResidual hf ω)))=_
    rw [H.rowResidual_as_fibers,ambient_action]
    rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnAverage_eq_ambient
statement:
theorem columnAverage_eq_ambient (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) :
    H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)=
      ambientAverage (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) (total H.columnIndex)
        (regroup H.columnIndex e) (H.columnLocalWeight z) (H.columnLocalPerm hf)
proof:
:= by
  unfold columnAverage ambientAverage averageMatrix
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv H.columnChoiceFinEquiv
  intro ω
  congr 1
  · rw [Complex.ofReal_prod]
    exact ((Fintype.equivFin A.Slot).symm.prod_comp
      (fun x => ((B.choiceWeight z (ω x).val/(H.columnHoles x).probability z : ℝ) : ℂ))).symm
  · change matrix (Equiv.permCongr e.symm (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω)))=_
    rw [H.columnResidual_as_fibers,ambient_action]
    rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.rowLocalMoment
statement:
theorem rowLocalMoment (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (i : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot))
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i)))) :
    (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix ρ.matrix (H.rowLocalWeight z i) (H.rowLocalPerm hf i)).conjTranspose*
      averageMatrix ρ.matrix (H.rowLocalWeight z i) (H.rowLocalPerm hf i))^q)).re=
      schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).conditionalAverage
        (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z (ρ.pullback (H.rowChildEquiv hf i)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).averageWithReference_moment
    (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint ((H.refPair hf).1 (H.rowSite i)) z (ρ.pullback (H.rowChildEquiv hf i)) q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.columnLocalMoment
statement:
theorem columnLocalMoment (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (i : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot))
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i)))) :
    (Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix ρ.matrix (H.columnLocalWeight z i) (H.columnLocalPerm hf i)).conjTranspose*
      averageMatrix ρ.matrix (H.columnLocalWeight z i) (H.columnLocalPerm hf i))^q)).re=
      schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).conditionalAverage
        (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z (ρ.pullback (H.columnChildEquiv i)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).averageWithReference_moment
    (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint ((H.refPair hf).2 (H.columnSite i)) z (ρ.pullback (H.columnChildEquiv i)) q

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.evenTrace_real
statement:
lemma evenTrace_real {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n]
    (K : Matrix n n ℂ) (q : ℕ) :
    Matrix.trace ((K.conjTranspose*K)^q)=((Matrix.trace ((K.conjTranspose*K)^q)).re : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := ((Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self K).pow q).trace_nonneg
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · simpa using ht.2.symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_projected_moment
statement:
theorem row_projected_moment (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i)))) :
    let P
proof:
:= ambientProjector (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) (total H.rowIndex) (regroup H.rowIndex e) ρ
    let X := H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    (Matrix.trace (((P*X).conjTranspose*(P*X))^q)).re=
      ∏ i, (Module.finrank ℂ ((ρ i).asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (SignedTensor.action p (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i)))) : ℝ)*
        schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).conditionalAverage
          (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.rowChildEquiv hf i))) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [H.rowAverage_eq_ambient,ambient_projected_moment _ _ _ _ _ _ hq]
  have he (i : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot)) :
      Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (H.rowLocalWeight z i) (H.rowLocalPerm hf i)).conjTranspose*
        averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (H.rowLocalWeight z i) (H.rowLocalPerm hf i))^q)=
        (schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).conditionalAverage
          (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.rowChildEquiv hf i))) : ℂ) := by
    rw [evenTrace_real,H.rowLocalMoment]
  simp only [he,← Complex.ofReal_natCast,← Complex.ofReal_mul,← Complex.ofReal_prod,Complex.ofReal_re]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_projected_moment
statement:
theorem column_projected_moment (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i)))) :
    let P
proof:
:= ambientProjector (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) (total H.columnIndex) (regroup H.columnIndex e) ρ
    let Y := H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    (Matrix.trace (((P*Y).conjTranspose*(P*Y))^q)).re=
      ∏ i, (Module.finrank ℂ ((ρ i).asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (SignedTensor.action p (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i)))) : ℝ)*
        schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).conditionalAverage
          (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.columnChildEquiv i))) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [H.columnAverage_eq_ambient,ambient_projected_moment _ _ _ _ _ _ hq]
  have he (i : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot)) :
      Matrix.trace (((averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (H.columnLocalWeight z i) (H.columnLocalPerm hf i)).conjTranspose*
        averageMatrix (ρ i).matrix (H.columnLocalWeight z i) (H.columnLocalPerm hf i))^q)=
        (schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).conditionalAverage
          (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.columnChildEquiv i))) : ℂ) := by
    rw [evenTrace_real,H.columnLocalMoment]
  simp only [he,← Complex.ofReal_natCast,← Complex.ofReal_mul,← Complex.ofReal_prod,Complex.ofReal_re]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_size_le
statement: lemma row_size_le (i : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot)) : FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i ≤ A.size
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr (H.rowLocalChart i)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin,(H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).card_freeAt] at hc
  rw [hc]
  exact Nat.sub_le _ _

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_size_le
statement: lemma column_size_le (i : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot)) : FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i ≤ B.size
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr (H.columnLocalChart i)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin,(H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).card_freeAt] at hc
  rw [hc]
  exact Nat.sub_le _ _

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_moment_bound
statement:
theorem row_moment_bound (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex i))))
    (E : Fin (Fintype.card B.Slot) → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ i, schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).conditionalAverage
      (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.rowChildEquiv hf i))) ≤ Real.exp (E i)) :
    let P
proof:
:= ambientProjector (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) (total H.rowIndex) (regroup H.rowIndex e) ρ
    let X := H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    (Matrix.trace (((P*X).conjTranspose*(P*X))^q)).re ≤
      ((A.size+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^(B.size*((2*p)*(2*p)))*Real.exp (∑ i, E i) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [H.row_projected_moment p e hf z hq ρ]
  simpa only [card_slot] using child_product_bound (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) A.size
    H.row_size_le ρ _ E (fun i => (H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).conditionalMoment_nonneg _ _ _ _) hE

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_moment_bound
statement:
theorem column_moment_bound (p : ℕ) (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree)
    (hf : H.Feasible) (z : ℝ) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (ρ : ∀ i, UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex i))))
    (E : Fin (Fintype.card A.Slot) → ℝ)
    (hE : ∀ i, schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).conditionalAverage
      (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).feasible_of_disjoint z ((ρ i).pullback (H.columnChildEquiv i))) ≤ Real.exp (E i)) :
    let P
proof:
:= ambientProjector (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) (total H.columnIndex) (regroup H.columnIndex e) ρ
    let Y := H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    (Matrix.trace (((Y*P).conjTranspose*(Y*P))^q)).re ≤
      ((B.size+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)^(A.size*((2*p)*(2*p)))*Real.exp (∑ i, E i) := by
  dsimp only
  have hc : _*_=_*_ := ambientProjector_commute_average (p := p) (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex)
    (total H.columnIndex) (regroup H.columnIndex e) ρ (H.columnLocalWeight z) (H.columnLocalPerm hf)
  rw [← H.columnAverage_eq_ambient] at hc
  rw [← hc,H.column_projected_moment p e hf z hq ρ]
  simpa only [card_slot] using child_product_bound (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) B.size
    H.column_size_le ρ _ E (fun i => (H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).conditionalMoment_nonneg _ _ _ _) hE

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {μ ν : FiniteLaw Ω} (h : ∀ x, μ x = ν x) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  cases μ
  cases ν
  congr
  exact funext h

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.sum_mass
statement: @[simp] theorem sum_mass (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) : ∑ x, μ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finsum_eq_sum_of_fintype] using μ.total

/- Uniform probability, not counting measure. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniform_apply [Nonempty Ω] (x : Ω) : uniform Ω x =
    (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (f : Ω → X) (y : X) :
    μ.map f y = ∑ x, if f x = y then μ x else 0
proof:
:= rfl

/- Mixture of two laws, with the real probability range explicit. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.monotone_prefix_average
statement:
theorem monotone_prefix_average (f : ℕ → ℝ) {u m : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m)
    (hf : ∀ i < m, ∀ j < m, i ≤ j → f i ≤ f j) :
    (m : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range u, f i) ≤
      (u : ℝ) * (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range u, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico u m, f i) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range u, ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico u m, f j := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j hj
    have hi' := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hj' := Finset.mem_Ico.mp hj
    exact hf i (lt_of_lt_of_le hi' hu) j hj'.2 (le_trans (le_of_lt hi') hj'.1)
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul,
    ← Finset.mul_sum, Nat.cast_sub hu] at h
  have hs := Finset.sum_range_add_sum_Ico f hu
  nlinarith

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_corrections
statement:
theorem sum_corrections (m u : ℕ) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range u, (Real.log m - Real.log (m-j : ℕ))) =
       (u : ℝ) * Real.log m - Real.log (m.descFactorial u : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  induction u with
  | zero => simp
  | succ u ih =>
    have hum : u ≤ m := by omega
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih hum, Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
      Real.log_mul (by exact_mod_cast (show m-u ≠ 0 by omega))
        (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hum).ne')]
    push_cast
    ring

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_eq
statement:
theorem lineCost_eq (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    lineCost m u = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range u, (Real.log m - Real.log (m-j : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineCost, Real.log_div (by positivity)
    (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hu).ne'), Real.log_pow,
    sum_corrections m u hu]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem lineCost_nonneg (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) :
    0 ≤ lineCost m u
proof:
:= by
  rw [lineCost_eq m u hm hu]
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j hj
  have hj' : j < m := (Finset.mem_range.mp hj).trans_le hu
  apply sub_nonneg.mpr
  apply Real.log_le_log
  · exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m-j by omega)
  · exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le m j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.full_lineCost_le
statement: theorem full_lineCost_le (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : lineCost m m ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  have hs := Stirling.le_log_factorial_stirling (Nat.ne_of_gt hm)
  have hm1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hp : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * Real.pi) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith [Real.pi_gt_three])
  have hl : 0 ≤ Real.log (m : ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg hm1
  rw [lineCost_eq m m hm le_rfl, sum_corrections m m le_rfl, Nat.descFactorial_self]
  linarith

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.lineCost_le
statement: theorem lineCost_le (m u : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hu : u ≤ m) : lineCost m u ≤ u
proof:
:= by
  have hs := monotone_prefix_average (fun j => Real.log m - Real.log (m-j : ℕ)) hu
    (by
      intro i hi j hj hij
      have hlog : Real.log (m-j : ℕ) ≤ Real.log (m-i : ℕ) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < m-j by omega))
          (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le_sub_left hij m))
      linarith)
  rw [← lineCost_eq m u hm hu, ← lineCost_eq m m hm le_rfl] at hs
  have hall := full_lineCost_le m hm
  have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ u := Nat.cast_nonneg u
  have hm0 : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hm
  nlinarith

/- Binary positions with their actual bit-coordinate labels. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_le
statement:
theorem lineCount_le (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    H.lineCount j L ≤ 2 ^ G.bits j
proof:
:= by
  have hb : H.lineCount j L ≤ Fintype.card (Cube (G.bits j)) := by
    apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn (fun i => H.path i j.castSucc j)
    · intro _ _
      exact Finset.mem_univ _
    · intro i hi i' hi' he
      apply H.disjoint j.castSucc
      funext k
      by_cases hk : k = j
      · subst k
        exact he
      · have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
        have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
        exact (congrFun h1 ⟨k, hk⟩).trans (congrFun h2 ⟨k, hk⟩).symm
  simpa [Cube] using hb

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_lineCount
statement:
theorem sum_lineCount (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) :
    ∑ L : G.Line j, H.lineCount j L = h
proof:
:= by
  unfold lineCount
  simp only [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_nonneg
statement: theorem cost_nonneg (H : G.Holes h) : 0 ≤ H.cost
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro L _
  exact lineCost_nonneg _ _ (by positivity) (H.lineCount_le j L)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_le
statement: theorem cost_le (H : G.Holes h) : H.cost ≤ (G.b : ℝ) * h
proof:
:= by
  calc
    H.cost ≤ ∑ j, ∑ L : G.Line j, (H.lineCount j L : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro L _
      exact lineCost_le _ _ (by positivity) (H.lineCount_le j L)
    _ = (G.b : ℝ) * h := by
      simp only [← Nat.cast_sum, H.sum_lineCount]
      simp

/- Permutations of the free input sites, presented as permutations fixing the
prescribed inputs. This is the symmetric group on exactly s-h sites. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.reference_compatible
statement:
theorem reference_compatible (H : G.Holes h) (hf : H.Feasible) :
    H.Compatible (H.reference hf)
proof:
:= hf.choose_spec

/- The remaining permutation relative to those identifications. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.choiceWeight_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem choiceWeight_eq (G : Grid) (z : ℝ) (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1)
    (ω : G.Choices) : G.choiceWeight z ω = G.choiceLaw z hz hz' ω
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.choiceWeight_pos
statement:
theorem choiceWeight_pos (G : Grid) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z < 1)
    (ω : G.Choices) : 0 < G.choiceWeight z ω
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro j _
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro L _
  apply add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
  · apply mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz')
    exact inv_pos.mpr (Nat.cast_pos.mpr Fintype.card_pos)
  · exact mul_nonneg hz ((binaryLaw (G.bits j)).nonneg (ω j L))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem boundary_zero (ω : G.Choices) : G.boundary ω 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundary]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_succ
statement:
theorem boundary_succ (ω : G.Choices) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < G.b) :
    G.boundary ω (t+1) = G.stage ω ⟨t,ht⟩ * G.boundary ω t
proof:
:= by
  unfold boundary
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by simpa using ht)]
  simp [List.reverse_append]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem stage_apply_same (ω : G.Choices) (j : Fin G.b) (x : G.Slot) :
    G.stage ω j x j = ω j (fun k => x k) (x j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage, fiberPerm, Equiv.piSplitAt_apply, Equiv.piSplitAt_symm_apply]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.stage_apply_ne
statement:
theorem stage_apply_ne (ω : G.Choices) (j k : Fin G.b) (hk : k ≠ j) (x : G.Slot) :
    G.stage ω j x k = x k
proof:
:= by
  simp [stage, fiberPerm, Equiv.piSplitAt_apply, Equiv.piSplitAt_symm_apply, hk]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.compatible_iff_step
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_step (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔ H.StepCompatible ω
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hω i j
    have hs := congrArg (fun g : Equiv.Perm G.Slot => g (H.path i 0))
      (G.boundary_succ ω j.isLt)
    change G.boundary ω (j.val+1) (H.path i 0) =
      G.stage ω j (G.boundary ω j.val (H.path i 0)) at hs
    have h1 := hω i j.succ
    have h0 := hω i j.castSucc
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at h1 h0
    rw [h1, h0] at hs
    exact hs.symm
  · intro hω i t
    have hb : ∀ n (hn : n ≤ G.b), G.boundary ω n (H.path i 0) =
        H.path i ⟨n, by omega⟩ := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero => intro hn; simp
      | succ n ih =>
        intro hn
        have hnb : n < G.b := by omega
        rw [G.boundary_succ ω hnb]
        change G.stage ω ⟨n,hnb⟩ (G.boundary ω n (H.path i 0)) = _
        rw [ih (by omega)]
        exact hω i ⟨n,hnb⟩
    exact hb t.val (by omega)

/- Compatibility is a product of independent line assignment events. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.step_iff_coordinate
statement:
theorem step_iff_coordinate (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.StepCompatible ω ↔ ∀ i (j : Fin G.b),
      ω j (fun k => H.path i j.castSucc k) (H.path i j.castSucc j) = H.path i j.succ j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hω i j
    have hh := congrFun (hω i j) j
    simpa using hh
  · intro hω i j
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = j
    · subst k
      exact (G.stage_apply_same ω j _).trans (hω i j)
    · exact (G.stage_apply_ne ω j k hk _).trans (H.coordinate_step i j k hk).symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.line_input_injective
statement:
theorem line_input_injective (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} => H.path i j.castSucc j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i i' he
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply H.disjoint j.castSucc
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst k; exact he
  · exact (congrFun i.property ⟨k,hk⟩).trans (congrFun i'.property ⟨k,hk⟩).symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.line_output_injective
statement:
theorem line_output_injective (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Function.Injective (fun i : {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} => H.path i j.succ j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i i' he
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply H.disjoint j.succ
  funext k
  by_cases hk : k = j
  · subst k; exact he
  · change H.path i.val j.succ k = H.path i'.val j.succ k
    rw [H.coordinate_step _ _ _ hk, H.coordinate_step _ _ _ hk]
    exact (congrFun i.property ⟨k,hk⟩).trans (congrFun i'.property ⟨k,hk⟩).symm

/- Disjoint source trajectories really are feasible; no probability event
is postulated to be nonempty. The main target still retains its explicit
feasibility hypothesis. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.feasible_of_disjoint
statement: theorem feasible_of_disjoint (H : G.Holes h) : H.Feasible
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∀ (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j), ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)),
      ∀ i : {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i}, σ (H.path i j.castSucc j) = H.path i j.succ j := by
    intro j L
    exact Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair _ _ (H.line_input_injective j L)
      (H.line_output_injective j L)
  choose ω hω using hex
  refine ⟨ω, (H.compatible_iff_step ω).mpr ((H.step_iff_coordinate ω).mpr ?_)⟩
  intro i j
  exact hω j (fun k => H.path i j.castSucc k) ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.mass_le_one
statement: theorem mass_le_one (μ : FiniteLaw Ω) (x : Ω) : μ x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← μ.sum_mass]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => μ.nonneg y) (Finset.mem_univ x)

/- A uniform, finite-alphabet perturbation interval, depending on the line
size only. This proves the source's half-to-two measure comparison. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.mix_uniform_between
statement:
theorem mix_uniform_between [Nonempty Ω] (ν : FiniteLaw Ω) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hzhalf : z ≤ 1/2) (hzcard : z ≤ (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (x : Ω) :
    (1/2 : ℝ) * uniform Ω x ≤ (uniform Ω).mix ν z hz (by linarith) x ∧
      (uniform Ω).mix ν z hz (by linarith) x ≤ 2 * uniform Ω x
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ν.nonneg x
  have hle := ν.mass_le_one x
  have hU : 0 ≤ uniform Ω x := (uniform Ω).nonneg x
  change (1/2 : ℝ) * uniform Ω x ≤ (1-z) * uniform Ω x + z * ν x ∧
    (1-z) * uniform Ω x + z * ν x ≤ 2 * uniform Ω x
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hz hn, mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hzhalf) hU]
  · change z ≤ uniform Ω x at hzcard
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hz hU, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hle hz]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_nonneg
statement:
theorem assignments_nonneg {h : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) : 0 ≤ μ.assignments x y
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro g _
  split_ifs
  · exact μ.nonneg g
  · rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.sum_assignments
statement:
theorem sum_assignments {h : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (x : Fin h ↪ Ω) : ∑ y, μ.assignments x y = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold assignments
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments_same
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments_same {h : ℕ} (x y z : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y =
      (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair y z y.injective z.injective
  have hz : y.trans σ.toEmbedding = z := by
    ext i
    exact hσ i
  unfold assignments
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulLeft σ)
    (fun g : Equiv.Perm Ω => if x.trans g.toEmbedding = z then
      uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g else 0)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro g _
  have he : x.trans (σ * g).toEmbedding = z ↔ x.trans g.toEmbedding = y := by
    rw [← hz]
    constructor
    · intro he
      ext i
      exact σ.injective (congrArg (fun f : Fin h ↪ Ω => f i) he)
    · intro he
      ext i
      change σ (g (x i)) = σ (y i)
      exact congrArg σ (congrArg (fun f : Fin h ↪ Ω => f i) he)
  simp only [Equiv.coe_mulLeft, he, uniform_apply]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y =
      ((Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial h : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (Fin h ↪ Ω) := ⟨y⟩
  have hh : (∑ z : Fin h ↪ Ω, (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y) = 1 := by
    convert sum_assignments (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)) x using 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro z _
    exact uniform_assignments_same x y z
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul,
    Fintype.card_embedding_eq, Fintype.card_fin] at hh
  have hm : ((Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial h : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hm
    rw [hm, zero_mul] at hh
    norm_num at hh
  exact ((mul_eq_one_iff_inv_eq₀ hm).mp hh).symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments_pos
statement:
theorem uniform_assignments_pos {h : ℕ} (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    0 < (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniform_assignments]
  apply inv_pos.mpr
  exact_mod_cast Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding x)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_le
statement:
theorem assignments_le {h : ℕ} (μ ν : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω)) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ g, μ g ≤ C * ν g) (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    μ.assignments x y ≤ C * ν.assignments x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold assignments
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro g _
  split_ifs
  · exact hb g
  · simp

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.le_assignments
statement:
theorem le_assignments {h : ℕ} (μ ν : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω)) (C : ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ g, C * ν g ≤ μ g) (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) :
    C * ν.assignments x y ≤ μ.assignments x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold assignments
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro g _
  split_ifs
  · exact hb g
  · simp

/- The exact factor four in the line-conditioning argument, with all
line assignments represented by actual injections, not abstract events. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.assignments_ratio_le_four
statement:
theorem assignments_ratio_le_four {h v : ℕ} (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm Ω))
    (hμlo : ∀ g, (1/2 : ℝ) * uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g ≤ μ g)
    (hμhi : ∀ g, μ g ≤ 2 * uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω) g)
    (x y : Fin h ↪ Ω) (x' y' : Fin (h+v) ↪ Ω) :
    μ.assignments x' y' / μ.assignments x y ≤
      4 * (((Fintype.card Ω - h).descFactorial v : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo := le_assignments μ (uniform _) (1/2) hμlo x y
  have hhi := assignments_le μ (uniform _) 2 hμhi x' y'
  have hp := uniform_assignments_pos x y
  have hmp : 0 < μ.assignments x y := lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) hlo
  have hcard : h+v ≤ Fintype.card Ω := by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_embedding x'
  have hprod : (Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial (h+v) =
      (Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial h * (Fintype.card Ω-h).descFactorial v := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, mul_comm] using
      (Nat.descFactorial_mul_descFactorial (n := Fintype.card Ω) (k := h) (m := h+v) (by omega)).symm
  have hh : ((Fintype.card Ω).descFactorial h : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega)).ne'
  have hv : ((Fintype.card Ω-h).descFactorial v : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr (by omega)).ne'
  calc
    _ ≤ (2 * (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x' y') /
          ((1/2) * (uniform (Equiv.Perm Ω)).assignments x y) := by
      exact div_le_div₀ (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) ((uniform _).assignments_nonneg x' y')) hhi (by positivity) hlo
    _ = _ := by
      rw [uniform_assignments, uniform_assignments, hprod, Nat.cast_mul]
      field_simp
      ring

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.compatible_iff_lines
statement:
theorem compatible_iff_lines (H : G.Holes h) (ω : G.Choices) :
    H.Compatible ω ↔ ∀ j L, H.LineCompatible j L (ω j L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.compatible_iff_step, H.step_iff_coordinate]
  constructor
  · intro hω j L i
    have hh := hω i.val j
    rw [i.property] at hh
    exact hh
  · intro hω i j
    exact hω j (fun k => H.path i j.castSucc k) ⟨i,rfl⟩

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_prod
statement:
theorem probability_prod (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.probability z = ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ : {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ},
      lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz' σ.val
proof:
:= by
  unfold probability
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp H.compatibleEquiv.symm]
  change (∑ σ : (∀ j L, {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ}),
    ∏ j, ∏ L, lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz' (σ j L).val) = _
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun j : Fin G.b =>
    fun σ : (∀ L, {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ}) =>
      ∏ L, lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz' (σ L).val)]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact (Fintype.prod_sum (fun L => fun σ : {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ} =>
    lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz' σ.val)).symm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.card_onLine
statement:
theorem card_onLine (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin h // H.OnLine j L i} = H.lineCount j L
proof:
:= by
  have hh := Fintype.card_subtype (H.OnLine j L)
  unfold lineCount
  convert hh using 1
  congr 2

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCompatible_iff_assignments
statement:
theorem lineCompatible_iff_assignments (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    H.LineCompatible j L σ ↔ (H.lineInput j L).trans σ.toEmbedding = H.lineOutput j L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    apply Function.Embedding.ext
    intro i
    exact hs (H.lineCards j L i)
  · intro hs i
    obtain ⟨k,rfl⟩ := (H.lineCards j L).surjective i
    exact congrArg (fun f : Fin (H.lineCount j L) ↪ Cube (G.bits j) => f k) hs

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff
statement:
theorem sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω]
    {p q : Ω → Prop} [Fintype {a // p a}] [DecidablePred q]
    (h : ∀ a, p a ↔ q a) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ a : {a // p a}, f a.val) = ∑ a, if q a then f a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter p) (by simp)]
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  simp only [h a]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineProbability_eq
statement:
theorem lineProbability_eq (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    (∑ σ : {σ // H.LineCompatible j L σ}, μ σ.val) =
      μ.assignments (H.lineInput j L) (H.lineOutput j L)
proof:
:= by
  exact sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff (H.lineCompatible_iff_assignments j L) μ.mass

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_eq_assignments
statement:
theorem probability_eq_assignments (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    H.probability z = ∏ j, ∏ L,
      (lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz').assignments (H.lineInput j L) (H.lineOutput j L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.probability_prod hz hz']
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro L _
  exact H.lineProbability_eq j L (lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz')

/- Under uniform line randomization each prescribed injection pays exactly
one falling-factorial denominator. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.probability_zero
statement:
theorem probability_zero (H : G.Holes h) :
    H.probability 0 = ∏ j, ∏ L,
      (((2 ^ G.bits j).descFactorial (H.lineCount j L) : ℝ)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.probability_eq_assignments (le_refl 0) zero_le_one]
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro L _
  have he : lineLaw (G.bits j) 0 (le_refl 0) zero_le_one = FiniteLaw.uniform _ := by
    ext σ
    simp [lineLaw, FiniteLaw.mix]
  rw [he]
  have hu := FiniteLaw.uniform_assignments (H.lineInput j L) (H.lineOutput j L)
  have hc : Fintype.card (Cube (G.bits j)) = 2 ^ G.bits j := by simp [Cube]
  rw [hc] at hu
  exact hu

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.onLine_row_iff
statement:
lemma onLine_row_iff (j : Fin A.b) (L : A.Line j) (y : B.Slot) (i : Fin h) :
    H.OnLine (Fin.castAdd B.b j) (rowLines A B j (L,y)) i ↔
      H.rowOf i=y ∧ (fun k : {k : Fin A.b // k≠j} =>
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc))).1 k.val)=L
proof:
:= by
  have hh := rowLines_evaluation A B j (H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc))
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have he := congrArg (rowLines A B j).symm hi
    change (rowLines A B j).symm (fun k => H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc) k.val)=
      (rowLines A B j).symm (rowLines A B j (L,y)) at he
    rw [hh,Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at he
    exact ⟨(H.row_constant i j.castSucc).symm.trans (congrArg Prod.snd he),congrArg Prod.fst he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi,hl⟩
    apply (rowLines A B j).symm.injective
    change (rowLines A B j).symm (fun k => H.path i (prefixTime A B j.castSucc) k.val)=
      (rowLines A B j).symm (rowLines A B j (L,y))
    rw [hh,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Prod.ext hl ((H.row_constant i j.castSucc).trans hi)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.onLine_column_iff
statement:
lemma onLine_column_iff (j : Fin B.b) (x : A.Slot) (L : B.Line j) (i : Fin h) :
    H.OnLine (Fin.natAdd A.b j) (columnLines A B j (x,L)) i ↔
      H.columnOf i=x ∧ (fun k : {k : Fin B.b // k≠j} =>
        (splitSlots A B (H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc))).2 k.val)=L
proof:
:= by
  have hh := columnLines_evaluation A B j (H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc))
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have he := congrArg (columnLines A B j).symm hi
    change (columnLines A B j).symm (fun k => H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc) k.val)=
      (columnLines A B j).symm (columnLines A B j (x,L)) at he
    rw [hh,Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at he
    exact ⟨(H.column_constant i j.castSucc).symm.trans (congrArg Prod.fst he),congrArg Prod.snd he⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi,hl⟩
    apply (columnLines A B j).symm.injective
    change (columnLines A B j).symm (fun k => H.path i (suffixTime A B j.castSucc) k.val)=
      (columnLines A B j).symm (columnLines A B j (x,L))
    rw [hh,Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    exact Prod.ext ((H.column_constant i j.castSucc).trans hi) hl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_row
statement:
lemma lineCount_row (j : Fin A.b) (L : A.Line j) (y : B.Slot) :
    H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) (rowLines A B j (L,y))=(H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L
proof:
:= by
  exact (H.card_onLine _ _).symm.trans ((Fintype.card_congr (H.rowOnLineEquiv j L y)).symm.trans
    ((H.rowHoles y).card_onLine j L))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCount_column
statement:
lemma lineCount_column (j : Fin B.b) (x : A.Slot) (L : B.Line j) :
    H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) (columnLines A B j (x,L))=(H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L
proof:
:= by
  exact (H.card_onLine _ _).symm.trans ((Fintype.card_congr (H.columnOnLineEquiv j x L)).symm.trans
    ((H.columnHoles x).card_onLine j L))

/- One head stage contributes exactly the sum of its child row potentials. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_stage_row
statement:
lemma cost_stage_row (j : Fin A.b) :
    (∑ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.castAdd B.b j),
      Real.log (((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b j) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^
          H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) L /
        ((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.castAdd B.b j)).descFactorial
          (H.lineCount (Fin.castAdd B.b j) L) : ℝ)))=
      ∑ y : B.Slot, ∑ L : A.Line j,
        Real.log (((2^A.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L /
          ((2^A.bits j).descFactorial ((H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (rowLines A B j).sum_comp,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro y _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro L _
  rw [H.lineCount_row,concat_bits_left]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_stage_column
statement:
lemma cost_stage_column (j : Fin B.b) :
    (∑ L : (concat A B).Line (Fin.natAdd A.b j),
      Real.log (((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b j) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^
          H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) L /
        ((2 ^ (concat A B).bits (Fin.natAdd A.b j)).descFactorial
          (H.lineCount (Fin.natAdd A.b j) L) : ℝ)))=
      ∑ x : A.Slot, ∑ L : B.Line j,
        Real.log (((2^B.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L /
          ((2^B.bits j).descFactorial ((H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (columnLines A B j).sum_comp,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro L _
  rw [H.lineCount_column,concat_bits_right]

/- No conditioning cost is discarded in the induction split. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.cost_split
statement: theorem cost_split : H.cost=(∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost)+(∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost)
proof:
:= by
  unfold cost
  erw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  congr 1
  · trans ∑ j : Fin A.b, ∑ y : B.Slot, ∑ L : A.Line j,
      Real.log (((2^A.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L /
        ((2^A.bits j).descFactorial ((H.rowHoles y).lineCount j L) : ℝ))
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      convert H.cost_stage_row j using 1
      congr 3
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · exact Finset.sum_comm
  · trans ∑ j : Fin B.b, ∑ x : A.Slot, ∑ L : B.Line j,
      Real.log (((2^B.bits j : ℕ) : ℝ)^(H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L /
        ((2^B.bits j).descFactorial ((H.columnHoles x).lineCount j L) : ℝ))
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      convert H.cost_stage_column j using 1
      congr 3
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · exact Finset.sum_comm

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_column_index_injective
statement: lemma row_column_index_injective : Function.Injective (fun x : H.JunctionFree => (H.rowIndex x,H.columnIndex x))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y he
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (splitSlots A B).injective
  exact Prod.ext ((Fintype.equivFin A.Slot).injective (congrArg Prod.snd he))
    ((Fintype.equivFin B.Slot).injective (congrArg Prod.fst he))

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_entropy_sum
statement:
lemma row_entropy_sum {p : ℕ} (α : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) p) (c e : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (-c*Real.log (activeIrrep (α i)).dimension+
      e*H.rowCount (H.rowSite i)*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).cost))=
      -c*blockEntropy α+e*h*Real.log A.size-∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul,
    blockEntropy]
  have hc : (∑ i, (H.rowCount (H.rowSite i) : ℝ))=h := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
    congr 1
    exact ((Fintype.equivFin B.Slot).symm.sum_comp H.rowCount).trans H.sum_rowCount
  rw [hc]
  congr 1
  exact (Fintype.equivFin B.Slot).symm.sum_comp (fun y => (H.rowHoles y).cost)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_entropy_sum
statement:
lemma column_entropy_sum {p : ℕ} (β : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) p) (c e : ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (-c*Real.log (activeIrrep (β i)).dimension+
      e*H.columnCount (H.columnSite i)*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).cost))=
      -c*blockEntropy β+e*h*Real.log B.size-∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_add_distrib,← Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_mul,
    blockEntropy]
  have hc : (∑ i, (H.columnCount (H.columnSite i) : ℝ))=h := by
    rw [← Nat.cast_sum]
    congr 1
    exact ((Fintype.equivFin A.Slot).symm.sum_comp H.columnCount).trans H.sum_columnCount
  rw [hc]
  congr 1
  exact (Fintype.equivFin A.Slot).symm.sum_comp (fun x => (H.columnHoles x).cost)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.row_child_hook_bound
statement:
theorem row_child_hook_bound (hq : 0 < q) (hAS : A.size ≤ s)
    (hR : ∀ y : B.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.rowHoles y).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles y).conditionalAverage (H.rowHoles y).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.rowCount y*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles y).cost))
    (α : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.rowIndex) p) :
      (Matrix.trace (((fiberProjector H.rowIndex eF (fun i => activeIrrep (α i))*
        H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)).conjTranspose*
        (fiberProjector H.rowIndex eF (fun i => activeIrrep (α i))*
        H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)))^q)).re ≤ Real.exp (-c*blockEntropy α+(e*h*Real.log A.size-(∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost)+
        ((B.size*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
    have hh := H.row_moment_bound p eF hf z hq.ne' (fun i => activeIrrep (α i))
      (fun i => -c*Real.log (activeIrrep (α i)).dimension+
        e*H.rowCount (H.rowSite i)*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles (H.rowSite i)).cost)
      (fun i => hR (H.rowSite i) _)
    apply hh.trans
    have hn : ((A.size+1 : ℕ):ℝ)^(B.size*((2*p)*(2*p))) ≤
        ((s+1 : ℕ):ℝ)^(B.size*((2*p)*(2*p))) := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hAS 1) _
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (Real.exp_pos _).le).trans_eq
    rw [nat_pow_eq_exp,H.row_entropy_sum,← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.column_child_hook_bound
statement:
theorem column_child_hook_bound (hq : 0 < q) (hBS : B.size ≤ s)
    (hC : ∀ x : A.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.columnHoles x).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles x).conditionalAverage (H.columnHoles x).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.columnCount x*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles x).cost))
    (β : BlockType (FiberBlocks.size H.columnIndex) p) :
      (Matrix.trace (((H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)*
        fiberProjector H.columnIndex eF (fun i => activeIrrep (β i))).conjTranspose*
        (H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)*
        fiberProjector H.columnIndex eF (fun i => activeIrrep (β i))))^q)).re ≤ Real.exp (-c*blockEntropy β+(e*h*Real.log B.size-(∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost)+
        ((A.size*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
    have hh := H.column_moment_bound p eF hf z hq.ne' (fun i => activeIrrep (β i))
      (fun i => -c*Real.log (activeIrrep (β i)).dimension+
        e*H.columnCount (H.columnSite i)*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles (H.columnSite i)).cost)
      (fun i => hC (H.columnSite i) _)
    apply hh.trans
    have hn : ((B.size+1 : ℕ):ℝ)^(A.size*((2*p)*(2*p))) ≤
        ((s+1 : ℕ):ℝ)^(A.size*((2*p)*(2*p))) := by
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast Nat.add_le_add_right hBS 1) _
    apply (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hn (Real.exp_pos _).le).trans_eq
    rw [nat_pow_eq_exp,H.column_entropy_sum,← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
/- Exact row/column induction estimate on the literal free junction board.
Only smaller-grid conditional estimates enter as hypotheses. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.grid_projected_hook_bound
statement:
theorem grid_projected_hook_bound (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (eF : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (z : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (c e : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcq : c ≤ q)
    (s : ℕ) (hpS : p ≤ s) (hAS : A.size ≤ s) (hBS : B.size ≤ s)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree))))
    (hR : ∀ y : B.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.rowHoles y).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles y).conditionalAverage (H.rowHoles y).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.rowCount y*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles y).cost))
    (hC : ∀ x : A.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.columnHoles x).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles x).conditionalAverage (H.columnHoles x).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.columnCount x*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles x).cost)) :
    let X
proof:
:= H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)
    let Y := H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)
    let P := ρ.projector (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree))
    (Matrix.trace (((Y*P*X).conjTranspose*(Y*P*X))^q)).re ≤
      Real.exp (-c*Real.log ρ.dimension+e*h*(Real.log A.size+Real.log B.size)-H.cost+c*h+
        (((2*q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*((A.size+B.size)*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ)+
          c*((A.size+B.size)*(41*p^2) : ℕ))*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ)) := by
  dsimp only
  let : NeZero (Fintype.card B.Slot) := ⟨Fintype.card_ne_zero⟩
  let ER := e*h*Real.log A.size-(∑ y, (H.rowHoles y).cost)+
    ((B.size*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ)
  let EC := e*h*Real.log B.size-(∑ x, (H.columnHoles x).cost)+
    ((A.size*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ):ℝ)*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ)
  have hr := H.row_child_hook_bound (p := p) (eF := eF) (hf := hf) (z := z) (q := q) (c := c) (e := e) (s := s) hq hAS hR
  have hc' := H.column_child_hook_bound (p := p) (eF := eF) (hf := hf) (z := z) (q := q) (c := c) (e := e) (s := s) hq hBS hC
  have hh := labeled_projected_moment_bound H.rowIndex H.columnIndex H.row_column_index_injective eF s hp hpS
    (fun i => (H.row_size_le i).trans hAS) (fun i => (H.column_size_le i).trans hBS)
    ρ q hq c ER EC hc hcq (H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF))
      (H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p eF)) hr hc'
  apply hh.trans_eq
  congr 1
  dsimp [ER,EC]
  rw [H.cost_split]
  simp only [card_slot]

  have hm : ((B.size:ℝ)*A.size-Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)=(h:ℝ) := by
    rw [H.card_freeAt]
    have hh : h ≤ (concat A B).size := by
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,card_slot] using Fintype.card_le_of_injective (H.path · 0) (H.disjoint 0)
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hh]
    simp only [concat_size,Nat.cast_mul]
    ring
  rw [hm]
  push_cast
  ring

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.junction_projector_commute_column
statement:
lemma junction_projector_commute_column (p : ℕ) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) :
    ρ.projector (action p _) * H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)=
      H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e) * ρ.projector (action p _)
proof:
:= by
  exact ρ.projector_commute_average (action p _)
    (fun ω : H.ColumnChoices => ((∏ x, B.choiceWeight z (ω x).val/(H.columnHoles x).probability z : ℝ) : ℂ))
    (fun ω => e.symm.permCongrHom (H.junctionFreeEquiv (H.columnResidual hf ω)))

/- The exact projected tensor moment on the literal junction board equals
its genuine Hom multiplicity times the main theorem's conditional moment. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.junction_projected_moment
statement:
theorem junction_projected_moment (p : ℕ) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    let X
proof:
:= H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    let Y := H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
    let P := ρ.projector (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree))
    (Matrix.trace (((Y*P*X).conjTranspose*(Y*P*X))^q)).re =
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) : ℝ) *
        schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z (ρ.pullback (H.junctionChart hf e))) := by
  dsimp only
  let w : {ω : (concat A B).Choices // H.Compatible ω} → ℂ := fun ω =>
    (((concat A B).choiceWeight z ω.val/H.probability z : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let g := fun ω => H.junctionChart hf e (H.residual hf ω)
  have ha : averageMatrix (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)) w g =
      H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)*H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e) :=
    H.junction_average_split hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)
  have hb : averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g=H.conditionalAverage hf z (ρ.pullback (H.junctionChart hf e)) := by
    rw [H.conditionalAverage_eq_sum]
    rfl
  have he := ρ.projected_operator_moment (action p _) (fun σ => (matrix_inv σ).symm) w g hq
  have hc : ρ.projector (action p _)*averageMatrix (action p _) w g=
      H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)*ρ.projector (action p _)*
        H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e) := by
    rw [ha,← mul_assoc,H.junction_projector_commute_column]
  rw [hc] at he
  have hre := congrArg Complex.re he
  simp only [Complex.mul_re,Complex.natCast_re,Complex.natCast_im,zero_mul,sub_zero] at hre
  calc
    _ = _ * schattenMoment q (averageMatrix ρ.matrix w g) := hre
    _ = _ := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin ρ.dimension) (Fin ρ.dimension) ℂ =>
      (Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
        (matrixRepresentation (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) : ℝ)*schattenMoment q M) hb

/- Hook occurrence removes the multiplicity without normalizing the trace. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.conditional_hook_moment_le_projected
statement:
theorem conditional_hook_moment_le_projected (p : ℕ) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree) (z : ℝ)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) {q : ℕ} (hq : q ≠ 0)
    (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ Boxes μ)
    (hρ : hasShape μ t ρ.asRepresentation) (hhook : Hook μ p) :
    schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z (ρ.pullback (H.junctionChart hf e))) ≤
      (Matrix.trace (((H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)*
        ρ.projector (action p _)*H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)).conjTranspose*
        (H.columnAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)*
        ρ.projector (action p _)*H.rowAverage hf z (H.junctionTensorAction p e)))^q)).re
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.junction_projected_moment p hf e z ρ hq]
  have hn := hook_multiplicity_pos ρ t hρ hhook
  have hr : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (ρ.asRepresentation.IntertwiningMap
      (matrixRepresentation (action p (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree)))) := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have ht := trace_moment_nonneg (H.conditionalAverage hf z (ρ.pullback (H.junctionChart hf e))) q
  exact (one_mul _).symm.le.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr ht)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.grid_conditional_hook_bound
statement:
theorem grid_conditional_hook_bound (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (eF : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ H.JunctionFree) (hf : H.Feasible)
    (z : ℝ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (c e : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hcq : c ≤ q)
    (s : ℕ) (hpS : p ≤ s) (hAS : A.size ≤ s) (hBS : B.size ≤ s)
    (ρ : UnitaryIrrep (Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree))))
    (hR : ∀ y : B.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.rowHoles y).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.rowHoles y).conditionalAverage (H.rowHoles y).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.rowCount y*Real.log A.size-(H.rowHoles y).cost))
    (hC : ∀ x : A.Slot, ∀ σ : UnitaryIrrep (H.columnHoles x).stabilizer,
      schattenMoment q ((H.columnHoles x).conditionalAverage (H.columnHoles x).feasible_of_disjoint z σ) ≤
        Real.exp (-c*Real.log σ.dimension+e*H.columnCount x*Real.log B.size-(H.columnHoles x).cost))
    (μ : YoungDiagram) (t : Fin (Fintype.card H.JunctionFree) ≃ Boxes μ)
    (hρ : hasShape μ t ρ.asRepresentation) (hhook : Hook μ p) :
    schattenMoment q (H.conditionalAverage hf z (ρ.pullback (H.junctionChart hf eF))) ≤
      Real.exp (-c*Real.log ρ.dimension+e*h*(Real.log A.size+Real.log B.size)-H.cost+c*h+
        (((2*q+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)*((A.size+B.size)*((2*p)*(2*p)) : ℕ)+
          c*((A.size+B.size)*(41*p^2) : ℕ))*Real.log (s+1 : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  exact (H.conditional_hook_moment_le_projected p hf eF z ρ hq.ne' μ t hρ hhook).trans
    (H.grid_projected_hook_bound p hp eF hf z q hq c e hc hcq s hpS hAS hBS ρ hR hC)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pathBetween_zero (x y : G.Slot) : G.pathBetween x y 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [pathBetween]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_last (x y : G.Slot) :
    G.pathBetween x y (Fin.last G.b) = y
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  simp [pathBetween, j.isLt]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_input
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_input (x y : G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc j = x j
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathBetween]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_output
statement:
@[simp] theorem pathBetween_output (x y : G.Slot) (j : Fin G.b) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.succ j = y j
proof:
:= by
  simp [pathBetween]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.pathBetween_step
statement:
theorem pathBetween_step (x y : G.Slot) (j k : Fin G.b) (hne : k ≠ j) :
    G.pathBetween x y j.succ k = G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc k
proof:
:= by
  have hne' : k.val ≠ j.val := fun he => hne (Fin.ext he)
  simp only [pathBetween, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
  have hi : k.val < j.val+1 ↔ k.val < j.val := by omega
  simp only [hi]

/- The stage-decorated line used by the auxiliary trajectory. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineCompatible_of_empty
statement:
theorem lineCompatible_of_empty (H : G.Holes h) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (he : ∀ i, ¬ H.OnLine j L i) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    H.LineCompatible j L σ
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact (he i.val i.property).elim

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_no_paths
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_no_paths (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (he : ∀ i, ¬ H.OnLine j L i)
    (ha : ∀ i ∈ A, G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ σ, G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ := by
    intro σ i hi hL
    exact (ha i hi hL).elim
  simp [localExtraProbability, H.lineCompatible_of_empty j L he, hr, μ.sum_mass]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraLineEvent_insert
statement:
theorem extraLineEvent_insert {G : Grid} {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    G.extraLineEvent x y (insert i A) j L σ ↔
      ((G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j = L → σ (x i j) = y i j) ∧
        G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [extraLineEvent]

/- The source's one-card marginal property, stated for a line law. This is
proved for both U and the actual binary law below, not a main-proof assumption. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraLineEvent_insert_off
statement:
theorem extraLineEvent_insert_off {G : Grid} {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (hne : G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) :
    G.extraLineEvent x y (insert i A) j L σ ↔ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [extraLineEvent_insert]
  simp [hne]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_insert_off
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_insert_off (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (j : Fin G.b) (L : G.Line j)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hne : G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j ≠ L) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j L μ =
      H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localExtraProbability, extraLineEvent_insert_off x y A i j L hne]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.localExtraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem localExtraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i) (j : Fin G.b)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (hμ : OneCardUniform μ) :
    H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j (G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j) μ =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have he : ∀ σ, H.LineCompatible j (G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j) σ :=
    H.lineCompatible_of_empty j _ (his.1 j)
  have ha : ∀ σ, G.extraLineEvent x y A j (G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j) σ := by
    intro σ a ha hL
    exact (his.2 j a (by intro he; subst a; exact hi ha) hL).elim
  simp only [localExtraProbability, he, true_and, extraLineEvent_insert, ha,
    and_true, true_implies, ite_true, μ.sum_mass, div_one]
  exact hμ (x i j) (y i j)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.stageExtraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem stageExtraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i) (j : Fin G.b)
    (μ : FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) (hμ : OneCardUniform μ) :
    (∏ L : G.Line j, H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j L μ) =
      (2^G.bits j : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∏ L : G.Line j, H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ
proof:
:= by
  let L₀ := G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j
  have hs := H.localExtraProbability_isolated_insert x y A i hi his j μ hμ
  have he : H.localExtraProbability x y A j L₀ μ = 1 := by
    apply H.localExtraProbability_no_paths x y A j L₀ μ (his.1 j)
    intro a ha
    exact his.2 j a (by intro he; subst a; exact hi ha)
  have hprod : (∏ L ∈ Finset.univ.erase L₀, H.localExtraProbability x y (insert i A) j L μ) =
      ∏ L ∈ Finset.univ.erase L₀, H.localExtraProbability x y A j L μ := by
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro L hL
    exact H.localExtraProbability_insert_off x y A i j L μ
      (Ne.symm (Finset.mem_erase.mp hL).1)
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ L₀),
    ← Finset.mul_prod_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ L₀), hs, he, one_mul, hprod]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_isolated_insert
statement:
theorem extraProbability_isolated_insert (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) (hi : i ∉ A)
    (his : H.LineIsolated x y i)
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hμ : ∀ j, OneCardUniform (μ j)) :
    H.extraProbability x y (insert i A) μ =
      (G.size : ℝ)⁻¹ * H.extraProbability x y A μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold extraProbability
  simp_rw [H.stageExtraProbability_isolated_insert x y A i hi his _ _ (hμ _)]
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
  congr 1
  simp [size, Nat.cast_prod, Nat.cast_pow]

/- Elementary pairing identity for the alternating sum. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.alternating_cancel
statement:
lemma alternating_cancel {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι) (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s)
    (P : Finset ι → ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ A ⊆ s.erase i, P (insert i A) = P A) :
    ∑ A ∈ s.powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card * P A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : s = insert i (s.erase i) := (Finset.insert_erase hi).symm
  rw [hs, Finset.sum_powerset_insert (Finset.notMem_erase i s)]
  have hh : (∑ A ∈ (s.erase i).powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ (insert i A).card * P (insert i A)) =
      -(∑ A ∈ (s.erase i).powerset, (-1 : ℝ) ^ A.card * P A) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hsub : A ⊆ s.erase i := Finset.mem_powerset.mp hA
    have hni : i ∉ A := fun hh => Finset.notMem_erase i s (hsub hh)
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hni, hP A hsub, pow_succ]
    ring
  rw [hh]
  ring

/- Isolated-path cancellation for the actual product conditional kernel.
There is no independence assumption between auxiliary particle factors. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.placementKernel_eq_zero_of_isolated
statement:
theorem placementKernel_eq_zero_of_isolated (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (i : Fin k) (his : H.LineIsolated x y i)
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (hμ : ∀ j, OneCardUniform (μ j)) : H.placementKernel x y μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsize : (G.size : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    exact_mod_cast (Finset.prod_pos (fun j _ => pow_pos (by decide : 0 < (2:ℕ)) _))
  have hc := alternating_cancel (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)) i (Finset.mem_univ _)
    (fun A => (G.size : ℝ)^A.card * H.extraProbability x y A μ) (by
      intro A hA
      have hi : i ∉ A := fun hi => Finset.notMem_erase i _ (hA hi)
      rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hi, pow_succ,
        H.extraProbability_isolated_insert x y A i hi his μ hμ]
      field_simp)
  have he : (∑ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ)^(k-A.card) * (G.size : ℝ)^A.card * H.extraProbability x y A μ) =
      (-1 : ℝ)^k * ∑ A ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).powerset,
        (-1 : ℝ)^A.card * ((G.size : ℝ)^A.card * H.extraProbability x y A μ) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro A hA
    have hAk : A.card ≤ k := by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ A
    have hp : (-1 : ℝ)^(k-A.card) = (-1 : ℝ)^k * (-1 : ℝ)^A.card := by
      have h := pow_add (-1 : ℝ) (k-A.card) A.card
      rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hAk] at h
      have hsq : (-1 : ℝ)^A.card * (-1 : ℝ)^A.card = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow]
        norm_num
      rw [h, mul_assoc, hsq, mul_one]
    rw [hp]
    ring
  rw [placementKernel, he, hc, mul_zero, mul_zero]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_coordinate_before
statement:
theorem boundary_coordinate_before (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (k : Fin G.b)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ k.val) : G.boundary ω t x k = x k
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    have htb : t < G.b := by omega
    rw [G.boundary_succ ω htb]
    change G.stage ω ⟨t,htb⟩ (G.boundary ω t x) k = _
    rw [G.stage_apply_ne ω _ k (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; dsimp at this; omega)]
    exact ih (by omega)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_coordinate_stable
statement:
theorem boundary_coordinate_stable (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (k : Fin G.b)
    (u v : ℕ) (hku : k.val < u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvb : v ≤ G.b) :
    G.boundary ω v x k = G.boundary ω u x k
proof:
:= by
  induction v, huv using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ v huv ih =>
    have hvb' : v < G.b := by omega
    rw [G.boundary_succ ω hvb']
    change G.stage ω ⟨v,hvb'⟩ (G.boundary ω v x) k = _
    rw [G.stage_apply_ne ω _ k (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; dsimp at this; omega)]
    exact ih (by omega)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.boundary_eq_pathBetween
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_pathBetween (ω : G.Choices) (x : G.Slot) (t : Fin (G.b+1)) :
    G.boundary ω t x = G.pathBetween x (G.sweep ω x) t
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold pathBetween
  split_ifs with hkt
  · exact (G.boundary_coordinate_stable ω x k t G.b hkt (by omega) le_rfl).symm
  · exact G.boundary_coordinate_before ω x k t (by omega)

/- Actual endpoint events are exactly the auxiliary path constraints. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments
statement:
theorem sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments (ω : G.Choices) (x y : G.Slot) :
    G.sweep ω x = y ↔
      ∀ j, ω j (G.pathLine x y j) (x j) = y j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hxy j
    have hs := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm G.Slot => p x j)
      (G.boundary_succ ω j.isLt)
    change G.boundary ω (j.val+1) x j = G.stage ω j (G.boundary ω j x) j at hs
    rw [show G.boundary ω (j.val+1) x = G.pathBetween x y j.succ by
      simpa [hxy] using G.boundary_eq_pathBetween ω x j.succ,
      show G.boundary ω j.val x = G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc by
      simpa [hxy] using G.boundary_eq_pathBetween ω x j.castSucc] at hs
    change (ω j (fun k => G.pathBetween x y j.castSucc k)) (x j) = y j
    simpa only [G.stage_apply_same, G.pathBetween_input, G.pathBetween_output] using hs.symm
  · intro hxy
    have hb : ∀ t (ht : t ≤ G.b),
        G.boundary ω t x = G.pathBetween x y ⟨t,by omega⟩ := by
      intro t
      induction t with
      | zero => intro ht; simp
      | succ t ih =>
        intro ht
        have htb : t < G.b := by omega
        rw [G.boundary_succ ω htb]
        change G.stage ω ⟨t,htb⟩ (G.boundary ω t x) = _
        rw [ih (by omega)]
        funext k
        by_cases hkt : k = ⟨t,htb⟩
        · subst k
          have hi := hxy ⟨t,htb⟩
          change ω ⟨t,htb⟩ (fun k => G.pathBetween x y ⟨t,by omega⟩ k) (x ⟨t,htb⟩) = y ⟨t,htb⟩ at hi
          simpa only [stage_apply_same, pathBetween, Fin.val_mk, lt_self_iff_false,
            ite_false, Nat.lt_succ_self, ite_true] using hi
        · rw [G.stage_apply_ne ω _ k hkt]
          exact (G.pathBetween_step x y ⟨t,htb⟩ k hkt).symm
    have hh := hb G.b le_rfl
    change G.sweep ω x = G.pathBetween x y (Fin.last G.b) at hh
    rw [G.pathBetween_last] at hh
    exact hh

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.endpointEvent_iff_lines
statement:
theorem endpointEvent_iff_lines {k : ℕ} (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k)) (ω : G.Choices) :
    G.endpointEvent x y A ω ↔ ∀ j L, G.extraLineEvent x y A j L (ω j L)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he j L i hi hL
    have h := (G.sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments ω (x i) (y i)).mp (he i hi) j
    simpa [hL] using h
  · intro he i hi
    apply (G.sweep_eq_iff_line_assignments ω (x i) (y i)).mpr
    intro j
    exact he j (G.pathLine (x i) (y i) j) i hi rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.sum_prod_ite_all
statement:
theorem sum_prod_ite_all {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (X i)]
    (w : ∀ i, X i → ℝ) (P : ∀ i, X i → Prop) :
    (∑ x : ∀ i, X i, if ∀ i, P i (x i) then ∏ i, w i (x i) else 0) =
      ∏ i, ∑ y, if P i y then w i y else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.prod_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  by_cases hx : ∀ i, P i (x i)
  · simp [hx]
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.mp hx
    rw [ite_eq_right hx]
    symm
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    simp [hi]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.sum_productLineMass_event
statement:
theorem sum_productLineMass_event
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))))
    (P : ∀ j : Fin G.b, G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)) → Prop) :
    (∑ ω, if ∀ j L, P j L (ω j L) then G.productLineMass μ ω else 0) =
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if P j L σ then μ j σ else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold productLineMass
  calc
    _ = ∏ j, ∑ ω : G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)),
        if ∀ L, P j L (ω L) then ∏ L, μ j (ω L) else 0 := by
      convert sum_prod_ite_all
        (fun j (ω : G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) => ∏ L, μ j (ω L))
        (fun j (ω : G.Line j → Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j))) => ∀ L, P j L (ω L)) using 1 <;>
        congr!
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro j _
      convert sum_prod_ite_all (fun _ σ => μ j σ) (P j) using 1

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.extraProbability_eq_conditionalEndpoint
statement:
theorem extraProbability_eq_conditionalEndpoint (H : G.Holes h) (x y : Fin k → G.Slot)
    (A : Finset (Fin k))
    (μ : ∀ j : Fin G.b, FiniteLaw (Equiv.Perm (Cube (G.bits j)))) :
    H.extraProbability x y A μ = H.conditionalEndpointProbability x y A μ
proof:
:= by
  have he : ∀ ω : G.Choices,
      H.Compatible ω ∧ G.endpointEvent x y A ω ↔
        ∀ j L, H.LineCompatible j L (ω j L) ∧ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L (ω j L) := by
    intro ω
    rw [H.compatible_iff_lines, G.endpointEvent_iff_lines]
    constructor
    · intro h j L
      exact ⟨h.1 j L, h.2 j L⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨fun j L => (h j L).1, fun j L => (h j L).2⟩
  unfold conditionalEndpointProbability
  simp only [he]
  simp only [H.compatible_iff_lines]
  have hn : (∑ ω : G.Choices,
      if ∀ j L, H.LineCompatible j L (ω j L) ∧ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L (ω j L)
      then G.productLineMass μ ω else 0) =
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if H.LineCompatible j L σ ∧ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ
        then μ j σ else 0 := by
    convert G.sum_productLineMass_event μ (fun j L σ =>
      H.LineCompatible j L σ ∧ G.extraLineEvent x y A j L σ) using 1 <;>
      congr!
  have hd : (∑ ω : G.Choices, if ∀ j L, H.LineCompatible j L (ω j L)
      then G.productLineMass μ ω else 0) =
      ∏ j, ∏ L, ∑ σ, if H.LineCompatible j L σ then μ j σ else 0 := by
    convert G.sum_productLineMass_event μ H.LineCompatible using 1
  rw [hn, hd]
  simp only [extraProbability, localExtraProbability, Finset.prod_div_distrib]

/- At the source law, the denominator in the direct event formula is exactly
the source normalizer (with all prescribed paths, not just endpoints). -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.Grid.Holes.lineMass_hole_normalizer
statement:
theorem lineMass_hole_normalizer (H : G.Holes h) {z : ℝ}
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hz' : z ≤ 1) :
    (∑ ω, if H.Compatible ω then
      G.productLineMass (fun j => lineLaw (G.bits j) z hz hz') ω else 0) =
      H.probability z
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact sum_subtype_eq_sum_ite_of_iff (fun _ => Iff.rfl) (G.choiceWeight z)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryBoundary_zero {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) :
    binaryBoundary bits 0 = 1
proof: := by simp [binaryBoundary]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryBoundary_last {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) :
    binaryBoundary bits d = binarySweep d bits
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binaryBoundary, binarySweep, orderedProduct]
  rw [List.take_of_length_le (by simp)]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_succ
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_succ {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    binaryBoundary bits (t+1) = binaryLayer ⟨t,ht⟩ (bits ⟨t,ht⟩) * binaryBoundary bits t
proof:
:= by
  unfold binaryBoundary
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by simpa using ht)]
  simp [List.reverse_append]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryLayer_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem binaryLayer_apply_same {d : ℕ} (j : Fin d)
    (bits : ({k : Fin d // k ≠ j} → Bool) → Bool) (x : Cube d) :
    binaryLayer j bits x j = Bool.xor (x j) (bits (fun k => x k))
proof:
:= by
  simp [binaryLayer, pairSwitch, Equiv.funSplitAt_apply, Equiv.funSplitAt_symm_apply]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryLayer_apply_ne
statement:
theorem binaryLayer_apply_ne {d : ℕ} (j k : Fin d) (hne : k ≠ j)
    (bits : ({k : Fin d // k ≠ j} → Bool) → Bool) (x : Cube d) :
    binaryLayer j bits x k = x k
proof:
:= by
  simp [binaryLayer, pairSwitch, Equiv.funSplitAt_apply, Equiv.funSplitAt_symm_apply, hne]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryPath_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem binaryPath_zero {d : ℕ} (x y : Cube d) : binaryPath x y 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp [binaryPath]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryPath_last
statement: @[simp] theorem binaryPath_last {d : ℕ} (x y : Cube d) : binaryPath x y d = y
proof:
:= by
  funext k; simp [binaryPath, k.isLt]

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_before
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_before {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d) (k : Fin d)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ k.val) : binaryBoundary bits t x k = x k
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp
  | succ t ih =>
    have htb : t < d := by omega
    rw [binaryBoundary_succ bits htb]
    change binaryLayer ⟨t,htb⟩ (bits ⟨t,htb⟩) (binaryBoundary bits t x) k = _
    rw [binaryLayer_apply_ne _ k (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; dsimp at this; omega)]
    exact ih (by omega)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_stable
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_stable {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d) (k : Fin d)
    (u v : ℕ) (hku : k.val < u) (huv : u ≤ v) (hvd : v ≤ d) :
    binaryBoundary bits v x k = binaryBoundary bits u x k
proof:
:= by
  induction v, huv using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rfl
  | succ v huv ih =>
    have hvd' : v < d := by omega
    rw [binaryBoundary_succ bits hvd']
    change binaryLayer ⟨v,hvd'⟩ (bits ⟨v,hvd'⟩) (binaryBoundary bits v x) k = _
    rw [binaryLayer_apply_ne _ k (by intro he; have := congrArg Fin.val he; dsimp at this; omega)]
    exact ih (by omega)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binaryBoundary_eq_path
statement:
theorem binaryBoundary_eq_path {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x : Cube d)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ d) :
    binaryBoundary bits t x = binaryPath x (binarySweep d bits x) t
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold binaryPath
  split_ifs with hkt
  · simpa using (binaryBoundary_stable bits x k t d hkt ht le_rfl).symm
  · exact binaryBoundary_before bits x k t (by omega)

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.binarySweep_eq_iff_coins
statement:
theorem binarySweep_eq_iff_coins {d : ℕ} (bits : BinaryChoices d) (x y : Cube d) :
    binarySweep d bits x = y ↔
      ∀ j, bits j (binaryPathLine x y j) = Bool.xor (x j) (y j)
proof:
:= by
  have hxor : ∀ a b c : Bool, Bool.xor a b = c ↔ b = Bool.xor a c := by decide
  constructor
  · intro hxy j
    have hs := congrArg (fun p : Equiv.Perm (Cube d) => p x j)
      (binaryBoundary_succ bits j.isLt)
    change binaryBoundary bits (j.val+1) x j =
      binaryLayer j (bits j) (binaryBoundary bits j.val x) j at hs
    rw [binaryBoundary_eq_path bits x (j.val+1) (by omega),
      binaryBoundary_eq_path bits x j.val (by omega), hxy,
      binaryLayer_apply_same] at hs
    have hh : Bool.xor (x j) (bits j (binaryPathLine x y j)) = y j := by
      change Bool.xor (x j) (bits j (fun k => if k.val.val < j.val then y k else x k)) = y j
      simpa only [binaryPath, Nat.lt_succ_self, ite_true, lt_self_iff_false, ite_false] using hs.symm
    exact (hxor _ _ _).mp hh
  · intro hxy
    have hb : ∀ t (ht : t ≤ d), binaryBoundary bits t x = binaryPath x y t := by
      intro t
      induction t with
      | zero => intro ht; simp
      | succ t ih =>
        intro ht
        have htd : t < d := by omega
        rw [binaryBoundary_succ bits htd]
        change binaryLayer ⟨t,htd⟩ (bits ⟨t,htd⟩) (binaryBoundary bits t x) = _
        rw [ih (by omega)]
        funext k
        by_cases hkt : k = ⟨t,htd⟩
        · subst k
          rw [binaryLayer_apply_same]
          have hi := (hxor _ _ _).mpr (hxy ⟨t,htd⟩)
          change Bool.xor (x ⟨t,htd⟩) (bits ⟨t,htd⟩ (fun k => if k.val.val < t then y k else x k)) = y ⟨t,htd⟩ at hi
          simpa only [binaryPath, Nat.lt_succ_self, ite_true, lt_self_iff_false, ite_false] using hi
        · rw [binaryLayer_apply_ne _ k hkt]
          have hne : k.val ≠ t := fun he => hkt (Fin.ext he)
          simp only [binaryPath]
          have he : k.val < t+1 ↔ k.val < t := by omega
          simp [he]
    simpa using hb d le_rfl

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_pi
statement:
theorem uniform_pi {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    {X : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Fintype (X i)] [∀ i, Nonempty (X i)] :
    uniform (∀ i, X i) = independent (fun i => uniform (X i))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (Fintype.card (∀ i, X i) : ℝ)⁻¹ = ∏ i, (Fintype.card (X i) : ℝ)⁻¹
  simp [Fintype.card_pi, Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_inv_distrib]

/- One specified coordinate of a uniform random function is uniform. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.uniform_eval
statement:
theorem uniform_eval {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [Nonempty B] (a : A) (b : B) :
    (∑ f : A → B, if f a = b then uniform (A → B) f else 0) =
      (Fintype.card B : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let e := Equiv.funSplitAt a B
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e.symm]
  have hc : Fintype.card (A → B) = Fintype.card B * Fintype.card ({j : A // j ≠ a} → B) := by
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
  simp only [uniform_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, e, Equiv.funSplitAt_symm_apply]
  rw [hc, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hB : (Fintype.card B : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hA : (Fintype.card ({j : A // j ≠ a} → B) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp
  simp

/- Exact pushforward probability identity. -/

name: OAI.CoordinateSweeps.FiniteLaw.map_event
statement:
theorem map_event {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (μ : FiniteLaw A) (f : A → B) (P : B → Prop) :
