      _ = _ := by simp
  have hright : (∫ s in c..(1:ℝ), (⌊u+s⌋ : ℝ)) = (1-c) * ((⌊u⌋ : ℝ)+1) := by
    calc
      _ = ∫ _ in c..(1:ℝ), ((⌊u⌋ : ℝ)+1) := by
        apply intervalIntegral.integral_congr_Ioo_of_le hc1
        intro s hs
        dsimp only
        have he : ⌊u+s⌋ = ⌊u⌋ + 1 := Int.floor_eq_iff.mpr ⟨by push_cast; dsimp [c] at hs; linarith [hs.1], by push_cast; linarith [Int.fract_lt_one u, hs.2]⟩
        rw [he]; push_cast; rfl
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals
    ((floor_shift_monotone u).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := c))
    ((floor_shift_monotone u).intervalIntegrable (μ := volume) (a := c) (b := 1)), hleft, hright]
  dsimp [c]
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_nonneg
statement: lemma separated_nonneg (u v s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ separated u v s
proof: := by unfold separated; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_le_one
statement: lemma separated_le_one (u v s : ℝ) : separated u v s ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold separated; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_symm
statement: lemma separated_symm (u v s : ℝ) : separated u v s = separated v u s
proof: := by simp [separated, eq_comm]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_measurable
statement: lemma separated_measurable (u v : ℝ) : Measurable (separated u v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold separated
  exact measurable_const.ite (measurableSet_eq_fun ((measurable_const.add measurable_id).floor)
    ((measurable_const.add measurable_id).floor)) measurable_const

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_integrable
statement: lemma separated_integrable (u v a b : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable (separated u v) volume a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (intervalIntegrable_const (c := (1:ℝ))).mono_fun' (separated_measurable u v).aestronglyMeasurable
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => by dsimp only; rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (separated_nonneg u v s)]; exact separated_le_one u v s

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.separated_le_floor_sub
statement:
lemma separated_le_floor_sub {u v : ℝ} (huv : u ≤ v) (s : ℝ) :
    separated u v s ≤ (⌊v+s⌋ : ℝ) - (⌊u+s⌋ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold separated
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]; simp
  · have hle : ⌊u+s⌋ ≤ ⌊v+s⌋ := Int.floor_mono (by linarith)
    have hlt : ⌊u+s⌋ + 1 ≤ ⌊v+s⌋ := by omega
    exact_mod_cast (show (1:ℤ) ≤ ⌊v+s⌋ - ⌊u+s⌋ by omega)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_separated_le
statement:
lemma integral_separated_le {u v : ℝ} :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, separated u v s) ≤ |u-v|
proof:
:= by
  wlog huv : u ≤ v generalizing u v
  · rw [show separated u v = separated v u by funext s; exact separated_symm _ _ _]
    simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using this (le_of_not_ge huv)
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, ((⌊v+s⌋ : ℝ) - (⌊u+s⌋ : ℝ)) := by
      apply intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (by norm_num) (separated_integrable _ _ _ _)
        (((floor_shift_monotone v).intervalIntegrable).sub ((floor_shift_monotone u).intervalIntegrable))
      intro s _
      exact separated_le_floor_sub huv s
    _ = v-u := by rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
      ((floor_shift_monotone v).intervalIntegrable) ((floor_shift_monotone u).intervalIntegrable),
      integral_floor_shift, integral_floor_shift]
    _ = |u-v| := by rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]; ring

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binEnvelope_nonneg
statement:
lemma binEnvelope_nonneg {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (ε s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ binEnvelope a b ε s
proof:
:= by
  unfold binEnvelope
  exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (by positivity) (separated_nonneg _ _ _))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binEnvelope_integrable
statement:
lemma binEnvelope_integrable (a b ε l r : ℝ) :
    IntervalIntegrable (binEnvelope a b ε) volume l r
proof:
:= by
  exact intervalIntegrable_const.add ((separated_integrable _ _ _ _).const_mul _)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.log_difference_bound
statement:
lemma log_difference_bound {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    a * (Real.log b - Real.log a) ≤ b-a
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le ha hab
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hb ha)
  rw [Real.log_div hb.ne' ha.ne'] at h
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h ha.le
  calc
    _ ≤ a*(b/a-1) := hh
    _ = b-a := by field_simp

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.logarithmic_envelope_bound
statement:
lemma logarithmic_envelope_bound {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (a-b)^2 + 2*a*b*(|Real.log a-Real.log b|/ε) ≤ 3/ε * |a-b| * (a+b)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hab : a ≤ b generalizing a b
  · have hh := this hb ha (le_of_not_ge hab)
    simpa only [abs_sub_comm b a, abs_sub_comm (Real.log b) (Real.log a),
      add_comm b a, sub_sq_comm b a, mul_right_comm (2:ℝ) b a] using hh
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab)]
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · subst a
    simp only [zero_sub, neg_neg, zero_mul, mul_zero, zero_add, neg_sq, add_zero]
    apply (le_mul_of_one_le_left (sq_nonneg b) (show 1 ≤ 3/ε by apply (le_div_iff₀ hε).mpr; linarith)).trans_eq
    ring
  have hap : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
  have hbp : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le hap hab
  rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (Real.log_le_log hap hab))]
  have hl := log_difference_bound hap hab
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hl (show 0 ≤ 2*b by positivity)
  have hsq : (a-b)^2 ≤ (b-a)*(a+b) := by nlinarith
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right hε).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hε1 (sq_nonneg (a-b)), mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_binEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma integral_binEnvelope_le {a b ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, binEnvelope a b ε s) ≤ 3/ε * |a-b| * (a+b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ (a-b)^2 + 2*a*b*(|Real.log a-Real.log b|/ε) := by
      unfold binEnvelope
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add intervalIntegrable_const
        ((separated_integrable _ _ _ _).const_mul _), intervalIntegral.integral_const,
        intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
      simp only [sub_zero, one_smul]
      apply add_le_add_right
      have hi := integral_separated_le (u := Real.log a/ε) (v := Real.log b/ε)
      rw [← sub_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos hε] at hi
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi (by positivity)
    _ ≤ _ := logarithmic_envelope_bound ha hb hε hε1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binWeight_nonneg
statement: lemma binWeight_nonneg (a ε s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ binWeight a ε s
proof:
:= by
  unfold binWeight; split <;> positivity

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binWeight_le
statement:
lemma binWeight_le {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) :
    binWeight a ε s ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  unfold binWeight
  split_ifs with hap
  · apply le_trans (b := Real.exp (Real.log a))
    · apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      have hf := Int.floor_le (Real.log a/ε+s)
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hf hε.le
      have he : ε*(Real.log a/ε+s) = Real.log a + ε*s := by field_simp
      linarith
    · exact (Real.exp_log hap).le
  · exact ha

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.sub_binWeight_le
statement:
lemma sub_binWeight_le {a ε : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) :
    a - binWeight a ε s ≤ ε*a
proof:
:= by
  unfold binWeight
  split_ifs with hap
  · have hf := Int.lt_floor_add_one (Real.log a/ε+s)
    have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hf hε
    have he : ε*(Real.log a/ε+s) = Real.log a + ε*s := by field_simp
    have hex : Real.exp (Real.log a - ε) ≤ Real.exp (ε*((⌊Real.log a/ε+s⌋ : ℝ)-s)) :=
      Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
    rw [Real.exp_sub, Real.exp_log hap] at hex
    have hex' : (1-ε)*a ≤ a / Real.exp ε := by
      have hh := Real.add_one_le_exp (-ε)
      rw [Real.exp_neg] at hh
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hh ha
      simpa only [neg_add_eq_sub, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hmul
    linarith
  · have : a = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hap) ha
    simp [this]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.unitary_row_normSq
statement:
lemma unitary_row_normSq {U : Matrix n n ℂ} (hU : U * Uᴴ = 1) (i : n) :
    ∑ j, Complex.normSq (U i j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Complex.re (congrFun (congrFun hU i) i)
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq,
    Complex.re_sum, Complex.one_re, Complex.star_def, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.ofReal_re] using h

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.unitary_col_normSq
statement:
lemma unitary_col_normSq {U : Matrix n n ℂ} (hU : Uᴴ * U = 1) (j : n) :
    ∑ i, Complex.normSq (U i j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Complex.star_def, Complex.normSq_conj] using
    unitary_row_normSq (U := Uᴴ) (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hU) j

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_cfc_eq
statement:
lemma hsSq_cfc_eq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    hsSq (cfc f A) = ∑ i, (f (hA.eigenvalues i))^2
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ := hA.eigenvectorUnitary
  have hU : Uᴴ * U = 1 := Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem hA.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  have he : cfc f A = U * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)) * Uᴴ := by
    erw [hA.cfc_eq]; rfl
  rw [he, hsSq_mul_right (U := Uᴴ) (by simpa only [Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose] using hU), hsSq_mul_left hU]
  unfold hsSq
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [Complex.normSq_ofReal, pow_two]
  · intro j _ hji
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ (Ne.symm hji), Complex.normSq_zero]
  · simp

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq
statement:
lemma hsSq_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    hsSq A = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i)^2
proof:
:= by
  have h := hsSq_cfc_eq hA (fun t => t)
  erw [cfc_id' ℝ A hA] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_nonneg
statement:
lemma overlap_nonneg {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i j : n) :
    0 ≤ overlap hA hB i j
proof: := Complex.normSq_nonneg _

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_row
statement:
lemma overlap_row {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (i : n) :
    ∑ j, overlap hA hB i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply unitary_row_normSq
  have h1 : (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * hA.eigenvectorUnitary = 1 :=
    Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem hA.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  have h2 : (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 :=
    Unitary.mul_star_self_of_mem hB.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ), h2, Matrix.one_mul, h1]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_col
statement:
lemma overlap_col {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) (j : n) :
    ∑ i, overlap hA hB i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply unitary_col_normSq
  have h1 : (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ) * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ = 1 :=
    Unitary.mul_star_self_of_mem hA.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  have h2 : (hB.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)ᴴ * hB.eigenvectorUnitary = 1 :=
    Unitary.star_mul_self_of_mem hB.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ), h1, Matrix.one_mul, h2]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_distance
statement:
lemma overlap_distance {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j)^2 * overlap hA hB i j) = hsSq (A-B)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hsSq_spectral_mixed hA hB (fun t => t) (fun t => t)
  erw [cfc_id' ℝ A hA, cfc_id' ℝ B hB] at h
  exact h.symm

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_square_sum_le
statement:
lemma overlap_square_sum_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (hA.eigenvalues i + hB.eigenvalues j)^2 * overlap hA hB i j) ≤
    2 * (hsSq A + hsSq B)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (2*(hA.eigenvalues i)^2 + 2*(hB.eigenvalues j)^2) * overlap hA hB i j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (hA.eigenvalues i-hB.eigenvalues j)]) (overlap_nonneg _ _ _ _)
    _ = _ := by
      simp_rw [add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => 2*(hB.eigenvalues j)^2 * overlap hA hB i j)]
      simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, overlap_row, overlap_col, mul_one]
      rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← hsSq_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq hA,
        ← hsSq_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq hB]
      ring

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.overlap_transport_le
statement:
lemma overlap_transport_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j| *
      (hA.eigenvalues i + hB.eigenvalues j) * overlap hA hB i j) ≤
      Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2 * (hsSq A + hsSq B))
proof:
:= by
  let r : n × n → ℝ := fun ij => |hA.eigenvalues ij.1 - hB.eigenvalues ij.2| *
    (hA.eigenvalues ij.1 + hB.eigenvalues ij.2) * overlap hA hB ij.1 ij.2
  let f : n × n → ℝ := fun ij => (hA.eigenvalues ij.1 - hB.eigenvalues ij.2)^2 * overlap hA hB ij.1 ij.2
  let g : n × n → ℝ := fun ij => (hA.eigenvalues ij.1 + hB.eigenvalues ij.2)^2 * overlap hA hB ij.1 ij.2
  have hc := Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul (Finset.univ : Finset (n × n))
    (r := r) (f := f) (g := g)
    (fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (overlap_nonneg _ _ _ _))
    (fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (overlap_nonneg _ _ _ _))
    (fun ij _ => by dsimp [r,f,g]; rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, sq_abs]; exact le_of_eq (by ring))
  have hf : ∑ ij, f ij = hsSq (A-B) := by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; exact overlap_distance hA hB
  have hg : ∑ ij, g ij ≤ 2 * (hsSq A + hsSq B) := by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; exact overlap_square_sum_le hA hB
  rw [hf] at hc
  have hbound := hc.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (hsSq_nonneg _))
  have hr : ∑ ij, r ij = ∑ i, ∑ j, |hA.eigenvalues i - hB.eigenvalues j| *
      (hA.eigenvalues i + hB.eigenvalues j) * overlap hA hB i j := by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [hr] at hbound
  have hprod : (Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2*(hsSq A+hsSq B)))^2 =
      hsSq (A-B)*(2*(hsSq A+hsSq B)) := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hsSq_nonneg _), Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith [hsSq_nonneg A, hsSq_nonneg B])]
  have hnon : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2*(hsSq A+hsSq B)) := by positivity
  rw [← hprod] at hbound
  exact le_of_sq_le_sq hbound hnon

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.spectralEnvelope_integrable
statement:
lemma spectralEnvelope_integrable {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (ε : ℝ) : IntervalIntegrable (spectralEnvelope hA hB ε) volume 0 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralEnvelope
  simpa only [Finset.sum_fn] using IntervalIntegrable.sum Finset.univ
    (fun i _ => IntervalIntegrable.sum Finset.univ
      (fun j _ => (binEnvelope_integrable (hA.eigenvalues i) (hB.eigenvalues j) ε 0 1).mul_const (overlap hA hB i j)))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_spectralEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma integral_spectralEnvelope_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, spectralEnvelope hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian ε s) ≤
    3/ε * (Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B)) * Real.sqrt (2*(hsSq A+hsSq B)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralEnvelope
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ =>
    (by simpa only [Finset.sum_fn] using IntervalIntegrable.sum Finset.univ (fun j _ => (binEnvelope_integrable (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) (hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues j) ε 0 1).mul_const (overlap hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian i j))))]
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun j _ => (binEnvelope_integrable _ _ _ _ _).mul_const _),
    intervalIntegral.integral_mul_const]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, ∑ j, (3/ε * |hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i-hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues j| *
        (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i+hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues j)) * overlap hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian i j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (integral_binEnvelope_le (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (hB.eigenvalues_nonneg j) hε hε1)
        (overlap_nonneg _ _ _ _)
    _ = (3/ε) * (∑ i, ∑ j, |hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i-hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues j| *
        (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i+hB.isHermitian.eigenvalues j) * overlap hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian i j) := by
      simp only [Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (overlap_transport_le hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian) (by positivity)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.hsSq_sqrt_gram
statement: lemma hsSq_sqrt_gram (M : Matrix n n ℂ) : hsSq (CFC.sqrt (Mᴴ * M)) = hsSq M
proof:
:= by
  have h := (Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg (Mᴴ*M))).isHermitian.eq
  rw [hsSq_eq_trace, h, CFC.sqrt_mul_sqrt_self _ (Matrix.posSemidef_conjTranspose_mul_self M).nonneg,
    ← hsSq_eq_trace]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.integral_spectralEnvelope_unit_le
statement:
lemma integral_spectralEnvelope_unit_le {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hAe : hsSq A = 1) (hBe : hsSq B = 1) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s in (0:ℝ)..1, spectralEnvelope hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian ε s) ≤
    (6/ε) * Real.sqrt (hsSq (A-B))
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_spectralEnvelope_le hA hB hε hε1
  rw [hAe, hBe] at h
  norm_num at h
  convert h using 1; ring

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.weighted_sqrt_le
statement:
lemma weighted_sqrt_le {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (w e : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hE : ∀ i, 0 ≤ e i) (hs : ∑ i, w i = 1) :
    (∑ i, w i * Real.sqrt (e i)) ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, w i * e i)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Finset.sum_sq_le_sum_mul_sum_of_sq_le_mul (Finset.univ : Finset ι)
    (r := fun i => w i * Real.sqrt (e i)) (f := fun i => w i) (g := fun i => w i * e i)
    (fun i _ => hw i) (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (hE i))
    (fun i _ => by rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (hE i)]; exact le_of_eq (by ring))
  rw [hs, one_mul, ← Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (hE i)))] at hc
  exact le_of_sq_le_sq hc (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.exists_shift_spectralEnvelope_le
statement:
lemma exists_shift_spectralEnvelope_le {ι : Type u_ι} [Fintype ι] (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) (hs : ∑ i, w i = 1) (A B : ι → Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ i, (A i).PosSemidef) (hB : ∀ i, (B i).PosSemidef)
    (hAe : ∀ i, hsSq (A i) = 1) (hBe : ∀ i, hsSq (B i) = 1)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, (∑ i, w i * spectralEnvelope (hA i).isHermitian (hB i).isHermitian ε s) ≤
      (6/ε) * Real.sqrt (∑ i, w i * hsSq (A i-B i))
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ∑ i, w i * spectralEnvelope (hA i).isHermitian (hB i).isHermitian ε s
  have hF : IntervalIntegrable F volume 0 1 := by
    simpa only [F, Finset.sum_fn] using IntervalIntegrable.sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (spectralEnvelope_integrable (hA i).isHermitian (hB i).isHermitian ε).const_mul (w i))
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1)) := ⟨by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hsF⟩ := MeasureTheory.exists_le_integral hF.1
  refine ⟨s, hsF.trans ?_⟩
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)]
  unfold F
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_finsetSum (fun i _ => (spectralEnvelope_integrable _ _ _).const_mul _)]
  simp_rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, w i * ((6/ε) * Real.sqrt (hsSq (A i-B i))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_spectralEnvelope_unit_le (hA i) (hB i) (hAe i) (hBe i) hε hε1) (hw i)
    _ = (6/ε) * ∑ i, w i * Real.sqrt (hsSq (A i-B i)) := by simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _; ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (weighted_sqrt_le w _ hw (fun i => hsSq_nonneg _) hs) (by positivity)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binIndicator_nonneg
statement: lemma binIndicator_nonneg (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) (a : ℝ) : 0 ≤ binIndicator ε s l a
proof:
:= by
  unfold binIndicator; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binIndicator_sq
statement: lemma binIndicator_sq (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) (a : ℝ) : (binIndicator ε s l a)^2 = binIndicator ε s l a
proof:
:= by
  unfold binIndicator; split <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binIndicator_mul_ne
statement:
lemma binIndicator_mul_ne (ε s : ℝ) {l k : ℤ} (hlk : l ≠ k) (a : ℝ) :
    binIndicator ε s l a * binIndicator ε s k a = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold binIndicator
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.sum_binIndicator_weight_sq_le
statement:
lemma sum_binIndicator_weight_sq_le (L : Finset ℤ) (ε s a : ℝ) :
    (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * (binIndicator ε s l a)^2) ≤ (binWeight a ε s)^2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binIndicator_sq]
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · simp only [binIndicator, ha, true_and, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, binWeight, ite_true]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · positivity
  · simp [binIndicator, ha, binWeight]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.scalar_mismatch_le
statement:
lemma scalar_mismatch_le (L : Finset ℤ) (ε s : ℝ) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * (binIndicator ε s l a-binIndicator ε s l b)^2) ≤
      binEnvelope a b ε s
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * (binIndicator ε s l a-binIndicator ε s l b)^2) ≤ a^2+b^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * ((binIndicator ε s l a)^2+(binIndicator ε s l b)^2) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro l _
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (sq_nonneg _)
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (binIndicator_nonneg ε s l a) (binIndicator_nonneg ε s l b)]
      _ = (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * (binIndicator ε s l a)^2) +
        (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * (binIndicator ε s l b)^2) := by simp [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ ≤ (binWeight a ε s)^2 + (binWeight b ε s)^2 := add_le_add
          (sum_binIndicator_weight_sq_le L ε s a) (sum_binIndicator_weight_sq_le L ε s b)
      _ ≤ a^2+b^2 := by
        have ha' := binWeight_le ha hε s
        have hb' := binWeight_le hb hε s
        nlinarith [binWeight_nonneg a ε s, binWeight_nonneg b ε s]
  by_cases ha0 : a = 0
  · simpa [binEnvelope, ha0] using hh
  by_cases hb0 : b = 0
  · simpa [binEnvelope, hb0] using hh
  have hap : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm ha0)
  have hbp : 0 < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hb (Ne.symm hb0)
  by_cases he : ⌊Real.log a/ε+s⌋ = ⌊Real.log b/ε+s⌋
  · have hi : ∀ l, binIndicator ε s l a = binIndicator ε s l b := by intro l; simp [binIndicator, hap, hbp, he]
    simp only [hi, sub_self, ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact binEnvelope_nonneg ha hb ε s
  · have hen : binEnvelope a b ε s = a^2+b^2 := by simp only [binEnvelope, separated, ite_eq_right he]; ring
    rw [hen]; exact hh

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binProjection_hermitian
statement:
lemma binProjection_hermitian (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    (binProjection A ε s l).IsHermitian
proof: := (cfc_predicate (binIndicator ε s l) A).isHermitian

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binProjection_pos
statement:
lemma binProjection_pos (A : Matrix n n ℂ) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    (binProjection A ε s l).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (cfc_nonneg (fun a _ => binIndicator_nonneg ε s l a))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binProjection_sq
statement:
lemma binProjection_sq {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (_hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε s : ℝ) (l : ℤ) :
    binProjection A ε s l * binProjection A ε s l = binProjection A ε s l
proof:
:= by
  unfold binProjection
  erw [← cfc_mul (binIndicator ε s l) (binIndicator ε s l) A
    (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
  apply cfc_congr
  intro a _
  simpa only [pow_two] using binIndicator_sq ε s l a

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binProjection_orthogonal
statement:
lemma binProjection_orthogonal {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (_hA : A.IsHermitian) (ε s : ℝ)
    {l k : ℤ} (hlk : l ≠ k) : binProjection A ε s l * binProjection A ε s k = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold binProjection
  erw [← cfc_mul (binIndicator ε s l) (binIndicator ε s k) A
    (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun _ : ℝ => 0) A := by apply cfc_congr; intro a _; exact binIndicator_mul_ne ε s hlk a
    _ = 0 := cfc_zero ℝ A

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.QuantumSampling.binProjection_mismatch_le
statement:
lemma binProjection_mismatch_le (L : Finset ℤ) {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) (s : ℝ) :
    (∑ l ∈ L, (binScale ε s l)^2 * hsSq (binProjection A ε s l-binProjection B ε s l)) ≤
    spectralEnvelope hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian ε s
proof:
:= by
  unfold binProjection spectralEnvelope
  simp_rw [hsSq_spectral_mixed hA.isHermitian hB.isHermitian, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i _
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j _
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (scalar_mismatch_le L ε s (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (hB.eigenvalues_nonneg j) hε)
    (overlap_nonneg _ _ _ _)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.isClosed_posSemidef
statement: lemma isClosed_posSemidef : IsClosed {A : Matrix n n ℂ | A.PosSemidef}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.posSemidef_iff_dotProduct_mulVec]
  apply IsClosed.inter
  · exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) continuous_id
  · have heq : {A : Matrix n n ℂ | ∀ x, 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)} =
        ⋂ x : n → ℂ, {A | 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)} := by ext; simp
    change IsClosed {A : Matrix n n ℂ | ∀ x, 0 ≤ star x ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ x)}
    rw [heq]
    apply isClosed_iInter
    intro x
    apply isClosed_le continuous_const
    simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    fun_prop

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.integral_matrix_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp
  exact @integral_nonneg_of_ae α (Matrix n n ℂ) _ _ _ μ _ _ _
    matrixClosedIci f (hf.mono fun _ h => h.nonneg)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.integral_matrix_mono
proof:
:=
  @integral_mono_ae α (Matrix n n ℂ) _ _ _ μ _ _ _ matrixClosedIci f g hf hg hfg

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.spectralLinear_apply
statement:
lemma spectralLinear_apply (U : Matrix n n ℂ) (v : n → ℝ) :
    spectralLinear U v = U * diagonal (fun i => (v i : ℂ)) * Uᴴ
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.cfc_eq_spectralLinear
statement:
lemma cfc_eq_spectralLinear {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) :
    cfc f A = spectralLinear (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix n n ℂ)
      (fun i => f (hA.eigenvalues i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.cfc_eq]
  rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.integrable_cfc
statement:
lemma integrable_cfc {α : Type u_α} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : α → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (fun s => f s (hA.eigenvalues i)) μ) :
    Integrable (fun s => cfc (f s) A) μ
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cfc_eq_spectralLinear hA]
  exact (spectralLinear _).integrable_comp (Integrable.of_eval hf)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.integral_cfc
statement:
lemma integral_cfc {α : Type u_α} [MeasurableSpace α] {μ : Measure α}
    {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : α → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, Integrable (fun s => f s (hA.eigenvalues i)) μ) :
    (∫ s, cfc (f s) A ∂μ) = cfc (fun t => ∫ s, f s t ∂μ) A
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [cfc_eq_spectralLinear hA]
  erw [(spectralLinear _).integral_comp_comm (Integrable.of_eval hf)]
  congr 1
  ext i
  exact eval_integral hf i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.spectrum_nonneg
statement:
lemma spectrum_nonneg {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ spectrum ℝ A) : 0 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at ht
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ht
  exact hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.eigenvalues_le_one
statement:
lemma eigenvalues_le_one {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    (hA1 : A ≤ 1) (i : n) : hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : cfc (fun t : ℝ => t) A ≤ cfc (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) A := by
    erw [cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian, cfc_const (1 : ℝ) A hA.isHermitian,
      map_one]
    exact hA1
  exact (cfc_le_iff (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) A
    (ha := hA.isHermitian)).mp h _ (hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues_mem_spectrum_real i)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.resolvent_cfc
statement:
lemma resolvent_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    resolvent A s = cfc (fun t : ℝ => (t + s)⁻¹) A
proof:
:= by
  erw [cfc_inv (fun t : ℝ => t + s) A
    (fun t ht => ne_of_gt (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (spectrum_nonneg hA ht) hs))
    (ha := hA.isHermitian)]
  erw [cfc_add A (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun _ : ℝ => s),
    cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian, cfc_const s A hA.isHermitian,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, ← Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse]
  rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.purificationKernel_cfc
statement:
lemma purificationKernel_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    purificationKernel A s = cfc (fun t : ℝ => t / (t + s)) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [purificationKernel, resolvent_cfc hA hs]
  calc
    A * cfc (fun t : ℝ => (t + s)⁻¹) A =
        cfc (fun t : ℝ => t) A * cfc (fun t : ℝ => (t + s)⁻¹) A := by
      erw [cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← cfc_mul (fun t : ℝ => t) (fun t : ℝ => (t + s)⁻¹) A
        (hg := A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
      rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.purificationKernel_square_cfc
statement:
lemma purificationKernel_square_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (purificationKernel A s)ᴴ * purificationKernel A s =
      cfc (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2 / (t + s) ^ 2) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [purificationKernel_cfc hA hs,
    (cfc_predicate (fun t : ℝ => t / (t + s)) A).isHermitian.eq,
    ← cfc_mul (fun t : ℝ => t / (t + s)) (fun t : ℝ => t / (t + s)) A
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
  apply cfc_congr
  intro t _
  change t / (t + s) * (t / (t + s)) = t ^ 2 / (t + s) ^ 2
  rw [← pow_two, div_pow]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.kernel_square_integrable
statement:
lemma kernel_square_integrable {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (purificationKernel A s)ᴴ * purificationKernel A s)
      (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_cfc hA.isHermitian (fun (s t : ℝ) => t ^ 2 / (t + s) ^ 2)
    (fun i => (scalar_square_integral (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)).1)
  apply hi.congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  exact (purificationKernel_square_cfc hA hs).symm

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.kernel_square_integral
statement:
lemma kernel_square_integral {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) :
    (∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, (purificationKernel A s)ᴴ * purificationKernel A s) = A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, cfc (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2 / (t + s) ^ 2) A := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
      exact purificationKernel_square_cfc hA hs
    _ = cfc (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, t ^ 2 / (t + s) ^ 2) A :=
      integral_cfc hA.isHermitian _ (fun i => (scalar_square_integral (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i)).1)
    _ = cfc (fun t : ℝ => t) A := by
      apply cfc_congr
      intro t ht
      exact (scalar_square_integral (spectrum_nonneg hA ht)).2
    _ = A := cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.entropyIntegrand_cfc
statement:
lemma entropyIntegrand_cfc {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    entropyIntegrand A s = cfc (fun t : ℝ => t / (1 + s) - t / (t + s)) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [entropyIntegrand, purificationKernel_cfc hA hs,
    cfc_sub (fun t : ℝ => t / (1 + s)) (fun t : ℝ => t / (t + s)) A
      (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _) (A.finite_real_spectrum.continuousOn _)]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = cfc (fun t : ℝ => (1 / (1 + s)) • t) A := by
      erw [cfc_smul (1 / (1 + s) : ℝ) (fun t : ℝ => t) A,
        cfc_id' ℝ A hA.isHermitian]
    _ = _ := by apply cfc_congr; intro t _; simp [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.entropy_integrable
statement:
lemma entropy_integrable {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hA1 : A ≤ 1) :
    IntegrableOn (entropyIntegrand A) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := integrable_cfc hA.isHermitian
    (fun (s t : ℝ) => t / (1 + s) - t / (t + s))
    (fun i => (scalar_entropy_integral (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (eigenvalues_le_one hA hA1 i)).1)
  apply hi.congr
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  exact (entropyIntegrand_cfc hA hs).symm

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.entropy_integral
statement:
lemma entropy_integral {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hA1 : A ≤ 1) :
    (∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, entropyIntegrand A s) = effectEntropy A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, cfc (fun t : ℝ => t / (1 + s) - t / (t + s)) A := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
      exact entropyIntegrand_cfc hA hs
    _ = cfc (fun t : ℝ => ∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0, t / (1 + s) - t / (t + s)) A :=
      integral_cfc hA.isHermitian _ (fun i =>
        (scalar_entropy_integral (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (eigenvalues_le_one hA hA1 i)).1)
    _ = effectEntropy A := by
      apply cfc_congr
      intro t ht
      rw [hA.isHermitian.spectrum_real_eq_range_eigenvalues] at ht
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ht
      exact (scalar_entropy_integral (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg i) (eigenvalues_le_one hA hA1 i)).2

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.scalar_kernel_memLp
statement:
lemma scalar_kernel_memLp {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    MemLp (fun s : ℝ => t / (t + s)) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun s : ℝ => t / (t + s)) := by fun_prop
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hm.aestronglyMeasurable).2
  simpa only [IntegrableOn, div_pow] using (scalar_square_integral ht).1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.kernel_entry_memLp
statement:
lemma kernel_entry_memLp {A : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (i j : n) :
    MemLp (fun s : ℝ => purificationKernel A s i j) 2 (volume.restrict (Ioi 0))
proof:
:= by
  let U : Matrix n n ℂ := hA.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary
  let t : n → ℝ := hA.isHermitian.eigenvalues
  have hf (k : n) : MemLp (fun s : ℝ => U i k * (t k / (t k + s) : ℝ) * star (U j k))
      2 (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) :=
    (((scalar_kernel_memLp (hA.eigenvalues_nonneg k)).ofReal (K := ℂ)).const_mul
      (U i k)).mul_const (star (U j k))
  have hi := memLp_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun k _ => hf k)
  apply hi.ae_eq
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
  rw [purificationKernel_cfc hA hs, hA.isHermitian.cfc_eq]
  change (∑ k, U i k * (t k / (t k + s) : ℝ) * star (U j k)) =
    (U * diagonal (fun k => ((t k / (t k + s) : ℝ) : ℂ)) * Uᴴ) i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Matrix.conjTranspose_apply,
    mul_ite, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.integrable_gram
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.of_eval
  intro i
  apply Integrable.of_eval
  intro j
  change Integrable (fun s => ∑ k, star (f s k i) * g s k j) μ
  apply integrable_finsetSum
  intro k _
  exact memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp ((hf k i).star.mul (hg k j))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.kernel_cross_integrable
statement:
lemma kernel_cross_integrable {A B : Matrix n n ℂ} (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (purificationKernel A s)ᴴ * purificationKernel B s) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:=
  integrable_gram (kernel_entry_memLp hA) (kernel_entry_memLp hB)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.kernel_distance_integrable
statement:
lemma kernel_distance_integrable {A B : Matrix n n ℂ}
    (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    IntegrableOn (fun s : ℝ => (purificationKernel A s - purificationKernel B s)ᴴ *
      (purificationKernel A s - purificationKernel B s)) (Ioi 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply integrable_gram <;> intro i j <;>
    exact (kernel_entry_memLp hA i j).sub (kernel_entry_memLp hB i j)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.entropy_gap_integrand_eq
statement:
lemma entropy_gap_integrand_eq {J : Type u_J} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : J → ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef)
    (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hmean : ∑ j, w j • A j = B)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) :
    (∑ j, w j • entropyIntegrand (A j) s) - entropyIntegrand B s =
      s • ∑ j, w j • (resolvent (A j) s - resolvent B s)
proof:
:= by
  have hc (c : ℝ) : ∑ j, w j • (c • A j) = c • B := by
    simp_rw [smul_comm (w _) c]
    rw [← Finset.smul_sum, hmean]
  have hone : ∑ j, w j • (1 : Matrix n n ℂ) = 1 := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_smul, hw, one_smul]
  have hr : ∑ j, w j • (s • resolvent (A j) s) = s • ∑ j, w j • resolvent (A j) s := by
    simp_rw [smul_comm (w _) s]
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  simp_rw [entropyIntegrand, purificationKernel_eq (hA _) hs, purificationKernel_eq hB hs,
    smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [hc, hone, hr, ← Finset.sum_smul, hw, one_smul]
  module

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Resolvent.weighted_distance_jensen
statement:
lemma weighted_distance_jensen {J : Type u_J} [Fintype J]
    (A : J → Matrix n n ℂ) (w : J → ℝ) (B : Matrix n n ℂ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (A j).PosSemidef) (hA1 : ∀ j, A j ≤ 1)
    (hB : B.PosSemidef) (hB1 : B ≤ 1)
    (hw0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (hw : ∑ j, w j = 1) (hmean : ∑ j, w j • A j = B) :
    (∑ j, w j • (∫ s : ℝ in Ioi 0,
        (purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s)ᴴ *
          (purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s))) ≤
      (∑ j, w j • effectEntropy (A j)) - effectEntropy B
proof:
:= by
  have hf (j : J) := (kernel_distance_integrable (hA j) hB).smul (w j)
  have hg (j : J) := (entropy_integrable (hA j) (hA1 j)).smul (w j)
  have hleft := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hf j)
  have hright := (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hg j)).sub
    (entropy_integrable hB hB1)
  have hi := integral_matrix_mono hleft hright (show
      (fun s => ∑ j, w j • ((purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s)ᴴ *
        (purificationKernel (A j) s - purificationKernel B s))) ≤ᵐ[volume.restrict (Ioi 0)]
      (fun s => (∑ j, w j • entropyIntegrand (A j) s) - entropyIntegrand B s) from by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with s hs
    rw [entropy_gap_integrand_eq A w B hA hB hw hmean hs]
    exact weighted_kernel_square_le A w B hA hB hw0 hw hmean hs)
  erw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hf j),
    integral_sub (integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun j _ => hg j))
      (entropy_integrable hB hB1),
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => hg j)] at hi
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply] at hi
  simp_rw [integral_smul, entropy_integral (hA _) (hA1 _), entropy_integral hB hB1] at hi
  exact hi

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Strategy.coeff_unit
statement: lemma coeff_unit (S : Strategy X Y A B) : hsSq S.coeff = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hsSq, coeff, Fintype.sum_prod_type] using S.state_unit

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Strategy.born_eq_prob
statement:
lemma born_eq_prob (S : Strategy X Y A B) (x : X) (y : Y) (a : A) (b : B) :
    S.born x y a b = prob S.coeff (S.alice x a) (S.bob y b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.born_eq_quadratic]
  rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.sum_profiles
statement:
lemma sum_profiles {I : Type u_I} {X : Type u_X} {Y : Type u_Y} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    (f : (I→X×Y) → ℝ) :
    (∑ z, f z) = ∑ xs : I → X, ∑ ys : I → Y, f (fun i => (xs i,ys i))
proof:
:= by
  let e : (I→X×Y) ≃ (I→X)×(I→Y) := {
    toFun := fun z => (fun i => (z i).1, fun i => (z i).2)
    invFun := fun t i => (t.1 i,t.2 i)
    left_inv := fun z => by funext i; exact Prod.eta _
    right_inv := fun t => by rcases t with ⟨xs,ys⟩; rfl }
  calc
    (∑ z, f z) = ∑ t : (I→X)×(I→Y), f (e.symm t) := (e.symm.sum_comp f).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]; rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Strategy.rate_eq_wins
statement:
lemma rate_eq_wins [Nonempty (Fin k)] (z : Profile (Fin k) (Fin (x+1)) (Fin (y+1)))
    (as : Fin k → Fin (a+1)) (bs : Fin k → Fin (b+1)) :
    Tests.rate (S.repetitionModel G).winsAt (z,as,bs) =
      (wins G (fun i => (z i).1) (fun i => (z i).2) as bs : ℝ)/(k : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tests.rate, uniform_avg, Fintype.card_fin, one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
  congr 1
  unfold wins
  rw [Nat.cast_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i _
  change (if G.accepts (z i).1 (z i).2 (as i) (bs i) then (1:ℝ) else 0) = _
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.Strategy.threshold_eq_model
statement:
lemma threshold_eq_model [Nonempty (Fin k)] (hk : 0 < k) (δ : ℝ) :
    thresholdProbability G δ S =
      Tests.threshold (S.repetitionModel G).joint
        (S.repetitionModel G).winsAt (entangledValue G+δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  symm
  unfold Tests.threshold
  rw [RepeatedModel.joint_avg]
  simp only [S.rate_eq_wins G, le_div_iff₀ hk', ← Nat.ceil_le]
  simp only [avg, pi, RepeatedModel.answers, outcomeLaw, Strategy.repetitionModel,
    smul_eq_mul, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rw [sum_profiles]
  unfold thresholdProbability
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro xs _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro ys _
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro as _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro bs _
  rw [S.born_eq_prob]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_nonneg
statement: lemma threshold_nonneg (s : ℝ) : 0 ≤ threshold ρ win s
proof:
:= by
  apply avg_nonneg; intro ω; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_le_one
statement: lemma threshold_le_one (s : ℝ) : threshold ρ win s ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply avg_le_const; intro ω; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_markov
statement: lemma threshold_markov {s : ℝ} (_hs : 0 ≤ s) : threshold ρ win s*s ≤ ρ.avg (rate win)
proof:
:= by
  change ρ.avg (fun ω => if s ≤ rate win ω then (1:ℝ) else 0)*s ≤ _
  rw [mul_comm]
  change s • ρ.avg (fun ω => if s ≤ rate win ω then (1:ℝ) else 0) ≤ _
  rw [← avg_smul]
  apply ρ.avg_mono
  intro ω
  change s*(if s ≤ rate win ω then 1 else 0) ≤ rate win ω
  split_ifs with h
  · simpa using h
  · simpa using rate_nonneg win ω

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_mean_bound
statement:
lemma threshold_mean_bound {v δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : v+δ ≤ 1)
    (hmean : ρ.avg (rate win) ≤ v) : threshold ρ win (v+δ) ≤ Real.exp (-δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmean0 : 0 ≤ ρ.avg (rate win) := ρ.avg_nonneg (rate_nonneg win)
  have hv : 0 ≤ v := hmean0.trans hmean
  have hm := (threshold_markov ρ win (show 0 ≤ v+δ by linarith)).trans hmean
  have hq := threshold_le_one ρ win (v+δ)
  have hmul := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1-(v+δ) by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 1-threshold ρ win (v+δ) by linarith)
  have he := Real.add_one_le_exp (-δ)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.geometric_bound
statement:
lemma geometric_bound {v δ : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : v+δ ≤ 1) (T : ℕ) :
    (∑ s ∈ Finset.range T, (v+δ/2)^s) ≤ 2/δ
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ v+δ/2 := by linarith
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ s ∈ Finset.range T, (v+δ/2)^s := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun s _ => pow_nonneg hr s)
  have hg := geom_sum_mul_neg (v+δ/2) T
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show δ/2 ≤ 1-(v+δ/2) by linarith) hsum
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hδ).mpr
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hr T]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_power_bound
statement:
lemma threshold_power_bound {v δ e : ℝ} (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : v+δ ≤ 1)
    (he : 0 ≤ e) (T : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ c : Finset I, c.card < T →
      (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => mass ρ win (insert i c)) ≤ (v+δ/2)*mass ρ win c+e) :
    threshold ρ win (v+δ)*(v+δ)^T ≤ (v+δ/2)^T+e*(2/δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlo := threshold_moment_lower ρ win (show 0 ≤ v+δ by linarith) T
  have hhi := moment_upper ρ win (show 0 ≤ v+δ/2 by linarith) he T hstep T ∅ (by simp)
  rw [mass_empty, mul_one] at hhi
  have hg := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (geometric_bound hv hδ hs T) he
  exact hlo.trans (hhi.trans (by linarith))

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.RepeatedModel.all_event_step
statement:
lemma all_event_step {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : (T : ℝ) ≤ δ^9*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/((2:ℝ)^90*(1+Real.log (((a+1)*(b+1) : ℕ) : ℝ))))
    (c : Finset I) (hc : c.card < T) :
    (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => M.mass (insert i c)) ≤
      (entangledValue G+δ/2)*M.mass c+Real.exp (-(δ^8*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^83))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < (Fintype.card I : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hd : (1:ℝ) ≤ (((a+1)*(b+1) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos a) (Nat.succ_pos b))
  have hc' : (c.card : ℝ) ≤ δ^9*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/((2:ℝ)^90*(1+Real.log (((a+1)*(b+1) : ℕ) : ℝ))) :=
    (show (c.card : ℝ) ≤ T by exact_mod_cast hc.le).trans hT
  by_cases hp : Real.exp (-(δ^8*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^83)) ≤ M.mass c
  · have hp0 := (Real.exp_pos _).trans_le hp
    obtain ⟨hsize, hcard, hsmall⟩ := testing_parameters_good hδ hδ1 hk hd hc' hp
    have hcNat : c.card < Fintype.card I := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    have hs : Real.log ((((a+1)*(b+1) : ℕ) : ℝ)^c.card/M.mass c) /
        ((Fintype.card I-c.card : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ δ^8/(2:ℝ)^80 := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_sub hcNat.le] using hsmall
    exact (M.good_event_step G hμ hV c hp0 hcNat hδ hδ1 hsize hs).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_pos _).le)
  · have hh := (uniform (R := I)).avg_le_const (fun i => M.mass_insert_le c i)
    have hv : 0 ≤ entangledValue G+δ/2 := by linarith [entangledValue_nonneg G]
    have hm := mul_nonneg hv (M.mass_nonneg c)
    linarith

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.RepeatedModel.threshold_power_bound
statement:
lemma threshold_power_bound {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : entangledValue G+δ ≤ 1) (T : ℕ)
    (hT : (T : ℝ) ≤ δ^9*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/((2:ℝ)^90*(1+Real.log (((a+1)*(b+1) : ℕ) : ℝ)))) :
    Tests.threshold M.joint M.winsAt (entangledValue G+δ)*(entangledValue G+δ)^T ≤
      (entangledValue G+δ/2)^T+Real.exp (-(δ^8*(Fintype.card I : ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^83))*(2/δ)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := entangledValue_nonneg G
  have hδ1 : δ ≤ 1 := by linarith
  exact Tests.threshold_power_bound M.joint M.winsAt hv hδ hs (Real.exp_pos _).le T
    (fun c hc => M.all_event_step G hμ hV hδ hδ1 T hT c hc)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.RepeatedModel.threshold_mean_bound
statement:
lemma threshold_mean_bound {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : entangledValue G+δ ≤ 1) :
    Tests.threshold M.joint M.winsAt (entangledValue G+δ) ≤ Real.exp (-δ)
proof:
:=
  Tests.threshold_mean_bound M.joint M.winsAt hδ hs (M.unconditional_rate_le_value G hμ hV)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.event_nonneg
statement: lemma event_nonneg (c : Finset I) (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ event win c ω
proof: := by unfold event; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.event_le_one
statement: lemma event_le_one (c : Finset I) (ω : Ω) : event win c ω ≤ 1
proof: := by unfold event; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.mass_nonneg
statement: lemma mass_nonneg (c : Finset I) : 0 ≤ mass ρ win c
proof: := ρ.avg_nonneg (event_nonneg win c)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.mass_le_one
statement: lemma mass_le_one (c : Finset I) : mass ρ win c ≤ 1
proof: := ρ.avg_le_const (event_le_one win c)

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.rate_nonneg
statement: lemma rate_nonneg (ω : Ω) : 0 ≤ rate win ω
proof:
:= by
  apply avg_nonneg; intro i; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.rate_le_one
statement: lemma rate_le_one (ω : Ω) : rate win ω ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply avg_le_const; intro i; split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.event_empty
statement: lemma event_empty (ω : Ω) : event win ∅ ω = 1
proof: := by simp [event]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.mass_empty
statement: lemma mass_empty : mass ρ win ∅ = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold mass
  conv_lhs => arg 2; ext ω; rw [event_empty]
  exact avg_const _ 1

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.event_insert
statement:
lemma event_insert (c : Finset I) (i : I) (ω : Ω) :
    event win (insert i c) ω = event win c ω*(if win ω i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [event, Finset.forall_mem_insert]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.avg_event_insert
statement:
lemma avg_event_insert (c : Finset I) (ω : Ω) :
    (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => event win (insert i c) ω) = event win c ω*rate win ω
proof:
:= by
  simp only [event_insert]
  change (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => event win c ω • (if win ω i then (1:ℝ) else 0)) = _
  rw [avg_smul]; rfl

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.moment_zero
statement: lemma moment_zero (c : Finset I) : moment ρ win c 0 = mass ρ win c
proof: := by simp only [moment, pow_zero, mul_one, mass]

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.moment_step
statement:
lemma moment_step (c : Finset I) (t : ℕ) :
    moment ρ win c (t+1) = (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => moment ρ win (insert i c) t)
proof:
:= by
  unfold moment
  rw [avg_comm]
  apply congrArg ρ.avg
  funext ω
  have he : (fun i => event win (insert i c) ω * rate win ω^t) =
      (fun i => (rate win ω^t) • event win (insert i c) ω) := by funext i; simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  rw [he, avg_smul, avg_event_insert, pow_succ]
  change _ = _*_
  ring

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.moment_upper
statement:
lemma moment_upper {r e : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_he : 0 ≤ e) (T : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ c : Finset I, c.card < T →
      (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => mass ρ win (insert i c)) ≤ r*mass ρ win c+e) :
    ∀ t : ℕ, ∀ c : Finset I, c.card+t ≤ T →
      moment ρ win c t ≤ r^t*mass ρ win c + e*∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, r^s
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | zero => intro c hc; simp only [moment_zero, pow_zero, one_mul, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty, mul_zero, add_zero]; exact le_rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    intro c hc
    rw [moment_step]
    have hbound := (uniform (R := I)).avg_mono (fun i => ih (insert i c) (by
      have hi := Finset.card_insert_le i c
      omega))
    have heq : (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => r^t*mass ρ win (insert i c)+e*∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, r^s) =
        r^t*(uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => mass ρ win (insert i c))+e*∑ s ∈ Finset.range t, r^s := by
      rw [avg_add, avg_const]
      change (uniform (R := I)).avg (fun i => (r^t) • mass ρ win (insert i c)) + _ = _
      rw [avg_smul]; rfl
    rw [heq] at hbound
    have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hstep c (by omega)) (pow_nonneg hr t)
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
    nlinarith

name: OAI.ThresholdParallelRepetition.FiniteProbability.Tests.threshold_moment_lower
statement:
lemma threshold_moment_lower {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 ≤ q) (t : ℕ) :
    (ρ.avg (fun ω => if q ≤ rate win ω then (1:ℝ) else 0))*q^t ≤ moment ρ win ∅ t
proof:
:= by
  have he : (ρ.avg (fun ω => if q ≤ rate win ω then (1:ℝ) else 0))*q^t =
      ρ.avg (fun ω => if q ≤ rate win ω then q^t else 0) := by
    rw [mul_comm]
    change (q^t) • ρ.avg (fun ω => if q ≤ rate win ω then (1:ℝ) else 0) = _
    rw [← avg_smul]
    congr 1; funext ω; split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [he]
  apply ρ.avg_mono
  intro ω
  simp only [event_empty, one_mul]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact pow_le_pow_left₀ hq h _
  · exact pow_nonneg (rate_nonneg win ω) _

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.integral_pos_mul_exp
statement:
theorem integral_pos_mul_exp {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ r : ℝ in Ioi 0, r * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) = (2 * b)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hb' : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hd (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun x => -(2 * b)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2))
      (x * Real.exp (-b * x ^ 2)) x := by
    apply (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul (-b)).exp.const_mul (-(2 * b)⁻¹)).congr_deriv
    field_simp [hb']
    ring
  have ht : Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => -(2 * b)⁻¹ * Real.exp (-b * y ^ 2))
      atTop (𝓝 (-(2 * b)⁻¹ * 0)) := by
    apply Tendsto.const_mul
    exact Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
      ((tendsto_pow_atTop two_ne_zero).const_mul_atTop_of_neg (neg_lt_zero.mpr hb))
  convert integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun x _ => hd x)
    (integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq hb).integrableOn ht using 1
  simp

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.integral_abs_mul_exp
statement:
theorem integral_abs_mul_exp {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∫ r : ℝ, |r| * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2) = b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun r => |r| * Real.exp (-b * r ^ 2)
  have hf : Integrable f := by
    simpa only [f, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)] using
      (integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq hb).abs
  have hpos : ∫ r in Ioi 0, f r = (2 * b)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← integral_pos_mul_exp hb]
    exact setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi (fun r hr => by
      simp only [f, abs_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < r from hr)])
  have hneg : ∫ r in Iic 0, f r = ∫ r in Ioi 0, f r := by
    calc
      ∫ r in Iic 0, f r = ∫ r in Ioi 0, f (-r) := by
        simpa [f] using (integral_comp_neg_Ioi 0 f).symm
      _ = ∫ r in Ioi 0, f r := by simp only [f, abs_neg, neg_sq]
  change (∫ r, f r) = _
  rw [← integral_add_compl measurableSet_Ioi hf, compl_Ioi, hneg, hpos]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.integral_abs_gaussianReal_std
statement:
theorem integral_abs_gaussianReal_std :
    ∫ x : ℝ, |x| ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = 2 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (by norm_num : (1 : NNReal) ≠ 0)]
  have hfun : (fun x : ℝ => gaussianPDFReal 0 1 x • |x|) =
      (fun x : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
        (|x| * Real.exp (-(1 / 2 : ℝ) * x ^ 2))) := by
    ext x
    simp only [gaussianPDFReal, NNReal.coe_one, sub_zero, mul_one, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [show -(x ^ 2) / (2 : ℝ) = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) * x ^ 2 by ring]
    ring
  rw [hfun, integral_const_mul, integral_abs_mul_exp (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/2)]
  norm_num
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.integral_abs_dual_stdGaussian
statement:
theorem integral_abs_dual_stdGaussian {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (L : StrongDual ℝ E) :
    ∫ x, |L x| ∂stdGaussian E = ‖L‖ * (2 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (stdGaussian E).map L = (gaussianReal 0 1).map (‖L‖ * ·) := by
    rw [IsGaussian.map_eq_gaussianReal, integral_strongDual_stdGaussian,
      variance_dual_stdGaussian, gaussianReal_map_const_mul]
    simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, Real.toNNReal_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖L‖)]
  rw [← integral_map L.continuous.aemeasurable (by fun_prop :
    AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => |x|) ((stdGaussian E).map L)), hm,
    integral_map (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)]
  simp_rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg L)]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_abs_gaussianReal_std]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Analytic.integral_abs_inner_stdGaussian
statement:
theorem integral_abs_inner_stdGaussian {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (v : E) :
    ∫ x, |⟪v, x⟫| ∂stdGaussian E = ‖v‖ * (2 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [InnerProductSpace.toDual_apply_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using
    integral_abs_dual_stdGaussian (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ E v)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.integral_comp_neg
statement:
theorem integral_comp_neg {d : ℕ} (f : Space d → ℝ) (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f (gaussian d)) :
    ∫ x, f (-x) ∂gaussian d = ∫ x, f x ∂gaussian d
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (gaussian d).map (fun x => -x) = gaussian d :=
    stdGaussian_map (LinearIsometryEquiv.neg ℝ)
  rw [← integral_map (by fun_prop) (hm.symm ▸ hf), hm]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.scoreMax_three
statement:
theorem scoreMax_three {d : ℕ} (v : Fin 3 → Space d) (x : Space d) :
    scoreMax v x = max ⟪v 0, x⟫ (max ⟪v 1, x⟫ ⟪v 2, x⟫)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (scoreMax_le_iff v x _).mpr
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact le_max_left _ _
    · exact (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
    · exact (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  · exact max_le (le_scoreMax v 0 x) (max_le (le_scoreMax v 1 x) (le_scoreMax v 2 x))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.three_range_identity
statement:
theorem three_range_identity (a b c : ℝ) :
    max a (max b c) + max (-a) (max (-b) (-c)) =
      (|a - b| + |a - c| + |b - c|) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rcases le_total b c with hbc | hcb
    · simp [max_eq_right hbc, max_eq_right (hab.trans hbc),
        max_eq_left (neg_le_neg hbc), max_eq_left (neg_le_neg hab),
        abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hbc),
        abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hab.trans hbc))]
      ring
    · rcases le_total a c with hac | hca
      · simp [max_eq_left hcb, max_eq_right hab,
          max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hcb), max_eq_left (neg_le_neg hac),
          abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hac),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcb)]
        ring
      · simp [max_eq_left hcb, max_eq_right hab,
          max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hcb), max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hca),
          abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hab), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hca),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcb)]
        ring
  · rcases le_total a c with hac | hca
    · simp [max_eq_right (hba.trans hac), max_eq_right hac,
        max_eq_left (neg_le_neg (hba.trans hac)), max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hba),
        abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hac),
        abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hba.trans hac))]
      ring
    · rcases le_total b c with hbc | hcb
      · simp [max_eq_right hbc, max_eq_left hca,
          max_eq_left (neg_le_neg hbc), max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hba),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hca),
          abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hbc)]
        ring
      · simp [max_eq_left hcb, max_eq_left hba,
          max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hcb), max_eq_right (neg_le_neg hca),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hba), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hca),
          abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcb)]
        ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.width_three
statement:
theorem width_three {d : ℕ} (v : Tuple d 3) :
    width v = (‖v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 1‖ + ‖v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 2‖ +
      ‖v.ofLp 1 - v.ofLp 2‖) / (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : Space d) : scoreMax v.ofLp x + scoreMax v.ofLp (-x) =
      (|⟪v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 1, x⟫| + |⟪v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 2, x⟫| +
        |⟪v.ofLp 1 - v.ofLp 2, x⟫|) / 2 := by
    simp only [scoreMax_three, inner_neg_right, inner_sub_left]
    exact three_range_identity _ _ _
  have hi (w : Space d) : Integrable (fun x => |⟪w, x⟫|) (gaussian d) :=
    ((integrable_id_gaussian d).const_inner w).abs
  have hneg : Integrable (fun x => scoreMax v.ofLp (-x)) (gaussian d) := by
    convert integrable_scoreMax (-v) using 1
    ext x
    simp only [scoreMax_three, PiLp.neg_apply, inner_neg_left, inner_neg_right]
  have h := integral_congr_ae (μ := gaussian d) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall he)
  rw [integral_add (integrable_scoreMax v) hneg,
    integral_comp_neg _ (integrable_scoreMax v).aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_div] at h
  rw [integral_add (f := fun x => |⟪v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 1, x⟫| +
      |⟪v.ofLp 0 - v.ofLp 2, x⟫|) (g := fun x => |⟪v.ofLp 1 - v.ofLp 2, x⟫|)
      ((hi _).add (hi _)) (hi _), integral_add (hi _) (hi _)] at h
  simp_rw [gaussian, Analytic.integral_abs_inner_stdGaussian] at h
  change width v + width v = _ at h
  have hs : Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
  field_simp [hs] at h ⊢
  nlinarith only [h]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.perimeter_sq_le
statement:
theorem perimeter_sq_le {E : Type uE} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (a b c : E) : (‖a-b‖ + ‖a-c‖ + ‖b-c‖)^2 ≤
      9 * (‖a‖^2 + ‖b‖^2 + ‖c‖^2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcs : (‖a-b‖ + ‖a-c‖ + ‖b-c‖)^2 ≤
      3 * (‖a-b‖^2 + ‖a-c‖^2 + ‖b-c‖^2) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖a-b‖ - ‖a-c‖), sq_nonneg (‖a-b‖ - ‖b-c‖),
      sq_nonneg (‖a-c‖ - ‖b-c‖)]
  have hid : ‖a-b‖^2 + ‖a-c‖^2 + ‖b-c‖^2 =
      3 * (‖a‖^2 + ‖b‖^2 + ‖c‖^2) - ‖a+b+c‖^2 := by
    simp only [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_add_sq_real, inner_add_left]
    ring
  rw [hid] at hcs
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖a+b+c‖]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.width_three_sq_le
statement:
theorem width_three_sq_le {d : ℕ} (v : Tuple d 3) :
    (width v)^2 ≤ (9 / (8 * Real.pi)) * ‖v‖^2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := perimeter_sq_le (v.ofLp 0) (v.ofLp 1) (v.ofLp 2)
  have hnorm : ‖v‖^2 = ‖v.ofLp 0‖^2 + ‖v.ofLp 1‖^2 + ‖v.ofLp 2‖^2 := by
    simp only [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rw [← hnorm] at hp
  rw [width_three, div_pow]
  have hs : (2 * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))^2 = 8 * Real.pi := by
    rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    ring
  rw [hs]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 8 * Real.pi)).mpr
  calc
    _ ≤ 9 * ‖v‖^2 := hp
    _ = 9 / (8 * Real.pi) * ‖v‖^2 * (8 * Real.pi) := by
      field_simp

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.three_partition_bound
statement:
theorem three_partition_bound {d : ℕ} {A : Fin 3 → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A) :
    value A ≤ 9 / (8 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : value A ≤ width (moments A) := by
    simpa only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_moments_sq] using
      pairing_le_width hA (moments A)
  have hsq := width_three_sq_le (moments A)
  rw [norm_moments_sq] at hsq
  have hn := value_nonneg A
  have hw : 0 ≤ width (moments A) := hn.trans hpair
  have hval := (sq_le_sq₀ hn hw).mpr hpair
  have hB : (0 : ℝ) < 9 / (8 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_congr_ae
statement:
theorem centroid_congr_ae {d : ℕ} {A B : Set (Space d)}
    (h : A =ᵐ[gaussian d] B) : centroid A = centroid B
proof:
:= by
  exact setIntegral_congr_set h

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.value_congr_ae
statement:
theorem value_congr_ae {d k : ℕ} {A B : Fin k → Set (Space d)}
    (h : ∀ i, A i =ᵐ[gaussian d] B i) : value A = value B
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [centroid_congr_ae (h i)]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.partition_congr_ae
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hB, ?_⟩
  have hh := ae_all_iff.mpr h
  filter_upwards [hA.2, hh] with x hx heq
  change ∀ i, (x ∈ A i) = (x ∈ B i) at heq
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨i, Eq.mp (heq i) hi, fun j hj => hu j (Eq.mpr (heq j) hj)⟩

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.closedCell_eq_scoreCell_ae
statement:
theorem closedCell_eq_scoreCell_ae {d k : ℕ} (v : Fin k → Space d)
    (hv : Function.Injective v) (i : Fin k) :
    closedCell v i =ᵐ[gaussian d] scoreCell v i
proof:
:= by
  have ht (j : Fin k) (hij : i ≠ j) : ∀ᵐ x ∂gaussian d, ⟪v i, x⟫ ≠ ⟪v j, x⟫ := by
    rw [ae_iff]
    simpa only [not_not, inner_sub_left, sub_eq_zero] using
      gaussian_hyperplane_null (v i - v j) (sub_ne_zero.mpr (hv.ne hij)) 0
  have ht' := ae_all_iff.mpr (fun j => ae_all_iff.mpr (fun hij => ht j hij))
  filter_upwards [ht'] with x hx
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro hc
    refine ⟨hc, fun j hji => ?_⟩
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hc j) (Ne.symm (hx j (ne_of_gt hji)))
  · exact fun hc => hc.1

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.axis_inner
statement:
theorem axis_inner (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ⟪axis0 d hd, axis0 d hd⟫ = 1 ∧ ⟪axis1 d hd, axis1 d hd⟫ = 1 ∧
      ⟪axis0 d hd, axis1 d hd⟫ = 0 ∧ ⟪axis1 d hd, axis0 d hd⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [axis0, axis1, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sectorScores_scores
statement:
theorem sectorScores_scores (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (x : Space d) :
    ⟪(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 0, x⟫ = 2 * Real.sqrt 3 * coord 0 x ∧
    ⟪(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 1, x⟫ = -Real.sqrt 3 * coord 0 x + 3 * coord 1 x ∧
    ⟪(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 2, x⟫ = -Real.sqrt 3 * coord 0 x - 3 * coord 1 x
proof:
:= by
  simp [sectorScores, axis0, axis1, coord, show 0 < d by omega, show 1 < d by omega,
    inner_add_left, inner_sub_left, inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sectorScores_closed
statement:
theorem sectorScores_closed (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (i : Fin 3) :
    closedCell (sectorScores d hd).ofLp i = propeller d 3 i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := sectorScores_scores d hd x
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [closedCell, propeller, Fin.forall_fin_succ, h0, h1, h2, abs_le] <;>
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sectorScores_norms
statement:
theorem sectorScores_norms (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    ‖sectorScores d hd‖^2 = 36 ∧
    ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 0 - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp 1‖ = 6 ∧
    ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 0 - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp 2‖ = 6 ∧
    ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp 1 - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp 2‖ = 6
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h00, h11, h01, h10⟩ := axis_inner d hd
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 3)^2 = 3 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hn (x : Space d) : ‖x‖^2 = ⟪x, x⟫ := (real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq x).symm
  constructor
  · rw [PiLp.norm_sq_eq_of_L2, Fin.sum_univ_three]
    change ‖(2 * Real.sqrt 3) • axis0 d hd‖^2 +
      ‖(-Real.sqrt 3) • axis0 d hd + (3 : ℝ) • axis1 d hd‖^2 +
      ‖(-Real.sqrt 3) • axis0 d hd - (3 : ℝ) • axis1 d hd‖^2 = 36
    simp only [hn, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
      inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right,
      h00, h01, h10, h11, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
    nlinarith only [hs]
  · have hsq (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
        ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp i - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp j‖^2 = 36 := by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> try contradiction
      all_goals dsimp [sectorScores]
      all_goals simp only [hn, inner_smul_left, inner_smul_right,
        inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right,
        h00, h01, h10, h11, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
      all_goals nlinarith only [hs]
    have he (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
        ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp i - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp j‖ = 6 := by
      nlinarith [hsq i j hij, norm_nonneg ((sectorScores d hd).ofLp i - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp j)]
    exact ⟨he 0 1 (by decide), he 0 2 (by decide), he 1 2 (by decide)⟩

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sectorScores_injective
statement:
theorem sectorScores_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    Function.Injective (sectorScores d hd).ofLp
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, h01, h02, h12⟩ := sectorScores_norms d hd
  intro i j hij
  have hz : ‖(sectorScores d hd).ofLp i - (sectorScores d hd).ofLp j‖ = 0 := by
    rw [hij, sub_self, norm_zero]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [norm_sub_rev]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.propeller_three
statement:
theorem propeller_three (d : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) :
    IsPartition (propeller d 3) ∧ value (propeller d 3) = 9 / (8 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  let v := sectorScores d hd
  have he (i : Fin 3) : propeller d 3 i =ᵐ[gaussian d] scoreCell v.ofLp i := by
    rw [← sectorScores_closed d hd i]
    exact closedCell_eq_scoreCell_ae v.ofLp (sectorScores_injective d hd) i
  have hp : IsPartition (propeller d 3) :=
    partition_congr_ae (scoreCell_partition v.ofLp)
      (fun i => by rw [← sectorScores_closed d hd i]; exact measurableSet_closedCell _ i)
      (fun i => (he i).symm)
  refine ⟨hp, le_antisymm (three_partition_bound hp) ?_⟩
  rw [value_congr_ae he]
  obtain ⟨hv, h01, h02, h12⟩ := sectorScores_norms d hd
  have hw : (width v)^2 = 36 * (9 / (8 * Real.pi)) := by
    rw [width_three, h01, h02, h12, div_pow, mul_pow,
      Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    field_simp; ring
  have hcs := norm_inner_le_norm (𝕜 := ℝ) v (moments (scoreCell v.ofLp))
  rw [pairing_scoreCell, Real.norm_eq_abs] at hcs
  have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg (width v))
    (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg v) (norm_nonneg (moments (scoreCell v.ofLp))))).mpr hcs
  rw [sq_abs, mul_pow, norm_moments_sq, hw] at hs
  change 36 * (9 / (8 * Real.pi)) ≤ ‖sectorScores d hd‖^2 * _ at hs
  rw [hv] at hs
  linarith only [hs]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.append_empty_partition
statement:
theorem append_empty_partition {d k : ℕ} {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)}
    (hA : IsPartition A) : IsPartition (Fin.lastCases ∅ A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simpa only [Fin.lastCases_last] using (MeasurableSet.empty : MeasurableSet (∅ : Set (Space d)))
    · simpa only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using hA.1 j
  · filter_upwards [hA.2] with x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hu⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨i.castSucc, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using hi
    · intro j
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun l => ?_) j
      · simp only [Fin.lastCases_last, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, false_implies]
      · intro hj
        exact congrArg Fin.castSucc (hu l (by simpa only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc] using hj))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.append_empty_value
statement:
theorem append_empty_value {d k : ℕ} (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) :
    value (Fin.lastCases ∅ A) = value A
proof:
:= by
  simp [value, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.propeller_succ
statement:
theorem propeller_succ (d k : ℕ) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    propeller d (k+1) = Fin.lastCases ∅ (propeller d k)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
  · simp [propeller, show k ≠ 0 by omega, show k ≠ 1 by omega, show k ≠ 2 by omega]
  · simp [propeller]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.propeller_attainment
statement:
theorem propeller_attainment (d k : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hk : 3 ≤ k) :
    IsPartition (propeller d k) ∧ value (propeller d k) = 9 / (8 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact propeller_three d hd
  | succ k hk ih =>
    rw [propeller_succ d k hk]
    exact ⟨append_empty_partition ih.1, (append_empty_value _).trans ih.2⟩

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_norm_le
statement:
theorem centroid_norm_le {d : ℕ} {A : Set (Space d)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    ‖centroid A‖ ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  let z := centroid A
  let f : Space d → ℝ := fun x => ⟪z, x⟫
  have hi : Integrable f (gaussian d) := (integrable_id_gaussian d).const_inner z
  have he : ∫ x, (A.indicator f) x ∂gaussian d = ‖z‖^2 := by
    rw [integral_indicator hA]
    change (∫ x in A, ⟪z, x⟫ ∂gaussian d) = _
    rw [integral_inner (integrable_id_restrict d A)]
    exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq z
  have hz : ∫ x, f x ∂gaussian d = 0 := by
    change (∫ x, ⟪z, x⟫ ∂gaussian d) = 0
    rw [integral_inner (integrable_id_gaussian d)]
    simp only [gaussian, integral_id_stdGaussian, inner_zero_right]
  have hab : ∫ x, |f x| ∂gaussian d = ‖z‖ * (2 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    Analytic.integral_abs_inner_stdGaussian z
  have hp (x : Space d) : A.indicator f x ≤ (|f x| + f x) / 2 := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ A
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      linarith only [le_abs_self (f x)]
    · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
      linarith only [neg_abs_le (f x)]
  have h := integral_mono_ae (hi.indicator hA) ((hi.abs.add hi).div_const 2)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hp)
  rw [he, integral_div] at h
  change ‖z‖^2 ≤ (∫ x, |f x| + f x ∂gaussian d) / 2 at h
  rw [integral_add hi.abs hi, hab, hz, add_zero] at h
  have hn := norm_nonneg z
  have hq : 0 ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hn' : ‖z‖^2 ≤ (1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) * ‖z‖ := by
    convert h using 1; ring
  nlinarith only [hn, hq, hn']

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_norm_sq_le
statement:
theorem centroid_norm_sq_le {d : ℕ} {A : Set (Space d)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    ‖centroid A‖^2 ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg (centroid A)) (by positivity :
      0 ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))).mpr (centroid_norm_le hA)
  simpa only [div_pow, one_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)] using h

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.normalized_centroid_lt_two_thirds
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hCp : 0 < C := (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 9 / (8 * Real.pi)).trans hC
  have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt C := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hCp
  have hn := centroid_norm_sq_le hA
  have hC' : 9 < C * (8 * Real.pi) := (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hC
  have hn' : ‖centroid A‖^2 * (2 * Real.pi) ≤ 1 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hn
  have hsq : 9 * ‖centroid A‖^2 < 4 * C := by nlinarith only [hC', hn', hp]
  apply (div_lt_iff₀ ht).mpr
  have ht2 := Real.sq_sqrt hCp.le
  have hz := norm_nonneg (centroid A)
  nlinarith only [hsq, ht2, hz, ht]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.main_attainment
statement: theorem main_attainment : MainAttainment
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  exact Reduction.propeller_attainment n (n+1) (by omega) (by omega)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.measurableSet_coneCap
statement: lemma measurableSet_coneCap (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) : MeasurableSet (coneCap n a)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_lt (by exact continuous_const.mul ((continuous_split n).snd.norm)) (by fun_prop) |>.measurableSet

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.coneCap_smul
statement:
lemma coneCap_smul (a : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0<r) (x : CE (n+1)) :
    r•x∈coneCap n a ↔ x∈coneCap n a
proof:
:= by
  have he : (split n (r•x)).2 = r•(split n x).2 := by ext i; rfl
  simp only [coneCap,mem_ofPred_eq,he,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr,PiLp.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← mul_assoc, mul_comm a r, mul_assoc, mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ hr]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.integrable_coord
statement: lemma integrable_coord : Integrable (fun x : CE (n+1) => x 0) (stdGaussian (CE (n+1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono' IsGaussian.integrable_id.norm (by fun_prop)
  filter_upwards [] with x
  exact PiLp.norm_apply_le x 0

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.tail_first_gaussian
statement: lemma tail_first_gaussian (a : ℝ) : ∫ x in Ioi a, x ∂gaussianReal 0 1 = gaussianConst*density a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,integral_gaussianReal_std]
  have he : (fun x : ℝ => (Ioi a).indicator (fun x=>x) x*density x) =
      (Ioi a).indicator (fun x => x*density x) := by
    funext x
    by_cases hx : x∈Ioi a <;> simp [hx]
  rw [he,integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,tail_first_moment]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.integral_cap
statement:
lemma integral_cap (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : CE (n+1), (coneCap n a).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) x ∂stdGaussian (CE (n+1)) = capP n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_split]
  have hi : Integrable (fun y => (coneCap n a).indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) (join n y))
      ((gaussianReal 0 1).prod (stdGaussian (CE n))) :=
    ((measurePreserving_split n).symm.integrable_comp
      (((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_coneCap n a)).aestronglyMeasurable)).mpr
      ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (measurableSet_coneCap n a))
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi]
  unfold capP
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with y
  rw [p_eq_integral_indicator]
  rfl

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.moment_cap
statement:
lemma moment_cap (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) :
    ∫ x : CE (n+1), (coneCap n a).indicator (fun x => x 0) x ∂stdGaussian (CE (n+1)) = capM n a
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_split]
  have hi : Integrable (fun y => (coneCap n a).indicator (fun x => x 0) (join n y))
      ((gaussianReal 0 1).prod (stdGaussian (CE n))) :=
    ((measurePreserving_split n).symm.integrable_comp
      ((integrable_coord.indicator (measurableSet_coneCap n a)).aestronglyMeasurable)).mpr
      (integrable_coord.indicator (measurableSet_coneCap n a))
  rw [integral_prod_symm _ hi]
  unfold capM
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with y
  rw [← tail_first_gaussian,← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
  rfl

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.integral_cone_norm
statement:
lemma integral_cone_norm {d : ℕ} (hd : 0<d) (K : Set (CE d))
    (hK : MeasurableSet K) (hcone : ∀ r:ℝ, 0<r → ∀ x, r•x∈K ↔ x∈K) :
    (∫ x : CE d, K.indicator (fun x => ‖x‖) x ∂stdGaussian (CE d)) =
      radial d (1/2)/radial (d-1) (1/2) * (stdGaussian (CE d)).real K
proof:
:= by
  let : NeZero d := ⟨by omega⟩
  have h0 := integral_homogeneous (ι:=Fin d) (K.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ))) 0 (by
    intro r hr x
    by_cases hx : x∈K <;> simp [hcone r hr x,hx])
  have h1 := integral_homogeneous (ι:=Fin d) (K.indicator (fun x => ‖x‖)) 1 (by
    intro r hr x
    by_cases hx : x∈K <;> simp [hcone r hr x,hx,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos hr])
  have he : (fun θ : Metric.sphere (0:CE d) 1 => K.indicator (fun x => ‖x‖) θ.1) =
      fun θ : Metric.sphere (0:CE d) 1 => K.indicator (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) θ.1 := by
    funext θ
    by_cases hh : θ.1∈K <;> simp [hh, mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp θ.2]
  rw [he] at h1
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Nat.add_zero,show d-1+1=d by omega] at h0 h1
  rw [integral_indicator hK,setIntegral_const,smul_eq_mul,mul_one] at h0
  have hr (q:ℕ) : (∫ r in Ioi (0:ℝ), r^q*Real.exp (-r^2/2))=radial q (1/2) := by
    unfold radial
    congr 1
    funext r; congr 2; ring
  rw [hr] at h0 h1
  rw [h1,h0]
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
  apply (eq_div_iff (radial_pos (d-1) (b:=1/2) (by norm_num)).ne').mpr
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Cap.coneCap_criterion
statement:
lemma coneCap_criterion {a : ℝ} (ha : 0≤a) (x : CE (n+1)) :
    x∈coneCap n a ↔ a/Real.sqrt (1+a^2)*‖x‖ < x 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < Real.sqrt (1+a^2) := by positivity
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0≤1+a^2 by positivity)
  have hn := norm_join_sq n (split n x)
  rw [join_split] at hn
  change ‖x‖^2 = (x 0)^2+‖(split n x).2‖^2 at hn
  change a*‖(split n x).2‖ < x 0 ↔ _
  rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hp]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx : 0 < x 0 := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) h
