name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.ProbabilityBounds.linear_quadratic_of_loss
statement:
lemma linear_quadratic_of_loss {r x : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrcap : r ≤ 2/3) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hc : (9/(8*Real.pi))*r^2/(1+Real.sqrt (1-r^2)) ≤ loss x) :
    0.415*r+0.15*r^2 < p x
proof:
:= by
  let P₀ := (0.415+0.15*r)*r
  have hP₀ : 0 < P₀ := by dsimp [P₀]; positivity
  have hP₀h : P₀ ≤ 1/2 := by dsimp [P₀]; nlinarith only [hr,hrcap]
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hPy⟩ := exists_p hP₀ hP₀h
  have ht := test_probability hr hrcap hy hPy
  have ht' := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right ht (sq_pos_of_pos hr)
  have htest : loss y < (9/(8*Real.pi))*r^2/(1+Real.sqrt (1-r^2)) := by
    unfold loss
    rw [hPy]
    dsimp [P₀] at *
    calc
      _ = (0.415+0.15*r)^2*G y*r^2 := by ring
      _ < (9/(8*Real.pi))/(1+Real.sqrt (1-r^2))*r^2 := ht'
      _ = _ := by ring
  by_contra! hh
  have hpx : p x ≤ p y := by rw [hPy]; dsimp [P₀]; nlinarith only [hh]
  have hyx : y ≤ x := by
    by_contra! hgt
    have hd : StrictAnti p := strictAnti_of_hasDerivAt_neg (fun z => hasDerivAt_p z)
      (fun z => mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by linarith [gaussianConst_tight.1]) (Real.exp_pos _))
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hpx) (hd hgt)
  have hh' := loss_antitone hy hx hyx
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hc.trans hh')) htest

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.φ_pos
statement: lemma φ_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < φ x
proof: := by unfold φ; positivity

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.φ_neg
statement: lemma φ_neg (x : ℝ) : φ (-x) = φ x
proof: := by simp [φ]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integrable_φ
statement: lemma integrable_φ : Integrable φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold φ
  have h := integrable_exp_neg_mul_sq (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/2)
  simpa only [φ, show ∀ x : ℝ, -x^2/2 = -(1/2:ℝ)*x^2 by intro x; ring] using
    h.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integral_φ
statement: lemma integral_φ : ∫ x, φ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold φ
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  simp_rw [show ∀ x : ℝ, -x^2/2 = -(1/2:ℝ)*x^2 by intro x; ring]
  rw [integral_gaussian]
  have hp : Real.pi/(1/2:ℝ) = 2*Real.pi := by ring
  rw [hp, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity)]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_φ
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_φ (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt φ (-x*φ x) x
proof:
:= by
  unfold φ
  convert ((((hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).neg.div_const 2).exp).const_mul
    ((Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹)) using 1
  first | rfl | (dsimp; ring)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.continuous_φ
statement: lemma continuous_φ : Continuous φ
proof:
:= by exact continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x =>
  (hasDerivAt_φ x).continuousAt

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_Φ
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_Φ (x : ℝ) : HasDerivAt Φ (φ x) x
proof:
:= by
  have heq : Φ = fun a => Φ 0 + ∫ t in (0:ℝ)..a, φ t := by
    funext a
    have hi := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic
      (a := 0) (b := a) integrable_φ.integrableOn integrable_φ.integrableOn
    change Φ a-Φ 0 = _ at hi
    linarith only [hi]
  rw [heq]
  exact (intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right integrable_φ.intervalIntegrable
    continuous_φ.stronglyMeasurable.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter continuous_φ.continuousAt).const_add _

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.continuous_Φ
statement: lemma continuous_Φ : Continuous Φ
proof:
:= continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x =>
  (hasDerivAt_Φ x).continuousAt

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.strictMono_Φ
statement: lemma strictMono_Φ : StrictMono Φ
proof:
:= strictMono_of_deriv_pos (fun x => by
    rw [(hasDerivAt_Φ x).deriv]; exact φ_pos x)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_pos
statement: lemma Φ_pos (x : ℝ) : 0 < Φ x
proof:
:= by
  apply (setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ (fun x => (φ_pos x).le))
    integrable_φ.integrableOn).mpr
  simp [Function.support, ne_of_gt (φ_pos _)]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_eq_one_sub_tail
statement: lemma Φ_eq_one_sub_tail (x : ℝ) : Φ x = 1 - ∫ y in Ioi x, φ y
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic integrable_φ (s := Iic x)
  rw [compl_Iic, integral_φ] at h
  unfold Φ
  linarith only [h]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_neg
statement: lemma Φ_neg (x : ℝ) : Φ (-x) = 1-Φ x
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_comp_neg_Iic (-x) φ
  simp only [φ_neg, neg_neg] at h
  change Φ (-x) = (∫ y in Ioi x, φ y) at h
  rw [h, Φ_eq_one_sub_tail]
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_lt_one
statement: lemma Φ_lt_one (x : ℝ) : Φ x < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Φ_pos (-x)
  rw [Φ_neg] at h
  linarith only [h]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_mem
statement: lemma Φ_mem (x : ℝ) : Φ x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1
proof: := ⟨Φ_pos x, Φ_lt_one x⟩

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_zero
statement: lemma Φ_zero : Φ 0 = 1/2
proof:
:= by
  have h := Φ_neg 0
  simp only [neg_zero] at h
  linarith only [h]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.tendsto_Φ_atTop
statement: lemma tendsto_Φ_atTop : Tendsto Φ atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := tendsto_integral_Ioi_zero (f := φ) (μ := volume) tendsto_id
  convert ht.const_sub 1 using 1
  · exact funext Φ_eq_one_sub_tail
  · norm_num

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.tendsto_Φ_atBot
statement: lemma tendsto_Φ_atBot : Tendsto Φ atBot (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := tendsto_Φ_atTop.comp tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop
  have hh := ht.const_sub 1
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Φ_neg, sub_sub_cancel, sub_self] using hh

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.range_Φ
statement: lemma range_Φ : range Φ = Ioo (0:ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x,rfl⟩; exact Φ_mem x
  · have hh := isPreconnected_univ.intermediate_value_Ioo
      (l₁ := atBot) (l₂ := atTop) (by simp) (by simp) continuous_Φ.continuousOn
      tendsto_Φ_atBot tendsto_Φ_atTop
    simpa only [image_univ] using hh

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.cdfIso_coe
statement: lemma cdfIso_coe (x : ℝ) : (cdfIso x : ℝ) = Φ x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.q_of_mem
statement: lemma q_of_mem {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) : q p = cdfIso.symm ⟨p,hp⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [q, hp]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.Φ_q
statement: lemma Φ_q {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) : Φ (q p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_of_mem hp, ← cdfIso_coe]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (cdfIso.apply_symm_apply ⟨p,hp⟩)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.q_Φ
statement: lemma q_Φ (x : ℝ) : q (Φ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [q_of_mem (Φ_mem x)]
  exact cdfIso.symm_apply_apply x

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.continuousOn_q
statement: lemma continuousOn_q : ContinuousOn q (Ioo (0:ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_domRestrict]
  change Continuous (fun p : Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 => q p)
  have heq : (fun p : Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 => q p) = cdfIso.symm := by
    funext p
    exact q_of_mem p.2
  rw [heq]
  exact cdfIso.symm.continuous

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.continuousAt_q
statement: lemma continuousAt_q {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) : ContinuousAt q p
proof:
:=
  continuousOn_q.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hp)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_q
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_q {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
    HasDerivAt q (φ (q p))⁻¹ p
proof:
:= by
  apply HasDerivAt.of_local_left_inverse (continuousAt_q hp) (hasDerivAt_Φ (q p))
    (ne_of_gt (φ_pos _))
  filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hp] with y hy
  exact Φ_q hy

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.strictMonoOn_q
statement: lemma strictMonoOn_q : StrictMonoOn q (Ioo (0:ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  rw [q_of_mem ha, q_of_mem hb]
  exact cdfIso.symm.strictMono hab

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.I_pos
statement: lemma I_pos (p : ℝ) : 0 < I p
proof: := φ_pos _

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.I_Φ
statement: lemma I_Φ (x : ℝ) : I (Φ x) = φ x
proof: := by simp [I, q_Φ]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_I
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_I {p : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) : HasDerivAt I (-q p) p
proof:
:= by
  convert (hasDerivAt_φ (q p)).comp p (hasDerivAt_q hp) using 1 <;>
    first | rfl | field_simp [ne_of_gt (φ_pos (q p))]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.antitoneOn_I_deriv
statement: lemma antitoneOn_I_deriv : AntitoneOn (fun p => -q p) (Ioo (0:ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  exact neg_le_neg (strictMonoOn_q.monotoneOn ha hb hab)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.concaveOn_I
statement: lemma concaveOn_I : ConcaveOn ℝ (Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) I
proof:
:= by
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (deriv I) (Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [(hasDerivAt_I ha).deriv, (hasDerivAt_I hb).deriv]
    exact antitoneOn_I_deriv ha hb hab
  apply (hanti.mono interior_subset).concaveOn_of_deriv (convex_Ioo 0 1)
  · exact fun p hp => (hasDerivAt_I hp).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · exact fun p hp => (hasDerivAt_I (interior_subset hp)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.concave_le_tangent
statement:
lemma concave_le_tangent {S : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConcaveOn ℝ S f)
    {x y d : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S) (hy : y ∈ S) (hd : HasDerivAt f d x) :
    f y ≤ f x+d*(y-x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x y with h | rfl | h
  · have hh := hf.slope_le_of_hasDerivAt hx hy h hd
    rw [slope_def_field] at hh
    have hh' := (div_le_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr h)).mp hh
    linarith
  · simp
  · have hh := hf.le_slope_of_hasDerivAt hy hx h hd
    rw [slope_def_field] at hh
    have hh' := (le_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr h)).mp hh
    nlinarith only [hh']

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.I_le_tangent
statement:
lemma I_le_tangent {p r : ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) (hr : r ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1) :
    I r ≤ I p-q p*(r-p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using concave_le_tangent concaveOn_I hp hr (hasDerivAt_I hp)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.φ_le_zero
statement: lemma φ_le_zero (x : ℝ) : φ x ≤ φ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold φ
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integrable_Φ_comp
statement:
lemma integrable_Φ_comp {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => Φ (f x)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) (continuous_Φ.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hf)
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Φ_pos _)]
  exact (Φ_lt_one _).le

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integrable_φ_comp
statement:
lemma integrable_φ_comp {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    Integrable (fun x => φ (f x)) μ
proof:
:= by
  apply Integrable.mono' (integrable_const (φ 0)) (continuous_φ.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hf)
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (φ_pos _)]
  exact φ_le_zero _

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integral_Φ_mem
statement:
lemma integral_Φ_mem {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    (∫ x, Φ (f x) ∂μ) ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos {g : X → ℝ} (hg : Integrable g μ) (hh : ∀ x, 0 < g x) : 0 < ∫ x, g x ∂μ := by
    apply (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg (fun x => (hh x).le) hg).mpr
    have heq : Function.support g = univ := by ext x; simp [Function.mem_support, ne_of_gt (hh x)]
    simp [heq]
  refine ⟨hpos (integrable_Φ_comp hf) (fun x => Φ_pos _), ?_⟩
  have hh := hpos ((integrable_const (1:ℝ)).sub (integrable_Φ_comp hf))
    (fun x => sub_pos.mpr (Φ_lt_one (f x)))
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hh
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const (1:ℝ)) (integrable_Φ_comp hf), integral_const] at hh
  simp only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul] at hh
  linarith only [hh]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.integral_φ_le_I
statement:
lemma integral_φ_le_I {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    (∫ x, φ (f x) ∂μ) ≤ I (∫ x, Φ (f x) ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  let p := ∫ x, Φ (f x) ∂μ
  have hp : p ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 := integral_Φ_mem hf
  have hi := integral_mono (integrable_φ_comp hf)
    ((integrable_const (I p)).sub (((integrable_Φ_comp hf).sub (integrable_const p)).const_mul (q p)))
    (fun x => by simpa only [I_Φ, Pi.sub_apply] using I_le_tangent hp (Φ_mem (f x)))
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_sub (integrable_const (I p)), integral_const, integral_const_mul,
    integral_sub (integrable_Φ_comp hf) (integrable_const p), integral_const] at hi
  · simpa only [probReal_univ, smul_eq_mul, one_mul, show (∫ x, Φ (f x) ∂μ) = p from rfl,
      sub_self, mul_zero, sub_zero] using hi
  · exact ((integrable_Φ_comp hf).sub (integrable_const p)).const_mul (q p)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_integral_shift
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_integral_shift {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (a : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, Φ (f x+s) ∂μ) (∫ x, φ (f x+a) ∂μ) a
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le (s := univ) (bound := fun _ => φ 0)
    (F' := fun s x => φ (f x+s)) (by simp) ?_ (integrable_Φ_comp (hf.add_const a))
    (continuous_φ.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hf.add_const a)) ?_ (integrable_const (φ 0)) ?_).2
  · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => continuous_Φ.comp_aestronglyMeasurable (hf.add_const s)
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    intro s _
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (φ_pos _)]
    exact φ_le_zero _
  · filter_upwards [] with x
    intro s _
    simpa only [mul_one, Function.comp_def, id_eq] using (hasDerivAt_Φ (f x+s)).comp s ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_add (f x))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.hasDerivAt_quantile_shift
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_quantile_shift {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (a : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => q (∫ x, Φ (f x+s) ∂μ))
      ((∫ x, φ (f x+a) ∂μ)/I (∫ x, Φ (f x+a) ∂μ)) a
proof:
:= by
  convert (hasDerivAt_q (integral_Φ_mem (hf.add_const a))).comp a
    (hasDerivAt_integral_shift hf a) using 1 <;> first | rfl | (simp only [I]; ring)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Quantile.quantile_shift_le
statement:
lemma quantile_shift_le {f : X → ℝ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    q (∫ x, Φ (f x+a) ∂μ) ≤ q (∫ x, Φ (f x) ∂μ)+a
proof:
:= by
  have hd (s : ℝ) := (hasDerivAt_quantile_shift hf s).sub (hasDerivAt_id s)
  have hm : Antitone (fun s => q (∫ x, Φ (f x+s) ∂μ)-s) := antitone_of_hasDerivAt_nonpos hd
    (fun s => by
      have hh := (div_le_one (I_pos _)).mpr (integral_φ_le_I (hf.add_const s))
      exact sub_nonpos.mpr hh)
  have hh := hm ha
  simp only [add_zero, sub_zero] at hh
  linarith only [hh]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.QuantilePDE.quantile_fderiv
proof:
:= by
  have hh := (hasDerivAt_q hu).comp_hasFDerivAt x hd
  convert hh using 1 <;> (first | rfl | (ext y; simp))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.QuantilePDE.quantile_gradient_line_derivative
statement:
lemma quantile_gradient_line_derivative {u : E → ℝ} {g : E → E}
    {K : E → E →L[ℝ] E} (hu : ∀ x, u x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hdu : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt u (innerSL ℝ (g x)) x)
    (hdg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (K x) x) (x e : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪(φ (q (u (x+s•e))))⁻¹ • g (x+s•e), e⟫)
      ((φ (q (u x)))⁻¹*⟪K x e,e⟫ +
        q (u x)*(φ (q (u x)))⁻¹^2*⟪g x,e⟫^2) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdx : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => x+s•e) e 0 := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id (0:ℝ)).smul_const e).const_add x
  have hdv : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => q (u (x+s•e)))
      ((φ (q (u x)))⁻¹*⟪g x,e⟫) 0 := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using (quantile_fderiv (hu (x+0•e)) (hdu (x+0•e))).comp_hasDerivAt 0 hdx
  have hdφ := (hasDerivAt_φ (q (u (x+0•e)))).comp 0 hdv
  have hdi := hdφ.inv (ne_of_gt (φ_pos _))
  have hdg' : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => g (x+s•e)) (K x e) 0 := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero] using (hdg (x+0•e)).comp_hasDerivAt 0 hdx
  have hi : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ⟪g (x+s•e), e⟫) ⟪K x e,e⟫ 0 := by
    simpa using hdg'.inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const (0:ℝ) e)
  have hh := hdi.mul hi
  convert hh using 1 <;> try rfl
  · funext s; simp only [real_inner_smul_left, Function.comp_def, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.inv_apply]
  · simp only [Function.comp_def, zero_smul, add_zero, Pi.inv_apply]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt (φ_pos (q (u x)))]
    ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.QuantilePDE.trace_quantile_hessian
statement:
lemma trace_quantile_hessian {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι]
    (e : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ E) (v a : ℝ) (g : E) (K : E →L[ℝ] E) :
    (∑ i : ι, (a*⟪K (e i),e i⟫ + v*a^2*⟪g,e i⟫^2)) - v*‖a • g‖^2 =
      a*(∑ i : ι, ⟪K (e i),e i⟫)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum,
    e.sum_sq_inner_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.abs_mul_φ_le
statement: lemma abs_mul_φ_le (a : ℝ) : |a| *φ a ≤ φ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : |a| ≤ 1+a^2/2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (|a|-1), sq_abs a]
  have he : |a| ≤ Real.exp (a^2/2) := hsq.trans (by nlinarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (a^2/2)])
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (Real.exp_pos (-a^2/2)).le
  rw [← Real.exp_add] at hh
  have heq : a^2/2 + -a^2/2 = 0 := by ring
  rw [heq, Real.exp_zero] at hh
  unfold φ
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), neg_zero, zero_div, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (by positivity : 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))⁻¹)]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.fderiv
proof:

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.grad_fderiv
statement:
lemma grad_fderiv {f : E → ℝ} {g : E → E} {K : E → E →L[ℝ] E}
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (g x)) x)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (K x) x) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (grad f g) (hess f g K x) x
proof:
:= by

  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.cdf_bound
statement:
lemma cdf_bound [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) : ‖Φ (f x)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Φ_pos _)]; exact (Φ_lt_one _).le

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.grad_bound
statement:
lemma grad_bound {f : E → ℝ} {g : E → E} {L : ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) (x : E) : ‖grad f g x‖ ≤ φ 0*L
proof:
:= by
  rw [grad, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (φ_pos _)]
  exact mul_le_mul (φ_le_zero _) (hL x) (norm_nonneg _) (φ_pos _).le

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SmoothCDF.hess_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : 0 ≤ D := (norm_nonneg (K x)).trans (hD x)
  calc
    ‖hess f g K x‖ ≤ ‖φ (f x) • K x‖ +
        ‖(f x*φ (f x)) • ((innerSL ℝ (g x)).smulRight (g x))‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ = φ (f x)*‖K x‖ + (|f x| *φ (f x))*‖g x‖^2 := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_pos (φ_pos _), abs_mul, abs_of_pos (φ_pos _),
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply_norm]
      ring
    _ ≤ φ 0*D + φ 0*L^2 := add_le_add
      (mul_le_mul (φ_le_zero _) (hD x) (norm_nonneg _) (φ_pos _).le)
      (mul_le_mul (abs_mul_φ_le _) ((sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hL0).2 (hL x))
        (sq_nonneg _) (φ_pos _).le)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.FourCertificates.loss_bound
statement: lemma loss_bound {x pu gu : ℝ} (hx:0≤x) (hp:p x≤pu) (hg:G x≤gu) : loss x≤pu^2*gu
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 := p_pos x
  have hg0 := G_nonneg hx
  have hsq : (p x)^2≤pu^2 := sq_le_sq₀ hp0.le (hp0.le.trans hp) |>.mpr hp
  exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq hg0).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg (sq_nonneg pu))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.mem_activeLabels
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_activeLabels (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) (i : Fin k) :
    i ∈ activeLabels A ↔ gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [activeLabels]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_active_centroid
statement:
theorem sum_active_centroid {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A) :
    ∑ i : activeLabels A, centroid (A i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (activeLabels A) (fun i => centroid (A i))]
  have he : ∑ i ∈ activeLabels A, centroid (A i) = ∑ i, centroid (A i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro i _ hi
    exact centroid_eq_zero_of_null (by simpa only [mem_activeLabels, not_not] using hi)
  rw [he, sum_centroid_eq_zero hA]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.active_centroids_obtuse
statement:
theorem active_centroids_obtuse {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A) :
    Pairwise (fun i j : activeLabels A => ⟪centroid (A i), centroid (A j)⟫ < 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  exact negative_inner_of_minimal hA (fun hh => hij (Subtype.ext hh))
    ((mem_activeLabels A i).mp i.property) ((mem_activeLabels A j).mp j.property)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.active_centroid_rank
statement:
theorem active_centroid_rank {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (i : activeLabels A) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (fun j : activeLabels A => centroid (A j)))) =
      activeCount A - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, activeCount] using GaussianPropeller.Gram.finrank_span
    (fun j : activeLabels A => centroid (A j)) (active_centroids_obtuse hA)
    (sum_active_centroid hA.1.1) i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.centroid_closedCell
statement:
theorem centroid_closedCell {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) {i : Fin k} (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) :
    centroid (closedCell (fun j => centroid (A j)) i) = centroid (A i)
proof:
:= by
  exact setIntegral_congr_set (active_eq_closedCell_ae hA hpos hi).symm

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.residual_orthogonal
statement:
theorem residual_orthogonal {z y : Space d} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ⟪z,residualVector z y⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [residualVector, inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    residualCoefficient]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.residualCoefficient_pos
statement:
theorem residualCoefficient_pos {z y : Space d} (h : ⟪z,y⟫ < 0) :
    0 < residualCoefficient z y
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [hz] at h
  exact div_pos (neg_pos.mpr h) (sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hz))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.minimal_residual_pair
statement:
theorem minimal_residual_pair {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hpos : 0 < value A) {i j l : Fin k}
    (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) (hj : gaussian d (A j) ≠ 0)
    (hl : gaussian d (A l) ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) (hil : i ≠ l) :
    let z
proof:
:= centroid (A i)
    let r := residualVector z (centroid (A j))
    let s := residualVector z (centroid (A l))
    Real.sqrt (‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2) ≤
      9*‖z‖*(1+residualCoefficient z (centroid (A j)))*
        (1+residualCoefficient z (centroid (A l)))/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) := by
  dsimp only
  let z := centroid (A i)
  let r := residualVector z (centroid (A j))
  let s := residualVector z (centroid (A l))
  let a := residualCoefficient z (centroid (A j))
  let b := residualCoefficient z (centroid (A l))
  have ha : 0 < a := residualCoefficient_pos (negative_inner_of_minimal hA hij hi hj)
  have hb : 0 < b := residualCoefficient_pos (negative_inner_of_minimal hA hil hi hl)
  have hz : z ≠ 0 := active_centroid_ne_zero hA hpos hi
  change Real.sqrt (‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2) ≤
    9*‖z‖*(1+a)*(1+b)/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))
  by_cases hd : 0 < ‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2
  · apply GaussianPropeller.Pair.centroid_residual_pair
      (closedCell (fun j => centroid (A j)) i) (measurableSet_closedCell _ _)
      z r s hz (centroid_closedCell hA hpos hi)
      (residual_orthogonal hz) (residual_orthogonal hz)
      (by linarith : 0 < 1+a) (by linarith : 0 < 1+b) ?_ ?_ hd
    · intro x hx
      have hh := hx j
      change ⟪centroid (A j),x⟫ ≤ ⟪z,x⟫ at hh
      simp only [r,residualVector,inner_add_left,inner_smul_left,starRingEnd_apply,star_trivial]
      change ⟪centroid (A j),x⟫+a*⟪z,x⟫ ≤ (1+a)*⟪z,x⟫
      linarith
    · intro x hx
      have hh := hx l
      change ⟪centroid (A l),x⟫ ≤ ⟪z,x⟫ at hh
      simp only [s,residualVector,inner_add_left,inner_smul_left,starRingEnd_apply,star_trivial]
      change ⟪centroid (A l),x⟫+b*⟪z,x⟫ ≤ (1+b)*⟪z,x⟫
      linarith
  · rw [Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_not_gt hd)]
    positivity

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.third_radius_gt
statement:
theorem third_radius_gt {L u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) (hL : L ≤ 8 / 9)
    (hcharge : (1 - L) * (0.415 / u - 0.734) ≤ 0.116) : 0.23 < u
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have hd : (0.415 : ℝ) / 0.23 ≤ 0.415 / u :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hu h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_right hd 0.734)
    (show 0 ≤ 1 - L by linarith)
  norm_num at hm
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.small_minimum_interval
proof:
:= by
  have hup : 0 < u := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < b := lt_of_lt_of_le hup hub
  have hd := div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0.415 by norm_num) hup hub
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_right hd 0.734)
    (show 0 ≤ 1 - L by linarith)
  have hLc : b ^ 2 + 2 * (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 + M ≤ L := by
    have hh := le_of_mul_le_mul_right ((hm.trans hcharge).trans hrow) hden
    linarith
  have hub2 : u ^ 2 ≤ b ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hua2 : a ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≤ (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hfirst : a ^ 2 - (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 - t ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hfirst0 : 0 ≤ u ^ 2 - t ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsecond : M ≤ L - u ^ 2 - 2 * t ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hp := mul_le_mul hfirst hsecond hM hfirst0
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.minimum_gt
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! htq
  by_cases hbig : 0.44 ≤ u
  · have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≤ (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hu2 : (0.44 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have hfirst : (0.44 : ℝ) ^ 2 - (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ u ^ 2 - t ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hsecond : (0.44 : ℝ) ^ 2 - 2 * (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
        L - u ^ 2 - 2 * t ^ 2 := by linarith
    have hp := mul_le_mul hfirst hsecond (by norm_num)
      (show 0 ≤ u ^ 2 - t ^ 2 by nlinarith)
    norm_num at hp
    nlinarith
  · have hb : u ≤ 0.44 := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hbig)
    by_cases h30 : u ≤ 0.30
    · exact small_minimum_interval (a := 0.23) (b := 0.30) (M := 0.72264)
        ht htq hL hu.le h30 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcharge hdet
    by_cases h35 : u ≤ 0.35
    · exact small_minimum_interval (a := 0.30) (b := 0.35) (M := 0.61198)
        ht htq hL (by linarith) h35 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcharge hdet
    by_cases h41 : u ≤ 0.41
    · exact small_minimum_interval (a := 0.35) (b := 0.41) (M := 0.40621)
        ht htq hL (by linarith) h41 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcharge hdet
    · exact small_minimum_interval (a := 0.41) (b := 0.44) (M := 0.24314)
        ht htq hL (by linarith) hb (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hcharge hdet

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.first_constraint_rational
proof:
:= by
  have hratio : (3 : ℝ) / Real.pi ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_one Real.pi_pos).mpr Real.pi_gt_three.le
  have hratio0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / Real.pi := by positivity

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.final_contradiction
statement:
theorem final_contradiction {c t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (ht12 : t < 0.12)
    (hc : 2.6 * t < c)
    (hdet : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (c - t ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 10 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * t ^ 2) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hratio : (3 : ℝ) / Real.pi < 150 / 157 := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hp]
    nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_d2]
  have hratio0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / Real.pi := by positivity
  have hratio2 : ((3 : ℝ) / Real.pi) ^ 2 < (150 / 157 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have ht2 : 0 < t ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos ht
  have htop := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hratio2 ht2
  have hc' : (2.48 : ℝ) * t < c - t ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hcsq : ((2.48 : ℝ) * t) ^ 2 < (c - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.charge_concave
statement:
theorem charge_concave {A : ℝ} (hA : 0.15 ≤ A) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ Set.univ (charge A)
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) (fun u : ℝ => (0.415 : ℝ) * u) :=
    (concaveOn_id convex_univ).smul (by norm_num)
  have hquad : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) (fun u : ℝ => (A - 0.15) * u ^ 2) :=
    (Even.convexOn_pow (by decide : Even (2 : ℕ))).smul (by linarith)
  exact hlin.sub hquad

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.min_charge_le
statement:
theorem min_charge_le {A a b u : ℝ} (hA : 0.15 ≤ A)
    (ha : a ≤ u) (hb : u ≤ b) : min (charge A a) (charge A b) ≤ charge A u
proof:
:=
  (charge_concave hA).min_le_of_mem_Icc (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _) ⟨ha, hb⟩

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.finalBudget_concave
statement:
theorem finalBudget_concave {A k : ℝ} (hA : 0.15 ≤ A) (hk : 0 ≤ k) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (finalBudget A k)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : ConcaveOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun t : ℝ =>
      (0.415 * Real.sqrt 2.6) * Real.sqrt t) :=
    Real.strictConcaveOn_sqrt.concaveOn.smul (by positivity)
  have hlin : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) (fun t : ℝ => (2.6 * (A - 0.15)) * t) :=
    (convexOn_id (convex_Ici (0 : ℝ))).smul (by positivity)
  have hquad := ((charge_concave hA).subset (Set.subset_univ _) (convex_Ici 0)).smul hk
  have heq : Set.EqOn
      (fun t : ℝ => (0.415 * Real.sqrt 2.6) * Real.sqrt t -
        (2.6 * (A - 0.15)) * t + k * charge A t)
      (finalBudget A k) (Set.Ici 0) := by
    intro t ht
    have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := ht
    have hsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2.6 * t by positivity)
    dsimp [finalBudget, charge]
    rw [hsq, Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2.6)]
    ring
  exact ((hsqrt.sub hlin).add hquad).congr heq

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.clipped_charge
statement:
theorem clipped_charge {A s q u δ : ℝ} (hd : 0 < A - 0.15) (hs : 0 < s)
    (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqu : q ≤ u) (hds : (A - 0.15) * s = 0.415)
    (hδ0 : 0 ≤ δ) (hδ : charge A u ≤ δ) :
    (A - 0.15) * q / (s + q) * (s ^ 2 - u ^ 2) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < s + q := by positivity
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ (A - 0.15) * q / (s + q) := by positivity
  by_cases hu : s ≤ u
  · have hsq : s ^ 2 - u ^ 2 ≤ 0 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hcoef hsq).trans hδ0
  · have hu' : u ≤ s := le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hu)
    have hprod : 0 ≤ (A - 0.15) * s * ((s - u) * (u - q)) :=
      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hu') (sub_nonneg.mpr hqu))
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ charge A u -
        (A - 0.15) * q / (s + q) * (s ^ 2 - u ^ 2) := by
      have heq : (charge A u - (A - 0.15) * q / (s + q) * (s ^ 2 - u ^ 2)) *
          (s + q) = (A - 0.15) * s * ((s - u) * (u - q)) := by
        dsimp [charge]
        rw [← hds]
        field_simp
        ring
      exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_left (heq.symm ▸ hprod) hden
    linarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.regime_five
statement: theorem regime_five : Regime 0.929 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hl, hu, he⟩ := smallRoot_five
  have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 429)
  have hsqrt0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (429 : ℝ)
  constructor
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact hl
  · simpa using hu.trans (by norm_num : (0.109 : ℝ) < 0.12)
  · exact he
  · norm_num [threshold]; nlinarith
  · norm_num; nlinarith
  · norm_num [charge]
  · norm_num [charge]
  · norm_num [charge]
  · norm_num [clipCoeff, threshold, charge]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.regime_six
statement: theorem regime_six : Regime 0.884 3
proof:
:= by

  have hsqrt0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg (429 : ℝ)
  constructor

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.sum_split
statement:
theorem sum_split (f : ℕ → ℝ) {p m : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, f i) + (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m - p), f (p + i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_add, Nat.add_sub_of_le hp]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.sum_prefix_le
statement:
theorem sum_prefix_le (f : ℕ → ℝ) {p m : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m)
    (hf : ∀ i < m, 0 ≤ f i) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, f i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, f i
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.range_mono hp)
    (fun i hi _ => hf i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.radius_le
statement: theorem radius_le {i j : ℕ} (hj : j < m) (hij : i ≤ j) : D.r j ≤ D.r i
proof:
:=
  D.ordered (show i ∈ Set.Iio m by exact lt_of_le_of_lt hij hj) hj hij

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.minimum_le
statement: theorem minimum_le {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) : D.r (m - 1) ≤ D.r i
proof:
:=
  D.radius_le (by omega) (by omega)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.prefix_norm
statement:
theorem prefix_norm {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, D.r i ^ 2) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [D.norm] using sum_prefix_le (fun i => D.r i ^ 2) hp (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.prefix_budget
statement:
theorem prefix_budget {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, D.δ i) ≤ 1 - A
proof:
:= by
  simpa [D.budget] using sum_prefix_le D.δ hp D.nonneg

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.first_two_cap
statement: theorem first_two_cap (hm : 2 ≤ m) : D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2 ≤ 8 / 9
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := D.cap 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := D.cap 1 (by omega)
  have hp0 := D.pos 0 (by omega)
  have hp1 := D.pos 1 (by omega)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.third_twice
statement: theorem third_twice (hm : 3 ≤ m) : 2 * D.r 2 ^ 2 ≤ D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := D.pos 2 (by omega)
  have h0 := D.radius_le (by omega : 2 < m) (by omega : 0 ≤ 2)
  have h1 := D.radius_le (by omega : 2 < m) (by omega : 1 ≤ 2)
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.common_charge
proof:
:= by
  let u := D.r 2
  have hu : 0 < u := D.pos 2 (by omega)
  have hterm : ∀ i < m - 2,
      D.r (2 + i) ^ 2 * (0.415 / u - (A - 0.15)) ≤ D.δ (2 + i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : 2 + i < m := by omega
    have hri := D.pos (2 + i) hi'
    have hle : D.r (2 + i) ≤ u := D.radius_le hi' (by omega)
    have hmul : D.r (2 + i) ^ 2 * (0.415 / u) ≤ 0.415 * D.r (2 + i) := by
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      apply (div_le_iff₀ hu).mpr
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hri) (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)]
    have hlower := D.lower (2 + i) hi'
    dsimp [charge] at hlower
    nlinarith
  have hsum := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul] at hsum
  have hn := sum_split (fun i => D.r i ^ 2) (by omega : 2 ≤ m)
  have hb := sum_split D.δ (by omega : 2 ≤ m)
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at hn hb
  rw [D.norm] at hn
  rw [D.budget] at hb
  have hd0 := D.nonneg 0 (by omega)
  have hd1 := D.nonneg 1 (by omega)
  have hL : 0 ≤ D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hAdj : 0 ≤ (A - 0.884) * (D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2) := by positivity
  have hns : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m - 2), D.r (2 + i) ^ 2) =
      1 - (D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2) := by linarith
  rw [hns] at hsum
  dsimp [u] at hsum
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.tail_coarse_cap
statement:
theorem tail_coarse_cap (hm : 5 ≤ m) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) (hi4 : 4 ≤ i) :
    D.r i ≤ 0.45
proof:
:= by
  have hn := D.prefix_norm (by omega : 5 ≤ m)
  have hp := D.pos i hi
  have h0 := D.radius_le hi (by omega : 0 ≤ i)
  have h1 := D.radius_le hi (by omega : 1 ≤ i)
  have h2 := D.radius_le hi (by omega : 2 ≤ i)
  have h3 := D.radius_le hi (by omega : 3 ≤ i)
  have h4 := D.radius_le hi hi4
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at hn
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.block_budget
statement:
theorem block_budget {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p + q ≤ m) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, D.δ (p + i) ≤ 1 - A
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.prefix_budget hpq
  have hs := sum_split D.δ (by omega : p ≤ p + q)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hs
  have hn : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, D.δ i :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i hi => D.nonneg i (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hi; omega))
  linarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.prefix_block_budget
statement:
theorem prefix_block_budget {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p + q ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, D.δ i) +
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, D.δ (p + i)) ≤ 1 - A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_add]
  exact D.prefix_budget hpq

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.prefix_block_norm
statement:
theorem prefix_block_norm {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p + q ≤ m) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range p, D.r i ^ 2) +
      (∑ i ∈ Finset.range q, D.r (p + i) ^ 2) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_add]
  exact D.prefix_norm hpq

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.minimum_lower
proof:
:= by
  have hc := D.common_charge (by omega) hA
  have hL := D.first_two_cap (by omega)
  have hu := third_radius_gt (D.pos 2 (by omega)) hL hc
  exact minimum_gt (D.pos (m - 1) (by omega)).le hu hL
    (D.third_twice (by omega)) hc (first_constraint_rational hdet)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.tail_base_charge
statement:
theorem tail_base_charge {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m)
    (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) (hi4 : 4 ≤ i) :
    charge A 0.066 ≤ D.δ i
proof:
:= by
  have h := min_charge_le (by linarith [R.A_lower] : 0.15 ≤ A)
    (ht.le.trans (D.minimum_le hi)) (D.tail_coarse_cap hm hi hi4)
  rw [min_eq_left R.tail_end_charge] at h
  exact h.trans (D.lower i hi)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.fourth_cap
statement:
theorem fourth_cap {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m)
    (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) : D.r 3 ≤ 0.42
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h4
  have hk : 2 ≤ k := R.k_lower
  have hd : 0 < A - 0.15 := by linarith [R.A_lower]
  have hs : 0 < threshold A := div_pos (by norm_num) hd
  have hds : (A - 0.15) * threshold A = 0.415 := by
    unfold threshold
    field_simp
  have hcoef : 0 ≤ clipCoeff A := by unfold clipCoeff; positivity
  have hfirst : ∀ i < 4,
      clipCoeff A * ((threshold A) ^ 2 - D.r i ^ 2) ≤ D.δ i := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < m := by omega
    exact clipped_charge hd hs (by norm_num)
      (h4.le.trans (D.radius_le (by omega : 3 < m) (by omega)))
      hds (D.nonneg i hi') (D.lower i hi')
  have hf := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hfirst i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at hf
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hf
  have htailnorm : (k - 1 : ℕ) * (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k - 1), D.r (4 + i) ^ 2 := by
    have hterm : ∀ i < k - 1, (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ D.r (4 + i) ^ 2 := by
      intro i hi
      have hi' : 4 + i < m := by omega
      have hr := ht.trans_le (D.minimum_le hi')
      nlinarith
    simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  have hn := D.prefix_block_norm (by omega : 4 + (k - 1) ≤ m)
  have hnm : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range 4, D.r i ^ 2) ≤
      1 - (k - 1 : ℕ) * (0.066 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hf' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sub_le_sub_left hnm (4 * (threshold A) ^ 2)) hcoef
  have htbudget : (k - 1 : ℕ) * charge A 0.066 ≤
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k - 1), D.δ (4 + i) := by
    have hterm : ∀ i < k - 1, charge A 0.066 ≤ D.δ (4 + i) := by
      intro i hi
      exact D.tail_base_charge R hm ht (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa using Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  have hb := D.prefix_block_budget (by omega : 4 + (k - 1) ≤ m)
  have hcast : ((k - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ k)]
    norm_num
  rw [hcast] at hf' htbudget
  have hmarg := R.four_margin
  nlinarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.tail_cap
statement:
theorem tail_cap {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m)
    (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) (hi3 : 3 ≤ i) :
    D.r i ≤ 0.42
proof:
:=
  (D.radius_le hi hi3).trans (D.fourth_cap R hm hkm ht)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.minimum_charge_bound
statement:
theorem minimum_charge_bound {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m)
    (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m) (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) :
    (k : ℝ) * charge A (D.r (m - 1)) ≤ 1 - A
proof:
:= by
  have hterm : ∀ i < k,
      min (charge A (D.r (m - 1))) (charge A 0.42) ≤ D.δ (3 + i) := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : 3 + i < m := by omega
    exact (min_charge_le (by linarith [R.A_lower] : 0.15 ≤ A)
      (D.minimum_le hi') (D.tail_cap R hm hkm ht hi' (by omega))).trans (D.lower _ hi')
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => hterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hs
  have hb := D.block_budget hkm
  by_cases h : charge A (D.r (m - 1)) ≤ charge A 0.42
  · rw [min_eq_left h] at hs
    exact hs.trans hb
  · rw [min_eq_right (le_of_not_ge h)] at hs
    linarith [R.cap_charge]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.minimum_le_root
statement:
theorem minimum_le_root {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m)
    (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m) (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) :
    D.r (m - 1) ≤ smallRoot A k
proof:
:= by
  have hb := D.minimum_charge_bound R hm hkm ht
  have hcap := D.tail_cap R hm hkm ht (by omega : m - 1 < m) (by omega : 3 ≤ m - 1)
  have hd : 0 ≤ A - 0.15 := by linarith [R.A_lower]
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : 0 < 2) R.k_lower)
  by_contra! h
  have hslope : 0 < 0.415 - (A - 0.15) * (D.r (m - 1) + smallRoot A k) := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcap hd
    linarith [R.root_slope]
  have hprod := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr h) hslope
  have hcharge : charge A (smallRoot A k) < charge A (D.r (m - 1)) := by
    dsimp [charge]
    nlinarith
  have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hcharge hk
  linarith [R.root_eq]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.tail_charge
statement:
theorem tail_charge {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m)
    (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < m) (hi3 : 3 ≤ i) :
    charge A (D.r (m - 1)) ≤ D.δ i
proof:
:= by
  have hbudget := D.minimum_charge_bound R hm hkm ht
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega : 0 < 2) R.k_lower)
  have hcharge : charge A (D.r (m - 1)) ≤ charge A 0.42 := by
    have h := (lt_of_le_of_lt hbudget R.cap_charge)
    nlinarith
  have h := min_charge_le (by linarith [R.A_lower] : 0.15 ≤ A)
    (D.minimum_le hi) (D.tail_cap R hm hkm ht hi hi3)
  rw [min_eq_left hcharge] at h
  exact h.trans (D.lower i hi)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.third_large
statement:
theorem third_large {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m)
    (ht : 0.066 < D.r (m - 1)) : 2.6 * D.r (m - 1) < D.r 2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let t := D.r (m - 1)
  let t₀ := smallRoot A k
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have htroot : t ≤ t₀ := D.minimum_le_root R hm hkm ht
  have htrootpos : 0 < t₀ := by dsimp [t₀]; linarith [R.root_lower]
  have hd : 0 < A - 0.15 := by linarith [R.A_lower]
  have hk : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := Nat.cast_nonneg k
  have htlt : t₀ < 0.12 := R.root_upper
  have he_inc : charge A 0.066 ≤ charge A t := by
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 0.066 + t ≤ 0.42 + t₀ by linarith) hd.le
    have hslope : 0 ≤ 0.415 - (A - 0.15) * (t + 0.066) := by
      linarith [R.root_slope]
    have hprod := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ t - 0.066 by dsimp [t]; linarith) hslope
    dsimp [charge]
    nlinarith
  have hfst : 1 - A < charge A 0.23 + (k : ℝ) * charge A t := by
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he_inc hk
    linarith [R.third_margin]
  have hspos : 0 < threshold A := div_pos (by norm_num) hd
  have hslopeeq : (A - 0.15) * threshold A = 0.415 := by
    unfold threshold
    field_simp
  have hsqrtpos : 0 < Real.sqrt (2.6 * t₀) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
  have hsqrtsq := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2.6 * t₀ by positivity)
  have hsqrtlt : Real.sqrt (2.6 * t₀) < threshold A := by
    have hcap := R.root_cap
    dsimp [t₀] at hsqrtsq ⊢
    nlinarith
  have hepos : 0 < charge A (Real.sqrt (2.6 * t₀)) := by
    have hp := mul_pos hd (sub_pos.mpr hsqrtlt)
    have hp' := mul_pos hsqrtpos hp
    dsimp [charge]
    nlinarith
  have hend : 1 - A < finalBudget A k t₀ := by
    dsimp [finalBudget]
    linarith [R.root_eq]
  have hlower := (finalBudget_concave (by linarith [R.A_lower] : 0.15 ≤ A) hk).min_le_of_mem_Icc (by norm_num : (0.066 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ici 0)
      (show t₀ ∈ Set.Ici 0 by exact htrootpos.le) (show t ∈ Set.Icc 0.066 t₀ by exact ⟨ht.le, htroot⟩)
  have hsnd : 1 - A < finalBudget A k t :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min R.final_margin hend) hlower
  by_contra! hthird
  have hthirdpos := D.pos 2 (by omega)
  have hthirdlow := third_radius_gt hthirdpos (D.first_two_cap (by omega))
    (D.common_charge (by omega) R.A_lower)
  have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 2.6 * t by positivity)
  have hthirdhi : D.r 2 ≤ Real.sqrt (2.6 * t) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (2.6 * t)]
  have hthirdcharge := (min_charge_le (by linarith [R.A_lower] : 0.15 ≤ A)
    hthirdlow.le hthirdhi).trans (D.lower 2 (by omega))
  have htailterm : ∀ i < k, charge A t ≤ D.δ (3 + i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact D.tail_charge R hm hkm ht (by omega) (by omega)
  have htail := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => htailterm i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi))
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at htail
  have hb := D.prefix_block_budget hkm
  simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, zero_add] at hb
  have h0 := D.nonneg 0 (by omega)
  have h1 := D.nonneg 1 (by omega)
  dsimp [finalBudget] at hsnd
  rcases le_total (charge A 0.23) (charge A (Real.sqrt (2.6 * t))) with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h] at hthirdcharge
    linarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h] at hthirdcharge
    linarith

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.RadiusData.incompatible
statement:
theorem incompatible {k : ℕ} (R : Regime A k) (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hkm : 3 + k ≤ m)
    (hdet₁ : (D.r 2 ^ 2 - D.r (m - 1) ^ 2) *
      (D.r 0 ^ 2 + D.r 1 ^ 2 - D.r 2 ^ 2 - 2 * D.r (m - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        8 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * D.r (m - 1) ^ 2)
    (hdet₂ : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (D.r 2 ^ 2 - D.r (m - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
      10 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * D.r (m - 1) ^ 2) : False
proof:
:= by
  have ht := D.minimum_lower hm R.A_lower hdet₁
  have htroot := D.minimum_le_root R hm hkm ht
  have ht12 := lt_of_le_of_lt htroot R.root_upper
  exact final_contradiction (by linarith : 0 < D.r (m - 1)) ht12
    (D.third_large R hm hkm ht) hdet₂

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Scalar.scalar_incompatibility
statement:
theorem scalar_incompatibility {m : ℕ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (r P : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hpos : ∀ i < m, 0 < r i) (hordered : AntitoneOn r (Set.Iio m))
    (hcap : ∀ i < m, r i ≤ 2 / 3)
    (hnorm : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, r i ^ 2 = 1)
    (hprob : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, P i = 1)
    (hquad : ∀ i < m, (if m = 5 then (0.929 : ℝ) else 0.884) * r i ^ 2 ≤ P i)
    (hlin : ∀ i < m, 0.415 * r i + 0.15 * r i ^ 2 ≤ P i)
    (hdet₁ : (r 2 ^ 2 - r (m - 1) ^ 2) *
      (r 0 ^ 2 + r 1 ^ 2 - r 2 ^ 2 - 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2) ≤
        8 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2)
    (hdet₂ : (3 / 2 : ℝ) * (r 2 ^ 2 - r (m - 1) ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤
      10 * (3 / Real.pi) ^ 2 * r (m - 1) ^ 2) : False
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ := if m = 5 then 0.929 else 0.884
  let D : RadiusData m A := {
    r := r
    δ := fun i => P i - A * r i ^ 2
    pos := hpos
    ordered := hordered
    cap := hcap
    norm := hnorm
    nonneg := fun i hi => sub_nonneg.mpr (hquad i hi)
    lower := by intro i hi; dsimp [charge]; linarith [hlin i hi]
    budget := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, hnorm, hprob, mul_one] }
  by_cases hm5 : m = 5
  · have hR : Regime A 2 := by simpa [A, hm5] using regime_five
    exact D.incompatible hR hm (by omega) hdet₁ hdet₂
  · have hR : Regime A 3 := by simpa [A, hm5] using regime_six
    exact D.incompatible hR hm (by omega) hdet₁ hdet₂

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sqrt_threshold
statement:
lemma sqrt_threshold {C:ℝ} (hC:9/(8*Real.pi)<C) :
    (3/2:ℝ)*gaussianConst < Real.sqrt C
proof:
:= by
  have hCp:0<C := (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  have hc0:0≤gaussianConst := by unfold gaussianConst; positivity
  have hc2:gaussianConst^2=1/(2*Real.pi) := by
    rw [gaussianConst,inv_pow,Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity),one_div]
  apply (sq_lt_sq₀ (by positivity : 0≤(3/2:ℝ)*gaussianConst) (Real.sqrt_nonneg C)).mp
  rw [mul_pow,hc2,Real.sq_sqrt hCp.le]
  have he : (3/2:ℝ)^2*(1/(2*Real.pi))=9/(8*Real.pi) := by field_simp; ring
  rwa [he]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.minimal_cap_three
statement:
lemma minimal_cap_three {A:Fin 4→Set (Space d)} (hA:MinimalOptimal A)
    (hC:9/(8*Real.pi)<value A) (hall:∀ j,gaussian d (A j)≠0) (i:Fin 4) :
    ‖centroid (A i)‖/Real.sqrt (value A) ≤
      (8/3:ℝ)*(gaussian d).real (A i)*(1-(gaussian d).real (A i))
proof:
:= by
  have hCp:0<value A := (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcone,hP,hM⟩ := minimal_span_cone (n:=2) hA hCp hall i (by norm_num)
  have hp := active_probability_mem (by norm_num) hA hCp (hall i)
  have hb := Cap.cone_three K hK hcone (by change (gaussian 3).real K∈Set.Ioo (0:ℝ) 1; rw [hP]; exact ⟨hp.1,by linarith only [hp.2]⟩)
    (by change (gaussian 3).real K≤1/2; rw [hP]; exact hp.2)
  change (∫ x, K.indicator (fun x:Space 3=>x 0) x ∂gaussian 3) ≤
    4*gaussianConst*(gaussian 3).real K*(1-(gaussian 3).real K) at hb
  rw [hP,hM] at hb
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hCp)).mpr
  have hs := sqrt_threshold hC
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (show 4*gaussianConst ≤ (8/3:ℝ)*Real.sqrt (value A) by linarith only [hs])
    (show 0≤(gaussian d).real (A i)*(1-(gaussian d).real (A i)) by exact mul_nonneg hp.1.le (by linarith only [hp.2]))
  nlinarith only [hb,hh]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.minimal_cap_four
statement:
lemma minimal_cap_four {A:Fin 5→Set (Space d)} (hA:MinimalOptimal A)
    (hC:9/(8*Real.pi)<value A) (hall:∀ j,gaussian d (A j)≠0) (i:Fin 5) :
    (929/1000:ℝ)*(‖centroid (A i)‖/Real.sqrt (value A))^2 ≤ (gaussian d).real (A i)
proof:
:= by
  have hCp:0<value A := (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  obtain ⟨K,hK,hcone,hP,hM⟩ := minimal_span_cone (n:=3) hA hCp hall i (by norm_num)
  have hp := active_probability_mem (by norm_num) hA hCp (hall i)
  have hb := Cap.cone_four K hK hcone (by change 0<(gaussian 4).real K; rw [hP]; exact hp.1)
    (by change 0≤∫ x, K.indicator (fun x:Space 4=>x 0) x ∂gaussian 4; rw [hM]; positivity)
  change (∫ x, K.indicator (fun x:Space 4=>x 0) x ∂gaussian 4)^2 ≤
    (963/2500:ℝ)*(gaussian 4).real K at hb
  rw [hP,hM] at hb
  have hn:(963/2500:ℝ)*(929/1000)<9/(8*Real.pi) := by
    apply (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    nlinarith only [Real.pi_lt_d6]
  have hh:=mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤929/1000)
  have hc:=mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hn.trans hC).le hp.1.le
  rw [div_pow,Real.sq_sqrt hCp.le,←mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hCp).mpr
  nlinarith only [hh,hc]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.FourCertificates.small_0
statement:
lemma small_0 {r x:ℝ} (hr:r∈Icc (39/250:ℝ) (157/1000:ℝ)) (hx:0≤x)
    (hl:(9/(8*Real.pi))*r^2/(1+Real.sqrt (1-(4/3:ℝ)*r^2))≤loss x) : small r < p x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hP : p x ≤ small (157/1000:ℝ) := (le_of_not_gt hn).trans (small_mono (by change 0≤r; linarith only [hr.1]) (by norm_num) hr.2)
  have hj : 0≤J 12 (9139/6250:ℝ) := by norm_num [J,Finset.sum_range_succ,Nat.factorial]
  have hj' : 0≤J 13 (9139/6250:ℝ) := by norm_num [J,Finset.sum_range_succ,Nat.factorial]
  have hpL : small (157/1000:ℝ) ≤ p (9139/6250:ℝ) := by
    apply le_trans ?_ (p_taylor_lower (by norm_num) 6 hj)
    norm_num [small,J,Finset.sum_range_succ,Nat.factorial]
  have hpU : p (9139/6250:ℝ)≤(449/6250:ℝ) := by
    apply le_trans (p_taylor_upper (by norm_num) 6 hj')
    norm_num [J,Finset.sum_range_succ,Nat.factorial]
  have hla : lambda (9139/6250:ℝ)≤(953337/500000:ℝ) := by
    apply lambda_taylor_upper (by norm_num) 6 (by norm_num) hj
    norm_num [E,J,Finset.sum_range_succ,Nat.factorial]
  have hg : G (9139/6250:ℝ)≤(847391/1000000:ℝ) := G_upper_of_lambda (by norm_num) hla (by norm_num)
  exact loss_row (lo:=(39/250:ℝ)) (q:=(9139/6250:ℝ)) (v:=(983643/1000000:ℝ))
    (u:=(449/6250:ℝ)^2*(847391/1000000:ℝ)) (by norm_num) hr.1 hx (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (loss_bound (by norm_num) hpU hg) (hP.trans hpL) hl

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.heat_mem
statement:
lemma heat_mem {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (t : ℝ) (x : E) :
    heat (fun y => Φ (f y)) t x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1
proof: := integral_Φ_mem (by fun_prop)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.continuous_qheat
statement:
lemma continuous_qheat {f : E → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun p : ℝ × E => qheat f p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hh := continuous_heat (continuous_Φ.comp hf) (SmoothCDF.cdf_bound f)
  exact continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun p =>
    (continuousAt_q (heat_mem hf p.1 p.2)).comp (f := fun p : ℝ × E => heat (fun y => Φ (f y)) p.1 p.2) hh.continuousAt

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.qheat_zero
statement: lemma qheat_zero (f : E → ℝ) (x : E) : qheat f 0 x = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [qheat, heat, q_Φ]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.qheat_le
statement:
lemma qheat_le {f : E → ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (t : ℝ) (x y : E) :
    qheat f t x ≤ qheat f t y + L*‖x-y‖
proof:
:= by
  have hc := hf.continuous
  have hfm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : E => f (y+Real.sqrt t • z)) γ := by fun_prop
  have hxm : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : E => f (x+Real.sqrt t • z)) γ := by fun_prop
  have hxy (z : E) : f (x+Real.sqrt t • z) ≤ f (y+Real.sqrt t • z)+L*‖x-y‖ := by
    have hh := hf.dist_le_mul (x+Real.sqrt t • z) (y+Real.sqrt t • z)
    rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] at hh
    linarith only [le_abs_self (f (x+Real.sqrt t • z)-f (y+Real.sqrt t • z)), hh]
  have hint : (∫ z : E, Φ (f (x+Real.sqrt t • z)) ∂γ) ≤
      ∫ z : E, Φ (f (y+Real.sqrt t • z)+L*‖x-y‖) ∂γ :=
    integral_mono (integrable_Φ_comp hxm) (integrable_Φ_comp (hfm.add_const _))
      (fun z => strictMono_Φ.monotone (hxy z))
  exact (strictMonoOn_q.monotoneOn (integral_Φ_mem hxm)
    (integral_Φ_mem (hfm.add_const _)) hint).trans (quantile_shift_le hfm (by positivity))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.qheat_lipschitz
statement:
lemma qheat_lipschitz {f : E → ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (t : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith L (qheat f t)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro x y
  rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, abs_le]
  have hxy := qheat_le hf t x y
  have hyx := qheat_le hf t y x
  rw [norm_sub_rev y x] at hyx
  constructor <;> linarith only [hxy,hyx]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.growth_bound
statement:
lemma growth_bound {f : E → ℝ} {L : ℝ≥0} (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (T : ℝ) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x, |qheat f t x| ≤ M+L*‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => |qheat f t 0|) :=
    ((continuous_qheat hf.continuous).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).abs
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.image hc).bddAbove
  refine ⟨max M 0, le_max_right _ _,?_⟩
  intro t ht x
  have hm : |qheat f t 0| ≤ max M 0 := (hM (mem_image_of_mem _ ht)).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  have hd := (qheat_lipschitz hf t).dist_le_mul x 0
  simp only [Real.dist_eq, dist_zero_right] at hd
  have hh := abs_sub_le (qheat f t x) (qheat f t 0) 0
  simp only [sub_zero] at hh
  linarith only [hh,hm,hd]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.EhrhardSmooth.qheat_concave
statement:
lemma qheat_concave {f : E → ℝ} {g : E → E} {K : E → E →L[ℝ] E}
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (g x)) x)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (K x) x) (hK : Continuous K)
    {L : ℝ≥0} {D : ℝ} (hL : ∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ L) (hD : ∀ x, ‖K x‖ ≤ D)
    (hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ univ f) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ univ (qheat f T)
proof:
:= by
  have hcf : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hf x).continuousAt)
  have hcg : Continuous g := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hg x).continuousAt)
  have hlip : LipschitzWith L f := lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le
    (fun x => (hf x).differentiableAt) (fun x => by
      rw [(hf x).fderiv]
      exact_mod_cast (show ‖innerSL ℝ (g x)‖ ≤ L by rw [innerSL_apply_norm]; exact hL x))
  let F : E → ℝ := fun x => Φ (f x)
  let G : E → E := SmoothCDF.grad f g
  let J : E → E →L[ℝ] E := SmoothCDF.hess f g K
  have hF (x : E) : HasFDerivAt F (innerSL ℝ (G x)) x := SmoothCDF.fderiv hf x
  have hG (x : E) : HasFDerivAt G (J x) x := SmoothCDF.grad_fderiv hf hg x
  have hcG : Continuous G := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hG x).continuousAt)
  have hcJ : Continuous J := SmoothCDF.continuous_hess hcf hcg hK
  have hFB (x : E) : ‖F x‖ ≤ 1 := SmoothCDF.cdf_bound f x
  have hGB (x : E) : ‖G x‖ ≤ φ 0*L := SmoothCDF.grad_bound hL x
  have hJB (x : E) : ‖J x‖ ≤ φ 0*(D+(L:ℝ)^2) := SmoothCDF.hess_bound L.coe_nonneg hL hD x
  let u : ℝ → E → ℝ := heat F
  let v : ℝ → E → ℝ := qheat f
  let p : ℝ → E → E := fun t x => (φ (v t x))⁻¹ • heat G t x
  let H : ℝ → E → E → ℝ := fun t x e =>
    (φ (v t x))⁻¹*⟪heat J t x e,e⟫ + v t x*(φ (v t x))⁻¹^2*⟪heat G t x,e⟫^2
  have hu (t : ℝ) (x : E) : u t x ∈ Ioo (0:ℝ) 1 := heat_mem hcf t x
  have hdu (t : ℝ) (x : E) : HasFDerivAt (u t) (innerSL ℝ (heat G t x)) x :=
    heat_gradient hF hcG hFB hGB t x
  have hdg (t : ℝ) (x : E) : HasFDerivAt (heat G t) (heat J t x) x :=
    fderiv_heat hG hcJ hGB hJB t x
  have hdv (t : ℝ) (x : E) : HasFDerivAt (v t) (innerSL ℝ (p t x)) x :=
    quantile_fderiv (hu t x) (hdu t x)
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hgrowth⟩ := growth_bound hlip T
  apply HeatMaximum.heat_concave (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ)
    (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ).orthonormal.norm_eq_one i)
    (p := p) (H := H) hT L.coe_nonneg hM (continuous_qheat hcf)
  · change ConcaveOn ℝ univ (qheat f 0)
    rw [show qheat f 0 = f from funext (qheat_zero f)]
    exact hconc
  · intro t _ x; exact hdv t x
  · intro t _ x e
    exact quantile_gradient_line_derivative (hu t) (hdu t) (hdg t) x e
  · intro t ht x
    have hh := (hasDerivAt_q (hu t x)).comp t (heat_equation hF hG hcJ hFB hGB hJB ht.1 x)
    have heq := trace_quantile_hessian (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ)
      (v t x) ((φ (v t x))⁻¹) (heat G t x) (heat J t x)
    change HasDerivAt (fun s => q (u s x))
      (((∑ i : ι, H t x (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i))-v t x*‖p t x‖^2)/2) t
    convert hh using 1 <;> try rfl
    change ((∑ i : ι, ((φ (v t x))⁻¹*⟪heat J t x (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i),
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i⟫ + v t x*(φ (v t x))⁻¹^2*⟪heat G t x,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i⟫^2))-v t x*‖(φ (v t x))⁻¹ • heat G t x‖^2)/2 = _
    rw [heq]
    change (φ (q (u t x)))⁻¹*(∑ i : ι, ⟪heat J t x (EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i),
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun ι ℝ i⟫)/2 = _
    ring
  · intro t _ x
    have hh := (hdv t x).le_of_lipschitz (qheat_lipschitz hlip t)
    simpa only [innerSL_apply_norm] using hh
  · exact hgrowth

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.Z_pos
statement: lemma Z_pos (v : ι → E) (x : E) : 0 < Z v x
proof:
:=
  Finset.sum_pos (fun _ _ => Real.exp_pos _) Finset.univ_nonempty

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.weight_pos
statement: lemma weight_pos (v : ι → E) (x : E) (i : ι) : 0 < weight v x i
proof:
:=
  div_pos (Real.exp_pos _) (Z_pos v x)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.sum_weight
statement: lemma sum_weight (v : ι → E) (x : E) : ∑ i, weight v x i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weight, ← Finset.sum_div]
  exact div_self (ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.continuous_Z
statement: lemma continuous_Z [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → E) : Continuous (Z v)
proof: := by unfold Z; fun_prop

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.continuous_weight
statement: lemma continuous_weight (v : ι → E) (i : ι) : Continuous (fun x => weight v x i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun x : E => Real.exp (-⟪v i,x⟫))).div
    (continuous_Z v) (fun x => ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.continuous_grad
statement: lemma continuous_grad (v : ι → E) : Continuous (grad v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold grad
  exact continuous_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (continuous_weight v i).smul continuous_const)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.continuous_hess
statement: lemma continuous_hess (v : ι → E) : Continuous (hess v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold hess
  apply continuous_finsetSum
  intro i _
  have h := continuous_grad v
  have hw := continuous_weight v i
  fun_prop

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.inner_grad
statement:
lemma inner_grad [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → E) (x e : E) :
    ⟪grad v x,e⟫ = ∑ i, weight v x i*⟪v i,e⟫
proof:
:= by
  simp only [grad, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.Z_fderiv
statement:
lemma Z_fderiv (v : ι → E) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (Z v) (-(Z v x) • innerSL ℝ (grad v x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hd (i : ι) : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E => Real.exp (-⟪v i,y⟫))
      (-Real.exp (-⟪v i,x⟫) • innerSL ℝ (v i)) x := by
    convert ((innerSL ℝ (v i)).hasFDerivAt.neg.exp) using 1 <;>
      (first | rfl | (ext y; simp))
  have hs := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  convert hs using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext e
  simp only [smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, sum_apply,
    inner_grad, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  dsimp only [weight]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x)]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_fderiv
statement:
lemma value_fderiv (v : ι → E) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (value v) (innerSL ℝ (grad v x)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hh := ((Z_fderiv v x).log (ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x))).neg
  convert hh using 1 <;> (first | rfl | (ext y; simp [ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x)]))

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.weight_fderiv
statement:
lemma weight_fderiv (v : ι → E) (x : E) (i : ι) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => weight v y i)
      (weight v x i • innerSL ℝ (grad v x-v i)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hn := ((innerSL ℝ (v i)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)).neg.exp
  have hi := (hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x))).comp_hasFDerivAt x (Z_fderiv v x)
  have hh := hn.mul hi
  convert hh using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext e
  simp only [smul_apply, innerSL_apply_apply, smul_eq_mul, inner_sub_left,
    Pi.neg_apply, Function.comp_def, add_apply, neg_apply]
  dsimp only [weight]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt (Z_pos v x)]
  ring

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.grad_fderiv
statement:
lemma grad_fderiv (v : ι → E) (x : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (grad v) (hess v x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hd (i : ι) := (weight_fderiv v x i).smul_const (v i)
  have hs := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  convert hs using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext e
  simp [hess, smul_smul]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.grad_bound
statement: lemma grad_bound (v : ι → E) {L : ℝ} (hL : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ L) (x : E) : ‖grad v x‖ ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖grad v x‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖weight v x i • v i‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, weight v x i*L := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (weight_pos v x i)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hL i) (weight_pos v x i).le
    _ = L := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_weight, one_mul]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.hess_bound
statement:
lemma hess_bound (v : ι → E) {L : ℝ} (hL0 : 0 ≤ L) (hL : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ L) (x : E) :
    ‖hess v x‖ ≤ 2*L^2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖hess v x‖ ≤ ∑ i, ‖weight v x i • ((innerSL ℝ (grad v x-v i)).smulRight (v i))‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i, weight v x i*(2*L^2) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (weight_pos v x i),
        ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, innerSL_apply_norm]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (weight_pos v x i).le
      have hd : ‖grad v x-v i‖ ≤ 2*L := (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (by linarith [grad_bound v hL x, hL i])
      calc
        ‖grad v x-v i‖*‖v i‖ ≤ (2*L)*L := mul_le_mul hd (hL i) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = _ := by ring
    _ = 2*L^2 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, sum_weight, one_mul]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.hess_nonpos
statement: lemma hess_nonpos (v : ι → E) (x e : E) : ⟪hess v x e,e⟫ ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hvariance : 0 ≤ ∑ i, weight v x i*(⟪v i,e⟫-⟪grad v x,e⟫)^2 :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (weight_pos v x i).le (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (∑ i, weight v x i*(⟪v i,e⟫-⟪grad v x,e⟫)^2) =
      -(∑ i, weight v x i*⟪grad v x-v i,e⟫*⟪v i,e⟫) := by
    simp_rw [inner_sub_left]
    have hp (i : ι) : weight v x i*(⟪v i,e⟫-⟪grad v x,e⟫)^2 +
        weight v x i*(⟪grad v x,e⟫-⟪v i,e⟫)*⟪v i,e⟫ =
        weight v x i*⟪grad v x,e⟫^2 - (weight v x i*⟪v i,e⟫)*⟪grad v x,e⟫ := by ring
    have hh := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.univ) rfl (fun i _ => hp i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul,
      sum_weight, one_mul, ← inner_grad] at hh
    nlinarith only [hh]
  rw [heq] at hvariance
  unfold hess
  simp only [sum_apply, smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left, innerSL_apply_apply, ← mul_assoc]
  linarith only [hvariance]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.concave_of_hessian
statement:
lemma concave_of_hessian {f : E → ℝ} {g : E → E} {K : E → E →L[ℝ] E}
    (hf : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt f (innerSL ℝ (g x)) x)
    (hg : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt g (K x) x)
    (hK : ∀ x e, ⟪K x e,e⟫ ≤ 0) : ConcaveOn ℝ univ f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ,?_⟩
  intro x _ y _ a b ha hb hab
  let d := y-x
  have hline (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => x+r•d) d s := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const d).const_add x
  have hdf (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => f (x+r•d)) ⟪g (x+s•d),d⟫ s := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, innerSL_apply_apply] using (hf (x+s•d)).comp_hasDerivAt s (hline s)
  have hdg (s : ℝ) : HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => ⟪g (x+r•d),d⟫) ⟪K (x+s•d) d,d⟫ s := by
    simpa using ((hg (x+s•d)).comp_hasDerivAt s (hline s)).inner ℝ (hasDerivAt_const s d)
  have hant : Antitone (fun s : ℝ => ⟪g (x+s•d),d⟫) := antitone_of_hasDerivAt_nonpos hdg (fun s => hK _ _)
  have hconc : ConcaveOn ℝ univ (fun s : ℝ => f (x+s•d)) :=
    Antitone.concaveOn_univ_of_deriv (fun s => (hdf s).differentiableAt) (by
      intro s t hst
      rw [(hdf s).deriv, (hdf t).deriv]
      exact hant hst)
  have hh := hconc.2 (mem_univ (0:ℝ)) (mem_univ (1:ℝ)) ha hb hab
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, mul_one, zero_add, zero_smul, add_zero, one_smul] at hh
  have heq : x+b•d = a•x+b•y := by
    dsimp [d]
    have haeq : a=1-b := by linarith only [hab]
    rw [haeq]
    module
  simpa only [heq, d, add_sub_cancel, smul_eq_mul] using hh

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_concave
statement:
lemma value_concave {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → E) :
    ConcaveOn ℝ univ (value v)
proof: := concave_of_hessian (value_fderiv v) (grad_fderiv v) (hess_nonpos v)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_lipschitz
statement:
lemma value_lipschitz {ι : Type uι} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → E)
    {L : ℝ≥0} (hL : ∀ i, ‖v i‖ ≤ L) : LipschitzWith L (value v)
proof:
:= by
  apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le (fun x => (value_fderiv v x).differentiableAt)
  intro x
  rw [(value_fderiv v x).fderiv]
  exact_mod_cast (show ‖innerSL ℝ (grad v x)‖ ≤ L by rw [innerSL_apply_norm]; exact grad_bound v hL x)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_le_score
statement: lemma value_le_score [Nonempty ι] (v : ι → E) (x : E) (i : ι) : value v x ≤ ⟪v i,x⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hh : Real.exp (-⟪v i,x⟫) ≤ Z v x := by
    apply Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => Real.exp (-⟪v j,x⟫))
    · intro j _; exact (Real.exp_pos _).le
    · exact Finset.mem_univ i
  have hl := Real.log_le_log (Real.exp_pos _) hh
  rw [Real.log_exp] at hl
  dsimp only [value]
  linarith only [hl]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_tendsto_atBot
statement:
lemma value_tendsto_atBot (v : ι → E) (x : E) (i : ι) (hi : ⟪v i,x⟫ < 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => value (fun j => (n:ℝ) • v j) x) atTop atBot
proof:
:= by
  have hh : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*⟪v i,x⟫) atTop atBot :=
    tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop.atTop_mul_const_of_neg hi
  apply tendsto_atBot_mono (fun n => ?_) hh
  simpa only [real_inner_smul_left] using value_le_score (fun j => (n:ℝ) • v j) x i

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.SoftMin.value_tendsto_atTop
statement:
lemma value_tendsto_atTop (v : ι → E) (x : E) (hi : ∀ i, 0 < ⟪v i,x⟫) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => value (fun j => (n:ℝ) • v j) x) atTop atTop
proof:
:= by
  have hz : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Z (fun j => (n:ℝ) • v j) x) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hh (i : ι) : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(n:ℝ)*⟪v i,x⟫)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
      simpa only [neg_mul, mul_neg] using
        (tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop (R := ℝ)).atTop_mul_const_of_neg (neg_neg_of_pos (hi i))
    have ht := tendsto_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hh i)
    simpa only [Z, real_inner_smul_left, neg_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero] using ht
  have hzn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Z (fun j => (n:ℝ) • v j) x) atTop (𝓝[>] 0) :=
    tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨hz, Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => Z_pos _ _)⟩
  exact tendsto_neg_atBot_atTop.comp (Real.tendsto_log_nhdsGT_zero.comp hzn)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sqrt_value_lower
statement:
lemma sqrt_value_lower {C : ℝ} (hC : 9/(8*Real.pi) < C) :
    3/(2*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) < Real.sqrt C
proof:
:= by
  have hCp : 0 < C := (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hs2 : (Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))^2 = 2*Real.pi := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hrel : (3/(2*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)))^2 = 9/(8*Real.pi) := by
    rw [div_pow, mul_pow, hs2]
    ring
  have ht2 := Real.sq_sqrt hCp.le
  have hn : 0 ≤ 3/(2*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) := by positivity
  nlinarith only [hrel,hC,ht2,Real.sqrt_nonneg C]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.normalize_pair_constant
statement:
lemma normalize_pair_constant {C z L M D : ℝ} (hC : 9/(8*Real.pi) < C)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hD : D ≤ 9*z*L*M/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))) :
    (Real.sqrt C)⁻¹*(Real.sqrt C)⁻¹*D ≤ (3/Real.pi)*(z/Real.sqrt C)*L*M
proof:
:= by
  have hCp : 0 < C := (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC
  have ht : 0 < Real.sqrt C := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hCp
  have hq : 0 < Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi) := by positivity
  have hp : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have hh := le_of_lt (sqrt_value_lower hC)
  have hh' : 3 ≤ Real.sqrt C*(2*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) := (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mp hh
  have hb : 9/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)) ≤ (3/Real.pi)*Real.sqrt C := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr
    calc
      9 ≤ 3*(Real.sqrt C*(2*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi))) := by linarith only [hh']
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have hDb : D ≤ (3/Real.pi)*Real.sqrt C*z*L*M := by
    calc
      D ≤ (9/(2*Real.pi*Real.sqrt (2*Real.pi)))*z*L*M := by
        convert hD using 1
        ring
      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hb hz) hL) hM
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDb
    (show 0 ≤ (Real.sqrt C)⁻¹*(Real.sqrt C)⁻¹ by positivity)
  convert hm using 1
  field_simp

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.minimal_normalized_pair
statement:
theorem minimal_normalized_pair {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : MinimalOptimal A)
    (hC : 9/(8*Real.pi) < value A) {i j l : Fin k}
    (hi : gaussian d (A i) ≠ 0) (hj : gaussian d (A j) ≠ 0)
    (hl : gaussian d (A l) ≠ 0) (hij : i ≠ j) (hil : i ≠ l) :
    let z
proof:
:= centroid (A i)
    let r := (Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹ • residualVector z (centroid (A j))
    let s := (Real.sqrt (value A))⁻¹ • residualVector z (centroid (A l))
    Real.sqrt (‖r‖^2*‖s‖^2-⟪r,s⟫^2) ≤
      (3/Real.pi)*(‖z‖/Real.sqrt (value A))*(1+residualCoefficient z (centroid (A j)))*
        (1+residualCoefficient z (centroid (A l))) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [GaussianPropeller.Pair.sqrt_gram_smul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  apply normalize_pair_constant hC (norm_nonneg _)
    (le_of_lt (lt_trans (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (lt_add_of_pos_right _
      (residualCoefficient_pos (negative_inner_of_minimal hA hij hi hj)))))
    (le_of_lt (lt_trans (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1) (lt_add_of_pos_right _
      (residualCoefficient_pos (negative_inner_of_minimal hA hil hi hl)))))
  exact minimal_residual_pair hA ((by positivity : (0:ℝ)<9/(8*Real.pi)).trans hC) hi hj hl hij hil

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_cell_probability
statement:
theorem sum_cell_probability {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A) :
    ∑ i, (gaussian d).real (A i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let : IsProbabilityMeasure (gaussian d) := by unfold gaussian; infer_instance
  have hsum := integral_congr_ae (sum_indicator_eq hA (fun _ => (1:ℝ)))
  rw [integral_finsetSum] at hsum
  · simpa only [integral_indicator_const (1:ℝ) (hA.1 _), smul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      integral_const, measureReal_def, measure_univ, ENNReal.toReal_one, one_smul] using hsum
  · intro i _
    exact (integrable_const (1:ℝ)).indicator (hA.1 i)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_active_probability
statement:
theorem sum_active_probability {A : Fin k → Set (Space d)} (hA : IsPartition A) :
    ∑ i : activeLabels A, (gaussian d).real (A i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (activeLabels A) (fun i => (gaussian d).real (A i))]
  have he : ∑ i ∈ activeLabels A, (gaussian d).real (A i) = ∑ i, (gaussian d).real (A i) := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
    intro i _ hi
    have hz : gaussian d (A i) = 0 := by simpa only [mem_activeLabels, not_not] using hi
    simp [measureReal_def,hz]
  rw [he,sum_cell_probability hA]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_active_norm_sq
statement:
theorem sum_active_norm_sq (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) :
    ∑ i : activeLabels A, ‖centroid (A i)‖^2 = value A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Finset.sum_coe_sort (activeLabels A) (fun i => ‖centroid (A i)‖^2)]
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ _)
  intro i _ hi
  have hz : gaussian d (A i) = 0 := by simpa only [mem_activeLabels, not_not] using hi
  simp [centroid_eq_zero_of_null hz]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Reduction.sum_active_radius_sq
statement:
theorem sum_active_radius_sq (A : Fin k → Set (Space d)) (hpos : 0 < value A) :
    ∑ i : activeLabels A, (‖centroid (A i)‖/Real.sqrt (value A))^2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le, ← Finset.sum_div, sum_active_norm_sq]
  exact div_self hpos.ne'

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Stein.integrable_bounded
statement:
lemma integrable_bounded {H : E → ℝ} (hH : AEStronglyMeasurable H γ)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : ∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ B) : Integrable H γ
proof:
:=
  Integrable.mono' (integrable_const B) hH (ae_of_all _ hB)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Stein.translation_expectation
statement:
lemma translation_expectation (v : E) {H : E → ℝ} (hH : Continuous H) :
    ∫ x, H (x+v) ∂γ = ∫ x, Real.exp (⟪v,x⟫-‖v‖^2/2)*H x ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_map (by fun_prop) hH.aestronglyMeasurable, stdGaussian_map_add]
  rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul (by fun_prop)
    (ae_of_all _ (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)), smul_eq_mul]

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Stein.weighted_mgf_derivative
statement:
lemma weighted_mgf_derivative {H : E → ℝ} (hH : Continuous H)
    {B : ℝ} (hB : ∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ B) (v : E) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x, H x*Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫) ∂γ)
      (∫ x, H x*⟪v,x⟫ ∂γ) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := (norm_nonneg (H 0)).trans (hB 0)
  have hi : Integrable (fun x : E => |⟪v,x⟫| *Real.exp |⟪v,x⟫|) γ := by
    simpa using (integrable_pow_abs_mul_exp_add_of_integrable_exp_mul
      (X := fun x : E => ⟪v,x⟫) (v := 0) (t := 2) (x := 1)
      (by simpa using integrable_exp_inner v 2)
      (by simpa using integrable_exp_inner v (-2)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 1)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := γ) (x₀ := 0) (F := fun s : ℝ => fun x : E => H x*Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫))
    (F' := fun s x => H x*(Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫)*⟪v,x⟫))
    (s := Ioo (-1) 1) (bound := fun x => B*(|⟪v,x⟫| *Real.exp |⟪v,x⟫|))
    (by exact Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => by fun_prop))
    (by simpa using integrable_bounded hH.aestronglyMeasurable hB)
    (by fun_prop) ?_ (hi.const_mul B) ?_
  · simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hd.2
  · filter_upwards [] with x s hs
    simp only [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have hs1 : |s| ≤ 1 := (abs_lt.mpr hs).le
    have he : Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫) ≤ Real.exp |⟪v,x⟫| := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact (le_abs_self _).trans (by rw [abs_mul]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg ⟪v,x⟫])
    calc
      |H x| *(Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫)*|⟪v,x⟫|) ≤ B*(Real.exp |⟪v,x⟫| *|⟪v,x⟫|) :=
        mul_le_mul (hB x) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (abs_nonneg _))
          (by positivity) hB0
      _ = _ := by ring
  · filter_upwards [] with x s _
    simpa only [id_eq, one_mul] using (((hasDerivAt_id s).mul_const ⟪v,x⟫).exp).const_mul (H x)

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Stein.integration_by_parts
statement:
lemma integration_by_parts {H : E → ℝ} {D : E → E →L[ℝ] ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ x, HasFDerivAt H (D x) x) (hcD : Continuous D)
    {B C : ℝ} (hB : ∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ B) (hC : ∀ x, ‖D x‖ ≤ C) (v : E) :
    ∫ x, D x v ∂γ = ∫ x, H x*⟪v,x⟫ ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous H := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun x => (hD x).continuousAt)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (μ := γ) (x₀ := 0) (F := fun s : ℝ => fun x : E => H (x+s•v))
    (F' := fun s x => D (x+s•v) v) (s := univ)
    (bound := fun _ => C*‖v‖) (Filter.univ_mem)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s => by fun_prop))
    (by simpa using integrable_bounded hc.aestronglyMeasurable hB)
    (by fun_prop) (ae_of_all _ (fun x s _ =>
      (D (x+s•v)).le_opNorm v |>.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC _) (norm_nonneg _))))
    (integrable_const _) (ae_of_all _ (fun x s _ => by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, one_smul, id_eq] using (hD (x+s•v)).comp_hasDerivAt s
        ((hasDerivAt_id s).smul_const v |>.const_add x)))
  have he : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-s^2*‖v‖^2/2)) 0 0 := by
    convert (((hasDerivAt_pow 2 (0:ℝ)).neg.mul_const (‖v‖^2)).div_const 2).exp using 1
    simp
  have hr := he.mul (weighted_mgf_derivative hc hB v)
  simp only [zero_pow (by norm_num : 2 ≠ 0), neg_zero, zero_mul, zero_div,
    Real.exp_zero, one_mul, zero_add] at hr
  have heq : (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-s^2*‖v‖^2/2)*
      (∫ x, H x*Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫) ∂γ)) = (fun s : ℝ => ∫ x, H (x+s•v) ∂γ) := by
    funext s
    rw [translation_expectation _ hc, ← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with x
    simp only [inner_smul_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs,
      starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
    rw [mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]
    rw [show -s^2*‖v‖^2/2+s*⟪v,x⟫ = s*⟪v,x⟫-s^2*‖v‖^2/2 by ring]
    ring
  change HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-s^2*‖v‖^2/2)*
      (∫ x, H x*Real.exp (s*⟪v,x⟫) ∂γ)) _ 0 at hr
  rw [heq] at hr
  simpa using hd.2.unique hr

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Taylor.E_zero
statement: lemma E_zero (n : ℕ) : E n 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold E
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
  · norm_num
  · intro k hk hk0
    simp [zero_pow hk0]
  · simp

name: OAI.GaussianPropeller.Taylor.exp_remainder
statement:
lemma exp_remainder {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, Real.exp (-x)-E n x =
      (-1:ℝ)^(n+1)*Real.exp (-c)*x^(n+1)/(Nat.factorial (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c,hc,h⟩ := taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv
    (f := fun t : ℝ => Real.exp ((-1)*t)) (x₀ := 0) (x := x) (n := n) hx.ne
    (by fun_prop)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  have he : taylorWithinEval (fun t : ℝ => Real.exp ((-1)*t)) n (uIcc 0 x) 0 x = E n x := by
    rw [taylor_within_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k hk
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_uIcc hx.ne)
      (by fun_prop) (by simp), iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul]
    simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [he, iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul] at h
  simpa only [neg_one_mul, sub_zero, mul_assoc] using h
