      exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hlt

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnCost_nonneg
statement:
lemma columnCost_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (a : Grid A D) :
    0 ≤ columnCost Q H e k i a
proof:
:= by
  unfold columnCost
  split_ifs
  · exact Law.light_cost_nonneg _ _ _
  · rfl

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnCost_le_comparison
statement:
lemma columnCost_le_comparison {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2) (H : ℝ)
    (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    Q.mean (columnCost Q H e k i) ≤
      Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i) -
      Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (gridPast e k i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.condEntropy_light_comparison (fun a => a.2 k i) (gridPast e k i)
    (fun y => columnPrediction Q k i y.2)
    (fun y => columnLight Q H k i y.2) (gridAllowed k i)
    (fun a ha => Q.predict_pos _ _ ha)
    (fun a ha => gridAllowed_actual a (hQ a ha) e k i)
  change Q.mean (columnCost Q H e k i) ≤
    -Q.mean (fun a => Real.log ((Q.predict (fun a => a.2 k i)
      (colHistory k i) (colHistory k i a)).mass (a.2 k i))) - _ at h
  rwa [Q.mean_predict_log, neg_neg] at h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.card_remainingValues
statement:
lemma card_remainingValues {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i : Fin A) :
    (remainingValues σ i).card = A - (i : ℕ)
proof: := by simp [remainingValues]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mem_remainingValues
statement:
lemma mem_remainingValues {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i w : Fin A) :
    w ∈ remainingValues σ i ↔ i ≤ σ.symm w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [remainingValues, Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_Ici, Equiv.toEmbedding_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h, hi, hw⟩
    rwa [← hw, σ.symm_apply_apply]
  · intro h
    exact ⟨σ.symm w, h, σ.apply_symm_apply w⟩

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.remainingValues_nonempty
statement:
lemma remainingValues_nonempty {A : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin A)) (i : Fin A) :
    (remainingValues σ i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_pos.mp
  rw [card_remainingValues]
  exact Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.isLt

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.columnPrediction_unused
statement:
lemma columnPrediction_unused {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) (w : Fin A) (hw : w ∉ remainingValues (a.2 k) i) :
    (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).mass w = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Q.predict_mass_zero _ _ (Q.map_mass_pos _ hQa)
  intro b _ hprev hvalue
  have hlt : (a.2 k).symm w < i := lt_of_not_ge (by simpa [mem_remainingValues] using hw)
  have he := (Law.history_eq_iff _ _ b a).mp hprev ((a.2 k).symm w) hlt
  change b.2 k ((a.2 k).symm w) = a.2 k ((a.2 k).symm w) at he
  rw [(a.2 k).apply_symm_apply] at he
  have hi : (a.2 k).symm w = i := (b.2 k).injective (he.trans hvalue.symm)
  exact (ne_of_lt hlt) hi

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entry_heavy_mass_bound
statement:
lemma entry_heavy_mass_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * entryHeavyMass Q H k i a ≤
      Real.log ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).entropy
proof:
:= by
  have h := (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).heavy_mass_uniformOn
    (remainingValues (a.2 k) i) (remainingValues_nonempty (a.2 k) i)
    (fun w hw => columnPrediction_unused Q k i a hQa w hw) hH
  rw [card_remainingValues] at h
  simpa only [entryHeavyMass, columnLight, not_le] using h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_entry_heavy_bound
statement:
lemma mean_entry_heavy_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) ≤
      Real.log ((A - (i : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) -
        Q.condEntropy (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.mean_mono_support (fun a ha => entry_heavy_mass_bound Q k i a ha hH)
  rw [Law.mean_const_mul, Law.mean_sub, Law.mean_const] at h
  change _ ≤ _ - Q.mean (fun a => (Q.predict (fun b => b.2 k i)
    (colHistory k i) (colHistory k i a)).entropy) at h
  rwa [Q.mean_prediction_entropy] at h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.column_heavy_bound
statement:
lemma column_heavy_bound {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (k : Fin D)
    {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * (∑ i : Fin A, Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i)) ≤
      (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).uniformDeficit
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin A))) =>
    mean_entry_heavy_bound Q k i hH)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_log_sub, grid_base_chain] at h
  simpa only [Law.uniformDeficit, Law.entropy, Law.mean, Fintype.card_perm,
    Fintype.card_fin, sub_neg_eq_add] using h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entryHeavyMass_nonneg
statement:
lemma entryHeavyMass_nonneg {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ)
    (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) (a : Grid A D) : 0 ≤ entryHeavyMass Q H k i a
proof:
:=
  Law.prob_nonneg _ _

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_columnCost_lower
statement:
lemma average_columnCost_lower {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (a : Grid A D) (hQa : 0 < Q.mass a) (ha : Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    1 - exposureError A D H K i - 2 * entryHeavyMass Q H k i a -
      (if ¬columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i) then 1 else 0) -
      (if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean (fun e => columnCost Q H e k i a)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg := (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean_nonneg
    (fun e => columnCost_nonneg Q H e k i a)
  have herror := exposureError_nonneg (by omega : 1 ≤ D) hH hK i
  have ht := entryHeavyMass_nonneg Q H k i a
  have hlight : entryHeavyMass Q H k i a = 1 -
      (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).prob (columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a)) :=
    Law.prob_not _ _
  by_cases hL : 1/2 ≤ (columnPrediction Q k i (colHistory k i a)).prob
      (columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a))
  · by_cases haL : columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i)
    · by_cases hc : K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ)
      · rw [ite_eq_right (not_not_intro haL), ite_eq_left hc]
        linarith
      · rw [ite_eq_right (not_not_intro haL), ite_eq_right hc]
        have hg := average_columnCost_good hD Q a hQa ha hH k i hL haL (le_of_not_gt hc)
        linarith
    · rw [ite_eq_left haL]
      have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
      linarith
  · have htlarge : 1 ≤ 2 * entryHeavyMass Q H k i a := by linarith
    have h₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if ¬columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i) then 1 else 0 := by
      split_ifs <;> norm_num
    have h₂ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0 := by split_ifs <;> norm_num
    linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_entry_heavy
statement:
lemma mean_entry_heavy {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) (H : ℝ) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) =
      Q.mean (fun a => if ¬columnLight Q H k i (colHistory k i a) (a.2 k i) then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.mean_predict_prob (fun a => a.2 k i) (colHistory k i)
    (fun v w => ¬columnLight Q H k i v w)
  rw [Q.prob_eq_mean] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.mean_columnCost_lower
statement:
lemma mean_columnCost_lower {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (hQ : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → Compatible a.1 a.2)
    {H K : ℝ} (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hK : 0 ≤ K) (k : Fin D) (i : Fin A) :
    1 - exposureError A D H K i - 3 * Q.mean (entryHeavyMass Q H k i) -
      Q.mean (fun a => if K < (entryClumpSize k i a : ℝ) then 1 else 0) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean (fun e => Q.mean (columnCost Q H e k i))
proof:
:= by
  have h := Q.mean_mono_support (fun a ha =>
    average_columnCost_lower hD Q a ha (hQ a ha) hH hK k i)
  rw [Law.mean_comm] at h
  simp only [Law.mean_sub, Law.mean_const, Law.mean_const_mul] at h
  rw [← mean_entry_heavy] at h
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_nonneg
statement: lemma prob_nonneg (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : 0 ≤ P.prob S
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_le_one
statement: lemma prob_le_one (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob S ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.total]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_mono
statement:
lemma prob_mono (P : Law α) {S T : α → Prop} (h : ∀ a, S a → T a) :
    P.prob S ≤ P.prob T
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro a _
  by_cases hs : S a
  · simp [hs, h a hs]
  · simp [hs]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mass_le_prob
statement:
lemma mass_le_prob (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : S a) :
    P.mass a ≤ P.prob S
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (f := fun b => if S b then P.mass b else 0)
    (fun b _ => by split_ifs <;> simp_all [P.nonneg]) (Finset.mem_univ a)
  simpa [ha, prob] using h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_not
statement: lemma prob_not (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) : P.prob (fun a => ¬S a) = 1 - P.prob S
proof:
:= by
  have h : P.prob (fun a => ¬S a) + P.prob S = 1 := by
    rw [prob, prob, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← P.total]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a _
    by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_mean
statement:
lemma prob_eq_mean (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    P.prob S = P.mean (fun a => if S a then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold prob mean
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_mass_of_not
statement:
lemma lightRescale_mass_of_not (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α} (ha : ¬L a) :
    (P.lightRescale L S).mass a = P.mass a
proof:
:= by
  unfold lightRescale
  split_ifs <;> simp [ha]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_mass_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < P.prob (fun a => L a ∧ S a) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩)
  simp [lightRescale, hA, hL, hS, mul_div_assoc]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_pos
statement:
lemma lightRescale_pos (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) : 0 < (P.lightRescale L S).mass a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hL : L a
  · rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_mem L S hp hL hS]
    exact div_pos (mul_pos hp (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob L hL)))
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩))
  · simpa [P.lightRescale_mass_of_not L S hL] using hp

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.lightRescale_log
statement:
lemma lightRescale_log (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) {a : α}
    (hp : 0 < P.mass a) (hS : S a) :
    Real.log ((P.lightRescale L S).mass a) = Real.log (P.mass a) -
      (if L a then Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L) else 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hL : L a
  · have hA : 0 < P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob _ ⟨hL, hS⟩)
    have hB : 0 < P.prob L := lt_of_lt_of_le hp (P.mass_le_prob L hL)
    rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_mem L S hp hL hS, ite_eq_left hL,
      Real.log_div (mul_pos hp hB).ne' hA.ne', Real.log_mul hp.ne' hB.ne',
      Real.log_div hA.ne' hB.ne']
    ring
  · rw [P.lightRescale_mass_of_not L S hL, ite_eq_right hL, sub_zero]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.light_cost_nonneg
statement:
lemma light_cost_nonneg (P : Law α) (L S : α → Prop) :
    0 ≤ -Real.log (P.prob (fun b => L b ∧ S b) / P.prob L)
proof:
:= by
  apply neg_nonneg.mpr
  apply Real.log_nonpos (div_nonneg (P.prob_nonneg _) (P.prob_nonneg _))
  by_cases hL : P.prob L = 0
  · simp [hL]
  · exact (div_le_one (lt_of_le_of_ne (P.prob_nonneg _) (Ne.symm hL))).mpr
      (P.prob_mono fun _ h => h.1)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_light_comparison
statement:
lemma condEntropy_light_comparison (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    (K : γ → Law β) (L S : γ → β → Prop)
    (hK : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < (K (Y a)).mass (X a))
    (hS : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → S (Y a) (X a)) :
    P.mean (fun a => if L (Y a) (X a) then
      -Real.log ((K (Y a)).prob (fun b => L (Y a) b ∧ S (Y a) b) /
        (K (Y a)).prob (L (Y a))) else 0) ≤
      -P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((K (Y a)).mass (X a))) - P.condEntropy X Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.condEntropy_le_prediction X Y
    (fun y => (K y).lightRescale (L y) (S y))
    (fun a ha => (K (Y a)).lightRescale_pos (L (Y a)) (S (Y a)) (hK a ha) (hS a ha))
  have he : P.mean (fun a => Real.log (((K (Y a)).lightRescale (L (Y a)) (S (Y a))).mass (X a))) =
      P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((K (Y a)).mass (X a))) +
        P.mean (fun a => if L (Y a) (X a) then
          -Real.log ((K (Y a)).prob (fun b => L (Y a) b ∧ S (Y a) b) /
            (K (Y a)).prob (L (Y a))) else 0) := by
    rw [← P.mean_add]
    apply P.mean_congr_support
    intro a ha
    rw [(K (Y a)).lightRescale_log _ _ (hK a ha) (hS a ha)]
    split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [he] at h
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.lists_incidence_count
statement:
lemma lists_incidence_count {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

    (S : β × β → Finset α) (r : α → Equiv.Perm β) (hr : MeetsLists S r) :
    ∑ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => i ∈ S (j, r i j))).card =
      ∑ b, (S b).card
proof:
:= by
  have hk (i : α) (j k : β) : i ∈ S (j, k) ↔ k = r i j ∧ i ∈ S (j, r i j) := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨(hr j k i h).symm, by simpa [hr j k i h] using h⟩
    · rintro ⟨rfl, h⟩
      exact h
  have hc (s : Finset α) : s.card = ∑ i, if i ∈ s then 1 else 0 := by simp
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, if i ∈ S (j, k) then 1 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.card_filter]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      symm
      calc
        _ = ∑ k, if k = r i j then (if i ∈ S (j, r i j) then 1 else 0) else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro k _
          by_cases he : k = r i j
          · subst k
            simp
          · have hmem : i ∉ S (j, k) := fun h => he (hr j k i h).symm
            simp [he, hmem]
        _ = _ := by simp
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ k, ∑ i, if i ∈ S (j, k) then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type, hc]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.meetsLists_probability_le
statement:
lemma meetsLists_probability_le {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (hn : 0 < Fintype.card β)
    (S : β × β → Finset α) :
    uniformProbability (MeetsLists S) ≤
      (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β) ^ (∑ b, (S b).card)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ r, MeetsLists S r
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := h
    let s : α → Finset β := fun i => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => i ∈ S (j, r i j))
    have hP : MeetsLists S = (fun r' => ∀ i, ∀ j ∈ s i, r' i j = r i j) := by
      funext r'
      apply propext
      constructor
      · intro hr' i j hj
        exact hr' j (r i j) i ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2)
      · intro hr' j k i hi
        have he := hr j k i hi
        have hm : j ∈ s i := by simpa [s, he] using hi
        exact (hr' i j hm).trans he
    rw [hP, uniformProbability_all (fun i (σ : Equiv.Perm β) => ∀ j ∈ s i, σ j = r i j)]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∏ i, (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β) ^ (s i).card := by
        apply Finset.prod_le_prod₀
        · intro i _
          exact uniformProbability_nonneg _
        · intro i _
          rw [uniformProbability_def]
          exact prescribed_function_probability_le hn (s i) (r i)
      _ = (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β) ^ (∑ i, (s i).card) :=
        Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum Finset.univ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [lists_incidence_count S r hr]
  · rw [uniformProbability_eq_zero _ h]
    positivity

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_reverse_succ
statement:
lemma sum_reverse_succ (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, f (n - (t : ℕ))) = ∑ t : Fin n, f ((t : ℕ) + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv Fin.revPerm
  intro t
  congr 1
  change n - (t : ℕ) = n - ((t : ℕ) + 1) + 1
  omega

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_log_sub
statement:
lemma sum_log_sub (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, Real.log ((n - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) = Real.log (n.factorial : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_reverse_succ n (fun k => Real.log (k : ℝ)),
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => Real.log ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)),
    Nat.factorial_eq_prod_range_add_one, Nat.cast_prod]
  exact (Real.log_prod (fun i _ => by positivity)).symm

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.sum_inv_sub
statement:
lemma sum_inv_sub (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ t : Fin n, 1 / ((n - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) = (harmonic n : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_reverse_succ n (fun k => 1 / (k : ℝ)),
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => 1 / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))]
  simp [harmonic, one_div]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_step_lower
statement:
lemma log_step_lower {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :
    Real.log x + 1 ≤ (x + 1) * Real.log (x + 1) - x * Real.log x
proof:
:= by
  have hx1 : 0 < x + 1 := by linarith
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hx hx1)) hx1.le
  rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' hx1.ne'] at h
  have hr : (x + 1) * (x / (x + 1) - 1) = -1 := by field_simp; ring
  rw [hr] at h
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_factorial_upper
statement:
lemma log_factorial_upper (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Real.log (n.factorial : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) * Real.log n - n + 1 + Real.log n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases hn0 : n = 0
    · subst n
      norm_num
    have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
    have hnreal : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
    have h₁ := ih hnpos
    have h₂ := log_step_lower hnreal
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul,
      Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    simp only [Nat.cast_succ]
    linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.neg_log_add_lower
statement:
lemma neg_log_add_lower {b a : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    -Real.log b - a / b ≤ -Real.log (b + a)
proof:
:= by
  have hba : 0 < b + a := by linarith
  have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (div_pos hba hb)
  rw [Real.log_div hba.ne' hb.ne'] at h
  have hr : (b + a) / b - 1 = a / b := by field_simp; ring
  rw [hr] at h
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_log_rank_lower
statement:
lemma average_log_rank_lower {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) :
    1 - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / (D : ℝ) ≤
      (∑ t : Fin D, -Real.log (((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ))) / D
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have he (t : Fin D) : -Real.log (((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)) =
      Real.log (D : ℝ) - Real.log ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.log_div (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt t.isLt).ne') hD0.ne']
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_log_sub]
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h := log_factorial_upper D hD
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hD0).mpr
  have he : (1 - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / (D : ℝ)) * D =
      (D : ℝ) - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) := by field_simp
  rw [he]
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.average_inverse_rank
statement:
lemma average_inverse_rank {D : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (a : ℝ) :
    (∑ t : Fin D, a / ((((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)))) / D =
      a * (harmonic D : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : (D : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt hD)
  have he (t : Fin D) : a / ((((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ))) =
      a * (1 / ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ)) * D := by field_simp
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.mul_sum, sum_inv_sub, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hD0]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_normalizingFactor_upper
statement:
lemma log_normalizingFactor_upper (A D : ℕ) (hA : 0 < A) (hD : 0 < D) :
    Real.log ((Nat.factorial (A*D) : ℝ) /
      ((Nat.factorial D : ℝ)^A * (Nat.factorial A : ℝ)^D)) ≤
      (A:ℝ)*D + 1 + Real.log ((A:ℝ)*D)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := log_factorial_upper (A*D) (Nat.mul_pos hA hD)
  rw [Nat.cast_mul] at hn
  have hfA := log_descFactorial_lower A A le_rfl
  have hfD := log_descFactorial_lower D D le_rfl
  simp only [Nat.descFactorial_self] at hfA hfD
  have h₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfA (Nat.cast_nonneg D : (0:ℝ) ≤ D)
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfD (Nat.cast_nonneg A : (0:ℝ) ≤ A)
  have hAa : (A:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hA
  have hDd : (D:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt hD
  rw [Real.log_div (by positivity) (by positivity),
    Real.log_mul (by positivity) (by positivity), Real.log_pow, Real.log_pow]
  rw [Real.log_mul hAa hDd] at hn ⊢
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.weightedCompatibility_bound
statement:
lemma weightedCompatibility_bound {A D : ℕ} {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 4 ≤ m) (hmdef : m^2 = (A:ℝ)*D)
    (hl : 1000 ≤ Real.log m) (hθ : 0 < 1-1000/Real.log m)
    (hAl : m/2 ≤ A) (hAu : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m)
    (hDl : m/2 ≤ D) (hDu : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ) :
    weightedCompatibility A D w v ≤
      Real.exp (50000*((A:ℝ)*D)^(54/100:ℝ)) *
        (∏ i, marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (w i)) *
        (∏ k, marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (v k))
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < A by linarith)
  have hD0 : 0 < D := by exact_mod_cast (show (0:ℝ) < D by linarith)
  have hD2 : 2 ≤ D := by exact_mod_cast (show (2:ℝ) ≤ D by linarith)
  let θ : ℝ := 1-1000/Real.log m
  let a : Grid A D → ℝ := compatibilityWeight w v
  have ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x := compatibilityWeight_nonneg w v hw hv
  by_cases hz : (∑ x : Grid A D, a x) = 0
  · have hW : weightedCompatibility A D w v = 0 := by
      change _ * uniformMean a = 0
      rw [uniformMean, hz, zero_div, mul_zero]
    rw [hW]
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => marginalFactor_nonneg θ (w i) (hw i))))
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => marginalFactor_nonneg θ (v k) (hv k)))
  have hZ : 0 < ∑ x : Grid A D, a x :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => ha x)) (Ne.symm hz)
  let Q : Law (Grid A D) := Law.tilt a ha hZ
  have hs (x : Grid A D) (hx : 0 < Q.mass x) : 0 < compatibilityWeight w v x :=
    (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hZ).mp hx
  have hwr (i : Fin A) : 0 < marginalFactor θ (w i) :=
    (Q.map (fun x => x.1 i)).marginalFactor_pos θ (w i) (hw i)
      (Q.map_support_weight (fun x => x.1 i) (w i) (fun x hx =>
        (compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs x hx)).2.1 i))
  have hvc (k : Fin D) : 0 < marginalFactor θ (v k) :=
    (Q.map (fun x => x.2 k)).marginalFactor_pos θ (v k) (hv k)
      (Q.map_support_weight (fun x => x.2 k) (v k) (fun x hx =>
        (compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs x hx)).2.2 k))
  have hWP : 0 < ∏ i, marginalFactor θ (w i) := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hwr i)
  have hVP : 0 < ∏ k, marginalFactor θ (v k) := Finset.prod_pos (fun k _ => hvc k)
  let F : ℝ := (Nat.factorial (A*D) : ℝ) /
      ((Nat.factorial D : ℝ)^A * (Nat.factorial A : ℝ)^D)
  have hF : 0 < F := by dsimp [F]; positivity
  have hU : 0 < uniformMean a := div_pos hZ (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)
  have hL : 0 < weightedCompatibility A D w v := mul_pos hF hU
  have hR : 0 < Real.exp (50000*((A:ℝ)*D)^(54/100:ℝ)) *
      (∏ i, marginalFactor θ (w i)) * (∏ k, marginalFactor θ (v k)) :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hWP) hVP
  apply (Real.log_le_log_iff hL hR).mp
  change Real.log (F * uniformMean a) ≤ _
  rw [Real.log_mul hF.ne' hU.ne',
    Real.log_mul (mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hWP).ne' hVP.ne',
    Real.log_mul (Real.exp_pos _).ne' hWP.ne', Real.log_exp,
    Real.log_prod (fun i _ => (hwr i).ne'), Real.log_prod (fun k _ => (hvc k).ne')]
  have hnorm := log_normalizingFactor_upper A D hA0 hD0
  change Real.log F ≤ _ at hnorm
  have hcompat := compatibility_log_mean_bound hD2 hm0 hl hθ hmgf w v hw hv hZ
  change Real.log (uniformMean a) ≤ _ at hcompat
  have herr := entropy_normalization_error (by linarith : 1 ≤ m) hA0 hD0 hAu hDu
  have hp : m^(108/100:ℝ) = ((A:ℝ)*D)^(54/100:ℝ) := by
    calc
      _ = m^((2:ℝ)*(54/100:ℝ)) := by norm_num
      _ = (m^(2:ℝ))^(54/100:ℝ) := Real.rpow_mul hm0.le _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.rpow_two, hmdef]
  have hlog : Real.log ((A:ℝ)*D) = 2*Real.log m := by
    rw [← hmdef, Real.log_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [hp] at herr
  rw [hlog] at hnorm
  change 0 < θ at hθ
  change Real.log (uniformMean a) ≤ -(A:ℝ)*D + _ + 1 +
      (∑ i, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (w i))) +
      (∑ k, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (v k))) at hcompat
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.weightedCompatibility_main
statement: theorem weightedCompatibility_main : WeightedCompatibilityTheorem
proof:
:= by
  have hgood : ∀ᶠ m : ℝ in Filter.atTop,
      4 ≤ m ∧ 1000 ≤ Real.log m ∧ ∀ (A D : ℕ),
      (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m → m/2 ≤ D → (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m →
      uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
        Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2 := by
    filter_upwards [Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (4:ℝ),
      Real.tendsto_log_atTop.eventually (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop (1000:ℝ)),
      eventual_clump_mgf] with m hm hl hg
    exact ⟨hm,hl,hg⟩
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hgood
  refine ⟨1000,50000,max b 4, by norm_num, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 4) (le_max_right b 4)
  · intro A D n m θ hm hθ hAl hAu hDl hDu w v hw hv
    have hh := hb m (le_trans (le_max_left b 4) hm)
    exact weightedCompatibility_bound hh.1 (Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity))
      hh.2.1 hθ hAl hAu hDl hDu (hh.2.2 A D hAu hDl hDu) w v hw hv

name: OAI.weightedCompatibility_main
statement: theorem weightedCompatibility_main : ThorpCompatibility.WeightedCompatibilityTheorem
proof:
:=
  ThorpCompatibility.weightedCompatibility_main

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.clump_exp_moment_simple
statement:
lemma clump_exp_moment_simple {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]
    (H z : ℝ) (hH : 0 ≤ H) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card β)
    (hsmall : Real.exp 2 * Fintype.card α *
      (Real.exp z * (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β)) ≤ H) :
    uniformMean (fun r : α → Equiv.Perm β => Real.exp (z * clumpCount H r)) ≤
      Real.exp ((Fintype.card β : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Fintype.card α + 1) * Real.exp (-H))
proof:
:= by
  have hbin := binomial_large_size_sum (Fintype.card α) H
    (Real.exp z * (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β)) hH (by positivity) hsmall
  have hsum : (∑ s : Finset α, clumpWeight H z s *
      (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card β) ^ s.card) ≤
        1 + (Fintype.card α + 1 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-H) := by
    rw [clump_subset_sum]
    exact hbin
  calc
    _ ≤ _ := clump_exp_moment_le H z hH hn
    _ ≤ (1 + (Fintype.card α + 1 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-H)) ^ (Fintype.card β ^ 2) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ _ hsum
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun s _ => mul_nonneg (clumpWeight_nonneg _ _ _) (by positivity)
    _ ≤ (Real.exp ((Fintype.card α + 1 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-H))) ^ (Fintype.card β ^ 2) := by
      apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity)
      simpa only [add_comm] using
        Real.add_one_le_exp ((Fintype.card α + 1 : ℕ) * Real.exp (-H))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.log_side_bound
statement:
lemma log_side_bound {m x : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hx : 0 < x) (hu : x ≤ 2*m) :
    1 + Real.log x ≤ 102 * m^(1/100:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have ht : 1 ≤ m^(1/100:ℝ) := Real.one_le_rpow hm (by norm_num)
  have hlog := Real.log_le_log hx hu
  rw [Real.log_mul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 0) hm0.ne'] at hlog
  have h₂ := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)
  have hp := Real.log_le_rpow_div hm0.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/100)
  norm_num at hp
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.exposure_error_polynomial
statement:
lemma exposure_error_polynomial {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A D : ℕ}
    (hA0 : 0 < A) (hD0 : 0 < D) (hA : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) (hD : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) :
    totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) ≤
      41820 * m * (m^(1/100:ℝ))^4
proof:
:= by
  let H : ℝ := m^(1/100:ℝ)
  have hH : 1 ≤ H := Real.one_le_rpow hm (by norm_num)
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := zero_le_one.trans hH
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ m := by linarith
  have hla := log_side_bound hm (by exact_mod_cast hA0) hA
  have hld := log_side_bound hm (by exact_mod_cast hD0) hD
  have hDlog0 : 0 ≤ 1 + Real.log (D:ℝ) := by
    have hn : 1 ≤ (D:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hD0
    linarith [Real.log_nonneg hn]
  have hha : (harmonic A : ℝ) ≤ 102*H := le_trans (harmonic_le_one_add_log A) hla
  have hha0 : 0 ≤ (harmonic A : ℝ) := by unfold harmonic; positivity
  have h₁ : (A:ℝ) * (1 + Real.log (D:ℝ)) ≤ 204*m*H := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2*m)*(102*H) := mul_le_mul hA hld hDlog0 (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have h₂ : 2 * (D:ℝ) * H * H * (1 + Real.log (D:ℝ)) * (harmonic A : ℝ) ≤
      41616*m*H^4 := by
    have hd : 2*(D:ℝ)*H^2 ≤ 4*m*H^2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hD (sq_nonneg H)]
    have hprod := mul_le_mul hld hha hha0 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 102*H)
    calc
      _ = (2*(D:ℝ)*H^2)*((1+Real.log (D:ℝ))*(harmonic A : ℝ)) := by ring
      _ ≤ (4*m*H^2)*((102*H)*(102*H)) :=
        mul_le_mul hd hprod (mul_nonneg hDlog0 hha0) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hp : H ≤ H^4 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by norm_num : 1 ≤ (4:ℕ))
  have h₃ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by positivity : 0 ≤ 204*m)
  change (A:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (D:ℝ)) +
    2*(D:ℝ)*H*H*(1+Real.log (D:ℝ))*(harmonic A : ℝ) ≤ _
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.entropy_normalization_error
statement:
lemma entropy_normalization_error {m : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A D : ℕ}
    (hA0 : 0 < A) (hD0 : 0 < D) (hA : (A:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) (hD : (D:ℝ) ≤ 2*m) :
    totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) + 2 + 2*Real.log m ≤
      50000*m^(108/100:ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  let H : ℝ := m^(1/100:ℝ)
  have hH : 1 ≤ H := Real.one_le_rpow hm (by norm_num)
  have hH0 : 0 ≤ H := zero_le_one.trans hH
  have hpoly := exposure_error_polynomial hm hA0 hD0 hA hD
  have hlog := Real.log_le_rpow_div hm0.le (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 1/100)
  norm_num [div_eq_mul_inv] at hlog
  have hpow : H ≤ H^4 := by simpa using pow_le_pow_right₀ hH (by norm_num : 1 ≤ (4:ℕ))
  have hmp : H^4 ≤ m*H^4 := by nlinarith [pow_nonneg hH0 4]
  have hsmall : 2 + 2*Real.log m ≤ 202*m*H^4 := by
    change Real.log m ≤ H * 100 at hlog
    nlinarith
  have heq : m*H^4 = m^(104/100:ℝ) := by
    change m*(m^(1/100:ℝ))^4 = _
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast hm0.le]
    calc
      _ = m^(1:ℝ) * m^((1/100:ℝ)*(4:ℕ)) := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
      _ = _ := by rw [← Real.rpow_add hm0]; norm_num
  have hmono : m^(104/100:ℝ) ≤ m^(108/100:ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hm (by norm_num)
  have hbound : totalExposureError A D H H + 2 + 2*Real.log m ≤ 42022*(m*H^4) := by
    change totalExposureError A D H H ≤ 41820*m*H^4 at hpoly
    nlinarith
  rw [heq] at hbound
  exact le_trans hbound (by nlinarith [Real.rpow_nonneg hm0.le (108/100:ℝ)])

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_permutation_card
statement:
lemma prescribed_permutation_card {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (σ : Equiv.Perm α) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = σ x)).card =
      (Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = σ x) =
      (permsOfFinset sᶜ).image (fun π => σ * π) := by
    ext τ
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_image]
    constructor
    · intro h
      refine ⟨σ⁻¹ * τ, ?_, by simp⟩
      rw [mem_perms_of_finset_iff]
      intro x hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_compl]
      intro hxs
      apply hx
      simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, h x hxs]
    · rintro ⟨π, hπ, rfl⟩ x hx
      have he : π x = x := by
        by_contra he
        have := mem_perms_of_finset_iff.mp hπ he
        simp [hx] at this
      simp [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, he]
  rw [hs, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun _ _ h => mul_left_cancel h),
    card_perms_of_finset, Finset.card_compl]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_function_card_le
statement:
lemma prescribed_function_card_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (s : Finset α) (f : α → α) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x)).card ≤
      (Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm α, ∀ x ∈ s, σ x = f x
  · obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h
    have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x) =
        Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = σ x) := by
      ext τ
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor <;> intro h x hx
      · rw [h x hx, hσ x hx]
      · rw [h x hx, hσ x hx]
    rw [he, prescribed_permutation_card]
  · have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
      intro τ _ hτ
      exact h ⟨τ, hτ⟩
    simp [he]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.prescribed_function_probability_le
statement:
lemma prescribed_function_probability_le {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
    (hn : 0 < Fintype.card α) (s : Finset α) (f : α → α) :
    ((Finset.univ.filter (fun τ : Equiv.Perm α => ∀ x ∈ s, τ x = f x)).card : ℝ) /
      Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm α) ≤ (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card α) ^ s.card
proof:
:= by
  have hs : s.card ≤ Fintype.card α := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have hcard := prescribed_function_card_le s f
  have hfac : (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card α).factorial := by positivity
  have hdesc : (0 : ℝ) < (Fintype.card α).descFactorial s.card := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hs
  have hn' : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card α := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hbase : 0 < ((Fintype.card α : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ s.card := by positivity
  have hmul : ((Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial : ℝ) *
      (Fintype.card α).descFactorial s.card = (Fintype.card α).factorial := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial hs
  rw [Fintype.card_perm]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((Fintype.card α - s.card).factorial : ℝ) / (Fintype.card α).factorial :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) hfac.le
    _ = 1 / ((Fintype.card α).descFactorial s.card : ℝ) := by
      apply (div_eq_div_iff hfac.ne' hdesc.ne').mpr
      simpa using hmul
    _ ≤ 1 / (((Fintype.card α : ℝ) / Real.exp 1) ^ s.card) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le hbase (descFactorial_exponential_lower _ _ hs)
    _ = (Real.exp 1 / Fintype.card α) ^ s.card := by
      rw [← one_div_pow, one_div_div]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_def
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_def {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop)
    [DecidablePred P] :
    uniformProbability P = ((Finset.univ.filter P).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card α
proof:
:= by
  unfold uniformProbability
  congr

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_nonneg
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop) :
    0 ≤ uniformProbability P
proof:
:= by
  unfold uniformProbability
  positivity

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_eq_zero
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_eq_zero {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop)
    (h : ¬ ∃ x, P x) : uniformProbability P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hP : ∀ x, ¬ P x := fun x hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩
  simp [uniformProbability, hP]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformProbability_all
statement:
lemma uniformProbability_all {ι α : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype α] [DecidableEq ι]
    (P : ι → α → Prop) :
    uniformProbability (fun f : ι → α => ∀ i, P i (f i)) =
      ∏ i, uniformProbability (P i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [uniformProbability_def]
  have hset : Finset.univ.filter (fun f : ι → α => ∀ i, P i (f i)) =
      Fintype.piFinset (fun i => Finset.univ.filter (P i)) := by
    ext f
    simp
  rw [show (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : ι → α => ∀ i, P i (f i))).card =
      ∏ i, (Finset.univ.filter (P i)).card by
    rw [hset, Fintype.card_piFinset]]
  simp only [uniformProbability, Fintype.card_pi, Nat.cast_prod, Finset.prod_div_distrib]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.restrict_mass
statement:
lemma restrict_mass (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) (h : 0 < P.prob S) (a : α) :
    (P.restrict S).mass a = (if S a then P.mass a else 0) / P.prob S
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrict, h]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_map_mass
statement:
lemma prob_eq_map_mass (P : Law α) (Y : α → γ) (y : γ) :
    P.prob (fun a => Y a = y) = (P.map Y).mass y
proof: := by rfl

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass
statement:
lemma predict_mass (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (y : γ)
    (hy : 0 < (P.map Y).mass y) (x : β) :
    (P.predict X Y y).mass x =
      (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mass (x, y) / (P.map Y).mass y
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < P.prob (fun a => Y a = y) := hy
  simp only [predict, map, P.restrict_mass _ hp, prob_eq_map_mass]
  rw [Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases hx : X a = x <;> by_cases hy' : Y a = y <;> simp [hx, hy']

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass_self
statement:
lemma predict_mass_self (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) :
    (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a) = P.condMass X Y a
proof:
:= by
  exact P.predict_mass X Y (Y a) (P.map_mass_pos Y ha) (X a)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_pos
statement:
lemma predict_pos (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ)
    {a : α} (ha : 0 < P.mass a) : 0 < (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.predict_mass_self X Y ha]
  exact P.condMass_pos X Y ha

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.predict_mass_zero
statement:
lemma predict_mass_zero (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) {y : γ} {x : β}
    (hy : 0 < (P.map Y).mass y)
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → Y a = y → X a ≠ x) :
    (P.predict X Y y).mass x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.predict_mass X Y y hy x]
  suffices hz : (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mass (x, y) = 0 by simp [hz]
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨a, he, ha⟩ := (P.map_mass_pos_iff _ _).mp
    (lt_of_le_of_ne ((P.map _).nonneg _) (Ne.symm hn))
  exact h a ha (congrArg Prod.snd he) (congrArg Prod.fst he)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict_log
statement:
lemma mean_predict_log (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.mean (fun a => Real.log ((P.predict X Y (Y a)).mass (X a))) =
      -P.condEntropy X Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.condEntropy_eq_mean, neg_neg]
  exact P.mean_congr_support fun a ha => congrArg Real.log (P.predict_mass_self X Y ha)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict
statement:
lemma mean_predict (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (f : γ → β → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mean (f (Y a))) =
      P.mean (fun a => f (Y a) (X a))
proof:
:= by
  have he : P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).mean (f (Y a))) =
      (P.map Y).mean (fun y => (P.predict X Y y).mean (f y)) := by
    rw [P.mean_map]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  have hsum : (P.map Y).mean (fun y => (P.predict X Y y).mean (f y)) =
      ∑ y, ∑ x, (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mass (x, y) * f y x := by
    unfold mean
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y _
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    by_cases hy : (P.map Y).mass y = 0
    · have hz : (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mass (x, y) = 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        obtain ⟨a, he, ha⟩ := (P.map_mass_pos_iff _ _).mp
          (lt_of_le_of_ne ((P.map _).nonneg _) (Ne.symm hn))
        have hpos := P.map_mass_pos Y ha
        have hya : Y a = y := congrArg Prod.snd he
        rw [hya, hy] at hpos
        exact lt_irrefl _ hpos
      simp [hy, hz]
    · rw [P.predict_mass X Y y (lt_of_le_of_ne ((P.map Y).nonneg _) (Ne.symm hy)) x]
      field_simp
  rw [hsum, Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = (P.map (fun a => (X a, Y a))).mean (fun b => f b.2 b.1) := by
      rw [mean, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    _ = _ := P.mean_map _ _

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_predict_prob
statement:
lemma mean_predict_prob (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (S : γ → β → Prop) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).prob (S (Y a))) =
      P.prob (fun a => S (Y a) (X a))
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [prob_eq_mean]
  exact P.mean_predict X Y (fun y x => if S y x then 1 else 0)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.condEntropy_predict_comparison
statement:
lemma condEntropy_predict_comparison {δ : Type*} [Fintype δ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) (Z : α → δ)
    (g : δ → γ) (hg : ∀ a, g (Z a) = Y a) :
    P.condEntropy X Z ≤ P.condEntropy X Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.condEntropy_le_prediction X Z (fun z => P.predict X Y (g z))
    (by intro a ha; rw [hg]; exact P.predict_pos X Y ha)
  simp_rw [hg] at h
  rw [P.mean_predict_log, neg_neg] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.random_order_exclusion
statement:
lemma random_order_exclusion {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D)
    (B : Law β) (f : β → Fin D) (k : Fin D)
    (hα : 0 < B.prob (fun b => f b = k)) :
    1 - (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) / (D : ℝ) -
        B.prob (fun b => f b = k) * (1 + Real.log (D : ℝ)) ≤
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean
        (fun e => -Real.log (B.prob (fun b => e k ≤ e (f b))))
proof:
:= by
  let α := B.prob (fun b => f b = k)
  let F : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ := fun e => B.prob (fun b => e k ≤ e (f b))
  have hF (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) : α ≤ F e :=
    B.prob_mono (fun b hb => by simp [hb])
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast k.pos
  have hstep (t : Fin D) :
      -Real.log (((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)) -
        α / ((((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ))) ≤
          (rankLaw k t).mean (fun e => -Real.log (F e)) := by
    have hb : 0 < (((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)) :=
      div_pos (by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_pos_of_lt t.isLt) hD0
    have hm : α ≤ (rankLaw k t).mean F := by
      calc
        α = (rankLaw k t).mean (fun _ => α) := (Law.mean_const _ _).symm
        _ ≤ _ := Law.mean_mono _ hF
    have hpos : 0 < (rankLaw k t).mean F := lt_of_lt_of_le hα hm
    calc
      _ ≤ -Real.log ((((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)) + α) :=
        neg_log_add_lower hb hα.le
      _ ≤ -Real.log ((rankLaw k t).mean F) := neg_le_neg
        (Real.log_le_log hpos (rankLaw_allowed_mean_le hD B f k t))
      _ ≤ _ := Law.neg_log_mean_le _ F (fun e _ => lt_of_lt_of_le hα (hF e)) hpos
  rw [← rankLaw_mean_average k]
  have hsim := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun t (_ : t ∈ Finset.univ) => hstep t)) hD0.le
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div,
    average_inverse_rank k.pos] at hsim
  have hbase := average_log_rank_lower k.pos
  have hharm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (harmonic_le_one_add_log D) hα.le
  dsimp [α, F] at *
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_comm
statement:
lemma mean_comm (P : Law α) (Q : Law β) (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => Q.mean (f a)) = Q.mean (fun b => P.mean (fun a => f a b))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_congr_support
statement:
lemma prob_congr_support (P : Law α) {S T : α → Prop}
    (h : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → (S a ↔ T a)) : P.prob S = P.prob T
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.prob_eq_mean, P.prob_eq_mean]
  apply P.mean_congr_support
  intro a ha
  rw [h a ha]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_map
statement:
lemma prob_map (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (S : β → Prop) :
    (P.map f).prob S = P.prob (fun a => S (f a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.prob_eq_mean, prob_eq_mean, P.mean_map]
  rfl

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_eq_sum_filter
statement:
lemma prob_eq_sum_filter (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    P.prob S = ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter S, P.mass a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.prob_le_card_mul
statement:
lemma prob_le_card_mul (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S]
    (c : ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, S a → P.mass a ≤ c) :
    P.prob S ≤ ((Finset.univ.filter S).card : ℝ) * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.prob_eq_sum_filter S]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _a ∈ Finset.univ.filter S, c :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a ha => hc a (Finset.mem_filter.mp ha).2)
    _ = _ := by simp

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_ite_const
statement:
lemma mean_ite_const (P : Law α) (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] (x y : ℝ) :
    P.mean (fun a => if S a then x else y) =
      P.prob S * x + (1 - P.prob S) * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.prob_not S]
  simp only [mean, prob, Finset.sum_mul, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_mean_average
statement:
lemma rankLaw_mean_average {D : ℕ} (k : Fin D) (g : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ) :
    (∑ t, (rankLaw k t).mean g) / (D : ℝ) =
      (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).mean g
proof:
:= by
  let P : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) := Law.uniform
  have h := P.mean_predict id (fun e => e k) (fun _ e => g e)
  have he : P.mean (fun e => (P.predict id (fun e => e k) (e k)).mean g) =
      (P.map (fun e => e k)).mean (fun t => (rankLaw k t).mean g) := by
    rw [P.mean_map]
    simp only [Law.predict, Law.map_id, rankLaw, P]
    rfl
  rw [he] at h
  have hm (t : Fin D) : (P.map (fun e => e k)).mass t = 1 / (D : ℝ) := by
    rw [← P.prob_eq_map_mass]
    exact uniform_rank_prob k t
  simpa only [Law.mean, hm, id_eq, one_div, ← Finset.mul_sum, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_comm, mul_one, P] using h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_later_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_later_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (rankLaw k t).prob (fun e => e k ≤ e l) ≤
      ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (rankLaw k t).prob (fun e => e k ≤ e l) =
      ((rankLaw k t).map (fun e => e l)).prob (fun s => t < s) := by
    rw [Law.prob_map]
    apply Law.prob_congr_support
    intro e he
    have hk := (rankLaw_mass_pos_iff k t e).mp he
    have hn : e l ≠ e k := fun h => hkl (e.injective h).symm
    rw [hk] at hn ⊢
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne h (Ne.symm hn)
    · exact le_of_lt
  rw [he]
  have hb := Law.prob_le_card_mul ((rankLaw k t).map (fun e => e l)) (fun s => t < s)
    (1 / ((D - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) (by
      intro s _
      rw [← Law.prob_eq_map_mass]
      exact rankLaw_other_prob_le hD k l t s hkl)
  have hc : (Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin D => t < s)).card = D - 1 - (t : ℕ) := by
    have he : Finset.univ.filter (fun s : Fin D => t < s) = Finset.Ioi t := by ext s; simp
    rw [he, Fin.card_Ioi]
  rw [hc] at hb
  refine le_trans hb ?_
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < D)
  have ht0 : (t : ℕ) ≤ D - 1 := by omega
  have hDt : (t : ℕ) ≤ D := Nat.le_of_lt t.isLt
  have hD1 : (0 : ℝ) < (D : ℝ) - 1 := by
    have h : (1 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < D)
    linarith
  rw [Nat.cast_sub ht0, Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ D), Nat.cast_sub hDt, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [mul_one_div]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hD1 hD0).mpr
  have htpos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_allowed_mean_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_allowed_mean_le {β : Type*} [Fintype β] {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D)
    (B : Law β) (f : β → Fin D) (k t : Fin D) :
    (rankLaw k t).mean (fun e => B.prob (fun b => e k ≤ e (f b))) ≤
      ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ) + B.prob (fun b => f b = k)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Law.prob_eq_mean]
  rw [Law.mean_comm]
  have hprob (b : β) : (rankLaw k t).mean (fun e => if e k ≤ e (f b) then 1 else 0) ≤
      (if f b = k then 1 else ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ)) := by
    by_cases hb : f b = k
    · simp [hb, Law.mean_const]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hb, ← Law.prob_eq_mean]
      exact rankLaw_later_le hD k (f b) t (Ne.symm hb)
  have h := B.mean_mono hprob
  rw [B.mean_ite_const] at h
  rw [← B.prob_eq_mean]
  refine le_trans h ?_
  have hα := B.prob_nonneg (fun b => f b = k)
  have hb : 0 ≤ ((D - (t : ℕ) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (D : ℝ) := by positivity
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniform_prob_card
statement:
lemma uniform_prob_card (S : α → Prop) [DecidablePred S] :
    (uniform : Law α).prob S =
      ((Finset.univ.filter S).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card α
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ _a ∈ Finset.univ.filter S, (1 / (Fintype.card α : ℝ)) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_filter]
      unfold prob uniform
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a _
      by_cases ha : S a <;> simp [ha]
    _ = _ := by simp [div_eq_mul_inv]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.restrict_prob
statement:
lemma restrict_prob (P : Law α) (S T : α → Prop) (hS : 0 < P.prob S) :
    (P.restrict S).prob T = P.prob (fun a => S a ∧ T a) / P.prob S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prob, P.restrict_mass S hS, Finset.sum_div]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  by_cases hs : S a <;> by_cases ht : T a <;> simp [hs, ht]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniform_rank_prob
statement:
lemma uniform_rank_prob {D : ℕ} (k t : Fin D) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t) = 1 / (D : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Law.uniform_prob_card]
  have hc := prescribed_permutation_card {k} (Equiv.swap k t)
  simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq, Equiv.swap_apply_left,
    Fintype.card_fin, Finset.card_singleton] at hc
  have he : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) => e k = t)).card =
      (D - 1).factorial := by convert hc using 2
  rw [he, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hD : 0 < D := k.pos
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hD)
  simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  have hd : (d.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp
  simp

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniform_two_rank_prob_le
statement:
lemma uniform_two_rank_prob_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t s : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t ∧ e l = s) ≤
      1 / ((D : ℝ) * (D - 1 : ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Law.uniform_prob_card]
  have hc := prescribed_function_card_le {k,l} (fun x : Fin D => if x = k then t else s)
  have hs : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) =>
      ∀ x ∈ ({k,l} : Finset (Fin D)), e x = if x = k then t else s)) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun e => e k = t ∧ e l = s) := by
    ext e
    simp [Ne.symm hkl]
  have hc' : (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D) => e k = t ∧ e l = s)).card ≤
      (D - 2).factorial := by
    convert hc using 2
    · ext e
      simp [Ne.symm hkl]
    · simp [hkl]
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) < D.factorial := by positivity
  rw [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  calc
    _ ≤ ((D - 2).factorial : ℝ) / D.factorial :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hc') hp.le
    _ = _ := by
      have hf' : ((D-2).factorial : ℝ) * ((D:ℝ) * (D-1:ℕ)) = D.factorial := by
        exact_mod_cast (by simpa [Nat.descFactorial_succ, mul_comm] using
          Nat.factorial_mul_descFactorial hD)
      have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < D)
      have hD1 : (0 : ℝ) < (D-1:ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < D-1)
      apply (div_eq_div_iff hp.ne' (mul_pos hD0 hD1).ne').mpr
      simpa using hf'

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_mass_pos_iff
statement:
lemma rankLaw_mass_pos_iff {D : ℕ} (k t : Fin D) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) :
    0 < (rankLaw k t).mass e ↔ e k = t
proof:
:= by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast k.pos
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card (Equiv.Perm (Fin D)) := by positivity
  have hp : 0 < (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t) := by
    rw [uniform_rank_prob]; positivity
  rw [rankLaw, Law.restrict_mass _ _ hp, uniform_rank_prob]
  by_cases he : e k = t <;> simp [he, Law.uniform, hD, hc]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.rankLaw_other_prob_le
statement:
lemma rankLaw_other_prob_le {D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) (k l t s : Fin D) (hkl : k ≠ l) :
    (rankLaw k t).prob (fun e => e l = s) ≤ 1 / (D - 1 : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  have hD0 : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast k.pos
  have hp : 0 < (Law.uniform : Law (Equiv.Perm (Fin D))).prob (fun e => e k = t) := by
    rw [uniform_rank_prob]; positivity
  rw [rankLaw, Law.restrict_prob _ _ _ hp, uniform_rank_prob]
  calc
    _ ≤ (1 / ((D : ℝ) * (D - 1 : ℕ))) / (1 / (D : ℝ)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (uniform_two_rank_prob_le hD k l t s hkl) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by field_simp

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_mono
statement:
lemma uniformMean_mono {α : Type*} [Fintype α] {f g : α → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    uniformMean f ≤ uniformMean g
proof:
:= by
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ => h x) (by positivity)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_sum
statement:
lemma uniformMean_sum {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (f : α → β → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => ∑ y, f x y) = ∑ y, uniformMean (fun x => f x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uniformMean]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_div]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_const_mul
statement:
lemma uniformMean_const_mul {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (a : ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => a * f x) = a * uniformMean f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uniformMean, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_div_assoc]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.uniformMean_indicator
statement:
lemma uniformMean_indicator {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop) [DecidablePred P] :
    uniformMean (fun x => if P x then 1 else 0) = uniformProbability P
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformProbability_def]
  simp [uniformMean]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_neg
statement: lemma mean_neg (P : Law α) (f : α → ℝ) : P.mean (fun a => -f a) = -P.mean f
proof:
:= by
  simp [mean, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.entropy_uniformOn_comparison
statement:
lemma entropy_uniformOn_comparison (P : Law α) (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ a, a ∉ s → P.mass a = 0) :
    P.relativeEntropy (uniformOn s hs) = Real.log (s.card : ℝ) - P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (s.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hs.card_ne_zero
  have hterm (a : α) : P.mass a * Real.log (P.mass a / (uniformOn s hs).mass a) =
      P.mass a * Real.log (P.mass a) + P.mass a * Real.log (s.card : ℝ) := by
    by_cases hp : P.mass a = 0
    · simp [hp]
    have ha : a ∈ s := by by_contra h; exact hp (hz a h)
    simp only [uniformOn, ite_eq_left ha, one_div, div_inv_eq_mul,
      Real.log_mul hp hc, mul_add]
  simp_rw [relativeEntropy, hterm]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, P.total, one_mul]
  unfold entropy mean
  ring

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.heavy_mass_uniformOn
statement:
lemma heavy_mass_uniformOn (P : Law α) (s : Finset α) (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hz : ∀ a, a ∉ s → P.mass a = 0) {H : ℝ} (hH : 0 < H) :
    (Real.log H - 1) * P.prob (fun a => H / (s.card : ℝ) < P.mass a) ≤
      Real.log (s.card : ℝ) - P.entropy
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ a, (uniformOn s hs).mass a = 0 → P.mass a = 0 := by
    intro a h
    by_cases ha : a ∈ s
    · simp [uniformOn, ha, hs.card_ne_zero] at h
    · exact hz a ha
  have h := P.heavy_mass_bound (uniformOn s hs) hH hzero
  rw [P.entropy_uniformOn_comparison s hs hz] at h
  convert h using 2
  congr 1
  funext a
  apply propext
  by_cases ha : a ∈ s
  · simp [uniformOn, ha, div_eq_mul_inv]
  · have hb : 0 ≤ H / (s.card : ℝ) := div_nonneg hH.le (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    simp [uniformOn, ha, hz a ha, not_lt.mpr hb]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.mean_prediction_entropy
statement:
lemma mean_prediction_entropy {β γ : Type*} [Fintype β] [Fintype γ]
    (P : Law α) (X : α → β) (Y : α → γ) :
    P.mean (fun a => (P.predict X Y (Y a)).entropy) = P.condEntropy X Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := P.mean_predict X Y (fun y b => -Real.log ((P.predict X Y y).mass b))
  simp only [mean_neg] at h
  rw [P.mean_predict_log, neg_neg] at h
  simpa only [entropy, mean_neg] using h

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.marginalFactor_nonneg
statement:
lemma marginalFactor_nonneg {α : Type*} [Fintype α] (θ : ℝ) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) : 0 ≤ marginalFactor θ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [marginalFactor, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
  apply Real.rpow_nonneg
  exact div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun x _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hw x) _))
    (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.marginalFactor_pos
statement:
lemma Law.marginalFactor_pos {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
    (P : Law α) (θ : ℝ) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) :
    0 < marginalFactor θ w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [marginalFactor, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
  exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (P.uniformMean_rpow_pos w hw hs _) θ

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibilityWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma compatibilityWeight_nonneg {A D : ℕ}
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ) (a : Grid A D) :
    0 ≤ compatibilityWeight w v a
proof:
:= by
  unfold compatibilityWeight
  split_ifs
  · exact mul_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun i _ => hw i _))
      (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun k _ => hv k _))
  · rfl

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibilityWeight_support
statement:
lemma compatibilityWeight_support {A D : ℕ}
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    {a : Grid A D} (ha : 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Compatible a.1 a.2 ∧ (∀ i, 0 < w i (a.1 i)) ∧ (∀ k, 0 < v k (a.2 k))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Compatible a.1 a.2 := by
    by_contra h
    simp [compatibilityWeight, h] at ha
  rw [compatibilityWeight, ite_eq_left hc] at ha
  refine ⟨hc, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hw i _)
    intro he
    have hz : (∏ j : Fin A, w j (a.1 j)) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i) he.symm
    simp [hz] at ha
  · intro k
    apply lt_of_le_of_ne (hv k _)
    intro he
    have hz : (∏ j : Fin D, v j (a.2 j)) = 0 := Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ k) he.symm
    simp [hz] at ha

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.map_support_weight
statement:
lemma Law.map_support_weight {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (P : Law α) (f : α → β) (w : β → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < P.mass a → 0 < w (f a)) (x : β) (hx : w x = 0) :
    (P.map f).mass x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨a,he,ha⟩ := (P.map_mass_pos_iff f x).mp
    (lt_of_le_of_ne ((P.map f).nonneg x) (Ne.symm hn))
  have hw := hs a ha
  rw [he,hx] at hw
  exact lt_irrefl _ hw

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_log_weight_mean
statement:
lemma grid_log_weight_mean {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D))
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Q.mean (fun a => Real.log (compatibilityWeight w v a)) =
      (∑ i : Fin A, (Q.map (fun a => a.1 i)).mean (fun σ => Real.log (w i σ))) +
      (∑ k : Fin D, (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).mean (fun σ => Real.log (v k σ)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Q.mean (fun a => (∑ i, Real.log (w i (a.1 i))) +
        (∑ k, Real.log (v k (a.2 k)))) := by
      apply Q.mean_congr_support
      intro a ha
      obtain ⟨hc, hr, hd⟩ := compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs a ha)
      rw [compatibilityWeight, ite_eq_left hc,
        Real.log_mul (Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => hr i)).ne'
          (Finset.prod_pos (fun k _ => hd k)).ne',
        Real.log_prod (fun i _ => (hr i).ne'), Real.log_prod (fun k _ => (hd k).ne')]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Q.mean_add, Law.mean_sum, Law.mean_sum]
      simp only [Law.mean_map, Function.comp_def]

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.grid_weight_variational
statement:
lemma grid_weight_variational {A D : ℕ} (Q : Law (Grid A D)) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hs : ∀ a, 0 < Q.mass a → 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Q.mean (fun a => Real.log (compatibilityWeight w v a)) - θ*(rowDeficit Q + colDeficit Q) ≤
      (∑ i, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (w i))) + (∑ k, Real.log (marginalFactor θ (v k)))
proof:
:= by
  have hwr (i : Fin A) := (Q.map (fun a => a.1 i)).weighted_gibbs_le hθ (w i) (hw i)
    (Q.map_support_weight (fun a => a.1 i) (w i) (fun a ha =>
      (compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs a ha)).2.1 i))
  have hvc (k : Fin D) := (Q.map (fun a => a.2 k)).weighted_gibbs_le hθ (v k) (hv k)
    (Q.map_support_weight (fun a => a.2 k) (v k) (fun a ha =>
      (compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs a ha)).2.2 k))
  have hr := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin A))) => hwr i)
  have hc := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k (_ : k ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin D))) => hvc k)
  simp only [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at hr hc
  rw [grid_log_weight_mean Q w v hw hv hs]
  unfold rowDeficit colDeficit
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.compatibility_log_mean_bound
statement:
lemma compatibility_log_mean_bound {A D : ℕ} (hD : 2 ≤ D) {m : ℝ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hl : 1000 ≤ Real.log m) (hθ : 0 < 1 - 1000/Real.log m)
    (hmgf : uniformMean (fun r : Rows A D =>
      Real.exp ((1/400 * Real.log m) * clumpCount (m^(1/100:ℝ)) r)) ≤ 2)
    (w : Fin A → Equiv.Perm (Fin D) → ℝ)
    (v : Fin D → Equiv.Perm (Fin A) → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ i σ, 0 ≤ w i σ) (hv : ∀ k σ, 0 ≤ v k σ)
    (hZ : 0 < ∑ a : Grid A D, compatibilityWeight w v a) :
    Real.log (uniformMean (compatibilityWeight w v)) ≤
      -(A:ℝ)*D + totalExposureError A D (m^(1/100:ℝ)) (m^(1/100:ℝ)) + 1 +
      (∑ i, Real.log (marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (w i))) +
      (∑ k, Real.log (marginalFactor (1-1000/Real.log m) (v k)))
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Law (Grid A D) := Law.tilt (compatibilityWeight w v) (compatibilityWeight_nonneg w v hw hv) hZ
  have hs (a : Grid A D) (ha : 0 < Q.mass a) : 0 < compatibilityWeight w v a := by
    exact (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right hZ).mp ha
  have hQ (a : Grid A D) (ha : 0 < Q.mass a) : Compatible a.1 a.2 :=
    (compatibilityWeight_support w v hw hv (hs a ha)).1
  have hE := grid_entropy_estimate hD Q hQ hm hl hmgf
  have hW := grid_weight_variational Q hθ w v hw hv hs
  have hG := Law.tilt_log_partition (compatibilityWeight w v) (compatibilityWeight_nonneg w v hw hv) hZ
  change Q.mean _ - Q.uniformDeficit = _ at hG
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.exists_mass_pos
statement: lemma exists_mass_pos (P : Law α) : ∃ x, 0 < P.mass x
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x (_ : x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset α)) => h x)
  simp only [P.total, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hh
  linarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.uniformMean_rpow_pos
statement:
lemma uniformMean_rpow_pos [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) (w : α → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) (p : ℝ) :
    0 < uniformMean (fun x => (w x)^p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := P.exists_mass_pos
  have hwx : 0 < w x := lt_of_le_of_ne (hw x) (by
    intro he
    exact hx.ne' (hs x he.symm))
  unfold uniformMean
  apply div_pos
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hwx p)
      (Finset.single_le_sum (fun y _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hw y) p) (Finset.mem_univ x))
  · exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.weighted_gibbs_le
statement:
lemma weighted_gibbs_le [Nonempty α] (P : Law α) {θ : ℝ} (hθ : 0 < θ)
    (w : α → ℝ) (hw : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) (hs : ∀ x, w x = 0 → P.mass x = 0) :
    P.mean (fun x => Real.log (w x)) - θ*P.uniformDeficit ≤
      Real.log (marginalFactor θ w)
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : 0 < ∑ x, (w x)^(1/θ) := by
    have h := P.uniformMean_rpow_pos w hw hs (1/θ)
    exact (div_pos_iff_of_pos_right (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)).mp h
  have h := P.gibbs_le (fun x => (w x)^(1/θ))
    (fun x => Real.rpow_nonneg (hw x) _) hZ (by
      intro x hz
      by_cases hx : w x = 0
      · exact hs x hx
      · exact False.elim ((Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne (hw x) (Ne.symm hx)) _).ne' hz))
  have he : P.mean (fun x => Real.log ((w x)^(1/θ))) =
      (1/θ)*P.mean (fun x => Real.log (w x)) := by
    rw [← P.mean_const_mul]
    apply P.mean_congr_support
    intro x hx
    apply Real.log_rpow
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hw x) (by intro he; exact hx.ne' (hs x he.symm))
  rw [he] at h
  have hmean := P.uniformMean_rpow_pos w hw hs (1/θ)
  simp only [marginalFactor, Real.rpow_eq_pow]
  rw [Real.log_rpow hmean, uniformMean,
    Real.log_div hZ.ne' (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero)]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hθ.le
  have ht : θ*(1/θ) = 1 := by field_simp
  rw [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, ht, one_mul] at hh
  unfold uniformDeficit
  nlinarith

name: OAI.ThorpCompatibility.Law.tilt_log_partition
statement:
lemma tilt_log_partition [Nonempty α] (a : α → ℝ) (ha : ∀ x, 0 ≤ a x)
    (hZ : 0 < ∑ x, a x) :
    (Law.tilt a ha hZ).mean (fun x => Real.log (a x)) -
      (Law.tilt a ha hZ).uniformDeficit = Real.log (uniformMean a)
proof:
:= by
  let P := Law.tilt a ha hZ
  have he : P.mean (fun x => Real.log (P.mass x)) =
      P.mean (fun x => Real.log (a x)) - Real.log (∑ x, a x) := by
    rw [← P.mean_const (Real.log (∑ x, a x)), ← P.mean_sub]
    apply P.mean_congr_support
    intro x hx
    have hax : a x ≠ 0 := by intro hz; simp [P, Law.tilt, hz] at hx
    exact Real.log_div hax hZ.ne'
  have hc : (Fintype.card α : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  change P.mean _ - P.uniformDeficit = _
  change P.mean _ - (Real.log (Fintype.card α) + P.mean (fun x => Real.log (P.mass x))) = _
  rw [he]
  unfold uniformMean
  rw [Real.log_div hZ.ne' hc]
  ring

name: OAI.Problem346.isGLEquivariantEmbedding_of_commutes

theorem isGLEquivariantEmbedding_of_commutes {a b : ℕ}
    (ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V))
    (hinj : Function.Injective ι)
    (hcomm : ∀ g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V,
      (plethysmAction b a g).comp ι = ι.comp (plethysmAction a b g)) :
    IsGLEquivariantEmbedding a b V ι

  intro g

    plethysmAction_isPlethysmAction b a g,
    plethysmAction_isPlethysmAction a b g,
    plethysmAction_bijective b a g, plethysmAction_bijective a b g, hcomm g⟩

proof:

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesMap_commutes_of_unique
statement:
theorem foulkesMap_commutes_of_unique {a b : ℕ}
    {μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V)}
    (hμ : IsFoulkesMap a b V μ)
    (huniq : ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap a b V ν → ν = μ)
    (g : V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V) :
    (plethysmAction a b g).comp μ = μ.comp (plethysmAction b a g)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := huniq _ (isFoulkesMap_conjugate hμ g)
  have he := congrArg (fun L => (plethysmAction a b g).comp L) hc
  simpa only [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, plethysmAction_comp_symm, LinearMap.id_comp] using he.symm

name: OAI.Problem346.symAlg_eq_zero_of_lift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem symAlg_eq_zero_of_lift_eq_zero (p : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ W)
    (h : ∀ φ : Module.Dual ℂ W, SymmetricAlgebra.lift φ p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℂ W
  let e := SymmetricAlgebra.equivMvPolynomial b
  apply e.injective
  simp only [map_zero]
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro x
  have he : (MvPolynomial.aeval x).comp e.toAlgHom =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (b.constr ℂ x) := by
    apply SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    simp [e]
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ W →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ => f p) he
  simpa using hx.trans (h (b.constr ℂ x))

/
space. -/

    (h : ∀ x : W, SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval ℂ W x) p = 0) : p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply symAlg_eq_zero_of_lift_eq_zero
  intro φ
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (Module.evalEquiv ℂ W).surjective φ
  exact h x

name: OAI.Problem346.IsFoulkesMap.surjective_of_vanishing
statement:
theorem IsFoulkesMap.surjective_of_vanishing (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V))
    (hμ : IsFoulkesMap a b V μ)
    (hvan : ∀ T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V,
      IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T →
      (∀ u : Fin b → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial b V u) = 0) → T = 0) :
    Function.Surjective μ
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.dualMap_injective_iff.mp
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  intro φ hφ
  change φ = 0
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hφ
  apply (monomialFunctional_eq_zero_iff a b V φ).mp
  apply hvan _ (monomialFunctional_symmetric a b V φ)
  intro u
  rw [monomialFunctional_apply, ← hμ.map_diagonal a b V μ u]
  have h := congrArg (fun L : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ =>
    L (symMonomial b (SymPow a V) (fun j => symMonomial a V (fun _ => u j)))) hφ
  exact h

name: OAI.Problem346.eq_zero_of_backward_chain
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_backward_chain {M : Type*} [Zero M]
    (P : ℕ → M) (m : ℕ)
    (hstep : ∀ k < m, P (k+1) = 0 → P k = 0)
    (hm : P m = 0) : P 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact Nat.decreasingInduction (motive := fun k _ => P k = 0)
    (fun k hk => hstep k (by omega)) hm (Nat.zero_le m)

/
propagating a zero endpoint backwards. Only zero reflection of each derivative
on its current polynomial is required. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.eq_zero_of_linear_chain
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_linear_chain {R M : Type*} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (P : ℕ → M) (D : ℕ → Module.End R M) (c : ℕ → R) (m : ℕ)
    (hchain : ∀ k < m, D k (P k) = c k • P (k+1))
    (hreflect : ∀ k < m, D k (P k) = 0 → P k = 0)
    (hm : P m = 0) : P 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_backward_chain P m _ hm
  intro k hk hz
  apply hreflect k hk
  rw [hchain k hk, hz, smul_zero]

name: OAI.Problem346.binary_power_factorization
statement:
theorem binary_power_factorization {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [Algebra ℂ A]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : A) (c : ℂ) :
    ∃ z : Fin r → ℂ, (∏ i : Fin r, (x - z i • y)) = x ^ r + c • y ^ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := IsAlgClosed.exists_pow_nat_eq (-c) hr
  let ζ : ℂ := Complex.exp (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I / r)
  have hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ r := Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp r hr.ne'
  have hp : (Polynomial.X ^ r - Polynomial.C (-c) : Polynomial ℂ) =
      ∏ i ∈ Finset.range r, (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (ζ ^ i * α)) :=
    X_pow_sub_C_eq_prod hζ hr hα
  have hh := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial ℂ => p.homogenize r) hp
  have hd : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range r,
      (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C (ζ ^ i * α)).natDegree ≤ 1 := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C]
  have hprod := Polynomial.homogenize_finsetProd (n := fun _ : ℕ => 1) hd
  simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hprod
  rw [hprod] at hh
  simp only [Polynomial.homogenize_sub, Polynomial.homogenize_X_pow le_rfl,
    Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, mul_one, Polynomial.homogenize_C,
    Polynomial.homogenize_X (by decide : (1 : ℕ) ≠ 0), Nat.sub_self, pow_one] at hh
  have he := congrArg (MvPolynomial.aeval ![x, y]) hh
  simp only [map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_prod, MvPolynomial.aeval_X,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    MvPolynomial.aeval_C] at he
  refine ⟨fun i => ζ ^ (i : ℕ) * α, ?_⟩
  change (∏ i : Fin r, (x - (ζ ^ (i : ℕ) * α) • y)) = _
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_eq_prod_range (fun i => x - (ζ ^ i * α) • y)]
  simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, map_neg, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, map_mul, map_pow] using he.symm

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_binary_power
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_binary_power (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) :
    ∃ v : Fin r → V, symMonomialRaw r V v =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x) ^ r + c • (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y) ^ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := binary_power_factorization r hr
    (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y) c
  refine ⟨fun i => x - z i • y, ?_⟩
  simpa only [symMonomialRaw, map_sub, map_smul] using hz

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_binary_power_mul
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_binary_power_mul (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) (u : Fin m → V) :
    ∃ v : Fin (r + m) → V, symMonomialRaw (r + m) V v =
      ((SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V x) ^ r + c • (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V y) ^ r) *
        symMonomialRaw m V u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := symMonomialRaw_binary_power V r hr x y c
  refine ⟨Fin.append w u, ?_⟩
  rw [← hw]
  simp only [symMonomialRaw, Fin.prod_univ_add, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomial_binary_power_mul
statement:
theorem symMonomial_binary_power_mul (V : Type*) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x y : V) (c : ℂ) (u : Fin m → V) :
    ∃ v : Fin (r + m) → V, symMonomial (r + m) V v =
      symMonomial (r + m) V (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => x) u) +
        c • symMonomial (r + m) V (Fin.append (fun _ : Fin r => y) u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := symMonomialRaw_binary_power_mul V r m hr x y c u
  refine ⟨v, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  change symMonomialRaw (r + m) V v = _
  rw [hv]
  simp only [symMonomial, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, symMonomialRaw,
    Fin.prod_univ_add, Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right,
    Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, add_mul, smul_mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Problem346.binary_diagonal_to_mixed_products
statement:
theorem binary_diagonal_to_mixed_products (r m : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V T)
    (hdiag : ∀ y : Fin (r+m) → V, T (fun _ => symMonomial (r+m) V y) = 0)
    (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V) :
    T (Fin.cons
      (symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => t)) (symMonomial m V y))
      (fun _ : Fin r =>
        symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply symmetric_diagonal_cons_zero T hT
  intro c
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := symMonomial_binary_power_mul V r m hr x t c y
  simp only [symPowMul_symMonomial]
  rw [← hv]
  exact hdiag v

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.eq_zero_of_shift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_shift_eq_zero (src dst : B) (hsd : src ≠ dst)
    {f : MvPolynomial (B × I) ℂ} {p q : ℕ} (hpq : q < p)
    (hp : IsBlockHomogeneous src f p) (hq : IsBlockHomogeneous dst f q)
    (hDf : shift src dst f = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine derivation_eq_zero_of_positive_weight
    (derivation src dst) (derivation dst src)
    (derivation src src - derivation dst dst)
    (commutator src dst hsd) (weight_commutator src dst hsd) ?_
    f p q hpq ?_ hDf
  · rintro ⟨b, i⟩
    by_cases hb : b = dst
    · subst b
      simp [hsd]
    · simp [hb]
  · apply block_difference_eigenvalue src dst _ _ _ _ hp hq
    · intro b i
      by_cases hb : b = src
      · subst b; simp
      · simp [hb]
    · intro b i
      by_cases hb : b = dst
      · subst b; simp
      · simp [hb]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialShift.shift_injOn
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf g hg hfg
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply eq_zero_of_shift_eq_zero src dst hsd hpq
  · exact (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule ℂ (blockWeight src) p).sub_mem hf.1 hg.1
  · exact (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule ℂ (blockWeight dst) q).sub_mem hf.2 hg.2
  · rw [map_sub, hfg, sub_self]

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.derivation_homogeneous_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem derivation_homogeneous_eigenvalue (w : σ → ℕ)
    (N : Derivation R (MvPolynomial σ R) (MvPolynomial σ R))
    (hN : ∀ i, N (X i) = w i • X i)
    {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R} (hf : f.IsWeightedHomogeneous w n) :
    N f = n • f
proof:
:= by
  rw [derivation_eq_weightedEuler w N hN]
  exact weightedEuler_of_homogeneous w hf

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.blockWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockWeight_apply (u k : β) (i : ι) :
    blockWeight u (k, i) = if k = u then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_euler_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem block_euler_eigenvalue (u : β)
    (N : Derivation R (MvPolynomial (β × ι) R) (MvPolynomial (β × ι) R))
    (hN : ∀ k i, N (X (k, i)) = if k = u then X (k, i) else 0)
    {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial (β × ι) R} (hf : IsBlockHomogeneous u f n) :
    N f = n • f
proof:
:= by
  apply derivation_homogeneous_eigenvalue (blockWeight u) N _ hf
  rintro ⟨k, i⟩
  simp only [hN, blockWeight_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp

/
as eigenvalue. This is the weight used by the positive-weight shift lemma. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_difference_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem block_difference_eigenvalue (u v : β)
    (Nu Nv : Derivation ℂ (MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ) (MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ))
    (hu : ∀ k i, Nu (X (k, i)) = if k = u then X (k, i) else 0)
    (hv : ∀ k i, Nv (X (k, i)) = if k = v then X (k, i) else 0)
    {p q : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ}
    (hp : IsBlockHomogeneous u f p) (hq : IsBlockHomogeneous v f q) :
    (Nu - Nv) f = ((p : ℂ) - (q : ℂ)) • f
proof:
:= by
  change Nu f - Nv f = _
  rw [block_euler_eigenvalue u Nu hu hp, block_euler_eigenvalue v Nv hv hq]
  rw [sub_smul]
  simp only [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_difference_nat_eigenvalue
statement:
theorem block_difference_nat_eigenvalue (u v : β)
    (Nu Nv : Derivation ℂ (MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ) (MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ))
    (hu : ∀ k i, Nu (X (k, i)) = if k = u then X (k, i) else 0)
    (hv : ∀ k i, Nv (X (k, i)) = if k = v then X (k, i) else 0)
    {p q : ℕ} (hpq : q ≤ p) {f : MvPolynomial (β × ι) ℂ}
    (hp : IsBlockHomogeneous u f p) (hq : IsBlockHomogeneous v f q) :
    (Nu - Nv) f = ((p - q : ℕ) : ℂ) • f
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hpq]
  exact block_difference_eigenvalue u v Nu Nv hu hv hp hq

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_pderiv_source
proof:
:= by

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_pderiv_other
proof:
:= by

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_shift_degree_source
proof:
:= by
  apply (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R (blockWeight u) (n - 1)).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  have hx : (X (v, i) : MvPolynomial (β × ι) R).IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (blockWeight u) 0 := by
    simpa [blockWeight_apply, Ne.symm huv] using
      (isWeightedHomogeneous_X (R := R) (blockWeight u) (v, i))

name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_shift_degree_destination
proof:
