name: OAI.Problem346.PolynomialWeights.block_shift_degree_spectator
statement:
theorem block_shift_degree_spectator {u v k : β} (huk : u ≠ k) (hvk : v ≠ k)
    {n : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial (β × ι) R} (hf : IsBlockHomogeneous k f n) :
    IsBlockHomogeneous k (∑ i : ι, X (v, i) * pderiv (u, i) f) n
proof:
:= by
  apply (weightedHomogeneousSubmodule R (blockWeight k) n).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  have hx : (X (v, i) : MvPolynomial (β × ι) R).IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (blockWeight k) 0 := by
    simpa [blockWeight_apply, hvk] using
      (isWeightedHomogeneous_X (R := R) (blockWeight k) (v, i))
  simpa using hx.mul (block_pderiv_other huk hf i)

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (v : Fin b → Fin a → V) (j : Fin b)
    (u : Fin a → V) :
    foulkesRowFormSpanning a b V v j u =
      foulkesFormula a b V (Function.update v j u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change foulkesMultilinear a b V
    (fun p => if h : p.1 = j then u p.2 else v p.1 p.2) = _
  rw [foulkesMultilinear_apply]
  congr 1
  funext k i
  by_cases h : k = j
  · subst k
    simp
  · simp [h]

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesRowFormSpanning_symmetric
statement:
theorem foulkesRowFormSpanning_symmetric (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (v : Fin b → Fin a → V) (j : Fin b)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (u : Fin a → V) :
    foulkesRowFormSpanning a b V v j (fun i => u (σ i)) =
      foulkesRowFormSpanning a b V v j u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply, foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply]
  have h := foulkesFormula_inner_permute a b V (Function.update v j u)
    (Function.update (fun _ => Equiv.refl (Fin a)) j σ)
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  funext k i
  by_cases hkj : k = j
  · subst k
    simp
  · simp [Function.update_of_ne hkj]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.exists_foulkesMap_from_spanning
statement:
theorem exists_foulkesMap_from_spanning (a b : ℕ) (V : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow a (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap a b V μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply exists_symPow_lift_on_spanning (symMonomial a V) (span_symMonomial a V)
    (foulkesFormula a b V)
  · intro v j
    obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_symPow_lift (foulkesRowFormSpanning a b V v j)
      (foulkesRowFormSpanning_symmetric a b V v j)
    exact ⟨L, fun u => (hL u).trans (foulkesRowFormSpanning_apply a b V v j u)⟩
  · intro σ v
    exact foulkesFormula_outer_permute a b V v σ

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetricAlgebra_ι_injective
statement:
lemma symmetricAlgebra_ι_injective :
    Function.Injective (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module ℂᵐᵒᵖ V := Module.compHom _ ((RingHom.id ℂ).fromOpposite mul_comm)
  have : IsCentralScalar ℂ V := ⟨fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (TrivSqZeroExt.inrHom ℂ V)) h
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.inr_injective (R := ℂ)
  simpa using h'

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma symMonomialRaw_one (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    symMonomialRaw 1 V v = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V (v 0)
proof:

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowSubmodule_one
statement:
lemma symPowSubmodule_one :
    symPowSubmodule 1 V = LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Set.range (symMonomialRaw 1 V) =
      Set.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨v 0, (symMonomialRaw_one V v).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨fun _ => v, symMonomialRaw_one V (fun _ => v)⟩
  rw [symPowSubmodule, h]
  exact Submodule.span_eq (LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V))

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowOneIntro_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma symPowOneIntro_coe (v : V) :
    (symPowOneIntro V v : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ V) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V v
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowOneIntro_bijective
statement: lemma symPowOneIntro_bijective : Function.Bijective (symPowOneIntro V)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    apply symmetricAlgebra_ι_injective V
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  · intro x
    have hx := x.property
    have hx' : (x : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ V) ∈ LinearMap.range (SymmetricAlgebra.ι ℂ V) := by
      simpa only [symPowSubmodule_one] using hx
    rcases hx' with ⟨v, hv⟩
    exact ⟨v, Subtype.ext hv⟩

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowOneEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma symPowOneEquiv_symm_apply (v : V) :
    (symPowOneEquiv V).symm v = symMonomial 1 V (fun _ => v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (symMonomialRaw_one V (fun _ => v)).symm

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowOneEquiv_symMonomial
statement:
@[simp] lemma symPowOneEquiv_symMonomial (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    symPowOneEquiv V (symMonomial 1 V v) = v 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (symPowOneEquiv V).symm.injective
  simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, symPowOneEquiv_symm_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [symMonomial, symMonomialRaw_one]

name: OAI.Problem346.derivation_eq_zero_of_positive_weight
statement:
theorem derivation_eq_zero_of_positive_weight
    (D E H : Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K) (MvPolynomial σ K))
    (hED : ⁅E, D⁆ = H) (hHE : ⁅H, E⁆ = (2 : K) • E)
    (hEX : ∀ i : σ, E (E (X i)) = 0)
    (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (p q : ℕ) (hpq : q < p)
    (hf : H f = ((p : K) - q) • f) (hDf : D f = 0) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ShiftInjectivity.eq_zero_of_positive_weight D.toLinearMap E.toLinearMap
    H.toLinearMap ?_ ?_ f (p - q) (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hpq) ?_ hDf ?_
  · intro z
    have hz := congrArg (fun F : Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K)
      (MvPolynomial σ K) => F z) hED
    simp only [Derivation.commutator_apply] at hz
    change D (E z) = E (D z) - H z
    linear_combination -hz
  · intro z
    have hz := congrArg (fun F : Derivation K (MvPolynomial σ K)
      (MvPolynomial σ K) => F z) hHE
    simp only [Derivation.commutator_apply, Derivation.smul_apply] at hz
    change H (E z) = E (H z) + (2 : K) • E z
    linear_combination hz
  · change H f = ((p - q : ℕ) : K) • f
    simpa only [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hpq)] using hf
  · exact mvPolynomial_derivation_locally_nilpotent_of_square_zero_X E hEX f

name: OAI.Problem346.diagonalPolynomial_eval
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold diagonalPolynomial
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
  rw [show (fun _ : Fin a => x + c • y) =
    (fun _ => c • y) + (fun _ => x) by ext; simp [add_comm]]
  rw [T.map_add_univ]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  have h := T.map_piecewise_smul (fun _ => c)
    (s.piecewise (fun _ => y) (fun _ => x)) s
  have heq : s.piecewise (fun i => c • s.piecewise (fun _ => y) (fun _ => x) i)
      (s.piecewise (fun _ => y) (fun _ => x)) =
      s.piecewise (fun _ => c • y) (fun _ => x) := by
    ext i
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> simp [Finset.piecewise, hi]
  rw [heq] at h
  simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h.symm

name: OAI.Problem346.diagonalPolynomial_coeff_one
statement:
lemma diagonalPolynomial_coeff_one {a : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => E) ℂ) (x y : E) :
    (diagonalPolynomial T x y).coeff 1 =
      ∑ i : Fin a, T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold diagonalPolynomial
  simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
  simp only [eq_comm (a := 1)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [← Finset.powerset_univ, ← Finset.powersetCard_eq_filter]
  simp [Finset.powersetCard_one, Finset.piecewise_singleton]

/
coefficient vanishes. This statement does not require symmetry. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.diagonal_linear_coefficient_zero
statement:
theorem diagonal_linear_coefficient_zero {a : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => E) ℂ) (x y : E)
    (h : ∀ c : ℂ, T (fun _ => x + c • y) = 0) :
    (∑ i : Fin a, T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : diagonalPolynomial T x y = 0 :=
    Polynomial.zero_of_eval_zero _ (fun c => by rw [diagonalPolynomial_eval, h])
  rw [← diagonalPolynomial_coeff_one, hp]
  simp

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetric_update_eq
statement:
lemma symmetric_update_eq {a : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => E) ℂ)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (v : Fin a → E),
      T (fun k => v (σ k)) = T v)
    (x y : E) (i j : Fin a) :
    T (Function.update (fun _ => x) j y) =
      T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := hsym (Equiv.swap i j) (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y)
  convert h using 1
  congr 1
  ext k
  by_cases hi : k = i
  · subst k
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left, Function.update_self]
    · simp [hij, Ne.symm hij]
  · by_cases hj : k = j
    · subst k; simp
    · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hi hj, Function.update_of_ne, hi, hj]

/
This is the coefficient-of-c argument in the split binary form step. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetric_diagonal_mixed_zero
statement:
theorem symmetric_diagonal_mixed_zero {a : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin a => E) ℂ)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (v : Fin a → E),
      T (fun k => v (σ k)) = T v)
    (x y : E) (i : Fin a)
    (h : ∀ c : ℂ, T (fun _ => x + c • y) = 0) :
    T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz := diagonal_linear_coefficient_zero T x y h
  have heq : (∑ j : Fin a, T (Function.update (fun _ => x) j y)) =
      (a : ℂ) * T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y) := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ _j : Fin a, T (Function.update (fun _ => x) i y) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        exact symmetric_update_eq T hsym x y i j
      _ = _ := by simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [heq] at hz
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt i.isLt))

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetric_diagonal_cons_zero
statement:
theorem symmetric_diagonal_cons_zero {r : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (r + 1) => E) ℂ)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (r + 1))) (v : Fin (r + 1) → E),
      T (fun k => v (σ k)) = T v)
    (x y : E) (h : ∀ c : ℂ, T (fun _ => x + c • y) = 0) :
    T (Fin.cons y (fun _ : Fin r => x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz := symmetric_diagonal_mixed_zero T hsym x y 0 h
  convert hz using 1
  congr 1
  ext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i <;> simp

name: OAI.Problem346.continuous_symmetric_multilinear_eq_zero_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem continuous_symmetric_multilinear_eq_zero_of_diagonal
    {W : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup W] [NormedSpace ℂ W] {n : ℕ}
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => W) ℂ)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → W),
      T (fun i => x (σ i)) = T x)
    (hdiag : ∀ x : W, T (fun _ => x) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h := T.iteratedFDeriv_comp_diagonal (0 : W) x
  have hz : (fun x : W => T (fun _ => x)) = fun _ => 0 := funext hdiag
  rw [hz] at h
  simp only [iteratedFDeriv_fun_zero, Pi.zero_apply, zero_apply] at h
  simp only [hsym, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_perm,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n)

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symmetric_multilinear_eq_zero_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem symmetric_multilinear_eq_zero_of_diagonal
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W] {n : ℕ}
    (T : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => W) ℂ)
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → W),
      T (fun i => x (σ i)) = T x)
    (hdiag : ∀ x : W, T (fun _ => x) = 0) : T = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  let L : (Fin n → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] W :=
    ∑ i : Fin n, (LinearMap.proj i).smulRight (x i)
  let S := T.compLinearMap (fun _ => L)
  have hL (z : Fin n → ℂ) : L z = ∑ i, z i • x i := by simp [L]
  have hS (z : Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) :
      S z = ∑ r : Fin n → Fin n, (∏ i, z i (r i)) • T (fun i => x (r i)) := by
    simp only [S, MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply, hL]
    rw [T.map_sum]
    simp only [T.map_smul_univ]
  have hc : Continuous S := by
    have heq : (fun z => S z) = fun z =>
        ∑ r : Fin n → Fin n, (∏ i, z i (r i)) • T (fun i => x (r i)) := funext hS
    rw [show (S : (Fin n → Fin n → ℂ) → ℂ) = _ from heq]
    fun_prop
  let C : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => Fin n → ℂ) ℂ := ⟨S, hc⟩
  have hC : C = 0 := continuous_symmetric_multilinear_eq_zero_of_diagonal C
    (by intro σ z; exact hsym σ (fun i => L (z i)))
    (by intro z; exact hdiag (L z))
  have hh := congrArg (fun f : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℂ
      (fun _ : Fin n => Fin n → ℂ) ℂ => f (fun i => Pi.single i 1)) hC
  change T (fun i => L (Pi.single i 1)) = 0 at hh
  simpa [hL] using hh

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.flipPairing_apply

theorem flipPairing_apply [Module.IsReflexive R E]

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.pairing_transpose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairing_transpose (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E')
    (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F') (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F') (y : F) (x : E') :

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.transpose_injective
statement:
theorem transpose_injective (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E')
    (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F') (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F')
    (hμ : Function.Surjective μ) : Function.Injective (transpose e f μ)
proof:
:= by
  exact e.symm.injective.comp ((LinearMap.dualMap_injective_of_surjective hμ).comp
    f.injective)

/
    identities expressed directly as evaluations of the perfect pairings. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.transpose_intertwines
statement:
theorem transpose_intertwines
    (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E') (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F')
    (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F') (A : E →ₗ[R] E) (A' : E' →ₗ[R] E')
    (B : F →ₗ[R] F) (B' : F' →ₗ[R] F')
    (he : ∀ x z, e (A x) z = e x (A' z))
    (hf : ∀ y w, f (B y) w = f y (B' w))
    (hμ : μ.comp A' = B'.comp μ) :
    A.comp (transpose e f μ) = (transpose e f μ).comp B
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  apply e.injective
  ext x
  change e (A (transpose e f μ y)) x = e (transpose e f μ (B y)) x
  rw [he, pairing_transpose, pairing_transpose, hf]
  exact congrArg (f y) (LinearMap.congr_fun hμ x)

/
    equivariant map into an injective equivariant map in the reverse direction.
    No group structure or finite-dimensionality is needed by this argument. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.DualEmbedding.exists_intertwining_injection_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_intertwining_injection_of_surjective {G : Type*}
    (e : E ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R E') (f : F ≃ₗ[R] Module.Dual R F')
    (A : G → E →ₗ[R] E) (B : G → F →ₗ[R] F)
    (A' : G → E' →ₗ[R] E') (B' : G → F' →ₗ[R] F')
    (he : ∀ g x z, e (A g x) z = e x (A' g z))
    (hf : ∀ g y w, f (B g y) w = f y (B' g w))
    (μ : E' →ₗ[R] F') (hμ : Function.Surjective μ)
    (hcomm : ∀ g, μ.comp (A' g) = (B' g).comp μ) :
    ∃ ι : F →ₗ[R] E, Function.Injective ι ∧
      ∀ g, (A g).comp ι = ι.comp (B g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨transpose e f μ, transpose_injective e f μ hμ, ?_⟩
  intro g
  exact transpose_intertwines e f μ (A g) (A' g) (B g) (B' g)
    (he g) (hf g) (hcomm g)

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_of_replacements
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_of_replacements
    {V S I B : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [Fintype S] [Fintype I] [Fintype B] [hS : DecidableEq S] [hB : DecidableEq B]
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : S => V) ℂ) (e : I → V)
    (blocks : S → B) (src dst : B) (hsd : src ≠ dst)
    (hdegree : (Finset.univ.filter (fun s => blocks s = dst)).card <
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun s => blocks s = src)).card)
    (hzero : ∀ s, blocks s = src →
      multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update blocks s dst) = 0) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e blocks = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS_eq : hS = Classical.decEq S := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hS_eq
  have hB_eq : hB = Classical.decEq B := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hB_eq
  apply PolynomialShift.eq_zero_of_shift_eq_zero src dst hsd hdegree
  · unfold PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous PolynomialWeights.blockWeight
    simpa only [multilinearPolynomial] using
      EncodingDegree.blockHomogeneous_expansion
        (fun k => L (fun s => e (k s))) blocks src
  · unfold PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous PolynomialWeights.blockWeight
    simpa only [multilinearPolynomial] using
      EncodingDegree.blockHomogeneous_expansion
        (fun k => L (fun s => e (k s))) blocks dst
  · have hd := SlotPolynomial.derivation_polynomial
      (fun k => L (fun s => e (k s))) blocks src dst
      (PolynomialShift.derivation src dst) (by intro b i; simp)
    have hz : (∑ s ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun s => blocks s = src),
        SlotPolynomial.polynomial (fun k => L (fun s => e (k s)))
          (Function.update blocks s dst)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro s hs
      simpa only [SlotPolynomial.polynomial, multilinearPolynomial] using
        hzero s (Finset.mem_filter.mp hs).2
    rw [hz] at hd
    simpa only [PolynomialShift.shift_apply, SlotPolynomial.polynomial,
      multilinearPolynomial] using hd

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.weightedHomogeneous_expansion
statement:
theorem weightedHomogeneous_expansion (c : (S → K) → R) (blocks : S → B)
    (w : B → ℕ) :
    MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous (fun x : B × K => w x.1)
      (∑ k : S → K, MvPolynomial.C (c k) *
        ∏ i : S, MvPolynomial.X (blocks i, k i))
      (∑ i : S, w (blocks i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.sum
  intro k _
  apply MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.C_mul
  apply MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.prod
  intro i _
  exact MvPolynomial.isWeightedHomogeneous_X _ _ _

/

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.blockHomogeneous_expansion
statement:
theorem blockHomogeneous_expansion [DecidableEq B]
    (c : (S → K) → R) (blocks : S → B) (b : B) :
    MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous
      (fun x : B × K => if x.1 = b then 1 else 0)
      (∑ k : S → K, MvPolynomial.C (c k) *
        ∏ i : S, MvPolynomial.X (blocks i, k i))
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => blocks i = b)).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Finset.sum_boole, Nat.cast_id] using
    (weightedHomogeneous_expansion c blocks (fun x => if x = b then 1 else 0))

/
corresponding source/destination contribution. This form avoids truncated subtraction. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.EncodingDegree.sum_weight_update
statement:
theorem sum_weight_update (blocks : S → B) (w : B → ℕ)
    (i : S) (b : B) :
    (∑ j : S, w ((Function.update blocks i b) j)) + w (blocks i) =
      (∑ j : S, w (blocks j)) + w b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h1 := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun j => w ((Function.update blocks i b) j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h2 := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ) (f := fun j => w (blocks j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h : (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w ((Function.update blocks i b) j)) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, w (blocks j) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.mem_erase.mp hj).1]
  simp only [Function.update_self] at h1
  omega

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) =
      if h : j.val < k ∧ j.val < m then some (some ⟨j.val, h.2⟩) else some none
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstLabel]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_succ (r m k : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (i.succ, j) =
      Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstLabel]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_ne_x
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero_ne_x (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) ≠ none
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstLabel_zero]
  split <;> simp

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (j : Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) = some none ↔ k ≤ j.val
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstLabel_zero]
  split <;> simp_all
  omega

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_eq_y_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_zero_eq_y_iff (r m k : ℕ) (_hk : k ≤ m)
    (j : Fin (r + m)) (y : Fin m) :
    firstLabel r m k (0, j) = some (some y) ↔ j.val = y.val ∧ y.val < k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [firstLabel_zero]
  split
  · simp only [Option.some.injEq, Fin.ext_iff]
    rename_i h
    constructor
    · intro h'
      exact ⟨h', h' ▸ h.1⟩
    · exact fun h' => h'.1
  · rename_i h
    simp only [Option.some.injEq, reduceCtorEq, false_iff]
    omega

/

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_x
statement: theorem firstLabelCount_x (r m k : ℕ) : firstLabelCount r m k none = r * r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [firstLabelCount, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    firstLabel_zero_ne_x, ite_false, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add, firstLabel_succ]
  have hrow : (∑ j : Fin (r + m),
      if Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j =
        (none : FirstBlock m) then 1 else 0) = r := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp
  simp only [hrow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id]

 theorem firstLabelCount_t (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    firstLabelCount r m k (some none) = r + m - k := by
  classical
  rw [firstLabelCount, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hrow : (∑ j : Fin (r + m),
      if Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j =
        (some none : FirstBlock m) then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp
  simp only [firstLabel_succ, hrow, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero,
    firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff r m k hk]
  rw [← Finset.card_filter]
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (r + m)))) (fun j => j.val < k)
  rw [Fin.card_filter_val_lt, Nat.min_eq_right (by omega)] at hc
  simp only [not_lt, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
  omega

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_t
statement:
theorem firstLabelCount_t (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    firstLabelCount r m k (some none) = r + m - k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [firstLabelCount, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hrow : (∑ j : Fin (r + m),
      if Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j =
        (some none : FirstBlock m) then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp
  simp only [firstLabel_succ, hrow, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero,
    firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff r m k hk]
  rw [← Finset.card_filter]
  have hc := Finset.card_filter_add_card_filter_not
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (r + m)))) (fun j => j.val < k)
  rw [Fin.card_filter_val_lt, Nat.min_eq_right (by omega)] at hc
  simp only [not_lt, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hc
  omega

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabelCount_y
statement:
theorem firstLabelCount_y (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (y : Fin m) :
    firstLabelCount r m k (some (some y)) = r + if y.val < k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [firstLabelCount, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hrow : (∑ j : Fin (r + m),
      if Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j =
        (some (some y) : FirstBlock m) then 1 else 0) = 1 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
    simp
  simp only [firstLabel_succ, hrow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  let y' : Fin (r + m) := ⟨y.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : ∀ j : Fin (r + m), j.val = y.val ↔ j = y' := by
    intro j
    change j.val = y'.val ↔ j = y'
    exact Fin.ext_iff.symm
  simp only [firstLabel_zero_eq_y_iff r m k hk, hj]
  by_cases hy : y.val < k <;> simp [hy, add_comm]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_step
statement:
theorem firstLabel_step (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) :
    firstLabel r m (k + 1) = Function.update (firstLabel r m k)
      (0, ⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk (Nat.le_add_left m r)⟩) (some (some ⟨k, hk⟩))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    by_cases hj : j.val = k
    · have hjeq : j = (⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk (Nat.le_add_left m r)⟩ : Fin (r + m)) := Fin.ext hj
      rw [hjeq]
      simp [firstLabel, hk]
    · have hp : ((0 : Fin (r + 1)), j) ≠ (0, (⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk (Nat.le_add_left m r)⟩ : Fin (r + m))) := by
        intro h
        exact hj (congrArg (fun p : Fin (r + 1) × Fin (r + m) => p.2.val) h)
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hp]
      have hlt : j.val < k + 1 ↔ j.val < k := by omega
      simp only [firstLabel_zero, hlt]
  · have hp : (i, j) ≠ (0, (⟨k, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hk (Nat.le_add_left m r)⟩ : Fin (r + m))) := by
      intro h
      exact hi (congrArg Prod.fst h)
    rw [Function.update_of_ne hp]
    simp [firstLabel, hi]

block-degree statements. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card (r m k : ℕ) (c : FirstBlock m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = c)).card =
      firstLabelCount r m k c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.card_filter _ _

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_t
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_t (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some none)).card = r + m - k
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstLabel_card, firstLabelCount_t r m k hk]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_y
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_y (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m) (y : Fin m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some (some y))).card =
      r + if y.val < k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstLabel_card, firstLabelCount_y r m k hk]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_card_y_next
statement:
theorem firstLabel_card_y_next (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k < m) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = some (some ⟨k, hk⟩))).card = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstLabel_card_y r m k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)]
  simp

/

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_eq_t_iff
statement:
theorem firstLabel_eq_t_iff (r m k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ m)
    (p : Fin (r + 1) × Fin (r + m)) :
    firstLabel r m k p = some none ↔ p.1 = 0 ∧ k ≤ p.2.val
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨i, j⟩
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa using firstLabel_zero_eq_t_iff r m k hk j
  · simp only [firstLabel, hi, ite_false, false_and, iff_false]
    refine Fin.addCases (fun x => ?_) (fun y => ?_) j <;> simp

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_zero_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_zero_row (r m k : ℕ) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (0,j) =
      if h : j.val < k ∧ j.val < m then some (some ⟨j.val,h.2⟩) else some none
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstLabel]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_succ_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_succ_row (r m k : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m k (i.succ,j) =
      Fin.addCases (fun _ : Fin r => none) (fun j : Fin m => some (some j)) j
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstLabel]

name: OAI.Problem346.firstLabel_initial_zero_row
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstLabel_initial_zero_row (r m : ℕ) (j : Fin (r+m)) :
    firstLabel r m 0 (0,j) = some none
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous
statement:
theorem firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : κ → V)
    (k : ℕ) (u : FirstBlock m) :
    PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous u (firstPolynomial T e k)
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun p => firstLabel r m k p = u)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : DecidableEq (Fin (r+1) × Fin (r+m)) := Classical.decEq _
  unfold PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous PolynomialWeights.blockWeight
  simpa only [firstPolynomial, multilinearPolynomial] using
    (EncodingDegree.blockHomogeneous_expansion
      (fun z => flattenedForm T (fun p => e (z p))) (firstLabel r m k) u)

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_zero_of_chain
statement:
theorem firstPolynomial_zero_of_chain {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V) (e : κ → V)
    (ht : ∀ k < m, PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous (some none)
      (firstPolynomial T e k) (r+m-k))
    (hy : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < m), PolynomialWeights.IsBlockHomogeneous
      (some (some (⟨k,hk⟩ : Fin m))) (firstPolynomial T e k) r)
    (hD : ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k < m),
      PolynomialShift.shift (some none) (some (some (⟨k,hk⟩ : Fin m)))
        (firstPolynomial T e k) = ((r+m-k : ℕ) : ℂ) • firstPolynomial T e (k+1))
    (hm : firstPolynomial T e m = 0) : firstPolynomial T e 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply eq_zero_of_backward_chain (firstPolynomial T e) m _ hm
  intro k hk hz
  apply PolynomialShift.eq_zero_of_shift_eq_zero
    (some none) (some (some (⟨k,hk⟩ : Fin m))) (by simp)
    (show r < r+m-k by omega) (ht k hk) (hy k hk)
  rw [hD k hk, hz, smul_zero]

/
at the initial stage. All degree counts and derivative identities are discharged. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.firstPolynomial_zero_of_final
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply firstPolynomial_zero_of_chain T e _ _ _ hm
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [firstLabel_card_t r m k (Nat.le_of_lt hk)] using
      firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous T e k (some none)
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [firstLabel_card_y_next r m k hk] using
      firstPolynomial_blockHomogeneous T e k (some (some (⟨k,hk⟩ : Fin m)))
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [firstPolynomial, PolynomialShift.shift_apply] using
      (firstLabel_derivative r m k hk V κ T e
        (PolynomialShift.derivation (some none) (some (some (⟨k,hk⟩ : Fin m))))
        (fun q j => by simp))

/
removed from the distinguished argument, while the other arguments remain fixed.
No outer symmetry or positive-degree assumptions are needed for this step. -/

name: OAI.Problem346.first_transfer
statement:
theorem first_transfer [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] {r m : ℕ}
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (h : ∀ (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V),
      T (Fin.cons (symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => t)) (symMonomial m V y))
        (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y))) = 0) :
    ∀ (x t : V) (y : Fin m → V),
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun _ => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (symMonomial m V y))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := Module.finBasis ℂ V
  have hm := firstPolynomial_final_eq_zero T e h
  have hzero := firstPolynomial_zero_of_final T e hm
  exact firstPolynomial_initial_vanishing T e hzero

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_apply (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T v =
      T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => v (i, j)))
proof:
:= rfl

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedSymmetricForm T v
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg T
  funext i
  exact symMonomial_permute b V (σ i) (fun j => v (i, j))

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedSymmetricForm_outer_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedSymmetricForm_outer_permute
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedSymmetricForm T (fun p => v (σ p.1, p.2)) =
      flattenedSymmetricForm T v
proof:
:= by
  exact hT σ (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => v (i, j)))

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem flattenedForm_apply {a b : ℕ} {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T x = T (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => x (i, j)))
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute_factors
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute_factors (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x
proof:
:=
  flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute T σ x

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute_slots
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute_slots (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (σ p.1, p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x
proof:
:=
  flattenedSymmetricForm_outer_permute T hT σ x

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_permute
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (τ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b))
    (x : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => x (σ p.1, τ p.1 p.2)) =
      flattenedForm T x
proof:
:=
  (flattenedForm_permute_factors a b V T τ (fun p => x (σ p.1, p.2))).trans
    (flattenedForm_permute_slots a b V T hT σ x)

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_factor_perm
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_factor_perm (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (v : Fin a × Fin b → V) :
    flattenedForm T (fun p => v (p.1, σ p.1 p.2)) = flattenedForm T v
proof:
:=
  flattenedSymmetricForm_inner_permute T σ v

/

name: OAI.Problem346.flattenedForm_row_perm
statement:
theorem flattenedForm_row_perm (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)

statement:
theorem foulkesFormula_inner_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (v : Fin b → Fin a → V)
    (τ : Fin b → Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) :
    foulkesFormula a b V (fun j i => v j (τ j i)) =
      foulkesFormula a b V v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold foulkesFormula
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv
    (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun j => Equiv.mulLeft (τ j))) _ _ (fun σ => rfl)

name: OAI.Problem346.foulkesFormula_outer_permute
statement:
theorem foulkesFormula_outer_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (v : Fin b → Fin a → V)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) :
    foulkesFormula a b V (fun j i => v (τ j) i) =
      foulkesFormula a b V v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold foulkesFormula
  congr 1
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.arrowCongr τ (Equiv.refl (Equiv.Perm (Fin a))))
  intro σ
  congr 1
  funext i
  simpa using symMonomial_perm_reindex b V
    (fun j => v j (σ (τ.symm j) i)) τ

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowMap_injective
statement:
theorem symPowMap_injective (n : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (symPowMap n f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := f.exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hf)
  have hgf : (symPowMap n g).comp (symPowMap n f) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← symPowMap_comp, hg, symPowMap_id]
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse (symPowMap n g) (symPowMap n f) :=
    fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun hgf x
  exact hleft.injective

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := f.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hf)
  have hfg : (symPowMap n f).comp (symPowMap n g) = LinearMap.id := by
    rw [← symPowMap_comp, hg, symPowMap_id]
  have hright : Function.RightInverse (symPowMap n g) (symPowMap n f) :=
    fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun hfg x
  exact hright.surjective

name: OAI.Problem346.exists_symPow_lift_on_spanning
statement:
theorem exists_symPow_lift_on_spanning
    {n : ℕ} {X V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (s : X → V) (hs : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range s) = ⊤)
    (F : (Fin n → X) → W)
    (hlinear : ∀ x : Fin n → X, ∀ i : Fin n,
      ∃ L : V →ₗ[ℂ] W, ∀ y, L (s y) = F (Function.update x i y))
    (hsym : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → X),
      F (fun i => x (σ i)) = F x) :
    ∃ L : SymPow n V →ₗ[ℂ] W, ∀ x : Fin n → X,
      L (symMonomial n V (fun i => s (x i))) = F x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_multilinear_extension_of_spanning
    (fun _ : Fin n => s) (fun _ => hs) F hlinear
  have hGs : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V),
      G (fun i => v (σ i)) = G v := by
    intro σ
    have h : G.domDomCongr σ = G := by
      apply multilinear_ext_of_span hs n
      intro v hv
      choose x hx using hv
      have he : v = fun i => s (x i) := funext (fun i => (hx i).symm)
      subst v
      change G (fun i => s (x (σ i))) = G (fun i => s (x i))
      rw [← hG, ← hG, hsym]
    intro v
    exact congrArg (fun G : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin n => V) W => G v) h
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_symPow_lift G hGs
  exact ⟨L, fun x => (hL _).trans (hG x).symm⟩

name: OAI.Problem346.zero_of_upward_grid
statement:
theorem zero_of_upward_grid {ι M : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Zero M]
    (r : ℕ) (F : (ι → ℕ) → M)
    (hend : F (fun _ => r) = 0)
    (hstep : ∀ (c : ι → ℕ), (∀ i, c i ≤ r) → ∀ i, c i < r →
      F (Function.update c i (c i + 1)) = 0 → F c = 0)
    (c : ι → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ r) : F c = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have aux : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ c : ι → ℕ, (∀ i, c i ≤ r) →
      (∑ i, (r - c i)) = n → F c = 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro c hc hn
      by_cases htop : ∀ i, c i = r
      · have heq : c = fun _ => r := funext htop
        simpa only [heq] using hend
      · push Not at htop
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := htop
        have hir : c i < r := lt_of_le_of_ne (hc i) hi
        apply hstep c hc i hir
        let c' := Function.update c i (c i + 1)
        have hc' : ∀ j, c' j ≤ r := by
          intro j
          by_cases hji : j = i
          · subst j
            simp only [c', Function.update_self]
            omega
          · simpa only [c', Function.update_of_ne hji] using hc j
        have hlt : (∑ j, (r - c' j)) < n := by
          rw [← hn]
          apply Finset.sum_lt_sum
          · intro j hj
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst j
              simp only [c', Function.update_self]
              omega
            · simp only [c', Function.update_of_ne hji, le_refl]
          · refine ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, ?_⟩
            simp only [c', Function.update_self]
            omega
        exact ih _ hlt c' hc' rfl
  exact aux _ c hc rfl

name: OAI.Problem346.canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one_aux
statement:
theorem canonical_foulkes_howe_a_one_aux (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V),
      IsFoulkesMap 1 b V μ ∧ Function.Bijective μ ∧
      ∀ ν : SymPow b (SymPow 1 V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow 1 (SymPow b V),
        IsFoulkesMap 1 b V ν → ν = μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(foulkesOneEquiv b V).toLinearMap, foulkesOneEquiv_isFoulkesMap b V,
    (foulkesOneEquiv b V).bijective, ?_⟩
  intro ν hν
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range (symMonomial b (SymPow 1 V))) = ⊤ := by
    exact (Submodule.span_range_subtype_eq_top_iff (symPowSubmodule b (SymPow 1 V))
      (fun v => Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self v))).mpr rfl
  apply LinearMap.ext_on_range hspan
  intro v
  have h := (hν (fun j _ => symPowOneEquiv V (v j))).trans
    ((foulkesOneEquiv_isFoulkesMap b V (fun j _ => symPowOneEquiv V (v j))).symm)
  simpa only [← symPowOneEquiv_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomial_cut
statement:
theorem symMonomial_cut (r m : ℕ) (x y : V) :
    symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else y) =
      symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x))
        (symMonomial m V (fun _ => y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [symPowMul_symMonomial]
  congr 1
  ext j
  refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) j
  · simp
  · simp

proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : SymPow (r+m) V => (z : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ V))
    (symMonomial_cut r m x y)
  simpa [symMonomial, symPowMul_coe, symMonomialRaw_const] using h

    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)

    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else v i))) =
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x))
        (symMonomial m V (fun _ => v i))))

    (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm (r+1) (r+m) V)
    (h : ∀ x t : V, ∀ Q : Fin r → SymPow m V,
      T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
        (fun i => symPowMul r m (symMonomial r V (fun _ => x)) (Q i))) = 0)
    (x t : V) (v : Fin r → V) :
    T (Fin.cons (symMonomial (r+m) V (fun _ => t))
      (fun i => symMonomial (r+m) V (fun j => if j.val < r then x else v i))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [multilinear_cut_endpoint]
  exact h x t (fun i => symMonomial m V (fun _ => v i))

name: OAI.Problem346.linearMap_eq_zero_of_symMonomial
statement:
theorem linearMap_eq_zero_of_symMonomial (n : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] {W : Type v} [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℂ W]
    (φ : SymPow n V →ₗ[ℂ] W)
    (hφ : ∀ x : Fin n → V, φ (symMonomial n V x) = 0) : φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change φ x = 0
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy
      exact hφ v
  | zero => exact map_zero φ
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
      change φ (⟨x, hx⟩ + ⟨y, hy⟩) = 0
      rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, add_zero]
  | smul c x hx ih =>
      change φ (c • (⟨x, hx⟩ : SymPow n V)) = 0
      rw [map_smul, ih, smul_zero]

name: OAI.Problem346.monomialFunctional_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem monomialFunctional_eq_zero_iff (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V]
    (φ : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) :
    monomialFunctional a b V φ = 0 ↔ φ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply linearMap_eq_zero_of_symMonomial
    intro x
    exact congrArg (fun T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V => T x) h
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

theorem plethysmFormMultilinear_inner_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (σ : Fin a → Equiv.Perm (Fin b)) (x : (Σ _ : Fin a, Fin b) → V) :
    plethysmFormMultilinear a b V T (fun ij => x ⟨ij.1, σ ij.1 ij.2⟩) =
      plethysmFormMultilinear a b V T x
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg T
  funext i
  exact symMonomial_permute b V (σ i) (fun j => x ⟨i,j⟩)

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmFormMultilinear_outer_permute
statement:
theorem plethysmFormMultilinear_outer_permute (a b : ℕ) (V : Type u)
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] (T : SymmetricMultilinearForm a b V)
    (hT : IsSymmetricMultilinearForm a b V T)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin a)) (x : (Σ _ : Fin a, Fin b) → V) :
    plethysmFormMultilinear a b V T (fun ij => x ⟨σ ij.1, ij.2⟩) =
      plethysmFormMultilinear a b V T x
proof:
:= by
  exact hT σ (fun i => symMonomial b V (fun j => x ⟨i,j⟩))

name: OAI.Problem346.eval_multilinearPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_multilinearPolynomial
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (z : β × κ → ℂ) :
    MvPolynomial.eval z (multilinearPolynomial L e block) =
      L (fun i => ∑ k, z (block i, k) • e k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [multilinearPolynomial, map_sum, map_mul, MvPolynomial.eval_C,
    map_prod, MvPolynomial.eval_X]
  rw [L.map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [L.map_smul_univ]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  exact mul_comm _ _

/

name: OAI.Problem346.eval_multilinearPolynomial_basis
statement:
theorem eval_multilinearPolynomial_basis
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (block : ι → β) (v : β → V) :
    MvPolynomial.eval (fun z : β × κ => e.repr (v z.1) z.2)
      (multilinearPolynomial L e block) = L (fun i => v (block i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_multilinearPolynomial]
  simp only [e.sum_repr]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β)
    (h : ∀ v : β → V, L (fun i => v (block i)) = 0) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e block = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro z
  rw [eval_multilinearPolynomial, map_zero]
  exact h (fun j => ∑ k, z (j, k) • e k)

/

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : Module.Basis κ ℂ V) (block : ι → β) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e block = 0 ↔
      ∀ v : β → V, L (fun i => v (block i)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    rw [← eval_multilinearPolynomial_basis L e block v, h, map_zero]
  · exact multilinearPolynomial_eq_zero L e block

/

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_perm
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_perm
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (σ : Equiv.Perm ι)
    (hσ : ∀ x : ι → V, L (fun i => x (σ i)) = L x) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e (fun i => block (σ i)) =
      multilinearPolynomial L e block
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro z
  rw [eval_multilinearPolynomial, eval_multilinearPolynomial]
  exact hσ (fun i => ∑ k, z (block i, k) • e k)

/

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_update_eq
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_update_eq [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (i j : ι) (dst : β)
    (hij : block i = block j)
    (hsym : ∀ x : ι → V, L (fun k => x (Equiv.swap i j k)) = L x) :
    multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block i dst) =
      multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block j dst)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp := multilinearPolynomial_perm L e (Function.update block i dst)
    (Equiv.swap i j) hsym
  have hlabels :
      (fun k => Function.update block i dst (Equiv.swap i j k)) =
        Function.update block j dst := by
    funext k
    by_cases hi : k = i
    · subst k
      by_cases heq : i = j
      · subst j
        rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left, Function.update_self]
      · simp [heq, Ne.symm heq, hij]
    · by_cases hj : k = j
      · subst k
        simp
      · simp [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hi hj, hi, hj]
  rw [hlabels] at hp
  exact hp.symm

/

name: OAI.Problem346.multilinearPolynomial_sum_updates
statement:
theorem multilinearPolynomial_sum_updates [DecidableEq ι]
    (L : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : ι => V) ℂ)
    (e : κ → V) (block : ι → β) (s : Finset ι) (j : ι) (dst : β)
    (hlabel : ∀ i ∈ s, block i = block j)
    (hsym : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ x : ι → V,
      L (fun k => x (Equiv.swap i j k)) = L x) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block i dst)) =
      (s.card : ℂ) • multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block j dst)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ s, multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block i dst)) =
        ∑ _i ∈ s, multilinearPolynomial L e (Function.update block j dst) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      exact multilinearPolynomial_update_eq L e block i j dst (hlabel i hi) (hsym i hi)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_const, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]

name: OAI.Problem346.symMonomialRaw_append
statement:
theorem symMonomialRaw_append (m n : ℕ) (v : Fin m → V) (w : Fin n → V) :
    symMonomialRaw (m + n) V (Fin.append v w) =
      symMonomialRaw m V v * symMonomialRaw n V w
proof:
:= by
  simp [symMonomialRaw, Fin.prod_univ_add]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowSubmodule_mul
statement:
theorem symPowSubmodule_mul (m n : ℕ) :
    symPowSubmodule m V * symPowSubmodule n V = symPowSubmodule (m + n) V
proof:
:= by
  unfold symPowSubmodule
  rw [Submodule.span_mul_span]
  apply congrArg (Submodule.span ℂ)
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨v, rfl⟩, y, ⟨w, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Fin.append v w, symMonomialRaw_append m n v w⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨symMonomialRaw m V (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd n i)),
      ⟨_, rfl⟩, symMonomialRaw n V (fun i => v (Fin.natAdd m i)), ⟨_, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [symMonomialRaw, Fin.prod_univ_add]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symPow_mul_mem
statement:
theorem symPow_mul_mem (m n : ℕ) (x : SymPow m V) (y : SymPow n V) :
    (x : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ V) * (y : SymmetricAlgebra ℂ V) ∈
      symPowSubmodule (m+n) V
proof:
:= by
  rw [← symPowSubmodule_mul]
  exact Submodule.mul_mem_mul x.property y.property

/

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowMul_coe

name: OAI.Problem346.symPowMul_symMonomial

@[simp] theorem symPowMul_symMonomial (m n : ℕ) (v : Fin m → V) (w : Fin n → V) :
    symPowMul m n (symMonomial m V v) (symMonomial n V w) =
      symMonomial (m+n) V (Fin.append v w)
proof:

  exact (symMonomialRaw_append m n v w).symm

theorem symMonomialRaw_const (n : ℕ) (v : V) :

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_symMonomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem plethysmMap_symMonomial (outer inner : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)

        (fun i => symMonomial inner W (fun j => f (x i j)))

name: OAI.Problem346.plethysmMap_foulkesFormula

theorem plethysmMap_foulkesFormula (a b : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] W)

proof:
:= by

  rw [map_smul, map_sum]
  congr 1

  intro σ _
  exact plethysmMap_symMonomial a b f (fun i j => x j ((σ j) i))

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.leftMultilinear_apply_monomial

@[simp] theorem leftMultilinear_apply_monomial (n : ℕ)

    leftMultilinear n B x (symMonomial n Y y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [leftMultilinear, LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply,
    symPowLiftLinear_symMonomial]
  exact permanentPairingMultilinear_apply n B x y

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.leftMultilinear_symmetric
statement:
theorem leftMultilinear_symmetric (n : ℕ) (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (x : Fin n → X) :
    leftMultilinear n B (fun i => x (σ i)) = leftMultilinear n B x
proof:
:= by
  apply symPow_linearMap_ext n Y
  intro y
  simp only [leftMultilinear_apply_monomial]
  exact permanentPairing_perm_left n (fun x y => B x y) x y σ

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.pairing_monomials
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairing_monomials (n : ℕ) (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    pairing n B (symMonomial n X x) (symMonomial n Y y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairing]

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_monomials
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualMap_monomials (n : ℕ)
    (x : Fin n → Module.Dual ℂ V) (y : Fin n → V) :
    dualMap V n (symMonomial n (Module.Dual ℂ V) x) (symMonomial n V y) =
      permanentPairing n (fun f v => f v) x y
proof:
:= by
  exact pairing_monomials n LinearMap.id x y

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_pure
statement:
theorem dualMap_pure (n : ℕ) (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (x : V) :
    dualMap V n p (symMonomial n V (fun _ => x)) =
      SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval ℂ V x) p.val
proof:
:= by
  have h : (LinearMap.applyₗ (symMonomial n V (fun _ => x))).comp (dualMap V n) =
      (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Module.Dual.eval ℂ V x)).toLinearMap.domRestrict
        (symPowSubmodule n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) := by
    apply symPow_linearMap_ext n (Module.Dual ℂ V)
    intro f
    change dualMap V n (symMonomial n (Module.Dual ℂ V) f)
      (symMonomial n V (fun _ => x)) = _
    rw [dualMap_monomials, permanentPairing_const_right]
    simp [symMonomial, symMonomialRaw]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h p

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_injective
statement:
theorem dualMap_injective [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (dualMap V n)
proof:
:=
  symPowDual_injective_of_pure_evaluation V n (dualMap V n) (dualMap_pure V n)

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dual_finrank
statement:
theorem dual_finrank (n : ℕ) [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] :
    Module.finrank ℂ (SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) =
      Module.finrank ℂ (Module.Dual ℂ (SymPow n V))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subspace.dual_finrank_eq]
  let e : Module.Dual ℂ V ≃ₗ[ℂ] V :=
    LinearEquiv.ofFinrankEq _ _ Subspace.dual_finrank_eq
  exact (symPowEquiv n e).finrank_eq

/

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dualEquiv_apply [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) : dualEquiv V n p = dualMap V n p
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualMap_natural
statement:
theorem dualMap_natural (n : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (q : SymPow n V) :
    dualMap V n (symPowMap n f.dualMap p) q =
      dualMap V n p (symPowMap n f q)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (dualMap V n).comp (symPowMap n f.dualMap) =
      (symPowMap n f).dualMap.comp (dualMap V n) := by
    apply symPow_linearMap_ext n (Module.Dual ℂ V)
    intro x
    apply symPow_linearMap_ext n V
    intro y
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, symPowMap_symMonomial,
      LinearMap.dualMap_apply, dualMap_monomials]
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h p) q

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.dualEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem dualEquiv_natural [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (n : ℕ) (f : V →ₗ[ℂ] V)
    (p : SymPow n (Module.Dual ℂ V)) (q : SymPow n V) :
    dualEquiv V n (symPowMap n f.dualMap p) q =
      dualEquiv V n p (symPowMap n f q)
proof:
:=
  dualMap_natural V n f p q

/

name: OAI.Problem346.PairingConstruction.comparison_of_surjection
statement:
theorem comparison_of_surjection [FiniteDimensional ℂ V] (a b : ℕ)
    (hsurj : ∃ μ : SymPow b (SymPow a (Module.Dual ℂ V)) →ₗ[ℂ]
      SymPow a (SymPow b (Module.Dual ℂ V)),
      IsFoulkesMap a b (Module.Dual ℂ V) μ ∧ Function.Surjective μ) :
    ∃ ι : SymPow a (SymPow b V) →ₗ[ℂ] SymPow b (SymPow a V),
      IsGLEquivariantEmbedding a b V ι
proof:
:= by
  apply PlethysmDual.comparison_of_dual_charts a b
    (PlethysmDual.plethysmDualEquivOf b a (dualEquiv V a) (dualEquiv (SymPow a V) b))
    (PlethysmDual.plethysmDualEquivOf a b (dualEquiv V b) (dualEquiv (SymPow b V) a))
  · intro g
    exact PlethysmDual.plethysmDualEquivOf_adjoint b a
      (dualEquiv V a) (dualEquiv (SymPow a V) b) g
      (dualEquiv_natural V a g.toLinearMap)
      (dualEquiv_natural (SymPow a V) b (symPowMap a g.toLinearMap))
  · intro g
    exact PlethysmDual.plethysmDualEquivOf_adjoint a b
      (dualEquiv V b) (dualEquiv (SymPow b V) a) g
      (dualEquiv_natural V b g.toLinearMap)
      (dualEquiv_natural (SymPow b V) a (symPowMap b g.toLinearMap))
  · exact hsurj

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_perm_right
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_perm_right {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairing n B x (fun i => y (τ i)) = permanentPairing n B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold permanentPairing
  congr 1
  simpa only [Equiv.coe_mulLeft, Equiv.Perm.mul_apply] using
    (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulLeft τ)
      (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ i))))

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_perm_left
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_perm_left {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permanentPairing n B (fun i => x (τ i)) y = permanentPairing n B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold permanentPairing
  congr 1
  calc
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x (τ i)) (y (σ i))) =
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x i) (y ((σ * τ⁻¹) i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      simpa only [Equiv.Perm.mul_apply, Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        (Equiv.prod_comp τ (fun i => B (x i) (y ((σ * τ⁻¹) i))))
    _ = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ i)) := by
      simpa only [Equiv.coe_mulRight] using
        (Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.mulRight τ⁻¹)
          (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ i))))

/

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_flip
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_flip {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairing n (fun y x => B x y) y x = permanentPairing n B x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold permanentPairing
  congr 1
  calc
    (∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x (σ i)) (y i)) =
        ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ⁻¹ i)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro σ _
      simpa only [Equiv.Perm.inv_def, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using
        (Equiv.prod_comp σ (fun i => B (x i) (y (σ⁻¹ i))))
    _ = ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ i)) := by
      exact Equiv.sum_comp (Equiv.inv (Equiv.Perm (Fin n)))
        (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => ∏ i, B (x i) (y (σ i)))

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_const_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairing_const_right {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Y) :
    permanentPairing n B x (fun _ => y) = ∏ i, B (x i) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : (n.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  simp [permanentPairing, Fintype.card_perm, hn]

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_const_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairing_const_left {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (x : X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairing n B (fun _ => x) y = ∏ i, B x (y i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← permanentPairing_flip n B]
  exact permanentPairing_const_right n (fun y x => B x y) y x

/

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairing_natural
statement:
theorem permanentPairing_natural {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    {X' : Type w} {Y' : Type z} (n : ℕ)
    (B : X → Y → ℂ) (B' : X' → Y' → ℂ)
    (f : X → X') (g : Y' → Y)
    (h : ∀ x y, B' (f x) y = B x (g y))
    (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y') :
    permanentPairing n B' (fun i => f (x i)) y =
      permanentPairing n B x (fun i => g (y i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [permanentPairing, h]

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairingRight_apply (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairingRight n B x y = permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [permanentPairingRight, permanentPairing]

/

name: OAI.Problem346.permanentPairingLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem permanentPairingLeft_apply (n : ℕ)
    (B : X →ₗ[ℂ] Y →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (x : Fin n → X) (y : Fin n → Y) :
    permanentPairingLeft n B y x = permanentPairing n (fun x y => B x y) x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [permanentPairingLeft, permanentPairing]
