    ((C.Cf q).subtype.restrictScalars k) Subtype.val_injective
  let : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.Ce q) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  let : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.Cf q) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  have hE : Module.Finite (C k q) (ModuleCat.of (C k q) (C.Ce q)) := inferInstance
  have hF : Module.Finite (C k q) (ModuleCat.of (C k q) (C.Cf q)) := inferInstance
  have hf : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j) := by
    cases j with
    | ofNat n =>
      rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
      · exact hE
      · exact hE
      · exact hF
      · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) PUnit)
    | negSucc n => exact hE
  exact Module.Finite.trans (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseObj_projective
statement: lemma reverseObj_projective (j : ℤ) : Module.Projective (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | ofNat n =>
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (C k q) (C.Ce q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (C k q) (C.Ce q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (C k q) (C.Cf q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (C k q) PUnit)
  | negSucc n => exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (C k q) (C.Ce q))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseJ_finite
statement:
lemma reverseJ_finite (hq : q ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite k ((reverseJ q hq).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := reverseObj_finite q j
  have : Module.Finite k (TrivialInduction.Obj k (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j)) := inferInstance
  let : Module.Finite (C.T q) (TrivialInduction.Obj k (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j)) :=
    Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  have : Module.Finite (C.T q) ((reverseJ q hq).X j) := by
    change Module.Finite (C.T q) (TrivialInduction.Obj k (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j))
    infer_instance
  exact Module.Finite.trans (C.T q) ((reverseJ q hq).X j)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseJ_projective
statement:
lemma reverseJ_projective (hq : q ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective (C.T q) ((reverseJ q hq).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := reverseObj_finite q j
  let : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  let := reverseObj_projective q j
  change Module.Projective (C.T q) (TrivialInduction.Obj k (C k q) (C.reverseObj q j))
  infer_instance

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.forwardJ_below
statement:
lemma forwardJ_below (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) (hj : j < 0) :
    IsZero ((forwardJ q hp).X j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | ofNat n => change (n : ℤ) < 0 at hj; omega
  | negSucc n =>
    exact (TrivialInduction.functor (k := k)).map_isZero
      (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton (ModuleCat.of (C k q) PUnit))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseJ_above
statement:
lemma reverseJ_above (hq : q ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) (hj : 2 < j) :
    IsZero ((reverseJ q hq).X j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | ofNat n =>
    change 2 < (n : ℤ) at hj
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
    · norm_num at hj
    · norm_num at hj
    · norm_num at hj
    · exact (TrivialInduction.functor (k := k)).map_isZero
        (ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton (ModuleCat.of (C k q) PUnit))
  | negSucc n => change 2 < -((n : ℤ)+1) at hj; omega

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.forwardJJ_finite
statement:
lemma forwardJJ_finite (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite (E q) ((forwardJJ q hp).X j)
proof:
:=
  OuterTensor.total_finite_below_int _ _ 0 0 (forwardJ_finite q hp) (forwardJ_finite q hp)
    (forwardJ_below q hp) (forwardJ_below q hp) j

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseJJ_finite
statement:
lemma reverseJJ_finite (hq : q ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite (E q) ((reverseJJ q hq).X j)
proof:
:=
  OuterTensor.total_finite_above_int _ _ 2 2 (reverseJ_finite q hq) (reverseJ_finite q hq)
    (reverseJ_above q hq) (reverseJ_above q hq) j

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.forwardJJ_projective
statement:
lemma forwardJJ_projective (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective (E q) ((forwardJJ q hp).X j)
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : ℤ) : Module.Finite (C.T q) ((forwardJ q hp).X i) := by
    let := forwardJ_finite q hp i
    exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  let := OuterTensor.total_projective_int (k := k) _ _ h h (forwardJ_projective q hp) (forwardJ_projective q hp) j
  infer_instance

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.reverseJJ_projective
statement:
lemma reverseJJ_projective (hq : q ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective (E q) ((reverseJJ q hq).X j)
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : ℤ) : Module.Finite (C.T q) ((reverseJ q hq).X i) := by
    let := reverseJ_finite q hq i
    exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  let := OuterTensor.total_projective_int (k := k) _ _ h h (reverseJ_projective q hq) (reverseJ_projective q hq) j
  infer_instance

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.jjFiber_totallyAcyclic
statement:
lemma jjFiber_totallyAcyclic (hq : q ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) :
    TotallyAcyclic (jjFiber q hq hp)
proof:
:= by
  let := jjReverseComparison_quasiIso q hq hp
  let := (formE q).injective
  exact ModuleFiber.totallyAcyclic _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.jjFiber_finite
statement:
lemma jjFiber_finite (hq : q ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite (E q) ((jjFiber q hq hp).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := forwardJJ_finite q hp j
  let := reverseJJ_finite q hq (j+1)
  exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (E q) ((reverseJJ q hq).X (j+1) × (forwardJJ q hp).X j))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.jjFiber_projective
statement:
lemma jjFiber_projective (hq : q ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 1+q^n ≠ 0) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective (E q) ((jjFiber q hq hp).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := forwardJJ_projective q hp j
  let := reverseJJ_projective q hq (j+1)
  exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective (E q) ((reverseJJ q hq).X (j+1) × (forwardJJ q hp).X j))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.tmul_smul_apply
statement:
lemma tmul_smul_apply (s : S) (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) (f : obj (k := k) X Z) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z from ((s ⊗ₜ[k] r) • f)) x =
      s • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) (r.unop • x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.left_smul_apply
statement:
lemma left_smul_apply (s : S) (f : Enveloping.Obj (obj (k := k) X Z)) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z from (s • f)) x = s • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) x
proof:
:= by
  change s • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) ((1:R) • x) = _
  rw [one_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.right_smul_apply
statement:
lemma right_smul_apply (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) (f : Enveloping.Obj (obj (k := k) X Z)) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z from (r • f)) x = (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) (r.unop • x)
proof:
:= by
  change (1:S) • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) (r.unop • x) = _
  rw [one_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.k_smul_apply
statement:
lemma k_smul_apply (c : k) (f : obj (k := k) X Z) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z from (c • f)) x = c • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) x
proof:
:= by
  change (show X →ₗ[k] Z from ((algebraMap k (Enveloping.Alg k S R) c) • f)) x = _
  change (show X →ₗ[k] Z from (((algebraMap k S c) ⊗ₜ[k] (1:Rᵐᵒᵖ)) • f)) x = _
  apply Eq.trans (tmul_smul_apply X Z (algebraMap k S c) 1 f x)
  exact (congrArg (fun y : X => (algebraMap k S c) • (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) y)
    (one_smul R x)).trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul S c ((show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) x))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurryLinear_balanced
statement:
lemma uncurryLinear_balanced (f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z)
    (r : R) (m : Enveloping.Obj M) (x : X) :
    uncurryLinear f (MulOpposite.op r • m) x = uncurryLinear f m (r • x)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun h : Enveloping.Obj (HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) =>
      (show X →ₗ[k] Z from h) x) ((Enveloping.rightMap f).map_smul (MulOpposite.op r) m)).trans
    (HomBimodule.right_smul_apply X Z (MulOpposite.op r) (f m) x)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma uncurry_mk (f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z)
    (m : Enveloping.Obj M) (x : X) :
    uncurry f (BalancedTensor.mk m x) = (show X →ₗ[k] Z from f m) x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.curryLinear_right
statement:
lemma curryLinear_right (g : Enveloping.evalObj X M ⟶ Z) (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) (m : Enveloping.Obj M) :
    curryLinear g (r • m) = r • curryLinear g m
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change g (BalancedTensor.mk (r • m) x) = g (BalancedTensor.mk m (r.unop • x))
  exact congrArg g (BalancedTensor.balance r.unop m x)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.curry_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma curry_apply (g : Enveloping.evalObj X M ⟶ Z) (m : M) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z from curry g m) x = g (BalancedTensor.mk (show Enveloping.Obj M from m) x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_curry
statement: lemma uncurry_curry (g : Enveloping.evalObj X M ⟶ Z) : uncurry (curry g) = g
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply BalancedTensor.hom_ext
  intro m x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.curry_uncurry
statement: lemma curry_uncurry (f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) : curry (uncurry f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_precompose
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply BalancedTensor.hom_ext
  intro m x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.postMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma postMap_apply (g : Z ⟶ Z') (f : obj (k := k) X Z) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z' from postMap X g f) x = g ((show X →ₗ[k] Z from f) x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.postMap_surjective
statement:
lemma postMap_surjective (g : Z ⟶ Z') (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (postMap (k := k) X g)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (g.hom.restrictScalars k)
    (show X →ₗ[k] Z' from f) hg
  refine ⟨p, ?_⟩
  exact hp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_postcompose
statement:
lemma uncurry_postcompose (f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) (g : Z ⟶ Z') :
    uncurry (f ≫ HomBimodule.postMap X g) = uncurry f ≫ g
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply BalancedTensor.hom_ext
  intro m x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.projective_cokernel_of_injective
statement:
lemma projective_cokernel_of_injective [Module.Injective R M] [Module.Projective R P]
    (i : M →ₗ[R] P) (q : P →ₗ[R] N)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (hq : Function.Surjective q) (he : Function.Exact i q) :
    Module.Projective R N
proof:
:= by
  let h := linearShortExact i q he hi hq
  have : CategoryTheory.Injective (linearShortComplex i q he).X₁ :=
    show CategoryTheory.Injective (ModuleCat.of R M) from Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R M
  have : Module.Projective R (linearShortComplex i q he).X₂ :=
    show Module.Projective R P from inferInstance
  let s := h.splittingOfInjective
  exact Module.Projective.of_split s.s.hom q (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp s.s_g)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.cosyzygy_left_projective
statement:
lemma cosyzygy_left_projective [Module.Projective R (Obj M.obj)] :
    Module.Projective R (Obj (M.cosyzygy (envelopingForm t u)).obj)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite R (Obj M.obj) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k R _
  let : Module.Injective R R := t.injective
  let : Module.Injective R (Obj M.obj) := injective_of_finite_projective
  let τ := envelopingForm t u
  let J := ModuleCat.of (Alg k R S) (Fin (Module.finrank k M) → Alg k R S)
  let : Module.Projective R (Obj J) := freeLeftProjective _
  let i : M.obj ⟶ J := ModuleCat.ofHom (M.embed τ)
  let q : J ⟶ (M.cosyzygy τ).obj := ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)).mkQ
  apply projective_cokernel_of_injective (leftMap i) (leftMap q)
  · exact M.embed_injective τ
  · change Function.Surjective (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)))
    exact Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  · change Function.Exact (M.embed τ) (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)))
    intro x
    exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.cosyzygy_right_projective
statement:
lemma cosyzygy_right_projective [Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj)] :
    Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj (M.cosyzygy (envelopingForm t u)).obj)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k Sᵐᵒᵖ _
  let : Module.Injective Sᵐᵒᵖ Sᵐᵒᵖ := u.op.injective
  let : Module.Injective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj) := injective_of_finite_projective
  let τ := envelopingForm t u
  let J := ModuleCat.of (Alg k R S) (Fin (Module.finrank k M) → Alg k R S)
  let : Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj J) := freeRightProjective _
  let i : M.obj ⟶ J := ModuleCat.ofHom (M.embed τ)
  let q : J ⟶ (M.cosyzygy τ).obj := ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)).mkQ
  apply projective_cokernel_of_injective (rightMap i) (rightMap q)
  · exact M.embed_injective τ
  · change Function.Surjective (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)))
    exact Submodule.mkQ_surjective _
  · change Function.Exact (M.embed τ) (Submodule.mkQ (LinearMap.range (M.embed τ)))
    intro x
    exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.negative_side_projective
statement:
theorem negative_side_projective (n : ℕ)
    [Module.Projective R (Obj M.obj)] [Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj)] :
    Module.Projective R (Obj (M.negative (envelopingForm t u) n).obj) ∧
      Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj (M.negative (envelopingForm t u) n).obj)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => change Module.Projective R (Obj M.obj) ∧ Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj)
            exact ⟨inferInstance,inferInstance⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    let := ih.1
    let := ih.2
    exact ⟨cosyzygy_left_projective t u _,cosyzygy_right_projective t u _⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.NatCoker.projective_of_contraction
statement:
lemma projective_of_contraction [Module.Projective R (P.X n)]
    (a : P.X n →ₗ[R] P.X (n+1)) (b : P.X (n+1) →ₗ[R] P.X (n+2))
    (h : a.comp (P.d (n+1) n).hom + (P.d (n+2) (n+1)).hom.comp b = LinearMap.id) :
    Module.Projective R (C P n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.Projective.of_split (ι P n) ((π P n).comp a)
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.range (P.d (n+2) (n+1)).hom) x
  change π P n (a (P.d (n+1) n y)) = π P n y
  have he := congrArg (π P n) (LinearMap.congr_fun h y)
  change π P n (a (P.d (n+1) n y) + P.d (n+2) (n+1) (b y)) = π P n y at he
  rw [map_add] at he
  have hz : π P n (P.d (n+2) (n+1) (b y)) = 0 :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨b y,rfl⟩
  simpa only [hz,add_zero] using he

name: OAI.Tachikawa.NatCoker.projective_of_homotopy
proof:
:= by
  let h := e.homotopyHomInvId.symm
  have he := h.comm (n+1)
  rw [dNext_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℕ).Rel (n+1) n from rfl),
    prevD_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℕ).Rel (n+2) (n+1) from rfl)] at he
  have hz : (e.hom ≫ e.inv).f (n+1) = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext x
    change e.inv.f (n+1) (e.hom.f (n+1) x) = 0
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (e.hom.f (n+1) x) 0, map_zero]
  rw [hz,add_zero] at he
  exact projective_of_contraction P n (h.hom n (n+1)).hom (h.hom (n+1) (n+2)).hom
    (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp he.symm)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDualZ_ec
statement:
lemma rightDualZ_ec (a b c d u v : k) (x : C k q) :
    rightDualZ q (ec q a b c d u v) x =
      a*x 4 + d*x 0 + q*b*x 3 + c*x 2 + u*x 8 + q*v*x 7
proof: := rfl

      a*x 6 + v*x 1 + b*x 5 + c*x 5 + u*x 9
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDualAug_surjective
statement: lemma rightDualAug_surjective (hq : q ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective (rightDualAug q)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  refine ⟨(ec q (φ (basis q 4)) (φ (basis q 3)/q) (φ (basis q 2))
    (φ (basis q 0)) (φ (basis q 8)) (φ (basis q 7)/q),
    ec q (φ (basis q 6)) (φ (basis q 5)) 0 0 (φ (basis q 9)) (φ (basis q 1))), ?_⟩
  change (_ : Module.Dual k (C k q)) = φ
  apply (basis q).ext
  intro i
  change rightDualZ q _ (basis q i) + rightDualV q _ (basis q i) = φ (basis q i)
  simp only [LinearMap.fst_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply, rightDualZ_ec, rightDualV_ec]
  fin_cases i <;> simp [basis_apply] <;> field_simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDualAug_apply
statement:
lemma rightDualAug_apply (x y : eC q) (a : C k q) :
    rightDualAug q (x,y) a =
      x.val 0*a 4 + x.val 4*a 0 + q*x.val 2*a 3 + x.val 3*a 2 +
      x.val 5*a 8 + q*x.val 6*a 7 +
      (y.val 0*a 6 + y.val 6*a 1 + y.val 2*a 5 + y.val 3*a 5 + y.val 5*a 9)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ec_eta q x, ← ec_eta q y]
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDualAug_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma rightDualAug_eq_zero_iff (hq : q ≠ 0) (x y : eC q) :
    rightDualAug q (x,y) = 0 ↔ x = 0 ∧ y.val 0 = 0 ∧
      y.val 2 + y.val 3 = 0 ∧ y.val 5 = 0 ∧ y.val 6 = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hh
    have h (i : Fin 10) := congrArg (fun ψ : DualBimodule k (C k q) => ψ (basis q i)) hh
    simp only [rightDualAug_apply, DualBimodule.zero_apply] at h
    have hx0 : x.val 0 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply] using h 4
    have hx2 : x.val 2 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply, hq] using h 3
    have hx3 : x.val 3 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply] using h 2
    have hx4 : x.val 4 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply] using h 0
    have hx5 : x.val 5 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply] using h 8
    have hx6 : x.val 6 = 0 := by simpa [basis_apply, hq] using h 7
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← ec_eta q x, ec_eq_zero]
      exact ⟨hx0,hx2,hx3,hx4,hx5,hx6⟩
    · simpa [basis_apply] using h 6
    · simpa [basis_apply] using h 5
    · simpa [basis_apply] using h 9
    · simpa [basis_apply] using h 1
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hy0, hy2, hy5, hy6⟩
    ext a
    rw [rightDualAug_apply]
    change _ = 0
    simp only [Submodule.coe_zero, zero_apply, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, hy0, hy5, hy6]
    rw [← _root_.add_mul, hy2, zero_mul]
    simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.exact_rightDualAug
statement:
lemma exact_rightDualAug (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    Function.Exact (rightDualD₁ q) (rightDualAug q)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x,y⟩
  constructor
  · intro hh
    obtain ⟨hx, ha, hbc, hu, hv⟩ := (rightDualAug_eq_zero_iff q hq x y).mp hh
    subst x
    have hc : y.val 3 = y.val 2 := by
      simpa only [CharTwo.neg_eq] using eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hbc
    refine ⟨ec q (y.val 2) (y.val 4) 0 0 0 0, ?_⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · change lambdaEll q 1 _ = y
      rw [lambdaEll_ec]
      have hy := ec_eta q y
      rw [ha, hu, hv, hc] at hy
      simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, one_mul] using hy
  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
    rw [← hz]
    change rightDualAug q (0, lambdaEll q 1 z) = 0
    rw [rightDualAug_eq_zero_iff q hq]
    rw [← ec_eta q z, lambdaEll_ec]
    change (0 : eC q) = 0 ∧ (0:k) = 0 ∧ z.val 0 + 1*z.val 0 = 0 ∧
      (0:k) = 0 ∧ (1+1)*z.val 5 = 0
    simp [CharTwo.add_self_eq_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDualResD_exact
statement:
lemma rightDualResD_exact (_hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (rightDualResD q (n+1)) (rightDualResD q n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
  · change Function.Exact (lambdaU q) (rightDualD₁ q)
    intro x
    change (0, lambdaEll q 1 x) = (0,0) ↔ _
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq]
    simpa only [true_and] using exact_lambdaU q x
  · change Function.Exact (fun _ : PUnit => (0 : fC q)) (lambdaU q)
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      refine ⟨PUnit.unit, ?_⟩
      exact ((lambdaU_injective q) (hx.trans (map_zero (lambdaU q)).symm)).symm
    · rintro ⟨_, rfl⟩
      exact map_zero _
  · change Function.Exact (fun _ : PUnit => (0 : PUnit)) (fun _ : PUnit => (0 : fC q))
    intro x
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨PUnit.unit, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · change Function.Exact (fun _ : PUnit => (0 : PUnit)) (fun _ : PUnit => (0 : PUnit))
    intro x
    exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨PUnit.unit, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.C.rightDual_projectiveDimension
statement:
lemma rightDual_projectiveDimension (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (ModuleCat.of (C k q)ᵐᵒᵖ (DualBimodule k (C k q))) 2
proof:
:= by
  let P := rightDualProjectiveResolution q hq
  apply HasProjectiveDimensionLT.mk
  intro i hi Y α
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := P.extMk_surjective α (i+1) rfl
  have hs : Subsingleton (P.complex.X i) := by
    change Subsingleton (rightDualResObj q i)
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hi
    rw [Nat.add_comm 3 n]
    exact inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton PUnit)
  have h : f = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rw [hs.elim x 0]
    exact map_zero _
  subst f
  exact P.extMk_zero _ _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.tLeftResolution_finiteC
statement:
lemma tLeftResolution_finiteC (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Finite (C k q) ((tLeftResolution q hq).complex.X n)
proof:
:= by
  change Module.Finite (C k q) (((Tachikawa.ProjectiveResolution.simpleSelf
      (ModuleCat.of (C k q) (C k q))).complex.X n) × C.leftDualResObj q n)
  have h : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.leftDualResObj q n) := by
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | n
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) (C.Ce q × C.Ce q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) (C.Ce q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) (C.Cf q))
    · exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) PUnit)
  let := h
  let : Module.Finite (C k q) ((Tachikawa.ProjectiveResolution.simpleSelf
      (ModuleCat.of (C k q) (C k q))).complex.X n) := by
    cases n with
    | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) (C k q))
    | succ n => exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite (C k q) PUnit)
  exact Module.Finite.prod

lemma tLeftResolution_above (hq : q ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 < n) :

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.tLeftUnderlying_smul
statement:
lemma tLeftUnderlying_smul (r : C k q) (x : TLeftObj q) :
    tLeftUnderlying q (r • x) = inclusionC q r * tLeftUnderlying q x
proof:
:= by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · rfl
  · change r • (show C k q × DualBimodule k (C k q) from x).2 =
      r • (show C k q × DualBimodule k (C k q) from x).2 +
        MulOpposite.op (show C k q × DualBimodule k (C k q) from x).1 • (0:DualBimodule k (C k q))
    rw [smul_zero, add_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.eLeftTensorEquiv_action
statement:
lemma eLeftTensorEquiv_action (r : B q) :
    (eLeftTensorEquiv q).toLinearMap.comp (OuterTensor.action k (C k q) (C k q) (TLeftObj q) (TLeftObj q) r) =
      (LinearMap.mulLeft k (inclusionB q r)).comp (eLeftTensorEquiv q).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  induction r using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro x y
    change (tLeftUnderlying q (a • x)) ⊗ₜ[k] (tLeftUnderlying q (b • y)) =
      (inclusionC q a ⊗ₜ[k] inclusionC q b) *
        ((tLeftUnderlying q x) ⊗ₜ[k] (tLeftUnderlying q y))
    rw [tLeftUnderlying_smul, tLeftUnderlying_smul, Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul]
  | add r s hr hs =>
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change eLeftTensorEquiv q ((OuterTensor.action k (C k q) (C k q) (TLeftObj q) (TLeftObj q) (r+s)) x) =
      inclusionB q (r+s) * eLeftTensorEquiv q x
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    change eLeftTensorEquiv q ((OuterTensor.action k (C k q) (C k q) (TLeftObj q) (TLeftObj q) r) x +
      (OuterTensor.action k (C k q) (C k q) (TLeftObj q) (TLeftObj q) s) x) = _
    apply ((eLeftTensorEquiv q).map_add _ _).trans
    apply Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (fun a b : E q => a+b) (LinearMap.congr_fun hr x) (LinearMap.congr_fun hs x))
    exact (add_mul (inclusionB q r) (inclusionB q s) (eLeftTensorEquiv q x)).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.eLeftTensorEquiv_smul
statement:
lemma eLeftTensorEquiv_smul (r : B q) (x : OuterTensor.Obj k (C k q) (C k q) (TLeftObj q) (TLeftObj q)) :
    eLeftTensorEquiv q (r • x) = inclusionB q r * eLeftTensorEquiv q x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (eLeftTensorEquiv_action q r) x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.cResObj_finite
statement: lemma cResObj_finite (n : ℕ) : Module.Finite (C k q) (C.resObj q n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    let : Module.Finite k (C.Cf q) := Module.Finite.of_injective
      ((C.Cf q).subtype.restrictScalars k) Subtype.val_injective
    exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k (C k q) (C.Cf q)
  | succ n =>
    let : Module.Finite k (C.Ce q) := Module.Finite.of_injective
      ((C.Ce q).subtype.restrictScalars k) Subtype.val_injective
    exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k (C k q) (C.Ce q)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.HomBimodule.representation_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma representation_apply (a : Enveloping.regular (k := k) (R := R)) (x : X) :
    (show X →ₗ[k] X from representation X a) x = (show R from a) • x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.homBase_smul
statement:
lemma homBase_smul {K R : Type} [Field K] [Ring R] [Algebra K R]
    (V : ModuleCat R) (f : HomBimodule.Base (k := K) V V) (c : K) (x : V) :
    f (c • x) = c • f x
proof: := (show V →ₗ[K] V from f).map_smul c x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.representation_socle
statement:
lemma representation_socle (a : E q) :
    Enveloping.twistedUnderlying (sigma q H hH)
      ((HomBimodule.representation (k := k) (ModuleCat.of (E q) (X q)) ≫
        socleBimoduleMap q H hH) (Enveloping.regularUnderlyingEquiv.symm a)) =
      characterE q a • zeta q
proof:
:= by
  change (characterE q a * 1) • zeta q = _
  rw [mul_one]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.socleBimoduleMap_ne_zero
statement: lemma socleBimoduleMap_ne_zero : socleBimoduleMap q H hH ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := representation_socle q H hH (1:E q)
  rw [h,CategoryTheory.Limits.comp_zero] at hh
  change (0:E q) = characterE q 1 • zeta q at hh
  rw [map_one,one_smul] at hh
  exact zeta_ne_zero q hh.symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.unit_injective
statement: lemma unit_injective (M : ModuleCat R) : Function.Injective ((unit (k := k)).app M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg (fun f => ModuleCat.CoextendScalars.equiv (algebraMap k R) _ f (1:R)) h
  change (1:R) • x = (1:R) • y at h'
  simpa only [one_smul] using h'

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.unit_π
statement: lemma unit_π (M : ModuleCat R) : (unit (k := k)).app M ≫ π M = 0
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app M) (cokernel.condition (unit (k := k)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.short_exact
statement: lemma short_exact (M : ModuleCat R) : (short (k := k) M).ShortExact

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.c_dimension
statement:
lemma c_dimension (M : ModuleCat R) (d : ℕ) [HasInjectiveDimensionLE M (d+1)] :
    HasInjectiveDimensionLE ((C (k := k)).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  apply (short_exact (k := k) M).hasInjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (d+1)
  · exact hasInjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge ((J (k := k)).obj M) 1 (d+1) (by omega)
  · exact inferInstanceAs (HasInjectiveDimensionLE M (d+1))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.iterate_dimension
statement:
lemma iterate_dimension (M : ModuleCat R) (d n : ℕ) [HasInjectiveDimensionLE M (d+n)] :
    HasInjectiveDimensionLE ((iterate (k := k) n).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing d with
  | zero => exact inferInstanceAs (HasInjectiveDimensionLE M d)
  | succ n ih =>
    have h : HasInjectiveDimensionLE M ((d+1)+n) := by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_comm 1 n] using (inferInstance : HasInjectiveDimensionLE M (d+(n+1)))
    let := ih (d+1)
    exact c_dimension ((iterate (k := k) n).obj M) d

name: OAI.Tachikawa.LeftCoinduced.iterate_injective
statement:
lemma iterate_injective (M : ModuleCat R) (d : ℕ) [HasInjectiveDimensionLE M d] :
    Injective ((iterate (k := k) d).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let : HasInjectiveDimensionLE M (0+d) := by simpa using (inferInstance : HasInjectiveDimensionLE M d)
  let := iterate_dimension (k := k) M 0 d
  exact inferInstance

name: OAI.Tachikawa.moduleCatFinite
statement: lemma moduleCatFinite [FiniteDimensional k M] : FiniteDimensional k (moduleCatObj (R := R) M)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.equiv (moduleCatUnderlyingEquiv (k := k) (R := R) M).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindExtendLeft_right
statement:
lemma coindExtendLeft_right (g : Obj Q →ₗ[Sᵐᵒᵖ] N) (s : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (x : Obj Q) :
    coindExtendLeft Q N g (s • x) = s • coindExtendLeft Q N g x
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro r
  change g (r • s • x) = s • g (r • x)
  rw [smul_comm,map_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindEvaluate_extend
statement:
lemma coindEvaluate_extend (g : Obj Q →ₗ[Sᵐᵒᵖ] N) :
    coindEvaluate Q N (coindExtend Q N g) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change g ((1:R) • x) = g x
  rw [one_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindExtend_evaluate
statement:
lemma coindExtend_evaluate (f : Q ⟶ coindObj (k := k) (R := R) N) :
    coindExtend Q N (coindEvaluate Q N f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro x
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro r
  change (show R →ₗ[k] N from f (((r ⊗ₜ[k] (1:Sᵐᵒᵖ)) : Alg k R S) • x)) 1 =
    (show R →ₗ[k] N from f x) r
  rw [f.hom.map_smul]
  change (1:Sᵐᵒᵖ) • (show R →ₗ[k] N from f x) (1*r) = _
  rw [one_smul,one_mul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindEvaluate_natural
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindMap_apply
statement:
lemma coindMap_apply {N N' : ModuleCat Sᵐᵒᵖ} (a : N ⟶ N')
    (f : coindObj (k := k) (R := R) N) (r : R) :
    (coindUnderlying N' (coindMap a f)) r = a (coindUnderlying N f r)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindUnit_apply
statement:
lemma coindUnit_apply (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) (z : L) (r : R) :
    (coindUnderlying _ (coindUnit L z)) r = r • (show Obj L from z)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindUnit_injective
statement: lemma coindUnit_injective (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) : Function.Injective (coindUnit (k := k) L)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have h' := congrArg (fun f => coindUnderlying _ f (1:R)) h
  change (1:R) • (show Obj L from x) = (1:R) • (show Obj L from y) at h'
  change (show Obj L from x) = (show Obj L from y)
  exact (one_smul R (show Obj L from x)).symm.trans
    (h'.trans (one_smul R (show Obj L from y)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindUnit_π
statement:
lemma coindUnit_π (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) :
    coindUnit L ≫ coindπ L = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.app L) (cokernel.condition (coindUnitNat (k := k)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindShort_exact
statement: lemma coindShort_exact (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) : (coindShort (k := k) L).ShortExact

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindπ_surjective
statement: lemma coindπ_surjective (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) : Function.Surjective (coindπ (k := k) L)
proof:
:=
  (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 inferInstance

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coind_exact
statement:
lemma coind_exact (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) :
    Function.Exact (coindUnit (k := k) L) (coindπ L)
proof:
:=
  (ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact _).1 (coindShort_exact L).exact

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindStep_exact
statement:
lemma coindStep_exact (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (coindStep L n) (coindStep L (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    change coindUnit ((coindIterate (n+2)).obj L) (coindπ ((coindIterate (n+1)).obj L) z) = 0 at hz
    have hz' : coindπ ((coindIterate (n+1)).obj L) z = 0 :=
      coindUnit_injective ((coindIterate (n+2)).obj L)
        (hz.trans ((coindUnit ((coindIterate (n+2)).obj L)).hom.map_zero).symm)
    obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := (coind_exact _ z).1 hz'
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := coindπ_surjective ((coindIterate n).obj L) x
    exact ⟨y,by change coindUnit _ (coindπ _ y) = z; rw [hy]; exact hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    have h := (coind_exact ((coindIterate (n+1)).obj L) (coindStep L n y)).2
      ⟨coindπ ((coindIterate n).obj L) y,rfl⟩
    change coindUnit _ (coindπ _ (coindStep L n y)) = 0
    rw [h,map_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coind_start_exact
statement:
lemma coind_start_exact (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) :
    Function.Exact (coindUnit L) (coindStep L 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  change coindUnit _ (coindπ L z) = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply (coind_exact L z).1
    exact coindUnit_injective ((coindIterate 1).obj L)
      (hz.trans ((coindUnit ((coindIterate 1).obj L)).hom.map_zero).symm)
  · intro hz
    have h := (coind_exact L z).2 hz
    rw [h]
    exact (coindUnit ((coindIterate 1).obj L)).hom.map_zero

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coind_finish_exact
statement:
lemma coind_finish_exact (L : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Exact (coindStep L n) (coindπ ((coindIterate (n+1)).obj L))
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  rw [coind_exact _ z]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x,hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := coindπ_surjective ((coindIterate n).obj L) x
    exact ⟨y,by change coindUnit _ (coindπ _ y) = z; rw [hy]; exact hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact ⟨coindπ ((coindIterate n).obj L) y,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFreeEvaluate_extend
statement:
lemma rightFreeEvaluate_extend (g : L →ₗ[R] Obj Q) :
    rightFreeEvaluate L Q (rightFreeExtend L Q g) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (1:Sᵐᵒᵖ) • g x = g x
  rw [one_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFreeExtend_evaluate
statement:
lemma rightFreeExtend_evaluate (f : rightFreeObj (k := k) (S := S) L ⟶ Q) :
    rightFreeExtend L Q (rightFreeEvaluate L Q f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext; intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add x y hx hy => erw [map_add,map_add,hx,hy]
  | tmul x s =>
    change (((1:R) ⊗ₜ[k] (show Sᵐᵒᵖ from s)) : Alg k R S) • f (x ⊗ₜ[k] (rightRegularOne (S := S))) =
      f (x ⊗ₜ[k] s)
    erw [← f.hom.map_smul]
    congr 1
    change ((1:R) • x) ⊗ₜ[k] ((show Sᵐᵒᵖ from s) • rightRegularOne) = x ⊗ₜ[k] s
    rw [one_smul]
    congr 1
    exact mul_one (show Sᵐᵒᵖ from s)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFreeEvaluate_natural
statement:
lemma rightFreeEvaluate_natural {L' : ModuleCat R} (a : L' ⟶ L)
    (f : rightFreeObj (k := k) (S := S) L ⟶ Q) :
    rightFreeEvaluate L' Q ((rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map a ≫ f) =
      (rightFreeEvaluate L Q f).comp a.hom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindTensorUnderlying_tmul
statement:
lemma coindTensorUnderlying_tmul (M : ModuleCat R)
    (φ : (LeftCoinduced.J (k := k)).obj M) (s : rightRegularObj (S := S)) (r : R) :
    (coindUnderlying _ (coindTensorUnderlying (S := S) M (φ ⊗ₜ[k] s))) r =
      (LeftCoinduced.underlying M φ r) ⊗ₜ[k] s
proof:
:= by
  change rTensorHomEquivHomRTensor k R M (rightRegularObj (S := S))
    ((LeftCoinduced.underlying M φ) ⊗ₜ[k] s) r = _
  rw [rTensorHomEquivHomRTensor_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coindTensor_unit
statement:
lemma coindTensor_unit (M : ModuleCat R) :
    (rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map ((LeftCoinduced.unit (k := k)).app M) ≫
      (coindTensorIso M).hom = coindUnit (rightFreeObj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | add x y hx hy => erw [map_add,map_add,hx,hy]
  | tmul x s =>
    apply (coindUnderlying _).injective
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro r
    change coindUnderlying _ (coindTensorUnderlying M
      (((LeftCoinduced.unit (k := k)).app M x) ⊗ₜ[k] s)) r = _
    rw [coindTensorUnderlying_tmul]
    change (r • x) ⊗ₜ[k] s = (r • x) ⊗ₜ[k] ((1:Sᵐᵒᵖ) • s)
    rw [one_smul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.coind_ext_zero
statement:
lemma coind_ext_zero (M : FiniteModule k (Alg k R S))
    [Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj)] (N : ModuleCat Sᵐᵒᵖ) (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext M.obj (coindObj (k := k) (R := R) N) (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  let P := M.projectiveResolution
  let Q := rightResolution M
  have hd (i : ℕ) : P.complex.d (i+1) i = ModuleCat.ofHom (M.posDifferential i) := by
    dsimp [P, FiniteModule.projectiveResolution, resolutionOfExact]
    exact ChainComplex.of_d _ _ _
  have he (i : ℕ) : Q.complex.d (i+1) i =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (rightMap (ModuleCat.ofHom (M.posDifferential i))) := by
    dsimp [Q, rightResolution, resolutionOfExact]
    exact ChainComplex.of_d _ _ _
  let : Subsingleton (Ext (ModuleCat.of Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M.obj)) N (n+1)) :=
    Ext.subsingleton_of_projective _ _ n
  apply ext_subsingleton_of_boundaries P n
  intro f hf
  let f' : Q.complex.X (n+1) ⟶ N :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (coindEvaluate (P.complex.X (n+1)) N f)
  have hf' : Q.complex.d (n+2) (n+1) ≫ f' = 0 := by
    rw [he]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    change (coindEvaluate _ N f).comp (rightMap (ModuleCat.ofHom (M.posDifferential (n+1)))) = 0
    erw [← coindEvaluate_natural]
    rw [hd (n+1)] at hf
    erw [hf]
    exact (coindHomEquiv _ N).map_zero
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := boundaries_of_ext_subsingleton Q n f' hf'
  let g' : P.complex.X n ⟶ coindObj (k := k) (R := R) N :=
    coindExtend _ N g.hom
  refine ⟨g', ?_⟩
  apply (coindHomEquiv _ N).injective
  change coindEvaluate _ N (P.complex.d (n+1) n ≫ g') = coindEvaluate _ N f
  rw [coindEvaluate_natural,show coindEvaluate _ N g' = g.hom from coindEvaluate_extend _ _ _]
  rw [hd]
  rw [he] at hg
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hg

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.regular_coind_ext_zero
statement:
lemma regular_coind_ext_zero (N : ModuleCat Rᵐᵒᵖ) (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (regular (k := k) (R := R))
      (coindObj (k := k) (R := R) N) (n+1))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.dualOuterUnderlying_tmul
statement:
lemma dualOuterUnderlying_tmul (φ : dualLeftObj (k := k) (R := R)) (x : N) (r : R) :
    dualOuterUnderlying N (φ ⊗ₜ[k] x) r = (dualLeftUnderlying φ r) • x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFree_map_exact
statement:
lemma rightFree_map_exact {A B C : ModuleCat R} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C)
    (h : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact ((rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f)
      ((rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map g)
proof:
:=
  Module.Flat.rTensor_exact (rightRegularObj (S := S))
    (show Function.Exact (f.hom.restrictScalars k) (g.hom.restrictScalars k) from h)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFree_map_surjective
statement:
lemma rightFree_map_surjective {A B : ModuleCat R} (f : A ⟶ B) (h : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective ((rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.rTensor_surjective (rightRegularObj (S := S))
    (show Function.Surjective (f.hom.restrictScalars k) from h)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFreeResolution_d
statement:
lemma rightFreeResolution_d (n : ℕ) :
    (rightFreeResolution (S := S) M).complex.d (n+1) n =
      (rightFreeFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map (ModuleCat.ofHom (M.posDifferential n))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [rightFreeResolution, resolutionOfExact]
  exact ChainComplex.of_d _ _ _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightFree_ext_zero
statement:
lemma rightFree_ext_zero (Q : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) [Module.Injective R (Obj Q)] (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (rightFreeObj (k := k) (S := S) M.obj) Q (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  let P := M.projectiveResolution
  let T := rightFreeResolution (S := S) M
  have hd (i : ℕ) : P.complex.d (i+1) i = ModuleCat.ofHom (M.posDifferential i) := by
    dsimp [P, FiniteModule.projectiveResolution, resolutionOfExact]
    exact ChainComplex.of_d _ _ _
  let : Injective (ModuleCat.of R (Obj Q)) := Module.injective_object_of_injective_module R (Obj Q)
  let : Subsingleton (Ext M.obj (ModuleCat.of R (Obj Q)) (n+1)) :=
    Ext.subsingleton_of_injective _ _ n
  apply ext_subsingleton_of_boundaries T n
  intro f hf
  let f' : P.complex.X (n+1) ⟶ ModuleCat.of R (Obj Q) :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (rightFreeEvaluate (P.complex.X (n+1)) Q f)
  have hf' : P.complex.d (n+2) (n+1) ≫ f' = 0 := by
    rw [hd]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    change (rightFreeEvaluate _ Q f).comp (M.posDifferential (n+1)) = 0
    rw [rightFreeResolution_d] at hf
    exact congrArg (rightFreeEvaluate (ModuleCat.of R (M.posTerm (n+2))) Q) hf
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := boundaries_of_ext_subsingleton P n f' hf'
  let g' : T.complex.X n ⟶ Q := rightFreeExtend _ Q g.hom
  refine ⟨g', ?_⟩
  apply (rightFreeHomEquiv _ Q).injective
  change rightFreeEvaluate _ Q (T.complex.d (n+1) n ≫ g') = rightFreeEvaluate _ Q f
  erw [rightFreeResolution_d, rightFreeEvaluate_natural]
  rw [show rightFreeEvaluate _ Q g' = g.hom from rightFreeEvaluate_extend _ _ _]
  rw [hd] at hg
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hg

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.regular_outer_ext_zero
statement:
lemma regular_outer_ext_zero (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (regular (k := k) (R := R)) (ordinaryOuterObj (k := k) (R := R)) (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  let e : ordinaryOuterObj (k := k) (R := R) ≅
      coindObj (k := k) (R := R) (rightRegularObj (S := R)) :=
    (dualOuterEquiv (rightRegularObj (S := R))).toModuleIso
  let := regular_coind_ext_zero (k := k) (R := R) (rightRegularObj (S := R)) n
  exact Function.Injective.subsingleton (extIso (k := k) (Iso.refl _) e (n+1)).injective

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.outer_dual_ext_zero
statement:
lemma outer_dual_ext_zero (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (ordinaryOuterObj (k := k) (R := R)) (dualRegularObj (k := k) (R := R)) (n+1))
proof:
:=
  rightFree_ext_zero (dualLeftFinite (k := k) (R := R)) (dualRegularObj (k := k) (R := R)) n

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.two_orthogonalities
statement:
theorem two_orthogonalities (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (Ext (regular (k := k) (R := R)) (ordinaryOuterObj (k := k) (R := R)) (n+1)) ∧
    Subsingleton (Ext (ordinaryOuterObj (k := k) (R := R)) (dualRegularObj (k := k) (R := R)) (n+1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨regular_outer_ext_zero n, outer_dual_ext_zero n⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.π_surjective
statement: lemma π_surjective : Function.Surjective (π P j)
proof: := Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.π_d
statement: lemma π_d : (π P j).comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _ |>.mpr ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.ι_π
statement: @[simp] lemma ι_π (x : P.X j) : ι P j (π P j x) = P.d j (j-1) x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.ι_comp_π
statement: lemma ι_comp_π : (ι P j).comp (π P j) = (P.d j (j-1)).hom
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.ι_injective
statement:
lemma ι_injective (h : Function.Exact (P.d (j+1) j) (P.d j (j-1))) :
    Function.Injective (ι P j)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P j x
  apply Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _ |>.mpr
  exact (h y).mp hx

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.descend_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma descend_π {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N) (hf) (x : P.X j) : descend P j f hf (π P j x) = f x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.descend_comp_π
statement:
lemma descend_comp_π {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N) (hf) : (descend P j f hf).comp (π P j) = f
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.projective_boundaries
statement:
lemma projective_boundaries {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] (j : ℤ) (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : f.comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0) :
    ∃ g : P.X (j-1) →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (P.d j (j-1)).hom = f
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := R) (M := N)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map (LinearMap.id (R := R) (M := N))
    c.surjective
  have hc (i : Fin c.rank) :
      ((LinearMap.proj i).comp (s.comp f)).comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, LinearMap.comp_assoc, hf, LinearMap.comp_zero, LinearMap.comp_zero]
  choose g hg using fun i : Fin c.rank => hP.2 j ((LinearMap.proj i).comp (s.comp f)) (hc i)
  refine ⟨c.map.comp (LinearMap.pi g), ?_⟩
  have heq : (LinearMap.pi g).comp (P.d j (j-1)).hom = s.comp f := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    funext i
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (hg i) x
  rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, heq, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hs, LinearMap.id_comp]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.extend_coker
statement:
lemma extend_coker {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] (j : ℤ) (f : CokerAt P j →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃ g : P.X (j-1) →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (CokerAt.ι P j) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP.projective_boundaries j (f.comp (CokerAt.π P j)) (by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, CokerAt.π_d, LinearMap.comp_zero])
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective P j x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hg y

name: OAI.Tachikawa.ComplexExact.adjacent
statement:
lemma ComplexExact.adjacent (hex : ComplexExact P) (i j l : ℤ)
    (hi : i = j+1) (hl : l = j-1) :
    Function.Exact (P.d i j) (P.d j l)
proof:
:= by
  subst i
  subst l
  exact hex j

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeResolutionTail_d
statement:
lemma completeResolutionTail_d (hex : ComplexExact P)
    (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j)) (n : ℕ) :
    (completeResolutionTail P hex proj).complex.d (n+1) n =
      P.d ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [completeResolutionTail, resolutionOfExact]
  exact ChainComplex.of_d _ _ n

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.factors_iff_boundary
statement:
lemma factors_iff_boundary (hP : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (fin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (P.X j))
    (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [Module k N] [IsScalarTower k R N]
    (j : ℤ) (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N) (hf : f.comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0) :
    CokerAt.descend P j f hf ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) ↔
      ∃ g : P.X (j-1) →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (P.d j (j-1)).hom = f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨J, hJf, hJp, a, b, hab⟩
    let := hJf
    let := hJp
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ := hP.extend_coker j a
    refine ⟨b.comp a', ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun ha' (CokerAt.π P j x)
    change a' (P.d j (j-1) x) = a (CokerAt.π P j x) at hx
    change b (a' (P.d j (j-1) x)) = f x
    rw [hx]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hab (CokerAt.π P j x)
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    refine ⟨P.X (j-1), fin _, proj _, CokerAt.ι P j, g, ?_⟩
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective P j x
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hg y

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.boundaries_of_stableHom
statement:
lemma boundaries_of_stableHom (hP : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (fin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (P.X j))
    (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (N : ModuleCat R) (i j l : ℤ) (hi : i = j+1) (hl : l = j-1)
    (h : Subsingleton (StableHom (k := k) (R := R) (M := CokerAt P j) (N := N)))
    (f : P.X j →ₗ[R] N) (hf : f.comp (P.d i j).hom = 0) :
    ∃ g : P.X l →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (P.d j l).hom = f
proof:
:= by
  subst i
  subst l
  apply (hP.factors_iff_boundary (k := k) fin proj j f hf).mp
  apply (stableClass_eq_zero_iff _).mp
  exact h.elim _ _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.ext_subsingleton_of_stableHom
statement:
lemma ext_subsingleton_of_stableHom (hP : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (fin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (P.X j))
    (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (N : ModuleCat R) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Subsingleton (StableHom (k := k) (R := R) (M := CokerAt P ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ))
      (N := N))) :
    Subsingleton (Abelian.Ext (ModuleCat.of R (CokerAt P 0)) N (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  let Q := completeResolutionTail P hP.1 proj
  apply ext_subsingleton_of_boundaries Q n
  intro f hf
  have hf' : f.hom.comp (P.d ((n+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ)).hom = 0 := by
    rw [completeResolutionTail_d] at hf
    exact ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hf
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hP.boundaries_of_stableHom fin proj N
    ((n+2 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((n+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (n : ℤ) (by omega) (by omega) h f.hom hf'
  refine ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom g, ?_⟩
  rw [completeResolutionTail_d]
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext hg

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.δ_π
statement: @[simp] lemma δ_π (i j : ℤ) (x : P.X i) : δ P i j (π P i x) = P.d i j x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.δ_comp_π
statement: lemma δ_comp_π (i j : ℤ) : (δ P i j).comp (π P i) = (P.d i j).hom
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.δ_injective
statement:
lemma δ_injective (hex : ComplexExact P) (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1) :
    Function.Injective (δ P i j)
proof:
:= by
  have hj : j = i-1 := by omega
  subst j
  exact ι_injective P i (hex i)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.π_comp_δ
statement: lemma π_comp_δ (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1) : (π P j).comp (δ P i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P (j+1) x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (π_d P j) y

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.δ_π_exact
statement:
lemma δ_π_exact (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1) :
    Function.Exact (δ P i j) (π P j)
proof:
:= by
  subst i
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hx
    exact ⟨π P (j+1) y, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (π_comp_δ P _ _ rfl) y

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.factorThrough_spec
statement:
lemma factorThrough_spec {L M N : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [AddCommGroup M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R L] [Module R M] [Module R N]
    (i : M →ₗ[R] N) (hi : Function.Injective i) (f : L →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : ∀ x, f x ∈ LinearMap.range i) :
    i.comp (factorThrough i hi f hf) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change i ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective i hi).symm ⟨f x, hf x⟩) = f x
  exact LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply i _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TotallyAcyclic.extend_at
statement:
lemma extend_at (hP : TotallyAcyclic P) {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1)
    (f : CokerAt P i →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃ g : P.X j →ₗ[R] N, g.comp (CokerAt.δ P i j) = f
proof:
:= by
  have hj : j = i-1 := by omega
  subst j
  exact hP.extend_coker i f

name: OAI.Tachikawa.comparison_step_up
statement:
lemma comparison_step_up (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j)) (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1)
    (v : CokerAt P j →ₗ[R] CokerAt Q j) :
    ∃ u : CokerAt P i →ₗ[R] CokerAt Q i, Nonempty (ComparisonStep P Q i j u v)
proof:
:= by
  let := proj j
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (CokerAt.π Q j)
    (v.comp (CokerAt.π P j)) (CokerAt.π_surjective Q j)
  have hr (x : CokerAt P i) : f (CokerAt.δ P i j x) ∈ LinearMap.range (CokerAt.δ Q i j) := by
    apply (CokerAt.δ_π_exact Q i j h _).mp
    change ((CokerAt.π Q j).comp f) (CokerAt.δ P i j x) = 0
    rw [hf]
    change v (((CokerAt.π P j).comp (CokerAt.δ P i j)) x) = 0
    rw [CokerAt.π_comp_δ P i j h]
    exact map_zero v
  let u := CokerAt.factorThrough (CokerAt.δ Q i j) (CokerAt.δ_injective Q hq i j h)
    (f.comp (CokerAt.δ P i j)) hr
  exact ⟨u, ⟨⟨f, (CokerAt.factorThrough_spec _ _ _ _).symm, hf⟩⟩⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.comparison_step_down
statement:
lemma comparison_step_down (hp : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j))
    (i j : ℤ) (h : i = j+1) (u : CokerAt P i →ₗ[R] CokerAt Q i) :
    ∃ v : CokerAt P j →ₗ[R] CokerAt Q j, Nonempty (ComparisonStep P Q i j u v)
proof:
:= by
  let := qfin j
  let := qproj j
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hp.extend_at i j h ((CokerAt.δ Q i j).comp u)
  subst i
  have hf' : ((CokerAt.π Q j).comp f).comp (P.d (j+1) j).hom = 0 := by
    ext x
    have hfx := LinearMap.congr_fun hf (CokerAt.π P (j+1) x)
    change f (P.d (j+1) j x) = CokerAt.δ Q (j+1) j (u (CokerAt.π P (j+1) x)) at hfx
    change CokerAt.π Q j (f (P.d (j+1) j x)) = 0
    rw [hfx]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (CokerAt.π_comp_δ Q _ _ rfl) _
  exact ⟨CokerAt.descend P j ((CokerAt.π Q j).comp f) hf', ⟨⟨f, hf, rfl⟩⟩⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteLift.cokerMap_zero
statement: lemma cokerMap_zero : cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ 0 = u₀
proof:
:=
  Int.inductionOn'_self

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteLift.cokerMap_up
statement:
lemma cokerMap_up (j : ℤ) (hj : 0 ≤ j) :
    cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ (j+1) =
      up P Q hq pproj j (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ j)
proof:
:=
  Int.inductionOn'_add_one hj

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteLift.cokerMap_down
statement:
lemma cokerMap_down (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≤ 0) :
    cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ (j-1) =
      down P Q hp qfin qproj j (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ j)
proof:
:=
  Int.inductionOn'_sub_one hj

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteLift.hasSquare_down
statement:
lemma hasSquare_down (i j : ℤ) (h : i-1=j) (hi : i ≤ 0) :
    Nonempty (ComparisonStep P Q i j
      (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ i)
      (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ j))
proof:
:= by
  subst j
  rw [cokerMap_down P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ i hi]
  exact ⟨downSquare P Q hp qfin qproj i _⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteLift.hasSquare
statement:
lemma hasSquare (j : ℤ) : Nonempty (ComparisonStep P Q (j+1) j
    (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ (j+1))
    (cokerMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ j))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : 0 ≤ j
  · rw [cokerMap_up P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ j hj]
    exact ⟨upSquare P Q hq pproj j _⟩
  · exact hasSquare_down P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u₀ (j+1) j (by omega) (by omega)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.map_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_π (f : P ⟶ Q) (j : ℤ) (x : P.X j) :
    map f j (π P j x) = π Q j (f.f j x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {S : ChainComplex (ModuleCat R) ℤ} (f : P ⟶ Q) (g : Q ⟶ S) (j : ℤ) :
    map (f ≫ g) j = (map g j).comp (map f j)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P j x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (j : ℤ) : map (𝟙 P) j = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := π_surjective P j x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.exists_complete_lift
statement:
theorem exists_complete_lift (hp : TotallyAcyclic P) (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (pproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j))
    (u : CokerAt P 0 →ₗ[R] CokerAt Q 0) :
    ∃ f : P ⟶ Q, CokerAt.map f 0 = u
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨CompleteLift.chainMap P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective P 0 x
  change CokerAt.π Q 0 ((CompleteLift.square P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u 0).map y) = _
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (CompleteLift.square P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u 0).lower y
  exact h.trans (LinearMap.congr_fun
    (CompleteLift.cokerMap_zero P Q hp hq pproj qfin qproj u) (CokerAt.π P 0 y))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CokerAt.augmentationEquiv_π
statement:
@[simp] lemma augmentationEquiv_π (x : P.X j) :
    augmentationEquiv P N j a he hs (π P j x) = a x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.embed_injective
statement: lemma embed_injective : Function.Injective (M.embed t)
proof: := t.freeEmbedding_injective

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.pos_exact
statement: lemma pos_exact (n : ℕ) : Function.Exact (M.posDifferential (n+1)) (M.posDifferential n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change ((M.positive (n+1)).cover.map x).val = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : (M.positive (n+1)).cover.map x = 0 := Subtype.ext hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (M.positive (n+2)).cover.surjective ⟨x, hx'⟩
    exact ⟨y, congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((M.positive (n+2)).cover.map y).property

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.neg_exact
statement: lemma neg_exact (n : ℕ) : Function.Exact (M.negDifferential t n) (M.negDifferential t (n+1))
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hz : (LinearMap.range ((M.negative t (n+1)).embed t)).mkQ x = 0 :=
      (M.negative t (n+2)).embed_injective t (hx.trans ((M.negative t (n+2)).embed t).map_zero.symm)
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hz
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Submodule.mkQ_surjective (LinearMap.range ((M.negative t n).embed t))) y
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    change (M.negative t (n+1)).embed t ((LinearMap.range ((M.negative t n).embed t)).mkQ z) = x
    exact (congrArg ((M.negative t (n+1)).embed t) hz).trans hy
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    apply ((M.negative t (n+2)).embed t).map_eq_zero_iff ((M.negative t (n+2)).embed_injective t) |>.mpr
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.middle_exact_left
statement: lemma middle_exact_left : Function.Exact (M.posDifferential 0) (M.middle t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change M.embed t (M.cover.map x) = 0 ↔ _
  rw [map_eq_zero_iff _ (M.embed_injective t)]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (M.positive 1).cover.surjective ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨y, congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact ((M.positive 1).cover.map y).property

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.middle_exact_right
statement: lemma middle_exact_right : Function.Exact (M.middle t) (M.negDifferential t 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hz : (LinearMap.range (M.embed t)).mkQ x = 0 :=
      (M.negative t 1).embed_injective t (hx.trans ((M.negative t 1).embed t).map_zero.symm)
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hz
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := M.cover.surjective y
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    apply ((M.negative t 1).embed t).map_eq_zero_iff ((M.negative t 1).embed_injective t) |>.mpr
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr ⟨M.cover.map y, rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.differential_exact
statement:
lemma differential_exact (j : ℤ) :
    Function.Exact (M.differential t (j+1)) (M.differential t j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j with
  | ofNat n => exact M.pos_exact n
  | negSucc n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => exact M.middle_exact_left t
    | succ n =>
      cases n with
      | zero => exact M.middle_exact_right t
      | succ n =>
        exact M.neg_exact t n

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.complete_exact
statement: lemma complete_exact : ComplexExact (M.complete t)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ (j i : ℤ), i=j-1 →
      Function.Exact ((M.complete t).d (j+1) j) ((M.complete t).d j i) by
    exact fun j => this j (j-1) rfl
  intro j i hi
  have hj : j=i+1 := by omega
  subst j
  change Function.Exact (ChainComplex.of.d (M.term t) (M.differential t) (i+1+1) (i+1))
    (ChainComplex.of.d (M.term t) (M.differential t) (i+1) i)
  simp only [ChainComplex.of_d]
  exact M.differential_exact t i

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.complete_projective
statement: lemma complete_projective (j : ℤ) : Module.Projective R ((M.complete t).X j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j <;> exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Projective R (Fin _ → R))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.complete_finite
statement: lemma complete_finite (j : ℤ) : Module.Finite R ((M.complete t).X j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j <;> exact inferInstanceAs (Module.Finite R (Fin _ → R))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.complete_d
statement: @[simp] lemma complete_d (j : ℤ) : (M.complete t).d (j+1) j = M.differential t j
proof:
:=
  ChainComplex.of_d _ _ j

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.augmentation_surjective
statement: lemma augmentation_surjective : Function.Surjective (M.augmentation t)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := M.cover.surjective x
  exact ⟨CokerAt.π (M.complete t) 0 y, rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.augmentation_injective
statement: lemma augmentation_injective : Function.Injective (M.augmentation t)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective (M.complete t) 0 x
  change M.cover.map y = 0 at hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (M.positive 1).cover.surjective ⟨y, hx⟩
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
  use z
  rw [complete_d]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hz

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.complete_totallyAcyclic
statement: lemma complete_totallyAcyclic : TotallyAcyclic (M.complete t)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M.complete_exact t, ?_⟩
  intro j f hf
  let : Module.Injective R R := t.injective
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R R
    (CokerAt (M.complete t) j) ((M.complete t).X (j-1))
    (CokerAt.ι (M.complete t) j) (CokerAt.ι_injective _ _ (M.complete_exact t j))
    (CokerAt.descend _ _ f hf)
  refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
  have hh := congrArg (fun a => a.comp (CokerAt.π (M.complete t) j)) hg
  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_assoc, CokerAt.ι_comp_π, CokerAt.descend_comp_π] using hh

name: OAI.Tachikawa.FiniteModule.pos_augmentation_exact
statement: lemma pos_augmentation_exact : Function.Exact (M.posDifferential 0) M.cover.map
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (M.positive 1).cover.surjective ⟨x,hx⟩
    exact ⟨y,congrArg Subtype.val hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact ((M.positive 1).cover.map y).property

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensorComplex_exact
statement:
lemma tensorComplex_exact [FiniteDimensional k (Obj M)] [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M)]
    (P : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R) ℤ) (hP : ComplexExact P) :
    ComplexExact (tensorComplex M P)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  intro j
  exact BalancedTensor.mapRight_exact (P.d (j+1) j).hom (P.d j (j-1)).hom (hP j)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensorComplex_finite
statement:
lemma tensorComplex_finite [FiniteDimensional k R] [FiniteDimensional k (Obj M)]
    (P : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R) ℤ) (fin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (P.X j)) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Finite S ((tensorComplex M P).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := fin j
  let : FiniteDimensional k (P.X j) := Module.Finite.trans R _
  let : FiniteDimensional k ((tensorComplex M P).X j) := inferInstanceAs
    (FiniteDimensional k (BalancedTensor.T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := Obj M) (N := P.X j)))
  exact Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensorComplex_projective
statement:
lemma tensorComplex_projective [Module.Projective S (Obj M)]
    (P : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R) ℤ)
    (fin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (P.X j)) (proj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j)) (j : ℤ) :
    Module.Projective S ((tensorComplex M P).X j)
proof:
:= by
  let := fin j
  let := proj j
  exact BalancedTensor.map_projective (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := Obj M) (N := P.X j)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensor_augmentation_exact
statement:
lemma tensor_augmentation_exact : Function.Exact
    ((tensorComplex M (N.complete t)).d 1 0)
    ((tensorFunctor M).map (ModuleCat.ofHom N.cover.map))
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Finite Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k _ _
  apply BalancedTensor.mapRight_exact
  change Function.Exact ((N.complete t).d (0+1) 0) N.cover.map
  rw [N.complete_d]
  exact N.pos_augmentation_exact

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensor_map_surjective
statement:
lemma tensor_map_surjective {X Y : ModuleCat R} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Surjective ((tensorFunctor M).map f)
proof:
:=
  BalancedTensor.mapRight_surjective f.hom hf

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.right_smul_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma right_smul_mk (u : Uᵐᵒᵖ) (m : M) (n : N) :
    u • (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) m n) = mk m (u • n)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.ofBimodule_tmul_smul
statement:
lemma ofBimodule_tmul_smul (r : R) (s : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (m : M) :
    (r ⊗ₜ[k] s) • (show ofBimodule (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) M from m) =
      (show ofBimodule (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) M from r • s • m)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.evalMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma evalMap_mk {M N : ModuleCat (Alg k S R)} (f : M ⟶ N) (m : Obj M) (x : X) :
    evalMap X f (BalancedTensor.mk m x) = BalancedTensor.mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (N := X) (leftMap f m) x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.exists_tensorCompleteLift
statement:
lemma exists_tensorCompleteLift : ∃ l : N.complete t ⟶ tensorComplex M (N.complete t),
    l.f 0 ≫ (tensorFunctor M).map (ModuleCat.ofHom N.cover.map) =
      ModuleCat.ofHom N.cover.map ≫ v
proof:
:= by
  let u := (tensorAugmentationEquiv M N t).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (v.hom.comp (N.cokerEquiv t).toLinearMap)
  obtain ⟨l,hl⟩ := exists_complete_lift (N.complete t) (tensorComplex M (N.complete t))
    (N.complete_totallyAcyclic t) (tensorComplex_exact M _ (N.complete_exact t))
    (N.complete_projective t) (tensorComplex_finite M _ (N.complete_finite t))
    (tensorComplex_projective M _ (N.complete_finite t) (N.complete_projective t)) u
  refine ⟨l,?_⟩
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hx := congrArg (tensorAugmentationEquiv M N t)
    (LinearMap.congr_fun hl (CokerAt.π (N.complete t) 0 x))
  change (tensorAugmentationEquiv M N t) (CokerAt.π _ 0 (l.f 0 x)) =
    (tensorAugmentationEquiv M N t) ((tensorAugmentationEquiv M N t).symm
      (v ((N.cokerEquiv t) (CokerAt.π _ 0 x)))) at hx
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hx
  exact hx

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tensorCompleteLift_aug
statement:
lemma tensorCompleteLift_aug : (tensorCompleteLift M N t v).f 0 ≫
    (tensorFunctor M).map (ModuleCat.ofHom N.cover.map) = ModuleCat.ofHom N.cover.map ≫ v
proof:
:=
  (exists_tensorCompleteLift M N t v).choose_spec

name: OAI.Tachikawa.goodComponent_up
statement:
lemma goodComponent_up (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (pproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (i j l : ℤ) (hij : i+1=j) (hjl : j+1=l)
    (a : P.X i →ₗ[R] Q.X j) (ha : GoodComponent f i j a) :
    ∃ b : P.X j →ₗ[R] Q.X l,
      (f.f j).hom = a.comp (P.d j i).hom + (Q.d l j).hom.comp b ∧
      GoodComponent f j l b
proof:
:= by
  let := pproj j
  let r := (f.f j).hom - a.comp (P.d j i).hom
  have hr (x : P.X j) : r x ∈ LinearMap.range (Q.d l j).hom := by
    have he := hq j
    have hi : i = j-1 := by omega
    have hl : l = j+1 := by omega
    subst i
    subst l
    apply (he _).mp
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (f.comm j (j-1))) x
    change Q.d j (j-1) (f.f j x) = f.f (j-1) (P.d j (j-1) x) at hc
    have hh := LinearMap.congr_fun ha x
    change f.f (j-1) (P.d j (j-1) x) - Q.d j (j-1) (a (P.d j (j-1) x)) = 0 at hh
    change Q.d j (j-1) (f.f j x - a (P.d j (j-1) x)) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hc]
    exact hh
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property
    (Q.d l j).hom.rangeRestrict (r.codRestrict _ hr) (by rintro ⟨x, y, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  have hb' : (Q.d l j).hom.comp b = r := by
    ext x
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun hb x)
  refine ⟨b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hb']
    dsimp only [r]
    abel
  · unfold GoodComponent
    rw [hb']
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [sub_sub_cancel, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    have hd : (P.d j i).hom.comp (P.d l j).hom = 0 :=
      ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (P.d_comp_d _ _ _)
    rw [hd, LinearMap.comp_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.goodComponent_down
statement:
lemma goodComponent_down (hp : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j))
    (i j l : ℤ) (hij : i+1=j) (hjl : j+1=l)
    (b : P.X j →ₗ[R] Q.X l) (hb : GoodComponent f j l b) :
    ∃ a : P.X i →ₗ[R] Q.X j,
      (f.f j).hom = a.comp (P.d j i).hom + (Q.d l j).hom.comp b ∧
      GoodComponent f i j a
proof:
:= by
  subst l
  let := qfin j
  let := qproj j
  have hi : i = j-1 := by omega
  subst i
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hp.projective_boundaries j
    ((f.f j).hom - (Q.d (j+1) j).hom.comp b) hb
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ha]
    abel
  · unfold GoodComponent
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (f.comm j (j-1))) x
    change Q.d j (j-1) (f.f j x) = f.f (j-1) (P.d j (j-1) x) at hc
    have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun ha x
    change a (P.d j (j-1) x) = f.f j x - Q.d (j+1) j (b x) at hx
    rw [hx, map_sub, ← hc]
    have hd := LinearMap.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (Q.d_comp_d (j+1) j (j-1))) (b x)
    change Q.d j (j-1) (Q.d (j+1) j (b x)) = 0 at hd
    rw [hd, sub_zero, sub_self]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.stateMap_self
statement: @[simp] lemma stateMap_self {i : ℤ} (a : State f i) : stateMap f a (i+1) rfl = a.val
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.up_step
statement: lemma up_step (j : ℤ) (a : State f j) : Step f j (j+1) rfl a (up f hq pproj j a)
proof:
:=
  (goodComponent_up f hq pproj j (j+1) (j+1+1) rfl rfl a.val a.property).choose_spec.1

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.down_step
statement:
lemma down_step (i j : ℤ) (h : i+1=j) (b : State f j) :
    Step f i j h (down f hp qfin qproj i j h b) b
proof:
:= by
  subst j
  exact (goodComponent_down f hp qfin qproj i (i+1) (i+1+1) rfl rfl b.val b.property).choose_spec.1

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.component_up
statement:
lemma component_up (j : ℤ) (hj : 0 ≤ j) :
    component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ (j+1) =
      up f hq pproj j (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ j)
proof:
:=
  Int.inductionOn'_add_one hj

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.component_down
statement:
lemma component_down (j : ℤ) (hj : j ≤ 0) :
    component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ (j-1) =
      down f hp qfin qproj (j-1) j (by omega) (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ j)
proof:
:=
  Int.inductionOn'_sub_one hj

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.hasStep_down
statement:
lemma hasStep_down (i j : ℤ) (h : i+1=j) (hj : j ≤ 0) :
    Step f i j h (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ i)
      (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : i=j-1 := by omega
  subst i
  rw [component_down f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ j hj]
  exact down_step f hp qfin qproj (j-1) j h _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteNull.hasStep
statement:
lemma hasStep (i j : ℤ) (h : i+1=j) :
    Step f i j h (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ i)
      (component f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : 0 ≤ i
  · subst j
    rw [component_up f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ i hi]
    exact up_step f hq pproj i _
  · exact hasStep_down f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀ i j h (by omega)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.exists_good_component_zero
statement:
lemma exists_good_component_zero (hp : TotallyAcyclic P)
    (pproj : Module.Projective R (P.X 0))
    (hf : CokerAt.map f 0 ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)) :
    Nonempty (CompleteNull.State f 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, hJf, hJp, a, b, hab⟩ := hf
  let := hJf
  let := hJp
  let := pproj
  obtain ⟨a', ha⟩ := hp.extend_at 0 (-1) rfl a
  obtain ⟨b', hb⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (CokerAt.π Q 0) b
    (CokerAt.π_surjective Q 0)
  let r := (f.f 0).hom - (b'.comp a').comp (P.d 0 (-1)).hom
  have hr (x : P.X 0) : r x ∈ LinearMap.range (Q.d 1 0).hom := by
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp
    change CokerAt.π Q 0 (r x) = 0
    have ha' := LinearMap.congr_fun ha (CokerAt.π P 0 x)
    change a' (P.d 0 (-1) x) = a (CokerAt.π P 0 x) at ha'
    have hb' := LinearMap.congr_fun hb (a (CokerAt.π P 0 x))
    change CokerAt.π Q 0 (b' (a (CokerAt.π P 0 x))) = b (a (CokerAt.π P 0 x)) at hb'
    have hab' := LinearMap.congr_fun hab (CokerAt.π P 0 x)
    change b (a (CokerAt.π P 0 x)) = CokerAt.π Q 0 (f.f 0 x) at hab'
    change CokerAt.π Q 0 (f.f 0 x - b' (a' (P.d 0 (-1) x))) = 0
    rw [map_sub, ha', hb', hab', sub_self]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property
    (Q.d 1 0).hom.rangeRestrict (r.codRestrict _ hr)
    (by rintro ⟨x, y, rfl⟩; exact ⟨y, rfl⟩)
  have hc' : (Q.d 1 0).hom.comp c = r := by
    ext x
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun hc x)
  refine ⟨⟨c, ?_⟩⟩
  unfold GoodComponent
  change ((f.f 0).hom - (Q.d 1 0).hom.comp c).comp (P.d 1 0).hom = 0
  rw [hc']
  dsimp only [r]
  rw [sub_sub_cancel, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  have hd : (P.d 0 (-1)).hom.comp (P.d 1 0).hom = 0 :=
    ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp (P.d_comp_d _ _ _)
  rw [hd, LinearMap.comp_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.nullhomotopic_of_coker_factors
statement:
theorem nullhomotopic_of_coker_factors (hp : TotallyAcyclic P) (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (pproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j))
    (hf : CokerAt.map f 0 ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)) : Nonempty (Homotopy f 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b₀⟩ := exists_good_component_zero f hp (pproj 0) hf
  exact ⟨CompleteNull.homotopy f hp hq pproj qfin qproj b₀⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.coker_factors_of_nullhomotopic
statement:
lemma coker_factors_of_nullhomotopic (h : Homotopy f 0)
    (pfin : Module.Finite R (P.X (-1))) (pproj : Module.Projective R (P.X (-1))) :
    CokerAt.map f 0 ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.X (-1), pfin, pproj, CokerAt.δ P 0 (-1),
    (CokerAt.π Q 0).comp (h.hom (-1) 0).hom, ?_⟩
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective P 0 x
  have hc := h.comm 0
  rw [dNext_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℤ).Rel 0 (-1) by decide),
    prevD_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℤ).Rel 1 0 by decide)] at hc
  have hc' := LinearMap.congr_fun (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hc) y
  change f.f 0 y = h.hom (-1) 0 (P.d 0 (-1) y) +
    Q.d 1 0 (h.hom 0 1 y) + 0 at hc'
  change CokerAt.π Q 0 (h.hom (-1) 0 (P.d 0 (-1) y)) = CokerAt.π Q 0 (f.f 0 y)
  have hz : CokerAt.π Q 0 (Q.d 1 0 (h.hom 0 1 y)) = 0 :=
    LinearMap.congr_fun (CokerAt.π_d Q 0) (h.hom 0 1 y)
  rw [hc', add_zero, map_add, hz, add_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.nullhomotopic_iff_coker_factors
statement:
theorem nullhomotopic_iff_coker_factors (hp : TotallyAcyclic P) (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (pproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (pfin : Module.Finite R (P.X (-1)))
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j)) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy f 0) ↔ CokerAt.map f 0 ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    exact coker_factors_of_nullhomotopic f h pfin (pproj (-1))
  · exact nullhomotopic_of_coker_factors f hp hq pproj qfin qproj

name: OAI.Tachikawa.complete_homotopy_of_augmentation
statement:
lemma complete_homotopy_of_augmentation (hp : TotallyAcyclic P) (hq : ComplexExact Q)
    (pproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (P.X j))
    (qfin : ∀ j, Module.Finite R (Q.X j)) (qproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (Q.X j))
    {N : ModuleCat.{0} R} (a : Q.X 0 →ₗ[R] N)
    (he : Function.Exact (Q.d 1 0) a) (hs : Function.Surjective a)
    (f g : P ⟶ Q) (hfg : a.comp (f.f 0).hom = a.comp (g.f 0).hom) :
    Nonempty (Homotopy f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : CokerAt.map (f-g) 0 = 0 := by
    ext x
    obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := CokerAt.π_surjective P 0 x
    apply (CokerAt.augmentationEquiv Q N 0 a he hs).injective
    change a (f.f 0 y-g.f 0 y) = _
    have hy : a (f.f 0 y) = a (g.f 0 y) := LinearMap.congr_fun hfg y
    rw [map_sub,hy,sub_self]
    exact (map_zero _).symm
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := nullhomotopic_of_coker_factors (k := k) (f-g) hp hq pproj qfin qproj
    (by rw [hz]; exact (projectiveFactors (k := k)).zero_mem)
  exact ⟨Homotopy.equivSubZero.symm h⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inLeft_left
statement: @[simp] lemma inLeft_left (j : ℤ) : inLeft v j ≫ left v j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX_fstX

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inLeft_right
statement: @[simp] lemma inLeft_right (j : ℤ) : inLeft v j ≫ right v j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX_sndX

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inRight_left
statement: @[simp] lemma inRight_left (j : ℤ) : inRight v j ≫ left v j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inrX_fstX

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inRight_right
statement: @[simp] lemma inRight_right (j : ℤ) : inRight v j ≫ right v j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inrX_sndX

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.total
statement: lemma total (j : ℤ) : left v j ≫ inLeft v j + right v j ≫ inRight v j = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.ext_to_X v j (j-1) (rel j) <;>
    simp only [add_comp,Category.assoc,inLeft_left,inLeft_right,inRight_left,
      inRight_right,Category.comp_id,comp_zero,zero_add,add_zero,Category.id_comp]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.ext_element
statement:
lemma ext_element (j : ℤ) {x y : (complex v).X j}
    (hl : left v j x = left v j y) (hr : right v j x = right v j y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f x) (total v j)
  have hy := congrArg (fun f => f y) (total v j)
  change inLeft v j (left v j x) + inRight v j (right v j x) = x at hx
  change inLeft v j (left v j y) + inRight v j (right v j y) = y at hy
  rw [hl,hr,hy] at hx
  exact hx.symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.left_d
statement:
lemma left_d (j : ℤ) (x : (complex v).X j) :
    left v (j-1) ((complex v).d j (j-1) x) = - B.d (j-1) (j-1-1) (left v j x)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x)
    (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.d_fstX v j (j-1) (j-1-1) (rel j) (rel (j-1)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.right_d
statement:
lemma right_d (j : ℤ) (x : (complex v).X j) :
    right v (j-1) ((complex v).d j (j-1) x) =
      v.f (j-1) (left v j x) + A.d j (j-1) (right v j x)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x)
    (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.d_sndX v j (j-1) (rel j))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inRight_d
statement: lemma inRight_d (i j : ℤ) : inRight v i ≫ (complex v).d i j = A.d i j ≫ inRight v j
proof:
:=
  HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inrX_d v i j

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.inLeft_d
statement:
lemma inLeft_d (j : ℤ) : inLeft v j ≫ (complex v).d j (j-1) =
    -B.d (j-1) (j-1-1) ≫ inLeft v (j-1) + v.f (j-1) ≫ inRight v (j-1)
proof:
:=
  HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX_d v j (j-1) (j-1-1) (rel j) (rel (j-1))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.exact
statement: lemma exact (hA : ComplexExact A) (hB : ComplexExact B) : ComplexExact (complex v)
proof:
:= by
  intro j x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hl : B.d (j-1) (j-1-1) (left v j x) = 0 := by
      have he := left_d v j x
      rw [hx,map_zero] at he
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp he.symm
    have hex := hB (j-1)
    rw [show j-1+1=j by omega] at hex
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (hex _).mp hl
    let y : (complex v).X (j+1) :=
      HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX v j (j+1) (by rfl) (-b)
    have hyl : left v j ((complex v).d (j+1) j y) = left v j x := by
      have he : HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX v j (j+1) (by rfl) ≫
          (complex v).d (j+1) j ≫ left v j = -B.d j (j-1) := by
        calc
          _ = (-B.d j (j-1) ≫ inLeft v j + v.f j ≫ inRight v j) ≫ left v j :=
            (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (fun f => f ≫ left v j)
              (HomologicalComplex.homotopyCofiber.inlX_d v (j+1) j (j-1) (by rfl) (rel j)))
          _ = _ := by simp only [add_comp,neg_comp,Category.assoc,inLeft_left,inRight_left,
            Category.comp_id,comp_zero,add_zero]
      have he' := congrArg (fun f => f (-b)) he
      change left v j ((complex v).d (j+1) j y) = -(B.d j (j-1) (-b)) at he'
      rw [map_neg,neg_neg] at he'
      exact he'.trans hb
    let z := x - (complex v).d (j+1) j y
    have hzl : left v j z = 0 := by simp only [z,map_sub,hyl,sub_self]
    have hzd : (complex v).d j (j-1) z = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub,hx]
      have hd := congrArg (fun f => f y) ((complex v).d_comp_d (j+1) j (j-1))
      change (complex v).d j (j-1) ((complex v).d (j+1) j y) = 0 at hd
      rw [hd,sub_self]
    have hzr : A.d j (j-1) (right v j z) = 0 := by
      have he := right_d v j z
      rw [hzd,map_zero,hzl,map_zero,zero_add] at he
      exact he.symm
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (hA j _).mp hzr
    refine ⟨y + inRight v (j+1) a,?_⟩
    rw [map_add]
    have hd := congrArg (fun f => f a) (inRight_d v (j+1) j)
    change (complex v).d (j+1) j (inRight v (j+1) a) = inRight v j (A.d (j+1) j a) at hd
    rw [hd,ha]
    have hz : inRight v j (right v j z) = z := by
      apply ext_element v j
      · exact (congrArg (fun f => f (right v j z)) (inRight_left v j)).trans hzl.symm
      · exact congrArg (fun f => f (right v j z)) (inRight_right v j)
    rw [hz]
    dsimp only [z]
    rw [add_comm,sub_add_cancel]
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f => f y) ((complex v).d_comp_d (j+1) j (j-1))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteCone.totallyAcyclic
statement:
lemma totallyAcyclic (hA : TotallyAcyclic A) (hB : TotallyAcyclic B) :
    TotallyAcyclic (complex v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨exact v hA.1 hB.1,?_⟩
  intro j fl hfl
  let f : (complex v).X j ⟶ ModuleCat.of R R := ModuleCat.ofHom fl
  have hf : (complex v).d (j+1) j ≫ f = 0 := ModuleCat.hom_ext hfl
  have hfa : A.d (j+1) j ≫ (inRight v j ≫ f) = 0 := by
    rw [← Category.assoc,← inRight_d,Category.assoc,hf,comp_zero]
