name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.evalMap_surjective
statement:
lemma evalMap_surjective (g : P ⟶ Q) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Surjective (evalMap X g)
proof:
:=
  BalancedTensor.mapLeft_surjective (leftMap g) (rightMap g).map_smul hg

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.evalMap_exact
statement:
lemma evalMap_exact [FiniteDimensional k R] [FiniteDimensional k M]
    [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M)] (t : SymmetrizingForm (k := k) (R := R))
    (f : M ⟶ P) (g : P ⟶ Q) (hi : Function.Injective f)
    (he : Function.Exact f g) (hs : Function.Surjective g) :
    Function.Exact (evalMap X f) (evalMap X g)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Injective Rᵐᵒᵖ Rᵐᵒᵖ := t.op.injective
  let : Module.Finite Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M) := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite k Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M)
  let : Module.Injective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M) := injective_of_finite_projective
  let H := linearShortExact (rightMap f) (rightMap g) he hi hs
  let : CategoryTheory.Injective (linearShortComplex (rightMap f) (rightMap g) he).X₁ :=
    Module.injective_object_of_injective_module Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M)
  let sp := H.splittingOfInjective
  apply BalancedTensor.mapLeft_exact_of_right_splitting (leftMap f) (leftMap g)
    (rightMap f).map_smul (rightMap g).map_smul sp.r.hom sp.s.hom
  · intro p
    exact congrArg (fun z : ModuleCat.of Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj P) ⟶ ModuleCat.of Rᵐᵒᵖ (Obj P) => z p) sp.id
  · intro m
    exact (he _).mpr ⟨m,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.eval_square_factors_iff
statement:
lemma eval_square_factors_iff
    (i : M ⟶ P) (pi : P ⟶ M') (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hex : Function.Exact i pi) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi)
    (j : N ⟶ Q) (delta : Q ⟶ N') (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (hex' : Function.Exact j delta) (hdelta : Function.Surjective delta)
    (f : M ⟶ N) (h : P ⟶ Q) (g : M' ⟶ N')
    (hu : i ≫ h = f ≫ j) (hl : h ≫ delta = pi ≫ g) :
    (evalMap X f).hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) ↔
      (evalMap X g).hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Injective S S := u.injective
  let : FiniteDimensional k P := Module.Finite.trans (Alg k S R) P
  let : FiniteDimensional k Q := Module.Finite.trans (Alg k S R) Q
  apply exact_square_factors_iff (P := evalObj X P) (Q := evalObj X Q)
    (evalMap X i).hom (evalMap X pi).hom
    (evalMap_injective X t i hi) (evalMap_exact X t i pi hi hex hpi)
    (evalMap_surjective X pi hpi)
    (evalMap X j).hom (evalMap X delta).hom
    (evalMap_injective X t j hj) (evalMap_exact X t j delta hj hex' hdelta)
    (evalMap_surjective X delta hdelta)
    (evalMap X f).hom (evalMap X h).hom (evalMap X g).hom
  · have hmap := congrArg (evaluation X).map hu
    rw [Functor.map_comp,Functor.map_comp] at hmap
    ext x
    exact congrArg (fun a : (evaluation X).obj M ⟶ (evaluation X).obj Q => a x) hmap
  · have hmap := congrArg (evaluation X).map hl
    rw [Functor.map_comp,Functor.map_comp] at hmap
    ext x
    exact congrArg (fun a : (evaluation X).obj P ⟶ (evaluation X).obj N' => a x) hmap

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_factors
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hPf, hPp, a, b, hab⟩ := hf
  let := hPf
  let := hPp
  let : FiniteDimensional k P := Module.Finite.trans (Enveloping.Alg k S R) P
  let a₀ : M ⟶ P := ModuleCat.ofHom a
  let b₀ : P ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z := ModuleCat.ofHom (X := P) (Y := HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) b
  have he : a₀ ≫ b₀ = f := ModuleCat.hom_ext hab
  refine ⟨Enveloping.evalObj X P, inferInstance, inferInstance,
    (Enveloping.evalMap X a₀).hom, (uncurry b₀).hom, ?_⟩
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp ((uncurry_precompose a₀ b₀).symm.trans (congrArg uncurry he))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.factors_of_uncurry
statement:
lemma factors_of_uncurry [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj M)]
    {f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z}
    (hf : (uncurry f).hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)) :
    f.hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P,hPf,hPp,a,b,hab⟩ := hf
  let := hPf
  let := hPp
  let : Module.Injective S S := tS.injective
  let : Module.Injective S P := injective_of_finite_projective
  let J := ModuleCat.of (Enveloping.Alg k S R)
    (Fin (Module.finrank k M) → Enveloping.Alg k S R)
  let i : M ⟶ J := ModuleCat.ofHom ((tS.tensor tR.op).freeEmbedding (M := M))
  have hi : Function.Injective i := (tS.tensor tR.op).freeEmbedding_injective
  have hei := Enveloping.evalMap_injective X tR i hi
  obtain ⟨a',ha'⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property S P (Enveloping.evalObj X M)
    (Enveloping.evalObj X J) (Enveloping.evalMap X i).hom hei a
  let ag : Enveloping.evalObj X J ⟶ Z := ModuleCat.ofHom (b.comp a')
  let g : J ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z := curry ag
  have hcomp : i ≫ g = f := by
    apply (equiv (k := k)).injective
    change uncurry (i ≫ g) = uncurry f
    rw [uncurry_precompose]
    change Enveloping.evalMap X i ≫ uncurry (curry ag) = _
    rw [uncurry_curry]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    change (b.comp a').comp (Enveloping.evalMap X i).hom = (uncurry f).hom
    rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, ha', hab]
  exact ⟨J, inferInstance, inferInstance, i.hom, g.hom, ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hcomp⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BimoduleTensorHom.factors_iff_uncurry
statement:
lemma factors_iff_uncurry [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj M)]
    (f : M ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) :
    f.hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) ↔ (uncurry f).hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨uncurry_factors, factors_of_uncurry tR tS⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.evaluation_nonzero_of_syzygy_composition
statement:
theorem evaluation_nonzero_of_syzygy_composition
    (U M T : FiniteModule k (Enveloping.Alg k S R))
    [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj U.obj)]
    [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj M.obj)]
    (e : T.obj ≃ₗ[Enveloping.Alg k S R] HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z)
    (g : U.obj →ₗ[Enveloping.Alg k S R] M.obj)
    (phi : M.obj →ₗ[Enveloping.Alg k S R] T.syzygy.obj)
    (hn : phi.comp g ∉ projectiveFactors (k := k)) :
    (Enveloping.evalMap X (ModuleCat.ofHom (X := U.obj) (Y := M.obj) g)).hom
      ∉ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  let tau := Enveloping.envelopingForm u t
  let : Module.Injective (Enveloping.Alg k S R) (Enveloping.Alg k S R) := tau.injective
  let PU := ModuleCat.of (Enveloping.Alg k S R)
    (Fin (Module.finrank k U) → Enveloping.Alg k S R)
  let PM := ModuleCat.of (Enveloping.Alg k S R)
    (Fin (Module.finrank k M) → Enveloping.Alg k S R)
  let PT := ModuleCat.of (Enveloping.Alg k S R) (Fin T.cover.rank → Enveloping.Alg k S R)
  obtain ⟨h,g',hu,hl⟩ := exists_exact_square_down (P := PU) (Q := PM)
    (U.embed tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection tau) (U.embed_injective tau)
    (U.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection_surjective tau)
    (M.embed tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) g
  obtain ⟨h',psi,hu',hl'⟩ := exists_exact_square_down (P := PM) (Q := PT)
    (M.embed tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection tau) (M.embed_injective tau)
    (M.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection_surjective tau)
    T.syzygyInclusion T.cover.map T.syzygyInclusion_exact phi
  have hnon : psi.comp g' ∉ projectiveFactors (k := k) := by
    apply mt (exact_square_factors_iff (P := PU) (Q := PT)
      (U.embed tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection tau) (U.embed_injective tau)
      (U.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection_surjective tau)
      T.syzygyInclusion T.cover.map T.syzygyInclusion_injective
      T.syzygyInclusion_exact T.cover.surjective
      (phi.comp g) (h'.comp h) (psi.comp g') ?_ ?_).mpr hn
    · rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc,hu,← LinearMap.comp_assoc,hu',LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    · rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc,hl',LinearMap.comp_assoc,hl,← LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  intro hgeval
  have hshift : (Enveloping.evalMap X (ModuleCat.ofHom
      (X := (U.cosyzygy tau).obj) (Y := (M.cosyzygy tau).obj) g')).hom
        ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) := by
    apply (Enveloping.eval_square_factors_iff t u X
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (X := U.obj) (Y := PU) (U.embed tau))
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (X := PU) (Y := (U.cosyzygy tau).obj) (U.cosyzygyProjection tau))
      (U.embed_injective tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) (U.cosyzygyProjection_surjective tau)
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (X := M.obj) (Y := PM) (M.embed tau))
      (ModuleCat.ofHom (X := PM) (Y := (M.cosyzygy tau).obj) (M.cosyzygyProjection tau))
      (M.embed_injective tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection_exact tau) (M.cosyzygyProjection_surjective tau)
      (ModuleCat.ofHom g) (ModuleCat.ofHom h) (ModuleCat.ofHom g')
      (ModuleCat.hom_ext hu) (ModuleCat.hom_ext hl)).mp hgeval
  let gt : (U.cosyzygy tau).obj ⟶ (M.cosyzygy tau).obj := ModuleCat.ofHom g'
  let psit : (M.cosyzygy tau).obj ⟶ HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (X := (M.cosyzygy tau).obj)
      (Y := HomBimodule.obj (k := k) X Z) (e.toLinearMap.comp psi)
  have hc : (BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry (gt ≫ psit)).hom ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) := by
    rw [BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry_precompose]
    exact projectiveFactors_postcomp hshift (BimoduleTensorHom.uncurry psit).hom
  let : Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj (U.cosyzygy tau).obj) :=
    Enveloping.cosyzygy_right_projective u t U
  have hh := BimoduleTensorHom.factors_of_uncurry t u hc
  have hh' := projectiveFactors_postcomp hh e.symm.toLinearMap
  apply hnon
  convert hh' using 1
  ext x
  change psi (g' x) = e.symm (e (psi (g' x)))
  exact (e.symm_apply_apply _).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.exists_evaluated_Y_lift
statement:
theorem exists_evaluated_Y_lift (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : (finiteU q H hH).obj ⟶ (Y q).obj,
      (Enveloping.evalMap (xObj q) g).hom ∉ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,psi,hn⟩ := exists_Y_lift_with_nonzero_composition q H hH hq
  let : Module.Projective (E q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj (Y q).obj) := (Y_side_projective q hq).2
  let : Module.Projective (E q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj (finiteU q H hH).obj) := by
    change Module.Projective (E q)ᵐᵒᵖ (Enveloping.Obj (U q H hH))
    infer_instance
  refine ⟨g,?_⟩
  exact evaluation_nonzero_of_syzygy_composition (formE q) (formE q)
    (xObj q) (xObj q) (finiteU q H hH) (Y q) (finiteS q)
    (LinearEquiv.refl _ _) g.hom psi.hom hn

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.sigma_fixed_x
statement:
lemma sigma_fixed_x (r : E q) (x : xObj q) :
    sigma q H hH r • x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  change characterE q (sigma q H hH r) * (show k from x) =
    characterE q r * (show k from x)
  rw [characterE_sigma]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Construction.exists_nonzero_X_YX
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_X_YX (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : (finiteU q H hH).obj ⟶ (Y q).obj,
      ((uXIso q H hH).inv ≫ Enveloping.evalMap (xObj q) g).hom ∉
        projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := exists_evaluated_Y_lift q H hH hq
  refine ⟨g,?_⟩
  intro hh
  have hp := projectiveFactors_precomp hh (uXIso q H hH).hom.hom
  apply hg
  convert hp using 1
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
  change Enveloping.evalMap (xObj q) g =
    (uXIso q H hH).hom ≫ ((uXIso q H hH).inv ≫ Enveloping.evalMap (xObj q) g)
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.retract_inc
statement: lemma retract_inc (i : I) : (retract K i).comp (inc K i) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  ((inc K i).exists_leftInverse_of_injective (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr Subtype.val_injective)).choose_spec

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.retract_cycle
statement: @[simp] lemma retract_cycle (i : I) (z : Z K i) : retract K i z = z
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (retract_inc K i) z

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.cycle_d
statement: lemma cycle_d (i j : I) (z : Z K i) : K.d i j z = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c.Rel i j
  · have hj : c.next i = j := c.next_eq' h
    subst j
    exact z.property
  · rw [K.shape i j h]
    rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.boundary_cycle
statement: @[simp] lemma boundary_cycle (i : I) (z : Z K (c.prev i)) : boundary K i z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact cycle_d K (c.prev i) i z

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_representatives
statement:
lemma quotient_representatives (i : I) :
    (quotient K i).comp (representatives K i) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  ((quotient K i).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _))).choose_spec

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_representatives_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotient_representatives_apply (i : I) (x : H K i) :
    quotient K i (representatives K i x) = x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (quotient_representatives K i) x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_boundary
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotient_boundary (i : I) (x : K.X (c.prev i)) :
    quotient K i (boundary K i x) = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ⟨x,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.boundary_rawLift
statement:
lemma boundary_rawLift (i : I) (z : LinearMap.range (boundary K i)) :
    boundary K i (rawLift K i z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (((boundary K i).rangeRestrict.exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
      (boundary K i).range_rangeRestrict).choose_spec) z
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.boundary_lift
statement:
lemma boundary_lift (i : I) (z : LinearMap.range (boundary K i)) :
    boundary K i (lift K i z) = z
proof:
:= by
  change boundary K i (rawLift K i z - inc K (c.prev i) (retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z))) = z
  change boundary K i (rawLift K i z - (retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z) : K.X (c.prev i))) = z
  rw [map_sub, boundary_cycle, sub_zero, boundary_rawLift]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.retract_lift
statement:
lemma retract_lift (i : I) (z : LinearMap.range (boundary K i)) :
    retract K (c.prev i) (lift K i z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z - inc K (c.prev i) (retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z))) = 0
  change retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z - (retract K (c.prev i) (rawLift K i z) : K.X (c.prev i))) = 0
  rw [map_sub, retract_cycle, sub_self]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.complement_cycle
statement: lemma complement_cycle (i : I) (z : Z K i) : complement K i z = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (z : K.X i) - inc K i (retract K i z) = 0
  rw [retract_cycle]
  exact sub_self _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.complement_eq_lift
statement:
lemma complement_eq_lift (i : I) (hi : c.Rel (c.prev i) i) (x : K.X (c.prev i)) :
    complement K (c.prev i) x = lift K i ((boundary K i).rangeRestrict x)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : x - rawLift K i ((boundary K i).rangeRestrict x) ∈ Z K (c.prev i) := by
    change K.d (c.prev i) (c.next (c.prev i)) (x - rawLift K i ((boundary K i).rangeRestrict x)) = 0
    rw [c.next_eq' hi, map_sub]
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val (boundary_rawLift K i ((boundary K i).rangeRestrict x))
    exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h.symm
  have h := complement_cycle K (c.prev i) ⟨_,hz⟩
  change complement K (c.prev i) (x - rawLift K i ((boundary K i).rangeRestrict x)) = 0 at h
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.homotopy_d
statement:
lemma homotopy_d (i : I) (x : K.X i) :
    K.d (c.prev i) i (homotopyComponent K i x) =
      inc K i (retract K i x) - inc K i (representatives K i (quotient K i (retract K i x)))
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (boundary_lift K i (boundaryPart K i (retract K i x)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.homotopy_boundary
statement:
lemma homotopy_boundary (i : I) (hi : c.Rel (c.prev i) i) (x : K.X (c.prev i)) :
    homotopyComponent K i (K.d (c.prev i) i x) = complement K (c.prev i) x
proof:
:= by
  change lift K i (boundaryPart K i (retract K i (boundary K i x))) = _
  rw [retract_cycle]
  have h : boundaryPart K i (boundary K i x) = (boundary K i).rangeRestrict x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change boundary K i x - representatives K i (quotient K i (boundary K i x)) = _
    rw [quotient_boundary, map_zero, sub_zero]
    rfl
  rw [h]
  exact (complement_eq_lift K i hi x).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHom_d
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHom_d (i j : ℤ) (f : P.X i ⟶ N) :
    (completeHom (k := k) P N).d i j f = P.d j i ≫ f
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHom_memZ
statement:
lemma completeHom_memZ (j : ℤ) (f : P.X j ⟶ N) :
    f ∈ VectorSplit.Z (completeHom (k := k) P N) j ↔ P.d (j+1) j ≫ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (completeHom (k := k) P N).d j ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).next j) f = 0 ↔ _
  rw [(ComplexShape.up ℤ).next_eq' (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel j (j+1) from rfl)]
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.CompleteHom.boundary_iff
statement:
lemma boundary_iff (j : ℤ) (z : VectorSplit.Z (completeHom (k := k) P N) j) :
    z ∈ LinearMap.range (VectorSplit.boundary (completeHom (k := k) P N) j) ↔
      (cokerCycles P N j).symm z ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  change _ ↔ CokerAt.descend P j z.val.hom (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp
    ((completeHom_memZ P N j z.val).mp z.property)) ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
  refine Iff.trans ?_ (hP.factors_iff_boundary (k := k) fin proj j z.val.hom
    (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp ((completeHom_memZ P N j z.val).mp z.property))).symm
  change (∃ g : P.X ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev j) ⟶ N,
    VectorSplit.boundary (completeHom (k := k) P N) j g = z) ↔ _
  simp only [← Subtype.val_inj]
  change (∃ g : P.X ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev j) ⟶ N,
    P.d j ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev j) ≫ g = z.val) ↔ _
  rw [(ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev_eq' (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel (j-1) j by change (j-1)+1=j; omega)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
    exact ⟨g.hom,ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g,hg⟩
    exact ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom g,ModuleCat.hom_ext hg⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.linear_descent
statement:
lemma linear_descent (ε : P →ₗ[R] M) (hε : Function.Surjective ε) (f : P →ₗ[R] Q)
    (h : LinearMap.ker ε ≤ LinearMap.ker f) : ∃ g : M →ₗ[R] Q, g.comp ε = f
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨((LinearMap.ker ε).liftQ f h).comp (ε.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hε).symm.toLinearMap, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (LinearMap.ker ε).liftQ f h ((ε.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hε).symm (ε x)) = f x
  have hx : ε x = (ε.quotKerEquivOfSurjective hε) ((LinearMap.ker ε).mkQ x) := rfl
  rw [hx,LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.hom_lift_surjective
statement: lemma hom_lift_surjective : Function.Surjective (homPostcompose (k := k) (M := P) δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  exact Module.projective_lifting_property δ f hδ

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.liftLinear_lifts
statement: lemma liftLinear_lifts (f : M →ₗ[R] N) : δ.comp (liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f) = f.comp ε
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (Classical.choose_spec
    ((homPostcompose (k := k) (M := P) δ).exists_rightInverse_of_surjective
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (hom_lift_surjective (k := k) δ hδ)))) (f.comp ε)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.kernelMap_class
statement:
lemma kernelMap_class (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : LinearMap.ker ε →ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker δ)
    (h : P →ₗ[R] Q) (hh : δ.comp h = f.comp ε)
    (hg : h.comp (LinearMap.ker ε).subtype = (LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.comp g) :
    stableClass (k := k) (kernelMap (k := k) ε δ hδ f) = stableClass (k := k) g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, stableClass_eq_zero_iff]
  let t : P →ₗ[R] LinearMap.ker δ := LinearMap.codRestrict (LinearMap.ker δ)
    (liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f - h) (by
      intro x
      change δ (liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f x - h x) = 0
      rw [map_sub]
      have h₁ := LinearMap.congr_fun (liftLinear_lifts (k := k) ε δ hδ f) x
      have h₂ := LinearMap.congr_fun hh x
      dsimp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h₁ h₂
      rw [h₁,h₂,sub_self])
  refine ⟨ModuleCat.of R P, inferInstance, inferInstance, (LinearMap.ker ε).subtype, t, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hg x
  change h x = (g x : Q) at hx
  change liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f x - h x = liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f x - (g x : Q)
  rw [hx]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.kernelMap_factors
statement:
lemma kernelMap_factors (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (hf : f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)) :
    kernelMap (k := k) ε δ hδ f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := (factors_iff_lifts δ hδ f).mp hf
  have hc := kernelMap_class (k := k) ε δ hδ f 0 (s.comp ε)
    (by rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc,hs]) (by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      change s (ε x) = 0
      rw [x.property,map_zero])
  apply (stableClass_eq_zero_iff _).mp
  simpa only [map_zero] using hc

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.map_class
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_class (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    map (k := k) ε δ hδ (stableClass (k := k) f) =
      stableClass (k := k) (kernelMap (k := k) ε δ hδ f)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.kernelMap_reflects_factors
statement:
lemma kernelMap_reflects_factors (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (hf : kernelMap (k := k) ε δ hδ f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)) :
    f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := (factors_iff_extends (k := k) (LinearMap.ker ε).subtype Subtype.val_injective _).mp hf
  let d := liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f - (LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.comp v
  have hd : LinearMap.ker ε ≤ LinearMap.ker d := by
    intro x hx
    have hh := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun hv ⟨x,hx⟩)
    change (v x : Q) = liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f x at hh
    change liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f x - (v x : Q) = 0
    rw [hh,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := linear_descent ε hε d hd
  apply (factors_iff_lifts δ hδ f).mpr
  refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := hε x
  have h₁ := LinearMap.congr_fun hs y
  have h₂ := LinearMap.congr_fun (liftLinear_lifts (k := k) ε δ hδ f) y
  change s (ε y) = liftLinear (k := k) ε δ hδ f y - (v y : Q) at h₁
  change δ (s (ε y)) = f (ε y)
  rw [h₁,map_sub,(v y).property,sub_zero]
  exact h₂

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.map_injective
statement: lemma map_injective : Function.Injective (map (k := k) ε δ hδ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mp
  apply eq_bot_iff.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨f,rfl⟩ := stableClass_surjective x
  change stableClass (k := k) (kernelMap (k := k) ε δ hδ f) = 0 at hx
  exact (stableClass_eq_zero_iff _).mpr (kernelMap_reflects_factors (k := k) ε δ hδ hε f
    ((stableClass_eq_zero_iff _).mp hx))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.StableShift.map_surjective
statement: lemma map_surjective : Function.Surjective (map (k := k) ε δ hδ)
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Injective R Q := injective_of_finite_projective
  intro x
  obtain ⟨g,rfl⟩ := stableClass_surjective x
  obtain ⟨h,hh⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R Q (LinearMap.ker ε) P
    (LinearMap.ker ε).subtype Subtype.val_injective ((LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.comp g)
  have hd : LinearMap.ker ε ≤ LinearMap.ker (δ.comp h) := by
    intro x hx
    have h₁ := LinearMap.congr_fun hh ⟨x,hx⟩
    change h x = (g ⟨x,hx⟩ : Q) at h₁
    change δ (h x) = 0
    rw [h₁]
    exact (g ⟨x,hx⟩).property
  obtain ⟨f,hf⟩ := linear_descent ε hε (δ.comp h) hd
  refine ⟨stableClass (k := k) f, ?_⟩
  exact kernelMap_class (k := k) ε δ hδ f g h hf.symm hh

name: OAI.Tachikawa.exact_square_factors_iff
statement:
theorem exact_square_factors_iff
    (i : M →ₗ[R] P) (pi : P →ₗ[R] M') (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hex : Function.Exact i pi) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi)
    (j : N →ₗ[R] Q) (delta : Q →ₗ[R] N') (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (hex' : Function.Exact j delta) (hdelta : Function.Surjective delta)
    (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (h : P →ₗ[R] Q) (g : M' →ₗ[R] N')
    (hu : h.comp i = j.comp f) (hl : delta.comp h = g.comp pi) :
    f ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k) ↔ g ∈ projectiveFactors (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  have hji : delta.comp j = 0 := by
    ext x
    exact (hex' (j x)).mpr ⟨x,rfl⟩
  have hpii : pi.comp i = 0 := by
    ext x
    exact (hex (i x)).mpr ⟨x,rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro hf
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := (factors_iff_extends (k := k) i hi f).mp hf
    have hz : LinearMap.ker pi ≤ LinearMap.ker (h - j.comp d) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := (hex x).mp hx
      change h (i y) - j (d (i y)) = 0
      have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hu y
      have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hd y
      change h (i y) = j (f y) at h1
      change d (i y) = f y at h2
      rw [h1,h2,sub_self]
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := linear_descent pi hpi (h - j.comp d) hz
    apply (factors_iff_lifts (k := k) delta hdelta g).mpr
    refine ⟨s,?_⟩
    ext x
    obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := hpi x
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hs y
    have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hl y
    change s (pi y) = h y - j (d y) at h1
    change delta (h y) = g (pi y) at h2
    change delta (s (pi y)) = g (pi y)
    rw [h1,map_sub,show delta (j (d y)) = 0 from LinearMap.congr_fun hji (d y),sub_zero,h2]
  · intro hg
    obtain ⟨s,hs⟩ := (factors_iff_lifts (k := k) delta hdelta g).mp hg
    have hr (x : P) : (h - s.comp pi) x ∈ LinearMap.range j := by
      apply (hex' _).mp
      change delta (h x - s (pi x)) = 0
      rw [map_sub]
      have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hl x
      have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hs (pi x)
      change delta (h x) = g (pi x) at h1
      change delta (s (pi x)) = g (pi x) at h2
      rw [h1,h2,sub_self]
    let d := CokerAt.factorThrough j hj (h - s.comp pi) hr
    have hd := CokerAt.factorThrough_spec j hj (h - s.comp pi) hr
    apply (factors_iff_extends (k := k) i hi f).mpr
    refine ⟨d,?_⟩
    ext x
    apply hj
    have h1 := LinearMap.congr_fun hd (i x)
    have h2 := LinearMap.congr_fun hu x
    change j (d (i x)) = h (i x) - s (pi (i x)) at h1
    change h (i x) = j (f x) at h2
    change j (d (i x)) = j (f x)
    rw [h1,show pi (i x) = 0 from LinearMap.congr_fun hpii x,map_zero,sub_zero,h2]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.exists_exact_square_down
statement:
theorem exists_exact_square_down
    (i : M →ₗ[R] P) (pi : P →ₗ[R] M') (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hex : Function.Exact i pi) (hpi : Function.Surjective pi)
    (j : N →ₗ[R] Q) (delta : Q →ₗ[R] N')
    (hex' : Function.Exact j delta) (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    ∃ (h : P →ₗ[R] Q) (g : M' →ₗ[R] N'),
      h.comp i = j.comp f ∧ delta.comp h = g.comp pi
proof:
:= by
  let : Module.Injective R Q := injective_of_finite_projective
  obtain ⟨h,hh⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R Q M P i hi (j.comp f)
  have hz : LinearMap.ker pi ≤ LinearMap.ker (delta.comp h) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y,rfl⟩ := (hex x).mp hx
    have he := LinearMap.congr_fun hh y
    change h (i y) = j (f y) at he
    change delta (h (i y)) = 0
    rw [he]
    exact (hex' _).mpr ⟨f y,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := linear_descent pi hpi (delta.comp h) hz
  exact ⟨h,g,hh,hg.symm⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.cycleMap_boundary
statement:
lemma cycleMap_boundary (f : K ⟶ L) (i : I) (x : K.X (c.prev i)) :
    cycleMap f i (boundary K i x) = boundary L i (f.f (c.prev i) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (congrArg (fun z => z x) (f.comm (c.prev i) i)).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_quotient
statement:
@[simp] lemma Hmap_quotient (f : K ⟶ L) (i : I) (z : Z K i) :
    Hmap f i (quotient K i z) = quotient L i (cycleMap f i z)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma quotient_eq_zero_iff (i : I) (z : Z K i) :
    quotient K i z = 0 ↔ ∃ x, boundary K i x = z
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_surjective
statement: lemma quotient_surjective (i : I) : Function.Surjective (quotient K i)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma Hmap_comp (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M) (i : I) :
    Hmap (f ≫ g) i = (Hmap g i).comp (Hmap f i)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective i x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_id
statement: @[simp] lemma Hmap_id (i : I) : Hmap (𝟙 K) i = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective i x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma Hmap_zero (i : I) : Hmap (0 : K ⟶ L) i = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective i x
  exact map_zero (quotient L i)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_add
statement: @[simp] lemma Hmap_add (f g : K ⟶ L) (i : I) : Hmap (f+g) i = Hmap f i + Hmap g i
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective i x
  change quotient L i (cycleMap (f+g) i z) =
    quotient L i (cycleMap f i z) + quotient L i (cycleMap g i z)
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_smul
statement: @[simp] lemma Hmap_smul (r : k) (f : K ⟶ L) (i : I) : Hmap (r • f) i = r • Hmap f i
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective i x
  change quotient L i (cycleMap (r • f) i z) = r • quotient L i (cycleMap f i z)
  rw [← map_smul]
  congr 1

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.quotient_zero_iff_predecessor
statement:
lemma quotient_zero_iff_predecessor (i : ℤ) (z : Z K i) :
    quotient K i z = 0 ↔ ∃ x : K.X (i-1), K.d (i-1) i x = z.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotient_eq_zero_iff]
  simp only [← Subtype.val_inj]
  change (∃ x : K.X ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev i),
    K.d ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev i) i x = z.val) ↔ _
  rw [(ComplexShape.up ℤ).prev_eq' (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel (i-1) i by change (i-1)+1=i; omega)]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.memZ_iff
statement: lemma memZ_iff (i : ℤ) (x : K.X i) : x ∈ Z K i ↔ K.d i (i+1) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change K.d i ((ComplexShape.up ℤ).next i) x = 0 ↔ _
  rw [(ComplexShape.up ℤ).next_eq' (show (ComplexShape.up ℤ).Rel i (i+1) from rfl)]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.comm_apply
statement:
lemma comm_apply {K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat k) ℤ} (f : K ⟶ L)
    (a b : ℤ) (x : K.X a) : L.d a b (f.f a x) = f.f b (K.d a b x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun z => z x) (f.comm a b)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_surjective_of_right_zero
statement:
lemma Hmap_surjective_of_right_zero (a : ℤ) (hM : Subsingleton (H M a)) :
    Function.Surjective (Hmap i a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective a x
  have hpz : quotient M a (cycleMap p a z) = 0 := hM.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a _).mp hpz
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := hp (a-1) y
  have hz' : p.f a (z.val - L.d (a-1) a v) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub,← comm_apply p,hv,hy]
    exact sub_self _
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := (he a _).mp hz'
  have huz : u ∈ Z K a := by
    rw [memZ_iff]
    apply hi (a+1)
    rw [map_zero,← comm_apply i,hu,map_sub]
    rw [(memZ_iff a z.val).mp z.property]
    have hd := congrArg (fun f => f v) (L.d_comp_d (a-1) a (a+1))
    change L.d a (a+1) (L.d (a-1) a v) = 0 at hd
    rw [hd,sub_self]
  refine ⟨quotient K a ⟨u,huz⟩,?_⟩
  rw [Hmap_quotient]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply (quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a _).mpr
  use -v
  change L.d (a-1) a (-v) = i.f a u - z.val
  rw [map_neg,hu]
  abel

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_injective_of_prev_surjective
statement:
lemma Hmap_injective_of_prev_surjective (a : ℤ)
    (hs : Function.Surjective (Hmap p (a-1))) : Function.Injective (Hmap i a)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective a x
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := (quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a _).mp hx
  have hpv : p.f (a-1) v ∈ Z M (a-1) := by
    rw [memZ_iff,show a-1+1=a by omega,comm_apply p,hv]
    exact (he a _).mpr ⟨z.val,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := hs (quotient M (a-1) ⟨p.f (a-1) v,hpv⟩)
  obtain ⟨w,rfl⟩ := quotient_surjective (a-1) c
  have hw : quotient M (a-1) (⟨p.f (a-1) v,hpv⟩ - cycleMap p (a-1) w) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub,← Hmap_quotient,hc,sub_self]
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := (quotient_zero_iff_predecessor (a-1) _).mp hw
  obtain ⟨b',hb'⟩ := hp (a-1-1) b
  have hv' : p.f (a-1) (v-w.val-L.d (a-1-1) (a-1) b') = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub,map_sub,← comm_apply p,hb',hb]
    change p.f (a-1) v - p.f (a-1) w.val - (p.f (a-1) v-p.f (a-1) w.val) = 0
    exact sub_self _
  obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := (he (a-1) _).mp hv'
  apply (quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a z).mpr
  refine ⟨u,?_⟩
  apply hi a
  rw [← comm_apply i,hu,map_sub,map_sub]
  have hwz := (memZ_iff (a-1) w.val).mp w.property
  rw [show a-1+1=a by omega] at hwz
  have hd := congrArg (fun f => f b') (L.d_comp_d (a-1-1) (a-1) a)
  change L.d (a-1) a (L.d (a-1-1) (a-1) b') = 0 at hd
  rw [hwz,hd,sub_zero,sub_zero]
  exact hv

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_injective_of_prev_zero
statement:
lemma Hmap_injective_of_prev_zero (a : ℤ) (hz : Subsingleton (H M (a-1))) :
    Function.Injective (Hmap i a)
proof:
:= by
  apply Hmap_injective_of_prev_surjective i p hi he hp a
  intro x
  exact ⟨0,by rw [map_zero]; exact hz.elim _ _⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.VectorSplit.Hmap_bijective_of_zeros
statement:
lemma Hmap_bijective_of_zeros (a : ℤ) (hprev : Subsingleton (H M (a-1)))
    (hnow : Subsingleton (H M a)) : Function.Bijective (Hmap i a)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Hmap_injective_of_prev_zero i p hi he hp a hprev,
    Hmap_surjective_of_right_zero i p hi he hp a hnow⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHomMap_apply (f : M ⟶ N) (a : ℤ) (g : P.X a ⟶ M) :
    (completeHomMap (k := k) P f).f a g = g ≫ f
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHomMap_comp (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ L) :
    completeHomMap (k := k) P (f ≫ g) = completeHomMap P f ≫ completeHomMap P g
proof:
:= by
  ext a x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_id
statement: @[simp] lemma completeHomMap_id : completeHomMap (k := k) P (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  ext a x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma completeHomMap_zero : completeHomMap (k := k) P (0 : M ⟶ N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHomMap_add (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    completeHomMap (k := k) P (f+g) = completeHomMap P f + completeHomMap P g
proof:
:= by
  ext a x
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_injective
statement:
lemma completeHomMap_injective (i : M ⟶ N) (hi : Function.Injective i) (a : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective ((completeHomMap (k := k) P i).f a)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (fun f : P.X a ⟶ M => f ≫ i)
  intro f g h
  ext x
  exact hi (congrArg (fun z => z x) h)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_exact
statement:
lemma completeHomMap_exact (i : M ⟶ N) (p : N ⟶ L)
    (hi : Function.Injective i) (he : Function.Exact i p) (a : ℤ) :
    Function.Exact ((completeHomMap (k := k) P i).f a) ((completeHomMap (k := k) P p).f a)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Exact (fun f : P.X a ⟶ M => f ≫ i) (fun f : P.X a ⟶ N => f ≫ p)
  intro f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hr (x : P.X a) : f x ∈ LinearMap.range i.hom :=
      (he (f x)).mp (congrArg (fun z => z x) hf)
    refine ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom (CokerAt.factorThrough i.hom hi f.hom hr),?_⟩
    exact ModuleCat.hom_ext (CokerAt.factorThrough_spec i.hom hi f.hom hr)
  · rintro ⟨g,rfl⟩
    ext x
    exact (he _).mpr ⟨g x,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHomMap_surjective
statement:
lemma completeHomMap_surjective (p : N ⟶ L) (hp : Function.Surjective p)
    (proj : ∀ a, Module.Projective R (P.X a)) (a : ℤ) :
    Function.Surjective ((completeHomMap (k := k) P p).f a)
proof:
:= by
  let := proj a
  change Function.Surjective (fun f : P.X a ⟶ N => f ≫ p)
  intro f
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property p.hom f.hom hp
  exact ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom g,ModuleCat.hom_ext hg⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHom_projective_zero
statement:
lemma completeHom_projective_zero (hP : TotallyAcyclic P) (N : ModuleCat.{0} R)
    [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] (a : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton (VectorSplit.H (completeHom (k := k) P N) a)
proof:
:= by
  apply subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := VectorSplit.quotient_surjective a x
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hP.projective_boundaries a z.val.hom
    (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp ((completeHom_memZ P N a z.val).mp z.property))
  apply (VectorSplit.quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a z).mpr
  exact ⟨ModuleCat.ofHom g,ModuleCat.hom_ext hg⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHmap_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHmap_comp {M N L : ModuleCat.{0} R} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ L) (a : ℤ) :
    completeHmap (k := k) P (f ≫ g) a = (completeHmap P g a).comp (completeHmap P f a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeHmap,completeHomMap_comp,VectorSplit.Hmap_comp]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHmap_id
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHmap_id (M : ModuleCat.{0} R) (a : ℤ) :
    completeHmap (k := k) P (𝟙 M) a = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeHmap,completeHomMap_id,VectorSplit.Hmap_id]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHmap_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHmap_add {M N : ModuleCat.{0} R} (f g : M ⟶ N) (a : ℤ) :
    completeHmap (k := k) P (f+g) a = completeHmap P f a + completeHmap P g a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeHmap,completeHomMap_add,VectorSplit.Hmap_add]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeHmap_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma completeHmap_zero {M N : ModuleCat.{0} R} (a : ℤ) :
    completeHmap (k := k) P (0 : M ⟶ N) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeHmap,completeHomMap_zero,VectorSplit.Hmap_zero]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeFunctorHom_homotopic
statement:
lemma completeFunctorHom_homotopic
    {l' : Q ⟶ (F.mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℤ)).obj P}
    (h : Homotopy l l') (a : ℤ) :
    VectorSplit.Hmap (completeFunctorHom (k := k) F P Q X l) a =
      VectorSplit.Hmap (completeFunctorHom (k := k) F P Q X l') a
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨z,rfl⟩ := VectorSplit.quotient_surjective a x
  rw [VectorSplit.Hmap_quotient,VectorSplit.Hmap_quotient]
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [← map_sub]
  apply (VectorSplit.quotient_zero_iff_predecessor a _).mpr
  refine ⟨h.hom (a-1) a ≫ F.map z.val,?_⟩
  change Q.d a (a-1) ≫ h.hom (a-1) a ≫ F.map z.val =
    l.f a ≫ F.map z.val - l'.f a ≫ F.map z.val
  have hc := h.comm a
  rw [dNext_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℤ).Rel a (a-1) by change a-1+1=a; omega),
    prevD_eq _ (show (ComplexShape.down ℤ).Rel (a+1) a from rfl)] at hc
  have hz := (completeHom_memZ P X a z.val).mp z.property
  rw [hc,Preadditive.add_comp,Preadditive.add_comp,Category.assoc]
  let cycle : P.X a ⟶ X := z.val
  change P.d (a+1) a ≫ cycle = 0 at hz
  change Q.d a (a-1) ≫ h.hom (a-1) a ≫ F.map cycle =
    Q.d a (a-1) ≫ h.hom (a-1) a ≫ F.map cycle +
      (h.hom a (a+1) ≫ F.map (P.d (a+1) a) ≫ F.map cycle) +
      l'.f a ≫ F.map cycle - l'.f a ≫ F.map cycle
  rw [← F.map_comp,hz,F.map_zero,Limits.comp_zero,add_zero,add_sub_cancel_right]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.completeFunctorHom_natural
statement:
lemma completeFunctorHom_natural :
    completeFunctorHom (k := k) F P Q X l ≫ completeHomMap Q (α.app X) =
      completeFunctorHom G P Q X (l ≫ (α.mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℤ)).app P)
proof:
:= by
  ext a g
  change P.X a ⟶ X at g
  change (l.f a ≫ F.map g) ≫ α.app X = (l.f a ≫ α.app (P.X a)) ≫ G.map g
  rw [Category.assoc,α.naturality,Category.assoc]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {φ ψ : DualBimodule k R} (h : ∀ x, φ x = ψ x) : φ = ψ
proof: := LinearMap.ext h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.add_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma add_apply (φ ψ : DualBimodule k R) (x : R) : (φ + ψ) x = φ x + ψ x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.zero_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_apply (x : R) : (0 : DualBimodule k R) x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.smul_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma smul_apply (c : k) (φ : DualBimodule k R) (x : R) : (c • φ) x = c * φ x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.left_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma left_apply (a : R) (φ : DualBimodule k R) (x : R) : (a • φ) x = φ (x * a)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.right_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma right_apply (a : Rᵐᵒᵖ) (φ : DualBimodule k R) (x : R) :
    (a • φ) x = φ (a.unop * x)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.DualBimodule.coinduce_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coinduce_apply {Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] [Module k Y]
    [IsScalarTower k R Y] (g : Y →ₗ[k] k) (y : Y) (r : R) :
    coinduce g y r = g (r • y)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TrivialExtension.trace_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma trace_apply (a : TrivialExtension k R) : trace a = a.snd 1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TrivialExtension.trace_mul
statement:
lemma trace_mul (a b : TrivialExtension k R) :
    trace (a * b) = b.snd a.fst + a.snd b.fst
proof:
:= by
  change (a.fst • b.snd + MulOpposite.op b.fst • a.snd) 1 = _
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TrivialExtension.trace_comm
statement: lemma trace_comm (a b : TrivialExtension k R) : trace (a * b) = trace (b * a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_mul, trace_mul, add_comm]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TrivialExtension.trace_nondegenerate
statement:
lemma trace_nondegenerate (a : TrivialExtension k R)
    (h : ∀ b : TrivialExtension k R, trace (a * b) = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : a.fst = 0 := by
    apply (Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff k a.fst).mp
    intro φ
    have := h (TrivSqZeroExt.inr (φ : DualBimodule k R))
    rw [trace_mul] at this
    change φ a.fst + a.snd 0 = 0 at this
    simpa using this
  have hsnd : a.snd = 0 := by
    ext r
    have := h (TrivSqZeroExt.inl r)
    rw [trace_mul] at this
    change (0 : DualBimodule k R) a.fst + a.snd r = 0 at this
    simpa using this
  exact TrivSqZeroExt.ext hfst hsnd

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.toDual_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma toDual_apply (a x : R) : t.toDual a x = t.linear (x * a)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.toDual_injective
statement: lemma toDual_injective : Function.Injective t.toDual
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
  intro a ha
  apply t.nondegenerate a
  intro b
  rw [t.comm]
  exact congrArg (fun f : DualBimodule k R => f b) ha

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.injective
statement: lemma injective [FiniteDimensional k R] : Module.Injective R R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro X Y _ _ _ _ f hf g
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := Module.Injective.extension_property R (DualBimodule k R) X Y f hf
    (t.dualEquiv.toLinearMap.comp g)
  refine ⟨t.dualEquiv.symm.toLinearMap.comp h, ?_⟩
  intro x
  change t.dualEquiv.symm (h (f x)) = g x
  have hhx := LinearMap.congr_fun hh x
  change h (f x) = t.dualEquiv (g x) at hhx
  rw [hhx]
  exact t.dualEquiv.symm_apply_apply (g x)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.symmetricOver
statement:
lemma SymmetrizingForm.symmetricOver (t : SymmetrizingForm (k := K) (R := A))
    [FiniteDimensional K A] : SymmetricOver K A
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨t.dualEquiv.restrictScalars K, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b c
    change t.linear (c * (a*b)) = t.linear ((c*a)*b)
    rw [mul_assoc]
  · intro a b c
    change t.linear (c * (a*b)) = t.linear ((b*c)*a)
    calc
      t.linear (c * (a*b)) = t.linear ((c*a)*b) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = t.linear (b*(c*a)) := t.comm _ _
      _ = t.linear ((b*c)*a) := by rw [mul_assoc]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.TrivialExtension.symmetricOver
statement:
lemma TrivialExtension.symmetricOver [FiniteDimensional K A] :
    SymmetricOver K (TrivialExtension K A)
proof:
:=
  (TrivialExtension.symmetrizingForm (k := K) (R := A)).symmetricOver

name: OAI.Tachikawa.counterexampleOf
statement:
lemma counterexampleOf (A M : Type) [Ring A] [Algebra k A]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] [Module k M] [IsScalarTower k A M]
    [Module.Finite k A] [Module.Finite k M]
    (sym : SymmetricOver k A) (nonproj : ¬ Module.Projective A M)
    (van : ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext
      (ModuleCat.of A M) (ModuleCat.of A M) (n+1))) : Counterexample
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, sym, M, inferInstance,
    inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, nonproj, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  obtain ⟨m,rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  exact van m

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.balance
statement:
lemma balance (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = mk m (r • n)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  change (relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)).mkQ _ -
    (relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)).mkQ _ = 0
  rw [← map_sub]
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
    (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r,m,n,rfl⟩)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : M →ₗ[S] N →ₗ[k] P)
    (hf : ∀ (r : R) (m : M) (n : N), f (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = f m (r • n)) (m : M) (n : N) :
    lift f hf (mk m n) = f m n
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim] theorem induction_on
    {p : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) → Prop}
    (x : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N))
    (h0 : p 0) (ht : ∀ m n, p (mk m n))
    (ha : ∀ x y, p x → p y → p (x+y)) : p x
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | hx
  · exact h0
  clear hx
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)).mkQ_surjective x
  induction z using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul m n => exact ht m n
  | add z z' hz hz' => exact ha _ _ hz hz'

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom_ext {f g : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) →ₗ[S] P}
    (h : ∀ m n, f (mk m n) = g (mk m n)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | ht m n => exact h m n
  | ha x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRightBilinear_balanced
statement:
lemma mapRightBilinear_balanced (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (r : R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    mapRightBilinear (k := k) (S := S) f (MulOpposite.op r • m) n = mapRightBilinear (k := k) (S := S) f m (r • n)
proof:
:= by
  change mk (MulOpposite.op r • m) (f n) = mk m (f (r • n))
  rw [f.map_smul]
  exact balance r m (f n)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapRight_mk (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (m : M) (n : N) :
    mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) f (mk m n) = mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) m (f n)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_id
statement:
lemma mapRight_id : mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[R] N) =
    LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_comp
statement:
lemma mapRight_comp (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (g : N' →ₗ[R] N'') :
    mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) (g.comp f) =
      (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) g).comp (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) f)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_add
statement:
lemma mapRight_add (f g : N →ₗ[R] N') :
    mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) (f+g) = mapRight (k := k) (S := S) f + mapRight (k := k) (S := S) g
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_zero
statement: lemma mapRight_zero : mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) (0 : N →ₗ[R] N') = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_surjective
statement:
lemma mapRight_surjective (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Surjective (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) f)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩
  | ht m n =>
    obtain ⟨n', rfl⟩ := hf n
    exact ⟨mk m n', rfl⟩
  | ha x y hx hy =>
    obtain ⟨a,rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨b,rfl⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨a+b, map_add _ _ _⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_split
statement:
lemma mapRight_split (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (g : N' →ₗ[R] N) (h : g.comp f = LinearMap.id) :
    (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) g).comp (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) f) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapRight_comp, h, mapRight_id]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.rightUnit_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightUnit_mk (m : M) (r : R) : rightUnit (k := k) (S := S) (mk m r) =
    MulOpposite.op r • m
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapLeft_mk (f : M →ₗ[S] M')
    (hf : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, f (r • m) = r • f m) (m : M) (n : N) :
    mapLeft (k := k) (N := N) f hf (mk m n) = mk (f m) n
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_id
statement:
lemma mapLeft_id : mapLeft (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (N := N)
    (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[S] M) (fun _ _ => rfl) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_comp
statement:
lemma mapLeft_comp (f : M →ₗ[S] M') (g : M' →ₗ[S] M'')
    (hf : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, f (r • m) = r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, g (r • m) = r • g m) :
    (mapLeft (k := k) (N := N) g hg).comp (mapLeft f hf) =
      mapLeft (g.comp f) (fun r m => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, hf, hg])
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_add
statement:
lemma mapLeft_add (f g : M →ₗ[S] M')
    (hf : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, f (r • m) = r • f m)
    (hg : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, g (r • m) = r • g m) :
    mapLeft (k := k) (N := N) (f+g)
      (fun r m => by simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, hf, hg, smul_add]) =
      mapLeft f hf + mapLeft g hg
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_zero
statement:
lemma mapLeft_zero : mapLeft (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (N := N)
    (0 : M →ₗ[S] M') (fun _ _ => by simp) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.fieldRelations_smul_mem
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨r,m,n,rfl⟩ := hx
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    refine ⟨r,s • m,n,?_⟩
    simp only [smul_sub, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_comm s (MulOpposite.op r)]
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
    rw [smul_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy
  | smul c x hx ih =>
    rw [smul_comm s c]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c ih

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.relations_restrictScalars
statement:
lemma relations_restrictScalars :
    (relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N)).restrictScalars k =
      relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := k)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · let V : Submodule S (M ⊗[k] N) :=
      { (relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := k)).toAddSubmonoid with
        smul_mem' := fun s x hx => fieldRelations_smul_mem s hx }
    have h : relations (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) ≤ V := by
      apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
      intro x hx
      exact Submodule.subset_span hx
    exact h
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span hx

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.restrictEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma restrictEquiv_mk (m : M) (n : N) :
    restrictEquiv (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) m n) =
      mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) m n
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.leftUnit_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma leftUnit_mk (r : R) (n : N) : leftUnit (k := k) (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) r n) = r • n
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.freeEval_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma freeEval_mk (m : ι → R) (n : N) (i : ι) :
    freeEval (k := k) (R := R) ι (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) m n) i = m i • n
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.freeEval_freeInv
statement: lemma freeEval_freeInv (x : ι → N) : freeEval (k := k) (R := R) ι (freeInv (k := k) (R := R) ι x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  simp [freeInv, freeEval_mk, Pi.single_apply]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.freeInv_freeEval
statement:
lemma freeInv_freeEval (x : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (M := ι → R) (N := N)) :
    freeInv ι (freeEval ι x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | ht m n =>
    simp only [freeInv, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, freeEval_mk]
    change (∑ i, (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (Pi.single i (1:R))) (m i • n)) = mk m n
    simp_rw [← balance]
    have hm : (∑ i, (MulOpposite.op (m i)) • (Pi.single i (1:R))) = m := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply, apply_ite]
    rw [← LinearMap.sum_apply, ← map_sum, hm]
  | ha x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.freeEquiv_mapRight
statement:
lemma freeEquiv_mapRight (f : N →ₗ[R] N')
    (x : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (M := ι → R) (N := N)) (i : ι) :
    freeEquiv ι (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) f x) i = f (freeEquiv ι x i)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | ht m n => exact (f.map_smul (m i) n).symm
  | ha x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, Pi.add_apply, hx, hy]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapLeft_mapRight
statement:
lemma mapLeft_mapRight (f : M →ₗ[S] M')
    (hf : ∀ (r : Rᵐᵒᵖ) m, f (r • m) = r • f m) (g : N →ₗ[R] N') :
    (mapLeft (k := k) f hf).comp (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) g) =
      (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) g).comp (mapLeft (k := k) f hf)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  intro m n
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.restrictEquiv_mapRight
statement:
lemma restrictEquiv_mapRight [SMulCommClass S Rᵐᵒᵖ M] (g : N →ₗ[R] N')
    (x : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N)) :
    restrictEquiv (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) g x) =
      mapRight (k := k) (S := k) g (restrictEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | ht m n => rfl
  | ha x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.free_mapRight_exact
statement:
lemma free_mapRight_exact (ι : Type) [Fintype ι]
    (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (g : N' →ₗ[R] N'') (he : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) (M := ι → R) f)
      (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) (M := ι → R) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hz : ∀ i, g (freeEquiv ι x i) = 0 := by
      intro i
      rw [← freeEquiv_mapRight, hx, map_zero]
      rfl
    choose y hy using fun i => (he (freeEquiv ι x i)).mp (hz i)
    refine ⟨(freeEquiv (k := k) (R := R) ι).symm y, ?_⟩
    apply (freeEquiv (k := k) (R := R) ι).injective
    ext i
    rw [freeEquiv_mapRight, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hy i
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    apply (freeEquiv (k := k) (R := R) ι).injective
    ext i
    rw [freeEquiv_mapRight, freeEquiv_mapRight, map_zero]
    exact (he _).mpr ⟨_,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.field_mapRight_exact
statement:
lemma field_mapRight_exact [Module.Finite Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
    (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (g : N' →ₗ[R] N'') (he : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) (M := M) f)
      (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) (M := M) g)
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := Rᵐᵒᵖ) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map LinearMap.id c.surjective
  let e := oppositeFree (R := R) (Fin c.rank)
  let u := e.toLinearMap.comp i
  let p := c.map.comp e.symm.toLinearMap
  have hp : p.comp u = LinearMap.id := by
    ext x
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hi x
  let U {L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [Module k L] [Module R L] :=
    mapLeft (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (N := L) (u.restrictScalars k) u.map_smul
  let P {L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [Module k L] [Module R L] :=
    mapLeft (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (N := L) (p.restrictScalars k) p.map_smul
  have hPU {L : Type} [AddCommGroup L] [Module k L] [Module R L] :
      (P (L := L)).comp (U (L := L)) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply hom_ext
    intro m n
    change mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) (p (u m)) n = mk m n
    exact congrArg (fun z => mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := k) z n) (LinearMap.congr_fun hp m)
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hUx : mapRight (k := k) (S := k) g (U x) = 0 := by
      dsimp only [U]
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLeft_mapRight (u.restrictScalars k) u.map_smul g]
      change U (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) g x) = 0
      rw [hx,map_zero]
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (free_mapRight_exact (k := k) (Fin c.rank) f g he (U x)).mp hUx
    refine ⟨P y, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [P]
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapLeft_mapRight (p.restrictScalars k) p.map_smul f]
    change P (mapRight (k := k) (S := k) f y) = x
    rw [hy]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun hPU x
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapRight_comp, he.linearMap_comp_eq_zero, mapRight_zero]
    rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mapRight_exact
statement:
lemma mapRight_exact [SMulCommClass S Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
    [Module.Finite Rᵐᵒᵖ M] [Module.Projective Rᵐᵒᵖ M]
    (f : N →ₗ[R] N') (g : N' →ₗ[R] N'') (he : Function.Exact f g) :
    Function.Exact (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) f)
      (mapRight (k := k) (S := S) (M := M) g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hz : mapRight (k := k) (S := k) (M := M) g (restrictEquiv x) = 0 := by
      rw [← restrictEquiv_mapRight, hx,map_zero]
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (field_mapRight_exact (k := k) f g he (restrictEquiv x)).mp hz
    refine ⟨restrictEquiv.symm y, ?_⟩
    apply restrictEquiv.injective
    rw [restrictEquiv_mapRight, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hy]
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← mapRight_comp, he.linearMap_comp_eq_zero, mapRight_zero]
    rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.rightFreeEval_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightFreeEval_mk (m : M) (x : ι → R) (i : ι) :
    rightFreeEval ι (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) m x) i = MulOpposite.op (x i) • m
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.rightFreeEval_inv
statement: lemma rightFreeEval_inv (x : ι → M) : rightFreeEval (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) ι (rightFreeInv (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) ι x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  simp only [rightFreeInv, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, rightFreeEval_mk, Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp
  · intro b _ h
    simp [Ne.symm h]
  · simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.rightFreeInv_eval
statement:
lemma rightFreeInv_eval (x : T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := ι → R)) :
    rightFreeInv ι (rightFreeEval ι x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | ht m n =>
    simp only [rightFreeInv, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.proj_apply, rightFreeEval_mk, LinearMap.flip_apply]
    simp_rw [balance]
    have hn : (∑ i, n i • Pi.single i (1:R)) = n := by
      ext j
      simp [Pi.single_apply, apply_ite]
    rw [← map_sum, hn]
  | ha x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.map_projective
statement:
lemma map_projective [Module.Projective S M] [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N] :
    Module.Projective S (T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.OuterTensor.tmul_smul_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tmul_smul_tmul (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (N : ModuleCat.{u} B)
    (a : A) (b : B) (x : M) (y : N) :
    (a ⊗ₜ[k] b) • (show Obj k A B M N from x ⊗ₜ[k] y) = (a • x) ⊗ₜ[k] (b • y)
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.OuterTensor.map_action
statement:
lemma map_action {M M' : ModuleCat.{u} A} {N N' : ModuleCat.{u} B}
    (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (r : A ⊗[k] B) :
    (TensorProduct.map (f.hom.restrictScalars k) (g.hom.restrictScalars k)).comp
      (action k A B M N r) =
    (action k A B M' N' r).comp
      (TensorProduct.map (f.hom.restrictScalars k) (g.hom.restrictScalars k))
proof:
:= by
  induction r using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul a b =>
    apply TensorProduct.ext'
    intro x y
    change (f.hom (a • x)) ⊗ₜ[k] (g.hom (b • y)) = (a • f.hom x) ⊗ₜ[k] (b • g.hom y)
    rw [map_smul, map_smul]
  | add r s hr hs =>
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_add, LinearMap.add_comp, hr, hs]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.OuterTensor.map_tmul
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.OuterTensor.map_comp
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.restrictScalars_injective k
  change (TensorProduct.map (f'.hom.restrictScalars k) (g'.hom.restrictScalars k)).comp
    (TensorProduct.map (f.hom.restrictScalars k) (g.hom.restrictScalars k)) = _
  exact (TensorProduct.map_comp _ _ _ _).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.OuterTensor.map_id
statement:
lemma map_id (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (N : ModuleCat.{u} B) :
    map (k := k) (𝟙 M) (𝟙 N) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.restrictScalars_injective k
  change TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[k] M) (LinearMap.id : N →ₗ[k] N) = LinearMap.id
  exact TensorProduct.map_id

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.tensorTrace_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma tensorTrace_tmul (r : R) (s : S) :
    tensorTrace t u (r ⊗ₜ[k] s) = t.linear r * u.linear s
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.tensorTrace_comm
statement:
lemma tensorTrace_comm (a b : R ⊗[k] S) :
    tensorTrace t u (a*b) = tensorTrace t u (b*a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul r s =>
    induction b using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r' s' => simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, tensorTrace_tmul,
        t.comm r r', u.comm s s']
    | add b c hb hc => simp only [mul_add, add_mul, map_add, hb, hc]
  | add a c ha hc => simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, ha, hc]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.SymmetrizingForm.tensorDualEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma tensorDualEquiv_apply (a b : R ⊗[k] S) :
    tensorDualEquiv t u a b = tensorTrace t u (b*a)
proof:
:= by
  induction a using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
  | tmul r s =>
    induction b using TensorProduct.inductionOn with
    | tmul r' s' =>
      dsimp only [tensorDualEquiv, DualBimodule]
      simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, tensorTrace_tmul]
      change u.linear (s'*s) * t.linear (r'*r) = t.linear (r'*r) * u.linear (s'*s)
      exact mul_comm _ _
    | add b c hb hc => simp only [map_add, add_mul, hb, hc]
  | add a c ha hc => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, mul_add, ha, hc]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.leftMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma leftMap_apply {M N : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : Obj M) :
    leftMap f x = f x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.rightMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma rightMap_apply {M N : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)} (f : M ⟶ N) (x : Obj M) :
    rightMap f x = f x
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.tmul_smul
statement:
lemma tmul_smul (M : ModuleCat (Alg k R S)) (r : R) (s : Sᵐᵒᵖ) (x : Obj M) :
    (r ⊗ₜ[k] s) • x = r • s • x
proof:
:= by
  change _ = (r ⊗ₜ[k] (1:Sᵐᵒᵖ)) • ((1:R) ⊗ₜ[k] s) • x
  rw [← mul_smul]
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.freeLeftProjective
statement:
lemma freeLeftProjective (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Projective R (Obj (ModuleCat.of (Alg k R S) (Fin n → Alg k R S)))
proof:
:=
  Module.Projective.of_equiv' (freeLeftEquiv (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) n).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.freeRightProjective
statement:
lemma freeRightProjective (n : ℕ) :
    Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj (ModuleCat.of (Alg k R S) (Fin n → Alg k R S)))
proof:
:=
  Module.Projective.of_equiv' (freeRightEquiv (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) n).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.projective_left
statement:
lemma projective_left (M : ModuleCat (Alg k R S))
    [Module.Finite (Alg k R S) M] [Module.Projective (Alg k R S) M] :
    Module.Projective R (Obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := Alg k R S) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map LinearMap.id c.surjective
  let := freeLeftProjective (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) c.rank
  apply Module.Projective.of_split
    (leftMap (ModuleCat.ofHom i)) (leftMap (ModuleCat.ofHom c.map))
  ext x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hi x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Enveloping.projective_right
statement:
lemma projective_right (M : ModuleCat (Alg k R S))
    [Module.Finite (Alg k R S) M] [Module.Projective (Alg k R S) M] :
    Module.Projective Sᵐᵒᵖ (Obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := Alg k R S) (M := M)
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map LinearMap.id c.surjective
  let := freeRightProjective (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) c.rank
  apply Module.Projective.of_split
    (rightMap (ModuleCat.ofHom i)) (rightMap (ModuleCat.ofHom c.map))
  ext x
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hi x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.upper_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma upper_apply (a : Alg F) : upper F a = a.fst.1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.lower_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma lower_apply (a : Alg F) : lower F a = a.fst.2
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.off_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma off_apply (a : Alg F) : off F a = a.snd
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.off_mul
statement:
lemma off_mul (a b : Alg F) :
    off F (a*b) = lower F a • off F b + MulOpposite.op (upper F b) • off F a
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.idempotent_e₀
statement: lemma idempotent_e₀ : IsIdempotentElem (e₀ F)
proof:
:= by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · apply Prod.ext <;> simp [e₀]
  · simp [e₀]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.idempotent_e₁
statement: lemma idempotent_e₁ : IsIdempotentElem (e₁ F)
proof:
:= by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · apply Prod.ext <;> simp [e₁]
  · simp [e₁]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.e₀_add_e₁
statement: lemma e₀_add_e₁ : e₀ F + e₁ F = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply TrivSqZeroExt.ext
  · apply Prod.ext <;> simp [e₀,e₁]
  · simp [e₀,e₁]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mk_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma mk_zero_left (n : N) :
    mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (0 : M) n = 0
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : N →ₗ[k] T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) => f n)
    (map_zero (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)))

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mk_add_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma mk_add_left (a b : M) (n : N) :
    mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (a+b) n = mk a n + mk b n
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : N →ₗ[k] T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) => f n)
    (map_add (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)) a b)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.BalancedTensor.mk_smul_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma mk_smul_left (s : S) (a : M) (n : N) :
    mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (s • a) n = s • mk a n
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : N →ₗ[k] T (k := k) (R := R) (S := S) (M := M) (N := N) => f n)
    (map_smul (mk (k := k) (R := R) (S := S)) s a)

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.triple_smul_fst
statement:
@[simp] lemma triple_smul_fst (a : Alg F) (x : Triple F L N α) :
    (a • x).1 = upper F a • x.1
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.triple_smul_snd
statement:
@[simp] lemma triple_smul_snd (a : Alg F) (x : Triple F L N α) :
    (a • x).2 = α (BalancedTensor.mk (off F a) x.1) + lower F a • x.2
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.e₀_smul_triple
statement: lemma e₀_smul_triple (x : Triple F L N α) : e₀ F • x = (x.1,0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (1:R) • x.1 = x.1
    exact one_smul R x.1
  · change α (BalancedTensor.mk (0 : Enveloping.Obj F) x.1) + (0:R) • x.2 = 0
    simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.e₁_smul_triple
statement: lemma e₁_smul_triple (x : Triple F L N α) : e₁ F • x = (0,x.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (0:R) • x.1 = 0
    exact zero_smul R x.1
  · change α (BalancedTensor.mk (0 : Enveloping.Obj F) x.1) + (1:R) • x.2 = x.2
    simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.diagonal_smul_triple
statement:
lemma diagonal_smul_triple (r : R) (x : Triple F L N α) :
    (TrivSqZeroExt.inl (r,r) : Alg F) • x = (r • x.1,r • x.2)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · change α (BalancedTensor.mk (0 : Enveloping.Obj F) x.1) + r • x.2 = r • x.2
    simp

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.hom_fst_e₁
statement: lemma hom_fst_e₁ (y : N) : (f (0,y)).1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Prod.fst (f.map_smul (e₁ F) (show Triple F L N α from (0,y)))
  rw [e₁_smul_triple,e₁_smul_triple] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.hom_snd_e₀
statement: lemma hom_snd_e₀ (x : L) : (f (x,0)).2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Prod.snd (f.map_smul (e₀ F) (show Triple F L N α from (x,0)))
  rw [e₀_smul_triple,e₀_smul_triple] at h
  exact h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.hom_pair
statement: lemma hom_pair (x : L) (y : N) : f (x,y) = (homUpper f x,homLower f y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := f.map_add (show Triple F L N α from (x,0)) (show Triple F L N α from (0,y))
  change f (x+0,0+y) = f (x,0)+f (0,y) at h
  rw [add_zero,zero_add] at h
  rw [h]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (f (x,0)).1 + (f (0,y)).1 = (f (x,0)).1
    rw [hom_fst_e₁,add_zero]
  · change (f (x,0)).2 + (f (0,y)).2 = (f (0,y)).2
    rw [hom_snd_e₀,zero_add]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.hom_compatible
statement:
lemma hom_compatible : (homLower f).comp α =
    β.comp (BalancedTensor.mapRight (M := Enveloping.Obj F) (homUpper f))
proof:
:= by
  apply BalancedTensor.hom_ext
  intro m x
  have h := congrArg Prod.snd (f.map_smul (TrivSqZeroExt.inr (show Off F from m))
    (show Triple F L N α from (x,0)))
  change (f (0 • x, α (BalancedTensor.mk m x) + 0 • (0:N))).2 =
    β (BalancedTensor.mk m (f (x,0)).1) + 0 • (f (x,0)).2 at h
  change (f (0,α (BalancedTensor.mk m x))).2 =
    β (BalancedTensor.mk m (f (x,0)).1)
  simpa only [zero_smul,add_zero] using h

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.tripleMap_hom
statement: lemma tripleMap_hom : tripleMap (homUpper f) (homLower f) (hom_compatible f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact (hom_pair f x.1 x.2).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.triple_hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] lemma triple_hom_ext {f g : Triple F L N α →ₗ[Alg F] Triple F L' N' β}
    (h₀ : homUpper f = homUpper g) (h₁ : homLower f = homLower g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change f (x.1,x.2) = g (x.1,x.2)
  rw [hom_pair f x.1 x.2,hom_pair g x.1 x.2,h₀,h₁]

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.cross₀₁_zero
statement: lemma cross₀₁_zero (f : D₀Obj F L ⟶ D₁Obj F L') : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply triple_hom_ext
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
  · have hc := hom_compatible f.hom
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have he := LinearMap.congr_fun hc x
    exact he

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₀Map_exact
statement:
lemma D₀Map_exact {L N P : ModuleCat R} (f : L ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P)
    (he : Function.Exact f g) : Function.Exact (D₀Map F f) (D₀Map F g)
proof:
:= by
  have ht := BalancedTensor.mapRight_exact (k := k) (R := R) (S := R) (M := Enveloping.Obj F) f.hom g.hom he
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h₀ : g x.1 = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hx
    have h₁ : BalancedTensor.mapRight (M := Enveloping.Obj F) g.hom x.2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := (he x.1).mp h₀
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (ht x.2).mp h₁
    exact ⟨(y,z),Prod.ext hy hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact (he _).mpr ⟨y.1,rfl⟩
    · exact (ht _).mpr ⟨y.2,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₁Map_exact
statement:
lemma D₁Map_exact {L N P : ModuleCat R} (f : L ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P)
    (he : Function.Exact f g) : Function.Exact (D₁Map F f) (D₁Map F g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have h₁ : g x.2 = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := (he x.2).mp h₁
    exact ⟨(0,z),Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) hz⟩
  · rintro ⟨y,rfl⟩
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · exact (he _).mpr ⟨y.2,rfl⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₀_exact
statement:
lemma D₀_exact (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat R)) (hS : S.Exact) :
    (S.map (D₀ F)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact] at hS ⊢
  exact D₀Map_exact F S.f S.g hS

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₁_exact
statement:
lemma D₁_exact (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat R)) (hS : S.Exact) :
    (S.map (D₁ F)).Exact
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShortComplex.ShortExact.moduleCat_exact_iff_function_exact] at hS ⊢
  exact D₁Map_exact F S.f S.g hS

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.freeTensorEval_mk
statement:
lemma freeTensorEval_mk (m : Enveloping.Obj F) (x : freeObj (R := R) ι) (i : ι) :
    freeTensorEval F ι (BalancedTensor.mk m x) i = MulOpposite.op (x i) • m
proof: := rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.freeTensorEval_inv
statement: lemma freeTensorEval_inv (x : ι → Enveloping.Obj F) : freeTensorEval F ι (freeTensorInv F ι x) = x
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [freeTensorEval,freeTensorInv,LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (BalancedTensor.mapRight_split (k := k) (S := R)
    (M := Enveloping.Obj F) (freeUnderlying (R := R) ι).symm.toLinearMap
      (freeUnderlying (R := R) ι).toLinearMap (by rfl))
      (BalancedTensor.rightFreeInv (k := k) (R := R) (S := R) (M := Enveloping.Obj F) ι x)
  dsimp only [LinearMap.comp_apply,LinearMap.id_apply] at h
  rw [h]
  exact BalancedTensor.rightFreeEval_inv ι x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.freeTensorInv_eval
statement:
lemma freeTensorInv_eval (x : Enveloping.evalType (freeObj (R := R) ι) F) :

proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [freeTensorEval,freeTensorInv,LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [BalancedTensor.rightFreeInv_eval]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (BalancedTensor.mapRight_split _ _ (by rfl)) x

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₀_projective
statement:
lemma D₀_projective [Module.Finite R L] [Module.Projective R L] :
    Module.Projective (Alg F) (D₀Obj F L)
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := R) (M := L)
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map LinearMap.id c.surjective
  let : Module.Projective (Alg F) (D₀Obj F (freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank))) :=
    D₀Free_projective F (Fin c.rank)
  let inclusion : L ⟶ freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank) := ModuleCat.ofHom i
  let projection : freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank) ⟶ L := ModuleCat.ofHom c.map
  refine Module.Projective.of_split (D₀Map F inclusion).hom (D₀Map F projection).hom ?_
  have h : inclusion ≫ projection = 𝟙 L := ModuleCat.hom_ext hi
  have he := (D₀ F).map_comp inclusion projection
  rw [h,(D₀ F).map_id] at he
  exact (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom he).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₁_projective
statement:
lemma D₁_projective [Module.Finite R L] [Module.Projective R L] :
    Module.Projective (Alg F) (D₁Obj F L)
proof:
:= by
  let c := finiteFreeCover (R := R) (M := L)
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property c.map LinearMap.id c.surjective
  let : Module.Projective (Alg F) (D₁Obj F (freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank))) :=
    D₁Free_projective F (Fin c.rank)
  let inclusion : L ⟶ freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank) := ModuleCat.ofHom i
  let projection : freeObj (R := R) (Fin c.rank) ⟶ L := ModuleCat.ofHom c.map
  refine Module.Projective.of_split (D₁Map F inclusion).hom (D₁Map F projection).hom ?_
  have h : inclusion ≫ projection = 𝟙 L := ModuleCat.hom_ext hi
  have he := (D₁ F).map_comp inclusion projection
  rw [h,(D₁ F).map_id] at he
  exact (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom he).symm

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.diagonal₀_pre
statement:
lemma diagonal₀_pre {L M N : ModuleCat.{0} R} (d : L ⟶ M)
    (f : D₀Obj F M ⟶ D₀Obj F N) :
    diagonal₀ (D₀Map F d ≫ f) = d ≫ diagonal₀ f
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (f.hom (d x, BalancedTensor.mapRight d.hom 0)).1 = _
  rw [map_zero]
  rfl

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₀_boundaries
statement:
lemma D₀_boundaries [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N]
    (j : ℤ) (f : D₀Obj F (P.X j) ⟶ D₀Obj F N)
    (hf : D₀Map F (P.d (j+1) j) ≫ f = 0) :
    ∃ g : D₀Obj F (P.X (j-1)) ⟶ D₀Obj F N, D₀Map F (P.d j (j-1)) ≫ g = f
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (diagonal₀ (F := F)) hf
  rw [diagonal₀_pre,map_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hP.projective_boundaries j (diagonal₀ f).hom (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp h)
  refine ⟨diagonal₀.symm (ModuleCat.ofHom g),?_⟩
  apply diagonal₀.injective
  rw [diagonal₀_pre,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact ModuleCat.hom_ext hg

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.D₁_boundaries
statement:
lemma D₁_boundaries [Module.Finite R N] [Module.Projective R N]

    (hf : D₁Map F (P.d (j+1) j) ≫ f = 0) :
    ∃ g : D₁Obj F (P.X (j-1)) ⟶ D₁Obj F N, D₁Map F (P.d j (j-1)) ≫ g = f
proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hP.projective_boundaries j (diagonal₁ f).hom (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp h)
  refine ⟨diagonal₁.symm (ModuleCat.ofHom g),?_⟩

name: OAI.Tachikawa.Triangular.cross_boundaries
statement:
lemma cross_boundaries [Module.Finite R (tensorObj F N)] [Module.Projective R (tensorObj F N)]
    (j : ℤ) (f : D₁Obj F (P.X j) ⟶ D₀Obj F N)
    (hf : D₁Map F (P.d (j+1) j) ≫ f = 0) :
    ∃ g : D₁Obj F (P.X (j-1)) ⟶ D₀Obj F N, D₁Map F (P.d j (j-1)) ≫ g = f
proof:
:= by

  rw [cross₁₀_pre,map_zero] at h
  obtain ⟨g,hg⟩ := hP.projective_boundaries j (cross₁₀ f).hom (ModuleCat.hom_ext_iff.mp h)
  refine ⟨cross₁₀.symm (ModuleCat.ofHom g),?_⟩
